void ApplyHistoryStep::set_ongoing_navigation_to_traversal(CanonicalNavigable& navigable, CanonicalSessionHistoryEntry const& target_entry)
{
    // AD-HOC: As in browsers, a push or replace leaves the ongoing navigation alone: a newer navigation goes on, and
    //         commits after it. So does a same-document traversal, where the spec sets "traversal" and so drops the
    //         navigation. See https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/12581.
    // NB: An update for a navigable's creation or destruction changes the document of no navigable but one its creation
    //     already marked as traversing.
    if (m_navigation_type != Web::Bindings::NavigationType::Traverse && m_navigation_type != Web::Bindings::NavigationType::Reload)
        return;
    if (navigable.active_document_is(target_entry) && !target_entry.document_state->reload_pending)
        return;

    // AD-HOC: A navigation admitted after a reload goes on, as the newest, and the reload leaves the navigable to it,
    //         its target entry being current already. A traversal that crosses documents has made current an entry
    //         whose document only it activates, and aborts the navigation, as specified. The specification's traversal
    //         queue does not model Ladybird's independently admitted UI-process navigations.
    //         See https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/12581.
    if (m_navigation_type == Web::Bindings::NavigationType::Reload) {
        auto ongoing_navigation_id = navigable.ongoing_navigation_id();
        auto ongoing_navigation = ongoing_navigation_id.has_value() ? navigable.navigation_with_id(*ongoing_navigation_id) : nullptr;
        if (ongoing_navigation && ongoing_navigation->sequence_number > m_operation_sequence_number)
            return;
    }

    // The marker cancels navigation-start requests that arrive while this operation is on the traversal queue, matching
    // navigate()'s "if navigable's ongoing navigation is 'traversal', then return".
    navigable.set_ongoing_navigation_to_traversal(m_operation_id);
}

ChangingNavigable* ApplyHistoryStep::changing_navigable(Web::HTML::CrossProcessId navigable_id) const
{
    auto it = m_changing_navigables.find_if([&](auto const& changing_navigable) { return changing_navigable->id == navigable_id; });
    return it == m_changing_navigables.end() ? nullptr : it->ptr();
}

}

// One of a run's changingNavigables: its history step job, and the changing navigable continuation the job enqueues.
// NB: The process running the job retains the rest of the continuation's state. What waits on the job looks the record
//     up again by its operation and navigable, which name it for as long as its run lasts.
struct WEBVIEW_API ChangingNavigable {
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    ChangingNavigable(CanonicalNavigable& navigable, NonnullRefPtr<CanonicalSessionHistoryEntry> target_entry)
        : id(navigable.id())
        , target_entry(move(target_entry))
        , m_navigable(navigable.make_weak_ptr())
    {
    }

    CanonicalNavigable& navigable() const
    {
        VERIFY(m_navigable);
        return *m_navigable;
    }

    bool has_pending_job() const { return !job_ended; }

    Web::HTML::CrossProcessId id;

    // The process running the job retains this exact entry instead of resolving a target step against its local session
    // history projection. The run looks it up again before it is activated, and follows a sync navigation that changed
    // it (whatwg/html#12961).
    NonnullRefPtr<CanonicalSessionHistoryEntry> target_entry;
    // Whether targetEntry's document state's reload pending was true when the job claimed it, and whether that reload
    // bypasses the HTTP cache. Populating the document sets both to false.
    bool target_entry_reload_pending { false };
    bool target_entry_reload_bypasses_cache { false };
    // The target entry as the job claimed it, for the processes the job runs in.
    Web::HTML::SessionHistoryEntryDescriptor target_entry_descriptor() const;

    // Nothing more comes from the process running the job, and it counts towards completedChangeJobs.
    bool job_ended { false };
    // The run's part of the continuation, which the process running the job applies with the rest.
    struct Continuation {
        Web::HTML::HistoryObjectLengthAndIndex history_object_length_and_index;
        Vector<Web::HTML::SessionHistoryEntryDescriptor> entries_for_navigation_api;
    };
    Optional<Continuation> continuation;

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsing-the-web.html#changing-navigable-continuation-state
    // NB: Its target entry and navigable are the record's. The process running the job reports update-only.
    RefPtr<CanonicalDocument> displayed_document;
    bool update_only { false };

    // Steps 2 and 3 of afterDocumentPopulated, which the continuation applies after potential unloads.
    bool clears_classic_history_api_state { false };
    bool clears_navigable_target_name { false };

    // targetEntry's document, as the job's process has it.
    RefPtr<CanonicalDocument> target_document(WebContentPage const& job_page) const;

    // Step 8 of the job, populating targetEntry's document, as its parts run across processes.
    struct AwaitingPopulation { };
    struct CreatingNavigationParams {
        NonnullRefPtr<NavigationLoader> loader;
    };
    struct AcquiringResponseBody {
        NonnullRefPtr<NavigationLoader> loader;
    };
    struct Populating {
        NonnullRefPtr<NavigationLoader> loader;
    };
    Variant<Empty, AwaitingPopulation, CreatingNavigationParams, AcquiringResponseBody, Populating> population;
    RefPtr<NavigationLoader> population_loader() const;
    RefPtr<CanonicalDocument> populated_document;

private:
    WeakPtr<CanonicalNavigable> m_navigable;
};

// The apply-history-step state a traversable navigable shares across runs.
struct TraversableApplyHistoryStepState {
    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/document-sequences.html#tn-running-nested-apply-history-step
    bool running_nested_apply_history_step { false };

    // AD-HOC: Concurrent runs share the current-step commit: a run commits its target step only if no newer run (a
    //         synchronous navigation that jumped the queue while it was paused) has moved the current step first, so
    //         the current step cannot move backwards past a newer run's commit. A newer run whose commit moves nothing
    //         (a synchronous replace re-commits the step it started from) leaves the paused run's own commit intact.
    //         See https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/12576.
    u64 generation_counter { 0 };
    u64 committed_generation { 0 };
};

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsing-the-web.html#apply-the-history-step
//
// One run of the apply-the-history-step algorithm, coordinated from the UI process. The algorithm's traversal-wide
// variables live on this object; the traversable runs the per-navigable jobs in the processes hosting the documents,
// and their completions resume the algorithm at the phase that dispatched them. Each job reports to the run exactly
// once, including after its process is lost.
class WEBVIEW_API ApplyHistoryStep {
    AK_MAKE_NONCOPYABLE(ApplyHistoryStep);
    AK_MAKE_NONMOVABLE(ApplyHistoryStep);

public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    ApplyHistoryStep(
        CanonicalTraversable& traversable,
        HistoryOperation& operation,
        Web::HTML::CrossProcessId operation_id,
        u64 operation_sequence_number,
        i32 step,
        bool check_for_cancelation,
        Optional<Web::HTML::CrossProcessId> initiator_to_check,
        Optional<Web::HTML::NavigationSourceSnapshot> source_snapshot_params,
        Web::HTML::UserNavigationInvolvement user_involvement,
        Optional<Web::Bindings::NavigationType> navigation_type);
    ~ApplyHistoryStep();

    void apply_the_history_step();
    // The run's operation finished. Its pending jobs end, and it calls none of its jobs from then on.
    void abandon();

    // The step this run committed as the current session history step, if it was the run that committed.
    Optional<i32> committed_step() const { return m_committed_step; }

    HistoryOperation& operation() const { return m_operation; }
    Web::HTML::UserNavigationInvolvement user_involvement() const { return m_user_involvement; }
    Optional<Web::Bindings::NavigationType> navigation_type() const { return m_navigation_type; }
    Optional<Web::HTML::NavigationSourceSnapshot> const& source_snapshot_params() const { return m_source_snapshot_params; }

    Vector<NonnullOwnPtr<ChangingNavigable>> const& changing_navigables() const { return m_changing_navigables; }
    ChangingNavigable* changing_navigable(Web::HTML::CrossProcessId) const;

    void changing_navigable_job_completed(ChangingNavigable&, Web::HTML::ChangingNavigableHistoryStepJobDisposition);
    void nonchanging_navigable_updated();
    // The run goes on once its continuations are processed again.
    void end_changing_navigable_job(ChangingNavigable&);
    void process_changing_navigable_continuations();

private:
    void get_changing_and_nonchanging_navigables();
    void run_changing_navigable_jobs();
    void update_nonchanging_navigables();
    void set_current_session_history_step();
    void append_the_claimed_target_entry_again(CanonicalNavigable&, CanonicalSessionHistoryEntry& claimed_target_entry);

    void set_ongoing_navigation_to_traversal(CanonicalNavigable&, CanonicalSessionHistoryEntry const&);
    void return_result(Web::HTML::HistoryStepResult);

    CanonicalTraversable& m_traversable;
    TraversableSessionHistory& m_session_history;
    SessionHistoryTraversalQueue& m_session_history_traversal_queue;
    TraversableApplyHistoryStepState& m_traversable_state;

    HistoryOperation& m_operation;
    Web::HTML::CrossProcessId const m_operation_id;
    u64 const m_operation_sequence_number;

    // The algorithm's arguments.
    // NB: A run that appends its claimed target entry again moves to that entry's step.
    i32 m_step;
    // NB: The HTML Standard spells this algorithm argument "checkForCancelation".
    bool const m_check_for_cancelation;
    Optional<Web::HTML::CrossProcessId> const m_initiator_to_check;
    Optional<Web::HTML::NavigationSourceSnapshot> const m_source_snapshot_params;
    Web::HTML::UserNavigationInvolvement const m_user_involvement;
    Optional<Web::Bindings::NavigationType> const m_navigation_type;

    // The algorithm's variables.
    i32 m_target_step { 0 };
    Vector<NonnullOwnPtr<ChangingNavigable>> m_changing_navigables;
    Vector<Web::HTML::CrossProcessId> m_nonchanging_navigables_that_still_need_updates;
    size_t m_completed_change_jobs { 0 };
    Vector<ChangingNavigable*> m_changing_navigable_continuations;
    // AD-HOC: One continuation is applied at a time, so synchronous navigations queued by its application are in the
    //         traversal queue before the next continuation checks for them.
    ChangingNavigable* m_continuation_being_applied { nullptr };
    HashTable<Web::HTML::CrossProcessId> m_navigables_that_must_wait_before_handling_sync_navigation;
    size_t m_completed_nonchanging_jobs { 0 };

    // AD-HOC: The generation that orders the runs' commits of the current step (whatwg/html#12576).
    u64 m_generation;
    // How far the run lets synchronous navigation steps jump.
    Optional<u64> m_synchronous_navigation_steps_to_jump_through;

    // The synchronous navigation steps this run is paused on ("running nested apply history step" is true).
    RefPtr<Core::Promise<Empty>> m_running_synchronous_navigation_steps;

    Optional<i32> m_committed_step;
};

}

#include <LibWebView/AudioDaemonSocket.h>

#if defined(HAVE_PULSEAUDIO)
#    include <AK/ScopeGuard.h>
#    include <AK/Time.h>
#    include <pulse/pulseaudio.h>
#    include <string.h>
#endif

namespace WebView {

Optional<ByteString> unix_path_from_server_string(StringView server)
{
    server = server.trim_whitespace();

    // A machine identifier may be carried in front of the address.
    if (server.starts_with('{')) {
        auto closing_brace = server.find('}');
        if (!closing_brace.has_value())
            return {};
        server = server.substring_view(closing_brace.value() + 1);
    }

    if (server.starts_with("unix:"sv))
        server = server.substring_view("unix:"sv.length());

    if (!server.starts_with('/'))
        return {};

    return ByteString { server };
}

#if defined(HAVE_PULSEAUDIO)

ErrorOr<ByteString> audio_daemon_socket_path()
{
    auto* main_loop = pa_mainloop_new();
    if (!main_loop)
        return Error::from_string_literal("Unable to create a PulseAudio main loop");
    ScopeGuard free_main_loop = [&] { pa_mainloop_free(main_loop); };

    auto* context = pa_context_new(pa_mainloop_get_api(main_loop), "Ladybird");
    if (!context)
        return Error::from_string_literal("Unable to create a PulseAudio context");
    ScopeGuard free_context = [&] {
        pa_context_disconnect(context);
        pa_context_unref(context);
    };

    // Only the attempt that succeeds says which of the library's candidates is the daemon, so this runs the
    // connection to its end.
    if (pa_context_connect(context, nullptr, PA_CONTEXT_NOFLAGS, nullptr) < 0) {
        warnln("Unable to look for the audio daemon: {}", pa_strerror(pa_context_errno(context)));
        return Error::from_string_literal("Unable to look for the audio daemon");
    }

    auto deadline = MonotonicTime::now() + AK::Duration::from_seconds(4);
    for (;;) {
        switch (pa_context_get_state(context)) {
        case PA_CONTEXT_READY: {
            auto const* server = pa_context_get_server(context);
            if (!server)
                return Error::from_string_literal("The audio daemon did not say where it was reached");
            auto path = unix_path_from_server_string({ server, strlen(server) });
            if (!path.has_value())
                return Error::from_string_literal("The audio daemon is not reachable over a UNIX socket");
            return path.release_value();
        }
        case PA_CONTEXT_FAILED:
        case PA_CONTEXT_TERMINATED:
            warnln("The audio daemon could not be reached: {}", pa_strerror(pa_context_errno(context)));
            return Error::from_string_literal("The audio daemon could not be reached");
        default:
            break;
        }

        auto remaining = (deadline - MonotonicTime::now()).to_microseconds();
        if (remaining <= 0)
            return Error::from_string_literal("The audio daemon did not answer in time");
        if (pa_mainloop_prepare(main_loop, static_cast<int>(remaining)) < 0 || pa_mainloop_poll(main_loop) < 0 || pa_mainloop_dispatch(main_loop) < 0)
            return Error::from_string_literal("The PulseAudio main loop failed");
    }
}

#else

ErrorOr<ByteString> audio_daemon_socket_path()
{
    return Error::from_string_literal("No audio daemon is known on this platform");
}

#endif

}

/*

#include <LibWebView/AudioServerActivity.h>
#include <LibWebView/AudioServerControlClient.h>

namespace WebView {

AudioServerActivity::AudioServerActivity(OnAudibilityChange on_audibility_change, OnCaptureChange on_capture_change)
    : m_on_audibility_change(move(on_audibility_change))
    , m_on_capture_change(move(on_capture_change))
{
}

AudioServerActivity::~AudioServerActivity()
{
    stop_watching();
}

void AudioServerActivity::watch(AudioServerControlClient& controller, AudibilityFilter audibility_filter, CaptureFilter capture_filter)
{
    stop_watching();
    forget_everything();
    m_controller = controller.make_weak_ptr<AudioServerControlClient>();
    controller.on_playback_group_audibility_changed = [this, filter = move(audibility_filter)](u64 tab_id, Audio::PlaybackGroupId group, Audio::Audibility audibility) {
        if (filter(tab_id, group, audibility))
            set_audibility(group, audibility);
    };
    controller.on_capture_activity_changed = [this, filter = move(capture_filter)](u64 tab_id, Audio::PlaybackGroupId group, bool capturing) {
        if (filter(tab_id))
            set_capturing(group, capturing);
    };
    controller.on_death = [this] {
        forget_everything();
    };
}

void AudioServerActivity::forget_audibility(Audio::PlaybackGroupId group)
{
    set_audibility(group, Audio::Audibility::Inaudible);
}

void AudioServerActivity::stop_watching()
{
    // A replaced AudioServer's death can be noticed after its replacement has begun reporting.
    if (auto controller = m_controller.strong_ref()) {
        controller->on_playback_group_audibility_changed = nullptr;
        controller->on_capture_activity_changed = nullptr;
        controller->on_death = nullptr;
    }
    m_controller.clear();
}

void AudioServerActivity::set_audibility(Audio::PlaybackGroupId group, Audio::Audibility audibility)
{
    switch (audibility) {
    case Audio::Audibility::Audible:
        if (m_audible_groups.set(group) != HashSetResult::InsertedNewEntry)
            return;
        break;
    case Audio::Audibility::Inaudible:
        if (!m_audible_groups.remove(group))
            return;
        break;
    }
    m_on_audibility_change(group, audibility);
}

void AudioServerActivity::set_capturing(Audio::PlaybackGroupId group, bool capturing)
{
    auto changed = capturing ? m_capturing_groups.set(group) == HashSetResult::InsertedNewEntry : m_capturing_groups.remove(group);
    if (changed)
        m_on_capture_change();
}

void AudioServerActivity::forget_everything()
{
    for (auto group : exchange(m_audible_groups, {}))
        m_on_audibility_change(group, Audio::Audibility::Inaudible);
    if (!exchange(m_capturing_groups, {}).is_empty())
        m_on_capture_change();
}

}

/*

#pragma once

#include <AK/Function.h>
#include <AK/HashTable.h>
#include <AK/WeakPtr.h>
#include <LibAudio/Audibility.h>
#include <LibAudio/PlaybackGroupId.h>

namespace WebView {

// Which groups a process's AudioServer has recently heard, and which hold capture streams. Only the watched AudioServer
// is heard: what it reported is forgotten once it dies or another is watched instead, and one that has been replaced is
// heard from no more.
class WEBVIEW_API AudioServerActivity {
public:
    using OnAudibilityChange = Function<void(Audio::PlaybackGroupId, Audio::Audibility)>;
    using OnCaptureChange = Function<void()>;
    // Whether to take the AudioServer's report.
    using AudibilityFilter = Function<bool(u64 tab_id, Audio::PlaybackGroupId, Audio::Audibility)>;
    using CaptureFilter = Function<bool(u64 tab_id)>;

    AudioServerActivity(OnAudibilityChange, OnCaptureChange);
    ~AudioServerActivity();

    void watch(AudioServerControlClient&, AudibilityFilter, CaptureFilter);
    void forget_audibility(Audio::PlaybackGroupId);

    // The renderer labels its capture streams, so these name the pages it says it captures for.
    HashTable<Audio::PlaybackGroupId> const& capturing_groups() const { return m_capturing_groups; }
    void set_capturing_for_testing(Audio::PlaybackGroupId group, bool capturing) { set_capturing(group, capturing); }

private:
    void stop_watching();
    void set_audibility(Audio::PlaybackGroupId, Audio::Audibility);
    void set_capturing(Audio::PlaybackGroupId, bool);
    void forget_everything();

    OnAudibilityChange m_on_audibility_change;
    OnCaptureChange m_on_capture_change;
    WeakPtr<AudioServerControlClient> m_controller;
    HashTable<Audio::PlaybackGroupId> m_audible_groups;
    HashTable<Audio::PlaybackGroupId> m_capturing_groups;
};

#include <LibWebView/AudioServerControlClient.h>

namespace WebView {

AudioServerControlClient::AudioServerControlClient(NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport> transport)
    : IPC::ConnectionToServer<AudioServerControlClientEndpoint, AudioServerControlEndpoint>(*this, move(transport))
{
}

AudioServerControlClient::~AudioServerControlClient() = default;

void AudioServerControlClient::die()
{
    // The holder launches a new AudioServer when it next connects a client; the clients of this one hear about it from
    // their own connections.
    if (on_death)
        on_death();
}

void AudioServerControlClient::capture_requested(u64 tab_id, u64 request_id, ByteString device_id, Audio::PlaybackGroupId group)
{
    if (on_capture_requested)
        on_capture_requested(tab_id, request_id, device_id, group);
}

void AudioServerControlClient::playback_group_audibility_changed(u64 tab_id, Audio::PlaybackGroupId group, Audio::Audibility audibility)
{
    // Reports queued before the connection closed still arrive, from an AudioServer that is gone.
    if (!is_open())
        return;
    if (on_playback_group_audibility_changed)
        on_playback_group_audibility_changed(tab_id, group, audibility);
}

void AudioServerControlClient::capture_activity_changed(u64 tab_id, Audio::PlaybackGroupId group, bool capturing)
{
    if (!is_open())
        return;
    if (on_capture_activity_changed)
        on_capture_activity_changed(tab_id, group, capturing);
}

}

// The control plane of a renderer's AudioServer, spoken only by the Browser, which launched it.
class WEBVIEW_API AudioServerControlClient final
    : public IPC::ConnectionToServer<AudioServerControlClientEndpoint, AudioServerControlEndpoint>
    , public AudioServerControlClientEndpoint {
    C_OBJECT_ABSTRACT(AudioServerControlClient);

public:
    explicit AudioServerControlClient(NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport>);
    virtual ~AudioServerControlClient() override;

    // A client of the tab asks to capture from the device for a page; the holder answers with capture_decided.
    Function<void(u64 tab_id, u64 request_id, ByteString const& device_id, Audio::PlaybackGroupId)> on_capture_requested;
    Function<void(u64 tab_id, Audio::PlaybackGroupId, Audio::Audibility)> on_playback_group_audibility_changed;
    Function<void(u64 tab_id, Audio::PlaybackGroupId, bool capturing)> on_capture_activity_changed;
    // Whatever the AudioServer heard goes with it.
    Function<void()> on_death;

private:
    virtual void die() override;
    virtual void capture_requested(u64 tab_id, u64 request_id, ByteString device_id, Audio::PlaybackGroupId group) override;
    virtual void playback_group_audibility_changed(u64 tab_id, Audio::PlaybackGroupId group, Audio::Audibility audibility) override;
    virtual void capture_activity_changed(u64 tab_id, Audio::PlaybackGroupId group, bool capturing) override;
};

Autocomplete::Autocomplete(AutocompleteHost& host, IsPrivate is_private)

    , m_is_private(is_private)
{
    m_service_client_id = m_host.autocomplete_service().register_client([this](auto query_id, auto entries) {
        local_query_complete(query_id, move(entries));
    });
}

Autocomplete::~Autocomplete()
{
    cancel_pending_query();
    m_host.autocomplete_service().unregister_client(m_service_client_id);
}

void Autocomplete::cancel_pending_query()
{
    stop_remote_query_timers();

    if (auto cancel_remote_query = move(m_cancel_remote_query))
        cancel_remote_query();

    // Buffered callbacks may still arrive after we stop the request, so clear
    // the active query as well and let the stale-response check discard them.
    m_host.autocomplete_service().cancel(m_service_client_id);
    m_query_id = {};
    m_query = {};
    m_trimmed_query = {};
    m_classified_query = {};
    m_local_suggestions.clear();
    m_remote_suggestions.clear();
    m_visited_host_families.clear();
    m_external_url.clear();
    m_external_url_handler_query_complete = true;
    m_external_url_has_handler = false;
}

void Autocomplete::record_engagement(OmniboxEngagement engagement)
{
    if (m_is_private == IsPrivate::Yes)
        return;
    if (engagement.destination_kind == OmniboxDestinationKind::Search && !m_host.autocomplete_settings().search_engine_settings().engine.has_value())
        return;
    m_host.autocomplete_service().record_engagement(move(engagement));
}

size_t autocomplete_preliminary_limit(size_t max_suggestions)
{
    return max(max_suggestions * 4, 32uz);
}

String autocomplete_suggestion_display_text(AutocompleteSuggestion const& suggestion)
{
    if (suggestion.source == AutocompleteSuggestionSource::Search)
        return suggestion.text;
    // NB: Choosing a search engine leaves the query in the field, rather than the address of the settings.
    if (suggestion.source == AutocompleteSuggestionSource::ChooseSearchEngine)
        return suggestion.highlight_input.is_empty() ? suggestion.text : suggestion.highlight_input;

    auto url = classify_user_input(suggestion.text).url;
    if (!url.has_value())
        url = URL::create_with_url_or_path(suggestion.text.to_byte_string());
    if (!url.has_value())
        return suggestion.text;
    return url_for_display(*url);
}

Vector<AutocompleteMatchRange> autocomplete_match_ranges(StringView input, StringView text)
{
    Vector<AutocompleteMatchRange> ranges;

    for (auto token : input.split_view_if([](char ch) { return is_ascii_space(ch); })) {
        if (token.is_empty())
            continue;

        for (size_t offset = 0; offset + token.length() <= text.length();) {
            auto candidate = text.substring_view(offset, token.length());
            if (candidate.equals_ignoring_ascii_case(token)) {
                ranges.append({ offset, token.length() });
                offset += token.length();
            } else {
                ++offset;
            }
        }
    }

    quick_sort(ranges, [](auto const& left, auto const& right) {
        return left.start < right.start;
    });

    Vector<AutocompleteMatchRange> merged_ranges;
    for (auto const& range : ranges) {
        if (merged_ranges.is_empty() || merged_ranges.last().start + merged_ranges.last().length < range.start) {
            merged_ranges.append(range);
            continue;
        }
        auto end = max(merged_ranges.last().start + merged_ranges.last().length, range.start + range.length);
        merged_ranges.last().length = end - merged_ranges.last().start;
    }
    return merged_ranges;
}

bool remote_autocomplete_suggestion_matches_input(StringView suggestion, StringView input)
{
    return suggestion.starts_with(input, CaseSensitivity::CaseInsensitive);
}

Vector<AutocompleteSuggestion> web_ui_autocomplete_suggestions(StringView input)
{
    if (!input.starts_with(about_url_prefix, CaseSensitivity::CaseInsensitive))
        return {};

    Vector<AutocompleteSuggestion> suggestions;
    suggestions.ensure_capacity(WebUI::pages().size());

    for (auto const& page : WebUI::pages()) {
        auto url = MUST(String::formatted("about:{}", page.host));
        if (!url.bytes_as_string_view().starts_with(input, CaseSensitivity::CaseInsensitive))
            continue;

        suggestions.unchecked_append({
            .source = AutocompleteSuggestionSource::WebUI,
            .text = move(url),
            .title = MUST(String::from_utf8(page.title)),
            .subtitle = {},
            .favicon_png = {},
            .highlight_input = {},
            .match_class = AutocompleteMatchClass::URLPrefix,
            .relevance = 1100,
            .is_verbatim = false,
            .can_be_automatically_selected = true,
            .can_be_inline_completed = true,
        });
    }

    return suggestions;
}

[[maybe_unused]] static ByteString log_autocomplete_suggestions(Vector<AutocompleteSuggestion> const& suggestions)
{
    Vector<ByteString> values;
    values.ensure_capacity(suggestions.size());

    for (auto const& suggestion : suggestions)
        values.unchecked_append(suggestion.text.bytes_as_string_view());

    return ByteString::formatted("[{}]", ByteString::join(", "sv, values));
}

static Optional<AutocompleteSuggestion> search_for_query_suggestion(Optional<SearchEngine> const& search_engine, StringView query)
{
    if (query.is_empty())
        return {};

    auto query_string = MUST(String::from_utf8(query));
    auto contains_whitespace = any_of(query, [](auto code_unit) { return is_ascii_space(code_unit); });

    if (!search_engine.has_value()) {
        return AutocompleteSuggestion {
            .source = AutocompleteSuggestionSource::ChooseSearchEngine,
            .text = "about:settings#search"_string,
            .title = "Choose a search engine…"_string,
            .subtitle = MUST(String::formatted("to search for “{}”", query_string)),
            .favicon_png = {},
            .highlight_input = {},
            .relevance = contains_whitespace ? 1000 : 900,
            .is_verbatim = true,
            .can_be_automatically_selected = true,
            .can_be_inline_completed = false,
        };
    }

    return AutocompleteSuggestion {
        .source = AutocompleteSuggestionSource::Search,
        .text = query_string,
        .title = query_string,
        .subtitle = {},
        .favicon_png = {},
        .highlight_input = {},
        .relevance = contains_whitespace ? 1000 : 900,
        .is_verbatim = true,
        .can_be_automatically_selected = true,
        .can_be_inline_completed = false,
    };
}

static AutocompleteSuggestion make_literal_url_suggestion(StringView query)
{
    return {
        .source = AutocompleteSuggestionSource::LiteralURL,
        .text = MUST(String::from_utf8(query)),
        .title = {},
        .subtitle = {},
        .favicon_png = {},
        .highlight_input = {},
        .relevance = 900,
        .is_verbatim = true,
        .can_be_automatically_selected = true,
        .can_be_inline_completed = false,
    };
}

// Whether the text starts with a scheme for the web, rather than one being guessed for it.
static bool starts_with_web_scheme(StringView text)
{
    text = text.trim_whitespace();
    return text.starts_with("http://"sv, CaseSensitivity::CaseInsensitive) || text.starts_with("https://"sv, CaseSensitivity::CaseInsensitive);
}

Optional<AutocompleteSuggestion> make_verbatim_autocomplete_suggestion(StringView query, ClassifiedUserInput const& classified_query, Optional<SearchEngine> const& search_engine)
{
    if (!query.is_empty() && classified_query.classification == UserInputClassification::InternalURL)
        return make_literal_url_suggestion(query);
    return search_for_query_suggestion(search_engine, query);
}

// A search for the text as typed, offered below the address that the text is, which is where Return goes. It is not
// the row for the text as typed, so it never becomes the default, even when it would outrank the address.
static Optional<AutocompleteSuggestion> search_below_address_for_query_suggestion(Optional<SearchEngine> const& search_engine, StringView query)
{
    auto suggestion = search_for_query_suggestion(search_engine, query);
    if (!suggestion.has_value())
        return {};
    suggestion->relevance = 850;
    suggestion->is_verbatim = false;
    suggestion->can_be_automatically_selected = false;
    return suggestion;
}

Optional<AutocompleteSuggestion> make_search_suggestion_for_address_like_text(StringView query, ClassifiedUserInput const& classified_query, Optional<SearchEngine> const& search_engine)
{
    if (!search_engine.has_value() || starts_with_web_scheme(query))
        return {};
    if (classified_query.classification != UserInputClassification::InternalURL || !classified_query.url.has_value())
        return {};
    if (!classified_query.url->scheme().is_one_of("http"sv, "https"sv))
        return {};

    return search_below_address_for_query_suggestion(search_engine, query);
}

// A remote suggestion that is a web address goes to that address rather than to a search for it. Only a public site
// counts: the search engine must not name the user's own machine or network. Text without a scheme, such as
// "google.com", may well be a phrase like "setup.py" instead, so it counts only for a site the user has been to.
static RemoteAutocompleteSuggestion classify_remote_autocomplete_suggestion(String suggestion)
{
    auto as_search = [&] { return RemoteAutocompleteSuggestion { .text = move(suggestion), .url = {}, .host_family_the_user_must_have_visited = {} }; };

    auto classified_suggestion = classify_user_input_ignoring_local_files(suggestion);
    if (classified_suggestion.classification != UserInputClassification::InternalURL || !classified_suggestion.url.has_value())
        return as_search();

    // NB: Rows do not show the scheme, so an http address would look like the https one for the same site. An address
    //     with a user name, such as "https://bank.example@evil.example/", names one site and goes to another.
    auto const& url = *classified_suggestion.url;
    if (url.scheme() != "https"sv || url.port().has_value() || !url.username().is_empty() || !url.password().is_empty())
        return as_search();

    auto const& host = url.host();
    if (!host.has_value() || !host->is_domain() || host->is_loopback_or_localhost())
        return as_search();

    auto const& domain = host->get<String>();
    auto public_suffix = URL::PublicSuffixData::find_matching_public_suffix(domain, URL::PublicSuffixData::IncludeStarRule::No);
    if (!public_suffix.has_value() || *public_suffix == domain)
        return as_search();

    Optional<String> host_family_the_user_must_have_visited;
    if (!starts_with_web_scheme(suggestion)) {
        host_family_the_user_must_have_visited = autocomplete_host_family(url);
        if (!host_family_the_user_must_have_visited.has_value())
            return as_search();
    }

    return { .text = move(suggestion), .url = url.serialize(), .host_family_the_user_must_have_visited = move(host_family_the_user_must_have_visited) };
}

static Vector<RemoteAutocompleteSuggestion> classify_remote_autocomplete_suggestions(Vector<String> suggestions)
{
    static constexpr auto maximum_remote_candidates = 50uz;
    Vector<RemoteAutocompleteSuggestion> classified_suggestions;
    classified_suggestions.ensure_capacity(min(suggestions.size(), maximum_remote_candidates));
    for (size_t index = 0; index < suggestions.size() && index < maximum_remote_candidates; ++index)
        classified_suggestions.unchecked_append(classify_remote_autocomplete_suggestion(move(suggestions[index])));
    return classified_suggestions;
}

static void add_visited_host_families(HashTable<String>& visited_host_families, ReadonlySpan<AutocompleteSuggestion> local_suggestions)
{
    for (auto const& suggestion : local_suggestions) {
        if (suggestion.source == AutocompleteSuggestionSource::Search || suggestion.source == AutocompleteSuggestionSource::ChooseSearchEngine)
            continue;
        auto url = URL::Parser::basic_parse(suggestion.text);
        // NB: A learned row holds the address the user went to as they typed it, such as "google.com" or
        //     "google.com:8443", which the URL parser takes for a scheme and a path. Such text is classified as Return
        //     would take it.
        if (suggestion.source == AutocompleteSuggestionSource::Adaptive && (!url.has_value() || url->has_an_opaque_path()))
            url = classify_user_input(suggestion.text).url;
        if (!url.has_value())
            continue;
        if (auto family = autocomplete_host_family(*url); family.has_value())
            visited_host_families.set(family.release_value());
    }
}

static Vector<AutocompleteSuggestion> make_remote_autocomplete_suggestions(ReadonlySpan<RemoteAutocompleteSuggestion> remote_suggestions, HashTable<String> const& visited_host_families, LocalSuggestionsAreComplete local_suggestions_are_complete)
{
    if (remote_suggestions.is_empty())
        return {};

    Vector<AutocompleteSuggestion> suggestions;
    suggestions.ensure_capacity(remote_suggestions.size());

    for (size_t index = 0; index < remote_suggestions.size(); ++index) {
        auto const& remote_suggestion = remote_suggestions[index];

        auto is_url = false;
        if (remote_suggestion.url.has_value()) {
            auto const& required_host_family = remote_suggestion.host_family_the_user_must_have_visited;
            is_url = !required_host_family.has_value() || visited_host_families.contains(*required_host_family);
            // NB: Shown as a search now, it could turn into a page under the user once the local rows arrive.
            if (!is_url && local_suggestions_are_complete == LocalSuggestionsAreComplete::No)
                continue;
        }

        suggestions.unchecked_append({
            .source = is_url ? AutocompleteSuggestionSource::RemoteURL : AutocompleteSuggestionSource::Search,
            .text = is_url ? *remote_suggestion.url : remote_suggestion.text,
            .title = {},
            .subtitle = {},
            .favicon_png = {},
            .highlight_input = {},
            .relevance = 700 - static_cast<i32>(index),
            .is_verbatim = false,
            .can_be_automatically_selected = false,
            .can_be_inline_completed = false,
        });
    }

    return suggestions;
}

Vector<AutocompleteSuggestion> make_remote_autocomplete_suggestions(Vector<String> remote_suggestions, ReadonlySpan<AutocompleteSuggestion> local_suggestions, LocalSuggestionsAreComplete local_suggestions_are_complete)
{
    HashTable<String> visited_host_families;
    add_visited_host_families(visited_host_families, local_suggestions);
    return make_remote_autocomplete_suggestions(classify_remote_autocomplete_suggestions(move(remote_suggestions)).span(), visited_host_families, local_suggestions_are_complete);
}

void Autocomplete::search_engine_settings_changed()
{
    cancel_pending_query();
}

void Autocomplete::query_autocomplete_engine(AutocompleteQueryID query_id, String query, size_t max_suggestions, Vector<AutocompleteSuggestion> additional_suggestions)
{
    stop_remote_query_timers();
    if (auto cancel_remote_query = move(m_cancel_remote_query))
        cancel_remote_query();
    m_host.autocomplete_service().cancel(m_service_client_id);

    m_max_suggestions = max_suggestions;
    m_query_id = query_id;

    // NB: The remote rows for the previous text stay until the ones for this text arrive. Dropping them now would
    //     shrink the list at every key press, only for it to grow again when the search engine answers. They are never
    //     where Return goes, as no remote row is selected automatically.
    // NB: The sites the user visited only matter for remote rows that carry over to this query.
    if (m_remote_suggestions.is_empty())
        m_visited_host_families.clear();
    m_trimmed_query = MUST(String::from_utf8(query.bytes_as_string_view().trim_whitespace()));
    m_query = move(query);
    m_local_query_complete = false;
    m_remote_query_complete = false;
    m_stopped_waiting_for_remote_query = false;
    m_classified_query = classify_user_input(m_trimmed_query);
    m_external_url = m_classified_query.classification == UserInputClassification::ExternalURL
        ? m_classified_query.url
        : Optional<URL::URL> {};
    m_external_url_handler_query_complete = !m_external_url.has_value();
    m_external_url_has_handler = false;
    m_local_suggestions.clear();

    dbgln_if(WEBVIEW_HISTORY_DEBUG, "[History] Autocomplete query='{}' trimmed='{}'", m_query, m_trimmed_query);

    // Private windows may read normal-profile history but never write through this worker connection.
    m_host.autocomplete_service().query(m_service_client_id, query_id, m_trimmed_query, m_max_suggestions, move(additional_suggestions));

    if (m_external_url.has_value()) {
        auto weak_this = make_weak_ptr();
        m_host.resolve_external_url_handler(*m_external_url, [weak_this, query_id](RefPtr<ExternalURLHandler> handler) mutable {
            if (!weak_this)
                return;
            weak_this->external_url_handler_query_complete(query_id, move(handler));
        });
    }

    if (m_trimmed_query.is_empty()) {
        m_remote_suggestions.clear();
        m_remote_query_complete = true;
        dbgln_if(WEBVIEW_HISTORY_DEBUG, "[History] Skipping remote autocomplete for empty query");
        return;
    }

    if (m_trimmed_query.starts_with_bytes(file_url_prefix)) {
        m_remote_suggestions.clear();
        m_remote_query_complete = true;
        dbgln_if(WEBVIEW_HISTORY_DEBUG, "[History] Skipping remote autocomplete for file URL query '{}'", m_trimmed_query);
        return;
    }

    if (m_trimmed_query.bytes_as_string_view().starts_with(about_url_prefix, CaseSensitivity::CaseInsensitive)) {
        m_remote_suggestions.clear();
        m_remote_query_complete = true;
        dbgln_if(WEBVIEW_HISTORY_DEBUG, "[History] Skipping remote autocomplete for about URL query '{}'", m_trimmed_query);
        return;
    }

    auto const& settings = m_host.autocomplete_settings();
    auto engine = settings.search_engine_settings().engine;
    if (!settings.search_engine_settings().suggestions || !engine.has_value() || !engine->suggestions_url.has_value()) {
        m_remote_suggestions.clear();
        m_remote_query_complete = true;
        dbgln_if(WEBVIEW_HISTORY_DEBUG, "[History] Skipping remote autocomplete because search suggestions are disabled or unavailable");
        return;
    }

    dbgln_if(WEBVIEW_HISTORY_DEBUG, "[History] Scheduling remote autocomplete suggestions from {} for '{}'", engine->name, m_query);

    // The search engine is asked right away, unless it was asked less than this long ago. The first key press after a
    // pause is thus answered as soon as can be, and fast typing asks no more often than this.
    // NB: The request starts from the timer even without a delay, as its answer must not arrive before this returns.
    static constexpr auto minimum_time_between_remote_queries = AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(100);
    auto remote_query_delay = AK::Duration::zero();
    if (m_last_remote_query_time.has_value())
        remote_query_delay = max(AK::Duration::zero(), minimum_time_between_remote_queries - (MonotonicTime::now() - *m_last_remote_query_time));
    m_remote_query_timer = Core::Timer::create_single_shot(remote_query_delay, [this, query_id, engine = engine.release_value(), query = m_query] {
        if (m_query_id != query_id)
            return;
        start_remote_query(query_id, engine, move(query));
    });
    m_remote_query_timer->start();

    // The search engine only has so long after the key press to answer. After that, the rows without its answer are
    // final, as the popup waits for the final rows to change, and a late answer makes new final rows.
    // NB: Of the remote rows for the previous text, the ones that start with the new text stand in for the answer then.
    //     The others would show the new text among suggestions for another.
    static constexpr auto remote_query_deadline_ms = 400;
    m_remote_query_deadline_timer = Core::Timer::create_single_shot(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(remote_query_deadline_ms), [this, query_id] {
        if (m_query_id != query_id || m_remote_query_complete)
            return;
        m_stopped_waiting_for_remote_query = true;
        drop_remote_suggestions_for_other_text();
        if (m_local_query_complete && m_external_url_handler_query_complete)
            deliver_current_result();
    });
    m_remote_query_deadline_timer->start();
}

void Autocomplete::stop_remote_query_timers()
{
    for (auto* timer : { &m_remote_query_timer, &m_remote_query_deadline_timer }) {
        if (!*timer)
            continue;
        (*timer)->stop();
        timer->clear();
    }
}

// Lets go of the remote suggestions for the previous text that the current text no longer starts.
void Autocomplete::drop_remote_suggestions_for_other_text()
{
    m_remote_suggestions.remove_all_matching([&](auto const& suggestion) {
        return !remote_autocomplete_suggestion_matches_input(suggestion.text, m_trimmed_query);
    });
}

void Autocomplete::start_remote_query(AutocompleteQueryID query_id, SearchEngine engine, String query)
{
    dbgln_if(WEBVIEW_HISTORY_DEBUG, "[History] Fetching remote autocomplete suggestions from {} for '{}'", engine.name, query);

    m_last_remote_query_time = MonotonicTime::now();
    if (!engine.suggestions_url_for_query(query).has_value()) {
        m_remote_query_complete = true;
        drop_remote_suggestions_for_other_text();
        deliver_current_result();
        return;
    }

    m_cancel_remote_query = m_host.fetch_remote_suggestions(engine, query, m_is_private, [this, query_id, engine, query](AutocompleteHost::RemoteResponse response) {
        // NB: The request is over. Canceling the query from inside the callbacks below must not cancel it again.
        m_cancel_remote_query = nullptr;

        if (m_query_id != query_id) {
            dbgln_if(WEBVIEW_HISTORY_DEBUG, "[History] Discarding stale remote autocomplete response for '{}' while current query is '{}'", query, m_query);
            return;
        }

        m_remote_query_complete = true;
        // NB: Without an answer, the remote rows for the previous text are all there is. Only the ones that still start
        //     with the text stay then.
        auto deliver_without_an_answer = [&] {
            drop_remote_suggestions_for_other_text();
            deliver_current_result();
        };

        if (response.had_network_error) {
            warnln("Unable to fetch autocomplete suggestions");
            deliver_without_an_answer();
            return;
        }
        if (response.response_code.has_value() && *response.response_code >= 400) {
            warnln("Received error response code {} from autocomplete engine", *response.response_code);
            deliver_without_an_answer();
            return;
        }

        Optional<ByteString const&> content_type;
        if (response.content_type.has_value())
            content_type = *response.content_type;

        if (auto result = received_autocomplete_response(content_type, StringView { response.body.bytes() }); result.is_error()) {
            warnln("Unable to handle autocomplete response: {}", result.error());
            deliver_without_an_answer();
        } else {
            dbgln_if(WEBVIEW_HISTORY_DEBUG, "[History] Remote autocomplete suggestions for '{}': {}", query, history_log_suggestions(result.value()));
            m_remote_suggestions = classify_remote_autocomplete_suggestions(result.release_value());

            deliver_current_result();
        }
    });
}

void Autocomplete::local_query_complete(AutocompleteQueryID query_id, Vector<AutocompleteSuggestion> suggestions)
{
    if (m_query_id != query_id)
        return;

    m_local_suggestions = move(suggestions);
    show_search_results_pages_as_searches(m_trimmed_query, m_local_suggestions, m_host.autocomplete_settings().search_engine_settings().engine);
    add_visited_host_families(m_visited_host_families, m_local_suggestions);
    m_local_query_complete = true;

    dbgln_if(WEBVIEW_HISTORY_DEBUG, "[History] Local autocomplete suggestions for '{}': {}", m_trimmed_query, log_autocomplete_suggestions(m_local_suggestions));
    deliver_current_result();
}

void Autocomplete::external_url_handler_query_complete(AutocompleteQueryID query_id, RefPtr<ExternalURLHandler> handler)
{
    if (m_query_id != query_id)
        return;

    m_external_url_handler_query_complete = true;
    m_external_url_has_handler = handler && !handler->is_ladybird();
    deliver_current_result();
}

void Autocomplete::deliver_current_result()
{
    if (!m_query_id.has_value())
        return;

    auto additional_suggestions = web_ui_autocomplete_suggestions(m_trimmed_query);
    Optional<AutocompleteSuggestion> verbatim_suggestion;
    if (additional_suggestions.is_empty() && m_external_url_handler_query_complete) {
        if (m_external_url_has_handler) {
            verbatim_suggestion = make_literal_url_suggestion(m_query);
            // NB: The app that handles the address is where Return goes, so a search for text with a space, such as
            //     "tel:+1 555 1234", must not outrank it.
            if (auto search_suggestion = search_below_address_for_query_suggestion(m_host.autocomplete_settings().search_engine_settings().engine, m_query); search_suggestion.has_value())
                additional_suggestions.append(search_suggestion.release_value());
        } else {
            auto const& search_engine = m_host.autocomplete_settings().search_engine_settings().engine;
            verbatim_suggestion = make_verbatim_autocomplete_suggestion(m_query, m_classified_query, search_engine);
            if (auto search_suggestion = make_search_suggestion_for_address_like_text(m_query, m_classified_query, search_engine); search_suggestion.has_value())
                additional_suggestions.append(search_suggestion.release_value());
        }
    }
    additional_suggestions.extend(m_local_suggestions);
    auto remote_suggestions = make_remote_autocomplete_suggestions(m_remote_suggestions.span(), m_visited_host_families,
        m_local_query_complete ? LocalSuggestionsAreComplete::Yes : LocalSuggestionsAreComplete::No);
    auto waits_for_remote_query = !m_remote_query_complete && !m_stopped_waiting_for_remote_query;
    auto merged_suggestions = mux_autocomplete_suggestions(
        m_trimmed_query,
        move(verbatim_suggestion),
        move(additional_suggestions),
        move(remote_suggestions),
        m_max_suggestions);
    for (auto& suggestion : merged_suggestions)
        suggestion.highlight_input = m_trimmed_query;
    auto result_kind = m_local_query_complete && !waits_for_remote_query && m_external_url_handler_query_complete
        ? AutocompleteResultKind::Final
        : AutocompleteResultKind::Intermediate;

    dbgln_if(WEBVIEW_HISTORY_DEBUG, "[History] Merged autocomplete suggestions for '{}': {}", m_query, log_autocomplete_suggestions(merged_suggestions));
    invoke_autocomplete_query_complete(*m_query_id, move(merged_suggestions), result_kind);
}

static ErrorOr<Vector<String>> parse_opensearch_autocomplete(JsonValue const& json)
{
    if (!json.is_array())
        return Error::from_string_literal("Expected OpenSearch autocomplete response to be a JSON array");

    auto const& values = json.as_array();
    if (values.size() < 2 || !values[1].is_array())
        return Error::from_string_literal("Invalid OpenSearch autocomplete response, expected suggestions in the second element");

    auto const& suggestions = values[1].as_array();
    Vector<String> results;
    results.ensure_capacity(suggestions.size());

    TRY(suggestions.try_for_each([&](JsonValue const& suggestion) -> ErrorOr<void> {
        if (!suggestion.is_string())
            return Error::from_string_literal("Invalid OpenSearch autocomplete response, expected value to be a string");
        results.unchecked_append(suggestion.as_string());
        return {};
    }));

    return results;
}

ErrorOr<Vector<String>> Autocomplete::received_autocomplete_response(Optional<ByteString const&> content_type, StringView response)
{
    auto decoder = [&]() -> Optional<TextCodec::Decoder> {
        if (!content_type.has_value())
            return {};

        auto mime_type = Web::MimeSniff::MimeType::parse(*content_type);
        if (!mime_type.has_value())
            return {};

        auto charset = mime_type->parameters().get("charset"sv);
        if (!charset.has_value())
            return {};

        return TextCodec::decoder_for(*charset);
    }();

    if (!decoder.has_value())
        decoder = TextCodec::decoder_for("UTF-8"sv);

    auto decoded_response = TRY(TextCodec::decode_to_utf8(response.bytes(), *decoder));
    auto json = TRY(JsonValue::from_string(decoded_response));

    return parse_opensearch_autocomplete(json);
}

void Autocomplete::invoke_autocomplete_query_complete(AutocompleteQueryID query_id, Vector<AutocompleteSuggestion> suggestions, AutocompleteResultKind result_kind) const
{
    dbgln_if(WEBVIEW_HISTORY_DEBUG, "[History] Delivering {} autocomplete suggestion(s) as a {} result: {}",
        suggestions.size(),
        result_kind == AutocompleteResultKind::Final ? "final"sv : "intermediate"sv,
        log_autocomplete_suggestions(suggestions));

    if (on_autocomplete_query_complete)
        on_autocomplete_query_complete(query_id, move(suggestions), result_kind);
}

}

    // The search engine took too long, so the rows without its answer are final, until it answers after all.

    // NB: The sites among the local rows, which tell which remote addresses are pages. They are kept for as long as remote
