FILE: Libraries/LibWebView/NotificationBackend.h
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#pragma once

#include <AK/Function.h>
#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <AK/RefPtr.h>
#include <AK/String.h>
#include <AK/Types.h>
#include <AK/kmalloc.h>
#include <LibGfx/Bitmap.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/NotificationsAPI/NotificationData.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/Page/PageId.h>
#include <LibWebView/Export.h>
#include <LibWebView/Forward.h>

namespace WebView {

// A notification as a platform backend shows it: the page's fields, plus what the browser adds to them.
struct PlatformNotification {
    // Names the notification for the life of the process; the backend reports every event by it.
    u64 id { 0 };
    // The page that asked for it, for a backend that keeps per-page state.
    Web::PageId page_id;
    // The notification with the same origin and tag that this one takes the place of, if any.
    Optional<u64> replaces;
    Web::NotificationsAPI::NotificationData data;
    // The origin the notification is shown as coming from. See attribution_for_origin().
    String attribution;
    RefPtr<Gfx::Bitmap const> icon;
};

// What a notification platform does for the browser. show() ends in on_shown() or on_failed() for its id, possibly
// before it returns; close() ends in on_closed() with ByUser::No. The platform reports the user's clicks and
// dismissals through on_clicked() and on_closed(); a click takes the notification down too, so it's followed by
// on_closed() with ByUser::Yes. Every callback runs on the main thread.
class WEBVIEW_API NotificationBackend {
public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    virtual ~NotificationBackend() = default;

    enum class ByUser {
        No,
        Yes,
    };

    virtual void show(PlatformNotification const&) = 0;
    virtual void close(u64 id) = 0;

    // Non-null for the backend tests install, which keeps what it was shown.
    virtual RecordingNotificationBackend* as_recording_backend() { return nullptr; }

    // True while the operating system hasn't yet been asked whether this browser may show notifications at all, so
    // the system will ask the user right after the browser does.
    virtual bool os_authorization_is_undetermined() const { return false; }

    Function<void(u64 id)> on_shown;
    Function<void(u64 id)> on_failed;
    Function<void(u64 id)> on_clicked;
    Function<void(u64 id, ByUser)> on_closed;
};

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWebView/NotificationBackendFreedesktop.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <AK/ByteString.h>
#include <AK/kmalloc.h>
#include <LibCore/EventLoop.h>
#include <LibCore/Notifier.h>
#include <LibCore/Timer.h>
#include <LibWebView/NotificationBackendFreedesktop.h>

#include <dbus/dbus.h>

namespace WebView {

static constexpr auto bus_name = "org.freedesktop.Notifications";
static constexpr auto object_path = "/org/freedesktop/Notifications";
static constexpr auto interface_name = "org.freedesktop.Notifications";

// Reasons the daemon gives in NotificationClosed.
static constexpr u32 closed_reason_dismissed_by_user = 2;

NotificationBackendFreedesktop::NotificationBackendFreedesktop()
{
    if (!connect())
        return;
    request_capabilities();
}

NotificationBackendFreedesktop::~NotificationBackendFreedesktop()
{
    if (!m_connection)
        return;
    dbus_connection_set_watch_functions(m_connection, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr);
    dbus_connection_set_timeout_functions(m_connection, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr);
    dbus_connection_close(m_connection);
    dbus_connection_unref(m_connection);
}

bool NotificationBackendFreedesktop::connect()
{
    DBusError error;
    dbus_error_init(&error);
    m_connection = dbus_bus_get_private(DBUS_BUS_SESSION, &error);
    if (!m_connection) {
        dbgln("Notifications: No session bus to reach a notification daemon over: {}", error.message ? error.message : "unknown error");
        dbus_error_free(&error);
        return false;
    }
    dbus_connection_set_exit_on_disconnect(m_connection, FALSE);

    dbus_connection_set_watch_functions(m_connection, add_watch, remove_watch, toggle_watch, this, nullptr);
    dbus_connection_set_timeout_functions(m_connection, add_timeout, remove_timeout, toggle_timeout, this, nullptr);
    dbus_connection_set_dispatch_status_function(
        m_connection, [](DBusConnection*, DBusDispatchStatus status, void* data) {
            if (status == DBUS_DISPATCH_DATA_REMAINS)
                Core::deferred_invoke([backend = static_cast<NotificationBackendFreedesktop*>(data)] { backend->dispatch(); });
        },
        this, nullptr);

    dbus_connection_add_filter(
        m_connection, [](DBusConnection*, DBusMessage* message, void* data) -> DBusHandlerResult {
            static_cast<NotificationBackendFreedesktop*>(data)->did_receive_signal(message);
            return DBUS_HANDLER_RESULT_NOT_YET_HANDLED;
        },
        this, nullptr);
    dbus_bus_add_match(m_connection, "type='signal',interface='org.freedesktop.Notifications'", nullptr);
    dbus_bus_add_match(m_connection, "type='signal',interface='org.freedesktop.DBus',member='NameOwnerChanged',arg0='org.freedesktop.Notifications'", nullptr);
    return true;
}

void NotificationBackendFreedesktop::remember_daemon_from(DBusMessage* reply)
{
    if (auto const* sender = dbus_message_get_sender(reply))
        m_daemon_unique_name = sender;
}

bool NotificationBackendFreedesktop::signal_is_from_the_daemon(DBusMessage* message) const
{
    // Until a reply has named the daemon, there is nothing to hold a signal against.
    if (m_daemon_unique_name.is_empty())
        return true;
    auto const* sender = dbus_message_get_sender(message);
    return sender && m_daemon_unique_name == sender;
}

// The daemon that handed out the ids in the maps is gone, and its notifications went with it. A daemon that takes its
// place numbers from one again, so none of those ids may match a later signal, and it may offer other capabilities.
void NotificationBackendFreedesktop::daemon_owner_changed(char const* new_owner)
{
    ++m_daemon_generation;
    m_daemon_unique_name = new_owner ? new_owner : "";
    auto ids = m_daemon_id_for.keys();
    m_daemon_id_for.clear();
    m_id_for_daemon_id.clear();
    m_capabilities.clear();
    m_capabilities_requested = false;
    for (auto id : ids) {
        if (on_closed)
            on_closed(id, ByUser::No);
    }
    // The successor answers for itself, and the notifications queued meanwhile go to it; with no successor yet, the
    // next show() asks whoever takes the name. This also covers a daemon that the first GetCapabilities activated,
    // whose NameOwnerChanged arrives ahead of its reply.
    if (!m_daemon_unique_name.is_empty())
        request_capabilities();
}

void NotificationBackendFreedesktop::dispatch()
{
    while (dbus_connection_dispatch(m_connection) == DBUS_DISPATCH_DATA_REMAINS) { }
}

unsigned NotificationBackendFreedesktop::add_watch(DBusWatch* watch, void* data)
{
    auto& backend = *static_cast<NotificationBackendFreedesktop*>(data);
    auto flags = dbus_watch_get_flags(watch);
    auto type = Core::Notifier::Type::None;
    if (flags & DBUS_WATCH_READABLE)
        type |= Core::Notifier::Type::Read;
    if (flags & DBUS_WATCH_WRITABLE)
        type |= Core::Notifier::Type::Write;
    auto notifier = Core::Notifier::construct(dbus_watch_get_unix_fd(watch), type);
    notifier->on_activation = [watch, &backend, flags] {
        dbus_watch_handle(watch, flags & (DBUS_WATCH_READABLE | DBUS_WATCH_WRITABLE));
        backend.dispatch();
    };
    notifier->set_enabled(dbus_watch_get_enabled(watch));
    backend.m_watches.append({ watch, move(notifier) });
    return TRUE;
}

void NotificationBackendFreedesktop::remove_watch(DBusWatch* watch, void* data)
{
    auto& backend = *static_cast<NotificationBackendFreedesktop*>(data);
    backend.m_watches.remove_all_matching([&](auto const& entry) { return entry.watch == watch; });
}

void NotificationBackendFreedesktop::toggle_watch(DBusWatch* watch, void* data)
{
    auto& backend = *static_cast<NotificationBackendFreedesktop*>(data);
    for (auto& entry : backend.m_watches) {
        if (entry.watch == watch)
            entry.notifier->set_enabled(dbus_watch_get_enabled(watch));
    }
}

unsigned NotificationBackendFreedesktop::add_timeout(DBusTimeout* timeout, void* data)
{
    auto& backend = *static_cast<NotificationBackendFreedesktop*>(data);
    auto timer = Core::Timer::create_repeating(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(dbus_timeout_get_interval(timeout)), [timeout, &backend] {
        dbus_timeout_handle(timeout);
        backend.dispatch();
    });
    if (dbus_timeout_get_enabled(timeout))
        timer->start();
    backend.m_timeouts.append({ timeout, move(timer) });
    return TRUE;
}

void NotificationBackendFreedesktop::remove_timeout(DBusTimeout* timeout, void* data)
{
    auto& backend = *static_cast<NotificationBackendFreedesktop*>(data);
    backend.m_timeouts.remove_all_matching([&](auto const& entry) { return entry.timeout == timeout; });
}

void NotificationBackendFreedesktop::toggle_timeout(DBusTimeout* timeout, void* data)
{
    auto& backend = *static_cast<NotificationBackendFreedesktop*>(data);
    for (auto& entry : backend.m_timeouts) {
        if (entry.timeout != timeout)
            continue;
        if (dbus_timeout_get_enabled(timeout))
            entry.timer->start(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(dbus_timeout_get_interval(timeout)));
        else
            entry.timer->stop();
    }
}

void NotificationBackendFreedesktop::request_capabilities()
{
    m_capabilities_requested = true;
    auto* message = dbus_message_new_method_call(bus_name, object_path, interface_name, "GetCapabilities");
    DBusPendingCall* pending = nullptr;
    if (!dbus_connection_send_with_reply(m_connection, message, &pending, -1) || !pending) {
        dbus_message_unref(message);
        m_capabilities = FreedesktopCapabilities {};
        return;
    }
    dbus_message_unref(message);
    struct Context {
        AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;
        NotificationBackendFreedesktop* backend;
        u64 daemon_generation;
    };
    dbus_pending_call_set_notify(
        pending, [](DBusPendingCall* pending, void* data) {
            auto* context = static_cast<Context*>(data);
            auto* reply = dbus_pending_call_steal_reply(pending);
            context->backend->did_receive_capabilities(context->daemon_generation, reply);
            if (reply)
                dbus_message_unref(reply); },
        new Context { this, m_daemon_generation }, [](void* data) { delete static_cast<Context*>(data); });
    dbus_pending_call_unref(pending);
}

void NotificationBackendFreedesktop::did_receive_capabilities(u64 daemon_generation, DBusMessage* reply)
{
    // A reply from a daemon that has since gone away; the daemon that took the name over has been asked anew.
    if (daemon_generation != m_daemon_generation)
        return;
    FreedesktopCapabilities capabilities;
    DBusMessageIter iterator;
    if (reply && dbus_message_get_type(reply) == DBUS_MESSAGE_TYPE_METHOD_RETURN)
        remember_daemon_from(reply);
    if (reply && dbus_message_get_type(reply) == DBUS_MESSAGE_TYPE_METHOD_RETURN && dbus_message_iter_init(reply, &iterator) && dbus_message_iter_get_arg_type(&iterator) == DBUS_TYPE_ARRAY) {
        DBusMessageIter entries;
        dbus_message_iter_recurse(&iterator, &entries);
        while (dbus_message_iter_get_arg_type(&entries) == DBUS_TYPE_STRING) {
            char const* capability = nullptr;
            dbus_message_iter_get_basic(&entries, &capability);
            StringView name { capability, strlen(capability) };
            if (name == "body"sv)
                capabilities.body = true;
            else if (name == "body-markup"sv)
                capabilities.body_markup = true;
            else if (name == "persistence"sv)
                capabilities.persistence = true;
            else if (name == "actions"sv)
                capabilities.actions = true;
            dbus_message_iter_next(&entries);
        }
    }
    m_capabilities = capabilities;
    for (auto& notification : exchange(m_waiting_for_capabilities, {}))
        send_notify(notification);
}

void NotificationBackendFreedesktop::show(PlatformNotification const& notification)
{
    if (!m_connection) {
        if (on_failed)
            on_failed(notification.id);
        return;
    }
    // A replaced notification that never reached the daemon is dropped here; one that did is replaced by send_notify().
    if (notification.replaces.has_value())
        m_waiting_for_capabilities.remove_first_matching([&](auto const& waiting) { return waiting.id == *notification.replaces; });
    if (!m_capabilities.has_value()) {
        m_waiting_for_capabilities.append(notification);
        // The daemon may have gone away without a successor; the next one to take the name is asked then.
        if (!m_capabilities_requested)
            request_capabilities();
        return;
    }
    send_notify(notification);
}

static void append_string(DBusMessageIter& iterator, String const& string)
{
    auto bytes = string.to_byte_string();
    char const* characters = bytes.characters();
    dbus_message_iter_append_basic(&iterator, DBUS_TYPE_STRING, &characters);
}

static void append_hint(DBusMessageIter& hints, FreedesktopHint const& hint)
{
    DBusMessageIter entry;
    dbus_message_iter_open_container(&hints, DBUS_TYPE_DICT_ENTRY, nullptr, &entry);
    append_string(entry, hint.name);

    DBusMessageIter variant;
    hint.value.visit(
        [&](u8 value) {
            dbus_message_iter_open_container(&entry, DBUS_TYPE_VARIANT, DBUS_TYPE_BYTE_AS_STRING, &variant);
            dbus_message_iter_append_basic(&variant, DBUS_TYPE_BYTE, &value);
        },
        [&](bool value) {
            dbus_bool_t dbus_value = value;
            dbus_message_iter_open_container(&entry, DBUS_TYPE_VARIANT, DBUS_TYPE_BOOLEAN_AS_STRING, &variant);
            dbus_message_iter_append_basic(&variant, DBUS_TYPE_BOOLEAN, &dbus_value);
        },
        [&](String const& value) {
            dbus_message_iter_open_container(&entry, DBUS_TYPE_VARIANT, DBUS_TYPE_STRING_AS_STRING, &variant);
            append_string(variant, value);
        },
        [&](FreedesktopImageData const& image) {
            dbus_message_iter_open_container(&entry, DBUS_TYPE_VARIANT, "(iiibiiay)", &variant);
            DBusMessageIter structure;
            dbus_message_iter_open_container(&variant, DBUS_TYPE_STRUCT, nullptr, &structure);
            dbus_message_iter_append_basic(&structure, DBUS_TYPE_INT32, &image.width);
            dbus_message_iter_append_basic(&structure, DBUS_TYPE_INT32, &image.height);
            dbus_message_iter_append_basic(&structure, DBUS_TYPE_INT32, &image.rowstride);
            dbus_bool_t has_alpha = image.has_alpha;
            dbus_message_iter_append_basic(&structure, DBUS_TYPE_BOOLEAN, &has_alpha);
            dbus_message_iter_append_basic(&structure, DBUS_TYPE_INT32, &image.bits_per_sample);
            dbus_message_iter_append_basic(&structure, DBUS_TYPE_INT32, &image.channels);
            DBusMessageIter bytes;
            dbus_message_iter_open_container(&structure, DBUS_TYPE_ARRAY, DBUS_TYPE_BYTE_AS_STRING, &bytes);
            auto const* pixels = image.pixels.data();
            int count = static_cast<int>(image.pixels.size());
            dbus_message_iter_append_fixed_array(&bytes, DBUS_TYPE_BYTE, &pixels, count);
            dbus_message_iter_close_container(&structure, &bytes);
            dbus_message_iter_close_container(&variant, &structure);
        });
    dbus_message_iter_close_container(&entry, &variant);
    dbus_message_iter_close_container(&hints, &entry);
}

void NotificationBackendFreedesktop::send_notify(PlatformNotification const& notification)
{
    u32 replaces_daemon_id = 0;
    if (notification.replaces.has_value()) {
        if (auto daemon_id = m_daemon_id_for.take(*notification.replaces); daemon_id.has_value()) {
            replaces_daemon_id = *daemon_id;
            m_id_for_daemon_id.remove(replaces_daemon_id);
        } else if (m_awaiting_reply.contains(*notification.replaces)) {
            // The one being replaced hasn't been acknowledged yet, so it can't be replaced in place: It comes down
            // as soon as it can.
            m_close_when_acknowledged.set(*notification.replaces);
        }
    }
    auto arguments = build_notify_arguments(notification, *m_capabilities, replaces_daemon_id);

    auto* message = dbus_message_new_method_call(bus_name, object_path, interface_name, "Notify");
    DBusMessageIter iterator;
    dbus_message_iter_init_append(message, &iterator);
    append_string(iterator, arguments.app_name);
    dbus_message_iter_append_basic(&iterator, DBUS_TYPE_UINT32, &arguments.replaces_id);
    append_string(iterator, arguments.app_icon);
    append_string(iterator, arguments.summary);
    append_string(iterator, arguments.body);

    DBusMessageIter actions;
    dbus_message_iter_open_container(&iterator, DBUS_TYPE_ARRAY, DBUS_TYPE_STRING_AS_STRING, &actions);
    for (auto const& action : arguments.actions)
        append_string(actions, action);
    dbus_message_iter_close_container(&iterator, &actions);

    DBusMessageIter hints;
    dbus_message_iter_open_container(&iterator, DBUS_TYPE_ARRAY, "{sv}", &hints);
    for (auto const& hint : arguments.hints)
        append_hint(hints, hint);
    dbus_message_iter_close_container(&iterator, &hints);

    dbus_message_iter_append_basic(&iterator, DBUS_TYPE_INT32, &arguments.expire_timeout);

    DBusPendingCall* pending = nullptr;
    if (!dbus_connection_send_with_reply(m_connection, message, &pending, -1) || !pending) {
        dbus_message_unref(message);
        if (on_failed)
            on_failed(notification.id);
        return;
    }
    dbus_message_unref(message);
    m_awaiting_reply.set(notification.id);

    struct Context {
        AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;
        NotificationBackendFreedesktop* backend;
        u64 id;
        u64 daemon_generation;
    };
    dbus_pending_call_set_notify(
        pending, [](DBusPendingCall* pending, void* data) {
            auto* context = static_cast<Context*>(data);
            auto* reply = dbus_pending_call_steal_reply(pending);
            context->backend->did_receive_notify_reply(context->id, context->daemon_generation, reply);
            if (reply)
                dbus_message_unref(reply); },
        new Context { this, notification.id, m_daemon_generation }, [](void* data) { delete static_cast<Context*>(data); });
    dbus_pending_call_unref(pending);
}

void NotificationBackendFreedesktop::send_close_notification(u32 daemon_id)
{
    auto* message = dbus_message_new_method_call(bus_name, object_path, interface_name, "CloseNotification");
    dbus_message_append_args(message, DBUS_TYPE_UINT32, &daemon_id, DBUS_TYPE_INVALID);
    dbus_message_set_no_reply(message, TRUE);
    dbus_connection_send(m_connection, message, nullptr);
    dbus_message_unref(message);
}

void NotificationBackendFreedesktop::did_receive_notify_reply(u64 id, u64 daemon_generation, DBusMessage* reply)
{
    m_awaiting_reply.remove(id);
    bool closed_meanwhile = m_close_when_acknowledged.remove(id);

    // The daemon this was sent to has gone away since, so whatever it answers, the notification isn't up anywhere.
    if (daemon_generation != m_daemon_generation) {
        if (!closed_meanwhile && on_failed)
            on_failed(id);
        return;
    }

    u32 daemon_id = 0;
    if (!reply || dbus_message_get_type(reply) != DBUS_MESSAGE_TYPE_METHOD_RETURN || !dbus_message_get_args(reply, nullptr, DBUS_TYPE_UINT32, &daemon_id, DBUS_TYPE_INVALID)) {
        if (reply && dbus_message_get_type(reply) == DBUS_MESSAGE_TYPE_ERROR)
            dbgln("Notifications: The notification daemon refused the request: {}", dbus_message_get_error_name(reply));
        if (!closed_meanwhile && on_failed)
            on_failed(id);
        return;
    }

    remember_daemon_from(reply);

    // Closed on this side while the daemon was still answering: It comes down now, and its close was reported then.
    if (closed_meanwhile) {
        send_close_notification(daemon_id);
        return;
    }

    m_daemon_id_for.set(id, daemon_id);
    m_id_for_daemon_id.set(daemon_id, id);
    if (on_shown)
        on_shown(id);
}

void NotificationBackendFreedesktop::close(u64 id)
{
    auto daemon_id = m_daemon_id_for.take(id);
    if (daemon_id.has_value()) {
        m_id_for_daemon_id.remove(*daemon_id);
        send_close_notification(*daemon_id);
    } else if (m_awaiting_reply.contains(id)) {
        // The daemon hasn't answered the Notify yet; its answer takes the notification down.
        m_close_when_acknowledged.set(id);
    } else {
        // Not sent yet (still waiting for the capabilities), or unknown: Nothing to take down.
        bool was_waiting = m_waiting_for_capabilities.remove_first_matching([&](auto const& waiting) { return waiting.id == id; });
        if (!was_waiting)
            return;
    }
    // The daemon's NotificationClosed for this id finds no mapping any more, so the close is reported once, here.
    if (on_closed)
        on_closed(id, ByUser::No);
}

void NotificationBackendFreedesktop::did_receive_signal(DBusMessage* message)
{
    if (dbus_message_is_signal(message, DBUS_INTERFACE_DBUS, "NameOwnerChanged")) {
        char const* name = nullptr;
        char const* old_owner = nullptr;
        char const* new_owner = nullptr;
        if (!dbus_message_get_args(message, nullptr, DBUS_TYPE_STRING, &name, DBUS_TYPE_STRING, &old_owner, DBUS_TYPE_STRING, &new_owner, DBUS_TYPE_INVALID))
            return;
        if (ByteString { name } == bus_name)
            daemon_owner_changed(new_owner);
        return;
    }

    if (!signal_is_from_the_daemon(message))
        return;

    if (dbus_message_is_signal(message, interface_name, "ActionInvoked")) {
        u32 daemon_id = 0;
        char const* action = nullptr;
        if (!dbus_message_get_args(message, nullptr, DBUS_TYPE_UINT32, &daemon_id, DBUS_TYPE_STRING, &action, DBUS_TYPE_INVALID))
            return;
        if (auto id = m_id_for_daemon_id.get(daemon_id); id.has_value() && on_clicked)
            on_clicked(*id);
        return;
    }

    if (dbus_message_is_signal(message, interface_name, "NotificationClosed")) {
        u32 daemon_id = 0;
        u32 reason = 0;
        if (!dbus_message_get_args(message, nullptr, DBUS_TYPE_UINT32, &daemon_id, DBUS_TYPE_UINT32, &reason, DBUS_TYPE_INVALID))
            return;
        auto id = m_id_for_daemon_id.take(daemon_id);
        if (!id.has_value())
            return;
        m_daemon_id_for.remove(*id);
        if (on_closed)
            on_closed(*id, reason == closed_reason_dismissed_by_user ? ByUser::Yes : ByUser::No);
    }
}

}

namespace WebView {

// Shows notifications through the Desktop Notifications daemon on the session bus (org.freedesktop.Notifications),
// over libdbus, with its sockets and timers on the browser's event loop. Without a session bus or a daemon, every show
// fails.
class WEBVIEW_API NotificationBackendFreedesktop final : public NotificationBackend {
public:
    NotificationBackendFreedesktop();
    virtual ~NotificationBackendFreedesktop() override;

    virtual void show(PlatformNotification const&) override;
    virtual void close(u64 id) override;

private:
    bool connect();
    void request_capabilities();
    void did_receive_capabilities(u64 daemon_generation, DBusMessage* reply);
    void send_notify(PlatformNotification const&);
    void send_close_notification(u32 daemon_id);
    void remember_daemon_from(DBusMessage* reply);
    bool signal_is_from_the_daemon(DBusMessage*) const;
    void daemon_owner_changed(char const* new_owner);
    void did_receive_notify_reply(u64 id, u64 daemon_generation, DBusMessage* reply);
    void did_receive_signal(DBusMessage*);
    void dispatch();

    static unsigned add_watch(DBusWatch*, void* data);
    static void remove_watch(DBusWatch*, void* data);
    static void toggle_watch(DBusWatch*, void* data);
    static unsigned add_timeout(DBusTimeout*, void* data);
    static void remove_timeout(DBusTimeout*, void* data);
    static void toggle_timeout(DBusTimeout*, void* data);

    DBusConnection* m_connection { nullptr };

    // The daemon names notifications by its own ids, handed out in the Notify reply. They mean something only to the
    // daemon that handed them out, which its replies name; a daemon that replaces it numbers from one again.
    HashMap<u64, u32> m_daemon_id_for;
    HashMap<u32, u64> m_id_for_daemon_id;
    ByteString m_daemon_unique_name;
    // Bumped whenever the name changes hands, so a reply from a daemon that has since gone away is told apart.
    u64 m_daemon_generation { 0 };

    Optional<FreedesktopCapabilities> m_capabilities;
    bool m_capabilities_requested { false };
    Vector<PlatformNotification> m_waiting_for_capabilities;

    // Notifications whose Notify the daemon hasn't answered yet, and among them the ones already closed on this side:
    // Those are taken down as soon as the daemon's id for them arrives.
    HashTable<u64> m_awaiting_reply;
    HashTable<u64> m_close_when_acknowledged;

    struct Watch {
        DBusWatch* watch { nullptr };
        RefPtr<Core::Notifier> notifier;
    };
    Vector<Watch> m_watches;

    struct Timeout {
        DBusTimeout* timeout { nullptr };
        RefPtr<Core::Timer> timer;
    };
    Vector<Timeout> m_timeouts;
};

#pragma once

#include <AK/HashMap.h>
#include <AK/HashTable.h>
#include <AK/NonnullOwnPtr.h>
#include <AK/String.h>
#include <AK/kmalloc.h>
#include <LibWebView/NotificationBackend.h>

namespace WebView {

namespace Detail {

struct NotificationCenterBridge {
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;
    void* delegate { nullptr };
    void* center { nullptr };
};

}

// Shows notifications through the user notification center. Needs a bundled application: Outside one there is no
// notification center to ask, and every show fails.
class WEBVIEW_API NotificationBackendMacOS final : public NotificationBackend {
public:
    NotificationBackendMacOS();
    virtual ~NotificationBackendMacOS() override;

    virtual void show(PlatformNotification const&) override;
    virtual void close(u64 id) override;
    virtual bool os_authorization_is_undetermined() const override { return m_authorization == Authorization::Unknown; }

    // What the notification center's delegate reports: the user activated or dismissed a request.
    void did_activate(String const& identifier);
    void did_dismiss(String const& identifier);

private:
    void request_authorization_then(Function<void(bool granted)>);

    // The notification center knows requests by a string identifier. A replacement keeps the identifier of the
    // notification it replaces, so the center swaps it in place; these maps keep track of which id holds it now.
    HashMap<String, u64> m_id_for_identifier;
    HashMap<u64, String> m_identifier_for_id;

    enum class Authorization {
        Unknown,
        Pending,
        Granted,
        Denied,
    };
    Authorization m_authorization { Authorization::Unknown };
    Vector<Function<void(bool)>> m_waiting_for_authorization;

    OwnPtr<Detail::NotificationCenterBridge> m_bridge;
    bool m_bundled { false };

    // Identifiers carry this launch's token, so a click on a notification left over from an earlier run of the browser
    // isn't delivered to whatever page holds that number now.
    String m_launch_token;
    // Closed by the browser before the center was asked to show them (authorization still pending).
    HashTable<u64> m_closed_before_shown;
};

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWebView/NotificationBackendMacOS.mm
/*

 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause

#include <AK/ByteString.h>
#include <AK/Format.h>
#include <LibCore/EventLoop.h>
#include <LibGfx/ImageFormats/PNGWriter.h>
#include <LibWebView/NotificationAttribution.h>
#include <LibWebView/NotificationBackendMacOS.h>

#import <Foundation/Foundation.h>
#import <UserNotifications/UserNotifications.h>

@interface LadybirdNotificationCenterDelegate : NSObject <UNUserNotificationCenterDelegate>
- (instancetype)initWithBackend:(WebView::NotificationBackendMacOS*)backend;
- (void)detach;
@end

namespace WebView {

// The bridge holds the center and the delegate as plain pointers, so the header stays C++; these read them back.
static UNUserNotificationCenter* center_of(Detail::NotificationCenterBridge& bridge)
{
    return (__bridge UNUserNotificationCenter*)bridge.center;
}

static LadybirdNotificationCenterDelegate* delegate_of(Detail::NotificationCenterBridge& bridge)
{
    return (__bridge LadybirdNotificationCenterDelegate*)bridge.delegate;
}

// Every callback from the center arrives on a queue of its own; the browser's state is touched on the main thread only.
static void on_main_thread(Function<void()> function)
{
    __block auto held = move(function);
    dispatch_async(dispatch_get_main_queue(), ^{
        held();
    });
}

static NSString* ns_string(String const& string)
{
    return [NSString stringWithUTF8String:string.to_byte_string().characters()];
}

NotificationBackendMacOS::NotificationBackendMacOS()
    : m_bridge(make<Detail::NotificationCenterBridge>())
{
    m_bundled = [[NSBundle mainBundle] bundleIdentifier] != nil;
    if (!m_bundled) {
        dbgln("Notifications: Not running from an application bundle, so there is no notification center to show them in");
        return;
    }
    m_bridge->center = (__bridge_retained void*)[UNUserNotificationCenter currentNotificationCenter];
    m_bridge->delegate = (__bridge_retained void*)[[LadybirdNotificationCenterDelegate alloc] initWithBackend:this];
    center_of(*m_bridge).delegate = delegate_of(*m_bridge);
    m_launch_token = MUST(String::from_utf8(StringView { [[[NSUUID UUID] UUIDString] UTF8String], strlen([[[NSUUID UUID] UUIDString] UTF8String]) }));

    // The center reports a user's dismissal only for a category that asks for it.
    auto* category = [UNNotificationCategory categoryWithIdentifier:@"org.ladybird.Ladybird.web-notification"
                                                            actions:@[]
                                                  intentIdentifiers:@[]
                                                            options:UNNotificationCategoryOptionCustomDismissAction];
    [center_of(*m_bridge) setNotificationCategories:[NSSet setWithObject:category]];
}

NotificationBackendMacOS::~NotificationBackendMacOS()
{
    if (m_bridge->delegate) {
        auto* delegate = (__bridge_transfer LadybirdNotificationCenterDelegate*)m_bridge->delegate;
        auto* center = (__bridge_transfer UNUserNotificationCenter*)m_bridge->center;
        [delegate detach];
        if (center.delegate == delegate)
            center.delegate = nil;
    }
}

void NotificationBackendMacOS::request_authorization_then(Function<void(bool)> then)
{
    switch (m_authorization) {
    case Authorization::Granted:
        then(true);
        return;
    case Authorization::Denied:
        then(false);
        return;
    case Authorization::Pending:
        m_waiting_for_authorization.append(move(then));
        return;
    case Authorization::Unknown:
        break;
    }

    m_authorization = Authorization::Pending;
    m_waiting_for_authorization.append(move(then));
    [center_of(*m_bridge) requestAuthorizationWithOptions:(UNAuthorizationOptionAlert | UNAuthorizationOptionSound)
                                        completionHandler:^(BOOL granted, NSError* error) {
                                            if (!granted)
                                                dbgln("Notifications: The notification center denied authorization{}{}", error ? ": "sv : ""sv, error ? [[error localizedDescription] UTF8String] : "");
                                            on_main_thread([this, granted = static_cast<bool>(granted)] {
                                                m_authorization = granted ? Authorization::Granted : Authorization::Denied;
                                                for (auto& waiting : exchange(m_waiting_for_authorization, {}))
                                                    waiting(granted);
                                            });
                                        }];
}

void NotificationBackendMacOS::show(PlatformNotification const& notification)
{
    if (!m_bundled) {
        if (on_failed)
            on_failed(notification.id);
        return;
    }

    request_authorization_then([this, notification](bool granted) {
        // Closed while the authorization was pending: Its close was reported then.
        if (m_closed_before_shown.remove(notification.id))
            return;
        if (!granted) {
            if (on_failed)
                on_failed(notification.id);
            return;
        }

        auto* content = [[UNMutableNotificationContent alloc] init];
        content.title = ns_string(platform_text(notification.data.title));
        content.subtitle = ns_string(notification.attribution);
        content.body = ns_string(platform_text(notification.data.body));
        content.threadIdentifier = ns_string(notification.attribution);
        content.categoryIdentifier = @"org.ladybird.Ladybird.web-notification";
        if (notification.data.silent != true)
            content.sound = [UNNotificationSound defaultSound];

        // A replacement without renotify shouldn't alert again.
        bool replaces = notification.replaces.has_value();
        if (replaces && !notification.data.renotify)
            content.interruptionLevel = UNNotificationInterruptionLevelPassive;

        // The center takes an attachment from a file, which it copies.
        NSURL* icon_file = nil;
        if (notification.icon) {
            if (auto png = Gfx::PNGWriter::encode(*notification.icon); !png.is_error()) {
                auto path = ByteString::formatted("{}ladybird-notification-icon-{}.png", [NSTemporaryDirectory() UTF8String], notification.id);
                icon_file = [NSURL fileURLWithPath:[NSString stringWithUTF8String:path.characters()]];
                NSData* data = [NSData dataWithBytes:png.value().data() length:png.value().size()];
                if ([data writeToURL:icon_file atomically:YES]) {
                    NSError* error = nil;
                    if (auto* attachment = [UNNotificationAttachment attachmentWithIdentifier:@"icon" URL:icon_file options:nil error:&error])
                        content.attachments = @[ attachment ];
                } else {
                    icon_file = nil;
                }
            }
        }

        // Reusing the replaced notification's identifier makes the center swap it in place.
        String identifier;
        if (replaces) {
            if (auto existing = m_identifier_for_id.take(*notification.replaces); existing.has_value())
                identifier = existing.release_value();
        }
        if (identifier.is_empty())
            identifier = MUST(String::formatted("{}-{}", m_launch_token, notification.id));
        m_identifier_for_id.set(notification.id, identifier);
        m_id_for_identifier.set(identifier, notification.id);

        auto* request = [UNNotificationRequest requestWithIdentifier:ns_string(identifier) content:content trigger:nil];
        [center_of(*m_bridge) addNotificationRequest:request
                               withCompletionHandler:^(NSError* error) {
                                   if (icon_file)
                                       [[NSFileManager defaultManager] removeItemAtURL:icon_file error:nil];
                                   bool failed = error != nil;
                                   if (failed)
                                       dbgln("Notifications: The notification center refused the request: {}", [[error localizedDescription] UTF8String]);
                                   on_main_thread([this, id = notification.id, failed] {
                                       if (failed) {
                                           if (auto identifier = m_identifier_for_id.take(id); identifier.has_value())
                                               m_id_for_identifier.remove(*identifier);
                                           if (on_failed)
                                               on_failed(id);
                                           return;
                                       }
                                       if (on_shown)
                                           on_shown(id);
                                   });
                               }];
    });
}

void NotificationBackendMacOS::close(u64 id)
{
    auto identifier = m_identifier_for_id.take(id);
    if (!identifier.has_value()) {
        // Not handed to the center yet (authorization pending): The show, when it gets its turn, finds this and
        // does nothing; the close is reported now.
        if (m_authorization == Authorization::Pending) {
            m_closed_before_shown.set(id);
            if (on_closed)
                on_closed(id, ByUser::No);
        }
        return;
    }
    m_id_for_identifier.remove(*identifier);
    NSArray* identifiers = @[ ns_string(*identifier) ];
    [center_of(*m_bridge) removeDeliveredNotificationsWithIdentifiers:identifiers];
    [center_of(*m_bridge) removePendingNotificationRequestsWithIdentifiers:identifiers];
    if (on_closed)
        on_closed(id, ByUser::No);
}

void NotificationBackendMacOS::did_activate(String const& identifier)
{
    auto id = m_id_for_identifier.take(identifier);
    if (!id.has_value())
        return;
    m_identifier_for_id.remove(*id);
    if (on_clicked)
        on_clicked(*id);
    if (on_closed)
        on_closed(*id, ByUser::Yes);
}

void NotificationBackendMacOS::did_dismiss(String const& identifier)
{
    auto id = m_id_for_identifier.take(identifier);
    if (!id.has_value())
        return;
    m_identifier_for_id.remove(*id);
    if (on_closed)
        on_closed(*id, ByUser::Yes);
}

}

@implementation LadybirdNotificationCenterDelegate
{
    WebView::NotificationBackendMacOS* m_backend;
}

- (instancetype)initWithBackend:(WebView::NotificationBackendMacOS*)backend
{
    if ((self = [super init]))
        m_backend = backend;
    return self;
}

- (void)detach
{
    m_backend = nullptr;
}

// Notifications show as banners even while the browser is the frontmost application.
- (void)userNotificationCenter:(UNUserNotificationCenter*)center
       willPresentNotification:(UNNotification*)notification
         withCompletionHandler:(void (^)(UNNotificationPresentationOptions))completionHandler
{
    completionHandler(UNNotificationPresentationOptionBanner | UNNotificationPresentationOptionSound);
}

- (void)userNotificationCenter:(UNUserNotificationCenter*)center
    didReceiveNotificationResponse:(UNNotificationResponse*)response
             withCompletionHandler:(void (^)(void))completionHandler
{
    auto identifier = MUST(String::from_utf8(StringView { [response.notification.request.identifier UTF8String], strlen([response.notification.request.identifier UTF8String]) }));
    bool dismissed = [response.actionIdentifier isEqualToString:UNNotificationDismissActionIdentifier];
    WebView::on_main_thread([self, identifier, dismissed] {
        if (!m_backend)
            return;
        if (dismissed)
            m_backend->did_dismiss(identifier);
        else
            m_backend->did_activate(identifier);
    });
    completionHandler();
}

@end

/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <AK/StringBuilder.h>
#include <LibWebView/NotificationAttribution.h>
#include <LibWebView/NotificationFreedesktopArguments.h>

namespace WebView {

static constexpr i32 expire_timeout_default = -1;
static constexpr i32 expire_timeout_never = 0;
static constexpr i32 expire_timeout_without_notification_center_ms = 25000;
static constexpr u8 urgency_normal = 1;
static constexpr u8 urgency_critical = 2;
// The longest side an icon may have before it's left out rather than put on the bus.
static constexpr int icon_maximum_side = 128;

static String escape_markup(String const& text)
{
    StringBuilder builder;
    for (auto code_point : text.code_points()) {
        switch (code_point) {
        case '&':
            builder.append("&amp;"sv);
            break;
        case '<':
            builder.append("&lt;"sv);
            break;
        case '>':
            builder.append("&gt;"sv);
            break;
        default:
            builder.append_code_point(code_point);
        }
    }
    return MUST(builder.to_string());
}

static FreedesktopImageData image_data_for(Gfx::Bitmap const& bitmap)
{
    FreedesktopImageData image;
    image.width = bitmap.width();
    image.height = bitmap.height();
    image.rowstride = bitmap.width() * 4;
    image.pixels = MUST(ByteBuffer::create_uninitialized(static_cast<size_t>(image.rowstride) * image.height));
    size_t offset = 0;
    for (int y = 0; y < bitmap.height(); ++y) {
        for (int x = 0; x < bitmap.width(); ++x) {
            // The daemon wants straight RGBA; a premultiplied bitmap's channels are scaled back up by their alpha.
            auto color = bitmap.get_pixel(x, y);
            auto alpha = color.alpha();
            auto straight = [&](u8 channel) -> u8 {
                if (bitmap.alpha_type() != Gfx::AlphaType::Premultiplied || alpha == 0 || alpha == 255)
                    return channel;
                return static_cast<u8>(min(255, (channel * 255 + alpha / 2) / alpha));
            };
            image.pixels[offset++] = straight(color.red());
            image.pixels[offset++] = straight(color.green());
            image.pixels[offset++] = straight(color.blue());
            image.pixels[offset++] = alpha;
        }
    }
    return image;
}

FreedesktopNotifyArguments build_notify_arguments(PlatformNotification const& notification, FreedesktopCapabilities const& capabilities, u32 replaces_daemon_id)
{
    FreedesktopNotifyArguments arguments;
    arguments.app_name = "Ladybird"_string;
    arguments.replaces_id = replaces_daemon_id;
    arguments.app_icon = "org.ladybird.Ladybird"_string;
    auto title = platform_text(notification.data.title);
    auto body = platform_text(notification.data.body);

    // The origin always shows: in the body where the daemon shows one, else ahead of the title.
    if (capabilities.body) {
        arguments.summary = title;
        auto attribution = notification.attribution;
        if (capabilities.body_markup) {
            attribution = escape_markup(attribution);
            body = escape_markup(body);
        }
        if (body.is_empty())
            arguments.body = attribution;
        else
            arguments.body = MUST(String::formatted("{}\n\n{}", attribution, body));
    } else {
        arguments.summary = MUST(String::formatted("{} \u2014 {}", notification.attribution, title));
    }

    // "default" makes the whole notification clickable where the daemon shows actions as buttons.
    if (capabilities.actions)
        arguments.actions = { "default"_string, "Activate"_string };

    bool sticky = notification.data.require_interaction;
    arguments.hints.append({ "urgency"_string, sticky ? urgency_critical : urgency_normal });
    // A replacement alerts again only when the page asked to renotify.
    bool quiet_replacement = notification.replaces.has_value() && !notification.data.renotify;
    if (notification.data.silent == true || quiet_replacement)
        arguments.hints.append({ "suppress-sound"_string, true });
    arguments.hints.append({ "desktop-entry"_string, "org.ladybird.Ladybird"_string });
    if (notification.icon && notification.icon->width() <= icon_maximum_side && notification.icon->height() <= icon_maximum_side)
        arguments.hints.append({ "image-data"_string, image_data_for(*notification.icon) });

    if (sticky)
        arguments.expire_timeout = expire_timeout_never;
    else if (capabilities.persistence)
        arguments.expire_timeout = expire_timeout_default;
    else
        arguments.expire_timeout = expire_timeout_without_notification_center_ms;

    return arguments;
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWebView/NotificationFreedesktopArguments.h
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause

#pragma once

#include <AK/ByteBuffer.h>
#include <AK/String.h>
#include <AK/Types.h>
#include <AK/Variant.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibWebView/Export.h>
#include <LibWebView/NotificationBackend.h>

namespace WebView {

// What a Desktop Notifications daemon (org.freedesktop.Notifications) says it can show, from its GetCapabilities.
struct FreedesktopCapabilities {
    bool body { false };
    bool body_markup { false };
    bool persistence { false };
    bool actions { false };
};

// The "image-data" hint: raw RGBA pixels, (iiibiiay) on the wire.
struct FreedesktopImageData {
    i32 width { 0 };
    i32 height { 0 };
    i32 rowstride { 0 };
    bool has_alpha { true };
    i32 bits_per_sample { 8 };
    i32 channels { 4 };
    ByteBuffer pixels;
};

struct FreedesktopHint {
    String name;
    Variant<u8, bool, String, FreedesktopImageData> value;
};

// The arguments of a Notify call (app_name, replaces_id, app_icon, summary, body, actions, hints, expire_timeout).
struct FreedesktopNotifyArguments {
    String app_name;
    u32 replaces_id { 0 };
    String app_icon;
    String summary;
    String body;
    Vector<String> actions;
    Vector<FreedesktopHint> hints;
    i32 expire_timeout { 0 };
};

// Lays a notification out for the daemon: the attribution opens the body, markup is escaped only for a daemon that
// renders it, a notification that requires interaction never expires and is critical, and one shown by a daemon
// without a notification center (no "persistence") expires after 25 seconds rather than at the daemon's whim.
WEBVIEW_API FreedesktopNotifyArguments build_notify_arguments(PlatformNotification const&, FreedesktopCapabilities const&, u32 replaces_daemon_id);

}

#include <LibURL/Parser.h>
#include <LibWebView/Application.h>
#include <LibWebView/CanonicalTraversable.h>
#include <LibWebView/NotificationAttribution.h>
#include <LibWebView/NotificationManager.h>
#include <LibWebView/ViewImplementation.h>
#include <LibWebView/WebContentPage.h>

namespace WebView {

NotificationManager& NotificationManager::the()
{
    static auto& manager = *new NotificationManager;
    return manager;
}

NotificationBackend& NotificationManager::backend()
{
    if (!m_backend)
        set_backend(Application::the().create_notification_backend());
    return *m_backend;
}

void NotificationManager::set_backend(NonnullOwnPtr<NotificationBackend> backend)
{
    m_backend = move(backend);
    install_backend_callbacks();
}

void NotificationManager::install_backend_callbacks()
{
    m_backend->on_shown = [this](u64 id) { backend_did_show(id); };
    m_backend->on_failed = [this](u64 id) { backend_did_fail(id); };
    m_backend->on_clicked = [this](u64 id) { backend_did_click(id); };
    m_backend->on_closed = [this](u64 id, NotificationBackend::ByUser by_user) { backend_did_close(id, by_user); };
}

void NotificationManager::show(WebContentPage& page, u64 page_notification_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId document_id, URL::Origin top_level_origin, Web::NotificationsAPI::NotificationData data, RefPtr<Gfx::Bitmap const> icon)
{
    // Only the page that shows the tab's document may notify for that document. A page hosting a cross-site frame
    // in the tab has its own process, and its renderer refuses the notification; one that asks anyway is misbehaving,
    // and would have the frame's notification attributed to the site it's embedded in.
    if (!page.displays_tab()) {
        page.client().did_misbehave("did_request_show_notification"sv, "notification from a page that doesn't display its tab"sv);
        return;
    }

    // The renderer scales icons down before sending them; one that didn't is sending more than any backend takes.
    if (icon && (icon->width() > icon_maximum_side || icon->height() > icon_maximum_side))
        icon = nullptr;

    // The notification belongs to the top-level origin the browser knows its document by, never to one the page
    // reports. (An origin, not a URL's: An opaque origin, which file: pages have, is the same one for the life of the
    // document, where a URL would make a fresh one on every ask.)
    auto url = page.view().url();
    auto origin = move(top_level_origin);

    Record record {
        .id = m_next_id++,
        .page = page,
        .page_id = page.id(),
        .page_notification_id = page_notification_id,
        .document_id = document_id,
        .origin = origin,
        .origin_url = URL::Parser::basic_parse(origin.serialize()).value_or(url),
        .traversable = page.traversable().make_weak_ptr<CanonicalTraversable>(),
        .tag = data.tag,
        .is_private = page.view().session().is_private(),
    };

    // Same origin and same tag take the place of the earlier notification (the spec's oldNotification): Its page
    // hears that it closed, and the platform replaces it in place.
    Optional<u64> replaces;
    if (!data.tag.is_empty()) {
        for (size_t index = 0; index < m_records.size(); ++index) {
            auto const& existing = m_records[index];
            if (existing.tag == data.tag && existing.is_private == record.is_private && existing.origin.is_same_origin(origin)) {
                replaces = existing.id;
                report_closed(existing, false);
                m_records.remove(index);
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    // An origin shows a bounded number of notifications at a time; the oldest makes room for a new one.
    size_t live_for_origin = 0;
    for (auto const& existing : m_records) {
        if (existing.is_private == record.is_private && existing.origin.is_same_origin(origin))
            ++live_for_origin;
    }
    while (live_for_origin >= max_live_notifications_per_origin) {
        for (size_t index = 0; index < m_records.size(); ++index) {
            if (m_records[index].is_private == record.is_private && m_records[index].origin.is_same_origin(origin)) {
                close_record_from_browser(index);
                --live_for_origin;
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    auto id = record.id;
    m_records.append(move(record));
    backend().show(PlatformNotification {
        .id = id,
        .page_id = page.id(),
        .replaces = replaces,
        .data = move(data),
        .attribution = attribution_for_origin(origin),
        .icon = move(icon),
    });
}

void NotificationManager::close(WebContentPage& page, u64 page_notification_id)
{
    if (auto index = index_of(page, page_notification_id); index.has_value())
        backend().close(m_records[*index].id);
}

Vector<u64> NotificationManager::ids_without_a_page_for_testing(Web::PageId page_id) const
{
    Vector<u64> ids;
    for (auto const& record : m_records) {
        if (record.page_id == page_id && !record.page)
            ids.append(record.id);
    }
    return ids;
}

void NotificationManager::abandon(WebContentPage& page, u64 page_notification_id)
{
    if (auto index = index_of(page, page_notification_id); index.has_value())
        m_records[*index].page = nullptr;
}

void NotificationManager::click_handled(WebContentPage& page, u64 page_notification_id, bool into_focus)
{
    // Only a click the browser sent can bring the tab into focus; the notification itself may be gone by now, since
    // a click takes it down.
    auto pending = m_clicks_awaiting_reply.find_first_index_if([&](auto const& reply) {
        return reply.page == &page && reply.page_notification_id == page_notification_id;
    });
    if (!pending.has_value())
        return;
    m_clicks_awaiting_reply.remove(*pending);
    if (into_focus)
        Application::the().focus_page_from_notification(page);
}

void NotificationManager::page_did_close(WebContentPage& page)
{
    // The notifications stay up; only their way back to the page is gone.
    for (auto& record : m_records) {
        if (record.page == &page)
            record.page = nullptr;
    }
    m_clicks_awaiting_reply.remove_all_matching([&](auto const& reply) { return reply.page == &page; });
}

void NotificationManager::reset_page_for_testing(WebContentPage& page)
{
    Vector<u64> live;
    for (auto const& record : m_records) {
        if (record.page_id == page.id())
            live.append(record.id);
    }
    for (auto id : live) {
        if (auto index = index_of(id); index.has_value()) {
            m_records.remove(*index);
            backend().close(id);
        }
    }
    m_clicks_awaiting_reply.remove_all_matching([&](auto const& reply) { return reply.page == &page; });
}

Optional<u64> NotificationManager::id_for(WebContentPage const& page, u64 page_notification_id) const
{
    if (auto index = index_of(page, page_notification_id); index.has_value())
        return m_records[*index].id;
    return {};
}

Optional<size_t> NotificationManager::index_of(u64 id) const
{
    for (size_t index = 0; index < m_records.size(); ++index) {
        if (m_records[index].id == id)
            return index;
    }
    return {};
}

Optional<size_t> NotificationManager::index_of(WebContentPage const& page, u64 page_notification_id) const
{
    for (size_t index = 0; index < m_records.size(); ++index) {
        auto const& record = m_records[index];
        if (record.page == &page && record.page_notification_id == page_notification_id)
            return index;
    }
    return {};
}

// Withdraws a notification the browser itself decided to drop, and tells its page.
void NotificationManager::close_record_from_browser(size_t index)
{
    auto record = m_records.take(index);
    backend().close(record.id);
    report_closed(record, false);
}

void NotificationManager::report_closed(Record const& record, bool by_user)
{
    if (record.page && record.page->is_open())
        record.page->async_notification_closed(record.page_notification_id, by_user);
}

void NotificationManager::backend_did_show(u64 id)
{
    auto index = index_of(id);
    if (!index.has_value())
        return;
    auto const& record = m_records[*index];
    if (record.page && record.page->is_open())
        record.page->async_notification_shown(record.page_notification_id);
}

void NotificationManager::backend_did_fail(u64 id)
{
    auto index = index_of(id);
    if (!index.has_value())
        return;
    auto record = m_records.take(*index);
    if (record.page && record.page->is_open())
        record.page->async_notification_show_failed(record.page_notification_id);
}

void NotificationManager::backend_did_click(u64 id)
{
    auto index = index_of(id);
    if (!index.has_value())
        return;
    auto const& record = m_records[*index];
    if (record.page && record.page->is_open()) {
        // The click is the user's, so the page may open a window from its handler: The UI process checks the
        // activation it granted, not the one the renderer reports.
        record.page->give_user_activation();
        // The renderer gives the notification's window activation too. The UI process keeps that window's sticky
        // activation for documents in other processes.
        record.page->give_sticky_activation_to_window_of(record.document_id);
        m_clicks_awaiting_reply.append({ record.page, record.page_notification_id });
        record.page->async_notification_clicked(record.page_notification_id);
        return;
    }

    // The page is gone, so the click opens the site instead; the notification has done its job.
    auto origin_url = record.origin_url;
    auto page_id = record.page_id;
    auto traversable = record.traversable;
    auto is_private = record.is_private;
    m_records.remove(*index);
    Application::the().open_url_in_new_tab_from_notification(origin_url, page_id, traversable.ptr(), is_private);
}

void NotificationManager::backend_did_close(u64 id, NotificationBackend::ByUser by_user)
{
    auto index = index_of(id);
    if (!index.has_value())
        return;
    auto record = m_records.take(*index);
    report_closed(record, by_user == NotificationBackend::ByUser::Yes);
}

}

/*

#pragma once

#include <AK/NonnullOwnPtr.h>
#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <AK/RefPtr.h>
#include <AK/Utf16String.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <AK/WeakPtr.h>
#include <AK/kmalloc.h>
#include <LibGfx/Bitmap.h>
#include <LibURL/Origin.h>
#include <LibURL/URL.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/HTML/CrossProcessId.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/NotificationsAPI/NotificationData.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/Page/PageId.h>
#include <LibWebView/BrowsingSession.h>
#include <LibWebView/Forward.h>
#include <LibWebView/NotificationBackend.h>

namespace WebView {

// Owns the notifications the browser has shown, each with the page that asked for it and the origin it belongs to,
// and drives the platform backend. A notification outlives its page: a click on one whose page is gone opens the
// origin in a new tab. Same origin and same tag replace an earlier notification, and an origin keeps at most
// max_live_notifications_per_origin at a time.
class WEBVIEW_API NotificationManager {
public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    static NotificationManager& the();

    static constexpr size_t max_live_notifications_per_origin = 8;
    // The longest side an icon may have by the time it reaches a backend; a renderer sending more is misbehaving.
    static constexpr int icon_maximum_side = 128;

    // The origin is the top-level origin of the document the notification came from, as the UI process knows it.
    void show(WebContentPage&, u64 page_notification_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId document_id, URL::Origin top_level_origin, Web::NotificationsAPI::NotificationData, RefPtr<Gfx::Bitmap const> icon);
    void close(WebContentPage&, u64 page_notification_id);
    // The page's document is gone: The notification stays up, and a click on it opens the site in a new tab.
    void abandon(WebContentPage&, u64 page_notification_id);
    void click_handled(WebContentPage&, u64 page_notification_id, bool into_focus);
    void page_did_close(WebContentPage&);
    // Drops everything a page's tests left behind: its live notifications and the clicks it owes an answer for.
    void reset_page_for_testing(WebContentPage&);

    NotificationBackend& backend();
    void set_backend(NonnullOwnPtr<NotificationBackend>);

    // The manager's id of a page's notification, for tests that act on it through the backend.
    Optional<u64> id_for(WebContentPage const&, u64 page_notification_id) const;
    // The ids of a page's notifications whose document has gone, so a test can wait for the page to have said so.
    Vector<u64> ids_without_a_page_for_testing(Web::PageId) const;

private:
    struct Record {
        u64 id { 0 };
        // Null once the page has closed or abandoned the notification; the record then only serves a later click.
        RefPtr<WebContentPage> page;
        Web::PageId page_id;
        u64 page_notification_id { 0 };
        Web::HTML::CrossProcessId document_id;
        URL::Origin origin;
        // What a click opens once the page is gone.
        URL::URL origin_url;
        WeakPtr<CanonicalTraversable> traversable;
        Utf16String tag;
        // Tag replacement and the per-origin cap never reach across sessions, so a private window's notification
        // can't close a normal window's and the other way around.
        IsPrivate is_private { IsPrivate::No };
    };

    NotificationManager() = default;

    void install_backend_callbacks();
    Optional<size_t> index_of(u64 id) const;
    Optional<size_t> index_of(WebContentPage const&, u64 page_notification_id) const;
    void close_record_from_browser(size_t index);
    void report_closed(Record const&, bool by_user);

    void backend_did_show(u64 id);
    void backend_did_fail(u64 id);
    void backend_did_click(u64 id);
    void backend_did_close(u64 id, NotificationBackend::ByUser);

    // A click sent to a page, until the page says whether its handler let the tab come into focus.
    struct PendingClickReply {
        RefPtr<WebContentPage> page;
        u64 page_notification_id { 0 };
    };

    OwnPtr<NotificationBackend> m_backend;
    Vector<Record> m_records;
    Vector<PendingClickReply> m_clicks_awaiting_reply;
    u64 m_next_id { 1 };
};

}

#include <LibWebView/NowPlayingInfo.h>
#include <math.h>

namespace WebView {

NowPlayingInfo now_playing_info_for(Optional<NowPlayingState> const& state, MonotonicTime now)
{
    NowPlayingInfo info;
    if (!state.has_value())
        return info;

    switch (state->playback_state) {
    case Web::Bindings::MediaSessionPlaybackState::Playing:
        info.playback_status = NowPlayingPlaybackStatus::Playing;
        break;
    case Web::Bindings::MediaSessionPlaybackState::Paused:
        info.playback_status = NowPlayingPlaybackStatus::Paused;
        break;
    case Web::Bindings::MediaSessionPlaybackState::None:
        break;
    }
    info.title = state->title;
    info.artist = state->artist;
    info.album = state->album;

    bool playing = info.playback_status == NowPlayingPlaybackStatus::Playing;
    info.playback_rate = playing ? 1.0 : 0.0;
    if (state->position.has_value()) {
        auto const& position = *state->position;
        if (isfinite(position.duration) && position.duration >= 0)
            info.duration = position.duration;
        if (playing) {
            info.playback_rate.clear();
            if (isfinite(position.playback_rate))
                info.playback_rate = position.playback_rate;
        }
        double elapsed = position.position;
        if (playing)
            elapsed += (now - position.last_position_updated_time).to_seconds_f64() * position.playback_rate;
        if (isfinite(elapsed)) {
            elapsed = max(0.0, elapsed);
            if (info.duration.has_value())
                elapsed = min(elapsed, *info.duration);
            info.elapsed_time = elapsed;
        }
    }

    using Web::Bindings::MediaSessionAction;
    auto const& actions = state->supported_actions;
    info.commands.play = actions.contains_slow(MediaSessionAction::Play);
    info.commands.pause = actions.contains_slow(MediaSessionAction::Pause);
    info.commands.toggle_play_pause = info.commands.play && info.commands.pause;
    info.commands.stop = actions.contains_slow(MediaSessionAction::Stop);
    info.commands.next_track = actions.contains_slow(MediaSessionAction::Nexttrack);
    info.commands.previous_track = actions.contains_slow(MediaSessionAction::Previoustrack);
    info.commands.change_playback_position = info.duration.has_value() && actions.contains_slow(MediaSessionAction::Seekto);
    return info;
}

}

#pragma once

#include <LibWebView/MediaSessionCoordinator.h>

namespace WebView {

enum class NowPlayingPlaybackStatus {
    Playing,
    Paused,
    Stopped,
};

struct NowPlayingInfo {
    NowPlayingPlaybackStatus playback_status { NowPlayingPlaybackStatus::Stopped };
    String title;
    String artist;
    String album;
    Optional<double> duration;
    Optional<double> elapsed_time;
    Optional<double> playback_rate { 0.0 };
    struct {
        bool play { false };
        bool pause { false };
        bool toggle_play_pause { false };
        bool stop { false };
        bool next_track { false };
        bool previous_track { false };
        bool change_playback_position { false };
    } commands;
};

WEBVIEW_API NowPlayingInfo now_playing_info_for(Optional<NowPlayingState> const&, MonotonicTime now);

}

/*
