#include <AK/AnyOf.h>
#include <LibURL/URL.h>
#include <LibWebView/Application.h>
#include <LibWebView/CanonicalTraversable.h>
#include <LibWebView/PageTranslation.h>
#include <LibWebView/Settings.h>
#include <LibWebView/URL.h>
#include <LibWebView/ViewImplementation.h>
#include <LibWebView/WebContentPage.h>

namespace WebView {

// The languages the user reads, most preferred first, one per language whatever its regions.
static Vector<String> languages_the_user_reads()
{
    Vector<String> languages;
    for (auto const& language : Application::settings().languages()) {
        if (!any_of(languages, [&](auto const& existing) { return is_same_language(existing, language); }))
            languages.append(language);
    }
    return languages;
}

PageTranslation::PageTranslation(ViewImplementation& view)
    : m_view(view)
{
}

PageTranslation::~PageTranslation()
{
    close_session();
}

bool PageTranslation::is_offered() const
{
    return is_translated() || !m_target_languages.is_empty();
}

void PageTranslation::translate_to(String const& target_language)
{
    auto* translator = Application::the().translator();
    if (!translator || !m_page_language.has_value())
        return;
    // The translation picked now replaces the one a download was for, so the download's completion doesn't undo it.
    m_translate_after_download.clear();
    if (m_target_language.has_value() && is_same_language(*m_target_language, target_language))
        return;

    // A page translated into another language is shown in the original first, since its text is already translated.
    if (is_translated()) {
        m_previous_translation = PreviousTranslation { *m_page_language, target_language, current_site() };
        show_original();
        return;
    }

    m_session_id = translator->create_session(*m_page_language, target_language, Application::settings().translation_prefers_higher_quality());
    m_target_language = target_language;
    m_translated_site = current_site();

    m_view.traversable().for_each_hosting_page([&](WebContentPage& page) {
        if (page.is_open())
            page.async_start_translation(*m_page_language, target_language);
    });

    did_change_state();
}

void PageTranslation::show_original()
{
    if (!is_translated())
        return;
    // The reload brings the original back; the translation the user turned off isn't carried over to it. The page stays
    // translated until the reload replaces its document, which may not happen, e.g. if the page asks the user to stay.
    if (!m_previous_translation.has_value() || is_same_language(m_previous_translation->target_language, *m_target_language))
        m_skip_continuation_for_next_document = true;
    stop_translating_pages();
    m_view.reload();
}

bool PageTranslation::translation_can_switch_models() const
{
    if (!m_target_language.has_value())
        return false;
    auto target = m_target_languages.find_if([&](auto const& target) { return is_same_language(target.language, *m_target_language); });
    return !target.is_end() && target->higher_quality_available && !target->faster_after_download;
}

void PageTranslation::translate_again()
{
    if (!is_translated())
        return;
    m_previous_translation = PreviousTranslation { *m_page_language, *m_target_language, current_site() };
    stop_translating_pages();
    m_view.reload();
}

// The platform's settings download the languages, and the page is translated once they're ready, since that's what
// the user downloads them for.
void PageTranslation::download_languages_for(String const& target_language)
{
    auto* translator = Application::the().translator();
    if (!translator || !any_of(m_target_languages, [&](auto const& target) { return is_same_language(target.language, target_language); }))
        return;
    m_translate_after_download = target_language;
    translator->open_language_download_settings();
}

void PageTranslation::prefer_higher_quality_models(bool prefers_higher_quality)
{
    Application::settings().set_translation_prefers_higher_quality(prefers_higher_quality);
    ViewImplementation::for_each_view([](ViewImplementation& view) {
        view.page_translation().did_change_model_preference();
        return IterationDecision::Continue;
    });
    // The text translated so far stays as it is in the other tabs, but this tab's page is shown in the other models'
    // translation, since the user chose them for it. A translation with only one model installed stays as it is, since
    // a reload would lose the page's state and change nothing.
    if (translation_can_switch_models())
        translate_again();
}

void PageTranslation::did_finish_loading()
{
    if (is_translated() || !Application::the().translator())
        return;

    detect_page_language([this] {
        // NB: This runs from detect_page_language()'s callbacks, which check that the translation is still alive.
        auto previous_translation = exchange(m_previous_translation, {});
        if (!previous_translation.has_value() || !m_page_language.has_value())
            return;
        // A translated page's next page is translated too, if it's in the same language on the same site.
        if (!is_same_language(previous_translation->source_language, *m_page_language) || previous_translation->site != current_site())
            return;
        auto target = m_target_languages.find_if([&](auto const& target) { return !target.needs_download && is_same_language(target.language, previous_translation->target_language); });
        if (!target.is_end())
            translate_to(target->language);
    });
}

void PageTranslation::did_change_active_document()
{
    ++m_generation;
    m_pending_samples.clear();

    // The next page continues the translation, unless the user showed the original. A translation into another language
    // that the user asked for while the page was translated is recorded already, and is kept.
    if (exchange(m_skip_continuation_for_next_document, false))
        m_previous_translation.clear();
    else if (is_translated() && !m_previous_translation.has_value())
        m_previous_translation = PreviousTranslation { *m_page_language, *m_target_language, m_translated_site };

    if (is_translated())
        stop_translating_pages();
    close_session();
    m_translate_after_download.clear();
    m_page_language.clear();
    m_target_languages.clear();
    m_target_language.clear();
    did_change_state();
}

void PageTranslation::did_change_installed_languages()
{
    if (!m_page_language.has_value())
        return;

    update_target_languages([this] {
        // This runs from update_target_languages()'s callback, which checks that the translation is still alive.
        auto* translator = Application::the().translator();
        // The units not yet translated get the faster models as soon as they're installed.
        if (m_session_id.has_value())
            translator->choose_session_model_again(*m_session_id, Application::settings().translation_prefers_higher_quality());

        if (!m_translate_after_download.has_value())
            return;
        auto target = m_target_languages.find_if([&](auto const& target) { return !target.needs_download && !target.faster_after_download && is_same_language(target.language, *m_translate_after_download); });
        if (target.is_end())
            return;
        m_translate_after_download.clear();
        translate_to(target->language);
    });
}

void PageTranslation::did_change_model_preference()
{
    if (auto* translator = Application::the().translator(); translator && m_session_id.has_value())
        translator->choose_session_model_again(*m_session_id, Application::settings().translation_prefers_higher_quality());
    did_change_state();
}

void PageTranslation::did_create_page(WebContentPage& page)
{
    if (is_translated())
        page.async_start_translation(*m_page_language, *m_target_language);
}

void PageTranslation::did_get_language_sample(Badge<WebContentPage>, u64 request_id, Web::TranslationLanguageSample sample)
{
    if (sample.text.length_in_code_units() > MAXIMUM_LANGUAGE_SAMPLE_LENGTH)
        sample.text = Utf16String::from_utf16(sample.text.substring_view(0, MAXIMUM_LANGUAGE_SAMPLE_LENGTH));
    if (auto callback = m_pending_samples.take(request_id); callback.has_value())
        (*callback)(move(sample));
}

void PageTranslation::did_request_translation(Badge<WebContentPage>, WebContentPage& requesting_page, Web::TranslationUnit unit)
{
    auto* translator = Application::the().translator();
    if (!translator || !m_session_id.has_value()) {
        requesting_page.async_did_translate({ unit.id, {} });
        return;
    }

    size_t unit_length = 0;
    for (auto const& run : unit.runs)
        unit_length += run.text.length_in_code_units();
    auto& units_in_flight = m_units_in_flight.ensure(&requesting_page);
    if (units_in_flight >= MAXIMUM_UNITS_IN_FLIGHT_PER_PAGE || unit_length > MAXIMUM_UNIT_LENGTH) {
        requesting_page.async_did_translate({ unit.id, {} });
        return;
    }
    ++units_in_flight;

    auto unit_id = unit.id;
    // NB: Closing the session drops this callback, and the session is closed before the translation is destroyed.
    translator->translate(*m_session_id, move(unit), [this, page = NonnullRefPtr { requesting_page }, unit_id](Optional<Vector<Web::TranslationRun>> runs) {
        if (auto it = m_units_in_flight.find(page.ptr()); it != m_units_in_flight.end() && --it->value == 0)
            m_units_in_flight.remove(it);
        if (page->is_open())
            page->async_did_translate({ unit_id, move(runs) });
    });
}

void PageTranslation::translate_for_testing(Badge<WebContentPage>, String target_language)
{
    detect_page_language([this, target_language = move(target_language)] {
        translate_to(target_language);
    });
}

void PageTranslation::detect_page_language(Function<void()> on_complete)
{
    auto request_id = m_next_sample_request_id++;
    auto generation = m_generation;
    m_pending_samples.set(request_id, [this, generation, on_complete = move(on_complete)](Web::TranslationLanguageSample sample) mutable {
        auto* translator = Application::the().translator();
        if (!translator || generation != m_generation)
            return;
        // The tab may be closed before the translator answers.
        translator->detect_language(sample, [weak_this = make_weak_ptr(), generation, on_complete = move(on_complete)](Optional<String> language) mutable {
            if (weak_this)
                weak_this->did_detect_page_language(generation, move(language), move(on_complete));
        });
    });
    m_view.page().async_request_translation_language_sample(request_id);
}

void PageTranslation::did_detect_page_language(u64 generation, Optional<String> language, Function<void()> on_complete)
{
    auto* translator = Application::the().translator();
    if (!translator || generation != m_generation)
        return;

    m_page_language = move(language);
    m_target_languages.clear();
    did_change_state();

    update_target_languages(move(on_complete));
}

void PageTranslation::update_target_languages(Function<void()> on_complete)
{
    auto* translator = Application::the().translator();
    if (!translator)
        return;

    // A page in a language the user reads isn't offered for translation.
    auto languages = languages_the_user_reads();
    if (!m_page_language.has_value() || any_of(languages, [&](auto const& language) { return is_same_language(language, *m_page_language); })) {
        if (on_complete)
            on_complete();
        return;
    }
    if (languages.size() > MAXIMUM_OFFERED_LANGUAGES)
        languages.shrink(MAXIMUM_OFFERED_LANGUAGES);

    auto request = ++m_target_languages_request;
    translator->target_languages(*m_page_language, languages, [weak_this = make_weak_ptr(), generation = m_generation, request, on_complete = move(on_complete)](Vector<Translator::TargetLanguage> target_languages) {
        if (!weak_this || generation != weak_this->m_generation)
            return;
        // Lookups can finish out of order. A result older than the one applied already is dropped, so it can't bring
        // back the offer of a download that's done; its callback still runs, with the newer languages.
        if (request > weak_this->m_applied_target_languages_request) {
            weak_this->m_applied_target_languages_request = request;
            weak_this->m_target_languages = move(target_languages);
            weak_this->did_change_state();
        }
        if (on_complete)
            on_complete();
    });
}

// The pages forget the translation, so a document they load next isn't translated unless it's asked for.
void PageTranslation::stop_translating_pages()
{
    m_view.traversable().for_each_hosting_page([](WebContentPage& page) {
        if (page.is_open())
            page.async_stop_translation();
    });
}

void PageTranslation::close_session()
{
    m_units_in_flight.clear();
    if (!m_session_id.has_value())
        return;
    if (auto* translator = Application::the().translator())
        translator->close_session(*m_session_id);
    m_session_id.clear();
}

void PageTranslation::did_change_state()
{
    m_view.did_change_state();
}

Optional<String> PageTranslation::current_site() const
{
    auto url = m_view.url();
    if (!url.host().has_value())
        return {};
    if (auto domain = url.host()->registrable_domain(); domain.has_value())
        return domain;
    return url.host()->serialize();
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWebView/PageTranslation.h
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#pragma once

#include <AK/Function.h>
#include <AK/HashMap.h>
#include <AK/NonnullRefPtr.h>
#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <AK/String.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <AK/Weakable.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/Page/Translation.h>
#include <LibWebView/Export.h>
#include <LibWebView/Forward.h>
#include <LibWebView/Translator.h>

namespace WebView {

// Translating one tab's page: working out which language the page is in, offering to translate it into a language the
// user reads, translating it with the platform translator, and showing the original again.
//
// The pages of every process that hosts a document of the tab translate their own documents. They send their text here
// one unit at a time, and get each unit's translation back.
class PageTranslation : public Weakable<PageTranslation> {
    AK_MAKE_NONCOPYABLE(PageTranslation);
    AK_MAKE_NONMOVABLE(PageTranslation);
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

public:
    // How many languages are offered at most.
    static constexpr size_t MAXIMUM_OFFERED_LANGUAGES = 5;
    // A page sends a few units at a time, of a paragraph's text each. One that sends more is answered without them being
    // translated, so a misbehaving WebContent process can't queue up unbounded work for the translator.
    static constexpr size_t MAXIMUM_UNITS_IN_FLIGHT_PER_PAGE = 8;
    static constexpr size_t MAXIMUM_UNIT_LENGTH = 65536;
    // The language sample is enough text to tell its language by, and no more is looked at.
    static constexpr size_t MAXIMUM_LANGUAGE_SAMPLE_LENGTH = 4096;

    explicit PageTranslation(ViewImplementation&);
    ~PageTranslation();

    // The language the page is shown in, if it's translated.
    Optional<String> const& target_language() const { return m_target_language; }
    bool is_translated() const { return m_target_language.has_value(); }

    // Whether the page can be translated into a language the user reads, perhaps after a download, or already is.
    WEBVIEW_API bool is_offered() const;

    // The languages the page can be translated into, perhaps after a download, most preferred first.
    Vector<Translator::TargetLanguage> const& target_languages() const { return m_target_languages; }

    WEBVIEW_API void translate_to(String const& target_language);
    // Shows the page as it was before it was translated, by loading it again.
    WEBVIEW_API void show_original();
    // Opens the platform's settings to download what translating into the target language needs, and translates the
    // page once it's done.
    WEBVIEW_API void download_languages_for(String const& target_language);
    // Saves the user's choice of models, and translates the page again with them if that changes its translation.
    WEBVIEW_API void prefer_higher_quality_models(bool);

    void did_finish_loading();
    void did_change_active_document();
    // A language's download started or finished, so the targets offered may have changed.
    void did_change_installed_languages();
    // The user chose other models to translate with.
    void did_change_model_preference();
    // A page that hosts a document of the tab starts translating it if the tab is translated.
    void did_create_page(WebContentPage&);

    void did_get_language_sample(Badge<WebContentPage>, u64 request_id, Web::TranslationLanguageSample);
    void did_request_translation(Badge<WebContentPage>, WebContentPage&, Web::TranslationUnit);
    // For tests: Works out which language the page is in, then translates it into the target language.
    void translate_for_testing(Badge<WebContentPage>, String target_language);

private:
    struct PreviousTranslation {
        String source_language;
        String target_language;
        Optional<String> site;
    };

    // Translates the page again from its original, e.g. with other models.
    void translate_again();
    bool translation_can_switch_models() const;
    void stop_translating_pages();
    void detect_page_language(Function<void()> on_complete = {});
    void did_detect_page_language(u64 generation, Optional<String> language, Function<void()> on_complete);
    void update_target_languages(Function<void()> on_complete = {});
    void close_session();
    void did_change_state();
    Optional<String> current_site() const;

    ViewImplementation& m_view;

    Optional<String> m_page_language;
    Vector<Translator::TargetLanguage> m_target_languages;
    Optional<String> m_target_language;
    // The site of the page that was translated, for continuing on the next page of that site.
    Optional<String> m_translated_site;
    Optional<Translator::SessionId> m_session_id;
    HashMap<WebContentPage const*, size_t> m_units_in_flight;

    // A translation in force when the user followed a link, which the next page of the same site continues.
    Optional<PreviousTranslation> m_previous_translation;
    // Set when the original is shown again, so the reload that shows it isn't translated straight away.
    bool m_skip_continuation_for_next_document { false };
    // The language the user is downloading to translate the page into, which it's translated into once the download is
    // done.
    Optional<String> m_translate_after_download;

    // Answers to requests made for an earlier document are ignored.
    u64 m_generation { 0 };
    u64 m_target_languages_request { 0 };
    u64 m_applied_target_languages_request { 0 };
    u64 m_next_sample_request_id { 0 };
    HashMap<u64, Function<void(Web::TranslationLanguageSample)>> m_pending_samples;
};

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWebView/PermissionManager.cpp
/*

#include <AK/JsonArray.h>
#include <AK/JsonObject.h>
#include <LibURL/Parser.h>
#include <LibWebView/PermissionManager.h>
#include <LibWebView/Utilities.h>

namespace WebView {

using Web::Permissions::EffectiveState;
using Web::Permissions::PermissionName;
using Web::Permissions::PromptOutcome;

static constexpr u8 DISMISSALS_BEFORE_EMBARGO = 3;
static constexpr u8 IGNORES_BEFORE_EMBARGO = 4;
static constexpr i64 PERSISTENCE_VERSION = 1;

static StringView decision_to_string(PermissionDecision decision)
{
    switch (decision) {
    case PermissionDecision::Allow:
        return "allow"sv;
    case PermissionDecision::AllowOnce:
        return "allow-once"sv;
    case PermissionDecision::Block:
        return "block"sv;
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

static Optional<PermissionDecision> persisted_decision_from_string(StringView decision)
{
    if (decision == "allow"sv)
        return PermissionDecision::Allow;
    if (decision == "block"sv)
        return PermissionDecision::Block;
    return {};
}

static Optional<URL::Origin> origin_from_string(StringView serialized_origin)
{
    auto url = URL::Parser::basic_parse(serialized_origin);
    if (!url.has_value())
        return {};
    auto origin = url->origin();
    if (origin.is_opaque())
        return {};
    return origin;
}

NonnullOwnPtr<PermissionManager> PermissionManager::create_for_ordinary_session(ByteString persistence_path)
{
    auto manager = adopt_own(*new PermissionManager(move(persistence_path), {}));
    manager->load();
    return manager;
}

NonnullOwnPtr<PermissionManager> PermissionManager::create_for_private_session(PermissionManager& ordinary_session)
{
    VERIFY(!ordinary_session.m_ordinary_session);
    auto manager = adopt_own(*new PermissionManager({}, ordinary_session.make_weak_ptr<PermissionManager>()));
    ordinary_session.register_observer(*manager);
    return manager;
}

PermissionManager::PermissionManager(Optional<ByteString> persistence_path, WeakPtr<PermissionManager> ordinary_session)
    : m_persistence_path(move(persistence_path))
    , m_ordinary_session(move(ordinary_session))
{
}

PermissionManager::~PermissionManager()
{
    if (m_ordinary_session)
        m_ordinary_session->unregister_observer(*this);
}

void PermissionManager::permissions_changed(PermissionManager const&)
{
    // The ordinary session changed, and a block there may change what this private session reports.
    did_change();
}

UnixDateTime PermissionManager::now() const
{
    if (m_clock)
        return m_clock();
    if (m_ordinary_session)
        return m_ordinary_session->now();
    return UnixDateTime::now();
}

bool PermissionManager::embargo_is_live(Entry const& entry) const
{
    return entry.embargo_until.has_value() && now() < *entry.embargo_until;
}

EffectiveState PermissionManager::global_default(PermissionName name) const
{
    if (m_ordinary_session)
        return m_ordinary_session->global_default(name);
    switch (name) {
    case PermissionName::Geolocation:
        return m_geolocation_default;
    case PermissionName::Microphone:
        return m_microphone_default;
    case PermissionName::Notifications:
        return m_notifications_default;
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

bool PermissionManager::os_denies_geolocation() const
{
    if (m_ordinary_session)
        return m_ordinary_session->os_denies_geolocation();
    return m_os_denies_geolocation;
}

bool PermissionManager::ordinary_session_blocks(PermissionName name, URL::Origin const& origin) const
{
    return m_ordinary_session && m_ordinary_session->decision(name, origin) == PermissionDecision::Block;
}

PermissionManager::Entry const* PermissionManager::find_entry(PermissionName name, URL::Origin const& origin) const
{
    for (auto const& entry : m_entries) {
        if (entry.name == name && entry.origin.is_same_origin(origin))
            return &entry;
    }
    return nullptr;
}

PermissionManager::Entry& PermissionManager::ensure_entry(PermissionName name, URL::Origin const& origin)
{
    if (auto const* entry = find_entry(name, origin))
        return const_cast<Entry&>(*entry);
    m_entries.append({ .name = name, .origin = origin, .decision = {}, .decided_at = now(), .hidden_since = {}, .dismissals = 0, .ignores = 0, .embargo_until = {} });
    return m_entries.last();
}

void PermissionManager::remove_empty_entries()
{
    m_entries.remove_all_matching([](auto const& entry) { return entry.is_empty(); });
}

EffectiveState PermissionManager::effective_state(PermissionName name, URL::Origin const& origin) const
{
    if (ordinary_session_blocks(name, origin))
        return EffectiveState::Denied;

    if (auto const* entry = find_entry(name, origin)) {
        if (entry->decision == PermissionDecision::Block)
            return EffectiveState::Denied;

        // AD-HOC: While the user's dismissals keep a site from asking, it reads as denied, though nothing is stored as
        //         a decision.
        if (embargo_is_live(*entry))
            return EffectiveState::Denied;

        if (entry->decision.has_value()) {
            // A feature the user turned off for every site, or the system denies the browser, stays off for a site
            // the user allowed too; the decision is kept for when it's back on.
            if (global_default(name) == EffectiveState::Denied)
                return EffectiveState::Denied;
            if (name == PermissionName::Geolocation && os_denies_geolocation())
                return EffectiveState::Denied;
            return EffectiveState::Granted;
        }
    }

    return global_default(name);
}

static String generation_key(PermissionName name, URL::Origin const& origin)
{
    return MUST(String::formatted("{} {}", Web::Permissions::to_string(name), origin.serialize()));
}

// A private session's generation moves with the ordinary session's for the same site too, so an answer given while the
// ordinary session blocked the site (and even unblocked it again) is stale.
u64 PermissionManager::decision_generation(PermissionName name, URL::Origin const& origin) const
{
    auto generation = m_generations.get(generation_key(name, origin)).value_or(0);
    if (m_ordinary_session)
        generation += m_ordinary_session->decision_generation(name, origin);
    return generation;
}

void PermissionManager::bump_generation(PermissionName name, URL::Origin const& origin)
{
    auto key = generation_key(name, origin);
    m_generations.set(key, m_generations.get(key).value_or(0) + 1);
}

// A private session reads the ordinary session's blocks as decisions of its own, since they bind it as well.
Optional<PermissionDecision> PermissionManager::decision(PermissionName name, URL::Origin const& origin) const
{
    if (ordinary_session_blocks(name, origin))
        return PermissionDecision::Block;
    if (auto const* entry = find_entry(name, origin))
        return entry->decision;
    return {};
}

void PermissionManager::set_decision(PermissionName name, URL::Origin const& origin, Optional<PermissionDecision> decision)
{
    if (origin.is_opaque())
        return;
    bump_generation(name, origin);

    auto const* existing = find_entry(name, origin);
    if (existing && existing->decision == decision && existing->dismissals == 0 && existing->ignores == 0 && !existing->embargo_until.has_value())
        return;
    if (!existing && !decision.has_value())
        return;

    auto& entry = ensure_entry(name, origin);
    entry.decision = decision;
    entry.decided_at = now();
    entry.hidden_since = {};
    entry.dismissals = 0;
    entry.ignores = 0;
    entry.embargo_until = {};
    if (decision == PermissionDecision::AllowOnce && presence_of(origin) == OriginPresence::Hidden)
        entry.hidden_since = now();

    remove_empty_entries();
    did_change();
}

void PermissionManager::reset_origin(URL::Origin const& origin)
{
    for (auto name : { PermissionName::Geolocation, PermissionName::Microphone, PermissionName::Notifications })
        bump_generation(name, origin);

    auto removed = m_entries.remove_all_matching([&](auto const& entry) { return entry.origin.is_same_origin(origin); });
    if (removed)
        did_change();
}

void PermissionManager::record_prompt_outcome(PermissionName name, URL::Origin const& origin, PromptOutcome outcome)
{
    if (origin.is_opaque())
        return;

    switch (outcome) {
    case PromptOutcome::AllowAlways:
        set_decision(name, origin, PermissionDecision::Allow);
        return;
    case PromptOutcome::AllowOnce:
        set_decision(name, origin, PermissionDecision::AllowOnce);
        return;
    case PromptOutcome::Block:
        set_decision(name, origin, PermissionDecision::Block);
        return;
    case PromptOutcome::Cancelled:
        return;
    case PromptOutcome::Dismissed:
    case PromptOutcome::Ignored:
        break;
    }

    bump_generation(name, origin);

    auto& entry = ensure_entry(name, origin);
    if (outcome == PromptOutcome::Dismissed)
        ++entry.dismissals;
    else
        ++entry.ignores;

    if (entry.dismissals >= DISMISSALS_BEFORE_EMBARGO || entry.ignores >= IGNORES_BEFORE_EMBARGO) {
        entry.dismissals = 0;
        entry.ignores = 0;
        entry.embargo_until = now() + m_timeouts.embargo;
    }

    did_change();
}

PermissionManager::OriginPresence PermissionManager::presence_of(URL::Origin const& origin) const
{
    auto presence = OriginPresence::Absent;
    for (auto const& it : m_views) {
        if (!it.value.origin.is_same_origin(origin))
            continue;
        if (it.value.visible)
            return OriginPresence::Visible;
        presence = OriginPresence::Hidden;
    }
    return presence;
}

bool PermissionManager::apply_presence()
{
    auto changed = false;
    auto deadlines_moved = false;
    for (auto& entry : m_entries) {
        if (entry.decision != PermissionDecision::AllowOnce)
            continue;

        switch (presence_of(entry.origin)) {
        case OriginPresence::Absent:
            entry.decision = {};
            entry.hidden_since = {};
            changed = true;
            break;
        case OriginPresence::Hidden:
            if (!entry.hidden_since.has_value()) {
                entry.hidden_since = now();
                deadlines_moved = true;
            }
            break;
        case OriginPresence::Visible:
            if (entry.hidden_since.has_value()) {
                entry.hidden_since = {};
                deadlines_moved = true;
            }
            break;
        }
    }

    if (changed)
        remove_empty_entries();
    if (deadlines_moved && !changed && on_deadlines_changed)
        on_deadlines_changed();
    return changed;
}

void PermissionManager::set_view_presence(u64 view_id, URL::Origin const& origin, bool visible)
{
    m_views.set(view_id, { origin, visible });
    if (apply_presence())
        did_change();
}

void PermissionManager::remove_view(u64 view_id)
{
    if (!m_views.remove(view_id))
        return;
    if (apply_presence())
        did_change();
}

void PermissionManager::set_global_default(PermissionName name, EffectiveState state)
{
    VERIFY(!m_ordinary_session);
    auto& current = [&]() -> EffectiveState& {
        switch (name) {
        case PermissionName::Geolocation:
            return m_geolocation_default;
        case PermissionName::Microphone:
            return m_microphone_default;
        case PermissionName::Notifications:
            return m_notifications_default;
        }
        VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
    }();
    if (current == state)
        return;
    current = state;
    did_change();
}

void PermissionManager::set_os_denies_geolocation(bool denies)
{
    VERIFY(!m_ordinary_session);
    if (m_os_denies_geolocation == denies)
        return;
    m_os_denies_geolocation = denies;
    did_change();
}

Web::Permissions::PermissionSnapshot PermissionManager::snapshot() const
{
    Web::Permissions::PermissionSnapshot snapshot;
    snapshot.revision = m_revision;
    snapshot.geolocation_default = global_default(PermissionName::Geolocation);
    snapshot.microphone_default = global_default(PermissionName::Microphone);
    snapshot.notifications_default = global_default(PermissionName::Notifications);

    auto add_entry = [&](PermissionName name, URL::Origin const& origin) {
        auto state = effective_state(name, origin);
        if (state == global_default(name))
            return;
        for (auto const& existing : snapshot.entries) {
            if (existing.name == name && existing.top_level_origin.is_same_origin(origin))
                return;
        }
        snapshot.entries.append({ origin, name, state });
    };

    for (auto const& entry : m_entries)
        add_entry(entry.name, entry.origin);
    if (m_ordinary_session) {
        for (auto const& entry : m_ordinary_session->m_entries) {
            if (entry.decision == PermissionDecision::Block)
                add_entry(entry.name, entry.origin);
        }
    }

    return snapshot;
}

Web::Permissions::PermissionSnapshot PermissionManager::snapshot_for(Vector<URL::Origin> const& origins) const
{
    auto full = snapshot();
    full.entries.remove_all_matching([&](auto const& entry) {
        return !origins.contains_slow(entry.top_level_origin);
    });
    full.origins = origins;
    return full;
}

Vector<SiteDecision> PermissionManager::site_decisions(PermissionName name) const
{
    Vector<SiteDecision> decisions;
    for (auto const& entry : m_entries) {
        if (entry.name == name && entry.decision.has_value())
            decisions.append({ entry.origin, *entry.decision });
    }
    return decisions;
}

Optional<UnixDateTime> PermissionManager::next_deadline() const
{
    Optional<UnixDateTime> deadline;
    auto consider = [&](UnixDateTime candidate) {
        if (!deadline.has_value() || candidate < *deadline)
            deadline = candidate;
    };

    for (auto const& entry : m_entries) {
        if (entry.decision == PermissionDecision::AllowOnce) {
            consider(entry.decided_at + m_timeouts.one_time_maximum);
            if (entry.hidden_since.has_value())
                consider(*entry.hidden_since + m_timeouts.background);
        }
        if (entry.embargo_until.has_value())
            consider(*entry.embargo_until);
    }
    return deadline;
}

void PermissionManager::run_expiry()
{
    auto current_time = now();
    auto changed = false;

    for (auto& entry : m_entries) {
        if (entry.decision == PermissionDecision::AllowOnce) {
            auto lifetime_ended = current_time >= entry.decided_at + m_timeouts.one_time_maximum;
            auto hidden_too_long = entry.hidden_since.has_value() && current_time >= *entry.hidden_since + m_timeouts.background;
            if (lifetime_ended || hidden_too_long) {
                entry.decision = {};
                entry.hidden_since = {};
                changed = true;
            }
        }
        if (entry.embargo_until.has_value() && current_time >= *entry.embargo_until) {
            entry.embargo_until = {};
            changed = true;
        }
    }

    if (changed) {
        remove_empty_entries();
        did_change();
    }
}

void PermissionManager::register_observer(PermissionManagerObserver& observer)
{
    m_observers.append(&observer);
}

void PermissionManager::unregister_observer(PermissionManagerObserver& observer)
{
    m_observers.remove_first_matching([&](auto* candidate) { return candidate == &observer; });
}

void PermissionManager::age_origin_for_testing(URL::Origin const& origin, AK::Duration duration)
{
    for (auto& entry : m_entries) {
        if (!entry.origin.is_same_origin(origin))
            continue;
        entry.decided_at -= duration;
        if (entry.hidden_since.has_value())
            *entry.hidden_since -= duration;
        if (entry.embargo_until.has_value())
            *entry.embargo_until -= duration;
    }
    run_expiry();
}

u8 PermissionManager::dismissals_for_testing(PermissionName name, URL::Origin const& top_level_origin) const
{
    auto const* entry = find_entry(name, top_level_origin);
    return entry ? entry->dismissals : 0;
}

void PermissionManager::set_clock_for_testing(Function<UnixDateTime()> clock)
{
    m_clock = move(clock);
}

void PermissionManager::did_change()
{
    ++m_revision;
    persist();

    auto observers = m_observers;
    for (auto* observer : observers)
        observer->permissions_changed(*this);
}

void PermissionManager::load()
{
    if (!m_persistence_path.has_value())
        return;

    auto json = read_json_file(*m_persistence_path);
    if (json.is_error())
        return;
    if (json.value().get_integer<i64>("version"sv) != PERSISTENCE_VERSION)
        return;

    auto read_key = [](JsonObject const& object) -> Optional<Entry> {
        auto origin = object.get_string("origin"sv).map([](auto const& string) { return origin_from_string(string); });
        auto name = object.get_string("permission"sv).map([](auto const& string) { return Web::Permissions::permission_name_from_string(string); });
        if (!origin.has_value() || !origin->has_value() || !name.has_value() || !name->has_value())
            return {};
        return Entry { .name = **name, .origin = origin->release_value(), .decision = {}, .decided_at = UnixDateTime::epoch(), .hidden_since = {}, .dismissals = 0, .ignores = 0, .embargo_until = {} };
    };

    if (auto decisions = json.value().get_array("decisions"sv); decisions.has_value()) {
        decisions->for_each([&](JsonValue const& value) {
            if (!value.is_object())
                return;
            auto entry = read_key(value.as_object());
            auto decision = value.as_object().get_string("decision"sv).map([](auto const& string) { return persisted_decision_from_string(string); });
            if (!entry.has_value() || !decision.has_value() || !decision->has_value())
                return;
            ensure_entry(entry->name, entry->origin).decision = **decision;
        });
    }

    if (auto embargoes = json.value().get_array("embargoes"sv); embargoes.has_value()) {
        embargoes->for_each([&](JsonValue const& value) {
            if (!value.is_object())
                return;
            auto const& object = value.as_object();
            auto key = read_key(object);
            if (!key.has_value())
                return;
            auto& entry = ensure_entry(key->name, key->origin);
            entry.dismissals = object.get_integer<u8>("dismissals"sv).value_or(0);
            entry.ignores = object.get_integer<u8>("ignores"sv).value_or(0);
            if (auto until = object.get_integer<i64>("until"sv); until.has_value())
                entry.embargo_until = UnixDateTime::from_milliseconds_since_epoch(*until);
        });
    }

    remove_empty_entries();
}

void PermissionManager::persist() const
{
    if (!m_persistence_path.has_value())
        return;

    JsonArray decisions;
    JsonArray embargoes;

    for (auto const& entry : m_entries) {
        auto origin = entry.origin.serialize();
        auto name = MUST(String::from_utf8(Web::Permissions::to_string(entry.name)));

        if (entry.decision == PermissionDecision::Allow || entry.decision == PermissionDecision::Block) {
            JsonObject object;
            object.set("origin"sv, origin);
            object.set("permission"sv, name);
            object.set("decision"sv, MUST(String::from_utf8(decision_to_string(*entry.decision))));
            decisions.must_append(move(object));
        }

        if (entry.dismissals != 0 || entry.ignores != 0 || entry.embargo_until.has_value()) {
            JsonObject object;
            object.set("origin"sv, origin);
            object.set("permission"sv, name);
            object.set("dismissals"sv, entry.dismissals);
            object.set("ignores"sv, entry.ignores);
            if (entry.embargo_until.has_value())
                object.set("until"sv, entry.embargo_until->milliseconds_since_epoch());
            else
                object.set("until"sv, JsonValue {});
            embargoes.must_append(move(object));
        }
    }

    JsonObject json;
    json.set("version"sv, PERSISTENCE_VERSION);
    json.set("decisions"sv, move(decisions));
    json.set("embargoes"sv, move(embargoes));

    if (auto result = write_json_file(*m_persistence_path, json); result.is_error())
        warnln("Unable to persist site permissions: {}", result.error());
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/ByteString.h>
#include <AK/Function.h>
#include <AK/HashMap.h>
#include <AK/Noncopyable.h>
#include <AK/NonnullOwnPtr.h>
#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <AK/Time.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <AK/WeakPtr.h>
#include <AK/Weakable.h>
#include <AK/kmalloc.h>
#include <LibURL/Origin.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/Permissions/Permissions.h>
#include <LibWebView/Export.h>

namespace WebView {

class PermissionManager;

// A decision the user made for a site. AllowOnce lasts only while the site is in use; the others last until the user
// changes them.
enum class PermissionDecision : u8 {
    Allow,
    AllowOnce,
    Block,
};

struct PermissionTimeouts {
    // A one-time grant ends once no tab has shown the site for this long.
    AK::Duration background { AK::Duration::from_seconds(5ll * 60) };
    // A one-time grant never lasts longer than this.
    AK::Duration one_time_maximum { AK::Duration::from_seconds(16ll * 60 * 60) };
    // How long a site may not ask again after the user has turned its prompts away too many times.
    AK::Duration embargo { AK::Duration::from_seconds(7ll * 24 * 60 * 60) };
};

struct SiteDecision {
    URL::Origin origin;
    PermissionDecision decision;
};

class WEBVIEW_API PermissionManagerObserver {
public:
    virtual ~PermissionManagerObserver() = default;
    virtual void permissions_changed(PermissionManager const&) = 0;
};

// Every permission decision of one browsing session, keyed by the top-level origin it was made for. The ordinary
// session's decisions persist in a file; a private session's live in memory only, and it also honors every block the
// ordinary session holds.
class WEBVIEW_API PermissionManager final
    : public PermissionManagerObserver
    , public Weakable<PermissionManager> {
    AK_MAKE_NONCOPYABLE(PermissionManager);
    AK_MAKE_NONMOVABLE(PermissionManager);

public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    static NonnullOwnPtr<PermissionManager> create_for_ordinary_session(ByteString persistence_path);
    static NonnullOwnPtr<PermissionManager> create_for_private_session(PermissionManager& ordinary_session);

    virtual ~PermissionManager() override;

    Web::Permissions::EffectiveState effective_state(Web::Permissions::PermissionName, URL::Origin const& top_level_origin) const;
    Web::Permissions::EffectiveState global_default(Web::Permissions::PermissionName) const;
    Optional<PermissionDecision> decision(Web::Permissions::PermissionName, URL::Origin const& top_level_origin) const;

    // Moves with every decision made for a site, however it was made, so an answer given to a prompt can tell if
    // anything was decided while the prompt was up.
    u64 decision_generation(Web::Permissions::PermissionName, URL::Origin const& top_level_origin) const;

    // An empty decision returns the site to asking.
    void set_decision(Web::Permissions::PermissionName, URL::Origin const& top_level_origin, Optional<PermissionDecision>);
    void reset_origin(URL::Origin const& top_level_origin);
    void record_prompt_outcome(Web::Permissions::PermissionName, URL::Origin const& top_level_origin, Web::Permissions::PromptOutcome);

    // Each view reports the origin of the top-level document it shows, and if it's visible; one-time grants end by these.
    void set_view_presence(u64 view_id, URL::Origin const& top_level_origin, bool visible);
    void remove_view(u64 view_id);

    // What a site with no decision of its own gets: Prompt, or Denied when the user has turned the feature off.
    void set_global_default(Web::Permissions::PermissionName, Web::Permissions::EffectiveState);
    void set_os_denies_geolocation(bool);

    Web::Permissions::PermissionSnapshot snapshot() const;
    // Only the given sites' states, for a process that shows those sites and no others.
    Web::Permissions::PermissionSnapshot snapshot_for(Vector<URL::Origin> const& top_level_origins) const;
    Vector<SiteDecision> site_decisions(Web::Permissions::PermissionName) const;

    // The earliest time at which run_expiry() has something to expire.
    Optional<UnixDateTime> next_deadline() const;
    Function<void()> on_deadlines_changed;
    void run_expiry();

    void register_observer(PermissionManagerObserver&);
    void unregister_observer(PermissionManagerObserver&);

    // Makes the given time pass for one origin's entries only, so concurrently running tests don't disturb each other.
    void age_origin_for_testing(URL::Origin const&, AK::Duration);
    u8 dismissals_for_testing(Web::Permissions::PermissionName, URL::Origin const& top_level_origin) const;
    void set_clock_for_testing(Function<UnixDateTime()>);

private:
    struct Entry {
        Web::Permissions::PermissionName name;
        URL::Origin origin;
        Optional<PermissionDecision> decision;
        UnixDateTime decided_at;
        Optional<UnixDateTime> hidden_since;
        u8 dismissals { 0 };
        u8 ignores { 0 };
        Optional<UnixDateTime> embargo_until;

        bool is_empty() const { return !decision.has_value() && dismissals == 0 && ignores == 0 && !embargo_until.has_value(); }
    };

    struct ViewPresence {
        URL::Origin origin;
        bool visible { false };
    };

    enum class OriginPresence : u8 {
        Absent,
        Hidden,
        Visible,
    };

    PermissionManager(Optional<ByteString> persistence_path, WeakPtr<PermissionManager> ordinary_session);

    virtual void permissions_changed(PermissionManager const&) override;

    UnixDateTime now() const;
    bool embargo_is_live(Entry const&) const;
    bool os_denies_geolocation() const;
    bool ordinary_session_blocks(Web::Permissions::PermissionName, URL::Origin const&) const;

    Entry const* find_entry(Web::Permissions::PermissionName, URL::Origin const&) const;
    Entry& ensure_entry(Web::Permissions::PermissionName, URL::Origin const&);
    void remove_empty_entries();

    OriginPresence presence_of(URL::Origin const&) const;
    bool apply_presence();

    void did_change();
    void bump_generation(Web::Permissions::PermissionName, URL::Origin const&);
    void load();
    void persist() const;

    Optional<ByteString> m_persistence_path;
    // The ordinary session's manager, which a private session's reads its inherited blocks and defaults from. Weak,
    // since the two sessions are torn down in no set order.
    WeakPtr<PermissionManager> m_ordinary_session;

    Vector<Entry> m_entries;
    HashMap<u64, ViewPresence> m_views;
    HashMap<String, u64> m_generations;

    Web::Permissions::EffectiveState m_geolocation_default { Web::Permissions::EffectiveState::Prompt };
    Web::Permissions::EffectiveState m_microphone_default { Web::Permissions::EffectiveState::Prompt };
    Web::Permissions::EffectiveState m_notifications_default { Web::Permissions::EffectiveState::Prompt };
    bool m_os_denies_geolocation { false };

    u64 m_revision { 0 };
    Vector<PermissionManagerObserver*> m_observers;

    Function<UnixDateTime()> m_clock;
    PermissionTimeouts m_timeouts;
};

}

/*

#include <LibCore/EventLoop.h>
#include <LibWebView/Application.h>
#include <LibWebView/CanonicalDocument.h>
#include <LibWebView/CanonicalNavigable.h>
#include <LibWebView/CanonicalSessionHistoryEntry.h>
#include <LibWebView/PictureInPictureManager.h>
#include <LibWebView/PictureInPictureWindow.h>
#include <LibWebView/WebContentClient.h>
#include <LibWebView/WebContentPage.h>

namespace WebView {

PictureInPictureManager& PictureInPictureManager::the()
{
    static auto& manager = *new PictureInPictureManager;
    return manager;
}

String PictureInPictureManager::open_window(WebContentPage& requesting_page, CanonicalNavigable& requesting_navigable, CanonicalTraversable& traversable, Gfx::IntSize video_size)
{
    // A page that already has a window replaces it itself, so only other pages are told that they lost theirs.
    if (auto index = index_of_window_for(requesting_page); index.has_value())
        retire_window(*index);

    // Test mode loads unrelated pages side by side, so there they do not take the window from one another.
    if (Application::web_content_options().is_test_mode == IsTestMode::No) {
        while (!m_windows.is_empty()) {
            auto page = m_windows.last().page;
            retire_window(m_windows.size() - 1);
            if (page->is_open())
                page->async_picture_in_picture_window_did_close(false);
        }
    }

    auto window = Application::the().create_picture_in_picture_window(requesting_page, traversable, video_size);
    if (!window)
        return {};
    window->act_for_document(requesting_navigable.active_document());

    window->on_resize = [this, window = window.ptr()](Gfx::IntSize size) {
        if (auto index = index_of(*window); index.has_value() && m_windows[*index].page->is_open())
            m_windows[*index].page->async_picture_in_picture_window_did_resize(size);
    };
    window->on_close = [this, window = window.ptr()](auto video_keeps_playing) {
        window_did_close(*window, video_keeps_playing);
    };
    window->on_page_close = [this, window = window.ptr()] {
        window_page_did_close(*window);
    };

    auto& opened_window = *window;
    m_windows.append({ requesting_page, requesting_navigable, requesting_navigable.active_document(), window.release_nonnull() });
    requesting_page.async_did_open_picture_in_picture_window(opened_window.size());
    return opened_window.handle();
}

void PictureInPictureManager::close_window(WebContentPage& page)
{
    if (auto index = index_of_window_for(page); index.has_value())
        retire_window(*index);
}

// A page that is closed before its process unloads it never runs the unloading steps that close its window's page, so
// that page is closed here, or it would keep the process running.
void PictureInPictureManager::close_window_and_its_page(WebContentPage& page)
{
    auto index = index_of_window_for(page);
    if (!index.has_value())
        return;
    m_windows[*index].window->close_page();
    retire_window(*index);
}

void PictureInPictureManager::video_size_did_change(WebContentPage& page, Gfx::IntSize video_size)
{
    if (auto index = index_of_window_for(page); index.has_value())
        m_windows[*index].window->set_video_size(video_size);
}

// A document with a window open may replace it without user activation, until the window closes.
bool PictureInPictureManager::document_has_open_window(CanonicalNavigable const& navigable) const
{
    return any_of(m_windows, [&](auto const& window) {
        return window.navigable.ptr() == &navigable && window.document_is_active();
    });
}

// A window closes once the document it was opened for is no longer active, as that document's unloading steps close it.
void PictureInPictureManager::active_documents_did_change()
{
    for (size_t index = m_windows.size(); index-- > 0;) {
        if (m_windows[index].document_is_active())
            continue;
        auto page = m_windows[index].page;
        retire_window(index);
        if (page->is_open())
            page->async_picture_in_picture_window_did_close(false);
    }
}

bool PictureInPictureManager::Window::document_is_active() const
{
    if (!navigable || !document)
        return false;
    auto const& entry = navigable->active_session_history_entry();
    return entry && entry->document_state->document == document.ptr();
}

Optional<size_t> PictureInPictureManager::index_of_window_for(WebContentPage const& page) const
{
    return m_windows.find_first_index_if([&](auto const& window) { return window.page.ptr() == &page; });
}

Optional<size_t> PictureInPictureManager::index_of(PictureInPictureWindow const& window) const
{
    return m_windows.find_first_index_if([&](auto const& entry) { return entry.window.ptr() == &window; });
}

// The page that a window shows outlives the window's place as another page's window, so a retired window stays hidden
// until the page that it shows has closed. Its process decides when that is, so the window leaves the tab now.
void PictureInPictureManager::retire_window(size_t index)
{
    auto window = m_windows.take(index).window;
    window->hide();
    window->leave_owners_tab();
    m_retired_windows.append(move(window));
}

// The window is gone as soon as the user closes it, and its page only learns of that after, so a page that is busy or
// misbehaves cannot keep it open, or replace it as the window it has open.
void PictureInPictureManager::window_did_close(PictureInPictureWindow& window, PictureInPictureWindow::VideoKeepsPlaying video_keeps_playing)
{
    auto index = index_of(window);
    if (!index.has_value())
        return;
    auto page = m_windows[*index].page;
    retire_window(*index);

    if (page->is_open())
        page->async_picture_in_picture_window_did_close(video_keeps_playing == PictureInPictureWindow::VideoKeepsPlaying::No);
}

void PictureInPictureManager::window_page_did_close(PictureInPictureWindow& window)
{
    if (auto index = index_of(window); index.has_value()) {
        m_closed_windows.append(m_windows.take(*index).window);
    } else if (auto index = m_retired_windows.find_first_index_if([&](auto const& retired_window) { return retired_window.ptr() == &window; }); index.has_value()) {
        m_closed_windows.append(m_retired_windows.take(*index));
    }

    // The window's page closes from within a callback of its view, so the window is destroyed once that returns. The
    // event loop may never get to this, so the window stays here for destroy_all_windows() to find.
    Core::deferred_invoke([this] {
        auto closed_windows = exchange(m_closed_windows, {});
    });
}

void PictureInPictureManager::destroy_all_windows()
{
    // Destroying a window's view closes its page, which comes back here, so the windows leave their lists first.
    auto windows = exchange(m_windows, {});
    auto retired_windows = exchange(m_retired_windows, {});
    auto closed_windows = exchange(m_closed_windows, {});
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/NonnullOwnPtr.h>
#include <AK/NonnullRefPtr.h>
#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <AK/String.h>

#include <LibWebCommon/Page/PageId.h>
#include <LibWebView/Forward.h>
#include <LibWebView/PictureInPictureWindow.h>

namespace WebView {

// Owns the Picture-in-Picture windows the browser shows, each with the page whose video it shows, and the document of
// that video. A page that opens a window takes it from any other page that had one. A window shows a page of its own,
// which the requesting page created in its process.
class WEBVIEW_API PictureInPictureManager {
public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    static PictureInPictureManager& the();

    // Returns the window's handle, or an empty string when no window could be opened.
    String open_window(WebContentPage& requesting_page, CanonicalNavigable& requesting_navigable, CanonicalTraversable&, Gfx::IntSize video_size);
    void close_window(WebContentPage&);
    void close_window_and_its_page(WebContentPage&);
    void video_size_did_change(WebContentPage&, Gfx::IntSize);

    // Windows need the application to be destroyed, and this manager outlives it, so the application ends them first.
    void destroy_all_windows();

    bool document_has_open_window(CanonicalNavigable const&) const;
    void active_documents_did_change();

private:
    struct Window {
        NonnullRefPtr<WebContentPage> page;
        WeakPtr<CanonicalNavigable> navigable;
        WeakPtr<CanonicalDocument> document;
        NonnullOwnPtr<PictureInPictureWindow> window;

        bool document_is_active() const;
    };

    Optional<size_t> index_of_window_for(WebContentPage const&) const;
    Optional<size_t> index_of(PictureInPictureWindow const&) const;
    void retire_window(size_t index);
    void window_did_close(PictureInPictureWindow&, PictureInPictureWindow::VideoKeepsPlaying);
    void window_page_did_close(PictureInPictureWindow&);

    Vector<Window> m_windows;
    Vector<NonnullOwnPtr<PictureInPictureWindow>> m_retired_windows;
    Vector<NonnullOwnPtr<PictureInPictureWindow>> m_closed_windows;
};

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWebView/PictureInPictureWindow.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <LibWebView/PictureInPictureWindow.h>
#include <LibWebView/ViewImplementation.h>

namespace WebView {

Gfx::IntSize PictureInPictureWindow::aspect_ratio(Gfx::IntSize video_size)
{
    if (video_size.is_empty())
        return { 16, 9 };
    return video_size;
}

static Gfx::IntSize size_with_width(Gfx::IntSize aspect_ratio, int width)
{
    return { width, width * aspect_ratio.height() / aspect_ratio.width() };
}

static Gfx::IntSize size_with_height(Gfx::IntSize aspect_ratio, int height)
{
    return { height * aspect_ratio.width() / aspect_ratio.height(), height };
}

// https://w3c.github.io/picture-in-picture/#pip
// It is also RECOMMENDED that the Picture-in-Picture window has a maximum and minimum size. For example, it could be
// restricted to be between a quarter and a half of one dimension of the screen.
// NB: The window opens at a quarter of the screen's width, and can shrink below that for as long as its controls fit.
static constexpr int minimum_width = 240;
static constexpr int minimum_height = 100;

Gfx::IntSize PictureInPictureWindow::minimum_size(Gfx::IntSize video_size)
{
    auto ratio = aspect_ratio(video_size);
    auto size = size_with_width(ratio, minimum_width);
    if (size.height() < minimum_height)
        size = size_with_height(ratio, minimum_height);
    return size;
}

Gfx::IntSize PictureInPictureWindow::maximum_size(Gfx::IntSize video_size, Gfx::IntSize screen_size)
{
    auto ratio = aspect_ratio(video_size);
    auto size = size_with_width(ratio, screen_size.width() / 2);
    if (size.height() > screen_size.height() / 2)
        size = size_with_height(ratio, screen_size.height() / 2);
    return size;
}

Gfx::IntSize PictureInPictureWindow::initial_size(Gfx::IntSize video_size, Gfx::IntSize screen_size)
{
    return size_for_video_size({ screen_size.width() / 4, 0 }, video_size, screen_size);
}

Gfx::IntSize PictureInPictureWindow::size_for_video_size(Gfx::IntSize window_size, Gfx::IntSize video_size, Gfx::IntSize screen_size)
{
    auto minimum = minimum_size(video_size);
    if (window_size.width() <= minimum.width())
        return minimum;

    auto maximum = maximum_size(video_size, screen_size);
    if (window_size.width() >= maximum.width())
        return maximum;

    return size_with_width(aspect_ratio(video_size), window_size.width());
}

void PictureInPictureWindow::close_page()
{
    if (!m_page_view)
        return;
    if (auto& page = m_page_view->page(); page.is_open())
        page.async_request_close_without_prompting();
}

void PictureInPictureWindow::act_for_document(CanonicalDocument const& document)
{
    if (m_page_view)
        m_page_view->set_owner_document({}, document);
}

void PictureInPictureWindow::leave_owners_tab()
{
    if (m_page_view)
        m_page_view->did_leave_owners_tab({});
}

void PictureInPictureWindow::report_page_close_of(ViewImplementation& view)
{
    m_page_view = &view;
    view.on_close = [this] {
        if (on_page_close)
            on_page_close();
    };
    view.on_web_content_crashed = [this](auto) {
        if (on_page_close)
            on_page_close();
    };
}

}

/*

#pragma once

#include <AK/Function.h>
#include <AK/String.h>
#include <AK/kmalloc.h>
#include <LibGfx/Size.h>
#include <LibWebView/Forward.h>

namespace WebView {

// The floating window that shows a page's Picture-in-Picture video, and keeps that video's aspect ratio. Sizes are in
// CSS pixels.
class WEBVIEW_API PictureInPictureWindow {
public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    static Gfx::IntSize aspect_ratio(Gfx::IntSize video_size);
    static Gfx::IntSize minimum_size(Gfx::IntSize video_size);
    static Gfx::IntSize maximum_size(Gfx::IntSize video_size, Gfx::IntSize screen_size);
    static Gfx::IntSize initial_size(Gfx::IntSize video_size, Gfx::IntSize screen_size);
    // The window keeps its width as its video changes shape, as far as its minimum and maximum sizes allow.
    static Gfx::IntSize size_for_video_size(Gfx::IntSize window_size, Gfx::IntSize video_size, Gfx::IntSize screen_size);

    virtual ~PictureInPictureWindow() = default;

    virtual Gfx::IntSize size() const = 0;
    virtual String handle() const = 0;
    virtual void hide() = 0;
    virtual void set_video_size(Gfx::IntSize) = 0;

    void close_page();
    void act_for_document(CanonicalDocument const&);
    void leave_owners_tab();

    // The user closes the window to stop watching its video, or to go back to the video's tab and watch it there.
    enum class VideoKeepsPlaying : bool {
        No,
        Yes,
    };

    Function<void(Gfx::IntSize)> on_resize;
    Function<void(VideoKeepsPlaying)> on_close;
    Function<void()> on_page_close;

protected:
    void report_page_close_of(ViewImplementation&);

private:
    ViewImplementation* m_page_view { nullptr };
};

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWebView/PlatformFeatureDecisions.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <LibWebView/PlatformFeatureDecisions.h>

namespace WebView {

using PlatformFeatures::FFmpegFacts;
using PlatformFeatures::VideoDecodeFacts;

// Until 63.20.101, FFmpeg gives a separate DPB the output's DRM format modifiers, which RADV lays out wrongly at some
// resolutions (#12902). FFmpeg decodes into a separate DPB on drivers that cannot decode into the output.
static bool system_ffmpeg_gives_a_separate_dpb_the_output_modifiers(SystemFacts const& facts)
{
    if (!facts.gpu.has_value() || !facts.system_ffmpeg.has_value())
        return false;
    if (facts.system_ffmpeg->avcodec_version >= FFmpegFacts::version(63, 20, 101))
        return false;
    auto uses_a_separate_dpb_without_modifiers = [](VideoDecodeFacts const& codec) {
        return codec.supported && !codec.dpb_and_output_coincide && !codec.dpb_supports_drm_format_modifiers;
    };
    return uses_a_separate_dpb_without_modifiers(facts.gpu->h264) || uses_a_separate_dpb_without_modifiers(facts.gpu->h265);
}

static constexpr u32 nvidia_proprietary_driver_id = 4; // VK_DRIVER_ID_NVIDIA_PROPRIETARY

// NVIDIA's driver decodes AV1 frames with 8 or more tiles and no reference frame motion vectors as copies of an earlier
// frame while the sequence header allows them (#14510, https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2084563). Clearing
// the flag for those frames avoids it, and does not change what they decode to.
static bool uses_nvidia_proprietary_driver(SystemFacts const& facts)
{
    return facts.gpu.has_value() && facts.gpu->driver_id == nvidia_proprietary_driver_id;
}

// The flag can only be cleared frame by frame where the sequence header is passed with each frame.
static bool cannot_work_around_nvidia_av1_tiles(SystemFacts const& facts)
{
    return uses_nvidia_proprietary_driver(facts) && !facts.gpu->supports_video_maintenance2;
}

static constexpr Array s_blocklist_rules {
    BlocklistRule {
        "system-ffmpeg-separate-dpb-modifiers"sv,
        Feature::VulkanVideoSystemFFmpegDirectExport,
        "The system FFmpeg predates 63.20.101 and gives a separate DPB the output's DRM format modifiers, which corrupts video on RADV (#12902)"sv,
        system_ffmpeg_gives_a_separate_dpb_the_output_modifiers,
    },
    BlocklistRule {
        "nvidia-av1-tiles"sv,
        Feature::VulkanVideoBundledFFmpegAV1KeepSequenceHeaderEnableRefMVsFlag,
        "NVIDIA driver bug repeats AV1 frames with many tiles and no reference frame motion vectors (#14510)"sv,
        uses_nvidia_proprietary_driver,
    },
    BlocklistRule {
        "nvidia-av1-tiles-without-video-maintenance2"sv,
        Feature::VulkanVideoBundledFFmpegAV1,
        "NVIDIA driver bug in AV1 decoding cannot be worked around without VK_KHR_video_maintenance2 (#14510)"sv,
        cannot_work_around_nvidia_av1_tiles,
    },
};

ReadonlySpan<BlocklistRule> blocklist_rules()
{
    return s_blocklist_rules;
}

static Optional<String> missing_codec(SystemFacts const& facts, VideoDecodeFacts PlatformFeatures::GpuFacts::* codec, StringView name)
{
    if (!facts.gpu.has_value() || !((*facts.gpu).*codec).supported)
        return MUST(String::formatted("The GPU does not decode {} through Vulkan", name));
    return {};
}

static Optional<String> missing_capability(Feature feature, SystemFacts const& facts, PlatformFeatures::Build const& build)
{
    switch (feature) {
    case Feature::GpuPainting:
        // The probe only describes the GPU through Vulkan, so otherwise the Compositor finds out for itself whether it
        // can paint on it.
        if (!build.paints_through_vulkan)
            return {};
        if (facts.probe_failure.has_value())
            return MUST(String::formatted("The system probe failed: {}", *facts.probe_failure));
        if (!facts.gpu.has_value())
            return "No Vulkan device was found"_string;
        return {};
    case Feature::YCbCrImport:
        if (!facts.gpu.has_value() || !facts.gpu->supports_ycbcr_sampling)
            return "The GPU does not support YCbCr sampling"_string;
        return {};
    case Feature::VulkanVideo:
        if (!facts.gpu.has_value())
            return "No Vulkan device was found"_string;
        if (facts.gpu->cannot_decode_video_because.has_value())
            return *facts.gpu->cannot_decode_video_because;
        return {};
    case Feature::VulkanVideoBundledFFmpeg:
        if (!facts.bundled_ffmpeg.has_value())
            return "The bundled FFmpeg was not described"_string;
        if (!facts.gpu.has_value() || !(facts.gpu->vp9.supported || facts.gpu->av1.supported))
            return "The GPU decodes neither VP9 nor AV1 through Vulkan"_string;
        return {};
    case Feature::VulkanVideoSystemFFmpeg:
        if (!facts.system_ffmpeg.has_value())
            return "No system FFmpeg was found"_string;
        if (!facts.system_ffmpeg->shares_bundled_struct_layouts)
            return "The system FFmpeg's structs are not laid out like the bundled one's"_string;
        if (!facts.gpu.has_value() || !(facts.gpu->h264.supported || facts.gpu->h265.supported))
            return "The GPU decodes neither H.264 nor HEVC through Vulkan"_string;
        return {};
    case Feature::VulkanVideoBundledFFmpegVP9:
        return missing_codec(facts, &PlatformFeatures::GpuFacts::vp9, "VP9"sv);
    case Feature::VulkanVideoBundledFFmpegAV1:
        return missing_codec(facts, &PlatformFeatures::GpuFacts::av1, "AV1"sv);
    case Feature::VulkanVideoSystemFFmpegH264:
        return missing_codec(facts, &PlatformFeatures::GpuFacts::h264, "H.264"sv);
    case Feature::VulkanVideoSystemFFmpegH265:
        return missing_codec(facts, &PlatformFeatures::GpuFacts::h265, "HEVC"sv);
    case Feature::VulkanVideoBundledFFmpegDirectExport:
    case Feature::VulkanVideoBundledFFmpegAV1KeepSequenceHeaderEnableRefMVsFlag:
    case Feature::VulkanVideoSystemFFmpegDirectExport:
        return {};
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

StringView feature_state_name(FeatureStatus::State state)
{
    switch (state) {
    case FeatureStatus::State::Enabled:
        return "Enabled"sv;
    case FeatureStatus::State::Unsupported:
        return "Unsupported"sv;
    case FeatureStatus::State::Blocklisted:
        return "Blocklisted"sv;
    case FeatureStatus::State::DisabledByUser:
        return "Disabled by user"sv;
    case FeatureStatus::State::BlockedByDependency:
        return "Blocked by dependency"sv;
    case FeatureStatus::State::FailedAtRuntime:
        return "Failed at runtime"sv;
    case FeatureStatus::State::NotBuilt:
        return "Not built"sv;
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

PlatformFeatureDecisions PlatformFeatureDecisions::evaluate(SystemFacts const& facts, FeatureOverrides const& overrides, HashMap<Feature, String> const& runtime_failures, ReadonlySpan<BlocklistRule> rules, PlatformFeatures::Build const& build)
{
    PlatformFeatureDecisions decisions;

    // Every dependency is declared before the features that depend on it, so it has been decided by the time they are.
    for (auto feature : PlatformFeatures::all_features) {
        auto& status = decisions.m_statuses[to_underlying(feature)];

        if (!build.includes(feature)) {
            status.state = FeatureStatus::State::NotBuilt;
            continue;
        }

        if (auto dependency = PlatformFeatures::dependency_of(feature); dependency.has_value()) {
            VERIFY(to_underlying(*dependency) < to_underlying(feature));
            auto const& dependency_status = decisions.status_of(*dependency);
            if (dependency_status.state != FeatureStatus::State::Enabled) {
                status.state = FeatureStatus::State::BlockedByDependency;
                status.blocking_feature = dependency_status.blocking_feature.value_or(*dependency);
                continue;
            }
        }

        if (auto capability = missing_capability(feature, facts, build); capability.has_value()) {
            status.state = FeatureStatus::State::Unsupported;
            status.reason = capability.release_value();
            continue;
        }

        if (auto failure = runtime_failures.get(feature); failure.has_value()) {
            status.state = FeatureStatus::State::FailedAtRuntime;
            status.reason = *failure;
            continue;
        }

        BlocklistRule const* matching_rule = nullptr;
        for (auto const& rule : rules) {
            if (rule.feature == feature && rule.matches(facts)) {
                matching_rule = &rule;
                break;
            }
        }

        // The rule is kept whatever the overrides decide, so that reports say which way the blocklist went.
        if (matching_rule != nullptr) {
            status.rule_id = matching_rule->id;
            status.reason = MUST(String::from_utf8(matching_rule->description));
        }

        if (overrides.force_enabled.contains(feature)) {
            status.forced = matching_rule != nullptr || overrides.disabled.contains(feature);
            if (matching_rule == nullptr && overrides.disabled.contains(feature))
                status.reason = "Overrides --disable-features"_string;
            continue;
        }

        if (overrides.disabled.contains(feature)) {
            status.state = FeatureStatus::State::DisabledByUser;
            continue;
        }

        if (matching_rule != nullptr)
            status.state = FeatureStatus::State::Blocklisted;
    }

    return decisions;
}

bool PlatformFeatureDecisions::decides_without_facts(FeatureProcess process, FeatureOverrides const& overrides, PlatformFeatures::Build const& build)
{
    // A process waits for the probe unless the overrides alone turn off each of its features, directly or through a
    // dependency that is off.
    for (auto feature : PlatformFeatures::all_features) {
        if (PlatformFeatures::process_of(feature) != process || !build.includes(feature))
            continue;
        auto is_turned_off = [&](Feature candidate) {
            return overrides.disabled.contains(candidate) && !overrides.force_enabled.contains(candidate);
        };
        bool turned_off = is_turned_off(feature);
        for (auto dependency = PlatformFeatures::dependency_of(feature); !turned_off && dependency.has_value(); dependency = PlatformFeatures::dependency_of(*dependency))
            turned_off = is_turned_off(*dependency);
        if (!turned_off)
            return false;
    }
    return true;
}

PlatformFeatures::ProcessFeatures PlatformFeatureDecisions::features_for(FeatureProcess process) const
{
    PlatformFeatures::ProcessFeatures features { process };
    for (auto feature : PlatformFeatures::all_features) {
        if (PlatformFeatures::process_of(feature) == process && is_enabled(feature))
            features.set_enabled(feature);
    }
    return features;
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/Array.h>

#include <AK/HashTable.h>

#include <LibPlatformFeatures/Feature.h>

namespace WebView {

using PlatformFeatures::Feature;
using PlatformFeatures::FeatureProcess;
using PlatformFeatures::SystemFacts;

// A feature that a driver or library claims to support, but which misbehaves under the conditions it matches.
struct BlocklistRule {
    StringView id;
    Feature feature;
    StringView description;
    bool (*matches)(SystemFacts const&);
};

WEBVIEW_API ReadonlySpan<BlocklistRule> blocklist_rules();

struct FeatureOverrides {
    HashTable<Feature> disabled;
    // Overrides the blocklist and the disabled set, but not a missing capability or a dependency that is off.
    HashTable<Feature> force_enabled;
};

struct FeatureStatus {
    enum class State : u8 {
        Enabled,
        Unsupported,
        Blocklisted,
        DisabledByUser,
        BlockedByDependency,
        FailedAtRuntime,
        // Not part of this build at all, so it is left out wherever features are listed.
        NotBuilt,
    };

    State state { State::Enabled };
    // What the state alone does not say: the missing capability, the failure, the rule that matched, or what forcing
    // overrode.
    String reason;
    // Set when a rule matched, even if the feature was disabled or forced on regardless.
    StringView rule_id;
    // Whether --force-enable-features turned the feature on past a rule or a disable.
    bool forced { false };
    // The feature whose own state turned this one off, when blocked by a dependency.
    Optional<Feature> blocking_feature;
};

WEBVIEW_API StringView feature_state_name(FeatureStatus::State);

class WEBVIEW_API PlatformFeatureDecisions {
public:
    static PlatformFeatureDecisions evaluate(SystemFacts const&, FeatureOverrides const&, HashMap<Feature, String> const& runtime_failures, ReadonlySpan<BlocklistRule> = blocklist_rules(), PlatformFeatures::Build const& = PlatformFeatures::this_build);
    // Whether the overrides alone decide every feature of the process, so that it need not wait for the probe.
    static bool decides_without_facts(FeatureProcess, FeatureOverrides const&, PlatformFeatures::Build const& = PlatformFeatures::this_build);

    FeatureStatus const& status_of(Feature feature) const { return m_statuses[to_underlying(feature)]; }
    bool is_enabled(Feature feature) const { return status_of(feature).state == FeatureStatus::State::Enabled; }

    PlatformFeatures::ProcessFeatures features_for(FeatureProcess) const;

private:
    Array<FeatureStatus, PlatformFeatures::all_features.size()> m_statuses;
};

}

template<>
struct AK::Formatter<WebView::FeatureStatus::State> : Formatter<StringView> {
    ErrorOr<void> format(FormatBuilder& builder, WebView::FeatureStatus::State state)
    {
        return Formatter<StringView>::format(builder, WebView::feature_state_name(state));
    }
};
