Process::Process(ProcessType type, RefPtr<IPC::ConnectionBase> connection, Core::Process process)
    : m_pid(process.pid())
    , m_process(move(process))
    , m_type(type)
    , m_connection(move(connection))
{
}

Process::Process(ProcessType type, pid_t pid)
    : m_pid(pid)
    , m_type(type)
{
}

Process Process::for_browser()
{
    return Process { ProcessType::Browser, Core::System::getpid() };
}

void Process::did_register(Badge<ProcessManager>, u64 child_id)
{
    m_child_id = child_id;
}

void Process::save_crash_report(Optional<int> exit_status)
{
    auto keeps_reports = Application::settings().crash_report_sending() != CrashReportSending::NeverSend;
    if (m_crash_report && exit_status.has_value() && keeps_reports) {
        if (auto result = m_crash_report->save(*exit_status); result.is_error())
            warnln("Could not save {} crash report: {}", process_name_from_type(m_type), result.error());
        else
            m_saved_crash_report_name = m_crash_report->saved_name();
    }
    m_crash_report = nullptr;
}

Process::~Process()
{
    // NB: A helper that never made it into the ProcessManager would run on untracked, so it is ended instead.
    if (m_process.has_value() && m_child_id == 0) {
        (void)Core::Process::terminate_process(m_pid, Core::Process::TerminationMode::Forceful);
#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
        Application::transport_bootstrap_server().unregister_child_transport(m_pid);
#endif
    }

    // shutdown() can release the connection's last owner while dispatching die().
    if (auto connection = m_connection.strong_ref())
        connection->shutdown();
}

Vector<ByteString> Process::helper_process_environment(ProcessType type)
{
    static constexpr Array allowed_names {
        "HOME"sv,
        "LANG"sv,
        "LANGUAGE"sv,
        "LLVM_PROFILE_FILE"sv,
        "LOGNAME"sv,
        "PATH"sv,
        "TMPDIR"sv,
        "TZ"sv,
        "USER"sv,
        "XDG_CACHE_HOME"sv,
        "XDG_CONFIG_DIRS"sv,
        "XDG_CONFIG_HOME"sv,
        "XDG_DATA_DIRS"sv,
        "XDG_DATA_HOME"sv,
        "XDG_RUNTIME_DIR"sv,
        "FONTCONFIG_FILE"sv,
        "FONTCONFIG_PATH"sv,
        "__CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING"sv,
    };
    static constexpr Array allowed_prefixes {
        "ASAN_"sv,
        "LADYBIRD_"sv,
        "LC_"sv,
        "LIBGC_"sv,
        "LIBJS_"sv,
        "LIBWASM_"sv,
        "LIBWEB_"sv,
        "LSAN_"sv,
        "RUST_"sv,
        "TSAN_"sv,
        "UBSAN_"sv,
    };
    // OpenSSL reads these to find the system's certificates. OPENSSL_CONF is not here on purpose: a configuration file
    // can load providers and engines into the process.
    static constexpr Array certificate_names {
        "SSL_CERT_DIR"sv,
        "SSL_CERT_FILE"sv,
    };
    // libpulse reads these to find the audio server, and the Browser uses them to decide which server the audio
    // clients may connect to.
    static constexpr Array audio_names {
        "PULSE_RUNTIME_PATH"sv,
        "PULSE_SERVER"sv,
    };
    // Mesa and the Vulkan loader read these to select and configure the GPU driver.
    static constexpr Array gpu_prefixes {
        "DRI_PRIME"sv,
        "MESA_"sv,
        "VK_"sv,
        "__EGL_"sv,
        "__GLX_"sv,
        "__GL_"sv,
    };

    Vector<ByteString> environment;
    for (auto** variable = Core::Environment::raw_environ(); *variable; ++variable) {
        auto entry = Core::Environment::Entry::from_chars(*variable);
        auto is_allowed = allowed_names.contains_slow(entry.name) || any_of(allowed_prefixes, [&](auto prefix) { return entry.name.starts_with(prefix); });
        if (type == ProcessType::RequestServer) {
            is_allowed |= certificate_names.contains_slow(entry.name);
        }
        if (type == ProcessType::AudioServer)
            is_allowed |= audio_names.contains_slow(entry.name);
        if (type == ProcessType::Compositor || type == ProcessType::VideoDecoderServer)
            is_allowed |= any_of(gpu_prefixes, [&](auto prefix) { return entry.name.starts_with(prefix); });
        if (is_allowed)
            environment.append(entry.full_entry);
    }
    return environment;
}

#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
// The kernel does not kill our helpers when we exit or die on macOS, so the ProcessReaper helper does it for us.
static void watch_with_process_reaper(pid_t pid)
{
    // Never destroyed: the pipe to the reaper has to stay open until this process is gone.
    static ProcessReaper* s_process_reaper = nullptr;
    static bool s_tried_to_start_process_reaper = false;

    if (!s_tried_to_start_process_reaper) {
        s_tried_to_start_process_reaper = true;
        auto candidate_paths = get_paths_for_helper_process("ProcessReaper"sv);
        if (!candidate_paths.is_error()) {
            for (auto const& path : candidate_paths.value()) {
                if (!FileSystem::exists(path))
                    continue;
                if (auto process_reaper = ProcessReaper::start(path); !process_reaper.is_error()) {
                    s_process_reaper = process_reaper.release_value().leak_ptr();
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        if (!s_process_reaper)
            warnln("Could not start the ProcessReaper, so helper processes may outlive this process");
    }

    if (s_process_reaper) {
        if (auto result = s_process_reaper->watch(pid); result.is_error())
            warnln("Could not ask the ProcessReaper to watch process {}: {}", pid, result.error());
    }
}
#endif

ErrorOr<Process::ProcessAndTransport> Process::spawn_with_transport(ProcessType type, Core::ProcessSpawnOptions const& options, bool capture_output)
{
    auto [core_process, transport, output_capture] = TRY(spawn_and_connect_to_process(type, options, capture_output));

    Process process { type, nullptr, move(core_process) };
    process.m_output_capture = move(output_capture);
    return ProcessAndTransport { move(process), move(transport) };
}

// The lifetime, environment and input that every helper is spawned with, whether or not it is connected to over IPC.
static void apply_helper_spawn_options([[maybe_unused]] ProcessType type, Core::ProcessSpawnOptions& spawn_options)
{
    spawn_options.die_with_parent = true;
    // Ctrl+C in the terminal that the Browser was started from must reach only the Browser, which ends its helpers once
    // it has quit. A helper that died of it first would look like a crash to a Browser that is still running.
    spawn_options.new_process_group = true;
#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS) || defined(AK_OS_LINUX)
    spawn_options.environment = Process::helper_process_environment(type);
#endif

#if !defined(AK_OS_WINDOWS)
    // Helpers must not read the terminal or pipe that the Browser was started from.
    spawn_options.file_actions.append(Core::FileAction::OpenFile { .path = "/dev/null", .mode = Core::File::OpenMode::Read, .fd = STDIN_FILENO });
#endif
}

ErrorOr<Core::Process> Process::spawn_without_transport(ProcessType type, Core::ProcessSpawnOptions const& options)
{
    auto spawn_options = options;
    apply_helper_spawn_options(type, spawn_options);
    auto process = TRY(Core::Process::spawn(spawn_options));
#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
    watch_with_process_reaper(process.pid());
#endif
    return process;
}

ErrorOr<Process::ProcessAndIPCTransport> Process::spawn_and_connect_to_process(ProcessType type, Core::ProcessSpawnOptions const& options, bool capture_output)
{
    // Set up pipes for stdout/stderr capture if requested
    ProcessOutputCapture output_capture;
    Array<int, 2> stdout_pipe {};
    Array<int, 2> stderr_pipe {};

    auto spawn_options = options;
    apply_helper_spawn_options(type, spawn_options);
    Vector<ByteString> arguments_with_stats;
    if (auto* stats_log = Core::StatsLog::the()) {
        arguments_with_stats = Vector<ByteString> { options.arguments };
        arguments_with_stats.append(ByteString::formatted("--stats-log-dir={}", stats_log->directory()));
        spawn_options.arguments = arguments_with_stats;
    }

    if (capture_output) {
        stdout_pipe = TRY(Core::System::pipe2(O_CLOEXEC));
        stderr_pipe = TRY(Core::System::pipe2(O_CLOEXEC));

        // The write ends stay close-on-exec, so no other process that is spawned meanwhile inherits them. The child
        // gets its copies from these file actions.
        spawn_options.file_actions.append(Core::FileAction::DupFd { .write_fd = stdout_pipe[1], .fd = STDOUT_FILENO });
        spawn_options.file_actions.append(Core::FileAction::DupFd { .write_fd = stderr_pipe[1], .fd = STDERR_FILENO });
    }

    // NB: A helper that we fail to connect to is ended rather than left running untracked.
    Optional<Core::Process> process;
    ArmedScopeGuard terminate_process_on_failure { [&] {
        if (!process.has_value())
            return;
        (void)Core::Process::terminate_process(process->pid(), Core::Process::TerminationMode::Forceful);
#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
        Application::transport_bootstrap_server().unregister_child_transport(process->pid());
#endif
    } };

#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
    auto port_a_recv = TRY(Core::MachPort::create_with_right(Core::MachPort::PortRight::Receive));
    auto port_a_send = TRY(port_a_recv.insert_right(Core::MachPort::MessageRight::MakeSend));
    auto port_b_recv = TRY(Core::MachPort::create_with_right(Core::MachPort::PortRight::Receive));
    auto port_b_send = TRY(port_b_recv.insert_right(Core::MachPort::MessageRight::MakeSend));

    // The child may receive startup messages before it has constructed its transport.
    IPC::TransportMachPort::raise_receive_queue_limit(port_b_recv);

    MutexLocker child_registration_locker(Application::transport_bootstrap_server().child_registration_lock());
    process = TRY(Core::Process::spawn(spawn_options));
    watch_with_process_reaper(process->pid());

    Application::transport_bootstrap_server().register_child_transport(process->pid(), IPC::TransportBootstrapMachPorts { move(port_b_recv), move(port_a_send) });

    auto transport = make<IPC::Transport>(move(port_a_recv), move(port_b_send));
#elif defined(AK_OS_WINDOWS)
    // A Windows pipe cannot carry a handle, so the helper also gets a line to the Browser's handle broker.
    auto channel = TRY(Core::System::duplex_pipe());
    ArmedScopeGuard guard_channel_0 { [&] { MUST(Core::System::close(channel[0])); } };
    ArmedScopeGuard guard_channel_1 { [&] { MUST(Core::System::close(channel[1])); } };
    auto broker_channel = TRY(Core::System::duplex_pipe());
    ArmedScopeGuard guard_broker_channel_0 { [&] { MUST(Core::System::close(broker_channel[0])); } };
    ArmedScopeGuard guard_broker_channel_1 { [&] { MUST(Core::System::close(broker_channel[1])); } };

    // Only the helper's ends reach the helper, and only this helper.
    spawn_options.file_actions.append(Core::FileAction::DupFd { .write_fd = channel[1], .fd = channel[1] });
    spawn_options.file_actions.append(Core::FileAction::DupFd { .write_fd = broker_channel[1], .fd = broker_channel[1] });
    TRY(Core::Environment::set("SOCKET_TAKEOVER"sv, ByteString::formatted("ipc:{};handle-broker:{}", channel[1], broker_channel[1]), Core::Environment::Overwrite::Yes));

    process = TRY(Core::Process::spawn(spawn_options));

    auto transport = TRY(IPC::Transport::adopt_fd(channel[0]));
    guard_channel_0.disarm();

    guard_broker_channel_0.disarm();
    Application::handle_broker_server().add_child(process->pid(), broker_channel[0]);
#else
    int socket_fds[2] {};
    TRY(Core::System::socketpair(AF_LOCAL, SOCK_STREAM | SOCK_CLOEXEC, 0, socket_fds));

    ArmedScopeGuard guard_fd_0 { [&] { MUST(Core::System::close(socket_fds[0])); } };
    ArmedScopeGuard guard_fd_1 { [&] { MUST(Core::System::close(socket_fds[1])); } };

    // Only the helper's end reaches the helper, and only this helper.
    spawn_options.file_actions.append(Core::FileAction::DupFd { .write_fd = socket_fds[1], .fd = socket_fds[1] });

    // NB: Only the helper gets to see this, if it has an environment of its own.
    auto takeover_string = ByteString::formatted("ipc:{}", socket_fds[1]);
    if (spawn_options.environment.has_value())
        spawn_options.environment->append(ByteString::formatted("SOCKET_TAKEOVER={}", takeover_string));
    else
        TRY(Core::Environment::set("SOCKET_TAKEOVER"sv, takeover_string, Core::Environment::Overwrite::Yes));

    process = TRY(Core::Process::spawn(spawn_options));

    auto ipc_socket = TRY(Core::LocalSocket::adopt_fd(socket_fds[0]));
    guard_fd_0.disarm();
    TRY(ipc_socket->set_blocking(true));

    auto transport = make<IPC::Transport>(move(ipc_socket));
#endif

    if (capture_output) {
        // Close write ends in parent
        MUST(Core::System::close(stdout_pipe[1]));
        MUST(Core::System::close(stderr_pipe[1]));

        // Wrap read ends in File objects
        output_capture.stdout_file = TRY(Core::File::adopt_fd(stdout_pipe[0], Core::File::OpenMode::Read));
        output_capture.stderr_file = TRY(Core::File::adopt_fd(stderr_pipe[0], Core::File::OpenMode::Read));
    }

    terminate_process_on_failure.disarm();
    return ProcessAndIPCTransport { process.release_value(), move(transport), move(output_capture) };
}

ErrorOr<Optional<pid_t>> Process::get_process_pid(StringView process_name, StringView pid_path)
{
    if (!FileSystem::exists(pid_path))
        return OptionalNone {};

    Optional<pid_t> pid;
    {
        auto pid_file = Core::File::open(pid_path, Core::File::OpenMode::Read);
        if (pid_file.is_error()) {
            warnln("Could not open {} PID file '{}': {}", process_name, pid_path, pid_file.error());
            return pid_file.release_error();
        }

        auto contents = pid_file.value()->read_until_eof();
        if (contents.is_error()) {
            warnln("Could not read {} PID file '{}': {}", process_name, pid_path, contents.error());
            return contents.release_error();
        }

        pid = StringView { contents.value() }.to_number<pid_t>();
    }

    if (!pid.has_value()) {
        warnln("{} PID file '{}' exists, but with an invalid PID", process_name, pid_path);
        TRY(FileSystem::remove(pid_path, FileSystem::RecursionMode::Disallowed));
        return OptionalNone {};
    }

    bool const process_not_found = [&pid]() {
#if defined(AK_OS_WINDOWS)
        HANDLE process_handle = OpenProcess(PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION, FALSE, *pid);
        if (process_handle == nullptr)
            return true;

        // FIXME: We should create an RAII wrapper around HANDLE objects.
        ScopeGuard handle_guard = [&process_handle] { CloseHandle(process_handle); };
        DWORD exit_code = 0;

        if (GetExitCodeProcess(process_handle, &exit_code) == 0)
            return true;

        return exit_code != STILL_ACTIVE;
#else
        return kill(*pid, 0) < 0;
#endif
    }();

    if (process_not_found) {
        warnln("{} PID file '{}' exists with PID {}, but process cannot be found", process_name, pid_path, *pid);
        TRY(FileSystem::remove(pid_path, FileSystem::RecursionMode::Disallowed));
        return OptionalNone {};
    }

    return pid;
}

// This is heavily based on how SystemServer's Service creates its socket.
ErrorOr<int> Process::create_ipc_socket(ByteString const& socket_path)
{
    auto socket_address_un = Core::SocketAddress::local(socket_path).to_sockaddr_un();
    if (!socket_address_un.has_value())
        return Error::from_string_literal("IPC socket path does not fit in sockaddr_un; the runtime directory path is too long");

    if (FileSystem::exists(socket_path))
        TRY(FileSystem::remove(socket_path, FileSystem::RecursionMode::Disallowed));

#if defined(AK_OS_WINDOWS)
    auto socket_fd = TRY(Core::System::socket(AF_LOCAL, SOCK_STREAM, 0));
    TRY(Core::System::set_socket_blocking(socket_fd, false));
    if (SetHandleInformation(to_handle(socket_fd), HANDLE_FLAG_INHERIT, 0) == 0)
        return Error::from_windows_error();
#else
#    ifdef SOCK_NONBLOCK
    auto socket_fd = TRY(Core::System::socket(AF_LOCAL, SOCK_STREAM | SOCK_NONBLOCK | SOCK_CLOEXEC, 0));
#    else
    auto socket_fd = TRY(Core::System::socket(AF_LOCAL, SOCK_STREAM, 0));

    int option = 1;
    TRY(Core::System::ioctl(socket_fd, FIONBIO, &option));
    TRY(Core::System::fcntl(socket_fd, F_SETFD, FD_CLOEXEC));
#    endif

#    if !defined(AK_OS_BSD_GENERIC) && !defined(AK_OS_GNU_HURD)
    TRY(Core::System::fchmod(socket_fd, 0600));
#    endif
#endif

    TRY(Core::System::bind(socket_fd, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&*socket_address_un), sizeof(*socket_address_un)));
    TRY(Core::System::listen(socket_fd, 16));

    return socket_fd;
}

ErrorOr<Process::ProcessPaths> Process::paths_for_process(StringView process_name, StringView runtime_directory)
{
    auto socket_path = ByteString::formatted("{}/{}.socket", runtime_directory, process_name);
    auto pid_path = ByteString::formatted("{}/{}.pid", runtime_directory, process_name);

    return ProcessPaths { move(socket_path), move(pid_path) };
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/Badge.h>
#include <AK/RefPtr.h>
#include <AK/Utf16String.h>
#include <AK/WeakPtr.h>
#include <LibCore/File.h>
#include <LibCore/Process.h>
#include <LibIPC/Connection.h>
#include <LibIPC/Transport.h>
#include <LibSandbox/ConnectBroker.h>
#include <LibURL/URL.h>
#include <LibWebView/BrowsingSession.h>
#include <LibWebView/CrashReport.h>
#include <LibWebView/Forward.h>
#include <LibWebView/ProcessType.h>

namespace WebView {

struct ProcessOutputCapture {
    OwnPtr<Core::File> stdout_file;
    OwnPtr<Core::File> stderr_file;
};

class WEBVIEW_API Process {
    AK_MAKE_NONCOPYABLE(Process);
    AK_MAKE_DEFAULT_MOVABLE(Process);

public:
    Process(ProcessType type, RefPtr<IPC::ConnectionBase> connection, Core::Process process);
    static Process for_browser();
    ~Process();

    template<typename ClientType>
    struct ProcessAndClient;

    template<typename ClientType, typename... ClientArguments>
    static ErrorOr<ProcessAndClient<ClientType>> spawn(ProcessType type, Core::ProcessSpawnOptions const& options, bool capture_output, ClientArguments&&... client_arguments);

    struct ProcessAndTransport;

    // For a helper that serves another process: The caller hands the transport over instead of connecting to it.
    static ErrorOr<ProcessAndTransport> spawn_with_transport(ProcessType type, Core::ProcessSpawnOptions const& options, bool capture_output);

    // For a helper that is not connected to over IPC, such as one that reports through its output and exits.
    static ErrorOr<Core::Process> spawn_without_transport(ProcessType, Core::ProcessSpawnOptions const&);

    ProcessType type() const { return m_type; }

    IsPrivate is_private() const { return m_is_private; }
    void set_is_private(IsPrivate is_private) { m_is_private = is_private; }

    Optional<Utf16String> const& title() const { return m_title; }
    void set_title(Optional<Utf16String> title) { m_title = move(title); }

    Optional<URL::URL> const& site_url() const { return m_site_url; }
    void set_site_url(Optional<URL::URL> site_url) { m_site_url = move(site_url); }

    Optional<u64> owner_child_id() const { return m_owner_child_id; }
    void set_owner_child_id(u64 child_id) { m_owner_child_id = child_id; }

    template<typename ConnectionFromClient>
    RefPtr<ConnectionFromClient> client()
    {
        if (auto strong_connection = m_connection.strong_ref())
            return as<ConnectionFromClient>(*strong_connection);
        return {};
    }

    void set_crash_report(NonnullOwnPtr<CrashReport> report) { m_crash_report = move(report); }

#if defined(AK_OS_LINUX)
    // The broker serves this process alone, so it lives exactly as long as the process does.
    void set_connect_broker(NonnullOwnPtr<Sandbox::ConnectBroker> broker) { m_connect_broker = move(broker); }
#endif
    void save_crash_report(Optional<int> exit_status);
    ByteString const& saved_crash_report_name() const { return m_saved_crash_report_name; }

    pid_t pid() const { return m_pid; }
    u64 child_id() const { return m_child_id; }
    void did_register(Badge<ProcessManager>, u64 child_id);

    ProcessOutputCapture& output_capture() { return m_output_capture; }
    ProcessOutputCapture const& output_capture() const { return m_output_capture; }

    struct ProcessPaths {
        ByteString socket_path;
        ByteString pid_path;
    };
    static ErrorOr<ProcessPaths> paths_for_process(StringView process_name, StringView runtime_directory);

    // Helper processes receive only debugging, sanitizer, locale and basic environment variables; others may hold
    // secrets.
    static Vector<ByteString> helper_process_environment(ProcessType);
    static ErrorOr<Optional<pid_t>> get_process_pid(StringView process_name, StringView pid_path);
    static ErrorOr<int> create_ipc_socket(ByteString const& socket_path);

private:
    struct ProcessAndIPCTransport {
        Core::Process process;
        NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport> transport;
        ProcessOutputCapture output_capture;
    };
    static ErrorOr<ProcessAndIPCTransport> spawn_and_connect_to_process(ProcessType, Core::ProcessSpawnOptions const& options, bool capture_output);

    OwnPtr<CrashReport> m_crash_report;
    ByteString m_saved_crash_report_name;

#if defined(AK_OS_LINUX)

    OwnPtr<Sandbox::ConnectBroker> m_connect_broker;
#endif
    Process(ProcessType, pid_t);

    pid_t m_pid { -1 };
    // NB: The browser's own record has no process of its own to hold. On Windows, holding the process keeps its handle,
    //     and with it its PID, until this record is gone.
    Optional<Core::Process> m_process;
    u64 m_child_id { 0 };
    ProcessType m_type;
    IsPrivate m_is_private { IsPrivate::No };
    Optional<Utf16String> m_title;
    Optional<URL::URL> m_site_url;
    Optional<u64> m_owner_child_id;
    WeakPtr<IPC::ConnectionBase> m_connection;
    ProcessOutputCapture m_output_capture;
};

template<typename ClientType>
struct Process::ProcessAndClient {
    Process process;
    NonnullRefPtr<ClientType> client;
};

struct Process::ProcessAndTransport {
    Process process;
    NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport> transport;
};

template<typename ClientType, typename... ClientArguments>
ErrorOr<Process::ProcessAndClient<ClientType>> Process::spawn(ProcessType type, Core::ProcessSpawnOptions const& options, bool capture_output, ClientArguments&&... client_arguments)
{
    auto [core_process, transport, output_capture] = TRY(spawn_and_connect_to_process(type, options, capture_output));

    // NB: Create the record first, so that a failure below ends the helper rather than leaving it running untracked.
    Process process { type, nullptr, move(core_process) };
    process.m_output_capture = move(output_capture);
    auto client = TRY(adopt_nonnull_ref_or_enomem(new (nothrow) ClientType { move(transport), forward<ClientArguments>(client_arguments)... }));
    process.m_connection = *client;
    return ProcessAndClient<ClientType> { move(process), client };
}

}

#include <AK/NumberFormat.h>
#include <AK/NumericLimits.h>
#include <AK/String.h>
#include <LibCore/EventLoop.h>
#include <LibCore/Process.h>
#include <LibCore/System.h>

namespace WebView {

ProcessType process_type_from_name(StringView name)
{
    if (name == "Browser"sv)
        return ProcessType::Browser;
    if (name == "UI"sv)
        return ProcessType::UI;
    if (name == "Hub"sv)
        return ProcessType::Hub;
    if (name == "Compositor"sv)
        return ProcessType::Compositor;
    if (name == "WebContent"sv)
        return ProcessType::WebContent;
    if (name == "RequestServer"sv)
        return ProcessType::RequestServer;
    if (name == "ImageDecoder"sv)
        return ProcessType::ImageDecoder;
    if (name == "MediaServer"sv)
        return ProcessType::MediaServer;
    if (name == "AudioServer"sv)
        return ProcessType::AudioServer;
    if (name == "VideoDecoderServer"sv)
        return ProcessType::VideoDecoderServer;
    if (name == "WebRTCClient"sv)
        return ProcessType::WebRTCClient;

    dbgln("Unknown process type: '{}'", name);
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

StringView process_name_from_type(ProcessType type)
{
    switch (type) {
    case ProcessType::Browser:
        return "Browser"sv;
    case ProcessType::UI:
        return "UI"sv;
    case ProcessType::Hub:
        return "Hub"sv;
    case ProcessType::Compositor:
        return "Compositor"sv;
    case ProcessType::WebContent:
        return "WebContent"sv;
    case ProcessType::RequestServer:
        return "RequestServer"sv;
    case ProcessType::ImageDecoder:
        return "ImageDecoder"sv;
    case ProcessType::MediaServer:
        return "MediaServer"sv;
    case ProcessType::AudioServer:
        return "AudioServer"sv;
    case ProcessType::VideoDecoderServer:
        return "VideoDecoderServer"sv;
    case ProcessType::WebRTCClient:
        return "WebRTCClient"sv;
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

ProcessManager::ProcessManager()
    : on_process_added([](Process&) { })
    , on_process_exited([](Process&&, Optional<int>) { })
    , on_process_near_memory_limit([](Process&, u64) { })
    , on_process_exceeded_memory_limit([](Process&, u64) { })
    , m_process_monitor(ProcessMonitor([this](pid_t pid, Optional<int> exit_status) {
        auto child_id = m_child_ids_by_pid.get(pid);
        if (!child_id.has_value())
            return;
        if (auto process = remove_process(*child_id); process.has_value()) {
            process->save_crash_report(exit_status);
            on_process_exited(process.release_value(), exit_status);
        }
    }))
{
    add_process(Process::for_browser());

#ifdef AK_OS_MACH
    mach_port_t task_name_port = MACH_PORT_NULL;
    auto res = task_get_special_port(mach_task_self(), TASK_NAME_PORT, &task_name_port);
    VERIFY(res == KERN_SUCCESS);
    set_process_task_name_port(getpid(), Core::MachPort::adopt_right(task_name_port, Core::MachPort::PortRight::Send));
#endif
}

ProcessManager::~ProcessManager() = default;

Optional<Process&> ProcessManager::find_process(pid_t pid)
{
    verify_event_loop();
    auto child_id = m_child_ids_by_pid.get(pid);
    if (!child_id.has_value())
        return {};
    return m_processes.get(*child_id);
}

Optional<Process&> ProcessManager::find_child(u64 child_id)
{
    verify_event_loop();
    return m_processes.get(child_id);
}

ChildIdentity ProcessManager::add_process(WebView::Process&& process)
{
    verify_event_loop();
    auto pid = process.pid();
    u64 child_id = 0;
    if (process.type() != ProcessType::Browser) {
        VERIFY(m_next_child_id < NumericLimits<u64>::max());
        child_id = m_next_child_id++;
    }
    process.did_register({}, child_id);
    on_process_added(process);
    VERIFY(m_processes.set(child_id, move(process)) == AK::HashSetResult::InsertedNewEntry);
    VERIFY(m_child_ids_by_pid.set(pid, child_id) == AK::HashSetResult::InsertedNewEntry);
    m_statistics.processes.append(make<Core::Platform::ProcessInfo>(pid));
    m_process_monitor.add_process(pid);
    return { child_id, pid };
}

ErrorOr<void> ProcessManager::terminate_child(u64 child_id, Core::Process::TerminationMode mode)
{
    verify_event_loop();
    // NB: Child ID zero is the browser itself.
    auto process = child_id != 0 ? find_child(child_id) : OptionalNone {};
    if (!process.has_value())
        return Error::from_errno(ESRCH);
    // NB: The process is still in the table, so its exit has not been handled yet. On POSIX it has not been reaped,
    //     and on Windows its Process keeps the handle open, so its PID cannot belong to another process yet.
    return Core::Process::terminate_process(process->pid(), mode);
}

void ProcessManager::for_each_process(Function<void(Process&)> callback)
{
    verify_event_loop();
    for (auto& entry : m_processes)
        callback(entry.value);
}

void ProcessManager::for_each_process_statistics(Function<void(Process&, Core::Platform::ProcessInfo const&)> callback)
{
    verify_event_loop();
    m_statistics.for_each_process([&](auto const& process) {
        auto process_handle = find_process(process.pid);
        if (!process_handle.has_value())
            return;

        callback(*process_handle, process);
    });
}

#if defined(AK_OS_MACH)
void ProcessManager::set_process_task_name_port(pid_t pid, Core::MachPort&& port)
{
    verify_event_loop();
    for (auto const& info : m_statistics.processes) {
        if (info->pid == pid) {
            info->task_name_port = move(port);
            return;
        }
    }
}
#endif

Optional<Process> ProcessManager::remove_process(u64 child_id)
{
    verify_event_loop();
    cancel_forced_exit(child_id);
    m_children_ended_for_memory_use.remove(child_id);
    m_memory_limit_warnings.remove(child_id);
    auto process = m_processes.take(child_id);
    if (!process.has_value())
        return {};
    auto pid = process->pid();
    m_child_ids_by_pid.remove(pid);
    m_statistics.processes.remove_first_matching([&](auto const& info) {
        return (info->pid == pid);
    });
    return process;
}

void ProcessManager::remove_all_processes()
{
    verify_event_loop();

    // NB: Shutting down a connection runs its die() handler, which looks up its process, for example to end a worker
    //     that did not notice the connection closing. Shut the connections down while the table is intact.
    Vector<u64> child_ids;
    child_ids.ensure_capacity(m_processes.size());
    for (auto const& entry : m_processes)
        child_ids.unchecked_append(entry.key);
    for (auto child_id : child_ids) {
        auto process = m_processes.get(child_id);
        if (!process.has_value())
            continue;
        if (auto connection = process->client<IPC::ConnectionBase>())
            connection->shutdown();
    }

    // Destroying a process may run a die() handler too, so take the processes out first. Lookups then see an empty
    // table rather than one being destroyed.
    m_child_ids_by_pid.clear();
    auto processes = move(m_processes);
    processes.clear();
}

void ProcessManager::cancel_forced_exit(u64 child_id)
{
    verify_event_loop();
    if (auto timer = m_forced_exit_timers.take(child_id); timer.has_value())
        (*timer)->stop();
}

void ProcessManager::force_exit_after_timeout(u64 child_id, int timeout_ms)
{
    verify_event_loop();
    if (!m_processes.contains(child_id))
        return;
    if (m_forced_exit_timers.contains(child_id))
        return;

    auto timer = Core::Timer::create_single_shot(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(timeout_ms), [this, child_id] {
        m_forced_exit_timers.remove(child_id);
        auto process = m_processes.get(child_id);
        if (!process.has_value())
            return;

        auto pid = process->pid();
        dbgln("Force-killing unresponsive {} process {}", process_name_from_type(process->type()), pid);
        auto result = terminate_child(child_id, Core::Process::TerminationMode::Forceful);
        if (result.is_error())
            dbgln("Failed to force-kill process {}: {}", pid, result.error());
    });
    timer->start();
    m_forced_exit_timers.set(child_id, move(timer));
}

void ProcessManager::update_all_process_statistics()
{
    verify_event_loop();
    (void)update_process_statistics(m_statistics);
}

u64 ProcessManager::default_web_content_memory_limit()
{
#if defined(HAS_ADDRESS_SANITIZER)
    // NB: A sanitizer multiplies the memory a helper uses, so the limit would end helpers that behave correctly.
    return 0;
#else
    // A page that needs this much memory is almost always a runaway one. A machine with more memory can let a page
    // go further before the rest of the system suffers, and a machine with little memory suffers long before one
    // helper uses all of it.
    auto physical_memory = Core::System::physical_memory_bytes();
    auto limit = physical_memory > 16 * GiB ? 16 * GiB : 8 * GiB;
    return min(limit, physical_memory / 2);
#endif
}

void ProcessManager::set_web_content_memory_limit(u64 limit_in_bytes)
{
    verify_event_loop();
    m_web_content_memory_limit = limit_in_bytes;
    if (limit_in_bytes == 0) {
        if (m_web_content_memory_limit_timer)
            m_web_content_memory_limit_timer->stop();
        return;
    }

    // NB: A runaway helper can grow by gigabytes per second, so a long interval would let it pass the limit by far.
    static constexpr auto check_interval = AK::Duration::from_seconds(2);
    if (!m_web_content_memory_limit_timer) {
        m_web_content_memory_limit_timer = Core::Timer::create_repeating(check_interval, [this] {
            check_web_content_memory_use();
        });
    }
    m_web_content_memory_limit_timer->start();
}

void ProcessManager::check_web_content_memory_use()
{
    verify_event_loop();

    // A helper this near the limit is asked to release memory, so that a page that only holds much garbage or many
    // caches does not have to be ended. The limit itself is not relaxed for it: a runaway helper does not shrink,
    // and waiting for it would only let it grow further.
    auto warning_threshold = m_web_content_memory_limit / 4 * 3;
    // NB: Releasing memory is costly for a helper, and one that stays near the limit most likely has nothing left to
    //     release. It is asked again, but each time after twice the wait, until it has been well below the limit for
    //     a while.
    static constexpr auto first_warning_interval = AK::Duration::from_seconds(10);
    static constexpr auto longest_warning_interval = AK::Duration::from_seconds(640);

    struct HelperAndMemoryUse {
        u64 child_id { 0 };
        u64 memory_usage_in_bytes { 0 };
    };
    Vector<HelperAndMemoryUse> helpers_near_limit;
    Vector<HelperAndMemoryUse> helpers_over_limit;
    auto now = MonotonicTime::now_coarse();
    for (auto const& info : m_statistics.processes) {
        // NB: Child ID zero is the browser itself.
        auto child_id = m_child_ids_by_pid.get(info->pid);
        if (!child_id.has_value() || *child_id == 0 || m_children_ended_for_memory_use.contains(*child_id))
            continue;
        // NB: Only WebContent has a limit for now. The other helpers serve every tab, so ending one of them would
        //     disturb all tabs, and none of them can tell the user why it was ended.
        if (auto process = find_child(*child_id); !process.has_value() || process->type() != ProcessType::WebContent)
            continue;
        auto usage = Core::Platform::process_resource_usage(*info);
        if (!usage.has_value())
            continue;
        if (usage->attributed_memory_bytes > m_web_content_memory_limit) {
            helpers_over_limit.append({ *child_id, usage->attributed_memory_bytes });
            continue;
        }
        auto warning = m_memory_limit_warnings.get(*child_id);
        if (usage->attributed_memory_bytes <= warning_threshold) {
            // NB: A helper that only dipped below the threshold keeps its wait, so that one that goes back and forth
            //     across the threshold is not asked each time it crosses.
            if (warning.has_value() && now >= warning->next_time + warning->interval)
                m_memory_limit_warnings.remove(*child_id);
            continue;
        }
        if (warning.has_value() && now < warning->next_time)
            continue;
        auto interval = warning.has_value() ? min(warning->interval + warning->interval, longest_warning_interval) : first_warning_interval;
        m_memory_limit_warnings.set(*child_id, { now + interval, interval });
        helpers_near_limit.append({ *child_id, usage->attributed_memory_bytes });
    }

    for (auto const& helper : helpers_near_limit) {
        auto process = find_child(helper.child_id);
        if (!process.has_value())
            continue;
        dbgln("{} process {} is near its memory limit: it uses {}, and the limit is {}", process_name_from_type(process->type()), process->pid(), human_readable_size(helper.memory_usage_in_bytes), human_readable_size(m_web_content_memory_limit));
        on_process_near_memory_limit(*process, helper.memory_usage_in_bytes);
    }

    // The callback may change the process table, so each helper is looked up again.
    for (auto const& helper : helpers_over_limit) {
        auto process = find_child(helper.child_id);
        if (!process.has_value())
            continue;
        warnln("Ending {} process {}: it uses {} of memory, and the limit is {}", process_name_from_type(process->type()), process->pid(), human_readable_size(helper.memory_usage_in_bytes), human_readable_size(m_web_content_memory_limit));
        // NB: The exit is handled in a later task, so the process is still in the table for the callback. A helper
        //     that could not be ended is not reported, or a later crash of it would be blamed on its memory use. It
        //     is not remembered either, so the next check tries again.
        if (auto result = terminate_child(helper.child_id, Core::Process::TerminationMode::Forceful); result.is_error()) {
            warnln("Failed to end process over its memory limit: {}", result.error());
            continue;
        }
        m_children_ended_for_memory_use.set(helper.child_id);
        on_process_exceeded_memory_limit(*process, helper.memory_usage_in_bytes);
    }
}

void ProcessManager::verify_event_loop() const
{
    if (Core::EventLoop::is_running())
        VERIFY(&Core::EventLoop::current() == m_creation_event_loop);
}

Optional<Core::Platform::ProcessResourceUsage> ProcessManager::resource_usage(pid_t pid) const
{
    verify_event_loop();
    for (auto const& process : m_statistics.processes) {
        if (process->pid == pid)
            return Core::Platform::process_resource_usage(*process);
    }
    return {};
}

}

/*

#pragma once

#include <AK/Function.h>
#include <AK/HashMap.h>
#include <AK/HashTable.h>
#include <AK/RefPtr.h>
#include <AK/Types.h>
#include <LibCore/EventLoop.h>
#include <LibCore/Platform/ProcessResourceUsage.h>
#include <LibCore/Platform/ProcessStatistics.h>
#include <LibCore/Process.h>
#include <LibCore/Timer.h>
#include <LibWebView/ChildIdentity.h>
#include <LibWebView/Forward.h>
#include <LibWebView/Process.h>
#include <LibWebView/ProcessMonitor.h>
#include <LibWebView/ProcessType.h>

namespace WebView {

WEBVIEW_API ProcessType process_type_from_name(StringView);
WEBVIEW_API StringView process_name_from_type(ProcessType type);

class WEBVIEW_API ProcessManager {
    AK_MAKE_NONCOPYABLE(ProcessManager);

public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    ProcessManager();
    ~ProcessManager();

    // Gives the process its child ID and starts watching for its exit.
    ChildIdentity add_process(Process&&);
    void for_each_process(Function<void(Process&)>);
    void for_each_process_statistics(Function<void(Process&, Core::Platform::ProcessInfo const&)>);
    Optional<Process> remove_process(u64 child_id);
    void remove_all_processes();
    Optional<Process&> find_process(pid_t);
    Optional<Process&> find_child(u64 child_id);
    ErrorOr<void> terminate_child(u64 child_id, Core::Process::TerminationMode);
    void cancel_forced_exit(u64 child_id);
    void force_exit_after_timeout(u64 child_id, int timeout_ms);

#if defined(AK_OS_MACH)
    void set_process_task_name_port(pid_t, Core::MachPort&&);
#endif

    void update_all_process_statistics();

    // The memory a WebContent process may use on this machine before it is ended. Zero means that there is no limit.
    static u64 default_web_content_memory_limit();
    // Ends each helper that uses more memory than the limit, so that one runaway process cannot take the machine
    // down. A helper that comes near the limit is reported first, so that it can be asked to release memory. A limit
    // of zero turns the check off.
    void set_web_content_memory_limit(u64 limit_in_bytes);
    Optional<Core::Platform::ProcessResourceUsage> resource_usage(pid_t) const;

    Function<void(Process&)> on_process_added; // test-web
    Function<void(Process&&, Optional<int> exit_status)> on_process_exited;
    // Called when a helper comes near the memory limit, and again from time to time while it stays there.
    Function<void(Process&, u64 memory_usage_in_bytes)> on_process_near_memory_limit;
    // Called when a helper was ended for using more memory than the limit, before its exit is handled.
    Function<void(Process&, u64 memory_usage_in_bytes)> on_process_exceeded_memory_limit;

private:
    void verify_event_loop() const;
    void check_web_content_memory_use();

    Core::Platform::ProcessStatistics m_statistics;
    HashMap<u64, Process> m_processes;
    // NB: Exit notifications and statistics name processes by PID.
    HashMap<pid_t, u64> m_child_ids_by_pid;
    HashMap<u64, RefPtr<Core::Timer>> m_forced_exit_timers;
    u64 m_web_content_memory_limit { 0 };
    RefPtr<Core::Timer> m_web_content_memory_limit_timer;
    // NB: A helper ended for its memory use stays in the table until its exit is handled.
    HashTable<u64> m_children_ended_for_memory_use;
    struct MemoryLimitWarning {
        // The helper is not asked to release memory again before this time.
        MonotonicTime next_time;
        // How long the helper had to wait this time, which is doubled for the next time.
        AK::Duration interval;
    };
    HashMap<u64, MemoryLimitWarning> m_memory_limit_warnings;
    u64 m_next_child_id { 1 };
    ProcessMonitor m_process_monitor;
    Core::EventLoop* m_creation_event_loop { &Core::EventLoop::current() };
};

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWebView/ProcessMonitor.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2025, ayeteadoe <ayeteadoe@gmail.com>
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause

#include <LibCore/EventLoop.h>
#include <LibWebView/ProcessMonitor.h>
#if !defined(AK_OS_WINDOWS)
#    include <LibCore/System.h>
#endif

namespace WebView {

ProcessMonitor::ProcessMonitor(Function<void(pid_t, Optional<int> exit_status)> exit_handler)
    : m_on_process_exit(move(exit_handler))
{
#if !defined(AK_OS_WINDOWS)
    m_signal_handle = Core::EventLoop::register_signal(SIGCHLD, [this](int) {
        auto result = Core::System::waitpid(-1, WNOHANG);
        while (!result.is_error() && result.value().pid > 0) {
            auto& [pid, status] = result.value();
            if (m_monitored_processes.contains(pid)) {
                if (WIFEXITED(status) || WIFSIGNALED(status)) {
                    m_monitored_processes.remove(pid);
                    m_on_process_exit(pid, status);
                }
            }
            result = Core::System::waitpid(-1, WNOHANG);
        }
    });
#endif
}

ProcessMonitor::~ProcessMonitor()
{
#if defined(AK_OS_WINDOWS)
    for (pid_t pid : m_monitored_processes) {
        Core::EventLoop::unregister_process(pid);
    }
#else
    Core::EventLoop::unregister_signal(m_signal_handle);
#endif
}

void ProcessMonitor::add_process(pid_t pid)
{
    if (m_monitored_processes.set(pid, AK::HashSetExistingEntryBehavior::Keep) != AK::HashSetResult::InsertedNewEntry)
        return;

#if defined(AK_OS_WINDOWS)
    Core::EventLoop::register_process(pid, [this](pid_t pid) {
        m_monitored_processes.remove(pid);
        m_on_process_exit(pid, {});
    });
#endif
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWebView/ProcessReaper.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <AK/ScopeGuard.h>
#include <LibCore/Process.h>
#include <LibCore/System.h>
#include <LibWebView/ProcessReaper.h>
#include <LibWebView/ProcessReaperProtocol.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>

namespace WebView {

// The reaper reads the helper records from this descriptor.
static constexpr int reaper_pipe_fd = 3;

ErrorOr<NonnullOwnPtr<ProcessReaper>> ProcessReaper::start(ByteString const& executable_path)
{
    // Both ends are close-on-exec, so that no helper inherits the write end: the reaper acts when the last copy of the
    // write end is closed, which must happen when this process is gone.
    auto pipe_fds = TRY(Core::System::pipe2(O_CLOEXEC));
    ScopeGuard close_read_end = [&] { (void)Core::System::close(pipe_fds[0]); };
    ArmedScopeGuard close_write_end = [&] { (void)Core::System::close(pipe_fds[1]); };

    // If the reaper is gone, writing to the pipe must fail instead of killing us with SIGPIPE.
    if (::fcntl(pipe_fds[1], F_SETNOSIGPIPE, 1) < 0)
        return Error::from_syscall("fcntl(F_SETNOSIGPIPE)"sv, errno);

    // If the read end already is the reaper's descriptor number, the child-side dup2() would do nothing and leave it
    // close-on-exec. Move it to a descriptor that cannot collide.
    if (pipe_fds[0] <= reaper_pipe_fd) {
        auto moved_fd = TRY(Core::System::fcntl(pipe_fds[0], F_DUPFD_CLOEXEC, reaper_pipe_fd + 1));
        (void)Core::System::close(pipe_fds[0]);
        pipe_fds[0] = moved_fd;
    }

    Vector<ByteString> arguments;
    auto process = TRY(Core::Process::spawn({
        .name = "ProcessReaper"sv,
        .executable = executable_path,
        // The reaper has to outlive the Browser, so a Ctrl+C meant for the Browser must not end it first.
        .new_process_group = true,
        .arguments = arguments,
        .environment = Vector<ByteString> {},
        .file_actions = {
            Core::FileAction::OpenFile { .path = "/dev/null", .mode = Core::File::OpenMode::Read, .fd = STDIN_FILENO },
            Core::FileAction::DupFd { .write_fd = pipe_fds[0], .fd = reaper_pipe_fd },
        },
    }));

    auto process_reaper = TRY(adopt_nonnull_own_or_enomem(new (nothrow) ProcessReaper(pipe_fds[1], process.pid())));
    close_write_end.disarm();
    return process_reaper;
}

ProcessReaper::ProcessReaper(int pipe_fd, pid_t pid)
    : m_pipe_fd(pipe_fd)
    , m_pid(pid)
{
}

ProcessReaper::~ProcessReaper()
{
    // Closing the pipe tells the reaper that we are gone, as our exit or death would.
    if (m_pipe_fd >= 0)
        (void)Core::System::close(m_pipe_fd);
}

ErrorOr<void> ProcessReaper::watch(pid_t pid)
{
    // The helper is our child, and we have not reaped it yet, so its PID still identifies it here. If it is already
    // gone, there is nothing left to kill.
    ProcessReaperRecord record { .pid = pid, .padding = 0, .start_time_in_microseconds = 0 };
    if (!process_start_time_in_microseconds(pid, record.start_time_in_microseconds))
        return {};

    // Writes of this size to a pipe are atomic, so the reaper always reads whole records.
    auto bytes = TRY(Core::System::write(m_pipe_fd, { &record, sizeof(record) }));
    if (bytes != sizeof(record))
        return Error::from_errno(EIO);
    return {};
}

}

#pragma once

// Starts the ProcessReaper helper, which kills the processes that it is told about once this process is gone. The
// kernel does that for us on Linux, but not on macOS.
class WEBVIEW_API ProcessReaper {

    AK_MAKE_NONMOVABLE(ProcessReaper);

    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    static ErrorOr<NonnullOwnPtr<ProcessReaper>> start(ByteString const& executable_path);
    ~ProcessReaper();

    ErrorOr<void> watch(pid_t);

    pid_t m_pid { -1 };

FILE: Libraries/LibWebView/ProcessReaperProtocol.h
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#pragma once

// Shared by the Browser and the ProcessReaper helper, which uses nothing but system libraries.

#include <libproc.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <sys/proc_info.h>
#include <sys/types.h>

namespace WebView {

// A PID alone does not identify a process: once the helper has exited and the Browser has reaped it, the system may
// give its PID to another process. The start time tells the two apart.
struct ProcessReaperRecord {
    pid_t pid;
    uint32_t padding;
    uint64_t start_time_in_microseconds;
};
static_assert(sizeof(ProcessReaperRecord) == 16);

inline bool process_start_time_in_microseconds(pid_t pid, uint64_t& start_time)
{
    proc_bsdinfo info {};
    if (proc_pidinfo(pid, PROC_PIDTBSDINFO, 0, &info, sizeof(info)) != sizeof(info))
        return false;
    start_time = info.pbi_start_tvsec * 1'000'000 + info.pbi_start_tvusec;
    return true;
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWebView/ProcessSnapshot.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <AK/HashMap.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/HTML/SandboxingFlagSet.h>
#include <LibWebView/Application.h>
#include <LibWebView/CanonicalDocument.h>
#include <LibWebView/CanonicalTraversable.h>
#include <LibWebView/ProcessManager.h>
#include <LibWebView/ProcessSnapshot.h>
#include <LibWebView/TabDiscarder.h>
#include <LibWebView/ViewImplementation.h>

namespace WebView {

Vector<ProcessSnapshot> process_snapshots(ProcessManager& manager)
{
    // A process that hosts pages of several views is shown with the most relevant one: the active view's, then a
    // visible view's, with ties going to the lower view ID. Within a view, its top-level page wins over its frames.
    struct ProcessPage {
        ViewImplementation* view;
        URL::URL url;
        ProcessPageKind kind;
    };
    HashMap<u64, ProcessPage> process_pages;
    HashMap<u64, Vector<ProcessTabSnapshot>> process_tabs;
    HashMap<u64, Vector<ProcessFrameSnapshot>> process_frames;
    auto now = MonotonicTime::now();
    // NB: The Application is only asked once there is a view, so that a ProcessManager without one can be described.
    bool did_look_up_active_view = false;
    Optional<ViewImplementation&> active_view;
    ViewImplementation::for_each_view([&](auto& view) {
        // An owned view's page shares its owner's process, which the owner's tab already lists.
        if (view.owner_view_id().has_value())
            return IterationDecision::Continue;
        if (!did_look_up_active_view) {
            active_view = Application::the().active_web_view();
            did_look_up_active_view = true;
        }
        auto priority = [&](auto const& candidate) {
            if (active_view.has_value() && &*active_view == &candidate)
                return 2;
            return candidate.traversable().system_visibility_state() == Web::HTML::VisibilityState::Visible ? 1 : 0;
        };
        auto add_page = [&](u64 child_id, URL::URL const& url, ProcessPageKind kind) {
            auto current = process_pages.get(child_id);
            if (!current.has_value() || priority(view) > priority(*current->view)
                || (priority(view) == priority(*current->view) && view.view_id() < current->view->view_id())
                || (current->view == &view && kind == ProcessPageKind::TopLevel && current->kind == ProcessPageKind::Frame))
                process_pages.set(child_id, ProcessPage { &view, url, kind });
        };
        auto top_level_child_id = view.page().client().child_id();
        add_page(top_level_child_id, view.url(), ProcessPageKind::TopLevel);
        ProcessTabSnapshot tab {
            .title = view.title(),
            .page = {
                .view_id = view.view_id(),
                .url = view.url(),
                .kind = ProcessPageKind::TopLevel,
            },
            .discard_blockers_under_memory_pressure = view.discard_blockers(ViewImplementation::DiscardReason::MemoryPressure, now),
            .discard_blockers_after_inactivity = {},
            .seconds_until_discarded_after_inactivity = {},
        };
        if (auto minimum_time_hidden = TabDiscarder::minimum_time_hidden_after_inactivity(); minimum_time_hidden.has_value()) {
            auto blockers = view.discard_blockers(ViewImplementation::DiscardReason::Inactivity, now);
            tab.discard_blockers_after_inactivity = blockers;
            // NB: A tab that the UI was asked to discard already isn't counted down again until the user has seen it.
            if (blockers == DiscardBlockers::None && view.hidden_since().has_value() && !view.discard_requested()) {
                auto remaining = *minimum_time_hidden - (now - *view.hidden_since());
                tab.seconds_until_discarded_after_inactivity = max<i64>(0, remaining.to_seconds());
            }
        }
        process_tabs.ensure(top_level_child_id).append(move(tab));
        view.traversable().for_each_in_subtree([&](auto const& navigable) {
            if (navigable.has_remote_host() && navigable.replicated_state().has_value()) {
                auto child_id = navigable.remote_host().client().child_id();
                add_page(child_id, navigable.replicated_state()->active_document_url, ProcessPageKind::Frame);
                if (child_id != top_level_child_id) {
                    process_frames.ensure(child_id).append({
                        .url = navigable.replicated_state()->active_document_url,
                        .is_sandboxed = has_flag(navigable.active_document().active_sandboxing_flag_set(), Web::HTML::SandboxingFlagSet::SandboxedOrigin),
                    });
                }
            }
            return IterationDecision::Continue;
        });
        return IterationDecision::Continue;
    });

    manager.update_all_process_statistics();
    Vector<ProcessSnapshot> snapshots;
    manager.for_each_process_statistics([&](auto& process, auto const& statistics) {
        ProcessSnapshot snapshot {
            .child_id = process.child_id(),
            .pid = statistics.pid,
            .type = process.type(),
            .is_private = process.is_private(),
            .title = process.title(),
            .site_url = process.site_url(),
            .owner_child_id = process.owner_child_id(),
            .cpu_percent = statistics.cpu_percent,
            .memory_usage_bytes = statistics.memory_usage_bytes,
            .page = {},
            .tabs = process_tabs.get(process.child_id()).value_or({}),
            .frames = process_frames.get(process.child_id()).value_or({}),
        };
        if (auto page = process_pages.get(process.child_id()); page.has_value()) {
            snapshot.site_url = page->url;
            snapshot.page = ProcessPageSnapshot {
                .view_id = page->view->view_id(),
                .url = page->url,
                .kind = page->kind,
            };
        }
        snapshots.append(move(snapshot));
    });
    return snapshots;
}

bool end_process(ProcessManager& process_manager, u64 child_id)
{
    auto result = process_manager.terminate_child(child_id, Core::Process::TerminationMode::Forceful);
    return !result.is_error() || (result.error().is_errno() && result.error().code() == ESRCH);
}

}

/*

#pragma once

#include <AK/ByteBuffer.h>
#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <AK/String.h>
#include <AK/Utf16String.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibURL/URL.h>
#include <LibWebView/BrowsingSession.h>
#include <LibWebView/DiscardBlockers.h>
#include <LibWebView/Export.h>
#include <LibWebView/Forward.h>
#include <LibWebView/ProcessType.h>

namespace WebView {

enum class ProcessPageKind : u8 {
    TopLevel,
    Frame,
};

// The page that a WebContent process is shown with in the task manager.
struct ProcessPageSnapshot {
    u64 view_id { 0 };
    URL::URL url;
    ProcessPageKind kind { ProcessPageKind::TopLevel };
};

// A tab whose page a WebContent process hosts.
struct ProcessTabSnapshot {
    Utf16String title;
    ProcessPageSnapshot page;
    // What keeps the tab loaded when the system is about to run out of memory, and once it was hidden for as long as
    // the user's settings allow, if they allow it.
    DiscardBlockers discard_blockers_under_memory_pressure { DiscardBlockers::None };
    Optional<DiscardBlockers> discard_blockers_after_inactivity;
    // How long until the tab is discarded for being hidden, if nothing keeps it.
    Optional<i64> seconds_until_discarded_after_inactivity;
};

// A frame whose document a WebContent process hosts for a tab another process displays.
struct ProcessFrameSnapshot {
    URL::URL url;
    bool is_sandboxed { false };
};

struct ProcessSnapshot {
    u64 child_id { 0 };
    pid_t pid { 0 };
    ProcessType type { ProcessType::Browser };
    IsPrivate is_private { IsPrivate::No };
    Optional<Utf16String> title;
    Optional<URL::URL> site_url;
    Optional<u64> owner_child_id;
    float cpu_percent { 0 };
    u64 memory_usage_bytes { 0 };
    Optional<ProcessPageSnapshot> page;
    // The tabs whose pages the process hosts, and the frames of other tabs' pages it hosts.
    Vector<ProcessTabSnapshot> tabs;
    Vector<ProcessFrameSnapshot> frames;
};

// Updates the process statistics, and describes every process with the page that best represents it.
WEBVIEW_API Vector<ProcessSnapshot> process_snapshots(ProcessManager&);

// Ends a process, and is satisfied with one that is already gone. Returns false for one that could not be ended.
WEBVIEW_API bool end_process(ProcessManager&, u64 child_id);

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWebView/Profile.cpp
/*

 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause

#include <AK/CharacterTypes.h>
#include <AK/Hex.h>
#include <AK/LexicalPath.h>
#include <AK/Random.h>
#include <LibCore/Directory.h>
#include <LibCrypto/Hash/Hash.h>
#include <LibFileSystem/FileSystem.h>
#include <LibWebView/Profile.h>

namespace WebView {

static ByteString profile_path(StringView root, StringView identifier)
{
    return LexicalPath::join(root, "Ladybird"sv, "Profiles"sv, identifier).string();
}

static ErrorOr<void> create_profile_directories(ProfilePaths const& paths)
{
    TRY(Core::Directory::create(paths.config, Core::Directory::CreateDirectories::Yes, 0700));
    TRY(Core::Directory::create(paths.data, Core::Directory::CreateDirectories::Yes, 0700));
    TRY(Core::Directory::create(paths.cache, Core::Directory::CreateDirectories::Yes, 0700));
    TRY(Core::Directory::create(paths.runtime, Core::Directory::CreateDirectories::Yes, 0700));
    return {};
}

Profile::Profile(ByteString identifier, ProfilePaths paths, Optional<ByteString> temporary_root)
    : m_identifier(move(identifier))
    , m_paths(move(paths))
    , m_temporary_root(move(temporary_root))
{
}

Profile::Profile(Profile&& other)
    : m_identifier(move(other.m_identifier))
    , m_paths(move(other.m_paths))
    , m_temporary_root(move(other.m_temporary_root))
{
    other.m_temporary_root.clear();
}

Profile& Profile::operator=(Profile&& other)
{
    if (this == &other)
        return *this;

    remove_temporary_root();
    m_identifier = move(other.m_identifier);
    m_paths = move(other.m_paths);
    m_temporary_root = move(other.m_temporary_root);
    other.m_temporary_root.clear();
    return *this;
}

Profile::~Profile()
{
    remove_temporary_root();
}

void Profile::remove_temporary_root()
{
    if (!m_temporary_root.has_value())
        return;
    if (FileSystem::exists(*m_temporary_root)) {
        if (auto result = FileSystem::remove(*m_temporary_root, FileSystem::RecursionMode::Allowed); result.is_error())
            warnln("Unable to remove temporary Ladybird profile '{}': {}", *m_temporary_root, result.error());
    }
    m_temporary_root.clear();
}

bool Profile::is_valid_name(StringView name)
{
    if (name.is_empty())
        return false;

    for (auto character : name.bytes()) {
        if (!is_ascii_lower_alpha(character) && !is_ascii_digit(character) && character != '_' && character != '-')
            return false;
    }
    return true;
}

ByteString Profile::routing_identifier(StringView canonical_profile_root)
{
    auto digest = Crypto::Hash::digest(Crypto::Hash::HashKind::SHA256, canonical_profile_root.bytes());
    return encode_hex(digest.bytes().slice(0, 16));
}

ErrorOr<Profile> Profile::create(ProfileSelection const& selection, ProfileRoots const& roots)
{
    auto selector_count = static_cast<unsigned>(selection.name.has_value())
        + static_cast<unsigned>(selection.path.has_value())
        + static_cast<unsigned>(selection.temporary);
    if (selector_count > 1)
        return Error::from_string_literal("Profile selectors are mutually exclusive");

    if (selection.name.has_value() && !is_valid_name(*selection.name))
        return Error::from_string_literal("Profile names may only contain lowercase ASCII letters, digits, '_' and '-'");

    if (selection.path.has_value()) {
        auto root = LexicalPath { *selection.path };
        if (!root.is_absolute())
            return Error::from_string_literal("Profile path must be absolute");

        TRY(Core::Directory::create(root, Core::Directory::CreateDirectories::Yes, 0700));
        root = LexicalPath { TRY(FileSystem::real_path(root.string())) };
        auto canonical_root = root.string();
        ProfilePaths paths {
            .config = root.append("config"sv).string(),
            .data = root.append("data"sv).string(),
            .cache = root.append("cache"sv).string(),
            .runtime = root.append("runtime"sv).string(),
            .identity = canonical_root,
        };
        TRY(create_profile_directories(paths));
        return Profile { "custom"sv, move(paths) };
    }

    if (selection.temporary) {
        TRY(Core::Directory::create(roots.temporary, Core::Directory::CreateDirectories::Yes, 0700));

        auto root = LexicalPath::join(roots.temporary, ByteString::formatted("ladybird-profile-{:016x}-{:016x}", get_random<u64>(), get_random<u64>())).string();
        TRY(Core::Directory::create(root, Core::Directory::CreateDirectories::Yes, 0700));
        root = TRY(FileSystem::real_path(root));

        ProfilePaths paths {
            .config = LexicalPath::join(root, "config"sv).string(),
            .data = LexicalPath::join(root, "data"sv).string(),
            .cache = LexicalPath::join(root, "cache"sv).string(),
            .runtime = LexicalPath::join(root, "runtime"sv).string(),
            .identity = root,
        };
        auto result = create_profile_directories(paths);
        if (result.is_error()) {
            MUST(FileSystem::remove(root, FileSystem::RecursionMode::Allowed));
            return result.release_error();
        }
        return Profile { "temporary"sv, move(paths), move(root) };
    }

    auto identifier = selection.name.value_or(DEFAULT_PROFILE_NAME);

    ProfilePaths paths {
        .config = profile_path(roots.config, identifier),
        .data = profile_path(roots.data, identifier),
        .cache = profile_path(roots.cache, identifier),
        .runtime = profile_path(roots.runtime, identifier),
        .identity = profile_path(roots.data, identifier),
    };

    TRY(create_profile_directories(paths));
    paths.identity = TRY(FileSystem::real_path(paths.identity));
    return Profile { move(identifier), move(paths) };
}

ErrorOr<Profile> Profile::create_legacy(ProfileRoots const& roots)
{
    ProfilePaths paths {
        .config = LexicalPath::join(roots.config, "Ladybird"sv).string(),
        .data = LexicalPath::join(roots.data, "Ladybird"sv).string(),
        .cache = LexicalPath::join(roots.cache, "Ladybird"sv).string(),
        .runtime = roots.runtime,
        .identity = LexicalPath::join(roots.data, "Ladybird"sv).string(),
    };

    TRY(create_profile_directories(paths));
    paths.identity = TRY(FileSystem::real_path(paths.identity));
    return Profile { "legacy"sv, move(paths) };
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWebView/Profile.h
/*

#pragma once

#include <AK/ByteString.h>
#include <AK/Error.h>
#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <LibCore/BrowserVersion.h>
#include <LibWebView/Export.h>

namespace WebView {

constexpr inline auto DEFAULT_PROFILE_NAME = BROWSER_IS_RELEASE_BUILD ? "default"sv : "developer"sv;

struct ProfileSelection {
    Optional<ByteString> name {};
    Optional<ByteString> path {};
    bool temporary { false };
};

struct ProfileRoots {
    ByteString config;
    ByteString data;
    ByteString cache;
    ByteString runtime;
    ByteString temporary;
};

struct ProfilePaths {
    ByteString config;
    ByteString data;
    ByteString cache;
    ByteString runtime;
    ByteString identity;
};

class WEBVIEW_API Profile {
    AK_MAKE_NONCOPYABLE(Profile);

public:
    Profile(Profile&&);
    Profile& operator=(Profile&&);
    ~Profile();

    static ErrorOr<Profile> create(ProfileSelection const&, ProfileRoots const&);
    static ErrorOr<Profile> create_legacy(ProfileRoots const&);
    static ByteString routing_identifier(StringView canonical_profile_root);
    static bool is_valid_name(StringView);

    ProfilePaths const& paths() const { return m_paths; }
    StringView identifier() const { return m_identifier; }
    bool is_temporary() const { return m_temporary_root.has_value(); }

private:
    Profile(ByteString identifier, ProfilePaths, Optional<ByteString> temporary_root = {});
    void remove_temporary_root();

    ByteString m_identifier;
    ProfilePaths m_paths;
    Optional<ByteString> m_temporary_root;
};

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWebView/QuarantineMacOS.mm
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <AK/Format.h>
#include <LibWebView/QuarantineMacOS.h>

#import <CoreServices/CoreServices.h>
#import <Foundation/Foundation.h>

namespace WebView {

// The system records a quarantine event for the file, from which it tells the user that the file came from the web.
bool mark_as_web_download(ByteString const& path)
{
    @autoreleasepool {
        auto* url = [NSURL fileURLWithFileSystemRepresentation:path.characters() isDirectory:NO relativeToURL:nil];
        auto* properties = @ {
            (__bridge NSString*)kLSQuarantineAgentNameKey : @"Ladybird",
            (__bridge NSString*)kLSQuarantineTypeKey : (__bridge NSString*)kLSQuarantineTypeWebDownload,
        };

        NSError* error = nil;
        if ([url setResourceValue:properties forKey:NSURLQuarantinePropertiesKey error:&error])
            return true;

        dbgln("Unable to mark {} as a web download: {}", path, error.localizedDescription.UTF8String);
        return false;
    }
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWebView/RecordingNotificationBackend.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <AK/JsonArray.h>
#include <AK/JsonObject.h>
#include <LibWebView/RecordingNotificationBackend.h>

namespace WebView {

void RecordingNotificationBackend::show(PlatformNotification const& notification)
{
    if (m_pages_holding_next_show.remove_first_matching([&](auto page_id) { return page_id == notification.page_id; })) {
        m_held.set(notification.id, notification.page_id);
        return;
    }

    // A replacement takes the replaced notification's place, as a platform that replaces in place would show it.
    if (notification.replaces.has_value()) {
        if (auto index = index_of(*notification.replaces); index.has_value()) {
            m_shown[*index] = notification;
            m_page_of.set(notification.id, notification.page_id);
            if (on_shown)
                on_shown(notification.id);
            return;
        }
    }

    m_shown.append(notification);
    m_page_of.set(notification.id, notification.page_id);
    if (on_shown)
        on_shown(notification.id);
}

void RecordingNotificationBackend::close(u64 id)
{
    // A held notification isn't shown, so there's nothing to close yet.
    if (m_held.contains(id))
        return;
    if (auto index = index_of(id); index.has_value())
        m_shown.remove(*index);
    m_closed.append({ id, m_page_of.get(id).value_or({}) });
    if (on_closed)
        on_closed(id, ByUser::No);
}

void RecordingNotificationBackend::click(u64 id)
{
    auto index = index_of(id);
    if (!index.has_value())
        return;
    // A click takes the notification down, as it does on every platform.
    m_shown.remove(*index);
    m_closed.append({ id, m_page_of.get(id).value_or({}) });
    if (on_clicked)
        on_clicked(id);
    if (on_closed)
        on_closed(id, ByUser::Yes);
}

void RecordingNotificationBackend::dismiss(u64 id)
{
    auto index = index_of(id);
    if (!index.has_value())
        return;
    m_shown.remove(*index);
    m_closed.append({ id, m_page_of.get(id).value_or({}) });
    if (on_closed)
        on_closed(id, ByUser::Yes);
}

void RecordingNotificationBackend::fail_held_shows_of(Web::PageId page_id)
{
    Vector<u64> ids;
    for (auto const& [id, held_page_id] : m_held) {
        if (held_page_id == page_id)
            ids.append(id);
    }
    for (auto id : ids) {
        m_held.remove(id);
        if (on_failed)
            on_failed(id);
    }
}

void RecordingNotificationBackend::record_focus(Web::PageId page_id)
{
    m_focused.append(page_id);
}

void RecordingNotificationBackend::record_open(URL::URL const& url, Web::PageId originating_page)
{
    m_opened.append({ url, originating_page });
}

void RecordingNotificationBackend::forget_page(Web::PageId page_id)
{
    m_shown.remove_all_matching([&](auto const& notification) { return notification.page_id == page_id; });
    m_closed.remove_all_matching([&](auto const& entry) { return entry.page_id == page_id; });
    m_focused.remove_all_matching([&](auto const& focused) { return focused == page_id; });
    m_opened.remove_all_matching([&](auto const& entry) { return entry.page_id == page_id; });
    m_pages_holding_next_show.remove_all_matching([&](auto holding_page_id) { return holding_page_id == page_id; });
    m_held.remove_all_matching([&](auto, auto held_page_id) { return held_page_id == page_id; });
}

String RecordingNotificationBackend::state_json(Web::PageId page_id, Vector<u64> const& abandoned) const
{
    JsonArray shown;
    for (auto const& notification : m_shown) {
        if (notification.page_id != page_id)
            continue;
        JsonObject entry;
        entry.set("id"sv, notification.id);
        entry.set("title"sv, notification.data.title.to_utf8());
        entry.set("body"sv, notification.data.body.to_utf8());
        entry.set("tag"sv, notification.data.tag.to_utf8());
        entry.set("attribution"sv, notification.attribution);
        entry.set("silent"sv, notification.data.silent.has_value() ? JsonValue(*notification.data.silent) : JsonValue());
        entry.set("requireInteraction"sv, notification.data.require_interaction);
        entry.set("renotify"sv, notification.data.renotify);
        entry.set("hasIcon"sv, !notification.icon.is_null());
        if (notification.icon) {
            entry.set("iconWidth"sv, notification.icon->width());
            entry.set("iconHeight"sv, notification.icon->height());
        }
        entry.set("replaces"sv, notification.replaces.has_value() ? JsonValue(*notification.replaces) : JsonValue());
        shown.must_append(move(entry));
    }

    JsonArray closed;
    for (auto const& entry : m_closed) {
        if (entry.page_id == page_id)
            closed.must_append(entry.id);
    }

    JsonArray focused;
    for (auto focused_page_id : m_focused) {
        if (focused_page_id == page_id)
            focused.must_append(focused_page_id.value());
    }

    JsonArray opened;
    for (auto const& entry : m_opened) {
        if (entry.page_id == page_id)
            opened.must_append(entry.url.serialize());
    }

    JsonArray abandoned_ids;
    for (auto id : abandoned)
        abandoned_ids.must_append(id);

    JsonObject state;
    state.set("shown"sv, move(shown));
    state.set("closed"sv, move(closed));
    state.set("focused"sv, move(focused));
    state.set("opened"sv, move(opened));
    state.set("abandoned"sv, move(abandoned_ids));
    return state.serialized();
}

Optional<size_t> RecordingNotificationBackend::index_of(u64 id) const
{
    for (size_t index = 0; index < m_shown.size(); ++index) {
        if (m_shown[index].id == id)
            return index;
    }
    return {};
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWebView/RecordingNotificationBackend.h
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#pragma once

#include <AK/HashMap.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibURL/URL.h>
#include <LibWebView/NotificationBackend.h>

namespace WebView {

// A backend that keeps the notifications it was asked to show, for tests to read and to act on as the user would.
class WEBVIEW_API RecordingNotificationBackend final : public NotificationBackend {
public:
    virtual void show(PlatformNotification const&) override;
    virtual void close(u64 id) override;

    // What the user would do with a shown notification.
    void click(u64 id);
    void dismiss(u64 id);

    virtual RecordingNotificationBackend* as_recording_backend() override { return this; }

    Vector<PlatformNotification> const& shown() const { return m_shown; }

    // What the browser did on a click: the pages it brought into focus, and the URLs it opened for notifications
    // whose page was gone. The test application records them here.
    void record_focus(Web::PageId);
    void record_open(URL::URL const&, Web::PageId originating_page);

    // Everything above, for the notifications of one page, as JSON for a test page to read. Tests run side by side in
    // one UI process, so each sees only its own.
    String state_json(Web::PageId, Vector<u64> const& abandoned) const;
    // Forgets a page's history, since test-web hands the page id to the next test it runs in the same view.
    void forget_page(Web::PageId);

    // Holds the page's next show() unanswered, as a platform that is still deciding would, until the page's held shows
    // fail as a platform that refuses the notification would.
    void hold_next_show_of(Web::PageId page_id) { m_pages_holding_next_show.append(page_id); }
    void fail_held_shows_of(Web::PageId);

private:
    Optional<size_t> index_of(u64 id) const;

    struct Closed {
        u64 id { 0 };
        Web::PageId page_id;
    };
    struct Opened {
        URL::URL url;
        Web::PageId page_id;
    };

    Vector<PlatformNotification> m_shown;
    Vector<Closed> m_closed;
    Vector<Web::PageId> m_focused;
    Vector<Opened> m_opened;
    HashMap<u64, Web::PageId> m_page_of;
    Vector<Web::PageId> m_pages_holding_next_show;
    HashMap<u64, Web::PageId> m_held;
};

}

#include <AK/Array.h>
#include <AK/Hex.h>
#include <AK/JsonArray.h>
#include <AK/JsonObject.h>
#include <AK/NumericLimits.h>
#include <AK/Random.h>
#include <AK/StdLibExtras.h>

#include <LibCore/Environment.h>
#include <LibCore/EventLoop.h>
#include <LibCore/Platform/ThreadQoS.h>
#include <LibCore/Timer.h>
#include <LibCrypto/Hash/Hash.h>
#include <LibHTTP/HeaderList.h>
#include <LibRequests/Request.h>
#include <LibRequests/RequestClient.h>
#include <LibThreading/Thread.h>

#include <LibWebView/Application.h>
