namespace WebView {

static constexpr auto default_endpoint = "https://reports.app.ladybird.org"sv;
static constexpr auto challenge_path = "/api/v1/challenges"sv;
static constexpr auto report_path = "/api/v1/reports"sv;
static constexpr auto challenge_algorithm = "sha256-seed-nonce-le-v1"sv;
static constexpr size_t maximum_challenge_token_length = 4096;
static constexpr u64 maximum_expected_work = 100'000'000;
static constexpr int request_timeout_ms = 30'000;
static constexpr int retry_delay_ms = 3'000;
static constexpr int maximum_retry_delay_ms = 60'000;

static String to_string(StringView text)
{
    return String::from_utf8_with_replacement_character(text);
}

static Optional<JsonObject> parse_json_object(StringView text)
{
    auto parsed = JsonValue::from_string(text);
    if (parsed.is_error() || !parsed.value().is_object())
        return {};
    return parsed.value().as_object();
}

static ByteString sha256_hex(ReadonlyBytes bytes)
{
    return encode_hex(Crypto::Hash::digest(Crypto::Hash::HashKind::SHA256, bytes).bytes());
}

void ReportSubmission::Contents::add(StringView key, StringView type, JsonValue value)
{
    fields.append({ key, type, move(value) });
}

// Empty values are left out, as the server has nothing to show for them.
void ReportSubmission::Contents::add_text(StringView key, StringView type, StringView value)
{
    if (!value.is_empty())
        add(key, type, to_string(value));
}

void ReportSubmission::Contents::add_build_information(StringView platform, StringView architecture, StringView git_commit, StringView build_configuration)
{
    add_text("platform"sv, "text"sv, platform);
    add_text("architecture"sv, "text"sv, architecture);
    add_text("git_commit"sv, "text"sv, git_commit);
    add_text("build_configuration"sv, "text"sv, build_configuration);
}

void ReportSubmission::Contents::add_platform_features(StringView report_text)
{
    auto header = [&](StringView name) -> StringView {
        for (auto line : report_text.split_view('\n')) {
            if (line.starts_with(name) && line.substring_view(name.length()).starts_with(": "sv))
                return line.substring_view(name.length() + 2);
        }
        return {};
    };
    if (auto features = JsonValue::from_string(header("Platform features"sv)); !features.is_error() && features.value().is_array())
        add("platform_features"sv, "platform_features"sv, features.release_value());
    add_text("gpu_device"sv, "text"sv, header("GPU device"sv));
    add_text("gpu_driver"sv, "text"sv, header("GPU driver"sv));
}

ByteString ReportSubmission::build_manifest(Contents const& contents, ReadonlySpan<Attachment> attachments)
{
    JsonArray fields;
    for (auto const& field : contents.fields) {
        JsonObject typed;
        typed.set("type"sv, to_string(field.type));
        typed.set("value"sv, field.value);
        JsonObject entry;
        entry.set("key"sv, to_string(field.key));
        entry.set("value"sv, move(typed));
        fields.must_append(move(entry));
    }

    JsonArray described_attachments;
    for (auto const& attachment : attachments) {
        JsonObject described;
        described.set("id"sv, to_string(attachment.id));
        described.set("name"sv, to_string(attachment.name));
        described.set("media_type"sv, to_string(attachment.media_type));
        described.set("size"sv, attachment.content.size());
        described.set("sha256"sv, to_string(sha256_hex(attachment.content.bytes())));
        described_attachments.must_append(move(described));
    }

    JsonObject manifest;
    manifest.set("protocol"sv, 1);
    manifest.set("submission_id"sv, generate_random_uuid());
    manifest.set("kind"sv, to_string(contents.kind));
    manifest.set("client_version"sv, to_string(contents.client_version));
    manifest.set("build"sv, to_string(contents.build));
    manifest.set("fields"sv, move(fields));
    manifest.set("attachments"sv, move(described_attachments));
    return manifest.serialized().to_byte_string();
}

static ByteString build_multipart_body(StringView manifest, ReadonlySpan<ReportSubmission::Attachment> attachments,
    StringView boundary)
{
    StringBuilder builder;
    auto append_part = [&](StringView disposition, StringView content_type, ReadonlyBytes content) {
        builder.appendff("--{}\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; {}\r\nContent-Type: {}\r\n\r\n",
            boundary, disposition, content_type);
        builder.append(StringView { content });
        builder.append("\r\n"sv);
    };

    append_part("name=\"manifest\""sv, "application/json"sv, manifest.bytes());
    for (auto const& attachment : attachments) {
        auto content_type = attachment.media_type == "text/plain"sv ? "text/plain; charset=utf-8"sv : attachment.media_type.view();
        append_part(ByteString::formatted("name=\"{}\"; filename=\"{}\"", attachment.id, attachment.name),
            content_type, attachment.content.bytes());
    }

    builder.appendff("--{}--\r\n", boundary);
    return builder.to_byte_string();
}

static Optional<u64> solve_challenge(ByteString const& token, u64 expected_work, Atomic<bool> const& cancelled)
{
    auto seed = Crypto::Hash::digest(Crypto::Hash::HashKind::SHA256, token.bytes());
    Array<u8, 40> candidate {};
    seed.bytes().copy_to(candidate.span().slice(0, 32));
    auto threshold = NumericLimits<u64>::max() / expected_work;

    for (u64 nonce = 0; nonce < NumericLimits<u64>::max(); ++nonce) {
        if (nonce % 4096 == 0 && cancelled.load())
            return {};
        for (size_t i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
            candidate[32 + i] = static_cast<u8>(nonce >> (i * 8));
        auto digest = Crypto::Hash::digest(Crypto::Hash::HashKind::SHA256, candidate.span());
        u64 prefix = 0;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
            prefix = prefix << 8 | digest.bytes()[i];
        if (prefix <= threshold)
            return nonce;
    }
    return {};
}

// The server would reject anything else again, so only these are worth another attempt. A conflict means the challenge
// expired or was already used, which the fresh challenge of the next attempt resolves.
static bool is_transient_status(u32 status)
{
    return status == 408 || status == 409 || status == 429 || (status >= 500 && status < 600);
}

// Only a delay in seconds is honored. A date falls back to the regular delay between attempts.
static Optional<int> retry_after_ms(HTTP::HeaderList const& headers)
{
    auto value = headers.get("Retry-After"sv);
    if (!value.has_value())
        return {};
    auto seconds = value->view().trim_whitespace().to_number<u32>();
    if (!seconds.has_value())
        return {};
    return static_cast<int>(min<u64>(*seconds * 1000ull, maximum_retry_delay_ms));
}

// A submission prepares its payload, solves the proof-of-work challenge off the main thread, and uploads the report.
// It can outlive whatever started it.
ReportSubmission::ReportSubmission() = default;

static ReportSubmission::PostFunction& s_post_function = *new ReportSubmission::PostFunction;

void ReportSubmission::set_post_function(PostFunction post_function)
{
    s_post_function = move(post_function);
}

// A submission of a payload prepared in advance sends that payload, so a retry of it keeps its submission ID.
NonnullRefPtr<ReportSubmission> ReportSubmission::create(Payload payload)
{
    auto submission = adopt_ref(*new ReportSubmission);
    submission->m_payload = move(payload);
    return submission;
}

ErrorOr<ReportSubmission::Payload, String> ReportSubmission::prepare()
{
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

ReportSubmission::~ReportSubmission()
{
    cancel_post();
    m_proof_cancelled.store(true);
    if (m_proof_thread && m_proof_thread->needs_to_be_joined())
        (void)m_proof_thread->join();
}

void ReportSubmission::cancel_post()
{
    if (auto cancel_post = move(m_cancel_post))
        cancel_post();
}

// A submission keeps itself alive until it is sent or fails for good, so it outlives the review that started it.
void ReportSubmission::start()
{
    m_self_while_in_flight = *this;
    begin_attempt();
}

// A canceled submission stops wherever it is and reports nothing more. A report that reached the server before then may
// still be stored there.
void ReportSubmission::cancel()
{
    // Letting go of the submission can release the last reference to it.
    NonnullRefPtr protector = *this;

    on_progress = nullptr;
    on_prepared = nullptr;
    on_retry = nullptr;
    on_sent = nullptr;
    on_failed = nullptr;
    ++m_post_serial;

    m_proof_cancelled.store(true);
    if (m_retry_timer) {
        m_retry_timer->stop();
        m_retry_timer = nullptr;
    }
    if (m_request_timeout) {
        m_request_timeout->stop();
        m_request_timeout = nullptr;
    }
    if (auto request = move(m_request))
        request->stop();
    cancel_post();
    m_self_while_in_flight = nullptr;

    did_finish();
}

void ReportSubmission::begin_attempt()
{
    if (on_progress)
        on_progress(Stage::Preparing);

    if (!m_payload.has_value()) {
        auto payload = prepare();
        if (payload.is_error()) {
            fail_preparation(payload.release_error());
            return;
        }
        m_payload = payload.release_value();
    }

    if (on_prepared)
        on_prepared(m_payload->manifest);
    request_challenge();
}

void ReportSubmission::fail_preparation(String reason)
{
    // Reporting the failure can release the last reference to this submission.
    NonnullRefPtr protector = *this;

    m_self_while_in_flight = nullptr;
    if (on_failed)
        on_failed(Failure::Preparation, move(reason));
    did_finish();
}

void ReportSubmission::request_challenge()
{
    if (on_progress)
        on_progress(Stage::RequestingChallenge);

    JsonObject body;
    body.set("manifest_digest"sv, to_string(sha256_hex(m_payload->manifest.bytes())));

    post(challenge_path, "requesting a challenge"sv, "application/json"sv, body.serialized().to_byte_string(), {},
        [this](ByteString response) {
            auto challenge = parse_json_object(response);
            if (!challenge.has_value()) {
                fail("The report server sent an unreadable challenge."_string, ShouldRetry::No);
                return;
            }

            auto algorithm = challenge->get_string("algorithm"sv);
            if (!algorithm.has_value() || *algorithm != challenge_algorithm) {
                fail("Unsupported report challenge."_string, ShouldRetry::No);
                return;
            }

            auto token = challenge->get_string("token"sv);
            auto expected_work = challenge->get_integer<u64>("expected_work"sv);
            if (!token.has_value() || token->bytes().size() > maximum_challenge_token_length
                || !expected_work.has_value() || *expected_work == 0 || *expected_work > maximum_expected_work) {
                fail("The report server supplied an invalid challenge."_string, ShouldRetry::No);
                return;
            }

            solve_proof(token->to_byte_string(), *expected_work);
        });
}

void ReportSubmission::solve_proof(ByteString token, u64 expected_work)
{
    if (on_progress)
        on_progress(Stage::SolvingProof);

    // A previous attempt's search has already delivered its result.
    if (m_proof_thread && m_proof_thread->needs_to_be_joined())
        (void)m_proof_thread->join();

    // The server chooses the difficulty, so the search runs on its own thread, at the priority of work that the user
    // follows through a progress indicator. A submission on its way keeps itself alive, so quitting the browser does not
    // wait for the search, whose result only goes to the main thread's event loop while that loop is still there.
    m_proof_thread = Threading::Thread::construct("Report proof"sv,
        [weak_this = make_weak_ptr<ReportSubmission>(), &cancelled = m_proof_cancelled,
            main_thread_event_loop = Core::EventLoop::current_weak(), attempt = m_attempt, token = move(token),
            expected_work]() mutable -> intptr_t {
            auto nonce = solve_challenge(token, expected_work, cancelled);
            auto event_loop = main_thread_event_loop->take();
            if (!event_loop)
                return 0;
            event_loop->deferred_invoke(
                [weak_this = move(weak_this), attempt, token = move(token), nonce]() mutable {
                    auto self = weak_this.strong_ref();
                    if (!self || self->m_attempt != attempt || self->m_proof_cancelled.load())
                        return;
                    if (!nonce.has_value()) {
                        self->fail("Could not compute the report's proof of work."_string, ShouldRetry::No);
                        return;
                    }
                    self->send_report(ProofOfWork { move(token), *nonce });
                });
            return 0;
        });
    m_proof_thread->set_qos(Core::Platform::ThreadQoS::Utility);
    m_proof_thread->start();
}

void ReportSubmission::send_report(ProofOfWork proof)
{
    if (on_progress)
        on_progress(Stage::Sending);

    auto boundary = ByteString::formatted("ladybird-{}", generate_random_uuid());
    auto body = build_multipart_body(m_payload->manifest, m_payload->attachments, boundary);
    auto content_type = ByteString::formatted("multipart/form-data; boundary={}", boundary);

    post(report_path, "sending the report"sv, content_type, move(body), move(proof), [this](ByteString response) {
        auto body = parse_json_object(response);
        auto receipt = body.has_value() ? body->get_string("receipt"sv) : Optional<String const&> {};
        if (!receipt.has_value() || receipt->is_empty()) {
            fail("Report server did not provide a receipt."_string, ShouldRetry::No);
            return;
        }
        finish();
    });
}

// A response outside the 2xx range fails this attempt, and the activity names what was going on in that message.
static Optional<URL::URL> report_server_url(StringView path)
{
    auto endpoint = Core::Environment::get("LADYBIRD_REPORTS_ENDPOINT"sv).value_or(default_endpoint);
    auto url = URL::Parser::basic_parse(MUST(String::formatted("{}{}{}", endpoint,
        endpoint.ends_with('/') ? ""sv : "/"sv, path.substring_view(1))));
    if (!url.has_value() || (url->scheme() != "https"sv && url->scheme() != "http"sv))
        return {};
    return url;
}

bool ReportSubmission::is_report_server_url(URL::URL const& url)
{
    for (auto path : { challenge_path, report_path }) {
        if (auto report_url = report_server_url(path); report_url.has_value() && *report_url == url)
            return true;
    }
    return false;
}

void ReportSubmission::post(StringView path, StringView activity, StringView content_type, ByteString body,
    Optional<ProofOfWork> proof, Function<void(ByteString)> on_success)
{
    auto url = report_server_url(path);
    if (!url.has_value()) {
        fail("Invalid report server configuration."_string, ShouldRetry::No);
        return;
    }

    auto headers = HTTP::HeaderList::create();
    headers->set({ "Content-Type"sv, ByteString { content_type } });
    if (proof.has_value()) {
        headers->set({ "X-Ladybird-Challenge"sv, proof->token });
        headers->set({ "X-Ladybird-Nonce"sv, ByteString::number(proof->nonce) });
    }

    if (s_post_function) {
        // NB: The hook may answer before it returns, and that answer can end this submission or start a retry.
        NonnullRefPtr protector = *this;
        auto serial = ++m_post_serial;
        arm_request_timeout();
        auto cancel_post = s_post_function(*url, headers->headers(), move(body),
            [weak_this = make_weak_ptr<ReportSubmission>(), serial, activity = ByteString { activity },
                on_success = move(on_success)](PostResponse response) {
                auto self = weak_this.strong_ref();
                if (!self || self->m_post_serial != serial)
                    return;
                self->m_cancel_post = nullptr;
                self->did_receive_response(activity, response.had_network_error, response.response_code,
                    *HTTP::HeaderList::create(move(response.headers)), response.body.bytes(), on_success);
            });
        if (m_post_serial == serial && m_request_timeout)
            m_cancel_post = move(cancel_post);
        return;
    }

    auto request_client = Application::request_server_client(IsPrivate::No);
    if (request_client.is_error()) {
        fail("Could not start the report request."_string, ShouldRetry::Yes);
        return;
    }
    m_request = request_client.value()->start_request("POST"sv, *url, {}, *headers, body.bytes(),
        HTTP::CacheMode::NoStore, HTTP::Cookie::IncludeCredentials::No);
    if (!m_request) {
        fail("Could not connect to the report server."_string, ShouldRetry::Yes);
        return;
    }

    arm_request_timeout();

    m_request->set_buffered_request_finished_callback(
        [weak_this = make_weak_ptr<ReportSubmission>(), activity = ByteString { activity },
            on_success = move(on_success)](u64, Requests::RequestTimingInfo const&,
            Optional<Requests::NetworkError> const& network_error, HTTP::HeaderList const& response_headers,
            Optional<u32> response_code, Optional<String> const&,
            Requests::CacheState,
            Core::ImmutableBytes payload) {
            auto self = weak_this.strong_ref();
            if (!self || !self->m_request)
                return;

            // A request cannot be destroyed from inside its own callback.
            Core::deferred_invoke([weak_this] {
                if (auto self = weak_this.strong_ref())
                    self->m_request = nullptr;
            });

            self->did_receive_response(activity, network_error.has_value(), response_code, response_headers, payload.bytes(), on_success);
        });
}

void ReportSubmission::arm_request_timeout()
{
    m_request_timeout = Core::Timer::create_single_shot(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(request_timeout_ms),
        [weak_this = make_weak_ptr<ReportSubmission>()] {
            auto self = weak_this.strong_ref();
            if (!self)
                return;
            auto request = move(self->m_request);
            self->m_request_timeout = nullptr;
            ++self->m_post_serial;
            if (request)
                request->stop();
            self->cancel_post();
            self->fail("The report server did not respond in time."_string, ShouldRetry::Yes);
        });
    m_request_timeout->start();
}

void ReportSubmission::did_receive_response(StringView activity, bool had_network_error, Optional<u32> response_code, HTTP::HeaderList const& response_headers, ReadonlyBytes body, Function<void(ByteString)> const& on_success)
{
    if (m_request_timeout)
        m_request_timeout->stop();
    m_request_timeout = nullptr;

    if (had_network_error || !response_code.has_value()) {
        fail("Network error while contacting the report server."_string, ShouldRetry::Yes);
        return;
    }
    if (*response_code < 200 || *response_code >= 300) {
        fail(MUST(String::formatted("Report server returned {} while {}.", *response_code, activity)),
            is_transient_status(*response_code) ? ShouldRetry::Yes : ShouldRetry::No,
            retry_after_ms(response_headers));
        return;
    }
    on_success(ByteString::copy(body));
}

void ReportSubmission::finish()
{
    // Reporting success can release the last reference to this submission.
    NonnullRefPtr protector = *this;

    if (m_request_timeout) {
        m_request_timeout->stop();
        m_request_timeout = nullptr;
    }
    did_send();
    m_self_while_in_flight = nullptr;
    if (on_sent)
        on_sent();
    did_finish();
}

void ReportSubmission::did_finish()
{
    auto finished = move(on_finished);
    on_finished = nullptr;
    if (finished)
        finished();
}

void ReportSubmission::fail(String reason, ShouldRetry should_retry, Optional<int> retry_after_ms)
{
    // Reporting the final failure can release the last reference to this submission.
    NonnullRefPtr protector = *this;

    if (m_request_timeout) {
        m_request_timeout->stop();
        m_request_timeout = nullptr;
    }

    if (should_retry == ShouldRetry::No || m_attempt >= maximum_attempts) {
        m_self_while_in_flight = nullptr;
        if (on_failed)
            on_failed(Failure::Sending, move(reason));
        did_finish();
        return;
    }

    // A server that asks for more time gets it, but it cannot keep the user waiting for long.
    auto delay_ms = clamp(retry_after_ms.value_or(retry_delay_ms), retry_delay_ms, maximum_retry_delay_ms);
    auto retry_number = m_attempt++;
    if (on_retry)
        on_retry(move(reason), retry_number, maximum_attempts - 1, static_cast<u32>(delay_ms / 1000));

    m_retry_timer = Core::Timer::create_single_shot(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(delay_ms),
        [weak_this = make_weak_ptr<ReportSubmission>()] {
            if (auto self = weak_this.strong_ref())
                self->begin_attempt();
        });
    m_retry_timer->start();
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/Atomic.h>
#include <AK/ByteString.h>
#include <AK/Error.h>
#include <AK/Function.h>
#include <AK/JsonValue.h>
#include <AK/RefCounted.h>
#include <AK/RefPtr.h>
#include <AK/String.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <AK/WeakPtr.h>
#include <AK/Weakable.h>
#include <LibCore/Forward.h>
#include <LibCore/ImmutableBytes.h>
#include <LibHTTP/Forward.h>
#include <LibHTTP/Header.h>
#include <LibRequests/Forward.h>
#include <LibThreading/Forward.h>
#include <LibURL/Forward.h>
#include <LibWebView/Forward.h>

namespace WebView {

class WEBVIEW_API ReportSubmission
    : public RefCounted<ReportSubmission>
    , public Weakable<ReportSubmission> {
public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    enum class Stage : u8 {
        Preparing,
        RequestingChallenge,
        SolvingProof,
        Sending,
    };

    enum class Failure : u8 {
        Preparation,
        Sending,
    };

    static constexpr u32 maximum_attempts = 6;

    struct Field {
        StringView key;
        StringView type;
        JsonValue value;
    };

    struct Attachment {
        ByteString id;
        ByteString name;
        ByteString media_type;
        Core::ImmutableBytes content;
    };

    struct Contents {
        void add(StringView key, StringView type, JsonValue value);
        void add_text(StringView key, StringView type, StringView value);
        void add_build_information(StringView platform, StringView architecture, StringView git_commit, StringView build_configuration);
        // From the lines that Application::describe_platform_features_for_report() wrote into a report's text.
        void add_platform_features(StringView report_text);

        StringView kind;
        ByteString client_version;
        ByteString build;
        Vector<Field> fields;
    };

    struct Payload {
        ByteString manifest;
        Vector<Attachment> attachments;
    };

    static ByteString build_manifest(Contents const&, ReadonlySpan<Attachment>);
    static NonnullRefPtr<ReportSubmission> create(Payload);

    struct PostResponse {
        bool had_network_error { false };
        Optional<u32> response_code;
        Vector<HTTP::Header> headers;
        ByteString body;
    };
    using PostFunction = Function<Function<void()>(URL::URL const&, Vector<HTTP::Header>, ByteString body, Function<void(PostResponse)>)>;
    // A process with no RequestServer of its own posts its reports through this.
    static void set_post_function(PostFunction);
    // Whether the URL is one that reports are posted to.
    static bool is_report_server_url(URL::URL const&);

    virtual ~ReportSubmission();

    void start();
    void cancel();

    // What another attempt needs to count as the same submission, once this one has been prepared.
    ByteString prepared_manifest() const { return m_payload.has_value() ? m_payload->manifest : ByteString {}; }

    Function<void(Stage)> on_progress;
    Function<void(ByteString const& manifest)> on_prepared;
    Function<void(String reason, u32 retry_number, u32 maximum_retries, u32 delay_seconds)> on_retry;
    Function<void()> on_sent;
    Function<void(Failure, String reason)> on_failed;

    // However it ended, even if it was canceled, and even if nothing is left of whoever started it.
    Function<void()> on_finished;

protected:
    ReportSubmission();

    virtual ErrorOr<Payload, String> prepare();
    virtual void did_send() { }

private:
    void did_finish();

    struct ProofOfWork {
        ByteString token;
        u64 nonce { 0 };
    };

    enum class ShouldRetry {
        No,
        Yes,
    };

    void begin_attempt();
    void fail_preparation(String reason);
    void request_challenge();
    void solve_proof(ByteString token, u64 expected_work);
    void send_report(ProofOfWork);
    void finish();
    void fail(String reason, ShouldRetry, Optional<int> retry_after_ms = {});

    void post(StringView path, StringView activity, StringView content_type, ByteString body, Optional<ProofOfWork>,
        Function<void(ByteString body)> on_success);

    Optional<Payload> m_payload;
    u32 m_attempt { 1 };

    void arm_request_timeout();
    void cancel_post();
    void did_receive_response(StringView activity, bool had_network_error, Optional<u32> response_code, HTTP::HeaderList const& response_headers, ReadonlyBytes body, Function<void(ByteString)> const& on_success);

    RefPtr<Requests::Request> m_request;
    RefPtr<Core::Timer> m_request_timeout;
    // Identifies the post made through the post function, so that a response to one given up on goes unnoticed.
    u64 m_post_serial { 0 };
    Function<void()> m_cancel_post;
    RefPtr<Core::Timer> m_retry_timer;

    RefPtr<ReportSubmission> m_self_while_in_flight;

    RefPtr<Threading::Thread> m_proof_thread;
    Atomic<bool> m_proof_cancelled { false };
};

}

static ByteString certificate_exception_key(ByteString const& host, u16 port)
{
    return ByteString::formatted("{}:{}", host, port);
}

// Entries last accessed in the same time bucket are evicted together.
static constexpr auto cache_access_granularity = AK::Duration::from_seconds(1);

// Leave room for new writes to avoid evicting after every write.
static constexpr u64 cache_eviction_target_percent = 90;

static constexpr auto cache_eviction_timeout = AK::Duration::from_seconds(10);

static constexpr size_t site_cache_key_size = 32;

RequestServerInstance::RequestServerInstance(NonnullRefPtr<BrowsingSession> session, Optional<Utf16String> site, ByteString cache_path)
    : m_session(move(session))
    , m_site(move(site))
    , m_cache_path(move(cache_path))
{
}

RequestServerInstance::~RequestServerInstance() = default;

RequestServerManager& RequestServerManager::the()
{
    return Application::request_server_manager();
}

RequestServerManager::RequestServerManager()
    : m_maximum_site_instances(Application::request_server_options().maximum_site_request_servers)
{
    if (!uses_site_request_servers())
        return;

    m_site_cache_key = load_or_create_site_cache_key();
}

RequestServerManager::~RequestServerManager() = default;

ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<RequestServerInstance>> RequestServerManager::browser_instance(BrowsingSession& session)
{
    for (auto& instance : m_instances) {
        if (instance->m_session.ptr() == &session && !instance->site().has_value())
            return instance;
    }
    return launch(session, {});
}

ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<RequestServerInstance>> RequestServerManager::instance_for_site(BrowsingSession& session, Utf16String const& top_level_site)
{
    if (!uses_site_request_servers())
        return browser_instance(session);

    for (auto& instance : m_instances) {
        if (instance->m_session.ptr() == &session && instance->site() == top_level_site)
            return instance;
    }

    auto site_instance_count = [&] {
        size_t count = 0;
        for (auto const& instance : m_instances) {
            if (instance->m_session.ptr() == &session && instance->site().has_value())
                ++count;
        }
        return count;
    };
    if (site_instance_count() >= m_maximum_site_instances) {
        retire_idle_instances();
        if (site_instance_count() >= m_maximum_site_instances)
            return browser_instance(session);
    }

    return launch(session, top_level_site);
}

RefPtr<RequestServerInstance> RequestServerManager::instance_for_client(int client_id)
{
    for (auto& instance : m_instances) {
        if (instance->has_client(client_id))
            return instance;
        if (instance->m_ui_client && instance->m_ui_client->request_server_client_id() == client_id)
            return instance;
    }
    return nullptr;
}

void RequestServerManager::for_each_instance(Function<IterationDecision(RequestServerInstance&)> const& callback)
{
    for (auto& instance : Vector { m_instances }) {
        if (callback(*instance) == IterationDecision::Break)
            return;
    }
}

ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<RequestServerInstance>> RequestServerManager::launch(NonnullRefPtr<BrowsingSession> session, Optional<Utf16String> site)
{
    auto cache_path = site.has_value() ? cache_path_for_site(*site) : Application::request_server_options().cache_path;
    auto instance = adopt_ref(*new RequestServerInstance(session, move(site), move(cache_path)));
    TRY(launch_process(*instance));
    m_instances.append(instance);
    if (m_dormant_site_caches.has_value() && is_live_cache_path(instance->cache_path()))
        m_dormant_site_caches->remove(instance->cache_path());
    return instance;
}

ErrorOr<void> RequestServerManager::launch_process(RequestServerInstance& instance)
{
    // Private sessions keep nothing on disk. Every RequestServer of a session would open the same cache otherwise.
    // A site's responses only pass through the RequestServer with no site on their way to the site's own.
    auto is_private = instance.session().is_private();
    auto keeps_disk_cache = is_private == IsPrivate::No && (instance.site().has_value() || !uses_site_request_servers());
    auto disk_cache_mode = keeps_disk_cache ? Application::request_server_options().http_disk_cache_mode : HTTPDiskCacheMode::Disabled;
    auto control_client = TRY(launch_request_server_process(instance.cache_path(), instance.site(), is_private, disk_cache_mode));

    auto weak_instance = instance.make_weak_ptr();
    control_client->on_client_disconnected = [weak_instance](int client_id) {
        if (auto instance = weak_instance.strong_ref())
            the().client_disconnected(*instance, client_id);
    };
    control_client->on_request_server_died = [weak_instance] {
        if (auto instance = weak_instance.strong_ref())
            the().did_lose_process(*instance);
    };
    control_client->on_disk_cache_size_changed = [weak_instance](u64 size) {
        if (auto instance = weak_instance.strong_ref())
            the().disk_cache_size_changed(*instance, size);
    };
    control_client->on_rejected_self_signed_certificate = [weak_instance](ByteString const& host, u16 port, ByteString const& fingerprint) {
        if (auto instance = weak_instance.strong_ref())
            the().did_reject_self_signed_certificate(instance->session(), { .host = host, .port = port, .fingerprint = fingerprint });
    };
    Application::the().configure_request_server_control_client(*control_client);

    for (auto const& exception : instance.session().trusted_certificates)
        control_client->async_trust_certificate(exception.host, exception.port, exception.fingerprint);

    instance.m_control_client = move(control_client);
    instance.m_ui_client = nullptr;

    auto connection = TRY(connect_new_client(instance, instance.session(), RequestServer::SiteBinding::Unrestricted));
    auto transport = TRY(connection.handle.create_transport());
    auto ui_client = make_ref_counted<Requests::RequestClient>(move(transport));
    instance.m_ui_client = move(ui_client);

    return {};
}

ErrorOr<RequestServerClientConnection> RequestServerManager::connect_new_client(RequestServerInstance& instance, BrowsingSession& session, RequestServer::SiteBinding site_binding)
{
    auto is_private = session.is_private() == IsPrivate::Yes ? RequestServer::IsPrivate::Yes : RequestServer::IsPrivate::No;

    // Random client IDs can collide across RequestServers. The UI identifies clients by ID alone, so retry collisions.
    for (size_t attempt = 0; attempt < 8; ++attempt) {
        auto response = send_sync_to_helper<Messages::RequestServerControl::ConnectNewClient>(instance.control_client(), is_private, site_binding);
        if (!response || response->client_id() < 0)
            return Error::from_string_literal("Failed to connect to RequestServer");

        auto client_id = response->client_id();
        if (Application::the().session_for_request_server_client(client_id))
            continue;

        Application::the().did_connect_request_server_client(client_id, session, site_binding);
        if (site_binding == RequestServer::SiteBinding::Bound) {
            instance.m_client_ids.set(client_id);
            instance.m_idle_timer = nullptr;
        }
        return RequestServerClientConnection { .handle = response->take_handle(), .client_id = client_id };
    }
    return Error::from_string_literal("RequestServer keeps handing out client IDs that are in use");
}

void RequestServerManager::retire_without_delay_once_disconnected(int client_id)
{
    for (auto& instance : m_instances) {
        if (instance->site().has_value() && instance->has_client(client_id)) {
            instance->m_client_ids_retiring_without_delay.set(client_id);
            return;
        }
    }
}

void RequestServerManager::client_disconnected(RequestServerInstance& instance, int client_id)
{
    Application::the().did_disconnect_request_server_client(client_id);
    instance.m_client_ids.remove(client_id);
    auto retires_without_delay = instance.m_client_ids_retiring_without_delay.remove(client_id);

    if (!instance.site().has_value() || !instance.m_client_ids.is_empty())
        return;

    // NB: This runs inside a message handler of the instance's control connection, which retiring the instance drops.
    //     So even an instance that retires without delay is retired from the event loop.
    auto idle_timeout = retires_without_delay ? AK::Duration::zero() : Application::request_server_options().idle_site_request_server_timeout;
    auto weak_instance = instance.make_weak_ptr();
    instance.m_idle_timer = Core::Timer::create_single_shot(idle_timeout, [weak_instance] {
        auto instance = weak_instance.strong_ref();
        if (instance && instance->m_client_ids.is_empty())
            the().retire(*instance);
    });
    instance.m_idle_timer->start();
}

void RequestServerManager::did_lose_process(RequestServerInstance& instance)
{
    if (Core::EventLoop::current().was_exit_requested())
        return;

    // The process took every client with it; nothing will report their disconnection.
    auto lost_client_ids = move(instance.m_client_ids);
    for (auto client_id : lost_client_ids)
        Application::the().did_disconnect_request_server_client(client_id);
    if (instance.m_ui_client)
        Application::the().did_disconnect_request_server_client(instance.m_ui_client->request_server_client_id());

    if (instance.site().has_value() && lost_client_ids.is_empty()) {
        retire(instance);
        return;
    }

    if (auto result = launch_process(instance); result.is_error()) {
        warnln("\033[31;1mUnable to launch replacement RequestServer: {}\033[0m", result.error());
        VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
    }

    auto reconnect = [&](RequestServerSiteBindings& bindings) {
        if (auto result = bindings.reconnect_lost_clients(instance, lost_client_ids); result.is_error()) {
            warnln("Unable to reconnect a process to its RequestServer: {}", result.error());
            VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
        }
        return IterationDecision::Continue;
    };
    WebContentClient::for_each_client([&](WebContentClient& client) { return reconnect(client.request_server_site_bindings()); });
    WorkerAgentManager::the().for_each_request_server_site_bindings([&](RequestServerSiteBindings& bindings) { return reconnect(bindings); });
}

void RequestServerManager::retire(RequestServerInstance& instance)
{
    instance.m_retired = true;
    // The process exits once its last client is gone; dropping the control connection and the UI client sees to that.
    m_instances.remove_first_matching([&](auto const& candidate) { return candidate.ptr() == &instance; });

    if (m_dormant_site_caches.has_value() && instance.site().has_value() && instance.session().is_private() == IsPrivate::No && !is_live_cache_path(instance.cache_path()))
        m_dormant_site_caches->set(instance.cache_path(), { .last_use = UnixDateTime::now(), .size = instance.m_disk_cache_size });
}

void RequestServerManager::retire_idle_instances()
{
    for (auto& instance : Vector { m_instances }) {
        if (instance->site().has_value() && instance->m_client_ids.is_empty())
            retire(*instance);
    }
}

static constexpr auto rejected_certificate_lifetime = AK::Duration::from_seconds(30);

static void remove_stale_rejections(Vector<BrowsingSession::RejectedCertificate>& rejections)
{
    auto now = MonotonicTime::now_coarse();
    rejections.remove_all_matching([&](auto const& rejection) { return now - rejection.rejected_at > rejected_certificate_lifetime; });
}

void RequestServerManager::did_reject_self_signed_certificate(BrowsingSession& session, BrowsingSession::CertificateException certificate)
{
    auto& rejections = session.rejected_self_signed_certificates.ensure(certificate_exception_key(certificate.host, certificate.port));
    remove_stale_rejections(rejections);
    rejections.remove_all_matching([&](auto const& rejection) { return rejection.certificate == certificate; });
    rejections.append({ .certificate = move(certificate), .rejected_at = MonotonicTime::now_coarse() });
}

// Warnings identify only the host and port. If recent rejections disagree, offering any certificate risks trusting
// one other than the certificate that triggered the warning.
Optional<BrowsingSession::CertificateException> RequestServerManager::rejected_self_signed_certificate(BrowsingSession& session, URL::URL const& url) const
{
    auto key = certificate_exception_key(url.serialized_host().to_byte_string(), url.port_or_default());
    auto rejections = session.rejected_self_signed_certificates.get(key);
    if (!rejections.has_value())
        return {};

    remove_stale_rejections(*rejections);
    if (rejections->is_empty()) {
        session.rejected_self_signed_certificates.remove(key);
        return {};
    }
    if (rejections->size() != 1)
        return {};
    return rejections->first().certificate;
}

void RequestServerManager::trust_certificate(BrowsingSession& session, BrowsingSession::CertificateException const& certificate)
{
    // A trusted certificate is no longer a candidate for a later warning about the same host and port.
    if (auto rejections = session.rejected_self_signed_certificates.get(certificate_exception_key(certificate.host, certificate.port)); rejections.has_value())
        rejections->remove_all_matching([&](auto const& rejection) { return rejection.certificate == certificate; });

    if (session.trusted_certificates.contains_slow(certificate))
        return;

    for (auto& instance : m_instances) {
        if (&instance->session() == &session)
            (void)send_sync_to_helper<Messages::RequestServerControl::TrustCertificate>(instance->control_client(), certificate.host, certificate.port, certificate.fingerprint);
    }

    session.trusted_certificates.append(certificate);
}

void RequestServerManager::disk_cache_settings_changed()
{
    auto settings = Application::settings().disk_cache_settings();
    for (auto& instance : m_instances)
        instance->control_client().async_set_disk_cache_settings(settings);

    evict_least_recently_used_cache_entries_if_needed();
}

void RequestServerManager::dns_settings_changed()
{
    for (auto& instance : m_instances)
        apply_dns_settings(instance->control_client());
}

ByteString RequestServerManager::sites_directory() const
{
    return LexicalPath::join(Application::request_server_options().cache_path, "RequestServer"sv, "Sites"sv).string();
}

// The sandbox of a RequestServer does not stop it from asking whether a path exists, so a name that it could work out
// itself would tell it which other sites the user has visited.
ByteString RequestServerManager::cache_path_for_site(Utf16String const& site) const
{
    auto site_bytes = site.to_byte_string();
    auto digest = MUST(Crypto::Authentication::hmac(Crypto::Hash::HashKind::SHA256, m_site_cache_key, site_bytes.bytes()));
    return LexicalPath::join(sites_directory(), encode_hex(digest.bytes())).string();
}

ByteBuffer RequestServerManager::load_or_create_site_cache_key() const
{
    auto path = LexicalPath::join(Application::request_server_options().cache_path, "RequestServer"sv, "SiteCacheKey"sv);

    if (auto file = Core::File::open(path.string(), Core::File::OpenMode::Read); !file.is_error()) {
        if (auto key = file.value()->read_until_eof(); !key.is_error() && key.value().size() == site_cache_key_size)
            return key.release_value();
    }

    // Nothing can find the caches of sites that were named with another key.
    (void)FileSystem::remove(sites_directory(), FileSystem::RecursionMode::Allowed);

    auto key = MUST(ByteBuffer::create_uninitialized(site_cache_key_size));
    fill_with_random(key.bytes());

    auto store_key = [&]() -> ErrorOr<void> {
        TRY(Core::Directory::create(path.parent(), Core::Directory::CreateDirectories::Yes));
        auto file = TRY(Core::File::open(path.string(), Core::File::OpenMode::Write, 0600));
        return file->write_until_depleted(key.bytes());
    };
    if (auto result = store_key(); result.is_error())
        warnln("Unable to store the site cache key: {}", result.error());

    return key;
}

// Private sessions keep nothing in the cache directories of their RequestServers.
bool RequestServerManager::is_live_cache_path(ByteString const& path) const
{
    return any_of(m_instances, [&](auto const& instance) {
        return instance->session().is_private() == IsPrivate::No && instance->cache_path() == path;
    });
}

Vector<ByteString> RequestServerManager::dormant_site_cache_paths()
{
    Vector<ByteString> paths;
    Core::DirIterator iterator(sites_directory(), Core::DirIterator::SkipParentAndBaseDir);
    while (iterator.has_next()) {
        auto path = iterator.next_full_path();
        if (!is_live_cache_path(path))
            paths.append(move(path));
    }
    return paths;
}

static void for_each_file_under(ByteString const& directory, Function<void(ByteString const&, struct stat const&)> const& callback)
{
    Core::DirIterator iterator(directory, Core::DirIterator::SkipParentAndBaseDir);
    while (iterator.has_next()) {
        auto path = iterator.next_full_path();
        auto stat = Core::File::stat(path);
        if (stat.is_error())
            continue;
        if (S_ISDIR(stat.value().st_mode))
            for_each_file_under(path, callback);
        else
            callback(path, stat.value());
    }
}

static UnixDateTime last_use_of_site_cache(ByteString const& path)
{
    UnixDateTime last_use;
    for_each_file_under(path, [&](auto const&, struct stat const& stat) {
        last_use = max(last_use, UnixDateTime::from_seconds_since_epoch(stat.st_mtime));
    });
    return last_use;
}

NonnullRefPtr<Core::Promise<Requests::CacheSizes>> RequestServerManager::estimate_cache_size_accessed_since(UnixDateTime since)
{
    struct Estimation : public RefCounted<Estimation> {
        Requests::CacheSizes sizes;
        size_t pending { 0 };
        NonnullRefPtr<Core::Promise<Requests::CacheSizes>> promise { Core::Promise<Requests::CacheSizes>::construct() };
    };
    auto estimation = adopt_ref(*new Estimation);

    for (auto const& path : dormant_site_cache_paths()) {
        for_each_file_under(path, [&](auto const&, struct stat const& stat) {
            estimation->sizes.total += stat.st_size;
            if (UnixDateTime::from_seconds_since_epoch(stat.st_mtime) >= since)
                estimation->sizes.since_requested_time += stat.st_size;
        });
    }

    auto settle = [estimation] {
        if (--estimation->pending == 0)
            estimation->promise->resolve(estimation->sizes);
    };

    estimation->pending = m_instances.size() + 1;
    for (auto& instance : m_instances) {
        instance->control_client().estimate_cache_size_accessed_since(since)->when_resolved([estimation, settle](Requests::CacheSizes sizes) {
                                                                                estimation->sizes.total += sizes.total;
                                                                                estimation->sizes.since_requested_time += sizes.since_requested_time;
                                                                                settle();
                                                                            })
            .when_rejected([settle](Error&) { settle(); });
    }
    settle();

    return estimation->promise;
}

NonnullRefPtr<Core::Promise<Empty>> RequestServerManager::clear_cache(UnixDateTime since)
{
    struct Clearing : public RefCounted<Clearing> {
        size_t pending { 0 };
        NonnullRefPtr<Core::Promise<Empty>> promise { Core::Promise<Empty>::construct() };
    };
    auto clearing = adopt_ref(*new Clearing);

    // Dormant sites lose their whole cache if any file was used since the cutoff.
    for (auto const& path : dormant_site_cache_paths()) {
        if (last_use_of_site_cache(path) >= since)
            (void)FileSystem::remove(path, FileSystem::RecursionMode::Allowed);
    }
    m_dormant_site_caches.clear();

    auto settle = [clearing] {
        if (--clearing->pending == 0)
            clearing->promise->resolve({});
    };

    clearing->pending = m_instances.size() + 1;
    for (auto& instance : m_instances) {
        instance->control_client().clear_cache(since)->when_resolved([settle](Empty) { settle(); }).when_rejected([settle](Error&) { settle(); });
    }
    settle();

    return clearing->promise;
}

HashMap<ByteString, RequestServerManager::DormantSiteCache>& RequestServerManager::dormant_site_caches()
{
    if (!m_dormant_site_caches.has_value()) {
        HashMap<ByteString, DormantSiteCache> caches;
        for (auto const& path : dormant_site_cache_paths()) {
            DormantSiteCache cache;
            for_each_file_under(path, [&](auto const&, struct stat const& stat) {
                cache.last_use = max(cache.last_use, UnixDateTime::from_seconds_since_epoch(stat.st_mtime));
                cache.size += stat.st_size;
            });
            caches.set(path, cache);
        }
        m_dormant_site_caches = move(caches);
    }
    return *m_dormant_site_caches;
}

u64 RequestServerManager::maximum_disk_cache_size() const
{
    // Apply the per-server free-space limit to the combined caches too.
    auto maximum_size = Application::settings().disk_cache_settings().maximum_size;
    auto disk_space = FileSystem::compute_disk_space(LexicalPath { Application::request_server_options().cache_path });
    if (disk_space.is_error())
        return maximum_size;
    return static_cast<u64>(HTTP::compute_maximum_disk_cache_size(disk_space.value().free_bytes, maximum_size));
}

void RequestServerManager::disk_cache_size_changed(RequestServerInstance& instance, u64 size)
{
    instance.m_disk_cache_size = size;
    evict_least_recently_used_cache_entries_if_needed();
}

void RequestServerManager::evict_least_recently_used_cache_entries_if_needed()
{
    // Size reports after eviction trigger another pass if needed.
    if (Application::request_server_options().http_disk_cache_mode == HTTPDiskCacheMode::Disabled)
        return;
    if (m_cache_eviction_start_time.has_value() && MonotonicTime::now() - *m_cache_eviction_start_time < cache_eviction_timeout)
        return;

    auto maximum_size = maximum_disk_cache_size();

    u64 total_size = 0;
    for (auto const& [path, cache] : dormant_site_caches())
        total_size += cache.size;
    for (auto const& instance : m_instances)
        total_size += instance->m_disk_cache_size;
    if (total_size <= maximum_size)
        return;

    struct Eviction : public RefCounted<Eviction> {
        u64 id { 0 };
        Vector<Requests::CacheAccessBucket> buckets;
        size_t pending { 0 };
        u64 target_size { 0 };
    };
    auto eviction = adopt_ref(*new Eviction);
    eviction->id = ++m_cache_eviction_id;
    eviction->target_size = maximum_size / 100 * cache_eviction_target_percent;
    m_cache_eviction_start_time = MonotonicTime::now();

    auto settle = [eviction] {
        if (--eviction->pending > 0)
            return;

        auto& manager = the();
        if (manager.m_cache_eviction_id != eviction->id)
            return;
        manager.m_cache_eviction_start_time.clear();

        auto& dormant_caches = manager.dormant_site_caches();
        for (auto const& [path, cache] : dormant_caches)
            eviction->buckets.append({ .last_access_time = cache.last_use, .size = cache.size });
        if (eviction->buckets.is_empty())
            return;

        // Keep the most recently used buckets that fit, and at least the most recent one.
        quick_sort(eviction->buckets, [](auto const& a, auto const& b) { return a.last_access_time > b.last_access_time; });
        auto cutoff = eviction->buckets.first().last_access_time;
        u64 kept_size = 0;
        for (auto const& bucket : eviction->buckets) {
            kept_size += bucket.size;
            if (kept_size > eviction->target_size)
                break;
            cutoff = bucket.last_access_time;
        }

        for (auto& instance : manager.m_instances)
            instance->control_client().async_remove_cache_entries_accessed_before(cutoff);

        dormant_caches.remove_all_matching([&](auto const& path, auto const& cache) {
            if (cache.last_use >= cutoff)
                return false;
            (void)FileSystem::remove(path, FileSystem::RecursionMode::Allowed);
            return true;
        });
    };

    eviction->pending = m_instances.size() + 1;
    for (auto& instance : m_instances) {
        instance->control_client().retrieve_cache_access_profile(cache_access_granularity)->when_resolved([eviction, settle](Vector<Requests::CacheAccessBucket> buckets) {
                                                                                              eviction->buckets.extend(move(buckets));
                                                                                              settle();
                                                                                          })
            .when_rejected([settle](Error&) { settle(); });
    }
    settle();
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/ByteBuffer.h>
#include <AK/HashMap.h>
#include <AK/HashTable.h>
#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <AK/RefCounted.h>
#include <AK/Utf16String.h>
#include <AK/WeakPtr.h>
#include <AK/Weakable.h>
#include <LibCore/Promise.h>
#include <LibCore/Timer.h>
#include <LibIPC/TransportHandle.h>
#include <LibRequests/CacheSizes.h>
#include <LibRequests/RequestClient.h>
#include <LibRequests/RequestControlClient.h>
#include <LibWebView/BrowsingSession.h>
#include <LibWebView/Forward.h>
#include <RequestServer/SiteBinding.h>

namespace WebView {

// One RequestServer process. The UI process speaks its control endpoint and holds a data client of its own on it, and
// hands out the data clients of the renderers and workers it serves.
class WEBVIEW_API RequestServerInstance
    : public RefCounted<RequestServerInstance>
    , public Weakable<RequestServerInstance> {
public:
    ~RequestServerInstance();

    // The top-level site whose requests this RequestServer makes, or nothing for the one that serves the UI process and
    // requests under no site.
    Optional<Utf16String> const& site() const { return m_site; }
    BrowsingSession& session() const { return *m_session; }
    ByteString const& cache_path() const { return m_cache_path; }

    Requests::RequestControlClient& control_client() { return *m_control_client; }
    Requests::RequestClient& ui_client() { return *m_ui_client; }

    // The IDs of the clients this RequestServer handed out, besides the UI process's own.
    HashTable<int> const& client_ids() const { return m_client_ids; }
    bool is_retired() const { return m_retired; }
    bool has_client(int client_id) const { return m_client_ids.contains(client_id); }

private:
    friend class RequestServerManager;

    RequestServerInstance(NonnullRefPtr<BrowsingSession>, Optional<Utf16String> site, ByteString cache_path);

    NonnullRefPtr<BrowsingSession> m_session;
    Optional<Utf16String> m_site;
    ByteString m_cache_path;

    RefPtr<Requests::RequestControlClient> m_control_client;
    RefPtr<Requests::RequestClient> m_ui_client;
    HashTable<int> m_client_ids;
    HashTable<int> m_client_ids_retiring_without_delay;
    RefPtr<Core::Timer> m_idle_timer;
    bool m_retired { false };

    // As last reported by the RequestServer.
    u64 m_disk_cache_size { 0 };
};

struct RequestServerClientConnection;

// Manages RequestServers per browsing session and top-level site, plus one with no site for the UI process
// and requests under no site. Each site's server only makes and caches requests for that site's partitions;
// its sandbox confines the cache to that site's directory.
class WEBVIEW_API RequestServerManager {
public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    static RequestServerManager& the();

    RequestServerManager();
    ~RequestServerManager();

    // The RequestServer with no site of the session. The default session's is launched with the browser.
    ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<RequestServerInstance>> browser_instance(BrowsingSession&);

    // The RequestServer of a site, launched when first asked for. Once there are as many as allowed and none is idle,
    // further sites share the RequestServer with no site.
    ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<RequestServerInstance>> instance_for_site(BrowsingSession&, Utf16String const& top_level_site);

    RefPtr<RequestServerInstance> instance_for_client(int client_id);
    void for_each_instance(Function<IterationDecision(RequestServerInstance&)> const&);

    ErrorOr<RequestServerClientConnection> connect_new_client(RequestServerInstance&, BrowsingSession&, RequestServer::SiteBinding);

    // The recently rejected certificate for this session, host and port, if unambiguous.
    Optional<BrowsingSession::CertificateException> rejected_self_signed_certificate(BrowsingSession&, URL::URL const&) const;
    void did_reject_self_signed_certificate(BrowsingSession&, BrowsingSession::CertificateException);

    // Makes every RequestServer of the session accept the certificate, including those launched later.
    void trust_certificate(BrowsingSession&, BrowsingSession::CertificateException const&);

    void disk_cache_settings_changed();
    void dns_settings_changed();

    NonnullRefPtr<Core::Promise<Requests::CacheSizes>> estimate_cache_size_accessed_since(UnixDateTime since);
    NonnullRefPtr<Core::Promise<Empty>> clear_cache(UnixDateTime since);

    bool uses_site_request_servers() const { return m_maximum_site_instances > 0; }

    // The process of the client is about to exit for good, such as for a discarded tab. If no other client of its
    // RequestServer is left then, nothing is likely to need that server soon, so it is retired right away.
    void retire_without_delay_once_disconnected(int client_id);

private:
    ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<RequestServerInstance>> launch(NonnullRefPtr<BrowsingSession>, Optional<Utf16String> site);
    ErrorOr<void> launch_process(RequestServerInstance&);
    void did_lose_process(RequestServerInstance&);
    void client_disconnected(RequestServerInstance&, int client_id);
    void retire(RequestServerInstance&);
    void retire_idle_instances();

    ByteString sites_directory() const;
    ByteString cache_path_for_site(Utf16String const& site) const;
    ByteBuffer load_or_create_site_cache_key() const;
    bool is_live_cache_path(ByteString const&) const;
    Vector<ByteString> dormant_site_cache_paths();

    // Enforce the user's combined cache size limit with least-recently-used eviction.
    // Caches of sites without a RequestServer are evicted whole.
    void disk_cache_size_changed(RequestServerInstance&, u64 size);
    void evict_least_recently_used_cache_entries_if_needed();
    u64 maximum_disk_cache_size() const;

    struct DormantSiteCache {
        UnixDateTime last_use;
        u64 size { 0 };
    };
    HashMap<ByteString, DormantSiteCache>& dormant_site_caches();

    Vector<NonnullRefPtr<RequestServerInstance>> m_instances;
    size_t m_maximum_site_instances { 0 };

    // Only the UI process has this. It names the cache directories of sites, see cache_path_for_site().
    ByteBuffer m_site_cache_key;

    Optional<HashMap<ByteString, DormantSiteCache>> m_dormant_site_caches;
    // Time out evictions if a RequestServer disappears before answering.
    Optional<MonotonicTime> m_cache_eviction_start_time;
    u64 m_cache_eviction_id { 0 };
};

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWebView/RequestServerSiteBindings.cpp
/*

 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause

#include <LibRequests/RequestControlClient.h>
#include <LibURL/Site.h>
#include <LibWebView/Application.h>
#include <LibWebView/CanonicalDocument.h>
#include <LibWebView/HelperProcess.h>
#include <LibWebView/RequestServerManager.h>
#include <LibWebView/RequestServerSiteBindings.h>

namespace WebView {

unsigned RequestServerSiteBindings::SiteTraits::hash(Site const& site)
{
    auto hash = site.top_level_site.hash();
    if (site.frame_site.has_value())
        hash = pair_int_hash(hash, site.frame_site->hash());
    return hash;
}

RequestServerSiteBindings::RequestServerSiteBindings(ConnectionHandler connection_handler)
    : m_connection_handler(move(connection_handler))
{
}

RequestServerSiteBindings::~RequestServerSiteBindings() = default;

ErrorOr<void> RequestServerSiteBindings::connect(BrowsingSession& session)
{
    m_session = session.make_weak_ptr();

    auto instance = TRY(RequestServerManager::the().browser_instance(session));
    auto connection = TRY(connect_client(*instance, {}));
    m_connection_handler(connection, {});

    for (auto const& top_level_site : top_level_sites_to_connect())
        TRY(connect_to_site(top_level_site));
    return {};
}

Optional<int> RequestServerSiteBindings::client_id_for(Optional<Utf16String> const& top_level_site) const
{
    if (!top_level_site.has_value())
        return m_client_id;
    return m_site_client_ids.get(*top_level_site);
}

bool RequestServerSiteBindings::has_client(int client_id) const
{
    if (m_client_id == client_id)
        return true;
    return any_of(m_site_client_ids, [&](auto const& entry) { return entry.value == client_id; });
}

void RequestServerSiteBindings::did_disconnect(int client_id)
{
    m_connected_client_ids.remove(client_id);
}

void RequestServerSiteBindings::bind_sites_of(CanonicalDocument const& document)
{
    auto top_level_origin = document.top_level_origin();
    if (!top_level_origin.has_value())
        return;

    // NB: A document whose top-level document has an opaque origin makes its requests without a network isolation key.
    auto top_level_site = URL::Site::serialize_for_partitioning(*top_level_origin);
    if (!top_level_site.has_value())
        return;

    bind({ top_level_site.release_value(), URL::Site::serialize_for_partitioning(document.origin()) });
}

void RequestServerSiteBindings::bind_sites_of(RequestServerSiteBindings const& other)
{
    for (auto const& site : other.m_sites)
        bind(site);
}

bool RequestServerSiteBindings::may_use_cookies_under(int client_id, Utf16String const& top_level_site, URL::URL const& url) const
{
    // A client of a site's RequestServer makes requests under that site alone.
    for (auto const& [client_top_level_site, site_client_id] : m_site_client_ids) {
        if (site_client_id == client_id && client_top_level_site != top_level_site)
            return false;
    }

    // FIXME: The process of the document that starts a navigation makes the navigation's requests. Until the UI process
    //        makes navigation requests itself, a client may use the cookies of a navigation to the request's URL.
    if (URL::Site::serialize_for_partitioning(url.origin()) == top_level_site)
        return true;

    return any_of(m_sites, [&](Site const& site) { return site.top_level_site == top_level_site; });
}

ErrorOr<void> RequestServerSiteBindings::reconnect_lost_clients(RequestServerInstance& instance, HashTable<int> const& lost_client_ids)
{
    // A process whose session is gone has nothing left to fetch for.
    if (!m_session)
        return {};

    if (m_client_id.has_value() && lost_client_ids.contains(*m_client_id)) {
        auto connection = TRY(connect_client(instance, {}));
        m_connection_handler(connection, {});
    }

    for (auto const& top_level_site : top_level_sites()) {
        auto client_id = m_site_client_ids.get(top_level_site);
        if (!client_id.has_value() || !lost_client_ids.contains(*client_id))
            continue;
        auto connection = TRY(connect_client(instance, top_level_site));
        m_connection_handler(connection, top_level_site);
    }
    return {};
}

ErrorOr<RequestServerClientConnection> RequestServerSiteBindings::replace_client(Optional<Utf16String> const& top_level_site, bool navigation_authorized)
{
    if (!client_id_for(top_level_site).has_value() && !navigation_authorized)
        return Error::from_string_literal("No existing client or authorized navigation for this site");

    auto session = m_session.strong_ref();
    if (!session)
        return Error::from_string_literal("The process's browsing session is gone");

    RefPtr<RequestServerInstance> instance;
    if (auto client_id = client_id_for(top_level_site); client_id.has_value())
        instance = RequestServerManager::the().instance_for_client(*client_id);
    if (!instance) {
        instance = top_level_site.has_value()
            ? TRY(RequestServerManager::the().instance_for_site(*session, *top_level_site))
            : TRY(RequestServerManager::the().browser_instance(*session));
    }
    return connect_client(*instance, top_level_site);
}

Vector<Utf16String> RequestServerSiteBindings::top_level_sites() const
{
    Vector<Utf16String> top_level_sites;
    for (auto const& entry : m_site_client_ids)
        top_level_sites.append(entry.key);
    return top_level_sites;
}

Vector<Utf16String> RequestServerSiteBindings::top_level_sites_to_connect() const
{
    HashTable<Utf16String> top_level_sites;
    for (auto const& site : m_sites)
        top_level_sites.set(site.top_level_site);

    Vector<Utf16String> result;
    for (auto const& top_level_site : top_level_sites)
        result.append(top_level_site);
    return result;
}

ErrorOr<RequestServerClientConnection> RequestServerSiteBindings::connect_client(RequestServerInstance& instance, Optional<Utf16String> const& top_level_site)
{
    auto session = m_session.strong_ref();
    VERIFY(session);

    auto connection = TRY(RequestServerManager::the().connect_new_client(instance, *session, RequestServer::SiteBinding::Bound));
    m_connected_client_ids.set(connection.client_id);
    if (top_level_site.has_value()) {
        m_site_client_ids.set(*top_level_site, connection.client_id);
        for (auto const& site : m_sites) {
            if (site.top_level_site == *top_level_site)
                send(site);
        }
    } else {
        m_client_id = connection.client_id;
    }
    return connection;
}

ErrorOr<void> RequestServerSiteBindings::connect_to_site(Utf16String const& top_level_site)
{
    auto session = m_session.strong_ref();
    VERIFY(session);

    auto instance = TRY(RequestServerManager::the().instance_for_site(*session, top_level_site));
    auto connection = TRY(connect_client(*instance, top_level_site));
    m_connection_handler(connection, top_level_site);
    return {};
}

void RequestServerSiteBindings::bind(Site site)
{
    if (m_sites.set(site) != HashSetResult::InsertedNewEntry)
        return;

    // NB: connect() handles sites bound before the process connects.
    if (!m_session || !m_client_id.has_value())
        return;

    if (m_site_client_ids.contains(site.top_level_site)) {
        send(site);
        return;
    }

    if (auto result = connect_to_site(site.top_level_site); result.is_error())
        warnln("Unable to connect a process to the RequestServer for {}: {}", site.top_level_site, result.error());
}

void RequestServerSiteBindings::send(Site const& site) const
{
    // NB: Replacement clients regain their site bindings when they connect.
    auto client_id = m_site_client_ids.get(site.top_level_site);
    if (!client_id.has_value())
        return;
    auto instance = RequestServerManager::the().instance_for_client(*client_id);
    if (!instance)
        return;

    (void)send_sync_to_helper<Messages::RequestServerControl::BindClientToSite>(instance->control_client(), *client_id, site.top_level_site, site.frame_site);
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWebView/RequestServerSiteBindings.h
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#pragma once

#include <AK/Function.h>
#include <AK/HashMap.h>
#include <AK/HashTable.h>
#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <AK/Utf16String.h>
#include <AK/WeakPtr.h>
#include <LibURL/Forward.h>
#include <LibWebView/Export.h>
#include <LibWebView/Forward.h>

namespace WebView {

struct RequestServerClientConnection;

// One process's RequestServer clients and site bindings. Each top-level site's client is bound to the sites of
// documents hosted under it; other requests use the server with no site through a client bound to no site.
// RequestServer rejects other sites' network isolation keys, preventing a compromised process from reaching
// their cache entries and restricting each site's RequestServer to that top-level site's requests.
//
// NB: Bindings last for the life of the process and are never revoked. A process that has hosted a site's document may
//     have kept anything that document could reach, so leaving the site grants it nothing it lacked.
class WEBVIEW_API RequestServerSiteBindings {
    AK_MAKE_NONCOPYABLE(RequestServerSiteBindings);
    AK_MAKE_NONMOVABLE(RequestServerSiteBindings);

public:
    // Hands the process a new client, for the RequestServer of the given top-level site or the one with no site.
    using ConnectionHandler = Function<void(RequestServerClientConnection&, Optional<Utf16String> const& top_level_site)>;

    explicit RequestServerSiteBindings(ConnectionHandler);
    ~RequestServerSiteBindings();

    // Connects to the server with no site and the servers of all bound top-level sites.
    // The session supplies cookies and must be the process's session.
    ErrorOr<void> connect(BrowsingSession&);

    // The process's client of the RequestServer of a top-level site, or of the one with no site.
    Optional<int> client_id() const { return m_client_id; }
    Optional<int> client_id_for(Optional<Utf16String> const& top_level_site) const;
    bool has_client(int client_id) const;

    // Whether client_id is a connected RequestServer client of the process, either a current client or an earlier one.
    bool has_connected_client(int client_id) const { return m_connected_client_ids.contains(client_id); }

    void did_disconnect(int client_id);

    // Binds the process to the sites of a document, before it is told to host it.
    void bind_sites_of(CanonicalDocument const&);

    // Binds the process to every site that another process is bound to, as for a worker that process starts.
    void bind_sites_of(RequestServerSiteBindings const&);

    // Whether the client may use the cookies of top_level_site's partition for a request for url.
    bool may_use_cookies_under(int client_id, Utf16String const& top_level_site, URL::URL const& url) const;

    ErrorOr<void> reconnect_lost_clients(RequestServerInstance&, HashTable<int> const& lost_client_ids);

    // Replaces the client for top_level_site (empty for the server with no site).
    // A new site requires navigation authorization authenticated by the UI process.
    // Returns the connection without calling the connection handler.
    ErrorOr<RequestServerClientConnection> replace_client(Optional<Utf16String> const& top_level_site, bool navigation_authorized = false);

    // Sites with clients, excluding the server with no site.
    Vector<Utf16String> top_level_sites() const;

private:
    struct Site {
        Utf16String top_level_site;
        Optional<Utf16String> frame_site;

        bool operator==(Site const&) const = default;
    };
    struct SiteTraits : public DefaultTraits<Site> {
        static unsigned hash(Site const&);
    };

    ErrorOr<RequestServerClientConnection> connect_client(RequestServerInstance&, Optional<Utf16String> const& top_level_site);
    ErrorOr<void> connect_to_site(Utf16String const& top_level_site);
    Vector<Utf16String> top_level_sites_to_connect() const;
    void bind(Site);
    void send(Site const&) const;

    ConnectionHandler m_connection_handler;
    WeakPtr<BrowsingSession> m_session;
    Optional<int> m_client_id;
    HashMap<Utf16String, int> m_site_client_ids;
    HashTable<int> m_connected_client_ids;
    HashTable<Site, SiteTraits> m_sites;
};

}

String SearchEngine::format_search_query_for_display(StringView query) const
{
    static constexpr auto MAX_SEARCH_STRING_LENGTH = 32;

    Utf8View query_view { query };
    auto is_truncated = query_view.length() > MAX_SEARCH_STRING_LENGTH;
    if (is_truncated)
        query_view = query_view.unicode_substring_view(0, MAX_SEARCH_STRING_LENGTH);

    return MUST(String::formatted("Search {} for “{}{}”", name, query_view.as_string(), is_truncated ? "…"sv : ""sv));
}

String SearchEngine::format_search_query_for_navigation(StringView query) const
{
    return MUST(query_url.replace("%s"sv, URL::percent_encode(query, URL::PercentEncodeSet::Component), ReplaceMode::All));
}

Optional<URL::URL> SearchEngine::suggestions_url_for_query(StringView query) const
{
    if (!suggestions_url.has_value())
        return {};
    return URL::Parser::basic_parse(MUST(suggestions_url->replace("%s"sv, URL::percent_encode(query, URL::PercentEncodeSet::Component), ReplaceMode::All)));
}
