JsonValue Settings::serialize_json() const
{
    JsonObject settings;
    settings.set(FIRST_RUN_COMPLETE_KEY, m_first_run_complete);
    settings.set(NEW_TAB_PAGE_URL_KEY, m_new_tab_page_url.serialize());
    settings.set(RESTORE_PREVIOUS_SESSION_KEY, m_restore_previous_session);

    JsonObject window_settings;
    if (m_window_settings.position.has_value()) {
        JsonObject position;
        position.set(WINDOW_X_KEY, m_window_settings.position->x());
        position.set(WINDOW_Y_KEY, m_window_settings.position->y());
        window_settings.set(WINDOW_POSITION_KEY, move(position));
    }

    JsonObject window_size;
    window_size.set(WINDOW_WIDTH_KEY, m_window_settings.size.width());
    window_size.set(WINDOW_HEIGHT_KEY, m_window_settings.size.height());
    window_settings.set(WINDOW_SIZE_KEY, move(window_size));
    window_settings.set(WINDOW_MAXIMIZED_KEY, m_window_settings.maximized);
    settings.set(WINDOW_SETTINGS_KEY, move(window_settings));

    JsonArray languages;
    languages.ensure_capacity(m_languages.size());
    for (auto const& language : m_languages)
        languages.must_append(language);
    settings.set(LANGUAGES_KEY, move(languages));
    settings.set(TRANSLATION_PREFERS_HIGHER_QUALITY_KEY, m_translation_prefers_higher_quality);

    JsonObject appearance;
    appearance.set(SHOW_MENU_BAR_KEY, m_appearance.show_menu_bar);
    appearance.set(SHOW_BOOKMARKS_BAR_KEY, show_bookmarks_bar_to_string(m_appearance.show_bookmarks_bar));
    appearance.set(INTERFACE_THEME_KEY, theme_preference_to_string(m_appearance.interface_theme));
    appearance.set(WEBSITE_COLOR_SCHEME_KEY, theme_preference_to_string(m_appearance.website_color_scheme));
    appearance.set(COLOR_THEME_KEY, color_theme_to_string(m_appearance.color_theme));
    settings.set(APPEARANCE_KEY, move(appearance));

    JsonObject zoom_per_host;
    for (auto const& [host, zoom_level] : m_content_settings.zoom_per_host)
        zoom_per_host.set(host, zoom_level);

    JsonObject content_settings;
    content_settings.set(DEFAULT_ZOOM_LEVEL_FACTOR_KEY, m_content_settings.default_zoom_level_factor);
    content_settings.set(ZOOM_PER_HOST_KEY, move(zoom_per_host));
    content_settings.set(ENABLE_FORCE_DARK_KEY, m_content_settings.enable_force_dark);
    JsonObject force_dark_per_host;
    for (auto const& [host, enabled] : m_content_settings.force_dark_per_host)
        force_dark_per_host.set(host, enabled);
    content_settings.set(FORCE_DARK_PER_HOST_KEY, move(force_dark_per_host));
    settings.set(CONTENT_SETTINGS_KEY, move(content_settings));

    JsonObject tab_settings;
    tab_settings.set(VERTICAL_TABS_ENABLED_KEY, m_tab_settings.vertical_tabs_enabled);
    tab_settings.set(VERTICAL_TABS_EXPANDED_KEY, m_tab_settings.vertical_tabs_expanded);
    tab_settings.set(VERTICAL_TABS_EXPAND_ON_HOVER_KEY, m_tab_settings.vertical_tabs_expand_on_hover);
    tab_settings.set(VERTICAL_TABS_POSITION_KEY, vertical_tabs_position_to_string(m_tab_settings.vertical_tabs_position));
    if (m_tab_settings.vertical_tabs_expanded_width.has_value())
        tab_settings.set(VERTICAL_TABS_EXPANDED_WIDTH_KEY, *m_tab_settings.vertical_tabs_expanded_width);
    tab_settings.set(EVERYTHING_IN_SIDEBAR_KEY, m_tab_settings.everything_in_sidebar);
    tab_settings.set(DISCARD_HIDDEN_TABS_AFTER_MINUTES_KEY, m_tab_settings.discard_hidden_tabs_after_minutes);
    tab_settings.set(TAB_PROCESSES_KEY, tab_processes_to_string(m_tab_settings.tab_processes));
    settings.set(TAB_SETTINGS_KEY, move(tab_settings));

    JsonObject browsing_behavior;
    browsing_behavior.set(ENABLE_AUTOSCROLL_KEY, m_browsing_behavior.enable_autoscroll);
    browsing_behavior.set(ENABLE_PRIMARY_PASTE_KEY, m_browsing_behavior.enable_primary_paste);
    settings.set(BROWSING_BEHAVIOR_KEY, move(browsing_behavior));

    JsonArray custom_search_engines;
    custom_search_engines.ensure_capacity(m_custom_search_engines.size());

    for (auto const& engine : m_custom_search_engines) {
        JsonObject search_engine;
        search_engine.set(SEARCH_ENGINE_NAME_KEY, engine.name);
        search_engine.set(SEARCH_ENGINE_URL_KEY, engine.query_url);
        if (engine.suggestions_url.has_value())
            search_engine.set(SEARCH_SUGGESTIONS_URL_KEY, *engine.suggestions_url);

        custom_search_engines.must_append(move(search_engine));
    }

    JsonObject search_engine;
    if (!custom_search_engines.is_empty())
        search_engine.set(SEARCH_ENGINE_CUSTOM_KEY, move(custom_search_engines));
    search_engine.set(SEARCH_ENGINE_SELECTION_KEY, m_search_engine_settings.engine.has_value() ? JsonValue(m_search_engine_settings.engine->name) : JsonValue {});

    search_engine.set(SEARCH_SUGGESTIONS_ENABLED_KEY, m_search_engine_settings.suggestions);
    settings.set(SEARCH_ENGINE_KEY, move(search_engine));

    auto save_site_setting = [&](AutoplaySiteSetting const& site_setting, StringView key) {
        JsonArray site_filters;
        site_filters.ensure_capacity(site_setting.site_filters.size());

        for (auto const& [filter, policy] : site_setting.site_filters) {
            JsonObject site_filter;
            site_filter.set(SITE_SETTING_FILTER_KEY, filter);
            site_filter.set(SITE_SETTING_POLICY_KEY, MUST(Web::HTML::autoplay_policy_to_string(policy).to_utf8()));
            site_filters.must_append(move(site_filter));
        }

        JsonObject setting;
        setting.set(SITE_SETTING_POLICY_KEY, MUST(Web::HTML::autoplay_policy_to_string(site_setting.policy).to_utf8()));
        setting.set(SITE_SETTING_SITE_FILTERS_KEY, move(site_filters));

        settings.set(key, move(setting));
    };

    save_site_setting(m_autoplay, AUTOPLAY_KEY);

    for (auto name : Web::Permissions::PERMISSION_NAMES) {
        JsonObject setting;
        setting.set(SITE_SETTING_POLICY_KEY, permission_policy(name) == PermissionPolicy::Block ? "block"_string : "ask"_string);
        settings.set(Web::Permissions::to_string(name), move(setting));
    }

    settings.set(GLOBAL_PRIVACY_CONTROL_KEY, m_global_privacy_control == GlobalPrivacyControl::Yes);
    settings.set(CRASH_REPORT_SENDING_KEY, crash_report_sending_to_string(m_crash_report_sending));

    JsonObject background_network_features;
    background_network_features.set(CONTENT_BLOCKER_SUBSCRIPTION_UPDATES_KEY, m_filter_list_updates_enabled);
#if defined(LADYBIRD_HAS_UPDATE_CHECK)
    background_network_features.set(UPDATE_CHECKS_KEY, m_update_checks_enabled);
#endif

    JsonObject background_networking;
    background_networking.set(BACKGROUND_NETWORKING_ENABLED_KEY, m_background_networking_enabled);
    background_networking.set(BACKGROUND_NETWORKING_FEATURES_KEY, move(background_network_features));
    settings.set(BACKGROUND_NETWORKING_KEY, move(background_networking));

    JsonArray disabled_sites;
    disabled_sites.ensure_capacity(m_content_blocker_disabled_sites.size());
    for (auto const& host : m_content_blocker_disabled_sites)
        disabled_sites.must_append(host);

    JsonObject built_in_content_blocker_lists;
    JsonArray custom_content_blocker_subscriptions;
    JsonArray local_content_blocker_lists;
    for (auto const& list : m_content_blocker_lists) {
        if (list.built_in) {
            built_in_content_blocker_lists.set(list.identifier, list.enabled);
            continue;
        }
        JsonObject object;
        object.set(CONTENT_BLOCKER_IDENTIFIER_KEY, list.identifier);
        object.set(CONTENT_BLOCKER_ENABLED_KEY, list.enabled);
        if (list.url.has_value()) {
            object.set(CONTENT_BLOCKER_URL_KEY, list.url->serialize());
            custom_content_blocker_subscriptions.must_append(move(object));
        } else {
            object.set(CONTENT_BLOCKER_NAME_KEY, list.name);
            local_content_blocker_lists.must_append(move(object));
        }
    }

    JsonObject content_blockers;
    content_blockers.set(CONTENT_BLOCKER_ENABLED_KEY, m_content_blocker_enabled);
    content_blockers.set(CONTENT_BLOCKER_DISABLED_SITES_KEY, move(disabled_sites));
    content_blockers.set(CONTENT_BLOCKER_BUILT_IN_LISTS_KEY, move(built_in_content_blocker_lists));
    content_blockers.set(CONTENT_BLOCKER_CUSTOM_SUBSCRIPTIONS_KEY, move(custom_content_blocker_subscriptions));
    content_blockers.set(CONTENT_BLOCKER_LOCAL_LISTS_KEY, move(local_content_blocker_lists));
    content_blockers.set(CONTENT_BLOCKER_CUSTOM_FILTERS_KEY, m_custom_content_blocker_filters);
    settings.set(CONTENT_BLOCKERS_KEY, move(content_blockers));

    // dnsSettings :: ({ mode: "system" } | { mode: "custom", server: string, port: u16, type: "udp" | "tls", forciblyEnabled: bool, dnssec: bool })
    //                & { proxy?: { server: string, resolvesAllHostnames: bool } }
    JsonObject dns_settings;
    m_dns_settings.visit(
        [&](SystemDNS) {
            dns_settings.set("mode"sv, "system"sv);
        },
        [&](DNSOverTLS const& dot) {
            dns_settings.set("mode"sv, "custom"sv);
            dns_settings.set("server"sv, dot.server_address.view());
            dns_settings.set("port"sv, dot.port);
            dns_settings.set("type"sv, "tls"sv);
            dns_settings.set("dnssec"sv, dot.validate_dnssec_locally);
            dns_settings.set("forciblyEnabled"sv, m_dns_override_by_command_line);
        },
        [&](DNSOverUDP const& dns) {
            dns_settings.set("mode"sv, "custom"sv);
            dns_settings.set("server"sv, dns.server_address.view());
            dns_settings.set("port"sv, dns.port);
            dns_settings.set("type"sv, "udp"sv);
            dns_settings.set("dnssec"sv, dns.validate_dnssec_locally);
            dns_settings.set("forciblyEnabled"sv, m_dns_override_by_command_line);
        });

    // Proxy-side resolution bypasses our DNS server and DNSSEC settings.
    // Settings exist without an application in tests, which have no proxies to speak of.
    HTTP::ProxyConfiguration proxy_configuration;
    if (Application::is_initialized())
        proxy_configuration = Application::request_server_options().proxy_configuration;
    auto resolves_hostnames = [](Optional<HTTP::Proxy> const& proxy) { return proxy.has_value() && proxy->resolves_hostnames(); };
    if (resolves_hostnames(proxy_configuration.http_proxy()) || resolves_hostnames(proxy_configuration.https_proxy())) {
        auto const& proxy = resolves_hostnames(proxy_configuration.https_proxy()) ? *proxy_configuration.https_proxy() : *proxy_configuration.http_proxy();

        JsonObject proxy_settings;
        proxy_settings.set("server"sv, MUST(proxy.host.contains(':') ? String::formatted("[{}]:{}", proxy.host, proxy.port) : String::formatted("{}:{}", proxy.host, proxy.port)));
        proxy_settings.set("resolvesAllHostnames"sv, resolves_hostnames(proxy_configuration.http_proxy()) && resolves_hostnames(proxy_configuration.https_proxy()));
        dns_settings.set("proxy"sv, move(proxy_settings));
    }

    settings.set(DNS_SETTINGS_KEY, move(dns_settings));

    JsonObject config_variables;
    for (auto const& variable : config_variable_definitions())
        config_variables.set(variable.name, m_config_variables[static_cast<size_t>(variable.id)]);
    settings.set(CONFIG_VARIABLES_KEY, move(config_variables));

    return settings;
}

ErrorOr<void> Settings::complete_first_run()
{
    auto was_complete = m_first_run_complete;
    m_first_run_complete = true;
    auto result = write_json_file(m_settings_path, serialize_json());
    if (result.is_error()) {
        m_first_run_complete = was_complete;
        return result.release_error();
    }
    return {};
}

WindowSettings Settings::parse_window_settings(JsonValue const& settings)
{
    if (!settings.is_object())
        return {};

    WindowSettings window_settings;

    if (auto position = settings.as_object().get_object(WINDOW_POSITION_KEY); position.has_value()) {
        auto x = position->get_integer<i32>(WINDOW_X_KEY);
        auto y = position->get_integer<i32>(WINDOW_Y_KEY);
        if (x.has_value() && y.has_value())
            window_settings.position = Gfx::IntPoint { *x, *y };
    }

    if (auto size = settings.as_object().get_object(WINDOW_SIZE_KEY); size.has_value()) {
        auto width = size->get_integer<i32>(WINDOW_WIDTH_KEY);
        auto height = size->get_integer<i32>(WINDOW_HEIGHT_KEY);
        if (width.has_value() && height.has_value() && *width > 0 && *height > 0)
            window_settings.size = Gfx::IntSize { *width, *height };
    }

    if (auto maximized = settings.as_object().get_bool(WINDOW_MAXIMIZED_KEY); maximized.has_value())
        window_settings.maximized = *maximized;

    return window_settings;
}

void Settings::set_window_settings(WindowSettings window_settings)
{
    m_window_settings = move(window_settings);
    persist_settings();
}

Vector<String> Settings::parse_json_languages(JsonValue const& languages)
{
    if (!languages.is_array())
        return Web::default_preferred_languages();

    Vector<String> parsed_languages;
    parsed_languages.ensure_capacity(languages.as_array().size());

    languages.as_array().for_each([&](JsonValue const& language) {
        if (language.is_string() && Unicode::is_locale_available(language.as_string()))
            parsed_languages.append(language.as_string());
    });

    if (parsed_languages.is_empty())
        return Web::default_preferred_languages();

    return parsed_languages;
}

void Settings::set_languages(Vector<String> languages)
{
    m_languages = move(languages);
    persist_settings();

    for (auto& observer : m_observers)
        observer.languages_changed();
}

    m_translation_prefers_higher_quality = translation_prefers_higher_quality;
    persist_settings();
}

Appearance Settings::parse_appearance(JsonValue const& settings)
{
    if (!settings.is_object())
        return {};

    Appearance appearance;

    if (auto show_menu_bar = settings.as_object().get_bool(SHOW_MENU_BAR_KEY); show_menu_bar.has_value())
        appearance.show_menu_bar = *show_menu_bar;
    if (auto show_bookmarks_bar = settings.as_object().get_string(SHOW_BOOKMARKS_BAR_KEY); show_bookmarks_bar.has_value()) {
        if (auto parsed = bookmarks_bar_position_from_string(*show_bookmarks_bar); parsed.has_value())
            appearance.show_bookmarks_bar = *parsed;
    }
    if (auto interface_theme = settings.as_object().get_string(INTERFACE_THEME_KEY); interface_theme.has_value()) {
        if (auto parsed = theme_preference_from_string(*interface_theme); parsed.has_value())
            appearance.interface_theme = *parsed;
    }
    if (auto website_color_scheme = settings.as_object().get_string(WEBSITE_COLOR_SCHEME_KEY); website_color_scheme.has_value()) {
        if (auto parsed = theme_preference_from_string(*website_color_scheme); parsed.has_value())
            appearance.website_color_scheme = *parsed;
    }
    if (auto color_theme = settings.as_object().get_string(COLOR_THEME_KEY); color_theme.has_value()) {
        if (auto parsed = color_theme_from_string(*color_theme); parsed.has_value())
            appearance.color_theme = *parsed;
    }

    return appearance;
}

void Settings::set_appearance(Appearance appearance)
{
    m_appearance = appearance;
    persist_settings();

    for (auto& observer : m_observers)
        observer.appearance_changed();
}

ContentSettings Settings::parse_content_settings(JsonValue const& settings)
{
    if (!settings.is_object())
        return {};

    ContentSettings content_settings;

    if (auto default_zoom_level_factor = settings.as_object().get_double_with_precision_loss(DEFAULT_ZOOM_LEVEL_FACTOR_KEY); default_zoom_level_factor.has_value())
        content_settings.default_zoom_level_factor = *default_zoom_level_factor;
    if (auto zoom_per_host = settings.as_object().get_object(ZOOM_PER_HOST_KEY); zoom_per_host.has_value()) {
        zoom_per_host->for_each_member([&](auto const& host, JsonValue const& value) {
            if (auto zoom_level = value.get_double_with_precision_loss(); zoom_level.has_value())
                content_settings.zoom_per_host.set(host, *zoom_level);
        });
    }
    if (auto enable_force_dark = settings.as_object().get_bool(ENABLE_FORCE_DARK_KEY); enable_force_dark.has_value())
        content_settings.enable_force_dark = *enable_force_dark;

    if (auto per_host = settings.as_object().get_object(FORCE_DARK_PER_HOST_KEY); per_host.has_value()) {
        per_host->for_each_member([&](auto const& host, JsonValue const& value) {
            if (!host.is_empty() && value.is_bool())
                content_settings.force_dark_per_host.set(host, value.as_bool());
        });
    }

    return content_settings;
}

void Settings::set_content_settings(ContentSettings content_settings)
{
    m_content_settings = move(content_settings);
    persist_settings();

    for (auto& observer : m_observers)
        observer.content_settings_changed();
}

bool Settings::force_dark_for_host(StringView host) const
{
    if (host.is_empty())
        return m_content_settings.enable_force_dark;
    return m_content_settings.force_dark_per_host.get(host).value_or(m_content_settings.enable_force_dark);
}

void Settings::set_force_dark_for_host(String const& host, bool enabled)
{
    if (host.is_empty() || m_content_settings.force_dark_per_host.get(host) == enabled)
        return;
    m_content_settings.force_dark_per_host.set(host, enabled);
    persist_settings();
    for (auto& observer : m_observers)
        observer.content_settings_changed();
}

void Settings::reset_host_setting(HostSetting setting, Optional<StringView> host)
{
    auto reset = [&](auto& overrides) {
        if (host.has_value())
            return overrides.remove(*host);
        if (overrides.is_empty())
            return false;
        overrides.clear();
        return true;
    };

    auto changed = [&]() {
        switch (setting) {
        case HostSetting::Zoom:
            return reset(m_content_settings.zoom_per_host);
        case HostSetting::ForceDark:
            return reset(m_content_settings.force_dark_per_host);
        }
        VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
    }();
    if (!changed)
        return;

    persist_settings();

    for (auto& observer : m_observers)
        observer.content_settings_changed();
}

double Settings::zoom_for_host(StringView host) const
{
    auto default_zoom_level_factor = m_content_settings.default_zoom_level_factor;
    if (host.is_empty())
        return default_zoom_level_factor;
    return m_content_settings.zoom_per_host.get(host).value_or(default_zoom_level_factor);
}

void Settings::set_zoom_for_host(String const& host, double zoom_level)
{
    if (host.is_empty())
        return;

    if (zoom_level == m_content_settings.default_zoom_level_factor) {
        if (!m_content_settings.zoom_per_host.remove(host))
            return;
    } else {
        if (m_content_settings.zoom_per_host.get(host) == zoom_level)
            return;
        m_content_settings.zoom_per_host.set(host, zoom_level);
    }

    persist_settings();

    for (auto& observer : m_observers)
        observer.content_settings_changed();
}

TabSettings Settings::parse_tab_settings(JsonValue const& settings)
{
    if (!settings.is_object())
        return {};

    TabSettings tab_settings;

    if (auto vertical_tabs_enabled = settings.as_object().get_bool(VERTICAL_TABS_ENABLED_KEY); vertical_tabs_enabled.has_value())
        tab_settings.vertical_tabs_enabled = *vertical_tabs_enabled;
    if (auto vertical_tabs_expanded = settings.as_object().get_bool(VERTICAL_TABS_EXPANDED_KEY); vertical_tabs_expanded.has_value())
        tab_settings.vertical_tabs_expanded = *vertical_tabs_expanded;
    if (auto vertical_tabs_expand_on_hover = settings.as_object().get_bool(VERTICAL_TABS_EXPAND_ON_HOVER_KEY); vertical_tabs_expand_on_hover.has_value())
        tab_settings.vertical_tabs_expand_on_hover = *vertical_tabs_expand_on_hover;
    if (auto vertical_tabs_position = settings.as_object().get_string(VERTICAL_TABS_POSITION_KEY); vertical_tabs_position.has_value()) {
        if (auto parsed_position = vertical_tabs_position_from_string(*vertical_tabs_position); parsed_position.has_value())
            tab_settings.vertical_tabs_position = *parsed_position;
    }
    if (auto vertical_tabs_expanded_width = settings.as_object().get_integer<u16>(VERTICAL_TABS_EXPANDED_WIDTH_KEY); vertical_tabs_expanded_width.has_value())
        tab_settings.vertical_tabs_expanded_width = *vertical_tabs_expanded_width;
    if (auto everything_in_sidebar = settings.as_object().get_bool(EVERYTHING_IN_SIDEBAR_KEY); everything_in_sidebar.has_value())
        tab_settings.everything_in_sidebar = *everything_in_sidebar;
    if (auto minutes = settings.as_object().get_integer<u32>(DISCARD_HIDDEN_TABS_AFTER_MINUTES_KEY); minutes.has_value())
        tab_settings.discard_hidden_tabs_after_minutes = *minutes;
    if (auto tab_processes = settings.as_object().get_string(TAB_PROCESSES_KEY); tab_processes.has_value()) {
        if (auto parsed_tab_processes = tab_processes_from_string(*tab_processes); parsed_tab_processes.has_value())
            tab_settings.tab_processes = *parsed_tab_processes;
    }

    return tab_settings;
}

void Settings::set_tab_settings(TabSettings tab_settings)
{
    m_tab_settings = tab_settings;
    persist_settings();

    for (auto& observer : m_observers)
        observer.tab_settings_changed();
}

BrowsingBehavior Settings::parse_browsing_behavior(JsonValue const& settings)
{
    if (!settings.is_object())
        return {};

    BrowsingBehavior browsing_behavior;

    if (auto enable_autoscroll = settings.as_object().get_bool(ENABLE_AUTOSCROLL_KEY); enable_autoscroll.has_value())
        browsing_behavior.enable_autoscroll = *enable_autoscroll;
    if (auto enable_primary_paste = settings.as_object().get_bool(ENABLE_PRIMARY_PASTE_KEY); enable_primary_paste.has_value())
        browsing_behavior.enable_primary_paste = *enable_primary_paste;

    return browsing_behavior;
}

BrowsingBehavior Settings::browsing_behavior() const
{
    auto browsing_behavior = m_browsing_behavior;

    // Override browsing behaviors depending on what the system supports. We do this here, rather than persisting the
    // setting override, so that we don't persist unsupported behavior when headless mode is used.
    browsing_behavior.enable_primary_paste &= Application::the().supports_clipboard_type(Application::ClipboardType::Selection);

    return browsing_behavior;
}

void Settings::set_browsing_behavior(BrowsingBehavior browsing_behavior)
{
    m_browsing_behavior = browsing_behavior;
    persist_settings();

    for (auto& observer : m_observers)
        observer.browsing_behavior_changed();
}

void Settings::set_search_engine_settings(SearchEngineSettings search_engine_settings)
{
    m_search_engine_settings = move(search_engine_settings);

    persist_settings();

    for (auto& observer : m_observers)
        observer.search_engine_settings_changed();
}

Optional<SearchEngine> Settings::parse_custom_search_engine(JsonValue const& search_engine)
{

    auto validate_url = [](StringView url) {
        if (!url.contains("%s"sv))
            return false;

        auto parsed_url = URL::Parser::basic_parse(url);
        if (!parsed_url.has_value())
            return false;
        if (!parsed_url->scheme().is_one_of("http"sv, "https"sv))
            return false;

        return true;
    };

    if (!search_engine.is_object())
        return {};

    auto name = search_engine.as_object().get_string(SEARCH_ENGINE_NAME_KEY);
    if (!name.has_value())
        return {};

    auto url = search_engine.as_object().get_string(SEARCH_ENGINE_URL_KEY);
    if (!url.has_value() || !validate_url(*url))
        return {};

    auto suggestions_url = search_engine.as_object().get_string(SEARCH_SUGGESTIONS_URL_KEY).map([&](auto value) { return value; });
    if (suggestions_url.has_value() && suggestions_url->is_empty())
        suggestions_url.clear();
    if (suggestions_url.has_value() && !validate_url(*suggestions_url))
        return {};

    return SearchEngine {
        .name = name.release_value(),
        .query_url = url.release_value(),
        .suggestions_url = move(suggestions_url),
    };
}

void Settings::add_custom_search_engine(SearchEngine search_engine)
{
    if (find_search_engine_by_name(search_engine.name).has_value())
        return;

    m_custom_search_engines.append(move(search_engine));
    persist_settings();

    for (auto& observer : m_observers)
        observer.search_engine_settings_changed();
}

void Settings::remove_custom_search_engine(SearchEngine const& search_engine)
{
    auto reset_default_search_engine = m_search_engine_settings.engine.has_value() && m_search_engine_settings.engine->name == search_engine.name;
    if (reset_default_search_engine)
        m_search_engine_settings.engine.clear();

    m_custom_search_engines.remove_all_matching([&](auto const& engine) {
        return engine.name == search_engine.name;
    });

    persist_settings();

    for (auto& observer : m_observers)
        observer.search_engine_settings_changed();
}

Optional<SearchEngine> Settings::find_search_engine_by_name(StringView name) const
{
    auto comparator = [&](auto const& engine) { return engine.name == name; };

    if (auto result = find_value(builtin_search_engines(), comparator); result.has_value())
        return result.copy();
    if (auto result = find_value(m_custom_search_engines, comparator); result.has_value())
        return result.copy();

    return {};
}

void Settings::set_autoplay_policy(Web::HTML::AutoplayPolicy policy)
{
    m_autoplay.policy = policy;
    persist_settings();

    for (auto& observer : m_observers)
        observer.autoplay_settings_changed();
}

void Settings::add_autoplay_site_filter(String const& site_filter, Web::HTML::AutoplayPolicy policy)
{
    auto trimmed_site_filter = MUST(site_filter.trim_whitespace());
    if (trimmed_site_filter.is_empty())
        return;

    m_autoplay.site_filters.set(move(trimmed_site_filter), policy);
    persist_settings();

    for (auto& observer : m_observers)
        observer.autoplay_settings_changed();
}

void Settings::remove_autoplay_site_filter(String const& site_filter)
{
    m_autoplay.site_filters.remove(site_filter);
    persist_settings();

    for (auto& observer : m_observers)
        observer.autoplay_settings_changed();
}

void Settings::remove_all_autoplay_site_filters()
{
    m_autoplay.site_filters.clear();
    persist_settings();

    for (auto& observer : m_observers)
        observer.autoplay_settings_changed();
}

PermissionPolicy Settings::permission_policy(Web::Permissions::PermissionName name) const
{
    return m_permission_policies.get(name).value_or(PermissionPolicy::Ask);
}

void Settings::set_permission_policy(Web::Permissions::PermissionName name, PermissionPolicy policy)
{
    if (permission_policy(name) == policy)
        return;

    m_permission_policies.set(name, policy);
    persist_settings();

    for (auto& observer : m_observers)
        observer.permission_settings_changed(name);
}

HTTP::DiskCacheSettings Settings::disk_cache_settings() const
{
    return { .maximum_size = config_variable_as_integer<u64>(ConfigVariableID::MaximumDiskCacheSize) * MiB };
}

void Settings::set_global_privacy_control(GlobalPrivacyControl global_privacy_control)
{
    m_global_privacy_control = global_privacy_control;
    persist_settings();

    for (auto& observer : m_observers)
        observer.global_privacy_control_changed();
}

void Settings::set_crash_report_sending(CrashReportSending crash_report_sending)
{
    m_crash_report_sending = crash_report_sending;
    persist_settings();

    for (auto& observer : m_observers)
        observer.crash_report_sending_changed();
}

DNSSettings Settings::parse_dns_settings(JsonValue const& dns_settings)
{
    if (!dns_settings.is_object())
        return SystemDNS {};

    auto const& dns_settings_object = dns_settings.as_object();

    if (auto mode = dns_settings_object.get_string("mode"sv); mode.has_value()) {
        if (*mode == "system"sv)
            return SystemDNS {};

        if (*mode == "custom"sv) {
            auto server = dns_settings_object.get_string("server"sv);
            auto port = dns_settings_object.get_u16("port"sv);
            auto type = dns_settings_object.get_string("type"sv);
            auto validate_dnssec_locally = dns_settings_object.get_bool("dnssec"sv);

            if (server.has_value() && port.has_value() && type.has_value()) {
                if (*type == "tls"sv)
                    return DNSOverTLS { .server_address = server->to_byte_string(), .port = *port, .validate_dnssec_locally = validate_dnssec_locally.value_or(false) };
                if (*type == "udp"sv)
                    return DNSOverUDP { .server_address = server->to_byte_string(), .port = *port, .validate_dnssec_locally = validate_dnssec_locally.value_or(false) };
            }
        }
    }

    dbgln("Invalid DNS settings in parse_dns_settings, falling back to system DNS");
    return SystemDNS {};
}

void Settings::set_background_networking_enabled(bool enabled)
{
    if (m_background_networking_enabled == enabled)
        return;

    m_background_networking_enabled = enabled;
    persist_settings();

    for (auto& observer : m_observers)
        observer.background_networking_settings_changed();
}

void Settings::set_filter_list_updates_enabled(bool enabled)
{
    if (m_filter_list_updates_enabled == enabled)
        return;

    m_filter_list_updates_enabled = enabled;
    persist_settings();

    for (auto& observer : m_observers)
        observer.background_networking_settings_changed();
}

void Settings::set_update_checks_enabled(bool enabled)
{
    if (m_update_checks_enabled == enabled)
        return;

    m_update_checks_enabled = enabled;
    persist_settings();

    for (auto& observer : m_observers)
        observer.background_networking_settings_changed();
}
#endif

Optional<ContentBlockerList const&> Settings::content_blocker_list(StringView identifier) const
{
    for (auto const& list : m_content_blocker_lists) {
        if (list.identifier == identifier)
            return list;
    }
    return {};
}

bool Settings::content_blocker_enabled_for_site(StringView site) const
{
    auto host = Web::canonical_content_blocking_host(site);
    return !host.has_value() || !m_content_blocker_disabled_sites.contains(*host);
}

ErrorOr<void> Settings::set_content_blocker_enabled_for_site(StringView site, bool enabled)
{
    auto host = Web::canonical_content_blocking_host(site);
    if (!host.has_value())
        return Error::from_string_literal("Invalid site hostname");

    auto changed = enabled
        ? m_content_blocker_disabled_sites.remove(*host)
        : m_content_blocker_disabled_sites.set(*host) == HashSetResult::InsertedNewEntry;
    if (!changed)
        return {};

    // FIXME: persist_settings should return an error so we can propagate to the UI.
    persist_settings();

    for (auto& observer : m_observers)
        observer.content_blocker_settings_changed();
    return {};
}

void Settings::set_content_blocker_enabled(bool enabled)
{
    if (m_content_blocker_enabled == enabled)
        return;
    m_content_blocker_enabled = enabled;
    persist_settings();
    for (auto& observer : m_observers)
        observer.content_blocker_settings_changed();
}

void Settings::set_content_blocker_list_enabled(StringView identifier, bool enabled)
{
    for (auto& list : m_content_blocker_lists) {
        if (list.identifier != identifier || list.enabled == enabled)
            continue;
        list.enabled = enabled;
        persist_settings();
        for (auto& observer : m_observers)
            observer.content_blocker_settings_changed();
        return;
    }
}

String Settings::add_content_blocker_list(String name, Optional<URL::URL> url)
{
    String identifier;
    do {
        identifier = MUST(String::formatted("list-{:016x}", get_random<u64>()));
    } while (content_blocker_list(identifier).has_value());
    m_content_blocker_lists.append({ identifier, move(name), move(url) });
    persist_settings();
    for (auto& observer : m_observers)
        observer.content_blocker_settings_changed();
    return identifier;
}

bool Settings::remove_content_blocker_list(StringView identifier)
{
    auto removed = m_content_blocker_lists.remove_all_matching([&](auto const& list) { return !list.built_in && list.identifier == identifier; });
    if (!removed)
        return false;
    persist_settings();
    for (auto& observer : m_observers)
        observer.content_blocker_settings_changed();
    return true;
}

void Settings::set_custom_content_blocker_filters(String filters)
{
    if (m_custom_content_blocker_filters == filters)
        return;
    m_custom_content_blocker_filters = move(filters);
    persist_settings();
    for (auto& observer : m_observers)
        observer.content_blocker_settings_changed();
}

void Settings::set_dns_settings(DNSSettings const& dns_settings, bool override_by_command_line)
{
    m_dns_settings = dns_settings;
    m_dns_override_by_command_line = override_by_command_line;

    if (!override_by_command_line)
        persist_settings();

    for (auto& observer : m_observers)
        observer.dns_settings_changed();
}

JsonValue const& Settings::config_variable(ConfigVariableID id) const
{
    return m_config_variables[static_cast<size_t>(id)];
}

bool Settings::config_variable_as_bool(ConfigVariableID id) const
{
    auto const& variable = config_variable_definition(id);
    VERIFY(variable.default_value.is_bool());

    auto value = config_variable(id).get_bool();
    VERIFY(value.has_value());
    return *value;
}

void Settings::set_config_variable(ConfigVariableID id, JsonValue value)
{
    auto const& variable = config_variable_definition(id);
    if (!config_variable_value_is_valid(variable, value))
        return;

    if (m_config_variables[static_cast<size_t>(id)].equals(value))
        return;

    m_config_variables[static_cast<size_t>(id)] = move(value);
    persist_settings();

    for (auto& observer : m_observers)
        observer.config_variable_changed(id);
}

void Settings::set_config_variable(StringView name, JsonValue const& value)
{
    auto id = config_variable_id_from_name(name);
    if (!id.has_value())
        return;

    set_config_variable(*id, value);
}

void Settings::persist_settings()
{
    auto settings = serialize_json();

    if (!m_settings_path.is_empty()) {
        if (auto result = write_json_file(m_settings_path, settings); result.is_error())
            warnln("Unable to persist Ladybird settings: {}", result.error());
    }

    if (on_persist)
        on_persist(settings);
}

void Settings::add_observer(Badge<SettingsObserver>, SettingsObserver& observer)
{
    m_observers.append(observer);
}

void Settings::remove_observer(Badge<SettingsObserver>, SettingsObserver& observer)
{
    auto was_removed = m_observers.remove_first_matching([&](auto const& candidate) {
        return &candidate == &observer;
    });
    VERIFY(was_removed);
}

SettingsObserver::SettingsObserver()
    : SettingsObserver(Application::settings())
{
}

SettingsObserver::SettingsObserver(Settings& settings)
    : m_settings(settings)
{
    m_settings->add_observer({}, *this);
}

SettingsObserver::~SettingsObserver()
{
    if (m_settings)
        m_settings->remove_observer({}, *this);
}

}

    // buttons, and there is no toolbar row. The sidebar is then always on the left.
    bool everything_in_sidebar { false };

// What the settings hold, which a Settings can start over from.

    ContentSettings m_content_settings;
    TabSettings m_tab_settings;

    GlobalPrivacyControl m_global_privacy_control { GlobalPrivacyControl::No };
    CrashReportSending m_crash_report_sending { CrashReportSending::AskMe };

    bool m_background_networking_enabled { true };
    bool m_filter_list_updates_enabled { false };
#if defined(LADYBIRD_HAS_UPDATE_CHECK)
    bool m_update_checks_enabled { true };
#endif
    bool m_content_blocker_enabled { false };
    HashTable<String> m_content_blocker_disabled_sites;
    Vector<ContentBlockerList> m_content_blocker_lists;
    String m_custom_content_blocker_filters;

    DNSSettings m_dns_settings { SystemDNS() };

    Array<JsonValue, static_cast<size_t>(ConfigVariableID::Count)> m_config_variables {};
};

class WEBVIEW_API Settings
    : public Weakable<Settings>
    , private SettingsData {
public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    // The platform's languages stand in for the user's list until the settings file carries one.
    static Settings create(ByteString settings_path, Vector<String> platform_languages = {});

    // Settings that live in another process, and are never read from or written to a file here.
    static Settings create_from_json(JsonValue const&);
    enum class PersistChange {
        No,
        Yes,
    };
    void replace_with_json(JsonValue const&, PersistChange);

    // Called with the settings as they are, whenever they have changed.
    Function<void(JsonValue const&)> on_persist;

    JsonValue serialize_json() const;

    // What turns one set of serialized settings into another, by top-level key. A key that is gone has the value null.
    static JsonObject changes_between(JsonObject const& from, JsonObject const& to);
    static void apply_changes(JsonObject& settings, JsonObject const& changes);

    bool first_run_complete() const { return m_first_run_complete; }
    ErrorOr<void> complete_first_run();

    static WindowSettings parse_window_settings(JsonValue const&);

    URL::URL const& new_tab_page_url() const { return m_new_tab_page_url; }
    void set_new_tab_page_url(URL::URL);

    // Read only at launch, so a change applies at the next launch.

    static Vector<String> parse_json_languages(JsonValue const&);
    Vector<String> const& languages() const { return m_languages; }

    // Whether pages are translated with the platform's higher-quality models, rather than its faster ones.
    bool translation_prefers_higher_quality() const { return m_translation_prefers_higher_quality; }
    void set_translation_prefers_higher_quality(bool);

    static Appearance parse_appearance(JsonValue const&);
    Appearance const& appearance() const { return m_appearance; }

    static ContentSettings parse_content_settings(JsonValue const&);

    static Optional<SearchEngine> parse_custom_search_engine(JsonValue const&);
    void add_custom_search_engine(SearchEngine);
    void remove_custom_search_engine(SearchEngine const&);

    AutoplaySiteSetting const& autoplay_settings() const { return m_autoplay; }

    void add_autoplay_site_filter(String const&, Web::HTML::AutoplayPolicy);
    void remove_autoplay_site_filter(String const&);
    void remove_all_autoplay_site_filters();

    PermissionPolicy permission_policy(Web::Permissions::PermissionName) const;
    void set_permission_policy(Web::Permissions::PermissionName, PermissionPolicy);

    HTTP::DiskCacheSettings disk_cache_settings() const;

    GlobalPrivacyControl global_privacy_control() const { return m_global_privacy_control; }
    void set_global_privacy_control(GlobalPrivacyControl);

    CrashReportSending crash_report_sending() const { return m_crash_report_sending; }
    void set_crash_report_sending(CrashReportSending);

    void set_background_networking_enabled(bool);

    bool automatic_filter_list_updates_allowed() const { return m_background_networking_enabled && m_filter_list_updates_enabled; }

    bool update_checks_enabled() const { return m_update_checks_enabled; }

    void set_update_checks_enabled(bool);

    bool content_blocker_enabled() const { return m_content_blocker_enabled; }
    void set_content_blocker_enabled(bool);

    HashTable<String> const& content_blocker_disabled_sites() const { return m_content_blocker_disabled_sites; }

    ErrorOr<void> set_content_blocker_enabled_for_site(StringView, bool enabled);

    Vector<ContentBlockerList> const& content_blocker_lists() const { return m_content_blocker_lists; }

    String add_content_blocker_list(String name, Optional<URL::URL> = {});

    void set_dns_settings(DNSSettings const&, bool override_by_command_line = false);

    JsonValue const& config_variable(ConfigVariableID) const;
    bool config_variable_as_bool(ConfigVariableID) const;
    void set_config_variable(ConfigVariableID, JsonValue);
    void set_config_variable(StringView name, JsonValue const&);

    template<Integral T>
    T config_variable_as_integer(ConfigVariableID id) const
    {
        auto const& variable = config_variable_definition(id);
        VERIFY(variable.default_value.is_number());

        auto value = config_variable(id).get_integer<T>();
        return value.value_or_lazy_evaluated([&] { return variable.default_value.get_integer<T>().value(); });
    }

    void add_observer(Badge<SettingsObserver>, SettingsObserver&);
    void remove_observer(Badge<SettingsObserver>, SettingsObserver&);

private:
    explicit Settings(ByteString settings_path);

    void reset_to_defaults();
    void load_from_json(JsonValue const&);

    void persist_settings();

    ByteString m_settings_path;
    bool m_dns_override_by_command_line { false };

    Vector<SettingsObserver&> m_observers;
};

// The platform spellchecker the UI process asks on behalf of every page. A document tag scopes what ignore() hides to
// one tab.
class WEBVIEW_API SpellChecker {
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

public:
    using DocumentTag = i64;

    virtual ~SpellChecker() = default;

    virtual DocumentTag create_document_tag() = 0;
    virtual void close_document_tag(DocumentTag) = 0;

    // Asynchronous; on_complete runs on the main thread.
    virtual void check(DocumentTag, Utf16String const& text, Function<void(Vector<Web::SpellingError>)> on_complete) = 0;

    // Asynchronous; on_complete runs on the main thread.
    virtual void guesses(DocumentTag, Utf16String const& word, Function<void(Vector<Utf16String>)> on_complete) = 0;

    virtual void ignore(DocumentTag, Utf16String const& word) = 0;
    virtual void learn(DocumentTag, Utf16String const& word) = 0;

    // Whether a learned word holds for every document tag, as it does in a user dictionary that every app shares.
    virtual bool learns_for_every_tag() const { return true; }

    // Whether suggest() can ever answer, i.e. the platform predicts text as the user types.
    virtual bool can_suggest() const { return false; }

    // Predicts how the text could continue at caret_offset (in UTF-16 code units). Asynchronous; on_complete runs on
    // the main thread, with nothing if there's no prediction.
    virtual void suggest(DocumentTag, [[maybe_unused]] Utf16String const& text, [[maybe_unused]] u32 caret_offset, Function<void(Optional<Web::WritingSuggestion>)> on_complete)
    {
        on_complete({});
    }
};

}

/*

#include <LibWebView/StorageAreaRegistry.h>

namespace WebView {

StorageAreaRegistry& StorageAreaRegistry::the()
{
    // Outlives the process, rather than running a destructor at exit.
    static auto* registry = new StorageAreaRegistry;
    return *registry;
}

void StorageAreaRegistry::remove_areas_of(Badge<StorageJar>, StorageJar& jar)
{
    auto areas = m_areas.take(&jar);
    if (!areas.has_value())
        return;
    for (auto const& entry : *areas) {
        for (auto const& listener_id : entry.value.listener_ids)
            m_live_connections.remove(listener_id.value);
    }
}

StorageAreaRegistry::Area* StorageAreaRegistry::area_for(StorageJar& jar, StorageBottleLocation const& location)
{
    auto areas = m_areas.get(&jar);
    if (!areas.has_value())
        return nullptr;
    auto area = areas->get(location);
    if (!area.has_value())
        return nullptr;
    return &*area;
}

Optional<StorageAreaRegistry::Connection> StorageAreaRegistry::connect(StorageAreaListener& listener, StorageJar& jar, StorageEndpointType storage_endpoint, String const& storage_key)
{
    if (storage_endpoint != StorageEndpointType::LocalStorage && storage_endpoint != StorageEndpointType::SessionStorage)
        return {};

    StorageBottleLocation location { storage_endpoint, storage_key };
    auto& area = m_areas.ensure(&jar).ensure(location, [&] { return Area { &jar, storage_endpoint, storage_key, {} }; });

    // A listener that connects again to an area it already mirrors has let its old mirror go; anything still
    // addressed to that one is dropped from here on.
    if (auto previous = area.listener_ids.get(&listener); previous.has_value())
        m_live_connections.remove(*previous);

    Web::StorageAPI::StorageAreaId id { m_next_id++ };
    area.listener_ids.set(&listener, id);
    m_live_connections.set(id, LiveConnection { &jar, location, &listener });
    m_issued_ids.ensure(&listener).set(id);

    jar.mark_accessed(storage_endpoint, storage_key);
    return Connection { id, jar.get_all_items(storage_endpoint, storage_key), jar.bottle_usage(storage_endpoint, storage_key) };
}

void StorageAreaRegistry::disconnect(StorageAreaListener& listener, Web::StorageAPI::StorageAreaId id)
{
    auto live = m_live_connections.get(id);
    if (!live.has_value() || live->listener != &listener)
        return;
    auto connection = *live;
    m_live_connections.remove(id);

    auto* area = area_for(*connection.jar, connection.location);
    if (!area)
        return;
    if (auto current = area->listener_ids.get(&listener); current.has_value() && *current == id)
        area->listener_ids.remove(&listener);
    if (!area->listener_ids.is_empty())
        return;

    // An area lives as long as something mirrors it.
    auto areas = m_areas.get(connection.jar);
    areas->remove(connection.location);
    if (areas->is_empty())
        m_areas.remove(connection.jar);
}

void StorageAreaRegistry::remove_listener(StorageAreaListener& listener)
{
    auto ids = m_issued_ids.take(&listener);
    if (!ids.has_value())
        return;
    for (auto id : *ids)
        disconnect(listener, id);
}

bool StorageAreaRegistry::was_issued_to(StorageAreaListener const& listener, Web::StorageAPI::StorageAreaId id) const
{
    auto ids = m_issued_ids.get(&listener);
    return ids.has_value() && ids->contains(id);
}

StorageAreaRegistry::Area* StorageAreaRegistry::connected_area(StorageAreaListener& listener, Web::StorageAPI::StorageAreaId id)
{
    auto live = m_live_connections.get(id);
    if (!live.has_value() || live->listener != &listener)
        return nullptr;
    return area_for(*live->jar, live->location);
}

void StorageAreaRegistry::set_item(StorageAreaListener& listener, Web::StorageAPI::StorageAreaId id, Utf16String const& key, Utf16String const& value, String const& url)
{
    auto* area = connected_area(listener, id);
    if (!area)
        return;

    m_current_write = CurrentWrite { &listener, url };
    auto result = area->jar->set_item(area->storage_endpoint, area->storage_key, key, value);
    m_current_write.clear();

    // The writer applied the write to its mirror before sending it, on the strength of the same quota rule — so a
    // refusal means another process filled the bottle in between, and the writer has to reload it to agree again.
    if (result.has<StorageOperationError>())
        listener.storage_area_write_refused(id, area->jar->get_all_items(area->storage_endpoint, area->storage_key));
    else
        listener.storage_area_write_acknowledged(id);
}

void StorageAreaRegistry::remove_item(StorageAreaListener& listener, Web::StorageAPI::StorageAreaId id, Utf16String const& key, String const& url)
{
    auto* area = connected_area(listener, id);
    if (!area)
        return;

    m_current_write = CurrentWrite { &listener, url };
    area->jar->remove_item(area->storage_endpoint, area->storage_key, key);
    m_current_write.clear();
    listener.storage_area_write_acknowledged(id);
}

void StorageAreaRegistry::clear(StorageAreaListener& listener, Web::StorageAPI::StorageAreaId id, String const& url)
{
    auto* area = connected_area(listener, id);
    if (!area)
        return;

    m_current_write = CurrentWrite { &listener, url };
    area->jar->clear_storage_key(area->storage_endpoint, area->storage_key);
    m_current_write.clear();
    listener.storage_area_write_acknowledged(id);
}

void StorageAreaRegistry::did_change(Badge<StorageJar>, StorageJar& jar, StorageChange const& change)
{
    Optional<String> writer_url;
    StorageAreaListener* writer = nullptr;
    if (m_current_write.has_value()) {
        writer = m_current_write->writer;
        writer_url = m_current_write->url;
    }

    if (auto* area = area_for(jar, { change.storage_endpoint, change.storage_key })) {
        // The writer already applied its own change; everyone else learns of it here, each under its own id.
        for (auto const& listener_id : area->listener_ids) {
            auto* listener = listener_id.key;
            if (listener == writer)
                continue;
            if (change.type == StorageChange::Type::Reset)
                listener->storage_area_reset(listener_id.value, jar.get_all_items(change.storage_endpoint, change.storage_key));
            else
                listener->storage_area_changed(listener_id.value, change.key, change.old_value, change.new_value, writer_url.value_or(change.storage_key));
        }
    }

    if (on_change_for_devtools)
        on_change_for_devtools(jar, change);
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWebView/StorageAreaRegistry.h
/*

 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#pragma once

#include <AK/Badge.h>
#include <AK/Function.h>
#include <AK/HashMap.h>
#include <AK/HashTable.h>
#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <AK/String.h>
#include <AK/Utf16String.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/StorageAPI/StorageAreaId.h>
#include <LibWebView/Export.h>
#include <LibWebView/Forward.h>
#include <LibWebView/StorageJar.h>

namespace WebView {

// A process that mirrors a storage area. Every change to the area's bottle reaches it here, except one it made itself,
// which it hears acknowledged or refused instead.
class WEBVIEW_API StorageAreaListener {
public:
    virtual ~StorageAreaListener() = default;

    // A null key means the bottle was cleared. The url is the document URL of the page that made the change, or the
    // storage key when no page did.
    virtual void storage_area_changed(Web::StorageAPI::StorageAreaId, Optional<Utf16String> const& key, Optional<Utf16String> const& old_value, Optional<Utf16String> const& new_value, String const& url) = 0;
    virtual void storage_area_write_acknowledged(Web::StorageAPI::StorageAreaId) = 0;
    // A write the jar refused, with everything the bottle holds, so the writer can fall back in line with it.
    virtual void storage_area_write_refused(Web::StorageAPI::StorageAreaId, Vector<StorageItem>) = 0;
    // The bottle changed in a way not worth describing key by key; this is everything it holds now.
    virtual void storage_area_reset(Web::StorageAPI::StorageAreaId, Vector<StorageItem>) = 0;
};

// The storage areas the browser process hands out: one per bottle of one jar, each knowing the processes that mirror
// it. Every jar reports its changes here, so a change made anywhere — by a page, by DevTools, by clearing site data —
// reaches every mirror of the bottle it happened in. Nothing else has to remember to broadcast.
class WEBVIEW_API StorageAreaRegistry {
public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    static StorageAreaRegistry& the();

    struct Connection {
        Web::StorageAPI::StorageAreaId id;
        Vector<StorageItem> items;
        u64 usage { 0 };
    };

    // Registers the listener at the exact point the items were read, so no change is missed or seen twice, and marks
    // the bottle accessed, since the listener's reads won't reach the jar. Every connection gets an id of its own,
    // even to an area others mirror too: a message meant for a connection that has since gone must never reach the
    // one that took its place. Only web storage is mirrored; asking for any other endpoint gets nothing, so no
    // process can write to a bottle whose endpoint has no quota.
    Optional<Connection> connect(StorageAreaListener&, StorageJar&, StorageEndpointType, String const& storage_key);
    void disconnect(StorageAreaListener&, Web::StorageAPI::StorageAreaId);
    // The listener's connection is gone.
    void remove_listener(StorageAreaListener&);

    // An area ID is a claim about the sender. One a listener was ever given stays valid for the listener's life: a
    // message it sent while the connection existed can arrive after it is gone, and such a message is dropped, not
    // held against it.
    bool was_issued_to(StorageAreaListener const&, Web::StorageAPI::StorageAreaId) const;

    // Writes from a listener. Each is dropped when the ID names no connection the listener still has.
    void set_item(StorageAreaListener&, Web::StorageAPI::StorageAreaId, Utf16String const& key, Utf16String const& value, String const& url);
    void remove_item(StorageAreaListener&, Web::StorageAPI::StorageAreaId, Utf16String const& key, String const& url);
    void clear(StorageAreaListener&, Web::StorageAPI::StorageAreaId, String const& url);

    // Every change to every jar, whoever made it.
    Function<void(StorageJar&, StorageChange const&)> on_change_for_devtools;

    void did_change(Badge<StorageJar>, StorageJar&, StorageChange const&);
    void remove_areas_of(Badge<StorageJar>, StorageJar&);

private:
    struct Area {
        StorageJar* jar { nullptr };
        StorageEndpointType storage_endpoint;
        String storage_key;
        HashMap<StorageAreaListener*, Web::StorageAPI::StorageAreaId> listener_ids;
    };

    // What a live id names.
    struct LiveConnection {
        StorageJar* jar { nullptr };
        StorageBottleLocation location;
        StorageAreaListener* listener { nullptr };
    };

    struct CurrentWrite {
        StorageAreaListener* writer { nullptr };
        String url;
    };

    Area* area_for(StorageJar&, StorageBottleLocation const&);
    Area* connected_area(StorageAreaListener&, Web::StorageAPI::StorageAreaId);

    HashMap<StorageJar*, HashMap<StorageBottleLocation, Area>> m_areas;
    HashMap<Web::StorageAPI::StorageAreaId, LiveConnection> m_live_connections;
    HashMap<StorageAreaListener const*, HashTable<Web::StorageAPI::StorageAreaId>> m_issued_ids;
    Optional<CurrentWrite> m_current_write;
    u64 m_next_id { 1 };
};

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWebView/StorageJar.cpp
/*

#include <AK/Array.h>
#include <AK/NonnullOwnPtr.h>
#include <AK/StdLibExtras.h>
#include <LibDatabase/Database.h>
#include <LibWebView/StorageAreaRegistry.h>
#include <LibWebView/StorageJar.h>

using Web::StorageAPI::quota_for;
using Web::StorageAPI::storage_quota_size;

namespace WebView {

static constexpr u32 WEB_STORAGE_SCHEMA_BASELINE_VERSION = 2u;

ErrorOr<Database::MigrationOutcome> StorageJar::migrate_schema(Database::Database& database, Database::MigrationMode mode)
{
    auto migrations = to_array<Database::Migration>({
        {
            .version = WEB_STORAGE_SCHEMA_BASELINE_VERSION,
            .sql = R"#(
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS WebStorage (
                    storage_endpoint INTEGER,
                    storage_key TEXT,
                    bottle_key TEXT,
                    bottle_value TEXT,
                    last_access_time INTEGER,
                    PRIMARY KEY(storage_endpoint, storage_key, bottle_key)
                );
            )#"sv,
        },
    });

    return database.migrate("WebStorage"sv, migrations, mode);
}

ErrorOr<NonnullOwnPtr<StorageJar>> StorageJar::create(Database::Database& database)
{
    Statements statements {};

    statements.get_item = TRY(database.prepare_statement("SELECT bottle_value FROM WebStorage WHERE storage_endpoint = ? AND storage_key = ? AND bottle_key = ?;"sv));
    statements.set_item = TRY(database.prepare_statement("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO WebStorage (storage_endpoint, storage_key, bottle_key, bottle_value, last_access_time) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?);"sv));
    statements.delete_item = TRY(database.prepare_statement("DELETE FROM WebStorage WHERE storage_endpoint = ? AND storage_key = ? AND bottle_key = ?;"sv));
    statements.delete_items_accessed_since = TRY(database.prepare_statement("DELETE FROM WebStorage WHERE last_access_time >= ?;"sv));
    statements.bottles_accessed_since = TRY(database.prepare_statement("SELECT DISTINCT storage_endpoint, storage_key FROM WebStorage WHERE last_access_time >= ?;"sv));
    statements.mark_accessed = TRY(database.prepare_statement("UPDATE WebStorage SET last_access_time = ? WHERE storage_endpoint = ? AND storage_key = ?;"sv));
    statements.clear = TRY(database.prepare_statement("DELETE FROM WebStorage WHERE storage_endpoint = ? AND storage_key = ?;"sv));
    statements.get_keys = TRY(database.prepare_statement("SELECT bottle_key FROM WebStorage WHERE storage_endpoint = ? AND storage_key = ?;"sv));
    statements.get_items = TRY(database.prepare_statement("SELECT bottle_key, bottle_value FROM WebStorage WHERE storage_endpoint = ? AND storage_key = ?;"sv));
    statements.calculate_size_excluding_bottle_key = TRY(database.prepare_statement("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(OCTET_LENGTH(bottle_key) + OCTET_LENGTH(bottle_value)), 0) FROM WebStorage WHERE storage_endpoint = ? AND storage_key = ? AND bottle_key != ?;"sv));
    statements.calculate_size = TRY(database.prepare_statement("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(OCTET_LENGTH(bottle_key), 0) + COALESCE(OCTET_LENGTH(bottle_value), 0)), 0) FROM WebStorage WHERE storage_key = ?;"sv));
    statements.calculate_bottle_size = TRY(database.prepare_statement("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(OCTET_LENGTH(bottle_key), 0) + COALESCE(OCTET_LENGTH(bottle_value), 0)), 0) FROM WebStorage WHERE storage_endpoint = ? AND storage_key = ?;"sv));
    statements.estimate_storage_size_accessed_since = TRY(database.prepare_statement("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(OCTET_LENGTH(storage_key), 0) + COALESCE(OCTET_LENGTH(bottle_key), 0) + COALESCE(OCTET_LENGTH(bottle_value), 0)), 0) FROM WebStorage WHERE last_access_time >= ?;"sv));

    return adopt_own(*new StorageJar { PersistedStorage { database, statements } });
}

NonnullOwnPtr<StorageJar> StorageJar::create()
{
    return adopt_own(*new StorageJar { OptionalNone {} });
}

StorageJar::StorageJar(Optional<PersistedStorage> persisted_storage)
    : m_persisted_storage(move(persisted_storage))
{
}

StorageJar::~StorageJar()
{
    StorageAreaRegistry::the().remove_areas_of({}, *this);
}

void StorageJar::notify(StorageChange const& change)
{
    // The registry hears of every change to every jar, by construction: nothing installed and nothing to forget.
    StorageAreaRegistry::the().did_change({}, *this, change);
    if (on_change)
        on_change(change);
}

Optional<Utf16String> StorageJar::get_item(StorageEndpointType storage_endpoint, String const& storage_key, Utf16String const& bottle_key)
{
    StorageLocation storage_location { storage_endpoint, storage_key, bottle_key };

    if (m_persisted_storage.has_value())
        return m_persisted_storage->get_item(storage_location);
    return m_transient_storage.get_item(storage_location);
}

Vector<StorageItem> StorageJar::get_all_items(StorageEndpointType storage_endpoint, String const& storage_key)
{
    if (m_persisted_storage.has_value())
        return m_persisted_storage->get_items(storage_endpoint, storage_key);
    return m_transient_storage.get_items(storage_endpoint, storage_key);
}

StorageSetResult StorageJar::set_item(StorageEndpointType storage_endpoint, String const& storage_key, Utf16String const& bottle_key, Utf16String const& bottle_value)
{
    StorageLocation storage_location { storage_endpoint, storage_key, bottle_key };

    auto result = m_persisted_storage.has_value()
        ? m_persisted_storage->set_item(storage_location, bottle_value)
        : m_transient_storage.set_item(storage_location, bottle_value);

    // A refused write and a write of the value already there change nothing, so neither is reported.
    if (auto const* old_value = result.get_pointer<Optional<Utf16String>>(); old_value && *old_value != bottle_value)
        notify({ StorageChange::Type::Set, storage_endpoint, storage_key, bottle_key, *old_value, bottle_value });
    return result;
}

void StorageJar::remove_item(StorageEndpointType storage_endpoint, String const& storage_key, Utf16String const& key)
{
    auto old_value = get_item(storage_endpoint, storage_key, key);
    if (!old_value.has_value())
        return;

    StorageLocation storage_location { storage_endpoint, storage_key, key };
    if (m_persisted_storage.has_value())
        m_persisted_storage->delete_item(storage_location);
    else
        m_transient_storage.delete_item(storage_location);
    notify({ StorageChange::Type::Removed, storage_endpoint, storage_key, key, move(old_value), {} });
}

void StorageJar::remove_items_accessed_since(UnixDateTime since)
{
    auto affected_bottles = m_persisted_storage.has_value()
        ? m_persisted_storage->delete_items_accessed_since(since)
        : m_transient_storage.delete_items_accessed_since(since);

    for (auto const& bottle : affected_bottles)
        notify({ StorageChange::Type::Reset, bottle.storage_endpoint, bottle.storage_key, {}, {}, {} });
}

void StorageJar::clear_storage_key(StorageEndpointType storage_endpoint, String const& storage_key)
{
    if (get_all_keys(storage_endpoint, storage_key).is_empty())
        return;

    if (m_persisted_storage.has_value())
        m_persisted_storage->clear(storage_endpoint, storage_key);
    else
        m_transient_storage.clear(storage_endpoint, storage_key);
    notify({ StorageChange::Type::Cleared, storage_endpoint, storage_key, {}, {}, {} });
}

void StorageJar::mark_accessed(StorageEndpointType storage_endpoint, String const& storage_key)
{
    if (m_persisted_storage.has_value())
        m_persisted_storage->mark_accessed(storage_endpoint, storage_key);
    else
        m_transient_storage.mark_accessed(storage_endpoint, storage_key);
}

Vector<Utf16String> StorageJar::get_all_keys(StorageEndpointType storage_endpoint, String const& storage_key)
{
    if (m_persisted_storage.has_value())
        return m_persisted_storage->get_keys(storage_endpoint, storage_key);
    return m_transient_storage.get_keys(storage_endpoint, storage_key);
}

u64 StorageJar::usage(String const& storage_key)
{
    if (m_persisted_storage.has_value())
        return m_persisted_storage->usage(storage_key);
    return m_transient_storage.usage(storage_key);
}

u64 StorageJar::bottle_usage(StorageEndpointType storage_endpoint, String const& storage_key)
{
    if (m_persisted_storage.has_value())
        return m_persisted_storage->bottle_usage(storage_endpoint, storage_key);
    return m_transient_storage.bottle_usage(storage_endpoint, storage_key);
}

Requests::CacheSizes StorageJar::estimate_storage_size_accessed_since(UnixDateTime since) const
{
    if (m_persisted_storage.has_value())
        return m_persisted_storage->estimate_storage_size_accessed_since(since);
    return m_transient_storage.estimate_storage_size_accessed_since(since);
}

void StorageJar::clone_from(StorageJar const& other)
{
    VERIFY(!m_persisted_storage.has_value());
    VERIFY(!other.m_persisted_storage.has_value());
    m_transient_storage = other.m_transient_storage;
}

Optional<Utf16String> StorageJar::TransientStorage::get_item(StorageLocation const& key)
{
    auto bottle = m_bottles.get({ key.storage_endpoint, key.storage_key });
    if (!bottle.has_value())
        return {};

    if (auto entry = bottle->items.get(key.bottle_key); entry.has_value())
        return entry->value;

    return {};
}

Vector<StorageItem> StorageJar::TransientStorage::get_items(StorageEndpointType storage_endpoint, String const& storage_key)
{
    Vector<StorageItem> items;
    auto bottle = m_bottles.get({ storage_endpoint, storage_key });
    if (!bottle.has_value())
        return items;

    items.ensure_capacity(bottle->items.size());
    for (auto const& [bottle_key, entry] : bottle->items)
        items.unchecked_append({ bottle_key, entry.value });
    return items;
}

StorageSetResult StorageJar::TransientStorage::set_item(StorageLocation const& key, Utf16String const& value)
{
    auto& bottle = m_bottles.ensure({ key.storage_endpoint, key.storage_key });

    Optional<Utf16String> old_value;
    auto current_size = bottle.usage;

    if (auto entry = bottle.items.get(key.bottle_key); entry.has_value()) {
        old_value = entry->value;
        current_size -= entry->quota_size;
    }

    auto new_size = storage_quota_size(key.bottle_key) + storage_quota_size(value);
    if (auto quota = quota_for(key.storage_endpoint); quota.has_value() && current_size + new_size > *quota)
        return StorageOperationError::QuotaExceededError;

    bottle.items.set(key.bottle_key, { value, UnixDateTime::now(), new_size });
    bottle.usage = current_size + new_size;
    return old_value;
}

void StorageJar::TransientStorage::delete_item(StorageLocation const& key)
{
    auto bottle = m_bottles.get({ key.storage_endpoint, key.storage_key });
    if (!bottle.has_value())
        return;

    if (auto entry = bottle->items.take(key.bottle_key); entry.has_value())
        bottle->usage -= entry->quota_size;
}

Vector<StorageBottleLocation> StorageJar::TransientStorage::delete_items_accessed_since(UnixDateTime since)
{
    Vector<StorageBottleLocation> affected_bottles;
    for (auto& [location, bottle] : m_bottles) {
        auto removed = bottle.items.remove_all_matching([&](auto const&, auto const& entry) {
            if (entry.last_access_time < since)
                return false;
            bottle.usage -= entry.quota_size;
            return true;
        });
        if (removed)
            affected_bottles.append(location);
    }
    return affected_bottles;
}

void StorageJar::TransientStorage::mark_accessed(StorageEndpointType storage_endpoint, String const& storage_key)
{
    auto bottle = m_bottles.get({ storage_endpoint, storage_key });
    if (!bottle.has_value())
        return;

    auto now = UnixDateTime::now();
    for (auto& entry : bottle->items)
        entry.value.last_access_time = now;
}

u64 StorageJar::TransientStorage::bottle_usage(StorageEndpointType storage_endpoint, String const& storage_key)
{
    auto bottle = m_bottles.get({ storage_endpoint, storage_key });
    return bottle.has_value() ? bottle->usage : 0;
}

void StorageJar::TransientStorage::clear(StorageEndpointType storage_endpoint, String const& storage_key)
{
    m_bottles.remove({ storage_endpoint, storage_key });
}

Vector<Utf16String> StorageJar::TransientStorage::get_keys(StorageEndpointType storage_endpoint, String const& storage_key)
{
    auto bottle = m_bottles.get({ storage_endpoint, storage_key });
    if (!bottle.has_value())
        return {};
    return bottle->items.keys();
}

Requests::CacheSizes StorageJar::TransientStorage::estimate_storage_size_accessed_since(UnixDateTime since) const
{
    Requests::CacheSizes sizes;

    for (auto const& [location, bottle] : m_bottles) {
        for (auto const& [bottle_key, entry] : bottle.items) {
            auto size = location.storage_key.byte_count() + entry.quota_size;
            sizes.total += size;

            if (entry.last_access_time >= since)
                sizes.since_requested_time += size;
        }
    }

    return sizes;
}

Optional<Utf16String> StorageJar::PersistedStorage::get_item(StorageLocation const& key)
{
    Optional<Utf16String> result;

    database->execute_statement(
        statements.get_item,
        [&](auto statement_id) -> ErrorOr<void> {
            result = database->result_column<Utf16String>(statement_id, 0);
            return {};
        },
        to_underlying(key.storage_endpoint),
        key.storage_key,
        key.bottle_key);

    return result;
}

Vector<StorageItem> StorageJar::PersistedStorage::get_items(StorageEndpointType storage_endpoint, String const& storage_key)
{
    Vector<StorageItem> items;

    database->execute_statement(
        statements.get_items,
        [&](auto statement_id) -> ErrorOr<void> {
            items.append({ database->result_column<Utf16String>(statement_id, 0), database->result_column<Utf16String>(statement_id, 1) });
            return {};
        },
        to_underlying(storage_endpoint),
        storage_key);

    return items;
}

StorageSetResult StorageJar::PersistedStorage::set_item(StorageLocation const& key, Utf16String const& value)
{
    auto old_value = get_item(key);

    size_t current_size = 0;
    database->execute_statement(
        statements.calculate_size_excluding_bottle_key,
        [&](auto statement_id) -> ErrorOr<void> {
            current_size = database->result_column<i64>(statement_id, 0);
            return {};
        },
        to_underlying(key.storage_endpoint),
        key.storage_key,
        key.bottle_key);

    auto new_size = storage_quota_size(key.bottle_key) + storage_quota_size(value);
    if (auto quota = quota_for(key.storage_endpoint); quota.has_value() && current_size + new_size > *quota)
        return StorageOperationError::QuotaExceededError;

    database->execute_statement(
        statements.set_item,
        {},
        to_underlying(key.storage_endpoint),
        key.storage_key,
        key.bottle_key,
        value,
        UnixDateTime::now());

    return old_value;
}

void StorageJar::PersistedStorage::delete_item(StorageLocation const& key)
{
    database->execute_statement(
        statements.delete_item,
        {},
        to_underlying(key.storage_endpoint),
        key.storage_key,
        key.bottle_key);
}

Vector<StorageBottleLocation> StorageJar::PersistedStorage::delete_items_accessed_since(UnixDateTime since)
{
    Vector<StorageBottleLocation> affected_bottles;

    database->execute_statement(
        statements.bottles_accessed_since,
        [&](auto statement_id) -> ErrorOr<void> {
            affected_bottles.append({ static_cast<StorageEndpointType>(database->result_column<i64>(statement_id, 0)), database->result_column<String>(statement_id, 1) });
            return {};
        },
        since);

    database->execute_statement(statements.delete_items_accessed_since, {}, since);
    return affected_bottles;
}

void StorageJar::PersistedStorage::mark_accessed(StorageEndpointType storage_endpoint, String const& storage_key)
{
    database->execute_statement(
        statements.mark_accessed,
        {},
        UnixDateTime::now(),
        to_underlying(storage_endpoint),
        storage_key);
}

u64 StorageJar::PersistedStorage::bottle_usage(StorageEndpointType storage_endpoint, String const& storage_key)
{
    u64 current_size_in_bytes = 0;
    database->execute_statement(
        statements.calculate_bottle_size,
        [&](auto statement_id) -> ErrorOr<void> {
            current_size_in_bytes = static_cast<u64>(database->result_column<i64>(statement_id, 0));
            return {};
        },
        to_underlying(storage_endpoint),
        storage_key);
    return current_size_in_bytes;
}

void StorageJar::PersistedStorage::clear(StorageEndpointType storage_endpoint, String const& storage_key)
{
    database->execute_statement(
        statements.clear,
        {},
        to_underlying(storage_endpoint),
        storage_key);
}

Vector<Utf16String> StorageJar::PersistedStorage::get_keys(StorageEndpointType storage_endpoint, String const& storage_key)
{
    Vector<Utf16String> keys;

    database->execute_statement(
        statements.get_keys,
        [&](auto statement_id) -> ErrorOr<void> {
            keys.append(database->result_column<Utf16String>(statement_id, 0));
            return {};
        },
        to_underlying(storage_endpoint),
        storage_key);

    return keys;
}

u64 StorageJar::PersistedStorage::usage(String const& storage_key)
{
    u64 current_size_in_bytes = 0;
    database->execute_statement(
        statements.calculate_size,
        [&](auto statement_id) -> ErrorOr<void> {
            current_size_in_bytes = static_cast<u64>(database->result_column<i64>(statement_id, 0));
            return {};
        },
        storage_key);
    return current_size_in_bytes;
}

Requests::CacheSizes StorageJar::PersistedStorage::estimate_storage_size_accessed_since(UnixDateTime since) const
{
    Requests::CacheSizes sizes;

    database->execute_statement(
        statements.estimate_storage_size_accessed_since,
        [&](auto statement_id) -> ErrorOr<void> { sizes.since_requested_time = static_cast<u64>(database->result_column<i64>(statement_id, 0)); return {}; },
        since);

    database->execute_statement(
        statements.estimate_storage_size_accessed_since,
        [&](auto statement_id) -> ErrorOr<void> { sizes.total = static_cast<u64>(database->result_column<i64>(statement_id, 0)); return {}; },
        UnixDateTime::earliest());

    return sizes;
}

u64 StorageJar::TransientStorage::usage(String const& storage_key)
{
    u64 current_size_in_bytes = 0;
    for (auto const& [location, bottle] : m_bottles) {
        if (location.storage_key == storage_key)
            current_size_in_bytes += bottle.usage;
    }
    return current_size_in_bytes;
}

}

/*
