#pragma once

#include <AK/Function.h>
#include <AK/HashMap.h>
#include <AK/String.h>
#include <AK/Time.h>
#include <AK/Traits.h>
#include <AK/Utf16String.h>
#include <LibDatabase/Forward.h>
#include <LibRequests/CacheSizes.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/StorageAPI/StorageEndpoint.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/WebView/StorageSetResult.h>
#include <LibWebView/Forward.h>

namespace WebView {

using StorageEndpointType = Web::StorageAPI::StorageEndpointType;

struct StorageLocation {
    bool operator==(StorageLocation const&) const = default;

    StorageEndpointType storage_endpoint;
    String storage_key;
    Utf16String bottle_key;
};

struct StorageBottleLocation {
    bool operator==(StorageBottleLocation const&) const = default;

    StorageEndpointType storage_endpoint;
    String storage_key;
};

// One change the jar applied, reported to whoever mirrors the bottle it happened in. Set and Removed name the key and
// carry the value it had before (and, for Set, after). Cleared names only the bottle. Reset says the bottle's content
// changed in a way too costly to enumerate key by key, so a mirror has to reload it.
struct StorageChange {
    enum class Type : u8 {
        Set,
        Removed,
        Cleared,
        Reset,
    };

    Type type;
    StorageEndpointType storage_endpoint;
    String storage_key;
    Optional<Utf16String> key;
    Optional<Utf16String> old_value;
    Optional<Utf16String> new_value;
};

struct StorageItem {
    Utf16String key;
    Utf16String value;
};

class WEBVIEW_API StorageJar {
    AK_MAKE_NONCOPYABLE(StorageJar);
    AK_MAKE_NONMOVABLE(StorageJar);

public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    static ErrorOr<Database::MigrationOutcome> migrate_schema(Database::Database&, Database::MigrationMode = Database::MigrationMode::Apply);

    static ErrorOr<NonnullOwnPtr<StorageJar>> create(Database::Database&);
    static NonnullOwnPtr<StorageJar> create();

    ~StorageJar();

    // Called after every change this jar applies, whoever asked for it, after the StorageAreaRegistry has heard of
    // it. The registry is told directly, so nothing here can be unhooked by mistake.
    Function<void(StorageChange const&)> on_change;

    Optional<Utf16String> get_item(StorageEndpointType storage_endpoint, String const& storage_key, Utf16String const& bottle_key);
    Vector<StorageItem> get_all_items(StorageEndpointType storage_endpoint, String const& storage_key);
    StorageSetResult set_item(StorageEndpointType storage_endpoint, String const& storage_key, Utf16String const& bottle_key, Utf16String const& bottle_value);
    void remove_item(StorageEndpointType storage_endpoint, String const& storage_key, Utf16String const& key);
    void remove_items_accessed_since(UnixDateTime);
    void clear_storage_key(StorageEndpointType storage_endpoint, String const& storage_key);
    Vector<Utf16String> get_all_keys(StorageEndpointType storage_endpoint, String const& storage_key);
    // Reads don't reach the jar once a process mirrors a bottle, so a mirror marks the bottle accessed when it loads it.
    void mark_accessed(StorageEndpointType storage_endpoint, String const& storage_key);
    u64 usage(String const& storage_key);
    u64 bottle_usage(StorageEndpointType storage_endpoint, String const& storage_key);
    Requests::CacheSizes estimate_storage_size_accessed_since(UnixDateTime since) const;

    void clone_from(StorageJar const&);

private:
    struct Statements {
        Database::StatementID get_item { 0 };
        Database::StatementID set_item { 0 };
        Database::StatementID delete_item { 0 };
        Database::StatementID delete_items_accessed_since { 0 };
        Database::StatementID bottles_accessed_since { 0 };
        Database::StatementID mark_accessed { 0 };
        Database::StatementID clear { 0 };
        Database::StatementID get_keys { 0 };
        Database::StatementID get_items { 0 };
        Database::StatementID calculate_size_excluding_bottle_key { 0 };
        Database::StatementID calculate_size { 0 };
        Database::StatementID calculate_bottle_size { 0 };
        Database::StatementID estimate_storage_size_accessed_since { 0 };
    };

    class TransientStorage {
    public:
        Optional<Utf16String> get_item(StorageLocation const& key);
        Vector<StorageItem> get_items(StorageEndpointType storage_endpoint, String const& storage_key);
        StorageSetResult set_item(StorageLocation const& key, Utf16String const& value);
        void delete_item(StorageLocation const& key);
        // Returns the bottles that lost at least one item.
        Vector<StorageBottleLocation> delete_items_accessed_since(UnixDateTime);
        void clear(StorageEndpointType storage_endpoint, String const& storage_key);
        Vector<Utf16String> get_keys(StorageEndpointType storage_endpoint, String const& storage_key);
        void mark_accessed(StorageEndpointType storage_endpoint, String const& storage_key);
        u64 usage(String const& storage_key);
        u64 bottle_usage(StorageEndpointType storage_endpoint, String const& storage_key);
        Requests::CacheSizes estimate_storage_size_accessed_since(UnixDateTime since) const;

    private:
        struct Entry {
            Utf16String value;
            UnixDateTime last_access_time;
            // Bytes this entry contributes toward its storage key's quota: Its bottle key plus its value.
            u64 quota_size { 0 };
        };

        struct Bottle {
            HashMap<Utf16String, Entry> items;
            // The sum of the quota sizes of the items, so a set need not add them up again.
            u64 usage { 0 };
        };

        HashMap<StorageBottleLocation, Bottle> m_bottles;
    };

    struct PersistedStorage {
        Optional<Utf16String> get_item(StorageLocation const& key);
        Vector<StorageItem> get_items(StorageEndpointType storage_endpoint, String const& storage_key);
        StorageSetResult set_item(StorageLocation const& key, Utf16String const& value);
        void delete_item(StorageLocation const& key);
        // Returns the bottles that lost at least one item.
        Vector<StorageBottleLocation> delete_items_accessed_since(UnixDateTime);
        void clear(StorageEndpointType storage_endpoint, String const& storage_key);
        Vector<Utf16String> get_keys(StorageEndpointType storage_endpoint, String const& storage_key);
        void mark_accessed(StorageEndpointType storage_endpoint, String const& storage_key);
        u64 usage(String const& storage_key);
        u64 bottle_usage(StorageEndpointType storage_endpoint, String const& storage_key);
        Requests::CacheSizes estimate_storage_size_accessed_since(UnixDateTime since) const;

        NonnullRefPtr<Database::Database> database;
        Statements statements;
    };

    explicit StorageJar(Optional<PersistedStorage>);

    void notify(StorageChange const&);

    Optional<PersistedStorage> m_persisted_storage;
    TransientStorage m_transient_storage;
};

}

template<>
struct AK::Traits<WebView::StorageBottleLocation> : public AK::DefaultTraits<WebView::StorageBottleLocation> {
    static unsigned hash(WebView::StorageBottleLocation const& key)
    {
        return pair_int_hash(to_underlying(key.storage_endpoint), key.storage_key.hash());
    }
};

FILE: Libraries/LibWebView/StringConversionsMacOS.mm
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibWebView/StringConversionsMacOS.h>

namespace WebView {

String ns_string_to_string(NSString* string)
{
    auto const* utf8 = [string UTF8String];
    return MUST(String::from_utf8({ utf8, strlen(utf8) }));
}

NSString* string_to_ns_string(StringView string)
{
    return [[NSString alloc] initWithData:string_to_ns_data(string) encoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding];
}

Utf16String ns_string_to_utf16_string(NSString* string)
{
    Vector<char16_t> code_units;
    code_units.resize(string.length);
    [string getCharacters:reinterpret_cast<unichar*>(code_units.data()) range:NSMakeRange(0, string.length)];
    return Utf16String::from_utf16(Utf16View { code_units.data(), code_units.size() });
}

NSString* utf16_string_to_ns_string(Utf16View const& string)
{
    Vector<unichar> code_units;
    code_units.ensure_capacity(string.length_in_code_units());
    for (size_t index = 0; index < string.length_in_code_units(); ++index)
        code_units.unchecked_append(string.code_unit_at(index));
    return [NSString stringWithCharacters:code_units.data() length:code_units.size()];
}

NSData* string_to_ns_data(StringView string)
{
    return [NSData dataWithBytes:string.characters_without_null_termination() length:string.length()];
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWebView/SystemProbeClient.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <LibCore/File.h>
#include <LibCore/Notifier.h>
#include <LibCore/Process.h>
#include <LibCore/System.h>
#include <LibCore/Timer.h>
#include <LibFileSystem/FileSystem.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/WebView/Utilities.h>
#include <LibWebView/Process.h>
#include <LibWebView/SystemProbeClient.h>

namespace WebView {

static ErrorOr<Core::Process> spawn_probe(Optional<Gfx::GpuDeviceIdentity> const& presentation_device, int output_fd)
{
    Vector<ByteString> arguments;
    if (presentation_device.has_value()) {
        arguments.append("--gpu-device"sv);
        arguments.append(presentation_device->to_byte_string());
    }

    Core::ProcessSpawnOptions options { .name = "SystemProbe"sv };
    options.arguments = arguments;
    options.file_actions.append(Core::FileAction::DupFd { .write_fd = output_fd, .fd = STDOUT_FILENO });

    for (auto const& path : TRY(get_paths_for_helper_process("SystemProbe"sv))) {
        if (!FileSystem::exists(path))
            continue;
        options.executable = path;
        // The probe loads the driver as the Compositor will, so it sees the same environment.
        return Process::spawn_without_transport(ProcessType::Compositor, options);
    }
    return Error::from_string_literal("The SystemProbe helper was not found");
}

NonnullOwnPtr<SystemProbeClient> SystemProbeClient::launch(Optional<Gfx::GpuDeviceIdentity> const& presentation_device, Function<void(PlatformFeatures::SystemFacts const&)> on_finish)
{
    auto client_owner = adopt_own(*new SystemProbeClient);
    auto& client = *client_owner;
    client.m_on_finish = move(on_finish);

    auto pipe = Core::System::pipe2(O_CLOEXEC);
    if (pipe.is_error()) {
        client.fail("Could not create a pipe for its report"sv);
        return client_owner;
    }
    auto output = Core::File::adopt_fd(pipe.value()[0], Core::File::OpenMode::Read);
    if (output.is_error()) {
        (void)Core::System::close(pipe.value()[0]);
        (void)Core::System::close(pipe.value()[1]);
        client.fail("Could not create a pipe for its report"sv);
        return client_owner;
    }
    client.m_output = output.release_value();

    auto process = spawn_probe(presentation_device, pipe.value()[1]);
    (void)Core::System::close(pipe.value()[1]);
    if (process.is_error()) {
        client.fail("It could not be launched"sv);
        return client_owner;
    }

    client.m_pid = process.value().pid();
    client.m_notifier = Core::Notifier::construct(client.m_output->fd(), Core::Notifier::Type::Read);
    client.m_notifier->on_activation = [&client] {
        client.read_available_output();
    };
    client.m_timeout_timer = Core::Timer::create_single_shot(timeout, [&client] {
        client.fail("It did not report in time"sv);
    });
    client.m_timeout_timer->start();
    return client_owner;
}

SystemProbeClient::~SystemProbeClient()
{
    if (!has_finished())
        terminate_probe();
}

void SystemProbeClient::read_available_output()
{
    Array<u8, 4 * KiB> buffer;
    auto result = m_output->read_some(buffer);
    if (result.is_error()) {
        if (result.error().is_errno() && (result.error().code() == EINTR || result.error().code() == EAGAIN))
            return;
        fail("Its report could not be read"sv);
        return;
    }
    auto bytes_read = result.value().size();
    if (bytes_read == 0) {
        finish_with_report();
        return;
    }
    if (m_report.size() + bytes_read > maximum_report_size) {
        fail("Its report was too large"sv);
        return;
    }
    m_report.append(result.value());
}

void SystemProbeClient::finish_with_report()
{
    auto facts = PlatformFeatures::SystemFacts::from_json(StringView { m_report.bytes() });
    if (facts.is_error()) {
        // A probe that died before reporting closed its output just the same.
        fail(m_report.is_empty() ? "It exited without a report"sv : "Its report could not be understood"sv);
        return;
    }
    finish(facts.release_value());
}

void SystemProbeClient::fail(StringView reason)
{
    terminate_probe();
    PlatformFeatures::SystemFacts facts;
    facts.probe_failure = MUST(String::from_utf8(reason));
    finish(move(facts));
}

void SystemProbeClient::finish(PlatformFeatures::SystemFacts facts)
{
    if (has_finished())
        return;
    m_facts = move(facts);
    stop_reading();

    if (m_on_finish)
        m_on_finish(*m_facts);
}

void SystemProbeClient::terminate_probe()
{
    if (m_pid > 0)
        (void)Core::Process::terminate_process(m_pid, Core::Process::TerminationMode::Forceful);
    stop_reading();
}

void SystemProbeClient::stop_reading()
{
    if (m_notifier) {
        m_notifier->close();
        m_notifier = nullptr;
    }
    if (m_timeout_timer) {
        m_timeout_timer->stop();
        m_timeout_timer = nullptr;
    }
    m_output = nullptr;
    // The ProcessMonitor reaps the probe along with every other child.
    m_pid = -1;
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWebView/SystemProbeClient.h
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#pragma once

#include <AK/ByteBuffer.h>
#include <AK/Function.h>
#include <AK/NonnullOwnPtr.h>
#include <AK/OwnPtr.h>
#include <AK/RefPtr.h>
#include <AK/Time.h>
#include <LibCore/Forward.h>
#include <LibGfx/GpuDeviceIdentity.h>
#include <LibPlatformFeatures/SystemFacts.h>
#include <LibWebView/Export.h>

namespace WebView {

// Runs the SystemProbe helper once and reads the facts it reports. A probe that crashes, hangs or reports something
// unreadable yields facts that say so, rather than an error.
class WEBVIEW_API SystemProbeClient {
    AK_MAKE_NONCOPYABLE(SystemProbeClient);
    AK_MAKE_NONMOVABLE(SystemProbeClient);

public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    static constexpr AK::Duration timeout = AK::Duration::from_seconds(4);
    static constexpr size_t maximum_report_size = 64 * KiB;

    // Destroying the client before the probe reports stops the probe without calling on_finish.
    static NonnullOwnPtr<SystemProbeClient> launch(Optional<Gfx::GpuDeviceIdentity> const& presentation_device, Function<void(PlatformFeatures::SystemFacts const&)> on_finish);

    ~SystemProbeClient();

    bool has_finished() const { return m_facts.has_value(); }

private:
    SystemProbeClient() = default;

    void read_available_output();
    void finish_with_report();
    void finish(PlatformFeatures::SystemFacts);
    void terminate_probe();
    void stop_reading();
    void fail(StringView reason);

    pid_t m_pid { -1 };
    OwnPtr<Core::File> m_output;
    RefPtr<Core::Notifier> m_notifier;
    RefPtr<Core::Timer> m_timeout_timer;
    ByteBuffer m_report;
    Optional<PlatformFeatures::SystemFacts> m_facts;
    // Called once, from launch() or from the event loop.
    Function<void(PlatformFeatures::SystemFacts const&)> m_on_finish;
};

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWebView/TabDiscarder.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <LibCore/Platform/MemoryPressure.h>
#include <LibCore/Timer.h>
#include <LibWebView/Application.h>
#include <LibWebView/TabDiscarder.h>
#include <LibWebView/ViewImplementation.h>

namespace WebView {

static constexpr auto check_interval = AK::Duration::from_seconds(5);

// A tab that the user saw a short while ago is likely to be one they come back to soon.
static constexpr auto minimum_time_hidden_under_memory_pressure = AK::Duration::from_seconds(10 * 60);

static TabDiscarder* s_the;

Optional<AK::Duration> TabDiscarder::minimum_time_hidden_after_inactivity()
{
    // NB: Without a discarder, as when the browser runs headless, no tab is discarded.
    if (!s_the)
        return {};
    auto minutes = Application::settings().tab_settings().discard_hidden_tabs_after_minutes;
    if (minutes == 0)
        return {};
    return AK::Duration::from_seconds(static_cast<i64>(minutes) * 60);
}

TabDiscarder::TabDiscarder()
    : m_timer(Core::Timer::create_repeating(check_interval, [this] { check_tabs(); }))
{
    VERIFY(!s_the);
    s_the = this;
    m_timer->start();
}

TabDiscarder::~TabDiscarder()
{
    s_the = nullptr;
}

void TabDiscarder::did_hide_a_tab()
{
    if (s_the && !s_the->m_timer->is_active())
        s_the->m_timer->start();
}

void TabDiscarder::check_tabs()
{
    auto has_hidden_tab = false;
    ViewImplementation::for_each_view([&](ViewImplementation& view) {
        // NB: A tab that the UI was asked to discard isn't asked about again until the user has seen it.
        if (!view.supports_discarding() || !view.hidden_since().has_value() || view.discard_requested())
            return IterationDecision::Continue;
        has_hidden_tab = true;
        return IterationDecision::Break;
    });
    if (!has_hidden_tab) {
        m_timer->stop();
        return;
    }

    auto now = MonotonicTime::now();

    // NB: The memory of a discarded tab comes back as its processes exit, so one tab is discarded at a time, and the
    //     next check sees whether the system still needs more. The tab the user saw least recently goes first, but a
    //     tab whose processes all host other tabs too frees little, so one that lets a process exit goes before it.
    if (Core::Platform::system_memory_pressure() == Core::Platform::MemoryPressure::Critical) {
        ViewImplementation* least_recently_seen = nullptr;
        ViewImplementation* least_recently_seen_ending_a_process = nullptr;
        auto seen_less_recently = [](ViewImplementation& view, ViewImplementation* other) {
            return !other || *view.hidden_since() < *other->hidden_since();
        };
        ViewImplementation::for_each_view([&](ViewImplementation& view) {
            if (!view.may_be_discarded(ViewImplementation::DiscardReason::MemoryPressure, minimum_time_hidden_under_memory_pressure, now))
                return IterationDecision::Continue;
            if (seen_less_recently(view, least_recently_seen))
                least_recently_seen = &view;
            if (seen_less_recently(view, least_recently_seen_ending_a_process) && view.discarding_ends_a_process())
                least_recently_seen_ending_a_process = &view;
            return IterationDecision::Continue;
        });
        if (auto* view = least_recently_seen_ending_a_process ? least_recently_seen_ending_a_process : least_recently_seen) {
            dbgln("Discarding tab {}, as the system is about to run out of memory", view->url());
            view->request_discard(ViewImplementation::DiscardReason::MemoryPressure);
        }
    }

    auto minimum_time_hidden = minimum_time_hidden_after_inactivity();
    if (!minimum_time_hidden.has_value())
        return;

    Vector<ViewImplementation&> inactive_views;
    ViewImplementation::for_each_view([&](ViewImplementation& view) {
        if (view.may_be_discarded(ViewImplementation::DiscardReason::Inactivity, *minimum_time_hidden, now))
            inactive_views.append(view);
        return IterationDecision::Continue;
    });
    for (auto& view : inactive_views) {
        dbgln("Discarding tab {}, as it was hidden for {} min", view.url(), minimum_time_hidden->to_seconds() / 60);
        view.request_discard(ViewImplementation::DiscardReason::Inactivity);
    }
}

}

#include <LibCore/Timer.h>
#include <LibWebView/TabIndicators.h>

namespace WebView {

TabIndicators::TabIndicators()
    : m_timer(Core::Timer::create_single_shot(AK::Duration::zero(), [this] {
        // The deadlines, not the timer's resolution, decide when an indicator stops showing.
        update_visibility(MonotonicTime::now());
    }))
{
}

TabIndicators::~TabIndicators() = default;

void TabIndicators::set_active(TabIndicator indicator, bool active, MonotonicTime now)
{
    auto& lingering = entry(indicator).lingering;
    lingering.set_active(active, now);

    // Even when the indicator's activity hasn't changed, another's deadline may have passed without the timer having
    // run yet.
    update_visibility(now);
}

bool TabIndicators::is_active(TabIndicator indicator) const
{
    auto const& lingering = entry(indicator).lingering;
    return lingering.is_active();
}

void TabIndicators::update_visibility(MonotonicTime now)
{
    for (auto& entry : m_entries)
        entry.visible = entry.lingering.is_visible(now);

    // Wake before notifying, so a listener that makes an indicator active again schedules from settled state.
    if (auto deadline = next_deadline(now); deadline.has_value())
        m_timer->restart(*deadline - now);
    else
        m_timer->stop();

    // A listener that changes an indicator reports it from a nested update, so an indicator is reported only while what
    // was last reported for it is out of date.
    for (auto& entry : m_entries) {
        if (entry.reported_visible == entry.visible)
            continue;

        entry.reported_visible = entry.visible;
        if (on_visibility_change)
            on_visibility_change(entry.indicator, entry.visible);
    }
}

TabIndicators::Entry& TabIndicators::entry(TabIndicator indicator)
{
    for (auto& entry : m_entries) {
        if (entry.indicator == indicator)
            return entry;
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

Optional<MonotonicTime> TabIndicators::next_deadline(MonotonicTime now) const
{
    Optional<MonotonicTime> next_deadline;
    for (auto const& entry : m_entries) {
        auto deadline = entry.lingering.visible_until();
        if (!deadline.has_value() || *deadline <= now)
            continue;
        if (!next_deadline.has_value() || *deadline < *next_deadline)
            next_deadline = deadline;
    }
    return next_deadline;
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/Array.h>
#include <AK/Function.h>
#include <AK/Noncopyable.h>
#include <AK/NonnullRefPtr.h>
#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <AK/Time.h>
#include <LibCore/Forward.h>
#include <LibWebView/Export.h>
#include <LibWebView/LingeringIndicator.h>

namespace WebView {

enum class TabIndicator : u8 {
    PlayingAudio,
    UsingLocation,
    UsingMicrophone,
};

// Each indicator lingers on a deadline of its own once what it shows stops, however it stopped.
class WEBVIEW_API TabIndicators {
    AK_MAKE_NONCOPYABLE(TabIndicators);
    AK_MAKE_NONMOVABLE(TabIndicators);

public:
    static constexpr AK::Duration LINGER = AK::Duration::from_seconds(3);

    TabIndicators();
    ~TabIndicators();

    Function<void(TabIndicator, bool visible)> on_visibility_change;

    void set_active(TabIndicator, bool active, MonotonicTime now);
    bool is_active(TabIndicator) const;
    bool is_visible(TabIndicator indicator) const { return entry(indicator).visible; }

    void update_visibility(MonotonicTime now);
    Optional<MonotonicTime> next_deadline(MonotonicTime now) const;

private:
    struct Entry {
        TabIndicator indicator;
        LingeringIndicator lingering { LINGER };
        bool visible { false };
        bool reported_visible { false };
    };

    Entry& entry(TabIndicator);
    Entry const& entry(TabIndicator indicator) const { return const_cast<TabIndicators&>(*this).entry(indicator); }

    Array<Entry, 3> m_entries {
        Entry { .indicator = TabIndicator::PlayingAudio },
        Entry { .indicator = TabIndicator::UsingLocation },
        Entry { .indicator = TabIndicator::UsingMicrophone },
    };
    NonnullRefPtr<Core::Timer> m_timer;
};

FILE: Libraries/LibWebView/TabPerformanceMonitor.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <AK/HashTable.h>
#include <LibRequests/RequestControlClient.h>
#include <LibWebView/Application.h>
#include <LibWebView/CanonicalNavigable.h>
#include <LibWebView/ProcessManager.h>
#include <LibWebView/RequestServerManager.h>
#include <LibWebView/TabPerformanceMonitor.h>
#include <LibWebView/ViewImplementation.h>
#include <LibWebView/WebContentClient.h>
#include <LibWebView/WebContentPage.h>
#include <LibWebView/WorkerAgentManager.h>

namespace WebView {

static TabPerformanceMonitor* s_monitor;

static WebContentClient* process_holding_request_server_client(int client_id)
{
    WebContentClient* process = nullptr;
    WebContentClient::for_each_client([&](WebContentClient& client) {
        if (!client.request_server_site_bindings().has_client(client_id))
            return IterationDecision::Continue;
        process = &client;
        return IterationDecision::Break;
    });
    if (process)
        return process;
    return WorkerAgentManager::the().host_of_request_server_client(client_id);
}

TabPerformanceMonitor& TabPerformanceMonitor::the()
{
    if (!s_monitor)
        s_monitor = new TabPerformanceMonitor;
    return *s_monitor;
}

void TabPerformanceMonitor::configure(Requests::RequestControlClient& requests)
{
    if (!s_monitor)
        return;
    requests.async_set_performance_monitor_enabled(s_monitor->m_enabled);
    if (!s_monitor->m_enabled) {
        requests.on_network_usage = nullptr;
        return;
    }
    requests.on_network_usage = [](Vector<Requests::NetworkUsage> usage, u64 interval_microseconds) {
        if (!s_monitor || !s_monitor->m_enabled)
            return;
        auto now = MonotonicTime::now();
        for (auto const& entry : usage) {
            // RequestServer names the client and its process names the page, so a process only charges its own pages.
            auto* process = process_holding_request_server_client(entry.client_id);
            if (!process)
                continue;
            Optional<u64> owner;
            // NB: What a worker on a thread of the process uses comes with no page.
            if (auto* page = process->page(entry.page_id)) {
                auto const& view = page->view();
                owner = view.owner_view_id().value_or(view.view_id());
            } else {
                owner = process->exclusive_performance_owner();
            }
            if (owner.has_value())
                s_monitor->m_tabs.ensure(*owner).add_network_bytes(now, interval_microseconds, entry.download_bytes, entry.upload_bytes);
        }
    };
}

void TabPerformanceMonitor::forget_view(u64 view_id)
{
    if (s_monitor)
        s_monitor->m_tabs.remove(view_id);
}

TabPerformanceMonitor::TabPerformanceMonitor()
{
    config_variable_changed(ConfigVariableID::ShowTabPerformanceMonitor);
}

void TabPerformanceMonitor::config_variable_changed(ConfigVariableID id)
{
    if (id != ConfigVariableID::ShowTabPerformanceMonitor)
        return;
    m_enabled = Application::settings().config_variable_as_bool(id);
    if (!m_enabled) {
        m_timer = nullptr;
        m_tabs.clear();
    }
    Application::request_server_manager().for_each_instance([](RequestServerInstance& instance) {
        configure(instance.control_client());
        return IterationDecision::Continue;
    });
    if (!m_enabled)
        return;
    m_timer = Core::Timer::create_repeating(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(500), [this] { sample(); });
    m_timer->start();
    sample();
}

void TabPerformanceMonitor::did_present(u64 view_id)
{
    if (s_monitor && s_monitor->m_enabled)
        s_monitor->m_tabs.ensure(view_id).did_present(MonotonicTime::now());
}

void TabPerformanceMonitor::sample()
{
    HashMap<u64, HashMap<pid_t, Core::Platform::ProcessResourceUsage>> processes;
    HashMap<u64, HashTable<u64>> tabs_sharing_processes;
    Application::process_manager().for_each_process([&](Process& process) {
        if (process.type() != ProcessType::WebContent)
            return;
        auto client = process.client<WebContentClient>();
        if (!client)
            return;
        auto owners = client->performance_owners();
        if (owners.is_empty())
            return;
        auto usage = Application::process_manager().resource_usage(process.pid());
        if (!usage.has_value())
            return;
        // NB: A process that several tabs share counts in full toward each of them. Each tab then reports how
        //     many other tabs share its processes, so the UI can show that the numbers overlap.
        for (auto owner : owners) {
            processes.ensure(owner).set(process.pid(), *usage);
            for (auto other_owner : owners) {
                if (other_owner != owner)
                    tabs_sharing_processes.ensure(owner).set(other_owner);
            }
        }
    });
    auto now = MonotonicTime::now();
    ViewImplementation::for_each_view([&](ViewImplementation& view) {
        if (view.owner_view_id().has_value())
            return IterationDecision::Continue;
        Optional<pid_t> top_level_process;
        if (auto page = view.traversable().display_page())
            top_level_process = page->client().pid();
        auto stats = m_tabs.ensure(view.view_id()).sample(now, processes.ensure(view.view_id()), top_level_process);
        if (auto sharing = tabs_sharing_processes.get(view.view_id()); sharing.has_value())
            stats.other_tabs_sharing_processes = sharing->size();
        if (view.on_performance_stats)
            view.on_performance_stats(stats);
        return IterationDecision::Continue;
    });
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWebView/TabPerformanceStats.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <AK/Checked.h>
#include <LibWebView/TabPerformanceStats.h>

namespace WebView {

String format_performance_bytes(u64 bytes)
{
    if (bytes >= 1'000'000'000)
        return MUST(String::formatted("{:.1f} GB", bytes / 1'000'000'000.0));
    if (bytes >= 1'000'000)
        return MUST(String::formatted("{:.1f} MB", bytes / 1'000'000.0));
    if (bytes >= 1'000)
        return MUST(String::formatted("{:.0f} KB", bytes / 1'000.0));
    return MUST(String::formatted("{} B", bytes));
}

void TabPerformanceAccumulator::add_network_bytes(MonotonicTime now, u64 interval_microseconds, u64 download, u64 upload)
{
    if (interval_microseconds > 0)
        m_network.append({ now, interval_microseconds, download, upload });
}

void TabPerformanceAccumulator::did_present(MonotonicTime now)
{
    if (!m_started_at.has_value())
        m_started_at = now;
    m_presentations.append(now);
    m_presentations.remove_all_matching([&](auto time) { return now - time > AK::Duration::from_seconds(1); });
}

TabPerformanceStats TabPerformanceAccumulator::sample(MonotonicTime now, HashMap<pid_t, Core::Platform::ProcessResourceUsage> const& processes, Optional<pid_t> top_level_process)
{
    TabPerformanceStats stats;
    if (!m_started_at.has_value())
        m_started_at = now;
    auto elapsed = m_previous_sample.has_value() ? (now - *m_previous_sample).to_microseconds() : 0;
    Checked<u64> memory = 0;
    double cpu = 0;
    bool has_baseline = false;
    for (auto const& process : processes) {
        memory += process.value.attributed_memory_bytes;
        if (auto previous = m_previous_processes.get(process.key); previous.has_value() && elapsed > 0
            && process.value.cpu_time_microseconds >= previous->cpu_time_microseconds) {
            cpu += 100.0 * static_cast<double>(process.value.cpu_time_microseconds - previous->cpu_time_microseconds) / elapsed;
            has_baseline = true;
        }
    }
    // NB: Peak memory belongs to the tab's top-level process. When that process is replaced, start a new peak once
    //     no replaced process counts toward the tab any more, so their memory does not carry over.
    if (top_level_process.has_value() && m_top_level_process.has_value() && *top_level_process != *m_top_level_process
        && !m_replaced_top_level_processes.contains_slow(*m_top_level_process))
        m_replaced_top_level_processes.append(*m_top_level_process);
    if (top_level_process.has_value()) {
        m_top_level_process = top_level_process;
        m_replaced_top_level_processes.remove_all_matching([&](pid_t pid) { return pid == *top_level_process; });
    }
    if (!m_replaced_top_level_processes.is_empty()) {
        m_replaced_top_level_processes.remove_all_matching([&](pid_t pid) { return !processes.contains(pid); });
        if (m_replaced_top_level_processes.is_empty())
            m_peak_memory_bytes.clear();
    }
    if (!processes.is_empty() && !memory.has_overflow()) {
        stats.memory_bytes = memory.value();
        m_peak_memory_bytes = max(m_peak_memory_bytes.value_or(0), memory.value());
    }
    stats.peak_memory_bytes = m_peak_memory_bytes;
    if (has_baseline) {
        stats.cpu_percent = cpu;
        m_cpu_history.append({ now, cpu });
    }
    m_cpu_history.remove_all_matching([&](auto const& sample) { return now - sample.time >= AK::Duration::from_seconds(10); });
    for (auto const& sample : m_cpu_history)
        stats.cpu_history.append(sample.percent);

    m_network.remove_all_matching([&](auto const& sample) { return now - sample.time >= AK::Duration::from_seconds(1); });
    Checked<u64> download = 0;
    Checked<u64> upload = 0;
    for (auto const& sample : m_network) {
        auto age = max<i64>(0, (now - sample.time).to_microseconds());
        auto overlap = min<u64>(sample.interval_microseconds, 1'000'000 - age);
        auto scale = [&](u64 bytes) -> u64 {
            Checked<u64> product = bytes;
            product *= overlap;
            if (!product.has_overflow())
                return product.value() / sample.interval_microseconds;
            // NB: Avoid overflow even for malformed counters, at the cost of fractional-byte precision.
            return (bytes / sample.interval_microseconds) * overlap;
        };
        download += scale(sample.download);
        upload += scale(sample.upload);
    }
    if (!download.has_overflow())
        stats.download_bytes_per_second = download.value();
    if (!upload.has_overflow())
        stats.upload_bytes_per_second = upload.value();

    m_presentations.remove_all_matching([&](auto time) { return now - time >= AK::Duration::from_seconds(1); });
    auto window_microseconds = min<i64>(1'000'000, (now - *m_started_at).to_microseconds());
    if (!m_presentations.is_empty() && window_microseconds > 0)
        stats.frames_per_second = static_cast<double>(m_presentations.size()) * 1'000'000 / window_microseconds;
    m_previous_sample = now;
    m_previous_processes = processes;
    return stats;
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/HashMap.h>

WEBVIEW_API String format_performance_bytes(u64);

struct TabPerformanceStats {

    Optional<u64> memory_bytes;
    Optional<u64> peak_memory_bytes;

// Pure accounting state: callers supply monotonic timestamps and cumulative process counters.
class WEBVIEW_API TabPerformanceAccumulator {

    Optional<MonotonicTime> m_previous_sample;
    Optional<MonotonicTime> m_started_at;
    Vector<NetworkSample> m_network;
    Vector<MonotonicTime> m_presentations;
    Vector<CPUSample> m_cpu_history;
    Optional<u64> m_peak_memory_bytes;
    Optional<pid_t> m_top_level_process;
    Vector<pid_t> m_replaced_top_level_processes;

FILE: Libraries/LibWebView/TerminalInputParser.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <AK/StringView.h>
#include <AK/Utf8View.h>
#include <LibWebView/TerminalInputParser.h>

namespace WebView {

using Web::UIEvents::KeyCode;
using Web::UIEvents::KeyModifier;
using Web::UIEvents::MouseButton;

static constexpr u8 escape = 0x1b;
static constexpr auto bracketed_paste_end = "\x1b[201~"sv;

// The modifier bits of the keyboard protocol, which SGR mouse reports carry two bits higher and without Super.
static KeyModifier modifiers_from_terminal_bits(u32 bits)
{
    auto modifiers = KeyModifier::Mod_None;
    if (bits & 1)
        modifiers |= KeyModifier::Mod_Shift;
    if (bits & 2)
        modifiers |= KeyModifier::Mod_Alt;
    if (bits & 4)
        modifiers |= KeyModifier::Mod_Ctrl;
    if (bits & 8)
        modifiers |= KeyModifier::Mod_Super;
    return modifiers;
}

static TerminalKeyReport key_press(KeyCode key, u32 code_point = 0, KeyModifier modifiers = KeyModifier::Mod_None)
{
    return { .key = key, .code_point = code_point, .modifiers = modifiers };
}

static TerminalKeyReport legacy_encoded(TerminalKeyReport report)
{
    report.is_legacy_encoding = true;
    return report;
}

// A key the keyboard protocol reports by number: a code point, or one of its private-use numbers for keys without one.
static TerminalKeyReport key_press_for_key_number(u32 number)
{
    switch (number) {
    case 0x1b:
        return key_press(KeyCode::Key_Escape, 0x1b);
    case '\r':
        return key_press(KeyCode::Key_Return, '\n');
    case '\t':
        return key_press(KeyCode::Key_Tab, '\t');
    case 0x7f:
    case '\b':
        return key_press(KeyCode::Key_Backspace, '\b');
    case 57358:
        return key_press(KeyCode::Key_CapsLock);
    case 57359:
        return key_press(KeyCode::Key_ScrollLock);
    case 57360:
        return key_press(KeyCode::Key_NumLock);
    case 57361:
        return key_press(KeyCode::Key_PrintScreen);
    case 57362:
        return key_press(KeyCode::Key_PauseBreak);
    case 57363:
        return key_press(KeyCode::Key_Menu);
    case 57441:
        return key_press(KeyCode::Key_LeftShift);
    case 57442:
        return key_press(KeyCode::Key_LeftControl);
    case 57443:
        return key_press(KeyCode::Key_LeftAlt);
    case 57444:
        return key_press(KeyCode::Key_LeftSuper);
    case 57447:
        return key_press(KeyCode::Key_RightShift);
    case 57448:
        return key_press(KeyCode::Key_RightControl);
    case 57449:
        return key_press(KeyCode::Key_RightAlt);
    case 57450:
        return key_press(KeyCode::Key_RightSuper);
    default:
        break;
    }
    // The rest of the private-use area holds keys this view has no key code for.
    if (number >= 0xe000 && number < 0xf900)
        return key_press(KeyCode::Key_Invalid);
    return key_press(Web::UIEvents::code_point_to_key_code(number), number);
}

// The keys of CSI 1;<modifiers> <letter> and SS3 <letter>.
static KeyCode key_for_letter(u8 letter)
{
    switch (letter) {
    case 'A':
        return KeyCode::Key_Up;
    case 'B':
        return KeyCode::Key_Down;
    case 'C':
        return KeyCode::Key_Right;
    case 'D':
        return KeyCode::Key_Left;
    case 'H':
        return KeyCode::Key_Home;
    case 'F':
        return KeyCode::Key_End;
    case 'P':
        return KeyCode::Key_F1;
    case 'Q':
        return KeyCode::Key_F2;
    case 'S':
        return KeyCode::Key_F4;
    default:
        return KeyCode::Key_Invalid;
    }
}

// The keys of CSI <number>;<modifiers> ~.
static KeyCode key_for_tilde_number(u32 number)
{
    switch (number) {
    case 1:
    case 7:
        return KeyCode::Key_Home;
    case 2:
        return KeyCode::Key_Insert;
    case 3:
        return KeyCode::Key_Delete;
    case 4:
    case 8:
        return KeyCode::Key_End;
    case 5:
        return KeyCode::Key_PageUp;
    case 6:
        return KeyCode::Key_PageDown;
    case 11:
        return KeyCode::Key_F1;
    case 12:
        return KeyCode::Key_F2;
    case 13:
        return KeyCode::Key_F3;
    case 14:
        return KeyCode::Key_F4;
    case 15:
        return KeyCode::Key_F5;
    case 17:
        return KeyCode::Key_F6;
    case 18:
        return KeyCode::Key_F7;
    case 19:
        return KeyCode::Key_F8;
    case 20:
        return KeyCode::Key_F9;
    case 21:
        return KeyCode::Key_F10;
    case 23:
        return KeyCode::Key_F11;
    case 24:
        return KeyCode::Key_F12;
    default:
        return KeyCode::Key_Invalid;
    }
}

// "<modifiers>[:<event type>]", where the modifiers are one more than their bits and the event type is 1 for a press,
// 2 for a repeat and 3 for a release.
static void apply_modifier_field(StringView field, TerminalKeyReport& report)
{
    if (field.is_empty())
        return;
    auto parts = field.split_view(':', SplitBehavior::KeepEmpty);
    if (auto modifiers = parts[0].to_number<u32>(); modifiers.has_value() && *modifiers > 0)
        report.modifiers = modifiers_from_terminal_bits(*modifiers - 1);
    if (parts.size() < 2)
        return;
    switch (parts[1].to_number<u32>().value_or(1)) {
    case 2:
        report.phase = TerminalKeyReport::Phase::Repeat;
        break;
    case 3:
        report.phase = TerminalKeyReport::Phase::Release;
        break;
    default:
        report.phase = TerminalKeyReport::Phase::Press;
        break;
    }
}

static Optional<TerminalMouseReport> mouse_report(u32 button_code, Gfx::IntPoint position, bool is_release)
{
    static constexpr u32 motion_bit = 32;
    static constexpr u32 wheel_bit = 64;
    static constexpr u32 extra_button_bit = 128;

    TerminalMouseReport report { .modifiers = modifiers_from_terminal_bits((button_code >> 2) & 7), .position = position };
    auto low_bits = static_cast<int>(button_code & 3);

    if (button_code & wheel_bit) {
        report.kind = TerminalMouseReport::Kind::Wheel;
        report.wheel_steps = low_bits < 2 ? Gfx::IntPoint { 0, low_bits == 0 ? -1 : 1 } : Gfx::IntPoint { low_bits == 2 ? -1 : 1, 0 };
        return report;
    }
    if (button_code & motion_bit) {
        report.kind = TerminalMouseReport::Kind::Motion;
        return report;
    }
    // Without the extra-button bit, 3 is a legacy release of no button in particular.
    if (low_bits == 3 && !(button_code & extra_button_bit))
        return {};
    report.button = Web::UIEvents::button_code_to_mouse_button(static_cast<i16>(low_bits + (button_code & extra_button_bit ? 3 : 0)));
    if (report.button == MouseButton::None)
        return {};
    report.kind = is_release ? TerminalMouseReport::Kind::Release : TerminalMouseReport::Kind::Press;
    return report;
}

Optional<size_t> TerminalInputParser::parse_control_sequence(ReadonlyBytes bytes, Vector<TerminalInput>& inputs)
{
    size_t index = 2;
    while (index < bytes.size() && bytes[index] >= 0x30 && bytes[index] <= 0x3f)
        ++index;
    auto parameters_end = index;
    while (index < bytes.size() && bytes[index] >= 0x20 && bytes[index] <= 0x2f)
        ++index;
    if (index >= bytes.size())
        return {};

    auto final_byte = bytes[index];
    size_t consumed = index + 1;
    if (final_byte < 0x40 || final_byte > 0x7e)
        return consumed;

    StringView parameters { bytes.slice(2, parameters_end - 2) };
    auto has_intermediates = parameters_end != index;

    if (parameters.starts_with('<') && (final_byte == 'M' || final_byte == 'm')) {
        auto fields = parameters.substring_view(1).split_view(';');
        if (fields.size() != 3)
            return consumed;
        auto button_code = fields[0].to_number<u32>();
        auto x = fields[1].to_number<int>();
        auto y = fields[2].to_number<int>();
        if (!button_code.has_value() || !x.has_value() || !y.has_value())
            return consumed;
        // Pixel coordinates count from one.
        if (auto report = mouse_report(*button_code, { *x - 1, *y - 1 }, final_byte == 'm'); report.has_value())
            inputs.append(report.release_value());
        return consumed;
    }

    if (final_byte == '~' && parameters == "200"sv) {
        m_paste = ByteBuffer {};
        return consumed;
    }

    if (parameters.is_empty() && (final_byte == 'I' || final_byte == 'O')) {
        inputs.append(TerminalFocusChange { .has_focus = final_byte == 'I' });
        return consumed;
    }

    if (parameters.starts_with('?') && final_byte == 'u' && !has_intermediates) {
        inputs.append(TerminalKeyboardProtocolFlags { .flags = parameters.substring_view(1).to_number<u32>().value_or(0) });
        return consumed;
    }

    // Replies to queries this parser has no use for, such as DECRQM and device attributes.
    if (has_intermediates || parameters.starts_with('?') || parameters.starts_with('>') || parameters.starts_with('='))
        return consumed;

    auto fields = parameters.split_view(';', SplitBehavior::KeepEmpty);

    if (final_byte == 't') {
        if (fields.size() == 3 && fields[0] == "4"sv) {
            auto height = fields[1].to_number<int>();
            auto width = fields[2].to_number<int>();
            if (height.has_value() && width.has_value())
                inputs.append(TerminalPixelSizeReport { .size = { *width, *height } });
        }
        return consumed;
    }

    TerminalKeyReport report;
    if (final_byte == 'u') {
        auto key_numbers = fields.is_empty() ? Vector<StringView> {} : fields[0].split_view(':', SplitBehavior::KeepEmpty);
        auto key_number = key_numbers.is_empty() ? Optional<u32> {} : key_numbers[0].to_number<u32>();
        if (!key_number.has_value())
            return consumed;
        report = key_press_for_key_number(*key_number);
        if (key_numbers.size() > 1)
            report.shifted_code_point = key_numbers[1].to_number<u32>();
        if (fields.size() > 2) {
            for (auto text : fields[2].split_view(':')) {
                if (auto code_point = text.to_number<u32>(); code_point.has_value())
                    report.text_code_points.append(*code_point);
            }
        }
    } else if (final_byte == '~') {
        auto number = fields.is_empty() ? Optional<u32> {} : fields[0].to_number<u32>();
        report = key_press(number.has_value() ? key_for_tilde_number(*number) : KeyCode::Key_Invalid);
    } else {
        report = key_press(key_for_letter(final_byte));
    }
    if (report.key == KeyCode::Key_Invalid)
        return consumed;
    if (fields.size() > 1)
        apply_modifier_field(fields[1], report);
    inputs.append(move(report));
    return consumed;
}

Optional<size_t> TerminalInputParser::parse_one(ReadonlyBytes bytes, Vector<TerminalInput>& inputs)
{
    if (m_paste.has_value()) {
        if (auto end = StringView { bytes }.find(bracketed_paste_end); end.has_value()) {
            m_paste->append(bytes.slice(0, *end));
            inputs.append(TerminalPaste { .text = ByteString { m_paste->bytes() } });
            m_paste.clear();
            return *end + bracketed_paste_end.length();
        }

        // Keep what may be the start of the end marker for the next chunk.
        size_t kept = 0;
        for (size_t length = min(bracketed_paste_end.length() - 1, bytes.size()); length > 0; --length) {
            if (StringView { bytes.slice(bytes.size() - length) } == bracketed_paste_end.substring_view(0, length)) {
                kept = length;
                break;
            }
        }
        m_paste->append(bytes.slice(0, bytes.size() - kept));
        if (kept == bytes.size())
            return {};
        return bytes.size() - kept;
    }

    if (bytes[0] == escape) {
        if (bytes.size() < 2)
            return {};

        switch (bytes[1]) {
        case '[':
            return parse_control_sequence(bytes, inputs);

        case 'O': {
            if (bytes.size() < 3)
                return {};
            auto key = bytes[2] == 'R' ? KeyCode::Key_F3 : key_for_letter(bytes[2]);
            if (key != KeyCode::Key_Invalid)
                inputs.append(legacy_encoded(key_press(key)));
            return 3;
        }

        case '_': {
            auto end = StringView { bytes }.find("\x1b\\"sv, 2);
            if (!end.has_value())
                return {};
            StringView body { bytes.slice(2, *end - 2) };
            if (body.starts_with('G')) {
                inputs.append(TerminalGraphicsReply { .text = body.substring_view(1) });
            } else if (body.starts_with("ladybird;"sv)) {
                auto command = body.substring_view("ladybird;"sv.length());
                auto separator = command.find(';');
                if (separator.has_value())
                    inputs.append(TerminalCommand { .name = command.substring_view(0, *separator), .argument = command.substring_view(*separator + 1) });
                else
                    inputs.append(TerminalCommand { .name = command, .argument = {} });
            }
            return *end + 2;
        }

        case ']':
        case 'P': {
            // An OSC or DCS reply, which ends with BEL (OSC only) or ST.
            for (size_t index = 2; index < bytes.size(); ++index) {
                if (bytes[1] == ']' && bytes[index] == 0x07)
                    return index + 1;
                if (bytes[index] == escape && index + 1 < bytes.size() && bytes[index + 1] == '\\')
                    return index + 2;
            }
            return {};
        }

        default: {
            // Legacy Alt+key: the key, with ESC before it.
            Vector<TerminalInput> key_inputs;
            auto key_consumed = parse_one(bytes.slice(1), key_inputs);
            if (!key_consumed.has_value())
                return {};
            for (auto& input : key_inputs) {
                if (auto* key = input.get_pointer<TerminalKeyReport>()) {
                    key->modifiers |= KeyModifier::Mod_Alt;
                    key->is_legacy_encoding = true;
                }
                inputs.append(move(input));
            }
            return 1 + *key_consumed;
        }
        }
    }

    // Legacy bytes: UTF-8 text and control characters.
    auto lead = bytes[0];
    size_t length = lead < 0x80 ? 1 : (lead >> 5) == 0x6 ? 2
        : (lead >> 4) == 0xe                             ? 3
        : (lead >> 3) == 0x1e                            ? 4
                                                         : 1;
    if (bytes.size() < length)
        return {};

    Utf8View view { StringView { bytes.slice(0, length) } };
    if (!view.validate())
        return length;
    auto code_point = *view.begin();

    TerminalKeyReport report;
    if (code_point == 0x00) {
        report = key_press(KeyCode::Key_Space, ' ', KeyModifier::Mod_Ctrl);
    } else if (code_point >= 0x01 && code_point <= 0x1a && code_point != '\t' && code_point != '\r' && code_point != '\n' && code_point != '\b') {
        auto letter = 'a' + code_point - 1;
        report = key_press(Web::UIEvents::code_point_to_key_code(letter), letter, KeyModifier::Mod_Ctrl);
    } else if (code_point >= 0x1c && code_point <= 0x1f) {
        auto character = "\\]^_"sv[code_point - 0x1c];
        report = key_press(Web::UIEvents::code_point_to_key_code(character), character, KeyModifier::Mod_Ctrl);
    } else {
        report = key_press_for_key_number(code_point == '\n' ? '\r' : code_point);
        if (code_point >= ' ' && code_point != 0x7f)
            report.text_code_points.append(code_point);
    }
    if (report.key != KeyCode::Key_Invalid)
        inputs.append(legacy_encoded(move(report)));
    return length;
}

Vector<TerminalInput> TerminalInputParser::parse(ReadonlyBytes chunk)
{
    Vector<TerminalInput> inputs;
    m_pending.append(chunk);

    // Without the keyboard protocol, the Escape key arrives as a lone ESC. Anything else that starts with one arrives
    // with the rest of its sequence.
    if (!m_paste.has_value() && m_pending.size() == 1 && m_pending[0] == escape) {
        m_pending.clear();
        inputs.append(legacy_encoded(key_press_for_key_number(escape)));
        return inputs;
    }

    auto bytes = m_pending.bytes();
    size_t offset = 0;
    while (offset < bytes.size()) {
        auto consumed = parse_one(bytes.slice(offset), inputs);
        if (!consumed.has_value())
            break;
        offset += *consumed;
    }

    m_pending = MUST(ByteBuffer::copy(bytes.slice(offset)));
    return inputs;
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/ByteBuffer.h>
#include <AK/ByteString.h>
#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <AK/Variant.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibGfx/Point.h>
#include <LibGfx/Size.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/UIEvents/KeyCode.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/UIEvents/MouseButton.h>
#include <LibWebView/Forward.h>

namespace WebView {

// An SGR mouse report with pixel coordinates (modes 1006 and 1016), from the pane's top-left pixel.
struct TerminalMouseReport {
    enum class Kind : u8 {
        Press,
        Release,
        Motion,
        Wheel,
    };

    Kind kind { Kind::Motion };
    Web::UIEvents::MouseButton button { Web::UIEvents::MouseButton::None };
    // For a wheel report, the direction it scrolls in: -1, 0 or 1 on each axis.
    Gfx::IntPoint wheel_steps {};
    Web::UIEvents::KeyModifier modifiers { Web::UIEvents::KeyModifier::Mod_None };
    Gfx::IntPoint position {};
};

// A key, as the Kitty keyboard protocol reports it, or as legacy bytes do.
struct TerminalKeyReport {
    enum class Phase : u8 {
        Press,
        Repeat,
        Release,
    };

    Web::UIEvents::KeyCode key { Web::UIEvents::KeyCode::Key_Invalid };
    // The character of the key without Shift, as a key event carries it; zero for keys without one, like arrows.
    u32 code_point { 0 };
    Optional<u32> shifted_code_point {};
    Web::UIEvents::KeyModifier modifiers { Web::UIEvents::KeyModifier::Mod_None };
    Phase phase { Phase::Press };
    Vector<u32> text_code_points {};
    // Legacy encodings, such as plain bytes, report presses only, even from a terminal that reports releases.
    bool is_legacy_encoding { false };
};

struct TerminalPaste {
    ByteString text {};
};

struct TerminalFocusChange {
    bool has_focus { false };
};

// A command sent to the pane's input as ESC _ ladybird;<name>;<argument> ESC \, which no key types.
struct TerminalCommand {
    ByteString name {};
    ByteString argument {};
};

struct TerminalGraphicsReply {
    ByteString text {};
};

struct TerminalKeyboardProtocolFlags {
    u32 flags { 0 };
};

struct TerminalPixelSizeReport {
    Gfx::IntSize size {};
};

using TerminalInput = Variant<TerminalMouseReport, TerminalKeyReport, TerminalPaste, TerminalFocusChange, TerminalCommand, TerminalGraphicsReply, TerminalKeyboardProtocolFlags, TerminalPixelSizeReport>;

// Turns the bytes a terminal sends into input. A chunk can end partway through a sequence; the rest is kept for the
// next chunk.
class WEBVIEW_API TerminalInputParser {
public:
    Vector<TerminalInput> parse(ReadonlyBytes chunk);

private:
    // Each returns how many bytes it consumed, or nothing when the sequence continues past the end of the bytes.
    Optional<size_t> parse_one(ReadonlyBytes, Vector<TerminalInput>&);
    Optional<size_t> parse_control_sequence(ReadonlyBytes, Vector<TerminalInput>&);

    ByteBuffer m_pending;
    Optional<ByteBuffer> m_paste;
};

}

#include <AK/Base64.h>
