namespace WebView {

using Web::UIEvents::KeyCode;
using Web::UIEvents::KeyModifier;
using Web::UIEvents::MouseButton;

static int s_terminal_fd = -1;
static NeverDestroyed<ByteString> s_log_path;

// One wheel report from the terminal scrolls one line, as terminals send a report for each line a wheel or touchpad
// scrolls.
static constexpr double wheel_pixels_per_terminal_wheel_report = 40;

static constexpr auto double_click_interval = AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(500);
static constexpr int double_click_distance_in_device_pixels = 4;

// The Kitty keyboard protocol's flags.
static constexpr u32 keyboard_protocol_disambiguates_escape_codes = 1;
static constexpr u32 keyboard_protocol_reports_event_types = 2;
static constexpr u32 keyboard_protocol_reports_all_keys_as_escape_codes = 8;
static constexpr u32 keyboard_protocol_reports_associated_text = 16;
static constexpr u32 requested_keyboard_protocol_flags = keyboard_protocol_disambiguates_escape_codes
    | keyboard_protocol_reports_event_types
    | keyboard_protocol_reports_all_keys_as_escape_codes
    | keyboard_protocol_reports_associated_text;

static constexpr auto delete_all_images = "\x1b_Ga=d,d=A,q=2\x1b\\"sv;
static constexpr auto query_pane_pixel_size = "\x1b[14t"sv;

static constexpr u32 first_image_id = 1;
// Raw bytes per chunk of an image sent inline, which base64 makes the protocol's largest chunk of 4096 bytes.
static constexpr size_t direct_transmission_raw_chunk_size = 3072;
static constexpr size_t direct_transmission_flush_size = 256 * KiB;

static ByteString temporary_frame_path(u64 transmission_number)
{
    // The terminal only reads image files whose path names them as such, in a temporary directory.
    return ByteString::formatted("/tmp/tty-graphics-protocol-ladybird-{}-{}.rgb", getpid(), transmission_number);
}

static void append_graphics_command(StringBuilder& builder, StringView keys, StringView payload)
{
    builder.appendff("\x1b_G{};{}\x1b\\", keys, payload);
}

ErrorOr<void> TerminalWebView::take_over_terminal()
{
    if (!TRY(Core::System::isatty(STDIN_FILENO)) || !TRY(Core::System::isatty(STDOUT_FILENO)))
        return Error::from_string_literal("Terminal mode needs to run in a terminal");

    s_terminal_fd = TRY(Core::System::dup(STDOUT_FILENO));
    TRY(Core::System::fcntl(s_terminal_fd, F_SETFD, FD_CLOEXEC));

    *s_log_path = ByteString::formatted("/tmp/ladybird-terminal-{}.log", getpid());
    auto log_fd = TRY(Core::System::open(*s_log_path, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_TRUNC | O_CLOEXEC, 0644));

    auto message = ByteString::formatted("Ladybird logs to {}\r\n", *s_log_path);
    (void)Core::System::write(s_terminal_fd, message.bytes());

    // Helper processes inherit these, so what any of them prints goes to the log rather than over the page.
    if (::dup2(log_fd, STDOUT_FILENO) < 0 || ::dup2(log_fd, STDERR_FILENO) < 0)
        return Error::from_syscall("dup2"sv, errno);
    TRY(Core::System::close(log_fd));
    return {};
}

TerminalWebView::PaneGeometry TerminalWebView::query_pane_geometry()
{
    struct winsize size {};
    if (ioctl(s_terminal_fd, TIOCGWINSZ, &size) < 0)
        return {};
    return { .rows = size.ws_row, .columns = size.ws_col, .pixel_size = { size.ws_xpixel, size.ws_ypixel } };
}

ErrorOr<NonnullOwnPtr<TerminalWebView>> TerminalWebView::create(Core::AnonymousBuffer theme, double device_pixel_ratio)
{
    if (s_terminal_fd < 0)
        return Error::from_string_literal("The terminal must be taken over before a terminal view is created");

    auto geometry = query_pane_geometry();
    auto page_pixel_size = geometry.page_pixel_size();
    if (page_pixel_size.is_empty())
        page_pixel_size = { 800, 600 };

    auto view = adopt_own(*new TerminalWebView(move(theme), page_pixel_size.to_type<Web::DevicePixels>(), device_pixel_ratio));
    view->m_pane_geometry = geometry;
    view->enter_terminal_modes();
    view->initialize_tab(Web::HTML::VisibilityState::Visible);
    view->set_presents_from_cpu_memory(true);
    view->show_notice(ByteString::formatted("logging to {}", *s_log_path));
    return view;
}

TerminalWebView::TerminalWebView(Core::AnonymousBuffer theme, Web::DevicePixelSize viewport_size, double device_pixel_ratio)
    : HeadlessWebView(move(theme), viewport_size)
{
    m_device_pixel_ratio = device_pixel_ratio;

    on_title_change = [this](auto const&) { draw_status_line(); };
    on_url_change = [this](auto const&) { draw_status_line(); };
    on_loading_state_change = [this](bool) { draw_status_line(); };
}

TerminalWebView::~TerminalWebView()
{
    leave_terminal_modes();
}

void TerminalWebView::quit()
{
    if (!m_terminal_modes_entered)
        return;
    leave_terminal_modes();
    Core::EventLoop::current().quit(0);
}

void TerminalWebView::write_to_terminal(StringView text)
{
    auto bytes = text.bytes();
    while (!bytes.is_empty()) {
        auto written = Core::System::write(s_terminal_fd, bytes);
        if (written.is_error()) {
            if (written.error().code() == EINTR || written.error().code() == EAGAIN)
                continue;
            return;
        }
        bytes = bytes.slice(written.value());
    }
}

void TerminalWebView::enter_terminal_modes()
{
    if (::tcgetattr(STDIN_FILENO, &m_original_terminal_attributes) == 0) {
        auto raw_attributes = m_original_terminal_attributes;
        cfmakeraw(&raw_attributes);
        ::tcsetattr(STDIN_FILENO, TCSANOW, &raw_attributes);
    }
    m_terminal_modes_entered = true;

    // Alternate screen, hidden cursor, mouse reports for every motion with SGR pixel coordinates, focus reports,
    // bracketed paste and the keyboard protocol; then ask which keyboard flags took.
    write_to_terminal(ByteString::formatted(
        "\x1b[?1049h\x1b[?25l\x1b[2J"
        "\x1b[?1003h\x1b[?1006h\x1b[?1016h\x1b[?1004h\x1b[?2004h"
        "\x1b[>{}u\x1b[?u",
        requested_keyboard_protocol_flags));
    if (m_pane_geometry.pixel_size.is_empty())
        write_to_terminal(query_pane_pixel_size);

    m_input_notifier = Core::Notifier::construct(STDIN_FILENO, Core::Notifier::Type::Read);
    m_input_notifier->on_activation = [this] {
        u8 buffer[64 * KiB];
        auto read = Core::System::read(STDIN_FILENO, { buffer, sizeof(buffer) });
        if (read.is_error()) {
            if (read.error().code() != EINTR && read.error().code() != EAGAIN)
                quit();
            return;
        }
        if (read.value() == 0) {
            quit();
            return;
        }
        for (auto const& input : m_input_parser.parse({ buffer, read.value() }))
            handle_input(input);
    };

    m_signal_handler_ids.append(Core::EventLoop::register_signal(SIGWINCH, [this](int) {
        m_pane_geometry = query_pane_geometry();
        if (m_pane_geometry.pixel_size.is_empty())
            write_to_terminal(query_pane_pixel_size);
        apply_pane_geometry();
    }));
    for (auto signal_number : { SIGTERM, SIGHUP }) {
        m_signal_handler_ids.append(Core::EventLoop::register_signal(signal_number, [this](int) {
            quit();
        }));
    }
}

void TerminalWebView::leave_terminal_modes()
{
    if (!m_terminal_modes_entered)
        return;
    m_terminal_modes_entered = false;

    m_input_notifier = nullptr;
    for (auto id : m_signal_handler_ids)
        Core::EventLoop::unregister_signal(id);
    m_signal_handler_ids.clear();

    write_to_terminal("\x1b[<u\x1b[?2004l\x1b[?1004l\x1b[?1016l\x1b[?1006l\x1b[?1003l"sv);
    write_to_terminal(delete_all_images);
    write_to_terminal("\x1b[?25h\x1b[?1049l"sv);
    ::tcsetattr(STDIN_FILENO, TCSANOW, &m_original_terminal_attributes);

    // The terminal deletes each frame's file once it reads it. Remove any it had not read yet.
    for (u64 number = m_image_data_transmissions > 4 ? m_image_data_transmissions - 4 : 0; number < m_image_data_transmissions; ++number)
        (void)Core::System::unlink(temporary_frame_path(number));
}

void TerminalWebView::apply_pane_geometry()
{
    m_drawn_status_line = {};
    m_frame_needs_full_redraw = true;
    m_displayed_image_id.clear();
    write_to_terminal(delete_all_images);
    write_to_terminal("\x1b[2J"sv);
    draw_status_line();

    auto page_pixel_size = m_pane_geometry.page_pixel_size();
    if (page_pixel_size.is_empty())
        return;
    if (page_pixel_size != viewport_size().to_type<int>())
        reset_viewport_size(page_pixel_size.to_type<Web::DevicePixels>());
    schedule_frame_flush();
}

void TerminalWebView::did_accept_presented_backing_store(i32, Gfx::IntRect damage_rect)
{
    m_pending_damage = m_pending_damage.has_value() ? m_pending_damage->united(damage_rect) : damage_rect;
    schedule_frame_flush();
}

void TerminalWebView::schedule_frame_flush()
{
    if (m_frame_flush_scheduled)
        return;
    m_frame_flush_scheduled = true;
    Core::deferred_invoke([weak_this = make_weak_ptr<TerminalWebView>()] {
        if (!weak_this)
            return;
        weak_this->m_frame_flush_scheduled = false;
        weak_this->flush_frame();
    });
}

void TerminalWebView::flush_frame()
{
    if (!m_terminal_modes_entered)
        return;

    auto frame = backing_stores().displayed_frame();
    if (!frame.has_value() || !frame->shared_image_buffer)
        return;
    auto bitmap = frame->shared_image_buffer->bitmap_if_present();
    if (!bitmap) {
        show_notice("frames are not in CPU memory");
        return;
    }

    if (auto result = transmit_frame(*bitmap); result.is_error())
        show_notice(ByteString::formatted("cannot draw frame: {}", result.error()));
    m_pending_damage.clear();
    m_frame_needs_full_redraw = false;
}

static ErrorOr<void> convert_to_rgb(Gfx::Bitmap const& bitmap, Gfx::IntRect rect, ByteBuffer& pixels)
{
    TRY(pixels.try_resize(static_cast<size_t>(rect.width()) * rect.height() * 3));
    auto red_is_low_byte = bitmap.format() == Gfx::BitmapFormat::RGBA8888 || bitmap.format() == Gfx::BitmapFormat::RGBx8888;
    auto* out = pixels.data();
    for (int y = rect.y(); y < rect.y() + rect.height(); ++y) {
        auto const* scanline = bitmap.scanline(y);
        for (int x = rect.x(); x < rect.x() + rect.width(); ++x) {
            auto pixel = scanline[x];
            u8 low = pixel & 0xff;
            u8 middle = (pixel >> 8) & 0xff;
            u8 high = (pixel >> 16) & 0xff;
            *out++ = red_is_low_byte ? low : high;
            *out++ = middle;
            *out++ = red_is_low_byte ? high : low;
        }
    }
    return {};
}

ErrorOr<void> TerminalWebView::send_image_data(StringView keys, ReadonlyBytes pixels)
{
    StringBuilder command;
    if (m_graphics_transmission == GraphicsTransmission::TemporaryFile) {
        auto path = temporary_frame_path(m_image_data_transmissions++);
        auto file = TRY(Core::File::open(path, Core::File::OpenMode::Write | Core::File::OpenMode::Truncate, 0600));
        TRY(file->write_until_depleted(pixels));
        append_graphics_command(command, ByteString::formatted("{},t=t", keys), TRY(encode_base64(path.bytes())));
        write_to_terminal(command.string_view());
        return {};
    }

    for (size_t offset = 0; offset < pixels.size(); offset += direct_transmission_raw_chunk_size) {
        auto chunk = pixels.slice(offset, min(direct_transmission_raw_chunk_size, pixels.size() - offset));
        auto has_more_chunks = offset + direct_transmission_raw_chunk_size < pixels.size();
        auto chunk_keys = offset == 0 ? ByteString::formatted("{},m={}", keys, has_more_chunks ? 1 : 0) : ByteString::formatted("m={}", has_more_chunks ? 1 : 0);
        append_graphics_command(command, chunk_keys, TRY(encode_base64(chunk)));
        if (command.length() >= direct_transmission_flush_size || !has_more_chunks) {
            write_to_terminal(command.string_view());
            command.clear();
        }
    }
    return {};
}

ErrorOr<void> TerminalWebView::transmit_frame(Gfx::Bitmap const& bitmap)
{
    // A frame laid out for a larger pane than this one is cut to fit above the status line.
    auto size = bitmap.size();
    auto page_pixel_size = m_pane_geometry.page_pixel_size();
    if (!page_pixel_size.is_empty())
        size = { min(size.width(), page_pixel_size.width()), min(size.height(), page_pixel_size.height()) };
    if (size.is_empty())
        return {};
    Gfx::IntRect frame_rect { {}, size };

    auto shows_frame_of_this_size = !m_frame_needs_full_redraw && m_displayed_image_id.has_value() && m_displayed_image_size == size;
    auto damage_rect = m_pending_damage.value_or(Gfx::IntRect {}).intersected(frame_rect);
    if (shows_frame_of_this_size && damage_rect.is_empty())
        return {};

    // Only the damaged part of a frame is sent, as an edit of the image on display.
    if (m_sends_damaged_rectangles && shows_frame_of_this_size && damage_rect != frame_rect) {
        TRY(convert_to_rgb(bitmap, damage_rect, m_frame_pixels));
        auto keys = ByteString::formatted("a=f,r=1,i={},x={},y={},s={},v={},f=24,q=1", *m_displayed_image_id, damage_rect.x(), damage_rect.y(), damage_rect.width(), damage_rect.height());
        return send_image_data(keys, m_frame_pixels);
    }

    TRY(convert_to_rgb(bitmap, frame_rect, m_frame_pixels));
    auto image_id = m_displayed_image_id == first_image_id ? first_image_id + 1 : first_image_id;
    write_to_terminal("\x1b[1;1H"sv);
    TRY(send_image_data(ByteString::formatted("a=T,f=24,s={},v={},i={},p=1,C=1,q=1", size.width(), size.height(), image_id), m_frame_pixels));
    // The new frame is placed before the old one goes, so the pane never shows neither.
    if (m_displayed_image_id.has_value())
        write_to_terminal(ByteString::formatted("\x1b_Ga=d,d=I,i={},q=2\x1b\\", *m_displayed_image_id));

    m_displayed_image_id = image_id;
    m_displayed_image_size = size;
    return {};
}

void TerminalWebView::handle_input(TerminalInput const& input)
{
    input.visit(
        [this](TerminalMouseReport const& report) {
            handle_mouse_report(report);
        },
        [this](TerminalKeyReport const& report) {
            handle_key_report(report);
        },
        [this](TerminalPaste const& paste) {
            if (m_url_prompt_text.has_value()) {
                m_url_prompt_text = ByteString::formatted("{}{}", *m_url_prompt_text, paste.text);
                draw_status_line();
                return;
            }
            commit_text_from_input_method(Utf16String::from_utf8(paste.text));
        },
        [this](TerminalFocusChange const& focus_change) {
            set_has_system_focus(focus_change.has_focus);
        },
        [this](TerminalCommand const& command) {
            handle_command(command);
        },
        [this](TerminalGraphicsReply const& reply) {
            if (reply.text.ends_with(";OK"sv))
                return;
            if (m_graphics_transmission == GraphicsTransmission::TemporaryFile) {
                // A terminal on another machine cannot read this machine's files.
                m_graphics_transmission = GraphicsTransmission::Direct;
                show_notice("sending frames inline");
                m_frame_needs_full_redraw = true;
                schedule_frame_flush();
                return;
            }
            show_notice(ByteString::formatted("graphics: {}", reply.text));
        },
        [this](TerminalKeyboardProtocolFlags const& flags) {
            m_terminal_reports_key_releases = (flags.flags & keyboard_protocol_reports_event_types) != 0;
        },
        [this](TerminalPixelSizeReport const& report) {
            if (!m_pane_geometry.pixel_size.is_empty())
                return;
            m_pane_geometry.pixel_size = report.size;
            apply_pane_geometry();
        });
}

static Web::MouseEvent mouse_event(Web::MouseEvent::Type type, Gfx::IntPoint position, MouseButton button, MouseButton buttons, KeyModifier modifiers)
{
    Web::MouseEvent event {};
    event.type = type;
    event.position = position.to_type<Web::DevicePixels>();
    event.screen_position = event.position;
    event.button = button;
    event.buttons = buttons;
    event.modifiers = modifiers;
    return event;
}

void TerminalWebView::handle_mouse_report(TerminalMouseReport const& report)
{
    auto viewport = viewport_size().to_type<int>();
    auto is_in_status_line = report.position.y() >= viewport.height();
    auto position_in_page = Gfx::IntPoint {
        clamp(report.position.x(), 0, max(0, viewport.width() - 1)),
        clamp(report.position.y(), 0, max(0, viewport.height() - 1)),
    };

    switch (report.kind) {
    case TerminalMouseReport::Kind::Wheel: {
        if (is_in_status_line)
            return;
        auto event = mouse_event(Web::MouseEvent::Type::MouseWheel, position_in_page, MouseButton::None, m_held_mouse_buttons, report.modifiers);
        event.wheel_delta_x = report.wheel_steps.x() * wheel_pixels_per_terminal_wheel_report;
        event.wheel_delta_y = report.wheel_steps.y() * wheel_pixels_per_terminal_wheel_report;
        event.wheel_tick_120ths_x = Web::wheel_tick_120ths_from_pixel_delta(event.wheel_delta_x, Web::WheelDeltaPrecision::Discrete);
        event.wheel_tick_120ths_y = Web::wheel_tick_120ths_from_pixel_delta(event.wheel_delta_y, Web::WheelDeltaPrecision::Discrete);
        event.wheel_delta_precision = Web::WheelDeltaPrecision::Discrete;
        enqueue_input_event(move(event));
        return;
    }

    case TerminalMouseReport::Kind::Motion:
        // A drag that leaves the page keeps going at its edge.
        if (is_in_status_line && m_held_mouse_buttons == MouseButton::None)
            return;
        enqueue_input_event(mouse_event(Web::MouseEvent::Type::MouseMove, position_in_page, MouseButton::None, m_held_mouse_buttons, report.modifiers));
        return;

    case TerminalMouseReport::Kind::Release: {
        if (!has_flag(m_held_mouse_buttons, report.button))
            return;
        m_held_mouse_buttons &= ~report.button;
        auto event = mouse_event(Web::MouseEvent::Type::MouseUp, position_in_page, report.button, m_held_mouse_buttons, report.modifiers);
        event.click_count = m_click_count;
        enqueue_input_event(move(event));
        return;
    }

    case TerminalMouseReport::Kind::Press: {
        if (is_in_status_line) {
            open_url_prompt();
            return;
        }

        auto now = MonotonicTime::now();
        auto distance = max(abs(position_in_page.x() - m_last_press_position.x()), abs(position_in_page.y() - m_last_press_position.y()));
        if (report.button == m_last_pressed_mouse_button && now - m_last_press_time < double_click_interval && distance <= double_click_distance_in_device_pixels * m_device_pixel_ratio)
            ++m_click_count;
        else
            m_click_count = 1;
        m_last_pressed_mouse_button = report.button;
        m_last_press_position = position_in_page;
        m_last_press_time = now;

        m_held_mouse_buttons |= report.button;
        auto event = mouse_event(Web::MouseEvent::Type::MouseDown, position_in_page, report.button, m_held_mouse_buttons, report.modifiers);
        event.click_count = m_click_count;
        enqueue_input_event(move(event));
        return;
    }
    }
}

static bool is_typed_character(u32 code_point)
{
    return code_point >= ' ' && code_point != 0x7f;
}

static bool has_shortcut_modifier(KeyModifier modifiers)
{
    return (modifiers & (KeyModifier::Mod_Ctrl | KeyModifier::Mod_Super)) != 0;
}

// The code point a key event carries, as the Qt UI takes it from the text a key types.
static u32 code_point_for_key_event(TerminalKeyReport const& report)
{
    if (!report.text_code_points.is_empty())
        return report.text_code_points.first();
    if (has_flag(report.modifiers, KeyModifier::Mod_Shift) && is_typed_character(report.code_point))
        return report.shifted_code_point.value_or(to_ascii_uppercase(report.code_point));
    return report.code_point;
}

bool TerminalWebView::handle_browser_shortcut(TerminalKeyReport const& report)
{
    auto is_key_with = [&](KeyCode key, KeyModifier modifiers) {
        return report.key == key && report.modifiers == modifiers;
    };

    if (is_key_with(KeyCode::Key_Q, KeyModifier::Mod_Ctrl)) {
        quit();
        return true;
    }
    if (is_key_with(KeyCode::Key_L, KeyModifier::Mod_Ctrl)) {
        open_url_prompt();
        return true;
    }
    if (is_key_with(KeyCode::Key_R, KeyModifier::Mod_Ctrl) || is_key_with(KeyCode::Key_F5, KeyModifier::Mod_None)) {
        reload();
        return true;
    }
    // Terminals that follow the macOS convention send Option+Left and Option+Right as Alt+B and Alt+F, the keys that
    // move a shell's cursor by words.
    if (is_key_with(KeyCode::Key_Left, KeyModifier::Mod_Alt) || is_key_with(KeyCode::Key_B, KeyModifier::Mod_Alt)) {
        traverse_the_history_by_delta(-1);
        return true;
    }
    if (is_key_with(KeyCode::Key_Right, KeyModifier::Mod_Alt) || is_key_with(KeyCode::Key_F, KeyModifier::Mod_Alt)) {
        traverse_the_history_by_delta(1);
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

void TerminalWebView::handle_url_prompt_key(TerminalKeyReport const& report)
{
    if (report.phase == TerminalKeyReport::Phase::Release)
        return;

    switch (report.key) {
    case KeyCode::Key_Escape:
        m_url_prompt_text.clear();
        break;
    case KeyCode::Key_Return:
        open_url(m_url_prompt_text.release_value());
        break;
    case KeyCode::Key_Backspace: {
        Utf8View text { m_url_prompt_text->view() };
        if (!text.is_empty())
            m_url_prompt_text = ByteString { text.unicode_substring_view(0, text.length() - 1).as_string() };
        break;
    }
    default: {
        auto code_point = code_point_for_key_event(report);
        if (has_shortcut_modifier(report.modifiers) || !is_typed_character(code_point))
            break;
        StringBuilder builder;
        builder.append(*m_url_prompt_text);
        builder.append_code_point(code_point);
        m_url_prompt_text = builder.to_byte_string();
        break;
    }
    }
    draw_status_line();
}

void TerminalWebView::handle_key_report(TerminalKeyReport const& report)
{
    if (m_url_prompt_text.has_value()) {
        handle_url_prompt_key(report);
        return;
    }

    if (report.phase != TerminalKeyReport::Phase::Release && handle_browser_shortcut(report))
        return;

    auto code_point = code_point_for_key_event(report);
    auto types_text = code_point != 0 && (!report.text_code_points.is_empty() || !has_shortcut_modifier(report.modifiers));

    auto key_event = [&](Web::KeyEvent::Type type, bool repeat) {
        Web::KeyEvent event {};
        event.type = type;
        event.key = report.key;
        event.modifiers = report.modifiers;
        event.code_point = code_point;
        event.repeat = repeat;
        event.should_insert_text = type == Web::KeyEvent::Type::KeyDown && types_text;
        return event;
    };

    // A release goes to the page only after its press did, which a shortcut, the URL prompt, or a terminal that turns
    // the press into another key keeps from it.
    auto& is_down_in_page = m_key_is_down_in_page[to_underlying(report.key)];
    switch (report.phase) {
    case TerminalKeyReport::Phase::Press:
        enqueue_input_event(key_event(Web::KeyEvent::Type::KeyDown, false));
        if (report.is_legacy_encoding || !m_terminal_reports_key_releases)
            enqueue_input_event(key_event(Web::KeyEvent::Type::KeyUp, false));
        else
            is_down_in_page = true;
        break;
    case TerminalKeyReport::Phase::Repeat:
        enqueue_input_event(key_event(Web::KeyEvent::Type::KeyDown, true));
        break;
    case TerminalKeyReport::Phase::Release:
        if (!exchange(is_down_in_page, false))
            break;
        enqueue_input_event(key_event(Web::KeyEvent::Type::KeyUp, false));
        break;
    }
}

void TerminalWebView::handle_command(TerminalCommand const& command)
{
    if (command.name == "open"sv) {
        open_url(command.argument);
    } else if (command.name == "back"sv) {
        traverse_the_history_by_delta(-1);
    } else if (command.name == "forward"sv) {
        traverse_the_history_by_delta(1);
    } else if (command.name == "reload"sv) {
        reload();
    } else if (command.name == "quit"sv) {
        quit();
    } else if (command.name == "frames"sv) {
        m_sends_damaged_rectangles = command.argument == "damage"sv;
        m_frame_needs_full_redraw = true;
        schedule_frame_flush();
        show_notice(m_sends_damaged_rectangles ? "sending damaged rectangles" : "sending whole frames");
    } else {
        show_notice(ByteString::formatted("unknown command: {}", command.name));
    }
}

void TerminalWebView::open_url_prompt()
{
    m_url_prompt_text = displayed_url().serialize().to_byte_string();
    draw_status_line();
}

void TerminalWebView::open_url(StringView text)
{
    auto url = sanitize_url(text, Application::settings().search_engine_settings().engine);
    if (!url.has_value()) {
        show_notice(ByteString::formatted("not a URL: {}", text));
        return;
    }
    load_from_browser_ui(*url);
}

void TerminalWebView::show_notice(ByteString notice)
{
    m_notice = move(notice);
    draw_status_line();

    if (!m_notice_timer) {
        m_notice_timer = Core::Timer::create_single_shot(AK::Duration::from_seconds(5), [this] {
            m_notice = {};
            draw_status_line();
        });
    }
    m_notice_timer->restart();
}

void TerminalWebView::draw_status_line()
{
    if (!m_terminal_modes_entered || m_pane_geometry.rows <= 0 || m_pane_geometry.columns <= 0)
        return;

    StringBuilder text;
    if (m_url_prompt_text.has_value()) {
        text.appendff(" Go to: {}█", *m_url_prompt_text);
    } else {
        auto url = displayed_url().serialize();
        auto heading = title().is_empty() ? url.to_byte_string() : title().to_byte_string();
        text.appendff(" {} — {}", heading, url);
        text.append("   ctrl-l url · ctrl-r reload · alt-←/→ history · ctrl-q quit"sv);
        if (!m_notice.is_empty())
            text.appendff(" · {}", m_notice);
    }
    Utf8View text_view { text.string_view() };
    auto visible_length = min(text_view.length(), static_cast<size_t>(max(0, m_pane_geometry.columns - 2)));
    auto visible_text = text_view.unicode_substring_view(0, visible_length);

    StringBuilder line;
    line.appendff("\x1b[{};1H\x1b[2K", m_pane_geometry.rows);
    if (!m_url_prompt_text.has_value())
        line.appendff("\x1b[{}m●\x1b[0m", is_loading() ? 33 : 32);
    line.appendff("\x1b[2m{}\x1b[0m", visible_text.as_string());

    auto status_line = line.to_byte_string();
    if (status_line == m_drawn_status_line)
        return;
    m_drawn_status_line = status_line;
    write_to_terminal(status_line);
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/Array.h>
#include <AK/ByteBuffer.h>
#include <AK/ByteString.h>
#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <AK/Time.h>
#include <LibCore/Forward.h>
#include <LibGfx/Rect.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/UIEvents/MouseButton.h>
#include <LibWebView/HeadlessWebView.h>
#include <LibWebView/TerminalInputParser.h>

#include <termios.h>

namespace WebView {

// A view that shows its page in the terminal it was started from: frames as Kitty graphics, and the terminal's mouse
// and keyboard reports as input. The last row of the terminal is a status line.
class WEBVIEW_API TerminalWebView final : public HeadlessWebView {
public:
    // Keeps the terminal for drawing, and sends what this process and every helper it starts would print there to a
    // log file instead. Must run before any helper process is started.
    static ErrorOr<void> take_over_terminal();

    static ErrorOr<NonnullOwnPtr<TerminalWebView>> create(Core::AnonymousBuffer theme, double device_pixel_ratio);
    virtual ~TerminalWebView() override;

private:
    struct PaneGeometry {
        int rows { 0 };
        int columns { 0 };
        Gfx::IntSize pixel_size;

        int cell_width() const { return columns > 0 ? pixel_size.width() / columns : 0; }
        int cell_height() const { return rows > 0 ? pixel_size.height() / rows : 0; }
        // Everything but the last row, which holds the status line.
        Gfx::IntSize page_pixel_size() const { return { columns * cell_width(), (rows - 1) * cell_height() }; }
    };

    enum class GraphicsTransmission : u8 {
        TemporaryFile,
        Direct,
    };

    TerminalWebView(Core::AnonymousBuffer theme, Web::DevicePixelSize viewport_size, double device_pixel_ratio);

    static PaneGeometry query_pane_geometry();

    // ^ViewImplementation
    virtual void did_accept_presented_backing_store(i32 bitmap_id, Gfx::IntRect damage_rect) override;

    void enter_terminal_modes();
    void leave_terminal_modes();
    void quit();
    void write_to_terminal(StringView);

    void apply_pane_geometry();

    void schedule_frame_flush();
    void flush_frame();
    ErrorOr<void> transmit_frame(Gfx::Bitmap const&);
    ErrorOr<void> send_image_data(StringView keys, ReadonlyBytes pixels);

    void handle_input(TerminalInput const&);
    void handle_mouse_report(TerminalMouseReport const&);
    void handle_key_report(TerminalKeyReport const&);
    bool handle_browser_shortcut(TerminalKeyReport const&);
    void handle_url_prompt_key(TerminalKeyReport const&);
    void handle_command(TerminalCommand const&);

    void open_url_prompt();
    void open_url(StringView);
    void show_notice(ByteString);
    void draw_status_line();

    struct termios m_original_terminal_attributes {};
    bool m_terminal_modes_entered { false };
    RefPtr<Core::Notifier> m_input_notifier;
    Vector<int> m_signal_handler_ids;
    TerminalInputParser m_input_parser;
    bool m_terminal_reports_key_releases { false };
    Array<bool, 256> m_key_is_down_in_page {};

    PaneGeometry m_pane_geometry;

    bool m_frame_flush_scheduled { false };
    bool m_frame_needs_full_redraw { true };
    Optional<Gfx::IntRect> m_pending_damage;
    ByteBuffer m_frame_pixels;
    u64 m_image_data_transmissions { 0 };
    GraphicsTransmission m_graphics_transmission { GraphicsTransmission::TemporaryFile };
    bool m_sends_damaged_rectangles { false };
    Optional<u32> m_displayed_image_id;
    Gfx::IntSize m_displayed_image_size;

    Web::UIEvents::MouseButton m_held_mouse_buttons { Web::UIEvents::MouseButton::None };
    Web::UIEvents::MouseButton m_last_pressed_mouse_button { Web::UIEvents::MouseButton::None };
    Gfx::IntPoint m_last_press_position;
    MonotonicTime m_last_press_time { MonotonicTime::now_coarse() };
    int m_click_count { 0 };

    Optional<ByteString> m_url_prompt_text;
    ByteString m_notice;
    RefPtr<Core::Timer> m_notice_timer;
    ByteString m_drawn_status_line;
};

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWebView/TestSpellChecker.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <AK/AnyOf.h>
#include <AK/CharacterTypes.h>
#include <LibCore/EventLoop.h>
#include <LibWebView/TestSpellChecker.h>

namespace WebView {

static constexpr Array s_misspelled_words {
    u"txet"sv,
    u"Txet"sv,
    u"quikc"sv,
    u"wrod"sv,
    u"speling"sv,
    u"lernword"sv,
    u"lernagain"sv,
};

static Vector<Utf16String> guesses_for(Utf16View word)
{
    auto guesses = [](std::initializer_list<StringView> words) {
        Vector<Utf16String> result;
        for (auto word : words)
            result.append(Utf16String::from_utf8(word));
        return result;
    };
    if (word == u"txet"sv)
        return guesses({ "text"sv, "teat"sv, "tet"sv });
    if (word == u"Txet"sv)
        return guesses({ "Text"sv, "Teat"sv, "Tet"sv });
    if (word == u"wrod"sv)
        return guesses({ "word"sv, "rod"sv, "wrong"sv, "wood"sv, "ford"sv, "prod"sv });
    if (word == u"speling"sv)
        return guesses({ "spelling"sv, "spieling"sv });
    if (word == u"lernword"sv)
        return guesses({ "learnword"sv });
    return {};
}

static bool is_word_code_unit(char16_t code_unit)
{
    return is_ascii_alpha(code_unit) || code_unit == '\'';
}

// What each word at the caret is predicted to become. The last one corrects what's typed rather than continuing it.
// Every test-web test has these predictions, so a test that types one of these words and then waits before pressing Tab
// accepts the prediction rather than moving focus.
static Optional<StringView> prediction_for(Utf16View partial_word)
{
    if (partial_word == u"predi"sv)
        return "prediction"sv;
    if (partial_word == u"Lady"sv)
        return "Ladybird browser"sv;
    if (partial_word == u"teh"sv)
        return "the"sv;
    return {};
}

SpellChecker::DocumentTag TestSpellChecker::create_document_tag()
{
    return m_next_document_tag++;
}

void TestSpellChecker::close_document_tag(DocumentTag tag)
{
    m_accepted_words.remove(tag);
}

bool TestSpellChecker::is_misspelled(DocumentTag tag, Utf16View word) const
{
    if (!any_of(s_misspelled_words, [&](auto misspelled) { return misspelled == word; }))
        return false;
    auto accepted = m_accepted_words.get(tag);
    return !accepted.has_value() || !accepted->contains(Utf16String::from_utf16(word));
}

void TestSpellChecker::check(DocumentTag tag, Utf16String const& text, Function<void(Vector<Web::SpellingError>)> on_complete)
{
    Vector<Web::SpellingError> errors;
    auto view = text.utf16_view();
    size_t index = 0;
    while (index < view.length_in_code_units()) {
        if (!is_word_code_unit(view.code_unit_at(index))) {
            ++index;
            continue;
        }
        auto start = index;
        while (index < view.length_in_code_units() && is_word_code_unit(view.code_unit_at(index)))
            ++index;
        if (is_misspelled(tag, view.substring_view(start, index - start)))
            errors.append({ static_cast<u32>(start), static_cast<u32>(index - start) });
    }

    // Answer on a later turn of the event loop, as platform spellcheckers do.
    Core::deferred_invoke([on_complete = move(on_complete), errors = move(errors)]() mutable {
        on_complete(move(errors));
    });
}

void TestSpellChecker::suggest(DocumentTag, Utf16String const& text, u32 caret_offset, Function<void(Optional<Web::WritingSuggestion>)> on_complete)
{
    Optional<Web::WritingSuggestion> suggestion;
    auto view = text.utf16_view();
    if (caret_offset <= view.length_in_code_units()) {
        // The candidate replaces the whole word the caret is in, as platform spellcheckers' candidates do.
        auto start = caret_offset;
        while (start > 0 && is_word_code_unit(view.code_unit_at(start - 1)))
            --start;
        auto end = caret_offset;
        while (end < view.length_in_code_units() && is_word_code_unit(view.code_unit_at(end)))
            ++end;
        if (start < caret_offset) {
            if (auto prediction = prediction_for(view.substring_view(start, end - start)); prediction.has_value())
                suggestion = Web::WritingSuggestion { start, end - start, Utf16String::from_utf8(*prediction) };
        }
    }

    // Answer on a later turn of the event loop, as platform spellcheckers do.
    Core::deferred_invoke([on_complete = move(on_complete), suggestion = move(suggestion)]() mutable {
        on_complete(move(suggestion));
    });
}

void TestSpellChecker::guesses(DocumentTag, Utf16String const& word, Function<void(Vector<Utf16String>)> on_complete)
{
    on_complete(guesses_for(word.utf16_view()));
}

void TestSpellChecker::ignore(DocumentTag tag, Utf16String const& word)
{
    m_accepted_words.ensure(tag).set(word);
}

void TestSpellChecker::learn(DocumentTag tag, Utf16String const& word)
{
    m_accepted_words.ensure(tag).set(word);
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/HashMap.h>
#include <AK/HashTable.h>
#include <LibWebView/SpellChecker.h>

namespace WebView {

// A spellchecker with a fixed word list, so tests give the same answers on every platform.
class WEBVIEW_API TestSpellChecker final : public SpellChecker {
public:
    virtual DocumentTag create_document_tag() override;
    virtual void close_document_tag(DocumentTag) override;
    virtual void check(DocumentTag, Utf16String const& text, Function<void(Vector<Web::SpellingError>)> on_complete) override;
    virtual void guesses(DocumentTag, Utf16String const& word, Function<void(Vector<Utf16String>)> on_complete) override;
    virtual void ignore(DocumentTag, Utf16String const& word) override;
    virtual void learn(DocumentTag, Utf16String const& word) override;
    virtual bool learns_for_every_tag() const override { return false; }
    virtual bool can_suggest() const override { return true; }
    virtual void suggest(DocumentTag, Utf16String const& text, u32 caret_offset, Function<void(Optional<Web::WritingSuggestion>)> on_complete) override;

private:
    bool is_misspelled(DocumentTag, Utf16View word) const;

    DocumentTag m_next_document_tag { 1 };
    // AD-HOC: A platform spellchecker learns a word for every app. Learned words stay with the tab's tag here, so
    //         views that run tests side by side never see each other's.
    HashMap<DocumentTag, HashTable<Utf16String>> m_accepted_words;
};

FILE: Libraries/LibWebView/TestTranslator.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <LibCore/EventLoop.h>
#include <LibWebView/TestTranslator.h>

namespace WebView {

void TestTranslator::detect_language(Web::TranslationLanguageSample const& sample, Function<void(Optional<String>)> on_complete)
{
    Core::deferred_invoke([on_complete = move(on_complete), language = sample.declared_language]() mutable {
        on_complete(move(language));
    });
}

void TestTranslator::target_languages(String const& source_language, Vector<String> const& candidates, Function<void(Vector<TargetLanguage>)> on_complete)
{
    Vector<TargetLanguage> target_languages;
    for (auto const& candidate : candidates) {
        if (is_same_language(candidate, source_language))
            continue;
        target_languages.append({ candidate, is_same_language(candidate, "xx"sv) });
    }
    Core::deferred_invoke([on_complete = move(on_complete), target_languages = move(target_languages)]() mutable {
        on_complete(move(target_languages));
    });
}

Translator::SessionId TestTranslator::create_session(String const&, String const& target_language, bool)
{
    auto session_id = ++m_last_session_id;
    m_target_languages.set(session_id, target_language);
    return session_id;
}

void TestTranslator::close_session(SessionId session_id)
{
    m_target_languages.remove(session_id);
}

void TestTranslator::translate(SessionId session_id, Web::TranslationUnit unit, Function<void(Optional<Vector<Web::TranslationRun>>)> on_complete)
{
    Vector<Web::TranslationRun> runs;
    runs.ensure_capacity(unit.runs.size());
    for (auto& run : unit.runs.in_reverse()) {
        if (!run.keep_as_is) {
            auto uppercase = run.text.to_ascii_uppercase();
            run.text = Utf16String::from_utf16(uppercase.utf16_view().trim_ascii_whitespace());
        }
        runs.unchecked_append(move(run));
    }
    if (auto target_language = m_target_languages.get(session_id); target_language.has_value() && !runs.is_empty()) {
        if (target_language->ends_with_bytes("-x-repeat"sv))
            runs.append(runs.first());
        else if (target_language->ends_with_bytes("-x-drop"sv) && runs.size() > 1)
            runs.take_last();
    }

    // Answer on a later turn of the event loop, as platform translators do, and never for a closed session.
    Core::deferred_invoke([this, session_id, on_complete = move(on_complete), runs = move(runs)]() mutable {
        if (m_target_languages.contains(session_id))
            on_complete(move(runs));
    });
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWebView/TestTranslator.h
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#pragma once

#include <AK/HashMap.h>
#include <LibWebView/Translator.h>

namespace WebView {

// A translator that gives the same answers on every platform, so tests can check what translating a page does to it.
// It "translates" a unit by putting its runs in reverse order, and by uppercasing the ASCII letters of every run it may
// translate and trimming the white space at its ends, as a real translation does. Reversing the runs means every test
// exercises the reordering a real translation can bring. A target language with the private use subtag "x-repeat" also
// gets the first run of each translation a second time, at its end, and one with "x-drop" loses its last run, as real
// translations sometimes do.
class WEBVIEW_API TestTranslator final : public Translator {
public:
    // The page's declared language, or nothing.
    virtual void detect_language(Web::TranslationLanguageSample const&, Function<void(Optional<String>)> on_complete) override;
    // Every candidate in another language; one whose primary language subtag is "xx" needs downloading first.
    virtual void target_languages(String const& source_language, Vector<String> const& candidates, Function<void(Vector<TargetLanguage>)> on_complete) override;
    virtual SessionId create_session(String const& source_language, String const& target_language, bool prefer_higher_quality) override;
    virtual void choose_session_model_again(SessionId, bool) override { }
    virtual void close_session(SessionId) override;
    virtual void translate(SessionId, Web::TranslationUnit, Function<void(Optional<Vector<Web::TranslationRun>>)> on_complete) override;
    virtual void open_language_download_settings() override { }

private:
    SessionId m_last_session_id { 0 };
    HashMap<SessionId, String> m_target_languages;
};

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWebView/Translator.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <LibWebView/Translator.h>

namespace WebView {

StringView primary_language_subtag(StringView language)
{
    if (auto separator = language.find_any_of("-_"sv); separator.has_value())
        return language.substring_view(0, *separator);
    return language;
}

bool is_same_language(StringView a, StringView b)
{
    return primary_language_subtag(a).equals_ignoring_ascii_case(primary_language_subtag(b));
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWebView/Translator.h
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#pragma once

#include <AK/Function.h>
#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <AK/String.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/Page/Translation.h>
#include <LibWebView/Export.h>

namespace WebView {

// The primary language subtag of a BCP 47 language tag, e.g. "pt" for "pt-BR".
WEBVIEW_API StringView primary_language_subtag(StringView language);
// Whether two language tags name the same language, whatever their regions or scripts.
WEBVIEW_API bool is_same_language(StringView, StringView);

// The platform translator the UI process asks on behalf of every page. Languages are BCP 47 tags.
class WEBVIEW_API Translator {
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

public:
    using SessionId = u64;

    virtual ~Translator() = default;

    // Works out which language a page is in. Asynchronous; on_complete runs on the main thread, with nothing if the
    // sample doesn't say.
    virtual void detect_language(Web::TranslationLanguageSample const&, Function<void(Optional<String>)> on_complete) = 0;

    struct TargetLanguage {
        String language;
        // The platform supports the pair, but the user has to download its languages before it can be translated.
        bool needs_download { false };
        // Only the platform's higher-quality models are installed for the pair, and they're much slower than the ones a
        // download would add.
        bool faster_after_download { false };
        // The platform's higher-quality models are installed for the pair, so the user can choose them.
        bool higher_quality_available { false };
        // A language the pair needs is being downloaded.
        bool downloading { false };
        // The languages of the pair the platform knows aren't installed, which may be the page's own as well as the
        // target. Empty if the platform doesn't say.
        Vector<String> languages_to_download {};
    };

    // Which of the candidate languages text in the source language can be translated into, in the candidates' order.
    // Asynchronous; on_complete runs on the main thread.
    virtual void target_languages(String const& source_language, Vector<String> const& candidates, Function<void(Vector<TargetLanguage>)> on_complete) = 0;

    // A session translates from one language to another, one unit at a time, in the order the units are given. It uses
    // the fastest of the pair's installed models, or the higher-quality ones if they're preferred and installed.
    virtual SessionId create_session(String const& source_language, String const& target_language, bool prefer_higher_quality) = 0;
    // Units the session hasn't started on yet are translated with the model the session would pick now, e.g. once the
    // download of a faster one completes.
    virtual void choose_session_model_again(SessionId, bool prefer_higher_quality) = 0;
    // Drops the units the session hasn't translated yet; their callbacks never run.
    virtual void close_session(SessionId) = 0;
    // Asynchronous; on_complete runs on the main thread, with nothing if the unit couldn't be translated.
    virtual void translate(SessionId, Web::TranslationUnit, Function<void(Optional<Vector<Web::TranslationRun>>)> on_complete) = 0;

    // Opens the platform's settings where the user downloads the languages a translation needs.
    virtual void open_language_download_settings() = 0;

    // What the user knows the platform's higher-quality models as, if it has any.
    virtual Optional<StringView> higher_quality_models_name() const { return {}; }

    // Runs on the main thread whenever a language's download starts or finishes, so the answers target_languages()
    // gives may have changed.
    Function<void()> on_languages_changed;
};

}

#if defined(LADYBIRD_HAS_UPDATE_CHECK)

static constexpr size_t maximum_feed_size = 4 * MiB;
static constexpr auto request_timeout = AK::Duration::from_seconds(30);

// A timer waits at most this long, and then works out again how long until the next check is due.
static constexpr auto longest_timer_wait = AK::Duration::from_seconds(24 * 60 * 60);

// The system updates a package by itself, so an automatic check only reminds the user of a release that the system has
// left uninstalled for this long.
static constexpr auto package_update_grace_period = AK::Duration::from_seconds(14 * 24 * 60 * 60);

static constexpr i64 STATE_VERSION = 1;
static constexpr auto VERSION_KEY = "version"sv;
static constexpr auto FIRST_START_KEY = "firstStart"sv;
static constexpr auto LAST_CHECK_KEY = "lastCheck"sv;
static constexpr auto SKIPPED_VERSION_KEY = "skippedVersion"sv;

Optional<Vector<u64>> parse_version(StringView version)
{
    Vector<u64> parts;
    for (auto part : version.split_view('.', SplitBehavior::KeepEmpty)) {
        if (part.is_empty() || !all_of(part, is_ascii_digit))
            return {};
        auto number = part.to_number<u64>();
        if (!number.has_value())
            return {};
        parts.append(*number);
    }
    if (parts.is_empty())
        return {};
    return parts;
}

static int compare_versions(Vector<u64> const& a, Vector<u64> const& b)
{
    for (size_t i = 0; i < max(a.size(), b.size()); ++i) {
        auto a_part = i < a.size() ? a[i] : 0;
        auto b_part = i < b.size() ? b[i] : 0;
        if (a_part != b_part)
            return a_part < b_part ? -1 : 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

bool is_newer_version(StringView candidate, StringView current)
{
    auto candidate_version = parse_version(candidate);
    auto current_version = parse_version(current);
    if (!candidate_version.has_value() || !current_version.has_value())
        return false;
    return compare_versions(*candidate_version, *current_version) > 0;
}

#endif

// https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/latest/os-release.html
OSRelease parse_os_release(StringView contents)
{
    OSRelease result;
    for (auto line : contents.lines()) {
        line = line.trim_whitespace();
        if (line.is_empty() || line.starts_with('#'))
            continue;

        auto equals = line.find('=');
        if (!equals.has_value())
            continue;
        auto key = line.substring_view(0, *equals);
        auto value = line.substring_view(*equals + 1);
        if (value.length() >= 2 && (value[0] == '"' || value[0] == '\'') && value[value.length() - 1] == value[0])
            value = value.substring_view(1, value.length() - 2);

        auto string = String::from_utf8(value);
        if (string.is_error())
            continue;
        if (key == "ID"sv)
            result.id = string.release_value();
        else if (key == "VERSION_ID"sv)
            result.version_id = string.release_value();
    }
    return result;
}

Optional<InstallMethod> parse_package_format(StringView contents)
{
    auto format = contents.trim_whitespace();
    if (format == "DEB"sv)
        return InstallMethod::DEB;
    if (format == "RPM"sv)
        return InstallMethod::RPM;
    if (format == "AppImage"sv)
        return InstallMethod::AppImage;
    return {};
}

static InstallMethod current_install_method()
{
#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
    return InstallMethod::MacOSApp;
#else
    if (FileSystem::exists("/.flatpak-info"sv))
        return InstallMethod::Flatpak;

    // The Linux packages say which kind they are in a file of their own, which an archive of the same build lacks.
    auto marker = LexicalPath::join(s_ladybird_resource_root, "package-format"sv).string();
    if (auto file = Core::File::open(marker, Core::File::OpenMode::Read); !file.is_error()) {
        if (auto contents = file.value()->read_until_eof(); !contents.is_error()) {
            if (auto install_method = parse_package_format(contents.value()); install_method.has_value())
                return *install_method;
        }
    }
    return InstallMethod::Source;
#endif
}

static OSRelease current_os_release()
{
    for (auto path : { "/etc/os-release"sv, "/usr/lib/os-release"sv }) {
        auto file = Core::File::open(path, Core::File::OpenMode::Read);
        if (file.is_error())
            continue;
        auto contents = file.value()->read_until_eof();
        if (!contents.is_error())
            return parse_os_release(contents.value());
    }
    return {};
}

static Optional<String> current_macos_version()
{
#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
    char version[32] {};
    size_t size = sizeof(version);
    if (sysctlbyname("kern.osproductversion", version, &size, nullptr, 0) != 0)
        return {};
    auto string = String::from_utf8(StringView { version, strnlen(version, sizeof(version)) });
    if (string.is_error())
        return {};
    return string.release_value();
#else
    return {};
#endif
}

#if defined(AK_OS_WINDOWS) && defined(LADYBIRD_HAS_UPDATE_CHECK)
// GetVersionEx reports an older version of Windows to an application that does not declare in its manifest that it
// supports the newer one. RtlGetVersion always reports the version that runs.
static Optional<String> current_windows_version()
{
    using RtlGetVersionFunction = NTSTATUS(WINAPI*)(PRTL_OSVERSIONINFOW);

    auto* ntdll = GetModuleHandleW(L"ntdll.dll");
    if (!ntdll)
        return {};
#    pragma clang diagnostic push
#    pragma clang diagnostic ignored "-Wcast-function-type-mismatch"
    auto rtl_get_version = reinterpret_cast<RtlGetVersionFunction>(GetProcAddress(ntdll, "RtlGetVersion"));
#    pragma clang diagnostic pop
    if (!rtl_get_version)
        return {};

    RTL_OSVERSIONINFOW info {};
    info.dwOSVersionInfoSize = sizeof(info);
    if (rtl_get_version(&info) != STATUS_SUCCESS)
        return {};
    return MUST(String::formatted("{}.{}.{}", info.dwMajorVersion, info.dwMinorVersion, info.dwBuildNumber));
}
#endif

SystemDescription describe_current_system()
{
    SystemDescription system;
    system.install_method = current_install_method();
#if ARCH(X86_64)
    system.architecture = Architecture::X86_64;
#elif ARCH(AARCH64)
    system.architecture = Architecture::AArch64;
#endif
    if (system.install_method != InstallMethod::MacOSApp && system.install_method != InstallMethod::Flatpak)
        system.os_release = current_os_release();
    system.macos_version = current_macos_version();
    return system;
}

#if defined(LADYBIRD_HAS_UPDATE_CHECK)

// releases.json names architectures the way that each kind of package does.
static Optional<StringView> architecture_name(InstallMethod install_method, Architecture architecture)
{
    if (architecture == Architecture::Other)
        return {};

    switch (install_method) {
    case InstallMethod::MacOSApp:
        return architecture == Architecture::AArch64 ? "arm64"sv : "x86_64"sv;
    case InstallMethod::DEB:
        return architecture == Architecture::AArch64 ? "arm64"sv : "amd64"sv;
    case InstallMethod::RPM:
    case InstallMethod::Flatpak:
    case InstallMethod::AppImage:
        return architecture == Architecture::AArch64 ? "aarch64"sv : "x86_64"sv;
    case InstallMethod::Source:
        return {};
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

static bool contains_string(Optional<JsonArray const&> array, StringView string)
{
    return array.has_value() && any_of(array->values(), [&](JsonValue const& value) {
        return value.is_string() && value.as_string() == string;
    });
}

static bool repository_installs_on(Optional<JsonObject const&> repository, SystemDescription const& system, StringView architecture)
{
    if (!repository.has_value() || !system.os_release.id.has_value() || !system.os_release.version_id.has_value())
        return false;

    auto systems = repository->get_array("systems"sv);
    return systems.has_value() && any_of(systems->values(), [&](JsonValue const& value) {
        if (!value.is_object())
            return false;
        auto const& entry = value.as_object();
        auto id = entry.get_string("id"sv);
        auto version_id = entry.get_string("version_id"sv);
        return id.has_value() && *id == *system.os_release.id && version_id.has_value() && *version_id == *system.os_release.version_id
            && contains_string(entry.get_array("architectures"sv), architecture);
    });
}

static bool runs_on_macos_version(JsonObject const& download, Optional<String> const& macos_version)
{
    auto minimum = download.get_string("minimum_macos_version"sv);
    if (!minimum.has_value() || !macos_version.has_value())
        return true;

    auto minimum_version = parse_version(*minimum);
    auto current_version = parse_version(*macos_version);
    if (!minimum_version.has_value() || !current_version.has_value())
        return true;
    return compare_versions(*current_version, *minimum_version) >= 0;
}

static bool release_installs_on(JsonObject const& release, SystemDescription const& system)
{
    auto architecture = architecture_name(system.install_method, system.architecture);
    auto downloads = release.get_array("downloads"sv);
    auto repositories = release.get_object("repositories"sv);

    auto has_download = [&](auto matches) {
        return downloads.has_value() && any_of(downloads->values(), [&](JsonValue const& value) {
            return value.is_object() && matches(value.as_object());
        });
    };

    switch (system.install_method) {
    case InstallMethod::MacOSApp:
        return architecture.has_value() && has_download([&](JsonObject const& download) {
            return download.get_string("platform"sv) == "macOS"sv && download.get_string("architecture"sv) == *architecture
                && runs_on_macos_version(download, system.macos_version);
        });
    case InstallMethod::DEB:
        return architecture.has_value() && repositories.has_value()
            && repository_installs_on(repositories->get_object("apt"sv), system, *architecture);
    case InstallMethod::RPM:
        return architecture.has_value() && repositories.has_value()
            && repository_installs_on(repositories->get_object("rpm"sv), system, *architecture);
    case InstallMethod::Flatpak: {
        if (!architecture.has_value() || !repositories.has_value())
            return false;
        auto flatpak = repositories->get_object("flatpak"sv);
        return flatpak.has_value() && contains_string(flatpak->get_array("architectures"sv), *architecture);
    }
    case InstallMethod::AppImage:
        return architecture.has_value() && has_download([&](JsonObject const& download) {
            auto name = download.get_string("name"sv);
            return download.get_string("platform"sv) == "Linux"sv && download.get_string("architecture"sv) == *architecture
                && name.has_value() && name->bytes_as_string_view().ends_with(".AppImage"sv);
        });
    case InstallMethod::Source:
        return has_download([](JsonObject const& download) { return download.get_string("platform"sv) == "source"sv; });
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

ErrorOr<Optional<String>> newest_release_for_system(StringView releases_json, SystemDescription const& system, Optional<UnixDateTime> published_before)
{
    auto json = TRY(JsonValue::from_string(releases_json));
    if (!json.is_object())
        return Error::from_string_literal("releases.json is not a JSON object");
    auto releases = json.as_object().get_array("releases"sv);
    if (!releases.has_value())
        return Error::from_string_literal("releases.json lists no releases");

    Optional<String> newest;
    Vector<u64> newest_version;
    for (auto const& value : releases->values()) {
        if (!value.is_object())
            continue;
        auto const& release = value.as_object();
        auto version = release.get_string("version"sv);
        if (!version.has_value())
            continue;
        auto parsed_version = parse_version(*version);
        if (!parsed_version.has_value() || !release_installs_on(release, system))
            continue;
        if (published_before.has_value()) {
            auto published = UnixDateTime::parse("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"sv, release.get_string("published"sv).value_or({}), true);
            if (!published.has_value() || *published > *published_before)
                continue;
        }
        if (!newest.has_value() || compare_versions(*parsed_version, newest_version) > 0) {
            newest = *version;
            newest_version = parsed_version.release_value();
        }
    }
    return newest;
}

AK::Duration time_until_next_update_check(UnixDateTime last_check, UnixDateTime now, AK::Duration interval)
{
    auto elapsed = now - last_check;
    if (elapsed < AK::Duration::zero() || elapsed >= interval)
        return AK::Duration::zero();
    return interval - elapsed;
}

struct CountedPeriods {
    bool _new { false };
    bool day { false };
    bool week { false };
    bool month { false };
};

// Days, weeks and months begin at midnight UTC. Weeks start on Monday, like those of ISO 8601, and the Unix epoch fell
// on a Thursday.
static CountedPeriods periods_begun_since(UnixDateTime earlier, UnixDateTime now)
{
    auto days = [](UnixDateTime time) { return time.seconds_since_epoch() / (24 * 60 * 60); };
    auto weeks = [&](UnixDateTime time) { return (days(time) + 3) / 7; };
    auto month = [](UnixDateTime time) { return time.to_byte_string("%Y-%m"sv, UnixDateTime::LocalTime::No); };
    return { .day = days(now) > days(earlier), .week = weeks(now) > weeks(earlier), .month = month(now) > month(earlier) };
}

static StringView install_method_name(InstallMethod install_method)
{
    switch (install_method) {
    case InstallMethod::MacOSApp:
        return "app"sv;
    case InstallMethod::DEB:
        return "deb"sv;
    case InstallMethod::RPM:
        return "rpm"sv;
    case InstallMethod::Flatpak:
        return "flatpak"sv;
    case InstallMethod::AppImage:
        return "appimage"sv;
    case InstallMethod::Source:
        return "source"sv;
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

static void append_member(StringBuilder& builder, StringView key, StringView value)
{
    if (!builder.is_empty())
        builder.append(", "sv);
    builder.append(key);
    if (!value.is_empty())
        builder.appendff("={}", value);
}

static void append_string_member(StringBuilder& builder, StringView key, StringView value)
{
    if (value.is_empty() || !all_of(value, [](char c) { return c >= 0x20 && c <= 0x7e; }))
        return;

    StringBuilder string;
    string.append('"');
    for (auto c : value) {
        if (c == '"' || c == '\\')
            string.append('\\');
        string.append(c);
    }
    string.append('"');
    append_member(builder, key, string.string_view());
}

// The header is a dictionary of structured field values (RFC 9651), which the server parses like any other. It tells
// which kind of installation checks, and nothing that tells one installation apart from another of the same kind.
static ByteString update_check_header(SystemDescription const& system, StringView browser_version, CountedPeriods counted)
{
    StringBuilder builder;
    append_string_member(builder, "version"sv, browser_version);

#    if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
    append_member(builder, "os"sv, "macos"sv);
    if (system.macos_version.has_value())
        append_string_member(builder, "os-version"sv, system.macos_version->bytes_as_string_view().find_first_split_view('.'));
#    elif defined(AK_OS_LINUX)
    append_member(builder, "os"sv, "linux"sv);
    if (system.os_release.version_id.has_value())
        append_string_member(builder, "os-version"sv, *system.os_release.version_id);
    if (system.os_release.id.has_value())
        append_string_member(builder, "distro"sv, *system.os_release.id);
#    elif defined(AK_OS_WINDOWS)
    append_member(builder, "os"sv, "windows"sv);
    if (auto windows_version = current_windows_version(); windows_version.has_value())
        append_string_member(builder, "os-version"sv, *windows_version);
#    endif

    if (system.architecture == Architecture::X86_64)
        append_member(builder, "arch"sv, "x86_64"sv);
    else if (system.architecture == Architecture::AArch64)
        append_member(builder, "arch"sv, "aarch64"sv);

    append_member(builder, "pkg"sv, install_method_name(system.install_method));
    if (counted._new)
        append_member(builder, "new"sv, {});
    if (counted.day)
        append_member(builder, "daily"sv, {});
    if (counted.week)
        append_member(builder, "weekly"sv, {});
    if (counted.month)
        append_member(builder, "monthly"sv, {});
    return builder.to_byte_string();
}

String release_page_url(StringView version)
{
    return MUST(String::formatted("https://github.com/LadybirdBrowser/ladybird/releases/tag/{}", version));
}

static AK::Duration update_check_interval()
{
    auto minutes = Application::settings().config_variable_as_integer<u32>(ConfigVariableID::UpdateCheckInterval);
    return AK::Duration::from_seconds(static_cast<i64>(minutes) * 60);
}

UpdateChecker::UpdateChecker(ByteString state_path)
    : m_state_path(move(state_path))
{
}

UpdateChecker::~UpdateChecker()
{
    if (auto request = move(m_request))
        request->stop();
}

UpdateChecker::State UpdateChecker::read_state() const
{
    auto json = read_json_file(m_state_path);
    if (json.is_error() || json.value().get_integer<i64>(VERSION_KEY) != STATE_VERSION)
        return {};

    State state;
    if (auto first_start = json.value().get_integer<i64>(FIRST_START_KEY); first_start.has_value())
        state.first_start = UnixDateTime::from_milliseconds_since_epoch(*first_start);
    if (auto last_check = json.value().get_integer<i64>(LAST_CHECK_KEY); last_check.has_value())
        state.last_check = UnixDateTime::from_milliseconds_since_epoch(*last_check);
    if (auto skipped_version = json.value().get_string(SKIPPED_VERSION_KEY); skipped_version.has_value())
        state.skipped_version = *skipped_version;
    return state;
}

void UpdateChecker::write_state(State const& state) const
{
    JsonObject json;
    json.set(VERSION_KEY, STATE_VERSION);
    if (state.first_start.has_value())
        json.set(FIRST_START_KEY, state.first_start->milliseconds_since_epoch());
    if (state.last_check.has_value())
        json.set(LAST_CHECK_KEY, state.last_check->milliseconds_since_epoch());
    if (state.skipped_version.has_value())
        json.set(SKIPPED_VERSION_KEY, *state.skipped_version);
    if (auto result = write_json_file(m_state_path, json); result.is_error())
        warnln("Unable to save the state of update checks: {}", result.error());
}

// The last check is kept here as well, so that one that could not be saved still counts. Once a check took place here,
// a saved check that lies ahead of now comes from a clock that was turned back, and a state file that cannot be written
// would otherwise keep making every check due at once.
Optional<UnixDateTime> UpdateChecker::last_check() const
{
    auto saved = read_state().last_check;
    if (!m_last_check.has_value())
        return saved;
    if (!saved.has_value() || *saved > UnixDateTime::now())
        return m_last_check;
    return max(*saved, *m_last_check);
}

// A first start waits for the interval as a check does, so that nothing is fetched before the user could turn checks off.
// Once a check took place here, it alone counts, as the state file may still hold a first start that it could not drop.
UnixDateTime UpdateChecker::next_check_waits_from() const
{
    auto epoch = UnixDateTime::epoch();
    if (m_last_check.has_value())
        return last_check().value_or(epoch);
    auto first_start = max(read_state().first_start.value_or(epoch), m_first_start.value_or(epoch));
    return max(last_check().value_or(epoch), first_start);
}

void UpdateChecker::start()
{
    if (!BROWSER_IS_RELEASE_BUILD)
        return;
    m_started = true;

    if (auto state = read_state(); !state.first_start.has_value() && !state.last_check.has_value()) {
        state.first_start = m_first_start = UnixDateTime::now();
        write_state(state);
    }
    schedule();
}

void UpdateChecker::settings_changed()
{
    if (m_started)
        schedule();
}

void UpdateChecker::schedule()
{
    if (m_timer)
        m_timer->stop();
    if (!m_started || !Application::settings().automatic_update_checks_allowed())
        return;

    auto wait = min(time_until_next_update_check(next_check_waits_from(), UnixDateTime::now(), update_check_interval()), longest_timer_wait);

    m_timer = Core::Timer::create_single_shot(wait, [weak_this = make_weak_ptr()] {
        if (weak_this)
            weak_this->check_if_due();
    });
    m_timer->start();
}

void UpdateChecker::check_if_due()
{
    if (!m_started || !Application::settings().automatic_update_checks_allowed())
        return;

    // Another instance of Ladybird may have checked meanwhile.
    if (time_until_next_update_check(next_check_waits_from(), UnixDateTime::now(), update_check_interval()) > AK::Duration::zero()) {
        schedule();
        return;
    }
    check(UpdateCheckTrigger::Automatic);
}

void UpdateChecker::check(UpdateCheckTrigger trigger)
{
    if (trigger == UpdateCheckTrigger::UserInitiated && !BROWSER_IS_RELEASE_BUILD) {
        report({ .kind = UpdateCheckResult::Kind::DevelopmentBuild, .update = {} }, trigger);
        return;
    }

    if (!m_waiting_triggers.contains_slow(trigger))
        m_waiting_triggers.append(trigger);
    if (m_request)
        return;

    m_check_started = UnixDateTime::now();
    auto client = Application::request_server_client(IsPrivate::No);
    if (client.is_error()) {
        finish(client.release_error());
        return;
    }

    // The first check of each day, week and month counts this installation once for it, and the very first check counts
    // it for all three and marks the installation as new.
    CountedPeriods counted;
    if (BROWSER_IS_RELEASE_BUILD) {
        if (auto previous_check = last_check(); previous_check.has_value())
            counted = periods_begun_since(*previous_check, m_check_started);
        else
            counted = { ._new = true, .day = true, .week = true, .month = true };
    }

    auto headers = HTTP::HeaderList::create();
    headers->set({ "User-Agent"sv, Web::default_user_agent });
    headers->set({ "Ladybird-Update-Check"sv, update_check_header(describe_current_system(), BROWSER_VERSION ""sv, counted) });
    m_request = client.value()->start_request("GET"sv, URL::Parser::basic_parse(RELEASES_FEED_URL).release_value(), {}, *headers, {},
        HTTP::CacheMode::NoStore, HTTP::Cookie::IncludeCredentials::No);
    if (!m_request) {
        finish(Error::from_string_literal("Unable to start the request for releases.json"));
        return;
    }

    m_timeout = Core::Timer::create_single_shot(request_timeout, [weak_this = make_weak_ptr()] {
        if (weak_this && weak_this->m_request)
            weak_this->stop_request(Error::from_string_literal("The request for releases.json timed out"));
    });
    m_timeout->start();

    // The body is taken as it arrives, so that one larger than any releases.json stops the request before it grows any
    // further.
    m_payload.clear();
    m_request->set_unbuffered_request_callbacks(
        [weak_this = make_weak_ptr()](NonnullRefPtr<HTTP::HeaderList>, Optional<u32> response_code, Optional<String> const&, Requests::CacheState) {
            if (!weak_this || !weak_this->m_request)
                return;
            if (!response_code.has_value() || *response_code < 200 || *response_code >= 300) {
                warnln("Unable to check for updates: received HTTP status {}", response_code.value_or(0));
                weak_this->stop_request(Error::from_string_literal("The server did not send releases.json"));
            }
        },
        [weak_this = make_weak_ptr()](Requests::ResponseData data) {
            if (weak_this)
                weak_this->receive(data.bytes());
        },
        [weak_this = make_weak_ptr()](Core::ImmutableBytes data) {
            if (weak_this)
                weak_this->receive(data.bytes());
        },
        [weak_this = make_weak_ptr()](u64, Requests::RequestTimingInfo const&, Optional<Requests::NetworkError> network_error) {
            if (!weak_this || !weak_this->m_request)
                return;

            // A request cannot be destroyed from inside its own callback.
            Core::deferred_invoke([request = move(weak_this->m_request)] { });

            auto payload = move(weak_this->m_payload);
            if (network_error.has_value()) {
                warnln("Unable to check for updates: {}", Requests::network_error_to_string(*network_error));
                weak_this->finish(Error::from_string_literal("The request for releases.json failed"));
            } else {
                weak_this->finish(StringView { payload.bytes() });
            }
        });
}

void UpdateChecker::receive(ReadonlyBytes data)
{
    if (!m_request)
        return;
    if (data.size() > maximum_feed_size - m_payload.size()) {
        stop_request(Error::from_string_literal("releases.json is too large"));
        return;
    }
    if (auto result = m_payload.try_append(data); result.is_error())
        stop_request(result.release_error());
}

void UpdateChecker::stop_request(Error error)
{
    if (auto request = move(m_request)) {
        request->stop();

        // A request cannot be destroyed from inside its own callback.
        Core::deferred_invoke([request = move(request)] { });
    }
    m_payload.clear();
    finish(move(error));
}

void UpdateChecker::finish(ErrorOr<StringView> payload)
{
    if (m_timeout)
        m_timeout->stop();
    m_timeout = nullptr;
    auto triggers = move(m_waiting_triggers);

    auto system = describe_current_system();
    auto is_package = first_is_one_of(system.install_method, InstallMethod::DEB, InstallMethod::RPM, InstallMethod::Flatpak);
    Optional<String> newest;
    Optional<String> overdue;
    auto succeeded = false;
    if (payload.is_error()) {
        warnln("Unable to check for updates: {}", payload.error());
    } else if (auto release = newest_release_for_system(payload.value(), system); release.is_error()) {
        warnln("Unable to check for updates: {}", release.error());
    } else {
        newest = release.release_value();
        overdue = is_package ? MUST(newest_release_for_system(payload.value(), system, UnixDateTime::now() - package_update_grace_period)) : newest;
        succeeded = true;
    }

    // A check that failed is tried again once the interval has passed, like one that succeeded. A check took place when
    // it started, as that is when it counted the installation. Later checks wait from it alone, as a first start that the
    // clock was turned back past would otherwise make every check due at once.
    if (BROWSER_IS_RELEASE_BUILD) {
        auto state = read_state();
        state.first_start = m_first_start = {};
        state.last_check = m_last_check = m_check_started;
        write_state(state);
    }

    // An automatic check of a package reminds the user once a release has gone uninstalled for the grace period, and then
    // names the newest release, as that is the one that the system's updater installs.
    for (auto trigger : triggers) {
        UpdateCheckResult result;
        auto outdated_by = trigger == UpdateCheckTrigger::Automatic ? overdue : newest;
        if (!succeeded)
            result.kind = UpdateCheckResult::Kind::Failed;
        else if (outdated_by.has_value() && (trigger == UpdateCheckTrigger::Debug || is_newer_version(*outdated_by, BROWSER_VERSION ""sv)))
            result = { .kind = UpdateCheckResult::Kind::UpdateAvailable, .update = AvailableUpdate { *newest, system.install_method } };
        else
            result.kind = UpdateCheckResult::Kind::UpToDate;
        report(result, trigger);
    }
    schedule();
}

void UpdateChecker::report(UpdateCheckResult const& result, UpdateCheckTrigger trigger)
{
    if (trigger == UpdateCheckTrigger::Automatic) {
        if (result.kind != UpdateCheckResult::Kind::UpdateAvailable)
            return;
        if (read_state().skipped_version == result.update->version)
            return;
    }
    if (on_result)
        on_result(result, trigger);
}

void UpdateChecker::skip_version(String const& version)
{
    auto state = read_state();
    state.skipped_version = version;
    write_state(state);
}

#endif

}

    MacOSApp,
    DEB,
    RPM,
    Flatpak,
    AppImage,
    Source,

    X86_64,
    AArch64,
    Other,

    Optional<String> version_id;

    String version;
    InstallMethod install_method { InstallMethod::Source };

    Automatic,
    UserInitiated,
    Debug,

    enum class Kind : u8 {
        UpdateAvailable,
        UpToDate,
        DevelopmentBuild,
        Failed,
    };

    Kind kind { Kind::Failed };

    AK_MAKE_NONMOVABLE(UpdateChecker);

    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    explicit UpdateChecker(ByteString state_path);
    ~UpdateChecker();

    void start();
    void settings_changed();
    void check(UpdateCheckTrigger);
    void skip_version(String const&);

    Function<void(UpdateCheckResult const&, UpdateCheckTrigger)> on_result;

private:
    struct State {
        Optional<UnixDateTime> first_start;
        Optional<UnixDateTime> last_check;
        Optional<String> skipped_version;
    };

    State read_state() const;
    void write_state(State const&) const;
    Optional<UnixDateTime> last_check() const;
    UnixDateTime next_check_waits_from() const;

    void schedule();
    void check_if_due();
    void receive(ReadonlyBytes);
    void stop_request(Error);
    void finish(ErrorOr<StringView> payload);
    void report(UpdateCheckResult const&, UpdateCheckTrigger);

    ByteString m_state_path;
    bool m_started { false };
    Optional<UnixDateTime> m_first_start;
    Optional<UnixDateTime> m_last_check;
    UnixDateTime m_check_started;

    RefPtr<Core::Timer> m_timer;
    RefPtr<Core::Timer> m_timeout;
    RefPtr<Requests::Request> m_request;
    ByteBuffer m_payload;
    Vector<UpdateCheckTrigger> m_waiting_triggers;
};

bool is_url_handled_internally(URL::URL const& url)
{
    return Web::Fetch::Infrastructure::is_fetch_scheme(url.scheme());
