        traversable().for_each_hosting_page(send_offer_to_trust_self_signed_certificates);
}

Vector<SitePermissionRow> ViewImplementation::site_permission_rows() const
{
    auto origin = permission_origin();
    auto const& manager = *session().permission_manager;

    Vector<SitePermissionRow> rows;
    for (auto name : { Web::Permissions::PermissionName::Geolocation, Web::Permissions::PermissionName::Microphone, Web::Permissions::PermissionName::Notifications }) {
        auto decision = manager.decision(name, origin);
        rows.append({
            .name = name,
            .decision = decision,
            .one_time_grant_is_live = decision == PermissionDecision::AllowOnce,
            .requested_by_page = m_permissions_requested_by_page.contains_slow(name),
        });
    }
    return rows;
}

void ViewImplementation::set_site_permission(URL::Origin const& origin, Web::Permissions::PermissionName name, Optional<PermissionDecision> decision)
{
    session().permission_manager->set_decision(name, origin, decision);
}

void ViewImplementation::reset_site_permissions(URL::Origin const& origin)
{
    session().permission_manager->reset_origin(origin);
}

void ViewImplementation::did_request_permission(Badge<WebContentPage>, Web::Permissions::PermissionName name)
{
    if (!m_permissions_requested_by_page.contains_slow(name))
        m_permissions_requested_by_page.append(name);
}

class MicrophoneAuthorizerForTesting final : public MicrophoneAuthorizer {
public:
    MicrophoneAuthorizerForTesting(MicrophoneAuthorization authorization, MicrophoneAuthorization answer, bool held)
        : m_authorization(authorization)
        , m_answer(answer)
        , m_held(held)
    {
    }

    u64 requests() const { return m_requests; }

    void release()
    {
        m_held = false;
        for (auto& on_complete : exchange(m_waiting, {}))
            answer(move(on_complete));
    }

    virtual MicrophoneAuthorization authorization() const override { return m_authorization; }

    virtual void request_authorization(Function<void(MicrophoneAuthorization)> on_complete) override
    {
        ++m_requests;
        if (m_held) {
            m_waiting.append(move(on_complete));
            return;
        }
        answer(move(on_complete));
    }

    virtual void open_system_settings() override { }

private:
    void answer(Function<void(MicrophoneAuthorization)> on_complete)
    {
        m_authorization = m_answer;
        on_complete(m_authorization);
    }

    MicrophoneAuthorization m_authorization;
    MicrophoneAuthorization m_answer;
    bool m_held { false };
    u64 m_requests { 0 };
    Vector<Function<void(MicrophoneAuthorization)>> m_waiting;
};

MicrophoneAuthorizer& ViewImplementation::microphone_authorizer() const
{
    if (m_microphone_authorizer_for_testing)
        return *m_microphone_authorizer_for_testing;
    return Application::the().microphone_authorizer();
}

MicrophoneAuthorization ViewImplementation::microphone_authorization() const
{
    return microphone_authorizer().authorization();
}

void ViewImplementation::ensure_microphone_authorization(Function<void(bool authorized)> on_complete)
{
    // The notice is about the site that asked, which the tab may have left by the time the system answers.
    auto settle = [weak_this = make_weak_ptr(), requesting_origin = permission_origin(), on_complete = move(on_complete)](MicrophoneAuthorization authorization) {
        auto authorized = authorization == MicrophoneAuthorization::Authorized;
        if (auto* view = weak_this.ptr(); view && !authorized && view->permission_origin().is_same_origin(requesting_origin))
            view->show_microphone_denied_notice();
        on_complete(authorized);
    };

    auto authorization = microphone_authorization();
    if (authorization != MicrophoneAuthorization::NotDetermined) {
        settle(authorization);
        return;
    }
    microphone_authorizer().request_authorization(move(settle));
}

bool ViewImplementation::has_shown_microphone_denied_notice(URL::Origin const& top_level_origin) const
{
    return m_sites_shown_microphone_denied_notice.find_first_index_if([&](auto const& site) { return site.is_same_origin(top_level_origin); }).has_value();
}

void ViewImplementation::show_microphone_denied_notice()
{
    // Once the user has seen the notice, the site can't bring it back in this tab, however often it asks. The notice
    // goes through the prompts, so requests made while it waits to come up share it.
    auto top_level_origin = permission_origin();
    if (has_shown_microphone_denied_notice(top_level_origin))
        return;

    auto is_file = top_level_origin.is_opaque() && url().scheme() == "file"sv;
    PermissionPromptRequest request { Web::Permissions::PermissionName::Microphone, move(top_level_origin), is_file, false, PermissionPromptKind::SystemDeniedNotice };
    request_permission_prompt(move(request), [](Web::Permissions::PromptOutcome) { });
}

void ViewImplementation::did_show_permission_prompt(PermissionPromptRequest const& request)
{
    // A prompt that comes up again, once its hidden tab is shown, is still the one prompt.
    auto pending = m_pending_permission_prompts.find_if([&](auto const& candidate) { return candidate.request.is_same_request_as(request); });
    if (pending == m_pending_permission_prompts.end() || exchange(pending->shown, true))
        return;
    if (request.kind != PermissionPromptKind::SystemDeniedNotice)
        return;

    ++m_microphone_denied_notices_shown;
    if (!has_shown_microphone_denied_notice(request.top_level_origin))
        m_sites_shown_microphone_denied_notice.append(request.top_level_origin);
}

void ViewImplementation::set_microphone_authorization_for_testing(MicrophoneAuthorization authorization, MicrophoneAuthorization answer, bool held)
{
    m_microphone_authorizer_for_testing = make<MicrophoneAuthorizerForTesting>(authorization, answer, held);
}

void ViewImplementation::release_system_microphone_answer_for_testing()
{
    if (m_microphone_authorizer_for_testing)
        m_microphone_authorizer_for_testing->release();
}

u64 ViewImplementation::system_microphone_requests_for_testing() const
{
    return m_microphone_authorizer_for_testing ? m_microphone_authorizer_for_testing->requests() : 0;
}

void ViewImplementation::update_location_in_use()
{
    auto in_use = !m_geolocation_position_request_ids.is_empty() || !m_geolocation_watch_ids.is_empty();
    m_tab_indicators.set_active(TabIndicator::UsingLocation, in_use, MonotonicTime::now());
}

void ViewImplementation::revoke_geolocation_without_permission()
{
    using ErrorCode = Web::Geolocation::GeolocationPositionErrorCode;

    m_geolocation_request_documents.remove_all_matching([&](auto const& key, auto const&) {
        return !m_geolocation_position_request_ids.contains(key) && !m_geolocation_watch_ids.contains(key);
    });

    Vector<GeolocationRequestKey> revoked;
    for (auto const& it : m_geolocation_request_documents) {
        if (!it.key.page->document_may_use(it.value, Web::Permissions::PermissionName::Geolocation))
            revoked.append(it.key);
    }

    for (auto const& key : revoked) {
        m_geolocation_request_documents.remove(key);
        if (auto provider_request_id = m_geolocation_position_request_ids.take(key); provider_request_id.has_value())
            Application::the().cancel_geolocation_position_request(*provider_request_id);
        if (auto provider_watch_id = m_geolocation_watch_ids.take(key); provider_watch_id.has_value())
            Application::the().stop_watching_geolocation_position(*provider_watch_id);
        key.page->async_geolocation_position_response(key.request_id, {}, to_underlying(ErrorCode::PermissionDenied));
    }
    update_location_in_use();
}

void ViewImplementation::geolocation_settings_changed()
{
    using ErrorCode = Web::Geolocation::GeolocationPositionErrorCode;

    if (Application::web_content_options().is_test_mode != IsTestMode::Yes && !Application::the().sites_can_ask_for_location()) {
        auto geolocation_position_request_ids = move(m_geolocation_position_request_ids);
        for (auto const& request : geolocation_position_request_ids) {
            Application::the().cancel_geolocation_position_request(request.value);
            request.key.page->async_geolocation_position_response(request.key.request_id, {}, to_underlying(ErrorCode::PermissionDenied));
        }

        auto geolocation_watch_ids = move(m_geolocation_watch_ids);
        for (auto const& watch : geolocation_watch_ids) {
            Application::the().stop_watching_geolocation_position(watch.value);
            watch.key.page->async_geolocation_position_response(watch.key.request_id, {}, to_underlying(ErrorCode::PermissionDenied));
        }
        m_geolocation_request_documents.clear();
    }

    send_geolocation_emulated_position(page());
    traversable().for_each_hosting_page([&](WebContentPage& page) {
        if (&page != &this->page())
            send_geolocation_emulated_position(page);
    });
    update_location_in_use();
}

void ViewImplementation::send_geolocation_emulated_position(WebContentPage& page)
{
    using ErrorCode = Web::Geolocation::GeolocationPositionErrorCode;

    if (Application::web_content_options().is_test_mode == IsTestMode::Yes)
        page.async_set_geolocation_emulated_position({ 37.7647658, -122.4345892, 100.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0 }, {});
    else if (Application::the().sites_can_ask_for_location())
        page.async_set_geolocation_emulated_position({}, {});
    else
        page.async_set_geolocation_emulated_position({}, to_underlying(ErrorCode::PermissionDenied));
}

static ErrorOr<void> write_screenshot_to_path(ReadonlyBytes encoded, LexicalPath const& path)
{
    auto dump_file = TRY(Core::File::open(path.string(), Core::File::OpenMode::Write));
    TRY(dump_file->write_until_depleted(encoded));

    return {};
}

static NonnullRefPtr<Core::Promise<LexicalPath>> write_screenshot(Gfx::Bitmap const* bitmap)
{
    if (!bitmap)
        return Core::Promise<LexicalPath>::rejected(Error::from_string_literal("Failed to take a screenshot"));

    // NB: The bitmap may be gone, or show something else, by the time a path is chosen.
    auto encoded = Gfx::PNGWriter::encode(*bitmap);
    if (encoded.is_error())
        return Core::Promise<LexicalPath>::rejected(encoded.release_error());

    auto destination = [] {
        if (auto const& screenshot_path = Application::browser_options().screenshot_path; screenshot_path.has_value())
            return Core::Promise<LexicalPath>::resolved(LexicalPath { *screenshot_path });

        auto file = AK::UnixDateTime::now().to_byte_string("screenshot-%Y-%m-%d-%H-%M-%S.png"sv);
        return Application::the().path_for_downloaded_file(file);
    }();

    auto promise = Core::Promise<LexicalPath>::construct();
    destination
        ->when_resolved([promise, encoded = encoded.release_value()](auto const& path) {
            if (auto result = write_screenshot_to_path(encoded, path); result.is_error())
                promise->reject(result.release_error());
            else
                promise->resolve(path);
        })
        .when_rejected([promise](auto& error) {
            promise->reject(move(error));
        });
    return promise;
}

static void report_saved_screenshot(Core::Promise<LexicalPath>& screenshot)
{
    screenshot
        .when_resolved([](auto const& path) {
            Application::the().display_download_confirmation_dialog("Screenshot"sv, path);
        })
        .when_rejected([](auto const& error) {
            if (error.is_errno() && error.code() == ECANCELED)
                return;

            auto error_message = MUST(String::formatted("{}", error));
            Application::the().display_error_dialog(error_message);
        });
}

NonnullRefPtr<Core::Promise<LexicalPath>> ViewImplementation::take_screenshot(ScreenshotType type)
{
    if (m_pending_screenshot) {
        // For simplicity, only allow taking one screenshot at a time for now. Revisit if we need
        // to allow spamming screenshot requests for some reason.
        return Core::Promise<LexicalPath>::rejected(Error::from_string_literal("A screenshot request is already in progress"));
    }

    switch (type) {
    case ScreenshotType::Visible: {
        RefPtr<Gfx::Bitmap> visible_bitmap;
        if (auto frame = m_backing_stores->displayed_frame(); frame.has_value() && frame->shared_image_buffer)
            visible_bitmap = frame->shared_image_buffer->bitmap_if_present();
        if (visible_bitmap)
            return write_screenshot(visible_bitmap.ptr());

        // GPU-shared backing stores have no CPU-visible pixels, so ask WebContent to paint a screenshot for us.
        break;
    }

    case ScreenshotType::Full:
        break;
    }

    auto promise = Core::Promise<LexicalPath>::construct();
    m_pending_screenshot = promise;
    page().async_take_document_screenshot();
    return promise;
}

void ViewImplementation::take_and_save_screenshot(ScreenshotType type)
{
    report_saved_screenshot(*take_screenshot(type));
}

// A screenshot the UI took itself, such as of the part of the page the user selected.
void ViewImplementation::save_screenshot(Gfx::Bitmap const& bitmap)
{
    report_saved_screenshot(*write_screenshot(&bitmap));
}

NonnullRefPtr<Core::Promise<LexicalPath>> ViewImplementation::take_dom_node_screenshot(Web::UniqueNodeID node_id)
{
    auto promise = Core::Promise<LexicalPath>::construct();

    if (m_pending_screenshot) {
        // For simplicity, only allow taking one screenshot at a time for now. Revisit if we need
        // to allow spamming screenshot requests for some reason.
        promise->reject(Error::from_string_literal("A screenshot request is already in progress"));
        return promise;
    }

    m_pending_screenshot = promise;
    page().async_take_dom_node_screenshot(node_id);

    return promise;
}

void ViewImplementation::did_receive_screenshot(Badge<WebContentPage>, Gfx::ShareableBitmap const& screenshot)
{
    // A renderer answers a screenshot request; any other screenshot it sends is misbehavior.
    if (!m_pending_screenshot) {
        page().client().did_misbehave("did_take_screenshot"sv, "no screenshot was requested"sv);
        return;
    }

    write_screenshot(screenshot.bitmap())
        ->when_resolved([pending_screenshot = m_pending_screenshot](auto const& path) {
            pending_screenshot->resolve(path);
        })
        .when_rejected([pending_screenshot = m_pending_screenshot](auto& error) {
            pending_screenshot->reject(move(error));
        });

    m_pending_screenshot = nullptr;
}

NonnullRefPtr<Core::Promise<String>> ViewImplementation::request_internal_page_info(PageInfoType type)
{
    auto promise = Core::Promise<String>::construct();

    if (m_pending_info_request) {
        // For simplicity, only allow one info request at a time for now.
        promise->reject(Error::from_string_literal("A page info request is already in progress"));
        return promise;
    }

    m_pending_info_request = promise;
    page().async_request_internal_page_info(type);

    return promise;
}

void ViewImplementation::did_receive_internal_page_info(Badge<WebContentPage>, PageInfoType, Optional<Core::AnonymousBuffer> const& info)
{
    // A renderer answers a page info request; any other page info it sends is misbehavior.
    if (!m_pending_info_request) {
        page().client().did_misbehave("did_get_internal_page_info"sv, "no page info was requested"sv);
        return;
    }

    String info_string;
    if (!info.has_value()) {
        info_string = "(no page)"_string;
    } else {
        info_string = String::from_utf8_with_replacement_character(StringView { info->bytes() });
    }
    m_pending_info_request->resolve(move(info_string));
    m_pending_info_request = nullptr;
}

ErrorOr<LexicalPath> ViewImplementation::dump_gc_graph()
{
    auto promise = request_internal_page_info(PageInfoType::GCGraph);
    auto gc_graph_json = TRY(promise->await());

    LexicalPath path { Core::StandardPaths::tempfile_directory() };
    path = path.append(TRY(AK::UnixDateTime::now().to_string("gc-graph-%Y-%m-%d-%H-%M-%S.js"sv)));

    // Write as a .js file so gc-heap-explorer.html can load it via <script> tag (avoiding CORS issues with file:// URLs)
    auto dump_file = TRY(Core::File::open(path.string(), Core::File::OpenMode::Write));
    TRY(dump_file->write_until_depleted("var GC_GRAPH_DUMP = "sv.bytes()));
    TRY(dump_file->write_until_depleted(gc_graph_json.bytes()));
    TRY(dump_file->write_until_depleted(";\n"sv.bytes()));

    return path;
}

void ViewImplementation::send_context_menu_request(ContextMenuRequest request, Gfx::IntPoint content_position)
{
    request.widget_position = to_widget_position(content_position);
    request.can_inspect_element = static_cast<bool>(on_inspect_element_request);
    did_request_context_menu(move(request));
}

void ViewImplementation::inspect_context_menu_element()
{
    if (m_inspect_element_hit_test_request_id.has_value())
        m_inspect_element_activated_before_hit_test = true;
    else if (m_inspect_element_node_id.has_value() && on_inspect_element_request)
        on_inspect_element_request(*m_inspect_element_node_id);
}

void ViewImplementation::replace_context_menu_misspelling(Utf16String const& replacement)
{
    if (m_spelling_context_menu_page && m_spelling_context_menu_page->is_open())
        m_spelling_context_menu_page->async_replace_context_menu_misspelling(replacement);
}

void ViewImplementation::do_context_menu_media_action(ContextMenuMediaAction action)
{
    if (!m_media_context_menu_page || !m_media_context_menu_page->is_open())
        return;

    auto& page = *m_media_context_menu_page;
    switch (action) {
    case ContextMenuMediaAction::TogglePlay:
        page.async_toggle_media_play_state();
        break;
    case ContextMenuMediaAction::ToggleMute:
        page.async_toggle_media_mute_state();
        break;
    case ContextMenuMediaAction::ToggleControls:
        page.async_toggle_media_controls_state();
        break;
    case ContextMenuMediaAction::ToggleLoop:
        page.async_toggle_media_loop_state();
        break;
    case ContextMenuMediaAction::TogglePictureInPicture:
        page.async_toggle_media_picture_in_picture_state();
        break;
    case ContextMenuMediaAction::ToggleFullscreen:
        page.async_toggle_media_fullscreen_state();
        break;
    }
}

void ViewImplementation::request_context_menu_dictionary_lookup(Function<void(Optional<DictionaryLookup> const&)> on_complete)
{
    if (!on_request_dictionary_lookup) {
        Optional<DictionaryLookup> lookup;
        on_complete(lookup);
        return;
    }

    selected_text_for_dictionary_lookup()->when_resolved([on_complete = move(on_complete)](auto& lookup) mutable {
        on_complete(lookup);
    });
}

void ViewImplementation::reject_pending_selection_requests()
{
    ++m_context_menu_request_id;

    auto reject_requests = [](auto& requests) {
        auto pending_requests = move(requests);
        for (auto& request : pending_requests)
            request.value->reject(Error::from_string_literal("WebContent was replaced before completing a selection request"));
    };

    reject_requests(m_pending_selected_text_requests);
    reject_requests(m_pending_selected_text_for_lookup_requests);
    reject_requests(m_pending_select_word_for_dictionary_lookup_requests);
    reject_requests(m_pending_cut_selected_text_requests);
}

SpellChecker::DocumentTag ViewImplementation::spell_document_tag()
{
    auto* spell_checker = Application::the().spell_checker();
    VERIFY(spell_checker);
    if (!m_spell_document_tag.has_value())
        m_spell_document_tag = spell_checker->create_document_tag();
    return *m_spell_document_tag;
}

void ViewImplementation::did_request_spell_check(Badge<WebContentPage>, WebContentPage& requesting_page, u64 request_id, Utf16String text)
{
    auto* spell_checker = Application::the().spell_checker();
    if (!spell_checker) {
        requesting_page.async_did_check_spelling(request_id, {});
        return;
    }
    spell_checker->check(spell_document_tag(), text, [page = NonnullRefPtr { requesting_page }, request_id](Vector<Web::SpellingError> errors) {
        if (page->is_open())
            page->async_did_check_spelling(request_id, move(errors));
    });
}

void ViewImplementation::did_request_writing_suggestion(Badge<WebContentPage>, WebContentPage& requesting_page, u64 request_id, Utf16String text, u32 caret_offset)
{
    auto* spell_checker = Application::the().spell_checker();
    if (!spell_checker) {
        requesting_page.async_did_get_writing_suggestion(request_id, {});
        return;
    }
    spell_checker->suggest(spell_document_tag(), text, caret_offset, [page = NonnullRefPtr { requesting_page }, request_id](Optional<Web::WritingSuggestion> suggestion) {
        if (page->is_open())
            page->async_did_get_writing_suggestion(request_id, move(suggestion));
    });
}

// Forgets what the user told the spellchecker to ignore or learn in this tab.
void ViewImplementation::reset_spell_checking()
{
    if (auto* spell_checker = Application::the().spell_checker(); spell_checker && m_spell_document_tag.has_value())
        spell_checker->close_document_tag(*m_spell_document_tag);
    m_spell_document_tag.clear();
    if (m_top_level_traversable) {
        traversable().for_each_hosting_page([](WebContentPage& page) {
            if (page.is_open())
                page.async_forget_accepted_spelling_words();
        });
    }
}

void ViewImplementation::update_context_menu_misspelling(Optional<Utf16String> misspelled_word, Function<void()> on_complete)
{
    auto* spell_checker = Application::the().spell_checker();
    m_context_menu_misspelled_word = spell_checker ? move(misspelled_word) : OptionalNone {};
    m_spelling_guesses.clear();
    if (!m_context_menu_misspelled_word.has_value()) {
        on_complete();
        return;
    }

    auto request_id = m_context_menu_request_id;
    spell_checker->guesses(spell_document_tag(), *m_context_menu_misspelled_word, [weak_this = make_weak_ptr(), request_id, on_complete = move(on_complete)](Vector<Utf16String> guesses) {
        if (!weak_this || request_id != weak_this->m_context_menu_request_id)
            return;
        if (guesses.size() > MAX_SPELLING_GUESSES)
            guesses.shrink(MAX_SPELLING_GUESSES);
        weak_this->m_spelling_guesses = move(guesses);
        on_complete();
    });
}

void ViewImplementation::ignore_misspelling(Utf16String const& word)
{
    auto* spell_checker = Application::the().spell_checker();
    if (!spell_checker)
        return;
    spell_checker->ignore(spell_document_tag(), word);
    // An ignored word holds for this tab, so every page of the tab drops its markers for it.
    traversable().for_each_hosting_page([&](WebContentPage& page) {
        page.async_accept_spelling_word(word);
    });
}

void ViewImplementation::learn_misspelling(Utf16String const& word)
{
    auto* spell_checker = Application::the().spell_checker();
    if (!spell_checker)
        return;
    spell_checker->learn(spell_document_tag(), word);
    // A learned word goes in the user's dictionary for every app, so every page of every tab drops its markers for it.
    // A spellchecker that learns for this tab's tag alone gets the word dropped from this tab alone.
    if (!spell_checker->learns_for_every_tag()) {
        traversable().for_each_hosting_page([&](WebContentPage& page) {
            page.async_accept_spelling_word(word);
        });
        return;
    }
    for_each_view([&](ViewImplementation& view) {
        if (view.m_top_level_traversable) {
            view.traversable().for_each_hosting_page([&](WebContentPage& page) {
                page.async_accept_spelling_word(word);
            });
        }
        return IterationDecision::Continue;
    });
}

void ViewImplementation::activate_spelling_menu_action_for_testing(Badge<WebContentPage>, WebContentPage& requesting_page, Web::SpellingMenuActionForTesting action, u32 guess_index)
{
    // NB: This describes the spelling items a context menu offers, as the application shows them.
    StringBuilder description;
    if (m_context_menu_misspelled_word.has_value()) {
        for (auto const& guess : m_spelling_guesses) {
            if (!description.is_empty())
                description.append(" | "sv);
            description.append(guess);
        }
        if (m_spelling_guesses.is_empty())
            description.append("No Guesses Found"sv);
        description.append(" | Ignore Spelling | Learn Spelling"sv);
    } else {
        description.append("(no spelling items)"sv);
    }

    switch (action) {
    case Web::SpellingMenuActionForTesting::None:
        break;
    case Web::SpellingMenuActionForTesting::Guess:
        if (m_context_menu_misspelled_word.has_value() && guess_index < m_spelling_guesses.size())
            replace_context_menu_misspelling(m_spelling_guesses[guess_index]);
        break;
    case Web::SpellingMenuActionForTesting::IgnoreSpelling:
        if (m_context_menu_misspelled_word.has_value())
            ignore_misspelling(*m_context_menu_misspelled_word);
        break;
    case Web::SpellingMenuActionForTesting::LearnSpelling:
        if (m_context_menu_misspelled_word.has_value())
            learn_misspelling(*m_context_menu_misspelled_word);
        break;
    }
    // The page gets this after whatever the action sent it, on the same connection.
    requesting_page.async_did_complete_spelling_menu_action_for_testing(MUST(description.to_string()));
}

void ViewImplementation::request_text_fragment_url(Optional<u64> generation_id)
{
    m_pending_text_fragment_url_request_id.clear();
    // NB: The link of an earlier context menu goes before the new menu is asked for, as the link can come first.
    did_make_link_to_highlight({});
    if (!generation_id.has_value())
        return;

    auto request_id = m_next_text_fragment_url_request_id++;
    m_pending_text_fragment_url_request_id = request_id;
    page().client().async_generate_text_fragment_url(page().id(), request_id, *generation_id);
}

void ViewImplementation::did_generate_text_fragment_url(u64 request_id, Optional<URL::URL> url)
{
    if (!m_pending_text_fragment_url_request_id.has_value() || *m_pending_text_fragment_url_request_id != request_id)
        return;
    m_pending_text_fragment_url_request_id.clear();
    did_make_link_to_highlight(move(url));
}

void ViewImplementation::prepare_inspect_element(Gfx::IntPoint content_position)
{
    m_inspect_element_node_id.clear();
    m_inspect_element_hit_test_request_id.clear();
    m_inspect_element_activated_before_hit_test = false;

    if (!on_inspect_element_request)
        return;

    auto request_id = m_next_node_hit_test_request_id++;
    m_inspect_element_hit_test_request_id = request_id;
    page().async_get_node_id_at_position(request_id, { content_position.x(), content_position.y() });
}

void ViewImplementation::did_request_page_context_menu(Badge<WebContentPage>, WebContentPage& requesting_page, Gfx::IntPoint content_position, Web::ContextMenuForInputEventsTarget for_input_events_target, Optional<Utf16String> misspelled_word, Optional<u64> text_fragment_generation_id)
{
    request_text_fragment_url(text_fragment_generation_id);
    prepare_inspect_element(content_position);
    m_spelling_context_menu_page = requesting_page;

    auto request_id = ++m_context_menu_request_id;
    auto weak_this = make_weak_ptr();
    auto makes_link_to_highlight = text_fragment_generation_id.has_value();
    // NB: The menu lists the guesses for a misspelled word, so it waits for them.
    update_context_menu_misspelling(move(misspelled_word), [weak_this, request_id, content_position, for_input_events_target, makes_link_to_highlight] {
        if (!weak_this || request_id != weak_this->m_context_menu_request_id)
            return;
        weak_this->request_context_menu_dictionary_lookup([weak_this, request_id, content_position, for_input_events_target, makes_link_to_highlight](auto const& lookup) {
            if (!weak_this || request_id != weak_this->m_context_menu_request_id)
                return;

            auto open_menu = [weak_this, request_id, content_position, for_input_events_target, lookup, makes_link_to_highlight](Optional<String> selected_text) {
                if (!weak_this || request_id != weak_this->m_context_menu_request_id)
                    return;

                ContextMenuRequest request;
                request.kind = ContextMenuKind::Page;
                request.is_editable = for_input_events_target == Web::ContextMenuForInputEventsTarget::Yes;
                request.selected_text = move(selected_text);
                request.dictionary_lookup = lookup;
                if (lookup.has_value() && weak_this->on_request_dictionary_lookup)
                    request.dictionary_lookup_position = weak_this->to_widget_position(lookup->baseline_origin.value_or(content_position));
                else
                    request.dictionary_lookup.clear();
                request.misspelled_word = weak_this->m_context_menu_misspelled_word;
                request.spelling_guesses = weak_this->m_spelling_guesses;
                request.makes_link_to_highlight = makes_link_to_highlight;
                weak_this->send_context_menu_request(move(request), content_position);
            };

            if (lookup.has_value()) {
                open_menu(lookup->text);
                return;
            }

            weak_this->selected_text_with_whitespace_collapsed()->when_resolved([open_menu = move(open_menu)](auto& selected_text) mutable {
                open_menu(selected_text);
            });
        });
    });
}

void ViewImplementation::did_request_link_context_menu(Badge<WebContentPage>, Gfx::IntPoint content_position, Web::HTML::PreparedNavigationDescriptor navigation, Optional<u64> text_fragment_generation_id)
{
    request_text_fragment_url(text_fragment_generation_id);
    prepare_inspect_element(content_position);
    ++m_context_menu_request_id;

    ContextMenuRequest request;
    request.kind = ContextMenuKind::Link;
    request.link_navigation = move(navigation);
    request.makes_link_to_highlight = text_fragment_generation_id.has_value();
    send_context_menu_request(move(request), content_position);
}

void ViewImplementation::download_url(URL::URL const& url, PromptForPath prompt_for_path, Optional<String> const& image_mime_type)
{
    // URLs with an opaque path, such as data: URLs, do not contain a usable filename, so the default filename is
    // used instead.
    auto suggested_filename = url.has_an_opaque_path() ? ByteString {} : url.basename();
    if (image_mime_type.has_value())
        suggested_filename = image_filename_with_extension(move(suggested_filename), *image_mime_type);

    if (prompt_for_path == PromptForPath::No) {
        if (auto download_path = Application::the().default_path_for_downloaded_file(suggested_filename); !download_path.is_error())
            Application::the().file_downloader().download_file(is_private(), url, download_path.release_value(), FileDownloader::MayReplaceDestination::No);
        return;
    }

    Application::the().path_for_downloaded_file(suggested_filename)->when_resolved([is_private = is_private(), url](auto const& download_path) {
        // NB: A file at a path the user chose was there when the user chose to replace it, as saving asks before replacing.
        auto may_replace_destination = FileSystem::exists(download_path.string())
            ? FileDownloader::MayReplaceDestination::Yes
            : FileDownloader::MayReplaceDestination::No;
        Application::the().file_downloader().download_file(is_private, url, download_path, may_replace_destination);
    });
}

void ViewImplementation::did_request_image_context_menu(Badge<WebContentPage>, Gfx::IntPoint content_position, Web::HTML::PreparedNavigationDescriptor navigation, Optional<Gfx::ShareableBitmap> bitmap, Optional<Web::HTML::PreparedNavigationDescriptor> link_navigation, Optional<String> image_mime_type)
{
    prepare_inspect_element(content_position);
    ++m_context_menu_request_id;

    ContextMenuRequest request;
    request.kind = ContextMenuKind::Image;
    request.navigation = move(navigation);
    request.image_bitmap = move(bitmap);
    request.link_navigation = move(link_navigation);
    request.image_mime_type = move(image_mime_type);
    send_context_menu_request(move(request), content_position);
}

void ViewImplementation::did_request_media_context_menu(Badge<WebContentPage>, WebContentPage& requesting_page, Gfx::IntPoint content_position, Web::MediaContextMenu media, Optional<Web::HTML::PreparedNavigationDescriptor> navigation)
{
    prepare_inspect_element(content_position);
    ++m_context_menu_request_id;

    m_media_context_menu_page = requesting_page;

    ContextMenuRequest request;
    request.kind = ContextMenuKind::Media;
    request.media = move(media);
    request.navigation = move(navigation);
    send_context_menu_request(move(request), content_position);
}

u64 ViewImplementation::add_navigation_listener(NavigationListener listener)
{
    auto id = m_next_navigation_listener_id++;
    m_navigation_listeners.set(id, move(listener));
    return id;
}

void ViewImplementation::remove_navigation_listener(u64 listener_id)
{
    m_navigation_listeners.remove(listener_id);
}

void ViewImplementation::request_close()
{
    if (m_debugger_paused) {
        resume_debugger(DebuggerResumeMode::Continue);
        set_debugger_paused(false);
    }

    if (needs_beforeunload_check()) {
        page().async_request_close();
        return;
    }

    page().request_close();
}

void ViewImplementation::force_close()
{
    page().async_force_close();
}

void ViewImplementation::request_close_preflight(Function<void(bool)> on_complete)
{
    auto request_id = m_next_close_preflight_request_id++;
    auto page_id = page().id();
    m_pending_close_preflight_requests.set(request_id, { page_id, move(on_complete) });
    page().async_request_close_preflight(request_id);
}

void ViewImplementation::did_complete_close_preflight(Badge<WebContentPage>, u64 request_id, bool approved)
{
    if (auto request = m_pending_close_preflight_requests.take(request_id); request.has_value())
        request->on_complete(approved);
}

Function<void()> ViewImplementation::prepare_for_close_without_prompting()
{
    if (m_debugger_paused) {
        resume_debugger(DebuggerResumeMode::Continue);
        set_debugger_paused(false);
    }

    NonnullRefPtr closing_page = page();
    closing_page->set_detached_close_pending(true);
    return [closing_page = move(closing_page)] {
        closing_page->async_request_close_without_prompting();
    };
}

void ViewImplementation::prepare_for_immediate_close()
{
    VERIFY(!needs_beforeunload_check());

    if (m_debugger_paused) {
        resume_debugger(DebuggerResumeMode::Continue);
        set_debugger_paused(false);
    }

    page().set_detached_close_pending(true);
}

// The way a frontend closes a tab with no beforeunload check to run: the view goes without waiting for its page.
void ViewImplementation::close_tab_for_testing()
{
    prepare_for_immediate_close();
    if (on_close)
        on_close();
}

}

class MicrophoneAuthorizerForTesting;

struct GeolocationRequestKey {
    NonnullRefPtr<WebContentPage> page;
    u64 request_id { 0 };

    bool operator==(GeolocationRequestKey const&) const = default;
};

enum class PermissionPromptKind : u8 {
    Question,
    // Tells the user the system keeps the feature from the browser, so no site can have it. Its answer decides nothing.
    SystemDeniedNotice,
};

// What the UI shows the user when a site asks for a permission. The origin is the top-level one the decision is kept
// for; a file: page has none worth showing, so the prompt names it as a file instead.
struct PermissionPromptRequest {
    Web::Permissions::PermissionName name;
    URL::Origin top_level_origin;
    bool is_file { false };
    bool show_os_hint { false };
    PermissionPromptKind kind { PermissionPromptKind::Question };

    bool is_same_request_as(PermissionPromptRequest const& other) const
    {
        return name == other.name && kind == other.kind && is_file == other.is_file && top_level_origin.is_same_origin(other.top_level_origin);
    }
};

using PermissionPromptCallback = Function<void(Web::Permissions::PromptOutcome)>;

// One permission as the site information panel shows it for the site a view shows.
struct SitePermissionRow {
    Web::Permissions::PermissionName name;
    Optional<PermissionDecision> decision;
    bool one_time_grant_is_live { false };
    bool requested_by_page { false };
};

class WEBVIEW_API ViewImplementation
    : public SettingsObserver
    , public Weakable<ViewImplementation> {
    friend class WebContentClient;
    friend class WebContentPage;
    friend class CanonicalTraversable;

public:
    virtual ~ViewImplementation();

    static void for_each_view(Function<IterationDecision(ViewImplementation&)>);
    static Optional<ViewImplementation&> find_view_by_id(u64);

    IsPrivate is_private() const { return m_is_private; }
    BrowsingSession& session() const { return *m_session; }

    // Asks the user, unless an identical prompt is already up, in which case its answer goes to every request for it.
    void request_permission_prompt(PermissionPromptRequest, PermissionPromptCallback);
    void set_next_permission_prompt_outcome_for_testing(Web::Permissions::PermissionName, Web::Permissions::PromptOutcome, bool held);
    // Answers the held prompt once this many requests wait on it, since the requests arrive over another connection.
    void release_held_permission_prompt_for_testing(u32 waiters);
    void reset_permission_prompts_for_testing();

    // The origin the view's permissions are kept for: its top-level document's, which an inherited about:blank keeps
    // while the URL's origin is opaque.
    URL::Origin permission_origin() const;
    // The site information panel's view of, and changes to, the permissions of the site this view shows.
    Vector<SitePermissionRow> site_permission_rows() const;
    // These act on the site given, which a panel showing it keeps even after the view moves on to another site.
    void set_site_permission(URL::Origin const&, Web::Permissions::PermissionName, Optional<PermissionDecision>);
    void reset_site_permissions(URL::Origin const&);
    void did_request_permission(Badge<WebContentPage>, Web::Permissions::PermissionName);

    MicrophoneAuthorization microphone_authorization() const;
    // Calls back with whether the system lets the browser use the microphone, once the system has asked the user if it
    // never has. The user is told why when it doesn't.
    void ensure_microphone_authorization(Function<void(bool authorized)>);
    // Tells the user the system keeps the microphone from the browser, unless this tab has already shown them that for
    // the site it shows.
    void show_microphone_denied_notice();
    // The UI calls this each time a prompt comes up on screen.
    void did_show_permission_prompt(PermissionPromptRequest const&);

    // The system answers with answer when it's asked, which it is while authorization is NotDetermined. A held answer
    // waits for release_system_microphone_answer_for_testing().
    void set_microphone_authorization_for_testing(MicrophoneAuthorization authorization, MicrophoneAuthorization answer, bool held);
    void release_system_microphone_answer_for_testing();
    u64 system_microphone_requests_for_testing() const;
    u64 microphone_denied_notices_shown_for_testing() const { return m_microphone_denied_notices_shown; }

    // Ends every location request and watch whose document the user has since taken the permission away from.
    void revoke_geolocation_without_permission();

    u64 view_id() const { return m_view_id; }
    pid_t web_content_pid() const;

    // A view that shows a page on behalf of another view, such as a Picture-in-Picture window, is part of that view's
    // tab rather than a tab or window of its own.
    Optional<u64> owner_view_id() const { return m_owner_view_id; }
    // The view whose tab this view is part of, which is none for a view whose owner is gone or that has left its tab.
    Optional<ViewImplementation&> tab_view();
    // The owner's document that this view acts for, which limits what the view is allowed, until it leaves the tab.
    CanonicalDocument const* owner_document() const { return m_owner_document.ptr(); }
    void set_owner_document(Badge<PictureInPictureWindow>, CanonicalDocument const& document) { m_owner_document = document; }
    void did_leave_owners_tab(Badge<PictureInPictureWindow>);

    CanonicalTraversable& traversable() const;
    bool has_traversable() const { return m_top_level_traversable != nullptr; }
    // A page that comes to host any navigable of the tab gets the tab's settings: the spoofed User-Agent and
    // navigator compatibility mode, the preferred languages and color scheme, the window geometry, and the rest of
    // what the UI decides for the tab. A page that displays the tab gets its viewport and focus on top of that.
    virtual void prepare_page_for_navigable(WebContentPage&);
    void prepare_page_for_tab(WebContentPage&);
    void did_change_display_page(Badge<CanonicalNavigable>, RefPtr<WebContentPage> previous_page);
    void did_cancel_loading(Badge<CanonicalNavigable>, bool canceled_navigation);
    void did_stop_loading(Badge<CanonicalTraversable>, bool stopped_navigation);
    void did_change_ongoing_navigation(Badge<CanonicalNavigable>);
    void did_change_active_document(Badge<CanonicalTraversable>);

    void set_text_fragment_indication_visibility(Badge<WebContentPage>, bool);
    // The URL of the tab's active document.
    URL::URL url() const;
    URL::URL const& displayed_url() const { return m_displayed_url; }

    void set_title(Badge<WebContentPage>, Utf16String title) { set_title(move(title)); }
    Utf16String const& title() const { return m_title; }

    void set_favicon(Badge<WebContentPage>, Optional<Gfx::Bitmap const&> favicon) { set_favicon(favicon); }

    String const& handle() const { return m_window_handle; }

    void server_did_paint(Badge<WebContentPage>, i32 bitmap_id, Gfx::IntSize size, Gfx::IntRect damage_rect, double device_pixel_ratio);
    // The Compositor showed the frame itself, in the remote layer of this view.
    void server_did_present_frame_in_remote_layer(Badge<WebContentPage>, Gfx::IntSize size, Gfx::IntRect damage_rect, double device_pixel_ratio);

    void set_window_position(Gfx::IntPoint);
    void set_window_size(Gfx::IntSize);
    void set_system_visibility_state(Web::HTML::VisibilityState);

    // A tab that the user doesn't see may be discarded: its pages close, so that the processes hosting them can let go
    // of their memory, and the tab stays in the tab strip to restore its current session history entry once the user
    // comes back to it.
    enum class DiscardReason : u8 {
        // The system is about to run out of memory.
        MemoryPressure,
        // The tab was hidden for long, without doing anything the user could notice.
        Inactivity,
    };
    bool may_be_discarded(DiscardReason, AK::Duration minimum_time_hidden, MonotonicTime now) const;
    DiscardBlockers discard_blockers(DiscardReason, MonotonicTime now) const;
    // Whether discarding the view would let a process exit, which is how its memory comes back.
    bool discarding_ends_a_process() const;
    void set_pinned(bool pinned);
    void set_current_tab_of_window(bool current_tab_of_window);
    // When the user last stopped seeing the view, if they don't see it now.

    // Shown by about:certificate so only the user, never a web page, can answer it.
    struct CertificateWarning {
        URL::URL url;
        BrowsingSession::CertificateException certificate;
        // Resubmit after trust: the failed TLS handshake prevented the server from receiving this form.
        Optional<Web::HTML::POSTResource> form_submission;
        URL::Origin form_initiator_origin;
        // A form another site submitted isn't sent again: the browser's UI would send it as the user's own.
        bool form_is_not_resent { false };
    };

    struct PendingInputEvent {
        Web::InputEvent event;

        // The page handling the event, which is not the view's own page when another process hosts the focused
        // navigable. A lost page never finishes the events it held.
        NonnullRefPtr<WebContentPage> endpoint;

        // Set once a page forwarded the event to a child frame another process hosts.
        bool forwarded_to_child_frame { false };

        // Unset while the event waits for the compositor to decide where an earlier key event goes.
        bool sent { false };

        // Set while the compositor decides whether it consumes the event, forwards it or hands it back. A compositor
        // that dies forwards none of the events still marked this way.
        bool routed_through_compositor { false };

        // Set while an answer of the compositor is still to come for a trip through it that WebContent already finished.
        bool expects_stale_compositor_answer { false };

        // A key event stays routed through the compositor until it forwards the event or hands it back. Later input
        // waits until then.
        bool awaits_compositor_dispatch() const { return routed_through_compositor && event.has<Web::KeyEvent>(); }

        // When the view delivered an event that gives user activation, until something consumes that activation.
        Optional<MonotonicTime> user_activation_time {};

        // When the view delivered a paste shortcut, until the page reads the clipboard for it.
        Optional<MonotonicTime> paste_shortcut_time {};
    };
    Vector<PendingInputEvent> m_pending_input_events;

struct AK::Traits<WebView::GeolocationRequestKey> : public AK::DefaultTraits<WebView::GeolocationRequestKey> {
    static unsigned hash(WebView::GeolocationRequestKey const& key)
    {
        return pair_int_hash(ptr_hash(key.page.ptr()), u64_hash(key.request_id));
    }
};

namespace WebView {

static constexpr auto diagnostics_reference = "diagnostics"sv;
static constexpr auto diagnostics_name = "webcompat-diagnostics.txt"sv;
static constexpr auto screenshot_reference = "screenshot"sv;
static constexpr auto screenshot_name = "screenshot.png"sv;

static constexpr auto browser_version = BROWSER_VERSION ""sv;
static constexpr auto platform = OS_STRING ""sv;
static constexpr auto architecture = CPU_STRING ""sv;

static constexpr auto build_configuration = BROWSER_BUILD_CONFIGURATION ""sv;

static String to_string(StringView text)
{
    return String::from_utf8_with_replacement_character(text);
}

static String format_viewport_size(Gfx::IntSize size)
{
    return MUST(String::formatted("{}x{}", size.width(), size.height()));
}

static String format_zoom_level(double zoom_level)
{
    return MUST(String::formatted("{}%", round_to<int>(zoom_level * 100)));
}

WebCompatReport::Page WebCompatReport::describe_page(ViewImplementation const& view)
{
    // The viewport in CSS pixels, as the page sees it.
    auto device_size = view.viewport_size();
    auto scale = view.device_pixel_ratio() * view.zoom_level();
    Gfx::IntSize viewport_size {
        round_to<int>(static_cast<double>(device_size.width().value()) / scale),
        round_to<int>(static_cast<double>(device_size.height().value()) / scale),
    };

    return {
        .url = view.url(),
        .user_agent = Application::the().user_agent_string(),
        .viewport_size = viewport_size,
        .device_pixel_ratio = view.device_pixel_ratio(),
        .zoom_level = view.zoom_level(),
    };
}

// The dumps of how the page was laid out and painted, taken together so they describe the same moment. Each one starts
// with what it is: the layout tree with its viewport, the stacking context tree with "SC for", and the display list with
// its visual context tree.
NonnullRefPtr<Core::Promise<String>> WebCompatReport::request_page_dumps(ViewImplementation& view)
{
    return view.request_internal_page_info(PageInfoType::LayoutTree | PageInfoType::StackingContextTree | PageInfoType::DisplayList);
}

Optional<String> WebCompatReport::validate(StringView description)
{
    if (description.trim_whitespace().is_empty())
        return "Describe what is wrong with this website."_string;
    if (description.length() > maximum_description_bytes)
        return "This description is too long to include in a report."_string;
    return {};
}

WebCompatReport::WebCompatReport(Page page)
    : m_page(move(page))
{
}

WebCompatReport::~WebCompatReport() = default;

Vector<ReportDetail> WebCompatReport::details() const
{
    Vector<ReportDetail> details;
    details.append({ "Website"_string, m_page.url.serialize(), false });
    details.append({ "User agent"_string, m_page.user_agent, true });
    details.append({ "Viewport size"_string, format_viewport_size(m_page.viewport_size), false });
    details.append({ "Device pixel ratio"_string, MUST(String::formatted("{}", m_page.device_pixel_ratio)), false });
    details.append({ "Zoom level"_string, format_zoom_level(m_page.zoom_level), false });
    details.append({ "Ladybird version"_string, to_string(browser_version), true });
    details.append({ "Platform"_string, to_string(platform), false });
    details.append({ "Architecture"_string, to_string(architecture), false });
    details.append({ "Git commit"_string, to_string(LADYBIRD_COMMIT), true });
    return details;
}

// Dumps that exceed the limit are cut at a character boundary, and say so.
void WebCompatReport::set_page_dumps(String dumps)
{
    auto bytes = dumps.bytes();
    if (bytes.size() <= maximum_page_dumps_bytes) {
        m_page_dumps = move(dumps);
        return;
    }

    auto length = maximum_page_dumps_bytes;
    while (length > 0 && (bytes[length] & 0xC0) == 0x80)
        --length;
    m_page_dumps = MUST(String::formatted("{}\n(Truncated)\n", StringView { bytes.slice(0, length) }));
}

ByteString WebCompatReport::diagnostics(IncludePageDumps include_page_dumps, IncludePlatformFeatures include_platform_features) const
{
    StringBuilder builder;
    builder.append("Ladybird web compatibility report, format 1\n"sv);
    append_build_information_for_process(builder, ProcessType::Browser);
    builder.appendff("URL: {}\n", m_page.url.serialize());
    builder.appendff("User agent: {}\n", m_page.user_agent);
    builder.appendff("Viewport size: {}\n", format_viewport_size(m_page.viewport_size));
    builder.appendff("Device pixel ratio: {}\n", m_page.device_pixel_ratio);
    builder.appendff("Zoom level: {}\n", format_zoom_level(m_page.zoom_level));

    if (include_platform_features == IncludePlatformFeatures::Yes && m_platform_features.has_value())
        builder.append(*m_platform_features);

    if (include_page_dumps == IncludePageDumps::Yes && m_page_dumps.has_value())
        builder.appendff("\n{}", *m_page_dumps);

    return builder.to_byte_string();
}

Optional<String> WebCompatReport::send(String const& description, Optional<ByteBuffer> screenshot_png,
    IncludePageDumps include_page_dumps, IncludePlatformFeatures include_platform_features)
{
    VERIFY(!m_submission);

    if (auto error = validate(description); error.has_value())
        return error;
    if (screenshot_png.has_value() && screenshot_png->size() > maximum_screenshot_bytes)
        return "This screenshot is too large to include in a report."_string;

    auto diagnostics_text = diagnostics(include_page_dumps, include_platform_features);
    Vector<ReportSubmission::Attachment> attachments;
    attachments.append({
        .id = diagnostics_reference,
        .name = diagnostics_name,
        .media_type = "text/plain"sv,
        .content = MUST(Core::ImmutableBytes::copy(diagnostics_text.bytes())),
    });
    if (screenshot_png.has_value()) {
        attachments.append({
            .id = screenshot_reference,
            .name = screenshot_name,
            .media_type = "image/png"sv,
            .content = Core::ImmutableBytes::adopt(screenshot_png.release_value()),
        });
    }

    auto url = m_page.url.serialize();
    auto viewport_size = format_viewport_size(m_page.viewport_size);

    ReportSubmission::Contents contents;
    contents.kind = "web_compat"sv;
    contents.client_version = browser_version;
    contents.build = build_configuration;
    contents.add_text("description"sv, "multiline"sv, description);
    contents.add_text("url"sv, "text"sv, url);
    contents.add_text("user_agent"sv, "text"sv, m_page.user_agent);
    contents.add_text("viewport_size"sv, "text"sv, viewport_size);
    contents.add("device_pixel_ratio"sv, "number"sv, m_page.device_pixel_ratio);
    contents.add("zoom_level"sv, "number"sv, m_page.zoom_level);
    contents.add_build_information(platform, architecture, LADYBIRD_COMMIT, build_configuration);
    if (include_platform_features == IncludePlatformFeatures::Yes && m_platform_features.has_value())
        contents.add_platform_features(*m_platform_features);

    auto manifest = ReportSubmission::build_manifest(contents, attachments);
    m_payload = ReportSubmission::Payload { move(manifest), move(attachments) };
    start_submission();
    return {};
}

void WebCompatReport::retry()
{
    VERIFY(m_payload.has_value());
    VERIFY(!m_submission);
    start_submission();
}

void WebCompatReport::cancel_sending()
{
    if (auto submission = move(m_submission))
        submission->cancel();
}

// A report on its way keeps being sent if this report is destroyed, which then only stops hearing about it.
void WebCompatReport::start_submission()
{
    auto submission = ReportSubmission::create(*m_payload);

    submission->on_progress = [weak_this = make_weak_ptr()](auto stage) {
        if (auto* self = weak_this.ptr(); self && self->on_progress)
            self->on_progress(stage);
    };
    submission->on_retry = [weak_this = make_weak_ptr()](String reason, u32 retry_number, u32 maximum_retries, u32 delay_seconds) {
        if (auto* self = weak_this.ptr(); self && self->on_retry)
            self->on_retry(move(reason), retry_number, maximum_retries, delay_seconds);
    };
    submission->on_sent = [weak_this = make_weak_ptr()] {
        if (auto* self = weak_this.ptr()) {
            self->m_submission = nullptr;
            if (self->on_sent)
                self->on_sent();
        }
    };
    submission->on_failed = [weak_this = make_weak_ptr()](auto failure, String reason) {
        if (auto* self = weak_this.ptr()) {
            self->m_submission = nullptr;
            if (self->on_failed)
                self->on_failed(failure, move(reason));
        }
    };

    m_submission = submission;
    submission->start();
}

URL::URL new_bug_report_url(BugReportDetails const& details)
{
    StringBuilder url;
    url.append("https://github.com/LadybirdBrowser/ladybird/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml"sv);
    auto append_field = [&](StringView id, StringView value) {
        url.appendff("&{}={}", id, URL::percent_encode(value, URL::PercentEncodeSet::Component));
    };

    // NB: These are the IDs of the fields in .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml, where the architecture is a choice
    //     of these values.
    append_field("os"sv, platform);
    append_field("architecture"sv, architecture == "x86_64"sv || architecture == "AArch64"sv ? architecture : "Other"sv);
    append_field("commit"sv, LADYBIRD_COMMIT);

    StringBuilder build_flags;
    build_flags.appendff("Ladybird {}, {}", browser_version, build_configuration);
    if (details.disable_sandbox == DisableSandbox::Yes)
        build_flags.append(", sandbox: off"sv);
    if (!details.gpu_painting_enabled)
        build_flags.append(", GPU painting: off"sv);
    append_field("build-flags"sv, build_flags.string_view());

    return URL::Parser::basic_parse(url.string_view()).release_value();
}

}

Messages::WebContentClient::DidAddBlobUrlEntryResponse WebContentClient::did_add_blob_url_entry(Web::PageId page_id, Web::HTML::EnvironmentId environment_id, Utf16String url, Web::FileAPI::SerializedBlobURLEntry entry)
{
    if (auto* page = this->page(page_id))
        return page->did_add_blob_url_entry(move(environment_id), move(url), move(entry));

    return URL::BlobURLEntry::Token { 0 };
}

void WebContentClient::did_remove_blob_url_entries(Web::PageId page_id, Web::HTML::EnvironmentId environment_id, Vector<Utf16String> urls)
{
    if (auto* page = this->page(page_id)) {
        page->did_remove_blob_url_entries(move(environment_id), move(urls));
        return;
    }

    // NB: A closed page's environments went with it, so its process can only revoke the entries it added itself.
    if (may_act_for_page(page_id))
        m_session->blob_url_store->remove_entries_added_by(urls, WeakPtr<WebContentClient> { *this });
}

void WebContentClient::close_worker_agent(Web::PageId page_id, Web::HTML::WorkerAgentId agent_id, Web::HTML::WorkerAgentOwnerToken owner_token)
{
    // NB: A page's workers are closed as its documents are destroyed, which happens after the tab's page has closed.
    if (may_act_for_page(page_id))
        WorkerAgentManager::the().close_worker_agent(*this, agent_id, owner_token);
}

void WebContentClient::note_hosted_document(CanonicalDocument const& document)
{
    // NB: An about:blank document starts out empty, and its origin is that of a document the process already hosts or
    //     an opaque one that nothing else can script.
    if (m_has_hosted_more_than_tabs_of_one_origin || Web::HTML::url_matches_about_blank(document.creation_url()))
        return;

    auto const& origin = document.origin();
    if (document.may_share_a_process_with_tabs_of_its_origin()) {
        if (!m_origin_of_hosted_tabs.has_value()) {
            m_origin_of_hosted_tabs = origin;
            m_hosted_tabs_are_origin_keyed = document.relevant_global_object().agent().agent_cluster_is_origin_keyed();
        }
        if (has_hosted_only_tabs_of_the_site_of(document)) {
            if (origin != *m_origin_of_hosted_tabs)
                m_has_hosted_tabs_of_more_than_one_origin_of_a_site = true;
            return;
        }
    } else if (!document.is_top_level() && m_origin_of_hosted_tabs.has_value()) {
        // NB: A data: URL iframe is hosted in the process of the document that made it, and holds only what that
        //     document already had.
        if (origin.is_opaque()) {
            if (document.creation_url().scheme() == "data"sv)
                return;
        } else if (m_hosted_tabs_are_origin_keyed ? origin.is_same_origin(*m_origin_of_hosted_tabs) : origin.is_same_site(*m_origin_of_hosted_tabs)) {
            return;
        }
    }

    m_has_hosted_more_than_tabs_of_one_origin = true;
    m_origin_of_hosted_tabs.clear();
}

static bool tabs_of_a_site_share_processes()
{
    return Application::the().tab_processes() == TabProcesses::PerSite;
}

bool WebContentClient::has_hosted_only_tabs_like(CanonicalDocument const& document) const
{
    if (tabs_of_a_site_share_processes())
        return has_hosted_only_tabs_of_the_site_of(document);
    return !m_has_hosted_tabs_of_more_than_one_origin_of_a_site && m_origin_of_hosted_tabs == document.origin()
        && m_hosted_tabs_are_origin_keyed == document.relevant_global_object().agent().agent_cluster_is_origin_keyed();
}

bool WebContentClient::has_hosted_only_tabs_unlike(CanonicalDocument const& document) const
{
    // NB: The user may want no tabs to share a process, which makes every other tab unlike the tabs of a process.
    if (Application::the().tab_processes() == TabProcesses::PerTab)
        return m_origin_of_hosted_tabs.has_value();
    if (tabs_of_a_site_share_processes())
        return m_origin_of_hosted_tabs.has_value() && !has_hosted_only_tabs_of_the_site_of(document);
    return m_origin_of_hosted_tabs.has_value() && !has_hosted_only_tabs_like(document);
}

// NB: An origin-keyed tab keeps apart from the other origins of its site, so its site is just its origin.
bool WebContentClient::has_hosted_only_tabs_of_the_site_of(CanonicalDocument const& document) const
{
    if (!m_origin_of_hosted_tabs.has_value() || m_hosted_tabs_are_origin_keyed != document.relevant_global_object().agent().agent_cluster_is_origin_keyed())
        return false;
    if (m_hosted_tabs_are_origin_keyed)
        return *m_origin_of_hosted_tabs == document.origin();
    return m_origin_of_hosted_tabs->is_same_site(document.origin());
}

bool WebContentClient::hosts_an_environment_with_storage_key(Web::StorageAPI::StorageKey const& storage_key)
{
    bool hosts_one = false;
    for_each_page([&](WebContentPage& page) {
        hosts_one = page.hosts_an_environment_with_storage_key(storage_key);
        return hosts_one ? IterationDecision::Break : IterationDecision::Continue;
    });
    return hosts_one;
}

Optional<CanonicalEnvironmentSettingsObject const&> WebContentClient::hosted_environment(Web::HTML::EnvironmentId const& environment_id)
{
    Optional<CanonicalEnvironmentSettingsObject const&> environment;
    for_each_page([&](WebContentPage& page) {
        environment = page.hosted_environment(environment_id);
        return environment.has_value() ? IterationDecision::Break : IterationDecision::Continue;
    });
    return environment;
}

bool WebContentClient::hosts_a_document_of_origin(URL::Origin const& origin)
{
    bool hosts_one = false;
    for_each_page([&](WebContentPage& page) {
        page.for_each_hosted_document([&](CanonicalDocument& document) {
            hosts_one = document.origin().is_same_origin(origin);
            return hosts_one ? IterationDecision::Break : IterationDecision::Continue;
        });
        return hosts_one ? IterationDecision::Break : IterationDecision::Continue;
    });
    return hosts_one;
}

}

WebContentClient::~WebContentClient()
{
    // The tree can still hold a page of a process that is gone; it reads as closed from now on.
    for (auto& page : m_pages)
        page.value->close();
    cancel_navigation_transactions();
    remove_blob_url_entries();
    StorageAreaRegistry::the().remove_listener(*this);
    WorkerAgentManager::the().remove_web_content_owner(*this);
    GamepadManager::the().client_disconnected(*this);
    clients().remove(this);
}

Optional<WebContentClient&> WebContentClient::client_for_compositor_context_id(Web::CompositorContextId context_id)
{
    Optional<WebContentClient&> client;
    for_each_client([&](auto& candidate) {
        if (!candidate.page_id_for_compositor_context_id(context_id).has_value())
            return IterationDecision::Continue;
        client = candidate;
        return IterationDecision::Break;
    });
    return client;
}

void WebContentClient::die()

    did_lose_process();
