    // NB: The browser process knows whether a navigable with the id exists.
    if (method == "browsingContext.locateNodes"sv) {
        if (auto locator = params.get_object("locator"sv); locator.has_value() && locator->get_string("type"sv) == "context"sv) {
            if (auto value = locator->get_object("value"sv); value.has_value()) {
                if (auto context_id = value->get_string("context"sv); context_id.has_value())
                    (void)TRY_OR_COMPLETE(get_a_navigable(*context_id));
            }
        }
    }
    run_content_command(*navigable, method, params, move(on_complete));
}

// https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#realm-id
// NB: The id of a realm names the document whose relevant realm it is, which the process hosting it gave.
static Optional<Web::HTML::CrossProcessId> document_id_of_realm_id(StringView realm_id)
{
    auto parts = realm_id.split_view('.');
    if (parts.size() != 2)
        return {};

    auto namespace_id = parts[0].to_number<u64>();
    auto local_id = parts[1].to_number<u64>();
    if (!namespace_id.has_value() || !local_id.has_value())
        return {};

    return Web::HTML::CrossProcessId { .namespace_id = *namespace_id, .local_id = *local_id };
}

// https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#get-a-realm
static ErrorOr<CanonicalNavigable*, Web::WebDriver::Error> get_the_navigable_of_a_realm(StringView realm_id)
{
    // 1. If realm id is null, return success with data null.
    // 2. If there is no realm with id realm id return error with error code no such frame
    auto document_id = document_id_of_realm_id(realm_id);
    if (!document_id.has_value())
        return no_such_frame();

    CanonicalNavigable* result = nullptr;
    for (auto& traversable : all_top_level_traversables()) {
        traversable.for_each_in_inclusive_subtree([&](CanonicalNavigable& navigable) {
            if (navigable.active_document().id() != *document_id)
                return IterationDecision::Continue;
            result = &navigable;
            return IterationDecision::Break;
        });
        if (result)
            break;
    }

    if (!result)
        return no_such_frame();

    // 3. Let realm be the realm with id realm id.
    // 4. Return success with data realm
    return result;
}

// https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#get-a-realm-from-a-target
void WebDriverBiDi::route_to_script_target(String const& method, JsonObject const& params, CommandResult on_complete)
{
    auto target = params.get("target"sv);
    if (!target.has_value() || !target->is_object())
        return on_complete(invalid_argument("Parameter 'target' must be an object"sv));

    // 1. If target matches the script.ContextTarget production:
    if (target->as_object().has("context"sv)) {
        // 1. Let sandbox be null.
        // 2. If target contains "sandbox", set sandbox to target["sandbox"].
        // 3. Let realm be get a realm from a navigable with target["context"] and sandbox.
        // https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#get-a-realm-from-a-navigable
        // 1. Let navigable be the result of trying to get a navigable with navigable id.
        // NB: The process hosting the navigable's active document gets its realm.
        auto navigable_id = TRY_OR_COMPLETE(get_string(target->as_object(), "context"sv));
        auto* navigable = TRY_OR_COMPLETE(get_a_navigable(navigable_id));
        run_content_command(*navigable, method, params, move(on_complete));
        return;
    }

    // 2. Otherwise:
    if (target->as_object().has("realm"sv)) {
        // 1. Assert: target matches the script.RealmTarget production.
        // 2. Let realm id be the value of the realm field of target.
        auto realm_id = TRY_OR_COMPLETE(get_string(target->as_object(), "realm"sv));

        // 3. Let realm be get a realm given realm id.
        // NB: The process hosting the realm's document gets it.
        auto* navigable = TRY_OR_COMPLETE(get_the_navigable_of_a_realm(realm_id));
        run_content_command(*navigable, method, params, move(on_complete));
        return;
    }

    on_complete(invalid_argument("Parameter 'target' must be a context or realm target"sv));
}

// https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#command-script-getRealms
void WebDriverBiDi::script_get_realms(JsonObject const& params, CommandResult on_complete)
{
    auto context = TRY_OR_COMPLETE(get_optional_string(params, "context"sv));
    auto type = TRY_OR_COMPLETE(get_optional_string(params, "type"sv));

    // script.RealmType = "window" / "dedicated-worker" / "shared-worker" / "service-worker" / "worker" /
    //                    "paint-worklet" / "audio-worklet" / "worklet"
    if (type.has_value() && !type->is_one_of("window"sv, "dedicated-worker"sv, "shared-worker"sv, "service-worker"sv, "worker"sv, "paint-worklet"sv, "audio-worklet"sv, "worklet"sv))
        return on_complete(invalid_argument("Parameter 'type' must be a realm type"sv));

    // 1. Let environment settings be a list of all the environment settings objects that have their execution ready
    //    flag set.
    // 2. If command parameters contains context:
    //     1. Let navigable be the result of trying to get a navigable with command parameters["context"].
    // NB: The processes hosting the navigables' documents hold their realms.
    Vector<CanonicalNavigable const*> navigables;
    if (context.has_value()) {
        navigables.append(TRY_OR_COMPLETE(get_a_navigable(*context)));
    } else {
        for (auto& traversable : all_top_level_traversables()) {
            traversable.for_each_in_inclusive_subtree([&](CanonicalNavigable const& navigable) {
                navigables.append(&navigable);
                return IterationDecision::Continue;
            });
        }
    }

    struct State : RefCounted<State> {
        Vector<Optional<JsonArray>> realms;
        size_t remaining { 0 };
        CommandResult on_complete;
    };
    auto state = adopt_ref(*new State);
    state->realms.resize(navigables.size());
    state->remaining = navigables.size();
    state->on_complete = move(on_complete);

    auto finish = [state] {
        // 3. Let realms be a list.
        JsonArray realms;
        for (auto& navigable_realms : state->realms) {
            if (!navigable_realms.has_value())
                continue;
            for (auto& realm : navigable_realms->values())
                realms.must_append(realm);
        }

        // 5. Let body be a map matching the script.GetRealmsResult production, with the realms field set to realms.
        JsonObject body;
        body.set("realms"sv, move(realms));

        // 6. Return success with data body.
        state->on_complete(JsonValue { move(body) });
    };

    if (navigables.is_empty()) {
        finish();
        return;
    }

    for (size_t i = 0; i < navigables.size(); ++i) {
        JsonObject navigable_params;
        navigable_params.set("context"sv, navigable_id(*navigables[i]));
        if (type.has_value())
            navigable_params.set("type"sv, *type);

        run_content_command(*navigables[i], "script.getRealms"_string, move(navigable_params), [state, i, finish, single_navigable = context.has_value()](Web::WebDriver::Response response) {
            if (response.is_error()) {
                // NB: A navigable that went away while we asked has no realms to report.
                if (single_navigable) {
                    state->on_complete(move(response));
                    return;
                }
            } else if (response.value().is_object()) {
                if (auto realms = response.value().as_object().get_array("realms"sv); realms.has_value())
                    state->realms[i] = *realms;
            }
            if (--state->remaining == 0)
                finish();
        });
    }
}

// https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#type-script-ChannelValue
static bool is_channel_value(JsonValue const& value)
{
    // script.ChannelValue = {
    //   type: "channel",
    //   value: script.ChannelProperties,
    // }
    // script.ChannelProperties = {
    //   channel: script.Channel,
    //   ? serializationOptions: script.SerializationOptions,
    //   ? ownership: script.ResultOwnership,
    // }
    if (!value.is_object())
        return false;
    auto const& object = value.as_object();
    if (object.get_string("type"sv) != "channel"sv)
        return false;
    auto properties = object.get_object("value"sv);
    if (!properties.has_value() || !properties->get_string("channel"sv).has_value())
        return false;
    if (auto ownership = properties->get("ownership"sv); ownership.has_value() && (!ownership->is_string() || !ownership->as_string().is_one_of("root"sv, "none"sv)))
        return false;
    if (auto options = properties->get("serializationOptions"sv); options.has_value() && Web::WebDriver::parse_serialization_options(*options).is_error())
        return false;
    return true;
}

// https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#command-script-addPreloadScript
void WebDriverBiDi::script_add_preload_script(JsonObject const& params, CommandResult on_complete)
{
    // 1. If command parameters contains "userContexts" and command parameters contains "contexts", return error with
    //    error code invalid argument.
    if (params.has("userContexts"sv) && params.has("contexts"sv))
        return on_complete(invalid_argument("Parameters 'contexts' and 'userContexts' are mutually exclusive"sv));

    // 2. Let function declaration be the functionDeclaration field of command parameters.
    auto function_declaration = TRY_OR_COMPLETE(get_string(params, "functionDeclaration"sv));

    // 3. Let arguments be the arguments field of command parameters if present, or an empty list otherwise.
    JsonArray arguments;
    if (auto value = params.get("arguments"sv); value.has_value()) {
        if (!value->is_array())
            return on_complete(invalid_argument("Parameter 'arguments' must be a list of channel values"sv));
        for (auto const& argument : value->as_array().values()) {
            if (!is_channel_value(argument))
                return on_complete(invalid_argument("Parameter 'arguments' must be a list of channel values"sv));
            arguments.must_append(argument);
        }
    }

    auto contexts = TRY_OR_COMPLETE(get_optional_non_empty_list_of_strings(params, "contexts"sv));
    auto input_user_contexts = TRY_OR_COMPLETE(get_optional_non_empty_list_of_strings(params, "userContexts"sv));
    auto sandbox = TRY_OR_COMPLETE(get_optional_string(params, "sandbox"sv));

    // 4. Let user contexts to be a set.
    Vector<String> user_contexts;

    // 5. Let navigables be null.
    Optional<Vector<String>> navigables;

    // 6. If the contexts field of command parameters is present:
    if (contexts.has_value()) {
        // 1. Set navigables to an empty set.
        navigables = Vector<String> {};

        // 2. For each navigable id of command parameters["contexts"]
        for (auto const& navigable_id : *contexts) {
            // 1. Let navigable be the result of trying to get a navigable with navigable id.
            // 2. If navigable is not a top-level traversable, return error with error code invalid argument.
            auto* traversable = TRY_OR_COMPLETE(get_a_top_level_traversable(navigable_id));

            // 3. Append navigable to navigables.
            if (!navigables->contains_slow(navigable_id))
                navigables->append(navigable_id);

            // NB: A process that hosts a frame of the traversable, and not the traversable itself, names it by its id.
            auto traversable_id = MUST(String::formatted("{}-{}", traversable->id().namespace_id, traversable->id().local_id));
            if (!navigables->contains_slow(traversable_id))
                navigables->append(move(traversable_id));
        }
    }
    // 7. Otherwise, if command parameters contains userContexts:
    else if (input_user_contexts.has_value()) {
        // 1. Set user contexts to create a set with command parameters["userContexts"].
        for (auto const& user_context_id : *input_user_contexts) {
            if (!user_contexts.contains_slow(user_context_id))
                user_contexts.append(user_context_id);
        }

        // 2. For each user context id of user contexts:
        for (auto const& user_context_id : user_contexts) {
            // 1. Set user context to get user context with user context id.
            // 2. If user context is null, return error with error code no such user context.
            if (user_context_id != DEFAULT_USER_CONTEXT_ID)
                return on_complete(Web::WebDriver::Error::from_code(Web::WebDriver::ErrorCode::NoSuchUserContext, "User context not found"sv));
        }
    }

    // 8. Let sandbox be the value of the "sandbox" field in command parameters, if present, or null otherwise.

    // 9. Let script be the string representation of a UUID.
    auto script = generate_random_uuid();

    // 10. Let preload script map be session's preload script map.
    // 11. Set preload script map[script] to a struct with function declaration function declaration, arguments
    //     arguments, contexts navigables, sandbox sandbox, and user contexts user contexts.
    m_session_state.preload_scripts.append({
        .id = script,
        .function_declaration = move(function_declaration),
        .arguments = move(arguments),
        .contexts = move(navigables),
        .sandbox = move(sandbox),
        .user_contexts = move(user_contexts),
    });
    push_session_state();

    // 12. Return a new map matching the script.AddPreloadScriptResult with the script field set to script.
    JsonObject result;
    result.set("script"sv, move(script));
    on_complete(JsonValue { move(result) });
}

// https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#command-script-removePreloadScript
void WebDriverBiDi::script_remove_preload_script(JsonObject const& params, CommandResult on_complete)
{
    // 1. Let script be the value of the "script" field in command parameters.
    auto script = TRY_OR_COMPLETE(get_string(params, "script"sv));

    // 2. Let preload script map be session's preload script map.
    // 3. If preload script map does not contain script, return error with error code no such script.
    // 4. Remove script from preload script map.
    auto removed = m_session_state.preload_scripts.remove_first_matching([&](auto const& preload_script) {
        return preload_script.id == script;
    });
    if (!removed)
        return on_complete(Web::WebDriver::Error::from_code(Web::WebDriver::ErrorCode::NoSuchScript, "Preload script not found"sv));

    push_session_state();

    // 5. Return null
    on_complete(JsonValue {});
}

}

namespace WebView {

class WebDriverBrowserConnection;
class WebDriverBiDiNetwork;

// https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/
// NB: The browser process runs the commands of a BiDi session that involve navigables, and routes those that run in the
//     process hosting a navigable's document to it. It exists only while WebDriver drives the browser.
class WebDriverBiDi : public Weakable<WebDriverBiDi> {
    AK_MAKE_NONCOPYABLE(WebDriverBiDi);
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;
    AK_MAKE_NONMOVABLE(WebDriverBiDi);

public:
    static WebDriverBiDi* the() { return s_the; }

    explicit WebDriverBiDi(WebDriverBrowserConnection&);
    ~WebDriverBiDi();

    void run_command(u64 command_id, String const& method, JsonValue params);
    void get_top_level_traversables(u64 command_id, Vector<String> const& navigable_ids);
    void run_subscribe_steps(u64 command_id, String const& event_name, Vector<String> const& top_level_traversable_ids);
    void set_enabled_events(Vector<String> const& event_names, HashMap<String, Optional<Vector<String>>> event_contexts);

    bool is_event_enabled(StringView event_name) const { return m_enabled_events.contains(event_name); }
    Web::WebDriver::BiDiSessionState const& session_state() const { return m_session_state; }
    void push_session_state_for_client(WebContentClient&) const;

    // Completes a command that a process hosting a navigable ran, if this object sent it.
    bool did_complete_content_command(u64 command_id, Web::WebDriver::Response&);

    // https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigable-id
    static String navigable_id(CanonicalNavigable const&);

    // https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-navigable-created
    void navigable_created(CanonicalNavigable const&, Optional<CanonicalNavigable const&> opener_navigable = {});
    void top_level_traversable_did_get_window_handle(CanonicalTraversable const&);

    // https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-navigable-destroyed
    void navigable_destroyed(CanonicalNavigable const&);
    void top_level_traversable_is_closing(CanonicalNavigable const&);
    void top_level_traversable_did_close(String const& window_handle);

    // NB: The navigations of a top-level traversable whose process crashed do not go on.
    void top_level_traversable_did_crash(CanonicalTraversable const&);

    // https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-navigation-status
    enum class NavigationStatusType : u8 {
        Canceled,
        Pending,
        Complete,
    };
    struct NavigationStatus {
        Optional<Utf16String> id;
        NavigationStatusType status { NavigationStatusType::Pending };
        URL::URL url;
    };

    // NB: A reload canceled before its history step applies emits no navigation event.
    void reload_did_not_apply(CanonicalTraversable const&, Optional<Utf16String> const& navigation_id);
    void navigation_superseded_reload(CanonicalNavigable const&);

    // https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-navigation-started
    void navigation_started(CanonicalNavigable const&, NavigationStatus const&);

    // https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-navigation-failed
    void navigation_failed(CanonicalNavigable const&, NavigationStatus const&);

    void did_receive_navigation_event(WebContentPage&, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId navigable_id, String const& name, Optional<Utf16String> navigation_id, URL::URL url);
    void download_response_finished(String const& context,
        JsonObject const& metadata,
        u64 decoded_body_size,
        Requests::RequestTimingInfo const*,
        Optional<StringView> error);
    void did_receive_event(WebContentPage&, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId navigable_id, String const& name, JsonValue params);

private:
    static WebDriverBiDi* s_the;

    using CommandResult = Function<void(Web::WebDriver::Response)>;

    void complete_command(u64 command_id, Web::WebDriver::Response);

    void emit_event(StringView name, JsonValue params, Vector<String> top_level_traversable_ids);
    void emit_event_for_navigable(StringView name, JsonValue params, CanonicalNavigable const&);

    void ensure_session_is_active();
    void push_session_state();

    void run_content_command(CanonicalNavigable const&, String const& method, JsonValue params, CommandResult);

    // https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#get-the-navigable-info
    JsonObject get_the_navigable_info(CanonicalNavigable const&, Optional<u64> max_depth, bool include_parent_id) const;

    // https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#get-the-navigation-info
    JsonObject get_the_navigation_info(CanonicalNavigable const&, NavigationStatus const&) const;

    // https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#await
    using ResumeSteps = Function<void(StringView event_name, NavigationStatus)>;
    // NB: A navigation is awaited for the navigable it navigates, whose events alone resume it.
    void await(Vector<StringView> events, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId navigable_id, Utf16String const& resume_id, ResumeSteps);

    // https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#resume
    void resume(StringView name, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId navigable_id, Utf16String const& id, NavigationStatus const&);

    // NB: The navigations awaited for a navigable that is gone, or whose process is gone, fail.
    void fail_navigations_of(Function<bool(Web::HTML::CrossProcessId)> const& is_affected_navigable);
    void remove_state_of_removed_navigables();

    // https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#await-a-navigation
    enum class WaitCondition : u8 {
        Committed,
        Interactive,
        Complete,
    };
    void await_a_navigation(CanonicalNavigable&, URL::URL, WaitCondition, LocalFileAccess, CommandResult);
    void await_navigation_completion(Web::HTML::CrossProcessId navigable_id, Utf16String const& navigation_id, WaitCondition, CommandResult);

    void browsing_context_activate(JsonObject const& params, CommandResult);
    void browsing_context_close(JsonObject const& params, CommandResult);
    void browsing_context_create(JsonObject const& params, CommandResult);
    void browsing_context_get_tree(JsonObject const& params, CommandResult);
    void browsing_context_navigate(JsonObject const& params, CommandResult);
    void browsing_context_reload(JsonObject const& params, CommandResult);
    void browsing_context_set_viewport(JsonObject const& params, CommandResult);
    void browsing_context_traverse_history(JsonObject const& params, CommandResult);
    void route_to_navigable(String const& method, JsonObject const& params, CommandResult);
    String os_window_of(String const& top_level_traversable_id) const;

    void script_add_preload_script(JsonObject const& params, CommandResult);
    void script_remove_preload_script(JsonObject const& params, CommandResult);
    void script_get_realms(JsonObject const& params, CommandResult);
    void route_to_script_target(String const& method, JsonObject const& params, CommandResult);

    WebDriverBrowserConnection& m_connection;

    HashTable<String> m_enabled_events;
    HashMap<String, Optional<Vector<String>>> m_enabled_event_contexts;
    Web::WebDriver::BiDiSessionState m_session_state;

    OwnPtr<WebDriverBiDiNetwork> m_network;
    struct BlockedNetworkRequest {
        RefPtr<WebContentPage> page;
        Web::HTML::CrossProcessId navigable_id;
        u64 generation;
        Optional<URL::URL> url;
        // The id of the navigation the request fetches the response of, if it does.
        Optional<Utf16String> navigation_id;
    };
    u64 m_next_network_interception_generation { 0 };
    HashMap<String, BlockedNetworkRequest> m_blocked_network_requests;

    u64 m_next_content_command_id;
    HashMap<u64, CommandResult> m_pending_content_commands;

    // https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#wait-queue
    struct Waiter {
        Vector<StringView> events;
        Web::HTML::CrossProcessId navigable_id;
        ResumeSteps algorithm;
    };
    HashMap<Utf16String, Waiter> m_wait_queue;

    // https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#original-opener
    HashMap<Web::HTML::CrossProcessId, String> m_original_openers;

    // NB: The navigables whose destruction was reported before they were removed.
    HashTable<Web::HTML::CrossProcessId> m_destroyed_navigables;

    // NB: The info of each closing top-level traversable, taken before its navigables go away with it.
    HashMap<Web::HTML::CrossProcessId, JsonObject> m_closing_traversable_infos;

    // NB: The commands closing a top-level traversable complete once it is closed.
    HashMap<String, Vector<CommandResult>> m_pending_close_commands;

    // NB: Reload commands wait for events from their own navigation.
    struct ReloadWaiter {
        Utf16String navigation_id;
        WaitCondition wait_condition;
        CommandResult on_complete;
    };
    HashMap<Web::HTML::CrossProcessId, ReloadWaiter> m_reload_waiters;

    // NB: The viewport a top-level traversable had before WebDriver BiDi first overrode it.
    struct ViewportDefaults {
        Gfx::IntSize viewport_size;
        double device_pixel_ratio { 1.0 };
    };
    HashMap<String, ViewportDefaults> m_viewport_defaults;
    struct ViewportOverride {
        Gfx::IntSize css_size;
        Gfx::IntSize device_size;
    };
    HashMap<String, ViewportOverride> m_css_viewport_overrides;

    // NB: The OS window of each tab created in the OS window of another top-level traversable.
    HashMap<String, String> m_tab_windows;
};

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWebView/WebDriverBiDiNetwork.cpp
/*

#include <AK/JsonArray.h>
#include <AK/Random.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/WebDriver/BiDi.h>
#include <LibWebView/WebDriverBiDiNetwork.h>

namespace WebView {

Web::WebDriver::BiDiSessionState session_state_for_hosted_traversables(Web::WebDriver::BiDiSessionState const& state, HashTable<String> const& hosted_traversables)
{
    auto filtered_state = state;
    filtered_state.network_navigable_headers.remove_all_matching([&](auto const& key, auto const&) {
        return !hosted_traversables.contains(key);
    });
    filtered_state.network_navigable_cache_behavior.remove_all_matching([&](auto const& key, auto const&) {
        return !hosted_traversables.contains(key);
    });
    return filtered_state;
}

using Web::WebDriver::as_js_uint;
using Web::WebDriver::Error;
using Web::WebDriver::ErrorCode;
using Web::WebDriver::Network::create_a_headers_list;
using Web::WebDriver::Network::UrlPattern;
using Web::WebDriver::Network::validate_interception_parameters;

static Error invalid_argument(StringView message)
{
    return Error::from_code(ErrorCode::InvalidArgument, message);
}

static ErrorOr<String, Error> get_string(JsonObject const& params, StringView name)
{
    auto value = params.get(name);
    if (!value.has_value() || !value->is_string())
        return invalid_argument(MUST(String::formatted("Parameter '{}' must be a string", name)));
    return value->as_string();
}

static ErrorOr<Vector<String>, Error> get_string_list(JsonObject const& params, StringView name)
{
    auto value = params.get(name);
    if (!value.has_value() || !value->is_array() || value->as_array().is_empty())
        return invalid_argument(MUST(String::formatted("Parameter '{}' must be a non-empty list of strings", name)));
    Vector<String> result;
    HashTable<String> seen;
    for (auto const& entry : value->as_array().values()) {
        if (!entry.is_string())
            return invalid_argument(MUST(String::formatted("Parameter '{}' must contain strings", name)));
        if (seen.set(entry.as_string()) == HashSetResult::InsertedNewEntry)
            result.append(entry.as_string());
    }
    return result;
}

static ErrorOr<Optional<Vector<String>>, Error> get_optional_string_list(JsonObject const& params, StringView name)
{
    if (!params.has(name))
        return Optional<Vector<String>> {};
    return TRY(get_string_list(params, name));
}

static ErrorOr<void, Error> validate_user_contexts(Vector<String> const& ids)
{
    // https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#get-user-context
    // FIXME: Support user contexts other than the default user context.
    for (auto const& id : ids) {
        if (id != "default"sv)
            return Error::from_code(ErrorCode::NoSuchUserContext, "User context not found"sv);
    }
    return {};
}

ErrorOr<JsonValue, Error> WebDriverBiDiNetwork::run_command(StringView method, JsonObject const& params, ValidateContext const& validate_context)
{
    if (method == "network.addIntercept"sv) {
        // https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#command-network-addIntercept
        auto phases = TRY(get_string_list(params, "phases"sv));
        Intercept entry;
        for (auto const& phase : phases) {
            if (!phase.is_one_of("beforeRequestSent"sv, "responseStarted"sv, "authRequired"sv))
                return invalid_argument("Unknown interception phase"sv);
            entry.phases.set(phase);
        }
        auto patterns = params.get("urlPatterns"sv);
        if (patterns.has_value() && !patterns->is_array())
            return invalid_argument("URL patterns must be a list"sv);
        entry.browsing_contexts = TRY(get_optional_string_list(params, "contexts"sv));
        // 1. Let intercept be the string representation of a UUID.
        auto intercept = generate_random_uuid();
        // 2. Let url patterns be the urlPatterns field of command parameters if present, or an empty list otherwise.
        // 3. Let navigables be null.
        // 4. If the contexts field of command parameters is present:
        if (entry.browsing_contexts.has_value()) {
            // 1. Set navigables to an empty set.
            // 2. For each navigable id of command parameters["contexts"]
            for (auto const& id : *entry.browsing_contexts) {
                // 1. Let navigable be the result of trying to get a navigable with navigable id.
                // 2. If navigable is not a top-level traversable, return error with error code invalid argument.
                // 3. Append navigable to navigables.
                TRY(validate_context(id));
            }
            // 3. If navigables is an empty set, return error with error code invalid argument.
            // NB: get_string_list() already rejected an empty list of contexts.
        }
        // 5. Let intercept map be session's intercept map.
        // 6. Let parsed patterns be an empty list.
        // 7. For each url pattern in url patterns:
        if (patterns.has_value()) {
            for (auto const& pattern : patterns->as_array().values()) {
                // 1. Let parsed be the result of trying to parse url pattern with url pattern.
                // 2. Append parsed to parsed patterns.
                entry.url_patterns.append(TRY(UrlPattern::parse(pattern)));
            }
        }
        // 8. Set intercept map[intercept] to a struct with url patterns parsed patterns, phases command parameters["phases"] and browsingContexts navigables.
        m_intercept_map.set(intercept, move(entry));
        // 9. Return a new map matching the network.AddInterceptResult production with the intercept field set to intercept.
        JsonObject result;
        result.set("intercept"sv, move(intercept));
        return JsonValue { move(result) };
    }
    if (method == "network.removeIntercept"sv) {
        // https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#command-network-removeIntercept
        // 1. Let intercept be the value of the "intercept" field in command parameters.
        auto intercept = TRY(get_string(params, "intercept"sv));
        // 2. Let intercept map be session's intercept map.
        // 3. If intercept map does not contain intercept, return error with error code no such intercept.
        // 4. Remove intercept from intercept map.
        if (!m_intercept_map.remove(intercept))
            return Error::from_code(ErrorCode::NoSuchIntercept, "Intercept not found"sv);
        // 5. Return success with data null.
        return JsonValue {};
    }
    if (method == "network.addDataCollector"sv) {
        // https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#command-network-addDataCollector
        auto data_types = TRY(get_string_list(params, "dataTypes"sv));
        for (auto const& type : data_types) {
            if (!type.is_one_of("request"sv, "response"sv))
                return invalid_argument("Unknown network data type"sv);
        }
        auto size_value = params.get("maxEncodedDataSize"sv);
        auto size = size_value.has_value() ? as_js_uint(*size_value) : Optional<u64> {};
        if (!size.has_value())
            return invalid_argument("maxEncodedDataSize must be a js-uint"sv);
        auto collector_type = params.has("collectorType"sv) ? TRY(get_string(params, "collectorType"sv)) : "blob"_string;
        if (collector_type != "blob"sv)
            return invalid_argument("Unknown collector type"sv);
        auto contexts = TRY(get_optional_string_list(params, "contexts"sv));
        auto user_contexts = TRY(get_optional_string_list(params, "userContexts"sv));
        // 1. Let collector id be the string representation of a UUID.
        auto collector_id = generate_random_uuid();
        // 2. Let input context ids be an empty set.
        // 3. If the contexts field of command parameters is present, set input context ids to create a set with command parameters[contexts].
        // 4. Let data types be create a set with command parameters["dataTypes"].
        // 5. Let max encoded item size be command parameters["maxEncodedDataSize"].
        // 6. Let collector type be command parameters["collectorType"].
        // 7. Let input user context ids be an empty set.
        // 8. If the userContexts field of command parameters is present, set input user context ids to create a set with command parameters[userContexts].
        // 9. If input user context ids is not empty and input context ids is not empty, return error with error code invalid argument.
        if (contexts.has_value() && user_contexts.has_value())
            return invalid_argument("contexts and userContexts are mutually exclusive"sv);
        // 10. If max encoded item size is 0 or max encoded item size is greater than max total collected size, return error with error code invalid argument.
        // NB: The implementation-defined budget for collected data is 200 MB.
        static constexpr u64 MAX_TOTAL_COLLECTED_SIZE = 200000000;
        if (*size == 0 || *size > MAX_TOTAL_COLLECTED_SIZE)
            return invalid_argument("maxEncodedDataSize exceeds the collection budget"sv);
        // 11. If input context ids is not empty:
        if (contexts.has_value()) {
            // 1. Let navigables be the result of trying to get valid navigables by ids with input context ids.
            // 2. For each navigable in navigables:
            //     1. If navigable is not a top-level traversable, return error with error code invalid argument.
            for (auto const& id : *contexts)
                TRY(validate_context(id));
        }
        // 12. Otherwise, if input user context ids is not empty:
        //      1. For each user context id of input user context ids:
        //          1. Let user context be get user context with user context id.
        //          2. If user context is null, return error with error code no such user context.
        else if (user_contexts.has_value()) {
            TRY(validate_user_contexts(*user_contexts));
        }
        // 13. Let collector be a collector with max encoded item size field set to max encoded item size, data types field set to data types, collector field set to collector id, collector type field set to collector type, contexts field set to input context ids, user contexts field set to input user context ids.
        // 14. Set session's network collectors[collector id] to collector.
        m_network_collectors.set(collector_id, Collector { *size, move(data_types), move(collector_type), move(contexts).value_or(Vector<String> {}), move(user_contexts).value_or(Vector<String> {}) });
        // 15. Return a new map matching the network.AddDataCollectorResult production with the collector field set to collector id.
        JsonObject result;
        result.set("collector"sv, move(collector_id));
        return JsonValue { move(result) };
    }
    if (method == "network.removeDataCollector"sv) {
        // https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#command-network-removeDataCollector
        // 1. Let collector id be the value of the "collector" field in command parameters.
        auto collector_id = TRY(get_string(params, "collector"sv));
        // 2. Let collectors be session's network collectors.
        // 3. If collectors does not contain collector id, return error with error code no such network collector.
        // 4. Remove collector id from session's network collectors.
        if (!m_network_collectors.remove(collector_id))
            return Error::from_code(ErrorCode::NoSuchNetworkCollector, "Network collector not found"sv);
        // 5. For collected data in collected network data, remove collector from data with collected data and collector id.
        // FIXME: Release collected bodies once Fetch supports network data collection.
        // 6. Return success with data null.
        return JsonValue {};
    }
    if (method == "network.getData"sv) {
        // https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#command-network-getData
        // 1. Let data type be command parameters["dataType"].
        auto data_type = TRY(get_string(params, "dataType"sv));
        if (!data_type.is_one_of("request"sv, "response"sv))
            return invalid_argument("Unknown network data type"sv);
        // 2. Let request id be command parameters["request"].
        TRY(get_string(params, "request"sv));
        auto disown_value = params.get("disown"sv);
        if (disown_value.has_value() && !disown_value->is_bool())
            return invalid_argument("Parameter 'disown' must be a boolean"sv);
        // 3. Let collector id be null.
        Optional<String> collector_id;
        // 4. If command parameters contains "collector":
        if (params.has("collector"sv)) {
            auto collector = TRY(get_string(params, "collector"sv));
            // 1. Let collectors be session's network collectors.
            // 2. If collectors does not contain collector id, return error with error code no such network collector.
            if (!m_network_collectors.contains(collector))
                return Error::from_code(ErrorCode::NoSuchNetworkCollector, "Network collector not found"sv);
            // 3. Set collector id to command parameters["collector"].
            collector_id = move(collector);
        }
        // 5. Let disown be command parameters["disown"].
        auto disown = disown_value.has_value() && disown_value->as_bool();
        // 6. If disown is true and collector id is null, return error with error code invalid argument.
        if (disown && !collector_id.has_value())
            return invalid_argument("Disowning data requires a collector"sv);
        // 7. Let collected data be get collected data given request id and data type.
        // 8. If collected data is null:
        //     1. Return error with error code no such network data.
        // FIXME: Look up collected data once Fetch supports network data collection.
        return Error::from_code(ErrorCode::NoSuchNetworkData, "Network data not found"sv);
    }
    if (method == "network.disownData"sv) {
        // https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#command-network-disownData
        // 1. Let data type be the value of the "dataType" field in command parameters.
        auto data_type = TRY(get_string(params, "dataType"sv));
        if (!data_type.is_one_of("request"sv, "response"sv))
            return invalid_argument("Unknown network data type"sv);
        // 2. Let collector id be the value of the "collector" field in command parameters.
        auto collector_id = TRY(get_string(params, "collector"sv));
        // 3. Let request id be the value of the "request" field in command parameters.
        TRY(get_string(params, "request"sv));
        // 4. Let collectors be session's network collectors.
        // 5. If collectors does not contain collector id, return error with error code no such network collector.
        if (!m_network_collectors.contains(collector_id))
            return Error::from_code(ErrorCode::NoSuchNetworkCollector, "Network collector not found"sv);
        // 6. Let collected data be get collected data with request id and data type.
        // 7. If collected data is null, return error with error code no such network data.
        // FIXME: Look up collected data once Fetch supports network data collection.
        return Error::from_code(ErrorCode::NoSuchNetworkData, "Network data not found"sv);
    }
    if (method == "network.setExtraHeaders"sv) {
        // https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#command-network-setExtraHeaders
        auto contexts = TRY(get_optional_string_list(params, "contexts"sv));
        auto user_contexts = TRY(get_optional_string_list(params, "userContexts"sv));
        // 1. If command parameters contains "userContexts" and command parameters contains "contexts", return error with error code invalid argument.
        if (contexts.has_value() && user_contexts.has_value())
            return invalid_argument("contexts and userContexts are mutually exclusive"sv);
        // 2. Let headers be the result of trying to create a headers list with command parameters["headers"].
        auto header_value = params.get("headers"sv);
        if (!header_value.has_value())
            return invalid_argument("Missing headers"sv);
        auto headers = TRY(create_a_headers_list(*header_value));
        // 3. If command parameters contains "userContexts":
        if (user_contexts.has_value()) {
            // 1. Let user contexts be an empty list.
            // 2. For user context id in command parameters["userContexts"]:
            //     1. Let user context be get user context with user context id.
            //     2. If user context is null, return error with error code no such user context.
            //     3. Append user context to user contexts.
            TRY(validate_user_contexts(*user_contexts));
            // 3. Let target be session's extra headers' user context headers
            // 4. For user context in user contexts:
            //     1. Set target[user context] to headers.
            for (auto const& id : *user_contexts)
                m_user_context_headers.set(id, headers);
            // 5. Return success with data null.
            return JsonValue {};
        }
        // 4. If command parameters contains "contexts":
        if (contexts.has_value()) {
            // 1. Let navigables be the result of trying to get valid top-level traversables by ids with command parameters["contexts"].
            for (auto const& id : *contexts)
                TRY(validate_context(id));
            // 2. Let target be session's extra headers' navigable headers
            // 3. For navigable in navigables:
            //     1. Set target[navigable] to headers.
            for (auto const& id : *contexts)
                m_navigable_headers.set(id, headers);
            // 4. Return success with data null.
            return JsonValue {};
        }
        // 5. Set session's extra headers' default headers to headers.
        m_default_headers = move(headers);
        // 6. Return success with data null.
        return JsonValue {};
    }
    if (method == "network.setCacheBehavior"sv) {
        // https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#command-network-setCacheBehavior
        // 1. Let behavior be command parameters["cacheBehavior"].
        auto behavior = TRY(get_string(params, "cacheBehavior"sv));
        if (!behavior.is_one_of("default"sv, "bypass"sv))
            return invalid_argument("Unknown cache behavior"sv);
        auto contexts = TRY(get_optional_string_list(params, "contexts"sv));
        // 2. If command parameters does not contain "contexts":
        if (!contexts.has_value()) {
            // 1. Set the default cache behavior to behavior.
            m_default_cache_behavior = move(behavior);
            // 2. Clear navigable cache behavior map.
            m_navigable_cache_behavior_map.clear();
            // 3. Switch on the value of behavior:
            //     "bypass"
            //         Perform implementation-defined steps to disable any implementation-specific resource caches.
            //     "default"
            //         Perform implementation-defined steps to enable any implementation-specific resource caches that
            //         are usually enabled in the current remote end configuration.
            // NB: The updated session state applies this to subsequent fetches.
            // 4. Return success with data null.
            return JsonValue {};
        }
        // 3. Let navigables be an empty set.
        // 4. For each navigable id of command parameters["contexts"]:
        //     1. Let context be the result of trying to get a navigable with navigable id.
        //     2. If context is not a top-level browsing context, return error with error code invalid argument.
        //     3. Append context to navigables.
        for (auto const& id : *contexts)
            TRY(validate_context(id));
        // 5. For each navigable in navigables:
        for (auto const& id : *contexts) {
            // 1. If navigable cache behavior map contains navigable, and navigable cache behavior map[navigable] is
            //    equal to behavior then continue.
            if (m_navigable_cache_behavior_map.get(id) == behavior)
                continue;
            // 2. Switch on the value of behavior:
            //     "bypass"
            //         Perform implementation-defined steps to disable any implementation-specific resource caches for
            //         network requests originating from any browsing context for which navigable is the top-level
            //         browsing context.
            //     "default"
            //         Perform implementation-defined steps to enable any implementation-specific resource caches that
            //         are usually enabled in the current remote end configuration for network requests originating
            //         from any browsing context for which navigable is the top-level browsing context.
            // NB: The updated session state applies this to subsequent fetches.
            // 3. If behavior is equal to default cache behavior:
            if (behavior == m_default_cache_behavior) {
                // 1. If navigable cache behavior map contains navigable, remove navigable cache behavior map[navigable].
                m_navigable_cache_behavior_map.remove(id);
            } else {
                // 4. Otherwise:
                //     1. Set navigable cache behavior map[navigable] to behavior.
                m_navigable_cache_behavior_map.set(id, behavior);
            }
        }
        // 6. Return success with data null.
        return JsonValue {};
    }
    if (method.is_one_of("network.continueRequest"sv, "network.continueResponse"sv, "network.provideResponse"sv, "network.continueWithAuth"sv, "network.failRequest"sv)) {
        // https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#command-network-continueRequest
        // https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#command-network-continueResponse
        // https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#command-network-provideResponse
        // https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#command-network-continueWithAuth
        // https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#command-network-failRequest
        TRY(validate_interception_parameters(method, params));
        // 1. Let blocked requests be session's blocked request map.
        // 2. Let request id be command parameters["request"].
        // 3. If blocked requests does not contain request id then return error with error code no such request.
        // NB: The browser routes known blocked requests to the process that paused them before reaching this lookup.
        return Error::from_code(ErrorCode::NoSuchRequest, "Blocked request not found"sv);
    }
    return Error::from_code(ErrorCode::UnknownCommand, "Command is not supported"sv);
}

void WebDriverBiDiNetwork::update_session_state(Web::WebDriver::BiDiSessionState& state, Function<String(String const&)> const& context_id) const
{
    state.network_intercepts.clear();
    for (auto const& [id, intercept] : m_intercept_map) {
        Vector<String> phases;
        for (auto const& phase : intercept.phases)
            phases.append(phase);
        auto contexts = intercept.browsing_contexts;
        if (contexts.has_value()) {
            for (auto& context : *contexts)
                context = context_id(context);
        }
        state.network_intercepts.append({ id, intercept.url_patterns, move(phases), move(contexts) });
    }
    state.network_default_headers = m_default_headers;
    state.network_user_context_headers = m_user_context_headers;
    state.network_navigable_headers.clear();
    for (auto const& [id, headers] : m_navigable_headers)
        state.network_navigable_headers.set(context_id(id), headers);
    state.network_default_cache_behavior = m_default_cache_behavior;
    state.network_navigable_cache_behavior.clear();
    for (auto const& [id, behavior] : m_navigable_cache_behavior_map)
        state.network_navigable_cache_behavior.set(context_id(id), behavior);
}

void WebDriverBiDiNetwork::context_destroyed(String const& id)
{
    // NB: Navigable headers and the navigable cache behavior map are weak maps keyed by top-level traversables. We key
    //     them by navigable ID, so we remove the entries of a top-level traversable once it is gone.
    m_navigable_headers.remove(id);
    m_navigable_cache_behavior_map.remove(id);
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/Function.h>
#include <AK/HashMap.h>
#include <AK/HashTable.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/WebDriver/BiDi.h>
#include <LibWebView/Export.h>

namespace WebView {

WEBVIEW_API Web::WebDriver::BiDiSessionState session_state_for_hosted_traversables(Web::WebDriver::BiDiSessionState const&, HashTable<String> const&);

// NB: The network state belongs to the browser side of a BiDi session, where context IDs can be resolved.
class WebDriverBiDiNetwork {
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

public:
    using ValidateContext = Function<ErrorOr<void, Web::WebDriver::Error>(String const&)>;
    ErrorOr<JsonValue, Web::WebDriver::Error> run_command(StringView method, JsonObject const&, ValidateContext const&);
    void update_session_state(Web::WebDriver::BiDiSessionState&, Function<String(String const&)> const& context_id) const;
    void context_destroyed(String const&);

private:
    // https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#intercept-map
    struct Intercept {
        Vector<Web::WebDriver::Network::UrlPattern> url_patterns;
        HashTable<String> phases;
        Optional<Vector<String>> browsing_contexts;
    };
    OrderedHashMap<String, Intercept> m_intercept_map;

    // https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#network-collectors
    struct Collector {
        u64 max_encoded_item_size;
        Vector<String> data_types;
        String collector_type;
        Vector<String> contexts;
        Vector<String> user_contexts;
    };
    HashMap<String, Collector> m_network_collectors;

    // https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#session-extra-headers
    Vector<Web::WebDriver::Network::Header> m_default_headers;
    HashMap<String, Vector<Web::WebDriver::Network::Header>> m_user_context_headers;
    HashMap<String, Vector<Web::WebDriver::Network::Header>> m_navigable_headers;

    // https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#default-cache-behavior
    String m_default_cache_behavior { "default"_string };
    // https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigable-cache-behavior-map
    HashMap<String, String> m_navigable_cache_behavior_map;
};

}

#include <AK/JsonObject.h>

namespace WebView {

ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<WebDriverBrowserConnection>> WebDriverBrowserConnection::connect(ByteString const& webdriver_endpoint)
{
#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
    auto transport_ports = TRY(IPC::bootstrap_transport_from_mach_server(webdriver_endpoint));
    auto transport = make<IPC::Transport>(move(transport_ports.receive_right), move(transport_ports.send_right));
#else
    auto socket = TRY(Core::LocalSocket::connect(webdriver_endpoint));
    auto transport = TRY(IPC::Transport::from_socket(move(socket)));
#endif
    return adopt_nonnull_ref_or_enomem(new (nothrow) WebDriverBrowserConnection(move(transport)));
}

WebDriverBrowserConnection::WebDriverBrowserConnection(NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport> transport)
    : IPC::ConnectionToServer<WebDriverBrowserClientEndpoint, WebDriverBrowserServerEndpoint>(*this, move(transport))
    , m_webdriver_bidi(make<WebDriverBiDi>(*this))
{
}

void WebDriverBrowserConnection::die()
{
    Application::the().webdriver_browser_connection_died({});
}

void WebDriverBrowserConnection::close_session()
{
    Core::EventLoop::current().quit(0);
}

// 10.1 Navigate To, https://w3c.github.io/webdriver/#navigate-to
void WebDriverBrowserConnection::navigate_to(u64 command_id, String window_handle, URL::URL url)
{
    // 1. If the current top-level browsing context is no longer open, return error with error code no such window.
    auto view = ViewImplementation::find_view_by_handle(window_handle);
    if (!view.has_value()) {
        async_command_complete(command_id, Web::WebDriver::Error::from_code(Web::WebDriver::ErrorCode::NoSuchWindow, "Window not found"sv));
        return;
    }

    // 4. Handle any user prompts and return its value if it is an error.
    auto strong_this = NonnullRefPtr { *this };
    view->run_webdriver_user_prompt_handling([strong_this, command_id, view_id = view->view_id(), url = move(url)](Web::WebDriver::Response response) {
        if (response.is_error()) {
            strong_this->async_command_complete(command_id, move(response));
            return;
        }

        auto view = ViewImplementation::find_view_by_id(view_id);
        if (!view.has_value()) {
            strong_this->async_command_complete(command_id, Web::WebDriver::Error::from_code(Web::WebDriver::ErrorCode::NoSuchWindow, "Window not found"sv));
            return;
        }

        // 5. Let current URL be the current top-level browsing context’s active document’s URL.
        // NB: The URL replica is ordered after every navigation report WebContent sent before it
        //     answered the user prompt job, so it reflects the document state this command observed.
        auto const& current_url = view->url();

        // FIXME: 6. If current URL and url do not have the same absolute URL:
        // FIXME:     a. If timer has not been started, start a timer. If this algorithm has not completed before timer reaches the session’s session page load timeout in milliseconds, return an error with error code timeout.

        // 7. Navigate the current top-level browsing context to url.
        // NB: "Navigate to a javascript: URL" can evaluate without producing a new Document,
        //     in which case "we will not perform a navigation".
        // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsing-the-web.html#navigate-to-a-javascript:-url
        auto is_same_document_fragment_navigation = url.fragment().has_value()
            && url.equals(current_url, URL::ExcludeFragment::Yes);
        if (url.scheme() != "javascript"sv && !is_same_document_fragment_navigation)
            view->did_start_webdriver_navigation();
        view->load_for_webdriver_navigation(url);

        // FIXME: 10. If the current top-level browsing context contains a refresh state pragma directive of time 1 second or less, wait until the refresh timeout has elapsed, a new navigate has begun, and return to the first step of this algorithm.

        // 11. Return success with data null.
        strong_this->async_command_complete(command_id, JsonValue {});
    });
}

// 10.5 Refresh, https://w3c.github.io/webdriver/#dfn-refresh
void WebDriverBrowserConnection::refresh(u64 command_id, String window_handle)
{
    // 1. If the current top-level browsing context is no longer open, return error with error code no such window.
    auto view = ViewImplementation::find_view_by_handle(window_handle);
    if (!view.has_value()) {
        async_command_complete(command_id, Web::WebDriver::Error::from_code(Web::WebDriver::ErrorCode::NoSuchWindow, "Window not found"sv));
        return;
    }

    // 2. Handle any user prompts and return its value if it is an error.
    auto strong_this = NonnullRefPtr { *this };
    view->run_webdriver_user_prompt_handling([strong_this, command_id, view_id = view->view_id()](Web::WebDriver::Response response) {
        if (response.is_error()) {
            strong_this->async_command_complete(command_id, move(response));
            return;
        }

        auto view = ViewImplementation::find_view_by_id(view_id);
        if (!view.has_value()) {
            strong_this->async_command_complete(command_id, Web::WebDriver::Error::from_code(Web::WebDriver::ErrorCode::NoSuchWindow, "Window not found"sv));
            return;
        }

        // 3. Initiate an overridden reload of the current top-level browsing context’s active document.
        view->did_start_webdriver_navigation();
        view->reload();

        // FIXME: 4. If url is special except for file:
        // FIXME:     1. Try to wait for navigation to complete.
        // FIXME:     2. Try to run the post-navigation checks.

        // 6. Return success with data null.
        strong_this->async_command_complete(command_id, JsonValue {});
    });
}

void WebDriverBrowserConnection::wait_for_navigation_completion(u64 command_id, String window_handle, Optional<u64> page_load_timeout)
{
    auto view = ViewImplementation::find_view_by_handle(window_handle);
    if (!view.has_value()) {
        async_command_complete(command_id, Web::WebDriver::Error::from_code(Web::WebDriver::ErrorCode::NoSuchWindow, "Window not found"sv));
        return;
    }

    auto strong_this = NonnullRefPtr { *this };
    view->wait_for_webdriver_navigation_completion(page_load_timeout, [strong_this, command_id](Web::WebDriver::Response response) {
        strong_this->async_command_complete(command_id, move(response));
    });
}

void WebDriverBrowserConnection::load_url(u64 command_id, String window_handle, URL::URL url)
{
    auto view = ViewImplementation::find_view_by_handle(window_handle);
    if (!view.has_value()) {
        async_command_complete(command_id, Web::WebDriver::Error::from_code(Web::WebDriver::ErrorCode::NoSuchWindow, "Window not found"sv));
        return;
    }

    auto strong_this = NonnullRefPtr { *this };
    Core::deferred_invoke([strong_this, command_id, view_id = view->view_id(), url = move(url)]() {
        auto view = ViewImplementation::find_view_by_id(view_id);
        if (!view.has_value()) {
            strong_this->async_command_complete(command_id, Web::WebDriver::Error::from_code(Web::WebDriver::ErrorCode::NoSuchWindow, "Window not found"sv));
            return;
        }

        // The wait is armed only as the load starts: The current document can finish loading before then, and its
        // completion would end a wait that was armed for the load.
        view->did_start_webdriver_navigation();
        view->load_from_browser_ui(url);
        strong_this->async_command_complete(command_id, JsonValue {});
    });
}

void WebDriverBrowserConnection::run_content_command(u64 command_id, String window_handle, Web::WebDriver::SessionBrowsingContext browsing_context, String name, JsonValue payload, Vector<String> arguments)
{
    auto view = ViewImplementation::find_view_by_handle(window_handle);
    if (!view.has_value()) {
        async_command_complete(command_id, Web::WebDriver::Error::from_code(Web::WebDriver::ErrorCode::NoSuchWindow, "Window not found"sv));
        return;
    }

    view->run_webdriver_content_command(command_id, browsing_context, name, move(payload), move(arguments));
}

// 11.3 Switch to Window, https://w3c.github.io/webdriver/#dfn-switch-to-window
void WebDriverBrowserConnection::switch_to_window(u64 command_id, String window_handle)
{
    // 4. If handle is equal to the associated window handle for some top-level browsing context, let context be the that
    //    browsing context, and set the current top-level browsing context with session and context.
    //    Otherwise, return error with error code no such window.
    auto view = ViewImplementation::find_view_by_handle(window_handle);
    if (!view.has_value()) {
        async_command_complete(command_id, Web::WebDriver::Error::from_code(Web::WebDriver::ErrorCode::NoSuchWindow, "Window not found"sv));
        return;
    }
    view->set_webdriver_current_browsing_context_to_top_level();

    // 5. Update any implementation-specific state that would result from the user selecting the current
    //    browsing context for interaction, without altering OS-level focus.
    if (view->on_activate_tab)
        view->on_activate_tab();

    async_command_complete(command_id, JsonValue {});
}

void WebDriverBrowserConnection::switch_to_parent_frame(u64 command_id, String window_handle)
{
    auto view = ViewImplementation::find_view_by_handle(window_handle);
    if (!view.has_value()) {
        async_command_complete(command_id, Web::WebDriver::Error::from_code(Web::WebDriver::ErrorCode::NoSuchWindow, "Window not found"sv));
        return;
    }

    view->switch_webdriver_to_parent_frame([strong_this = NonnullRefPtr { *this }, command_id](Web::WebDriver::Response response) {
        strong_this->async_command_complete(command_id, move(response));
    });
}

void WebDriverBrowserConnection::set_current_browsing_context_to_top_level(u64 command_id, String window_handle)
{
    auto view = ViewImplementation::find_view_by_handle(window_handle);
    if (!view.has_value()) {
        async_command_complete(command_id, Web::WebDriver::Error::from_code(Web::WebDriver::ErrorCode::NoSuchWindow, "Window not found"sv));
        return;
    }

    view->set_webdriver_current_browsing_context_to_top_level();
    async_command_complete(command_id, JsonValue {});
}

// 10.3 Back, https://w3c.github.io/webdriver/#dfn-back
// 10.4 Forward, https://w3c.github.io/webdriver/#dfn-forward
void WebDriverBrowserConnection::traverse_history(u64 command_id, String window_handle, i32 delta, bool handle_user_prompts)
{
    // 1. If session's current top-level browsing context is no longer open, return error with error code no such window.
    auto view = ViewImplementation::find_view_by_handle(window_handle);
    if (!view.has_value()) {
        async_command_complete(command_id, Web::WebDriver::Error::from_code(Web::WebDriver::ErrorCode::NoSuchWindow, "Window not found"sv));
        return;
    }

    auto strong_this = NonnullRefPtr { *this };
    auto run_traversal = [strong_this, command_id, view_id = view->view_id(), delta]() {
        // Defer the traversal, so its cancelation checks can safely call back into the WebContent
        // process whose message dispatch we may currently be inside.
        Core::deferred_invoke([strong_this, command_id, view_id, delta]() {
            auto view = ViewImplementation::find_view_by_id(view_id);
            if (!view.has_value()) {
                strong_this->async_command_complete(command_id, Web::WebDriver::Error::from_code(Web::WebDriver::ErrorCode::NoSuchWindow, "Window not found"sv));
                return;
            }

            view->traverse_the_history_by_delta(delta, CheckForCancelation::Yes, [strong_this, command_id]() {
                strong_this->async_command_complete(command_id, JsonValue {});
            });
        });
    };

    if (!handle_user_prompts) {
        run_traversal();
        return;
    }

    // 2. Try to handle any user prompts with session.
    view->run_webdriver_user_prompt_handling([strong_this, command_id, run_traversal = move(run_traversal)](Web::WebDriver::Response response) mutable {
        if (response.is_error()) {
            strong_this->async_command_complete(command_id, move(response));
            return;
        }

        run_traversal();
    });
}

void WebDriverBrowserConnection::get_session_history(u64 command_id, String window_handle)
{
    auto view = ViewImplementation::find_view_by_handle(window_handle);
    if (!view.has_value()) {
        async_command_complete(command_id, Web::WebDriver::Error::from_code(Web::WebDriver::ErrorCode::NoSuchWindow, "Window not found"sv));
        return;
    }

    JsonObject result;
    result.set("ui"sv, view->webdriver_session_history());
    async_command_complete(command_id, JsonValue { move(result) });
}

// https://w3c.github.io/permissions/#webdriver-command-set-permission
void WebDriverBrowserConnection::set_permission(u64 command_id, String window_handle, JsonValue parameters)
{
    auto invalid_argument = [&](StringView message) {
        async_command_complete(command_id, Web::WebDriver::Error::from_code(Web::WebDriver::ErrorCode::InvalidArgument, message));
    };

    auto view = ViewImplementation::find_view_by_handle(window_handle);
    if (!view.has_value()) {
        async_command_complete(command_id, Web::WebDriver::Error::from_code(Web::WebDriver::ErrorCode::NoSuchWindow, "Window not found"sv));
        return;
    }

    if (!parameters.is_object())
        return invalid_argument("Parameters must be an object"sv);
    auto descriptor = parameters.as_object().get_object("descriptor"sv);
    if (!descriptor.has_value())
        return invalid_argument("The descriptor must be an object"sv);
    auto name = descriptor->get_string("name"sv).map([](auto const& string) { return Web::Permissions::permission_name_from_string(string); });
    if (!name.has_value() || !name->has_value())
        return invalid_argument("The permission name is not supported"sv);

    Optional<PermissionDecision> decision;
    auto state = parameters.as_object().get_string("state"sv);
    if (state == "granted"sv)
        decision = PermissionDecision::Allow;
    else if (state == "denied"sv)
        decision = PermissionDecision::Block;
    else if (state != "prompt"sv)
        return invalid_argument("The state must be granted, denied, or prompt"sv);

    // NB: A permission is kept for the top-level document's origin, whichever frame the session is in.
    view->set_site_permission(view->permission_origin(), **name, decision);
    async_command_complete(command_id, JsonValue {});
}

void WebDriverBrowserConnection::bidi_command(u64 command_id, String method, JsonValue params)
{
    m_webdriver_bidi->run_command(command_id, method, move(params));
}

void WebDriverBrowserConnection::bidi_get_top_level_traversables(u64 command_id, Vector<String> navigable_ids)
{
    m_webdriver_bidi->get_top_level_traversables(command_id, navigable_ids);
}

void WebDriverBrowserConnection::bidi_run_subscribe_steps(u64 command_id, String event_name, Vector<String> top_level_traversable_ids)
{
    m_webdriver_bidi->run_subscribe_steps(command_id, event_name, top_level_traversable_ids);
}

void WebDriverBrowserConnection::set_bidi_enabled_events(Vector<String> event_names, HashMap<String, Optional<Vector<String>>> event_contexts)
{
    m_webdriver_bidi->set_enabled_events(event_names, move(event_contexts));
}

FILE: Libraries/LibWebView/WebUI.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2025, Tim Flynn <trflynn89@ladybird.org>

#include <AK/NeverDestroyed.h>
#include <LibIPC/Transport.h>
#include <LibIPC/TransportHandle.h>
#include <LibWebView/WebContentClient.h>
#include <LibWebView/WebContentPage.h>
#include <LibWebView/WebUI.h>
#include <LibWebView/WebUI/AboutUI.h>
#include <LibWebView/WebUI/ApplicationWebUI.h>
#include <LibWebView/WebUI/CertificateUI.h>
#include <LibWebView/WebUI/CrashReportsUI.h>
#include <LibWebView/WebUI/SettingsUI.h>
#include <LibWebView/WebUI/SupportUI.h>

namespace WebView {

static constexpr auto s_pages = to_array<WebUI::Page>({
    { "about"sv, "About URLs"sv, WebUI::PageType::Dynamic },
    { "certificate"sv, "Certificate Warning"sv, WebUI::PageType::Dynamic },
    { "crashes"sv, "Crash Reports"sv, WebUI::PageType::Dynamic },
    { "licenses"sv, "Licenses"sv, WebUI::PageType::Static },
    { "newtab"sv, "New Tab"sv, WebUI::PageType::Static },
    { "settings"sv, "Settings"sv, WebUI::PageType::Dynamic },
    { "support"sv, "Support"sv, WebUI::PageType::Dynamic },
    { "welcome"sv, "Welcome"sv, WebUI::PageType::Dynamic },
});

struct ApplicationPage {
    String host;
    String title;
};

static Vector<ApplicationPage>& application_pages()
{
    static NeverDestroyed<Vector<ApplicationPage>> s_application_pages;
    return *s_application_pages;
}

Vector<WebUI::Page> WebUI::pages()
{
    Vector<Page> pages;
    pages.ensure_capacity(s_pages.size() + application_pages().size());
    for (auto const& page : s_pages)
        pages.unchecked_append(page);
    for (auto const& page : application_pages())
        pages.unchecked_append({ page.host, page.title, PageType::Application });
    return pages;
}

Optional<WebUI::Page> WebUI::page_for_host(StringView host)
{
    for (auto const& page : s_pages) {
        if (page.host == host)
            return page;
    }
    for (auto const& page : application_pages()) {
        if (page.host == host)
            return Page { page.host, page.title, PageType::Application };
    }
    return {};
}

void WebUI::add_application_page(String host, String title)
{
    if (!page_for_host(host).has_value())
        application_pages().append({ move(host), move(title) });
}

template<typename WebUIType>
static ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<WebUIType>> create_web_ui(WebContentClient& client, Web::PageId page_id, String host)
{
    VERIFY(page_id > 0);

    auto paired = TRY(IPC::Transport::create_paired());
    auto handle = move(paired.remote_handle);

    auto web_ui = WebUIType::create(client, page_id, move(paired.local), move(host));
    client.async_connect_to_web_ui(page_id, move(handle));

    return web_ui;
}

ErrorOr<RefPtr<WebUI>> WebUI::create(WebContentClient& client, Web::PageId page_id, String host)
{
    auto page = page_for_host(host);
    if (!page.has_value() || page->type == PageType::Static)
        return nullptr;

    RefPtr<WebUI> web_ui;

    if (page->type == PageType::Application)
        web_ui = TRY(create_web_ui<ApplicationWebUI>(client, page_id, move(host)));
    else if (page->host == "about"sv)
        web_ui = TRY(create_web_ui<AboutUI>(client, page_id, move(host)));
    else if (page->host == "certificate"sv)
        web_ui = TRY(create_web_ui<CertificateUI>(client, page_id, move(host)));
    else if (page->host == "crashes"sv)
        web_ui = TRY(create_web_ui<CrashReportsUI>(client, page_id, move(host)));
    else if (page->host.is_one_of("settings"sv, "welcome"sv))
        web_ui = TRY(create_web_ui<SettingsUI>(client, page_id, move(host)));
    else if (page->host == "support"sv)
        web_ui = TRY(create_web_ui<SupportUI>(client, page_id, move(host)));

    VERIFY(web_ui);
    web_ui->register_interfaces();

    return web_ui;
}

WebUI::WebUI(WebContentClient& client, Web::PageId page_id, NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport> transport, String host)
    : IPC::ConnectionToServer<WebUIClientEndpoint, WebUIServerEndpoint>(*this, move(transport))
    , m_client(client)
    , m_page_id(page_id)
    , m_host(move(host))
{
}

WebUI::~WebUI() = default;

void WebUI::die()
{
    if (auto client = m_client.strong_ref())
        if (auto* page = client->page(m_page_id))
            page->web_ui_disconnected({}, *this);
}

void WebUI::register_interface(StringView name, Interface interface)
{
    auto result = m_interfaces.set(name, move(interface));
    VERIFY(result == HashSetResult::InsertedNewEntry);
}

void WebUI::received_message(String name, JsonValue data)
{
    if (!has_client())
        return;

    auto interface = m_interfaces.get(name);
    if (!interface.has_value()) {
        warnln("Received message from WebUI for unrecognized interface: {}", name);
        return;
    }

    interface.value()(move(data));
}

}

class WEBVIEW_API WebUI
    : public IPC::ConnectionToServer<WebUIClientEndpoint, WebUIServerEndpoint>
    , public WebUIClientEndpoint {
public:
    enum class PageType {
        Static,
        Dynamic,
        Application,
    };

    struct Page {
        StringView host;
        StringView title;
        PageType type;
    };

    static Vector<Page> pages();
    static Optional<Page> page_for_host(StringView);

    virtual ~WebUI();

    Web::PageId page_id() const { return m_page_id; }

    WebUI(WebContentClient&, Web::PageId, NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport>, String host);

    // NB: The client of a WebUI is destroyed when its process exits, which can happen before the WebUI's own
    //     connection closes. Code that can run after that checks has_client() first.
    WebContentClient& client() const { return *m_client; }
    bool has_client() const { return !m_client.is_null(); }

    using Interface = Function<void(JsonValue)>;

    virtual void register_interfaces() { }
    void register_interface(StringView name, Interface);

private:
    virtual void die() override;
    virtual void received_message(String name, JsonValue data) override;

    WeakPtr<WebContentClient> m_client;
    Web::PageId m_page_id;
    String m_host;

    HashMap<StringView, Interface> m_interfaces;
};

#include <AK/JsonArray.h>
#include <AK/JsonObject.h>
#include <LibWebView/WebUI/AboutUI.h>

namespace WebView {

void AboutUI::register_interfaces()
{
    register_interface("loadPages"sv, [this](auto const&) {
        load_pages();
    });
}

void AboutUI::load_pages()
{
    auto pages = WebUI::pages();

    JsonArray page_list;
    page_list.ensure_capacity(pages.size());

    for (auto const& page : pages) {
        JsonObject entry;
        entry.set("host"sv, page.host);
        entry.set("title"sv, page.title);
        page_list.must_append(move(entry));
    }

    async_send_message("loadPages"sv, move(page_list));
}

}

#include <AK/HashMap.h>
#include <AK/NeverDestroyed.h>

#include <LibWebView/WebContentPage.h>
#include <LibWebView/WebUI/ApplicationWebUI.h>

namespace WebView {

static ApplicationWebUI::Callbacks& callbacks()
{
    static NeverDestroyed<ApplicationWebUI::Callbacks> s_callbacks;
    return *s_callbacks;
}

static HashMap<u64, ApplicationWebUI*>& web_uis()
{
    static NeverDestroyed<HashMap<u64, ApplicationWebUI*>> s_web_uis;
    return *s_web_uis;
}

static u64 s_next_id { 1 };

void ApplicationWebUI::set_callbacks(Callbacks callbacks)
{
    ::WebView::callbacks() = move(callbacks);
}

ApplicationWebUI* ApplicationWebUI::find(u64 id)
{
    return web_uis().get(id).value_or(nullptr);
}

ApplicationWebUI::~ApplicationWebUI()
{
    web_uis().remove(m_id);
    if (callbacks().on_close)
        callbacks().on_close(m_id);
}

void ApplicationWebUI::register_interfaces()
{
    m_id = s_next_id++;
    web_uis().set(m_id, this);
    if (callbacks().on_open)
        callbacks().on_open(m_id, host(), client().is_private());
}

void ApplicationWebUI::received_message(String name, JsonValue data)
{
    if (has_client() && callbacks().on_message)
        callbacks().on_message(m_id, move(name), move(data));
}

bool ApplicationWebUI::consume_user_activation()
{
    if (!has_client())
        return false;
    auto* page = client().page(page_id());
    return page && page->consume_transient_user_activation();
}

void ApplicationWebUI::send_to_page(String const& name, JsonValue const& data)
{
    if (has_client())
        async_send_message(name, data);
}

}

/*

#include <AK/JsonObject.h>
#include <LibURL/Parser.h>
#include <LibWebView/ViewImplementation.h>
#include <LibWebView/WebContentClient.h>
#include <LibWebView/WebContentPage.h>
#include <LibWebView/WebUI/CertificateUI.h>

namespace WebView {

void CertificateUI::register_interfaces()
{
    register_interface("loadCertificateWarning"sv, [this](auto const&) {
        load_certificate_warning();
    });
    register_interface("trustCertificate"sv, [this](auto const& data) {
        answer_certificate_warning(data, true);
    });
    register_interface("rejectCertificate"sv, [this](auto const& data) {
        answer_certificate_warning(data, false);
    });
}

ViewImplementation* CertificateUI::view() const
{
    if (!has_client())
        return nullptr;

    auto* page = client().page(page_id());
    if (!page || !page->displays_tab())
        return nullptr;
    return &page->view();
}

void CertificateUI::load_certificate_warning()
{
    auto* view = this->view();
    if (!view || !view->certificate_warning().has_value()) {
        async_send_message("loadCertificateWarning"sv, JsonValue {});
        return;
    }

    auto const& warning = *view->certificate_warning();

    JsonObject object;
    // Use the URL to identify the answer, but display only the origin to omit credentials, paths and queries.
    object.set("url"sv, warning.url.serialize());
    object.set("origin"sv, warning.url.origin().serialize());
    object.set("resendsForm"sv, warning.form_submission.has_value());
    object.set("formIsNotResent"sv, warning.form_is_not_resent);
    object.set("host"sv, MUST(String::from_byte_string(warning.certificate.host)));
    object.set("fingerprint"sv, MUST(String::from_byte_string(warning.certificate.fingerprint)));
    async_send_message("loadCertificateWarning"sv, move(object));
}

void CertificateUI::answer_certificate_warning(JsonValue const& data, bool trust)
{
    if (!data.is_object())
        return;

    auto url_string = data.as_object().get_string("url"sv);
    auto fingerprint = data.as_object().get_string("fingerprint"sv);
    if (!url_string.has_value() || !fingerprint.has_value())
        return;

    auto url = URL::Parser::basic_parse(*url_string);
    if (!url.has_value())
        return;

    if (auto* view = this->view())
        view->answer_certificate_warning({}, *url, *fingerprint, trust);
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWebView/WebUI/CrashReportsUI.cpp
/*

 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
