#include <AK/HashMap.h>
#include <AK/Hex.h>
#include <AK/JsonArray.h>
#include <AK/JsonObject.h>
#include <LibCrypto/Hash/Hash.h>
#include <LibURL/Parser.h>
#include <LibWebView/CrashReportDiagnostics.h>
#include <LibWebView/CrashReportStore.h>
#include <LibWebView/WebUI/CrashReportsUI.h>

namespace WebView {

static StringView plain_process_name(StringView process)
{
    if (process == "Compositor"sv)
        return "Graphics process"sv;
    if (process == "WebContent"sv)
        return "Page"sv;
    if (process == "RequestServer"sv)
        return "Network process"sv;
    if (process == "ImageDecoder"sv)
        return "Image decoder"sv;
    if (process == "MediaServer"sv)
        return "Media process"sv;
    if (process == "AudioServer"sv)
        return "Audio process"sv;
    if (process == "VideoDecoderServer"sv)
        return "Video decoder"sv;
    if (process == "WebRTCClient"sv)
        return "WebRTC process"sv;
    return "Ladybird"sv;
}

static Optional<String> website_host(String const& website)
{
    auto url = URL::Parser::basic_parse(website);
    if (!url.has_value() || !url->host().has_value())
        return {};
    return MUST(String::from_utf8(url->serialized_host()));
}

void CrashReportsUI::register_interfaces()
{
    register_interface("loadReports"sv, [this](auto const&) {
        load_reports();
    });
    register_interface("sendReports"sv, [this](auto const& data) {
        send_reports(data);
    });
    register_interface("deleteReports"sv, [this](auto const& data) {
        delete_reports(data);
    });
    register_interface("showReport"sv, [this](auto const& data) {
        show_report(data);
    });
}

void CrashReportsUI::crash_reports_changed()
{
    if (has_client())
        load_reports();
}

static CrashReportsUI::ReportSummary read_report_summary(CrashReportStore const& store, ByteString const& name)
{
    // Only a stack can show that two reports are the same crash, so every other report gets a row of its own.
    CrashReportsUI::ReportSummary summary { name, "Unreadable report"_string, {} };

    // A report that cannot be read still counts as waiting, so it gets a row to delete it from.
    auto report = store.saved_report(name);
    if (report.is_error()) {
        warnln("Could not read crash report {}: {}", name, report.error());
        return summary;
    }

    auto diagnostics = CrashReportDiagnostics::parse(report.value().text);
    if (diagnostics.has_native_stack())
        summary.signature = diagnostics.signature();
    summary.process = MUST(String::from_utf8(plain_process_name(diagnostics.header("Process"sv))));
    summary.crashed_at = diagnostics.crashed_at;
    return summary;
}

void CrashReportsUI::load_reports()
{
    struct Group {
        ByteString id;
        String process;
        Optional<UnixDateTime> last_crashed_at;
        Vector<ByteString> names;
        Vector<String> websites;
        Vector<Optional<String>> website_of_each_report;
        Vector<String> hosts;
    };

    auto& store = CrashReportStore::the();
    auto& outbox = CrashReportOutbox::the();

    Vector<ByteString> names;
    if (auto pending = store.pending_report_names(); pending.is_error())
        warnln("Could not list crash reports: {}", pending.error());
    else
        names = pending.release_value();

    // The names come newest first, so a group's first report is its last crash.
    Vector<Group> groups;
    HashMap<ByteString, size_t> group_indices;
    HashMap<ByteString, ReportSummary> report_summaries;
    for (auto const& name : names) {
        // A saved report does not change, and this runs each time any report does.
        auto cached_summary = m_report_summaries.get(name);
        auto summary = cached_summary.has_value() ? cached_summary.value() : read_report_summary(store, name);
        report_summaries.set(name, summary);
        auto const& [signature, process, crashed_at] = summary;

        auto index = group_indices.ensure(signature, [&] {
            groups.append({
                .id = encode_hex(Crypto::Hash::digest(Crypto::Hash::HashKind::SHA256, signature.bytes()).bytes()),
                .process = process,
                .last_crashed_at = crashed_at,
                .names = {},
                .websites = {},
                .website_of_each_report = {},
                .hosts = {},
            });
            return groups.size() - 1;
        });
        auto& group = groups[index];
        group.names.append(name);

        auto website = store.website(name);
        group.website_of_each_report.append(website);
        if (website.has_value()) {
            if (auto host = website_host(*website); host.has_value() && !group.hosts.contains_slow(*host))
                group.hosts.append(host.release_value());
            if (!group.websites.contains_slow(*website))
                group.websites.append(website.release_value());
        }
    }

    m_report_summaries = move(report_summaries);

    JsonArray serialized_groups;
    serialized_groups.ensure_capacity(groups.size());
    for (auto const& group : groups) {
        JsonArray serialized_names;
        bool is_sending = false;
        bool could_not_send = false;
        String note;
        JsonArray included_websites;
        for (auto const& name : group.names) {
            serialized_names.must_append(String::from_utf8_with_replacement_character(name));
            is_sending |= outbox.is_sending(name);
            could_not_send |= outbox.could_not_send(name);
            if (auto attempt = outbox.failed_attempt(name); attempt.has_value()) {
                if (note.is_empty())
                    note = attempt->description;
                if (attempt->url.has_value())
                    included_websites.must_append(*attempt->url);
            }
        }

        JsonObject serialized_group;
        serialized_group.set("id"sv, String::from_utf8_with_replacement_character(group.id));
        // A row only names a site when that is the whole truth about the websites it would send.
        if (group.hosts.size() == 1)
            serialized_group.set("process"sv, MUST(String::formatted("{} on {}", group.process, group.hosts.first())));
        else if (group.hosts.size() > 1)
            serialized_group.set("process"sv, MUST(String::formatted("{} on {} websites", group.process, group.hosts.size())));
        else
            serialized_group.set("process"sv, group.process);
        if (group.last_crashed_at.has_value())
            serialized_group.set("lastCrashedAt"sv, group.last_crashed_at->milliseconds_since_epoch());
        serialized_group.set("names"sv, move(serialized_names));

        JsonArray serialized_websites;
        for (auto const& website : group.websites)
            serialized_websites.must_append(website);
        serialized_group.set("websites"sv, move(serialized_websites));

        // In the order of the names, so that the page can tell which reports a ticked website belongs to.
        JsonArray serialized_website_of_each_report;
        for (auto const& website : group.website_of_each_report)
            serialized_website_of_each_report.must_append(website.has_value() ? JsonValue { *website } : JsonValue {});
        serialized_group.set("websiteOfEachReport"sv, move(serialized_website_of_each_report));

        // A page opened after a failed attempt starts from the choices that were made for it.
        serialized_group.set("note"sv, note);
        serialized_group.set("includedWebsites"sv, move(included_websites));

        serialized_group.set("isSending"sv, is_sending);
        serialized_group.set("couldNotSend"sv, could_not_send);
        serialized_groups.must_append(move(serialized_group));
    }

    async_send_message("loadReports"sv, move(serialized_groups));
}

void CrashReportsUI::send_reports(JsonValue const& data)
{
    if (!data.is_array())
        return;

    Vector<CrashReportOutbox::Report> reports;
    data.as_array().for_each([&](JsonValue const& value) {
        if (!value.is_object())
            return;
        auto name = value.as_object().get_string("name"sv);
        auto description = value.as_object().get_string("description"sv);
        if (!name.has_value())
            return;

        // The website only ever leaves this computer because the user ticked its box for this report.
        auto report_name = name->to_byte_string();
        Optional<String> url;
        if (value.as_object().get_bool("includeWebsite"sv).value_or(false))
            url = CrashReportStore::the().website(report_name);
        reports.append({ move(report_name), description.has_value() ? *description : String {}, move(url) });
    });

    CrashReportOutbox::the().send(move(reports));
}

void CrashReportsUI::delete_reports(JsonValue const& data)
{
    if (!data.is_array())
        return;

    Vector<ByteString> names;
    data.as_array().for_each([&](JsonValue const& value) {
        if (value.is_string())
            names.append(value.as_string().to_byte_string());
    });

    CrashReportOutbox::the().remove(names);
}

void CrashReportsUI::show_report(JsonValue const& data)
{
    if (!data.is_string())
        return;

    auto name = data.as_string().to_byte_string();
    auto report = CrashReportStore::the().saved_report(name);
    if (report.is_error()) {
        warnln("Could not read crash report {}: {}", name, report.error());
        return;
    }

    JsonObject message;
    message.set("name"sv, String::from_utf8_with_replacement_character(name));
    message.set("text"sv, String::from_utf8_with_replacement_character(report.value().text));
    async_send_message("showReport"sv, move(message));
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/ByteString.h>

#include <LibWebView/CrashReportOutbox.h>

namespace WebView {

class CrashReportsUI final
    : public WebUI
    , public CrashReportOutboxObserver {
    WEB_UI(CrashReportsUI);

public:
    // What the list needs to know about a report, which takes reading all of it to find out.
    struct ReportSummary {
        ByteString signature;
        String process;
        Optional<UnixDateTime> crashed_at;
    };

private:
    virtual void register_interfaces() override;

    virtual void crash_reports_changed() override;

    void load_reports();
    void send_reports(JsonValue const&);
    void delete_reports(JsonValue const&);
    void show_report(JsonValue const&);

    HashMap<ByteString, ReportSummary> m_report_summaries;
};

static StringView config_variable_type_to_string(JsonValue::Type type)
{
    switch (type) {
    case JsonValue::Type::Null:
        return "null"sv;
    case JsonValue::Type::Bool:
        return "boolean"sv;
    case JsonValue::Type::Number:
        return "number"sv;
    case JsonValue::Type::String:
        return "string"sv;
    case JsonValue::Type::Array:
        return "array"sv;
    case JsonValue::Type::Object:
        return "object"sv;
    }

    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

static bool should_show_config_variable(ConfigVariableID id)
{
    // NB: The Debug menu has the toggle for this one.
    if (id == ConfigVariableID::ShowTabPerformanceMonitor)
        return false;
    if (id == ConfigVariableID::ShowFeedbackButton)
        return !BROWSER_IS_FINAL_RELEASE;
    if (id == ConfigVariableID::UseClientSideWindowDecorations)
        return Application::the().supports_client_side_window_decorations();
    if (id == ConfigVariableID::VerticalTabsHoverExpandDelay || id == ConfigVariableID::VerticalTabsHoverExpandAnimationDuration)
        return Application::the().supports_vertical_tabs();
    return true;
}

SettingsUISitePermissionsObserver::SettingsUISitePermissionsObserver(SettingsUI& settings_ui)
    : m_settings_ui(settings_ui)
    , m_manager(*Application::default_session().permission_manager)
{
    m_manager->register_observer(*this);
}

// The settings page can outlive the browsing session at shutdown.
SettingsUISitePermissionsObserver::~SettingsUISitePermissionsObserver()
{
    if (auto* manager = m_manager.ptr())
        manager->unregister_observer(*this);
}

void SettingsUISitePermissionsObserver::permissions_changed(PermissionManager const&)
{
    m_settings_ui.broadcast_settings_change();
}

void SettingsUI::load_features()
{
    auto& application = Application::the();

    JsonObject features;
    features.set("menuBar"_string, application.supports_system_menu_bar());
    features.set("primaryPaste"_string, application.supports_clipboard_type(Application::ClipboardType::Selection));
    features.set("verticalTabs"_string, application.supports_vertical_tabs());
    features.set("geolocation"_string, Core::GeolocationProvider::is_available());

    async_send_message("loadFeatures"sv, move(features));
}

JsonObject SettingsUI::serialize_settings() const
{
    auto settings_json = Application::settings().serialize_json();
    auto settings = move(settings_json.as_object());

    settings.set("defaultNewTabPageURL"sv, Settings::default_new_tab_page_url().serialize());

    switch (Application::the().default_browser().status()) {
    case DefaultBrowserStatus::Unknown:
        break;
    case DefaultBrowserStatus::Unavailable:
        settings.set("defaultBrowser"sv, "unavailable"_string);
        break;
    case DefaultBrowserStatus::NotDefault:
        settings.set("defaultBrowser"sv, "not-default"_string);
        break;
    case DefaultBrowserStatus::Default:
        settings.set("defaultBrowser"sv, "default"_string);
        break;
    }

    // The sites the user allowed or blocked, for each permission.
    JsonObject site_settings;
    site_settings.set("autoplay"sv, settings.get("autoplay"sv).value());
    for (auto name : Web::Permissions::PERMISSION_NAMES) {
        JsonArray sites;
        for (auto const& site : Application::default_session().permission_manager->site_decisions(name)) {
            JsonObject entry;
            entry.set("filter"sv, site.origin.serialize());
            switch (site.decision) {
            case PermissionDecision::Allow:
                entry.set("policy"sv, "allow"_string);
                break;
            case PermissionDecision::AllowOnce:
                entry.set("policy"sv, "allow-once"_string);
                break;
            case PermissionDecision::Block:
                entry.set("policy"sv, "block"_string);
                break;
            }
            sites.must_append(move(entry));
        }

        JsonObject setting;
        setting.set("policy"sv, Application::settings().permission_policy(name) == PermissionPolicy::Block ? "block"sv : "ask"sv);
        setting.set("siteFilters"sv, move(sites));
        site_settings.set(Web::Permissions::to_string(name), move(setting));
    }

    settings.set("siteSettings"sv, move(site_settings));

    JsonArray config_variables;
    for (auto const& variable : config_variable_definitions()) {
        if (!should_show_config_variable(variable.id))
            continue;

        JsonObject variable_object;
        variable_object.set("name"sv, variable.name);
        variable_object.set("title"sv, variable.title);
        variable_object.set("description"sv, variable.description);
        variable_object.set("type"sv, config_variable_type_to_string(variable.default_value.type()));
        if (variable.array_element_type.has_value())
            variable_object.set("elementType"sv, config_variable_type_to_string(*variable.array_element_type));
        variable_object.set("defaultValue"sv, variable.default_value);
        variable_object.set("value"sv, Application::settings().config_variable(variable.id));

        config_variables.must_append(move(variable_object));
    }

    settings.set("configVariableDefinitions"sv, move(config_variables));

    JsonArray lists;
    for (auto const& list : Application::settings().content_blocker_lists()) {
        JsonObject object;
        object.set("identifier"sv, list.identifier);
        object.set("name"sv, list.name);
        object.set("description"sv, list.description);
        object.set("url"sv, list.url.has_value() ? JsonValue(list.url->serialize()) : JsonValue {});
        object.set("builtIn"sv, list.built_in);
        object.set("languageSpecific"sv, list.language_specific);
        object.set("enabled"sv, list.enabled);
        auto updated = Application::the().content_blocker_list_last_updated_at(list.identifier);
        object.set("lastUpdatedAt"sv, updated.has_value() ? JsonValue(updated->milliseconds_since_epoch()) : JsonValue {});
        lists.must_append(move(object));
    }
    settings.set("contentBlockerLists"sv, move(lists));
    settings.set("contentBlockerListUpdateInProgress"sv, Application::the().content_blocker_list_update_in_progress());

    return settings;
}

void SettingsUI::load_current_settings()
{
    m_current_settings = serialize_settings();
    async_send_message("loadSettings"sv, *m_current_settings);
}

void SettingsUI::broadcast_settings_change()
{
    if (!m_current_settings.has_value() || m_settings_change_scheduled)
        return;
    m_settings_change_scheduled = true;

    // Defer to allow the current handler to finish, including any downloads started after changing a setting.
    Core::deferred_invoke([weak_this = make_weak_ptr<SettingsUI>()] {
        auto* self = weak_this.ptr();
        if (!self)
            return;

        auto settings = self->serialize_settings();
        JsonObject changes;

        settings.for_each_member([&](auto const& name, auto const& value) {
            auto previous = self->m_current_settings->get(name);
            if (!previous.has_value() || !previous->equals(value))
                changes.set(name, value);
        });

        self->m_current_settings->for_each_member([&](auto const& name, auto const&) {
            if (!settings.has(name))
                changes.set(name, JsonValue {});
        });
        self->m_current_settings = move(settings);
        self->m_settings_change_scheduled = false;

        if (!changes.is_empty())
            self->async_send_message("loadSettings"sv, changes);
    });
}

void SettingsUI::complete_first_run(JsonValue const&)
{
    auto& settings = Application::settings();

    if (auto result = settings.complete_first_run(); result.is_error()) {
        async_send_message("firstRunError"sv, "Could not save your settings. Please try again."_string);
        return;
    }

    async_send_message("firstRunCompleted"sv, settings.new_tab_page_url().serialize());
}

void SettingsUI::make_default_browser(JsonValue const&)
{
    Application::the().default_browser().make_default([weak_this = make_weak_ptr<SettingsUI>()](MakeDefaultBrowserResult const& result) {
        auto self = weak_this.strong_ref();
        if (!self)
            return;

        if (!result.failed) {
            self->async_send_message("defaultBrowserResult"sv, JsonValue {});
            return;
        }

        auto failure = result.system_message.has_value()
            ? MUST(String::formatted("Could not make Ladybird the default browser. The system reported: {}", *result.system_message))
            : "Could not make Ladybird the default browser. Choose it in your system settings instead."_string;
        self->async_send_message("defaultBrowserResult"sv, move(failure));
    });
}

void SettingsUI::set_new_tab_page_url(JsonValue const& new_tab_page_url)
{
    if (!new_tab_page_url.is_string())
        return;

    auto parsed_new_tab_page_url = URL::Parser::basic_parse(new_tab_page_url.as_string());
    if (!parsed_new_tab_page_url.has_value())
        return;

    Application::settings().set_new_tab_page_url(parsed_new_tab_page_url.release_value());
}

void SettingsUI::set_restore_previous_session(JsonValue const& restore_previous_session)
{
    if (!restore_previous_session.is_bool())
        return;

    Application::settings().set_restore_previous_session(restore_previous_session.as_bool());
}

void SettingsUI::set_languages(JsonValue const& languages)
{
    auto parsed_languages = Settings::parse_json_languages(languages);
    Application::settings().set_languages(move(parsed_languages));
}

void SettingsUI::set_appearance(JsonValue const& appearance)
{
    auto parsed_appearance = Settings::parse_appearance(appearance);
    Application::settings().set_appearance(parsed_appearance);
}

void SettingsUI::set_content_settings(JsonValue const& content_settings)
{
    auto& settings = Application::settings();
    auto parsed_content_settings = Settings::parse_content_settings(content_settings);
    auto const& current_content_settings = settings.content_settings();

    // Host choices change through their own controls, independently of edits to the default.
    parsed_content_settings.zoom_per_host = current_content_settings.zoom_per_host;
    parsed_content_settings.force_dark_per_host = current_content_settings.force_dark_per_host;

    Application::settings().set_content_settings(move(parsed_content_settings));
}

void SettingsUI::reset_host_setting(JsonValue const& data)
{
    if (!data.is_object())
        return;

    auto setting = data.as_object().get_string("setting"sv);
    auto host = data.as_object().get_string("host"sv);
    if (data.as_object().has("host"sv) && !host.has_value())
        return;

    auto host_view = host.map([](auto const& value) { return value.bytes_as_string_view(); });

    if (setting == "zoom"sv)
        Application::settings().reset_host_setting(HostSetting::Zoom, host_view);
    else if (setting == "force-dark"sv)
        Application::settings().reset_host_setting(HostSetting::ForceDark, host_view);
}

void SettingsUI::set_tab_settings(JsonValue const& tab_settings)
{
    auto& settings = Application::settings();
    auto parsed_tab_settings = Settings::parse_tab_settings(tab_settings);
    auto const& current_tab_settings = settings.tab_settings();

    // Collapsed/expanded vertical tabs and their width are not controlled by the settings UI. Don't overwrite them.
    parsed_tab_settings.vertical_tabs_expanded = current_tab_settings.vertical_tabs_expanded;
    parsed_tab_settings.vertical_tabs_expanded_width = current_tab_settings.vertical_tabs_expanded_width;

    // NB: A sidebar layout picked on the welcome page opens expanded, so the choice shows in the window at once.
    if (host() == "welcome"sv && parsed_tab_settings.vertical_tabs_enabled)
        parsed_tab_settings.vertical_tabs_expanded = true;

    settings.set_tab_settings(parsed_tab_settings);
}

void SettingsUI::set_browsing_behavior(JsonValue const& browsing_behavior)
{
    auto parsed_browsing_behavior = Settings::parse_browsing_behavior(browsing_behavior);
    Application::settings().set_browsing_behavior(parsed_browsing_behavior);
}

void SettingsUI::set_config_variable(JsonValue const& variable)
{
    if (!variable.is_object())
        return;

    auto name = variable.as_object().get_string("name"sv);
    auto value = variable.as_object().get("value"sv);
    if (!name.has_value() || !value.has_value())
        return;

    Application::settings().set_config_variable(*name, *value);
}

void SettingsUI::load_available_engines()
{
    JsonArray search_engines;
    for (auto const& engine : WebView::builtin_search_engines()) {
        JsonObject object;
        object.set("name"sv, engine.name);
        object.set("supportsSuggestions"sv, engine.suggestions_url.has_value());
        search_engines.must_append(move(object));
    }

    JsonObject engines;
    engines.set("search"sv, move(search_engines));

    async_send_message("loadEngines"sv, move(engines));
}

void SettingsUI::set_search_engine_settings(JsonValue const& data)
{
    if (!data.is_object())
        return;

    auto engine = data.as_object().get("engine"sv);
    auto suggestions = data.as_object().get_bool("suggestions"sv);
    if (!engine.has_value() || (!engine->is_null() && !engine->is_string()) || !suggestions.has_value())
        return;

    auto& settings = Application::settings();
    SearchEngineSettings search_engine_settings;
    if (engine->is_string())
        search_engine_settings.engine = settings.find_search_engine_by_name(engine->as_string());
    search_engine_settings.suggestions = *suggestions;
    settings.set_search_engine_settings(move(search_engine_settings));
}

void SettingsUI::add_custom_search_engine(JsonValue const& search_engine)
{
    if (auto custom_engine = Settings::parse_custom_search_engine(search_engine); custom_engine.has_value())
        Application::settings().add_custom_search_engine(custom_engine.release_value());
}

void SettingsUI::remove_custom_search_engine(JsonValue const& search_engine)
{
    if (auto custom_engine = Settings::parse_custom_search_engine(search_engine); custom_engine.has_value())
        Application::settings().remove_custom_search_engine(*custom_engine);
}

void SettingsUI::load_forcibly_enabled_site_settings()
{
    JsonArray site_settings;

    if (Application::web_content_options().enable_autoplay == EnableAutoplay::Yes)
        site_settings.must_append("autoplay"sv);

    async_send_message("forciblyEnableSiteSettings"sv, move(site_settings));
}

void SettingsUI::set_site_setting_policy(JsonValue const& site_setting)
{
    if (!site_setting.is_object())
        return;

    auto setting = site_setting.as_object().get_string("setting"sv);
    auto policy = site_setting.as_object().get_string("policy"sv);
    if (!setting.has_value() || !policy.has_value() || !policy->is_ascii())
        return;

    if (*setting == "autoplay"sv) {
        auto policy_utf16 = Utf16View::from_ascii(*policy);
        if (auto parsed = Web::HTML::autoplay_policy_from_string(policy_utf16); parsed.has_value())
            Application::settings().set_autoplay_policy(*parsed);
    } else if (auto name = Web::Permissions::permission_name_from_string(*setting); name.has_value()) {
        if (*policy == "ask"sv)
            Application::settings().set_permission_policy(*name, PermissionPolicy::Ask);
        else if (*policy == "block"sv)
            Application::settings().set_permission_policy(*name, PermissionPolicy::Block);
    }
}

static Optional<URL::Origin> site_setting_origin(String const& filter)
{
    auto url = URL::Parser::basic_parse(filter.bytes_as_string_view().trim_whitespace());
    if (!url.has_value() || url->origin().is_opaque())
        return {};
    return url->origin();
}

void SettingsUI::add_site_setting_filter(JsonValue const& site_setting)
{
    if (!site_setting.is_object())
        return;

    auto setting = site_setting.as_object().get_string("setting"sv);
    auto filter = site_setting.as_object().get_string("filter"sv);
    auto policy = site_setting.as_object().get_string("policy"sv);
    if (!setting.has_value() || !filter.has_value() || !policy.has_value() || !policy->is_ascii())
        return;

    auto origin = site_setting_origin(*filter);
    if (!origin.has_value())
        return;

    if (*setting == "autoplay"sv) {
        auto policy_utf16 = Utf16String::from_utf8_without_validation(*policy);
        if (auto parsed = Web::HTML::autoplay_policy_from_string(policy_utf16.utf16_view()); parsed.has_value())
            Application::settings().add_autoplay_site_filter(origin->serialize(), *parsed);
    } else if (auto name = Web::Permissions::permission_name_from_string(*setting); name.has_value()) {
        PermissionDecision decision;
        if (*policy == "allow"sv)
            decision = PermissionDecision::Allow;
        else if (*policy == "block"sv)
            decision = PermissionDecision::Block;
        else
            return;

        Application::default_session().permission_manager->set_decision(*name, *origin, decision);
    }
}

void SettingsUI::remove_site_setting_filter(JsonValue const& site_setting)
{
    if (!site_setting.is_object())
        return;

    auto setting = site_setting.as_object().get_string("setting"sv);
    auto filter = site_setting.as_object().get_string("filter"sv);
    if (!setting.has_value() || !filter.has_value())
        return;

    auto origin = site_setting_origin(*filter);
    if (!origin.has_value())
        return;

    if (*setting == "autoplay"sv) {
        Application::settings().remove_autoplay_site_filter(origin->serialize());
    } else if (auto name = Web::Permissions::permission_name_from_string(*setting); name.has_value()) {
        Application::default_session().permission_manager->set_decision(*name, *origin, {});
    }
}

void SettingsUI::remove_all_site_setting_filters(JsonValue const& site_setting)
{
    if (!site_setting.is_object())
        return;

    auto setting = site_setting.as_object().get_string("setting"sv);
    if (!setting.has_value())
        return;

    if (*setting == "autoplay"sv) {
        Application::settings().remove_all_autoplay_site_filters();
    } else if (auto name = Web::Permissions::permission_name_from_string(*setting); name.has_value()) {
        auto& manager = *Application::default_session().permission_manager;

        for (auto const& site : manager.site_decisions(*name))
            manager.set_decision(*name, site.origin, {});
    }
}

void SettingsUI::estimate_browsing_data_sizes(JsonValue const& options)
{
    if (!options.is_object())
        return;

    auto& application = Application::the();

    auto since = [&]() {
        if (auto since = options.as_object().get_integer<i64>("since"sv); since.has_value())
            return UnixDateTime::from_milliseconds_since_epoch(*since);
        return UnixDateTime::earliest();
    }();

    application.estimate_browsing_data_size_accessed_since(since)
        ->when_resolved([weak_this = make_weak_ptr<SettingsUI>()](Application::BrowsingDataSizes const& sizes) {
            JsonObject result;

            result.set("cacheSizeSinceRequestedTime"sv, sizes.cache_size_since_requested_time);
            result.set("totalCacheSize"sv, sizes.total_cache_size);

            result.set("siteDataSizeSinceRequestedTime"sv, sizes.site_data_size_since_requested_time);
            result.set("totalSiteDataSize"sv, sizes.total_site_data_size);

            if (auto self = weak_this.strong_ref())
                self->async_send_message("estimatedBrowsingDataSizes"sv, move(result));
        })
        .when_rejected([](Error const& error) {
            dbgln("Failed to estimate browsing data sizes: {}", error);
        });
}

void SettingsUI::clear_browsing_data(JsonValue const& options)
{
    if (!options.is_object())
        return;

    Application::ClearBrowsingDataOptions clear_browsing_data_options;

    if (auto since = options.as_object().get_integer<i64>("since"sv); since.has_value())
        clear_browsing_data_options.since = UnixDateTime::from_milliseconds_since_epoch(*since);

    clear_browsing_data_options.delete_cached_files = options.as_object().get_bool("cachedFiles"sv).value_or(false)
        ? Application::ClearBrowsingDataOptions::Delete::Yes
        : Application::ClearBrowsingDataOptions::Delete::No;

    clear_browsing_data_options.delete_history = options.as_object().get_bool("history"sv).value_or(false)
        ? Application::ClearBrowsingDataOptions::Delete::Yes
        : Application::ClearBrowsingDataOptions::Delete::No;

    clear_browsing_data_options.delete_download_history = options.as_object().get_bool("downloadHistory"sv).value_or(false)
        ? Application::ClearBrowsingDataOptions::Delete::Yes
        : Application::ClearBrowsingDataOptions::Delete::No;

    clear_browsing_data_options.delete_site_data = options.as_object().get_bool("siteData"sv).value_or(false)
        ? Application::ClearBrowsingDataOptions::Delete::Yes
        : Application::ClearBrowsingDataOptions::Delete::No;

    auto& application = Application::the();

    application.clear_browsing_data(clear_browsing_data_options)
        ->when_resolved([weak_this = make_weak_ptr<SettingsUI>()](Empty) {
            if (auto self = weak_this.strong_ref())
                self->async_send_message("clearedBrowsingData"sv, {});
        })
        .when_rejected([](Error const& error) {
            dbgln("Failed to clear browser data: {}", error);
        });
}

void SettingsUI::set_global_privacy_control(JsonValue const& global_privacy_control)
{
    if (!global_privacy_control.is_bool())
        return;

    Application::settings().set_global_privacy_control(global_privacy_control.as_bool() ? GlobalPrivacyControl::Yes : GlobalPrivacyControl::No);
}

void SettingsUI::crash_reports_changed()
{
    if (has_client())
        async_send_message("crashReportsWaiting"sv, CrashReportOutbox::the().waiting_report_count());
}

void SettingsUI::set_crash_report_sending(JsonValue const& crash_report_sending)
{
    if (!crash_report_sending.is_string())
        return;

    auto sending = crash_report_sending_from_string(crash_report_sending.as_string());
    Application::settings().set_crash_report_sending(sending);

    if (sending == CrashReportSending::NeverSend)
        CrashReportOutbox::the().discard_all();
}

void SettingsUI::set_services_network_access_enabled(JsonValue const& enabled)
{
    if (!enabled.is_bool())
        return;

    Application::settings().set_background_networking_enabled(enabled.as_bool());
}

void SettingsUI::set_filter_list_updates_enabled(JsonValue const& enabled)
{
    if (!enabled.is_bool())
        return;

    Application::settings().set_filter_list_updates_enabled(enabled.as_bool());
}

#if defined(LADYBIRD_HAS_UPDATE_CHECK)
void SettingsUI::set_update_checks_enabled(JsonValue const& enabled)
{
    if (!enabled.is_bool())
        return;

    Application::settings().set_update_checks_enabled(enabled.as_bool());
}
#endif

void SettingsUI::update_content_blocker_lists(JsonValue const&)
{
    Application::the().update_content_blocker_lists({});
    broadcast_settings_change();
}

void SettingsUI::set_content_blocker_enabled(JsonValue const& enabled)
{
    if (!enabled.is_bool())
        return;

    Application::settings().set_content_blocker_enabled(enabled.as_bool());

    if (enabled.as_bool()) {
        for (auto const& list : Application::settings().content_blocker_lists()) {
            if (list.enabled)
                Application::the().download_content_blocker_list_if_needed({}, list.identifier);
        }
    }
}

void SettingsUI::set_content_blocker_enabled_for_site(JsonValue const& value)
{
    if (!value.is_object())
        return;

    auto site = value.as_object().get_string("site"sv);
    auto enabled = value.as_object().get_bool("enabled"sv);
    if (!site.has_value() || !enabled.has_value())
        return;

    if (auto result = Application::settings().set_content_blocker_enabled_for_site(*site, *enabled); result.is_error())
        dbgln("Unable to change content blocking for {}: {}", *site, result.error());
}

void SettingsUI::set_content_blocker_list_enabled(JsonValue const& value)
{
    if (!value.is_object())
        return;

    auto identifier = value.as_object().get_string("identifier"sv);
    auto enabled = value.as_object().get_bool("enabled"sv);
    if (!identifier.has_value() || !enabled.has_value())
        return;

    Application::settings().set_content_blocker_list_enabled(*identifier, *enabled);
    if (*enabled && Application::settings().content_blocker_enabled())
        Application::the().download_content_blocker_list_if_needed({}, *identifier);
}

void SettingsUI::add_custom_content_blocker_subscription(JsonValue const& value)
{
    if (!value.is_string())
        return;

    auto url = URL::Parser::basic_parse(value.as_string());
    if (!url.has_value() || !url->scheme().is_one_of("http"sv, "https"sv)) {
        report_content_blocker_result("subscription"_string, "Enter an HTTP or HTTPS URL."_string);
        return;
    }

    for (auto const& subscription : Application::settings().content_blocker_lists()) {
        if (!subscription.built_in && subscription.url == url) {
            report_content_blocker_result("subscription"_string, "Subscription already added."_string);
            return;
        }
    }

    auto identifier = Application::settings().add_content_blocker_list(url->serialize(), url);
    Application::the().download_content_blocker_list_if_needed({}, identifier);
    report_content_blocker_result("subscription"_string, "Subscription added."_string);
}

void SettingsUI::remove_content_blocker_list(JsonValue const& value)
{
    if (!value.is_string())
        return;

    Application::the().remove_content_blocker_list({}, value.as_string());
}

void SettingsUI::import_local_content_blocker_list(JsonValue const& value)
{
    if (!value.is_object())
        return;

    auto name = value.as_object().get_string("name"sv);
    auto contents = value.as_object().get_string("contents"sv);
    if (!name.has_value() || name->is_empty() || !contents.has_value())
        return;

    if (auto result = Application::the().import_local_content_blocker_list(*name, *contents); result.is_error())
        report_content_blocker_result("import"_string, MUST(String::formatted("Unable to import list: {}", result.error())));
    else
        report_content_blocker_result("import"_string, MUST(String::formatted("{} imported.", *name)));
}

void SettingsUI::set_custom_content_blocker_filters(JsonValue const& value)
{
    if (!value.is_string() || value.as_string().bytes().size() > 4 * MiB)
        return;

    Application::settings().set_custom_content_blocker_filters(value.as_string());
}

void SettingsUI::report_content_blocker_result(String operation, String message)
{
    JsonObject result;
    result.set("operation"sv, move(operation));
    result.set("message"sv, move(message));
    async_send_message("contentBlockerResult"sv, result);
}

void SettingsUI::set_dns_settings(JsonValue const& dns_settings)
{
    Application::settings().set_dns_settings(Settings::parse_dns_settings(dns_settings));
}

}

    s_open_pages->set(this);
    register_interface("loadPlatformFeatures"sv, [this](auto const&) {
        load_platform_features();
    });

    }

{
    async_send_message("loadPlatformFeatures"sv, Application::the().platform_features_report());
}

#include <LibWebView/Application.h>
#include <LibWebView/AudioServerControlClient.h>
#include <LibWebView/BlobURLStore.h>
#include <LibWebView/BrowsingSession.h>
#include <LibWebView/CanonicalEnvironmentSettingsObject.h>
#include <LibWebView/CookieJar.h>
#include <LibWebView/HSTSStore.h>
#include <LibWebView/HelperProcess.h>
#include <LibWebView/ImageDecoderManager.h>
#include <LibWebView/PermissionManager.h>
#include <LibWebView/Utilities.h>
#include <LibWebView/WebContentClient.h>
#include <LibWebView/WebWorkerClient.h>
#include <LibWebView/WorkerAgentManager.h>

namespace WebView {

WebWorkerClient::WebWorkerClient(NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport> transport, BrowsingSession& session, Web::HTML::WorkerAgentId agent_id)
    : IPC::ConnectionToServer<WebWorkerClientEndpoint, WebWorkerServerEndpoint>(*this, move(transport))
    , m_is_private(session.is_private())
    , m_session(session.make_weak_ptr())
    , m_request_server_site_bindings([this](RequestServerClientConnection& connection, Optional<Utf16String> const& top_level_site) {
        async_connect_to_request_server(move(connection.handle), connection.client_id, top_level_site);
    })
    , m_agent_id(agent_id)
    , m_audio_tab_id(allocate_audio_tab_id())
{
}

WebWorkerClient::~WebWorkerClient()
{
    remove_blob_url_entries();
}

void WebWorkerClient::set_host(WebContentClient& host)
{
    m_host = host;
    m_host_child_id = host.child_id();
}

void WebWorkerClient::did_misbehave(StringView message_name, StringView reason)
{
    // NB: A worker on a thread is one trust domain with its process, so all of that goes.
    if (auto host = m_host.strong_ref()) {
        host->did_misbehave(message_name, reason);
        shutdown();
        return;
    }
    shutdown();
}

void WebWorkerClient::die()
{
    remove_blob_url_entries();
    WorkerAgentManager::the().worker_did_die(m_agent_id);

    // NB: The process of a worker on a thread goes on, and so may its use of the decoder.
    if (m_image_decoder_client_generation.has_value())
        ImageDecoderManager::the().process_did_release_decoder(child_id(), *m_image_decoder_client_generation);

    WorkerAgentManager::the().worker_thread_did_exit(*this);
}

void WebWorkerClient::did_close_worker()
{
    forget_inside_settings_of_closing_worker();
    WorkerAgentManager::the().worker_did_close(m_agent_id);
}

void WebWorkerClient::did_close_shared_worker()
{
    WorkerAgentManager::the().shared_worker_did_close(m_agent_id);
}

void WebWorkerClient::did_finish_loading_worker_script(bool worker_is_secure_context)
{
    m_script_blob_url = {};
    WorkerAgentManager::the().worker_did_finish_loading_script(m_agent_id, worker_is_secure_context);
}

void WebWorkerClient::did_fail_loading_worker_script()
{
    WorkerAgentManager::the().worker_did_fail_loading_script(m_agent_id);
}

void WebWorkerClient::did_report_outside_settings_content_security_policy_violation(u64 policy_index, String effective_directive, URL::URL resource)
{
    WorkerAgentManager::the().worker_did_report_outside_settings_content_security_policy_violation(m_agent_id, policy_index, move(effective_directive), move(resource));
}

void WebWorkerClient::remove_blob_url_entries()
{
    if (auto session = m_session.strong_ref())
        session->blob_url_store->remove_entries_added_by(WeakPtr<WebWorkerClient> { *this });
}

void WebWorkerClient::set_inside_settings(NonnullOwnPtr<CanonicalWorkerEnvironmentSettingsObject> inside_settings, Vector<LocalFileRoot> local_file_roots)
{
    m_top_level_origin = inside_settings->top_level_origin();
    m_inside_settings = move(inside_settings);
    m_local_file_roots = move(local_file_roots);
}

void WebWorkerClient::forget_inside_settings_of_closing_worker()
{
    m_inside_settings = nullptr;
    m_script_blob_url = {};
}

// The environment a worker names is its own.
Optional<CanonicalEnvironmentSettingsObject const&> WebWorkerClient::hosted_environment(Web::HTML::EnvironmentId const& environment_id) const
{
    if (!m_inside_settings || m_inside_settings->id() != environment_id)
        return {};
    return *m_inside_settings;
}

// A worker may learn the permissions only of its own top-level site; asking about any other gets just the defaults.
Messages::WebWorkerClient::DidRequestPermissionSnapshotResponse WebWorkerClient::did_request_permission_snapshot(URL::Origin top_level_origin)
{
    auto session = m_session.strong_ref();
    if (!session)
        return Web::Permissions::PermissionSnapshot {};

    auto worker_top_level_origin = m_inside_settings ? m_inside_settings->top_level_origin() : Optional<URL::Origin> {};
    if (worker_top_level_origin.has_value() && worker_top_level_origin->is_same_origin(top_level_origin) && !top_level_origin.is_opaque() && !m_permission_origins.contains_slow(top_level_origin))
        m_permission_origins.append(top_level_origin);
    return session->permission_manager->snapshot_for(m_permission_origins);
}

Messages::WebWorkerClient::DidRequestCookieResponse WebWorkerClient::did_request_cookie(URL::URL url, HTTP::Cookie::Source source)
{
    // RequestServer handles the cookies of HTTP requests itself, so a worker has no use for HttpOnly cookies.
    if (source == HTTP::Cookie::Source::Http) {
        did_misbehave("did_request_cookie"sv, "HTTP cookie source"sv);
        return HTTP::Cookie::VersionedCookie {};
    }

    if (!m_inside_settings || !m_inside_settings->may_use_cookies_of(url))
        return HTTP::Cookie::VersionedCookie {};

    auto top_level_site = network_isolation_top_level_site(*m_inside_settings);
    if (!top_level_site.has_value())
        return HTTP::Cookie::VersionedCookie {};

    HTTP::Cookie::PartitionContext partition_context { top_level_site.release_value(), m_inside_settings->has_cross_site_ancestor() };
    HTTP::Cookie::VersionedCookie cookie;
    if (auto session = m_session.strong_ref())
        cookie.cookie = session->cookie_jar->get_cookie(url, source, partition_context, HTTP::Cookie::non_http_same_site_context(partition_context));
    return cookie;
}

Messages::WebWorkerClient::DidAddBlobUrlEntryResponse WebWorkerClient::did_add_blob_url_entry(Web::HTML::EnvironmentId environment_id, Utf16String url, Web::FileAPI::SerializedBlobURLEntry entry)
{
    auto session = m_session.strong_ref();
    auto environment = hosted_environment(environment_id);
    if (!session || !environment.has_value())
        return 0;
    entry.origin = environment->origin();

    Optional<LocalFileRoot> root_of_adder;
    if (m_local_file_roots.size() == 1)
        root_of_adder = m_local_file_roots.first();
    return session->blob_url_store->add_entry(move(url), move(entry), WeakPtr<WebWorkerClient> { *this }, move(root_of_adder));
}

void WebWorkerClient::did_remove_blob_url_entries(Web::HTML::EnvironmentId environment_id, Vector<Utf16String> urls)
{
    auto environment = hosted_environment(environment_id);
    if (!environment.has_value())
        return;
    if (auto session = m_session.strong_ref())
        session->blob_url_store->remove_entries(urls, environment->origin(), WeakPtr<WebWorkerClient> { *this });
}

Messages::WebWorkerClient::DidRequestBlobUrlEntryResponse WebWorkerClient::did_request_blob_url_entry(Utf16String url, Optional<URL::BlobURLEntry::Token> token)
{
    auto session = m_session.strong_ref();
    if (!session)
        return Optional<Web::FileAPI::SerializedBlobURLEntry> {};
    return session->blob_url_store->resolve(url, token);
}

void WebWorkerClient::did_request_file(ByteString path, i32 request_id)
{
    if (!m_inside_settings)
        return;

    auto file = open_local_file_for_renderer(path, m_local_file_roots);
    if (file.is_error())
        async_handle_file_return(file.error().code(), {}, request_id);
    else
        async_handle_file_return(0, move(file.value().file), request_id);
}

Messages::WebWorkerClient::DidIsKnownHstsHostResponse WebWorkerClient::did_is_known_hsts_host(String domain)
{
    auto session = m_session.strong_ref();
    return session ? session->hsts_store->is_known_hsts_host(domain) : true;
}

Messages::WebWorkerClient::RequestMediaServerConnectionResponse WebWorkerClient::request_media_server_connection()
{
    auto connection = connect_new_media_server_client(m_media_server_client, child_id(), is_private(), [weak_self = make_weak_ptr<WebWorkerClient>()]() -> ErrorOr<IPC::TransportHandle> {
        auto self = weak_self.strong_ref();
        if (!self)
            return Error::from_string_literal("The worker is gone");
        TRY(ensure_audio_server_is_running(self->m_audio_server_client, self->child_id(), self->is_private()));
        return connect_new_audio_server_client(*self->m_audio_server_client, self->m_audio_tab_id);
    });
    if (connection.is_error()) {
        warnln("Unable to connect a MediaServer client: {}", connection.error());
        return OptionalNone {};
    }
    return move(connection.value().handle);
}

Messages::WebWorkerClient::RequestImageDecoderConnectionResponse WebWorkerClient::request_image_decoder_connection()
{
    // NB: A thread is part of its process, and what the decoder of a process may see goes by all that the process hosts.
    auto host = m_host.strong_ref();
    if (!host)
        return Optional<IPC::TransportHandle> {};
    return host->connect_new_image_decoder_client(m_image_decoder_client_generation);
}

void WebWorkerClient::did_release_image_decoder()
{
    if (auto generation = exchange(m_image_decoder_client_generation, {}); generation.has_value())
        ImageDecoderManager::the().process_did_release_decoder(child_id(), *generation);
}

Messages::WebWorkerClient::RequestCompositorConnectionResponse WebWorkerClient::request_compositor_connection()
{
    auto handle = Application::the().connect_new_compositor_canvas_client();
    if (handle.is_error()) {
        warnln("Unable to connect a worker to the compositor: {}", handle.error());
        return { Optional<IPC::TransportHandle> {}, 0 };
    }
    return { handle.release_value(), Application::the().compositor_generation() };
}

void WebWorkerClient::did_post_broadcast_channel_message(Web::HTML::PostedBroadcastChannelMessage message)
{
    if (auto settings = hosted_environment(message.environment_id); settings.has_value())
        WorkerAgentManager::the().post_broadcast_channel_message(move(message), *settings, *this, m_is_private);
}

void WebWorkerClient::register_dedicated_worker(Web::HTML::WorkerAgentStartRequest request, IPC::TransportHandle worker_transport)
{
    auto outside_settings = hosted_environment(request.outside_settings.id);
    WorkerAgentManager::the().register_dedicated_worker(*this, outside_settings, move(request), move(worker_transport));
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/ByteString.h>

#include <LibWebView/RequestServerSiteBindings.h>
#include <WebContent/WebWorkerClientEndpoint.h>
#include <WebContent/WebWorkerServerEndpoint.h>

namespace WebView {

class WEBVIEW_API WebWorkerClient final
    : public IPC::ConnectionToServer<WebWorkerClientEndpoint, WebWorkerServerEndpoint>
    , public WebWorkerClientEndpoint {
    C_OBJECT_ABSTRACT(WebWorkerClient);

public:
    WebWorkerClient(NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport>, BrowsingSession&, Web::HTML::WorkerAgentId agent_id);
    ~WebWorkerClient();

    RefPtr<BrowsingSession> session() const { return m_session.strong_ref(); }
    IsPrivate is_private() const { return m_is_private; }

    // The sites this worker asked for the permissions of: at most its top-level site.
    Vector<URL::Origin> const& permission_origins() const { return m_permission_origins; }
    RequestServerSiteBindings& request_server_site_bindings() { return m_request_server_site_bindings; }
    void remove_blob_url_entries();

    // The process the worker's thread runs in.
    u64 child_id() const { return m_host_child_id; }

    // The WebContent process that runs this worker on a thread.
    WebContentClient* host() const { return m_host.ptr(); }
    void set_host(WebContentClient&);

    Optional<CanonicalEnvironmentSettingsObject const&> hosted_environment(Web::HTML::EnvironmentId const& environment_id) const;

    void set_inside_settings(NonnullOwnPtr<CanonicalWorkerEnvironmentSettingsObject>, Vector<LocalFileRoot> local_file_roots);
    CanonicalWorkerEnvironmentSettingsObject const* inside_settings() const { return m_inside_settings.ptr(); }
    void forget_inside_settings_of_closing_worker();
    Optional<URL::Origin> const& top_level_origin() const { return m_top_level_origin; }
    Vector<LocalFileRoot> const& local_file_roots() const { return m_local_file_roots; }
    void keep_script_blob_url_until_script_loads(BlobURLHandle handle) { m_script_blob_url = move(handle); }

    virtual void did_close_worker() override;
    virtual void did_close_shared_worker() override;
    virtual void did_finish_loading_worker_script(bool worker_is_secure_context) override;
    virtual void did_fail_loading_worker_script() override;
    virtual void did_report_outside_settings_content_security_policy_violation(u64 policy_index, String effective_directive, URL::URL resource) override;
    virtual Messages::WebWorkerClient::DidRequestCookieResponse did_request_cookie(URL::URL, HTTP::Cookie::Source) override;
    virtual Messages::WebWorkerClient::DidAddBlobUrlEntryResponse did_add_blob_url_entry(Web::HTML::EnvironmentId environment_id, Utf16String url, Web::FileAPI::SerializedBlobURLEntry entry) override;
    virtual void did_remove_blob_url_entries(Web::HTML::EnvironmentId environment_id, Vector<Utf16String> urls) override;
    virtual Messages::WebWorkerClient::DidRequestBlobUrlEntryResponse did_request_blob_url_entry(Utf16String url, Optional<URL::BlobURLEntry::Token> token) override;
    virtual void did_request_file(ByteString path, i32 request_id) override;
    virtual Messages::WebWorkerClient::DidIsKnownHstsHostResponse did_is_known_hsts_host(String domain) override;
    virtual Messages::WebWorkerClient::DidRequestPermissionSnapshotResponse did_request_permission_snapshot(URL::Origin top_level_origin) override;
    virtual Messages::WebWorkerClient::RequestMediaServerConnectionResponse request_media_server_connection() override;
    virtual Messages::WebWorkerClient::RequestImageDecoderConnectionResponse request_image_decoder_connection() override;
    virtual void did_release_image_decoder() override;
    virtual Messages::WebWorkerClient::RequestCompositorConnectionResponse request_compositor_connection() override;
    virtual void did_post_broadcast_channel_message(Web::HTML::PostedBroadcastChannelMessage) override;
    virtual void register_dedicated_worker(Web::HTML::WorkerAgentStartRequest request, IPC::TransportHandle worker_transport) override;

private:
    virtual void did_misbehave(StringView message_name, StringView reason) override;

    virtual void die() override;

    IsPrivate m_is_private { IsPrivate::No };
    WeakPtr<BrowsingSession> m_session;
    RequestServerSiteBindings m_request_server_site_bindings;

    u64 m_host_child_id { 0 };
    WeakPtr<WebContentClient> m_host;
    Optional<u64> m_image_decoder_client_generation;
    Web::HTML::WorkerAgentId m_agent_id { 0 };
    Vector<URL::Origin> m_permission_origins;

    OwnPtr<CanonicalWorkerEnvironmentSettingsObject> m_inside_settings;
    Optional<URL::Origin> m_top_level_origin;
    Vector<LocalFileRoot> m_local_file_roots;
    // Keeps the blob URL entry of the worker's script alive until the script is loaded, so that the owner can
    // revoke the URL right after constructing the worker.
    BlobURLHandle m_script_blob_url;

    // The controller connections to the MediaServer and AudioServer spawned for this worker, from its first media use
    // until it ends.
    RefPtr<MediaClient::Client> m_media_server_client;
    RefPtr<AudioServerControlClient> m_audio_server_client;
    u64 m_audio_tab_id { 0 };
};

}
