#pragma once

#include <clang/AST/ASTConsumer.h>
#include <clang/AST/RecursiveASTVisitor.h>
#include <clang/Frontend/FrontendAction.h>

struct LibJSCellMacro {
    enum class Type {
        GCCell,
        JSObject,
        JSEnvironment,
        JSPrototypeObject,
        WebWrappable,
    };

    struct Arg {
        std::string text;
        clang::SourceLocation location;
    };

    clang::SourceRange range;
    Type type;
    std::vector<Arg> args;

    static char const* type_name(Type);
};

using LibJSCellMacroMap = std::unordered_map<unsigned int, std::vector<LibJSCellMacro>>;

using PolymorphicSubclasses = std::unordered_map<clang::CXXRecordDecl const*, std::vector<clang::CXXRecordDecl const*>>;

class LibJSPPCallbacks : public clang::PPCallbacks {
public:
    LibJSPPCallbacks(clang::Preprocessor& preprocessor, LibJSCellMacroMap& macro_map)
        : m_preprocessor(preprocessor)
        , m_macro_map(macro_map)
    {
    }

    virtual void LexedFileChanged(clang::FileID curr_fid, LexedFileChangeReason, clang::SrcMgr::CharacteristicKind, clang::FileID, clang::SourceLocation) override;

    virtual void MacroExpands(clang::Token const& name_token, clang::MacroDefinition const& definition, clang::SourceRange range, clang::MacroArgs const* args) override;

private:
    clang::Preprocessor& m_preprocessor;
    std::vector<unsigned int> m_curr_fid_hash_stack;
    LibJSCellMacroMap& m_macro_map;
};

class LibJSGCVisitor : public clang::RecursiveASTVisitor<LibJSGCVisitor> {
public:
    explicit LibJSGCVisitor(clang::ASTContext& context, LibJSCellMacroMap const& macro_map, bool detect_invalid_function_members)
        : m_context(context)
        , m_macro_map(macro_map)
        , m_detect_invalid_function_members(detect_invalid_function_members)
    {
    }

    bool VisitCXXRecordDecl(clang::CXXRecordDecl*);
    bool VisitCXXMethodDecl(clang::CXXMethodDecl*);
    bool VisitCXXConstructExpr(clang::CXXConstructExpr*);
    bool VisitClassTemplateDecl(clang::ClassTemplateDecl*);

    void validate_claims_of_no_cell_edges();
    bool VisitVarDecl(clang::VarDecl*);
    bool VisitCXXForRangeStmt(clang::CXXForRangeStmt*);
    bool VisitFunctionDecl(clang::FunctionDecl*);
    bool VisitLambdaExpr(clang::LambdaExpr*);

private:
    struct CellMacroExpectation {
        LibJSCellMacro::Type type;
        std::string base_name;
    };

    void validate_record_macros(clang::CXXRecordDecl const&);
    void validate_engine_subclass_is_in_libjs(clang::CXXRecordDecl const&);
    void validate_gc_members_of_polymorphic_record(clang::CXXRecordDecl const&);
    void remember_claim_of_no_cell_edges(clang::CXXRecordDecl const&);
    void validate_claim_of_no_cell_edges(clang::CXXRecordDecl const&, bool callbacks_hold_roots, clang::CXXRecordDecl const* claiming_base = nullptr);
    void remember_polymorphic_subclass(clang::CXXRecordDecl const&);
    void validate_object_on_stack(clang::VarDecl const&, clang::SourceLocation);
    void validate_type_on_stack(clang::QualType, clang::SourceLocation);
    CellMacroExpectation get_record_cell_macro_expectation(clang::CXXRecordDecl const&);

    clang::ASTContext& m_context;
    LibJSCellMacroMap const& m_macro_map;
    bool m_detect_invalid_function_members;
    PolymorphicSubclasses m_polymorphic_subclasses;

    struct ClaimOfNoCellEdges {
        clang::CXXRecordDecl const* record;
        bool callbacks_hold_roots;
        bool covers_subclasses;
    };
    std::vector<ClaimOfNoCellEdges> m_claims_of_no_cell_edges;
};

class LibJSGCASTConsumer : public clang::ASTConsumer {
public:
    LibJSGCASTConsumer(clang::CompilerInstance&, bool detect_invalid_function_members);

private:
    virtual void HandleTranslationUnit(clang::ASTContext& context) override;

    clang::CompilerInstance& m_compiler;
    LibJSCellMacroMap m_macro_map;
    bool m_detect_invalid_function_members;
};

class LibJSGCPluginAction : public clang::PluginASTAction {
public:
    virtual bool ParseArgs(clang::CompilerInstance const&, std::vector<std::string> const& args) override
    {
        m_detect_invalid_function_members = std::find(args.begin(), args.end(), "detect-invalid-function-members") != args.end();
        return true;
    }

    virtual std::unique_ptr<clang::ASTConsumer> CreateASTConsumer(clang::CompilerInstance& compiler, llvm::StringRef) override
    {
        return std::make_unique<LibJSGCASTConsumer>(compiler, m_detect_invalid_function_members);
    }

    ActionType getActionType() override
    {
        return AddAfterMainAction;
    }

private:
    bool m_detect_invalid_function_members { false };
};

/*

#include "MathFunctionsPluginAction.h"
#include <clang/Basic/SourceManager.h>
#include <clang/Frontend/FrontendPluginRegistry.h>
#include <llvm/ADT/StringSet.h>
#include <optional>

// The math functions that the C library of each platform computes differently.
static llvm::StringSet<> const math_functions = {
    "acos",
    "acosh",
    "asin",
    "asinh",
    "atan",
    "atan2",
    "atanh",
    "cbrt",
    "cos",
    "cosh",
    "exp",
    "exp2",
    "expm1",
    "hypot",
    "log",
    "log10",
    "log1p",
    "log2",
    "pow",
    "sin",
    "sincos",
    "sinh",
    "tan",
    "tanh",
};

static std::optional<llvm::StringRef> math_function_name(clang::FunctionDecl const& function, clang::SourceManager const& source_manager)
{
    if (!function.getDeclName().isIdentifier())
        return {};

    // A function of our own that shares a name with one of the C library is fine.
    if (!function.getBuiltinID() && !source_manager.isInSystemHeader(function.getCanonicalDecl()->getLocation()))
        return {};

    clang::NamespaceDecl const* outermost_namespace = nullptr;
    for (auto const* context = function.getDeclContext(); context; context = context->getParent()) {
        if (auto const* namespace_decl = llvm::dyn_cast<clang::NamespaceDecl>(context))
            outermost_namespace = namespace_decl;
    }
    if (outermost_namespace && outermost_namespace->getName() != "std")
        return {};

    auto name = function.getName();
    name.consume_front("__builtin_");
    if (math_functions.contains(name))
        return name;
    if ((name.ends_with("f") || name.ends_with("l")) && math_functions.contains(name.drop_back()))
        return name.drop_back();
    return {};
}

bool MathFunctionsVisitor::TraverseDecl(clang::Decl* declaration)
{
    if (declaration) {
        auto location = declaration->getLocation();
        if (location.isValid() && m_context.getSourceManager().isInSystemHeader(location))
            return true;
    }
    return RecursiveASTVisitor::TraverseDecl(declaration);
}

bool MathFunctionsVisitor::VisitDeclRefExpr(clang::DeclRefExpr* reference)
{
    auto const* function = llvm::dyn_cast<clang::FunctionDecl>(reference->getDecl());
    if (!function)
        return true;
    auto& source_manager = m_context.getSourceManager();
    auto name = math_function_name(*function, source_manager);
    if (!name)
        return true;

    auto location = source_manager.getFileLoc(reference->getLocation());
    if (source_manager.isInSystemHeader(location))
        return true;

    auto& diag_engine = m_context.getDiagnostics();
    auto diag_id = diag_engine.getCustomDiagID(clang::DiagnosticsEngine::Error, "%0 is computed differently by the C library of each platform. Use AK::%1 from AK/Math.h instead");
    diag_engine.Report(reference->getBeginLoc(), diag_id) << function << *name;
    return true;
}

void MathFunctionsASTConsumer::HandleTranslationUnit(clang::ASTContext& context)
{
    MathFunctionsVisitor visitor(context);
    visitor.TraverseDecl(context.getTranslationUnitDecl());
}

static clang::FrontendPluginRegistry::Add<MathFunctionsPluginAction> X("math_functions", "check that math functions come from AK/Math.h");

        set(CMAKE_LINK_GROUP_USING_no_as_needed "LINKER:--push-state,--no-as-needed" "LINKER:--pop-state" CACHE STRING "Link group using no-as-needed")
        set_property(TARGET unofficial::skia::skia APPEND PROPERTY INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES "$<LINK_GROUP:no_as_needed,Fontconfig::Fontconfig>")
    endif()
    if (ANDROID)
        # FIXME: Submit a proper patch to vcpkg in order not to bring host's libc++ when compiling for Android
        get_target_property(link_libs unofficial::skia::skia INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES)
        set(filtered_libs)
        foreach(lib ${link_libs})
            if (NOT lib MATCHES "lib/libc\\+\\+.so$")
                list(APPEND filtered_libs ${lib})
            endif()
        endforeach()
        set_property(TARGET unofficial::skia::skia PROPERTY INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES ${filtered_libs})
    endif()
else()
    # Get skia version from vcpkg.json
    file(READ ${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/vcpkg.json VCPKG_DOT_JSON)
    string(JSON VCPKG_OVERRIDES_LENGTH LENGTH ${VCPKG_DOT_JSON} overrides)
    MATH(EXPR VCPKG_OVERRIDES_END_RANGE "${VCPKG_OVERRIDES_LENGTH}-1")
    foreach(IDX RANGE ${VCPKG_OVERRIDES_END_RANGE})
      string(JSON VCPKG_OVERRIDE_NAME GET ${VCPKG_DOT_JSON} overrides ${IDX} name)
      if(VCPKG_OVERRIDE_NAME STREQUAL "skia")
        string(JSON SKIA_REQUIRED_VERSION GET ${VCPKG_DOT_JSON} overrides ${IDX} version)
        string(REGEX MATCH "[0-9]+" SKIA_REQUIRED_VERSION ${SKIA_REQUIRED_VERSION})
      endif()
    endforeach()

    pkg_check_modules(skia skia=${SKIA_REQUIRED_VERSION} REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET skia)
    set(SKIA_TARGET PkgConfig::skia)
    set_property(TARGET PkgConfig::skia APPEND PROPERTY INTERFACE_COMPILE_DEFINITIONS "SKCMS_DLL")
endif()
add_library(skia ALIAS ${SKIA_TARGET})

if (WIN32)
    get_target_property(SKIA_COMPILE_DEFINITIONS ${SKIA_TARGET} INTERFACE_COMPILE_DEFINITIONS)
    if (SKIA_COMPILE_DEFINITIONS AND "${SKIA_COMPILE_DEFINITIONS}" MATCHES "SK_DIRECT3D")
        set(HAS_DIRECTX ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
        add_cxx_compile_definitions(USE_DIRECTX=1)
    else()
        set(HAS_DIRECTX OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
        message(WARNING "Skia was not built with Direct3D support; Windows GPU painting will be disabled")
    endif()
else()
    set(HAS_DIRECTX OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
endif()

if (ENABLE_GUI_TARGETS AND NOT ANDROID)
    set(LADYBIRD_QT_COMPONENTS Core Gui Widgets)
    if (NOT APPLE)
        list(APPEND LADYBIRD_QT_COMPONENTS Positioning)
    endif()

    if (APPLE OR HAS_DIRECTX)
        # The native presentation paths use platform GPU buffer handles directly instead of copying frames through CPU
        # memory.
        list(APPEND LADYBIRD_QT_COMPONENTS GuiPrivate)
        set(QT_NO_PRIVATE_MODULE_WARNING ON)
    endif()

    if (LINUX AND "qt" IN_LIST VCPKG_MANIFEST_FEATURES)
        set(vcpkg_qt_package_dir "${VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR}/${VCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET}/share")
        set(vcpkg_qt_dir "${vcpkg_qt_package_dir}/Qt6")

        # Cached package directories take priority over the search paths, including for Qt modules.
        get_cmake_property(cached_qt_dirs CACHE_VARIABLES)
        list(FILTER cached_qt_dirs INCLUDE REGEX "^Qt6.*_DIR$")
        foreach (cached_qt_dir IN LISTS cached_qt_dirs)
            cmake_path(IS_PREFIX vcpkg_qt_package_dir "$CACHE{${cached_qt_dir}}" NORMALIZE is_vcpkg_qt_dir)
            if (NOT is_vcpkg_qt_dir)
                unset("${cached_qt_dir}" CACHE)
            endif()
        endforeach()

        list(APPEND LADYBIRD_QT_COMPONENTS Svg)
        find_package(Qt6 6.10 REQUIRED COMPONENTS ${LADYBIRD_QT_COMPONENTS} PATHS "${vcpkg_qt_dir}" NO_DEFAULT_PATH)

        get_target_property(qt_core_type Qt6::Core TYPE)
        if (NOT qt_core_type STREQUAL "SHARED_LIBRARY" OR NOT Qt6_DIR STREQUAL vcpkg_qt_dir)
            message(FATAL_ERROR "The qt feature requires shared Qt from vcpkg.")
        endif()
    else()
        find_package(Qt6 6.10 REQUIRED COMPONENTS ${LADYBIRD_QT_COMPONENTS})
    endif()
endif()

FILE: Meta/CMake/check_skia_confinement.cmake
# Only the Compositor process links Skia. ladybird_check_skia_confinement() walks the link dependencies of the given
# targets, through the shared libraries that they load and the static libraries that they take in, and fails the
# configuration if any of them reaches Skia.

function(_ladybird_skia_link_path target chain output)
    get_property(visited GLOBAL PROPERTY _LADYBIRD_SKIA_CHECK_VISITED)
    if ("${target}" IN_LIST visited)
        return()
    endif()
    set_property(GLOBAL APPEND PROPERTY _LADYBIRD_SKIA_CHECK_VISITED "${target}")

    get_target_property(aliased_target "${target}" ALIASED_TARGET)
    if (aliased_target)
        set(target "${aliased_target}")
    endif()
    if ("${target}" STREQUAL "${SKIA_TARGET}")
        set("${output}" "${chain}" PARENT_SCOPE)
        return()
    endif()

    get_target_property(type "${target}" TYPE)
    set(dependencies "")
    if (NOT "${type}" STREQUAL "INTERFACE_LIBRARY")
        get_target_property(link_libraries "${target}" LINK_LIBRARIES)
        if (link_libraries)
            list(APPEND dependencies ${link_libraries})
        endif()
    endif()
    get_target_property(interface_link_libraries "${target}" INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES)
    if (interface_link_libraries)
        list(APPEND dependencies ${interface_link_libraries})
    endif()

    foreach (dependency IN LISTS dependencies)
        # A static library passes its private dependencies on as $<LINK_ONLY:...>. Other generator expressions do not
        # name Skia.
        string(REGEX REPLACE "^\\$<LINK_ONLY:(.+)>$" "\\1" dependency "${dependency}")
        if (dependency MATCHES "^\\$<" OR NOT TARGET "${dependency}")
            continue()
        endif()
        _ladybird_skia_link_path("${dependency}" "${chain} -> ${dependency}" found_chain)
        if (found_chain)
            set("${output}" "${found_chain}" PARENT_SCOPE)
            return()
        endif()
    endforeach()
endfunction()

function(ladybird_check_skia_confinement)
    foreach (target IN LISTS ARGN)
        if (NOT TARGET "${target}")
            continue()
        endif()
        set_property(GLOBAL PROPERTY _LADYBIRD_SKIA_CHECK_VISITED "")
        _ladybird_skia_link_path("${target}" "${target}" chain)
        if (chain)
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Only the Compositor may link Skia, but ${target} reaches it: ${chain}")
        endif()
    endforeach()
endfunction()

FILE: Meta/CMake/code_generators.cmake
#
# Functions for generating sources using host tools
#

function(embed_as_string name source_file output source_variable_name)
    cmake_parse_arguments(PARSE_ARGV 4 EMBED_STRING_VIEW "" "NAMESPACE" "")
    set(namespace_arg "")
    if (EMBED_STRING_VIEW_NAMESPACE)
        set(namespace_arg "-s ${EMBED_STRING_VIEW_NAMESPACE}")
    endif()
    add_custom_command(
        OUTPUT "${output}"
        COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/embed_as_string.py" "${source_file}" -o "${output}.tmp" -n "${source_variable_name}" ${namespace_arg}
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E copy_if_different "${output}.tmp" "${output}"
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E remove "${output}.tmp"
        VERBATIM
        DEPENDS "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/embed_as_string.py"
        MAIN_DEPENDENCY "${source_file}"
    )

    add_custom_target("generate_${name}" DEPENDS "${output}")
    add_dependencies(ladybird_codegen_accumulator "generate_${name}")
endfunction()

function(compile_ipc source output)
    cmake_parse_arguments(PARSE_ARGV 2 ARG "" "RUST_OUTPUT" "")
    if (NOT IS_ABSOLUTE ${source})
        set(source ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${source})
    endif()
    if (NOT IS_ABSOLUTE ${output})
        set(output ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${output})
    endif()
    cmake_path(REPLACE_EXTENSION output LAST_ONLY .cpp OUTPUT_VARIABLE implementation)
    get_filename_component(output_name ${output} NAME)
    cmake_path(RELATIVE_PATH CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR BASE_DIRECTORY ${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR} OUTPUT_VARIABLE current_source_dir_relative)
    set(library_arguments)
    if (current_source_dir_relative MATCHES "^Libraries/(Lib[^/]+)(/|$)")
        # NB: The library is defined after its IPC files, so its export macro is only known when the build is generated.
        list(APPEND library_arguments --library ${CMAKE_MATCH_1} "--export-macro=$<TARGET_PROPERTY:${CMAKE_MATCH_1},LADYBIRD_EXPORT_MACRO>")
        set(GENERATED_IPC TRUE PARENT_SCOPE)
    endif()
    set(rust_arguments)
    set(rust_output)
    set(rust_commands)
    if (ARG_RUST_OUTPUT)
        get_filename_component(rust_output "${ARG_RUST_OUTPUT}" ABSOLUTE BASE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}")
        list(APPEND rust_arguments --rust-output ${rust_output}.tmp)
        list(APPEND rust_commands
            COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E copy_if_different ${rust_output}.tmp ${rust_output}
            COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E remove ${rust_output}.tmp)
    endif()
    add_custom_command(
        OUTPUT ${output} ${implementation} ${rust_output}
        COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/generate_ipc_definitions.py"
            --input ${source} --output ${output}.tmp --implementation ${implementation}.tmp
            --header-name ${output_name} ${library_arguments} ${rust_arguments}
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E copy_if_different ${output}.tmp ${output}
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E copy_if_different ${implementation}.tmp ${implementation}
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E remove ${output}.tmp ${implementation}.tmp
        ${rust_commands}
        VERBATIM
        DEPENDS "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/generate_ipc_definitions.py"
            "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Utils/lexer.py"
            "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Utils/utils.py"
        MAIN_DEPENDENCY ${source}
    )
    add_custom_target(generate_${output_name} DEPENDS ${output} ${implementation} ${rust_output})
    add_dependencies(ladybird_codegen_accumulator generate_${output_name})
    list(APPEND SOURCES ${implementation})
    set(SOURCES ${SOURCES} PARENT_SCOPE)

    if (ENABLE_INSTALL_HEADERS)
        # NB: A header generated into a subdirectory of the library is installed into the same subdirectory, where
        #     the library's headers include it from.
        get_filename_component(output_directory ${output} DIRECTORY)
        file(RELATIVE_PATH output_subdirectory ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR} ${output_directory})
        if (output_subdirectory MATCHES "^\\.\\.")
            set(output_subdirectory "")
        endif()
        install(FILES ${output} DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/${current_source_dir_relative}/${output_subdirectory}" OPTIONAL)
    endif()
endfunction()

# Flags shared by Lagom and Ladybird.
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 23)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

macro(add_cxx_compile_options)
    set(args "")
    foreach(arg ${ARGN})
        string(APPEND args ${arg}$<SEMICOLON>)
    endforeach()
    add_compile_options($<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C,CXX,ASM>:${args}>)
endmacro()

# For options that only mean something to C++, some of which GCC rejects when it compiles C.
macro(add_cxx_only_compile_options)
    set(args "")
    foreach(arg ${ARGN})
        string(APPEND args ${arg}$<SEMICOLON>)
    endforeach()
    add_compile_options($<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:${args}>)
endmacro()

macro(add_cxx_compile_definitions)
    set(args "")
    foreach(arg ${ARGN})
        string(APPEND args ${arg}$<SEMICOLON>)
    endforeach()
    add_compile_definitions($<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C,CXX,ASM>:${args}>)
endmacro()

macro(add_cxx_link_options)
    set(args "")
    foreach(arg ${ARGN})
        string(APPEND args ${arg}$<SEMICOLON>)
    endforeach()
    add_link_options($<$<LINK_LANGUAGE:C,CXX>:${args}>)
endmacro()

include(CheckLinkerFlag)
include(CMakePushCheckState)
function(add_cxx_link_option_if_supported option)
    cmake_push_check_state()
    if (MSVC)
        set(CMAKE_REQUIRED_LINK_OPTIONS /WX)
    else()
        set(CMAKE_REQUIRED_LINK_OPTIONS -Werror)
    endif()
    check_linker_flag(CXX ${option} LAGOM_LINKER_SUPPORTS_${option})
    if (${LAGOM_LINKER_SUPPORTS_${option}})
        add_cxx_link_options(${option})
    endif()
    cmake_pop_check_state()
endfunction()

# RUSTC_TARGET_CPU_FLAGS names the same CPU for rustc, so that Rust code runs on the instruction set C++ code does.
if (LADYBIRD_BASELINE_CPU_TARGET)
    # Binaries that run on other machines, and ccache caches that different runners share, need a common architecture.
    if (APPLE AND CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR STREQUAL "arm64")
        add_cxx_compile_options(-mcpu=apple-m1)
        set(RUSTC_TARGET_CPU_FLAGS -Ctarget-cpu=apple-m1)
    elseif (CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "^(aarch64|arm64)$")
        add_cxx_compile_options(-march=armv8.2-a)
        set(RUSTC_TARGET_CPU_FLAGS -Ctarget-feature=+v8.2a)
    elseif (CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "^(x86_64|amd64|AMD64)$")
        # Keep distributed binaries usable on SSE4.2/POPCNT machines without AVX or BMI.
        add_cxx_compile_options(-march=x86-64-v2)
        set(RUSTC_TARGET_CPU_FLAGS -Ctarget-cpu=x86-64-v2)
    endif()
elseif (CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR STREQUAL "riscv64")
    # On RISC-V the generic -march=native is not yet supported and both gcc and clang require an explicit
    # ISA or target string. Unfortunately hardware probing is also neither easy nor reliable at the moment.
    # For the time being use the defaults for the best compatibility with existing hardware and toolchains.
    # FIXME: Remove this branch once -march=native is supported.
elseif (NOT CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING)
    # In all other cases, compile for the native architecture of the host system.
    add_cxx_compile_options(-march=native)
    set(RUSTC_TARGET_CPU_FLAGS -Ctarget-cpu=native)
endif()

# Stack walks such as the crash handler's follow frame pointers. Apple platforms keep them by default, and Windows
# unwinds through the unwind tables its ABI requires instead, so only other platforms need to ask for them.
if (NOT APPLE AND NOT WIN32)
    add_cxx_compile_options(-fno-omit-frame-pointer)
    set(RUSTC_TARGET_FRAME_POINTER_FLAGS -Cforce-frame-pointers=yes)
endif()

add_cxx_compile_options(-Wlogical-op)

    add_cxx_compile_options(-Wmissing-designated-field-initializers)
endif()
add_cxx_only_compile_options(-Wsuggest-override)

add_cxx_only_compile_options(-Wno-invalid-offsetof)

add_cxx_compile_options(-Wno-shorten-64-to-32)
add_cxx_compile_options(-Wno-unknown-warning-option)
add_cxx_compile_options(-Wno-unused-command-line-argument)

    add_cxx_compile_options(-ffp-contract=off)
    add_cxx_compile_options(-fstrict-flex-arrays=2)

    if (UNIX AND NOT APPLE AND NOT ENABLE_FUZZERS)

        add_cxx_only_compile_options(-fvisibility-inlines-hidden)
    endif()

if (CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang")
    add_cxx_compile_options(-Wno-implicit-const-int-float-conversion)
    add_cxx_only_compile_options(-Wno-unqualified-std-cast-call)

    # Used for the #embed directive.
    # FIXME: Remove this once #embed is no longer an extension.
    add_cxx_compile_options(-Wno-c23-extensions)
endif()

if (CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang" AND NOT MSVC)
    # Clang's default constexpr-steps limit is 1048576(2^20), GCC doesn't have one
    add_cxx_only_compile_options(-fconstexpr-steps=16777216)

    add_cxx_compile_options(-Wmissing-prototypes)
elseif (CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU")
    add_cxx_only_compile_options(-Wno-literal-suffix)
    add_cxx_compile_options(-Wvla)

    # FIXME: These warnings trigger on Function and ByteBuffer in GCC (only when LTO is disabled...)
    #        investigate this and maybe reenable them if they're not false positives/invalid.
    add_cxx_compile_options(-Wno-array-bounds)
    add_cxx_compile_options(-Wno-stringop-overflow)

    # FIXME: This warning seems useful but has too many false positives with GCC 13.
    add_cxx_only_compile_options(-Wno-dangling-reference)
elseif (MSVC)
    # Warning options and defines
    add_cxx_compile_options(/W4)
    add_cxx_compile_options(-Wno-reserved-identifier)
    add_cxx_compile_options(-Wno-microsoft-unqualified-friend) # MSVC doesn't support unqualified friends
    add_cxx_compile_definitions(_CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS) # _s replacements not desired (or implemented on any other platform other than VxWorks)
    add_cxx_compile_definitions(_CRT_NONSTDC_NO_WARNINGS) # POSIX names are just fine, thanks

    # Windows API defines
    add_cxx_compile_definitions(_USE_MATH_DEFINES)
    add_cxx_compile_definitions(NOMINMAX)
    add_cxx_compile_definitions(WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN)
    add_cxx_compile_definitions(_WIN32_WINNT=0x0A00)
    add_cxx_compile_definitions(WINVER=0x0A00)

    # TODO: Use export macros everywhere
    set(CMAKE_WINDOWS_EXPORT_ALL_SYMBOLS ON)

    # full symbolic debugginng information
    add_cxx_compile_options(/Z7)

    # Compiler options
    # disable exceptions
    add_cxx_compile_options(/EHs-)
    # disable floating-point expression contraction, which the default /fp:precise allows
    add_cxx_compile_options(/clang:-ffp-contract=off)
    # reduces object size
    add_cxx_compile_options(/Zc:inline)
    # equivalent of -fvisibility-inlines-hidden
    add_cxx_compile_options(/Zc:dllexportInlines-)
    # clang-cl has this off by default unlike other clang versions
    add_cxx_compile_options(-fstrict-aliasing)
    add_cxx_compile_options(/clang:-fstrict-flex-arrays=2)
    add_cxx_compile_options(/clang:-ftrivial-auto-var-init=zero)
    # create COMDATs from functions and data, enables deduplication
    add_cxx_compile_options(/Gw)
    add_cxx_compile_options(/Gy)
    # enable control flow protection
    add_cxx_compile_options(/guard:cf)

    # Linker options
    # increase stack size reserve to match Linux
    add_cxx_link_options(/STACK:0x800000)
    # enable control flow protection
    add_cxx_link_options(/GUARD:CF)
    add_cxx_link_option_if_supported(-prefetch-inputs)

    # Use ghash compressed debug info for build time and pdb size reduction
    if (CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "RelWithDebInfo" OR CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "Debug")
        add_cxx_compile_options(-gcodeview-ghash)
        add_cxx_link_options(/DEBUG:GHASH)
    endif()
endif()

include(${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/sanitizers.cmake)

include(CheckPIESupported)
check_pie_supported(LANGUAGES CXX)
if(CMAKE_CXX_LINK_PIE_SUPPORTED)
    set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
endif()

include(CheckCXXSourceCompiles)
if (LINUX)
    # Some distributions' compilers define _FORTIFY_SOURCE themselves, and a different value than ours is an error.
    add_cxx_compile_options(-U_FORTIFY_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=3)
    add_cxx_compile_definitions(_FILE_OFFSET_BITS=64)
    add_cxx_compile_options(-fstack-clash-protection)
    add_cxx_link_option_if_supported(LINKER:-z,relro)
    add_cxx_link_option_if_supported(LINKER:-z,now)

    # glibc older than 2.36 cannot load binaries with packed relative relocations, but linkers can still produce them.
    # The checks are nested because __GLIBC_PREREQ(2, 36) does not parse in an #if where the macro is not defined.
    check_cxx_source_compiles("
        #include <features.h>
        #ifdef __GLIBC__
        #    if !__GLIBC_PREREQ(2, 36)
        #        error glibc is too old to load packed relative relocations
        #    endif
        #endif
        int main() { }
    " LAGOM_LIBC_SUPPORTS_PACKED_RELATIVE_RELOCS)
    if (LAGOM_LIBC_SUPPORTS_PACKED_RELATIVE_RELOCS)
        add_cxx_link_option_if_supported(LINKER:-z,pack-relative-relocs)
    endif()
endif()

if (APPLE)
    list(APPEND CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH /opt/homebrew)
    add_cxx_link_options(LINKER:-dead_strip)

    # The debug info of LTO code lives in the objects the linker generates, which it deletes after linking unless told
    # where to keep them; dsymutil reads it from there.
    if (LADYBIRD_GENERATE_SYMBOL_FILES)
        file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/lto")
        add_cxx_link_options("LINKER:-object_path_lto,${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/lto/$<TARGET_PROPERTY:NAME>")
    endif()
endif()

if (HAIKU)
    # Haiku needs some extra compile definitions to make important stuff in its headers available.
    add_compile_definitions(_DEFAULT_SOURCE)
    add_compile_definitions(_GNU_SOURCE)
    add_compile_definitions(__USE_GNU)
endif()

if (NOT WIN32)
    add_cxx_link_option_if_supported(LINKER:--gdb-index)
    add_cxx_link_option_if_supported(LINKER:--build-id)

    if (NOT ENABLE_FUZZERS)
        add_cxx_link_option_if_supported(LINKER:-Bsymbolic-non-weak-functions)
    endif()
endif()

if (NOT WIN32 AND NOT APPLE AND NOT ENABLE_FUZZERS)
    # NOTE: Assume ELF
    # NOTE: --no-undefined is not compatible with clang sanitizer runtimes
    # NOTE: Some BSDs don't export all symbols from LibC so we can't use --no-undefined
    if ((CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang$" AND (ENABLE_ADDRESS_SANITIZER OR ENABLE_MEMORY_SANITIZER OR ENABLE_THREAD_SANITIZER OR ENABLE_UNDEFINED_SANITIZER OR ENABLE_LAGOM_COVERAGE_COLLECTION)) OR BSD)
        add_link_options(LINKER:--allow-shlib-undefined)
        add_link_options(LINKER:-z,undefs)
    else()
        add_link_options(LINKER:-z,defs)
        add_link_options(LINKER:--no-undefined)
        add_link_options(LINKER:--no-allow-shlib-undefined)
    endif()
endif()

if (CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "Debug")
    if (NOT MSVC)
        add_cxx_compile_options(-ggdb3)
        add_cxx_compile_options(-Og)
    endif()
elseif (CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "RelWithDebInfo")
    if (NOT MSVC)
        add_cxx_compile_options(-O2)
        add_cxx_compile_options(-g1)
    else()
        # Add OPT:REF either way as it doesn't impact debugging experience negatively and decreases binary size
        # see: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/build/reference/opt-optimizations?view=msvc-170
        # This doesn't play nicely with ASAN
        if (NOT ENABLE_ADDRESS_SANITIZER)
            add_cxx_link_options(/OPT:REF)
        endif()
        # Override /Ob1 that cmake adds to allow inlining on all functions.
        # This makes debugging worse but is closer to a normal build for profiling and testing.
        add_cxx_compile_options(/O2)
    endif()
elseif (CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "Release")
    if (NOT MSVC)
        add_cxx_compile_options(-O3)

        # Line tables, inlined frames included, are what symbolicating a crash report needs.
        if (LADYBIRD_GENERATE_SYMBOL_FILES)
            add_cxx_compile_options(-g1)
        endif()
    else()
        add_cxx_compile_options(/O2)
    endif()
endif()

    include(CheckIPOSupported)
    check_ipo_supported(RESULT IPO_AVAILABLE OUTPUT output)
    if(IPO_AVAILABLE)
        set(CMAKE_INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION TRUE)
    else()
        message(WARNING "Not enabling IPO as it is not supported: ${output}")
    endif()
endif()

if (ENABLE_LAGOM_COVERAGE_COLLECTION)
    if (CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang$" AND NOT ENABLE_FUZZERS)
        add_cxx_compile_options(-fprofile-instr-generate -fcoverage-mapping)
        add_cxx_link_options(-fprofile-instr-generate)
    else()
        message(FATAL_ERROR
            "Collecting code coverage is unsupported in this configuration.")
    endif()
endif()

# Runs while CPack packages, once the files of the package are staged. A Linux package says which kind it is, so that
# the browser in it can tell how to update it: the same build can also end up in an archive.
set(marker "${CPACK_TEMPORARY_DIRECTORY}/Browser${CPACK_PACKAGING_INSTALL_PREFIX}/${CPACK_LADYBIRD_RESOURCE_DIRECTORY}/package-format")
file(WRITE "${marker}" "${CPACK_GENERATOR}\n")
file(CHMOD "${marker}" PERMISSIONS OWNER_READ OWNER_WRITE GROUP_READ WORLD_READ)

FILE: Meta/CMake/cpack_project_config.cmake
# The archives keep a relocatable layout of Ladybird's components, while the Linux packages install into a fixed
# directory and group the components into the browser package and its debug symbols package.
if (CPACK_GENERATOR MATCHES "^(DEB|RPM)$")
    set(CPACK_PACKAGING_INSTALL_PREFIX "${CPACK_LADYBIRD_PACKAGE_INSTALL_PREFIX}")
    set(CPACK_PACKAGE_RELOCATABLE OFF)
    set(CPACK_COMPONENT_LADYBIRD_RUNTIME_GROUP Browser)
    set(CPACK_COMPONENT_LADYBIRD_SYSTEMINTEGRATION_GROUP Browser)
    set(CPACK_COMPONENT_LADYBIRD_SYSTEMSYMBOLS_GROUP DebugSymbols)
    set(CPACK_PRE_BUILD_SCRIPTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/cpack_package_format.cmake")
endif()

# A Linux package targets the ABI of the distribution that built it, so its version names that distribution version:
# Debian packages like Ubuntu's backports do, RPM packages with the dist tag of rpmbuild. Builds for several versions
# of a distribution can then share a repository, and upgrading the distribution also moves Ladybird to the build for it.
if (CPACK_GENERATOR STREQUAL "DEB")
    file(STRINGS /etc/os-release os_release REGEX "^(ID|VERSION_ID)=")
    foreach (line IN LISTS os_release)
        if (line MATCHES "^(ID|VERSION_ID)=\"?([^\"]*)\"?$")
            set(os_release_${CMAKE_MATCH_1} "${CMAKE_MATCH_2}")
        endif()
    endforeach()
    set(CPACK_DEBIAN_PACKAGE_RELEASE "1~${os_release_ID}${os_release_VERSION_ID}")
    set(CPACK_DEBIAN_DEBUGSYMBOLS_PACKAGE_DEPENDS
        "ladybird (= ${CPACK_PACKAGE_VERSION}-${CPACK_DEBIAN_PACKAGE_RELEASE})")
endif()

#[=======================================================================[.rst:
FindWebP
--------------

Find WebP headers and libraries.

Imported Targets
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

``WebP::webp``
  The WebP library, if found.

``WebP::webpdemux``
  The WebP demux library, if found.

``WebP::libwebpmux``
  The WebP mux library, if found.

``WebP::webpdecoder``
  The WebP decoder library, if found.

Result Variables
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

This will define the following variables in your project:

``WebP_FOUND``
  true if (the requested version of) WebP is available.
``WebP_VERSION``
  the version of WebP.
``WebP_LIBRARIES``
  the libraries to link against to use WebP.
``WebP_INCLUDE_DIRS``
  where to find the WebP headers.
``WebP_COMPILE_OPTIONS``
  this should be passed to target_compile_options(), if the
  target is not used for linking

#]=======================================================================]

find_package(PkgConfig QUIET)
pkg_check_modules(PC_WEBP QUIET libwebp)
set(WebP_COMPILE_OPTIONS ${PC_WEBP_CFLAGS_OTHER})
set(WebP_VERSION ${PC_WEBP_CFLAGS_VERSION})

find_path(WebP_INCLUDE_DIR
    NAMES webp/encode.h
    HINTS ${PC_WEBP_INCLUDEDIR} ${PC_WEBP_INCLUDE_DIRS}
)

find_library(WebP_LIBRARY
    NAMES ${WebP_NAMES} webp libwebp
    HINTS ${PC_WEBP_LIBDIR} ${PC_WEBP_LIBRARY_DIRS}
)

# There's nothing in the WebP headers that could be used to detect the exact
# WebP version being used so don't attempt to do so. A version can only be found
# through pkg-config
if ("${WebP_FIND_VERSION}" VERSION_GREATER "${WebP_VERSION}")
    if (WebP_VERSION)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Required version (" ${WebP_FIND_VERSION} ") is higher than found version (" ${WebP_VERSION} ")")
    else ()
        message(WARNING "Cannot determine WebP version without pkg-config")
    endif ()
endif ()

# Find components
if (WebP_INCLUDE_DIR AND WebP_LIBRARY)
    set(_WebP_REQUIRED_LIBS_FOUND ON)
    set(WebP_LIBS_FOUND "WebP (required): ${WebP_LIBRARY}")
else ()
    set(_WebP_REQUIRED_LIBS_FOUND OFF)
    set(WebP_LIBS_NOT_FOUND "WebP (required)")
endif ()

find_library(WebP_DEMUX_LIBRARY
    NAMES ${WebP_DEMUX_NAMES} webpdemux libwebpdemux
    HINTS ${PC_WEBP_LIBDIR} ${PC_WEBP_LIBRARY_DIRS}
)

if (WebP_DEMUX_LIBRARY)

        list(APPEND WebP_LIBS_FOUND "webpdemux (required): ${WebP_DEMUX_LIBRARY}")
    else ()
       list(APPEND WebP_LIBS_FOUND "webpdemux (optional): ${WebP_DEMUX_LIBRARY}")
    endif ()
else ()
    if (WebP_FIND_REQUIRED_webpdemux)
       set(_WebP_REQUIRED_LIBS_FOUND OFF)
       list(APPEND WebP_LIBS_NOT_FOUND "webpdemux (required)")
    else ()
       list(APPEND WebP_LIBS_NOT_FOUND "webpdemux (optional)")
    endif ()
endif ()

find_library(WebP_MUX_LIBRARY
    NAMES ${WebP_MUX_NAMES} webpmux libwebpmux
    HINTS ${PC_WEBP_LIBDIR} ${PC_WEBP_LIBRARY_DIRS}
)

if (WebP_MUX_LIBRARY)

if (NOT WebP_FIND_QUIETLY)
    if (WebP_LIBS_FOUND)

FILE: Meta/CMake/flatpak/angle/angle-install.sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -e

cd angle

# Headers
pushd include
    find . -type f -and -name "*.h" -exec install -D -m644 {} "$FLATPAK_DEST/include/angle/"{} \;
popd

# Libraries
libs=(
  libEGL.so
  libGLESv1_CM.so
  libGLESv2.so
  libchrome_zlib.so
  libfeature_support.so
  libthird_party_abseil-cpp_absl.so
)

for lib in "${libs[@]}"; do
    install -D -m644 out/"$lib" "$FLATPAK_DEST/lib/$lib"
done

# Licenses: flatpak-builder only records those at the top of a module's source, and ANGLE is checked out below it,
# with the third-party code that it builds in.
licenses="$FLATPAK_DEST/share/licenses/$FLATPAK_ID/angle"
install -D -m644 LICENSE "$licenses/LICENSE"
shopt -s nullglob
# Some keep their license texts in a LICENSES directory.
for license in {,src/,src/common/}third_party/*/{LICENSE,COPYING}* third_party/*/{src,source}/{LICENSE,COPYING}*; do
    for file in "$license" "$license"/*; do
        [[ -f "$file" ]] && install -D -m644 "$file" "$licenses/${file//\//_}"
    done
done
shopt -u nullglob

# Pkg-config

+// allocate() is only defined in this file, but the inline alloc*() helpers in vk_cache_utils.h call
+// it from other translation units, so the instantiations have to be emitted from here. GCC 15
+// inlines this file's constant-count uses and then emits no out-of-line copy at all, which leaves
+// libGLESv2 with undefined references; the explicit instantiations force the copies to exist.

FILE: Meta/CMake/flatpak/generate-cargo-sources.py
#!/usr/bin/env python3

# Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
#
# SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause

# Generate cargo-sources.json for Flatpak builds from Cargo.lock.
# Run this script whenever Rust dependencies change.

import argparse
import json
import re
import sys

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

script_dir = Path(__file__).parent
repo_root = script_dir / ".." / ".." / ".."
lock_path = repo_root / "Cargo.lock"
out_path = script_dir / "cargo-sources.json"


def generate(lock: str) -> str:
    crates = []
    for m in re.finditer(
        r'name = "(.+?)"\nversion = "(.+?)"\nsource = "registry.+?"\nchecksum = "(.+?)"',
        lock,
    ):
        crates.append((m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3)))

    sources: list[dict[str, Any]] = [
        {
            "type": "git",
            "url": "https://github.com/corrosion-rs/corrosion.git",
            "tag": "v0.5.1",
            "dest": "corrosion",
        },
    ]

    for name, version, checksum in crates:
        sources.append(
            {
                "type": "archive",
                "archive-type": "tar-gzip",
                "url": f"https://static.crates.io/crates/{name}/{name}-{version}.crate",
                "sha256": checksum,
                "dest": f"cargo/vendor/{name}-{version}",
            }
        )

    checksum_commands = []
    for name, version, checksum in crates:
        d = f"cargo/vendor/{name}-{version}"
        checksum_json = json.dumps({"files": {}, "package": checksum})
        checksum_commands.append(f"echo '{checksum_json}' > {d}/.cargo-checksum.json")

    cargo_config = '[source.crates-io]\\nreplace-with = "vendored-sources"\\n\\n[source.vendored-sources]\\ndirectory = "cargo/vendor"\\n'

    sources.append(
        {
            "type": "shell",
            "commands": [
                *checksum_commands,
                "mkdir -p .cargo",
                f"printf '{cargo_config}' > .cargo/config.toml",
            ],
        }
    )

    return json.dumps(sources, indent=4) + "\n"


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Generate cargo-sources.json for Flatpak builds from Cargo.lock.")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--check", action="store_true", help="only check that cargo-sources.json matches Cargo.lock, without writing it"
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()

    sources = generate(lock_path.read_text())
    if args.check:
        if not out_path.exists() or out_path.read_text() != sources:
            script = Path(__file__).resolve().relative_to(repo_root.resolve())
            print(f"{out_path.name} does not match Cargo.lock; run {script} to update it.")
            sys.exit(1)
        return

    out_path.write_text(sources)
    print(f"Generated {out_path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

FILE: Meta/CMake/flatpak/gn-whole-enchilada.sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -e

REV_SHORT=97b68a0 # 97b68a0bb62b7528bc3491c7949d6804223c2b82
REV_NUM=2255 # git describe HEAD --match initial-commit | cut -d- -f3

env CC=gcc CXX=g++ python3 build/gen.py --no-last-commit-position

cat > out/last_commit_position.h <<EOF
    #ifndef OUT_LAST_COMMIT_POSITION_H_
    #define OUT_LAST_COMMIT_POSITION_H_

    #define LAST_COMMIT_POSITION_NUM ${REV_NUM}
    #define LAST_COMMIT_POSITION "${REV_NUM} (${REV_SHORT})"

    #endif  // OUT_LAST_COMMIT_POSITION_H_
EOF

ninja -j"$(nproc)" -C out

cp -v out/gn "$FLATPAK_DEST"/bin/

FILE: Meta/CMake/flatpak/skia/skia-install.sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -e

# Libs
mkdir -p "$FLATPAK_DEST/lib"
for path in out/*.a out/*.so; do
    install -Dm644 "$path" "$FLATPAK_DEST/lib/$(basename "$path")"
done

# Includes
mkdir -p "$FLATPAK_DEST/include/skia/modules"
pushd include
    find . -name '*.h' -exec install -Dm644 {} "$FLATPAK_DEST/include/skia/{}" \;
popd
pushd modules
    find . -name '*.h' -exec install -Dm644 {} "$FLATPAK_DEST/include/skia/modules/{}" \;
popd

# Pkg-config
mkdir -p "$FLATPAK_DEST/lib/pkgconfig"
cat > "$FLATPAK_DEST/lib/pkgconfig/skia.pc" <<EOF
    prefix=${FLATPAK_DEST}
    exec_prefix=\${prefix}
    libdir=\${prefix}/lib
    includedir=\${prefix}/include/skia
    Name: skia
    Description: 2D graphic library for drawing text, geometries and images.
    URL: https://skia.org/
    Version: 148
    Libs: -L\${libdir} -lskia -lskcms
    Cflags: -I\${includedir}
EOF

# Some skia includes are assumed to be under an include sub directory by
# other includes
# shellcheck disable=SC2013
for file in $(grep -rl '#include "include/' "$FLATPAK_DEST/include/skia"); do
  sed -i -e 's|#include "include/|#include "|g' "$file"
done

FILE: Meta/CMake/get_linked_lagom_libraries.cmake
function(add_lagom_library list item)
    list(FIND "${list}" "${item}" item_is_present)

    if (item_is_present EQUAL -1)
        set("${list}" "${${list}}" "${item}" PARENT_SCOPE)
     endif()
endfunction()

function(get_linked_lagom_libraries_impl target output)
    if (NOT TARGET "${target}")
        return()
    endif()

    get_property(visited GLOBAL PROPERTY _LADYBIRD_LINKED_LAGOM_LIBRARIES_VISITED)
    if ("${target}" IN_LIST visited)
        return()
    endif()
    set_property(GLOBAL APPEND PROPERTY _LADYBIRD_LINKED_LAGOM_LIBRARIES_VISITED "${target}")

    get_target_property(target_is_imported "${target}" IMPORTED)
    if (target_is_imported)
        return()
    endif()

    get_target_property(target_type "${target}" TYPE)

    if ("${target_type}" STREQUAL "SHARED_LIBRARY")
        add_lagom_library("${output}" "${target}")
    elseif ("${target_type}" STREQUAL "INTERFACE_LIBRARY")
        return()
    endif()

    get_target_property(target_libraries "${target}" LINK_LIBRARIES)

    foreach(target_library IN LISTS target_libraries)
        get_linked_lagom_libraries_impl("${target_library}" "${output}")
    endforeach()

    set("${output}" "${${output}}" PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

function(get_linked_lagom_libraries target output)
    # Track all visited targets, including static libraries, separately from the shared libraries collected for installation.
    set_property(GLOBAL PROPERTY _LADYBIRD_LINKED_LAGOM_LIBRARIES_VISITED "")

    get_linked_lagom_libraries_impl(${target} ${output})
    set("${output}" "${${output}}" PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

FILE: Meta/CMake/install_vcpkg_libraries.cmake
include_guard()

# CMake collects runtime dependencies only on Windows, Linux and macOS.
# Windows is left out too, as its vcpkg DLLs live in bin/ and install as RUNTIME artifacts.
set(LADYBIRD_INSTALLS_VCPKG_LIBRARIES OFF)
if (CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME MATCHES "^(Linux|Darwin)$" AND NOT "${VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR}" STREQUAL "")
    set(LADYBIRD_INSTALLS_VCPKG_LIBRARIES ON)
endif()

function(ladybird_vcpkg_library_directory output_variable)
    set(vcpkg_library_dir "${VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR}/${VCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET}/lib")
    if (NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE MATCHES "Release|RelWithDebInfo")
        set(vcpkg_library_dir "${VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR}/${VCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET}/debug/lib")
    endif()
    set(${output_variable} "${vcpkg_library_dir}" PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

# Installs the shared libraries from vcpkg that the binaries in the runtime dependency set link. Call it after every
# install() that adds to the set.
function(ladybird_install_vcpkg_libraries dependency_set)
    cmake_parse_arguments(PARSE_ARGV 1 ARG "" "DESTINATION;COMPONENT" "")

    ladybird_vcpkg_library_directory(vcpkg_library_dir)
    file(GLOB vcpkg_shared_libraries LIST_DIRECTORIES false
        "${vcpkg_library_dir}/*.dylib" "${vcpkg_library_dir}/*.so" "${vcpkg_library_dir}/*.so.*")

    set(system_library_regexes "")
    if (APPLE)
        # These are in the dyld shared cache rather than on disk.
        set(system_library_regexes "^/usr/lib/" "^/System/")
    endif()

    # A dependency found through a plugin's relative runpath can contain .. segments.
    install(RUNTIME_DEPENDENCY_SET ${dependency_set}
        PRE_EXCLUDE_REGEXES ${system_library_regexes}
        POST_INCLUDE_FILES ${vcpkg_shared_libraries}
        POST_EXCLUDE_REGEXES ".*"
        DIRECTORIES "${vcpkg_library_dir}"
        LIBRARY DESTINATION ${ARG_DESTINATION} COMPONENT ${ARG_COMPONENT}
    )

    # The libraries are installed under the names of the files they resolve to, yet binaries may link them through the
    # versioned links next to those files.
    install(CODE "
    set(library_install_dir \"\$ENV{DESTDIR}\${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/${ARG_DESTINATION}\")
    file(GLOB links LIST_DIRECTORIES false \"${vcpkg_library_dir}/*\")
    foreach (link IN LISTS links)
      cmake_path(GET link FILENAME link_name)
      if (NOT IS_SYMLINK \"\${link}\" OR NOT link_name MATCHES \"\\\\.[0-9]+\\\\.dylib\$|\\\\.so\\\\.[0-9]+\")
        continue()
      endif()
      file(REAL_PATH \"\${link}\" target)
      cmake_path(GET target FILENAME target_name)
      if (EXISTS \"\${library_install_dir}/\${target_name}\" AND NOT link_name STREQUAL target_name)
        file(CREATE_LINK \"\${target_name}\" \"\${library_install_dir}/\${link_name}\" SYMBOLIC)
      endif()
    endforeach()
  "
            COMPONENT ${ARG_COMPONENT})
endfunction()

FILE: Meta/CMake/ladybird_helper_processes.cmake
set(ladybird_helper_processes
    AudioServer
    Compositor
    Hub
    ImageDecoder
    MediaServer
    RequestServer
    SystemProbe
    VideoDecoderServer
    WebContent
    WebRTCClient
)

# Kills the helpers when the Browser is gone, which the kernel cannot do on macOS.
if (APPLE)
    list(APPEND ladybird_helper_processes ProcessReaper)
endif()

function(ladybird_write_entitlements path)
    set(plist "<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\"?>\n<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC \"-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN\" \"http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd\">\n<plist version=\"1.0\">\n<dict>\n")
    foreach (entitlement IN LISTS ARGN)
        string(APPEND plist "\t<key>${entitlement}</key>\n\t<true/>\n")
    endforeach()
    string(APPEND plist "</dict>\n</plist>\n")
    file(WRITE "${path}" "${plist}")
endfunction()

# On macOS, helpers run with the hardened runtime, so the kernel refuses to run code from memory that was writable, except
# in the MAP_JIT regions where the renderers put the code that their JIT compilers generate. Library validation stays
# off, since development builds sign their libraries ad hoc, without a team identifier. Every build of the helper signs
# it, so that targeted builds keep these protections too. Release signing uses the .release.entitlements file instead:
# every library in a release bundle carries the same team identifier, so library validation stays on, and debuggers
# must not be able to attach.
function(ladybird_sign_helper_process target)
    if (NOT APPLE)
        return()
    endif()
    cmake_parse_arguments(PARSE_ARGV 1 ARG "ALLOW_JIT" "" "ENTITLEMENTS")

    set(entitlements com.apple.security.cs.disable-library-validation ${ARG_ENTITLEMENTS})
    if (ARG_ALLOW_JIT)
        list(APPEND entitlements com.apple.security.cs.allow-jit)
    endif()
    if (CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE MATCHES "Debug|RelWithDebInfo")
        list(APPEND entitlements com.apple.security.get-task-allow)
    endif()

    set(entitlements_file "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${target}.entitlements")
    ladybird_write_entitlements("${entitlements_file}" ${entitlements})

    set(release_entitlements ${ARG_ENTITLEMENTS})
    if (ARG_ALLOW_JIT)
        list(APPEND release_entitlements com.apple.security.cs.allow-jit)
    endif()
    ladybird_write_entitlements("${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${target}.release.entitlements" ${release_entitlements})
    install(FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${target}.release.entitlements" DESTINATION entitlements
        COMPONENT ladybird_Runtime)

    ladybird_codesign_command(codesign_command "${target}" --entitlements "${entitlements_file}" -o runtime "$<TARGET_FILE:${target}>")
    add_custom_command(TARGET ${target} POST_BUILD COMMAND ${codesign_command} VERBATIM)
endfunction()

FILE: Meta/CMake/lagom_install_options.cmake
include_guard()

include(GNUInstallDirs) # make sure to include before we mess w/RPATH

# Handle multi-config generators (e.g. MSVC, Xcode, Ninja Multi-Config)
get_property(is_multi_config GLOBAL PROPERTY GENERATOR_IS_MULTI_CONFIG)
set(IN_BUILD_PREFIX "")
if (is_multi_config)
    set(IN_BUILD_PREFIX "$<CONFIG>/")
endif()

# Mirror the structure of the installed tree to ensure that rpaths
# always remain valid.
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/${IN_BUILD_PREFIX}${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}")
set(CMAKE_LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/${IN_BUILD_PREFIX}${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}")
set(CMAKE_ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/${IN_BUILD_PREFIX}${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}")

set(CMAKE_SKIP_BUILD_RPATH FALSE)

if ("${VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR}" STREQUAL "")
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_WITH_INSTALL_RPATH TRUE)
else()
    if (CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE MATCHES "Release|RelWithDebInfo")
        set(CMAKE_BUILD_RPATH "${VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR}/${VCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET}/lib")
    else()
        set(CMAKE_BUILD_RPATH "${VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR}/${VCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET}/debug/lib")
    endif()
endif()

# See slide 100 of the following ppt :^)
# https://crascit.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/09/Deep-CMake-For-Library-Authors-Craig-Scott-CppCon-2019.pdf
if (APPLE)
    set(CMAKE_MACOSX_RPATH TRUE)
    set(CMAKE_INSTALL_NAME_DIR "@rpath")
endif()

# Static builds without vcpkg install no libraries, so their executables have nothing to look for next to them.
if (BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OR NOT "${VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR}" STREQUAL "")
    if (APPLE)
        set(CMAKE_INSTALL_RPATH "@executable_path/../lib")
    else()
        set(CMAKE_INSTALL_RPATH "$ORIGIN:$ORIGIN/../${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}")
    endif()
endif()

# Installs carry the shared libraries from vcpkg, so they must not look for them in the build machine's vcpkg tree.
if ("${VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR}" STREQUAL "")
    set(CMAKE_INSTALL_RPATH_USE_LINK_PATH TRUE)
endif()

set(CMAKE_INSTALL_MESSAGE NEVER)

function (generate_css_implementation)
    set(LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")


    invoke_py_generator(
        "DescriptorID.cpp"
        "generate_libweb_css_descriptors.py"
        "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/CSS/Descriptors.json"
        "CSS/DescriptorID.h"
        "CSS/DescriptorID.cpp"
        arguments -j "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/CSS/Descriptors.json"
    )

    invoke_py_generator(
        "Enums.cpp"
        "generate_libweb_css_enums.py"
        "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/CSS/Enums.json"
        "CSS/Enums.h"
        "CSS/Enums.cpp"
        arguments -j "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/CSS/Enums.json"
    )

    invoke_py_header_generator(
        "MediaFeatureID.h"
        "generate_libweb_css_media_feature_id.py"
        "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/CSS/MediaFeatures.json"
        "CSS/MediaFeatureID.h"
        arguments -j "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/CSS/MediaFeatures.json"
    )

    invoke_py_generator(
        "PropertyID.cpp"
        "generate_libweb_css_property_id.py"
        "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/CSS/Properties.json"
        "CSS/PropertyID.h"
        "CSS/PropertyID.cpp"
        arguments -j "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/CSS/Properties.json"
                  -e "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/CSS/Enums.json"
                  -g "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/CSS/LogicalPropertyGroups.json"
        dependencies "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/CSS/Enums.json" "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/CSS/LogicalPropertyGroups.json"
                     "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Utils/utils.py"
    )

    invoke_py_header_generator(
        "PseudoClass.h"
        "generate_libweb_css_pseudo_class.py"
        "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/CSS/PseudoClasses.json"
        "CSS/PseudoClass.h"
        arguments -j "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/CSS/PseudoClasses.json"
    )

    invoke_py_generator(
        "PseudoElement.cpp"
        "generate_libweb_css_pseudo_element.py"
        "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/CSS/PseudoElements.json"
        "CSS/PseudoElement.h"
        "CSS/PseudoElement.cpp"
        arguments -j "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/CSS/PseudoElements.json"
    )

    invoke_py_header_generator(
        "TransformFunctions.h"
        "generate_libweb_css_transform_functions.py"
        "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/CSS/TransformFunctions.json"
        "CSS/TransformFunctions.h"
        arguments -j "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/CSS/TransformFunctions.json"
    )

    invoke_py_generator(
        "Units.cpp"
        "generate_libweb_css_units.py"
        "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/CSS/Units.json"
        "CSS/Units.h"
        "CSS/Units.cpp"
        arguments -j "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/CSS/Units.json"
    )

    invoke_py_generator(
        "Keyword.cpp"
        "generate_libweb_css_keyword.py"
        "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/CSS/Keywords.json"
        "CSS/Keyword.h"
        "CSS/Keyword.cpp"
        arguments -j "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/CSS/Keywords.json"
        dependencies "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Utils/utils.py"
    )

    invoke_py_idl_generator(
        "GeneratedCSSNumericFactoryMethods.idl"
        "generate_libweb_css_numeric_factory_methods.py"
        "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/CSS/Units.json"
        "CSS/GeneratedCSSNumericFactoryMethods.idl"
        arguments -j "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/CSS/Units.json"
    )

    embed_as_string(
        "DefaultStyleSheetSource.cpp"
        "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/CSS/Default.css"
        "CSS/DefaultStyleSheetSource.cpp"
        "default_stylesheet_source"
        NAMESPACE "Web::CSS"
    )

    embed_as_string(
        "QuirksModeStyleSheetSource.cpp"
        "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/CSS/QuirksMode.css"
        "CSS/QuirksModeStyleSheetSource.cpp"
        "quirks_mode_stylesheet_source"
        NAMESPACE "Web::CSS"
    )

    embed_as_string(
        "MathMLStyleSheetSource.cpp"
        "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/MathML/Default.css"
        "MathML/MathMLStyleSheetSource.cpp"
        "mathml_stylesheet_source"
        NAMESPACE "Web::CSS"
    )

    embed_as_string(
        "SVGStyleSheetSource.cpp"
        "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/SVG/Default.css"
        "SVG/SVGStyleSheetSource.cpp"
        "svg_stylesheet_source"
        NAMESPACE "Web::CSS"
    )

    set(CSS_GENERATED_HEADERS
       "CSS/Enums.h"
       "CSS/Keyword.h"
       "CSS/MediaFeatureID.h"
       "CSS/PropertyID.h"
       "CSS/PseudoClass.h"
       "CSS/PseudoElement.h"
       "CSS/TransformFunctions.h"
    )
    list(TRANSFORM CSS_GENERATED_HEADERS PREPEND "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/")
    if (ENABLE_INSTALL_HEADERS)
        install(FILES ${CSS_GENERATED_HEADERS} DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/LibWeb/CSS")
    endif()
    list(APPEND LIBWEB_ALL_GENERATED_HEADERS ${CSS_GENERATED_HEADERS})
    set(LIBWEB_ALL_GENERATED_HEADERS ${LIBWEB_ALL_GENERATED_HEADERS} PARENT_SCOPE)

    set(CSS_GENERATED_IDL
        "GeneratedCSSNumericFactoryMethods.idl"
    )
    list(APPEND LIBWEB_ALL_GENERATED_IDL ${CSS_GENERATED_IDL})
    set(LIBWEB_ALL_GENERATED_IDL ${LIBWEB_ALL_GENERATED_IDL} PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

function (generate_html_implementation)
    set(LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")

    invoke_py_generator(
        "NamedCharacterReferences.cpp"
        "generate_libweb_html_named_character_references.py"
        "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/HTML/Parser/Entities.json"
        "HTML/Parser/NamedCharacterReferences.h"
        "HTML/Parser/NamedCharacterReferences.cpp"
        arguments -j "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/HTML/Parser/Entities.json"
    )

    invoke_py_generator(
        "MediaControlsDOM.cpp"
        "generate_dom_tree.py"
        "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/HTML/MediaControls.html"
        "HTML/MediaControlsDOM.h"
        "HTML/MediaControlsDOM.cpp"
        arguments -i "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/HTML/MediaControls.html"
                  -s MediaControlsDOM
                  -n "Web::HTML"
                  --html-tags "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/HTML/TagNames.h"
                  --html-attributes "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/HTML/AttributeNames.h"
                  --svg-tags "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/SVG/TagNames.h"
                  --svg-attributes "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/SVG/AttributeNames.h"
        dependencies "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/HTML/TagNames.h"
                     "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/HTML/AttributeNames.h"
                     "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/SVG/TagNames.h"
                     "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/SVG/AttributeNames.h"
                     "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/HTML/MediaControls.css"
    )

    set(HTML_GENERATED_HEADERS
       "HTML/Parser/NamedCharacterReferences.h"
       "HTML/MediaControlsDOM.h"
    )
    list(TRANSFORM HTML_GENERATED_HEADERS PREPEND "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/")
    if (ENABLE_INSTALL_HEADERS)
        install(FILES ${HTML_GENERATED_HEADERS} DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/LibWeb/HTML")
    endif()
    list(APPEND LIBWEB_ALL_GENERATED_HEADERS ${HTML_GENERATED_HEADERS})
    set(LIBWEB_ALL_GENERATED_HEADERS ${LIBWEB_ALL_GENERATED_HEADERS} PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

function (generate_js_bindings target)
    set(LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
    set(generated_idl_targets ${LIBWEB_ALL_GENERATED_IDL})
    list(TRANSFORM generated_idl_targets PREPEND "generate_")
    set(LIBWEB_ALL_BINDINGS_SOURCES)
    set(LIBWEB_ALL_COMMON_BINDINGS_HEADERS)
    get_target_property(libwebcommon_binary_dir LibWebCommon BINARY_DIR)
    set(LIBWEB_COMMON_BINDINGS_DIRECTORY "${libwebcommon_binary_dir}/Bindings")
    set(LIBWEB_ALL_IDL_FILES)
    set(LIBWEB_ALL_PARSED_IDL_FILES)
    macro(libweb_add_bindings_source class)
        get_filename_component(basename "${class}" NAME)

        set(BINDINGS_HEADER "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/Bindings/${basename}.h")
        set(BINDINGS_SOURCE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/Bindings/${basename}.cpp")
        set(BINDINGS_SOURCES ${BINDINGS_HEADER} ${BINDINGS_SOURCE})
        target_sources(${target} PRIVATE ${BINDINGS_SOURCES})

        if (ENABLE_INSTALL_HEADERS)
            install(FILES ${BINDINGS_HEADER} DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/LibWeb/Bindings")
        endif()

        list(APPEND LIBWEB_ALL_GENERATED_HEADERS ${BINDINGS_HEADER})

        list(APPEND LIBWEB_ALL_BINDINGS_SOURCES ${BINDINGS_SOURCES})

        # The module's enumerations, which LibWebCommon provides so that processes without LibWeb can use them.
        set(COMMON_BINDINGS_HEADER "${LIBWEB_COMMON_BINDINGS_DIRECTORY}/${basename}.h")
        if (ENABLE_INSTALL_HEADERS)
            install(FILES ${COMMON_BINDINGS_HEADER} DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/LibWebCommon/Bindings")
        endif()
        list(APPEND LIBWEB_ALL_COMMON_BINDINGS_HEADERS ${COMMON_BINDINGS_HEADER})
    endmacro()

    macro(libweb_js_bindings class)
        get_filename_component(basename "${class}" NAME)
        set(idl_path "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/${class}.idl")
        if ("${basename}.idl" IN_LIST LIBWEB_ALL_GENERATED_IDL)
            set(idl_path "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${class}.idl")
        endif()

        libweb_add_bindings_source(${class})

        list(APPEND LIBWEB_ALL_IDL_FILES "${idl_path}")

        list(APPEND LIBWEB_ALL_PARSED_IDL_FILES "${idl_path}")
    endmacro()

    set(bindings_generator "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/generate_libweb_bindings.py")
    set(bindings_generator_dependencies
        "${bindings_generator}"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/__init__.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/arguments.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/attributes.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/callback_interfaces.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/constants.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/constructors.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/context.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/cpp_types.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/default_values.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/extended_attributes.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/global_mixins.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/glue_headers.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/includes.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/interface_declaration.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/interfaces.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/intrinsics.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/iterables.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/json_conversions.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/named_and_indexed_properties.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/namespaces.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/operations.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/overload_resolution.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/realms.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/rust_bindings.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/rust_members.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/rust_names.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/rust_overloads.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/rust_structured_serialize.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/rust_to_idl_value.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/rust_to_js_value.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/rust_types.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/rust_usage.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/security_checks.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/to_idl_value.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/to_js_value.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/wrappers.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Utils/lexer.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Utils/utils.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Utils/webidl_parser.py")

    set(exposed_interface_sources
        Forward.h
        IntrinsicDefinitions.cpp IntrinsicDefinitions.h
        AudioWorkletExposedInterfaces.cpp AudioWorkletExposedInterfaces.h
        DedicatedWorkerExposedInterfaces.cpp DedicatedWorkerExposedInterfaces.h
        SharedWorkerExposedInterfaces.cpp SharedWorkerExposedInterfaces.h
        WindowExposedInterfaces.cpp WindowExposedInterfaces.h
        WrapperFactory.cpp)
    list(TRANSFORM exposed_interface_sources PREPEND "Bindings/")
    target_sources(${target} PRIVATE ${exposed_interface_sources})

    set(exposed_interface_headers ${exposed_interface_sources})
    list(FILTER exposed_interface_headers INCLUDE REGEX "\.h$")
    list(TRANSFORM exposed_interface_headers PREPEND "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/")

    if (ENABLE_INSTALL_HEADERS)
        install(FILES ${exposed_interface_headers} DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/LibWeb/Bindings")
    endif()

    list(APPEND LIBWEB_ALL_GENERATED_HEADERS ${exposed_interface_headers})
    set(LIBWEB_ALL_GENERATED_HEADERS ${LIBWEB_ALL_GENERATED_HEADERS} PARENT_SCOPE)

    include("idl_files.cmake")
    list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES LIBWEB_ALL_PARSED_IDL_FILES)

    set(GLOBAL_MIXIN_HEADERS
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/Bindings/DedicatedWorkerGlobalScopeGlobalMixin.h"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/Bindings/SharedWorkerGlobalScopeGlobalMixin.h"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/Bindings/WindowGlobalMixin.h")
    if (ENABLE_INSTALL_HEADERS)
        install(FILES ${GLOBAL_MIXIN_HEADERS} DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/LibWeb/Bindings")
    endif()
    list(APPEND LIBWEB_ALL_GENERATED_HEADERS ${GLOBAL_MIXIN_HEADERS})
    list(APPEND LIBWEB_ALL_BINDINGS_SOURCES ${GLOBAL_MIXIN_HEADERS})

    set(LIBWEB_ALL_IDL_FILES_ARGUMENT ${LIBWEB_ALL_IDL_FILES})
    set(LIBWEB_ALL_PARSED_IDL_FILES_ARGUMENT ${LIBWEB_ALL_PARSED_IDL_FILES})
    set(LIBWEB_BINDINGS_DEPFILE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/Bindings/LibWebBindings.d")
    if (WIN32)
        list(JOIN LIBWEB_ALL_IDL_FILES "\n" idl_file_list)
        file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/all_idl_files.txt" CONTENT "${idl_file_list}" NEWLINE_STYLE UNIX)
        set(LIBWEB_ALL_IDL_FILES_ARGUMENT "@${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/all_idl_files.txt")

        list(JOIN LIBWEB_ALL_PARSED_IDL_FILES "\n" parsed_idl_file_list)
        file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/all_parsed_idl_files.txt" CONTENT "${parsed_idl_file_list}" NEWLINE_STYLE UNIX)
        set(LIBWEB_ALL_PARSED_IDL_FILES_ARGUMENT "@${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/all_parsed_idl_files.txt")
    endif()

    # The bindings of the interfaces implemented in Rust, which libweb_bindings_rust includes.
    set(rust_bindings_source "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/Bindings/RustBindings.rs")

    add_custom_command(
        OUTPUT ${LIBWEB_ALL_BINDINGS_SOURCES} ${LIBWEB_ALL_COMMON_BINDINGS_HEADERS} ${exposed_interface_sources} ${rust_bindings_source}
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E make_directory "Bindings"
        COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${bindings_generator}" -o "Bindings"
                --common-output-path "${LIBWEB_COMMON_BINDINGS_DIRECTORY}"
                --depfile "${LIBWEB_BINDINGS_DEPFILE}"
                ${LIBWEB_ALL_PARSED_IDL_FILES_ARGUMENT}
        VERBATIM
        COMMENT "Generating LibWeb bindings"
        DEPFILE "${LIBWEB_BINDINGS_DEPFILE}"
        DEPENDS ${bindings_generator_dependencies} ${LIBWEB_ALL_IDL_FILES} ${LIBWEB_ALL_PARSED_IDL_FILES}
    )

    add_custom_target(generate_bindings DEPENDS ${LIBWEB_ALL_BINDINGS_SOURCES} ${LIBWEB_ALL_COMMON_BINDINGS_HEADERS} ${rust_bindings_source})
    add_dependencies(ladybird_codegen_accumulator generate_bindings)
    add_dependencies(${target} generate_bindings)
    add_dependencies(generate_bindings ${generated_idl_targets})

    add_custom_target(generate_exposed_interfaces DEPENDS ${exposed_interface_sources})
    add_dependencies(ladybird_codegen_accumulator generate_exposed_interfaces)
    add_dependencies(${target} generate_exposed_interfaces)
    add_dependencies(generate_exposed_interfaces ${generated_idl_targets})

    set(LIBWEB_ALL_GENERATED_HEADERS ${LIBWEB_ALL_GENERATED_HEADERS} PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

FILE: Meta/CMake/licenses.cmake
include_guard()

set(licenses_text_file "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/LICENSES.txt")

set(licenses_generator "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/generate-licenses.py")
set(licenses_arguments
    --output "${licenses_text_file}"
    --source-dir "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}"
    --cargo "${RUST_CARGO}"
    --rust-target "${RUST_TARGET_TRIPLE}"
)
set(licenses_dependencies
    "${licenses_generator}"
    "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/LICENSE"
    "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Cargo.lock"
    "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/CMake/lgpl-libraries.txt"
)

if (NOT "${VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR}" STREQUAL "" AND NOT "${VCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET}" STREQUAL "")
    list(APPEND licenses_arguments
        --vcpkg-installed-dir "${VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR}"
        --vcpkg-triplet "${VCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET}"
    )
    list(APPEND licenses_dependencies "${VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR}/vcpkg/status")
endif()

if (NOT ENABLE_NETWORK_DOWNLOADS)
    list(APPEND licenses_arguments --offline)
endif()

# flatpak-builder builds the other modules of the Flatpak, and records their license files for the app.
set(building_flatpak OFF)
if (DEFINED ENV{FLATPAK_ID} AND DEFINED ENV{FLATPAK_DEST})
    set(building_flatpak ON)
    set(flatpak_manifest "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/CMake/flatpak/org.ladybird.Ladybird.json")
    list(APPEND licenses_arguments
        --flatpak-manifest "${flatpak_manifest}"
        --flatpak-licenses-dir "$ENV{FLATPAK_DEST}/share/licenses/$ENV{FLATPAK_ID}"
    )
    list(APPEND licenses_dependencies "${flatpak_manifest}")
endif()

# Build Release publishes the source archives of the LGPL libraries of a distribution build and of the Flatpak, so
# LICENSES.txt points to them.
if ((LADYBIRD_VCPKG_TYPE STREQUAL "distribution" OR building_flatpak) AND NOT LADYBIRD_VERSION STREQUAL "")
    list(APPEND licenses_arguments --release)
endif()

add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT "${licenses_text_file}"
    COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} "${licenses_generator}" ${licenses_arguments}
    DEPENDS ${licenses_dependencies}
    COMMENT "Collecting the licenses of third-party software"
    JOB_POOL cargo
    VERBATIM
)

# about:licenses decompresses the file itself, and falls back to the uncompressed one.
set(brotli_hints "")
if (NOT "${VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR}" STREQUAL "" AND NOT "${VCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET}" STREQUAL "")
    list(APPEND brotli_hints "${VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR}/${VCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET}/tools/brotli")
endif()
find_program(BROTLI_EXECUTABLE brotli HINTS ${brotli_hints})

if (BROTLI_EXECUTABLE)
    set(LADYBIRD_LICENSES_FILE "${licenses_text_file}.br")
    add_custom_command(
        OUTPUT "${LADYBIRD_LICENSES_FILE}"
        COMMAND "${BROTLI_EXECUTABLE}" --best --force "--output=${LADYBIRD_LICENSES_FILE}" "${licenses_text_file}"
        DEPENDS "${licenses_text_file}"
        COMMENT "Compressing the licenses of third-party software"
        VERBATIM
    )
else()
    message(STATUS "Found no brotli tool, so the licenses of third-party software are installed uncompressed")
    set(LADYBIRD_LICENSES_FILE "${licenses_text_file}")
endif()

add_custom_target(generate_licenses ALL DEPENDS "${LADYBIRD_LICENSES_FILE}")

# The source archives of the LGPL ports, which distribution builds ship as shared libraries, at the addresses that
# LICENSES.txt of a release names, for the Build Release workflow to hand to release-tools.
if (LADYBIRD_VCPKG_TYPE STREQUAL "distribution" AND NOT "${VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR}" STREQUAL "")
    add_custom_target(third_party_sources
        COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} "${licenses_generator}"
            --source-dir "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}"
            --vcpkg-installed-dir "${VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR}"
            --vcpkg-triplet "${VCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET}"
            --vcpkg-root "$ENV{VCPKG_ROOT}"
            --third-party-sources "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/third-party-sources.tar"
        COMMENT "Packaging the source code of the LGPL ports"
        VERBATIM
    )
endif()

# Pass the values below to CPack as they are, rather than unescaping them once more.
set(CPACK_VERBATIM_VARIABLES ON)
set(CPACK_GENERATOR "TGZ")

set(CPACK_THREADS 0)

    if("arm64" IN_LIST CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES AND "x86_64" IN_LIST CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES)
        set(CPACK_SYSTEM_NAME "macOS-universal2")
    else()
        set(CPACK_SYSTEM_NAME "macOS-${CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR}")
    endif()
else()
    set(CPACK_SYSTEM_NAME "${CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME}-${CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR}")
endif()

set(CPACK_ARCHIVE_JS_FILE_NAME "ladybird-js-${CPACK_SYSTEM_NAME}")
set(CPACK_ARCHIVE_WASM_FILE_NAME "ladybird-wasm-${CPACK_SYSTEM_NAME}")

set(CPACK_PACKAGE_FILE_NAME "ladybird-${ladybird_package_name}")

    "Ladybird is a truly independent web browser, using a novel engine based on web standards.")

set(CPACK_LADYBIRD_PACKAGE_INSTALL_PREFIX "${LADYBIRD_PACKAGE_INSTALL_PREFIX}")
set(CPACK_LADYBIRD_RESOURCE_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/Lagom")

# The Linux packages are the browser itself and its debug symbols, named like the debug packages of Debian and Fedora.
set(CPACK_DEB_COMPONENT_INSTALL ON)
set(CPACK_DEBIAN_FILE_NAME DEB-DEFAULT)
set(CPACK_DEBIAN_COMPRESSION_TYPE xz)
set(CPACK_DEBIAN_COMPRESSION_LEVEL 9)
set(CPACK_DEBIAN_PACKAGE_SECTION web)
set(CPACK_DEBIAN_BROWSER_PACKAGE_NAME ladybird)
set(CPACK_DEBIAN_BROWSER_DESCRIPTION "${CPACK_PACKAGE_DESCRIPTION}")
set(CPACK_DEBIAN_BROWSER_PACKAGE_SHLIBDEPS ON)
set(CPACK_DEBIAN_BROWSER_PACKAGE_DEPENDS fonts-liberation2)
set(CPACK_DEBIAN_BROWSER_PACKAGE_RECOMMENDS "libavcodec63 | libavcodec62 | libavcodec61 | libavcodec60")
set(CPACK_DEBIAN_DEBUGSYMBOLS_PACKAGE_NAME ladybird-dbgsym)
set(CPACK_DEBIAN_DEBUGSYMBOLS_PACKAGE_SECTION debug)
set(CPACK_DEBIAN_DEBUGSYMBOLS_DESCRIPTION "Debug symbols for Ladybird, which debuggers find by build ID.")

set(CPACK_RPM_PACKAGE_LICENSE "BSD-2-Clause")

set(CPACK_RPM_BROWSER_PACKAGE_NAME ladybird)

set(CPACK_RPM_DEBUGSYMBOLS_PACKAGE_AUTOREQPROV OFF)

set(CPACK_RPM_DEBUGSYMBOLS_PACKAGE_DESCRIPTION "Debug symbols for Ladybird, which debuggers find by build ID.")

# The binaries are stripped and their debug symbols laid out by CPack already, so keep rpmbuild from doing it again.
# rpmbuild compresses on a single thread by default, which takes many minutes for packages of our size.
set(CPACK_RPM_SPEC_INSTALL_POST "/bin/true")
set(CPACK_RPM_SPEC_MORE_DEFINE "%define _build_id_links none\n%define _binary_payload w9T0.xzdio")

# The package carries the shared libraries from vcpkg for itself alone, so it must not offer them to the system, nor
# ask the system for them.
include(install_vcpkg_libraries)
if (LINUX AND LADYBIRD_INSTALLS_VCPKG_LIBRARIES)
    ladybird_vcpkg_library_directory(vcpkg_library_dir)
    file(GLOB vcpkg_shared_library_links RELATIVE "${vcpkg_library_dir}" "${vcpkg_library_dir}/*.so")
    list(TRANSFORM vcpkg_shared_library_links REPLACE "\\.so$" "")
    list(TRANSFORM vcpkg_shared_library_links REPLACE "([][+.*()^$?|\\\\])" "\\\\\\\\\\1")
    list(JOIN vcpkg_shared_library_links "|" vcpkg_shared_library_names)
    if (vcpkg_shared_library_names)
        string(APPEND CPACK_RPM_SPEC_MORE_DEFINE "\n%global __provides_exclude ^(${vcpkg_shared_library_names})\\\\.so")
        string(APPEND CPACK_RPM_SPEC_MORE_DEFINE "\n%global __requires_exclude ^(${vcpkg_shared_library_names})\\\\.so")
    endif()
endif()
set(CPACK_RPM_EXCLUDE_FROM_AUTO_FILELIST_ADDITION /opt /usr/lib/debug /usr/lib/debug/.build-id /usr/share/applications
    /usr/share/dbus-1 /usr/share/dbus-1/services /usr/share/icons /usr/share/icons/hicolor
    /usr/share/icons/hicolor/scalable /usr/share/icons/hicolor/scalable/apps /usr/share/metainfo)
