                f"{what} has the union type {union_type}, and the Rust bindings do not convert a JS value to a "
                f"union with the member {member_type} yet"
            )
    return members


def rust_numeric_literal(literal: Optional[str], idl_type_name: str) -> Optional[str]:
    """The Rust literal of a number of the IDL, if it is a value of the numeric type."""
    if idl_type_name in FLOATING_POINT_TYPES and literal is not None and DECIMAL_LITERAL.fullmatch(literal):
        return f"{literal}_{FLOATING_POINT_TYPES[idl_type_name]}"
    if idl_type_name in INTEGER_TYPES:
        return rust_integer_literal(literal, idl_type_name)
    return None


def rust_string_literal(default_value: Optional[str], idl_type_name: str, what: str) -> Optional[str]:
    """The Rust expression of a string of the IDL, if the default value is one, as a value of the string type."""
    if idl_type_name not in STRING_TYPES or idl_type_name == "ByteString":
        return None
    if default_value is None or not default_value.startswith('"'):
        return None
    string = default_value[1:-1]
    if not string.isascii() or "\\" in string:
        raise UnsupportedByRustBindings(f"{what} has the default value {default_value}")
    if idl_type_name == "USVString":
        return f'UsvString::from_ascii(b"{string}")'
    return f'Utf16String::from_ascii(b"{string}")'


def rust_default_value(
    member: Union[OperationParameter, DictionaryMember], context: GenerationContext, what: str
) -> str:
    """An expression of the default value of the parameter or of the dictionary member."""
    name = member.type.name
    default_value = member.default_value
    if member.type.nullable and default_value == "null":
        return "None"

    # NB: A nullable type with another default value has that value, not null.
    def value(literal: str) -> str:
        return f"Some({literal})" if member.type.nullable else literal

    string_literal = rust_string_literal(default_value, name, what)
    if string_literal is not None:
        return value(string_literal)
    if name == "boolean" and default_value in ("true", "false"):
        return value(default_value)
    numeric_literal = rust_numeric_literal(default_value, name)
    if numeric_literal is not None:
        return value(numeric_literal)
    if member.type.nullable and default_value == "null":
        return "None"
    if name == "any" and default_value in ("null", "undefined"):
        return "Value::NULL" if default_value == "null" else "Value::UNDEFINED"
    if isinstance(member.type, IDLParameterizedType) and name == "sequence" and default_value == "[]":
        if is_sequence_of_cells(member.type, context):
            return "MarkedVec::new(vm)"
        return "Vec::new()"
    dictionary = resolved_dictionary(member.type, context)
    if dictionary is not None and default_value == "{}":
        # NB: The C++ bindings do not run the conversion for a missing argument either, so the members of the default
        #     value are not read from a JS object.
        if dictionary_holds_sequence_of_cells(dictionary, context):
            return f"<{rust_dictionary_path(dictionary, context)}>::empty(vm)"
        return f"<{rust_dictionary_path(dictionary, context)}>::empty()"
    enumeration = context.enumeration(member.type)
    if enumeration is not None and default_value is not None and default_value[1:-1] in enumeration.values:
        variant = rust_enumeration_variant(default_value[1:-1], enumeration)
        return f"{rust_enumeration_path(enumeration, context)}::{variant}"
    if isinstance(member.type, IDLUnionType) and is_named_union(member.type, context):
        union_members = union_members_by_kind(member.type, context, what)
        union_path = rust_union_path(member.type, context, what)
        dictionary_type = union_members.dictionary_type
        if dictionary_type is not None and default_value == "{}":
            dictionary = context.dictionaries[dictionary_type.name]
            return (
                f"{union_path}::{rust_union_variant(dictionary_type)}"
                f"(<{rust_dictionary_path(dictionary, context)}>::empty())"
            )
        string_type = union_members.string_type
        string_literal = None if string_type is None else rust_string_literal(default_value, string_type.name, what)
        if string_type is not None and string_literal is not None:
            return f"{union_path}::{rust_union_variant(string_type)}({string_literal})"
        for enumeration_type in union_members.enumeration_types:
            enumeration = context.enumeration(enumeration_type)
            assert enumeration is not None
            if default_value is not None and default_value[1:-1] in enumeration.values:
                variant = rust_enumeration_variant(default_value[1:-1], enumeration)
                return (
                    f"{union_path}::{rust_union_variant(enumeration_type)}"
                    f"({rust_enumeration_path(enumeration, context)}::{variant})"
                )
        # NB: A number is a value of the numeric member that the conversion to the union takes, as the C++ bindings
        #     take the default value of such a union to be.
        numeric_type = union_members.numeric_type
        numeric_literal = None if numeric_type is None else rust_numeric_literal(default_value, numeric_type.name)
        if numeric_type is not None and numeric_literal is not None:
            return f"{union_path}::{rust_union_variant(numeric_type)}({numeric_literal})"
    raise UnsupportedByRustBindings(
        f"{what} has the default value {default_value}, which the Rust bindings do not have"
    )


def dictionary_can_be_empty(context: GenerationContext, dictionary: Dictionary) -> bool:
    """Whether the dictionary has a value without members: none of its members or of those of the dictionaries it
    inherits from is required."""
    return not any(
        member.required
        for inherited_dictionary in context.dictionary_inheritance_stack(dictionary)
        for member in inherited_dictionary.members
    )


def write_dictionary_from_js(out: TextIO, context: GenerationContext, dictionary: Dictionary) -> None:
    """The conversion of a JS value to the dictionary's struct, which reads the members in the order of the C++
    bindings, the lexicographical one that the parser puts them in. The struct is built by naming every field, so that
    one that does not match the members of the dictionary does not compile."""
    path = rust_dictionary_path(dictionary, context)
    holds_sequence_of_cells = dictionary_holds_sequence_of_cells(dictionary, context)
    ancestors = context.dictionary_inheritance_stack(dictionary)[1:]
    if any(dictionary_holds_sequence_of_cells(ancestor, context) for ancestor in ancestors):
        # NB: The struct of such a dictionary has the lifetime of the reference to the VM, which the struct of a
        #     dictionary that inherits from it would have to pass on.
        raise UnsupportedByRustBindings(
            f"the dictionary {dictionary.name} inherits from a dictionary that holds a sequence of values that are or "
            "can hold cells, which the Rust bindings do not convert to yet"
        )
    keys = []
    conversions = []
    empty_fields = []
    parent_field = []
    parent_conversion = ""
    if dictionary.parent_name:
        # NB: The struct of a dictionary that inherits from another holds that dictionary's struct in the field
        #     `parent`, whose members are converted first, step 4 of https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#js-dictionary
        parent_path = rust_dictionary_path(context.dictionaries[dictionary.parent_name], context)
        parent_field = ["parent"]
        parent_conversion = f"            let parent = <{parent_path}>::from_js(vm, value)?;\n"
        empty_fields.append(f"parent: <{parent_path} as EmptyDictionary>::empty()")
    for member in dictionary.members:
        what = f"{dictionary.name}.{member.name}"
        local = rust_local_name(member.name)
        key = f"{rust_identifier(member.name).removeprefix('r#').rstrip('_').upper()}_KEY"
        keys.append(
            f'            static {key}: LazyLock<PropertyKey> = LazyLock::new(|| PropertyKey::from_utf8("{member.name}"));\n'
        )
        conversion = rust_to_idl_value(
            member.type,
            member.extended_attributes,
            "member",
            member.name,
            context,
            what,
            keeps_cells_alive=holds_sequence_of_cells,
        )
        if member.required:
            missing = f"""return vm.throw_completion(
                    ErrorKind::TypeError,
                    ErrorType::MissingRequiredProperty,
                    &[&"{member.name}"],
                )"""
            present = f"{conversion}?"
        elif member.default_value is not None:
            missing = rust_default_value(member, context, what)
            present = f"{conversion}?"
            empty_fields.append(f"{rust_identifier(member.name)}: {missing}")
        else:
            missing = "None"
            present = f"Some({conversion}?)"
            empty_fields.append(f"{rust_identifier(member.name)}: None")
        conversions.append(
            f"""            let {local} = match dictionary_member(vm, object, &{key})? {{
                Some(member) => {present},
                None => {missing},
            }};
"""
        )
    fields = ", ".join(
        parent_field
        + [f"{rust_identifier(member.name)}: {rust_local_name(member.name)}" for member in dictionary.members]
    )
    if holds_sequence_of_cells:
        # NB: The struct keeps the sequences of its members alive in MarkedVecs for as long as the reference to the VM
        #     lives, a lifetime that the result of FromJs::from_js() cannot have, so the conversions are its methods.
        empty = ""
        if dictionary_can_be_empty(context, dictionary):
            vm = "vm" if any("vm" in field for field in empty_fields) else "_vm"
            empty = f"""
        pub(crate) fn empty({vm}: &'vm Vm) -> Self {{
            Self {{ {", ".join(empty_fields)} }}
        }}
"""
        out.write(
            f"""
    /// The conversion of a JS value to the dictionary {dictionary.name}, https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#js-dictionary
    /// whose struct keeps the sequences of its members alive for as long as the reference to the VM lives.
    impl<'vm> {path}<'vm> {{
        pub(crate) fn from_js(vm: &'vm Vm, value: Value) -> ThrowCompletionOr<Self> {{
{"".join(keys)}            let object = dictionary_object(vm, value, "{dictionary.name}")?;
{parent_conversion}{"".join(conversions)}            Ok(Self {{ {fields} }})
        }}
{empty}    }}
"""
        )
        return
    out.write(
        f"""
    /// The conversion of a JS value to the dictionary {dictionary.name}, https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#js-dictionary
    impl FromJs for {path} {{
        fn from_js(vm: &Vm, value: Value) -> ThrowCompletionOr<Self> {{
{"".join(keys)}            let object = dictionary_object(vm, value, "{dictionary.name}")?;
{parent_conversion}{"".join(conversions)}            Ok(Self {{ {fields} }})
        }}
    }}
"""
    )
    if dictionary_can_be_empty(context, dictionary):
        out.write(
            f"""
    impl EmptyDictionary for {path} {{
        fn empty() -> Self {{
            Self {{ {", ".join(empty_fields)} }}
        }}
    }}
"""
        )


def write_enumeration_from_js(out: TextIO, context: GenerationContext, enumeration: Enumeration) -> None:
    """The conversion of a JS value to the enum of an enumeration, which the module of its IDL file defines with a
    variant for each value, named as the C++ bindings name theirs."""
    values = ", ".join(f'"{value}"' for value in enumeration.values)
    arms = "".join(
        f"                {index} => Self::{rust_enumeration_variant(value, enumeration)},\n"
        for index, value in enumerate(enumeration.values)
    )
    out.write(
        f"""
    /// The conversion of a JS value to the enumeration {enumeration.name},
    /// https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#js-enumeration
    impl FromJs for {rust_enumeration_path(enumeration, context)} {{
        fn from_js(vm: &Vm, value: Value) -> ThrowCompletionOr<Self> {{
            Ok(match to_enumeration_value(vm, value, "{enumeration.name}", &[{values}])? {{
{arms}                _ => unreachable!("the value is one of the values of the enumeration"),
            }})
        }}
    }}
"""
    )


def write_any_interface_from_js(out: TextIO, interface: Interface, context: GenerationContext) -> None:
    """The conversion of a JS value to the enum of an object of an interface that others inherit from,
    rust_any_interface_path(), whose variant is the interface of the object."""
    interface_path = rust_interface_path(interface)
    arms = "".join(
        f"""                if let Some(object) = implementation_if::<{rust_interface_path(implementing)}>(value.as_object()) {{
                    return Ok(Self::{implementing.name}(object));
                }}
"""
        for implementing in [interface] + inheriting_interfaces(interface, context)
    )
    out.write(
        f"""
    /// The conversion of a JS value to an object of the interface {interface.name} or of one that inherits from it,
    /// https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#js-interface
    impl FromJs for {rust_any_interface_path(interface)} {{
        fn from_js(vm: &Vm, value: Value) -> ThrowCompletionOr<Self> {{
            // 1. If V implements I, then return the IDL interface type value that represents a reference to that
            //    platform object.
            if value.is_object() && is_host_instance_of(&value.as_object(), <{interface_path} as Interface>::wrapper_class()) {{
{arms}                unreachable!("a wrapper of the interface wraps an object of it or of an interface that inherits from it");
            }}
            // 2. Throw a TypeError.
            vm.throw_completion(ErrorKind::TypeError, ErrorType::NotAnObjectOfType, &[&"{interface.name}"])
        }}
    }}
"""
    )


def write_union_from_js(out: TextIO, context: GenerationContext, union_type: IDLUnionType) -> None:
    """The conversion of a JS value to the enum of a union, with the steps of https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#js-union
    that apply to its members, in the order of the C++ bindings."""
    what = f"the union {union_type}"
    path = rust_union_path(union_type, context, what)
    members = union_members_by_kind(union_type, context, what)
    holds_sequence_of_cells = union_holds_sequence_of_cells(union_type, context)
    dictionary_type = members.dictionary_type
    string_type = members.string_type
    array_buffer_type = members.array_buffer_type
    shared_array_buffer_type = members.shared_array_buffer_type
    array_buffer_view_type = members.array_buffer_view_type
    steps = []
    dictionary_conversion = None
    if dictionary_type is not None:
        dictionary_path = rust_dictionary_path(context.dictionaries[dictionary_type.name], context)
        dictionary_conversion = (
            f"Ok(Self::{rust_union_variant(dictionary_type)}(<{dictionary_path}>::from_js(vm, value)?))"
        )
    if (
        members.typed_array_types
        or members.sequence_type is not None
        or members.record_type is not None
        or members.interface_types
        or members.buffer_source_type is not None
        or array_buffer_type is not None
        or shared_array_buffer_type is not None
        or array_buffer_view_type is not None
    ):
        if dictionary_conversion is not None:
            steps.append(
                f"""            // 4. If V is null or undefined, then:
            //     1. If types includes a dictionary type, then return the result of converting V to that
            //        dictionary type.
            if value.is_nullish() {{
                return {dictionary_conversion};
            }}
"""
            )
        steps.append("            if value.is_object() {\n")
        for interface_type in members.interface_types:
            steps.append(
                """                // 5. If V is a platform object, then:
                //     1. If types includes an interface type that V implements, then return the IDL value that is a
                //        reference to the object V.
"""
            )
            if is_window_proxy(interface_type):
                steps.append(
                    f"""                if let Some(window_proxy) = window_proxy_from_object(value.as_object()) {{
                    return Ok(Self::{rust_union_variant(interface_type)}(window_proxy));
                }}
"""
                )
                continue
            interface = context.interfaces[interface_type.name]
            if rust_interface(interface_type, context) is not None and inheriting_interfaces(interface, context):
                # NB: A wrapper of the interface wraps an object of the interface or of one that inherits from it,
                #     which the variant holds as such.
                interface_path = rust_interface_path(interface)
                any_interface_path = rust_any_interface_path(interface)
                steps.append(
                    f"""                if is_host_instance_of(&value.as_object(), <{interface_path} as Interface>::wrapper_class()) {{
"""
                )
                for implementing in [interface] + inheriting_interfaces(interface, context):
                    steps.append(
                        f"""                    if let Some(object) = implementation_if::<{rust_interface_path(implementing)}>(value.as_object()) {{
                        return Ok(Self::{rust_union_variant(interface_type)}({any_interface_path}::{implementing.name}(object)));
                    }}
"""
                    )
                steps.append(
                    """                    unreachable!("a wrapper of the interface wraps an object of it or of an interface that inherits from it");
                }
"""
                )
                continue
            if rust_interface(interface_type, context) is not None:
                interface_path = rust_interface_path(interface)
                steps.append(
                    f"""                if is_host_instance_of(&value.as_object(), <{interface_path} as Interface>::wrapper_class()) {{
                    return Ok(Self::{rust_union_variant(interface_type)}(implementation_of::<{interface_path}>(value.as_object())));
                }}
"""
                )
                continue
            steps.append(
                f"""                if implements_cpp_interface(value.as_object(), {cpp_interface_name_constant(interface)}) {{
                    // SAFETY: The object is a wrapper of an object that implements the interface.
                    let object = unsafe {{ CppInterface::from_wrapper(value.as_object()) }};
                    return Ok(Self::{rust_union_variant(interface_type)}(object));
                }}
"""
            )
        if members.buffer_source_type is not None:
            rules = buffer_source_rules(members.buffer_source_type, {})
            steps.append(
                f"""                // 6. If V is an Object, V has an [[ArrayBufferData]] internal slot, and IsSharedArrayBuffer(V) is
                //    false, then:
                //     1. If types includes ArrayBuffer, then return the result of converting V to ArrayBuffer.
                // 8. If V is an Object and V has a [[DataView]] internal slot, then:
                //     1. If types includes DataView, then return the result of converting V to DataView.
                // 9. If V is an Object and V has a [[TypedArrayName]] internal slot, then:
                //     1. If types includes a typed array type whose name is the value of V's [[TypedArrayName]]
                //        internal slot, then return the result of converting V to that type.
                if let Some(buffer_source) = buffer_source_if(vm, value.as_object(), BufferSourceTypes {{
                    array_buffer_type: Some({rules}),
                    shared_array_buffer_type: None,
                    array_buffer_view_type: Some({rules}),
                }})? {{
                    return Ok(Self::BufferSource(buffer_source));
                }}
"""
            )
        if array_buffer_type is not None or shared_array_buffer_type is not None or array_buffer_view_type is not None:
            if array_buffer_type is not None and "AllowShared" in array_buffer_type.extended_attributes:
                raise UnsupportedByRustBindings(
                    f"{what} has [AllowShared] ArrayBuffer, which Rust does not convert yet"
                )
            steps.append(
                f"""                // 6. If V is an Object, V has an [[ArrayBufferData]] internal slot, and IsSharedArrayBuffer(V) is
                //    false, then:
                //     1. If types includes ArrayBuffer, then return the result of converting V to ArrayBuffer.
                // 7. If V is an Object, V, has an [[ArrayBufferData]] internal slot, and IsSharedArrayBuffer(V) is
                //    true, then:
                //     1. If types includes SharedArrayBuffer, then return the result of converting V to
                //        SharedArrayBuffer.
                // 8. If V is an Object and V has a [[DataView]] internal slot, then:
                //     1. If types includes DataView, then return the result of converting V to DataView.
                // 9. If V is an Object and V has a [[TypedArrayName]] internal slot, then:
                //     1. If types includes a typed array type whose name is the value of V's [[TypedArrayName]]
                //        internal slot, then return the result of converting V to that type.
                if let Some(buffer_source) = buffer_source_if(vm, value.as_object(), BufferSourceTypes {{
                    array_buffer_type: {optional_buffer_source_rules(array_buffer_type)},
                    shared_array_buffer_type: {optional_buffer_source_rules(shared_array_buffer_type)},
                    array_buffer_view_type: {optional_buffer_source_rules(array_buffer_view_type)},
                }})? {{
                    // NB: The match wraps the converted value in the union's Rust enum.
                    return Ok(match buffer_source {{
"""
            )
            if array_buffer_type is not None:
                guard = " if !buffer.is_shared_array_buffer()" if shared_array_buffer_type is not None else ""
                buffer = "Some(buffer)" if array_buffer_type.nullable else "buffer"
                variant = rust_union_variant(array_buffer_type)
                steps.append(
                    f"                        BufferSource::ArrayBuffer(buffer){guard} => Self::{variant}({buffer}),\n"
                )
            if shared_array_buffer_type is not None:
                buffer = "Some(buffer)" if shared_array_buffer_type.nullable else "buffer"
                variant = rust_union_variant(shared_array_buffer_type)
                steps.append(
                    f"                        BufferSource::ArrayBuffer(buffer) => Self::{variant}({buffer}),\n"
                )
            if array_buffer_view_type is not None:
                data_view = "ArrayBufferView::DataView(view)"
                typed_array = "ArrayBufferView::TypedArray(view)"
                if array_buffer_view_type.nullable:
                    data_view = f"Some({data_view})"
                    typed_array = f"Some({typed_array})"
                steps.append(
                    f"""                        BufferSource::DataView(view) => Self::ArrayBufferView({data_view}),
                        BufferSource::TypedArray(view) => Self::ArrayBufferView({typed_array}),
"""
                )
            if array_buffer_view_type is None or (array_buffer_type is None and shared_array_buffer_type is None):
                steps.append(
                    '                        _ => unreachable!("buffer_source_if only returns included buffer types"),\n'
                )
            steps.append("                    });\n                }\n")
        for typed_array_type in members.typed_array_types:
            name = typed_array_type.name
            conversion = rust_to_idl_value(typed_array_type, {}, "value", "value", context, what)
            steps.append(
                f"""                // 9. If V is an Object and V has a [[TypedArrayName]] internal slot, then:
                //     1. If types includes a typed array type whose name is the value of V's [[TypedArrayName]]
                //        internal slot, then return the result of converting V to that type.
                let typed_array = value.as_object().downcast::<TypedArrayBase>();
                if typed_array.is_some_and(|typed_array| typed_array.kind() == TypedArrayKind::{name}) {{
                    return Ok(Self::{rust_union_variant(typed_array_type)}({conversion}?));
                }}
"""
            )
        if members.sequence_type is not None and holds_sequence_of_cells:
            element = rust_to_idl_value(members.sequence_type.parameters[0], {}, "value", "value", context, what)
            steps.append(
                f"""                // 11. If V is an Object, then:
                //     2. If types includes a sequence type, then:
                //         1. Let method be ? GetMethod(V, %Symbol.iterator%).
                //         2. If method is not undefined, return the result of creating a sequence of that type from
                //            V and method.
                if let Some(method) = iterator_method(vm, value)? {{
                    return Ok(Self::Sequence(sequence_from_iterable(vm, value, method, MarkedVec::new(vm), |value| {element})?));
                }}
"""
            )
        elif members.sequence_type is not None:
            element = rust_sequence_element_to_idl_value(members.sequence_type, "value", context, what)
            steps.append(
                f"""                // 11. If V is an Object, then:
                //     2. If types includes a sequence type, then:
                //         1. Let method be ? GetMethod(V, %Symbol.iterator%).
                //         2. If method is not undefined, return the result of creating a sequence of that type from
                //            V and method.
                if let Some(method) = iterator_method(vm, value)? {{
                    return Ok(Self::Sequence(sequence_from_iterable(vm, value, method, Vec::new(), |value| {element})?));
                }}
"""
            )
        if dictionary_conversion is not None:
            steps.append(
                f"""                //     4. If types includes a dictionary type, then return the result of converting V to that
                //        dictionary type.
                return {dictionary_conversion};
"""
            )
        elif members.record_type is not None:
            conversion = rust_record_to_idl_value(members.record_type, "value", "value", context, what)
            steps.append(
                f"""                //     5. If types includes a record type, then return the result of converting V to that record
                //        type.
                return Ok(Self::{rust_union_variant(members.record_type)}({conversion}?));
"""
            )
        steps.append("            }\n")
    elif dictionary_conversion is not None:
        steps.append(
            f"""            // 4. If V is null or undefined, then:
            //     1. If types includes a dictionary type, then return the result of converting V to that
            //        dictionary type.
            // 11. If V is an Object, then:
            //     4. If types includes a dictionary type, then return the result of converting V to that
            //        dictionary type.
            if value.is_nullish() || value.is_object() {{
                return {dictionary_conversion};
            }}
"""
        )
    if members.object_type is not None:
        steps.append(
            """            // 11. If V is an Object, then:
            //     7. If types includes object, then return the IDL value that is a reference to the object V.
            if value.is_object() {
                return Ok(Self::Object(value.as_object()));
            }
"""
        )
    numeric_type = members.numeric_type
    numeric_conversion = None
    if numeric_type is not None:
        if members.names_numeric_argument:
            numeric_conversion = f"to_{numeric_type.name}(vm, value, identifier)"
        else:
            numeric_conversion = rust_to_idl_value(numeric_type, {}, "value", "value", context, what)
        steps.append(
            f"""            // 13. If V is a Number, then:
            //     1. If types includes a numeric type, then return the result of converting V to that numeric type.
            if value.is_number() {{
                return Ok(Self::{rust_union_variant(numeric_type)}({numeric_conversion}?));
            }}
"""
        )
    if members.enumeration_types:
        steps.append(
            "            if value.is_string() {\n                let enumeration_string = to_dom_string(vm, value)?;\n"
        )
        for enumeration_type in members.enumeration_types:
            enumeration = context.enumeration(enumeration_type)
            assert enumeration is not None
            path_to_enumeration = rust_enumeration_path(enumeration, context)
            for enumeration_value in enumeration.values:
                variant = rust_enumeration_variant(enumeration_value, enumeration)
                steps.append(
                    f'''                if enumeration_string == Utf16String::from_ascii(b"{enumeration_value}") {{
                    return Ok(Self::{rust_union_variant(enumeration_type)}({path_to_enumeration}::{variant}));
                }}
'''
                )
        steps.append("            }\n")
    if string_type is not None:
        conversion = rust_to_idl_value(string_type, {}, "value", "value", context, what)
        steps.append(
            f"""            // 15. If types includes a string type, then return the result of converting V to that type.
            Ok(Self::{rust_union_variant(string_type)}({conversion}?))
"""
        )
    elif numeric_type is not None:
        steps.append(
            f"""            // 17. If types includes a numeric type, then return the result of converting V to that numeric type.
            Ok(Self::{rust_union_variant(numeric_type)}({numeric_conversion}?))
"""
        )
    else:
        steps.append(
            """            // 20. Throw a TypeError.
            throw_no_union_types_matched(vm)
"""
        )
    implementation = f"impl FromJs for {path}"
    conversion = "fn from_js(vm: &Vm, value: Value)"
    if members.names_numeric_argument:
        implementation = f"impl {path}"
        conversion = "pub(crate) fn from_js_with_identifier(vm: &Vm, value: Value, identifier: &str)"
    if holds_sequence_of_cells:
        # NB: The enum keeps the sequence alive in a MarkedVec for as long as the reference to the VM lives, a lifetime
        #     that the result of FromJs::from_js() cannot have, so the conversion is its method.
        implementation = f"impl<'vm> {path}<'vm>"
        conversion = "pub(crate) fn from_js(vm: &'vm Vm, value: Value)"
        if members.names_numeric_argument:
            conversion = "pub(crate) fn from_js_with_identifier(vm: &'vm Vm, value: Value, identifier: &str)"
    out.write(
        f"""
    /// The conversion of a JS value to the union {union_type}, https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#js-union
    {implementation} {{
        {conversion} -> ThrowCompletionOr<Self> {{
{"".join(steps)}        }}
    }}
"""
    )

FILE: Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/rust_to_js_value.py
# Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
#
# SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause

# The Rust expressions that convert IDL values to JS values, https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#js-type-mapping, for the
# Rust bindings of the interfaces implemented in Rust, as to_js_value.py writes the C++ ones. The bindings runtime
# implements ToJs for the types whose conversion does not depend on the IDL type, and this module writes the
# implementations for the definitions of the IDL.

from typing import TextIO

from Generators.libweb_bindings.context import GenerationContext
from Generators.libweb_bindings.rust_names import rust_identifier
from Generators.libweb_bindings.rust_names import rust_local_name
from Generators.libweb_bindings.rust_types import UnsupportedByRustBindings
from Generators.libweb_bindings.rust_types import dictionary_holds_sequence_of_cells
from Generators.libweb_bindings.rust_types import holds_cells
from Generators.libweb_bindings.rust_types import is_sequence_of_cells
from Generators.libweb_bindings.rust_types import is_window_proxy
from Generators.libweb_bindings.rust_types import member_other_than_undefined
from Generators.libweb_bindings.rust_types import rust_dictionary_path
from Generators.libweb_bindings.rust_types import rust_enumeration_path
from Generators.libweb_bindings.rust_types import rust_enumeration_variant
from Generators.libweb_bindings.rust_types import rust_type
from Generators.libweb_bindings.rust_types import rust_union_path
from Generators.libweb_bindings.rust_types import rust_union_variant
from Utils.webidl_parser import Dictionary
from Utils.webidl_parser import Enumeration
from Utils.webidl_parser import IDLParameterizedType
from Utils.webidl_parser import IDLType
from Utils.webidl_parser import IDLUnionType


def rust_to_js_value(
    idl_type: IDLType, expression: str, call_context: str, context: GenerationContext, what: str
) -> str:
    """An expression of type ThrowCompletionOr<Value> that converts the IDL value to a JS value. The call context is an
    expression of type &CallContext. Nullable types and unions with undefined both have an Option as their Rust type,
    so the conversion follows from the IDL type and not from the Rust one."""
    rust_type(idl_type, context, what, is_result=True)

    def inner(inner_type: IDLType) -> str:
        return rust_to_js_value(inner_type, "value", call_context, context, what)

    # https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#js-nullable-type
    if idl_type.nullable:
        return f"""match {expression} {{
            Some(value) => {inner(idl_type.without_nullable())},
            None => Ok(Value::NULL),
        }}"""
    optional_member = member_other_than_undefined(idl_type)
    if optional_member is not None:
        return f"""match {expression} {{
            Some(value) => {inner(optional_member)},
            None => Ok(Value::UNDEFINED),
        }}"""
    if isinstance(idl_type, IDLParameterizedType) and idl_type.name in ("sequence", "FrozenArray"):
        element_type = idl_type.parameters[0]
        # NB: The conversion of an element can allocate, as that of an object of an interface does for its wrapper,
        #     and the elements after it must live through that, in the MarkedVec that holds them (see rust_type()).
        if holds_cells(element_type, context):
            dictionary = context.dictionaries.get(element_type.without_nullable().name)
            if dictionary is not None and dictionary_holds_sequence_of_cells(dictionary, context):
                conversion = rust_to_js_value(element_type, "value", call_context, context, what)
            else:
                conversion = rust_to_js_value(element_type, "ToOwned::to_owned(value)", call_context, context, what)
            array = f"rooted_sequence_to_js({call_context}, {expression}, |value| {conversion})"
        else:
            array = f"sequence_to_js({call_context}, {expression}, |value| {inner(element_type)})"
        if idl_type.name == "FrozenArray":
            return f"frozen_array_to_js({call_context}, {array})"
        return array
    if isinstance(idl_type, IDLParameterizedType) and idl_type.name == "record":
        value_type = idl_type.parameters[1]
        if holds_cells(value_type, context):
            # NB: The entries are in a Vec, which hides the values from the collector while those before them are
            #     converted.
            raise UnsupportedByRustBindings(
                f"{what} has the type {idl_type}, a record of values that are or can hold cells, which the Rust "
                "bindings do not convert yet"
            )
        return f"record_to_js({call_context}, {expression}, |value| {inner(value_type)})"
    if is_window_proxy(idl_type):
        return f"Ok(window_proxy_to_js({call_context}, {expression}))"
    return f"{expression}.to_js({call_context})"


def write_enumeration_to_js(out: TextIO, context: GenerationContext, enumeration: Enumeration) -> None:
    """The conversion of the enum of an enumeration, which matches every variant, so that an enum that does not match
    the values of the enumeration does not compile."""
    arms = "".join(
        f'                Self::{rust_enumeration_variant(value, enumeration)} => "{value}",\n'
        for value in enumeration.values
    )
    out.write(
        f"""
    /// The conversion of the enumeration {enumeration.name}, https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#js-enumeration
    impl ToJs for {rust_enumeration_path(enumeration, context)} {{
        fn to_js(self, cx: &CallContext) -> ThrowCompletionOr<Value> {{
            let enumeration_value = match self {{
{arms}            }};
            Ok(enumeration_value_to_js(cx, enumeration_value))
        }}
    }}
"""
    )


def write_union_to_js(out: TextIO, context: GenerationContext, union_type: IDLUnionType) -> None:
    """The conversion of the enum of a union, which the module of its typedef defines with a variant for each member,
    named as the type of the member and holding its IDL value."""
    what = f"the union {union_type}"
    path = rust_union_path(union_type, context, what)
    arms = "".join(
        f"""                Self::{rust_union_variant(member_type)}(value) => {rust_to_js_value(member_type, "value", "cx", context, what)},
"""
        for member_type in union_type.flattened_member_types()
    )
    out.write(
        f"""
    /// The conversion of the union {union_type}, https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#js-union
    impl ToJs for {path} {{
        fn to_js(self, cx: &CallContext) -> ThrowCompletionOr<Value> {{
            match self {{
{arms}            }}
        }}
    }}
"""
    )


def has_sequence_of_cells(idl_type: IDLType, context: GenerationContext) -> bool:
    """Whether the IDL values of the type have a sequence of values that are or can hold cells, however deep in the
    type the sequence is."""
    return any(
        isinstance(nested_type, IDLParameterizedType)
        and nested_type.name == "sequence"
        and holds_cells(nested_type, context)
        for nested_type in idl_type.nested_types()
    )


def write_dictionary_to_js(out: TextIO, context: GenerationContext, dictionary: Dictionary) -> None:
    """The conversion of the dictionary's struct, which the implementation defines with a field per member: the type
    of a required member or of one with a default value, and an Option of it otherwise. The fields are bound to locals
    with names of their own, so that a member can have any name, and the keys of the members are interned once."""
    path = rust_dictionary_path(dictionary, context)
    fields = []
    keys = []
    conversions = []
    prepared_members = []
    borrows_dictionary = dictionary_holds_sequence_of_cells(dictionary, context)
    impl_type = f"&{path}" if borrows_dictionary else path
    # NB: The least-derived dictionary comes first, as in the C++ bindings.
    inheritance_chain = list(reversed(context.dictionary_inheritance_stack(dictionary)))
    if any(dictionary_holds_sequence_of_cells(ancestor, context) for ancestor in inheritance_chain[:-1]):
        raise UnsupportedByRustBindings(
            f"the dictionary {dictionary.name} inherits from a dictionary that holds a sequence of values that are or "
            "can hold cells, which the Rust bindings do not convert to a JS value yet"
        )
    if len(inheritance_chain) > 1:
        fields.append(f"    //   parent: {rust_dictionary_path(inheritance_chain[-2], context)},\n")
    for member, is_own_member in [
        (member, item is dictionary) for item in inheritance_chain for member in item.members
    ]:
        what = f"{dictionary.name}.{member.name}"
        member_type = rust_type(member.type, context, what)
        field = rust_identifier(member.name)
        local = rust_local_name(member.name)
        if has_sequence_of_cells(member.type, context):
            if not is_sequence_of_cells(member.type, context):
                raise UnsupportedByRustBindings(
                    f"{what} has the type {member.type}, with a nested sequence of values that are or can hold cells, "
                    "which the Rust bindings do not convert from a member of a dictionary yet"
                )
            # Keep the original dictionary in its root while copying its sequence into a MarkedVec.
            if member.required or member.default_value is not None:
                prepared_members.append(
                    f"            let {local} = crate::bindings::conversions::mark_sequence(cx, {local}.as_slice());\n"
                )
            else:
                prepared_members.append(
                    f"            let {local} = {local}.as_deref().map(|value| crate::bindings::conversions::mark_sequence(cx, value));\n"
                )
        elif borrows_dictionary:
            prepared_members.append(f"            let {local} = ToOwned::to_owned({local});\n")
        key = f"{rust_identifier(member.name).removeprefix('r#').rstrip('_').upper()}_KEY"
        keys.append(
            f'            static {key}: LazyLock<PropertyKey> = LazyLock::new(|| PropertyKey::from_utf8("{member.name}"));\n'
        )
        always_present = member.required or member.default_value is not None
        field_type = member_type if always_present else f"Option<{member_type}>"
        if is_own_member:
            fields.append(f"    //   {field}: {field_type},\n")
        if always_present:
            conversion = rust_to_js_value(member.type, local, "cx", context, what)
            conversions.append(f"            set_dictionary_member(cx, object, &{key}, {conversion}?)?;\n")
        else:
            conversion = rust_to_js_value(member.type, "value", "cx", context, what)
            conversions.append(
                f"""            if let Some(value) = {local} {{
                set_dictionary_member(cx, object, &{key}, {conversion}?)?;
            }}
"""
            )

    pattern = None
    for item in inheritance_chain:
        bindings = [f"{rust_identifier(member.name)}: {rust_local_name(member.name)}" for member in item.members]
        if pattern is not None:
            bindings.insert(0, f"parent: {pattern}")
        pattern = f"{rust_dictionary_path(item, context)} {{ {', '.join(bindings)} }}"
    out.write(
        f"""
    /// The conversion of the dictionary {dictionary.name}, a struct with the fields:
{"".join(fields)}    impl ToJs for {impl_type} {{
        fn to_js(self, cx: &CallContext) -> ThrowCompletionOr<Value> {{
{"".join(keys)}            let {pattern} = self;
{"".join(prepared_members)}            let object = create_dictionary_object(cx);
{"".join(conversions)}            Ok(Value::from_object(object))
        }}
    }}
"""
    )

FILE: Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/rust_types.py
# Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
#
# SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause

# The Rust types of IDL values, for the Rust bindings of the interfaces implemented in Rust. They cover the types that
# those interfaces use so far; every other type is an error.

import re

from collections.abc import Iterable
from dataclasses import replace
from pathlib import Path
from typing import FrozenSet
from typing import List
from typing import Optional

from Generators.libweb_bindings.context import GenerationContext
from Utils.utils import string_to_cpp_enum_name
from Utils.utils import title_case_to_snake_case
from Utils.webidl_parser import Dictionary
from Utils.webidl_parser import Enumeration
from Utils.webidl_parser import IDLParameterizedType
from Utils.webidl_parser import IDLType
from Utils.webidl_parser import IDLUnionType
from Utils.webidl_parser import Interface
from Utils.webidl_parser import OperationParameter

# The typed arrays, whose names are the variants of the runtime's TypedArrayKind.
TYPED_ARRAY_NAMES = {
    "Int8Array",
    "Uint8Array",
    "Uint8ClampedArray",
    "Int16Array",
    "Uint16Array",
    "Int32Array",
    "Uint32Array",
    "BigInt64Array",
    "BigUint64Array",
    "Float16Array",
    "Float32Array",
    "Float64Array",
}

# The extended attributes of a type or a parameter that the Rust bindings handle.
SUPPORTED_TYPE_EXTENDED_ATTRIBUTES = {
    "AllowShared",
    "AllowResizable",
    "Clamp",
    "EnforceRange",
    "LegacyNullToEmptyString",
}

# The integer types, with the Rust type of their values.
INTEGER_TYPES = {
    "short": "i16",
    "unsigned short": "u16",
    "long": "i32",
    "unsigned long": "u32",
    "long long": "i64",
    "unsigned long long": "u64",
}

# The floating point types, with the Rust type of their values.
FLOATING_POINT_TYPES = {"float": "f32", "unrestricted float": "f32", "double": "f64", "unrestricted double": "f64"}

# The types whose values are plain data, with the Rust type of their values. None of these Rust types is or holds a
# cell, which holds_cells() relies on.
PLAIN_DATA_TYPES = {
    "ByteString": "ByteString",
    "CSSOMString": "Utf16String",
    "DOMString": "Utf16String",
    "USVString": "UsvString",
    "boolean": "bool",
    "undefined": "()",
    **INTEGER_TYPES,
    **FLOATING_POINT_TYPES,
}

# The unions that the bindings runtime has a type for, by the name of the typedef that names the union.
RUNTIME_UNION_TYPES = {"ArrayBufferView": "ArrayBufferView", "BufferSource": "BufferSource"}

# The unions that no typedef names and more than one interface's IDL uses, whose enums the bindings runtime defines,
# by their type name.
SHARED_UNNAMED_UNIONS = {"DOMStringOrDOMStringSequence": "crate::bindings::conversions"}

DECIMAL_LITERAL = re.compile(r"-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?")

# https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#prod-integer
INTEGER_LITERAL = re.compile(r"-?([1-9][0-9]*|0[Xx][0-9A-Fa-f]+|0[0-7]*)")


class UnsupportedByRustBindings(Exception):
    pass


def idl_integer_value(literal: Optional[str], idl_type_name: str) -> Optional[int]:
    """The value of an integer token of the IDL, or None if the token is not one or its value is not one of the
    integer type."""
    if literal is None or not INTEGER_LITERAL.fullmatch(literal):
        return None
    digits = literal.removeprefix("-")
    if digits[:2] in ("0x", "0X"):
        magnitude = int(digits, 16)
    elif digits.startswith("0"):
        magnitude = int(digits, 8)
    else:
        magnitude = int(digits, 10)
    integer = -magnitude if literal.startswith("-") else magnitude
    rust_integer_type = INTEGER_TYPES[idl_type_name]
    bits = int(rust_integer_type[1:])
    if rust_integer_type.startswith("u"):
        lowest, highest = 0, 2**bits - 1
    else:
        lowest, highest = -(2 ** (bits - 1)), 2 ** (bits - 1) - 1
    if not lowest <= integer <= highest:
        return None
    return integer


def rust_integer_literal(literal: Optional[str], idl_type_name: str) -> Optional[str]:
    """The Rust literal of the value of an integer token of the IDL, if it is a value of the integer type."""
    integer = idl_integer_value(literal, idl_type_name)
    return None if integer is None else f"{integer}_{INTEGER_TYPES[idl_type_name]}"


def is_implemented_in_rust(interface: Optional[Interface]) -> bool:
    return interface is not None and interface.extended_attributes.get("ImplementedIn") == "Rust"


def is_member_implemented_in_rust(member) -> bool:
    """Whether an attribute or an operation of an interface implemented in C++ is [ImplementedIn=Rust]: its bindings
    and its steps are Rust code, which the C++ bindings call to define it on the interface prototype object."""
    return member.extended_attributes.get("ImplementedIn") == "Rust"


def rust_member_definition_entry_point(interface: Interface, member) -> str:
    """The entry point of the Rust bindings that defines an [ImplementedIn=Rust] member of an interface implemented in
    C++ on its interface prototype object."""
    return f"web_rust_{title_case_to_snake_case(interface.name)}_define_{title_case_to_snake_case(member.name)}"


def rust_implemented_members(interface: Optional[Interface]) -> Optional[Interface]:
    """The interface implemented in C++ with only its members that are [ImplementedIn=Rust], without that extended
    attribute, which is what the Rust bindings write bindings for. None if it has no such member."""
    if interface is None or is_implemented_in_rust(interface):
        return None
    attributes = [attribute for attribute in interface.regular_attributes if is_member_implemented_in_rust(attribute)]
    operations = [operation for operation in interface.regular_operations if is_member_implemented_in_rust(operation)]
    if not attributes and not operations:
        return None

    def without_implemented_in(member):
        extended_attributes = dict(member.extended_attributes)
        del extended_attributes["ImplementedIn"]
        return replace(member, extended_attributes=extended_attributes)

    return replace(
        interface,
        extended_attributes={},
        parent_name="",
        constants=[],
        regular_attributes=[without_implemented_in(attribute) for attribute in attributes],
        static_attributes=[],
        regular_operations=[without_implemented_in(operation) for operation in operations],
        static_operations=[],
        constructors=[],
        stringifier=None,
        iterable=None,
        async_iterable=None,
        named_property_getter=None,
        indexed_property_getter=None,
        named_property_setter=None,
        named_property_deleter=None,
        indexed_property_setter=None,
        maplike=None,
        setlike=None,
    )


# The interfaces implemented in C++ that an interface implemented in Rust can inherit from
# (Libraries/LibWeb/Bindings/RustEventTarget.h).
CPP_PARENT_INTERFACES = ("EventTarget", "Event")


def cpp_ancestor(interface: Interface, context: GenerationContext) -> Optional[Interface]:
    """The interface implemented in C++ that the interface inherits from, through any number of interfaces
    implemented in Rust, if any."""
    ancestor = context.interfaces.get(interface.parent_name)
    while ancestor is not None and is_implemented_in_rust(ancestor):
        ancestor = context.interfaces.get(ancestor.parent_name)
    return ancestor


def resolved_dictionary(idl_type: IDLType, context: GenerationContext) -> Optional[Dictionary]:
    return context.dictionaries.get(idl_type.name)


def rust_interface(idl_type: IDLType, context: GenerationContext) -> Optional[Interface]:
    """The interface that the type names, if it is implemented in Rust."""
    if isinstance(idl_type, (IDLParameterizedType, IDLUnionType)):
        return None
    interface = context.interfaces.get(idl_type.name)
    return interface if is_implemented_in_rust(interface) else None


def rust_module_path(idl_path: Path) -> str:
    """The Rust module of the hand-written definitions of an IDL file, which follows from its path:
    Encoding/TextEncoder.idl names crate::encoding::text_encoder."""
    parts = idl_path.parts
    namespace = parts[parts.index("LibWeb") + 1]
    module = "webidl" if namespace == "WebIDL" else title_case_to_snake_case(namespace)
    return f"crate::{module}::{title_case_to_snake_case(idl_path.stem)}"


def cpp_interface(idl_type: IDLType, context: GenerationContext) -> Optional[Interface]:
    """The interface that the type names, if LibWeb implements it in C++."""
    if isinstance(idl_type, (IDLParameterizedType, IDLUnionType)):
        return None
    interface = context.interfaces.get(idl_type.name)
    if interface is None or is_implemented_in_rust(interface):
        return None
    if interface.is_namespace or interface.is_callback_interface:
        return None
    return interface


def is_window_proxy(idl_type: IDLType) -> bool:
    """Whether the type is WindowProxy, which no IDL file defines. Rust holds its values as the objects that scripts
    see."""
    return not isinstance(idl_type, (IDLParameterizedType, IDLUnionType)) and idl_type.name == "WindowProxy"


def is_callback_interface(idl_type: IDLType, context: GenerationContext) -> bool:
    """Whether the type names a callback interface."""
    if isinstance(idl_type, (IDLParameterizedType, IDLUnionType)):
        return False
    interface = context.interfaces.get(idl_type.name)
    return interface is not None and interface.is_callback_interface


def cpp_interface_name_constant(interface: Interface) -> str:
    """The constant of the generated Rust bindings that is the Web::Bindings::InterfaceName of an interface that
    LibWeb implements in C++."""
    return f"super::cpp_interface_names::{title_case_to_snake_case(interface.name).upper()}"


def is_union_of_cpp_interfaces(idl_type: IDLType, context: GenerationContext) -> bool:
    return isinstance(idl_type, IDLUnionType) and all(
        cpp_interface(member_type, context) is not None for member_type in idl_type.flattened_member_types()
    )


def inheriting_interfaces(interface: Interface, context: GenerationContext) -> List[Interface]:
    """The interfaces that inherit from the interface, through any number of interfaces between them."""
    inheriting = []
    for other in context.interfaces.values():
        ancestor = context.interfaces.get(other.parent_name)
        while ancestor is not None and ancestor.name != interface.name:
            ancestor = context.interfaces.get(ancestor.parent_name)
        if ancestor is not None:
            inheriting.append(other)
    return inheriting


def rust_interface_path(interface: Interface) -> str:
    """The Rust path of the implementation of an interface: crate::encoding::text_encoder::TextEncoder for
    Encoding/TextEncoder.idl."""
    return f"{rust_module_path(interface.path)}::{interface.name}"


def rust_any_interface_path(interface: Interface) -> str:
    """The Rust path of the enum of an object of an interface that others inherit from, which is an object of the
    interface or of any of those, with a variant for each that is named after its interface:
    crate::file_api::blob::AnyBlob for FileAPI/Blob.idl."""
    return f"{rust_module_path(interface.path)}::Any{interface.name}"


def rust_dictionary_path(dictionary: Dictionary, context: GenerationContext) -> str:
    """The Rust path of the struct of a dictionary, which is in the module of the IDL file that defines the
    dictionary: crate::encoding::text_encoder::TextEncoderEncodeIntoResult."""
    for module in context.modules:
        if any(defined.name == dictionary.name for defined in module.dictionaries):
            return f"{rust_module_path(module.path)}::{dictionary.name}"
    raise RuntimeError(f"No module defines the dictionary {dictionary.name}")


def union_typedef_names(idl_type: IDLUnionType, context: GenerationContext) -> List[str]:
    return sorted(
        name
        for name, typedef in context.typedefs.items()
        if typedef.type.without_nullable() == idl_type.without_nullable()
    )


def is_unnamed_union_of_cpp_interfaces(idl_type: IDLType, context: GenerationContext) -> bool:
    """Whether the IDL values of the union are objects of interfaces that LibWeb implements in C++ and nothing says
    which. Their Rust type is that of such an object, which is all an implementation can do with one: hand it on."""
    return (
        isinstance(idl_type, IDLUnionType)
        and is_union_of_cpp_interfaces(idl_type, context)
        and not union_typedef_names(idl_type, context)
    )


def idl_type_name(idl_type: IDLType, what: str, context: Optional[GenerationContext] = None) -> str:
    """The name the Rust bindings give the type: Path2DOrDOMString for (Path2D or DOMString),
    UnrestrictedDoubleSequence for sequence<unrestricted double>. Given the context, a member union that one typedef
    names has the typedef's name: DocumentOrXMLHttpRequestBodyInit for (Document or XMLHttpRequestBodyInit)."""
    if isinstance(idl_type, IDLUnionType):
        if context is not None:
            names = union_typedef_names(idl_type, context)
            if len(names) == 1:
                return f"{names[0]}OrNull" if idl_type.nullable else names[0]
        name = "Or".join(idl_type_name(member_type, what, context) for member_type in idl_type.member_types)
    elif isinstance(idl_type, IDLParameterizedType) and idl_type.name == "record":
        key_type, value_type = idl_type.parameters
        name = f"{idl_type_name(key_type, what, context)}{idl_type_name(value_type, what, context)}Record"
    elif isinstance(idl_type, IDLParameterizedType):
        if idl_type.name != "sequence":
            raise UnsupportedByRustBindings(f"{what} has the type {idl_type}, which the Rust bindings have no name for")
        name = f"{idl_type_name(idl_type.parameters[0], what, context)}Sequence"
    else:
        name = "".join(word[:1].upper() + word[1:] for word in idl_type.name.split(" "))
    return f"{name}OrNull" if idl_type.nullable else name


def member_types_of_interface(interface: Interface) -> List[IDLType]:
    """The types that the attributes, operations and constructors of an interface or a mixin name."""
    types = [attribute.type for attribute in interface.regular_attributes + interface.static_attributes]
    for operation in interface.regular_operations + interface.static_operations:
        types.append(operation.return_type)
        types.extend(parameter.type for parameter in operation.parameters)
    for constructor in interface.constructors:
        types.extend(parameter.type for parameter in constructor.parameters)
    return types


def unnamed_union_idl_path(idl_type: IDLUnionType, context: GenerationContext, what: str) -> Path:
    """The IDL file of a union that no typedef names: the file of the mixin, or else of the interface or the
    dictionary, whose members name it. An interface has the members of the mixins that it includes, so a union that
    a mixin names is the mixin's."""
    union_type = idl_type.without_nullable()

    def name_the_union(types: Iterable[IDLType]) -> bool:
        return any(
            nested_type.without_nullable() == union_type
            for named_type in types
            for nested_type in named_type.nested_types()
        )

    paths = {mixin.path for mixin in context.mixins.values() if name_the_union(member_types_of_interface(mixin))}
    if not paths:
        interfaces = []
        for module in context.modules:
            if module.interface is not None and name_the_union(member_types_of_interface(module.interface)):
                paths.add(module.path)
                interfaces.append(module.interface)
            if any(name_the_union(member.type for member in dictionary.members) for dictionary in module.dictionaries):
                paths.add(module.path)
        # NB: A union that an interface and the interfaces that inherit from it name, as the constructors of
        #     DOMMatrixReadOnly and DOMMatrix do, is the union of the interface that the others inherit from.
        roots = [
            interface
            for interface in interfaces
            if all(other is interface or other in inheriting_interfaces(interface, context) for other in interfaces)
        ]
        if len(roots) == 1 and len(paths) == len(interfaces):
            paths = {roots[0].path}
    if len(paths) != 1:
        raise UnsupportedByRustBindings(
            f"{what} has the union type {idl_type}, which no typedef names and which the IDL files "
            f"{sorted(str(path) for path in paths)} name, so that no one module defines its enum"
        )
    return paths.pop()


def runtime_union_type(idl_type: IDLType, context: GenerationContext) -> Optional[str]:
    """The type of the bindings runtime for the union, if it has one."""
    if not isinstance(idl_type, IDLUnionType):
        return None
    for name, runtime_type in RUNTIME_UNION_TYPES.items():
        typedef = context.typedefs.get(name)
        if typedef is not None and typedef.type.without_nullable() == idl_type.without_nullable():
            return runtime_type
    return None


def union_member_types(idl_type: IDLUnionType, context: GenerationContext) -> List[IDLType]:
    """The flattened member types of the union, except that a union the bindings runtime has a type for is one
    member, as BufferSource is in (BufferSource or Blob or USVString)."""
    member_types: List[IDLType] = []
    for member_type in idl_type.member_types:
        if isinstance(member_type, IDLUnionType) and runtime_union_type(member_type, context) is None:
            member_types.extend(union_member_types(member_type, context))
        else:
            member_types.append(member_type)
    return member_types


def member_other_than_undefined(idl_type: IDLType) -> Optional[IDLType]:
    """The other member of a union of a type and undefined, whose IDL values are those of the type or nothing."""
    if not isinstance(idl_type, IDLUnionType) or idl_type.nullable or len(idl_type.member_types) != 2:
        return None
    others = [member for member in idl_type.member_types if member.name != "undefined"]
    return others[0] if len(others) == 1 else None


def is_named_union(idl_type: IDLType, context: GenerationContext) -> bool:
    """Whether the Rust type of the union is an enum that the module of an IDL file defines, rust_union_path()."""
    return (
        isinstance(idl_type, IDLUnionType)
        and runtime_union_type(idl_type, context) is None
        and member_other_than_undefined(idl_type) is None
        and not is_unnamed_union_of_cpp_interfaces(idl_type, context)
    )


def rust_union_variant(member_type: IDLType) -> str:
    """The variant of a member of a union in the enum of the union, which has the type name of the member, such as
    DOMString or UnrestrictedDouble. A union has at most one sequence type and one record type, whose variants are
    Sequence and Record."""
    if isinstance(member_type, IDLParameterizedType) and member_type.name == "sequence":
        return "Sequence"
    if isinstance(member_type, IDLParameterizedType) and member_type.name == "record":
        return "Record"
    return idl_type_name(member_type, f"the union member {member_type}")


def rust_enumeration_path(enumeration: Enumeration, context: GenerationContext) -> str:
    """The Rust path of the enum of an enumeration, which is in the module of the IDL file that defines the
    enumeration: crate::web_gl::web_gl_rendering_context::WebGLPowerPreference."""
    return f"{rust_module_path(enumeration.path)}::{enumeration.name}"


def rust_enumeration_variant(value: str, enumeration: Enumeration) -> str:
    """The variant of a value of an enumeration in the enum of the enumeration, which the C++ bindings name the same
    way."""
    variant = string_to_cpp_enum_name(value)
    is_plain = value.isascii() and value.isprintable() and '"' not in value and "\\" not in value
    if not is_plain or not re.fullmatch(r"(?:[A-Z]|_[0-9])[A-Za-z0-9]*", variant) or variant == "Self":
        raise UnsupportedByRustBindings(
            f"The value {value!r} of the enumeration {enumeration.name} has no name that the Rust bindings can give "
            "its variant"
        )
    return variant


def rust_union_path(idl_type: IDLUnionType, context: GenerationContext, what: str) -> str:
    """The Rust path of the enum of a union, which is in the module of the IDL file whose typedef names the union:
    crate::url_pattern::url_pattern::URLPatternInput. The generator resolves typedefs before it converts types, so
    the typedef is found again by its type. A union that no typedef names has its type name, in the module of the
    IDL file that names it: crate::html::path2d::Path2DOrDOMString."""
    names = union_typedef_names(idl_type, context)
    if len(names) > 1:
        raise UnsupportedByRustBindings(f"{what} has the union type {idl_type}, which the typedefs {names} all name")
    if not names:
        type_name = idl_type_name(idl_type.without_nullable(), what, context)
        if type_name in SHARED_UNNAMED_UNIONS:
            return f"{SHARED_UNNAMED_UNIONS[type_name]}::{type_name}"
        idl_path = unnamed_union_idl_path(idl_type, context, what)
        return f"{rust_module_path(idl_path)}::{type_name}"
    name = names[0]
    for module in context.modules:
        if any(typedef.name == name for typedef in module.typedefs):
            return f"{rust_module_path(module.path)}::{name}"
    raise RuntimeError(f"No module defines the typedef {name}")


def rust_type(idl_type: IDLType, context: GenerationContext, what: str, is_result: bool = False) -> str:
    """The Rust type of the IDL values of the type. A result is a value that the implementation returns, which it
    creates, so that it knows the interface of an object it returns."""
    unsupported_attributes = set(idl_type.extended_attributes) - SUPPORTED_TYPE_EXTENDED_ATTRIBUTES
    if unsupported_attributes:
        raise UnsupportedByRustBindings(f"{what} has extended attributes {sorted(unsupported_attributes)}")
    if idl_type.nullable:
        return f"Option<{rust_type(idl_type.without_nullable(), context, what, is_result)}>"
    name = idl_type.name
    if isinstance(idl_type, IDLParameterizedType):
        if name in ("sequence", "FrozenArray"):
            element_type = idl_type.parameters[0]
            element = rust_type(element_type, context, what, is_result)
            # NB: A Vec would hide cells that the implementation returns from the collector until they are converted.
            if is_result and holds_cells(element_type, context):
                return f"MarkedVec<'_, {element}>"
            return f"Vec<{element}>"
        if name == "Promise":
            return "WebIdlPromise"
        if name == "record":
            key_type, value_type = idl_type.parameters
            if key_type.name not in ("ByteString", "DOMString", "USVString"):
                raise UnsupportedByRustBindings(f"{what} has a record with keys of the type {key_type}")
            return f"Vec<({rust_type(key_type, context, what)}, {rust_type(value_type, context, what)})>"
        raise UnsupportedByRustBindings(f"{what} has the type {idl_type}, which the Rust bindings do not convert yet")
    if name in PLAIN_DATA_TYPES:
        return PLAIN_DATA_TYPES[name]
    if name == "any":
        return "Value"
    if name == "object":
        return "Gc<Object>"
    if name in TYPED_ARRAY_NAMES:
        return "Gc<TypedArrayBase>"
    if name in ("ArrayBuffer", "SharedArrayBuffer"):
        return "Gc<ArrayBuffer>"
    callback_function = context.callback_function(idl_type)
    if callback_function is not None:
        # NB: A callback function value that the implementation receives keeps its callback context, and one that it
        #     returns is a function that it created.
        if is_result:
            return "Gc<FunctionObject>"
        return "PromiseCallbackFunction" if is_promise_type(callback_function.return_type) else "CallbackFunction"
    if is_callback_interface(idl_type, context) and not is_result:
        return "CallbackInterface"
    interface = rust_interface(idl_type, context)
    if interface is not None:
        if inheriting_interfaces(interface, context) and not is_result:
            # NB: An object of such a type is a cell of any of several classes, which Ref<T> cannot express. An object
            #     that an implementation returns is one of exactly the interface, whose cell it created.
            return rust_any_interface_path(interface)
        return f"Ref<{rust_interface_path(interface)}>"
    if (
        is_window_proxy(idl_type)
        or cpp_interface(idl_type, context) is not None
        or is_unnamed_union_of_cpp_interfaces(idl_type, context)
    ):
        return "CppInterface"
    dictionary = resolved_dictionary(idl_type, context)
    if dictionary is not None:
        return rust_dictionary_type(dictionary, context)
    enumeration = context.enumeration(idl_type)
    if enumeration is not None:
        return rust_enumeration_path(enumeration, context)
    runtime_type = runtime_union_type(idl_type, context)
    if runtime_type is not None:
        return runtime_type
    optional_member = member_other_than_undefined(idl_type)
    if optional_member is not None:
        return f"Option<{rust_type(optional_member, context, what)}>"
    if isinstance(idl_type, IDLUnionType):
        for member_type in union_member_types(idl_type, context):
            rust_type(member_type, context, what, is_result)
        return rust_union_path(idl_type, context, what)
    raise UnsupportedByRustBindings(f"{what} has the type {idl_type}, which the Rust bindings do not convert yet")


def is_promise_type(idl_type: IDLType) -> bool:
    return isinstance(idl_type, IDLParameterizedType) and idl_type.name == "Promise"


def holds_cells(
    idl_type: IDLType, context: GenerationContext, enclosing_dictionary_names: FrozenSet[str] = frozenset()
) -> bool:
    """Whether the Rust type of the IDL values of the type is or can hold a cell, which a Vec would hide from the
    collector. Only plain data, and what is made of nothing but plain data, holds none: a type that this function
    does not know holds one."""

    def any_holds_cells(idl_types: Iterable[IDLType]) -> bool:
        return any(holds_cells(inner_type, context, enclosing_dictionary_names) for inner_type in idl_types)

    if isinstance(idl_type, IDLUnionType):
        if runtime_union_type(idl_type, context) is not None:
            # NB: The bindings runtime defines the types of its unions by hand, so nothing checks them against the
            #     members of the unions.
            return True
        return any_holds_cells(idl_type.flattened_member_types())
    if isinstance(idl_type, IDLParameterizedType):
        if idl_type.name in ("sequence", "FrozenArray", "record"):
            return any_holds_cells(idl_type.parameters)
        return True
    if idl_type.name in PLAIN_DATA_TYPES or context.enumeration(idl_type) is not None:
        return False
    dictionary = resolved_dictionary(idl_type, context)
    if dictionary is None:
        return True
    if dictionary.name in enclosing_dictionary_names:
        # NB: A dictionary that names itself, as it can through a sequence, holds a cell only if a member outside of
        #     that cycle does.
        return False
    return any(
        holds_cells(member.type, context, enclosing_dictionary_names | {dictionary.name})
        for inherited_dictionary in context.dictionary_inheritance_stack(dictionary)
        for member in inherited_dictionary.members
    )


def is_sequence_of_cells(idl_type: IDLType, context: GenerationContext) -> bool:
    """Whether the type is a sequence whose elements are or can hold cells, which the bindings gather in a MarkedVec
    for a parameter."""
    return (
        isinstance(idl_type, IDLParameterizedType)
        and idl_type.name == "sequence"
        and not idl_type.nullable
        and holds_cells(idl_type.parameters[0], context)
    )


def is_record_of_cells(idl_type: IDLType, context: GenerationContext) -> bool:
    """Whether the type is a record whose values are or can hold cells, which the bindings gather in a MarkedVec for a
    parameter."""
    return (
        isinstance(idl_type, IDLParameterizedType)
        and idl_type.name == "record"
        and not idl_type.nullable
        and holds_cells(idl_type.parameters[1], context)
    )


def union_holds_sequence_of_cells(idl_type: IDLType, context: GenerationContext) -> bool:
    """Whether the type is a union with a member that is a sequence of values that are or can hold cells, which the
    enum of the union keeps alive in a MarkedVec, for as long as the reference to the VM that it was converted with
    lives."""
    return isinstance(idl_type, IDLUnionType) and any(
        is_sequence_of_cells(member_type, context) for member_type in idl_type.flattened_member_types()
    )


def dictionary_holds_sequence_of_cells(dictionary: Dictionary, context: GenerationContext) -> bool:
    """Whether a member of the dictionary is a sequence of values that are or can hold cells, or a union with such a
    member, which the struct of the dictionary keeps alive in a MarkedVec, for as long as the reference to the VM that
    it was converted with lives."""
    return any(
        is_sequence_of_cells(member.type, context) or union_holds_sequence_of_cells(member.type, context)
        for member in dictionary.members
    )


def rust_dictionary_type(dictionary: Dictionary, context: GenerationContext) -> str:
    """The Rust type of the struct of a dictionary: its path, with the lifetime of the reference to the VM when the
    dictionary holds a sequence of values that are or can hold cells."""
    path = rust_dictionary_path(dictionary, context)
    if dictionary_holds_sequence_of_cells(dictionary, context):
        return f"{path}<'_>"
    return path


def rust_parameter_type(parameter: OperationParameter, context: GenerationContext, what: str) -> str:
    """The Rust type the implementation receives for the parameter."""
    if parameter.variadic:
        element_type = rust_type(parameter.type, context, what)
        if holds_cells(parameter.type, context):
            return f"MarkedVec<'_, {element_type}>"
        return f"Vec<{element_type}>"
    if is_sequence_of_cells(parameter.type, context):
        assert isinstance(parameter.type, IDLParameterizedType)
        value_type = f"MarkedVec<'_, {rust_type(parameter.type.parameters[0], context, what)}>"
    elif is_record_of_cells(parameter.type, context):
        assert isinstance(parameter.type, IDLParameterizedType)
        key_type, record_value_type = (rust_type(type, context, what) for type in parameter.type.parameters)
        value_type = f"MarkedVec<'_, ({key_type}, {record_value_type})>"
    else:
        value_type = rust_type(parameter.type, context, what)
    if parameter.optional and parameter.default_value is None:
        return f"Option<{value_type}>"
    return value_type
