#include <AK/ByteString.h>
#include <AudioServer/PlatformAudio.h>
#include <AudioServer/PulseAudioWrappers.h>
#include <LibAudio/RecordStream.h>
#include <LibCore/EventLoop.h>
#include <LibThreading/Thread.h>

namespace Audio {

namespace {

class RecordStreamPulseAudio final : public RecordStream {
public:
    explicit RecordStreamPulseAudio(NonnullRefPtr<PulseAudioRecordStream> stream)
        : m_stream(move(stream))
    {
    }

    virtual SampleSpecification const& sample_specification() const override { return m_stream->sample_specification(); }

private:
    NonnullRefPtr<PulseAudioRecordStream> m_stream;
};

}

static ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<RecordStream>> create_pulse_audio_record_stream(SampleSpecification const& specification, u32 fragment_size_bytes, ByteString device_name, RecordStream::RecordCallback callback)
{
    auto context = TRY(PulseAudioContext::the());

    auto pulse_stream = TRY(context->create_record_stream(specification, fragment_size_bytes,
        device_name.is_empty() ? nullptr : device_name.characters(), move(callback)));

    auto stream = TRY(adopt_nonnull_ref_or_enomem(new (nothrow) RecordStreamPulseAudio(move(pulse_stream))));
    return stream;
}

NonnullRefPtr<RecordStream::CreatePromise> create_platform_record_stream(SampleSpecification const& specification, u32 fragment_size_bytes, StringView device_id, RecordStream::RecordCallback callback)
{
    auto promise = RecordStream::CreatePromise::construct();

    // AudioDevices encodes PulseAudio sources as "pulse:source:<name>". Unrecognized or
    // empty ids fall through to the server's default source.
    constexpr auto pulse_source_prefix = "pulse:source:"sv;
    ByteString device_name;
    if (device_id.starts_with(pulse_source_prefix))
        device_name = device_id.substring_view(pulse_source_prefix.length());

    if (!Core::EventLoop::is_running()) {
        auto stream_or_error = create_pulse_audio_record_stream(specification, fragment_size_bytes, move(device_name), move(callback));
        if (stream_or_error.is_error())
            promise->reject(stream_or_error.release_error());
        else
            promise->resolve(stream_or_error.release_value());
        return promise;
    }

    auto& main_thread_event_loop = Core::EventLoop::current();
    auto thread_or_error = Threading::Thread::try_create("AudioCaptureCtl"sv, [&main_thread_event_loop, promise, specification, fragment_size_bytes, device_name = move(device_name), callback = move(callback)]() mutable {
        auto stream_or_error = create_pulse_audio_record_stream(specification, fragment_size_bytes, move(device_name), move(callback));
        main_thread_event_loop.deferred_invoke([promise, stream_or_error = move(stream_or_error)]() mutable {
            if (stream_or_error.is_error())
                promise->reject(stream_or_error.release_error());
            else
                promise->resolve(stream_or_error.release_value());
        });
        return 0;
    });
    if (thread_or_error.is_error()) {
        promise->reject(thread_or_error.release_error());
        return promise;
    }
    auto thread = thread_or_error.release_value();
    thread->start();
    thread->detach();
    return promise;
}

}

#include <AK/LexicalPath.h>
#include <AudioServer/Sandbox.h>
#include <LibCore/Directory.h>
#include <LibCore/StandardPaths.h>
#include <LibCore/System.h>
#include <LibSandbox/Sandbox.h>
#include <LibSandbox/Seccomp.h>

namespace AudioServer {

ErrorOr<void> apply_sandbox(StringView)
{
    TRY(Sandbox::install_no_new_privileges());
    TRY(Sandbox::configure_runtime());

    auto executable_path = TRY(Core::System::current_executable_path());
    auto build_root = LexicalPath::dirname(LexicalPath::dirname(executable_path));

    Vector<Sandbox::PathRule> paths;
    // cpptrace opens loaded ELF objects when symbolizing in-process stack traces.
    TRY(Sandbox::add_path_if_exists(paths, executable_path, Sandbox::PathRule::Access::ReadOnly));
    TRY(Sandbox::add_path_if_exists(paths, LexicalPath::join(build_root, "lib"sv).string(), Sandbox::PathRule::Access::ReadOnly));
    TRY(Sandbox::add_loaded_library_directories(paths, build_root));
    TRY(Sandbox::add_path_if_exists(paths, "/proc/self"sv, Sandbox::PathRule::Access::ReadOnly));

    // libpulse still keeps its cookie and runtime files in these, so they stay readable.
    auto pulse_runtime_path = LexicalPath::join(TRY(Core::StandardPaths::runtime_directory()), "pulse"sv).string();
    TRY(Core::Directory::create(pulse_runtime_path, Core::Directory::CreateDirectories::Yes, 0700));
    TRY(Sandbox::add_path_if_exists(paths, pulse_runtime_path, Sandbox::PathRule::Access::ReadOnly));
    TRY(Sandbox::add_path_if_exists(paths, LexicalPath::join(Core::StandardPaths::config_directory(), "pulse"sv).string(), Sandbox::PathRule::Access::ReadOnly));
    TRY(Sandbox::restrict_filesystem(paths.span()));

    Sandbox::SeccompPolicy policy;
    policy.allow_readonly_file_opens();
    policy.allow_filesystem_metadata_queries();
    policy.allow_file_descriptor_operations();
    policy.allow_ipc();
    policy.allow_socket_pairs();
    policy.broker_unix_socket_connections();
    policy.allow_pulseaudio_client_file_operations();
    policy.allow_common_runtime();
    TRY(policy.install());
    return {};
}

}

FILE: Services/AudioServer/SandboxMacOS.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <AudioServer/Sandbox.h>
#include <AudioToolbox/AudioConverter.h>
#include <LibCore/System.h>
#include <LibSandbox/Sandbox.h>

namespace AudioServer {

ErrorOr<void> apply_sandbox(StringView mach_server_name)
{
    TRY(Sandbox::configure_runtime());

    auto executable_path = TRY(Core::System::current_executable_path());
    Vector<Sandbox::SeatbeltPath> paths;
    TRY(Sandbox::add_seatbelt_path_if_exists(paths, executable_path, Sandbox::SeatbeltPath::Access::ReadOnly));
    // The audio frameworks look up the main bundle of the process.
    if (auto bundle = Sandbox::application_bundle_for_executable(executable_path); bundle.has_value())
        TRY(Sandbox::add_seatbelt_path_if_exists(paths, *bundle, Sandbox::SeatbeltPath::Access::ReadOnly));

    // AudioToolbox checks the code signature of the process the first time it creates an AudioConverter or initializes
    // an output unit, and it asks for the path behind a descriptor it holds to do so, which the sandbox doesn't allow:
    // The output then fails to open, or the process crashes with SIGBUS. It checks only once per process, and on any
    // attempt to create a converter, even one that fails, so asking for one here gets the check done before the sandbox
    // is in place, whatever the result.
    AudioStreamBasicDescription const source_format {
        .mSampleRate = 48000,
        .mFormatID = kAudioFormatLinearPCM,
        .mFormatFlags = kAudioFormatFlagIsFloat | kAudioFormatFlagIsPacked,
        .mBytesPerPacket = 4,
        .mFramesPerPacket = 1,
        .mBytesPerFrame = 4,
        .mChannelsPerFrame = 1,
        .mBitsPerChannel = 32,
        .mReserved = 0,
    };
    auto destination_format = source_format;
    destination_format.mSampleRate = 44100;
    AudioConverterRef converter = nullptr;
    if (AudioConverterNew(&source_format, &destination_format, &converter) == noErr)
        AudioConverterDispose(converter);

    return Sandbox::apply_macos_sandbox({
        .paths = paths.span(),
        .mach_server_name = mach_server_name,
        .system_services = Sandbox::SystemService::Audio,
    });
}

}

FILE: Services/AudioServer/ServerConnection.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <AK/Atomic.h>
#include <AudioServer/ServerConnection.h>
#include <LibAudio/RecordStreamFailure.h>
#include <math.h>

namespace Audio {

static MixerClientId s_next_mixer_client_id { 1 };

ServerConnection::ServerConnection(NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport> transport, int client_id, NonnullRefPtr<PlaybackStreamMixer> mixer, NonnullRefPtr<CaptureDevices> capture_devices, CapturePermissionRequest request_capture_permission)
    : IPC::ConnectionFromClient<AudioClientEndpoint, AudioServerEndpoint>(*this, move(transport), client_id)
    , m_mixer(move(mixer))
    , m_capture_devices(move(capture_devices))
    , m_request_capture_permission(move(request_capture_permission))
{
}

ServerConnection::~ServerConnection()
{
    stop_listening_for_device_changes();
    // Removing the streams settles their drains, which must not find a connection that is going away.
    revoke_weak_ptrs();
    remove_streams_from_mixer();
    remove_record_streams();
}

void ServerConnection::die()
{
    stop_listening_for_device_changes();
    remove_streams_from_mixer();
    remove_record_streams();
    if (on_death)
        on_death();
}

void ServerConnection::remove_record_streams()
{
    for (auto& [stream_id, stream] : exchange(m_record_streams, {}))
        record_stream_gone(stream);
}

void ServerConnection::record_stream_gone(RecordStreamState const& stream)
{
    if (stream.subscriber_id.has_value())
        m_capture_devices->unsubscribe(stream.subscriber_id.value());
    if (stream.may_capture && on_capture_stopped)
        on_capture_stopped(stream.group);
}

void ServerConnection::set_capture_permitted(bool permitted)
{
    if (m_capture_permitted == permitted)
        return;
    m_capture_permitted = permitted;
    if (!permitted) {
        for (auto& [stream_id, stream] : m_record_streams)
            async_record_stream_closed(stream_id);
        remove_record_streams();
    }
    if (m_client_watches_devices)
        send_device_list();
}

void ServerConnection::stop_listening_for_device_changes()
{
    if (m_devices_changed_listener_id.has_value())
        AudioDevices::the().remove_devices_changed_listener(m_devices_changed_listener_id.release_value());
}

void ServerConnection::remove_streams_from_mixer()
{
    for (auto& [stream_id, stream] : m_streams) {
        if (stream.has_ring)
            m_mixer->remove_client(stream.mixer_client_id);
    }
    m_streams.clear();
}

ServerConnection::StreamState* ServerConnection::find_stream(u64 stream_id, StringView operation)
{
    auto stream = m_streams.get(stream_id);
    if (!stream.has_value()) {
        did_misbehave(ByteString::formatted("{}: unknown stream", operation).characters());
        return nullptr;
    }
    return &stream.value();
}

void ServerConnection::declare_session(u64 session_id, PlaybackGroupId group)
{
    if (m_session_groups.contains(session_id)) {
        did_misbehave("declare_session: session ID already exists");
        return;
    }
    m_session_groups.set(session_id, group);
}

void ServerConnection::rebind_session(u64 session_id, PlaybackGroupId group)
{
    auto session_group = m_session_groups.get(session_id);
    if (!session_group.has_value()) {
        did_misbehave("rebind_session: unknown session");
        return;
    }
    session_group.value() = group;
    move_streams_of_session_to(session_id, group);
}

void ServerConnection::destroy_session(u64 session_id)
{
    if (!m_session_groups.remove(session_id)) {
        did_misbehave("destroy_session: unknown session");
        return;
    }
    move_streams_of_session_to(session_id, {});
}

void ServerConnection::move_streams_of_session_to(u64 session_id, Optional<PlaybackGroupId> group)
{
    for (auto& [stream_id, stream] : m_streams) {
        if (stream.session_id == session_id && stream.has_ring)
            m_mixer->set_client_group(stream.mixer_client_id, group);
    }
}

void ServerConnection::create_stream(u64 stream_id, u64 session_id)
{
    if (m_streams.contains(stream_id)) {
        did_misbehave("create_stream: stream ID already exists");
        return;
    }
    if (!m_session_groups.contains(session_id)) {
        did_misbehave("create_stream: unknown session");
        return;
    }
    m_streams.set(stream_id, StreamState { .mixer_client_id = s_next_mixer_client_id++, .session_id = session_id });

    m_mixer->when_device_ready([weak_self = make_weak_ptr<ServerConnection>(), stream_id](ErrorOr<SampleSpecification> const& specification) {
        // The client may have given up on the stream while the device was opening.
        auto self = weak_self.strong_ref();
        if (!self || !self->m_streams.contains(stream_id))
            return;
        if (specification.is_error()) {
            self->m_streams.remove(stream_id);
            self->async_stream_creation_failed(stream_id);
            return;
        }
        self->async_stream_created(stream_id, specification.value(), self->m_mixer->device_target_latency_ms());
    });
}

void ServerConnection::destroy_stream(u64 stream_id)
{
    auto stream = m_streams.take(stream_id);
    if (!stream.has_value())
        return;
    if (stream->has_ring)
        m_mixer->remove_client(stream->mixer_client_id);
}

void ServerConnection::attach_stream_ring(u64 stream_id, SharedAudioFrameRing ring)
{
    auto* stream = find_stream(stream_id, "attach_stream_ring"sv);
    if (!stream)
        return;
    if (stream->has_ring) {
        did_misbehave("attach_stream_ring: stream already has a ring");
        return;
    }
    auto const& device_specification = m_mixer->device_sample_specification();
    if (!device_specification.has_value() || ring.sample_rate() != device_specification->sample_rate() || ring.channel_count() != device_specification->channel_count()) {
        did_misbehave("attach_stream_ring: ring does not match the device format");
        return;
    }
    stream->has_ring = true;
    m_mixer->add_client(stream->mixer_client_id, move(ring), stream->volume, m_session_groups.get(stream->session_id));
}

void ServerConnection::resume_stream(u64 stream_id, u64 request_id)
{
    auto* stream = find_stream(stream_id, "resume_stream"sv);
    if (!stream)
        return;
    if (!stream->has_ring) {
        did_misbehave("resume_stream: stream has no ring");
        return;
    }
    m_mixer->resume_client(stream->mixer_client_id);
    async_stream_request_completed(stream_id, request_id);
}

void ServerConnection::drain_stream(u64 stream_id, u64 request_id)
{
    auto* stream = find_stream(stream_id, "drain_stream"sv);
    if (!stream)
        return;
    if (!stream->has_ring) {
        async_stream_request_completed(stream_id, request_id);
        return;
    }
    m_mixer->drain_client(stream->mixer_client_id, [weak_self = make_weak_ptr<ServerConnection>(), stream_id, request_id] {
        auto self = weak_self.strong_ref();
        if (self && self->m_streams.contains(stream_id))
            self->async_stream_request_completed(stream_id, request_id);
    });
}

void ServerConnection::discard_stream(u64 stream_id, u64 request_id)
{
    auto* stream = find_stream(stream_id, "discard_stream"sv);
    if (!stream)
        return;
    if (stream->has_ring)
        m_mixer->discard_client(stream->mixer_client_id);
    async_stream_request_completed(stream_id, request_id);
}

void ServerConnection::set_stream_volume(u64 stream_id, float volume)
{
    auto* stream = find_stream(stream_id, "set_stream_volume"sv);
    if (!stream)
        return;
    if (isnan(volume) || volume < 0.0f || volume > 1.0f) {
        did_misbehave("set_stream_volume: volume is outside [0, 1]");
        return;
    }
    stream->volume = volume;
    if (stream->has_ring)
        m_mixer->set_client_gain(stream->mixer_client_id, volume);
}

void ServerConnection::watch_devices()
{
    m_client_watches_devices = true;
    if (!m_devices_changed_listener_id.has_value())
        m_devices_changed_listener_id = AudioDevices::the().add_devices_changed_listener([this] { devices_changed(); });
    // A list not yet available follows as soon as the platform reports one.
    if (AudioDevices::the().has_device_list())
        send_device_list();
}

static Vector<AudioDeviceInfo> reduced_to_their_existence(Vector<AudioDeviceInfo> const& devices)
{
    if (devices.is_empty())
        return {};
    return { AudioDeviceInfo { .dom_device_id = {}, .label = {}, .group_id = {}, .sample_rate_hz = 0, .channel_count = 0, .is_default = true } };
}

void ServerConnection::send_device_list()
{
    auto& devices = AudioDevices::the();
    // A page without the permission may learn only that devices exist, so that is all its process learns.
    if (!m_capture_permitted) {
        async_devices_changed(reduced_to_their_existence(devices.input_devices()), reduced_to_their_existence(devices.output_devices()));
        return;
    }
    async_devices_changed(devices.input_devices(), devices.output_devices());
}

void ServerConnection::devices_changed()
{
    if (m_client_watches_devices)
        send_device_list();
}

void ServerConnection::create_record_stream(u64 stream_id, ByteString device_id, PlaybackGroupId group)
{
    if (m_record_streams.contains(stream_id)) {
        did_misbehave("create_record_stream: stream ID already exists");
        return;
    }

    // The Browser rules on every request, so a client once allowed cannot simply start another.
    m_record_streams.set(stream_id, RecordStreamState { .group = group, .subscriber_id = {}, .may_capture = false });
    m_request_capture_permission(device_id, group, [weak_self = make_weak_ptr<ServerConnection>(), stream_id, device_id](bool allowed) {
        auto self = weak_self.strong_ref();
        if (self)
            self->capture_permission_decided(stream_id, device_id, allowed);
    });
}

void ServerConnection::capture_permission_decided(u64 stream_id, ByteString const& device_id, bool allowed)
{
    // The client may have given up on the stream, or the tab lost the permission, while the Browser was asked.
    if (!m_record_streams.contains(stream_id))
        return;
    if (!allowed) {
        m_record_streams.remove(stream_id);
        async_record_stream_creation_failed(stream_id, RecordStreamFailure::Refused);
        return;
    }

    // The stream counts as capturing from here on, even while the device opens.
    auto& stream = m_record_streams.get(stream_id).value();
    stream.may_capture = true;
    if (on_capture_started)
        on_capture_started(stream.group);

    // The state exists before subscribing, since a device that is already open reports at once.
    auto subscriber_id = m_capture_devices->subscribe(device_id, [weak_self = make_weak_ptr<ServerConnection>(), stream_id](CaptureSubscriberId subscriber_id, ErrorOr<SampleSpecification> const& result) {
        auto self = weak_self.strong_ref();
        if (self)
            self->capture_device_ready(stream_id, subscriber_id, result);
    });
    // The callback may have failed and removed the stream already.
    if (auto stream = m_record_streams.get(stream_id); stream.has_value())
        stream->subscriber_id = subscriber_id;
}

void ServerConnection::capture_device_ready(u64 stream_id, CaptureSubscriberId subscriber_id, ErrorOr<SampleSpecification> const& result)
{
    // The client may have given up on the stream while the device was opening.
    if (!m_record_streams.contains(stream_id))
        return;

    auto fail = [&] {
        auto stream = m_record_streams.take(stream_id).release_value();
        stream.subscriber_id = subscriber_id;
        record_stream_gone(stream);
        async_record_stream_creation_failed(stream_id, RecordStreamFailure::DeviceUnavailable);
    };
    if (result.is_error()) {
        fail();
        return;
    }

    // A quarter of a second of room: the client pops every fragment, so this only ever absorbs scheduling hiccups.
    auto const& specification = result.value();
    auto ring = SharedAudioFrameRing::create(specification.sample_rate(), specification.channel_count(), specification.sample_rate() / 4);
    if (ring.is_error()) {
        fail();
        return;
    }
    m_capture_devices->attach_ring(subscriber_id, ring.value());
    async_record_stream_created(stream_id, ring.release_value());
}

void ServerConnection::destroy_record_stream(u64 stream_id)
{
    if (auto stream = m_record_streams.take(stream_id); stream.has_value())
        record_stream_gone(*stream);
}

}

FILE: Services/AudioServer/ServerConnection.h
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause

#pragma once

#include <AK/Function.h>
#include <AK/HashMap.h>
#include <AK/NonnullRefPtr.h>
#include <AudioServer/CaptureDevices.h>
#include <AudioServer/PlaybackStreamMixer.h>
#include <LibAudio/AudioClientEndpoint.h>
#include <LibAudio/AudioDevices.h>
#include <LibAudio/AudioServerEndpoint.h>
#include <LibIPC/ConnectionFromClient.h>

namespace Audio {

// The server end of one client process's audio connection; each stream becomes a client of the tab's mixer.
class ServerConnection final
    : public IPC::ConnectionFromClient<AudioClientEndpoint, AudioServerEndpoint> {
    C_OBJECT(ServerConnection);

public:
    // Asks the Browser whether the client's tab may capture from the device; the answer comes once, on this thread.
    using CapturePermissionRequest = Function<void(ByteString const& device_id, PlaybackGroupId, Function<void(bool allowed)> on_decided)>;

    virtual ~ServerConnection() override;

    // Runs when the client disconnects, after its streams have left the mixer.
    Function<void()> on_death;
    // A capture stream counts from the moment the Browser lets it capture until it is gone, however it goes.
    Function<void(PlaybackGroupId)> on_capture_started;
    Function<void(PlaybackGroupId)> on_capture_stopped;

    // Whether the Browser says the client's tab holds the microphone permission. Without it the client learns of the
    // devices by their existence alone, and the capture streams it has are closed.
    void set_capture_permitted(bool);

private:
    ServerConnection(NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport>, int client_id, NonnullRefPtr<PlaybackStreamMixer>, NonnullRefPtr<CaptureDevices>, CapturePermissionRequest);

    virtual void die() override;
    void remove_streams_from_mixer();
    void remove_record_streams();
    void stop_listening_for_device_changes();

    virtual void declare_session(u64 session_id, PlaybackGroupId group) override;
    virtual void rebind_session(u64 session_id, PlaybackGroupId group) override;
    virtual void destroy_session(u64 session_id) override;
    virtual void create_stream(u64 stream_id, u64 session_id) override;
    virtual void destroy_stream(u64 stream_id) override;
    virtual void attach_stream_ring(u64 stream_id, SharedAudioFrameRing ring) override;
    virtual void resume_stream(u64 stream_id, u64 request_id) override;
    virtual void drain_stream(u64 stream_id, u64 request_id) override;
    virtual void discard_stream(u64 stream_id, u64 request_id) override;
    virtual void set_stream_volume(u64 stream_id, float volume) override;
    virtual void watch_devices() override;
    virtual void create_record_stream(u64 stream_id, ByteString device_id, PlaybackGroupId group) override;
    virtual void destroy_record_stream(u64 stream_id) override;

    void devices_changed();
    void send_device_list();
    void capture_permission_decided(u64 stream_id, ByteString const& device_id, bool allowed);
    void capture_device_ready(u64 stream_id, CaptureSubscriberId, ErrorOr<SampleSpecification> const&);

    struct StreamState {
        MixerClientId mixer_client_id { 0 };
        u64 session_id { 0 };
        bool has_ring { false };
        float volume { 1 };
    };
    StreamState* find_stream(u64 stream_id, StringView operation);
    // The streams of a destroyed session belong to no group, and play into nothing.
    void move_streams_of_session_to(u64 session_id, Optional<PlaybackGroupId>);

    // No subscriber while the Browser is being asked.
    struct RecordStreamState {
        PlaybackGroupId group;
        Optional<CaptureSubscriberId> subscriber_id;
        bool may_capture { false };
    };
    void record_stream_gone(RecordStreamState const&);

    NonnullRefPtr<PlaybackStreamMixer> m_mixer;
    HashMap<u64, PlaybackGroupId> m_session_groups;
    HashMap<u64, StreamState> m_streams;

    NonnullRefPtr<CaptureDevices> m_capture_devices;
    CapturePermissionRequest m_request_capture_permission;
    HashMap<u64, RecordStreamState> m_record_streams;
    bool m_capture_permitted { false };

    Optional<AudioDevices::ListenerId> m_devices_changed_listener_id;
    bool m_client_watches_devices { false };
};

}

FILE: Services/AudioServer/Tabs.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <AK/AtomicRefCounted.h>
#include <AK/NeverDestroyed.h>
#include <AudioServer/ControlConnection.h>
#include <AudioServer/PlatformAudio.h>
#include <AudioServer/Tabs.h>
#include <LibAudio/AudioDevices.h>
#include <LibAudio/NullPlaybackStream.h>
#include <LibAudio/PlaybackStream.h>
#include <LibAudio/RecordStream.h>
#include <LibCore/EventLoop.h>
#include <LibIPC/Transport.h>

namespace AudioServer {

// The device never underruns, since the mix is silence where no client has frames, so its own buffer can stay well
// below the lookahead the clients keep in their rings.
static constexpr u32 DEVICE_TARGET_LATENCY_MS = 40;

Tabs& Tabs::the()
{
    static NeverDestroyed<Tabs> instance;
    return *instance;
}

Tabs::Tabs()
    : m_capture_activity([this](u64 tab_id, Audio::PlaybackGroupId group, bool capturing) {
        if (auto control_connection = m_control_connection.strong_ref())
            control_connection->async_capture_activity_changed(tab_id, group, capturing);
    })
{
}

void Tabs::set_control_connection(ControlConnection& connection)
{
    m_control_connection = connection.make_weak_ptr<ControlConnection>();
}

// The null fallback needs the callback the failed platform stream was given, and the mixer's callback is not copyable.
struct SharedDataRequestCallback : public AtomicRefCounted<SharedDataRequestCallback> {
    explicit SharedDataRequestCallback(Audio::PlaybackStream::AudioDataRequestCallback callback)
        : callback(move(callback))
    {
    }
    Audio::PlaybackStream::AudioDataRequestCallback callback;
};

static NonnullRefPtr<Audio::PlaybackStream::CreatePromise> create_device_stream(Audio::AudioOutput audio_output, Audio::OutputState state, u32 target_latency_ms, Audio::PlaybackStream::AudioDataRequestCallback callback)
{
    if (audio_output == Audio::AudioOutput::Null) {
        auto promise = Audio::PlaybackStream::CreatePromise::construct();
        promise->resolve(Audio::NullPlaybackStream::create(state, target_latency_ms, move(callback)));
        return promise;
    }

    auto shared_callback = make_ref_counted<SharedDataRequestCallback>(move(callback));
    auto make_data_request_callback = [shared_callback] {
        return [shared_callback](Span<float> buffer, MonotonicTime buffer_starts_playing_at) {
            return shared_callback->callback(buffer, buffer_starts_playing_at);
        };
    };

    // A device that cannot be opened plays into nothing, so the clients' clocks run and the tab keeps working.
    auto promise = Audio::PlaybackStream::CreatePromise::construct();
    auto platform_promise = Audio::create_platform_playback_stream(state, target_latency_ms, make_data_request_callback());
    platform_promise->when_resolved([promise](NonnullRefPtr<Audio::PlaybackStream>& stream) {
        promise->resolve(stream);
    });
    platform_promise->when_rejected([promise, make_data_request_callback, state, target_latency_ms](Error& error) {
        warnln("Failed to open the audio output: {}; playing into nothing", error);
        promise->resolve(Audio::NullPlaybackStream::create(state, target_latency_ms, make_data_request_callback()));
    });
    return promise;
}

// The only input device of a headless AudioServer, which opens like any other and delivers nothing.
class NullRecordStream final : public Audio::RecordStream {
public:
    explicit NullRecordStream(Audio::SampleSpecification const& specification)
        : m_specification(specification)
    {
    }

    virtual Audio::SampleSpecification const& sample_specification() const override { return m_specification; }

private:
    Audio::SampleSpecification m_specification;
};

void Tabs::set_audio_output(Audio::AudioOutput audio_output)
{
    m_audio_output = audio_output;
    if (audio_output != Audio::AudioOutput::Null)
        return;

    Audio::AudioDeviceInfo null_input_device {
        .dom_device_id = "null:input",
        .label = "Null input",
        .group_id = {},
        .sample_rate_hz = 48000,
        .channel_count = 1,
        .is_default = true,
    };
    Audio::AudioDevices::the().report_device_list(Audio::AudioDeviceEnumeration { .inputs = { move(null_input_device) }, .outputs = {} });
}

Tabs::Tab& Tabs::tab_for(u64 tab_id)
{
    return m_tabs.ensure(tab_id, [this, tab_id] {
        auto mixer = Audio::PlaybackStreamMixer::create(Core::EventLoop::current(), DEVICE_TARGET_LATENCY_MS, [audio_output = m_audio_output](Audio::OutputState state, u32 target_latency_ms, Audio::PlaybackStream::AudioDataRequestCallback callback) {
            return create_device_stream(audio_output, state, target_latency_ms, move(callback));
        });
        if (auto authorized_groups = m_authorized_playback_groups.get(tab_id); authorized_groups.has_value()) {
            for (auto group : *authorized_groups)
                mixer->set_group_authorization(group, Audio::PlaybackGroupAuthorization::Authorized);
        }
        if (auto muted_groups = m_muted_playback_groups.get(tab_id); muted_groups.has_value()) {
            for (auto group : *muted_groups)
                mixer->set_group_mute_state(group, Audio::PlaybackGroupMuteState::Muted);
        }
        mixer->on_group_audibility_changed = [this, tab_id](Audio::PlaybackGroupId group, Audio::Audibility audibility) {
            if (auto control_connection = m_control_connection.strong_ref())
                control_connection->async_playback_group_audibility_changed(tab_id, group, audibility);
        };
        return Tab { .mixer = move(mixer), .connections = {} };
    });
}

Audio::CaptureDevices& Tabs::capture_devices()
{
    if (!m_capture_devices) {
        m_capture_devices = Audio::CaptureDevices::create([audio_output = m_audio_output](Audio::SampleSpecification const& specification, u32 fragment_size_bytes, StringView device_id, Audio::RecordStream::RecordCallback callback) {
            if (audio_output == Audio::AudioOutput::Null)
                return Audio::RecordStream::CreatePromise::resolved(adopt_ref<Audio::RecordStream>(*new NullRecordStream(specification)));
            return Audio::create_platform_record_stream(specification, fragment_size_bytes, device_id, move(callback));
        });
    }
    return *m_capture_devices;
}

ErrorOr<IPC::TransportHandle> Tabs::connect_client(u64 tab_id)
{
    auto paired_transports = TRY(IPC::Transport::create_paired());
    auto handle = move(paired_transports.remote_handle);

    auto& tab = tab_for(tab_id);
    auto client_id = m_next_client_id++;
    auto connection = Audio::ServerConnection::construct(move(paired_transports.local), client_id, tab.mixer, capture_devices(), [tab_id](ByteString const& device_id, Audio::PlaybackGroupId group, Function<void(bool)> on_decided) {
        Tabs::the().request_capture_permission(tab_id, device_id, group, move(on_decided));
    });
    connection->set_capture_permitted(m_tabs_with_capture_permission.contains(tab_id));
    connection->on_death = [tab_id, client_id] {
        Tabs::the().connection_died(tab_id, client_id);
    };
    connection->on_capture_started = [tab_id](Audio::PlaybackGroupId group) {
        Tabs::the().m_capture_activity.stream_started(tab_id, group);
    };
    connection->on_capture_stopped = [tab_id](Audio::PlaybackGroupId group) {
        Tabs::the().m_capture_activity.stream_stopped(tab_id, group);
    };
    tab.connections.set(client_id, move(connection));
    return handle;
}

void Tabs::set_capture_permission(u64 tab_id, bool granted)
{
    if (granted)
        m_tabs_with_capture_permission.set(tab_id);
    else
        m_tabs_with_capture_permission.remove(tab_id);
    auto tab = m_tabs.get(tab_id);
    if (!tab.has_value())
        return;
    for (auto& [client_id, connection] : tab->connections)
        connection->set_capture_permitted(granted);
}

static void remove_group(HashMap<u64, HashTable<Audio::PlaybackGroupId>>& groups_by_tab, u64 tab_id, Audio::PlaybackGroupId group)
{
    auto groups = groups_by_tab.get(tab_id);
    if (!groups.has_value())
        return;
    groups->remove(group);
    if (groups->is_empty())
        groups_by_tab.remove(tab_id);
}

void Tabs::set_playback_group_authorization(u64 tab_id, Audio::PlaybackGroupId group, Audio::PlaybackGroupAuthorization authorization)
{
    switch (authorization) {
    case Audio::PlaybackGroupAuthorization::Authorized:
        m_authorized_playback_groups.ensure(tab_id).set(group);
        break;
    case Audio::PlaybackGroupAuthorization::Unauthorized:
        remove_group(m_authorized_playback_groups, tab_id, group);
        break;
    }
    if (auto tab = m_tabs.get(tab_id); tab.has_value())
        tab->mixer->set_group_authorization(group, authorization);
}

void Tabs::set_playback_group_mute_state(u64 tab_id, Audio::PlaybackGroupId group, Audio::PlaybackGroupMuteState mute_state)
{
    switch (mute_state) {
    case Audio::PlaybackGroupMuteState::Muted:
        m_muted_playback_groups.ensure(tab_id).set(group);
        break;
    case Audio::PlaybackGroupMuteState::Unmuted:
        remove_group(m_muted_playback_groups, tab_id, group);
        break;
    }
    if (auto tab = m_tabs.get(tab_id); tab.has_value())
        tab->mixer->set_group_mute_state(group, mute_state);
}

void Tabs::request_capture_permission(u64 tab_id, ByteString const& device_id, Audio::PlaybackGroupId group, Function<void(bool)> on_decided)
{
    auto control_connection = m_control_connection.strong_ref();
    if (!control_connection) {
        on_decided(false);
        return;
    }
    auto request_id = m_next_capture_request_id++;
    m_pending_capture_decisions.set(request_id, move(on_decided));
    control_connection->async_capture_requested(tab_id, request_id, device_id, group);
}

void Tabs::capture_decided(u64 request_id, bool allowed)
{
    if (auto on_decided = m_pending_capture_decisions.take(request_id); on_decided.has_value())
        on_decided.value()(allowed);
}

void Tabs::connection_died(u64 tab_id, int client_id)
{
    auto tab = m_tabs.get(tab_id);
    if (!tab.has_value())
        return;
    tab->connections.remove(client_id);
    if (!tab->connections.is_empty())
        return;
    tab->mixer->report_every_group_inaudible();
    m_tabs.remove(tab_id);
}

}

class ControlConnection;

// The tabs with connected client processes: each has a mixer, and the Browser's word on whether its pages hold the
// microphone permission, on which playback groups may play, and on which the user has muted.
class Tabs {
public:
    static Tabs& the();

    Tabs();

    // Decides what every tab's devices are; headless instances discard their mix into a null stream and capture from a
    // null input device.
    void set_audio_output(Audio::AudioOutput);
    // The Browser rules on every capture request, and is asked over this connection.
    void set_control_connection(ControlConnection&);

    // it, and the capture streams they have are closed without it.

    // clients, present and future, since a client can reconnect while the Browser's word stands.

    void set_playback_group_mute_state(u64 tab_id, Audio::PlaybackGroupId, Audio::PlaybackGroupMuteState);

    };

    void connection_died(u64 tab_id, int client_id);
    void request_capture_permission(u64 tab_id, ByteString const& device_id, Audio::PlaybackGroupId, Function<void(bool)> on_decided);

    HashMap<u64, Tab> m_tabs;
    HashTable<u64> m_tabs_with_capture_permission;
    HashMap<u64, HashTable<Audio::PlaybackGroupId>> m_authorized_playback_groups;
    HashMap<u64, HashTable<Audio::PlaybackGroupId>> m_muted_playback_groups;
    RefPtr<Audio::CaptureDevices> m_capture_devices;
    int m_next_client_id { 1 };
    Audio::AudioOutput m_audio_output { Audio::AudioOutput::Platform };

    WeakPtr<ControlConnection> m_control_connection;
    HashMap<u64, Function<void(bool)>> m_pending_capture_decisions;
    u64 m_next_capture_request_id { 1 };
    CaptureActivity m_capture_activity;
};

/*

 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause

#include <AK/Format.h>
#include <Compositor/AnimatedImage.h>
#include <LibGfx/Bitmap.h>

namespace Compositor {

AnimatedImage::AnimatedImage(Description description)
    : m_session_id(description.session_id)
    , m_size(description.size)
    , m_color_space(move(description.color_space))
    , m_frame_durations_in_milliseconds(move(description.frame_durations_in_milliseconds))
    , m_loop_count(description.loop_count)
{
    VERIFY(!m_frame_durations_in_milliseconds.is_empty());
    for (auto& duration : m_frame_durations_in_milliseconds) {
        duration = max(duration, MINIMUM_FRAME_DURATION_IN_MILLISECONDS);
        m_loop_duration_in_milliseconds += duration;
    }
}

void AnimatedImage::start(MonotonicTime now)
{
    // NB: With no decoder to ask for frames, the image stays on the frame it has.
    if (m_session_id == 0)
        return;
    m_start_time = now;
}

void AnimatedImage::stop()
{
    m_start_time.clear();
}

AnimatedImage::TimelinePosition AnimatedImage::position_at(MonotonicTime now) const
{
    VERIFY(m_start_time.has_value());
    auto elapsed_in_milliseconds = static_cast<u64>(max<i64>((now - *m_start_time).to_milliseconds(), 0));

    auto loops_completed = elapsed_in_milliseconds / m_loop_duration_in_milliseconds;
    if (m_loop_count > 0 && loops_completed >= m_loop_count)
        return { .loops_completed = m_loop_count, .frame_index = frame_count() - 1, .frame_end_in_milliseconds = m_loop_duration_in_milliseconds, .has_finished = true };

    auto time_in_loop = elapsed_in_milliseconds % m_loop_duration_in_milliseconds;
    u64 frame_end = 0;
    for (u32 frame_index = 0; frame_index < frame_count(); ++frame_index) {
        frame_end += m_frame_durations_in_milliseconds[frame_index];
        if (time_in_loop < frame_end)
            return { .loops_completed = loops_completed, .frame_index = frame_index, .frame_end_in_milliseconds = frame_end };
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

bool AnimatedImage::is_animating(MonotonicTime now) const
{
    return m_start_time.has_value() && !position_at(now).has_finished;
}

u32 AnimatedImage::frame_index_at(MonotonicTime now) const
{
    if (!m_start_time.has_value())
        return m_shown_frame_index;
    return position_at(now).frame_index;
}

u32 AnimatedImage::loops_completed_at(MonotonicTime now) const
{
    if (!m_start_time.has_value())
        return 0;
    return position_at(now).loops_completed;
}

MonotonicTime AnimatedImage::next_frame_time_after(MonotonicTime now) const
{
    auto position = position_at(now);
    auto elapsed_in_milliseconds = position.loops_completed * m_loop_duration_in_milliseconds + position.frame_end_in_milliseconds;
    return *m_start_time + AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(static_cast<i64>(elapsed_in_milliseconds));
}

// How far before the target frame a frame is, going round the loop.
u32 AnimatedImage::frames_behind(u32 frame_index, u32 target_frame_index) const
{
    return (target_frame_index + frame_count() - frame_index) % frame_count();
}

bool AnimatedImage::advance_to(MonotonicTime now)
{
    auto target_frame_index = frame_index_at(now);

    // A decoder that falls behind must not stop the image: take the newest frame that has arrived.
    BufferSlot const* best_slot = nullptr;
    auto fewest_frames_behind = frames_behind(m_shown_frame_index, target_frame_index);
    for (auto const& slot : m_buffer_slots) {
        if (!slot.frame_index.has_value())
            continue;
        auto slot_frames_behind = frames_behind(*slot.frame_index, target_frame_index);
        if (slot_frames_behind < fewest_frames_behind) {
            fewest_frames_behind = slot_frames_behind;
            best_slot = &slot;
        }
    }
    if (!best_slot)
        return false;

    m_shown_frame_index = *best_slot->frame_index;
    m_shown_frame = best_slot->frame;
    return true;
}

Optional<AnimatedImage::FrameRequest> AnimatedImage::take_frame_request(MonotonicTime now)
{
    if (m_request_in_flight || m_session_id == 0)
        return {};

    auto target_frame_index = frame_index_at(now);

    // Count how many frames ahead of the target are in the pool.
    u32 frames_ahead = 0;
    for (u32 offset = 1; offset <= BUFFER_POOL_SIZE; ++offset) {
        if (!find_slot((target_frame_index + offset) % frame_count()))
            break;
        ++frames_ahead;
    }

    // Ask for more when the pool is less than half full, which gives the decoder time to answer while frames remain.
    bool target_frame_is_missing = target_frame_index != m_shown_frame_index && !find_slot(target_frame_index);
    if (frames_ahead >= REQUEST_BATCH_SIZE && !target_frame_is_missing)
        return {};

    m_requested_start_frame_index = target_frame_is_missing ? target_frame_index : (target_frame_index + frames_ahead + 1) % frame_count();
    m_request_in_flight = true;
    return FrameRequest { .session_id = m_session_id, .start_frame_index = m_requested_start_frame_index, .count = REQUEST_BATCH_SIZE };
}

AnimatedImage::BufferSlot const* AnimatedImage::find_slot(u32 frame_index) const
{
    for (auto const& slot : m_buffer_slots) {
        if (slot.frame_index == frame_index)
            return &slot;
    }
    return nullptr;
}

AnimatedImage::BufferSlot& AnimatedImage::evict_oldest_slot()
{
    BufferSlot* oldest = &m_buffer_slots[0];
    for (auto& slot : m_buffer_slots) {
        if (slot.generation < oldest->generation)
            oldest = &slot;
    }
    return *oldest;
}

bool AnimatedImage::receive_frames(Vector<NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::Bitmap>> bitmaps)
{
    m_request_in_flight = false;

    bool received_new_frame = false;
    for (u32 i = 0; i < bitmaps.size(); ++i) {
        u32 frame_index = m_requested_start_frame_index + i;
        if (frame_index >= frame_count())
            break;

        // NB: The decoder parses untrusted data, so what it sends is checked rather than trusted.
        if (bitmaps[i]->size() != m_size) {
            dbgln("Compositor: Dropping an animated image frame of the wrong size");
            continue;
        }

        if (find_slot(frame_index))
            continue;

        auto frame = Gfx::DecodedImageFrame::create(*bitmaps[i], m_color_space);
        if (frame.is_error()) {
            dbgln("Compositor: Dropping an animated image frame: {}", frame.error());
            continue;
        }

        auto& slot = evict_oldest_slot();
        slot.frame_index = frame_index;
        slot.frame = frame.release_value();
        slot.generation = ++m_write_generation;
        received_new_frame = true;
    }
    return received_new_frame;
}

void AnimatedImage::decoding_failed()
{
    m_request_in_flight = false;
}

void AnimatedImage::lose_decoder()
{
    m_session_id = 0;
    m_request_in_flight = false;
    stop();
    for (auto& slot : m_buffer_slots)
        slot = {};
}

}

FILE: Services/Compositor/AnimatedImage.h
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#pragma once

#include <AK/Array.h>
#include <AK/NonnullRefPtr.h>
#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <AK/Time.h>
#include <AK/Types.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <AK/kmalloc.h>
#include <LibGfx/ColorSpace.h>
#include <LibGfx/DecodedImageFrame.h>
#include <LibGfx/Forward.h>
#include <LibGfx/Size.h>

namespace Compositor {

// A multi-frame image that advances by the clock, whatever the page's main thread is doing. The frames come straight
// from the image decoder of the page's process, a few at a time.
class AnimatedImage {
public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    struct Description {
        i64 session_id { 0 };
        Gfx::IntSize size;
        Gfx::ColorSpace color_space;
        Vector<u32> frame_durations_in_milliseconds;
        u32 loop_count { 0 };
    };

    struct FrameRequest {
        i64 session_id { 0 };
        u32 start_frame_index { 0 };
        u32 count { 0 };
    };

    explicit AnimatedImage(Description);

    i64 session_id() const { return m_session_id; }

    void start(MonotonicTime now);
    void stop();

    // Whether the image still has frames to move through.
    bool is_animating(MonotonicTime now) const;
    u32 frame_index_at(MonotonicTime now) const;
    u32 loops_completed_at(MonotonicTime now) const;
    MonotonicTime next_frame_time_after(MonotonicTime now) const;

    // Moves to the frame for the time, or as near it as the frames that have arrived allow. Returns whether the image
    // now shows another frame.
    bool advance_to(MonotonicTime now);
    Optional<Gfx::DecodedImageFrame> const& shown_frame() const { return m_shown_frame; }
    u32 shown_frame_index() const { return m_shown_frame_index; }

    // The frames to ask the decoder for next, if any. The caller must ask for them.
    Optional<FrameRequest> take_frame_request(MonotonicTime now);
    // Returns whether any of the frames is one the image did not have.
    bool receive_frames(Vector<NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::Bitmap>>);
    void decoding_failed();
    // The decoder this image's session was on is gone. The image keeps showing the frame it has.
    void lose_decoder();

private:
    static constexpr u32 BUFFER_POOL_SIZE = 8;
    static constexpr u32 REQUEST_BATCH_SIZE = 4;
    // NB: The decoders hand out what the file says, which can be 0 for each frame of a loop.
    static constexpr u32 MINIMUM_FRAME_DURATION_IN_MILLISECONDS = 10;

    struct BufferSlot {
        Optional<u32> frame_index;
        Optional<Gfx::DecodedImageFrame> frame;
        u64 generation { 0 };
    };

    struct TimelinePosition {
        u64 loops_completed { 0 };
        u32 frame_index { 0 };
        // When the frame ends, in milliseconds since the start of its loop.
        u64 frame_end_in_milliseconds { 0 };
        bool has_finished { false };
    };

    u32 frame_count() const { return m_frame_durations_in_milliseconds.size(); }
    TimelinePosition position_at(MonotonicTime now) const;
    BufferSlot const* find_slot(u32 frame_index) const;
    BufferSlot& evict_oldest_slot();
    u32 frames_behind(u32 frame_index, u32 target_frame_index) const;

    i64 m_session_id { 0 };
    Gfx::IntSize m_size;
    Gfx::ColorSpace m_color_space;
    Vector<u32> m_frame_durations_in_milliseconds;
    u64 m_loop_duration_in_milliseconds { 0 };
    u32 m_loop_count { 0 };

    Optional<MonotonicTime> m_start_time;

    Array<BufferSlot, BUFFER_POOL_SIZE> m_buffer_slots;
    u64 m_write_generation { 0 };
    bool m_request_in_flight { false };
    u32 m_requested_start_frame_index { 0 };

    // Until a frame arrives from the decoder, the display list's own frame 0 shows.
    Optional<Gfx::DecodedImageFrame> m_shown_frame;
    u32 m_shown_frame_index { 0 };
};

}

#include <AK/AnyOf.h>
#include <Compositor/BackingStoreFactory.h>
#include <Compositor/PaintingSurface.h>
#include <Compositor/SkiaBackendContext.h>
#include <LibGfx/Bitmap.h>
#include <LibGfx/SharedImageBuffer.h>

#ifdef USE_VULKAN_DMABUF_IMAGES
#    include <AK/Array.h>
#    include <LibGfx/VulkanImage.h>
#    include <libdrm/drm_fourcc.h>
#endif

#ifdef USE_DIRECTX
#    include <LibGfx/D3DSharedTexture.h>
#endif

namespace Compositor {

#if defined(USE_DIRECTX) || defined(USE_VULKAN)
static NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::PaintingSurface> create_gpu_painting_surface_with_bitmap_flush(Gfx::IntSize size, Gfx::SharedImageBuffer& buffer, RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext> const& skia_backend_context)
{
    auto surface = Gfx::PaintingSurface::create_with_size(size, Gfx::BitmapFormat::BGRA8888, Gfx::AlphaType::Premultiplied, skia_backend_context, {}, Gfx::PaintingSurface::TextAntialiasing::LCD);
    auto bitmap = buffer.bitmap();
    surface->set_on_flush([bitmap = move(bitmap)](auto& surface) {
        surface.read_into_bitmap(*bitmap);
    });
    return surface;
}
#endif

static NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::PaintingSurface> create_shareable_bitmap_backing_store([[maybe_unused]] Gfx::IntSize size, Gfx::SharedImageBuffer& buffer, RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext> const& skia_backend_context)
{
#ifdef AK_OS_MACOS
    if (skia_backend_context)
        return Gfx::PaintingSurface::create_from_shared_image_buffer(buffer, *skia_backend_context);
#else
#    if defined(USE_DIRECTX) || defined(USE_VULKAN)
    if (skia_backend_context)
        return create_gpu_painting_surface_with_bitmap_flush(size, buffer, skia_backend_context);
#    else
    (void)skia_backend_context;
#    endif
#endif

    return Gfx::PaintingSurface::wrap_bitmap(*buffer.bitmap(), Gfx::PaintingSurface::TextAntialiasing::LCD);
}

#if defined(USE_VULKAN_DMABUF_IMAGES) || defined(USE_DIRECTX)
struct GpuBackingStore {
    RefPtr<Gfx::PaintingSurface> surface;
    Gfx::SharedImage shared_image;
};
#endif

static Vector<u64>& presentation_drm_format_modifiers()
{
    static Vector<u64> modifiers;
    return modifiers;
}

void set_presentation_drm_format_modifiers(Vector<u64> modifiers)
{
    presentation_drm_format_modifiers() = move(modifiers);
}

#ifdef USE_VULKAN_DMABUF_IMAGES
// A presentation on another GPU can only import a linear layout. On ours, the driver picks a layout that suits it among
// those the presentation can import, which matters to GPUs such as NVIDIA's that cannot render to a linear one at all.
static Vector<u64> shared_backing_store_drm_format_modifiers(Gfx::VulkanContext const& vulkan_context)
{
    if (!vulkan_context.is_preferred_device)
        return { DRM_FORMAT_MOD_LINEAR };

    auto modifiers = Gfx::renderable_drm_format_modifiers(vulkan_context, VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM);
    // NB: The presentation can still show frames that it cannot import, after the view reads them back.
    auto const& importable_modifiers = presentation_drm_format_modifiers();
    if (any_of(modifiers, [&](u64 modifier) { return importable_modifiers.contains_slow(modifier); }))
        modifiers.remove_all_matching([&](u64 modifier) { return !importable_modifiers.contains_slow(modifier); });
    // NB: A linear layout is the slowest to paint into, so it is only used when there is nothing else.
    if (any_of(modifiers, [](u64 modifier) { return modifier != DRM_FORMAT_MOD_LINEAR; }))
        modifiers.remove_all_matching([](u64 modifier) { return modifier == DRM_FORMAT_MOD_LINEAR; });
    return modifiers;
}

static ErrorOr<GpuBackingStore> create_shared_gpu_backing_store(Gfx::IntSize size, Gfx::SkiaBackendContext& skia_backend_context)
{
    auto const& vulkan_context = skia_backend_context.vulkan_context();
    auto const modifiers = shared_backing_store_drm_format_modifiers(vulkan_context);
    auto image = TRY(Gfx::create_shared_vulkan_image(vulkan_context, size.width(), size.height(), VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM, modifiers.span()));
    auto shared_image = Gfx::duplicate_shared_image(*image);

    return GpuBackingStore {
        .surface = Gfx::PaintingSurface::create_from_vkimage(skia_backend_context, move(image), Gfx::PaintingSurface::Origin::TopLeft, Gfx::PaintingSurface::TextAntialiasing::LCD),
        .shared_image = move(shared_image),
    };
}
#endif

#ifdef USE_DIRECTX
static ErrorOr<GpuBackingStore> create_shared_gpu_backing_store(Gfx::IntSize size, Gfx::SkiaBackendContext& skia_backend_context)
{
    auto texture = TRY(Gfx::D3DSharedTexture::create(skia_backend_context.direct3d_context(), size));
    auto shared_image = Gfx::duplicate_shared_image(*texture);

    return GpuBackingStore {
        .surface = TRY(Gfx::PaintingSurface::create_from_d3d_texture(skia_backend_context, move(texture))),
        .shared_image = move(shared_image),
    };
}
#endif

static ErrorOr<NewBackingStore> create_shared_bitmap_backing_store(Gfx::IntSize size, RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext> const& skia_backend_context)
{
    auto shared_image_buffer = make<Gfx::SharedImageBuffer>(Gfx::SharedImageBuffer::create(size));
    auto surface = create_shareable_bitmap_backing_store(size, *shared_image_buffer, skia_backend_context);
    auto shared_image = shared_image_buffer->export_shared_image();
    return NewBackingStore {
        .surface = move(surface),
        .window_server_surface = nullptr,
        .shared_image_buffer = move(shared_image_buffer),
        .shared_image = move(shared_image),
    };
}

static ErrorOr<NewBackingStore> create_shared_gpu_image_backing_store([[maybe_unused]] Gfx::IntSize size, [[maybe_unused]] RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext> const& skia_backend_context)
{
#if defined(USE_VULKAN_DMABUF_IMAGES) || defined(USE_DIRECTX)
    if (!skia_backend_context)
        return Error::from_string_literal("Shared GPU images need a GPU");
    auto backing_store = create_shared_gpu_backing_store(size, *skia_backend_context);
    if (backing_store.is_error()) {
        static bool reported_failure = false;
        if (!reported_failure) {
            dbgln("Failed to allocate shared GPU backing store ({}), falling back to shareable bitmaps", backing_store.error());
            reported_failure = true;
        }
        return backing_store.release_error();
    }
    auto store = backing_store.release_value();
    return NewBackingStore {
        .surface = store.surface.release_nonnull(),
        .window_server_surface = nullptr,
        .shared_image_buffer = nullptr,
        .shared_image = move(store.shared_image),
    };
#else
    return Error::from_string_literal("Shared GPU images are not supported on this platform");
#endif
}

ErrorOr<NewBackingStore> create_backing_store(RustFFI::StoreKind kind, Gfx::IntSize size, RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext> const& skia_backend_context, WindowServer* window_server_showing_stores)
{
    switch (kind) {
    case RustFFI::StoreKind::Offscreen:
        return NewBackingStore {
            .surface = TRY(Gfx::PaintingSurface::try_create_with_size(size, Gfx::BitmapFormat::BGRA8888, Gfx::AlphaType::Premultiplied, skia_backend_context)),
            .window_server_surface = nullptr,
            .shared_image_buffer = nullptr,
            .shared_image = {},
        };
    case RustFFI::StoreKind::SharedBitmap:
        return create_shared_bitmap_backing_store(size, skia_backend_context);
    case RustFFI::StoreKind::SharedGpuImage:
        return create_shared_gpu_image_backing_store(size, skia_backend_context);
    case RustFFI::StoreKind::ShownByWindowServer: {
        if (!window_server_showing_stores)
            return Error::from_string_literal("No window server shows the stores");
        auto surface = TRY(window_server_showing_stores->try_create_presentable_surface(size, skia_backend_context));
        return NewBackingStore {
            .surface = surface->painting_surface(),
            .window_server_surface = move(surface),
            .shared_image_buffer = nullptr,
            .shared_image = {},
        };
    }
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

bool shared_image_buffer_is_in_use([[maybe_unused]] Gfx::SharedImageBuffer const& buffer)
{
#ifdef AK_OS_MACOS
    // The send right exported to the UI counts as use as well, so a freshly published store reads as in use until the
    // UI has imported it.
    return buffer.iosurface_handle().is_in_use();
#else
    return false;
#endif
}

}

#include <AK/ByteReader.h>

namespace Gfx {

StringView export_format_name(ExportFormat format)
{
    switch (format) {
#define ENUMERATE_EXPORT_FORMAT(format) \
    case Gfx::ExportFormat::format:     \
        return #format##sv;
        ENUMERATE_EXPORT_FORMATS(ENUMERATE_EXPORT_FORMAT)
#undef ENUMERATE_EXPORT_FORMAT
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

static int bytes_per_pixel_for_export_format(ExportFormat format)
{
    switch (format) {
    case ExportFormat::Luminance8:
    case ExportFormat::Alpha8:
        return 1;
    case ExportFormat::LuminanceAlpha88:
    case ExportFormat::RGB565:
    case ExportFormat::RGBA5551:
    case ExportFormat::RGBA4444:
        return 2;
    case ExportFormat::RGB888:
        return 3;
    case ExportFormat::RGBA8888:
        return 4;
    default:
        VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
    }
}

static SkColorType export_format_to_skia_color_type(ExportFormat format)
{
    switch (format) {
    case ExportFormat::Alpha8:
        return SkColorType::kAlpha_8_SkColorType;
    case ExportFormat::RGB565:
        return SkColorType::kRGB_565_SkColorType;
    case ExportFormat::RGBA4444:
        return SkColorType::kARGB_4444_SkColorType;
    case ExportFormat::Luminance8:
    case ExportFormat::LuminanceAlpha88:
    case ExportFormat::RGBA5551:
    case ExportFormat::RGB888:
        // These need to be converted manually because Skia has no color type for them.
        VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
    case ExportFormat::RGBA8888:
        return SkColorType::kRGBA_8888_SkColorType;
    default:
        VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
    }
}

static ErrorOr<void> draw_bitmap_into_pixels(Bitmap const& bitmap, ColorSpace const& color_space, SkColorType color_type, int flags, int width, int height, void* pixels, size_t pitch)
{
    auto image = sk_image_from_bitmap(bitmap, color_space);
    if (!image)
        return Error::from_string_literal("Failed to create a Skia image for this Bitmap");

    auto image_info = SkImageInfo::Make(
        width,
        height,
        color_type,
        flags & ExportFlags::PremultiplyAlpha ? SkAlphaType::kPremul_SkAlphaType : SkAlphaType::kUnpremul_SkAlphaType,
        SkColorSpace::MakeSRGB());
    auto surface = SkSurfaces::WrapPixels(image_info, pixels, pitch);
    if (!surface)
        return Error::from_string_literal("Failed to create a Skia surface for the exported pixels");
    auto* surface_canvas = surface->getCanvas();
    auto dst_rect = Gfx::to_skia_rect(Gfx::Rect { 0, 0, width, height });

    if (flags & ExportFlags::FlipY) {
        surface_canvas->translate(0, dst_rect.height());
        surface_canvas->scale(1, -1);
    }

    surface_canvas->drawImageRect(
        image.get(),
        dst_rect,
        Gfx::to_skia_sampling_options(Gfx::ScalingMode::NearestNeighbor));
    return {};
}

ErrorOr<BitmapExportResult> export_bitmap_to_byte_buffer(
    Bitmap const& bitmap,
    ColorSpace const& color_space,
    ExportFormat format,
    int flags,
    Optional<int> target_width,
    Optional<int> target_height)
{
    int width = target_width.value_or(bitmap.width());
    int height = target_height.value_or(bitmap.height());

    Checked<size_t> buffer_pitch = width;
    int number_of_bytes = bytes_per_pixel_for_export_format(format);
    buffer_pitch *= number_of_bytes;
    if (buffer_pitch.has_overflow())
        return Error::from_string_literal("Gfx::export_bitmap_to_byte_buffer size overflow");

    if (Checked<size_t>::multiplication_would_overflow(buffer_pitch.value(), height))
        return Error::from_string_literal("Gfx::export_bitmap_to_byte_buffer size overflow");

    auto buffer = MUST(ByteBuffer::create_zeroed(buffer_pitch.value() * height));

    if (width > 0 && height > 0) {
        if (format == ExportFormat::RGB888 || format == ExportFormat::RGBA5551 || format == ExportFormat::Luminance8 || format == ExportFormat::LuminanceAlpha88) {
            // Skia has no color type for 24 bit RGB, for 16 bit RGBA with 1 bit of alpha, or for a luminance that's the
            // red channel (its gray color type weighs all three channels), so we draw into 32 bit RGBA and pack that.
            Checked<size_t> rgba_pitch = width;
            rgba_pitch *= 4;
            if (rgba_pitch.has_overflow() || Checked<size_t>::multiplication_would_overflow(rgba_pitch.value(), height))
                return Error::from_string_literal("Gfx::export_bitmap_to_byte_buffer size overflow");
            auto rgba_buffer = TRY(ByteBuffer::create_zeroed(rgba_pitch.value() * height));
            TRY(draw_bitmap_into_pixels(bitmap, color_space, SkColorType::kRGBA_8888_SkColorType, flags, width, height, rgba_buffer.data(), rgba_pitch.value()));

            for (auto y = 0; y < height; y++) {
                auto const* source_row = rgba_buffer.data() + (y * rgba_pitch.value());
                auto* destination_row = buffer.data() + (y * buffer_pitch.value());
                for (auto x = 0; x < width; x++) {
                    auto const* source = source_row + (x * 4ull);
                    switch (format) {
                    case ExportFormat::RGB888:
                        destination_row[(x * 3ull) + 0] = source[0];
                        destination_row[(x * 3ull) + 1] = source[1];
                        destination_row[(x * 3ull) + 2] = source[2];
                        break;
                    case ExportFormat::RGBA5551: {
                        u16 pixel = ((source[0] >> 3) << 11) | ((source[1] >> 3) << 6) | ((source[2] >> 3) << 1) | (source[3] >> 7);
                        ByteReader::store(destination_row + (x * 2ull), pixel);
                        break;
                    }
                    case ExportFormat::Luminance8:
                        destination_row[x] = source[0];
                        break;
                    case ExportFormat::LuminanceAlpha88:
                        destination_row[(x * 2ull) + 0] = source[0];
                        destination_row[(x * 2ull) + 1] = source[3];
                        break;
                    default:
                        VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            TRY(draw_bitmap_into_pixels(bitmap, color_space, export_format_to_skia_color_type(format), flags, width, height, buffer.data(), buffer_pitch.value()));
        }
    } else {
        VERIFY(buffer.is_empty());
    }

    return BitmapExportResult {
        .buffer = move(buffer),
        .width = width,
        .height = height,
    };
}

}
