// NB: GPU canvases share the compositor's Skia context.
struct Gfx::DecodedImageFrameRasterizerData final : public Gfx::RasterizerData {
    sk_sp<SkImage> raster_image;
    sk_sp<SkImage> gpu_image;
};

namespace Compositor {

using namespace Compositing;

ErrorOr<NonnullOwnPtr<Canvas2DCommandPlayer>> Canvas2DCommandPlayer::create(RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext> skia_backend_context, Gfx::IntSize size, Gfx::BitmapFormat format, Gfx::AlphaType alpha_type, Gfx::ColorSpace const& color_space, Resolvers resolvers)
{
    auto surface = TRY(Gfx::PaintingSurface::try_create_with_size(size, format, alpha_type, move(skia_backend_context), color_space));
    return make<Canvas2DCommandPlayer>(move(surface), color_space, move(resolvers));
}

Canvas2DCommandPlayer::Canvas2DCommandPlayer(NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::PaintingSurface> surface, Gfx::ColorSpace const& color_space, Resolvers resolvers)
    : m_color_space(color_space)
    , m_surface(move(surface))
    , m_initial_save_count(m_surface->canvas().save())
    , m_resolvers(move(resolvers))
{
}

Canvas2DCommandPlayer::~Canvas2DCommandPlayer() = default;

sk_sp<SkImage> Canvas2DCommandPlayer::image_of_frame(Gfx::DecodedImageFrame const& frame) const
{
    auto& images = frame.identity().rasterizer_data().get([] { return make<Gfx::DecodedImageFrameRasterizerData>(); });
    auto skia_backend_context = m_surface->skia_backend_context();
    auto& cached_image = skia_backend_context ? images.gpu_image : images.raster_image;
    if (cached_image)
        return cached_image;

    if (skia_backend_context) {
        if (auto texture_image = Gfx::sk_texture_image_sharing_pixels_of_decoded_image_frame(frame, *skia_backend_context)) {
            cached_image = texture_image;
            return texture_image;
        }
    }

    cached_image = Gfx::sk_image_adopting_bitmap(frame.bitmap_sharing_pixels(), frame.color_space());
    return cached_image;
}

NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::PaintingSurface> Canvas2DCommandPlayer::surface() const
{
    return m_surface;
}

void Canvas2DCommandPlayer::clear(Gfx::Color color)
{
    clear_rect({ {}, m_surface->size().to_type<float>() }, color);
}

void Canvas2DCommandPlayer::play_command(DisplayListCommandType command_type, ReadonlyBytes payload)
{
    m_payload = payload;
    switch (command_type) {
#define PLAY_CANVAS_2D_COMMAND(command_type)                                        \
    case DisplayListCommandType::command_type:                                      \
        play_command(read_display_list_object<Compositing::command_type>(payload)); \
        break;
        ENUMERATE_CANVAS_2D_COMMANDS(PLAY_CANVAS_2D_COMMAND)
#undef PLAY_CANVAS_2D_COMMAND
    default:
        // NB: Validation lets only the commands of the canvas 2D stream onto the tape of a canvas.
        VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
    }
    m_payload = {};
}

ReadonlyBytes Canvas2DCommandPlayer::inline_data(DisplayListDataSpan span) const
{
    return m_payload.slice(span.offset, span.size);
}

// NB: The tape is not aligned for the values of an array span, so they are copied out.
template<typename T>
static Vector<T> inline_objects(ReadonlyBytes bytes)
{
    Vector<T> objects;
    objects.resize(bytes.size() / sizeof(T));
    if (!objects.is_empty())
        __builtin_memcpy(objects.data(), bytes.data(), objects.size() * sizeof(T));
    return objects;
}

SkPath Canvas2DCommandPlayer::path_from(DisplayListDataSpan path_data) const
{
    return Gfx::skia_path_from_serialized_bytes(inline_data(path_data));
}

sk_sp<SkImageFilter> Canvas2DCommandPlayer::image_filter_from(Canvas2DCompositing const& compositing) const
{
    if (!compositing.has_filter)
        return nullptr;
    return Gfx::to_skia_image_filter(inline_data(compositing.filter), [](u64) -> Gfx::DecodedImageFrame const& {
        // A canvas filter comes from CSS filter functions, which draw no images.
        VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
    });
}

SkColorSpace* Canvas2DCommandPlayer::surface_color_space() const
{
    return m_surface->sk_surface().imageInfo().colorSpace();
}

Optional<SkPaint> Canvas2DCommandPlayer::paint_from(Canvas2DPaint const& style, Canvas2DCompositing const& compositing) const
{
    SkPaint paint;
    auto* color_space = surface_color_space();

    auto set_shader_with_color_stops = [&](auto make_shader) {
        auto stop_colors = inline_objects<Gfx::Color>(inline_data(style.color_stops.colors));
        auto positions = inline_objects<float>(inline_data(style.color_stops.positions));
        Vector<SkColor4f> colors;
        colors.ensure_capacity(stop_colors.size());
        for (auto const& color : stop_colors)
            colors.unchecked_append(Gfx::to_skia_color4f(color));
        SkGradient gradient { SkGradient::Colors { { colors.data(), colors.size() }, { positions.data(), positions.size() }, SkTileMode::kClamp, sk_ref_sp(color_space) }, {} };
        paint.setShader(make_shader(gradient));
    };

    switch (style.kind) {
    case Canvas2DPaintKind::Color:
        paint.setColor(Gfx::to_skia_color4f(style.color), color_space);
        break;
    case Canvas2DPaintKind::LinearGradient: {
        // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-createlineargradient
        // If x0 = x1 and y0 = y1, then the linear gradient must paint nothing.
        if (style.start_point == style.end_point) {
            paint.setColor(SK_ColorTRANSPARENT);
            break;
        }
        Array points { Gfx::to_skia_point(style.start_point), Gfx::to_skia_point(style.end_point) };
        set_shader_with_color_stops([&](SkGradient const& gradient) {
            return SkShaders::LinearGradient(points.data(), gradient);
        });
        break;
    }
    case Canvas2DPaintKind::RadialGradient:
        // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-createradialgradient
        // 1. If x0 = x1 and y0 = y1 and r0 = r1, then the radial gradient must paint nothing. Return.
        if (style.start_point == style.end_point && style.start_radius == style.end_radius) {
            paint.setColor(SK_ColorTRANSPARENT);
            break;
        }
        set_shader_with_color_stops([&](SkGradient const& gradient) {
            return SkShaders::TwoPointConicalGradient(Gfx::to_skia_point(style.start_point), style.start_radius, Gfx::to_skia_point(style.end_point), style.end_radius, gradient);
        });
        break;
    case Canvas2DPaintKind::ConicGradient: {
        // NB: The angles of a Skia sweep gradient pick where its colors start and end, and every angle outside of them
        //     takes the color of the nearest end. So the gradient is rotated to its start angle instead.
        SkMatrix rotation_to_start_angle;
        rotation_to_start_angle.setRotate(AK::to_degrees(style.start_angle), style.start_point.x(), style.start_point.y());
        set_shader_with_color_stops([&](SkGradient const& gradient) {
            return SkShaders::SweepGradient(Gfx::to_skia_point(style.start_point), 0, 360, gradient, &rotation_to_start_angle);
        });
        break;
    }
    case Canvas2DPaintKind::Pattern: {
        if (!style.pattern_has_image)
            break;
        auto const* frame = m_resolvers.image_frame(style.pattern_image_id.value());
        if (!frame)
            return {};
        auto image = image_of_frame(*frame);
        if (!image)
            break;

        auto repeat_x = first_is_one_of(style.pattern_repetition, Canvas2DPatternRepetition::Repeat, Canvas2DPatternRepetition::RepeatX);
        auto repeat_y = first_is_one_of(style.pattern_repetition, Canvas2DPatternRepetition::Repeat, Canvas2DPatternRepetition::RepeatY);

        // FIXME: Implement sampling configuration.
        SkSamplingOptions sampling_options { SkFilterMode::kLinear };
        Optional<SkMatrix> pattern_matrix;
        if (style.pattern_transform.has_value())
            pattern_matrix = Gfx::to_skia_matrix(*style.pattern_transform);
        paint.setShader(image->makeShader(
            repeat_x ? SkTileMode::kRepeat : SkTileMode::kDecal,
            repeat_y ? SkTileMode::kRepeat : SkTileMode::kDecal,
            sampling_options,
            pattern_matrix.has_value() ? &pattern_matrix.value() : nullptr));
        break;
    }
    }

    paint.setAlphaf(paint.getAlphaf() * compositing.global_alpha);
    paint.setImageFilter(image_filter_from(compositing));
    return paint;
}

// NB: These operators change the destination even where the source is fully transparent, which makes them affect
//     pixels that the source does not cover.
static bool affects_pixels_not_covered_by_source(Gfx::CompositingAndBlendingOperator compositing_and_blending_operator)
{
    return first_is_one_of(compositing_and_blending_operator,
        Gfx::CompositingAndBlendingOperator::Copy,
        Gfx::CompositingAndBlendingOperator::SourceIn,
        Gfx::CompositingAndBlendingOperator::SourceOut,
        Gfx::CompositingAndBlendingOperator::DestinationIn,
        Gfx::CompositingAndBlendingOperator::DestinationATop);
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#drawing-model
template<typename Callback>
static void draw_with_compositing(SkCanvas& canvas, SkPaint& paint, Canvas2DCompositing const& compositing, Callback draw)
{
    auto compositing_and_blending_operator = compositing.compositing_and_blending_operator;

    // 5. When shadows are drawn, render the shadow from image B, using the current shadow styles, creating image C.
    // 6. When shadows are drawn, composite C within the clipping region over the current output bitmap using the
    //    current compositing and blending operator.
    // NB: The current transformation matrix does not affect the offset and the blur of a shadow, so the source is
    //     drawn into a layer whose filter makes the shadow in the coordinates of the canvas. The paint carries the
    //     global alpha and the filter of the context, so the layer holds image B.
    if (compositing.has_shadow) {
        auto const& shadow = compositing.shadow;
        auto matrix = canvas.getTotalMatrix();
        canvas.save();
        canvas.resetMatrix();
        auto sigma = shadow.blur / 2;
        SkPaint shadow_layer_paint;
        shadow_layer_paint.setImageFilter(SkImageFilters::DropShadowOnly(shadow.offset_x, shadow.offset_y, sigma, sigma, Gfx::to_skia_color4f(shadow.color), sk_ref_sp(canvas.imageInfo().colorSpace()), nullptr));
        shadow_layer_paint.setBlender(Gfx::to_skia_blender(compositing_and_blending_operator));
        canvas.saveLayer(nullptr, &shadow_layer_paint);
        canvas.setMatrix(matrix);
        draw(canvas, paint);
        canvas.restore();
        canvas.restore();
    }

    // 7. Composite B within the clipping region over the current output bitmap using the current compositing and
    //    blending operator.
    // NB: A Skia blend mode only touches the pixels that a draw covers. For the operators that also affect uncovered
    //     pixels, the source is drawn into a transparent layer, which is then composited onto all of the destination
    //     inside the clip.
    if (!affects_pixels_not_covered_by_source(compositing_and_blending_operator)) {
        paint.setBlender(Gfx::to_skia_blender(compositing_and_blending_operator));
        draw(canvas, paint);
        return;
    }

    SkPaint layer_paint;
    layer_paint.setBlender(Gfx::to_skia_blender(compositing_and_blending_operator));
    canvas.saveLayer(nullptr, &layer_paint);
    draw(canvas, paint);
    canvas.restore();
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#trace-a-path
static SkPath prune_path_for_stroking(SkPath const& path)
{
    // 2. Prune all zero-length line segments from path.
    // 3. Remove from path any subpaths containing no lines (i.e. subpaths with just one point).
    // NB: Skia strokes a zero-length segment with caps, so such segments and the subpaths that are left with no
    //     lines are removed before the path is stroked.
    auto is_zero_length = [](SkSpan<SkPoint const> points) {
        for (size_t i = 1; i < points.size(); ++i) {
            if (points[i] != points[0])
                return false;
        }
        return true;
    };

    SkPathBuilder builder(path.getFillType());
    bool subpath_has_lines = false;
    auto iterator = path.iter();
    while (auto record = iterator.next()) {
        auto points = record->fPoints;
        switch (record->fVerb) {
        case SkPathVerb::kMove:
            subpath_has_lines = false;
            continue;
        case SkPathVerb::kClose:
            if (subpath_has_lines)
                builder.close();
            subpath_has_lines = false;
            continue;
        case SkPathVerb::kLine:
        case SkPathVerb::kQuad:
        case SkPathVerb::kConic:
        case SkPathVerb::kCubic:
            break;
        }

        if (is_zero_length(points))
            continue;
        if (!subpath_has_lines) {
            builder.moveTo(points[0]);
            subpath_has_lines = true;
        }
        switch (record->fVerb) {
        case SkPathVerb::kLine:
            builder.lineTo(points[1]);
            break;
        case SkPathVerb::kQuad:
            builder.quadTo(points[1], points[2]);
            break;
        case SkPathVerb::kConic:
            builder.conicTo(points[1], points[2], record->conicWeight());
            break;
        case SkPathVerb::kCubic:
            builder.cubicTo(points[1], points[2], points[3]);
            break;
        default:
            VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
        }
    }
    return builder.detach();
}

void Canvas2DCommandPlayer::play_command(Canvas2DFillPath const& command)
{
    auto path = path_from(command.path_data);
    path.setFillType(Gfx::to_skia_path_fill_type(command.winding_rule));
    auto paint = paint_from(command.paint, command.compositing);
    if (!paint.has_value())
        return;
    paint->setAntiAlias(true);
    draw_with_compositing(m_surface->canvas(), *paint, command.compositing, [&](SkCanvas& canvas, SkPaint const& paint) {
        canvas.drawPath(path, paint);
    });
}

void Canvas2DCommandPlayer::play_command(Canvas2DStrokePath const& command)
{
    // Skia treats zero thickness as a special case and will draw a hairline, while we want to draw nothing.
    if (command.thickness <= 0)
        return;

    auto path = prune_path_for_stroking(path_from(command.path_data));
    auto dash_array = inline_objects<float>(inline_data(command.dash_array));
    auto paint = paint_from(command.paint, command.compositing);
    if (!paint.has_value())
        return;
    paint->setAntiAlias(true);
    paint->setStyle(SkPaint::Style::kStroke_Style);
    paint->setStrokeWidth(command.thickness);
    paint->setStrokeCap(Gfx::to_skia_cap(command.cap_style));
    paint->setStrokeJoin(Gfx::to_skia_join(command.join_style));
    paint->setStrokeMiter(command.miter_limit);
    paint->setPathEffect(SkDashPathEffect::Make({ dash_array.data(), dash_array.size() }, command.dash_offset));
    draw_with_compositing(m_surface->canvas(), *paint, command.compositing, [&](SkCanvas& canvas, SkPaint const& paint) {
        canvas.drawPath(path, paint);
    });
}

void Canvas2DCommandPlayer::play_command(Canvas2DDrawGlyphRuns const& command)
{
    if (!m_resolvers.font)
        return;
    auto paint = paint_from(command.paint, command.compositing);
    if (!paint.has_value())
        return;

    struct SkiaGlyphRun {
        SkFont font;
        Vector<SkGlyphID, 32> glyph_ids;
        Vector<SkPoint, 32> glyph_positions;
    };

    auto tape_glyphs = inline_objects<DisplayListGlyph>(inline_data(command.glyphs));
    auto tape_runs = inline_objects<Canvas2DGlyphRun>(inline_data(command.runs));
    Vector<SkiaGlyphRun, 2> skia_runs;
    skia_runs.ensure_capacity(tape_runs.size());
    size_t first_glyph = 0;
    for (auto const& run : tape_runs) {
        // NB: The tape validation guarantees that the runs split the glyphs exactly.
        auto run_glyphs = tape_glyphs.span().slice(first_glyph, run.glyph_count);
        first_glyph += run.glyph_count;
        auto const* font = m_resolvers.font(run.font_id.value());
        if (!font || run_glyphs.is_empty() || font->is_invisible())
            continue;

        auto sk_font = skia_font(*font, 1);
        if (!sk_font.has_value())
            continue;

        SkiaGlyphRun skia_run { .font = sk_font.release_value(), .glyph_ids = {}, .glyph_positions = {} };

        // NB: Preserve canvas text's fractional baseline and unhinted outline geometry.
        skia_run.font.setHinting(SkFontHinting::kNone);
        skia_run.font.setForceAutoHinting(false);
        skia_run.font.setBaselineSnap(false);

        // NB: The scale goes on the font rather than the canvas, as it must not scale the paint of the text.
        skia_run.font.setScaleX(skia_run.font.getScaleX() * command.horizontal_scale);

        skia_run.glyph_ids.ensure_capacity(run_glyphs.size());
        skia_run.glyph_positions.ensure_capacity(run_glyphs.size());
        auto font_ascent = font->pixel_metrics().ascent;
        for (auto const& glyph : run_glyphs) {
            skia_run.glyph_ids.unchecked_append(static_cast<SkGlyphID>(glyph.glyph_id));
            skia_run.glyph_positions.unchecked_append({ glyph.position.x() * command.horizontal_scale, glyph.position.y() + font_ascent });
        }
        skia_runs.unchecked_append(move(skia_run));
    }

    // NB: Not drawTextBlob(). Skia caches a drawn SkTextBlob once per subpixel origin, and finds a cached entry by
    //     scanning every entry of that blob. Canvas text is often redrawn at moving fractional positions, which
    //     piles up thousands of entries per blob and makes each draw scan all of them.
    draw_with_compositing(m_surface->canvas(), *paint, command.compositing, [&](SkCanvas& canvas, SkPaint const& paint) {
        auto draw_runs = [&](SkPaint const& run_paint) {
            for (auto const& run : skia_runs)
                canvas.drawGlyphs({ run.glyph_ids.data(), run.glyph_ids.size() }, { run.glyph_positions.data(), run.glyph_positions.size() }, Gfx::to_skia_point(command.translation), run.font, run_paint);
        };

        if (skia_runs.size() <= 1 || !paint.getImageFilter()) {
            draw_runs(paint);
            return;
        }

        // NB: The filter of the context applies to the text as a whole, so it goes on a layer that holds all runs.
        //     Otherwise, what the filter makes of one run would land on top of the other runs.
        SkPaint layer_paint;
        layer_paint.setImageFilter(paint.refImageFilter());
        layer_paint.setBlender(paint.refBlender());
        SkPaint run_paint = paint;
        run_paint.setImageFilter(nullptr);
        run_paint.setBlender(nullptr);
        canvas.saveLayer(nullptr, &layer_paint);
        draw_runs(run_paint);
        canvas.restore();
    });
}

void Canvas2DCommandPlayer::clear_rect(Gfx::FloatRect const& rect, Gfx::Color color)
{
    auto& canvas = m_surface->canvas();
    canvas.save();
    canvas.clipRect(Gfx::to_skia_rect(rect));
    SkPaint paint;
    paint.setColor(Gfx::to_skia_color4f(color), surface_color_space());
    paint.setBlendMode(SkBlendMode::kSrc);
    canvas.drawPaint(paint);
    canvas.restore();
}

void Canvas2DCommandPlayer::play_command(Canvas2DClearRect const& command)
{
    clear_rect(command.rect, command.color);
}

void Canvas2DCommandPlayer::play_command(Canvas2DDrawImageFrame const& command)
{
    auto const* frame = m_resolvers.image_frame(command.frame_id.value());
    if (!frame)
        return;
    auto image = image_of_frame(*frame);
    if (!image)
        return;
    draw_image(*image, command.dst_rect, command.src_rect, command.scaling_mode, command.compositing);
}

void Canvas2DCommandPlayer::play_command(Canvas2DDrawCanvas const& command)
{
    if (!m_resolvers.canvas_surface)
        return;

    auto* source_surface = m_resolvers.canvas_surface(command.source_canvas_id.value());
    if (!source_surface)
        return;

    auto image = source_surface->sk_image_snapshot<sk_sp<SkImage>>();
    if (!image)
        return;
    draw_image(*image, command.dst_rect, command.src_rect, command.scaling_mode, command.compositing);
}

void Canvas2DCommandPlayer::play_command(Canvas2DDrawVideoFrame const& command)
{
    if (!m_resolvers.video_frame_image)
        return;
    auto image = m_resolvers.video_frame_image(command.video_sink_handle, command.generation);
    if (!image)
        return;
    draw_image(*image, command.dst_rect, command.src_rect, command.scaling_mode, command.compositing);
}

void Canvas2DCommandPlayer::draw_image(SkImage const& image, Gfx::FloatRect const& dst_rect, Gfx::FloatRect const& src_rect, Gfx::ScalingMode scaling_mode, Canvas2DCompositing const& compositing)
{
    SkPaint paint;
    paint.setImageFilter(image_filter_from(compositing));
    paint.setAlpha(static_cast<u8>(compositing.global_alpha * 255));

    draw_with_compositing(m_surface->canvas(), paint, compositing, [&](SkCanvas& canvas, SkPaint const& paint) {
        canvas.drawImageRect(
            &image,
            Gfx::to_skia_rect(src_rect),
            Gfx::to_skia_rect(dst_rect),
            Gfx::to_skia_sampling_options(scaling_mode),
            &paint,
            SkCanvas::kStrict_SrcRectConstraint);
    });
}

void Canvas2DCommandPlayer::play_command(Canvas2DSetTransform const& command)
{
    m_surface->canvas().setMatrix(Gfx::to_skia_matrix(command.transform));
}

void Canvas2DCommandPlayer::play_command(Canvas2DSave const&)
{
    m_surface->canvas().save();
}

void Canvas2DCommandPlayer::play_command(Canvas2DRestore const&)
{
    m_surface->canvas().restore();
}

void Canvas2DCommandPlayer::play_command(Canvas2DClipPath const& command)
{
    auto path = path_from(command.path_data);
    path.setFillType(Gfx::to_skia_path_fill_type(command.winding_rule));
    m_surface->canvas().clipPath(path, SkClipOp::kIntersect, true);
}

void Canvas2DCommandPlayer::play_command(Canvas2DReset const&)
{
    auto& canvas = m_surface->canvas();
    canvas.restoreToCount(m_initial_save_count);
    canvas.save();
}

void Canvas2DCommandPlayer::play_command(Canvas2DClearCanvas const& command)
{
    auto size = m_surface->size();
    if (size.is_empty())
        return;

    static constexpr int max_strip_height = 64;
    auto strip_height = min(size.height(), max_strip_height);
    auto strip_or_error = Gfx::Bitmap::create(Gfx::BitmapFormat::BGRA8888, Gfx::AlphaType::Premultiplied, { size.width(), strip_height });
    if (strip_or_error.is_error())
        return;
    auto strip = strip_or_error.release_value();
    auto alpha = command.color.alpha();
    auto premultiply = [alpha](u8 channel) { return static_cast<u8>((channel * alpha + 127) / 255); };
    auto pixel = Gfx::Color(premultiply(command.color.red()), premultiply(command.color.green()), premultiply(command.color.blue()), alpha).value();
    for (int y = 0; y < strip_height; ++y) {
        auto* scanline = strip->scanline(y);
        for (int x = 0; x < size.width(); ++x)
            scanline[x] = pixel;
    }

    for (int y = 0; y < size.height(); y += strip_height)
        m_surface->write_from_bitmap(*strip, { 0, y }, m_color_space);
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-putimagedata
void Canvas2DCommandPlayer::play_command(Canvas2DPutImageFrame const& command)
{
    // NB: putImageData() sets the pixels of the output bitmap, so they are written to the surface directly, without
    //     the current transformation matrix, the clipping region, or compositing.
    auto const* frame = m_resolvers.image_frame(command.frame_id.value());
    if (!frame)
        return;
    m_surface->write_from_bitmap(*frame->bitmap_sharing_pixels(), command.position, frame->color_space());
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/Function.h>
#include <AK/Noncopyable.h>
#include <AK/NonnullOwnPtr.h>
#include <AK/NonnullRefPtr.h>
#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <AK/RefPtr.h>
#include <AK/Span.h>
#include <Compositor/Forward.h>
#include <LibCompositing/DisplayList/DisplayListCommandsGenerated.h>
#include <LibGfx/ColorSpace.h>
#include <LibGfx/Forward.h>
#include <LibGfx/Rect.h>
#include <LibGfx/ScalingMode.h>

class SkColorSpace;
class SkImage;
class SkImageFilter;
class SkPaint;
class SkPath;
template<typename T>
class sk_sp;

namespace Compositor {

// Plays the tape of a 2D canvas into the surface of the canvas.
class Canvas2DCommandPlayer {
    AK_MAKE_NONCOPYABLE(Canvas2DCommandPlayer);
    AK_MAKE_NONMOVABLE(Canvas2DCommandPlayer);

public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    using FontResolver = Function<Gfx::Font const*(u64)>;
    using ImageFrameResolver = Function<Gfx::DecodedImageFrame const*(u64)>;
    using CanvasSurfaceResolver = Function<Gfx::PaintingSurface const*(u64)>;
    using VideoFrameImageResolver = Function<sk_sp<SkImage>(u64 video_sink_handle, u64 generation)>;

    struct Resolvers {
        CanvasSurfaceResolver canvas_surface;
        FontResolver font;
        ImageFrameResolver image_frame;
        VideoFrameImageResolver video_frame_image;
    };

    // The pixels of the surface, and the colors of the commands, are in the color space. Fails when a surface of the
    // size can't be allocated.
    static ErrorOr<NonnullOwnPtr<Canvas2DCommandPlayer>> create(RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext>, Gfx::IntSize, Gfx::BitmapFormat, Gfx::AlphaType, Gfx::ColorSpace const&, Resolvers);
    Canvas2DCommandPlayer(NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::PaintingSurface>, Gfx::ColorSpace const&, Resolvers);
    ~Canvas2DCommandPlayer();

    NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::PaintingSurface> surface() const;

    void clear(Gfx::Color);

    void play_command(Compositing::DisplayListCommandType, ReadonlyBytes payload);

private:
#define DECLARE_PLAY_COMMAND(command_type) \
    void play_command(Compositing::command_type const&);
    ENUMERATE_CANVAS_2D_COMMANDS(DECLARE_PLAY_COMMAND)
#undef DECLARE_PLAY_COMMAND

    void clear_rect(Gfx::FloatRect const&, Gfx::Color);
    sk_sp<SkImage> image_of_frame(Gfx::DecodedImageFrame const&) const;
    void draw_image(SkImage const&, Gfx::FloatRect const& dst_rect, Gfx::FloatRect const& src_rect, Gfx::ScalingMode, Compositing::Canvas2DCompositing const&);

    ReadonlyBytes inline_data(Compositing::DisplayListDataSpan) const;
    SkPath path_from(Compositing::DisplayListDataSpan) const;
    sk_sp<SkImageFilter> image_filter_from(Compositing::Canvas2DCompositing const&) const;
    // The colors of a canvas are in the color space of its surface.
    SkColorSpace* surface_color_space() const;
    // Has no value if the image of a pattern can't be resolved.
    Optional<SkPaint> paint_from(Compositing::Canvas2DPaint const& style, Compositing::Canvas2DCompositing const&) const;

    Gfx::ColorSpace m_color_space;
    NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::PaintingSurface> m_surface;
    int m_initial_save_count { 0 };
    Resolvers m_resolvers;
    // The payload of the record that plays, which the spans of its command address.
    ReadonlyBytes m_payload;
};

}

#include <Compositor/BitmapExport.h>
#include <Compositor/Canvas2DCommandPlayer.h>
#include <Compositor/CanvasHost.h>
#include <Compositor/CanvasSurfaceRegistry.h>
#include <Compositor/OpenGLContext.h>
#include <Compositor/PaintingSurface.h>
#include <Compositor/SkiaBackendContext.h>
#include <Compositor/VideoFrameHolds.h>
#include <Compositor/VideoFrameSkia.h>
#include <LibCompositing/CanvasSize.h>
#include <LibCompositing/DisplayList/RegisteredImageFrames.h>

#include <LibGfx/ColorSpace.h>

#include <core/SkImage.h>

namespace Compositor {

struct CanvasHost::VideoFrameImage {
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    u64 generation { 0 };
    // Kept until replaced, since the GPU samples the image after the commands are played.
    RefPtr<Media::VideoFrame> frame;
    sk_sp<SkImage> image_on_gpu;
    // NB: A canvas that draws in memory does not read back image_on_gpu instead: Skia caches readbacks by image ID,
    //     and the image of a video surface keeps its ID while the surface shows new frames.
    sk_sp<SkImage> image_in_memory;
};

CanvasHost::CanvasHost(RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext> skia_backend_context, CanvasSurfaceRegistry& canvas_surface_registry, VideoFrameHolds const& video_frame_holds)
    : m_skia_backend_context(move(skia_backend_context))
    , m_canvas_surface_registry(canvas_surface_registry)
    , m_canvas_surface_owner_id(canvas_surface_registry.allocate_owner_id())
    , m_video_frame_holds(video_frame_holds)
{
}

CanvasHost::~CanvasHost()
{
    for (auto canvas_id : m_contexts.keys())
        m_canvas_surface_registry.remove_canvas_surface(canvas_id);
}

OwnPtr<Canvas2DCommandPlayer> CanvasHost::create_2d_command_player(Gfx::IntSize size, bool alpha, bool will_read_frequently, Gfx::ColorSpace const& color_space)
{
    if (!Compositing::is_valid_canvas_2d_size(size))
        return nullptr;

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#concept-canvas-will-read-frequently
    // "When a CanvasSettings object's will read frequently is true, the user agent may optimize the canvas for
    //  readback operations."
    // NB: The canvas then draws in memory, where a readback copies its pixels instead of waiting for the GPU.
    auto skia_backend_context_of_canvas = will_read_frequently ? nullptr : m_skia_backend_context;

    auto format = alpha ? Gfx::BitmapFormat::BGRA8888 : Gfx::BitmapFormat::BGRx8888;
    auto canvas_surface_resolver = [this](u64 canvas_id) -> Gfx::PaintingSurface const* {
        // A 2D source resolves to its live draw surface: the shared command
        // stream replays in recording order, so at this point the surface holds
        // exactly the commands recorded before the referencing DrawCanvas.
        auto* context = this->context(Compositing::CanvasId { canvas_id });
        if (!context)
            return nullptr;
        if (auto* canvas_context = context->get_pointer<Canvas2DContext>())
            return canvas_context->command_player->surface().ptr();
        // WebGL sources are presented separately and resolve via the registry.
        return m_canvas_surface_registry.canvas_surface(m_canvas_surface_owner_id, Compositing::CanvasId { canvas_id });
    };
    auto font_resolver = [this](u64 font_id) -> Gfx::Font const* {
        if (!m_described_canvas_2d_fonts.contains(Compositing::FontResourceId { font_id }))
            return nullptr;
        return &m_described_canvas_2d_fonts.font(Compositing::FontResourceId { font_id });
    };
    auto image_frame_resolver = [this](u64 frame_id) -> Gfx::DecodedImageFrame const* {
        if (!m_image_frames_registered_while_painting)
            return nullptr;
        auto image_frame = m_image_frames_registered_while_painting->image_frame(Compositing::ImageFrameResourceId { frame_id });
        if (!image_frame)
            return nullptr;
        return &image_frame->frame();
    };
    auto video_frame_image_resolver = [this, skia_backend_context_of_canvas](u64 video_sink_handle, u64 generation) {
        return held_video_frame_image(Media::VideoSinkHandle { video_sink_handle }, generation, skia_backend_context_of_canvas);
    };
    auto player_or_error = Canvas2DCommandPlayer::create(skia_backend_context_of_canvas, size, format, Gfx::AlphaType::Premultiplied, color_space,
        Canvas2DCommandPlayer::Resolvers {
            .canvas_surface = move(canvas_surface_resolver),
            .font = move(font_resolver),
            .image_frame = move(image_frame_resolver),
            .video_frame_image = move(video_frame_image_resolver),
        });
    // NB: Memory for a canvas of a size that passed the check above can still run out.
    if (player_or_error.is_error()) {
        dbgln("Unable to create a {}x{} 2D canvas context: {}", size.width(), size.height(), player_or_error.error());
        return nullptr;
    }
    auto player = player_or_error.release_value();

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#the-canvas-settings:concept-canvas-alpha
    // "Thus, the bitmap of such a context starts off as opaque black instead of transparent black"
    // AD-HOC: Skia hands out a fully transparent surface by default; only clear when alpha is disabled.
    if (!alpha)
        player->clear(Gfx::Color::Black);

    return player;
}

static void copy_surface_contents(Gfx::PaintingSurface& source, Gfx::PaintingSurface& destination)
{
    destination.copy_from_surface(source);
}

// The pool keeps a surface that the window server shows, or that a frame takes to it, as it is.
static ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<PresentableSurface>> present_into_surface_of_pool(PresentableSurfacePool& pool, Gfx::PaintingSurface& source, RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext> const& skia_backend_context)
{
    auto surface = TRY(pool.surface_for_next_content(source.size(), skia_backend_context));
    copy_surface_contents(source, surface->painting_surface());
    return surface;
}

bool CanvasHost::create_2d_context(Compositing::CanvasId canvas_id, Gfx::IntSize size, bool alpha, bool will_read_frequently, Gfx::ColorSpace const& color_space)
{
    auto command_player = create_2d_command_player(size, alpha, will_read_frequently, color_space);
    if (!command_player)
        return false;

    // NB: A canvas that draws in memory still presents onto the GPU, if there is one. A present then uploads it once,
    //     instead of every composited frame uploading a fresh snapshot of it.
    PresentableSurfacePool presented_surfaces;
    auto presented_surface_or_error = present_into_surface_of_pool(presented_surfaces, command_player->surface(), m_skia_backend_context);
    if (presented_surface_or_error.is_error()) {
        dbgln("Unable to create the presented surface of a {}x{} 2D canvas context: {}", size.width(), size.height(), presented_surface_or_error.error());
        return false;
    }
    auto presented_surface = presented_surface_or_error.release_value();
    m_canvas_surface_registry.set_canvas_surface(m_canvas_surface_owner_id, canvas_id, *presented_surface);
    Canvas2DContext context {
        .command_player = command_player.release_nonnull(),
        .presented_surfaces = move(presented_surfaces),
        .presented_surface = presented_surface->painting_surface(),
    };
    m_contexts.set(canvas_id, move(context));
    return true;
}

bool CanvasHost::create_webgl_context(Compositing::CanvasId canvas_id, OpenGLContext::WebGLVersion version, OpenGLContext::DrawingBufferOptions options, Gfx::IntSize size)
{
    auto gl_context = OpenGLContext::create(m_skia_backend_context, version, options);
    if (!gl_context)
        return false;
    gl_context->set_size(size);
    m_contexts.set(canvas_id, gl_context.release_nonnull());
    return true;
}

void CanvasHost::destroy_2d_context(Compositing::CanvasId canvas_id)
{
    auto* context = this->context(canvas_id);
    VERIFY(context && context->has<Canvas2DContext>());
    m_contexts.remove(canvas_id);
    m_canvas_surface_registry.remove_canvas_surface(canvas_id);
}

void CanvasHost::destroy_webgl_context(Compositing::CanvasId canvas_id)
{
    auto* context = this->context(canvas_id);
    if (!context || !context->has<WebGLContext>())
        return;
    m_contexts.remove(canvas_id);
    m_canvas_surface_registry.remove_canvas_surface(canvas_id);
}

CanvasHost::Context* CanvasHost::context(Compositing::CanvasId canvas_id)
{
    auto it = m_contexts.find(canvas_id);
    if (it == m_contexts.end())
        return nullptr;
    return &it->value;
}

CanvasHost::Canvas2DContext& CanvasHost::canvas_2d_context(Compositing::CanvasId canvas_id)
{
    auto* context = this->context(canvas_id);
    VERIFY(context);
    return context->get<Canvas2DContext>();
}

bool CanvasHost::try_present_2d_context(Compositing::CanvasId canvas_id)
{
    auto& context = canvas_2d_context(canvas_id);
    auto presented_surface_or_error = present_into_surface_of_pool(context.presented_surfaces, context.command_player->surface(), m_skia_backend_context);
    // The canvas goes on showing what it presented before, and presents again with its next commands.
    if (presented_surface_or_error.is_error()) {
        dbgln("Unable to present a 2D canvas context: {}", presented_surface_or_error.error());
        return false;
    }
    auto presented_surface = presented_surface_or_error.release_value();
    m_canvas_surface_registry.set_canvas_surface(m_canvas_surface_owner_id, canvas_id, *presented_surface);
    context.presented_surface = presented_surface->painting_surface();
    return true;
}

bool CanvasHost::describe_canvas_2d_fonts(Vector<Compositing::DisplayListFontDescription> const& fonts, Compositing::RegisteredTypefaces const& registered_typefaces)
{
    if (!m_described_canvas_2d_fonts.add_described_fonts_made_of_registered_typefaces(fonts, registered_typefaces))
        return false;
    Vector<u64> described_font_ids;
    described_font_ids.ensure_capacity(fonts.size());
    for (auto const& font : fonts)
        described_font_ids.unchecked_append(font.id.value());
    (void)m_described_canvas_2d_fonts.retain_only(described_font_ids);
    return true;
}

Canvas2DCommandPlayer& CanvasHost::begin_2d_painting(Compositing::CanvasId canvas_id, Compositing::RegisteredImageFrames const& registered_image_frames)
{
    VERIFY(!m_image_frames_registered_while_painting);
    m_image_frames_registered_while_painting = &registered_image_frames;
    m_painting_sampled_video_frame_on_gpu = false;
    return *canvas_2d_context(canvas_id).command_player;
}

bool CanvasHost::end_2d_painting_reporting_whether_video_frames_were_sampled_on_gpu()
{
    m_image_frames_registered_while_painting = nullptr;
    return m_painting_sampled_video_frame_on_gpu;
}

void CanvasHost::flush_2d_contexts(ReadonlySpan<Compositing::CanvasId> canvas_ids)
{
    if (!m_skia_backend_context)
        return;
    for (auto canvas_id : canvas_ids)
        m_skia_backend_context->flush_and_submit(canvas_2d_context(canvas_id).command_player->surface());
}

sk_sp<SkImage> CanvasHost::held_video_frame_image(Media::VideoSinkHandle handle, u64 generation, RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext> const& skia_backend_context_of_canvas)
{
    auto* video_frame_image = m_video_frame_images.get(handle).value_or(nullptr);
    if (!video_frame_image || video_frame_image->generation != generation) {
        auto frame = m_video_frame_holds.held_frame(handle, generation);
        if (!frame)
            return nullptr;
        auto new_video_frame_image = make<VideoFrameImage>(generation, move(frame), sk_sp<SkImage> {}, sk_sp<SkImage> {});
        video_frame_image = new_video_frame_image.ptr();
        m_video_frame_images.set(handle, move(new_video_frame_image));
    }

    if (!skia_backend_context_of_canvas) {
        if (!video_frame_image->image_in_memory)
            video_frame_image->image_in_memory = sk_image_in_memory_from_video_frame(*video_frame_image->frame, m_skia_backend_context);
        return video_frame_image->image_in_memory;
    }

    if (!video_frame_image->image_on_gpu) {
        video_frame_image->image_on_gpu = sk_image_from_video_frame(*video_frame_image->frame, skia_backend_context_of_canvas);
        if (video_frame_image->image_on_gpu)
            m_painting_sampled_video_frame_on_gpu = true;
    }
    return video_frame_image->image_on_gpu;
}

void CanvasHost::forget_video_sink(Media::VideoSinkHandle handle)
{
    m_video_frame_images.remove(handle);
}

OpenGLContext& CanvasHost::webgl_context(Compositing::CanvasId canvas_id)
{
    auto* context = this->context(canvas_id);
    VERIFY(context);
    return *context->get<WebGLContext>();
}

CanvasHost::WebGLPresentOutcome CanvasHost::present_webgl_context(Compositing::CanvasId canvas_id, bool preserve_drawing_buffer, bool show_presented_frame)
{
    auto& gl_context = webgl_context(canvas_id);
    auto outcome = WebGLPresentOutcome::ShowedPresentedFrame;
    auto surface = show_presented_frame ? gl_context.presented_surface() : nullptr;
    if (!surface) {
        gl_context.present_drawing_buffer(preserve_drawing_buffer);
        surface = gl_context.presented_surface();
        if (!surface)
            return WebGLPresentOutcome::NoDrawingBuffer;
        outcome = WebGLPresentOutcome::Presented;
    }
    if (auto presentable_surface = gl_context.presented_presentable_surface(); presentable_surface && &presentable_surface->painting_surface() == surface.ptr())
        m_canvas_surface_registry.set_canvas_surface(m_canvas_surface_owner_id, canvas_id, *presentable_surface);
    else
        m_canvas_surface_registry.set_canvas_surface(m_canvas_surface_owner_id, canvas_id, surface.release_nonnull());
    return outcome;
}

Optional<Gfx::IntSize> CanvasHost::read_back_webgl_drawing_buffer(Compositing::CanvasId canvas_id, bool from_presented_frame, Gfx::IntRect rect, Bytes pixels)
{
    auto& gl_context = webgl_context(canvas_id);
    gl_context.make_current();
    gl_context.flush_drawing_buffer();
    auto surface = from_presented_frame ? gl_context.presented_surface() : gl_context.drawing_buffer_surface();
    if (!surface)
        return {};
    return read_back_surface_into(*surface, rect, Gfx::AlphaType::Premultiplied, {}, pixels);
}

RefPtr<Media::VideoFrame> CanvasHost::held_video_frame(Media::VideoSinkHandle handle, u64 generation) const
{
    return m_video_frame_holds.held_frame(handle, generation);
}

CanvasHost::WebGLImageConversion CanvasHost::convert_image_for_webgl_upload(WebGLImageSource source, Compositing::RegisteredImageFrames const& registered_image_frames, Gfx::ExportFormat format, int export_flags, Optional<Gfx::IntSize> target_size, Gfx::BitmapExportResult& out_pixels) const
{
    Optional<BitmapInColorSpace> bitmap;
    auto conversion = source.visit(
        [&](Compositing::ImageFrameResourceId id) {
            auto image_frame = registered_image_frames.image_frame(id);
            if (!image_frame)
                return WebGLImageConversion::UnknownImageFrame;
            bitmap = BitmapInColorSpace { image_frame->frame().bitmap_sharing_pixels(), image_frame->frame().color_space() };
            return WebGLImageConversion::Converted;
        },
        [&](HeldVideoFrame held_video_frame) {
            if (auto video_frame = this->held_video_frame(held_video_frame.sink_handle, held_video_frame.generation)) {
                auto video_bitmap = bitmap_from_video_frame(*video_frame, m_skia_backend_context);
                if (video_bitmap.is_error())
                    return WebGLImageConversion::Failed;
                bitmap = video_bitmap.release_value();
                return WebGLImageConversion::Converted;
            }
            auto missing_frame_bitmap = Gfx::Bitmap::create(Gfx::BitmapFormat::BGRA8888, { 1, 1 });
            if (missing_frame_bitmap.is_error())
                return WebGLImageConversion::Failed;
            bitmap = BitmapInColorSpace { missing_frame_bitmap.release_value(), {} };
            return WebGLImageConversion::Converted;
        });
    if (conversion != WebGLImageConversion::Converted)
        return conversion;

    Optional<int> target_width;
    Optional<int> target_height;
    if (target_size.has_value()) {
        target_width = target_size->width();
        target_height = target_size->height();
    }
    auto pixels = Gfx::export_bitmap_to_byte_buffer(*bitmap->bitmap, bitmap->color_space, format, export_flags, target_width, target_height);
    if (pixels.is_error())
        return WebGLImageConversion::Failed;
    out_pixels = pixels.release_value();
    return WebGLImageConversion::Converted;
}

Gfx::ShareableBitmap CanvasHost::read_back_surface(Gfx::PaintingSurface& surface, Gfx::IntRect rect, Gfx::AlphaType alpha_type, Gfx::ColorSpace const& color_space)
{
    auto clipped_rect = rect.intersected(surface.rect());
    if (clipped_rect.is_empty())
        return {};

    // Unpremultiplied pixels are for ImageData, which stores them as RGBA8888. Reading into that format lets the
    // surface do the conversion.
    auto format = alpha_type == Gfx::AlphaType::Unpremultiplied ? Gfx::BitmapFormat::RGBA8888 : Gfx::BitmapFormat::BGRA8888;
    auto bitmap_or_error = Gfx::Bitmap::create_shareable(format, alpha_type, clipped_rect.size());
    if (bitmap_or_error.is_error())
        return {};

    auto bitmap = bitmap_or_error.release_value();
    surface.flush();
    surface.read_into_bitmap(*bitmap, clipped_rect.location(), color_space);
    return Gfx::ShareableBitmap { move(bitmap), Gfx::ShareableBitmap::ConstructWithKnownGoodBitmap };
}

Optional<Gfx::IntSize> CanvasHost::read_back_surface_into(Gfx::PaintingSurface& surface, Gfx::IntRect rect, Gfx::AlphaType alpha_type, Gfx::ColorSpace const& color_space, Bytes pixels)
{
    auto clipped_rect = rect.intersected(surface.rect());
    if (clipped_rect.is_empty())
        return {};
    auto pitch = static_cast<size_t>(clipped_rect.width()) * sizeof(u32);
    if (pitch * static_cast<size_t>(clipped_rect.height()) > pixels.size())
        return {};

    auto format = alpha_type == Gfx::AlphaType::Unpremultiplied ? Gfx::BitmapFormat::RGBA8888 : Gfx::BitmapFormat::BGRA8888;
    auto bitmap = Gfx::Bitmap::create_wrapper(format, alpha_type, clipped_rect.size(), pitch, pixels.data());
    if (bitmap.is_error())
        return {};
    surface.flush();
    surface.read_into_bitmap(*bitmap.value(), clipped_rect.location(), color_space);
    return clipped_rect.size();
}

RefPtr<Gfx::PaintingSurface> CanvasHost::presented_surface(Compositing::CanvasId canvas_id)
{
    auto* context = this->context(canvas_id);
    if (!context)
        return nullptr;

    return context->visit(
        [](Canvas2DContext& canvas_context) -> RefPtr<Gfx::PaintingSurface> {
            return canvas_context.presented_surface;
        },
        [](WebGLContext& gl_context) -> RefPtr<Gfx::PaintingSurface> {
            return gl_context->presented_surface();
        });
}

Optional<Gfx::IntSize> CanvasHost::read_back_canvas_2d_pixels(Compositing::CanvasId canvas_id, Gfx::IntRect rect, Gfx::AlphaType alpha_type, Gfx::ColorSpace const& color_space, Bytes pixels)
{
    auto* context = this->context(canvas_id);
    if (!context)
        return {};
    auto* canvas_context = context->get_pointer<Canvas2DContext>();
    if (!canvas_context)
        return {};
    return read_back_surface_into(canvas_context->command_player->surface(), rect, alpha_type, color_space, pixels);
}

}

/*

 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#pragma once

#include <AK/HashMap.h>
#include <AK/Noncopyable.h>
#include <AK/NonnullRefPtr.h>
#include <Compositor/PaintingSurface.h>
#include <Compositor/PresentableSurface.h>
#include <LibCompositing/DisplayList/DisplayListResourceIds.h>

namespace Compositor {

// NB: One registry holds the canvases of every WebContent that shares a compositor state. A canvas ID that a display
//     list or command stream names only resolves to a surface of the owner it is resolved for, so a WebContent cannot
//     draw (and then read back) the canvases of another.
class CanvasSurfaceRegistry {
    AK_MAKE_NONCOPYABLE(CanvasSurfaceRegistry);
    AK_MAKE_DEFAULT_MOVABLE(CanvasSurfaceRegistry);

public:
    CanvasSurfaceRegistry() = default;
    ~CanvasSurfaceRegistry() = default;

    Compositing::CanvasSurfaceOwnerId allocate_owner_id()
    {
        return Compositing::CanvasSurfaceOwnerId { m_next_owner_id++ };
    }

    Compositing::CanvasId allocate_canvas_id()
    {
        return reserve_canvas_ids(1);
    }

    Compositing::CanvasId reserve_canvas_ids(u64 count)
    {
        auto first = Compositing::CanvasId { m_next_canvas_id };
        m_next_canvas_id += count;
        return first;
    }

    void set_canvas_surface(Compositing::CanvasSurfaceOwnerId owner_id, Compositing::CanvasId id, NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::PaintingSurface> surface)
    {
        set_entry(owner_id, id, move(surface), {});
    }

    // The canvas shows the content of a surface that the window server can show as it is.
    void set_canvas_surface(Compositing::CanvasSurfaceOwnerId owner_id, Compositing::CanvasId id, PresentableSurface& surface)
    {
        set_entry(owner_id, id, surface.painting_surface(), WeakPresentableSurface { surface });
    }

    void remove_canvas_surface(Compositing::CanvasId id)
    {
        m_entries.remove(id);
    }

    Gfx::PaintingSurface const* canvas_surface(Compositing::CanvasSurfaceOwnerId owner_id, Compositing::CanvasId id) const
    {
        auto const* entry = entry_of(owner_id, id);
        return entry ? entry->surface.ptr() : nullptr;
    }

    u64 canvas_content_generation(Compositing::CanvasSurfaceOwnerId owner_id, Compositing::CanvasId id) const
    {
        auto const* entry = entry_of(owner_id, id);
        return entry ? entry->content_generation : 0;
    }

    // Null for a canvas whose content the window server cannot show as it is. Whoever holds the surface keeps it busy.
    RefPtr<PresentableSurface> presentable_canvas_surface(Compositing::CanvasSurfaceOwnerId owner_id, Compositing::CanvasId id) const
    {
        auto const* entry = entry_of(owner_id, id);
        return entry ? entry->presentable_surface.strong_ref() : nullptr;
    }

private:
    struct Entry {
        Compositing::CanvasSurfaceOwnerId owner_id;
        NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::PaintingSurface> surface;
        WeakPresentableSurface presentable_surface;
        u64 content_generation { 0 };
    };

    void set_entry(Compositing::CanvasSurfaceOwnerId owner_id, Compositing::CanvasId id, NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::PaintingSurface> surface, WeakPresentableSurface presentable_surface)
    {
        if (auto existing = m_entries.get(id); existing.has_value())
            VERIFY(existing->owner_id == owner_id);
        m_entries.set(id, { .owner_id = owner_id, .surface = move(surface), .presentable_surface = move(presentable_surface), .content_generation = ++m_last_content_generation });
    }

    Entry const* entry_of(Compositing::CanvasSurfaceOwnerId owner_id, Compositing::CanvasId id) const
    {
        auto it = m_entries.find(id);
        if (it == m_entries.end() || it->value.owner_id != owner_id)
            return nullptr;
        return &it->value;
    }

    u64 m_next_owner_id { 1 };
    u64 m_next_canvas_id { 1 };
    u64 m_last_content_generation { 0 };
    HashMap<Compositing::CanvasId, Entry> m_entries;
};

// The canvases of one owner, which is what a display list of that owner's contexts may draw.
class OwnedCanvasSurfaces {
public:
    OwnedCanvasSurfaces(CanvasSurfaceRegistry const& registry, Compositing::CanvasSurfaceOwnerId owner_id)
        : m_registry(&registry)
        , m_owner_id(owner_id)
    {
    }

    Gfx::PaintingSurface const* canvas_surface(Compositing::CanvasId id) const { return m_registry->canvas_surface(m_owner_id, id); }
    u64 canvas_content_generation(Compositing::CanvasId id) const { return m_registry->canvas_content_generation(m_owner_id, id); }
    RefPtr<PresentableSurface> presentable_canvas_surface(Compositing::CanvasId id) const { return m_registry->presentable_canvas_surface(m_owner_id, id); }

private:
    CanvasSurfaceRegistry const* m_registry { nullptr };
    Compositing::CanvasSurfaceOwnerId m_owner_id;
};

}

#include <AK/Mutex.h>

#include <Compositor/SkiaUtils.h>

namespace Gfx {

static skcms_Matrix3x3 to_xyz_d50_for_color_primaries(Media::ColorPrimaries color_primaries)
{
    auto primaries = [&] {
        switch (color_primaries) {
        case Media::ColorPrimaries::BT709:
        case Media::ColorPrimaries::Unspecified:
            return SkNamedPrimaries::kRec709;
        case Media::ColorPrimaries::BT470M:
            return SkNamedPrimaries::kRec470SystemM;
        case Media::ColorPrimaries::BT470BG:
            return SkNamedPrimaries::kRec470SystemBG;
        case Media::ColorPrimaries::BT601:
            return SkNamedPrimaries::kRec601;
        case Media::ColorPrimaries::SMPTE240:
            return SkNamedPrimaries::kSMPTE_ST_240;
        case Media::ColorPrimaries::GenericFilm:
            return SkNamedPrimaries::kGenericFilm;
        case Media::ColorPrimaries::BT2020:
            return SkNamedPrimaries::kRec2020;
        case Media::ColorPrimaries::SMPTE431:
            return SkNamedPrimaries::kSMPTE_RP_431_2;
        case Media::ColorPrimaries::SMPTE432:
            return SkNamedPrimaries::kSMPTE_EG_432_1;
        case Media::ColorPrimaries::EBU3213:
            return SkNamedPrimaries::kITU_T_H273_Value22;
        case Media::ColorPrimaries::XYZ:
            break;
        }
        VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
    };

    if (color_primaries == Media::ColorPrimaries::XYZ)
        return SkNamedGamut::kXYZ;
    skcms_Matrix3x3 result;
    VERIFY(primaries().toXYZD50(&result));
    return result;
}

static skcms_TransferFunction transfer_function_for_transfer_characteristics(Media::TransferCharacteristics transfer_characteristics)
{
    switch (transfer_characteristics) {
    case Media::TransferCharacteristics::BT709:
    case Media::TransferCharacteristics::Unspecified:
    case Media::TransferCharacteristics::BT601:
    case Media::TransferCharacteristics::BT2020BitDepth10:
    case Media::TransferCharacteristics::BT2020BitDepth12:
        // This is not technically correct, but other browsers treat these as sRGB as an optimization. The actual
        // transfer characteristics would give output that is not the same as theirs.
        return SkNamedTransferFn::kSRGB;
    case Media::TransferCharacteristics::BT470M:
        return SkNamedTransferFn::kRec470SystemM;
    case Media::TransferCharacteristics::BT470BG:
        return SkNamedTransferFn::kRec470SystemBG;
    case Media::TransferCharacteristics::SMPTE240:
        return SkNamedTransferFn::kSMPTE_ST_240;
    case Media::TransferCharacteristics::Linear:
        return SkNamedTransferFn::kLinear;
    case Media::TransferCharacteristics::IEC61966:
        return SkNamedTransferFn::kIEC61966_2_4;
    case Media::TransferCharacteristics::SRGB:
        return SkNamedTransferFn::kSRGB;
    case Media::TransferCharacteristics::SMPTE2084:
        return SkNamedTransferFn::kPQ;
    case Media::TransferCharacteristics::SMPTE428:
        return SkNamedTransferFn::kSMPTE_ST_428_1;
    case Media::TransferCharacteristics::HLG:
        return SkNamedTransferFn::kHLG;
    case Media::TransferCharacteristics::Log100:
    case Media::TransferCharacteristics::Log100Sqrt10:
    case Media::TransferCharacteristics::BT1361:
        // ColorSpace::from_cicp() and IPC decoding reject these.
        break;
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

static sk_sp<SkColorSpace> create_skia_color_space(ColorSpace::Data const& data)
{
    return data.visit(
        [](Empty) -> sk_sp<SkColorSpace> {
            return nullptr;
        },
        [](ColorSpace::CICP const& cicp) -> sk_sp<SkColorSpace> {
            return SkColorSpace::MakeRGB(transfer_function_for_transfer_characteristics(cicp.transfer_characteristics), to_xyz_d50_for_color_primaries(cicp.color_primaries));
        },
        [](NonnullRefPtr<ColorSpace::ICCProfile const> const& icc_profile) -> sk_sp<SkColorSpace> {
            auto icc_bytes = icc_profile->bytes();
            skcms_ICCProfile parsed_icc_profile {};
            if (!skcms_Parse(icc_bytes.data(), icc_bytes.size(), &parsed_icc_profile)) {
                dbgln("Failed to parse an ICC profile, drawing as sRGB");
                return nullptr;
            }

            auto color_space = SkColorSpace::Make(parsed_icc_profile);
            if (!color_space && parsed_icc_profile.has_trc && parsed_icc_profile.has_toXYZD50) {
                skcms_TransferFunction transfer_function;
                float max_error;
                if (skcms_ApproximateCurve(&parsed_icc_profile.trc[0], &transfer_function, &max_error))
                    color_space = SkColorSpace::MakeRGB(transfer_function, parsed_icc_profile.toXYZD50);
            }
            return color_space;
        });
}

static bool have_same_data(ColorSpace::Data const& a, ColorSpace::Data const& b)
{
    if (a.index() != b.index())
        return false;
    return a.visit(
        [](Empty) { return true; },
        [&](ColorSpace::CICP const& cicp) {
            auto const& other = b.get<ColorSpace::CICP>();
            return cicp.color_primaries == other.color_primaries && cicp.transfer_characteristics == other.transfer_characteristics;
        },
        [&](NonnullRefPtr<ColorSpace::ICCProfile const> const& icc_profile) {
            auto const& other = b.get<NonnullRefPtr<ColorSpace::ICCProfile const>>();
            return icc_profile->bytes() == other->bytes();
        });
}

sk_sp<SkColorSpace> to_skia_color_space(ColorSpace const& color_space)
{
    if (color_space.data().has<Empty>())
        return nullptr;

    // Images in one color space are drawn many times, and each request would parse the ICC profile again, or make a
    // new Skia color space object for anything but sRGB. So keep the color spaces that were made last.
    struct CachedColorSpace {
        ColorSpace::Data data;
        sk_sp<SkColorSpace> skia_color_space;
    };
    struct Cache {
        Mutex mutex;
        Vector<CachedColorSpace> entries;
    };
    static constexpr size_t max_cached_color_spaces = 32;
    static NeverDestroyed<Cache> cache;

    MutexLocker locker(cache->mutex);
    for (auto const& entry : cache->entries) {
        if (have_same_data(entry.data, color_space.data()))
            return entry.skia_color_space;
    }
    if (cache->entries.size() >= max_cached_color_spaces)
        cache->entries.clear();
    auto skia_color_space = create_skia_color_space(color_space.data());
    cache->entries.append({ color_space.data(), skia_color_space });
    return skia_color_space;
}

}

static void post_message_to_web_content(void* host, u64 client_id, ReadonlyBytes bytes, ReadonlySpan<IPC::RawAttachment> attachments)
{
    auto buffer = IPC::adopt_encoded_message(bytes, attachments);
    static_cast<CompositorCoreHost*>(host)->post_message_to_web_content(WebContentClientId { client_id }, buffer);
}

static void post_message_to_render_clock_of_web_content(void* host, u64 client_id, ReadonlyBytes bytes, ReadonlySpan<IPC::RawAttachment> attachments)
{
    auto buffer = IPC::adopt_encoded_message(bytes, attachments);
    static_cast<CompositorCoreHost*>(host)->post_message_to_render_clock_of_web_content(WebContentClientId { client_id }, buffer);
}

static void post_message_to_presentation(void* host, u64 presentation_id, ReadonlyBytes bytes, ReadonlySpan<IPC::RawAttachment> attachments)
{
    auto buffer = IPC::adopt_encoded_message(bytes, attachments);
    static_cast<CompositorCoreHost*>(host)->post_message_to_presentation(PresentationId { presentation_id }, buffer);
}

static void set_timer(void* host, u64 timer_number, i64 delay_nanoseconds)
{
    static_cast<CompositorCoreHost*>(host)->set_timer(timer_number, AK::Duration::from_nanoseconds(delay_nanoseconds));
}

static void cancel_timer(void* host, u64 timer_number)
{
    static_cast<CompositorCoreHost*>(host)->cancel_timer(timer_number);
}

static void destroy_timer(void* host, u64 timer_number)
{
    static_cast<CompositorCoreHost*>(host)->destroy_timer(timer_number);
}

static void shape_overlay_label(void* host, u64 context_id, bool has_font_family, ReadonlyBytes font_family, float font_size_in_points, double device_pixel_ratio, ReadonlyBytes text, void* receiver, void (*receive)(void*, RustFFI::FfiOverlayLabel const*))
{
    Optional<StringView> font_family_view;
    if (has_font_family)
        font_family_view = StringView { font_family };
    auto label = static_cast<CompositorCoreHost*>(host)->shape_overlay_label(Web::CompositorContextId { context_id }, font_family_view, font_size_in_points, device_pixel_ratio, StringView { text });
    if (!label.has_value())
        return;
    RustFFI::FfiOverlayLabel ffi_label {
        .font_id = label->font_id,
        .glyph_ids = label->glyph_ids.span(),
        .glyph_x_positions = label->glyph_x_positions.span(),
        .width = label->width,
        .ascent = label->ascent,
        .descent = label->descent,
        .font_ascent = label->font_ascent,
    };
    receive(receiver, &ffi_label);
}

static MonotonicTime now()
{
    return MonotonicTime::now();
}

CompositorCore::CompositorCore(CompositorCoreHost& host, RustFFI::FfiRasterHost raster_host, bool scrollbars_always_shown, RustFFI::GpuBackend gpu)
{
    RustFFI::FfiCompositorCoreHost ffi_host {
        .host = &host,
        .post_message_to_web_content = Compositor::post_message_to_web_content,
        .post_message_to_render_clock_of_web_content = Compositor::post_message_to_render_clock_of_web_content,
        .post_message_to_presentation = Compositor::post_message_to_presentation,
        .set_timer = Compositor::set_timer,
        .cancel_timer = Compositor::cancel_timer,
        .destroy_timer = Compositor::destroy_timer,
        .shape_overlay_label = Compositor::shape_overlay_label,
    };
    m_core = RustFFI::compositor_core_create(ffi_host, raster_host, scrollbars_always_shown, gpu);
}

CompositorCore::~CompositorCore()
{
    RustFFI::compositor_core_destroy(m_core);
}

void CompositorCore::set_ui_overlays(Web::CompositorContextId context_id, Compositing::UIOverlays const& overlays)
{
    auto const& paused_debugger = overlays.paused_debugger;
    auto const& picture_in_picture_controls = overlays.picture_in_picture_controls;
    auto const& compositor_layers = overlays.compositor_layers;
    auto font_family = paused_debugger.has_value() && paused_debugger->font_family.has_value() ? paused_debugger->font_family->bytes() : ReadonlyBytes {};
    auto compositor_layers_font_family = compositor_layers.has_value() && compositor_layers->font_family.has_value() ? compositor_layers->font_family->bytes() : ReadonlyBytes {};
    RustFFI::FfiUIOverlays ffi_overlays {
        .has_paused_debugger = paused_debugger.has_value(),
        .paused_debugger_has_font_family = paused_debugger.has_value() && paused_debugger->font_family.has_value(),
        .paused_debugger_font_family = font_family,
        .paused_debugger_has_hovered_action = paused_debugger.has_value() && paused_debugger->hovered_action.has_value(),
        .paused_debugger_hovered_action = paused_debugger.has_value() && paused_debugger->hovered_action.has_value() ? to_underlying(*paused_debugger->hovered_action) : u8 { 0 },
        .has_picture_in_picture_controls = picture_in_picture_controls.has_value(),
        .picture_in_picture_controls_shown = picture_in_picture_controls.has_value() && picture_in_picture_controls->shown,
        .picture_in_picture_controls_has_hovered_control = picture_in_picture_controls.has_value() && picture_in_picture_controls->hovered_control.has_value(),
        .picture_in_picture_controls_hovered_control = picture_in_picture_controls.has_value() && picture_in_picture_controls->hovered_control.has_value() ? to_underlying(*picture_in_picture_controls->hovered_control) : u8 { 0 },
        .has_compositor_layers = compositor_layers.has_value(),
        .compositor_layers_has_font_family = compositor_layers.has_value() && compositor_layers->font_family.has_value(),
        .compositor_layers_font_family = compositor_layers_font_family,
        .compositor_layers_hidden_layer_ids = compositor_layers.has_value() ? compositor_layers->hidden_layer_ids.span() : ReadonlySpan<u64> {},
        .compositor_layers_selected_layer_ids = compositor_layers.has_value() ? compositor_layers->selected_layer_ids.span() : ReadonlySpan<u64> {},
        .compositor_layers_has_hovered_layer_id = compositor_layers.has_value() && compositor_layers->hovered_layer_id.has_value(),
        .compositor_layers_hovered_layer_id = compositor_layers.has_value() ? compositor_layers->hovered_layer_id.value_or(0) : 0,
        .compositor_layers_raster_count_reset_generation = compositor_layers.has_value() ? compositor_layers->raster_count_reset_generation : 0,
    };
    RustFFI::compositor_core_set_ui_overlays(m_core, context_id.value(), &ffi_overlays, now().nanoseconds());
}

Optional<CompositorCore::PresentedFrame> CompositorCore::presented_frame_for_snapshot(Web::CompositorContextId context_id)
{
    Gfx::IntSize frame_size;
    auto const* surface = RustFFI::compositor_core_presented_frame_for_snapshot(m_core, context_id.value(), now().nanoseconds(), &frame_size);
    if (!surface)
        return {};
    return PresentedFrame { adopt_ref(const_cast<Gfx::PaintingSurface&>(*surface)), frame_size };
}

void CompositorCore::timer_fired(u64 timer_number)
{
    RustFFI::compositor_core_timer_fired(m_core, timer_number, now().nanoseconds());
}

IPC::RawMessage::OutcomeInRust CompositorCore::handle_message_from_web_content(WebContentClientId client_id, IPC::RawMessage& message)
{
    return message.hand_to_rust([&](IPC::FfiRawMessage raw_message) {
        RustFFI::compositor_core_handle_web_content_message(m_core, client_id.value(), raw_message, now().nanoseconds());
    });
}

IPC::RawMessage::OutcomeInRust CompositorCore::handle_message_from_control(IPC::RawMessage& message)
{
    return message.hand_to_rust([&](IPC::FfiRawMessage raw_message) {
        RustFFI::compositor_core_handle_control_message(m_core, raw_message, now().nanoseconds());
    });
}

IPC::RawMessage::OutcomeInRust CompositorCore::handle_message_from_presentation(PresentationId presentation_id, IPC::RawMessage& message)
{
    return message.hand_to_rust([&](IPC::FfiRawMessage raw_message) {
        RustFFI::compositor_core_handle_presentation_message(m_core, presentation_id.value(), raw_message, now().nanoseconds());
    });
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/Noncopyable.h>
#include <AK/NonnullRefPtr.h>
#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <Compositor/CompositorCoreHost.h>
#include <Compositor/PaintingSurface.h>
#include <LibCompositing/Types.h>
#include <LibCompositing/UIOverlays.h>
#include <LibIPC/Message.h>
#include <LibIPC/RawMessage.h>

namespace Compositor {

// The logic of the compositor, which is Rust (compositor_core): the contexts, their scrolling and input, and when and
// what of their frames is painted and presented. It talks to the process through its hosts, which paint and present as
// it asks, and it is never entered while one of its own calls runs.
class CompositorCore {
    AK_MAKE_NONCOPYABLE(CompositorCore);
    AK_MAKE_NONMOVABLE(CompositorCore);

public:
    CompositorCore(CompositorCoreHost&, RustFFI::FfiRasterHost, bool scrollbars_always_shown, RustFFI::GpuBackend);
    ~CompositorCore();

    using ContextOwnerCheckResult = RustFFI::ContextOwnerCheckResult;
    using PresentationCapabilities = RustFFI::FfiPresentationCapabilities;

    void create_context(Web::CompositorContextId, Optional<u64> page_id, WebContentClientId);
    // Also leaves the contexts nested in it without a parent.
    void destroy_context(Web::CompositorContextId);
    ContextOwnerCheckResult check_context_owner(Web::CompositorContextId, WebContentClientId) const;
    bool context_can_be_nested_in(Web::CompositorContextId, Web::CompositorContextId parent_context_id) const;
    bool presents_to_client(Web::CompositorContextId) const;
    bool context_is_effectively_visible(Web::CompositorContextId) const;
    Optional<Web::CompositorContextId> parent_context(Web::CompositorContextId) const;
    Optional<PresentationId> bound_presentation(Web::CompositorContextId) const;
    void set_parent_context(Web::CompositorContextId, Optional<Web::CompositorContextId>);
    void stop_presenting_to_client(Web::CompositorContextId);
    // Ends the fling of a context that is hidden, whether or not it was visible. Answers whether the context became
    // visible.
    bool set_visibility(Web::CompositorContextId, Compositing::ContextVisibility);
    void viewport_size_updated(Web::CompositorContextId, Gfx::IntSize, double device_pixel_ratio, Compositing::WindowResizingInProgress);
    void set_ui_overlays(Web::CompositorContextId, Compositing::UIOverlays const&);

    void register_presentation(PresentationId, PresentationCapabilities const&);
    // Leaves every context bound to the presentation unbound.
    void unregister_presentation(PresentationId);
    void set_presentation_gpu_capability(PresentationId, bool supported, u64 adapter_luid);
    void set_scrollbar_track_press_jumps(PresentationId, bool jumps);
    void bind_presentation(Web::CompositorContextId, PresentationId);
    void set_display_metadata(Web::CompositorContextId, Optional<u64> display_id, double refresh_rate);
    void set_window_server_may_show_high_dynamic_range(bool);
    void set_presents_from_cpu_memory(Web::CompositorContextId, bool);
    void set_scales_frames_to_fit(Web::CompositorContextId, bool);

    void request_rendering_opportunity(Web::CompositorContextId, double maximum_frames_per_second);
    void request_clock_tick(Web::CompositorContextId, double maximum_frames_per_second);
    void hurry_rendering_opportunity(Web::CompositorContextId);
    void present_frame_of_page(Web::CompositorContextId, Gfx::IntRect viewport_rect);
    void presented_store_released(Web::CompositorContextId, i32 bitmap_id);
    void vsync(Optional<u64> display_id, MonotonicTime frame_time);
    void gpu_work_finished(u64 token);
    void frame_ready_for_hand_off(u64 token);
    // A video sink or an image frame that the context draws has new pixels.
    void context_content_changed(Web::CompositorContextId);
    void canvas_content_changed(WebContentClientId, Compositing::CanvasId);
    void forget_web_content_client(WebContentClientId);

    // Answers false for a context with nothing to paint yet.
    bool paint_screenshot(Web::CompositorContextId, Gfx::PaintingSurface&);
    struct PresentedFrame {
        NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::PaintingSurface> surface;
        Gfx::IntSize frame_size;
    };
    // The surface that holds the frame on screen as a whole, and the size of the frame in it.
    Optional<PresentedFrame> presented_frame_for_snapshot(Web::CompositorContextId);

    void timer_fired(u64 timer_number);

    // The messages of CompositorWebContentServer, CompositorPresentationServer and CompositorControlServer that are marked
    // [RustReceiver].
    IPC::RawMessage::OutcomeInRust handle_message_from_web_content(WebContentClientId, IPC::RawMessage&);
    IPC::RawMessage::OutcomeInRust handle_message_from_presentation(PresentationId, IPC::RawMessage&);
    IPC::RawMessage::OutcomeInRust handle_message_from_control(IPC::RawMessage&);

private:
    RustFFI::CompositorCore* m_core { nullptr };
};

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/DistinctNumeric.h>
#include <AK/Optional.h>

#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <Compositor/CompositorCoreRustFFI.h>

#include <LibWebCommon/Page/CompositorContextId.h>

namespace Compositor {

AK_TYPEDEF_DISTINCT_ORDERED_ID(u64, WebContentClientId);
AK_TYPEDEF_DISTINCT_ORDERED_ID(u64, PresentationId);

// A label of an overlay, shaped in a font that the overlays' resources of its context hold: the glyphs, where each goes
// along the line in device pixels, and the metrics of the font that placing the line needs.
struct OverlayLabel {
    u64 font_id { 0 };
    Vector<u32> glyph_ids;
    Vector<float> glyph_x_positions;
    float width { 0 };
    // At the size the label is shaped at: the ascent above the baseline, which is negative, and the descent.
    float ascent { 0 };
    float descent { 0 };
    // The ascent that the painter places glyphs below, at the font's own size.
    float font_ascent { 0 };
};

// What the scroll and input logic of the contexts asks of the process around it. None of these calls comes back into
// that logic before it returns.
class CompositorCoreHost {
public:
    virtual ~CompositorCoreHost() = default;

    // A message for a client that is gone is dropped.
    virtual void post_message_to_web_content(WebContentClientId, IPC::MessageBuffer&) = 0;
    // A client without a render clock channel hears nothing.
    virtual void post_message_to_render_clock_of_web_content(WebContentClientId, IPC::MessageBuffer&) = 0;
    // A message for a presentation that is gone is dropped.
    virtual void post_message_to_presentation(PresentationId, IPC::MessageBuffer&) = 0;
    // A timer, which the core knows by its number, fires once after the delay, and setting it again replaces the delay.
    virtual void set_timer(u64 timer_number, AK::Duration delay) = 0;
    virtual void cancel_timer(u64 timer_number) = 0;
    // The timer is not set again.
    virtual void destroy_timer(u64 timer_number) = 0;
    // In the font family given, or the default one. Empty where no font draws the label.
    virtual Optional<OverlayLabel> shape_overlay_label(Web::CompositorContextId, Optional<StringView> font_family, float font_size_in_points, double device_pixel_ratio, StringView text) = 0;
};

}
