#include <AK/IDAllocator.h>
#include <AK/Math.h>
#include <Compositor/ConnectionFromClient.h>
#include <Compositor/ConnectionFromPresentation.h>
#include <Compositor/ConnectionFromWebContent.h>
#include <LibCompositing/FontServiceClient.h>
#include <LibCompositing/UIOverlays.h>
#include <LibCore/Process.h>
#include <LibIPC/Transport.h>

namespace Compositor {

static IDAllocator s_web_content_connection_ids;

ConnectionFromClient::ConnectionFromClient(NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport> transport, RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext> skia_backend_context, bool scrollbars_always_shown)
    : IPC::ConnectionFromClient<CompositorControlClientEndpoint, CompositorControlServerEndpoint>(*this, move(transport), 1)
    , m_compositor_state(CompositorState::create(move(skia_backend_context), scrollbars_always_shown))
{
}

void ConnectionFromClient::die()
{
    for (auto& [id, connection] : m_web_content_connections)
        connection->notify_compositor_lost();
    Core::Process::terminate_immediately(0);
}

void ConnectionFromClient::set_font_service(IPC::TransportHandle handle, IPC::File catalog, u64 catalog_size, u64 generation)
{
    MUST(Compositing::install_font_service(move(handle), move(catalog), catalog_size, generation));
}

Messages::CompositorControlServer::ConnectWebContentResponse ConnectionFromClient::connect_web_content()
{
    auto paired_transport = MUST(IPC::Transport::create_paired());
    auto web_content_connection_id = s_web_content_connection_ids.allocate();
    auto connection = ConnectionFromWebContent::construct(move(paired_transport.local), m_compositor_state, web_content_connection_id);
    connection->set_on_death([this](ConnectionFromWebContent& dead) {
        auto client_id = dead.client_id();
        m_web_content_connections.remove(client_id);
        s_web_content_connection_ids.deallocate(client_id);
    });
    m_web_content_connections.set(web_content_connection_id, move(connection));
    return { move(paired_transport.remote_handle), web_content_connection_id };
}

void ConnectionFromClient::connect_render_clock(i32 web_content_connection_id, IPC::TransportHandle handle)
{
    if (auto connection = m_web_content_connections.get(web_content_connection_id); connection.has_value())
        (*connection)->install_render_clock_channel(move(handle));
}

void ConnectionFromClient::connect_video_presentation(i32 web_content_connection_id, IPC::TransportHandle handle)
{
    if (auto connection = m_web_content_connections.get(web_content_connection_id); connection.has_value())
        (*connection)->install_video_presentation_channel(move(handle));
}

Messages::CompositorControlServer::CreatePresentationConnectionResponse ConnectionFromClient::create_presentation_connection(bool synthesizes_scroll_momentum, bool scrolls_elastically, Optional<u64> gpu_presentation_adapter_luid)
{
    auto paired_transport = MUST(IPC::Transport::create_paired());
    // NB: The capabilities come with the connection, so the first backing stores of a context bound to it match them.
    auto capabilities = CompositorState::PresentationCapabilities {
        .synthesizes_scroll_momentum = synthesizes_scroll_momentum,
        .scrolls_elastically = scrolls_elastically,
        .gpu_presentation_adapter_luid = gpu_presentation_adapter_luid,
    };
    auto connection = ConnectionFromPresentation::construct(move(paired_transport.local), m_compositor_state, capabilities);
    auto presentation_id = connection->presentation_id().value();
    connection->set_on_death([this, presentation_id] {
        m_presentation_connections.remove(presentation_id);
    });
    m_presentation_connections.set(presentation_id, move(connection));
    return { move(paired_transport.remote_handle), presentation_id };
}

void ConnectionFromClient::bind_presentation(Web::CompositorContextId context_id, u64 presentation_id)
{
    auto connection = m_presentation_connections.get(presentation_id);
    if (!connection.has_value()) {
        dbgln("Compositor: Ignoring binding of context {} to presentation {}, which is already gone", context_id, presentation_id);
        return;
    }
    m_compositor_state->bind_presentation(context_id, **connection);
}

ErrorOr<OwnPtr<IPC::MessageBuffer>> ConnectionFromClient::handle_raw(IPC::RawMessage& message)
{
    auto outcome = m_compositor_state->handle_message_from_control(message);
    if (outcome.misbehavior.has_value()) {
        did_misbehave(outcome.misbehavior->characters());
        return nullptr;
    }
    return move(outcome.response);
}

void ConnectionFromClient::create_context(Web::CompositorContextId context_id, Optional<u64> page_id, i32 web_content_connection_id)
{
    auto* connection = web_content_connection(web_content_connection_id);
    if (!connection) {
        dbgln("Compositor: Ignoring context {} for WebContent connection {}, which is already gone", context_id, web_content_connection_id);
        return;
    }

    m_compositor_state->create_context(context_id, page_id, *connection);
}

void ConnectionFromClient::viewport_size_updated(Web::CompositorContextId context_id, Gfx::IntSize viewport_size, double device_pixel_ratio, Compositing::WindowResizingInProgress window_resize_in_progress)
{
    if (!isfinite(device_pixel_ratio) || device_pixel_ratio <= 0) {
        did_misbehave("Invalid device pixel ratio");
        return;
    }
    m_compositor_state->viewport_size_updated(context_id, viewport_size, device_pixel_ratio, window_resize_in_progress);
}

void ConnectionFromClient::set_ui_overlays(Web::CompositorContextId context_id, Compositing::UIOverlays overlays)
{
    m_compositor_state->set_ui_overlays(context_id, move(overlays));
}

void ConnectionFromClient::set_display_metadata(Web::CompositorContextId context_id, Optional<u64> display_id, double refresh_rate)
{
    m_compositor_state->set_display_metadata(context_id, display_id, refresh_rate);
}

void ConnectionFromClient::set_context_visibility(Web::CompositorContextId context_id, Compositing::ContextVisibility visibility)
{
    m_compositor_state->set_context_visibility(context_id, visibility);
}

void ConnectionFromClient::set_context_presents_from_cpu_memory(Web::CompositorContextId context_id, bool presents_from_cpu_memory)
{
    m_compositor_state->set_context_presents_from_cpu_memory(context_id, presents_from_cpu_memory);
}

void ConnectionFromClient::set_context_scales_frames_to_fit(Web::CompositorContextId context_id, bool scales_frames_to_fit)
{
    m_compositor_state->set_context_scales_frames_to_fit(context_id, scales_frames_to_fit);
}

void ConnectionFromClient::crash()
{
    warnln("Crashing Compositor process by request from Browser");
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

ConnectionFromWebContent* ConnectionFromClient::web_content_connection(i32 web_content_connection_id)
{
    auto it = m_web_content_connections.find(web_content_connection_id);
    if (it == m_web_content_connections.end())
        return nullptr;
    return it->value.ptr();
}

}

#include <Compositor/ConnectionFromPresentation.h>

namespace Compositor {

ConnectionFromPresentation::ConnectionFromPresentation(NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport> transport, NonnullRefPtr<CompositorState> compositor_state, CompositorState::PresentationCapabilities capabilities)
    : IPC::ConnectionFromClient<CompositorPresentationClientEndpoint, CompositorPresentationServerEndpoint>(*this, move(transport), 1)
    , m_compositor_state(move(compositor_state))
{
    m_presentation_id = m_compositor_state->register_presentation(*this, capabilities);
}

ConnectionFromPresentation::~ConnectionFromPresentation()
{
    m_compositor_state->unregister_presentation(*this);
}

void ConnectionFromPresentation::die()
{
    auto protector = NonnullRefPtr { *this };
    m_compositor_state->unregister_presentation(*this);
    if (auto on_death = move(m_on_death))
        on_death();
}

bool ConnectionFromPresentation::is_bound_to(Web::CompositorContextId context_id) const
{
    return m_compositor_state->presentation_for_context(context_id) == this;
}

void ConnectionFromPresentation::did_allocate_backing_stores(Web::CompositorContextId context_id, Vector<i32> bitmap_ids, Vector<Gfx::SharedImage>&& backing_stores)
{
    async_did_allocate_backing_stores(context_id, move(bitmap_ids), move(backing_stores));
}

void ConnectionFromPresentation::did_add_backing_stores(Web::CompositorContextId context_id, Vector<i32> bitmap_ids, Vector<Gfx::SharedImage>&& backing_stores)
{
    async_did_add_backing_stores(context_id, move(bitmap_ids), move(backing_stores));
}

void ConnectionFromPresentation::did_retire_backing_stores(Web::CompositorContextId context_id, Vector<i32> bitmap_ids)
{
    async_did_retire_backing_stores(context_id, move(bitmap_ids));
}

void ConnectionFromPresentation::post_message_to_presentation(IPC::MessageBuffer& buffer)
{
    (void)post_message(buffer);
}

ErrorOr<OwnPtr<IPC::MessageBuffer>> ConnectionFromPresentation::handle_raw(IPC::RawMessage& message)
{
    auto outcome = m_compositor_state->handle_message_from_presentation(m_presentation_id, message);
    if (outcome.misbehavior.has_value())
        did_misbehave(outcome.misbehavior->characters());
    return nullptr;
}

void ConnectionFromPresentation::presented_bitmap_ready_to_paint(Web::CompositorContextId context_id, i32 bitmap_id)
{
    if (!is_bound_to(context_id))
        return;
    m_compositor_state->presented_bitmap_ready_to_paint(context_id, bitmap_id);
}

void ConnectionFromPresentation::take_frame_snapshot(Web::CompositorContextId context_id, u64 request_id)
{
    Optional<Gfx::ShareableBitmap> snapshot;
    if (is_bound_to(context_id))
        snapshot = m_compositor_state->take_frame_snapshot(context_id);
    async_did_take_frame_snapshot(request_id, move(snapshot));
}

void ConnectionFromPresentation::set_client_gpu_presentation_capability(bool supported, u64 adapter_luid)
{
    m_compositor_state->set_client_gpu_presentation_capability(*this, supported, adapter_luid);
}

void ConnectionFromPresentation::set_scrollbar_track_press_jumps(bool jumps)
{
    m_compositor_state->set_scrollbar_track_press_jumps(*this, jumps);
}

#pragma once

namespace Compositor {

// Carries the frames of the contexts bound to it, the release of their buffers and the input to them.
class ConnectionFromPresentation final
    : public IPC::ConnectionFromClient<CompositorPresentationClientEndpoint, CompositorPresentationServerEndpoint>
    , public CompositorStateClient {
    C_OBJECT(ConnectionFromPresentation);

public:
    virtual ~ConnectionFromPresentation() override;

    void set_on_death(Function<void()> on_death) { m_on_death = move(on_death); }

    virtual PresentationId presentation_id() const override { return m_presentation_id; }

private:
    ConnectionFromPresentation(NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport>, NonnullRefPtr<CompositorState>, CompositorState::PresentationCapabilities);

    virtual void die() override;
    virtual void post_message_to_presentation(IPC::MessageBuffer&) override;
    virtual void did_allocate_backing_stores(Web::CompositorContextId, Vector<i32> bitmap_ids, Vector<Gfx::SharedImage>&& backing_stores) override;
    virtual void did_add_backing_stores(Web::CompositorContextId, Vector<i32> bitmap_ids, Vector<Gfx::SharedImage>&& backing_stores) override;
    virtual void did_retire_backing_stores(Web::CompositorContextId, Vector<i32> bitmap_ids) override;

    virtual ErrorOr<OwnPtr<IPC::MessageBuffer>> handle_raw(IPC::RawMessage&) override;
    virtual void presented_bitmap_ready_to_paint(Web::CompositorContextId, i32 bitmap_id) override;
    virtual void take_frame_snapshot(Web::CompositorContextId, u64 request_id) override;
    virtual void set_client_gpu_presentation_capability(bool supported, u64 adapter_luid) override;
    virtual void set_scrollbar_track_press_jumps(bool jumps) override;

    bool is_bound_to(Web::CompositorContextId) const;

    NonnullRefPtr<CompositorState> m_compositor_state;
    PresentationId m_presentation_id;
    Function<void()> m_on_death;
};

}

#include <AK/Debug.h>
#include <AK/Math.h>
#include <Compositor/ConnectionFromWebContent.h>
#include <LibGfx/ColorSpace.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/Page/InputEvent.h>

namespace Compositor {

ConnectionFromWebContent::ConnectionFromWebContent(NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport> transport, NonnullRefPtr<CompositorState> compositor_state, int client_id)
    : IPC::ConnectionFromClient<CompositorWebContentClientEndpoint, CompositorWebContentServerEndpoint>(*this, move(transport), client_id)
    , m_compositor_state(move(compositor_state))
    , m_web_content_client_id(m_compositor_state->register_web_content_client(*this))
    , m_canvas_host(m_compositor_state->skia_backend_context(), m_compositor_state->canvas_surface_registry(), m_video_frame_holds)
{
}

void ConnectionFromWebContent::die()
{
    auto protector = NonnullRefPtr { *this };
    drop_image_decoder();
    m_compositor_state->destroy_contexts_for_web_content_client(*this);
    if (m_on_death)
        m_on_death(*this);
}

void ConnectionFromWebContent::install_video_presentation_channel(IPC::TransportHandle handle)
{
    auto transport_or_error = handle.create_transport();
    if (transport_or_error.is_error()) {
        dbgln("Compositor: Could not take up a video presentation channel: {}", transport_or_error.error());
        return;
    }
    m_video_presentation_connection = adopt_ref(*new Media::VideoPresentationClientConnection(transport_or_error.release_value()));
    m_compositor_state->create_video_edges(*this);

    dbgln_if(VIDEO_PRESENTATION_CHANNEL_DEBUG, "Compositor: established video presentation channel for WebContent (client_id={})", client_id());
}

void ConnectionFromWebContent::install_render_clock_channel(IPC::TransportHandle handle)
{
    auto transport_or_error = handle.create_transport();
    if (transport_or_error.is_error()) {
        dbgln("Compositor: Could not take up a render clock channel: {}", transport_or_error.error());
        return;
    }
    // A new channel replaces the one before it, whose requests were for the contexts the process armed then.
    m_render_clock_connection = RenderClockConnection::construct(transport_or_error.release_value(), client_id());
    m_render_clock_connection->on_request_clock_tick = [this](Web::CompositorContextId context_id, double maximum_frames_per_second) {
        if (!context_is_owned_by_this_connection(context_id))
            return;
        if (!isfinite(maximum_frames_per_second) || maximum_frames_per_second <= 0) {
            did_misbehave("WebContent sent an invalid maximum clock tick rate");
            return;
        }
        m_compositor_state->request_clock_tick(context_id, maximum_frames_per_second);
    };
}

void ConnectionFromWebContent::drop_image_decoder()
{
    if (!m_image_decoder)
        return;
    m_image_decoder->on_death = nullptr;
    m_image_decoder->on_animation_frames_decoded = nullptr;
    m_image_decoder->on_animation_decode_failed = nullptr;
    m_image_decoder = nullptr;
}

void ConnectionFromWebContent::connect_to_image_decoder(IPC::TransportHandle handle)
{
    // NB: A new channel means a new decoder, whose sessions the ones of the old decoder must not be confused with.
    m_compositor_state->animated_image_decoder_lost(*this);
    drop_image_decoder();

    auto transport_or_error = handle.create_transport();
    if (transport_or_error.is_error()) {
        dbgln("Compositor: Could not take up an image decoder channel: {}", transport_or_error.error());
        return;
    }
    m_image_decoder = make_ref_counted<ImageDecoderClient::Client>(transport_or_error.release_value());
    m_image_decoder->on_death = [this] {
        m_compositor_state->animated_image_decoder_lost(*this);
        drop_image_decoder();
    };
    m_image_decoder->on_animation_frames_decoded = [this](i64 session_id, Vector<NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::Bitmap>> bitmaps) {
        m_compositor_state->animated_image_frames_decoded(*this, session_id, move(bitmaps));
    };
    m_image_decoder->on_animation_decode_failed = [this](i64 session_id, String) {
        m_compositor_state->animated_image_decode_failed(*this, session_id);
    };
}

void ConnectionFromWebContent::add_animated_image(u64 frame_id, i64 session_id, Gfx::IntSize size, Gfx::ColorSpace color_space, Vector<u32> frame_durations_in_milliseconds, u32 loop_count)
{
    if (frame_durations_in_milliseconds.is_empty()) {
        did_misbehave("WebContent added an animated image with no frames");
        return;
    }
    m_compositor_state->add_animated_image(*this, Compositing::ImageFrameResourceId { frame_id },
        { .session_id = session_id, .size = size, .color_space = move(color_space), .frame_durations_in_milliseconds = move(frame_durations_in_milliseconds), .loop_count = loop_count });
}

void ConnectionFromWebContent::remove_animated_image(u64 frame_id)
{
    m_compositor_state->remove_animated_image(*this, Compositing::ImageFrameResourceId { frame_id });
}

void ConnectionFromWebContent::start_animated_image(u64 frame_id)
{
    m_compositor_state->start_animated_image(*this, Compositing::ImageFrameResourceId { frame_id });
}

void ConnectionFromWebContent::stop_animated_image(u64 frame_id)
{
    m_compositor_state->stop_animated_image(*this, Compositing::ImageFrameResourceId { frame_id });
}

Messages::CompositorWebContentServer::AnimatedImageStateForTestingResponse ConnectionFromWebContent::animated_image_state_for_testing(u64 frame_id)
{
    auto const* image = m_compositor_state->animated_image(*this, Compositing::ImageFrameResourceId { frame_id });
    if (!image)
        return { false, 0, 0, 0 };
    auto now = MonotonicTime::now();
    return { image->is_animating(now), image->frame_index_at(now), image->shown_frame_index(), image->loops_completed_at(now) };
}

void ConnectionFromWebContent::request_animated_image_frames(AnimatedImage::FrameRequest const& request)
{
    if (m_image_decoder)
        m_image_decoder->request_animation_frames(request.session_id, request.start_frame_index, request.count);
}

void ConnectionFromWebContent::add_video_sink(Media::VideoSinkHandle video_sink_handle, NonnullRefPtr<Compositing::VideoFramePresentationPage> presentation_page)
{
    m_video_frame_holds.add_sink(video_sink_handle, move(presentation_page));
    m_compositor_state->add_video_sink(*this, video_sink_handle);
}

void ConnectionFromWebContent::remove_video_sink(Media::VideoSinkHandle video_sink_handle)
{
    m_video_frame_holds.remove_sink(video_sink_handle);
    m_canvas_host.forget_video_sink(video_sink_handle);
    m_compositor_state->remove_video_sink(*this, video_sink_handle);
}

void ConnectionFromWebContent::release_video_frame_hold(Media::VideoSinkHandle video_sink_handle, u64 generation)
{
    if (m_video_frame_holds.release_hold(video_sink_handle, generation).is_error())
        did_misbehave("WebContent released a video frame hold that it did not take");
}

void ConnectionFromWebContent::video_sink_presented_frame(Media::VideoSinkHandle video_sink_handle, RefPtr<Media::VideoFrame> frame, Media::DisplayingVideoSinkFrameCounts new_frame_counts)
{
    m_video_frame_holds.present_frame(video_sink_handle, move(frame), new_frame_counts);
}

void ConnectionFromWebContent::video_sink_counted_frames(Media::VideoSinkHandle video_sink_handle, Media::DisplayingVideoSinkFrameCounts new_frame_counts)
{
    m_video_frame_holds.add_frame_counts(video_sink_handle, new_frame_counts);
}

void ConnectionFromWebContent::bring_video_sink_up_to_date(Media::VideoSinkHandle video_sink_handle, u64 token)
{
    m_compositor_state->bring_video_sink_up_to_date(*this, video_sink_handle, token);
}

void ConnectionFromWebContent::video_sink_frame_freshness_changed(Media::VideoSinkHandle video_sink_handle, bool frame_is_up_to_date)
{
    m_video_frame_holds.set_frame_is_up_to_date(video_sink_handle, frame_is_up_to_date);
}

void ConnectionFromWebContent::create_video_edge(Media::VideoSinkHandle video_sink_handle)
{
    if (!m_video_presentation_connection)
        return;
    auto result = m_video_presentation_connection->create_edge(video_sink_handle, [this, video_sink_handle](NonnullRefPtr<Media::DisplayingVideoSink> sink) {
        m_compositor_state->on_video_sink_ready(*this, video_sink_handle, move(sink));
    });
    if (result.is_error())
        dbgln("Compositor: Not showing video sink {}: {}", video_sink_handle.value(), result.error());
}

void ConnectionFromWebContent::release_video_edge(Media::VideoSinkHandle video_sink_handle)
{
    if (m_video_presentation_connection)
        m_video_presentation_connection->release_edge(video_sink_handle);
}

void ConnectionFromWebContent::notify_compositor_lost()
{
    async_did_lose_compositor();
}

void ConnectionFromWebContent::post_message_to_web_content(IPC::MessageBuffer& buffer)
{
    (void)post_message(buffer);
}

void ConnectionFromWebContent::post_message_to_render_clock(IPC::MessageBuffer& buffer)
{
    if (m_render_clock_connection)
        (void)m_render_clock_connection->post_message(buffer);
}

ErrorOr<OwnPtr<IPC::MessageBuffer>> ConnectionFromWebContent::handle_raw(IPC::RawMessage& message)
{
    auto outcome = m_compositor_state->handle_message_from_web_content(web_content_client_id(), message);
    if (outcome.misbehavior.has_value()) {
        did_misbehave(outcome.misbehavior->characters());
        return nullptr;
    }
    return move(outcome.response);
}

bool ConnectionFromWebContent::context_is_owned_by_this_connection(Web::CompositorContextId context_id)
{
    switch (m_compositor_state->check_context_owner(context_id, web_content_client_id())) {
    case CompositorState::ContextOwnerCheckResult::OwnedByClient:
        return true;
    case CompositorState::ContextOwnerCheckResult::ContextUnavailable:
        return false;
    case CompositorState::ContextOwnerCheckResult::ConflictingOwner:
        did_misbehave("WebContent tried to use a compositor context owned by another connection");
        return false;
    }

    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

void ConnectionFromWebContent::request_rendering_opportunity(Web::CompositorContextId context_id, double maximum_frames_per_second)
{
    if (!context_is_owned_by_this_connection(context_id))
        return;
    if (!isfinite(maximum_frames_per_second) || maximum_frames_per_second <= 0) {
        did_misbehave("WebContent sent an invalid maximum frame rate");
        return;
    }
    m_compositor_state->request_rendering_opportunity(context_id, maximum_frames_per_second);
}

void ConnectionFromWebContent::hurry_rendering_opportunity(Web::CompositorContextId context_id)
{
    if (!context_is_owned_by_this_connection(context_id))
        return;
    m_compositor_state->hurry_rendering_opportunity(context_id);
}

void ConnectionFromWebContent::set_parent_context(Web::CompositorContextId context_id, Optional<Web::CompositorContextId> parent_context_id)
{
    if (!context_is_owned_by_this_connection(context_id))
        return;
    if (parent_context_id.has_value() && !m_compositor_state->context_can_be_nested_in(context_id, *parent_context_id)) {
        did_misbehave("WebContent nested a compositor context that cannot be nested");
        return;
    }
    m_compositor_state->set_parent_context(context_id, parent_context_id);
}

void ConnectionFromWebContent::stop_presenting_to_client(Web::CompositorContextId context_id)
{
    if (!context_is_owned_by_this_connection(context_id))
        return;
    m_compositor_state->stop_presenting_to_client(context_id);
}

void ConnectionFromWebContent::destroy_context(Web::CompositorContextId context_id)
{
    if (!context_is_owned_by_this_connection(context_id))
        return;
    m_compositor_state->destroy_context(context_id);
}

void ConnectionFromWebContent::register_typeface(Compositing::TypefaceRegistration registration)
{
    if (!m_registered_typefaces.register_typeface(move(registration)))
        did_misbehave("WebContent registered a typeface under an id that names another one");
}

void ConnectionFromWebContent::unregister_typeface(u64 typeface_id)
{
    m_registered_typefaces.unregister_typeface(typeface_id);
}

void ConnectionFromWebContent::register_image_frames(Vector<Compositing::DisplayListImageFrameResource> image_frames)
{
    for (auto& image_frame : image_frames)
        m_registered_image_frames.register_image_frame(move(image_frame));
}

void ConnectionFromWebContent::unregister_image_frame(Compositing::ImageFrameResourceId image_frame_id)
{
    m_registered_image_frames.unregister_image_frame(image_frame_id);
}

void ConnectionFromWebContent::describe_display_list_fonts(Web::CompositorContextId context_id, Vector<Compositing::DisplayListFontDescription> fonts)
{
    if (!context_is_owned_by_this_connection(context_id))
        return;
    if (!m_compositor_state->describe_display_list_fonts(context_id, fonts, m_registered_typefaces))
        did_misbehave("WebContent described a font of a typeface it has not registered");
}

void ConnectionFromWebContent::describe_canvas_2d_fonts(Vector<Compositing::DisplayListFontDescription> fonts)
{
    if (!m_canvas_host.describe_canvas_2d_fonts(fonts, m_registered_typefaces))
        did_misbehave("WebContent described a font of a typeface it has not registered");
}

void ConnectionFromWebContent::stage_rasterization(u64 token, Vector<Compositing::DisplayListFontDescription> fonts, Vector<Compositing::ImageFrameResourceId> image_frame_ids, Gfx::ShareableBitmap target_bitmap)
{
    if (!m_compositor_state->stage_rasterization(*this, token, fonts, image_frame_ids, m_registered_typefaces, move(target_bitmap)))
        did_misbehave("WebContent staged a rasterization under a token in use, or with a typeface or an image frame it has not registered");
}

Messages::CompositorWebContentServer::AllocatePlaceholderCanvasResponse ConnectionFromWebContent::allocate_placeholder_canvas()
{
    auto allocation = m_compositor_state->allocate_placeholder_canvas(*this);
    return { allocation.canvas_id, allocation.secret };
}

void ConnectionFromWebContent::release_placeholder_canvas(Compositing::CanvasId canvas_id)
{
    m_compositor_state->release_placeholder_canvas(*this, canvas_id);
}

void ConnectionFromWebContent::commit_placeholder_canvas(Compositing::CanvasId canvas_id, u64 secret, Optional<Compositing::CanvasId> source_canvas_id, Gfx::IntSize size, bool origin_clean)
{
    RefPtr<Gfx::PaintingSurface> source_surface;
    if (source_canvas_id.has_value()) {
        source_surface = m_canvas_host.presented_surface(*source_canvas_id);
        if (!source_surface)
            return;
    }
    m_compositor_state->commit_placeholder_canvas(canvas_id, secret, move(source_surface), size, origin_clean);
}

Messages::CompositorWebContentServer::GetPlaceholderCanvasPixelsResponse ConnectionFromWebContent::get_placeholder_canvas_pixels(Compositing::CanvasId canvas_id, Gfx::IntRect rect)
{
    auto result = m_compositor_state->read_placeholder_canvas_pixels(*this, canvas_id, rect);
    return { move(result.pixels), result.origin_clean };
}

void ConnectionFromWebContent::placeholder_canvas_committed(Compositing::CanvasId canvas_id, Gfx::IntSize size, bool origin_clean)
{
    async_placeholder_canvas_committed(canvas_id, size, origin_clean);
}

void ConnectionFromWebContent::viewport_size_updated(Web::CompositorContextId context_id, Gfx::IntSize viewport_size, double device_pixel_ratio, Compositing::WindowResizingInProgress window_resize_in_progress)
{
    if (!context_is_owned_by_this_connection(context_id))
        return;
    if (!isfinite(device_pixel_ratio) || device_pixel_ratio <= 0) {
        did_misbehave("WebContent sent an invalid device pixel ratio");
        return;
    }
    m_compositor_state->viewport_size_updated(context_id, viewport_size, device_pixel_ratio, window_resize_in_progress);
}

void ConnectionFromWebContent::present_frame(Web::CompositorContextId context_id, Gfx::IntRect viewport_rect)
{
    if (!context_is_owned_by_this_connection(context_id))
        return;
    m_compositor_state->present_frame(context_id, viewport_rect);
}

void ConnectionFromWebContent::prepare_remote_descendants_for_screenshot(Web::CompositorContextId context_id, u64 request_id)
{
    if (!context_is_owned_by_this_connection(context_id)) {
        async_remote_descendants_prepared_for_screenshot(request_id);
        return;
    }
    m_compositor_state->prepare_remote_descendants_for_screenshot(*this, context_id, request_id);
}

void ConnectionFromWebContent::did_paint_contexts_for_screenshot(u64 preparation_id)
{
    m_compositor_state->did_paint_contexts_for_screenshot(*this, preparation_id);
}

void ConnectionFromWebContent::request_screenshot(Web::CompositorContextId context_id, Compositing::ScreenshotRequestId request_id, Gfx::ShareableBitmap target_bitmap)
{
    if (!context_is_owned_by_this_connection(context_id))
        return;
    m_compositor_state->request_screenshot(*this, context_id, request_id, move(target_bitmap));
}

}

    : m_canvas_surfaces(canvas_surfaces)
{
}

void ContextRasterTargets::retain_only_fonts(ReadonlySpan<u64> font_ids)
{
    m_raster_cache.forget_fonts(m_fonts.retain_only(font_ids));
}

void ContextRasterTargets::retain_only_image_frames(ReadonlySpan<u64> image_frame_ids)
{
    m_raster_cache.forget_image_frames(m_image_frames.retain_only(image_frame_ids));
}

static RefPtr<Gfx::Font> fallback_font_of_overlay_labels(float font_size_in_points)
{
    static Optional<FlyString> s_system_sans_serif_family;
    auto& font_database = Gfx::FontDatabase::the();
    if (!s_system_sans_serif_family.has_value())
        s_system_sans_serif_family = font_database.resolve_generic_family("sans-serif"sv, 400, 0);
    if (s_system_sans_serif_family.has_value()) {
        if (auto font = font_database.get(*s_system_sans_serif_family, font_size_in_points, 400, Gfx::FontWidth::Normal, 0))
            return font;
    }
    return font_database.get("SerenitySans"_fly_string, font_size_in_points, 400, Gfx::FontWidth::Normal, 0);
}

Optional<OverlayLabel> ContextRasterTargets::shape_overlay_label(Optional<StringView> font_family, float font_size_in_points, double device_pixel_ratio, StringView text)
{
    RefPtr<Gfx::Font> font;
    if (font_family.has_value())
        font = Gfx::FontDatabase::the().get(MUST(FlyString::from_utf8(*font_family)), font_size_in_points, 400, Gfx::FontWidth::Normal, 0);
    if (!font)
        font = fallback_font_of_overlay_labels(font_size_in_points);
    if (!font)
        return {};
    auto skia_font = Compositor::skia_font(*font, static_cast<float>(device_pixel_ratio));
    if (!skia_font.has_value())
        return {};

    OverlayLabel label;
    auto glyph_count = skia_font->countText(text.characters_without_null_termination(), text.length(), SkTextEncoding::kUTF8);
    Vector<SkGlyphID> glyphs;
    glyphs.resize(glyph_count);
    skia_font->textToGlyphs(text.characters_without_null_termination(), text.length(), SkTextEncoding::kUTF8, { glyphs.data(), glyphs.size() });
    label.glyph_x_positions.resize(glyph_count);
    skia_font->getXPos({ glyphs.data(), glyphs.size() }, { label.glyph_x_positions.data(), label.glyph_x_positions.size() });
    label.glyph_ids.ensure_capacity(glyph_count);
    for (auto glyph : glyphs)
        label.glyph_ids.unchecked_append(glyph);
    label.width = skia_font->measureText(text.characters_without_null_termination(), text.length(), SkTextEncoding::kUTF8);
    SkFontMetrics font_metrics;
    skia_font->getMetrics(&font_metrics);
    label.ascent = font_metrics.fAscent;
    label.descent = font_metrics.fDescent;
    label.font_ascent = font->pixel_metrics().ascent;
    label.font_id = m_overlay_fonts.add(*font).value();
    return label;
}

bool ContextRasterTargets::set_drawn_video_sinks(ReadonlySpan<u64> handles)
{
    HashTable<Media::VideoSinkHandle> drawn_video_sinks;
    for (auto handle : handles)
        drawn_video_sinks.set(Media::VideoSinkHandle { handle });
    bool changed = drawn_video_sinks.size() != m_drawn_video_sinks.size();
    for (auto handle : m_drawn_video_sinks) {
        if (drawn_video_sinks.contains(handle))
            continue;
        m_raster_cache.forget_video_sink(handle);
        changed = true;
    }
    if (!changed)
        return false;
    m_drawn_video_sinks = move(drawn_video_sinks);
    return true;
}

}

// What the frames of a context are painted with and into: its backing stores, the resources and raster caches that its
// page and the overlays draw with, and the surfaces that the window server shows above its frames. Which frame is
// painted, and what of it, is decided by the presenting logic in Rust.
class ContextRasterTargets {
    AK_MAKE_NONCOPYABLE(ContextRasterTargets);
    AK_MAKE_NONMOVABLE(ContextRasterTargets);

public:
    explicit ContextRasterTargets(OwnedCanvasSurfaces);

    DrawnFonts& fonts() { return m_fonts; }
    DrawnFonts const& fonts() const { return m_fonts; }
    DrawnImageFrames& image_frames() { return m_image_frames; }
    DrawnImageFrames const& image_frames() const { return m_image_frames; }
    void retain_only_fonts(ReadonlySpan<u64> font_ids);
    void retain_only_image_frames(ReadonlySpan<u64> image_frame_ids);
    DisplayListRasterCache& raster_cache() { return m_raster_cache; }
    OwnedCanvasSurfaces const& canvas_surfaces() const { return m_canvas_surfaces; }

    // The fonts that the overlays draw with, apart from those of the page.
    DrawnFonts const& overlay_fonts() const { return m_overlay_fonts; }
    DisplayListRasterCache& overlay_raster_cache() { return m_overlay_raster_cache; }
    // Shapes a label of the overlays, in a font that the overlays' fonts then hold.
    Optional<OverlayLabel> shape_overlay_label(Optional<StringView> font_family, float font_size_in_points, double device_pixel_ratio, StringView text);

    // The video sinks that the display list of the context draws. Answers whether these are other sinks than before.
    bool set_drawn_video_sinks(ReadonlySpan<u64> handles);
    HashTable<Media::VideoSinkHandle> const& drawn_video_sinks() const { return m_drawn_video_sinks; }
    bool draws_video_sink(Media::VideoSinkHandle handle) const { return m_drawn_video_sinks.contains(handle); }

private:
    DrawnFonts m_fonts;
    DrawnImageFrames m_image_frames;
    DisplayListRasterCache m_raster_cache;
    OwnedCanvasSurfaces m_canvas_surfaces;
    DrawnFonts m_overlay_fonts;
    DisplayListRasterCache m_overlay_raster_cache;
    HashTable<Media::VideoSinkHandle> m_drawn_video_sinks;
};

// A CoreAnimation layer tree that this process commits frames into, and that another process shows in a view of its
// own by the ID of the tree's context.
class CoreAnimationRemoteLayer final : public RemoteLayer {
public:
    static OwnPtr<CoreAnimationRemoteLayer> try_create();
    virtual ~CoreAnimationRemoteLayer() override;

    virtual Compositing::RemoteLayerHostHandle host_handle() const override;
    virtual bool can_show(WindowServerPlacement const&, Content const&, double device_pixel_ratio) const override;
    virtual bool show_frame(Frame) override;
    virtual void place_frame(Optional<Gfx::IntSize> fit_within) override;

    enum class SublayerKind : u8 {
        // A video frame or a surface, in a layer of its own inside the layers that clip it.
        PlacedContent,
        Group,
        Tile,
        Color,
        Backdrop,
    };

private:
    CoreAnimationRemoteLayer() = default;

    struct ShownSublayer {
        SublayerKind kind { SublayerKind::PlacedContent };
        // The layer among the sublayers of the group the sublayer is in, or of the frame: the layer that clips placed
        // content, or the one layer of a group, a tile or a color.
        void* outermost_layer { nullptr };
        void* rounded_clip_layer { nullptr };
        // The mask of the outermost layer of placed content clipped by a path, and the identity of the path its
        // outline was made of.
        void* path_clip_mask_layer { nullptr };
        Optional<u64> identity_of_path_in_clip_mask;
        void* content_layer { nullptr };
        Variant<Empty, NonnullRefPtr<Media::VideoFrame>, PresentableSurface::Lease> content;
        // What a group, a tile or a color was last shown with, so that a frame sets only what it changes.
        Optional<RemoteSublayer::Group> shown_group;
        Optional<Gfx::IntRect> shown_rect;
        Optional<Gfx::Color> shown_color;
        Optional<bool> shown_as_opaque;
        Optional<RemoteSublayer::Backdrop> shown_backdrop;
        double shown_at_device_pixel_ratio { 0 };
        // Of a group, the sublayers in it, bottom to top.
        Vector<u64> identities_of_sublayers;
    };

    void lay_out_frame(Optional<Gfx::IntSize> fit_within);
    void show_sublayers(Vector<RemoteSublayer>&);
    ShownSublayer& shown_sublayer_of_kind(u64 identity, SublayerKind);
    void use_content_layer_of_kind_for(ShownSublayer&, RemoteSublayer const&);
    void update_shown_sublayer(ShownSublayer&, RemoteSublayer&);
    void update_path_clip_mask(ShownSublayer&, RemoteSublayer const&);
    void update_shown_group(ShownSublayer&, RemoteSublayer::Group const&);
    void update_shown_tile(ShownSublayer&, RemoteSublayer::Tile&, Gfx::IntRect);
    void update_shown_color(ShownSublayer&, Gfx::Color, Gfx::IntRect);
    void update_shown_backdrop(ShownSublayer&, RemoteSublayer::Backdrop const&);
    void show_content(ShownSublayer&, RemoteSublayer&);
    void stop_showing_content(ShownSublayer&);
    void stop_showing_sublayer(ShownSublayer&);
    void keep_video_frame_until_window_server_lets_go(NonnullRefPtr<Media::VideoFrame>);
    void release_video_frames_window_server_let_go_of();

    void* m_context { nullptr };
    void* m_root_layer { nullptr };
    void* m_frame_layer { nullptr };
    void* m_content_layer { nullptr };
    Gfx::IntSize m_painted_size;
    double m_device_pixel_ratio { 1.0 };
    HashMap<u64, ShownSublayer> m_shown_sublayers;
    // The sublayers of the frame itself, bottom to top.
    Vector<u64> m_identities_of_sublayers_of_frame;
    // Whether a sublayer got another layer under the identity it had, which the layer it is in has to take.
    bool m_sublayer_got_another_layer { false };
    // A decoder decodes into the surface of a frame again once nothing holds the frame, so a replaced frame is held
    // until the window server can no longer be reading it. Its surface reads as in use for as long as the decoder's
    // pixel buffer lives, which is as long as the frame does, so that cannot tell.
    struct ReplacedVideoFrame {
        NonnullRefPtr<Media::VideoFrame> frame;
        MonotonicTime replaced_at;
    };
    Vector<ReplacedVideoFrame> m_replaced_video_frames;
    RefPtr<Core::Timer> m_video_frame_release_timer;
    u32 m_core_animation_context_id { 0 };
};

// A CAContext carries a layer tree to the window server, where a CALayerHost in another process shows it by the
// context's ID. Neither is public API, so the context is reached through the runtime and checked before use.
@protocol LadybirdCoreAnimationContext <NSObject>

@end

@end
