void DisplayListRasterCache::forget_fonts(ReadonlySpan<u64> font_ids)
{
    if (font_ids.is_empty())
        return;
    HashTable<u64> forgotten_font_ids;
    for (auto id : font_ids)
        forgotten_font_ids.set(id);
    m_text_blobs.remove_all_matching([&](auto const& key, auto const& text_blob) {
        if (!forgotten_font_ids.contains(key.font_id))
            return false;
        m_text_blob_cache_bytes -= text_blob->byte_size;
        return true;
    });
}

void DisplayListRasterCache::forget_image_frames(ReadonlySpan<u64> image_frame_ids)
{
    // Filters retain the images of the image frames that they were made with.
    if (!image_frame_ids.is_empty())
        m_layer_image_filter_cache = nullptr;
    for (auto id : image_frame_ids)
        m_image_frame_images.remove(id);
}

DisplayListRasterCache::LayerImageFilterCache& DisplayListRasterCache::ensure_layer_image_filter_cache()
{
    if (!m_layer_image_filter_cache)
        m_layer_image_filter_cache = make<LayerImageFilterCache>();
    return *m_layer_image_filter_cache;
}

sk_sp<SkImageFilter> DisplayListRasterCache::layer_image_filter(ReplayLayer const& layer, Function<sk_sp<SkImageFilter>()> const& create)
{
    ReadonlyBytes filter_bytes { layer.filter_bytes, layer.filter_bytes_size };
    auto& entries = ensure_layer_image_filter_cache().entries;
    if (auto* cached = entries.find(layer.filter_cache_key); cached && cached->filter_bytes.bytes() == filter_bytes)
        return cached->image_filter;
    auto image_filter = create();
    entries.this_frame.set(layer.filter_cache_key, LayerImageFilterCache::Entry { MUST(ByteBuffer::copy(filter_bytes)), image_filter });
    return image_filter;
}

sk_sp<SkImageFilter> DisplayListRasterCache::backdrop_image_filter(ReplayLayer const& layer, Optional<Gfx::FloatRect> blur_edge, bool limited_to_region, Function<sk_sp<SkImageFilter>()> const& create)
{
    ReadonlyBytes filter_bytes { layer.backdrop_filter_bytes, layer.backdrop_filter_bytes_size };
    auto& entries = ensure_layer_image_filter_cache().backdrop_entries;
    if (auto* cached = entries.find(layer.filter_cache_key); cached
        && cached->filter_bytes.bytes() == filter_bytes
        && cached->region == layer.backdrop_region
        && cached->blur_edge == blur_edge
        && cached->corner_radii == layer.backdrop_corner_radii
        && cached->base_color == layer.backdrop_base_color
        && cached->limited_to_region == limited_to_region)
        return cached->image_filter;
    auto image_filter = create();
    entries.this_frame.set(layer.filter_cache_key, LayerImageFilterCache::BackdropEntry { MUST(ByteBuffer::copy(filter_bytes)), layer.backdrop_region, blur_edge, layer.backdrop_corner_radii, layer.backdrop_base_color, limited_to_region, image_filter });
    return image_filter;
}

static sk_sp<SkImage> create_skia_image(Gfx::DecodedImageFrame const& frame, RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext> const& skia_backend_context)
{
    if (skia_backend_context) {
        if (auto image = Gfx::sk_texture_image_sharing_pixels_of_decoded_image_frame(frame, *skia_backend_context))
            return image;
    }

    auto raster_image = Gfx::sk_image_from_decoded_image_frame(frame);
    auto* gr_context = skia_backend_context ? skia_backend_context->sk_context() : nullptr;
    if (!gr_context)
        return raster_image;

    auto texture_image = SkImages::TextureFromImage(gr_context, raster_image.get(), skgpu::Mipmapped::kNo, skgpu::Budgeted::kYes);
    if (texture_image)
        return texture_image;
    return raster_image;
}

sk_sp<SkImage> DisplayListRasterCache::image_for_image_frame(Gfx::DecodedImageFrame const& frame, ImageFrameResourceId id, RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext> const& skia_backend_context)
{
    if (auto cached = m_image_frame_images.get(id.value()); cached.has_value()) {
        auto const& image = *cached.value();
        // A frame replaced under the same id has pixels of its own, so this also catches a replacement that was
        // not evicted.
        if (image.frame.has_same_pixels_as(frame) && image.skia_backend_context.ptr() == skia_backend_context.ptr())
            return image.image;
    }

    auto image = create_skia_image(frame, skia_backend_context);
    m_image_frame_images.set(id.value(), make<ImageFrameImage>(frame, skia_backend_context, image));
    return image;
}

void DisplayListRasterCache::forget_video_sink(Media::VideoSinkHandle handle)
{
    m_video_sink_images.remove(handle.value());
}

void DisplayListRasterCache::forget_vector_images_other_than(ReadonlySpan<u64> drawn_vector_image_ids)
{
    if (m_vector_image_rasters.is_empty())
        return;
    HashTable<u64> drawn;
    for (auto id : drawn_vector_image_ids)
        drawn.set(id);
    m_vector_image_rasters.remove_all_matching([&](auto id, auto const&) { return !drawn.contains(id); });
}

sk_sp<SkImage> DisplayListRasterCache::image_for_video_sink(Media::VideoSinkHandle handle, Media::VideoFrame const& frame, RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext> const& skia_backend_context, Gfx::IntSize& visible_size)
{
    auto& cached_image = *m_video_sink_images.ensure(handle.value(), [] { return make<VideoSinkImage>(); });
    auto cached_image_matches = [&] {
        if (!cached_image.image)
            return false;
        if (cached_image.skia_backend_context != skia_backend_context)
            return false;
        return cached_image.frame_id == frame.id();
    }();
    if (cached_image_matches) {
        cached_image.drawn_frame = frame;
        visible_size = cached_image.visible_size;
        return cached_image.image;
    }

    auto image = sk_image_from_video_frame(frame, skia_backend_context);
    if (!image)
        return nullptr;

    cached_image.frame_id = frame.id();
    cached_image.drawn_frame = frame;
    cached_image.skia_backend_context = skia_backend_context;
    cached_image.image = image;
    cached_image.visible_size = frame.size().to_type<int>();
    visible_size = cached_image.visible_size;
    return image;
}

sk_sp<SkImage> DisplayListRasterCache::repeated_tile_raster(u64 tile_key, Gfx::IntSize tile_size, RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext> const& skia_backend_context) const
{
    auto cached_raster = m_repeated_tile_rasters.find(tile_key);
    if (cached_raster == m_repeated_tile_rasters.end())
        return nullptr;

    auto const& raster = *cached_raster->value;
    if (raster.tile_size != tile_size)
        return nullptr;
    if (raster.skia_backend_context.ptr() != skia_backend_context.ptr())
        return nullptr;

    return raster.image;
}

void DisplayListRasterCache::add_repeated_tile_raster(u64 tile_key, Gfx::IntSize tile_size, RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext> const& skia_backend_context, sk_sp<SkImage> image)
{
    constexpr size_t max_repeated_tile_raster_bytes = 64 * MiB;
    auto raster = make<RepeatedTileRaster>(tile_size, skia_backend_context, move(image));
    if (m_repeated_tile_raster_bytes + raster->byte_size() > max_repeated_tile_raster_bytes) {
        m_repeated_tile_rasters.clear();
        m_repeated_tile_raster_bytes = 0;
    }
    if (auto existing = m_repeated_tile_rasters.get(tile_key); existing.has_value())
        m_repeated_tile_raster_bytes -= (*existing)->byte_size();
    m_repeated_tile_raster_bytes += raster->byte_size();
    m_repeated_tile_rasters.set(tile_key, move(raster));
}

sk_sp<SkImage> DisplayListRasterCache::vector_image_raster(DisplayListResourceId id, RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext> const& skia_backend_context, Gfx::IntRect visible_rect_in_recorded_space, Gfx::IntRect& raster_rect_in_recorded_space)
{
    auto cached_rasters = m_vector_image_rasters.find(id.value());
    if (cached_rasters == m_vector_image_rasters.end())
        return nullptr;

    auto& rasters = *cached_rasters->value;
    if (rasters.skia_backend_context.ptr() != skia_backend_context.ptr())
        return nullptr;

    for (size_t i = 0; i < rasters.rasters.size(); ++i) {
        if (!rasters.rasters[i].rect_in_recorded_space.contains(visible_rect_in_recorded_space))
            continue;
        if (i != 0) {
            auto raster = move(rasters.rasters[i]);
            rasters.rasters.remove(i);
            rasters.rasters.prepend(move(raster));
        }
        rasters.rasters.first().last_used = MonotonicTime::now();
        raster_rect_in_recorded_space = rasters.rasters.first().rect_in_recorded_space;
        return rasters.rasters.first().image;
    }
    return {};
}

bool DisplayListRasterCache::has_rasterized_vector_image(DisplayListResourceId id) const
{
    return m_vector_image_rasters.contains(id.value());
}

bool DisplayListRasterCache::reserve_vector_image_raster(DisplayListResourceId id, RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext> const& skia_backend_context, Gfx::IntRect rect_in_recorded_space)
{
    auto& rasters = *m_vector_image_rasters.ensure(id.value(), [&] {
        return make<VectorImageRasters>(skia_backend_context);
    });

    if (rasters.skia_backend_context.ptr() != skia_backend_context.ptr()) {
        rasters.rasters.clear();
        rasters.skia_backend_context = skia_backend_context;
    }

    // When the budget is exceeded, evict rasters that are not part of the active working set (not used
    // recently). If everything is recently used, the live working set genuinely exceeds the budget; then skip
    // caching this raster instead of evicting hot entries, so an oversized page degrades to direct replay for
    // the overflow instead of thrashing the whole cache. Additions are rare by design, so the total is simply
    // recomputed here instead of being tracked incrementally.
    constexpr size_t max_vector_image_raster_cache_bytes = 512 * MiB;
    auto raster_bytes = static_cast<size_t>(rect_in_recorded_space.width()) * rect_in_recorded_space.height() * 4;
    auto total_bytes = raster_bytes + m_vector_image_raster_cache_reserved_bytes;
    for (auto const& it : m_vector_image_rasters)
        total_bytes += it.value->total_byte_size();
    if (total_bytes > max_vector_image_raster_cache_bytes) {
        auto now = MonotonicTime::now();
        for (auto& it : m_vector_image_rasters) {
            it.value->rasters.remove_all_matching([&](auto const& raster) {
                if (now - raster.last_used < AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(250))
                    return false;
                total_bytes -= raster.byte_size();
                return true;
            });
        }
        if (total_bytes > max_vector_image_raster_cache_bytes)
            return false;
    }

    // Reserve before rasterizing: the records of an image can create other cached rasters while they are painted.
    m_vector_image_raster_cache_reserved_bytes += raster_bytes;
    return true;
}

sk_sp<SkImage> DisplayListRasterCache::finish_vector_image_raster(DisplayListResourceId id, RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext> const& skia_backend_context, Gfx::IntRect rect_in_recorded_space, sk_sp<SkImage> image)
{
    auto raster_bytes = static_cast<size_t>(rect_in_recorded_space.width()) * rect_in_recorded_space.height() * 4;
    m_vector_image_raster_cache_reserved_bytes -= raster_bytes;
    if (!image)
        return {};

    auto& rasters = *m_vector_image_rasters.ensure(id.value(), [&] {
        return make<VectorImageRasters>(skia_backend_context);
    });
    if (rasters.skia_backend_context.ptr() != skia_backend_context.ptr()) {
        rasters.rasters.clear();
        rasters.skia_backend_context = skia_backend_context;
    }
    if (rasters.rasters.size() == VectorImageRasters::max_rasters)
        rasters.rasters.take_last();
    rasters.rasters.prepend({ rect_in_recorded_space, image });
    return image;
}

static u64 text_blob_glyph_hash(ReadonlySpan<DisplayListGlyph> glyphs)
{
    u64 hash = glyphs.size();
    for (auto const& glyph : glyphs) {
        u64 position = static_cast<u64>(bit_cast<u32>(glyph.position.x())) << 32 | bit_cast<u32>(glyph.position.y());
        hash = (hash ^ position) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
        hash = (hash ^ glyph.glyph_id) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
        hash ^= hash >> 32;
    }
    return hash;
}

static sk_sp<SkTextBlob> make_text_blob(Gfx::Font const& font, float scale, ReadonlySpan<DisplayListGlyph> glyphs, [[maybe_unused]] u8 font_smoothing, bool uses_lcd_text)
{
    if (font.is_invisible())
        return nullptr;
    auto maybe_sk_font = skia_font(font, scale, uses_lcd_text);
    if (!maybe_sk_font.has_value())
        return nullptr;
    auto& sk_font = *maybe_sk_font;
#ifdef AK_OS_MACOS
    // INTEROP: Blink disables CoreGraphics outline dilation for antialiased text.
    // https://source.chromium.org/chromium/chromium/src/+/main:third_party/blink/renderer/platform/fonts/mac/font_platform_data_mac.mm
    switch (static_cast<FontSmoothing>(font_smoothing)) {
    case FontSmoothing::Antialiased:
        sk_font.setEdging(SkFont::Edging::kAntiAlias);
        sk_font.setHinting(SkFontHinting::kNone);
        break;
    case FontSmoothing::None:
        sk_font.setEdging(SkFont::Edging::kAlias);
        break;
    case FontSmoothing::SubpixelAntialiased:
        sk_font.setEdging(SkFont::Edging::kSubpixelAntiAlias);
        break;
    default:
        break;
    }
#endif
    SkTextBlobBuilder builder;
    auto const& run = builder.allocRunPos(sk_font, glyphs.size());

    auto font_ascent = font.pixel_metrics().ascent;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < glyphs.size(); ++i) {
        run.glyphs[i] = glyphs[i].glyph_id;
        run.pos[i * 2] = glyphs[i].position.x() * scale;
        run.pos[i * 2 + 1] = (glyphs[i].position.y() + font_ascent) * scale;
    }
    return builder.make();
}

sk_sp<SkTextBlob> DisplayListRasterCache::text_blob(Gfx::Font const& font, FontResourceId font_id, float scale, ReadonlySpan<DisplayListGlyph> glyphs, u8 font_smoothing, bool uses_lcd_text)
{
    constexpr size_t max_text_blob_cache_bytes = 16 * MiB;
    constexpr auto text_blob_idle_duration = AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(250);

    ReadonlyBytes glyph_bytes { reinterpret_cast<u8 const*>(glyphs.data()), glyphs.size() * sizeof(DisplayListGlyph) };
    TextBlobCacheKey key { font_id.value(), bit_cast<u32>(scale), font_smoothing, uses_lcd_text, text_blob_glyph_hash(glyphs) };
    auto now = MonotonicTime::now();

    if (auto cached = m_text_blobs.find(key); cached != m_text_blobs.end()) {
        auto& text_blob = *cached->value;
        if (text_blob.glyph_bytes.bytes() == glyph_bytes) {
            text_blob.last_used = now;
            return text_blob.blob;
        }
        m_text_blob_cache_bytes -= text_blob.byte_size;
        m_text_blobs.remove(cached);
    }

    auto blob = make_text_blob(font, scale, glyphs, font_smoothing, uses_lcd_text);
    if (!blob)
        return nullptr;

    auto byte_size = glyphs.size() * 24 + 256;
    if (m_text_blob_cache_bytes + byte_size > max_text_blob_cache_bytes) {
        if (now - m_text_blob_cache_sweep_time < text_blob_idle_duration)
            return blob;
        m_text_blob_cache_sweep_time = now;
        m_text_blobs.remove_all_matching([&](auto const&, auto const& text_blob) {
            if (now - text_blob->last_used < text_blob_idle_duration)
                return false;
            m_text_blob_cache_bytes -= text_blob->byte_size;
            return true;
        });
        if (m_text_blob_cache_bytes + byte_size > max_text_blob_cache_bytes)
            return blob;
    }

    m_text_blob_cache_bytes += byte_size;
    m_text_blobs.set(key, make<TextBlob>(MUST(ByteBuffer::copy(glyph_bytes)), blob, byte_size, now));
    return blob;
}

SkPath DisplayListRasterCache::clip_path(u64 path_identity, Gfx::PathData const& path)
{
    if (auto it = m_clip_paths.find(path_identity); it != m_clip_paths.end())
        return it->value->path;
    auto entry = m_clip_paths_from_last_frame.take(path_identity).value_or_lazy_evaluated([&] {
        return make<ClipPath>(Gfx::to_skia_path(path));
    });
    auto skia_path = entry->path;
    m_clip_paths.set(path_identity, move(entry));
    return skia_path;
}

void DisplayListRasterCache::drop_what_was_not_used_since_last_frame()
{
    swap(m_clip_paths, m_clip_paths_from_last_frame);
    m_clip_paths.clear_with_capacity();
    if (m_layer_image_filter_cache) {
        m_layer_image_filter_cache->entries.begin_frame();
        m_layer_image_filter_cache->backdrop_entries.begin_frame();
    }
}

}

namespace Compositor {

struct TextBlobCacheKey {
    u64 font_id { 0 };
    u32 scale_bits { 0 };
    u8 font_smoothing { 0 };
    bool uses_lcd_text { false };
    u64 glyph_hash { 0 };

    bool operator==(TextBlobCacheKey const&) const = default;
};

}

namespace AK {

template<>
struct Traits<Compositor::TextBlobCacheKey> : public DefaultTraits<Compositor::TextBlobCacheKey> {
    static unsigned hash(Compositor::TextBlobCacheKey const& key)
    {
        auto font_options = (static_cast<unsigned>(key.font_smoothing) << 1) | key.uses_lcd_text;
        return pair_int_hash(pair_int_hash(u64_hash(key.font_id ^ key.glyph_hash), key.scale_bits), font_options);
    }
};

}

namespace Compositor {

// The Skia images and text blobs that the player makes from the fonts and the image frames that one display list, or
// what else is painted, draws. They are kept until it stops drawing what they were made from.
class DisplayListRasterCache {
    AK_MAKE_NONCOPYABLE(DisplayListRasterCache);
    AK_MAKE_NONMOVABLE(DisplayListRasterCache);

public:
    DisplayListRasterCache();
    ~DisplayListRasterCache();

    // Drops everything made from these fonts, which are no longer drawn.
    void forget_fonts(ReadonlySpan<u64> font_ids);
    // Drops everything made from these image frames, which are no longer drawn.
    void forget_image_frames(ReadonlySpan<u64> image_frame_ids);
    // Drops the image made from the frame of a video sink that is no longer drawn.
    void forget_video_sink(Media::VideoSinkHandle);
    // Drops the rasters of every SVG image but these, which are the ones that the display list of the context draws.
    void forget_vector_images_other_than(ReadonlySpan<u64> drawn_vector_image_ids);

    sk_sp<SkImage> image_for_image_frame(Gfx::DecodedImageFrame const&, Compositing::ImageFrameResourceId, RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext> const&);
    // The image of the frame that the video sink shows. The image can be larger than the frame, whose visible size is
    // the part of it to draw.
    sk_sp<SkImage> image_for_video_sink(Media::VideoSinkHandle, Media::VideoFrame const&, RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext> const&, Gfx::IntSize& visible_size);
    sk_sp<SkImage> repeated_tile_raster(u64 tile_key, Gfx::IntSize, RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext> const&) const;
    void add_repeated_tile_raster(u64 tile_key, Gfx::IntSize, RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext> const&, sk_sp<SkImage>);
    sk_sp<SkImage> vector_image_raster(Compositing::DisplayListResourceId, RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext> const&, Gfx::IntRect visible_rect_in_recorded_space, Gfx::IntRect& raster_rect_in_recorded_space);
    bool has_rasterized_vector_image(Compositing::DisplayListResourceId) const;
    // Makes room for a raster of the image, which then counts against the budget until it is finished, and answers false
    // where the rasters in use leave no room for it.
    bool reserve_vector_image_raster(Compositing::DisplayListResourceId, RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext> const&, Gfx::IntRect rect_in_recorded_space);
    // Keeps the raster that was reserved, unless it could not be made.
    sk_sp<SkImage> finish_vector_image_raster(Compositing::DisplayListResourceId, RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext> const&, Gfx::IntRect rect_in_recorded_space, sk_sp<SkImage>);
    sk_sp<SkTextBlob> text_blob(Gfx::Font const&, Compositing::FontResourceId, float scale, ReadonlySpan<Compositing::DisplayListGlyph>, u8 font_smoothing, bool uses_lcd_text = false);

    sk_sp<SkImageFilter> layer_image_filter(Compositing::ReplayLayer const&, Function<sk_sp<SkImageFilter>()> const& create);
    sk_sp<SkImageFilter> backdrop_image_filter(Compositing::ReplayLayer const&, Optional<Gfx::FloatRect> blur_edge, bool limited_to_region, Function<sk_sp<SkImageFilter>()> const& create);

    // The Skia path for a path that stays the same for as long as it has this identity. Keeping one Skia path lets
    // the caches that are keyed on it work.
    SkPath clip_path(u64 path_identity, Gfx::PathData const&);
    // Drops the clip paths and layer filters that were not used since the last call.
    void drop_what_was_not_used_since_last_frame();

private:
    struct ImageFrameImage;
    struct VideoSinkImage;
    struct RepeatedTileRaster;
    struct VectorImageRasters;
    struct TextBlob;
    struct ClipPath;
    struct LayerImageFilterCache;
    LayerImageFilterCache& ensure_layer_image_filter_cache();

    OwnPtr<LayerImageFilterCache> m_layer_image_filter_cache;

    HashMap<u64, NonnullOwnPtr<ImageFrameImage>> m_image_frame_images;
    HashMap<u64, NonnullOwnPtr<VideoSinkImage>> m_video_sink_images;
    HashMap<u64, NonnullOwnPtr<RepeatedTileRaster>> m_repeated_tile_rasters;
    size_t m_repeated_tile_raster_bytes { 0 };
    HashMap<u64, NonnullOwnPtr<VectorImageRasters>> m_vector_image_rasters;
    size_t m_vector_image_raster_cache_reserved_bytes { 0 };
    HashMap<TextBlobCacheKey, NonnullOwnPtr<TextBlob>> m_text_blobs;
    size_t m_text_blob_cache_bytes { 0 };
    MonotonicTime m_text_blob_cache_sweep_time { MonotonicTime::now() };
    HashMap<u64, NonnullOwnPtr<ClipPath>> m_clip_paths;
    HashMap<u64, NonnullOwnPtr<ClipPath>> m_clip_paths_from_last_frame;
};

}

#include <AK/HashTable.h>
#include <Compositor/DrawnResources.h>
#include <LibCompositing/DisplayList/RegisteredTypefaces.h>
#include <LibGfx/Font/Font.h>

namespace Compositor {

template<typename Value>
static Vector<u64> retain_only_the_ids(HashMap<u64, Value>& values_by_id, ReadonlySpan<u64> ids)
{
    HashTable<u64> retained_ids;
    for (auto id : ids)
        retained_ids.set(id);
    Vector<u64> removed_ids;
    values_by_id.remove_all_matching([&](auto id, auto const&) {
        if (retained_ids.contains(id))
            return false;
        removed_ids.append(id);
        return true;
    });
    return removed_ids;
}

bool DrawnFonts::add_described_fonts_made_of_registered_typefaces(ReadonlySpan<Compositing::DisplayListFontDescription> descriptions, Compositing::RegisteredTypefaces const& registered_typefaces)
{
    bool every_typeface_is_registered = true;
    for (auto const& description : descriptions) {
        // NB: Font IDs are immutable. Keep the typeface that Skia's glyph caches were built for.
        if (contains(description.id))
            continue;
        auto font = registered_typefaces.font_described_by(description);
        if (!font) {
            every_typeface_is_registered = false;
            continue;
        }
        m_fonts_by_id.set(description.id.value(), font.release_nonnull());
    }
    return every_typeface_is_registered;
}

Compositing::FontResourceId DrawnFonts::add(Gfx::Font const& font)
{
    auto id = font.id();
    m_fonts_by_id.ensure(id, [&]() -> NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::Font const> { return font; });
    return { id };
}

Vector<u64> DrawnFonts::retain_only(ReadonlySpan<u64> font_ids)
{
    return retain_only_the_ids(m_fonts_by_id, font_ids);
}

bool DrawnImageFrames::take_registered(ReadonlySpan<u64> image_frame_ids, Compositing::RegisteredImageFrames const& registered_image_frames)
{
    Vector<NonnullRefPtr<Compositing::RegisteredImageFrame>> image_frames_to_hold;
    Vector<u64> ids_of_image_frames_to_hold;
    for (auto id : image_frame_ids) {
        if (m_image_frames_by_id.contains(id))
            continue;
        auto image_frame = registered_image_frames.image_frame(Compositing::ImageFrameResourceId { id });
        if (!image_frame)
            return false;
        image_frames_to_hold.append(image_frame.release_nonnull());
        ids_of_image_frames_to_hold.append(id);
    }
    for (size_t i = 0; i < image_frames_to_hold.size(); ++i)
        m_image_frames_by_id.set(ids_of_image_frames_to_hold[i], move(image_frames_to_hold[i]));
    return true;
}

Vector<u64> DrawnImageFrames::retain_only(ReadonlySpan<u64> image_frame_ids)
{
    return retain_only_the_ids(m_image_frames_by_id, image_frame_ids);
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/HashMap.h>
#include <AK/NonnullRefPtr.h>
#include <AK/Span.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibCompositing/DisplayList/DisplayListResources.h>
#include <LibCompositing/DisplayList/RegisteredImageFrames.h>

#include <LibGfx/Forward.h>

namespace Compositor {

// The fonts that a display list, the overlays, a batch of a canvas 2D stream or a staged rasterization draws, each
// under the id that its commands name it by.
class DrawnFonts {
public:
    [[nodiscard]] bool add_described_fonts_made_of_registered_typefaces(ReadonlySpan<Compositing::DisplayListFontDescription>, Compositing::RegisteredTypefaces const&);
    Compositing::FontResourceId add(Gfx::Font const&);

    bool contains(Compositing::FontResourceId id) const { return m_fonts_by_id.contains(id.value()); }
    Gfx::Font const& font(Compositing::FontResourceId id) const { return *m_fonts_by_id.get(id.value()).value(); }

    // Returns the ids of the fonts that were removed.
    Vector<u64> retain_only(ReadonlySpan<u64> font_ids);

private:
    HashMap<u64, NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::Font const>> m_fonts_by_id;
};

// The registered image frames that a display list and its visual context tree, or a staged rasterization, draw.
class DrawnImageFrames {
public:
    // Holds the image frame registered under each id that it holds none for, and answers whether it then holds one
    // for every id. It takes none where one of them is missing.
    [[nodiscard]] bool take_registered(ReadonlySpan<u64> image_frame_ids, Compositing::RegisteredImageFrames const&);

    size_t size() const { return m_image_frames_by_id.size(); }
    bool contains(Compositing::ImageFrameResourceId id) const { return m_image_frames_by_id.contains(id.value()); }
    Compositing::RegisteredImageFrame const& image_frame(Compositing::ImageFrameResourceId id) const { return *m_image_frames_by_id.get(id.value()).value(); }
    Compositing::RegisteredImageFrame& image_frame(Compositing::ImageFrameResourceId id) { return *m_image_frames_by_id.get(id.value()).value(); }

    template<typename Callback>
    void for_each(Callback callback) const
    {
        for (auto const& [id, image_frame] : m_image_frames_by_id)
            callback(Compositing::ImageFrameResourceId { id }, *image_frame);
    }

    // Returns the ids of the image frames that were removed.
    Vector<u64> retain_only(ReadonlySpan<u64> image_frame_ids);

private:
    HashMap<u64, NonnullRefPtr<Compositing::RegisteredImageFrame>> m_image_frames_by_id;
};

#include <AK/Atomic.h>
#include <AK/Math.h>
#include <AK/NeverDestroyed.h>
#include <AK/ScopeGuard.h>
#include <AK/TypeCasts.h>
#include <Compositor/FontSkia.h>
#include <LibGfx/Font/Font.h>
#include <LibGfx/RasterizerData.h>

#include <core/SkData.h>
#include <core/SkFont.h>
#include <core/SkFontArguments.h>
#include <core/SkFontMgr.h>
#include <core/SkFontTypes.h>
#include <core/SkStream.h>
#include <core/SkSurfaceProps.h>
#include <core/SkTypeface.h>
#include <ports/SkFontMgr_empty.h>

#if defined(USE_FONTCONFIG)
#    include <LibGfx/Font/GlobalFontConfig.h>
#endif

#ifdef AK_OS_MACOS
#    include <LibGfx/Font/TypefaceCoreText.h>
#    include <ports/SkTypeface_mac.h>
#    include <src/ports/SkTypeface_mac_ct.h>
#endif

#ifdef AK_OS_WINDOWS
#    include <src/ports/SkTypeface_win_dw.h>
#endif

using Compositor::FontRasterizer;

static FontRasterizer s_font_rasterizer { FontRasterizer::Platform };
static bool s_use_test_font_rendering { false };

#if defined(USE_FONTCONFIG)
static SkFontHinting to_skia_hinting(Gfx::FontHintingStyle style)
{
    switch (style) {
    case Gfx::FontHintingStyle::None:
        return SkFontHinting::kNone;
    case Gfx::FontHintingStyle::Slight:
        return SkFontHinting::kSlight;
    case Gfx::FontHintingStyle::Normal:
        return SkFontHinting::kNormal;
    case Gfx::FontHintingStyle::Full:
        return SkFontHinting::kFull;
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

// The scale's bits sit above, bit 0 says the word holds an answer, bits 1 and 2 carry the style and bit 3 the
// autohinting flag, and bit 4 records whether the font allows LCD text.
static constexpr u64 rendering_options_memo_holds_answer = 1;

static u64 encode_rendering_options(float scale, Gfx::FontRenderingOptions options)
{
    return (static_cast<u64>(bit_cast<u32>(scale)) << 32)
        | rendering_options_memo_holds_answer
        | (static_cast<u64>(to_underlying(options.hinting_style)) << 1)
        | (static_cast<u64>(options.force_autohinting) << 3)
        | (static_cast<u64>(options.allows_lcd_text) << 4);
}
#endif

// What the compositor keeps with each typeface.
struct Gfx::TypefaceRasterizerData final : public Gfx::RasterizerData {
    explicit TypefaceRasterizerData(sk_sp<SkTypeface> typeface)
        : typeface(move(typeface))
    {
    }

    sk_sp<SkTypeface> typeface;
};

namespace {

#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
// CoreText places the bitmap glyphs of an installed font, such as Apple Color Emoji, lower than it places the same
// glyphs of font data, whose bitmaps would then sit on the baseline. So an installed font is drawn by its name. Only
// the font that draws the glyphs changes, which has the same glyphs as the data that shapes them.
static sk_sp<SkTypeface> make_installed_bitmap_font_skia_typeface(Gfx::Typeface const& typeface)
{
    if (!typeface.system_font_identifier().has_value() || !Gfx::typeface_has_bitmap_glyphs(typeface))
        return nullptr;
    auto postscript_name = typeface.postscript_name();
    if (!postscript_name.has_value())
        return nullptr;
    auto installed_typeface = Gfx::TypefaceCoreText::try_load_postscript_name(*postscript_name);
    if (installed_typeface.is_error())
        return nullptr;
    return SkMakeTypefaceFromCTFont(installed_typeface.value()->core_text_font());
}
#endif

// The Skia typeface of font data from the font manager of the platform. Null where FreeType is that font manager.
// The typeface loaders are called directly, because a font manager also finds the system fonts when it is made.
sk_sp<SkTypeface> make_platform_skia_typeface([[maybe_unused]] sk_sp<SkData> const& data, [[maybe_unused]] Gfx::Typeface const& typeface)
{
    if (s_font_rasterizer == FontRasterizer::FreeType)
        return nullptr;
#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
    if (auto installed_typeface = make_installed_bitmap_font_skia_typeface(typeface))
        return installed_typeface;

    // The CoreText typeface loader of Skia loads only the first face of font data.
    if (typeface.collection_index() != 0) {
        auto font = Gfx::create_core_text_font_from_data(typeface.font_data_backing().release_nonnull(), typeface.font_data(), typeface.collection_index());
        if (!font)
            return nullptr;
        ScopeGuard release_font = [&] { CFRelease(font); };
        return SkMakeTypefaceFromCTFont(font);
    }
    return SkTypeface_Mac::MakeFromStream(std::make_unique<SkMemoryStream>(data), SkFontArguments {});
#elif defined(AK_OS_WINDOWS)
    return DWriteFontTypeface::MakeFromStream(std::make_unique<SkMemoryStream>(data), SkFontArguments {}.setCollectionIndex(static_cast<int>(typeface.collection_index())));
#else
    return nullptr;
#endif
}

sk_sp<SkTypeface> make_skia_typeface(Gfx::Typeface const& typeface)
{
#ifdef AK_OS_MACOS
    if (auto const* core_text_typeface = as_if<Gfx::TypefaceCoreText>(typeface))
        return SkMakeTypefaceFromCTFont(core_text_typeface->core_text_font());
#endif
    auto backing = typeface.font_data_backing();
    if (!backing)
        return nullptr;

    // Skia can keep a typeface in text blobs and glyph caches after the typeface is gone, so the data keeps its backing.
    auto bytes = typeface.font_data();
    auto data = SkData::MakeWithProc(
        bytes.data(), bytes.size(), [](void const*, void* context) { static_cast<Gfx::Typeface::FontDataBacking*>(context)->unref(); }, backing.leak_ref());
    if (auto skia_typeface = make_platform_skia_typeface(data, typeface))
        return skia_typeface;

    // FreeType also loads some data that the font manager of the platform does not.
    static NeverDestroyed<sk_sp<SkFontMgr>> font_manager { SkFontMgr_New_Custom_Empty() };
    if (auto skia_typeface = (*font_manager)->makeFromStream(std::make_unique<SkMemoryStream>(data), SkFontArguments {}.setCollectionIndex(static_cast<int>(typeface.collection_index()))))
        return skia_typeface;

    dbgln("Compositor: Skia does not load the typeface of family '{}'", typeface.family());
    return nullptr;
}

// The Skia typeface of a typeface. Null if Skia cannot load it.
sk_sp<SkTypeface> const& skia_typeface(Gfx::Typeface const& typeface)
{
    return typeface.rasterizer_data([&] { return make<Gfx::TypefaceRasterizerData>(make_skia_typeface(typeface)); }).typeface;
}

// The typeface of the font's variations. Without variations, or if Skia cannot apply them, it is the typeface itself.
sk_sp<SkTypeface> typeface_with_variations(Gfx::Font const& font)
{
    auto const& typeface = skia_typeface(font.typeface());
    if (!typeface)
        return nullptr;
    auto axes = font.variation_settings().to_sorted_list();
    if (axes.is_empty())
        return typeface;

    Vector<SkFontArguments::VariationPosition::Coordinate> coordinates;
    coordinates.ensure_capacity(axes.size());
    for (auto const& axis : axes)
        coordinates.unchecked_append({ axis.tag.to_u32(), axis.value });
    SkFontArguments arguments;
    arguments.setVariationDesignPosition({ coordinates.data(), static_cast<int>(coordinates.size()) });
    arguments.setCollectionIndex(static_cast<int>(font.typeface().collection_index()));
    if (auto clone = typeface->makeClone(arguments))
        return clone;
    return typeface;
}

}

// What the compositor keeps with each font.
struct Gfx::FontRasterizerData final : public Gfx::RasterizerData {
    explicit FontRasterizerData(Font const& font)
        : typeface(typeface_with_variations(font))
    {
    }

    sk_sp<SkTypeface> typeface;
#if defined(USE_FONTCONFIG)
    // A font is drawn at one scale most of the time, and fontconfig's answer is a pure function of the family, the
    // scaled pixel size, the weight and the slope, so one answer is kept.
    Atomic<u64> rendering_options_memo { 0 };
#endif
};

namespace {

Gfx::FontRasterizerData& font_data(Gfx::Font const& font)
{
    return font.rasterizer_data([&] { return make<Gfx::FontRasterizerData>(font); });
}

#if defined(USE_FONTCONFIG)
Gfx::FontRenderingOptions rendering_options(Gfx::Font const& font, float scale, Gfx::FontRasterizerData& data)
{
    auto& memo = data.rendering_options_memo;
    auto value = memo.load(AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed);
    if ((value & rendering_options_memo_holds_answer) != 0 && bit_cast<float>(static_cast<u32>(value >> 32)) == scale) {
        return Gfx::FontRenderingOptions {
            .hinting_style = static_cast<Gfx::FontHintingStyle>((value >> 1) & 3),
            .force_autohinting = ((value >> 3) & 1) != 0,
            .allows_lcd_text = ((value >> 4) & 1) != 0,
        };
    }

    auto options = Gfx::GlobalFontConfig::the().rendering_options_for_font(font.family(), font.pixel_size() * scale, font.weight(), font.slope());
    memo.store(encode_rendering_options(scale, options), AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed);
    return options;
}
#endif

}

namespace Compositor {

void set_font_rasterizer(FontRasterizer rasterizer)
{
    s_font_rasterizer = rasterizer;
}

void use_test_font_rendering()
{
    s_use_test_font_rendering = true;
}

#if defined(AK_OS_LINUX) && defined(USE_FONTCONFIG)
static SkPixelGeometry configured_pixel_geometry()
{
    switch (Gfx::GlobalFontConfig::the().subpixel_order()) {
    case Gfx::FontSubpixelOrder::None:
        return kUnknown_SkPixelGeometry;
    case Gfx::FontSubpixelOrder::RGB:
        return kRGB_H_SkPixelGeometry;
    case Gfx::FontSubpixelOrder::BGR:
        return kBGR_H_SkPixelGeometry;
    case Gfx::FontSubpixelOrder::VerticalRGB:
        return kRGB_V_SkPixelGeometry;
    case Gfx::FontSubpixelOrder::VerticalBGR:
        return kBGR_V_SkPixelGeometry;
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}
#endif

SkSurfaceProps skia_text_surface_properties(u32 flags, [[maybe_unused]] bool allows_lcd_text)
{
    auto geometry = kUnknown_SkPixelGeometry;
#if defined(AK_OS_LINUX) && defined(USE_FONTCONFIG)
    if (allows_lcd_text && !s_use_test_font_rendering) {
        static auto const configured_geometry = configured_pixel_geometry();
        geometry = configured_geometry;
    }
#endif
#if defined(AK_OS_LINUX)
    // Skia's default sRGB text gamma makes partially covered pixels too bright on dark backgrounds.
    // Use Chromium's Linux text contrast and gamma.
    if (!s_use_test_font_rendering)
        return { flags, geometry, 0.2f, 1.2f };
#endif
    return { flags, geometry };
}

Optional<SkFont> skia_font(Gfx::Font const& font, float scale, [[maybe_unused]] bool requests_lcd_text)
{
    auto& data = font_data(font);
    if (!data.typeface)
        return {};

    SkFont sk_font { data.typeface, font.pixel_size() * scale };
    sk_font.setSubpixel(true);

    // NB: Skia's x axis runs as text does but its y axis runs downward, so a slant that tips the glyphs' tops toward
    //     the end of the line is a negative skew.
    auto synthesis = font.synthesis();
    sk_font.setEmbolden(synthesis.bold);
    if (synthesis.oblique_angle != 0)
        sk_font.setSkewX(-AK::tan(AK::to_radians(synthesis.oblique_angle)));

#if defined(USE_FONTCONFIG)
    if (s_use_test_font_rendering) {
        sk_font.setHinting(SkFontHinting::kNormal);
    } else {
        auto options = rendering_options(font, scale, data);
        sk_font.setHinting(to_skia_hinting(options.hinting_style));
        sk_font.setForceAutoHinting(options.force_autohinting);
        if (requests_lcd_text && options.allows_lcd_text)
            sk_font.setEdging(SkFont::Edging::kSubpixelAntiAlias);
    }
#endif

    return sk_font;
}

}

FILE: Services/Compositor/main.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <Compositor/BackingStoreFactory.h>
#include <Compositor/ConnectionFromClient.h>
#include <Compositor/FontSkia.h>
#include <Compositor/MainDispatchQueue.h>
#include <Compositor/Sandbox.h>
#include <Compositor/SkiaBackendContext.h>
#include <LibCore/ArgsParser.h>
#include <LibCore/CrashHandler.h>
#include <LibCore/EventLoop.h>
#include <LibCore/Platform/TaskRole.h>
#include <LibCore/Platform/ThreadQoS.h>
#include <LibCore/Process.h>
#include <LibCore/ResourceImplementationFile.h>
#include <LibCore/StatsLog.h>
#include <LibGfx/Font/Font.h>
#include <LibGfx/GpuDeviceIdentity.h>
#include <LibIPC/SingleServer.h>
#include <LibMain/Main.h>
#include <LibPlatformFeatures/ProcessFeatures.h>

ErrorOr<int> ladybird_main(Main::Arguments arguments)
{
    AK::set_rich_debug_enabled(true);

    StringView mach_server_name;
    StringView cache_path;
    StringView resource_root;
    bool wait_for_debugger = false;
    bool enable_test_mode = false;
    StringView platform_features;
    bool force_fontconfig = false;
    bool disable_sandbox = false;
    StringView gpu_device;

    int crash_report_fd = -1;
    StringView stats_log_directory;
    Core::ArgsParser args_parser;
    args_parser.add_option(stats_log_directory, "Directory for process statistics (JSON lines)", "stats-log-dir", 0, "path");
    args_parser.add_option(crash_report_fd, "Descriptor for anonymous crash diagnostics", "crash-report-fd", 0, "fd");
    args_parser.add_option(mach_server_name, "Mach server name", "mach-server-name", 0, "mach_server_name");
    args_parser.add_option(cache_path, "Path to the profile cache", "cache-path", 0, "path");
    args_parser.add_option(resource_root, "Path to the browser's resources", "resource-root", 0, "path");
    args_parser.add_option(wait_for_debugger, "Wait for debugger", "wait-for-debugger");
    args_parser.add_option(enable_test_mode, "Enable test mode", "test-mode");
    args_parser.add_option(platform_features, "The platform features the Browser decided this process may use", "platform-features", 0, "feature,...");
    args_parser.add_option(force_fontconfig, "Force using fontconfig for font loading", "force-fontconfig");
    args_parser.add_option(disable_sandbox, "Disable process sandboxing", "disable-sandbox");
    args_parser.add_option(gpu_device, "The GPU to paint on, as the presentation identifies it", "gpu-device", 0, "identity");
    StringView drm_format_modifiers;
    args_parser.add_option(drm_format_modifiers, "The DRM format modifiers the presentation can import from that GPU", "drm-format-modifiers", 0, "hex,...");
    args_parser.parse(arguments);

    auto stats_log = TRY(Core::StatsLog::create(stats_log_directory, "Compositor"sv));

    if (resource_root.is_empty())
        return Error::from_string_literal("--resource-root is required");

    PlatformFeatures::ProcessFeatures::initialize_for_current_process(TRY(PlatformFeatures::ProcessFeatures::from_string(PlatformFeatures::FeatureProcess::Compositor, platform_features)));
    auto const& features = PlatformFeatures::ProcessFeatures::the();

    Optional<Gfx::GpuDeviceIdentity> preferred_gpu_device;
    if (!gpu_device.is_empty()) {
        preferred_gpu_device = Gfx::GpuDeviceIdentity::from_string(gpu_device);
        if (!preferred_gpu_device.has_value())
            return Error::from_string_literal("Malformed GPU device identity");
    }

    if (!drm_format_modifiers.is_empty()) {
        Vector<u64> modifiers;
        for (auto modifier : drm_format_modifiers.split_view(',')) {
            auto value = modifier.to_number<u64>(TrimWhitespace::No, 16);
            if (!value.has_value())
                return Error::from_string_literal("Malformed DRM format modifier");
            modifiers.append(*value);
        }
        Compositor::set_presentation_drm_format_modifiers(move(modifiers));
    }

    if (crash_report_fd >= 0) {
        if (auto result = Core::CrashHandler::initialize(crash_report_fd); result.is_error())
            warnln("Could not install crash report handler: {}", result.error());
    }

    if (wait_for_debugger)
        Core::Process::wait_for_debugger_and_break();

    if (auto result = Core::Platform::adopt_foreground_application_task_role(); result.is_error())
        warnln("Could not adopt the foreground application task role: {}", result.error());
    if (auto result = Core::Platform::set_current_thread_qos(Core::Platform::ThreadQoS::UserInteractive); result.is_error())
        warnln("Could not set main thread QoS: {}", result.error());

    if (enable_test_mode)
        Compositor::use_test_font_rendering();

    Core::ResourceImplementation::install(make<Core::ResourceImplementationFile>(TRY(String::from_utf8(resource_root))));
    if (force_fontconfig)
        Compositor::set_font_rasterizer(Compositor::FontRasterizer::FreeType);

#if defined(AK_OS_LINUX)
    // NB: The GPU driver starts threads, and Landlock does not confine a thread that already runs. Seccomp covers every
    //     thread, so the rest of the sandbox can wait until the driver is done with the syscalls that only its setup uses.
    if (!disable_sandbox)
        TRY(Compositor::restrict_filesystem(resource_root));
#endif

    if (features.is_enabled(PlatformFeatures::Feature::GpuPainting))
        Gfx::SkiaBackendContext::initialize_gpu_backend(preferred_gpu_device);
    auto skia_backend_context = Gfx::SkiaBackendContext::the_main_thread_context();

    auto& event_loop = Core::EventLoop::initialize_for_current_thread();
#ifdef AK_OS_MACOS
    if (auto result = Compositor::drain_main_dispatch_queue_in_event_loop(); result.is_error())
        warnln("Unable to drain the main dispatch queue, so HDR video will not show: {}", result.error());
#endif

    if (!disable_sandbox)
        TRY(Compositor::apply_sandbox(mach_server_name, cache_path, resource_root));

    Optional<Gfx::GpuDeviceIdentity> gpu_device_identity;
#ifdef USE_VULKAN_DMABUF_IMAGES
    // Hardware decoding only starts once the GPU it decodes on is named, which is only done when its frames can be imported.
    if (skia_backend_context && features.is_enabled(PlatformFeatures::Feature::YCbCrImport) && skia_backend_context->vulkan_context().can_sample_through_ycbcr_conversion)
        gpu_device_identity = skia_backend_context->vulkan_context().device_identity;
#endif

    auto client = TRY(IPC::take_over_accepted_client_from_system_server<Compositor::ConnectionFromClient>(
        mach_server_name, move(skia_backend_context), enable_test_mode));
    client->async_gpu_device_identity_reported(move(gpu_device_identity));

    if (stats_log)
        stats_log->start_sampling([](JsonObject& values) {
            if (auto context = Gfx::SkiaBackendContext::the_main_thread_context())
                values.set("gpu.skia_resource_cache_bytes"sv, context->resource_cache_bytes());
        });

    return event_loop.exec();
}

FILE: Services/Compositor/MainDispatchQueue.h
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#pragma once

#include <AK/Error.h>

namespace Compositor {

// Blocks submitted to the main dispatch queue run on this thread's event loop from then on. Only a run loop drains the
// queue otherwise, and AVFoundation shows nothing until its blocks there have run. Must be called on the main thread,
// once its event loop exists.
ErrorOr<void> drain_main_dispatch_queue_in_event_loop();

}

FILE: Services/Compositor/MainDispatchQueue.mm
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <AK/Types.h>
#include <Compositor/MainDispatchQueue.h>
#include <LibCore/Notifier.h>

#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <mach/mach.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <sys/event.h>
#include <unistd.h>

namespace Compositor {

// libdispatch wakes the main thread's run loop through a port of its own, and the run loop has libdispatch drain the
// queue once the port has a message. Neither function is public, as CoreFoundation is their only intended caller.
using MainQueuePortFunction = mach_port_t (*)();
using MainQueueDrainFunction = void (*)(void*);

ErrorOr<void> drain_main_dispatch_queue_in_event_loop()
{
    VERIFY(pthread_main_np());

    auto main_queue_port = reinterpret_cast<MainQueuePortFunction>(dlsym(RTLD_DEFAULT, "_dispatch_get_main_queue_port_4CF"));
    auto drain_main_queue = reinterpret_cast<MainQueueDrainFunction>(dlsym(RTLD_DEFAULT, "_dispatch_main_queue_callback_4CF"));
    if (!main_queue_port || !drain_main_queue)
        return Error::from_string_literal("libdispatch has no functions to drain its main queue with");
    auto port = main_queue_port();
    if (port == MACH_PORT_NULL)
        return Error::from_string_literal("libdispatch has no port for its main queue");

    // A kqueue reads as ready for as long as the port holds a message, so the event loop can wait on it like a socket.
    auto port_queue = kqueue();
    if (port_queue < 0)
        return Error::from_syscall("kqueue"sv, errno);
    struct kevent change;
    EV_SET(&change, port, EVFILT_MACHPORT, EV_ADD, 0, 0, nullptr);
    if (kevent(port_queue, &change, 1, nullptr, 0, nullptr) < 0) {
        auto error = Error::from_syscall("kevent"sv, errno);
        close(port_queue);
        return error;
    }

    auto notifier = Core::Notifier::construct(port_queue, Core::Notifier::Type::Read);
    notifier->on_activation = [port, port_queue, drain_main_queue] {
        struct kevent event;
        timespec const no_wait {};
        (void)kevent(port_queue, nullptr, 0, &event, 1, &no_wait);

        // The message only wakes the run loop, and the run loop takes it off the port before libdispatch drains.
        struct {
            mach_msg_header_t header;
            u8 body_and_trailer[256];
        } message;
        while (mach_msg(&message.header, MACH_RCV_MSG | MACH_RCV_TIMEOUT, 0, sizeof(message), port, 0, MACH_PORT_NULL) == MACH_MSG_SUCCESS) { }
        // Blocks on the main queue autorelease into the run loop's pool, which this process doesn't have.
        @autoreleasepool {
            drain_main_queue(nullptr);
        }
    };
    // The queue is drained for as long as the process lives.
    (void)notifier.leak_ref();
    return {};
}

}
