// Enable WebGL if we're on macOS and can use Metal, if Linux can use ANGLE's OpenGL backend for CPU-painting tests,
// if Windows can use ANGLE's Direct3D 11 backend, or if we can use shareable Vulkan images.
#if defined(ENABLE_WEBGL_CPU_PAINTING_SURFACE) || defined(USE_VULKAN_DMABUF_IMAGES)
#    define ENABLE_WEBGL 1
#endif

namespace Compositor {

using namespace Compositing::WebGL;

struct OpenGLContext::ColorBuffer {
    RefPtr<Gfx::PaintingSurface> painting_surface;
#ifdef AK_OS_MACOS
    OwnPtr<Gfx::SharedImageBuffer> shared_image_buffer;
#endif
#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS) || defined(USE_DIRECTX)
    RefPtr<PresentableSurface> presentable_surface;
#endif
    EGLSurface surface { EGL_NO_SURFACE };
#if defined(USE_VULKAN_DMABUF_IMAGES) || defined(USE_DIRECTX)
    EGLImage egl_image { EGL_NO_IMAGE };
#endif
    GLuint texture { 0 };

    bool is_allocated() const { return painting_surface; }
};

struct OpenGLContext::Impl {
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    EGLDisplay display { EGL_NO_DISPLAY };
    EGLConfig config { EGL_NO_CONFIG_KHR };
    EGLContext context { EGL_NO_CONTEXT };

    GLuint framebuffer { 0 };
    GLuint depth_buffer { 0 };
    EGLint texture_target { 0 };
    bool uses_cpu_painting_surface { false };
    Optional<bool> supports_copy_texture {};

    // A shared drawing buffer is composited straight from GPU memory, so presenting moves the default framebuffer
    // to another color buffer instead of letting the page draw over the frame being composited. Besides the
    // presented buffer and the one being drawn, a third holds the frame presented before, which a raster submitted
    // before the latest present may still be reading on the GPU. A fourth is allocated only while the window server
    // shows the buffers itself and still reads the other two. The CPU painting surface is a copy made when
    // presenting, so it only uses the first.
    static constexpr size_t usual_color_buffer_count = 3;
    Array<ColorBuffer, usual_color_buffer_count + 1> color_buffers {};
    // What Skia draws for an upload into one of the page's textures, at the size of the latest upload.
    ColorBuffer upload_color_buffer {};
    Gfx::IntSize upload_color_buffer_size {};
    size_t drawing_color_buffer_index { 0 };
    Optional<size_t> presented_color_buffer_index {};

#ifdef USE_VULKAN_DMABUF_IMAGES
    struct {
        PFNEGLQUERYDMABUFFORMATSEXTPROC query_dma_buf_formats { nullptr };
        PFNEGLQUERYDMABUFMODIFIERSEXTPROC query_dma_buf_modifiers { nullptr };
    } ext_procs;
#endif
};

OpenGLContext::OpenGLContext(RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext> skia_backend_context, Impl impl, WebGLVersion webgl_version, DrawingBufferOptions drawing_buffer_options)
    : m_skia_backend_context(move(skia_backend_context))
    , m_impl(make<Impl>(move(impl)))
    , m_webgl_version(webgl_version)
    , m_drawing_buffer_options(drawing_buffer_options)
{
}

OpenGLContext::~OpenGLContext()
{
#ifdef ENABLE_WEBGL
    free_surface_resources();
    eglMakeCurrent(m_impl->display, EGL_NO_SURFACE, EGL_NO_SURFACE, EGL_NO_CONTEXT);
    eglDestroyContext(m_impl->display, m_impl->context);
#endif
}

void OpenGLContext::free_surface_resources()
{
#ifdef ENABLE_WEBGL
    eglMakeCurrent(m_impl->display, EGL_NO_SURFACE, EGL_NO_SURFACE, m_impl->context);

    if (m_impl->framebuffer) {
        glDeleteFramebuffers(1, &m_impl->framebuffer);
        m_impl->framebuffer = 0;
    }

    if (m_impl->depth_buffer) {
        glDeleteRenderbuffers(1, &m_impl->depth_buffer);
        m_impl->depth_buffer = 0;
    }

    for (auto& color_buffer : m_impl->color_buffers)
        free_color_buffer(color_buffer);
    free_color_buffer(m_impl->upload_color_buffer);
    m_impl->upload_color_buffer_size = {};
    m_impl->drawing_color_buffer_index = 0;
    m_impl->presented_color_buffer_index.clear();
#endif
}

void OpenGLContext::free_color_buffer([[maybe_unused]] ColorBuffer& color_buffer)
{
#ifdef ENABLE_WEBGL
    if (color_buffer.texture) {
        glDeleteTextures(1, &color_buffer.texture);
        color_buffer.texture = 0;
    }

#    if defined(USE_VULKAN_DMABUF_IMAGES) || defined(USE_DIRECTX)
    if (color_buffer.egl_image != EGL_NO_IMAGE) {
        eglDestroyImage(m_impl->display, color_buffer.egl_image);
        color_buffer.egl_image = EGL_NO_IMAGE;
    }
#    endif

    if (color_buffer.surface != EGL_NO_SURFACE) {
#    ifdef AK_OS_MACOS
        eglReleaseTexImage(m_impl->display, color_buffer.surface, EGL_BACK_BUFFER);
#    endif
        eglDestroySurface(m_impl->display, color_buffer.surface);
        color_buffer.surface = EGL_NO_SURFACE;
    }

    // NB: The compositor may still hold the painting surface of the presented buffer; it keeps the shared image alive.
    color_buffer.painting_surface = nullptr;
#    ifdef AK_OS_MACOS
    color_buffer.shared_image_buffer = nullptr;
#    endif
#    if defined(AK_OS_MACOS) || defined(USE_DIRECTX)
    color_buffer.presentable_surface = nullptr;
#    endif
#endif
}

#ifdef ENABLE_WEBGL
static EGLConfig get_egl_config(EGLDisplay display)
{
    EGLint const config_attribs[] = {
        EGL_SURFACE_TYPE, EGL_PBUFFER_BIT,
        EGL_RENDERABLE_TYPE, EGL_OPENGL_ES2_BIT,
        EGL_RED_SIZE, 8,
        EGL_GREEN_SIZE, 8,
        EGL_BLUE_SIZE, 8,
        EGL_ALPHA_SIZE, 8,
        EGL_DEPTH_SIZE, 24,
        EGL_STENCIL_SIZE, 8,
        EGL_NONE
    };

    EGLint number_of_configs;
    eglChooseConfig(display, config_attribs, NULL, 0, &number_of_configs);

    Vector<EGLConfig> configs;
    configs.resize(number_of_configs);
    eglChooseConfig(display, config_attribs, configs.data(), number_of_configs, &number_of_configs);
    return number_of_configs > 0 ? configs[0] : EGL_NO_CONFIG_KHR;
}

static bool extension_list_contains(GLenum list, StringView extension)
{
    auto const* extensions = reinterpret_cast<char const*>(glGetString(list));
    return extensions && StringView { extensions, strlen(extensions) }.split_view(' ').contains_slow(extension);
}
#endif

#ifdef USE_DIRECTX
static Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11Device1> get_d3d11_device(EGLDisplay display)
{
    EGLAttrib device = 0;
    if (!eglQueryDisplayAttribEXT(display, EGL_DEVICE_EXT, &device))
        return {};
    EGLAttrib d3d11_device = 0;
    if (!eglQueryDeviceAttribEXT(reinterpret_cast<EGLDeviceEXT>(device), EGL_D3D11_DEVICE_ANGLE, &d3d11_device))
        return {};
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11Device1> d3d11_device1;
    if (FAILED(reinterpret_cast<ID3D11Device*>(d3d11_device)->QueryInterface(IID_PPV_ARGS(&d3d11_device1))))
        return {};
    return d3d11_device1;
}
#endif

void const* OpenGLContext::address_of_function([[maybe_unused]] char const* name)
{
#ifdef ENABLE_WEBGL
    return reinterpret_cast<void const*>(eglGetProcAddress(name));
#else
    return nullptr;
#endif
}

OwnPtr<OpenGLContext> OpenGLContext::create(RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext> skia_backend_context, WebGLVersion webgl_version, [[maybe_unused]] DrawingBufferOptions drawing_buffer_options)
{
#ifdef ENABLE_WEBGL
#    ifdef ENABLE_WEBGL_CPU_PAINTING_SURFACE
    bool use_cpu_painting_surface = !skia_backend_context;
#    else
    if (!skia_backend_context)
        return {};
    bool use_cpu_painting_surface = false;
#    endif

#    if !defined(AK_OS_MACOS) && !defined(USE_VULKAN_DMABUF_IMAGES) && !defined(USE_DIRECTX)
    if (!use_cpu_painting_surface)
        return {};
#    endif

    Vector<EGLAttrib, 8> display_attributes {
        EGL_PLATFORM_ANGLE_TYPE_ANGLE,
#    if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
        EGL_PLATFORM_ANGLE_TYPE_METAL_ANGLE,
#    elif defined(USE_VULKAN_DMABUF_IMAGES) || (defined(AK_OS_LINUX) && !defined(AK_OS_ANDROID))
        EGL_PLATFORM_ANGLE_TYPE_OPENGL_ANGLE,
        EGL_PLATFORM_ANGLE_NATIVE_PLATFORM_TYPE_ANGLE,
        EGL_PLATFORM_SURFACELESS_MESA,
#    elif defined(AK_OS_WINDOWS)
        EGL_PLATFORM_ANGLE_TYPE_D3D11_ANGLE,
#    endif
    };
#    ifdef USE_DIRECTX
    // ANGLE can only open the textures that Skia composites if its device is on the same adapter as Skia's.
    if (!use_cpu_painting_surface) {
        auto adapter_luid = skia_backend_context->direct3d_context().adapter_luid();
        display_attributes.append(EGL_PLATFORM_ANGLE_D3D_LUID_HIGH_ANGLE);
        display_attributes.append(static_cast<i32>(adapter_luid >> 32));
        display_attributes.append(EGL_PLATFORM_ANGLE_D3D_LUID_LOW_ANGLE);
        display_attributes.append(static_cast<u32>(adapter_luid));
    }
#    endif
    display_attributes.append(EGL_NONE);

    auto display = eglGetPlatformDisplay(EGL_PLATFORM_ANGLE_ANGLE, reinterpret_cast<void*>(EGL_DEFAULT_DISPLAY), display_attributes.data());
    if (display == EGL_NO_DISPLAY) {
        dbgln("Failed to get EGL display");
        return {};
    }

    EGLint major, minor;
    if (!eglInitialize(display, &major, &minor)) {
        dbgln("Failed to initialize EGL");
        return {};
    }

    auto* config = get_egl_config(display);
    if (config == EGL_NO_CONFIG_KHR) {
        dbgln("Failed to find EGLConfig");
        return {};
    }

    EGLint texture_target;
#    if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
    if (use_cpu_painting_surface) {
        texture_target = EGL_TEXTURE_2D;
    } else {
        eglGetConfigAttrib(display, config, EGL_BIND_TO_TEXTURE_TARGET_ANGLE, &texture_target);
        VERIFY(texture_target == EGL_TEXTURE_RECTANGLE_ANGLE || texture_target == EGL_TEXTURE_2D);
    }
#    else
    texture_target = EGL_TEXTURE_2D;
#    endif

    EGLint context_attributes[] = {
        EGL_CONTEXT_CLIENT_VERSION,
        webgl_version == WebGLVersion::WebGL1 ? 2 : 3,
        EGL_CONTEXT_WEBGL_COMPATIBILITY_ANGLE,
        EGL_TRUE,
        EGL_ROBUST_RESOURCE_INITIALIZATION_ANGLE,
        EGL_TRUE,
        EGL_CONTEXT_OPENGL_BACKWARDS_COMPATIBLE_ANGLE,
        EGL_FALSE,
        // WebGL has no client arrays. With them, ANGLE's GL backend shares a default vertex array between contexts.
        EGL_CONTEXT_CLIENT_ARRAYS_ENABLED_ANGLE,
        EGL_FALSE,
#    ifdef USE_VULKAN_DMABUF_IMAGES
        // we need GL_OES_EGL_image
        EGL_EXTENSIONS_ENABLED_ANGLE,
        EGL_TRUE,
#    endif
        EGL_NONE,
        EGL_NONE,
    };
    auto context = eglCreateContext(display, config, EGL_NO_CONTEXT, context_attributes);
    if (context == EGL_NO_CONTEXT) {
        dbgln("Failed to create EGL context");
        return {};
    }

#    ifdef USE_VULKAN_DMABUF_IMAGES
    PFNEGLQUERYDMABUFFORMATSEXTPROC pfn_egl_query_dma_buf_formats_ext = nullptr;
    PFNEGLQUERYDMABUFMODIFIERSEXTPROC pfn_egl_query_dma_buf_modifiers_ext = nullptr;

    if (!use_cpu_painting_surface) {
        pfn_egl_query_dma_buf_formats_ext = reinterpret_cast<PFNEGLQUERYDMABUFFORMATSEXTPROC>(eglGetProcAddress("eglQueryDmaBufFormatsEXT"));
        if (!pfn_egl_query_dma_buf_formats_ext) {
            dbgln("eglQueryDmaBufFormatsEXT unavailable");
            return {};
        }

        pfn_egl_query_dma_buf_modifiers_ext = reinterpret_cast<PFNEGLQUERYDMABUFMODIFIERSEXTPROC>(eglGetProcAddress("eglQueryDmaBufModifiersEXT"));
        if (!pfn_egl_query_dma_buf_modifiers_ext) {
            dbgln("eglQueryDmaBufModifiersEXT unavailable");
            return {};
        }
    }
#    endif

#    ifdef USE_DIRECTX
    if (!use_cpu_painting_surface) {
        eglMakeCurrent(display, EGL_NO_SURFACE, EGL_NO_SURFACE, context);
        // Drawing buffers are imported as EGL images, which a WebGL context leaves disabled.
        if (extension_list_contains(GL_REQUESTABLE_EXTENSIONS_ANGLE, "GL_OES_EGL_image"sv)) {
            glRequestExtensionANGLE("GL_OES_EGL_image");
        } else {
            dbgln("Compositor: ANGLE cannot import EGL images; falling back to a CPU painting surface");
            use_cpu_painting_surface = true;
        }
    }
#    endif

    return make<OpenGLContext>(skia_backend_context, Impl {
                                                         .display = display,
                                                         .config = config,
                                                         .context = context,
                                                         .texture_target = texture_target,
                                                         .uses_cpu_painting_surface = use_cpu_painting_surface,
#    ifdef USE_VULKAN_DMABUF_IMAGES
                                                         .ext_procs = {
                                                             .query_dma_buf_formats = pfn_egl_query_dma_buf_formats_ext,
                                                             .query_dma_buf_modifiers = pfn_egl_query_dma_buf_modifiers_ext,
                                                         },
#    endif
                                                     },
        webgl_version, drawing_buffer_options);
#else
    (void)skia_backend_context;
    (void)webgl_version;
    return {};
#endif
}

#ifdef ENABLE_WEBGL
u32 OpenGLContext::color_buffer_texture_target() const
{
    return m_impl->texture_target == EGL_TEXTURE_RECTANGLE_ANGLE ? GL_TEXTURE_RECTANGLE_ANGLE : GL_TEXTURE_2D;
}

// Color buffers are also allocated when the canvas is resized and while presenting, between the page's commands, so
// setting one up must leave the page's texture binding alone.
template<typename Callback>
static void with_texture_bound(GLenum target, GLuint texture, Callback callback)
{
    GLint original_texture = 0;
    glGetIntegerv(target == GL_TEXTURE_RECTANGLE_ANGLE ? GL_TEXTURE_BINDING_RECTANGLE_ANGLE : GL_TEXTURE_BINDING_2D, &original_texture);
    glBindTexture(target, texture);
    callback();
    glBindTexture(target, original_texture);
}
#endif

#ifdef AK_OS_MACOS
void OpenGLContext::allocate_iosurface_color_buffer(ColorBuffer& color_buffer, Gfx::IntSize size, Gfx::PaintingSurface::Origin origin)
{
    color_buffer.shared_image_buffer = make<Gfx::SharedImageBuffer>(Gfx::SharedImageBuffer::create(size));
    color_buffer.painting_surface = Gfx::PaintingSurface::create_from_shared_image_buffer(*color_buffer.shared_image_buffer, *m_skia_backend_context, origin);
    color_buffer.presentable_surface = PresentableSurface::create(*color_buffer.painting_surface, origin, make<CoreAnimationSurface>(*color_buffer.shared_image_buffer));

    EGLint const surface_attributes[] = {
        EGL_WIDTH,
        size.width(),
        EGL_HEIGHT,
        size.height(),
        EGL_IOSURFACE_PLANE_ANGLE,
        0,
        EGL_TEXTURE_TARGET,
        m_impl->texture_target,
        EGL_TEXTURE_INTERNAL_FORMAT_ANGLE,
        GL_BGRA_EXT,
        EGL_TEXTURE_FORMAT,
        EGL_TEXTURE_RGBA,
        EGL_TEXTURE_TYPE_ANGLE,
        GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE,
        EGL_NONE,
        EGL_NONE,
    };
    color_buffer.surface = eglCreatePbufferFromClientBuffer(m_impl->display, EGL_IOSURFACE_ANGLE, color_buffer.shared_image_buffer->iosurface_handle().core_foundation_pointer(), m_impl->config, surface_attributes);

    eglMakeCurrent(m_impl->display, EGL_NO_SURFACE, EGL_NO_SURFACE, m_impl->context);

    glGenTextures(1, &color_buffer.texture);
    with_texture_bound(color_buffer_texture_target(), color_buffer.texture, [&] {
        auto result = eglBindTexImage(m_impl->display, color_buffer.surface, EGL_BACK_BUFFER);
        VERIFY(result == EGL_TRUE);
    });
}
#endif

#if defined(USE_VULKAN_DMABUF_IMAGES) || defined(USE_DIRECTX)
void OpenGLContext::create_texture_from_egl_image(ColorBuffer& color_buffer)
{
    eglMakeCurrent(m_impl->display, EGL_NO_SURFACE, EGL_NO_SURFACE, m_impl->context);

    glGenTextures(1, &color_buffer.texture);
    with_texture_bound(GL_TEXTURE_2D, color_buffer.texture, [&] {
        glEGLImageTargetTexture2DOES(GL_TEXTURE_2D, color_buffer.egl_image);
    });
}
#endif

#ifdef USE_DIRECTX
bool OpenGLContext::allocate_d3d_color_buffer(ColorBuffer& color_buffer, Gfx::IntSize size, Gfx::PaintingSurface::Origin origin)
{
    auto d3d11_device = get_d3d11_device(m_impl->display);
    if (!d3d11_device) {
        dbgln("Compositor: ANGLE's Direct3D 11 device is unavailable");
        return false;
    }

    auto texture = Gfx::D3DSharedTexture::create(m_skia_backend_context->direct3d_context(), size);
    if (texture.is_error()) {
        dbgln("Compositor: Failed to allocate a shared Direct3D texture for WebGL: {}", texture.error());
        return false;
    }

    // Skia composites the texture from its Direct3D 12 device, and ANGLE draws into it from its own Direct3D 11
    // device, which opens it through its shared handle. The EGL image keeps a reference to what ANGLE opened.
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11Texture2D> d3d11_texture;
    auto result = d3d11_device->OpenSharedResource1(texture.value()->shared_handle(), IID_PPV_ARGS(&d3d11_texture));
    if (FAILED(result)) {
        dbgln("Compositor: ANGLE failed to open a shared Direct3D texture: {}", Error::from_windows_error(result));
        return false;
    }

    color_buffer.egl_image = eglCreateImage(m_impl->display, EGL_NO_CONTEXT, EGL_D3D11_TEXTURE_ANGLE, static_cast<EGLClientBuffer>(d3d11_texture.Get()), nullptr);
    if (color_buffer.egl_image == EGL_NO_IMAGE) {
        dbgln("Compositor: eglCreateImage for a shared Direct3D texture failed: {:#x}", eglGetError());
        return false;
    }

    auto painting_surface = Gfx::PaintingSurface::create_from_d3d_texture(*m_skia_backend_context, texture.release_value(), origin);
    if (painting_surface.is_error()) {
        dbgln("Compositor: {}", painting_surface.error());
        free_color_buffer(color_buffer);
        return false;
    }
    color_buffer.painting_surface = painting_surface.release_value();
    color_buffer.presentable_surface = PresentableSurface::create(*color_buffer.painting_surface, origin, make<DirectCompositionSurface>());

    create_texture_from_egl_image(color_buffer);
    return true;
}
#endif

#ifdef USE_VULKAN_DMABUF_IMAGES
bool OpenGLContext::allocate_vkimage_color_buffer(ColorBuffer& color_buffer, Gfx::IntSize size, Gfx::PaintingSurface::Origin origin)
{
    VERIFY(m_skia_backend_context);

    VkFormat vulkan_format = VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM;
    uint32_t drm_format = Gfx::vk_format_to_drm_format(vulkan_format);

    // Ensure that our format is supported by the implementation.
    // FIXME: try other formats if not?
    EGLint num_formats = 0;
    m_impl->ext_procs.query_dma_buf_formats(m_impl->display, 0, nullptr, &num_formats);
    Vector<EGLint> egl_formats;
    egl_formats.resize(num_formats);
    m_impl->ext_procs.query_dma_buf_formats(m_impl->display, num_formats, egl_formats.data(), &num_formats);
    if (egl_formats.find(drm_format) == egl_formats.end()) {
        dbgln("Compositor: DMABUF format {:#x} is not supported by this driver; falling back to a CPU painting surface", drm_format);
        return false;
    }

    EGLint num_modifiers = 0;
    m_impl->ext_procs.query_dma_buf_modifiers(m_impl->display, drm_format, 0, nullptr, nullptr, &num_modifiers);
    Vector<uint64_t> egl_modifiers;
    egl_modifiers.resize(num_modifiers);
    Vector<EGLBoolean> external_only;
    external_only.resize(num_modifiers);
    m_impl->ext_procs.query_dma_buf_modifiers(m_impl->display, drm_format, num_modifiers, egl_modifiers.data(), external_only.data(), &num_modifiers);
    Vector<uint64_t> renderable_modifiers;
    for (int i = 0; i < num_modifiers; ++i) {
        if (!external_only[i]) {
            renderable_modifiers.append(egl_modifiers[i]);
        }
    }

    auto vulkan_image_or_error = Gfx::create_shared_vulkan_image(m_skia_backend_context->vulkan_context(), size.width(), size.height(), vulkan_format, renderable_modifiers);
    if (vulkan_image_or_error.is_error()) {
        dbgln("Compositor: create_shared_vulkan_image failed ({}); falling back to a CPU painting surface", vulkan_image_or_error.error());
        return false;
    }
    auto vulkan_image = vulkan_image_or_error.release_value();
    color_buffer.painting_surface = Gfx::PaintingSurface::create_from_vkimage(*m_skia_backend_context, vulkan_image, origin);

    EGLAttrib attribs[] = {
        EGL_WIDTH,
        size.width(),
        EGL_HEIGHT,
        size.height(),
        EGL_LINUX_DRM_FOURCC_EXT,
        drm_format,
        EGL_DMA_BUF_PLANE0_FD_EXT,
        vulkan_image->get_dma_buf_fd(), // EGL takes ownership of the fd
        EGL_DMA_BUF_PLANE0_OFFSET_EXT,
        0,
        EGL_DMA_BUF_PLANE0_PITCH_EXT,
        static_cast<uint32_t>(vulkan_image->info.row_pitch),
        EGL_DMA_BUF_PLANE0_MODIFIER_LO_EXT,
        static_cast<uint32_t>(vulkan_image->info.modifier & 0xffffffff),
        EGL_DMA_BUF_PLANE0_MODIFIER_HI_EXT,
        static_cast<uint32_t>(vulkan_image->info.modifier >> 32),
        EGL_NONE,
    };
    color_buffer.egl_image = eglCreateImage(m_impl->display, EGL_NO_CONTEXT, EGL_LINUX_DMA_BUF_EXT, nullptr, attribs);
    if (color_buffer.egl_image == EGL_NO_IMAGE) {
        dbgln("Compositor: eglCreateImage for the DMABUF failed; falling back to a CPU painting surface");
        free_color_buffer(color_buffer);
        return false;
    }

    create_texture_from_egl_image(color_buffer);
    return true;
}
#endif

#if defined(ENABLE_WEBGL_CPU_PAINTING_SURFACE)
void OpenGLContext::allocate_cpu_painting_surface(ColorBuffer& color_buffer)
{
    color_buffer.painting_surface = Gfx::PaintingSurface::create_with_size(
        m_size,
        Gfx::BitmapFormat::BGRA8888,
        Gfx::AlphaType::Premultiplied);

    eglMakeCurrent(m_impl->display, EGL_NO_SURFACE, EGL_NO_SURFACE, m_impl->context);

    glGenTextures(1, &color_buffer.texture);
    with_texture_bound(GL_TEXTURE_2D, color_buffer.texture, [&] {
        glTexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, GL_LINEAR);
        glTexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, GL_LINEAR);
        glTexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_S, GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
        glTexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_T, GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE);

        auto has_pixel_buffer_objects = supports_pixel_buffer_objects();
        GLint original_pixel_unpack_buffer = 0;
        if (has_pixel_buffer_objects) {
            glGetIntegerv(GL_PIXEL_UNPACK_BUFFER_BINDING, &original_pixel_unpack_buffer);
            glBindBuffer(GL_PIXEL_UNPACK_BUFFER, 0);
        }
        glTexImage2D(GL_TEXTURE_2D, 0, GL_RGBA, m_size.width(), m_size.height(), 0, GL_RGBA, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, nullptr);
        if (has_pixel_buffer_objects)
            glBindBuffer(GL_PIXEL_UNPACK_BUFFER, original_pixel_unpack_buffer);
    });
}

void OpenGLContext::copy_default_framebuffer_to_cpu_painting_surface()
{
    VERIFY(m_impl->uses_cpu_painting_surface);
    auto& painting_surface = m_impl->color_buffers[m_impl->drawing_color_buffer_index].painting_surface;
    VERIFY(painting_surface);

    auto bitmap = MUST(Gfx::Bitmap::create(Gfx::BitmapFormat::RGBA8888, Gfx::AlphaType::Premultiplied, m_size));

    GLenum framebuffer_target = GL_FRAMEBUFFER;
    GLenum framebuffer_binding = GL_FRAMEBUFFER_BINDING;
    if (m_webgl_version == WebGLVersion::WebGL2) {
        framebuffer_target = GL_READ_FRAMEBUFFER;
        framebuffer_binding = GL_READ_FRAMEBUFFER_BINDING;
    }

    GLint original_framebuffer;
    glGetIntegerv(framebuffer_binding, &original_framebuffer);

    GLint original_read_buffer = GL_COLOR_ATTACHMENT0;
    if (m_webgl_version == WebGLVersion::WebGL2)
        glGetIntegerv(GL_READ_BUFFER, &original_read_buffer);

    glBindFramebuffer(framebuffer_target, default_framebuffer());
    if (m_webgl_version == WebGLVersion::WebGL2)
        glReadBuffer(GL_COLOR_ATTACHMENT0);

    GLint original_pack_alignment;
    glGetIntegerv(GL_PACK_ALIGNMENT, &original_pack_alignment);
    glPixelStorei(GL_PACK_ALIGNMENT, 4);

    auto has_pixel_buffer_objects = supports_pixel_buffer_objects();
    GLint original_pixel_pack_buffer = 0;
    if (has_pixel_buffer_objects) {
        glGetIntegerv(GL_PIXEL_PACK_BUFFER_BINDING, &original_pixel_pack_buffer);
        glBindBuffer(GL_PIXEL_PACK_BUFFER, 0);
    }

    auto has_pack_subimage_parameters = supports_pack_subimage_parameters();
    GLint original_pack_row_length = 0;
    GLint original_pack_skip_pixels = 0;
    GLint original_pack_skip_rows = 0;
    if (has_pack_subimage_parameters) {
        glGetIntegerv(GL_PACK_ROW_LENGTH, &original_pack_row_length);
        glGetIntegerv(GL_PACK_SKIP_PIXELS, &original_pack_skip_pixels);
        glGetIntegerv(GL_PACK_SKIP_ROWS, &original_pack_skip_rows);
        glPixelStorei(GL_PACK_ROW_LENGTH, 0);
        glPixelStorei(GL_PACK_SKIP_PIXELS, 0);
        glPixelStorei(GL_PACK_SKIP_ROWS, 0);
    }

    // ANGLE's Direct3D 11 backend waits for the GPU on every glReadPixels(), so the frame is read with one call. The
    // page's pack state decides where in the bitmap that call writes, so ANGLE is told the size of the bitmap and
    // refuses to write past it.
    VERIFY(bitmap->pitch() == static_cast<size_t>(m_size.width()) * sizeof(Gfx::RawPixel));
    glReadPixelsRobustANGLE(0, 0, m_size.width(), m_size.height(), GL_RGBA, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, static_cast<GLsizei>(bitmap->size_in_bytes()), nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, bitmap->scanline_u8(0));

    // GL's rows go from the bottom of the image up, so flip them into the bitmap's top-down order.
    for (int top = 0, bottom = m_size.height() - 1; top < bottom; ++top, --bottom) {
        auto* top_row = bitmap->scanline(top);
        auto* bottom_row = bitmap->scanline(bottom);
        for (int x = 0; x < m_size.width(); ++x)
            swap(top_row[x], bottom_row[x]);
    }

    if (has_pack_subimage_parameters) {
        glPixelStorei(GL_PACK_ROW_LENGTH, original_pack_row_length);
        glPixelStorei(GL_PACK_SKIP_PIXELS, original_pack_skip_pixels);
        glPixelStorei(GL_PACK_SKIP_ROWS, original_pack_skip_rows);
    }
    if (has_pixel_buffer_objects)
        glBindBuffer(GL_PIXEL_PACK_BUFFER, original_pixel_pack_buffer);
    glPixelStorei(GL_PACK_ALIGNMENT, original_pack_alignment);

    glBindFramebuffer(framebuffer_target, original_framebuffer);
    if (m_webgl_version == WebGLVersion::WebGL2)
        glReadBuffer(original_read_buffer);

    painting_surface->write_from_bitmap(*bitmap);
}
#endif

void OpenGLContext::allocate_painting_surface_if_needed()
{
#ifdef ENABLE_WEBGL
    if (!m_drawing_buffer_needs_allocation)
        return;
    m_drawing_buffer_needs_allocation = false;

    free_surface_resources();

    VERIFY(!m_size.is_empty());

    auto& color_buffer = m_impl->color_buffers[m_impl->drawing_color_buffer_index];
#    if defined(ENABLE_WEBGL_CPU_PAINTING_SURFACE)
    // A driver can offer to share a drawing buffer with Skia and still fail to allocate one (an unsupported format or
    // modifier, or a failed import), so the context falls back to a CPU painting surface.
    if (!m_impl->uses_cpu_painting_surface && !allocate_color_buffer(color_buffer)) {
        m_impl->uses_cpu_painting_surface = true;
        free_surface_resources();
    }
    if (m_impl->uses_cpu_painting_surface)
        allocate_cpu_painting_surface(color_buffer);
#    else
    (void)allocate_color_buffer(color_buffer);
#    endif
    VERIFY(color_buffer.is_allocated());
    VERIFY(eglGetCurrentContext() == m_impl->context);

    glViewport(0, 0, m_size.width(), m_size.height());

    glGenFramebuffers(1, &m_impl->framebuffer);
    glBindFramebuffer(GL_FRAMEBUFFER, m_impl->framebuffer);
    glFramebufferTexture2D(GL_FRAMEBUFFER, GL_COLOR_ATTACHMENT0, color_buffer_texture_target(), color_buffer.texture, 0);

    if (m_drawing_buffer_options.depth || m_drawing_buffer_options.stencil) {
        glGenRenderbuffers(1, &m_impl->depth_buffer);
        glBindRenderbuffer(GL_RENDERBUFFER, m_impl->depth_buffer);

        if (m_drawing_buffer_options.depth && m_drawing_buffer_options.stencil) {
            glRenderbufferStorage(GL_RENDERBUFFER, GL_DEPTH24_STENCIL8, m_size.width(), m_size.height());
            glFramebufferRenderbuffer(GL_FRAMEBUFFER, GL_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT, GL_RENDERBUFFER, m_impl->depth_buffer);
        } else if (m_drawing_buffer_options.depth) {
            glRenderbufferStorage(GL_RENDERBUFFER, GL_DEPTH_COMPONENT24, m_size.width(), m_size.height());
            glFramebufferRenderbuffer(GL_FRAMEBUFFER, GL_DEPTH_ATTACHMENT, GL_RENDERBUFFER, m_impl->depth_buffer);
        } else {
            VERIFY(m_drawing_buffer_options.stencil);
            glRenderbufferStorage(GL_RENDERBUFFER, GL_STENCIL_INDEX8, m_size.width(), m_size.height());
            glFramebufferRenderbuffer(GL_FRAMEBUFFER, GL_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT, GL_RENDERBUFFER, m_impl->depth_buffer);
        }
    }

    VERIFY(glCheckFramebufferStatus(GL_FRAMEBUFFER) == GL_FRAMEBUFFER_COMPLETE);
#endif
}

void OpenGLContext::set_size(Gfx::IntSize const& size)
{
    if (m_size != size)
        m_drawing_buffer_needs_allocation = true;
    m_size = size;
}

void OpenGLContext::make_current()
{
#ifdef ENABLE_WEBGL
    allocate_painting_surface_if_needed();
    eglMakeCurrent(m_impl->display, EGL_NO_SURFACE, EGL_NO_SURFACE, m_impl->context);
#endif
}

void OpenGLContext::flush_drawing_buffer()
{
#ifdef ENABLE_WEBGL
    make_current();

    // "Before the drawing buffer is presented for compositing the implementation shall ensure that all rendering operations have been flushed to the drawing buffer."
    // With Metal, glFlush flushes the command buffer, but without waiting for it to be scheduled or completed.
    // eglWaitUntilWorkScheduledANGLE flushes the command buffer, and waits until it has been scheduled, hence the name.
    // eglWaitUntilWorkScheduledANGLE only has an effect on CGL and Metal backends, so we only use it on macOS.
#    if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
    if (m_impl->uses_cpu_painting_surface)
        glFinish();
    else
        eglWaitUntilWorkScheduledANGLE(m_impl->display);
#    else
    // FIXME: CPU sync for now, but it would be better to export a fence and have Skia wait for it before reading from a
    //        shared surface
    glFinish();
#    endif

#    if defined(ENABLE_WEBGL_CPU_PAINTING_SURFACE)
    if (m_impl->uses_cpu_painting_surface)
        copy_default_framebuffer_to_cpu_painting_surface();
#    endif
#endif
}

void OpenGLContext::present_drawing_buffer([[maybe_unused]] bool preserve_drawing_buffer)
{
#ifdef ENABLE_WEBGL
    flush_drawing_buffer();

    auto presented_index = m_impl->drawing_color_buffer_index;
    m_impl->presented_color_buffer_index = presented_index;
    if (m_impl->uses_cpu_painting_surface)
        return;

    // The page drew into the shared image behind Skia's back, so drop any snapshot Skia cached of it.
    auto& presented_color_buffer = m_impl->color_buffers[presented_index];
    presented_color_buffer.painting_surface->notify_content_will_change();

    auto next_index = next_color_buffer_index_after(presented_index);
    auto& next_color_buffer = m_impl->color_buffers[next_index];
    // NB: Without a second color buffer the page keeps drawing into the presented one, which a frame composited
    //     while it draws can catch half drawn.
    if (preserve_drawing_buffer && !supports_copy_texture())
        return;
    if (!next_color_buffer.is_allocated() && !allocate_color_buffer(next_color_buffer))
        return;

    if (preserve_drawing_buffer) {
        glCopySubTextureCHROMIUM(presented_color_buffer.texture, 0, color_buffer_texture_target(), next_color_buffer.texture, 0,
            0, 0, 0, 0, m_size.width(), m_size.height(), GL_FALSE, GL_FALSE, GL_FALSE);
    }
    attach_color_buffer_to_default_framebuffer(next_color_buffer);
    m_impl->drawing_color_buffer_index = next_index;
#endif
}

#ifdef ENABLE_WEBGL
// The buffer after the presented one, unless the window server still reads it or a frame on its way there holds it.
// Then the other usual buffer, and when that one is busy too, the spare.
size_t OpenGLContext::next_color_buffer_index_after(size_t presented_index) const
{
    auto& color_buffers = m_impl->color_buffers;
    auto is_busy = [&](size_t index) {
#    if defined(AK_OS_MACOS) || defined(USE_DIRECTX)
        auto const& presentable_surface = color_buffers[index].presentable_surface;
        return presentable_surface && presentable_surface->is_busy();
#    else
        (void)index;
        return false;
#    endif
    };
    auto spare_index = Impl::usual_color_buffer_count;
    auto buffer_count = color_buffers[spare_index].is_allocated() ? color_buffers.size() : Impl::usual_color_buffer_count;
    for (size_t step = 1; step < buffer_count; ++step) {
        auto index = (presented_index + step) % buffer_count;
        if (!is_busy(index))
            return index;
    }
    if (!color_buffers[spare_index].is_allocated())
        return spare_index;
    return (presented_index + 1) % buffer_count;
}

bool OpenGLContext::allocate_color_buffer(ColorBuffer& color_buffer)
{
    return allocate_shared_color_buffer(color_buffer, m_size, Gfx::PaintingSurface::Origin::BottomLeft);
}

bool OpenGLContext::allocate_shared_color_buffer([[maybe_unused]] ColorBuffer& color_buffer, [[maybe_unused]] Gfx::IntSize size, [[maybe_unused]] Gfx::PaintingSurface::Origin origin)
{
#    if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
    allocate_iosurface_color_buffer(color_buffer, size, origin);
    return true;
#    elif defined(USE_VULKAN_DMABUF_IMAGES)
    return allocate_vkimage_color_buffer(color_buffer, size, origin);
#    elif defined(USE_DIRECTX)
    return allocate_d3d_color_buffer(color_buffer, size, origin);
#    else
    return false;
#    endif
}

void OpenGLContext::attach_color_buffer_to_default_framebuffer(ColorBuffer const& color_buffer)
{
    GLenum framebuffer_target = GL_FRAMEBUFFER;
    GLenum framebuffer_binding = GL_FRAMEBUFFER_BINDING;
    if (m_webgl_version == WebGLVersion::WebGL2) {
        framebuffer_target = GL_DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER;
        framebuffer_binding = GL_DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER_BINDING;
    }
    GLint original_framebuffer;
    glGetIntegerv(framebuffer_binding, &original_framebuffer);

    glBindFramebuffer(framebuffer_target, default_framebuffer());
    glFramebufferTexture2D(framebuffer_target, GL_COLOR_ATTACHMENT0, color_buffer_texture_target(), color_buffer.texture, 0);

    glBindFramebuffer(framebuffer_target, original_framebuffer);
}

bool OpenGLContext::supports_copy_texture()
{
    if (!m_impl->supports_copy_texture.has_value())
        m_impl->supports_copy_texture = extension_list_contains(GL_EXTENSIONS, "GL_CHROMIUM_copy_texture"sv);
    return *m_impl->supports_copy_texture;
}
#endif

// WebGL 2 runs on OpenGL ES 3, where this pixel store state is core. WebGL 1 runs on OpenGL ES 2, which only holds it
// while ANGLE has the extension for it enabled.
bool OpenGLContext::is_webgl2_or_has_enabled_extension([[maybe_unused]] StringView extension) const
{
#ifdef ENABLE_WEBGL
    return m_webgl_version == WebGLVersion::WebGL2 || extension_list_contains(GL_EXTENSIONS, extension);
#else
    return false;
#endif
}

bool OpenGLContext::supports_pixel_buffer_objects() const
{
    return is_webgl2_or_has_enabled_extension("GL_NV_pixel_buffer_object"sv);
}

bool OpenGLContext::supports_pack_subimage_parameters() const
{
    return is_webgl2_or_has_enabled_extension("GL_NV_pack_subimage"sv);
}

bool OpenGLContext::can_copy_images_into_textures()
{
#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS) || defined(USE_VULKAN_DMABUF_IMAGES)
    return m_skia_backend_context && !m_impl->uses_cpu_painting_surface && supports_copy_texture();
#else
    // FIXME: Windows shares color buffers too, but ANGLE's Direct3D 11 device may not have run a copy out of the upload
    //        buffer yet when Skia's Direct3D 12 device draws the next upload into it.
    return false;
#endif
}

#ifdef ENABLE_WEBGL
static Optional<GLenum> texture_binding_for_copy_destination(GLenum target)
{
    switch (target) {
    case GL_TEXTURE_2D:
        return GL_TEXTURE_BINDING_2D;
    case GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP_POSITIVE_X:
    case GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP_NEGATIVE_X:
    case GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP_POSITIVE_Y:
    case GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP_NEGATIVE_Y:
    case GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP_POSITIVE_Z:
    case GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP_NEGATIVE_Z:
        return GL_TEXTURE_BINDING_CUBE_MAP;
    default:
        return {};
    }
}
#endif

bool OpenGLContext::copy_image_into_bound_texture([[maybe_unused]] SkImage const& image, [[maybe_unused]] Gfx::IntSize source_size, [[maybe_unused]] Gfx::IntSize size, [[maybe_unused]] u32 target, [[maybe_unused]] i32 level, [[maybe_unused]] i32 xoffset, [[maybe_unused]] i32 yoffset, [[maybe_unused]] bool flip_y, [[maybe_unused]] bool premultiply_alpha)
{
#ifdef ENABLE_WEBGL
    auto destination_binding = texture_binding_for_copy_destination(target);
    if (!destination_binding.has_value() || size.is_empty() || !can_copy_images_into_textures())
        return false;

    auto& upload_color_buffer = m_impl->upload_color_buffer;
    if (m_impl->upload_color_buffer_size != size) {
        free_color_buffer(upload_color_buffer);
        m_impl->upload_color_buffer_size = {};
        if (!allocate_shared_color_buffer(upload_color_buffer, size, Gfx::PaintingSurface::Origin::TopLeft))
            return false;
        m_impl->upload_color_buffer_size = size;
    }

    auto& canvas = upload_color_buffer.painting_surface->canvas();
    canvas.clear(SK_ColorTRANSPARENT);
    canvas.drawImageRect(&image, SkRect::MakeIWH(source_size.width(), source_size.height()), SkRect::MakeIWH(size.width(), size.height()), Gfx::to_skia_sampling_options(Gfx::ScalingMode::Bilinear), nullptr, SkCanvas::kStrict_SrcRectConstraint);
    m_skia_backend_context->flush_and_submit(*upload_color_buffer.painting_surface);

    eglMakeCurrent(m_impl->display, EGL_NO_SURFACE, EGL_NO_SURFACE, m_impl->context);
    GLint destination_texture = 0;
    glGetIntegerv(destination_binding.value(), &destination_texture);
    glCopySubTextureCHROMIUM(upload_color_buffer.texture, 0, target, destination_texture, level, xoffset, yoffset, 0, 0, size.width(), size.height(), flip_y, premultiply_alpha, GL_FALSE);
    return true;
#else
    return false;
#endif
}

RefPtr<Gfx::PaintingSurface> OpenGLContext::drawing_buffer_surface()
{
    return m_impl->color_buffers[m_impl->drawing_color_buffer_index].painting_surface;
}

RefPtr<Gfx::PaintingSurface> OpenGLContext::presented_surface()
{
    if (!m_impl->presented_color_buffer_index.has_value())
        return nullptr;
    return m_impl->color_buffers[*m_impl->presented_color_buffer_index].painting_surface;
}

RefPtr<PresentableSurface> OpenGLContext::presented_presentable_surface()
{
#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS) || defined(USE_DIRECTX)
    if (!m_impl->presented_color_buffer_index.has_value() || m_impl->uses_cpu_painting_surface)
        return nullptr;
    // When presenting could not move the page onto another buffer, it goes on drawing into the presented one, which
    // the window server would then show half drawn.
    if (*m_impl->presented_color_buffer_index == m_impl->drawing_color_buffer_index)
        return nullptr;
    return m_impl->color_buffers[*m_impl->presented_color_buffer_index].presentable_surface;
#else
    return nullptr;
#endif
}

u32 OpenGLContext::default_renderbuffer() const
{
    return m_impl->depth_buffer;
}

u32 OpenGLContext::default_framebuffer() const
{
    return m_impl->framebuffer;
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/NonnullOwnPtr.h>
#include <AK/NonnullRefPtr.h>
#include <AK/OwnPtr.h>
#include <AK/RefPtr.h>
#include <AK/StringView.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <Compositor/PaintingSurface.h>
#include <Compositor/PresentableSurface.h>
#include <LibCompositing/WebGL/Types.h>
#include <LibGfx/Forward.h>
#include <LibGfx/Size.h>

class SkImage;

#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS) || (defined(AK_OS_LINUX) && !defined(AK_OS_ANDROID)) || defined(AK_OS_WINDOWS)
#    define ENABLE_WEBGL_CPU_PAINTING_SURFACE
#endif

namespace Compositor {

class OpenGLContext {
public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    using WebGLVersion = Compositing::WebGL::WebGLVersion;

    struct DrawingBufferOptions {
        bool depth;
        bool stencil;
        bool antialias;
    };

    static OwnPtr<OpenGLContext> create(RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext>, WebGLVersion, DrawingBufferOptions);
    static void const* address_of_function(char const* name);

    void allocate_painting_surface_if_needed();

    struct Impl;
    OpenGLContext(RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext>, Impl, WebGLVersion, DrawingBufferOptions);

    ~OpenGLContext();

    void make_current();

    // Makes everything drawn so far visible to readers of the drawing buffer's surface.
    void flush_drawing_buffer();
    // Hands the drawing buffer over for compositing and moves the page onto another one, so drawing the next frame
    // cannot change the frame being composited.
    void present_drawing_buffer(bool preserve_drawing_buffer);

    void set_size(Gfx::IntSize const&);

    RefPtr<Gfx::PaintingSurface> drawing_buffer_surface();
    RefPtr<Gfx::PaintingSurface> presented_surface();
    // Null where the window server cannot show the presented buffer as it is.
    RefPtr<PresentableSurface> presented_presentable_surface();

    u32 default_framebuffer() const;
    u32 default_renderbuffer() const;

    WebGLVersion webgl_version() const { return m_webgl_version; }
    bool supports_pixel_buffer_objects() const;
    bool supports_pack_subimage_parameters() const;
    bool can_copy_images_into_textures();
    // The source size is the part of the image to copy, which can be smaller than the image.
    bool copy_image_into_bound_texture(SkImage const&, Gfx::IntSize source_size, Gfx::IntSize, u32 target, i32 level, i32 xoffset, i32 yoffset, bool flip_y, bool premultiply_alpha);

private:
    struct ColorBuffer;

    RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext> m_skia_backend_context;
    Gfx::IntSize m_size;
    bool m_drawing_buffer_needs_allocation { true };
    NonnullOwnPtr<Impl> m_impl;
    WebGLVersion m_webgl_version;
    [[maybe_unused]] DrawingBufferOptions m_drawing_buffer_options;

    void free_surface_resources();
    void free_color_buffer(ColorBuffer&);
    bool allocate_color_buffer(ColorBuffer&);
    size_t next_color_buffer_index_after(size_t presented_index) const;
    bool allocate_shared_color_buffer(ColorBuffer&, Gfx::IntSize, Gfx::PaintingSurface::Origin);
    void attach_color_buffer_to_default_framebuffer(ColorBuffer const&);
    u32 color_buffer_texture_target() const;
    bool supports_copy_texture();
    bool is_webgl2_or_has_enabled_extension(StringView) const;
#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
    void allocate_iosurface_color_buffer(ColorBuffer&, Gfx::IntSize, Gfx::PaintingSurface::Origin);
#endif
#if defined(USE_VULKAN_DMABUF_IMAGES)
    bool allocate_vkimage_color_buffer(ColorBuffer&, Gfx::IntSize, Gfx::PaintingSurface::Origin);
#endif
#if defined(USE_DIRECTX)
    bool allocate_d3d_color_buffer(ColorBuffer&, Gfx::IntSize, Gfx::PaintingSurface::Origin);
#endif
#if defined(USE_VULKAN_DMABUF_IMAGES) || defined(USE_DIRECTX)
    void create_texture_from_egl_image(ColorBuffer&);
#endif
#if defined(ENABLE_WEBGL_CPU_PAINTING_SURFACE)
    void allocate_cpu_painting_surface(ColorBuffer&);
    void copy_default_framebuffer_to_cpu_painting_surface();
#endif
};

namespace Gfx {

struct PaintingSurface::Impl {
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    RefPtr<SkiaBackendContext> context;
    sk_sp<SkSurface> surface;
    RefPtr<Bitmap> bitmap;
    bool wraps_shared_image { false };
    Function<void(PaintingSurface&)> on_flush {};
};

void PaintingSurface::destroy_impl(void* impl)
{
    auto* surface_impl = static_cast<PaintingSurface::Impl*>(impl);
    // NB: The surface may draw into the pixels of the bitmap, so it goes first.
    surface_impl->surface = nullptr;
    delete surface_impl;
}

NonnullRefPtr<PaintingSurface> PaintingSurface::adopt_impl(IntSize size, NonnullOwnPtr<Impl> impl)
{
    auto const* gpu_backend_context = impl->context.ptr();
    return adopt_ref(const_cast<PaintingSurface&>(*Compositor::RustFFI::compositor_painting_surface_create(size, gpu_backend_context, impl.leak_ptr(), destroy_impl)));
}

PaintingSurface::Impl& PaintingSurface::impl() const
{
    return *static_cast<Impl*>(Compositor::RustFFI::compositor_painting_surface_skia_surface(this));
}

#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS) || defined(USE_VULKAN_DMABUF_IMAGES) || defined(USE_DIRECTX)
static GrSurfaceOrigin origin_to_sk_origin(PaintingSurface::Origin origin)
{
    switch (origin) {
    case PaintingSurface::Origin::BottomLeft:
        return kBottomLeft_GrSurfaceOrigin;
    default:
        VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
    case PaintingSurface::Origin::TopLeft:
        return kTopLeft_GrSurfaceOrigin;
    }
}
#endif

#ifdef USE_VULKAN_DMABUF_IMAGES
static SkColorType vk_format_to_sk_color_type(VkFormat format)
{
    switch (format) {
    case VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM:
        return kBGRA_8888_SkColorType;
    // add more as needed
    default:
        VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
        return kUnknown_SkColorType;
    }
}

static void release_vulkan_image(void* context)
{
    VulkanImage* image = static_cast<VulkanImage*>(context);
    image->unref();
}

NonnullRefPtr<PaintingSurface> PaintingSurface::create_from_vkimage(NonnullRefPtr<SkiaBackendContext> context, NonnullRefPtr<VulkanImage> vulkan_image, Origin origin, TextAntialiasing text_antialiasing)
{
    IntSize size(vulkan_image->info.extent.width, vulkan_image->info.extent.height);
    GrVkImageInfo info = {
        .fImage = vulkan_image->image,
        .fAlloc = {}, // we're managing the memory ourselves
        .fImageTiling = vulkan_image->info.tiling,
        .fImageLayout = vulkan_image->info.layout,
        .fFormat = vulkan_image->info.format,
        .fImageUsageFlags = vulkan_image->info.usage,
        .fSampleCount = 1,
        .fLevelCount = 1,
        .fCurrentQueueFamily = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED,
        .fProtected = skgpu::Protected::kNo,
        .fYcbcrConversionInfo = {},
        .fSharingMode = vulkan_image->info.sharing_mode,
    };
    GrBackendRenderTarget rt = GrBackendRenderTargets::MakeVk(size.width(), size.height(), info);
    // Note, we're implicitly giving Skia a reference to vulkan_image. It will eventually be released by the callback function.
    vulkan_image->ref();
    auto properties = Compositor::skia_text_surface_properties(SkSurfaceProps::kDefault_Flag, text_antialiasing == TextAntialiasing::LCD);
    sk_sp<SkSurface> surface = SkSurfaces::WrapBackendRenderTarget(context->sk_context(), rt, origin_to_sk_origin(origin), vk_format_to_sk_color_type(vulkan_image->info.format),
        SkColorSpace::MakeSRGB(), &properties, release_vulkan_image, vulkan_image.ptr());
    return adopt_impl(size, make<Impl>(context, surface, nullptr, true));
}
#endif

#ifdef USE_DIRECTX
static void release_d3d_texture(void* context)
{
    auto* texture = static_cast<D3DSharedTexture*>(context);
    texture->unref();
}

ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<PaintingSurface>> PaintingSurface::create_from_d3d_texture(NonnullRefPtr<SkiaBackendContext> context, NonnullRefPtr<D3DSharedTexture> texture, Origin origin)
{
    auto size = texture->size();
    GrD3DTextureResourceInfo info(nullptr, nullptr, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON, DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM,
        /* sampleCount */ 1, /* levelCount */ 1, /* sampleQualityLevel */ 0);
    // NOTE: The positional resource argument of GrD3DTextureResourceInfo would adopt our reference, so attach it with retain() instead.
    info.fResource.retain(texture->resource());
    auto render_target = GrBackendRenderTargets::MakeD3D(size.width(), size.height(), info);
    // Note, we're implicitly giving Skia a reference to the texture. It will eventually be released by the callback function,
    // which is guaranteed to be invoked even if wrapping fails.
    texture->ref();
    sk_sp<SkSurface> surface = SkSurfaces::WrapBackendRenderTarget(context->sk_context(), render_target, origin_to_sk_origin(origin),
        kRGBA_8888_SkColorType, SkColorSpace::MakeSRGB(), nullptr, release_d3d_texture, texture.ptr());
    if (!surface)
        return Error::from_string_literal("Failed to wrap shared Direct3D texture in a Skia surface");
    return adopt_impl(size, make<Impl>(context, surface, nullptr, true));
}

ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<PaintingSurface>> PaintingSurface::create_from_d3d_texture_also_drawn_from(NonnullRefPtr<SkiaBackendContext> context, NonnullRefPtr<D3DSharedTexture> texture, Origin origin)
{
    auto size = texture->size();
    GrD3DTextureResourceInfo info(nullptr, nullptr, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON, DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM,
        /* sampleCount */ 1, /* levelCount */ 1, /* sampleQualityLevel */ 0);
    // NOTE: The positional resource argument of GrD3DTextureResourceInfo would adopt our reference, so attach it with retain() instead.
    info.fResource.retain(texture->resource());
    auto backend_texture = GrBackendTextures::MakeD3D(size.width(), size.height(), info);
    // Note, we're implicitly giving Skia a reference to the texture. It will eventually be released by the callback function,
    // which is guaranteed to be invoked even if wrapping fails.
    texture->ref();
    sk_sp<SkSurface> surface = SkSurfaces::WrapBackendTexture(context->sk_context(), backend_texture, origin_to_sk_origin(origin),
        /* sampleCnt */ 1, kRGBA_8888_SkColorType, SkColorSpace::MakeSRGB(), nullptr, release_d3d_texture, texture.ptr());
    if (!surface)
        return Error::from_string_literal("Failed to wrap shared Direct3D texture in a Skia surface");
    return adopt_impl(size, make<Impl>(context, surface, nullptr, true));
}
#endif

// The Skia color space of pixels in the color space, where sRGB is explicit.
static sk_sp<SkColorSpace> skia_color_space_of_pixels(ColorSpace const& color_space)
{
    if (auto skia_color_space = to_skia_color_space(color_space))
        return skia_color_space;
    return SkColorSpace::MakeSRGB();
}

NonnullRefPtr<PaintingSurface> PaintingSurface::create_with_size(IntSize size, BitmapFormat color_type, AlphaType alpha_type, RefPtr<SkiaBackendContext> context, ColorSpace const& color_space, TextAntialiasing text_antialiasing)
{
    return MUST(try_create_with_size(size, color_type, alpha_type, move(context), color_space, text_antialiasing));
}

ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<PaintingSurface>> PaintingSurface::try_create_with_size(IntSize size, BitmapFormat color_type, AlphaType alpha_type, RefPtr<SkiaBackendContext> context, ColorSpace const& color_space, TextAntialiasing text_antialiasing)
{
    auto sk_color_type = to_skia_color_type(color_type);
    auto sk_alpha_type = to_skia_alpha_type(color_type, alpha_type);
    auto image_info = SkImageInfo::Make(size.width(), size.height(), sk_color_type, sk_alpha_type, skia_color_space_of_pixels(color_space));

    if (context) {
        // NB: Dynamic MSAA lets Skia render complex antialiased paths on the GPU instead of
        //     rasterizing coverage masks on the CPU and uploading them as textures.
        auto properties = Compositor::skia_text_surface_properties(SkSurfaceProps::kDynamicMSAA_Flag, text_antialiasing == TextAntialiasing::LCD);
        auto surface = SkSurfaces::RenderTarget(context->sk_context(), skgpu::Budgeted::kNo, image_info, 0, &properties);
        if (surface)
            return adopt_impl(size, make<Impl>(context, surface, nullptr));
        dbgln("Unable to create GPU surface for size {}x{}, falling back to CPU", size.width(), size.height());
        context = nullptr;
    }

    auto bitmap = TRY(Bitmap::create(color_type, alpha_type, size));
    auto properties = Compositor::skia_text_surface_properties(SkSurfaceProps::kDefault_Flag, text_antialiasing == TextAntialiasing::LCD);
    auto surface = SkSurfaces::WrapPixels(image_info, bitmap->begin(), bitmap->pitch(), &properties);
    if (!surface)
        return Error::from_string_literal("Unable to create a surface for the bitmap");
    return adopt_impl(size, make<Impl>(context, surface, bitmap));
}

NonnullRefPtr<PaintingSurface> PaintingSurface::wrap_bitmap(Bitmap& bitmap, TextAntialiasing text_antialiasing)
{
    auto color_type = to_skia_color_type(bitmap.format());
    auto alpha_type = to_skia_alpha_type(bitmap.format(), bitmap.alpha_type());
    auto size = bitmap.size();
    auto image_info = SkImageInfo::Make(bitmap.width(), bitmap.height(), color_type, alpha_type, SkColorSpace::MakeSRGB());
    auto properties = Compositor::skia_text_surface_properties(SkSurfaceProps::kDefault_Flag, text_antialiasing == TextAntialiasing::LCD);
    auto surface = SkSurfaces::WrapPixels(image_info, bitmap.begin(), bitmap.pitch(), &properties);
    return adopt_impl(size, make<Impl>(RefPtr<SkiaBackendContext> {}, surface, bitmap));
}

#ifdef AK_OS_MACOS
NonnullRefPtr<PaintingSurface> PaintingSurface::create_from_shared_image_buffer(SharedImageBuffer& shared_image_buffer, NonnullRefPtr<SkiaBackendContext> context, Origin origin)
{
    auto const& iosurface_handle = shared_image_buffer.iosurface_handle();
    auto metal_texture = context->metal_context().create_texture_from_iosurface(iosurface_handle, MetalTextureFormat::BGRA8, 0);
    IntSize const size { metal_texture->width(), metal_texture->height() };
    auto image_info = SkImageInfo::Make(size.width(), size.height(), kBGRA_8888_SkColorType, kPremul_SkAlphaType, SkColorSpace::MakeSRGB());
    GrMtlTextureInfo mtl_info;
    mtl_info.fTexture = sk_ret_cfp(metal_texture->texture());
    auto backend_render_target = GrBackendRenderTargets::MakeMtl(metal_texture->width(), metal_texture->height(), mtl_info);
    auto surface = SkSurfaces::WrapBackendRenderTarget(context->sk_context(), backend_render_target, origin_to_sk_origin(origin), kBGRA_8888_SkColorType, SkColorSpace::MakeSRGB(), nullptr);
    return adopt_impl(size, make<Impl>(context, surface, nullptr, true));
}
#endif

void PaintingSurface::read_into_bitmap(Bitmap& bitmap, IntPoint source_position, ColorSpace const& color_space) const
{
    auto color_type = to_skia_color_type(bitmap.format());
    auto alpha_type = to_skia_alpha_type(bitmap.format(), bitmap.alpha_type());
    auto image_info = SkImageInfo::Make(bitmap.width(), bitmap.height(), color_type, alpha_type, skia_color_space_of_pixels(color_space));
    SkPixmap const pixmap(image_info, bitmap.begin(), bitmap.pitch());

    auto surface_color_space = impl().surface->imageInfo().refColorSpace();
    if (SkColorSpace::Equals(surface_color_space.get(), image_info.colorSpace())) {
        impl().surface->readPixels(pixmap, source_position.x(), source_position.y());
        return;
    }

    // NB: Drawing clamps each premultiplied component to [0, 1], but not to the alpha, so a translucent color that a
    //     draw converted from a wider gamut can have more color than its alpha allows. The pixels are unpremultiplied
    //     in the color space of the surface first, and clamped to its gamut, which holds the color that they show, so
    //     that the conversion to the other color space starts from that. They are unpremultiplied to floats, which
    //     loses no precision before the conversion, a strip of rows at a time, so that a large readback needs no
    //     large buffer of floats.
    if (bitmap.width() <= 0 || bitmap.height() <= 0)
        return;
    static constexpr int max_strip_pixel_count = 1024 * 1024;
    auto strip_height = clamp(max_strip_pixel_count / bitmap.width(), 1, bitmap.height());
    auto strip_info = SkImageInfo::Make(bitmap.width(), strip_height, kRGBA_F32_SkColorType, kUnpremul_SkAlphaType, surface_color_space);
    auto strip_pixels = ByteBuffer::create_uninitialized(strip_info.computeMinByteSize());
    if (strip_pixels.is_error())
        return;
    for (int y = 0; y < bitmap.height(); y += strip_height) {
        auto rows = min(strip_height, bitmap.height() - y);
        SkPixmap const unpremultiplied_pixmap(strip_info.makeWH(bitmap.width(), rows), strip_pixels.value().data(), strip_info.minRowBytes());
        if (!impl().surface->readPixels(unpremultiplied_pixmap, source_position.x(), source_position.y() + y))
            return;
        auto components = Span<float> { reinterpret_cast<float*>(strip_pixels.value().data()), unpremultiplied_pixmap.computeByteSize() / sizeof(float) };
        for (auto& component : components)
            component = clamp(component, 0.0f, 1.0f);
        SkPixmap destination_rows;
        if (!pixmap.extractSubset(&destination_rows, SkIRect::MakeXYWH(0, y, bitmap.width(), rows)))
            return;
        unpremultiplied_pixmap.readPixels(destination_rows);
    }
}

void PaintingSurface::write_from_bitmap(Bitmap const& bitmap, IntPoint destination_position, ColorSpace const& color_space)
{
    auto color_type = to_skia_color_type(bitmap.format());
    auto alpha_type = to_skia_alpha_type(bitmap.format(), bitmap.alpha_type());
    auto image_info = SkImageInfo::Make(bitmap.width(), bitmap.height(), color_type, alpha_type, skia_color_space_of_pixels(color_space));
    SkPixmap const pixmap(image_info, bitmap.begin(), bitmap.pitch());
    impl().surface->writePixels(pixmap, destination_position.x(), destination_position.y());
}

void PaintingSurface::copy_from_surface(PaintingSurface& source)
{
    source.flush();

    // OPTIMIZATION: Pixels in memory are written straight into this surface, which for a surface on the GPU is one
    //               upload. A snapshot of them would copy them first, and the GPU would upload the copy into a texture
    //               of its own before drawing it here.
    SkPixmap source_pixels;
    if (source.size() == size() && source.impl().surface->peekPixels(&source_pixels)) {
        impl().surface->writePixels(source_pixels, 0, 0);
        return;
    }

    auto image = source.impl().surface->makeImageSnapshot();
    if (!image)
        return;

    SkPaint paint;
    paint.setBlendMode(SkBlendMode::kSrc);
    canvas().drawImageRect(
        image.get(),
        SkRect::MakeIWH(image->width(), image->height()),
        SkRect::MakeIWH(size().width(), size().height()),
        SkSamplingOptions {},
        &paint,
        SkCanvas::kStrict_SrcRectConstraint);
}

IntSize PaintingSurface::size() const
{
    IntSize size;
    Compositor::RustFFI::compositor_painting_surface_size(this, &size);
    return size;
}

IntRect PaintingSurface::rect() const
{
    return { {}, size() };
}

SkCanvas& PaintingSurface::canvas() const
{
    return *impl().surface->getCanvas();
}

SkSurface& PaintingSurface::sk_surface() const
{
    return *impl().surface;
}

void PaintingSurface::notify_content_will_change()
{
    impl().surface->notifyContentWillChange(SkSurface::kDiscard_ContentChangeMode);
}

template<>
sk_sp<SkImage> PaintingSurface::sk_image_snapshot() const
{
    return impl().surface->makeImageSnapshot();
}

RefPtr<SkiaBackendContext> PaintingSurface::skia_backend_context() const
{
    return impl().context;
}

bool PaintingSurface::wraps_shared_image() const
{
    return impl().wraps_shared_image;
}

void PaintingSurface::set_on_flush(Function<void(PaintingSurface&)> on_flush)
{
    impl().on_flush = move(on_flush);
}

void PaintingSurface::flush()
{
    if (impl().on_flush)
        impl().on_flush(*this);
}

void PaintingSurface::ref() const
{
    Compositor::RustFFI::compositor_painting_surface_retain(this);
}

void PaintingSurface::unref() const
{
    Compositor::RustFFI::compositor_painting_surface_release(this);
}

class SkCanvas;
class SkSurface;

namespace Gfx {

class SharedImage;

// A surface that the Compositor paints into. A pointer to it is the Rust core's surface itself, which the core and the
// C++ around it share by reference counting. Only the Compositor's main thread may reference or release it.
class PaintingSurface {
    AK_MAKE_NONCOPYABLE(PaintingSurface);
    AK_MAKE_NONMOVABLE(PaintingSurface);

public:
    enum class Origin {
        TopLeft,
        BottomLeft,
    };

    enum class TextAntialiasing {
        Grayscale,
        LCD,
    };

    // A surface whose pixels are in the color space, which is sRGB unless one is given.
    static NonnullRefPtr<PaintingSurface> create_with_size(IntSize size, BitmapFormat color_type, AlphaType alpha_type, RefPtr<SkiaBackendContext> = {}, ColorSpace const& = {}, TextAntialiasing = TextAntialiasing::Grayscale);
    // Fails when neither a GPU surface nor a bitmap of the size can be allocated.
    static ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<PaintingSurface>> try_create_with_size(IntSize size, BitmapFormat color_type, AlphaType alpha_type, RefPtr<SkiaBackendContext> = {}, ColorSpace const& = {}, TextAntialiasing = TextAntialiasing::Grayscale);
    static NonnullRefPtr<PaintingSurface> wrap_bitmap(Bitmap&, TextAntialiasing = TextAntialiasing::Grayscale);

#ifdef AK_OS_MACOS
    static NonnullRefPtr<PaintingSurface> create_from_shared_image_buffer(SharedImageBuffer&, NonnullRefPtr<SkiaBackendContext>, Origin = Origin::TopLeft);
#endif

#ifdef USE_VULKAN_DMABUF_IMAGES
    static NonnullRefPtr<PaintingSurface> create_from_vkimage(NonnullRefPtr<SkiaBackendContext> context, NonnullRefPtr<VulkanImage> vulkan_image, Origin origin, TextAntialiasing = TextAntialiasing::Grayscale);
#endif

#ifdef USE_DIRECTX
    static ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<PaintingSurface>> create_from_d3d_texture(NonnullRefPtr<SkiaBackendContext>, NonnullRefPtr<D3DSharedTexture>, Origin = Origin::TopLeft);
    // Over the texture as one that is drawn from as well as into, so that a snapshot of the surface shares the texture
    // instead of copying it.
    static ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<PaintingSurface>> create_from_d3d_texture_also_drawn_from(NonnullRefPtr<SkiaBackendContext>, NonnullRefPtr<D3DSharedTexture>, Origin = Origin::TopLeft);
#endif

    // The pixels of the bitmap are in the color space, which is sRGB unless one is given. The surface converts them
    // from or to the color space of its own pixels.
    void read_into_bitmap(Bitmap&, IntPoint source_position = {}, ColorSpace const& = {}) const;
    void write_from_bitmap(Bitmap const&, IntPoint destination_position = {}, ColorSpace const& = {});
    void copy_from_surface(PaintingSurface&);

    void notify_content_will_change();

    IntSize size() const;
    IntRect rect() const;

    SkCanvas& canvas() const;
    SkSurface& sk_surface() const;

    template<typename T>
    T sk_image_snapshot() const;

    RefPtr<SkiaBackendContext> skia_backend_context() const;

    // Whether the surface draws into an image shared with another process, rather than one Skia allocated.
    bool wraps_shared_image() const;

    // Runs after every flush.
    void set_on_flush(Function<void(PaintingSurface&)>);
    void flush();

    void ref() const;
    void unref() const;

    PaintingSurface() = delete;
    ~PaintingSurface() = delete;

private:
    struct Impl;

    static NonnullRefPtr<PaintingSurface> adopt_impl(IntSize, NonnullOwnPtr<Impl>);
    static void destroy_impl(void*);
    Impl& impl() const;
};

}

    return adopt_ref(const_cast<PresentableSurface&>(*surface));
}

NonnullRefPtr<PresentableSurface> PresentableSurface::create(NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::PaintingSurface> painting_surface, Gfx::PaintingSurface::Origin origin, OwnPtr<WindowServerSurface> window_server_surface)
{
    return adopt_presentable_surface(RustFFI::compositor_presentable_surface_create(
        painting_surface.ptr(),
        origin == Gfx::PaintingSurface::Origin::BottomLeft,
        window_server_surface.leak_ptr(),
        window_server_surface_may_be_read,
        destroy_window_server_surface));
}

Gfx::PaintingSurface& PresentableSurface::painting_surface() const
{
    return const_cast<Gfx::PaintingSurface&>(*RustFFI::compositor_presentable_surface_painting_surface(this));
}

bool PresentableSurface::content_is_upside_down() const
{
    return RustFFI::compositor_presentable_surface_content_is_upside_down(this);
}

WindowServerSurface const* PresentableSurface::window_server_surface() const
{
    return static_cast<WindowServerSurface const*>(RustFFI::compositor_presentable_surface_window_server_surface(this));
}

void PresentableSurface::did_hand_to_window_server()
{
    RustFFI::compositor_presentable_surface_did_hand_to_window_server(this);
}

bool PresentableSurface::is_read_by_window_server() const
{
    return RustFFI::compositor_presentable_surface_is_read_by_window_server(this);
}

bool PresentableSurface::is_busy() const
{
    return RustFFI::compositor_presentable_surface_is_busy(this);
}

void PresentableSurface::ref() const
{
    RustFFI::compositor_presentable_surface_retain(this);
}

void PresentableSurface::unref() const
{
    RustFFI::compositor_presentable_surface_release(this);
}

PresentableSurface::Lease::Lease(PresentableSurface& surface)
    : m_surface(surface)
{
    RustFFI::compositor_presentable_surface_add_lease(m_surface.ptr());
}

PresentableSurface::Lease::Lease(Lease const& other)
    : m_surface(other.m_surface)
{
    if (m_surface)
        RustFFI::compositor_presentable_surface_add_lease(m_surface.ptr());
}

PresentableSurface::Lease::Lease(Lease&& other)
    : m_surface(move(other.m_surface))
{
}

PresentableSurface::Lease& PresentableSurface::Lease::operator=(Lease const& other)
{
    if (this == &other)
        return *this;
    release();
    m_surface = other.m_surface;
    if (m_surface)
        RustFFI::compositor_presentable_surface_add_lease(m_surface.ptr());
    return *this;
}

PresentableSurface::Lease& PresentableSurface::Lease::operator=(Lease&& other)
{
    if (this == &other)
        return *this;
    release();
    m_surface = move(other.m_surface);
    return *this;
}

PresentableSurface::Lease::~Lease()
{
    release();
}

void PresentableSurface::Lease::release()
{
    if (!m_surface)
        return;
    RustFFI::compositor_presentable_surface_remove_lease(m_surface.ptr());
    m_surface = nullptr;
}

WeakPresentableSurface::WeakPresentableSurface(PresentableSurface const& surface)
    : m_weak(RustFFI::compositor_presentable_surface_downgrade(&surface))
{
}

WeakPresentableSurface::WeakPresentableSurface(WeakPresentableSurface&& other)
    : m_weak(exchange(other.m_weak, nullptr))
{
}

WeakPresentableSurface& WeakPresentableSurface::operator=(WeakPresentableSurface&& other)
{
    if (this != &other) {
        RustFFI::compositor_weak_presentable_surface_destroy(m_weak);
        m_weak = exchange(other.m_weak, nullptr);
    }
    return *this;
}

WeakPresentableSurface::~WeakPresentableSurface()
{
    RustFFI::compositor_weak_presentable_surface_destroy(m_weak);
}

RefPtr<PresentableSurface> WeakPresentableSurface::strong_ref() const
{
    if (!m_weak)
        return nullptr;
    auto const* surface = RustFFI::compositor_weak_presentable_surface_upgrade(m_weak);
    if (!surface)
        return nullptr;
    return adopt_presentable_surface(surface);
}

PresentableSurfacePool::PresentableSurfacePool()
    : m_pool(RustFFI::compositor_presentable_surface_pool_create())
{
}

PresentableSurfacePool::PresentableSurfacePool(PresentableSurfacePool&& other)
    : m_pool(exchange(other.m_pool, nullptr))
{
}

PresentableSurfacePool& PresentableSurfacePool::operator=(PresentableSurfacePool&& other)
{
    if (this != &other) {
        RustFFI::compositor_presentable_surface_pool_destroy(m_pool);
        m_pool = exchange(other.m_pool, nullptr);
    }
    return *this;
}

PresentableSurfacePool::~PresentableSurfacePool()
{
    RustFFI::compositor_presentable_surface_pool_destroy(m_pool);
}

namespace {

struct SurfaceCreation {
    Gfx::IntSize size;
    RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext> const& skia_backend_context;
    Optional<Error> error;
};

}

ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<PresentableSurface>> PresentableSurfacePool::create_surface(Gfx::IntSize size, RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext> const& skia_backend_context)
{
    if (skia_backend_context) {
        if (auto surface = TRY(WindowServer::try_create_presentable_surface_for_sublayers(size, *skia_backend_context)))
            return surface.release_nonnull();
    }
    auto painting_surface = TRY(Gfx::PaintingSurface::try_create_with_size(size, Gfx::BitmapFormat::BGRA8888, Gfx::AlphaType::Premultiplied, skia_backend_context));
    return PresentableSurface::create(move(painting_surface), Gfx::PaintingSurface::Origin::TopLeft);
}

static PresentableSurface const* create_surface_for_pool(void* context)
{
    auto& creation = *static_cast<SurfaceCreation*>(context);
    auto surface = PresentableSurfacePool::create_surface(creation.size, creation.skia_backend_context);
    if (surface.is_error()) {
        creation.error = surface.release_error();
        return nullptr;
    }
    return &surface.release_value().leak_ref();
}

ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<PresentableSurface>> PresentableSurfacePool::surface_for_next_content(Gfx::IntSize size, RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext> const& skia_backend_context)
{
    if (!m_pool)
        m_pool = RustFFI::compositor_presentable_surface_pool_create();
    SurfaceCreation creation { size, skia_backend_context, {} };
    auto const* surface = RustFFI::compositor_presentable_surface_pool_surface_for_next_content(m_pool, size, skia_backend_context.ptr(), create_surface_for_pool, &creation);
    if (!surface) {
        if (creation.error.has_value())
            return creation.error.release_value();
        return Error::from_string_literal("Every surface of the pool is busy");
    }
    return adopt_presentable_surface(surface);
}

}

FILE: Services/Compositor/PresentableSurface.h
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#pragma once

#include <AK/Error.h>
#include <AK/Noncopyable.h>
#include <AK/NonnullRefPtr.h>
#include <AK/OwnPtr.h>
#include <AK/RefPtr.h>
#include <AK/kmalloc.h>
#include <Compositor/PaintingSurface.h>
#include <LibGfx/Forward.h>
#include <LibGfx/Size.h>

namespace Compositor {

// The Rust core's halves of a weak surface reference and of a pool, which only it defines.
struct FfiWeakPresentableSurface;
struct FfiPresentableSurfacePool;

class WindowServerSurface {
public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    virtual ~WindowServerSurface() = default;

    virtual bool may_be_read_by_window_server() const = 0;
};

// A surface whose content the window server can show as it is, instead of after it is composited into a frame. While a
// lease of it is held, as by a frame on its way to the window server and by the layer that shows it, or while the
// window server still reads it, the surface is busy, and its content must stay as it is. A pointer to it is the Rust
// core's surface itself, which the core and the C++ around it share by reference counting. Only the Compositor's main
// thread may use it.
class PresentableSurface {
    AK_MAKE_NONCOPYABLE(PresentableSurface);
    AK_MAKE_NONMOVABLE(PresentableSurface);

public:
    // Keeps the content of the surface as it is for as long as it is held. Holding the surface itself does not.
    class Lease {
    public:
        Lease(Lease const&);
        Lease(Lease&&);
        Lease& operator=(Lease const&);
        Lease& operator=(Lease&&);
        ~Lease();

        PresentableSurface& surface() const { return *m_surface; }

    private:
        friend class PresentableSurface;

        explicit Lease(PresentableSurface&);
        void release();

        RefPtr<PresentableSurface> m_surface;
    };

    static NonnullRefPtr<PresentableSurface> create(NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::PaintingSurface>, Gfx::PaintingSurface::Origin, OwnPtr<WindowServerSurface> = {});

    Gfx::PaintingSurface& painting_surface() const;
    Gfx::IntSize size() const { return painting_surface().size(); }
    bool content_is_upside_down() const;

    // Null for a surface that draws into memory the window server cannot read.
    WindowServerSurface const* window_server_surface() const;

    // GPU work in flight on a surface counts as use too, so only a surface handed to the window server is checked.
    void did_hand_to_window_server();
    bool is_read_by_window_server() const;
    Lease lease() { return Lease { *this }; }
    bool is_busy() const;

    void ref() const;
    void unref() const;

    PresentableSurface() = delete;
    ~PresentableSurface() = delete;
};

// A weak reference to a surface, which tells whether anything still holds it.
class WeakPresentableSurface {
    AK_MAKE_NONCOPYABLE(WeakPresentableSurface);

public:
    WeakPresentableSurface() = default;
    explicit WeakPresentableSurface(PresentableSurface const&);
    WeakPresentableSurface(WeakPresentableSurface&&);
    WeakPresentableSurface& operator=(WeakPresentableSurface&&);
    ~WeakPresentableSurface();

    RefPtr<PresentableSurface> strong_ref() const;

private:
    FfiWeakPresentableSurface* m_weak { nullptr };
};

// The surfaces that one piece of content, such as a canvas, is presented from in turn. The content goes into its
// latest surface again unless that one is busy, so content that is only ever composited into frames keeps a single
// surface.
class PresentableSurfacePool {
    AK_MAKE_NONCOPYABLE(PresentableSurfacePool);

public:
    PresentableSurfacePool();
    PresentableSurfacePool(PresentableSurfacePool&&);
    PresentableSurfacePool& operator=(PresentableSurfacePool&&);
    ~PresentableSurfacePool();

    // A surface of the size for the next content, which is never one that is busy. Fails when every surface is busy and
    // the pool is full, or when no surface can be allocated, and the content then has to wait for a later turn.
    ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<PresentableSurface>> surface_for_next_content(Gfx::IntSize, RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext> const&);

    // A surface the window server can show by itself where it can, and one in memory or on the GPU otherwise.
    static ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<PresentableSurface>> create_surface(Gfx::IntSize, RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext> const&);

private:
    FfiPresentableSurfacePool* m_pool { nullptr };
};

}

template<>
inline constexpr bool AllocatedWithCustomAllocator<Compositor::PresentableSurface> = true;
