use crate::host::WebContentClientId;
use crate::raster_host::RasterHost;
use libcompositing_rust::display_list::canvas_2d::for_each_canvas_2d_command;
use libcompositing_rust::display_list::commands::CanvasId;
use libcompositing_rust::display_list::validate::validate_canvas_2d_tape;
use libcompositing_rust::ipc_types::{Compositing_Canvas2DCommandStreamSegment, Web_Bindings_PredefinedColorSpace};
use libgfx_rust::IntSize;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::ops::Range;

const RESERVED_CANVAS_ID_COUNT: u64 = 1 << 20;

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct Canvas2DContexts {
    clients: HashMap<WebContentClientId, ClientContexts>,
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct ClientContexts {
    reserved_ids: Range<u64>,
    drew_since_presenting: HashMap<CanvasId, bool>,
}

pub struct ContextCreation {
    pub canvas_id: CanvasId,
    pub size: IntSize,
    pub alpha: bool,
    pub will_read_frequently: bool,
    pub color_space: Web_Bindings_PredefinedColorSpace,
}

impl Canvas2DContexts {
    pub fn reserve_ids(&mut self, client: WebContentClientId, raster: &RasterHost) -> Result<Range<u64>, &'static str> {
        let contexts = self.clients.entry(client).or_default();
        if !contexts.reserved_ids.is_empty() {
            return Err("WebContent reserved canvas IDs before using up its range");
        }
        let first_id = raster.reserve_canvas_ids(RESERVED_CANVAS_ID_COUNT);
        contexts.reserved_ids = first_id..first_id + RESERVED_CANVAS_ID_COUNT;
        Ok(contexts.reserved_ids.clone())
    }

    pub fn create(
        &mut self,
        client: WebContentClientId,
        raster: &RasterHost,
        creation: ContextCreation,
    ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
        let contexts = self.clients.entry(client).or_default();
        // NB: WebContent names its contexts with the IDs of its range in order, so each ID names one context only.
        if contexts.reserved_ids.is_empty() || creation.canvas_id.0 != contexts.reserved_ids.start {
            return Err("WebContent named a 2D canvas context with an ID other than the next one it reserved");
        }
        contexts.reserved_ids.start += 1;
        // NB: A context that cannot be created is not a protocol violation: commands recorded for it are dropped.
        if raster.create_canvas_2d_context(
            client.0,
            creation.canvas_id,
            creation.size,
            creation.alpha,
            creation.will_read_frequently,
            creation.color_space,
        ) {
            contexts.drew_since_presenting.insert(creation.canvas_id, false);
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn destroy(&mut self, client: WebContentClientId, raster: &RasterHost, canvas_id: CanvasId) {
        let Some(contexts) = self.clients.get_mut(&client) else {
            return;
        };
        if contexts.drew_since_presenting.remove(&canvas_id).is_some() {
            raster.destroy_canvas_2d_context(client.0, canvas_id);
        }
    }

    pub fn play_stream(
        &mut self,
        client: WebContentClientId,
        raster: &RasterHost,
        segments: &[Compositing_Canvas2DCommandStreamSegment],
    ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
        if segments
            .iter()
            .any(|segment| validate_canvas_2d_tape(&segment.tape).is_err())
        {
            return Err("WebContent sent a canvas 2D stream that does not validate");
        }
        let Some(contexts) = self.clients.get_mut(&client) else {
            return Ok(());
        };
        let mut contexts_that_sampled_video_frames = Vec::new();
        for segment in segments {
            // The canvas may have been destroyed while this segment was pending in
            // WebContent, so a missing context is not a protocol violation.
            let Some(drew_since_presenting) = contexts.drew_since_presenting.get_mut(&segment.canvas_id) else {
                continue;
            };
            if !segment.tape.is_empty() {
                let painting = raster.begin_canvas_2d_painting(client.0, segment.canvas_id);
                for_each_canvas_2d_command(&segment.tape, |command_type, payload| {
                    painting.play_command(command_type, payload);
                });
                if painting.end_reporting_whether_video_frames_were_sampled_on_the_gpu()
                    && !contexts_that_sampled_video_frames.contains(&segment.canvas_id)
                {
                    contexts_that_sampled_video_frames.push(segment.canvas_id);
                }
                *drew_since_presenting = true;
            }
            if segment.present
                && *drew_since_presenting
                && raster.try_present_canvas_2d_context(client.0, segment.canvas_id)
            {
                *drew_since_presenting = false;
            }
        }
        // The frames stay held only until WebContent releases them, which follows this stream, so the GPU has to have
        // finished sampling them by then.
        if !contexts_that_sampled_video_frames.is_empty() {
            raster.flush_canvas_2d_contexts(client.0, &contexts_that_sampled_video_frames);
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn forget_client(&mut self, client: WebContentClientId) {
        self.clients.remove(&client);
    }
}

FILE: Services/Compositor/Rust/src/context_scene.rs
/*

 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause

//! What WebContent last sent a context to draw, and the visual context tree it is drawn with: the one WebContent sent, with the visual viewport this context has pinch-zoomed or panned since, and with its visual animations sampled.

use libcompositing_rust::display_list::commands::SpatialNodeIndex;
use libcompositing_rust::display_list::layers::{LayerStack, UnvalidatedLayerPlan};
use libcompositing_rust::display_list::placement::spatial_nodes_whose_scroll_offset_placement_leaves_out;
use libcompositing_rust::scrolling::{
    AccumulatedVisualContextTree, DisplayList, ScrollStateSnapshot, TransformWithOrigin,
    animated_content_may_affect_viewport,
};
use libcompositing_rust::time::MonotonicTime;
use libgfx_rust::{FloatMatrix4x4, IntRect, IntSize};
use std::io::Write;
use std::rc::Rc;

/// A plan of the layers of the display list a scene holds under the tree WebContent published, as WebContent sent it,
/// once it passed the checks against the two.
#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct ReceivedLayerPlan {
    /// The viewport, in device pixels, the plan was made within.
    pub viewport_rect: IntRect,
    pub stack: Rc<LayerStack>,
    /// The spatial nodes whose scroll offset the plan reads. It holds wherever the compositor scrolls or moves the
    /// other nodes to, which include the anchors of its spaces. Empty for a plan of one layer.
    pub nodes_whose_scroll_offset_plan_reads: Rc<[u32]>,
    /// What the overlay of layers tells of the stack past its layers, as WebContent wrote it.
    pub note_lines: Rc<[String]>,
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct ContextScene {
    display_list: Option<Rc<DisplayList>>,
    visual_context_tree: Option<AccumulatedVisualContextTree>,
    layer_plan: Option<ReceivedLayerPlan>,
    /// Whether the scene holds the display list and the tree of the update WebContent sent last, which the plans it
    /// sends with scroll states are of.
    holds_list_and_tree_sent_last: bool,
    async_visual_viewport_transform: Option<TransformWithOrigin>,
    visual_context_tree_for_compositing: Option<AccumulatedVisualContextTree>,
    sampled_visual_context_tree: Option<AccumulatedVisualContextTree>,
    visual_animation_sample_time_ns: Option<i64>,
    has_active_visual_animations: bool,
    animated_content_may_affect_viewport: Option<bool>,
}

fn update_visual_animation_sampling_state(
    visual_context_tree: &AccumulatedVisualContextTree,
    sample_time_ns: &mut Option<i64>,
    has_active_animations: &mut bool,
    now: MonotonicTime,
) {
    *has_active_animations = visual_context_tree.has_active_visual_animation_at(now.nanoseconds());
    // A replacement tree can be presented before the next vsync. Keep the most recent sample so that presentation
    // remains continuous, but sample dormant and completed descriptors at the current boundary when necessary.
    if !visual_context_tree.has_visual_animations() {
        *sample_time_ns = None;
    } else if !*has_active_animations {
        *sample_time_ns = Some(now.nanoseconds());
    }
}

impl ContextScene {
    pub fn install(
        &mut self,
        display_list: Rc<DisplayList>,
        visual_context_tree: AccumulatedVisualContextTree,
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) {
        self.display_list = Some(display_list);
        self.layer_plan = None;
        self.animated_content_may_affect_viewport = None;
        self.take_visual_context_tree_unless_content_is_unchanged(visual_context_tree);
        update_visual_animation_sampling_state(
            self.visual_context_tree.as_ref().unwrap(),
            &mut self.visual_animation_sample_time_ns,
            &mut self.has_active_visual_animations,
            now,
        );
    }

    // Keeping the held tree keeps what frames cached under the number of its copy, and the main thread publishes most
    // lists with the content of the tree before.
    fn take_visual_context_tree_unless_content_is_unchanged(
        &mut self,
        visual_context_tree: AccumulatedVisualContextTree,
    ) {
        if self
            .visual_context_tree
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|held| held.as_arc().has_same_content_as(visual_context_tree.as_arc()))
        {
            return;
        }
        self.invalidate_visual_context_tree_for_compositing();
        self.visual_context_tree = Some(visual_context_tree);
    }

    /// Returns false, leaving everything as it was, for a tree that does not fit the installed display list.
    pub fn replace_visual_context_tree(
        &mut self,
        visual_context_tree: AccumulatedVisualContextTree,
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) -> bool {
        if self.display_list.as_ref().is_none_or(|list| {
            list.compatible_visual_context_tree_structural_epoch() != visual_context_tree.structural_epoch()
        }) {
            let _ = writeln!(
                std::io::stderr(),
                "Compositor: Dropping stale visual context tree update (tree epoch {}, display list epoch {})",
                visual_context_tree.structural_epoch(),
                self.display_list
                    .as_ref()
                    .map_or(0, |list| list.compatible_visual_context_tree_structural_epoch())
            );
            return false;
        }
        if self
            .display_list
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|list| !visual_context_tree.has_every_node_the_runs_of_display_list_name(list))
        {
            let _ = writeln!(
                std::io::stderr(),
                "Compositor: Dropping visual context tree update without a node the display list names"
            );
            return false;
        }
        if self.display_list.as_ref().is_some_and(|list| {
            !list
                .storage()
                .effect_clip_plan_holds_under(visual_context_tree.as_arc())
        }) {
            let _ = writeln!(
                std::io::stderr(),
                "Compositor: Dropping visual context tree update that nests the effects of the display list otherwise"
            );
            return false;
        }
        self.layer_plan = None;
        self.take_visual_context_tree_unless_content_is_unchanged(visual_context_tree);
        update_visual_animation_sampling_state(
            self.visual_context_tree.as_ref().unwrap(),
            &mut self.visual_animation_sample_time_ns,
            &mut self.has_active_visual_animations,
            now,
        );
        true
    }

    // NB: WebContent sends a plan with each display list and tree it can plan for, and with a scroll state only where
    //     the viewport rect or a scroll offset that the plan it sent last reads changed. So a list or a tree that comes
    //     without a plan leaves the scene without one, and a scroll state that comes without one keeps the plan the
    //     scene holds. After a list or a tree that the compositor refuses, WebContent plans for what the scene does not
    //     hold: a plan that comes with a scroll state is then dropped, until a list or a tree is installed.

    /// Forgets the plan of layers, ahead of a display list or a tree that WebContent sent, which the compositor may
    /// refuse.
    pub fn forget_layer_plan(&mut self) {
        self.layer_plan = None;
        self.holds_list_and_tree_sent_last = false;
    }

    /// Takes the plan of layers that came with the display list or the tree the scene just installed. Fails for a plan
    /// that does not pass the checks against them.
    pub fn take_layer_plan_of_installed_update(
        &mut self,
        layer_plan: Option<UnvalidatedLayerPlan>,
    ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
        self.holds_list_and_tree_sent_last = true;
        self.take_layer_plan(layer_plan)
    }

    /// Takes the plan of layers that came with a scroll state, if any. Fails for a plan that does not pass the checks
    /// against the display list and the tree it is of.
    pub fn take_layer_plan_of_scroll_state(
        &mut self,
        layer_plan: Option<UnvalidatedLayerPlan>,
    ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
        match layer_plan {
            Some(layer_plan) if self.holds_list_and_tree_sent_last => self.take_layer_plan(Some(layer_plan)),
            _ => Ok(()),
        }
    }

    fn take_layer_plan(&mut self, layer_plan: Option<UnvalidatedLayerPlan>) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
        self.layer_plan = None;
        let (Some(layer_plan), Some(display_list), Some(tree)) =
            (layer_plan, &self.display_list, &self.visual_context_tree)
        else {
            return Ok(());
        };
        // A plan of another list is of one the compositor refused for a reason WebContent does not learn.
        if layer_plan.display_list_id != display_list.id() {
            return Ok(());
        }
        let layer_plan = layer_plan.validated(display_list.storage(), tree.as_arc())?;
        // The spaces of a plan of more than one layer are at the anchors that plans take for the tree. A plan of one
        // layer replays the whole display list, and no frame reads which scroll offsets it leaves out.
        let nodes_whose_scroll_offset_plan_reads = if layer_plan.stack.replays_whole_list() {
            Rc::default()
        } else {
            let anchors_of_spaces: Vec<SpatialNodeIndex> = layer_plan
                .stack
                .spaces
                .iter()
                .skip(1)
                .map(|space| space.anchor)
                .collect();
            spatial_nodes_whose_scroll_offset_placement_leaves_out(tree.as_arc(), &anchors_of_spaces)
                .into_iter()
                .enumerate()
                .filter(|&(_, leaves_out)| !leaves_out)
                .map(|(node_index, _)| node_index as u32)
                .collect()
        };
        self.layer_plan = Some(ReceivedLayerPlan {
            viewport_rect: layer_plan.viewport_rect,
            stack: Rc::new(layer_plan.stack),
            nodes_whose_scroll_offset_plan_reads,
            note_lines: layer_plan.note_lines.into(),
        });
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn display_list(&self) -> &Option<Rc<DisplayList>> {
        &self.display_list
    }
    pub fn visual_context_tree(&self) -> &Option<AccumulatedVisualContextTree> {
        &self.visual_context_tree
    }

    pub fn current_visual_context_tree(&self) -> &AccumulatedVisualContextTree {
        assert!(self.display_list.is_some());
        assert!(self.visual_context_tree.is_some());
        self.visual_context_tree.as_ref().unwrap()
    }

    pub fn visual_context_tree_for_compositing(&mut self) -> &AccumulatedVisualContextTree {
        if let Some(transform) = self.async_visual_viewport_transform
            && self.visual_context_tree_for_compositing.is_none()
        {
            self.sampled_visual_context_tree = None;
            self.visual_context_tree_for_compositing = Some(
                self.current_visual_context_tree()
                    .with_visual_viewport_transform(&transform),
            );
        }
        let unsampled_tree = self
            .visual_context_tree_for_compositing
            .as_ref()
            .unwrap_or_else(|| self.visual_context_tree.as_ref().unwrap());
        let Some(sample_time_ns) = self.visual_animation_sample_time_ns else {
            return unsampled_tree;
        };
        if self.sampled_visual_context_tree.is_none() {
            self.sampled_visual_context_tree = Some(unsampled_tree.with_visual_animation_samples(sample_time_ns));
        }
        self.sampled_visual_context_tree.as_ref().unwrap()
    }

    /// The plan of layers of the display list and the tree as WebContent published it, unless frames draw the tree
    /// through a visual viewport transform other than its own.
    pub fn layer_plan_unless_visual_viewport_differs(&self) -> Option<&ReceivedLayerPlan> {
        let layer_plan = self.layer_plan.as_ref()?;
        let tree = self.visual_context_tree.as_ref()?;
        if let Some(transform) = self.async_visual_viewport_transform {
            let published_transform = tree.visual_viewport_transform();
            if transform.matrix != published_transform.matrix || transform.origin != published_transform.origin {
                return None;
            }
        }
        Some(layer_plan)
    }

    pub fn visual_viewport_transform(&self) -> TransformWithOrigin {
        if let Some(transform) = self.async_visual_viewport_transform {
            return transform;
        }
        if let Some(tree) = &self.visual_context_tree {
            return tree.visual_viewport_transform();
        }
        TransformWithOrigin {
            matrix: FloatMatrix4x4::identity(),
            origin: Default::default(),
        }
    }

    pub fn visual_viewport_scale(&self) -> Option<f32> {
        let tree = self.visual_context_tree.as_ref()?;
        if let Some(transform) = self.async_visual_viewport_transform {
            return Some(transform.matrix.elements[0][0]);
        }
        Some(tree.visual_viewport_transform().matrix.elements[0][0])
    }

    /// How many screen pixels a zoomed visual viewport shows one pixel of the layout viewport with. Scrollers scroll
    /// and stretch in the pixels of the layout viewport.
    pub fn visual_viewport_magnification(&self) -> f32 {
        let scale = self.visual_viewport_scale().unwrap_or(1.0);
        if scale < 1.0 { 1.0 } else { scale }
    }

    pub fn has_async_visual_viewport_transform(&self) -> bool {
        self.async_visual_viewport_transform.is_some()
    }

    pub fn set_async_visual_viewport_transform(&mut self, transform: TransformWithOrigin) {
        self.invalidate_visual_context_tree_for_compositing();
        self.async_visual_viewport_transform = Some(transform);
    }

    pub fn drop_async_visual_viewport_transform(&mut self) {
        self.invalidate_visual_context_tree_for_compositing();
        self.async_visual_viewport_transform = None;
    }

    pub fn advance_visual_animations(&mut self, now: MonotonicTime) -> bool {
        if !self.visual_context_tree.as_ref().unwrap().has_visual_animations() {
            return false;
        }
        self.sampled_visual_context_tree = None;
        self.visual_animation_sample_time_ns = Some(now.nanoseconds());
        self.visual_context_tree_for_compositing();
        self.has_active_visual_animations = self
            .visual_context_tree
            .as_ref()
            .unwrap()
            .has_active_visual_animation_at(now.nanoseconds());
        self.has_active_visual_animations
    }

    pub fn visual_animations_need_frame(
        &mut self,
        scroll_state_snapshot: &ScrollStateSnapshot,
        viewport_size: IntSize,
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) -> bool {
        if !self.has_active_visual_animations {
            return false;
        }
        if let Some(affects_viewport) = self.animated_content_may_affect_viewport {
            return affects_viewport;
        }
        let sample_time_ns = self.visual_animation_sample_time_ns.unwrap_or(now.nanoseconds());
        let transformed_tree;
        let tree = if let Some(transform) = self.async_visual_viewport_transform {
            transformed_tree = self
                .current_visual_context_tree()
                .with_visual_viewport_transform(&transform);
            &transformed_tree
        } else {
            self.current_visual_context_tree()
        };
        let effect = animated_content_may_affect_viewport(
            self.display_list.as_ref().unwrap(),
            tree,
            scroll_state_snapshot,
            IntRect::new(0, 0, viewport_size.width, viewport_size.height),
            sample_time_ns,
        );
        if effect.stable_until_scene_changes {
            self.animated_content_may_affect_viewport = Some(effect.may_affect_viewport);
        }
        effect.may_affect_viewport
    }

    pub fn forget_whether_animated_content_may_affect_viewport(&mut self) {
        self.animated_content_may_affect_viewport = None;
    }

    fn invalidate_visual_context_tree_for_compositing(&mut self) {
        self.animated_content_may_affect_viewport = None;
        self.sampled_visual_context_tree = None;
        self.visual_context_tree_for_compositing = None;
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use libcompositing_rust::display_list::builder::DisplayListBuilder;
    use libcompositing_rust::display_list::commands::{ContextRef, EffectNodeIndex, FillRect};
    use libcompositing_rust::display_list::layers::LayerPlan;
    use libcompositing_rust::display_list::layers::planning::InputsOfLayerPlan;
    use libcompositing_rust::display_list::storage::{ChunkIndexInList, DisplayListStorage, ListPosition, ListSpan};
    use libcompositing_rust::ipc_types::LayerPlanOnWire;
    use libcompositing_rust::visual_context::VisualContextTree;
    use libgfx_rust::{Color, CompositingAndBlendingOperator};
    use libipc_rust::wire::{Decoder, Encoder};
    use std::sync::Arc;

    const VIEWPORT: IntRect = IntRect::new(0, 0, 800, 600);
    const DISPLAY_LIST_ID: u64 = 7;

    fn scene_with_one_rect() -> (ContextScene, Arc<DisplayListStorage>, Arc<VisualContextTree>) {
        let tree = Arc::new(VisualContextTree::create_identity());
        let mut builder = DisplayListBuilder::new();
        builder.append(
            &FillRect {
                rect: IntRect::new(10, 10, 100, 100),
                color: Color::from_rgb(0, 128, 0),
                compositing_and_blending_operator: CompositingAndBlendingOperator::Normal,
                background_color_animation_effect: EffectNodeIndex::NONE,
            },
            &[],
            ContextRef::default(),
        );
        let list = DisplayListStorage::recorded(&builder.finish(), tree.clone());
        let display_list = DisplayList::new(
            list.clone(),
            DISPLAY_LIST_ID,
            tree.structural_epoch,
            None,
            None,
            Default::default(),
        );
        let mut scene = ContextScene::default();
        scene.install(
            Rc::new(display_list),
            AccumulatedVisualContextTree::from_arc(tree.clone()),
            MonotonicTime::default(),
        );
        (scene, list, tree)
    }

    // A plan as the compositor receives it from WebContent.
    fn received(display_list_id: u64, stack: LayerStack) -> UnvalidatedLayerPlan {
        let mut encoder = Encoder::new();
        encoder
            .encode(&LayerPlanOnWire::Planned(Arc::new(LayerPlan {
                display_list_id,
                viewport_rect: VIEWPORT,
                stack,
                note_lines: Vec::new(),
            })))
            .unwrap();
        let (bytes, _) = encoder.finish();
        Decoder::new(&bytes, [])
            .decode::<LayerPlanOnWire>()
            .unwrap()
            .into_received()
    }

    fn stack_of_plan(scene: &ContextScene) -> Option<LayerStack> {
        scene
            .layer_plan_unless_visual_viewport_differs()
            .map(|layer_plan| (*layer_plan.stack).clone())
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_plan_is_taken_with_the_list_it_is_of_and_one_that_does_not_fit_it_is_refused() {
        let (mut scene, list, tree) = scene_with_one_rect();
        let planned = InputsOfLayerPlan::new(list.clone(), tree, &[], VIEWPORT).plan().stack;
        assert_eq!(planned.why_list_is_one_layer, None);
        let span_past_end_of_list = ListSpan {
            begin: ListPosition::default(),
            end: ListPosition::new(ChunkIndexInList(0), list.whole_span().end.offset + 8),
        };
        let stack_not_fitting_list = || {
            let mut stack = planned.clone();
            stack.bands[0].record_spans = vec![span_past_end_of_list];
            stack
        };

        scene.forget_layer_plan();
        assert_eq!(
            scene.take_layer_plan_of_installed_update(Some(received(DISPLAY_LIST_ID, planned.clone()))),
            Ok(())
        );
        assert_eq!(stack_of_plan(&scene), Some(planned.clone()));
        // A scroll state without a plan keeps the plan.
        assert_eq!(scene.take_layer_plan_of_scroll_state(None), Ok(()));
        assert_eq!(stack_of_plan(&scene), Some(planned.clone()));

        // The stub of the message answers WebContent with misbehavior for a plan that does not pass the checks.
        assert!(
            scene
                .take_layer_plan_of_scroll_state(Some(received(DISPLAY_LIST_ID, stack_not_fitting_list())))
                .is_err()
        );
        assert_eq!(stack_of_plan(&scene), None);
        assert!(
            scene
                .take_layer_plan_of_installed_update(Some(received(DISPLAY_LIST_ID, stack_not_fitting_list())))
                .is_err()
        );

        // A plan of another list is of one the compositor refused, and goes unchecked.
        assert_eq!(
            scene.take_layer_plan_of_installed_update(Some(received(DISPLAY_LIST_ID + 1, stack_not_fitting_list()))),
            Ok(())
        );
        assert_eq!(stack_of_plan(&scene), None);

        // After a list or a tree the compositor may refuse, a plan with a scroll state is not of what the scene holds
        // until a plan comes with a list or a tree the scene installs.
        scene.forget_layer_plan();
        assert_eq!(
            scene.take_layer_plan_of_scroll_state(Some(received(DISPLAY_LIST_ID, stack_not_fitting_list()))),
            Ok(())
        );
        assert_eq!(stack_of_plan(&scene), None);
        assert_eq!(scene.take_layer_plan_of_installed_update(None), Ok(()));
        assert_eq!(
            scene.take_layer_plan_of_scroll_state(Some(received(DISPLAY_LIST_ID, planned.clone()))),
            Ok(())
        );
        assert_eq!(stack_of_plan(&scene), Some(planned));
    }
}

//! Frames, viewport state, and scroll update publication for a compositor context.

use super::*;
use std::fmt::Write;

struct JsonWriter(String);

impl JsonWriter {
    fn string(&mut self, value: &str) {
        self.0.push('"');
        for ch in value.chars() {
            match ch {
                '\u{8}' => self.0.push_str("\\b"),
                '\n' => self.0.push_str("\\n"),
                '\t' => self.0.push_str("\\t"),
                '"' => self.0.push_str("\\\""),
                '\\' => self.0.push_str("\\\\"),
                '\u{0}'..='\u{1f}' => {
                    write!(self.0, "\\u{:04x}", ch as u32).unwrap();
                }
                _ => self.0.push(ch),
            }
        }
        self.0.push('"');
    }

    fn key(&mut self, key: &str) {
        if !self.0.ends_with('{') {
            self.0.push(',');
        }
        self.string(key);
        self.0.push(':');
    }

    fn number(&mut self, value: f64) {
        if value.is_finite() {
            write!(self.0, "{value}").unwrap();
        } else {
            self.0.push_str("null");
        }
    }

    fn point(&mut self, x: f64, y: f64) {
        self.0.push_str("{\"x\":");
        self.number(x);
        self.key("y");
        self.number(y);
        self.0.push('}');
    }
}

impl ContextState {
    pub(super) fn wheel_step_can_stretch_elastically(
        &self,
        wheel_delta_precision: WheelDeltaPrecision,
        scroll_gesture_phase: ScrollGesturePhase,
    ) -> bool {
        self.presents_to_client()
            && self
                .elastic_overscroll_controller
                .step_can_stretch(wheel_delta_precision, scroll_gesture_phase)
    }

    pub(super) fn pull_elastic_overscroll_by(
        &mut self,
        node: &AsyncScrollNode,
        step_delta: FloatPoint,
        delta_the_scroller_did_not_scroll_by: FloatPoint,
    ) -> bool {
        let scroll_offset = self
            .async_scroll_tree
            .scroll_offset_for_node(node.scroll_node_index, &self.scroll_state_snapshot);
        let Some(scroll_offset) = scroll_offset else {
            return false;
        };
        self.elastic_overscroll_controller.pull_by(
            node,
            scroll_offset,
            step_delta,
            delta_the_scroller_did_not_scroll_by,
            self.scene.visual_viewport_magnification(),
        )
    }

    pub fn set_scroll_capabilities(&mut self, capabilities: &ScrollCapabilities) {
        self.presentation_synthesizes_scroll_momentum = capabilities.synthesizes_scroll_momentum;
        self.elastic_overscroll_controller
            .set_enabled(capabilities.scrolls_elastically);
        self.scrollbar_track_press_jumps = capabilities.scrollbar_track_press_jumps;
        self.wheel_gesture_routing
            .set_touchpad_gesture_end(capabilities.touchpad_gesture_end);
    }

    pub fn advance_elastic_overscroll_rebounds(&mut self, frame_time: MonotonicTime) -> Option<IntRect> {
        if !self.elastic_overscroll_controller.advance_rebounds(frame_time) {
            return None;
        }
        Some(self.async_scrolling_viewport_rect)
    }

    /// Where the first step of a wheel gesture at the position, by the delta in CSS pixels, would go.
    pub fn route_first_wheel_step_for_testing(
        &mut self,
        position: FloatPoint,
        delta_in_css_pixels: FloatPoint,
        nested_context_regions: NestedContextRegions,
    ) -> FirstWheelStepRouteForTesting {
        let document_id = self.async_scroll_tree.document_id();
        if !self.presents_to_client() {
            return FirstWheelStepRouteForTesting {
                route: libcompositing_rust::scrolling::FirstWheelStepRoute {
                    decision: InputRoutingDecision::ContextNotPresenting,
                    scroller: None,
                },
                document_id,
            };
        }
        if self.scene.display_list().is_none() || self.scene.visual_context_tree().is_none() {
            return FirstWheelStepRouteForTesting {
                route: libcompositing_rust::scrolling::FirstWheelStepRoute {
                    decision: InputRoutingDecision::NoAsyncScrollingState,
                    scroller: None,
                },
                document_id,
            };
        }
        let delta = delta_in_css_pixels.scaled(
            self.async_scroll_tree.device_pixels_per_css_pixel() as f32 / self.scene.visual_viewport_magnification(),
        );
        FirstWheelStepRouteForTesting {
            route: self.async_scroll_tree.route_first_wheel_step(
                self.wheel_gesture_routing.admission(),
                self.scene.visual_context_tree_for_compositing(),
                position,
                delta,
                nested_context_regions,
            ),
            document_id,
        }
    }

    /// The installed scrolling state, its routing admission, and how far the given scroller is stretched, as JSON.
    pub fn scroll_state_for_testing(&self, scroller: AsyncScrollNodeStableID) -> String {
        let mut scroll_state = JsonWriter(async_scrolling_state_to_json(self.async_scroll_tree.state()));
        scroll_state.0.pop();
        let admission = self.wheel_gesture_routing.admission();
        let admission_name = if admission == WheelRoutingAdmission::Accepted {
            "accepted".to_string()
        } else {
            input_routing_decision_for_wheel_step_not_admitted_by(admission).name()
        };
        scroll_state.key("wheelRoutingAdmission");
        scroll_state.string(&admission_name);
        if let Some(index) = self.async_scroll_tree.scroll_node_index_for_stable_id(scroller)
            && let Some(offset) = self
                .async_scroll_tree
                .css_scroll_offset_for_node(index, &self.scroll_state_snapshot)
        {
            scroll_state.key("scrollOffset");
            scroll_state.point(offset.x.to_double(), offset.y.to_double());
        }
        let stretch = self
            .elastic_overscroll_controller
            .stretch_of(scroller)
            .scaled(1.0 / self.async_scroll_tree.device_pixels_per_css_pixel() as f32);
        scroll_state.key("stretch");
        scroll_state.point(stretch.x as f64, stretch.y as f64);
        scroll_state.key("visualViewportScale");
        scroll_state.number(self.scene.visual_viewport_scale().unwrap_or(1.0) as f64);
        let visual_viewport_offset = visual_viewport_scroll_offset(&self.scene.visual_viewport_transform());
        scroll_state.key("visualViewportOffset");
        scroll_state.point(visual_viewport_offset.x as f64, visual_viewport_offset.y as f64);
        scroll_state.0.push('}');
        scroll_state.0
    }

    pub(super) fn scroll_state_snapshot_stretched_by_elastic_overscrolls(&self) -> Option<ScrollStateSnapshot> {
        self.elastic_overscroll_controller
            .stretched_scroll_state_snapshot(&self.scroll_state_snapshot, &self.async_scroll_tree)
    }

    pub fn take_pending_async_scroll_updates(&mut self) -> PendingAsyncScrollUpdates {
        let mut updates = self
            .async_scroll_update_outbox
            .take_updates(self.user_scroll_gesture_state());
        updates.document_id = self.async_scroll_tree.document_id();
        updates
    }

    pub fn has_pending_async_scroll_updates(&self) -> bool {
        self.async_scroll_update_outbox
            .has_updates(&self.user_scroll_gesture_state())
    }

    pub fn publish_pending_async_scroll_updates(&mut self) {
        if !self.has_pending_async_scroll_updates() {
            return;
        }
        let updates = self.take_pending_async_scroll_updates();
        self.host.post_to_web_content(
            self.web_content_client_id,
            compositor_web_content_client::messages::AsyncScrollUpdates {
                context_id: self.context_id,
                updates,
            },
        );
    }

    /// Returns whether the overlays have to repaint all of the viewport. The page's next frame repaints all of it when
    /// its size changes, but the paused debugger's page does not paint again, and a new pixel ratio alone need not
    /// repaint the page.
    pub fn viewport_size_updated(&mut self, viewport_size: IntSize, device_pixel_ratio: f64) -> bool {
        let only_the_pixel_ratio_changed =
            viewport_size == self.viewport_size && device_pixel_ratio != self.device_pixel_ratio;
        self.scene.forget_whether_animated_content_may_affect_viewport();
        if self.viewport_size != viewport_size {
            self.keyboard_scroll_controller.forget_target();
        }
        self.viewport_size = viewport_size;
        self.device_pixel_ratio = device_pixel_ratio;
        let ui_overlays = self.overlays.ui_overlays();
        ui_overlays.paused_debugger.is_some()
            || (only_the_pixel_ratio_changed && ui_overlays.picture_in_picture_controls.is_some())
    }

    pub fn set_ui_overlays(&mut self, ui_overlays: UIOverlays, now: MonotonicTime) -> UIOverlaysChange {
        let shows_paused_debugger = ui_overlays.paused_debugger.is_some();
        let change = self.overlays.set_ui_overlays(ui_overlays, now);
        if change == UIOverlaysChange::RepaintsEverything && shows_paused_debugger {
            self.end_keyboard_scroll_gesture();
        }
        change
    }

    pub fn set_compositor_layers_overlay_needs_frames_until(&mut self, until: Option<MonotonicTime>) {
        self.overlays.set_compositor_layers_overlay_needs_frames_until(until);
    }

    /// What the fades of the overlays repaint of the viewport as they advance to the frame.
    pub fn advance_overlay_fades(&mut self, frame_time: MonotonicTime) -> Option<IntRect> {
        self.overlays
            .advance_fades(frame_time, self.viewport_size, self.device_pixel_ratio)
    }

    /// Whether the compositor layers overlay needs the frame, which rasters no tile again for that.
    pub fn compositor_layers_overlay_needs_frame(&mut self, frame_time: MonotonicTime) -> bool {
        self.overlays.compositor_layers_overlay_needs_frame(frame_time)
    }

    pub fn viewport_rect(&self) -> IntRect {
        IntRect::new(0, 0, self.viewport_size.width, self.viewport_size.height)
    }

    pub fn set_visibility(&mut self, visibility: ContextVisibility) -> bool {
        if self.visibility == visibility {
            return false;
        }
        self.visibility = visibility;
        if visibility == ContextVisibility::Hidden {
            self.end_keyboard_scroll_gesture();
            self.elastic_overscroll_controller.forget();
        }
        true
    }

    /// Where the compositor has scrolled each scroll node to.
    pub fn scroll_offsets(&self) -> Vec<CompositorScrollOffset> {
        let scroll_nodes = self.async_scroll_tree.scroll_nodes();
        let mut scroll_offsets = Vec::with_capacity(scroll_nodes.len());
        for node in scroll_nodes {
            scroll_offsets.push(CompositorScrollOffset {
                scroll_node: node.stable_node_id,
                offset: self
                    .async_scroll_tree
                    .css_scroll_offset_for_scroll_node(node, &self.scroll_state_snapshot),
            });
        }
        scroll_offsets
    }

    fn frame_inputs_as_presented_now(&mut self, now: MonotonicTime) -> FrameInputs {
        let stretched_scroll_state_snapshot = self.scroll_state_snapshot_stretched_by_elastic_overscrolls();
        let presented_scroll_state_snapshot =
            stretched_scroll_state_snapshot.unwrap_or_else(|| self.scroll_state_snapshot.clone());
        let scrollbars = self
            .scrollbar_controller
            .scrollbars_of_frame(&presented_scroll_state_snapshot);
        let overlays = self.overlays.picture_of_frame(
            self.viewport_size,
            self.device_pixel_ratio,
            &self.host.overlay_label_shaper(self.context_id),
        );
        FrameInputs {
            visual_context_tree: self.scene.visual_context_tree_for_compositing().clone(),
            layer_plan: self.scene.layer_plan_unless_visual_viewport_differs().cloned(),
            presented_scroll_state_snapshot,
            scrollbars,
            painted_at: now,
            overlays,
        }
    }

    // Each frame shows the scrollbars as of when it is painted. An elastic overscroll moves the presented scroll offsets
    // only, and shows the scrollbars of the stretched scroller as a scroll does.
    fn update_scrollbar_visibility(&mut self, now: MonotonicTime) {
        let stretched_scroll_state_snapshot = self.scroll_state_snapshot_stretched_by_elastic_overscrolls();
        let presented_scroll_state_snapshot = stretched_scroll_state_snapshot
            .as_ref()
            .unwrap_or(&self.scroll_state_snapshot);
        self.scrollbar_controller
            .update_visibility(presented_scroll_state_snapshot, now);
        self.report_scrollbar_visibility_changes();
        // A hovered scrollbar starts to grow here, which needs display ticks before anything else asks for a frame.
        if self.scrollbar_controller.fades_need_frame(now) {
            self.host.request_display_ticks(self.context_id);
        }
        // The fade out runs on display ticks, which the wait before it does not need.
        let fade_out_time = self.scrollbar_controller.next_fade_out_time();
        let Some(fade_out_time) = fade_out_time else {
            self.host.cancel_timer(self.context_id, ContextTimer::ScrollbarFadeOut);
            return;
        };
        let delay = max(Duration::zero(), fade_out_time - now);
        self.host
            .set_timer(self.context_id, ContextTimer::ScrollbarFadeOut, delay);
    }

    // NB: This goes on the connection the compositor forwards input on, so the main thread knows which scrollbars have
    //     faded out before it hit tests any later press. A nested context another process owns reports to that process,
    //     which gets its input through the UI instead.
    fn report_scrollbar_visibility_changes(&mut self) {
        let changes = self.scrollbar_controller.take_visibility_changes();
        if !changes.is_empty() {
            self.host.post_to_web_content(
                self.web_content_client_id,
                compositor_web_content_client::messages::OverlayScrollbarVisibilitiesChanged { visibilities: changes },
            );
        }
    }

    /// Advances the fades of the scrollbars to a frame, and answers whether any of them changed. The frame finds what
    /// changed in the content hashes of their records.
    pub fn advance_scrollbar_fades(&mut self, frame_time: MonotonicTime) -> bool {
        if self.scene.visual_context_tree().is_none() {
            return false;
        }
        let some_scrollbar_changed = self.scrollbar_controller.advance_fades(frame_time);
        self.report_scrollbar_visibility_changes();
        some_scrollbar_changed
    }

    /// Each frame shows the scrollbars as of when it is painted, so this updates which of them are shown. Empty until a
    /// display list is installed.
    pub fn frame_inputs(&mut self, now: MonotonicTime) -> Option<FrameInputs> {
        self.update_scrollbar_visibility(now);
        self.scene.display_list().as_ref()?;
        self.ask_render_clock_for_display_list_where_scrolled_past_its_window();
        Some(self.frame_inputs_as_presented_now(now))
    }

    fn ask_render_clock_for_display_list_where_scrolled_past_its_window(&mut self) {
        if !self.has_async_scrolling_state {
            return;
        }
        let (Some(display_list), Some(visual_context_tree)) =
            (self.scene.display_list(), self.scene.visual_context_tree())
        else {
            return;
        };
        let Some(window) = display_list.window() else {
            return;
        };
        let asks = self
            .display_list_coverage_watch
            .asks_for_display_list_where_scrolled(&ShownOfDisplayList {
                display_list_id: display_list.id(),
                window,
                visual_context_tree: visual_context_tree.as_arc(),
                scroll_state_snapshot: &self.scroll_state_snapshot,
                viewport_size: self.viewport_size,
            });
        if asks {
            self.host.post_to_render_clock_of_web_content(
                self.web_content_client_id,
                render_clock_client::messages::DisplayListCoverageRunsOut {
                    context_id: self.context_id,
                    scroll_offsets: self.scroll_offsets(),
                },
            );
        }
    }

    pub fn frame_inputs_for_screenshot(&mut self, now: MonotonicTime) -> ScreenshotInputs {
        assert!(self.scene.display_list().is_some());
        // Screenshot requests can arrive between display ticks, so sample animations and scrollbar visibility at capture
        // time.
        let capture_time = now;
        self.advance_visual_animations(capture_time);
        self.update_scrollbar_visibility(now);
        let scrollbar_fades_changed = self.advance_scrollbar_fades(capture_time);
        ScreenshotInputs {
            frame_inputs: self.frame_inputs_as_presented_now(capture_time),
            scrollbar_fades_changed,
        }
    }

    fn apply_visual_viewport_scroll_delta(&mut self, delta: FloatPoint) -> Option<VisualViewportScrollDelta> {
        if delta.is_zero() {
            return None;
        }
        self.scene.visual_context_tree().as_ref()?;
        let document_id = self.async_scroll_tree.document_id()?;
        let mut transform = self.scene.visual_viewport_transform();
        let scale = transform.matrix.elements[0][0];
        if scale <= 1.0 {
            return None;
        }
        let min_x = -(self.async_scrolling_viewport_rect.width as f32) * (scale - 1.0);
        let min_y = -(self.async_scrolling_viewport_rect.height as f32) * (scale - 1.0);
        let old_x = transform.matrix.elements[0][3];
        let old_y = transform.matrix.elements[1][3];
        let new_x = clamp(old_x - delta.x, min_x, 0.0);
        let new_y = clamp(old_y - delta.y, min_y, 0.0);
        let consumed_delta = FloatPoint {
            x: old_x - new_x,
            y: old_y - new_y,
        };
        if consumed_delta.is_zero() {
            return None;
        }
        transform.matrix.elements[0][3] = new_x;
        transform.matrix.elements[1][3] = new_y;
        self.scene.set_async_visual_viewport_transform(transform);
        self.visual_viewport_document_id = Some(document_id);
        self.note_user_input_scrolled(AsyncScrollNodeStableID {
            node_id: document_id,
            kind: AsyncScrollNodeKind::VisualViewport,
            pseudo_element_type: 0,
        });
        self.rebuild_wheel_hit_test_targets();
        Some(VisualViewportScrollDelta {
            scroll_offset: AsyncScrollOffset {
                stable_node_id: AsyncScrollNodeStableID {
                    node_id: document_id,
                    kind: AsyncScrollNodeKind::VisualViewport,
                    pseudo_element_type: 0,
                },
                compositor_scroll_offset: visual_viewport_scroll_offset(&transform),
                unadopted_scroll_delta: consumed_delta.scaled(1.0 / scale),
                last_relative_scroll_delta: Default::default(),
                visual_viewport_scale: Some(scale),
                applied_scroll_request_id: 0,
                user_input_scroll_count: 0,
                context_user_input_scroll_count: 0,
            },
            consumed_delta,
        })
    }

    /// Pans the visual viewport of a zoomed page by as much of a delta in screen pixels as it has room for, and returns
    /// that part of the delta.
    pub(super) fn pan_visual_viewport_by(&mut self, delta_in_screen_pixels: FloatPoint) -> FloatPoint {
        let Some(delta) = self.apply_visual_viewport_scroll_delta(delta_in_screen_pixels) else {
            return Default::default();
        };
        self.store_pending_async_scroll_offsets(&[delta.scroll_offset], None);
        delta.consumed_delta
    }

    pub(super) fn scroll_offsets_by_stable_id(&self) -> HashMap<AsyncScrollNodeStableID, FloatPoint> {
        let mut scroll_offsets = HashMap::new();
        if !self.has_async_scrolling_state {
            return scroll_offsets;
        }
        for node in self.async_scroll_tree.scroll_nodes() {
            scroll_offsets.insert(
                node.stable_node_id,
                AsyncScrollTree::scroll_offset_for_scroll_node(node, &self.scroll_state_snapshot),
            );
        }
        scroll_offsets
    }

    /// The main thread asks for every scroll of its own, so the offsets a snapshot of its scroll state has for the
    /// boxes this context already scrolls are what it last heard of them. Only a box new to this context takes its
    /// offset from the snapshot.
    pub(super) fn keep_scroll_offsets_of_known_nodes(
        &mut self,
        scroll_offsets_of_known_nodes: &HashMap<AsyncScrollNodeStableID, FloatPoint>,
    ) -> Option<FloatPoint> {
        let mut viewport_scroll_offset = None;
        let mut clamped_scroll_offsets = Vec::new();
        let mut kept_any_scroll_offset = false;
        self.scroll_offsets_differ_from_last_frame = false;
        self.scroll_nodes_seeded_by_last_frame.clear();
        for node in self.async_scroll_tree.scroll_nodes() {
            let known_scroll_offset = scroll_offsets_of_known_nodes.get(&node.stable_node_id);
            let Some(&known_scroll_offset) = known_scroll_offset else {
                self.scroll_nodes_seeded_by_last_frame.insert(node.stable_node_id);
                continue;
            };
            if AsyncScrollTree::scroll_offset_for_scroll_node(node, &self.scroll_state_snapshot) != known_scroll_offset
            {
                self.scroll_offsets_differ_from_last_frame = true;
            }
            let kept_scroll_offset = self
                .async_scroll_tree
                .set_scroll_offset_leaving_sticky_offsets_unresolved(
                    node,
                    known_scroll_offset,
                    &mut self.scroll_state_snapshot,
                );
            kept_any_scroll_offset = true;
            if node.is_viewport {
                viewport_scroll_offset = Some(kept_scroll_offset);
            }
            // A box whose scroll range shrank past its offset is told where it ended up.
            if kept_scroll_offset != known_scroll_offset {
                clamped_scroll_offsets.push(AsyncScrollOffset {
                    stable_node_id: node.stable_node_id,
                    compositor_scroll_offset: kept_scroll_offset,
                    unadopted_scroll_delta: kept_scroll_offset - known_scroll_offset,
                    last_relative_scroll_delta: Default::default(),
                    visual_viewport_scale: None,
                    applied_scroll_request_id: 0,
                    user_input_scroll_count: 0,
                    context_user_input_scroll_count: 0,
                });
            }
        }
        // Resolving sticky offsets walks the whole visual context tree, so it runs once, after every offset is kept.
        if kept_any_scroll_offset {
            resolve_sticky_offsets(
                self.scene.current_visual_context_tree(),
                &mut self.scroll_state_snapshot,
            );
        }
        if !clamped_scroll_offsets.is_empty() {
            self.store_pending_async_scroll_offsets(&clamped_scroll_offsets, None);
        }
        viewport_scroll_offset
    }

    pub(super) fn store_pending_async_scroll_offsets(
        &mut self,
        scroll_offsets: &[AsyncScrollOffset],
        operation_id: Option<AsyncScrollOperationID>,
    ) {
        self.scene.forget_whether_animated_content_may_affect_viewport();
        let mut stamped_scroll_offsets = Vec::with_capacity(scroll_offsets.len());
        for mut scroll_offset in scroll_offsets.iter().cloned() {
            scroll_offset.applied_scroll_request_id = self
                .applied_scroll_request_ids
                .get(&scroll_offset.stable_node_id)
                .copied()
                .unwrap_or(0);
            scroll_offset.user_input_scroll_count = self
                .user_input_scroll_counts
                .get(&scroll_offset.stable_node_id)
                .copied()
                .unwrap_or(0);
            scroll_offset.context_user_input_scroll_count = self.context_user_input_scroll_count;
            stamped_scroll_offsets.push(scroll_offset);
        }
        self.async_scroll_update_outbox
            .record_scroll_offsets(&stamped_scroll_offsets);
        self.scroll_offsets_differ_from_last_frame = true;
        if let Some(id) = operation_id {
            self.async_scroll_update_outbox.complete_operation(id);
        }
    }
}

//! Gesture lifetimes, scrollbar scrolling, and visual animations for a compositor context.

use super::*;

impl ContextState {
    pub(super) fn resolve_wheel_scroll_latch(
        &mut self,
        scroll_gesture_phase: ScrollGesturePhase,
        gesture_id: Option<u64>,
    ) -> ResolvedLatch {
        self.wheel_gesture_routing.resolve_latch(
            &self.async_scroll_tree,
            self.scene.visual_context_tree().as_ref(),
            scroll_gesture_phase,
            gesture_id,
        )
    }

    /// The scroller the first step of a gesture goes to, as the hit test at the position finds it, or as it is found
    /// from the innermost of the scrollers the page found around the target that this context knows.
    pub(super) fn route_first_wheel_step(
        &mut self,
        position: FloatPoint,
        delta: FloatPoint,
        wheel_delta_precision: WheelDeltaPrecision,
        wheel_step_dispatch: WheelStepDispatch,
        nested_context_regions: NestedContextRegions,
        scroll_chain: &[AsyncScrollNodeStableID],
    ) -> WheelHitTestResult {
        let in_flight_destination_for = |state: &Self, stable_node_id| {
            if wheel_delta_precision == WheelDeltaPrecision::Discrete {
                return state.in_flight_wheel_destination(stable_node_id);
            }
            None
        };
        for &stable_node_id in scroll_chain {
            if let Some(scroll_node_index) = self.async_scroll_tree.scroll_node_index_for_stable_id(stable_node_id) {
                return self
                    .async_scroll_tree
                    .hit_test_result_for_scroll_node(scroll_node_index, delta, &|id| {
                        in_flight_destination_for(self, id)
                    });
            }
        }
        let visual_context_tree = self.scene.visual_context_tree_for_compositing().clone();
        self.async_scroll_tree.hit_test_scroll_node_for_wheel(
            &visual_context_tree,
            position,
            delta,
            &|id| in_flight_destination_for(self, id),
            wheel_step_dispatch,
            nested_context_regions,
        )
    }

    /// The scroller the first step of a wheel gesture is routed to, which the gesture is latched to.
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub(super) fn route_and_latch_wheel_gesture(
        &mut self,
        position: FloatPoint,
        delta: FloatPoint,
        wheel_delta_precision: WheelDeltaPrecision,
        scroll_gesture_phase: ScrollGesturePhase,
        gesture_id: Option<u64>,
        wheel_step_dispatch: WheelStepDispatch,
        nested_context_regions: NestedContextRegions,
        scroll_chain: &[AsyncScrollNodeStableID],
    ) -> WheelGestureLatchAttempt {
        let scroll_target = self.route_first_wheel_step(
            position,
            delta,
            wheel_delta_precision,
            wheel_step_dispatch,
            nested_context_regions,
            scroll_chain,
        );
        if scroll_target.is_blocked_by_a_region() {
            return WheelGestureLatchAttempt {
                decision: input_routing_decision_for_first_wheel_step(scroll_target.outcome),
                latched_scroll_node_index: None,
            };
        }
        let mut scroll_node_index_to_latch = scroll_target.scroll_node_index;
        let mut decision = InputRoutingDecision::Latched;
        // Fingers that start to pull where every scroller under them is already at its edge stretch the outermost one. A
        // context nested in another one turns the gesture away instead, which passes it on to the document around it.
        let fingers_start_a_gesture_at_an_edge = scroll_node_index_to_latch.is_none()
            && scroll_target.innermost_scroll_node_index.is_some()
            && !delta.is_zero()
            && scroll_gesture_phase == ScrollGesturePhase::Ongoing
            && self.wheel_step_can_stretch_elastically(wheel_delta_precision, scroll_gesture_phase);
        if fingers_start_a_gesture_at_an_edge {
            scroll_node_index_to_latch = self
                .async_scroll_tree
                .outermost_scroll_node_wheel_scrollable_along_main_axis_of(
                    scroll_target.innermost_scroll_node_index.unwrap(),
                    delta,
                );
            decision = InputRoutingDecision::LatchedOutermostScrollerToStretch;
        }
        let Some(index) = scroll_node_index_to_latch else {
            return WheelGestureLatchAttempt {
                decision: input_routing_decision_for_first_wheel_step(scroll_target.outcome),
                latched_scroll_node_index: None,
            };
        };
        let node = self.async_scroll_tree.scroll_node_for_index(index);
        assert!(node.is_some());
        self.wheel_gesture_routing
            .latch(node.unwrap().stable_node_id, scroll_gesture_phase, gesture_id);
        WheelGestureLatchAttempt {
            decision,
            latched_scroll_node_index: scroll_node_index_to_latch,
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn report_started_user_scroll(
        &mut self,
        operation_id: AsyncScrollOperationID,
        stable_node_id: AsyncScrollNodeStableID,
        step_start_offset: FloatPoint,
        destination_offset: FloatPoint,
        animation_kind: ScrollAnimationKind,
        is_absolute_scroll: bool,
    ) {
        let scroll_node_index = self.async_scroll_tree.scroll_node_index_for_stable_id(stable_node_id);
        assert!(scroll_node_index.is_some());
        let current_offset = self
            .async_scroll_tree
            .css_scroll_offset_for_node(scroll_node_index.unwrap(), &self.scroll_state_snapshot);
        assert!(current_offset.is_some());
        let destination = self.async_scroll_tree.css_pixels_from_device_offset(destination_offset);
        self.note_user_input_scrolled(stable_node_id);
        self.async_scroll_update_outbox
            .record_started_user_scroll(StartedUserScroll {
                stable_node_id,
                operation_id,
                initial_scroll_offset: current_offset.unwrap(),
                unsnapped_scroll_destination: destination,
                relative_scroll_delta: {
                    let start = self.async_scroll_tree.css_pixels_from_device_offset(step_start_offset);
                    libcompositing_rust::css_pixels::CssPixelPoint {
                        x: destination.x - start.x,
                        y: destination.y - start.y,
                    }
                },
                selection: SnapDestination {
                    position: destination,
                    ..Default::default()
                },
                settles_gesture: false,
                is_absolute_scroll,
                animation_kind: Some(animation_kind),
            });
    }

    pub(super) fn cancel_smooth_scroll_taken_over_by_user_input(&mut self, scroll_node_index: SpatialNodeIndex) {
        for animation in &self.smooth_scroll_animations {
            let animated_scroll_node_index = self
                .async_scroll_tree
                .scroll_node_index_for_stable_id(animation.stable_node_id);
            if animated_scroll_node_index != Some(scroll_node_index) {
                continue;
            }
            self.async_scroll_update_outbox
                .note_operation_taken_over_by_user_input(animation.operation_id);
            let stable_node_id = animation.stable_node_id;
            self.cancel_smooth_scroll(stable_node_id);
            return;
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn box_of_captured_scrollbar(&self) -> Option<AsyncScrollNodeStableID> {
        let scrollbar_index = self.scrollbar_controller.captured_scrollbar_index()?;
        self.scrollbar_controller
            .scrollbars()
            .get(scrollbar_index)?
            .scroller_stable_node_id
    }

    pub(super) fn note_user_scroll_gesture_end_if_drag_ended(
        &mut self,
        box_of_dragged_scrollbar: Option<AsyncScrollNodeStableID>,
    ) {
        if let Some(id) = box_of_dragged_scrollbar
            && !self.scrollbar_controller.has_captured_scrollbar()
        {
            self.async_scroll_update_outbox.note_user_scroll_gesture_ended(&[id]);
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn end_user_scroll_gesture_of_held_keys(&mut self) {
        self.async_scroll_update_outbox
            .note_user_scroll_gesture_ended(&self.boxes_scrolled_by_held_keys);
        self.boxes_scrolled_by_held_keys.clear();
    }

    pub(super) fn user_scroll_gesture_state(&self) -> UserScrollGestureState {
        let mut state = UserScrollGestureState::default();
        if let Some(id) = self.box_of_captured_scrollbar() {
            state.boxes_in_user_scroll_gesture.push(id);
        }
        for &id in &self.boxes_scrolled_by_held_keys {
            if !state.boxes_in_user_scroll_gesture.contains(&id) {
                state.boxes_in_user_scroll_gesture.push(id);
            }
        }
        for id in self.scroll_snap_controller.boxes_with_gesture_awaiting_input() {
            if !state.boxes_in_user_scroll_gesture.contains(&id) {
                state.boxes_in_user_scroll_gesture.push(id);
            }
        }
        if let Some(id) = self.wheel_gesture_routing.scroller_held_by_fingers()
            && !state.boxes_in_user_scroll_gesture.contains(&id)
        {
            state.boxes_in_user_scroll_gesture.push(id);
        }
        state.wheel_latched_scroller = self.wheel_gesture_routing.latched_scroller();
        state
    }

    pub(super) fn schedule_end_of_scroll_step_gestures(&self, now: MonotonicTime) {
        let deadline = self.scroll_snap_controller.earliest_gesture_input_deadline();
        let Some(deadline) = deadline else {
            self.host
                .cancel_timer(self.context_id, ContextTimer::ScrollStepGestureInput);
            return;
        };
        self.host.set_timer(
            self.context_id,
            ContextTimer::ScrollStepGestureInput,
            max(deadline - now, Duration::zero()),
        );
    }

    /// A gesture whose steps this context chains ends once they stop arriving, which is reported to WebContent so
    /// that it settles the gesture then rather than on a clock of its own.
    pub(super) fn end_scroll_step_gestures_whose_input_ran_out(&mut self, now: MonotonicTime) {
        let ended_boxes = self.scroll_snap_controller.end_gestures_whose_input_ran_out(now);
        if !ended_boxes.is_empty() {
            self.async_scroll_update_outbox
                .note_user_scroll_gesture_ended(&ended_boxes);
            self.request_rendering_update();
        }
        self.schedule_end_of_scroll_step_gestures(now);
    }

    #[allow(clippy::unnecessary_wraps)]
    fn start_scrollbar_press_scroll(
        &mut self,
        node: &AsyncScrollNode,
        old_scroll_offset: FloatPoint,
        destination: FloatPoint,
        is_absolute_scroll: bool,
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) -> Option<PendingFrame> {
        let operation_id = self.async_scroll_update_outbox.allocate_operation_id();
        self.smooth_scroll_animations.push(ActiveSmoothScrollAnimation {
            stable_node_id: node.stable_node_id,
            operation_id,
            animation: SmoothScrollAnimation::new(
                old_scroll_offset,
                destination,
                self.async_scroll_tree.device_pixels_per_css_pixel(),
                ScrollAnimationKind::SmoothScroll,
            ),
            started_at: now,
            is_user_scroll: true,
            heads_to_end_of_scroll_range: false,
        });
        self.report_started_user_scroll(
            operation_id,
            node.stable_node_id,
            old_scroll_offset,
            destination,
            ScrollAnimationKind::SmoothScroll,
            is_absolute_scroll,
        );
        self.scrollbar_press_scroll_operation = Some(operation_id);
        Some(PendingFrame::repainting_changes(self.async_scrolling_viewport_rect))
    }

    // https://source.chromium.org/chromium/chromium/src/+/main:cc/input/scroll_utils.cc
    // INTEROP: A page is most of the scrollport, keeping as much of the last page in view as Chromium does.
    fn scrollbar_page_step(scrollport_length: f32, device_pixels_per_css_pixel: f32) -> f32 {
        const MIN_FRACTION_TO_STEP_WHEN_PAGING: f32 = 0.875;
        const MAX_OVERLAP_BETWEEN_PAGES: f32 = 40.0;
        max(
            1.0,
            max(
                scrollport_length * MIN_FRACTION_TO_STEP_WHEN_PAGING,
                scrollport_length - MAX_OVERLAP_BETWEEN_PAGES * device_pixels_per_css_pixel,
            ),
        )
    }

    /// Pages the scroller of the captured scrollbar once toward the pointer, from where a page scroll in flight goes,
    /// unless the thumb has reached the pointer there.
    pub(super) fn page_captured_scrollbar(&mut self, now: MonotonicTime) -> Option<PendingFrame> {
        let scrollbar_index = self.scrollbar_controller.captured_scrollbar_index();
        if scrollbar_index.is_none() || self.scrollbar_paging.is_none_or(|paging| paging.direction == 0) {
            return None;
        }
        let scrollbar_index = scrollbar_index.unwrap();
        let scrollbar = *self.scrollbar_controller.scrollbars().get(scrollbar_index)?;
        let node = self
            .async_scroll_tree
            .scroll_node_for_index(scrollbar.scroll_node_index)
            .copied();
        let old_scroll_offset = self
            .async_scroll_tree
            .scroll_offset_for_node(scrollbar.scroll_node_index, &self.scroll_state_snapshot);
        let (Some(node), Some(old_scroll_offset)) = (node, old_scroll_offset) else {
            return None;
        };
        let running_animation = self.index_of_running_scrollbar_press_scroll();
        let step_start = running_animation.map_or(old_scroll_offset, |index| {
            self.smooth_scroll_animations[index].animation.destination_offset()
        });
        let paging = self.scrollbar_paging.unwrap();
        if self
            .scrollbar_controller
            .paging_direction(scrollbar_index, paging.primary_position, step_start)
            != paging.direction
        {
            return None;
        }
        let orientation = if scrollbar.vertical {
            Orientation::Vertical
        } else {
            Orientation::Horizontal
        };
        let step = Self::scrollbar_page_step(
            node.scrollport_rect.primary_size_for_orientation(orientation) as f32,
            self.async_scroll_tree.device_pixels_per_css_pixel() as f32,
        );
        let mut destination = step_start;
        destination.set_primary_offset_for_orientation(
            orientation,
            step_start.primary_offset_for_orientation(orientation) + paging.direction as f32 * step,
        );
        destination = self
            .async_scroll_tree
            .clamped_scroll_offset_for_node(scrollbar.scroll_node_index, destination);
        if destination == step_start {
            return None;
        }
        if let Some(index) = running_animation {
            self.retarget_user_scroll(index, destination, now);
            let operation_id = self.smooth_scroll_animations[index].operation_id;
            self.report_started_user_scroll(
                operation_id,
                node.stable_node_id,
                step_start,
                destination,
                ScrollAnimationKind::SmoothScroll,
                false,
            );
            return Some(PendingFrame::repainting_changes(self.async_scrolling_viewport_rect));
        }
        self.cancel_smooth_scroll_taken_over_by_user_input(scrollbar.scroll_node_index);
        self.start_scrollbar_press_scroll(&node, old_scroll_offset, destination, false, now)
    }

    fn index_of_running_scrollbar_press_scroll(&mut self) -> Option<usize> {
        let operation_id = self.scrollbar_press_scroll_operation?;
        let animation = self
            .smooth_scroll_animations
            .iter()
            .position(|animation| animation.operation_id == operation_id);
        if animation.is_none() {
            self.scrollbar_press_scroll_operation = None;
            return None;
        }
        animation
    }

    pub(super) fn stop_scrollbar_paging(&mut self) {
        self.scrollbar_paging = None;
        self.host.cancel_timer(self.context_id, ContextTimer::ScrollbarPaging);
        self.scrollbar_paging_timer_is_armed = false;
    }

    pub(super) fn apply_scrollbar_drag(&mut self, drag: &Drag, now: MonotonicTime) -> Option<PendingFrame> {
        let dragged_to = self.scrollbar_controller.scroll_offset_for_drag(
            &self.async_scroll_tree,
            &self.scroll_state_snapshot,
            drag,
        )?;
        // A scrollbar scrolls its own scroller to where the thumb was dragged, and never hands any of that to an ancestor.
        let scroll_node_index = dragged_to.scroll_node_index;
        let node = self.async_scroll_tree.scroll_node_for_index(scroll_node_index).copied();
        let old_scroll_offset = self
            .async_scroll_tree
            .scroll_offset_for_node(scroll_node_index, &self.scroll_state_snapshot);
        let (Some(node), Some(old_scroll_offset)) = (node, old_scroll_offset) else {
            return None;
        };
        let destination = self
            .async_scroll_tree
            .clamped_scroll_offset_for_node(scroll_node_index, dragged_to.scroll_offset);
        // A press beside the thumb scrolls there smoothly, as a page step does. Dragging on before that scroll has ended
        // moves where it goes.
        if let Some(index) = self.index_of_running_scrollbar_press_scroll() {
            if self.smooth_scroll_animations[index].animation.destination_offset() == destination {
                return None;
            }
            self.retarget_user_scroll(index, destination, now);
            let operation_id = self.smooth_scroll_animations[index].operation_id;
            self.report_started_user_scroll(
                operation_id,
                node.stable_node_id,
                old_scroll_offset,
                destination,
                ScrollAnimationKind::SmoothScroll,
                true,
            );
            return Some(PendingFrame::repainting_changes(self.async_scrolling_viewport_rect));
        }
        if destination == old_scroll_offset {
            return None;
        }
        self.cancel_smooth_scroll_taken_over_by_user_input(scroll_node_index);
        if drag.is_press_beside_thumb {
            return self.start_scrollbar_press_scroll(&node, old_scroll_offset, destination, true, now);
        }
        let new_scroll_offset = self.async_scroll_tree.set_scroll_offset(
            scroll_node_index,
            dragged_to.scroll_offset,
            self.scene.current_visual_context_tree(),
            &mut self.scroll_state_snapshot,
        );
        self.note_user_input_scrolled(node.stable_node_id);
        assert!(new_scroll_offset.is_some());
        self.rebuild_wheel_hit_test_targets();
        let mut scroll_offsets = Vec::new();
        let new_scroll_offset = new_scroll_offset.unwrap();
        scroll_offsets.push(AsyncScrollOffset {
            stable_node_id: node.stable_node_id,
            compositor_scroll_offset: new_scroll_offset,
            unadopted_scroll_delta: new_scroll_offset - old_scroll_offset,
            last_relative_scroll_delta: Default::default(),
            visual_viewport_scale: None,
            applied_scroll_request_id: 0,
            user_input_scroll_count: 0,
            context_user_input_scroll_count: 0,
        });
        self.store_pending_async_scroll_offsets(&scroll_offsets, None);
        if !node.is_viewport {
            return Some(PendingFrame::repainting_changes(self.async_scrolling_viewport_rect));
        }
        self.async_scrolling_viewport_rect.x = new_scroll_offset.x as i32;
        self.async_scrolling_viewport_rect.y = new_scroll_offset.y as i32;
        Some(PendingFrame::repainting_everything(self.async_scrolling_viewport_rect))
    }

    pub(super) fn rebuild_wheel_hit_test_targets(&mut self) {
        assert!(self.scene.display_list().is_some());
        let display_list = self.scene.display_list().as_ref().unwrap().clone();
        self.async_scroll_tree.rebuild_wheel_hit_test_targets(
            Some(&display_list),
            Some(self.scene.visual_context_tree_for_compositing()),
            &self.scroll_state_snapshot,
        );
    }

    pub fn visual_animations_need_frame(&mut self, now: MonotonicTime) -> bool {
        self.scene
            .visual_animations_need_frame(&self.scroll_state_snapshot, self.viewport_size, now)
    }

    pub fn advance_visual_animations(&mut self, now: MonotonicTime) -> bool {
        let animations_are_active = self.scene.advance_visual_animations(now);
        // The main thread hovers what is under the pointer at rest again as a transform animation moves content under it,
        // with the animation sampled at the frame's time, and once more as the content moves away. So does the clock lane
        // of the frame, at its next tick, while the main thread runs a task.
        let animated_content_is_under_pointer = animations_are_active
            && self.pointer_position.is_some_and(|position| {
                self.scene
                    .visual_context_tree_for_compositing()
                    .running_transform_animation_covers_point(now.nanoseconds(), position, &self.scroll_state_snapshot)
            });
        if animated_content_is_under_pointer || self.animated_content_was_under_pointer {
            self.host.post_to_web_content(
                self.web_content_client_id,
                compositor_web_content_client::messages::AnimatedContentMovedUnderPointer {
                    context_id: self.context_id,
                    frame_time_nanoseconds: now.nanoseconds(),
                },
            );
            self.host.post_to_render_clock_of_web_content(
                self.web_content_client_id,
                render_clock_client::messages::PointerRestsOnMovingContent {
                    context_id: self.context_id,
                },
            );
        }
        self.animated_content_was_under_pointer = animated_content_is_under_pointer;
        animations_are_active
    }
}
