//! Keyboard and pointer input for a compositor context.

use super::*;

impl ContextState {
    fn key_scroll_for(&self, event: &KeyEvent) -> Option<KeyScroll> {
        if !self.presents_to_client()
            || self.overlays.ui_overlays().paused_debugger.is_some()
            || self.visibility != ContextVisibility::Visible
            || !is_keyboard_scroll_key(event.key, event.modifiers.0)
            || !self.keyboard_scroll_controller.has_target()
            || self.scene.visual_context_tree().is_none()
            || !self
                .keyboard_scroll_controller
                .state_matches_visual_context_tree_epoch(self.scene.current_visual_context_tree().structural_epoch())
        {
            return None;
        }
        let key_step = self
            .keyboard_scroll_controller
            .step_for_key(event, &self.async_scroll_tree)?;
        let mut target_scroll_node_index = self.async_scroll_tree.scroll_node_for_keyboard_scroll(
            key_step.keyboard_scroll_target,
            key_step.delta,
            &self.scroll_state_snapshot_at_keyboard_step_starts(),
        );
        // If every destination is at its boundary, consume repeats while a scrolling box can still move toward it.
        // Falling back would cancel the running animation and lose the steps already accumulated in its destination.
        if target_scroll_node_index.is_none() {
            target_scroll_node_index = self.async_scroll_tree.scroll_node_for_keyboard_scroll(
                key_step.keyboard_scroll_target,
                key_step.delta,
                &self.scroll_state_snapshot,
            );
        }
        Some(KeyScroll {
            step: key_step,
            target_scroll_node_index,
        })
    }

    pub fn box_scrolled_for_key_event(&self, event: &KeyEvent) -> Option<AsyncScrollNodeStableID> {
        if event.r#type != KeyEventType::KeyDown {
            return None;
        }
        let key_scroll = self.key_scroll_for(event)?;
        Some(
            self.async_scroll_tree
                .scroll_node_for_index(key_scroll.target_scroll_node_index?)?
                .stable_node_id,
        )
    }

    pub fn handle_key_event(&mut self, event: &KeyEvent, now: MonotonicTime) -> ContextUpdateResult {
        if !is_keyboard_scroll_key(event.key, KeyModifier::Mod_None.0) {
            return Default::default();
        }
        // Release the key even if focus, modifiers, or routing eligibility changed while it was held. Other scroll
        // keys may still be held, so only end the gesture when the last one is released.
        if event.r#type == KeyEventType::KeyUp {
            let release = self.keyboard_scroll_controller.release_key(event);
            if release == KeyRelease::Ignored {
                return Default::default();
            }
            if release == KeyRelease::ReleasedLastHeldKey {
                self.end_user_scroll_gesture_of_held_keys();
            }
            return ContextUpdateResult {
                accepted: true,
                should_request_rendering_update: true,
                ..Default::default()
            };
        }
        let Some(key_scroll) = self.key_scroll_for(event) else {
            return Default::default();
        };
        let key_step = &key_scroll.step;
        let mut delta = key_step.delta;
        // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view/#viewport-perform-a-scroll
        // The visual viewport takes as much of the scroll as it can before the layout viewport takes the rest.
        let mut panned_visual_viewport = false;
        if key_scroll
            .target_scroll_node_index
            .is_none_or(|index| self.async_scroll_tree.scroll_node_is_viewport(index))
        {
            let magnification = self.scene.visual_viewport_magnification();
            let delta_in_screen_pixels = delta.scaled(magnification);
            let panned_delta = self.pan_visual_viewport_by(delta_in_screen_pixels);
            panned_visual_viewport = !panned_delta.is_zero();
            delta = (delta_in_screen_pixels - panned_delta).scaled(1.0 / magnification);
        }
        let result_of_pan = |viewport_rect| ContextUpdateResult {
            accepted: true,
            frame_to_present: Some(PendingFrame::repainting_changes(viewport_rect)),
            should_request_rendering_update: true,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        // NB: With nothing to scroll here, the main thread must not hold back the keys after this one. It still gets to
        //     scroll for this one, as content it added may have extended the scroll range since the compositor last heard.
        let Some(target_scroll_node_index) = key_scroll.target_scroll_node_index else {
            if panned_visual_viewport {
                return result_of_pan(self.async_scrolling_viewport_rect);
            }
            return ContextUpdateResult {
                accepted: true,
                key_found_nothing_to_scroll: true,
                ..Default::default()
            };
        };
        if delta.is_zero() {
            return result_of_pan(self.async_scrolling_viewport_rect);
        }
        let scrolls_to_extent = key_step.scrolls_to_extent;
        self.keyboard_scroll_controller.hold_key(event.key);
        let Some(node) = self.async_scroll_tree.scroll_node_for_index(target_scroll_node_index) else {
            return Default::default();
        };
        let stable_node_id = node.stable_node_id;
        if !self.boxes_scrolled_by_held_keys.contains(&stable_node_id) {
            self.boxes_scrolled_by_held_keys.push(stable_node_id);
        }
        let mut scroll_in_flight_destination = None;
        for running_animation in &self.smooth_scroll_animations {
            if running_animation.stable_node_id == stable_node_id
                && running_animation.is_user_scroll
                && running_animation.animation.kind() == ScrollAnimationKind::SmoothScroll
            {
                scroll_in_flight_destination = Some(running_animation.animation.destination_offset());
            }
        }
        let css_scroll_in_flight_destination =
            scroll_in_flight_destination.map(|offset| self.async_scroll_tree.css_pixels_from_device_offset(offset));
        if let Some(decision) = self.scroll_snap_controller.decide_key_step(
            &self.async_scroll_tree,
            &self.scroll_state_snapshot,
            target_scroll_node_index,
            self.async_scroll_tree.css_pixels_from_device_offset(delta),
            key_step.snap_selection_intent,
            css_scroll_in_flight_destination,
            now,
        ) {
            self.schedule_end_of_scroll_step_gestures(now);
            match decision {
                StepDecision::SnapScrollStart(mut snap_scroll) => {
                    snap_scroll.is_absolute_scroll = scrolls_to_extent;
                    self.start_snap_scroll(target_scroll_node_index, snap_scroll, false, now);
                    return result_of_pan(self.async_scrolling_viewport_rect);
                }
                StepDecision::StepConsumed(consumed) => {
                    if let Some(mut updated_scroll) = consumed.updated_scroll {
                        updated_scroll.is_absolute_scroll = scrolls_to_extent;
                        self.note_user_input_scrolled(updated_scroll.stable_node_id);
                        self.async_scroll_update_outbox
                            .record_started_user_scroll(updated_scroll);
                    }
                }
            }
            return ContextUpdateResult {
                accepted: true,
                should_request_rendering_update: true,
                ..Default::default()
            };
        }
        let current_offset = self
            .async_scroll_tree
            .scroll_offset_for_node(target_scroll_node_index, &self.scroll_state_snapshot);
        assert!(current_offset.is_some());
        // A plain step continues toward the animation's destination, including any snap on the other axis.
        let step_start = scroll_in_flight_destination.unwrap_or(current_offset.unwrap());
        let destination = self.async_scroll_tree.clamped_scroll_offset_for_node(
            target_scroll_node_index,
            FloatPoint {
                x: step_start.x + delta.x,
                y: step_start.y + delta.y,
            },
        );
        if destination == step_start {
            if panned_visual_viewport {
                return result_of_pan(self.async_scrolling_viewport_rect);
            }
            return ContextUpdateResult {
                accepted: true,
                should_request_rendering_update: true,
                ..Default::default()
            };
        }
        for index in 0..self.smooth_scroll_animations.len() {
            let animation = &self.smooth_scroll_animations[index];
            if animation.stable_node_id != stable_node_id
                || !animation.is_user_scroll
                || animation.animation.kind() != ScrollAnimationKind::SmoothScroll
            {
                continue;
            }
            self.retarget_user_scroll(index, destination, now);
            self.smooth_scroll_animations[index].heads_to_end_of_scroll_range = scrolls_to_extent;
            let operation_id = self.smooth_scroll_animations[index].operation_id;
            self.report_started_user_scroll(
                operation_id,
                stable_node_id,
                step_start,
                destination,
                ScrollAnimationKind::SmoothScroll,
                scrolls_to_extent,
            );
            return result_of_pan(self.async_scrolling_viewport_rect);
        }
        self.cancel_smooth_scroll_taken_over_by_user_input(target_scroll_node_index);
        let operation_id = self.async_scroll_update_outbox.allocate_operation_id();
        self.smooth_scroll_animations.push(ActiveSmoothScrollAnimation {
            stable_node_id,
            operation_id,
            animation: SmoothScrollAnimation::new(
                current_offset.unwrap(),
                destination,
                self.async_scroll_tree.device_pixels_per_css_pixel(),
                ScrollAnimationKind::SmoothScroll,
            ),
            started_at: now,
            is_user_scroll: true,
            heads_to_end_of_scroll_range: scrolls_to_extent,
        });
        self.report_started_user_scroll(
            operation_id,
            stable_node_id,
            step_start,
            destination,
            ScrollAnimationKind::SmoothScroll,
            scrolls_to_extent,
        );
        result_of_pan(self.async_scrolling_viewport_rect)
    }

    fn scroll_state_snapshot_at_keyboard_step_starts(&self) -> ScrollStateSnapshot {
        let mut snapshot = self.scroll_state_snapshot.clone();
        for running_animation in &self.smooth_scroll_animations {
            // A key continues a keyboard animation, but takes over other animations from the presented offset.
            if !running_animation.is_user_scroll
                || running_animation.animation.kind() != ScrollAnimationKind::SmoothScroll
            {
                continue;
            }
            let Some(scroll_node_index) = self
                .async_scroll_tree
                .scroll_node_index_for_stable_id(running_animation.stable_node_id)
            else {
                continue;
            };
            let mut destination = running_animation.animation.destination_offset();
            // A snap destination at the boundary can still consume steps until their accumulated input reaches it.
            if let Some(unsnapped_destination) = self
                .scroll_snap_controller
                .unsnapped_destination_for_snap_scroll(running_animation.stable_node_id, running_animation.operation_id)
            {
                destination = self
                    .async_scroll_tree
                    .device_offset_from_css_pixels(unsnapped_destination);
            }
            snapshot.set_device_offset_for_index(
                scroll_node_index,
                FloatPoint {
                    x: -destination.x,
                    y: -destination.y,
                },
            );
        }
        snapshot
    }

    pub fn handle_mouse_event(&mut self, event: &MouseEvent, now: MonotonicTime) -> ContextUpdateResult {
        if !self.presents_to_client() {
            return ContextUpdateResult::declined(InputRoutingDecision::ContextNotPresenting);
        }
        let position = FloatPoint {
            x: event.position.x as f32,
            y: event.position.y as f32,
        };
        self.handle_mouse_event_at(event, position, now)
    }

    /// A mouse event that the context this one is nested in hands to it, at a position in this context's device pixels.
    pub fn handle_mouse_event_from_containing_context(
        &mut self,
        event: &MouseEvent,
        position: FloatPoint,
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) -> ContextUpdateResult {
        if event.r#type == MouseEventType::MouseMove {
            self.note_pointer_position(Some(position));
        } else if matches!(event.r#type, MouseEventType::MouseLeave | MouseEventType::MouseCancel) {
            self.note_pointer_position(None);
        }
        self.handle_mouse_event_at(event, position, now)
    }

    /// Where the pointer is in this context's device pixels, as the mouse event the context takes or hands on says, or
    /// nowhere, as the pointer leaves it.
    pub fn note_pointer_position(&mut self, position: Option<FloatPoint>) {
        self.pointer_position = position;
    }

    // A frame that shows how the scrollbars grow, which it finds in the content hashes of their records.
    fn frame_repainting_scrollbars(&self) -> Option<PendingFrame> {
        if self.async_scrolling_viewport_rect.is_empty() {
            return None;
        }
        Some(PendingFrame {
            viewport_rect: self.async_scrolling_viewport_rect,
            forced_damage_rect: Default::default(),
        })
    }

    /// The pointer left the scrollbar it was over here for a context nested in this one, or for the one around it.
    pub fn clear_scrollbar_hover(&mut self) -> Option<PendingFrame> {
        if !self.scrollbar_controller.set_hovered_scrollbar(None) {
            return None;
        }
        self.frame_repainting_scrollbars()
    }

    fn scrollbar_under_pointer(&mut self, position: FloatPoint) -> Option<usize> {
        self.scrollbar_controller.hit_test_scrollbar(
            &self.async_scroll_tree,
            self.scene.visual_context_tree_for_compositing(),
            &self.scroll_state_snapshot,
            position,
        )
    }

    // A nested context only takes the pointer where no scrollbar comes after the nested context's content in paint order.
    // The scrollbars of the viewport come after all else. A scrollbar that has faded out takes no pointer.
    fn nested_context_taking_mouse_event_at(&mut self, position: FloatPoint) -> Option<NestedContextHit> {
        if !self.has_async_scrolling_state {
            return None;
        }
        let tree = self.scene.visual_context_tree_for_compositing();
        let hit = self.async_scroll_tree.nested_context_at(tree, position)?;
        if let Some(index) = self.scrollbar_controller.hit_test_scrollbar(
            &self.async_scroll_tree,
            tree,
            &self.scroll_state_snapshot,
            position,
        ) && self
            .scrollbar_controller
            .scrollbars()
            .get(index)
            .is_some_and(|scrollbar| scrollbar.paint_order_index > hit.paint_order_index)
        {
            return None;
        }
        Some(hit)
    }

    pub fn position_in_content_of_nested_context(
        &mut self,
        nested_context_id: CompositorContextId,
        position: FloatPoint,
    ) -> Option<NestedContextHit> {
        if !self.has_async_scrolling_state {
            return None;
        }
        self.async_scroll_tree.position_in_content_of_nested_context(
            nested_context_id,
            self.scene.visual_context_tree_for_compositing(),
            position,
        )
    }

    #[allow(clippy::field_reassign_with_default)]
    fn handle_mouse_event_at(
        &mut self,
        event: &MouseEvent,
        position: FloatPoint,
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) -> ContextUpdateResult {
        if self.scrollbar_controller.is_empty() && !self.async_scroll_tree.has_nested_contexts() {
            return ContextUpdateResult::declined(InputRoutingDecision::NotOverAScrollbar);
        }
        let scroller_of_scrollbar = |controller: &ScrollbarController, index: usize| {
            controller
                .scrollbars()
                .get(index)
                .and_then(|scrollbar| scrollbar.scroller_stable_node_id)
        };
        // The pointer goes on into a nested context, and leaves the scrollbar here it was over.
        let hand_to_nested_context = |state: &mut Self, hit| ContextUpdateResult {
            frame_to_present: state.clear_scrollbar_hover(),
            nested_context_mouse_hit: Some(hit),
            ..Default::default()
        };
        match event.r#type {
            MouseEventType::MouseDown => {
                if event.button != MouseButton::Primary {
                    return ContextUpdateResult::declined(InputRoutingDecision::NotPrimaryButton);
                }
                if let Some(hit) = self.nested_context_taking_mouse_event_at(position) {
                    return hand_to_nested_context(self, hit);
                }
                let Some(drag) = self.scrollbar_controller.begin_drag(
                    &self.async_scroll_tree,
                    self.scene.visual_context_tree_for_compositing(),
                    &self.scroll_state_snapshot,
                    position,
                ) else {
                    return ContextUpdateResult::declined(InputRoutingDecision::NotOverAScrollbar);
                };
                self.scrollbar_press_scroll_operation = None;
                self.stop_scrollbar_paging();
                let mut result = ContextUpdateResult {
                    accepted: true,
                    ..Default::default()
                };
                result.routing_decision = Some(InputRoutingDecision::BeganScrollbarDrag);
                result.routed_scroller = scroller_of_scrollbar(&self.scrollbar_controller, drag.scrollbar_index);
                result.scrollbar_dragged_by_compositor = self
                    .scrollbar_controller
                    .captured_scrollbar_the_page_takes(self.context_id);
                result.frame_to_present = self.frame_repainting_scrollbars();
                // A press beside the thumb pages toward the pointer or jumps there, as the platform says, and a modifier swaps
                // the two.
                let press_jumps = self.scrollbar_track_press_jumps
                    != !(event.modifiers & SCROLLBAR_TRACK_PRESS_INVERTING_MODIFIER).is_empty();
                if drag.is_press_beside_thumb && !press_jumps {
                    let Some(scrollbar) = self.scrollbar_controller.scrollbars().get(drag.scrollbar_index) else {
                        return result;
                    };
                    let scroll_offset = self
                        .async_scroll_tree
                        .scroll_offset_for_node(scrollbar.scroll_node_index, &self.scroll_state_snapshot);
                    assert!(scroll_offset.is_some());
                    self.scrollbar_paging = Some(ScrollbarPaging {
                        direction: self.scrollbar_controller.paging_direction(
                            drag.scrollbar_index,
                            drag.primary_position,
                            scroll_offset.unwrap(),
                        ),
                        primary_position: drag.primary_position,
                    });
                    if let Some(frame) = self.page_captured_scrollbar(now) {
                        result.frame_to_present = Some(frame);
                        result.should_request_rendering_update = true;
                    }
                    self.host.set_timer(
                        self.context_id,
                        ContextTimer::ScrollbarPaging,
                        SCROLLBAR_PAGING_INITIAL_DELAY,
                    );
                    self.scrollbar_paging_timer_is_armed = true;
                    return result;
                }
                if let Some(frame) = self.apply_scrollbar_drag(&drag, now) {
                    result.frame_to_present = Some(frame);
                    result.should_request_rendering_update = true;
                }
                result
            }
            MouseEventType::MouseMove => {
                if self.scrollbar_controller.has_captured_scrollbar() {
                    let scrollbar_dragged_by_compositor = self
                        .scrollbar_controller
                        .captured_scrollbar_the_page_takes(self.context_id);
                    let drag = self.scrollbar_controller.captured_drag(
                        self.scene.visual_context_tree_for_compositing(),
                        &self.scroll_state_snapshot,
                        position,
                    );
                    assert!(drag.is_some());
                    let drag = drag.unwrap();
                    // While paging, the pointer only says where the thumb pages to.
                    let mut frame_to_present = None;
                    if let Some(paging) = &mut self.scrollbar_paging {
                        paging.primary_position = drag.primary_position;
                        if !self.scrollbar_paging_timer_is_armed {
                            self.host.set_timer(
                                self.context_id,
                                ContextTimer::ScrollbarPaging,
                                SCROLLBAR_PAGING_REPEAT_INTERVAL,
                            );
                            self.scrollbar_paging_timer_is_armed = true;
                        }
                    } else {
                        frame_to_present = self.apply_scrollbar_drag(&drag, now);
                    }
                    return ContextUpdateResult {
                        accepted: true,
                        frame_to_present,
                        should_request_rendering_update: frame_to_present.is_some(),
                        scrollbar_dragged_by_compositor,
                        routing_decision: Some(InputRoutingDecision::ContinuedScrollbarDrag),
                        routed_scroller: scroller_of_scrollbar(&self.scrollbar_controller, drag.scrollbar_index),
                        ..Default::default()
                    };
                }
                if let Some(hit) = self.nested_context_taking_mouse_event_at(position) {
                    return hand_to_nested_context(self, hit);
                }
                let hovered_scrollbar_index = self.scrollbar_under_pointer(position);
                let mut frame_to_present = None;
                if self.scrollbar_controller.set_hovered_scrollbar(hovered_scrollbar_index) {
                    frame_to_present = self.frame_repainting_scrollbars();
                }
                let Some(index) = hovered_scrollbar_index else {
                    return ContextUpdateResult {
                        frame_to_present,
                        routing_decision: Some(InputRoutingDecision::NotOverAScrollbar),
                        ..Default::default()
                    };
                };
                // The page sees the pointer move over a scrollbar of an element, as it is part of the element, but not over a
                // scrollbar of the viewport.
                let Some(scrollbar) = self.scrollbar_controller.scrollbars().get(index) else {
                    return ContextUpdateResult::default();
                };
                let scrolls_viewport = scrollbar.scrolls_viewport;
                ContextUpdateResult {
                    accepted: scrolls_viewport,
                    frame_to_present,
                    should_request_rendering_update: false,
                    routing_decision: Some(if scrolls_viewport {
                        InputRoutingDecision::HoveringViewportScrollbar
                    } else {
                        InputRoutingDecision::HoveringElementScrollbar
                    }),
                    routed_scroller: scroller_of_scrollbar(&self.scrollbar_controller, index),
                    ..Default::default()
                }
            }
            MouseEventType::MouseUp => {
                if event.button != MouseButton::Primary {
                    return ContextUpdateResult::declined(InputRoutingDecision::NotPrimaryButton);
                }
                let box_of_dragged_scrollbar = self.box_of_captured_scrollbar();
                let scrollbar_dragged_by_compositor = self
                    .scrollbar_controller
                    .captured_scrollbar_the_page_takes(self.context_id);
                let drag = self.scrollbar_controller.release_captured_drag(
                    self.scene.visual_context_tree_for_compositing(),
                    &self.scroll_state_snapshot,
                    position,
                );
                let was_paging = self.scrollbar_paging.is_some();
                self.stop_scrollbar_paging();
                let Some(drag) = drag else {
                    return ContextUpdateResult::declined(InputRoutingDecision::NoScrollbarDrag);
                };
                self.note_user_scroll_gesture_end_if_drag_ended(box_of_dragged_scrollbar);
                let mut result = ContextUpdateResult {
                    accepted: true,
                    ..Default::default()
                };
                result.routing_decision = Some(InputRoutingDecision::EndedScrollbarDrag);
                result.routed_scroller = scroller_of_scrollbar(&self.scrollbar_controller, drag.scrollbar_index);
                result.scrollbar_dragged_by_compositor = scrollbar_dragged_by_compositor;
                // The main thread learns of the release from the next update it takes, so one is asked for even when the
                // release scrolls nothing.
                result.should_request_rendering_update = true;
                result.frame_to_present = self.frame_repainting_scrollbars();
                if !was_paging && let Some(frame) = self.apply_scrollbar_drag(&drag, now) {
                    result.frame_to_present = Some(frame);
                }
                let hovered = self.scrollbar_under_pointer(position);
                if self.scrollbar_controller.set_hovered_scrollbar(hovered)
                    && let Some(frame) = self.frame_repainting_scrollbars()
                {
                    result.frame_to_present = Some(frame);
                }
                result
            }
            MouseEventType::MouseLeave => {
                let had_capture = self.scrollbar_controller.has_captured_scrollbar();
                let mut frame_to_present = None;
                if self.scrollbar_controller.set_hovered_scrollbar(None) {
                    frame_to_present = self.frame_repainting_scrollbars();
                }
                ContextUpdateResult {
                    accepted: had_capture,
                    frame_to_present,
                    should_request_rendering_update: false,
                    scrollbar_dragged_by_compositor: self
                        .scrollbar_controller
                        .captured_scrollbar_the_page_takes(self.context_id),
                    routing_decision: Some(if had_capture {
                        InputRoutingDecision::LeftDuringScrollbarDrag
                    } else {
                        InputRoutingDecision::NoScrollbarDrag
                    }),
                    ..Default::default()
                }
            }
            MouseEventType::MouseCancel => {
                // A cancel ends a drag where it last scrolled to, as a cancel has no position of its own, and the pointer then
                // counts as having left. The page still sees the cancel, so it is not accepted.
                let was_dragging_scrollbar = self.scrollbar_controller.has_captured_scrollbar();
                let box_of_dragged_scrollbar = self.box_of_captured_scrollbar();
                self.scrollbar_controller.release_captured_drag(
                    self.scene.visual_context_tree_for_compositing(),
                    &self.scroll_state_snapshot,
                    position,
                );
                self.stop_scrollbar_paging();
                self.note_user_scroll_gesture_end_if_drag_ended(box_of_dragged_scrollbar);
                let hovered_scrollbar_changed = self.scrollbar_controller.set_hovered_scrollbar(None);
                let mut result = ContextUpdateResult::default();
                // As for a release, the main thread learns that the drag ended from the next update it takes.
                result.should_request_rendering_update = was_dragging_scrollbar;
                if was_dragging_scrollbar || hovered_scrollbar_changed {
                    result.frame_to_present = self.frame_repainting_scrollbars();
                }
                result
            }
            MouseEventType::MouseWheel => ContextUpdateResult::default(),
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct AsyncScrollEnqueueResult {
    pub accepted: bool,
    pub operation_id: Option<AsyncScrollOperationID>,
    /// Why the compositor took or turned away a wheel step, and the scroller it routed the step to.
    pub routing_decision: Option<InputRoutingDecision>,
    pub routed_scroller: Option<AsyncScrollNodeStableID>,
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct AsyncScrollResult {
    pub enqueue_result: AsyncScrollEnqueueResult,
    pub frame_to_present: Option<PendingFrame>,
}

impl AsyncScrollResult {
    pub fn declined(decision: InputRoutingDecision) -> Self {
        Self {
            enqueue_result: AsyncScrollEnqueueResult {
                routing_decision: Some(decision),
                ..Default::default()
            },
            ..Default::default()
        }
    }
}

/// A wheel step that goes to a context nested in this one: the first step of a gesture over the content of the
/// nested context, or a step of a gesture latched to a context nested here.
pub struct NestedContextWheelStep {
    pub context_id: CompositorContextId,
    /// Where the first step lands in the content of the nested context.
    pub hit: Option<NestedContextHit>,
}

/// An operation that a wheel step asked to follow, whose end the scroll updates of the context report.
pub struct TrackedScrollOperation {
    pub context_id: CompositorContextId,
    pub operation_id: AsyncScrollOperationID,
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct ContextUpdateResult {
    pub accepted: bool,
    pub frame_to_present: Option<PendingFrame>,
    pub should_request_rendering_update: bool,
    /// Whether a key event found nothing to scroll by the compositor's scroll range, which may lag behind the page's.
    pub key_found_nothing_to_scroll: bool,
    pub scrollbar_dragged_by_compositor: Option<ScrollbarDraggedByCompositor>,
    /// Why a wheel or mouse event was taken or turned away, and the scroller it was routed to.
    pub routing_decision: Option<InputRoutingDecision>,
    pub routed_scroller: Option<AsyncScrollNodeStableID>,
    /// How the first step of a wheel gesture went by a nested context, ahead of `routing_decision`.
    pub nested_context_hand_off: Option<InputRoutingDecision>,
    /// Set instead of everything else for a wheel step that a nested context is to take.
    pub nested_context_wheel_step: Option<NestedContextWheelStep>,
    /// Set, with at most the frame of the scrollbar the pointer left here, for a mouse event that the nested context
    /// under the pointer is to take.
    pub nested_context_mouse_hit: Option<NestedContextHit>,
    pub tracked_scroll_operation: Option<TrackedScrollOperation>,
}

impl ContextUpdateResult {
    pub fn declined(decision: InputRoutingDecision) -> Self {
        Self {
            routing_decision: Some(decision),
            ..Default::default()
        }
    }
}

/// A step of a wheel gesture at a position in this context's device pixels. The delta is in CSS pixels, with the axes
/// already swapped for Shift.
pub struct WheelStep {
    pub position: FloatPoint,
    pub delta_in_css_pixels: FloatPoint,
    pub wheel_delta_precision: WheelDeltaPrecision,
    pub scroll_gesture_phase: ScrollGesturePhase,
    /// The gesture the step is in, which the latch a context takes for the step is for. A context nested in another
    /// one takes it for the gesture of the containing context.
    pub gesture_id: Option<u64>,
    pub operation_tracking: AsyncScrollOperationTracking,
}

/// What the wheel event listeners of the page that dispatches a gesture's wheel events let through without waiting
/// for the page. That page may be the page of a context nested in this one.
#[derive(Default)]
pub struct WheelEventListenerGate {
    /// The page dispatched a step of the gesture and did not cancel it, and the listeners are as they were then.
    pub page_let_the_gesture_through: bool,
    /// Why the listeners hold the steps of a latched gesture back for the page, if they do.
    pub reason_to_hold_latched_steps_back: Option<InputRoutingDecision>,
}

/// What may hold a step back for the page before this context scrolls by it.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum WheelStepAdmission {
    /// The wheel event listeners of this context's page see the step, which waits for the page if they may cancel it.
    ByThisPage,
    /// A context nested in this one passed the step on. Only the page of that context sees the step.
    PassedOnByNestedContext,
    /// The page let the gesture through. Nothing holds the step back, and a step that finds nothing to scroll is done
    /// with all the same, so that the page is not asked about the gesture again.
    LetThroughByThePage,
}

/// Where the first step of a gesture that the containing context hands in goes in this context. A nested context
/// passes a step on to the document around it unless one of its scrollers takes or keeps it.
pub struct FirstWheelStepRoute {
    pub kind: FirstWheelStepRouteKind,
    pub decision: InputRoutingDecision,
    pub scroll_node_index: Option<SpatialNodeIndex>,
    pub scroller: Option<AsyncScrollNodeStableID>,
    pub nested_context_hit: Option<NestedContextHit>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum FirstWheelStepRouteKind {
    Declined,
    ScrollNode,
    NestedContext,
    Kept,
    PassedOn,
}

/// What a presenting context keeps of the contexts nested in it that the pointer is in, with positions in the device

    /// ends.

    pub last_position_in_context_with_captured_scrollbar: FloatPoint,
    pub context_under_pointer: Option<CompositorContextId>,
}

/// What this context noted of a wheel event as the event arrived.

    pub wheel_gesture_mark: WheelGestureMark,
    /// Only the first step of a gesture that moves anything goes to a nested context.
    pub is_first_wheel_event_with_delta: bool,
}

    pub scrolls_elastically: bool,

        Self {
            synthesizes_scroll_momentum: false,
            scrolls_elastically: false,
            scrollbar_track_press_jumps: false,
            touchpad_gesture_end: TouchpadGestureEnd::AfterIdleDelay,
        }
    }
}

/// Collects the routing decisions of input events while a test asks for them.
#[derive(Default)]
pub struct InputTraceRecorder {
    records: Option<Vec<InputTraceRecord>>,
}

impl InputTraceRecorder {
    pub fn begin(&mut self) {
        self.records = Some(Vec::new());
    }
    pub fn is_recording(&self) -> bool {
        self.records.is_some()
    }
    pub fn record(&mut self, record: InputTraceRecord) {
        // A test that never takes its trace must not grow it without bound.
        let Some(records) = self.records.as_mut().filter(|records| records.len() < 10_000) else {
            return;
        };
        records.push(record);
    }
    /// Returns what was recorded since the trace began, and stops recording.
    pub fn take(&mut self) -> Vec<InputTraceRecord> {
        self.records.take().unwrap_or_default()
    }
}

pub struct ContextState {
    host: Rc<Host>,
    web_content_client_id: WebContentClientId,
    context_id: CompositorContextId,
    page_id: Option<u64>,
    bound_presentation: Option<PresentationId>,

    parent_context_id: Option<CompositorContextId>,

    scene: ContextScene,
    presents_to_client: bool,
    viewport_size: IntSize,
    device_pixel_ratio: f64,
    overlays: ContextOverlays,
    scroll_state_snapshot: ScrollStateSnapshot,
    display_list_coverage_watch: DisplayListCoverageWatch,

    async_scroll_tree: AsyncScrollTree,
    scrollbar_controller: ScrollbarController,
    scroll_snap_controller: ScrollSnapController,

    async_scroll_update_outbox: AsyncScrollUpdateOutbox,
    // The last of the main thread's scroll requests applied to each box, which the box's reported offsets are marked with.
    applied_scroll_request_ids: HashMap<AsyncScrollNodeStableID, u64>,
    // How many times this context scrolled each box for user input of its own, which the reports are marked with too.
    user_input_scroll_counts: HashMap<AsyncScrollNodeStableID, u64>,
    context_user_input_scroll_count: u64,
    // The boxes the last frame brought, whose offsets came from that frame's snapshot.
    scroll_nodes_seeded_by_last_frame: HashSet<AsyncScrollNodeStableID>,
    scroll_offsets_differ_from_last_frame: bool,
    // The document whose visual viewport this context zoomed or panned, which it presents as it left it from then on.
    visual_viewport_document_id: Option<UniqueNodeId>,
    pinch_gesture_was_let_through: bool,
    keyboard_scroll_controller: KeyboardScrollController,
    // The boxes that the keys held since none was have scrolled, whose gesture lasts until the last of them is released.
    boxes_scrolled_by_held_keys: Vec<AsyncScrollNodeStableID>,
    wheel_gesture_routing: WheelGestureRouting,
    smooth_scroll_animations: Vec<ActiveSmoothScrollAnimation>,
    // The smooth scroll that a press beside the thumb of the captured scrollbar started.
    scrollbar_press_scroll_operation: Option<AsyncScrollOperationID>,
    scrollbar_paging: Option<ScrollbarPaging>,
    scrollbar_track_press_jumps: bool,
    presentation_synthesizes_scroll_momentum: bool,
    scrollbar_paging_timer_is_armed: bool,
    pointer_in_nested_contexts: PointerInNestedContexts,
    pointer_position: Option<FloatPoint>,
    animated_content_was_under_pointer: bool,
    scroll_fling_controller: ScrollFlingController,
    last_reported_scroll_momentum_step: Option<MouseEvent>,
    reported_scroll_momentum_was_interrupted: bool,
    elastic_overscroll_controller: ElasticOverscrollController,
    async_scrolling_viewport_rect: IntRect,
    has_async_scrolling_state: bool,

    caret_blink_cycle_start_time_ns: Option<i64>,
    input_trace: InputTraceRecorder,
    visibility: ContextVisibility,
}

// INTEROP: Holding a press beside the thumb pages again after these delays, as in Chromium and Firefox.
const SCROLLBAR_PAGING_INITIAL_DELAY: Duration = Duration::from_milliseconds(250);
const SCROLLBAR_PAGING_REPEAT_INTERVAL: Duration = Duration::from_milliseconds(50);

// INTEROP: The modifier that makes a press beside the thumb page instead of jumping there or the other way around, as in
//          Chromium and Firefox.
#[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
const SCROLLBAR_TRACK_PRESS_INVERTING_MODIFIER: KeyModifier = KeyModifier::Mod_Alt;
#[cfg(not(target_os = "macos"))]
const SCROLLBAR_TRACK_PRESS_INVERTING_MODIFIER: KeyModifier = KeyModifier::Mod_Shift;

// The offset of the visual viewport in the layout viewport, in device pixels of the content it scales.
fn visual_viewport_scroll_offset(transform: &TransformWithOrigin) -> FloatPoint {
    let scale = transform.matrix.elements[0][0];
    FloatPoint {
        x: -transform.matrix.elements[0][3],
        y: -transform.matrix.elements[1][3],
    }
    .scaled(1.0 / scale)
}

fn clamp_visual_viewport_transform_to_viewport(transform: &mut TransformWithOrigin, viewport_rect: IntRect) {
    let scale = transform.matrix.elements[0][0];
    if scale <= 1.0 {
        transform.matrix.elements[0][3] = 0.0;
        transform.matrix.elements[1][3] = 0.0;
        return;
    }
    let min_x = -(viewport_rect.width as f32) * (scale - 1.0);
    let min_y = -(viewport_rect.height as f32) * (scale - 1.0);
    transform.matrix.elements[0][3] = clamp(transform.matrix.elements[0][3], min_x, 0.0);
    transform.matrix.elements[1][3] = clamp(transform.matrix.elements[1][3], min_y, 0.0);
}

    pub fn is_owned_by(&self, web_content_client_id: WebContentClientId) -> bool {

    }

    pub fn request_display_ticks_if_needed(&mut self, now: MonotonicTime) {
        if self.needs_animation_frames(now) {
            self.host.request_display_ticks(self.context_id);
        }
    }

    /// Answers whether the timer asks for a frame, as each blink of a caret does.
    pub fn timer_fired(&mut self, timer: ContextTimer, now: MonotonicTime) -> bool {
        match timer {
            ContextTimer::ScrollStepGestureInput => self.end_scroll_step_gestures_whose_input_ran_out(now),
            ContextTimer::ScrollbarPaging => {
                self.scrollbar_paging_timer_is_armed = false;
                if self.scrollbar_paging.is_none() || !self.scrollbar_controller.has_captured_scrollbar() {
                    self.stop_scrollbar_paging();
                    return false;
                }
                // Once the thumb reaches the pointer, paging waits for the pointer to move.
                if self.page_captured_scrollbar(now).is_none() {
                    return false;
                }
                self.request_rendering_update();
                self.request_display_ticks_if_needed(now);
                self.host.set_timer(
                    self.context_id,
                    ContextTimer::ScrollbarPaging,
                    SCROLLBAR_PAGING_REPEAT_INTERVAL,
                );
                self.scrollbar_paging_timer_is_armed = true;
            }
            ContextTimer::ScrollbarFadeOut => self.request_display_ticks_if_needed(now),
            ContextTimer::CaretBlink => {
                self.schedule_next_caret_blink(now);
                // The frame finds what the blink changes in the content hashes of what draws each caret.
                return true;
            }
            // The core handles the timers of presenting.
            ContextTimer::BackingStoreShrink
            | ContextTimer::SurplusStoreRetirement
            | ContextTimer::HiddenStoreRetirement
            | ContextTimer::SpareTileEviction
            | ContextTimer::TileRasterScratchSurfaceRelease => {}
        }
        false
    }

    pub fn request_rendering_update(&mut self) {
        // The rendering update this asks for adopts the scroll updates it finds pushed by then. What is pending here goes
        // ahead of the request on the wire, so that an update run on the request never misses it.
        if self.has_pending_async_scroll_updates() {
            let updates = self.take_pending_async_scroll_updates();
            self.host.post_to_web_content(
                self.web_content_client_id,
                compositor_web_content_client::messages::AsyncScrollUpdates {
                    context_id: self.context_id,
                    updates,
                },
            );
        }
        self.host.post_to_web_content(
            self.web_content_client_id,
            compositor_web_content_client::messages::RequestRenderingUpdate {},
        );
    }

    pub fn post_clock_tick(&self, frame_time: MonotonicTime, frame_interval_milliseconds: f64) {
        self.host.post_to_render_clock_of_web_content(
            self.web_content_client_id,
            render_clock_client::messages::ClockTick {
                context_id: self.context_id,
                frame_time_nanoseconds: frame_time.nanoseconds(),
                frame_interval_milliseconds,
                scroll_offsets: self.scroll_offsets(),
            },
        );
    }

    pub fn dispatch_mouse_event_to_web_content(
        &self,
        event: &MouseEvent,
        nested_context_scrolled_since_last_frame: bool,
    ) {
        assert!(self.page_id.is_some());
        self.host.post_to_web_content(
            self.web_content_client_id,
            compositor_web_content_client::messages::MouseEvent {
                page_id: self.page_id.unwrap(),
                event: event.clone(),
            },
        );
        // The render clock hears where the pointer went too, without waiting for WebContent's main thread, so that hover
        // can follow the pointer while that thread runs a task. The lanes hit test it in the frames on screen, which a
        // scroll since, here or in a nested context, has moved. A button going up ends the drag a lane follows, whether or
        // not a move comes after it.
        if matches!(event.r#type, MouseEventType::MouseMove | MouseEventType::MouseUp) {
            self.host.post_to_render_clock_of_web_content(
                self.web_content_client_id,
                render_clock_client::messages::PointerMoved {
                    context_id: self.context_id,
                    position: event.position,
                    buttons: event.buttons.0 as u32,
                    scrolled_since_frame: self.scrolled_since_last_frame() || nested_context_scrolled_since_last_frame,
                    input_event_id: event.id,
                },
            );
        } else if event.r#type == MouseEventType::MouseLeave {
            self.host.post_to_render_clock_of_web_content(
                self.web_content_client_id,
                render_clock_client::messages::PointerLeft {
                    context_id: self.context_id,
                    input_event_id: event.id,
                },
            );
        }
    }

    /// Whether the scroll offsets here moved past those of the last frame WebContent presented.
    pub fn scrolled_since_last_frame(&self) -> bool {
        self.has_pending_async_scroll_updates()
            || self.scroll_offsets_differ_from_last_frame
            || self.has_active_smooth_scroll_animations()
            || self.has_active_scroll_fling()
    }

    pub fn dispatch_key_event_to_web_content(&self, event: &KeyEvent) {
        assert!(self.page_id.is_some());
        self.host.post_to_web_content(
            self.web_content_client_id,
            compositor_web_content_client::messages::KeyEvent {
                page_id: self.page_id.unwrap(),
                event: event.clone(),
            },
        );
    }

    pub fn dispatch_pinch_event_to_web_content(&self, event: &PinchEvent) {
        assert!(self.page_id.is_some());
        self.host.post_to_web_content(
            self.web_content_client_id,
            compositor_web_content_client::messages::PinchEvent {
                page_id: self.page_id.unwrap(),
                event: event.clone(),
            },

    }

    pub fn stop_presenting_to_client(&mut self) {
        self.pointer_in_nested_contexts = Default::default();
        self.end_keyboard_scroll_gesture();
        self.elastic_overscroll_controller.forget();
        self.presents_to_client = false;
    }

    pub fn set_parent_context(&mut self, parent_context_id: Option<CompositorContextId>) {
        self.parent_context_id = parent_context_id;
    }

    /// Returns false, leaving everything as it was, for scrolling state with numbers no scroll can be calculated with.
    pub fn install_display_list_update(
        &mut self,
        display_list: Rc<DisplayList>,
        visual_context_tree: AccumulatedVisualContextTree,
        scroll_state_snapshot: ScrollStateSnapshot,
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) -> bool {
        assert_eq!(
            display_list.compatible_visual_context_tree_structural_epoch(),
            visual_context_tree.structural_epoch()
        );
        let async_scrolling_state = async_scrolling_state_from(&display_list, visual_context_tree.as_arc());
        if !scroll_state_snapshot.has_only_finite_offsets()
            || !async_scrolling_state.has_only_numbers_scrolls_can_be_calculated_with()
        {
            return false;
        }
        let scroll_offsets_of_known_nodes = self.scroll_offsets_by_stable_id();
        self.scene.install(display_list, visual_context_tree, now);
        self.keyboard_scroll_controller.forget_target();
        self.scroll_state_snapshot = scroll_state_snapshot;
        self.scroll_state_snapshot
            .set_node_count(self.scene.visual_context_tree().as_ref().unwrap().spatial_node_count());
        let display_list = self.scene.display_list().as_ref().unwrap().clone();
        self.restart_caret_blink_for(&display_list, now);
        // The visual viewport of another document is where that document's visual context tree has it.
        if self.scene.has_async_visual_viewport_transform()
            && async_scrolling_state.document_id != self.visual_viewport_document_id
        {
            self.scene.drop_async_visual_viewport_transform();
            self.visual_viewport_document_id = None;
        }
        // NB: What the page of one document let through of a pinch says nothing about the page of the next.
        if async_scrolling_state.document_id != self.async_scroll_tree.document_id() {
            self.pinch_gesture_was_let_through = false;
        }
        self.adopt_scrolling_state(async_scrolling_state, &scroll_offsets_of_known_nodes);
        if let Some(metadata) = self.scene.display_list().as_ref().unwrap().async_scrolling_metadata() {
            self.adopt_keyboard_scroll_state(metadata.keyboard_scroll_state.clone());
        }
        true
    }

    fn adopt_scrolling_state(
        &mut self,
        async_scrolling_state: AsyncScrollingState,
        scroll_offsets_of_known_nodes: &HashMap<AsyncScrollNodeStableID, FloatPoint>,
    ) {
        let mut async_scrolling_viewport_rect = async_scrolling_state.viewport_rect;
        self.wheel_gesture_routing
            .did_install_scrolling_state(&async_scrolling_state);
        let box_of_dragged_scrollbar = self.box_of_captured_scrollbar();
        self.scrollbar_controller
            .set_scrollbars(&async_scrolling_state.scrollbars);
        if !self.scrollbar_controller.has_captured_scrollbar() {
            self.stop_scrollbar_paging();
        }
        self.note_user_scroll_gesture_end_if_drag_ended(box_of_dragged_scrollbar);
        self.async_scroll_tree.set_state(async_scrolling_state);
        self.elastic_overscroll_controller
            .did_install_scrolling_state(&self.async_scroll_tree);
        self.scroll_snap_controller
            .did_install_scrolling_state(&self.async_scroll_tree);
        if let Some(offset) = self.keep_scroll_offsets_of_known_nodes(scroll_offsets_of_known_nodes) {
            async_scrolling_viewport_rect.x = offset.x as i32;
            async_scrolling_viewport_rect.y = offset.y as i32;
        }
        self.rebuild_wheel_hit_test_targets();
        self.async_scrolling_viewport_rect = async_scrolling_viewport_rect;
        self.has_async_scrolling_state = true;
    }

    fn restart_caret_blink_for(&mut self, display_list: &DisplayList, now: MonotonicTime) {
        let mut blink_cycle_start_time_ns = None;
        display_list.for_each_caret(|caret| {
            if caret.should_blink {
                blink_cycle_start_time_ns = Some(caret.blink_cycle_start_time_ns);
            }
        });
        if blink_cycle_start_time_ns == self.caret_blink_cycle_start_time_ns {
            return;
        }
        self.caret_blink_cycle_start_time_ns = blink_cycle_start_time_ns;
        self.host.cancel_timer(self.context_id, ContextTimer::CaretBlink);
        if self.caret_blink_cycle_start_time_ns.is_none() {
            return;
        }
        self.schedule_next_caret_blink(now);
    }

    fn schedule_next_caret_blink(&self, now: MonotonicTime) {
        let Some(start) = self.caret_blink_cycle_start_time_ns else {
            return;
        };
        let now_ns = now.nanoseconds();
        let elapsed_ns = if now_ns > start { now_ns - start } else { 0 };
        let delay_ns = 500_000_000 - elapsed_ns % 500_000_000;
        self.host.set_timer(
            self.context_id,
            ContextTimer::CaretBlink,
            Duration::from_nanoseconds(delay_ns),
        );
    }

    pub fn forget_layer_plan(&mut self) {
        self.scene.forget_layer_plan();
    }

    pub fn take_layer_plan_of_installed_update(
        &mut self,
        layer_plan: Option<UnvalidatedLayerPlan>,
    ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
        self.scene.take_layer_plan_of_installed_update(layer_plan)
    }

    pub fn take_layer_plan_of_scroll_state(
        &mut self,
        layer_plan: Option<UnvalidatedLayerPlan>,
    ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
        self.scene.take_layer_plan_of_scroll_state(layer_plan)
    }

    /// Returns false for a tree that does not fit the installed display list, which keeps the tree it has and takes
    /// only the scroll state that pairs with the new one.
    pub fn update_visual_context_tree(
        &mut self,
        visual_context_tree: AccumulatedVisualContextTree,
        scroll_state_snapshot: ScrollStateSnapshot,
        keyboard_scroll_state: KeyboardScrollState,
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) -> bool {
        let scroll_offsets_of_known_nodes = self.scroll_offsets_by_stable_id();
        let previous_visual_context_tree = self.scene.visual_context_tree().clone();
        if !self.scene.replace_visual_context_tree(visual_context_tree, now) {
            self.update_scroll_state(scroll_state_snapshot, keyboard_scroll_state);
            return false;
        }
        let compositor_scroll_table_changed = previous_visual_context_tree.is_some_and(|previous| {
            previous.as_arc().compositor_scroll_table()
                != self
                    .scene
                    .visual_context_tree()
                    .as_ref()
                    .unwrap()
                    .as_arc()
                    .compositor_scroll_table()
        });
        self.update_scroll_state_with_known_offsets(
            scroll_state_snapshot,
            keyboard_scroll_state,
            &scroll_offsets_of_known_nodes,
            compositor_scroll_table_changed,
        );
        true
    }

    pub fn update_scroll_state(
        &mut self,
        scroll_state_snapshot: ScrollStateSnapshot,
        keyboard_scroll_state: KeyboardScrollState,
    ) {
        let scroll_offsets_of_known_nodes = self.scroll_offsets_by_stable_id();
        self.update_scroll_state_with_known_offsets(
            scroll_state_snapshot,
            keyboard_scroll_state,
            &scroll_offsets_of_known_nodes,
            false,
        );
    }

    fn update_scroll_state_with_known_offsets(
        &mut self,
        scroll_state_snapshot: ScrollStateSnapshot,
        keyboard_scroll_state: KeyboardScrollState,
        scroll_offsets_of_known_nodes: &HashMap<AsyncScrollNodeStableID, FloatPoint>,
        compositor_scroll_table_changed: bool,
    ) {
        self.scene.forget_whether_animated_content_may_affect_viewport();
        // Newly adopted stable ids must start at the offsets in the snapshot that pairs with this tree.
        self.scroll_state_snapshot = scroll_state_snapshot;
        self.scroll_state_snapshot.set_node_count(
            self.scene
                .visual_context_tree()
                .as_ref()
                .map_or(0, |tree| tree.spatial_node_count()),
        );
        if !self.has_async_scrolling_state {
            return;
        }
        if compositor_scroll_table_changed {
            let async_scrolling_state = async_scrolling_state_from(
                self.scene.display_list().as_ref().unwrap(),
                self.scene.visual_context_tree().as_ref().unwrap().as_arc(),
            );
            self.adopt_scrolling_state(async_scrolling_state, scroll_offsets_of_known_nodes);
        } else {
            let kept_viewport_scroll_offset = self.keep_scroll_offsets_of_known_nodes(scroll_offsets_of_known_nodes);
            self.rebuild_wheel_hit_test_targets();
            if let Some(offset) = kept_viewport_scroll_offset {
                self.async_scrolling_viewport_rect.x = offset.x as i32;
                self.async_scrolling_viewport_rect.y = offset.y as i32;
            }
        }
        self.adopt_keyboard_scroll_state(keyboard_scroll_state);
    }

    pub fn invalidate_wheel_event_listener_state(&mut self, generation: u64) {
        self.wheel_gesture_routing
            .invalidate_wheel_event_listener_state(generation);
    }
    pub fn invalidate_keyboard_scroll_state(&mut self, generation: u64) {
        self.keyboard_scroll_controller.invalidate_state(generation);
    }

    fn adopt_keyboard_scroll_state(&mut self, state: KeyboardScrollState) {
        if self.keyboard_scroll_controller.adopt_state(state) && !self.keyboard_scroll_controller.has_target() {
            self.end_keyboard_scroll_gesture();
        }
    }

    fn end_keyboard_scroll_gesture(&mut self) {
        if !self.keyboard_scroll_controller.release_all_keys() {
            return;
        }
        self.end_user_scroll_gesture_of_held_keys();
        self.request_rendering_update();
    }
}

fn clamp<T: PartialOrd>(value: T, min: T, max: T) -> T {
    if value > max {
        max
    } else if value < min {
        min
    } else {
        value
    }
}

fn max<T: PartialOrd>(a: T, b: T) -> T {
    if a < b { b } else { a }
}
