//! Wheel event routing for a compositor context.

use super::*;

impl WheelStep {
    pub fn for_wheel_event(
        event: &MouseEvent,
        gesture_id: Option<u64>,
        operation_tracking: AsyncScrollOperationTracking,
    ) -> Self {
        let mut delta_in_css_pixels = FloatPoint {
            x: event.wheel_delta_x as f32,
            y: event.wheel_delta_y as f32,
        };
        if !(event.modifiers & KeyModifier::Mod_Shift).is_empty() {
            delta_in_css_pixels = FloatPoint {
                x: delta_in_css_pixels.y,
                y: delta_in_css_pixels.x,
            };
        }
        Self {
            position: ContextState::wheel_event_position(event),
            delta_in_css_pixels,
            wheel_delta_precision: event.wheel_delta_precision,
            scroll_gesture_phase: event.scroll_gesture_phase,
            gesture_id,
            operation_tracking,
        }
    }
}

impl ContextState {
    /// The UI's wheel deltas are in CSS pixels; this scales them for the scroll tree, which works in device pixels.
    pub fn handle_wheel_event(
        &mut self,
        event: &MouseEvent,
        is_first_wheel_event_with_delta: bool,
        listener_gate: &WheelEventListenerGate,
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) -> ContextUpdateResult {
        assert_eq!(event.r#type, MouseEventType::MouseWheel);
        if !self.presents_to_client() {
            return ContextUpdateResult::declined(InputRoutingDecision::ContextNotPresenting);
        }
        self.scroll_fling_controller.note_wheel_event(event, now);
        self.scroll_for_wheel_event(
            event,
            is_first_wheel_event_with_delta,
            listener_gate,
            AsyncScrollOperationTracking::No,
            now,
        )
    }

    /// Routes the event like one from the UI, also in a context that is nested in another one.
    pub fn scroll_for_wheel_event_from_main_thread(
        &mut self,
        event: &MouseEvent,
        is_first_wheel_event_with_delta: bool,
        listener_gate: &WheelEventListenerGate,
        operation_tracking: AsyncScrollOperationTracking,
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) -> ContextUpdateResult {
        assert_eq!(event.r#type, MouseEventType::MouseWheel);
        self.scroll_for_wheel_event(
            event,
            is_first_wheel_event_with_delta,
            listener_gate,
            operation_tracking,
            now,
        )
    }

    fn wheel_event_position(event: &MouseEvent) -> FloatPoint {
        FloatPoint {
            x: event.position.x as f32,
            y: event.position.y as f32,
        }
    }

    fn wheel_event_delta_in_device_pixels(&self, event: &MouseEvent) -> FloatPoint {
        let mut wheel_delta_x = event.wheel_delta_x;
        let mut wheel_delta_y = event.wheel_delta_y;
        if !(event.modifiers & KeyModifier::Mod_Shift).is_empty() {
            std::mem::swap(&mut wheel_delta_x, &mut wheel_delta_y);
        }
        FloatPoint {
            x: wheel_delta_x as f32,
            y: wheel_delta_y as f32,
        }
        .scaled(self.async_scroll_tree.device_pixels_per_css_pixel() as f32)
    }

    pub fn wheel_event_listener_gate(&self, gesture_id: Option<u64>) -> WheelEventListenerGate {
        WheelEventListenerGate {
            page_let_the_gesture_through: self.wheel_gesture_routing.page_let_gesture_through(gesture_id),
            reason_to_hold_latched_steps_back: self.wheel_gesture_routing.reason_to_hold_latched_steps_back(gesture_id),
        }
    }

    /// A wheel event of the UI that this context did not scroll by is left to its page, which then answers whether it
    /// let the event through.
    pub fn note_wheel_event_left_to_the_page(&mut self, event: &MouseEvent) {
        self.wheel_gesture_routing.note_delta_left_to_the_page(
            WheelStep::for_wheel_event(event, None, AsyncScrollOperationTracking::No).delta_in_css_pixels,
        );
    }

    fn note_wheel_event(&mut self, event: &MouseEvent, now: MonotonicTime) -> NotedWheelEvent {
        assert_eq!(event.r#type, MouseEventType::MouseWheel);
        // The end of the gesture before this one may never have arrived.
        let noted = self.wheel_gesture_routing.note_wheel_event(
            event,
            ContextState::wheel_event_position(event),
            &self.async_scroll_tree,
            now,
        );
        if noted.starts_gesture {
            self.elastic_overscroll_controller.end_gesture(now);
        }
        NotedWheelEvent {
            wheel_gesture_mark: WheelGestureMark {
                gesture_id: self.wheel_gesture_routing.gesture_id().unwrap(),
                lasts_until_fingers_lift: self.wheel_gesture_routing.gesture_lasts_until_fingers_lift(),
                step_number: noted.step_number,
            },
            is_first_wheel_event_with_delta: noted.is_first_wheel_event_with_delta,
        }
    }

    /// Takes note of a wheel event from the UI as it arrives, ahead of anything that may turn it away or leave it to
    /// the page.
    pub fn note_wheel_event_from_ui(&mut self, event: &MouseEvent, now: MonotonicTime) -> NotedWheelEvent {
        let phase = event.scroll_gesture_phase;
        let noted = self.note_wheel_event(event, now);
        if phase == ScrollGesturePhase::Momentum {
            self.last_reported_scroll_momentum_step = Some(event.clone());
            self.last_reported_scroll_momentum_step
                .as_mut()
                .unwrap()
                .wheel_gesture_mark = Some(noted.wheel_gesture_mark.clone());
        } else {
            self.last_reported_scroll_momentum_step = None;
        }
        // A stretch is released with the velocity of the steps as they arrived from the UI, not as they were scrolled.
        // Fling steps are not timed here, which leaves them out of the velocity; no platform both flings and stretches.
        if self.wheel_step_can_stretch_elastically(event.wheel_delta_precision, phase) {
            let delta = self
                .wheel_event_delta_in_device_pixels(event)
                .scaled(1.0 / self.scene.visual_viewport_magnification());
            self.elastic_overscroll_controller.note_step_from_ui(delta, now);
        }
        noted
    }

    /// Takes note of a wheel event that the main thread has and the UI did not send here, as the UI's events are noted.
    /// Such an event adds nothing to the velocity of a flick or of a stretch release.
    pub fn note_wheel_event_from_main_thread(&mut self, event: &MouseEvent, now: MonotonicTime) -> NotedWheelEvent {
        self.note_wheel_event(event, now)
    }

    /// Starts a fling if the gesture that the event ends was a flick. Use only on platforms that send no momentum
    /// scroll events.
    pub fn start_scroll_fling_if_flicked(&mut self, gesture_end_event: &MouseEvent, now: MonotonicTime) -> bool {
        self.scroll_fling_controller.start_if_flicked(gesture_end_event, now)
    }

    /// Ends the fling before a wheel event from a new gesture or other input.
    pub fn interrupt_scroll_fling(&mut self, event: &MouseEvent, now: MonotonicTime) -> Option<MouseEvent> {
        self.scroll_fling_controller.interrupt(event, now)
    }

    fn interrupt_reported_scroll_momentum(&mut self) -> Option<MouseEvent> {
        self.last_reported_scroll_momentum_step.as_ref()?;
        // WebContent holds the gesture open while momentum events arrive. The end of the gesture releases it.
        let mut gesture_end = self.last_reported_scroll_momentum_step.take().unwrap();
        gesture_end.wheel_delta_x = 0.0;
        gesture_end.wheel_delta_y = 0.0;
        gesture_end.wheel_tick_120ths_x = 0.0;
        gesture_end.wheel_tick_120ths_y = 0.0;
        gesture_end.scroll_gesture_phase = ScrollGesturePhase::Ended;
        gesture_end.async_scroll_performed_default_action = false;
        // The IDs of UI input events start at 1. Thus, ID 0 does not match a UI event.
        gesture_end.id = 0;
        self.reported_scroll_momentum_was_interrupted = true;
        Some(gesture_end)
    }

    /// Ends the fling, or the gesture whose momentum the platform is reporting, if it scrolls the box, so that the rest
    /// of its momentum scrolls nothing. Returns the end of the gesture to send on to WebContent.
    pub fn end_momentum_scrolling(&mut self, stable_node_id: AsyncScrollNodeStableID) -> Option<MouseEvent> {
        if self.wheel_gesture_routing.latched_scroller() != Some(stable_node_id) {
            return None;
        }
        if self.has_active_scroll_fling() {
            return self.end_scroll_fling();
        }
        self.interrupt_reported_scroll_momentum()
    }

    pub fn clear_per_test_input_state(&mut self) {
        // A gesture held by fingers never ends by itself, so one a test left unended would take in the next test's steps.
        self.wheel_gesture_routing.forget_gesture();
        self.pointer_in_nested_contexts = Default::default();
        // The pointer a test moved through the UI process rests on in this context, where the next test's moves may not
        // reach: one that moves the pointer in the page alone would have frames of its animations report content under
        // a pointer that is not there.
        self.note_pointer_position(None);
        self.animated_content_was_under_pointer = false;
        self.last_reported_scroll_momentum_step = None;
        self.reported_scroll_momentum_was_interrupted = false;
    }

    /// Whether the wheel event from the UI is momentum, or the end, of a gesture whose momentum was interrupted.
    pub fn absorbs_wheel_event_of_interrupted_momentum(&mut self, event: &MouseEvent) -> bool {
        if !self.reported_scroll_momentum_was_interrupted {
            return false;
        }
        if matches!(
            event.scroll_gesture_phase,
            ScrollGesturePhase::Momentum | ScrollGesturePhase::Ended
        ) {
            return true;
        }
        self.reported_scroll_momentum_was_interrupted = false;
        false
    }

    /// The wheel event of the next step of the fling, which is scrolled by like a wheel event from the UI.
    pub fn take_scroll_fling_step(&mut self, frame_time: MonotonicTime) -> Option<MouseEvent> {
        self.scroll_fling_controller.take_step(frame_time)
    }
    pub fn end_scroll_fling(&mut self) -> Option<MouseEvent> {
        self.scroll_fling_controller.end()
    }

    pub fn scroll_for_fling_step(
        &mut self,
        event: &MouseEvent,
        listener_gate: &WheelEventListenerGate,
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) -> ContextUpdateResult {
        if !self.presents_to_client() {
            return ContextUpdateResult::declined(InputRoutingDecision::ContextNotPresenting);
        }
        self.scroll_for_wheel_event(event, false, listener_gate, AsyncScrollOperationTracking::No, now)
    }

    pub fn end_scroll_fling_on_next_step(&mut self) {
        self.scroll_fling_controller.end_on_next_step();
    }

    fn scroll_for_wheel_event(
        &mut self,
        event: &MouseEvent,
        is_first_wheel_event_with_delta: bool,
        listener_gate: &WheelEventListenerGate,
        operation_tracking: AsyncScrollOperationTracking,
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) -> ContextUpdateResult {
        let step = WheelStep::for_wheel_event(event, self.wheel_gesture_routing.gesture_id(), operation_tracking);
        // The end of a gesture lets go of the scroller it stretched even if the context has stopped taking wheel events.
        if step.scroll_gesture_phase == ScrollGesturePhase::Ended {
            self.elastic_overscroll_controller.end_gesture(now);
        }
        let latch = self.resolve_wheel_scroll_latch(step.scroll_gesture_phase, step.gesture_id);
        if let Some(context_id) = latch.nested_context_id {
            return ContextUpdateResult {
                nested_context_wheel_step: Some(NestedContextWheelStep { context_id, hit: None }),
                ..Default::default()
            };
        }
        if latch.scroll_node_index.is_some() {
            // A blocking listener added during the gesture holds its later steps back until the page lets one through.
            if let Some(reason) = listener_gate.reason_to_hold_latched_steps_back {
                return ContextUpdateResult::declined(reason);
            }
            let admission = if listener_gate.page_let_the_gesture_through {
                WheelStepAdmission::LetThroughByThePage
            } else {
                WheelStepAdmission::ByThisPage
            };
            return self.scroll_for_wheel_step_in_this_context(
                &step,
                latch.scroll_node_index,
                NestedContextRegions::LeaveToMainThread,
                admission,
                &[],
                now,
            );
        }
        if listener_gate.page_let_the_gesture_through {
            return self.scroll_for_wheel_step_in_this_context(
                &step,
                None,
                NestedContextRegions::Ignore,
                WheelStepAdmission::LetThroughByThePage,
                &[],
                now,
            );
        }
        // The first step of a gesture over the content of a nested context goes to that context. A gesture whose first step
        // went elsewhere is not handed to a nested context that comes under the pointer later.
        let mut nested_context_regions = NestedContextRegions::LeaveToMainThread;
        if is_first_wheel_event_with_delta && self.may_hand_first_wheel_steps_to_nested_contexts() {
            nested_context_regions = NestedContextRegions::HandToNestedContext;
            if let Some(hit) = self.nested_context_for_wheel_at(step.position) {
                return ContextUpdateResult {
                    nested_context_wheel_step: Some(NestedContextWheelStep {
                        context_id: hit.child_context_id,
                        hit: Some(hit),
                    }),
                    ..Default::default()
                };
            }
        }
        self.scroll_for_wheel_step_in_this_context(
            &step,
            None,
            nested_context_regions,
            WheelStepAdmission::ByThisPage,
            &[],
            now,
        )
    }

    pub fn scroll_for_wheel_event_passed_on_by_nested_context(
        &mut self,
        event: &MouseEvent,
        operation_tracking: AsyncScrollOperationTracking,
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) -> ContextUpdateResult {
        let step = WheelStep::for_wheel_event(event, self.wheel_gesture_routing.gesture_id(), operation_tracking);
        self.scroll_for_wheel_step_in_this_context(
            &step,
            None,
            NestedContextRegions::Ignore,
            WheelStepAdmission::PassedOnByNestedContext,
            &[],
            now,
        )
    }

    /// The first step of a gesture that the page let through, routed from the scrollers the page found around its
    /// target, innermost first, if this context knows one, and by a hit test otherwise.
    pub fn scroll_for_first_wheel_step_the_page_let_through(
        &mut self,
        step: &WheelStep,
        scroll_chain: &[AsyncScrollNodeStableID],
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) -> ContextUpdateResult {
        self.scroll_for_wheel_step_in_this_context(
            step,
            None,
            NestedContextRegions::Ignore,
            WheelStepAdmission::LetThroughByThePage,
            scroll_chain,
            now,
        )
    }

    /// A step of a gesture that the page let through and that is latched to a scroller of this context. Empty once the
    /// scroller is gone.
    pub fn scroll_for_latched_wheel_step_the_page_let_through(
        &mut self,
        step: &WheelStep,
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) -> Option<ContextUpdateResult> {
        let latch = self.resolve_wheel_scroll_latch(step.scroll_gesture_phase, step.gesture_id);
        latch.scroll_node_index?;
        Some(self.scroll_for_wheel_step_in_this_context(
            step,
            latch.scroll_node_index,
            NestedContextRegions::Ignore,
            WheelStepAdmission::LetThroughByThePage,
            &[],
            now,
        ))
    }

    /// A step of a gesture that this context has moved past scrolls once along its route, latching and stretching
    /// nothing.
    pub fn scroll_for_overtaken_wheel_step(
        &mut self,
        step: &WheelStep,
        scroll_chain: &[AsyncScrollNodeStableID],
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) -> ContextUpdateResult {
        if !self.has_async_scrolling_state {
            return ContextUpdateResult::declined(InputRoutingDecision::NoAsyncScrollingState);
        }
        let delta = step
            .delta_in_css_pixels
            .scaled(self.async_scroll_tree.device_pixels_per_css_pixel() as f32);
        if delta.is_zero() {
            return ContextUpdateResult::declined(InputRoutingDecision::StepOvertaken);
        }
        let scroll_target = self.route_first_wheel_step(
            step.position,
            delta,
            step.wheel_delta_precision,
            WheelStepDispatch::DispatchedAndNotCanceled,
            NestedContextRegions::Ignore,
            scroll_chain,
        );
        let Some(scroll_node_index) = scroll_target.scroll_node_index else {
            return ContextUpdateResult::declined(InputRoutingDecision::StepOvertaken);
        };
        self.scroll_snap_controller
            .note_gesture_phase(step.scroll_gesture_phase);
        let node_scroll = self.scroll_node_by_wheel_delta(
            scroll_node_index,
            delta,
            step.wheel_delta_precision,
            step.scroll_gesture_phase,
            step.operation_tracking,
            self.async_scrolling_viewport_rect,
            ScrollChaining::ToScrollableAncestors,
            now,
        );
        let outcome = node_scroll.outcome;
        ContextUpdateResult {
            accepted: true,
            frame_to_present: outcome.viewport_rect_to_present.map(PendingFrame::repainting_changes),
            should_request_rendering_update: outcome.viewport_rect_to_present.is_some(),
            routing_decision: Some(InputRoutingDecision::StepOvertaken),
            tracked_scroll_operation: self.tracked_scroll_operation(step.operation_tracking, outcome.operation_id),
            ..Default::default()
        }
    }

    fn tracked_scroll_operation(
        &self,
        operation_tracking: AsyncScrollOperationTracking,
        operation_id: Option<AsyncScrollOperationID>,
    ) -> Option<TrackedScrollOperation> {
        if operation_tracking == AsyncScrollOperationTracking::No || operation_id.is_none() {
            return None;
        }
        Some(TrackedScrollOperation {
            context_id: self.context_id,
            operation_id: operation_id.unwrap(),
        })
    }

    // A step of the gesture latched to the scroller, or the first step, which latches the gesture to the scroller it is
    // routed to.
    fn scroll_for_wheel_step_in_this_context(
        &mut self,
        step: &WheelStep,
        mut latched_scroll_node_index: Option<SpatialNodeIndex>,
        nested_context_regions: NestedContextRegions,
        admission: WheelStepAdmission,
        scroll_chain: &[AsyncScrollNodeStableID],
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) -> ContextUpdateResult {
        let delta = step
            .delta_in_css_pixels
            .scaled(self.async_scroll_tree.device_pixels_per_css_pixel() as f32);
        let is_first_step_of_gesture = latched_scroll_node_index.is_none();
        let found_nothing_to_scroll = |decision| {
            let there_is_nothing_to_scroll = matches!(
                decision,
                InputRoutingDecision::NoScrollTarget
                    | InputRoutingDecision::NoScrollNode
                    | InputRoutingDecision::GestureEndWithNothingToSnap
            );
            if admission == WheelStepAdmission::LetThroughByThePage && there_is_nothing_to_scroll {
                return ContextUpdateResult {
                    accepted: true,
                    routing_decision: Some(decision),
                    ..Default::default()
                };
            }
            ContextUpdateResult::declined(decision)
        };
        if is_first_step_of_gesture {
            let routing_admission = self.wheel_gesture_routing.admission();
            // A page without scroll nodes still has a visual viewport to pan once it is zoomed in.
            let can_pan_zoomed_visual_viewport = routing_admission == WheelRoutingAdmission::NoScrollNode
                && self.scene.visual_viewport_scale().unwrap_or(1.0) > 1.0;
            // Only the listeners of the page that sees the step may hold it back.
            let is_admitted = routing_admission == WheelRoutingAdmission::Accepted
                || (admission != WheelStepAdmission::ByThisPage
                    && matches!(
                        routing_admission,
                        WheelRoutingAdmission::BlockingWheelEventListeners
                            | WheelRoutingAdmission::StaleWheelEventListeners
                    ));
            if !is_admitted && !can_pan_zoomed_visual_viewport {
                let decision = input_routing_decision_for_wheel_step_not_admitted_by(routing_admission);
                if routing_admission == WheelRoutingAdmission::NoScrollNode {
                    return found_nothing_to_scroll(decision);
                }
                return ContextUpdateResult::declined(decision);
            }
        }
        self.scroll_snap_controller
            .note_gesture_phase(step.scroll_gesture_phase);
        if step.scroll_gesture_phase == ScrollGesturePhase::Ended && delta.is_zero() {
            let operation_id = self.snap_at_gesture_end(now);
            if operation_id.is_none() {
                return found_nothing_to_scroll(InputRoutingDecision::GestureEndWithNothingToSnap);
            }
            return ContextUpdateResult {
                accepted: true,
                frame_to_present: Some(PendingFrame::repainting_changes(self.async_scrolling_viewport_rect)),
                should_request_rendering_update: true,
                routing_decision: Some(InputRoutingDecision::SnappedAtGestureEnd),
                tracked_scroll_operation: self.tracked_scroll_operation(step.operation_tracking, operation_id),
                ..Default::default()
            };
        }
        // Whether a gesture waits for the page is decided by its first step; the steps of a latched gesture are not held
        // back by regions the cursor moves over later.
        let wheel_step_dispatch = if admission == WheelStepAdmission::ByThisPage {
            WheelStepDispatch::NotYetDispatched
        } else {
            WheelStepDispatch::DispatchedAndNotCanceled
        };
        if is_first_step_of_gesture && wheel_step_dispatch == WheelStepDispatch::NotYetDispatched {
            let initial_scroll_target = self.async_scroll_tree.hit_test_scroll_node_for_wheel(
                self.scene.visual_context_tree_for_compositing(),
                step.position,
                delta,
                &|_| None,
                wheel_step_dispatch,
                nested_context_regions,
            );
            if initial_scroll_target.is_blocked_by_a_region() {
                return ContextUpdateResult::declined(input_routing_decision_for_first_wheel_step(
                    initial_scroll_target.outcome,
                ));
            }
        }
        if delta.is_zero() {
            return ContextUpdateResult {
                accepted: true,
                routing_decision: Some(InputRoutingDecision::StepWithoutDelta),
                routed_scroller: self.wheel_gesture_routing.latched_scroller(),
                ..Default::default()
            };
        }
        // A gesture is latched before its first step pans the visual viewport, so that the scroller it belongs to is known
        // for as long as the gesture only pans.
        let mut routing_decision = InputRoutingDecision::ContinuedLatch;
        if is_first_step_of_gesture {
            let latch_attempt = self.route_and_latch_wheel_gesture(
                step.position,
                delta.scaled(1.0 / self.scene.visual_viewport_magnification()),
                step.wheel_delta_precision,
                step.scroll_gesture_phase,
                step.gesture_id,
                wheel_step_dispatch,
                nested_context_regions,
                scroll_chain,
            );
            latched_scroll_node_index = latch_attempt.latched_scroll_node_index;
            routing_decision = latch_attempt.decision;
        }
        // A zoomed page still pans its visual viewport by a gesture that no scroller takes.
        let Some(latched_scroll_node_index) = latched_scroll_node_index else {
            if self.pan_visual_viewport_by(delta).is_zero() {
                return found_nothing_to_scroll(routing_decision);
            }
            return ContextUpdateResult {
                accepted: true,
                frame_to_present: Some(PendingFrame::repainting_changes(self.async_scrolling_viewport_rect)),
                should_request_rendering_update: true,
                routing_decision: Some(InputRoutingDecision::PannedVisualViewport),
                ..Default::default()
            };
        };
        let scroll_chaining = if is_first_step_of_gesture {
            ScrollChaining::ToScrollableAncestors
        } else {
            ScrollChaining::None
        };
        let outcome = self.perform_wheel_scroll_of_node(
            latched_scroll_node_index,
            delta,
            step.wheel_delta_precision,
            step.scroll_gesture_phase,
            step.operation_tracking,
            self.async_scrolling_viewport_rect,
            scroll_chaining,
            VisualViewportPanning::BeforeScrolling,
            now,
        );
        ContextUpdateResult {
            accepted: true,
            frame_to_present: outcome.viewport_rect_to_present.map(PendingFrame::repainting_changes),
            should_request_rendering_update: outcome.viewport_rect_to_present.is_some()
                && !outcome.only_elastic_overscroll_changed,
            routing_decision: Some(routing_decision),
            routed_scroller: self.wheel_gesture_routing.latched_scroller(),
            tracked_scroll_operation: self.tracked_scroll_operation(step.operation_tracking, outcome.operation_id),
            ..Default::default()
        }
    }

    pub fn may_hand_first_wheel_steps_to_nested_contexts(&self) -> bool {
        // A zoomed page pans its visual viewport before anything scrolls. This document's wheel event listeners never see
        // the wheel events over a document nested in it, whatever state they are in.
        self.has_async_scrolling_state && self.scene.visual_viewport_scale().unwrap_or(1.0) == 1.0
    }

    /// Whether this context's page may cancel the ctrl+wheel event of a pinch at the position, or has yet to tell.
    pub fn page_may_cancel_pinch_at(&mut self, position: FloatPoint) -> bool {
        if !self.has_async_scrolling_state || !self.wheel_gesture_routing.admits_async_pinch() {
            return true;
        }
        let tree = self.scene.visual_context_tree_for_compositing();
        // NB: The main thread takes the wheel events of a nested document the compositor cannot reach.
        self.async_scroll_tree.blocks_wheel_event_at_position(tree, position)
            || self
                .async_scroll_tree
                .main_thread_wheel_event_region_contains(tree, position)
    }

    pub fn nested_context_for_wheel_at(&mut self, position: FloatPoint) -> Option<NestedContextHit> {
        if !self.has_async_scrolling_state {
            return None;
        }
        self.async_scroll_tree
            .nested_context_for_wheel_at(self.scene.visual_context_tree_for_compositing(), position)
    }

    pub fn latch_wheel_gesture_to_nested_context(
        &mut self,
        nested_context_id: CompositorContextId,
        scroller: Option<AsyncScrollNodeStableID>,
        scroll_gesture_phase: ScrollGesturePhase,
    ) {
        self.wheel_gesture_routing.latch_to_nested_context(
            nested_context_id,
            scroller,
            scroll_gesture_phase,
            self.wheel_gesture_routing.gesture_id(),
        );
    }

    /// Where a position in the viewport of a context nested in this one lies in this context's viewport.
    pub fn position_of_nested_context_position(
        &mut self,
        nested_context_id: CompositorContextId,
        position_in_nested_context: FloatPoint,
        nested_context_viewport_size: IntSize,
    ) -> Option<FloatPoint> {
        if !self.has_async_scrolling_state {
            return None;
        }
        self.async_scroll_tree.position_of_nested_context_position(
            nested_context_id,
            position_in_nested_context,
            libgfx_rust::FloatSize {
                width: nested_context_viewport_size.width as f32,
                height: nested_context_viewport_size.height as f32,
            },
            self.scene.visual_context_tree_for_compositing(),
        )
    }

    /// The scrollers the page found around the target of a step that it let through, innermost first, go before a hit
    /// test at the position of the step.
    pub fn route_first_wheel_step_from_containing_context(
        &mut self,
        position: FloatPoint,
        delta_in_css_pixels: FloatPoint,
        wheel_delta_precision: WheelDeltaPrecision,
        nested_context_regions: NestedContextRegions,
        admission: WheelStepAdmission,
        scroll_chain: &[AsyncScrollNodeStableID],
    ) -> FirstWheelStepRoute {
        use FirstWheelStepRouteKind as Kind;
        let route = |kind, decision, scroll_node_index, scroller, nested_context_hit| FirstWheelStepRoute {
            kind,
            decision,
            scroll_node_index,
            scroller,
            nested_context_hit,
        };
        let routing_admission = self.wheel_gesture_routing.admission();
        if !self.has_async_scrolling_state || routing_admission == WheelRoutingAdmission::NoAsyncScrollingState {
            return route(
                Kind::Declined,
                InputRoutingDecision::NoAsyncScrollingState,
                None,
                None,
                None,
            );
        }
        // A document's wheel event listeners never see the wheel events over a document nested in it.
        let tree = self.scene.visual_context_tree_for_compositing();
        if nested_context_regions == NestedContextRegions::HandToNestedContext
            && let Some(hit) = self.async_scroll_tree.nested_context_for_wheel_at(tree, position)
        {
            return route(
                Kind::NestedContext,
                InputRoutingDecision::HandedToNestedContext,
                None,
                None,
                Some(hit),
            );
        }
        let listeners_of_this_page_see_the_step = admission == WheelStepAdmission::ByThisPage;
        if listeners_of_this_page_see_the_step
            && matches!(
                routing_admission,
                WheelRoutingAdmission::BlockingWheelEventListeners | WheelRoutingAdmission::StaleWheelEventListeners
            )
        {
            return route(
                Kind::Declined,
                input_routing_decision_for_wheel_step_not_admitted_by(routing_admission),
                None,
                None,
                None,
            );
        }
        let delta = delta_in_css_pixels.scaled(self.async_scroll_tree.device_pixels_per_css_pixel() as f32);
        let wheel_step_dispatch = if listeners_of_this_page_see_the_step {
            WheelStepDispatch::NotYetDispatched
        } else {
            WheelStepDispatch::DispatchedAndNotCanceled
        };
        let scroll_target = self.route_first_wheel_step(
            position,
            delta,
            wheel_delta_precision,
            wheel_step_dispatch,
            nested_context_regions,
            scroll_chain,
        );
        let scroller_of = |index: Option<SpatialNodeIndex>| {
            index
                .and_then(|index| self.async_scroll_tree.scroll_node_for_index(index))
                .map(|node| node.stable_node_id)
        };
        if scroll_target.outcome == WheelHitTestOutcome::FoundScrollTarget {
            return route(
                Kind::ScrollNode,
                InputRoutingDecision::Latched,
                scroll_target.scroll_node_index,
                scroller_of(scroll_target.scroll_node_index),
                None,
            );
        }
        if scroll_target.outcome != WheelHitTestOutcome::NoScrollTarget {
            return route(
                Kind::Declined,
                input_routing_decision_for_first_wheel_step(scroll_target.outcome),
                None,
                None,
                None,
            );
        }
        // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-overscroll-1/#scroll-chaining-and-boundary-default-actions
        // A nested context does not stretch at its edge. It passes the step on to the document around it unless a scroller
        // keeps it, the viewport included.
        let viewport_keeps_the_scroll = self.async_scroll_tree.viewport_keeps_scrolls_along_main_axis_of(delta);
        if scroll_target.scroll_node_index_keeping_the_scroll.is_none() && !viewport_keeps_the_scroll {
            return route(
                Kind::PassedOn,
                InputRoutingDecision::NestedContextPassedStepOn,
                None,
                None,
                None,
            );
        }
        let scroll_node_index_keeping_the_scroll = scroll_target
            .scroll_node_index_keeping_the_scroll
            .or_else(|| self.async_scroll_tree.viewport_scroll_node_index());
        route(
            Kind::Kept,
            InputRoutingDecision::ScrollKeptByOverscrollBehavior,
            scroll_node_index_keeping_the_scroll,
            scroller_of(scroll_node_index_keeping_the_scroll),
            None,
        )
    }

    /// Latches the gesture to the scroller the route found, or to the one that keeps the step, and scrolls by the step.
    pub fn take_first_wheel_step_from_containing_context(
        &mut self,
        route: &FirstWheelStepRoute,
        step: &WheelStep,
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) -> ContextUpdateResult {
        assert!(matches!(
            route.kind,
            FirstWheelStepRouteKind::ScrollNode | FirstWheelStepRouteKind::Kept
        ));
        if route.kind == FirstWheelStepRouteKind::Kept {
            if let Some(scroller) = route.scroller {
                self.wheel_gesture_routing
                    .latch(scroller, step.scroll_gesture_phase, step.gesture_id);
            } else {
                self.wheel_gesture_routing
                    .latch_keeping_steps(step.scroll_gesture_phase, step.gesture_id);
            }
            return ContextUpdateResult {
                accepted: true,
                routing_decision: Some(route.decision),
                routed_scroller: route.scroller,
                ..Default::default()
            };
        }
        let (Some(scroller), Some(scroll_node_index)) = (route.scroller, route.scroll_node_index) else {
            return ContextUpdateResult::declined(InputRoutingDecision::NestedContextUnavailable);
        };
        self.wheel_gesture_routing
            .latch(scroller, step.scroll_gesture_phase, step.gesture_id);
        self.take_wheel_step_from_containing_context(
            scroll_node_index,
            route.decision,
            step,
            ScrollChaining::ToScrollableAncestors,
            now,
        )
    }

    pub fn take_latched_wheel_step_from_containing_context(
        &mut self,
        step: &WheelStep,
        admission: WheelStepAdmission,
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) -> ContextUpdateResult {
        if !self.has_async_scrolling_state {
            return ContextUpdateResult::declined(InputRoutingDecision::NoAsyncScrollingState);
        }
        let latch = self.wheel_gesture_routing.resolve_latch(
            &self.async_scroll_tree,
            self.scene.visual_context_tree().as_ref(),
            step.scroll_gesture_phase,
            step.gesture_id,
        );
        if latch.keeps_steps {
            return ContextUpdateResult {
                accepted: true,
                routing_decision: Some(InputRoutingDecision::ScrollKeptByOverscrollBehavior),
                ..Default::default()
            };
        }
        let Some(scroll_node_index) = latch.scroll_node_index else {
            return ContextUpdateResult::declined(InputRoutingDecision::NestedContextUnavailable);
        };
        if step.scroll_gesture_phase == ScrollGesturePhase::Ended && step.delta_in_css_pixels.is_zero() {
            self.scroll_snap_controller
                .note_gesture_phase(step.scroll_gesture_phase);
            let operation_id = self.snap_at_gesture_end(now);
            if operation_id.is_none() {
                if admission == WheelStepAdmission::LetThroughByThePage {
                    return ContextUpdateResult {
                        accepted: true,
                        routing_decision: Some(InputRoutingDecision::GestureEndWithNothingToSnap),
                        ..Default::default()
                    };
                }
                return ContextUpdateResult::declined(InputRoutingDecision::GestureEndWithNothingToSnap);
            }
            return ContextUpdateResult {
                accepted: true,
                frame_to_present: Some(PendingFrame::repainting_changes(self.async_scrolling_viewport_rect)),
                should_request_rendering_update: true,
                routing_decision: Some(InputRoutingDecision::SnappedAtGestureEnd),
                routed_scroller: self.wheel_gesture_routing.latched_scroller(),
                tracked_scroll_operation: self.tracked_scroll_operation(step.operation_tracking, operation_id),
                ..Default::default()
            };
        }
        self.take_wheel_step_from_containing_context(
            scroll_node_index,
            InputRoutingDecision::ContinuedLatch,
            step,
            ScrollChaining::None,
            now,
        )
    }

    fn take_wheel_step_from_containing_context(
        &mut self,
        scroll_node_index: SpatialNodeIndex,
        decision: InputRoutingDecision,
        step: &WheelStep,
        scroll_chaining: ScrollChaining,
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) -> ContextUpdateResult {
        self.scroll_snap_controller
            .note_gesture_phase(step.scroll_gesture_phase);
        let delta = step
            .delta_in_css_pixels
            .scaled(self.async_scroll_tree.device_pixels_per_css_pixel() as f32);
        let outcome = self.perform_wheel_scroll_of_node(
            scroll_node_index,
            delta,
            step.wheel_delta_precision,
            step.scroll_gesture_phase,
            step.operation_tracking,
            self.async_scrolling_viewport_rect,
            scroll_chaining,
            VisualViewportPanning::No,
            now,
        );
        ContextUpdateResult {
            accepted: true,
            frame_to_present: outcome.viewport_rect_to_present.map(PendingFrame::repainting_changes),
            should_request_rendering_update: outcome.viewport_rect_to_present.is_some()
                && !outcome.only_elastic_overscroll_changed,
            routing_decision: Some(decision),
            routed_scroller: self.wheel_gesture_routing.latched_scroller(),
            tracked_scroll_operation: self.tracked_scroll_operation(step.operation_tracking, outcome.operation_id),
            ..Default::default()
        }
    }
}

//! Keyboard, mouse, and pinch input routing between compositor contexts.

use super::*;
use crate::context_state::PointerInNestedContexts;
use libcompositing_rust::ipc_types::{
    Compositing_AsyncScrollOperationTracking as AsyncScrollOperationTracking, Web_InputTraceRecord as InputTraceRecord,
    Web_InputTraceStage as InputTraceStage, compositor_presentation_client,
};
use libcompositing_rust::scrolling::{
    InputRoutingDecision, KeyEvent, KeyEventType, MouseEvent, MouseEventType, NestedContextHit, PinchEvent,
    ScrollGesturePhase,
};

impl CompositorCore {
    pub fn handle_and_dispatch_key_event(
        &self,
        context_id: CompositorContextId,
        mut event: KeyEvent,
        allow_keyboard_scroll: bool,
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        // NB: The presentation connection only passes on input for the contexts bound to it.
        let context = self.context_if_present(context_id).expect("context exists");
        assert!(context.borrow().bound_presentation().is_some());
        let presentation_id = context.borrow().bound_presentation().unwrap();
        if !context.borrow().can_dispatch_input_to_web_content() {
            // No context could take the event; the UI sends it to WebContent itself.
            self.host.post_to_presentation(
                presentation_id,
                compositor_presentation_client::messages::DidNotDispatchInputEvent {
                    context_id,
                    event_id: event.id,
                },
            );
            return;
        }

        let mut later_keys_need_not_wait = false;
        if allow_keyboard_scroll {
            let scroll_box = context.borrow().box_scrolled_for_key_event(&event);
            if let Some(scroll_box) = scroll_box {
                let end_event = context.borrow_mut().end_momentum_scrolling(scroll_box);
                self.dispatch_scroll_fling_step(context_id, context, end_event, now);
            }
            let result = context.borrow_mut().handle_key_event(&event, now);
            later_keys_need_not_wait =
                self.apply_context_update_result(context_id, context, &result) && event.r#type == KeyEventType::KeyDown;
            event.async_scroll_performed_default_action =
                later_keys_need_not_wait && !result.key_found_nothing_to_scroll;
            if later_keys_need_not_wait && result.key_found_nothing_to_scroll {
                event.user_input_scroll_count_with_nothing_to_scroll = Some(context.borrow().user_input_scroll_count());
            }
        }

        // The scroll updates the event produced reach WebContent ahead of the event itself on the same connection.
        self.publish_pending_async_scroll_updates(context_id, context);
        context.borrow().dispatch_key_event_to_web_content(&event);
        // The compositor forwarded the key event to WebContent, after performing its default action by scrolling if it says so.
        self.host.post_to_presentation(
            presentation_id,
            compositor_presentation_client::messages::DidDispatchInputEvent {
                context_id,
                event_id: event.id,
                performed_default_action: later_keys_need_not_wait,
            },
        );
    }

    pub fn handle_and_dispatch_mouse_event(
        &self,
        context_id: CompositorContextId,
        mut event: MouseEvent,
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        // NB: The presentation connection only passes on input for the contexts bound to it.
        let context = self.context_if_present(context_id).expect("context exists");
        assert!(context.borrow().bound_presentation().is_some());
        let presentation_id = context.borrow().bound_presentation().unwrap();
        let record_routing = |decision, scroller| {
            context.borrow_mut().input_trace_mut().record(InputTraceRecord {
                input_event_id: event.id,
                stage: InputTraceStage::Compositor,
                decision,
                scroller,
                dom_target: None,
            });
        };
        if !context.borrow().can_dispatch_input_to_web_content() {
            record_routing(InputRoutingDecision::NotDispatchedByCompositor, None);
            self.host.post_to_presentation(
                presentation_id,
                compositor_presentation_client::messages::DidNotDispatchInputEvent {
                    context_id,
                    event_id: event.id,
                },
            );
            return;
        }

        if event.r#type == MouseEventType::MouseMove {
            context.borrow_mut().note_pointer_position(Some(FloatPoint {
                x: event.position.x as f32,
                y: event.position.y as f32,
            }));
        } else if matches!(event.r#type, MouseEventType::MouseLeave | MouseEventType::MouseCancel) {
            context.borrow_mut().note_pointer_position(None);
        }

        if event.r#type == MouseEventType::MouseDown {
            let end_event = context.borrow_mut().end_scroll_fling();
            self.dispatch_scroll_fling_step(context_id, context, end_event, now);
        }

        let is_wheel_event = event.r#type == MouseEventType::MouseWheel;
        let mut is_first_wheel_event_with_delta = false;
        if is_wheel_event {
            // A key, or a script's smooth scroll, takes over from momentum, until wheel input other than the momentum takes
            // over again.
            let absorbs_event = context.borrow_mut().absorbs_wheel_event_of_interrupted_momentum(&event);
            if absorbs_event {
                record_routing(InputRoutingDecision::MomentumInterrupted, None);
                // The compositor performed the event's whole default action, so the UI hears nothing more about it.
                self.host.post_to_presentation(
                    presentation_id,
                    compositor_presentation_client::messages::DidConsumeInputEvent {
                        context_id,
                        event_id: event.id,
                    },
                );
                return;
            }
            let noted = context.borrow_mut().note_wheel_event_from_ui(&event, now);
            event.wheel_gesture_mark = Some(noted.wheel_gesture_mark);
            is_first_wheel_event_with_delta = noted.is_first_wheel_event_with_delta;

            // The UI can send the end of a gesture more than once. An end that arrives during a fling belongs to the
            // flicked gesture, so it does not stop the fling.
            if event.scroll_gesture_phase == ScrollGesturePhase::Ended && context.borrow().has_active_scroll_fling() {
                record_routing(InputRoutingDecision::GestureEndAbsorbedByFling, None);
                self.host.post_to_presentation(
                    presentation_id,
                    compositor_presentation_client::messages::DidConsumeInputEvent {
                        context_id,
                        event_id: event.id,
                    },
                );
                return;
            }

            // A new gesture must not continue the gesture of the fling, so the fling ends first.
            let end_event = context.borrow_mut().interrupt_scroll_fling(&event, now);
            self.dispatch_scroll_fling_step(context_id, context, end_event, now);

            // If the gesture continues as a fling, the end of the fling is the end of the gesture.
            let synthesizes_scroll_momentum = context.borrow().presentation_synthesizes_scroll_momentum();
            let starts_fling = synthesizes_scroll_momentum
                && event.scroll_gesture_phase == ScrollGesturePhase::Ended
                && context.borrow_mut().start_scroll_fling_if_flicked(&event, now);
            if starts_fling {
                record_routing(InputRoutingDecision::FlingStarted, None);
                self.host.post_to_presentation(
                    presentation_id,
                    compositor_presentation_client::messages::DidConsumeInputEvent {
                        context_id,
                        event_id: event.id,
                    },
                );
                context.borrow_mut().request_display_ticks_if_needed(now);
                return;
            }
        }

        let result = if is_wheel_event {
            self.scroll_for_wheel_step(
                context_id,
                context,
                &event,
                WheelStepOrigin::UI,
                is_first_wheel_event_with_delta,
                AsyncScrollOperationTracking::No,
                now,
            )
        } else {
            self.handle_mouse_event_in_nested_contexts(context_id, context, &event, now)
        };
        if let Some(decision) = result.nested_context_hand_off {
            record_routing(decision, None);
        }
        if let Some(decision) = result.routing_decision {
            record_routing(decision, result.routed_scroller);
        }

        // Asks for the present, publishes the scroll updates the event produced and asks for a rendering update, the last
        // two of which reach WebContent ahead of the event itself on the same connection. Those of a nested context
        // another process owns go on that process's connection instead, while the event reaches it through the UI.
        let handled = self.apply_context_update_result(context_id, context, &result);
        // A wheel event that lets go of a stretched scroller presents nothing itself; the rebound does from here on. A press
        // beside the thumb of a scrollbar scrolls there in an animation too.
        context.borrow_mut().request_display_ticks_if_needed(now);
        if is_wheel_event {
            event.async_scroll_performed_default_action = handled;
            if !handled {
                context.borrow_mut().note_wheel_event_left_to_the_page(&event);
            }
        } else if handled {
            // The page still sees the events of a drag the compositor scrolls for a scrollbar the display list paints.
            if result.scrollbar_dragged_by_compositor.is_none() {
                record_routing(InputRoutingDecision::ConsumedByCompositor, None);
                self.host.post_to_presentation(
                    presentation_id,
                    compositor_presentation_client::messages::DidConsumeInputEvent {
                        context_id,
                        event_id: event.id,
                    },
                );
                return;
            }
            event.scrollbar_dragged_by_compositor = result.scrollbar_dragged_by_compositor;
        }
        record_routing(InputRoutingDecision::ForwardedToPage, None);
        context
            .borrow()
            .dispatch_mouse_event_to_web_content(&event, self.nested_context_scrolled_since_last_frame(context_id));
    }
}

// The content box of a nested context is drawn scaled to the size of its viewport.
pub(super) fn position_in_nested_context(
    hit: &NestedContextHit,
    nested_context: &RefCell<ContextState>,
) -> Option<FloatPoint> {
    let viewport_size = nested_context.borrow().viewport_size();
    if hit.content_box_size.is_empty() || viewport_size.width <= 0 || viewport_size.height <= 0 {
        return None;
    }
    Some(FloatPoint {
        x: hit.position_in_content_box.x * viewport_size.width as f32 / hit.content_box_size.width,
        y: hit.position_in_content_box.y * viewport_size.height as f32 / hit.content_box_size.height,
    })
}

impl CompositorCore {
    // Where the position in the presenting context lands in the nested context, through each context in between and
    // without regard to where their content is or what clips it.
    pub(super) fn position_in_nested_context_ignoring_clips(
        &self,
        presenting_context_id: CompositorContextId,
        presenting_context: &RefCell<ContextState>,
        nested_context: &RefCell<ContextState>,
        mut position: FloatPoint,
    ) -> Option<FloatPoint> {
        let mut contexts_from_nested_context_outward = Vec::new();
        let mut context = nested_context;
        // A walk up the parents that outlasts the number of contexts went around a loop.
        let mut remaining_contexts = self.contexts.len();
        while !std::ptr::eq(context, presenting_context) {
            if remaining_contexts == 0 {
                return None;
            }
            contexts_from_nested_context_outward.push(context);
            let parent_context_id = context.borrow().parent_context_id()?;
            context = if parent_context_id == presenting_context_id {
                presenting_context
            } else {
                self.context_if_present(parent_context_id)?
            };
            remaining_contexts -= 1;
        }

        let mut containing_context = presenting_context;
        for context_in_between in contexts_from_nested_context_outward.into_iter().rev() {
            let context_in_between_id = context_in_between.borrow().context_id();
            let hit = containing_context
                .borrow_mut()
                .position_in_content_of_nested_context(context_in_between_id, position)?;
            let position_in_context = position_in_nested_context(&hit, context_in_between)?;
            position = position_in_context;
            containing_context = context_in_between;
        }
        Some(position)
    }

    // The scrollbars of a context nested in the presenting context `context_id` take the pointer over that context's
    // content, and a drag of one of them takes the pointer wherever it goes until the drag ends.
    fn handle_mouse_event_in_nested_contexts(
        &self,
        context_id: CompositorContextId,
        context: &RefCell<ContextState>,
        event: &MouseEvent,
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) -> ContextUpdateResult {
        let mut pointer = context.borrow().pointer_in_nested_contexts_copy();
        let result = (|| {
            let mut context_with_captured_scrollbar =
                self.context_still_nested_in(context_id, pointer.context_with_captured_scrollbar);
            if context_with_captured_scrollbar.is_none_or(|context| !context.borrow().has_captured_scrollbar()) {
                pointer.context_with_captured_scrollbar = None;
                context_with_captured_scrollbar = None;
            }

            // The nested context presents and publishes what the event changed, and this context reports how the event went.
            let result_of_nested_context = |nested_context_id,
                                            nested_context: &RefCell<ContextState>,
                                            nested_result: &ContextUpdateResult,
                                            frame_of_this_context| {
                self.apply_context_update_result(nested_context_id, nested_context, nested_result);
                nested_context.borrow_mut().request_display_ticks_if_needed(now);
                // Node ids are only unique within the process that made them.
                let client = context.borrow().web_content_client_id();
                let ids_are_of_this_process = nested_context.borrow().is_owned_by(client);
                ContextUpdateResult {
                    accepted: nested_result.accepted,
                    frame_to_present: frame_of_this_context,
                    scrollbar_dragged_by_compositor: nested_result.scrollbar_dragged_by_compositor,
                    routing_decision: nested_result.routing_decision,
                    routed_scroller: if ids_are_of_this_process {
                        nested_result.routed_scroller
                    } else {
                        None
                    },
                    nested_context_hand_off: Some(InputRoutingDecision::HandedToNestedContext),
                    ..Default::default()
                }
            };

            let send_to_context_with_captured_scrollbar =
                |event_to_send: &MouseEvent,
                 pointer: &mut PointerInNestedContexts,
                 captured_context: &mut Option<&RefCell<ContextState>>| {
                    let nested_context_id = pointer.context_with_captured_scrollbar.unwrap();
                    let position = FloatPoint {
                        x: event_to_send.position.x as f32,
                        y: event_to_send.position.y as f32,
                    };
                    // A leave or a cancel has no position of its own.
                    if matches!(
                        event_to_send.r#type,
                        MouseEventType::MouseDown | MouseEventType::MouseMove | MouseEventType::MouseUp
                    ) {
                        let position_in_nested_context = self.position_in_nested_context_ignoring_clips(
                            context_id,
                            context,
                            captured_context.unwrap(),
                            position,
                        );
                        if let Some(position_in_nested_context) = position_in_nested_context {
                            pointer.last_position_in_context_with_captured_scrollbar = position_in_nested_context;
                        }
                    }
                    let nested_context = captured_context.unwrap();
                    let nested_result = nested_context.borrow_mut().handle_mouse_event_from_containing_context(
                        event_to_send,
                        pointer.last_position_in_context_with_captured_scrollbar,
                        now,
                    );
                    let result = result_of_nested_context(nested_context_id, nested_context, &nested_result, None);
                    if !nested_context.borrow().has_captured_scrollbar() {
                        pointer.context_with_captured_scrollbar = None;
                        *captured_context = None;
                        pointer.context_under_pointer = Some(nested_context_id);
                    }
                    result
                };

            // The scrollbar the pointer was over in the nested context it left is no longer hovered.
            let note_context_under_pointer = |nested_context_id, pointer: &mut PointerInNestedContexts| {
                if pointer.context_under_pointer == nested_context_id {
                    return;
                }
                if let Some(context_left) = self.context_still_nested_in(context_id, pointer.context_under_pointer) {
                    context_left.borrow_mut().note_pointer_position(None);
                    let frame_to_present = context_left.borrow_mut().clear_scrollbar_hover();
                    if let Some(frame_to_present) = frame_to_present {
                        self.request_present(pointer.context_under_pointer.unwrap(), &frame_to_present);
                    }
                }
                pointer.context_under_pointer = nested_context_id;
            };

            match event.r#type {
                MouseEventType::MouseDown | MouseEventType::MouseMove => {
                    if context_with_captured_scrollbar.is_some() {
                        if event.r#type == MouseEventType::MouseMove {
                            return send_to_context_with_captured_scrollbar(
                                event,
                                &mut pointer,
                                &mut context_with_captured_scrollbar,
                            );
                        }
                        // A press while a drag is still held means the release of that drag never came, so the drag ends there.
                        let mut cancel_event = event.clone();
                        cancel_event.r#type = MouseEventType::MouseCancel;
                        send_to_context_with_captured_scrollbar(
                            &cancel_event,
                            &mut pointer,
                            &mut context_with_captured_scrollbar,
                        );
                    }

                    let mut result = context.borrow_mut().handle_mouse_event(event, now);
                    if result.nested_context_mouse_hit.is_none() {
                        note_context_under_pointer(None, &mut pointer);
                        return result;
                    }

                    let frame_of_this_context = result.frame_to_present;
                    let mut containing_context_id = context_id;
                    let mut containing_context = context;
                    let mut position = FloatPoint::default();
                    while let Some(hit) = result.nested_context_mouse_hit.as_ref() {
                        // WebContent names the contexts its display lists draw, so a context only reaches those nested in it.
                        let nested_context = self.context_if_present(hit.child_context_id);
                        let mut position_in_nested_context_content = None;
                        if let Some(nested_context) = nested_context
                            && nested_context.borrow().parent_context_id() == Some(containing_context_id)
                        {
                            position_in_nested_context_content = position_in_nested_context(hit, nested_context);
                        }
                        let Some(position_in_nested_context_content) = position_in_nested_context_content else {
                            note_context_under_pointer(None, &mut pointer);
                            let mut declined =
                                ContextUpdateResult::declined(InputRoutingDecision::NestedContextUnavailable);
                            declined.frame_to_present = frame_of_this_context;
                            declined.nested_context_hand_off = Some(InputRoutingDecision::HandedToNestedContext);
                            return declined;
                        };
                        if !std::ptr::eq(containing_context, context) {
                            self.apply_context_update_result(containing_context_id, containing_context, &result);
                            containing_context.borrow_mut().request_display_ticks_if_needed(now);
                        }
                        containing_context_id = hit.child_context_id;
                        containing_context = nested_context.unwrap();
                        position = position_in_nested_context_content;
                        result = containing_context
                            .borrow_mut()
                            .handle_mouse_event_from_containing_context(event, position, now);
                    }

                    note_context_under_pointer(Some(containing_context_id), &mut pointer);
                    if event.r#type == MouseEventType::MouseDown && containing_context.borrow().has_captured_scrollbar()
                    {
                        pointer.context_with_captured_scrollbar = Some(containing_context_id);
                        pointer.last_position_in_context_with_captured_scrollbar = position;
                    }
                    result_of_nested_context(
                        containing_context_id,
                        containing_context,
                        &result,
                        frame_of_this_context,
                    )
                }
                MouseEventType::MouseUp => {
                    if context_with_captured_scrollbar.is_some() {
                        return send_to_context_with_captured_scrollbar(
                            event,
                            &mut pointer,
                            &mut context_with_captured_scrollbar,
                        );
                    }
                    context.borrow_mut().handle_mouse_event(event, now)
                }
                MouseEventType::MouseLeave | MouseEventType::MouseCancel => {
                    // The pointer leaves every nested context it was in, and a cancel ends the drag of one, as in this context.
                    let mut result_of_context_with_captured_scrollbar = None;
                    let mut context_with_captured_scrollbar_id = None;
                    if context_with_captured_scrollbar.is_some() {
                        context_with_captured_scrollbar_id = pointer.context_with_captured_scrollbar;
                        result_of_context_with_captured_scrollbar = Some(send_to_context_with_captured_scrollbar(
                            event,
                            &mut pointer,
                            &mut context_with_captured_scrollbar,
                        ));
                    }
                    if let Some(context_under_pointer) =
                        self.context_still_nested_in(context_id, pointer.context_under_pointer)
                        && pointer.context_under_pointer != context_with_captured_scrollbar_id
                    {
                        let nested_result = context_under_pointer
                            .borrow_mut()
                            .handle_mouse_event_from_containing_context(event, FloatPoint::default(), now);
                        self.apply_context_update_result(
                            pointer.context_under_pointer.unwrap(),
                            context_under_pointer,
                            &nested_result,
                        );
                        context_under_pointer.borrow_mut().request_display_ticks_if_needed(now);
                    }
                    pointer.context_under_pointer = None;

                    let result = context.borrow_mut().handle_mouse_event(event, now);
                    let Some(mut result_of_context_with_captured_scrollbar) = result_of_context_with_captured_scrollbar
                    else {
                        return result;
                    };
                    result_of_context_with_captured_scrollbar.frame_to_present = result.frame_to_present;
                    result_of_context_with_captured_scrollbar
                }
                MouseEventType::MouseWheel => context.borrow_mut().handle_mouse_event(event, now),
            }
        })();
        context.borrow_mut().set_pointer_in_nested_contexts(pointer);
        result
    }

    // A pinch is a ctrl+wheel event first, to the document under it, whose blocking wheel event listeners may cancel it
    // before anything zooms. Only the documents at the position can see that event.
    fn page_under_pinch_may_cancel_it(
        &self,
        context_id: CompositorContextId,
        context: &RefCell<ContextState>,
        mut position: FloatPoint,
    ) -> bool {
        let mut containing_context_id = context_id;
        let mut containing_context = context;
        // A walk down the nested contexts that outlasts the number of contexts went around a loop.
        for _ in 0..self.contexts.len() {
            if containing_context.borrow_mut().page_may_cancel_pinch_at(position) {
                return true;
            }
            let hit = containing_context.borrow_mut().nested_context_for_wheel_at(position);
            let Some(hit) = hit else { return false };
            // NB: Nothing is known yet of the listeners of a context that is not available.
            let Some(nested_context) = self.context_if_present(hit.child_context_id) else {
                return true;
            };
            if nested_context.borrow().parent_context_id() != Some(containing_context_id) {
                return true;
            }
            let Some(position_in_nested) = position_in_nested_context(&hit, nested_context) else {
                return true;
            };
            containing_context_id = hit.child_context_id;
            containing_context = nested_context;
            position = position_in_nested;
        }
        true
    }

    pub fn handle_and_dispatch_pinch_event(&self, context_id: CompositorContextId, mut event: PinchEvent) {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        // NB: The presentation connection only passes on input for the contexts bound to it.
        let context = self.context_if_present(context_id).expect("context exists");
        assert!(context.borrow().bound_presentation().is_some());
        let presentation_id = context.borrow().bound_presentation().unwrap();
        if !context.borrow().can_dispatch_input_to_web_content() {
            self.host.post_to_presentation(
                presentation_id,
                compositor_presentation_client::messages::DidNotDispatchInputEvent {
                    context_id,
                    event_id: event.id,
                },
            );
            return;
        }

        // The first step of a gesture decides for the steps after it: a gesture the page let through zooms from here on,
        // whatever listeners have appeared since, and any other leaves each step to the page, wherever the pinch has moved.
        // A page that already let this step through leaves only the zoom to do.
        let position = FloatPoint {
            x: event.position.x as f32,
            y: event.position.y as f32,
        };
        let may_zoom = if event.continues_gesture {
            context.borrow().pinch_gesture_was_let_through()
        } else {
            !self.page_under_pinch_may_cancel_it(context_id, context, position)
        };
        if event.wheel_event_was_dispatched || may_zoom {
            let result = context.borrow_mut().handle_pinch_event(&event);
            event.async_zoom_performed_default_action = self.apply_context_update_result(context_id, context, &result);
        }
        context
            .borrow_mut()
            .set_pinch_gesture_was_let_through(event.async_zoom_performed_default_action);

        // The scroll updates the event produced reach WebContent ahead of the event itself on the same connection.
        self.publish_pending_async_scroll_updates(context_id, context);
        context.borrow().dispatch_pinch_event_to_web_content(&event);
        self.host.post_to_presentation(
            presentation_id,
            compositor_presentation_client::messages::DidDispatchInputEvent {
                context_id,
                event_id: event.id,
                performed_default_action: event.async_zoom_performed_default_action,
            },
        );
    }
}
