// The time a display list takes to be taken in, which WebContent's time to publish it is logged next to.
fn display_list_timing_enabled() -> bool {
    static ENABLED: std::sync::OnceLock<bool> = std::sync::OnceLock::new();
    *ENABLED.get_or_init(|| {
        std::env::var_os("LADYBIRD_DISPLAY_LIST_TIMING").is_some_and(|value| !value.is_empty() && value != "0")
    })
}

const DISPLAY_LIST_WITH_UNUSABLE_SCROLLING_STATE: &str =
    "WebContent published a display list with scrolling state the compositor cannot use";

fn misbehavior_of_layer_plan(why_plan_fails_checks: &'static str) -> Misbehavior {
    let _ = writeln!(
        std::io::stderr(),
        "Compositor: Rejecting plan of layers from WebContent: {why_plan_fails_checks}"
    );
    Misbehavior("WebContent sent a plan of layers that does not fit its display list and visual context tree")
}

// The main thread allocates the ids of the scrolls it requests from here up, so that they never meet the ids the
// compositor allocates for scrolls of its own.
const FIRST_OPERATION_ID_THE_MAIN_THREAD_REQUESTS: AsyncScrollOperationID = 1 << 63;

// Wheel deltas are scrolled by as floats.
fn is_valid_wheel_delta(delta: f64) -> bool {
    delta.is_finite() && delta.abs() <= f32::MAX as f64
}

fn is_valid_wheel_event(event: &MouseEvent) -> bool {
    event.r#type == MouseEventType::MouseWheel
        && is_valid_wheel_delta(event.wheel_delta_x)
        && is_valid_wheel_delta(event.wheel_delta_y)
}

fn is_valid_wheel_step_let_through(step: &WheelStepLetThrough) -> bool {
    step.position.x.is_finite()
        && step.position.y.is_finite()
        && step.delta_in_css_pixels.x.is_finite()
        && step.delta_in_css_pixels.y.is_finite()
}

fn is_valid_scroll_request(scroll_request: &ScrollRequest) -> bool {
    let is_finite = |point: FloatPoint| point.x.is_finite() && point.y.is_finite();
    if scroll_request
        .jump_offset
        .is_some_and(|jump_offset| !is_finite(jump_offset))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if let Some(relative_scroll) = &scroll_request.relative_scroll {
        if !is_finite(relative_scroll.delta)
            || !is_finite(relative_scroll.lower_bound)
            || !is_finite(relative_scroll.upper_bound)
        {
            return false;
        }
        if relative_scroll.lower_bound.x > relative_scroll.upper_bound.x
            || relative_scroll.lower_bound.y > relative_scroll.upper_bound.y
        {
            return false;
        }
    }
    if let Some(scale) = scroll_request.visual_viewport_scale
        && (!scale.is_finite() || scale <= 0.0)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if let Some(smooth_scroll) = &scroll_request.smooth_scroll {
        if !is_finite(smooth_scroll.destination_offset) {
            return false;
        }
        if !(smooth_scroll.relative_lower_bound.x <= smooth_scroll.relative_upper_bound.x
            && smooth_scroll.relative_lower_bound.y <= smooth_scroll.relative_upper_bound.y)
        {
            return false;
        }
        // WebContent names the compositor's own scrolls only to head them somewhere else.
        if smooth_scroll.operation_id < FIRST_OPERATION_ID_THE_MAIN_THREAD_REQUESTS
            && !smooth_scroll.retargets_operation
        {
            return false;
        }
    }
    true
}

// NB: The IPC decoder already rejects key codes, event types, wheel delta precisions and scroll gesture phases that do
//     not exist, and pinch scales that are not finite. These check the rest of what the UI sends.

fn is_valid_modifiers(modifiers: KeyModifier) -> bool {
    (modifiers & !KeyModifier::Mod_Mask).is_empty()
}

fn is_valid_key_event(event: &KeyEvent) -> bool {
    is_valid_modifiers(event.modifiers)
        && event.code_point <= 0x10ffff
        // Only the compositor sets this, on its way to WebContent.
        && !event.async_scroll_performed_default_action
}

fn is_valid_mouse_event(event: &MouseEvent) -> bool {
    let all_buttons = MouseButton::Primary
        | MouseButton::Secondary
        | MouseButton::Middle
        | MouseButton::Backward
        | MouseButton::Forward;
    [
        MouseButton::None,
        MouseButton::Primary,
        MouseButton::Secondary,
        MouseButton::Middle,
        MouseButton::Backward,
        MouseButton::Forward,
    ]
    .contains(&event.button)
        && (event.buttons & !all_buttons).is_empty()
        && is_valid_modifiers(event.modifiers)
        && is_valid_wheel_delta(event.wheel_delta_x)
        && is_valid_wheel_delta(event.wheel_delta_y)
        && is_valid_wheel_delta(event.wheel_tick_120ths_x)
        && is_valid_wheel_delta(event.wheel_tick_120ths_y)
        && event.click_count >= 0
        // Only the compositor sets these, on its way to WebContent.
        && !event.async_scroll_performed_default_action
        && event.scrollbar_dragged_by_compositor.is_none()
        && event.wheel_gesture_mark.is_none()
}

fn is_valid_pinch_event(event: &PinchEvent) -> bool {
    is_valid_modifiers(event.modifiers)
        // Only the compositor sets this, on its way to WebContent.
        && !event.async_zoom_performed_default_action
}

impl CompositorCore {
    fn context_is_owned_by(
        &self,
        context_id: CompositorContextId,
        client_id: WebContentClientId,
    ) -> Result<bool, Misbehavior> {
        match self.check_context_owner(context_id, client_id) {
            ContextOwnerCheckResult::OwnedByClient => Ok(true),
            ContextOwnerCheckResult::ContextUnavailable => Ok(false),
            ContextOwnerCheckResult::ConflictingOwner => Err(Misbehavior(
                "WebContent tried to use a compositor context owned by another connection",
            )),
        }
    }

    fn is_bound_to(&self, context_id: CompositorContextId, presentation_id: PresentationId) -> bool {
        self.context_if_present(context_id)
            .is_some_and(|context| context.borrow().bound_presentation() == Some(presentation_id))
    }
}

pub struct MessagesFromWebContent<'a> {
    pub core: &'a CompositorCore,
    pub client_id: WebContentClientId,
    pub now: MonotonicTime,
}

impl MessagesFromWebContent<'_> {
    fn context_is_owned_by_sender(&self, context_id: CompositorContextId) -> Result<bool, Misbehavior> {
        self.core.context_is_owned_by(context_id, self.client_id)
    }
}

impl MessagesFromWebContent<'_> {
    /// Rasterizes the display list `message` hands over into the bitmap staged for it, and answers whether it did.
    fn rasterize_staged_display_list(&mut self, message: RasterizeDisplayList) -> Result<bool, Misbehavior> {
        let raster = self.core.raster();
        let (client, token) = (self.client_id.0, message.token);
        let not_rasterized = |reason: &str| {
            let _ = writeln!(
                std::io::stderr(),
                "Compositor: Not rasterizing display list from WebContent: {reason}"
            );
            raster.discard_staged_rasterization(client, token);
            Ok(false)
        };
        let SharedDisplayList {
            chunks_in_paint_order,
            packed_chunks,
            packed_chunk_sizes,
            properties,
            ..
        } = message.display_list;
        let storage = match raster
            .receive_display_list_chunks(packed_chunks, &packed_chunk_sizes)
            .and_then(|sent| chunks_of_list_sent_whole(sent, &chunks_in_paint_order))
            .and_then(DisplayListStorage::of_chunks)
        {
            Ok(storage) => storage,
            Err(error) => {
                let _ = writeln!(
                    std::io::stderr(),
                    "Compositor: Rejecting display list to rasterize from WebContent: {error}"
                );
                raster.discard_staged_rasterization(client, token);
                return Err(Misbehavior(
                    "WebContent asked to rasterize a display list its shared buffer does not hold",
                ));
            }
        };
        let tree = message.visual_context_tree;
        if properties.compatible_visual_context_tree_structural_epoch != tree.structural_epoch
            || !tree.display_list_references_only_live_nodes(storage.runs())
        {
            return not_rasterized("Display list does not match its visual context tree");
        }
        let summary = storage.summary();
        let mut image_frame_ids = summary.image_frame_ids.clone();
        tree.for_each_effects_filter_image_frame_id(&mut |id| image_frame_ids.push(id));
        if !raster.staged_rasterization_has_resources(client, token, &summary.font_ids, &image_frame_ids) {
            return not_rasterized("Display list draws resources that were not staged for it");
        }
        let time_ns = self.now.nanoseconds();
        let success = raster.rasterize_staged(client, token, |painter| {
            let frame = ReplayFrame::unscrolled(time_ns);
            replay_display_list(
                &tree,
                &storage,
                properties.root_group_color,
                &frame,
                ReplaySelection::default(),
                painter,
            );
        });
        Ok(success)
    }
}

fn misbehavior(error: ReplayError) -> Misbehavior {
    Misbehavior(error.0)
}

impl MessagesFromWebContent<'_> {
    fn map_shared_memory(&self, buffer: Core_AnonymousBuffer) -> Result<Option<SharedMemory>, Misbehavior> {
        self.core.raster().map_shared_memory(buffer).ok_or(Misbehavior(
            "WebContent sent shared memory that does not hold as much as it claims",
        ))
    }
}

    fn update_display_list(&mut self, message: UpdateDisplayList) -> Result<(), Misbehavior> {
        let started_at = std::time::Instant::now();
        let SharedDisplayList {
            chunks_in_paint_order,
            packed_chunks,
            packed_chunk_sizes,
            properties,
            async_scrolling_metadata,
        } = message.display_list;
        let sent = match self
            .core
            .raster()
            .receive_display_list_chunks(packed_chunks, &packed_chunk_sizes)
        {
            Ok(sent) => sent,
            Err(error) => {
                let _ = writeln!(
                    std::io::stderr(),
                    "Compositor: Rejecting display list from WebContent: {error}"
                );
                return Err(Misbehavior(
                    "WebContent published a display list its shared buffer does not hold",
                ));
            }
        };
        let sent_chunk_count = sent.len();
        // The chunks are taken in before anything else is checked: the list counts as one of the latest of the context
        // on both ends whether it is installed or not.
        let chunks = match self.core.take_in_display_list_chunks(
            self.client_id,
            message.context_id,
            sent,
            &chunks_in_paint_order,
        ) {
            Ok(Some(chunks)) => chunks,
            Ok(None) => return Ok(()),
            Err(error) => return Err(Misbehavior(error)),
        };
        let chunk_count = chunks.len();
        let storage = match DisplayListStorage::of_chunks(chunks) {
            Ok(storage) => storage,
            Err(error) => {
                let _ = writeln!(
                    std::io::stderr(),
                    "Compositor: Dropping display list update from WebContent: {error}"
                );
                return Ok(());
            }
        };
        let adopt_time = started_at.elapsed();
        let tree = message.visual_context_tree;
        if !self.context_is_owned_by_sender(message.context_id)? {
            return Ok(());
        }
        self.core.forget_layer_plan(message.context_id);
        if properties.compatible_visual_context_tree_structural_epoch != tree.structural_epoch {
            let _ = writeln!(
                std::io::stderr(),
                "Compositor: Dropping inconsistent display list update (display list epoch {}, tree epoch {})",
                properties.compatible_visual_context_tree_structural_epoch,
                tree.structural_epoch
            );
            return Ok(());
        }
        if !tree.display_list_references_only_live_nodes(storage.runs()) {
            let _ = writeln!(
                std::io::stderr(),
                "Compositor: Dropping display list update that names nodes its visual context tree does not hold"
            );
            return Ok(());
        }
        if !self
            .core
            .raster()
            .context_holds_fonts(message.context_id, &storage.summary().font_ids)
        {
            let _ = writeln!(
                std::io::stderr(),
                "Compositor: Dropping display list update that draws fonts its context does not hold"
            );
            return Ok(());
        }
        let mut image_frame_ids = storage.summary().image_frame_ids.clone();
        tree.for_each_effects_filter_image_frame_id(&mut |id| image_frame_ids.push(id));
        if !self
            .core
            .raster()
            .take_registered_image_frames(message.context_id, &image_frame_ids)
        {
            let _ = writeln!(
                std::io::stderr(),
                "Compositor: Dropping display list update that draws image frames that are not registered"
            );
            return Ok(());
        }
        let window = match properties.window.as_ref().map(RecordedWindow::from_ipc) {
            Some(None) => {
                let _ = writeln!(
                    std::io::stderr(),
                    "Compositor: Dropping display list update whose window no recording could have placed"
                );
                return Ok(());
            }
            window => window.flatten(),
        };
        let scroll_state_snapshot = message.scroll_state;
        let storage_size = storage.byte_size();
        let display_list = DisplayList::new(
            storage,
            properties.id,
            properties.compatible_visual_context_tree_structural_epoch,
            async_scrolling_metadata,
            properties.surface_clear_color,
            properties.root_group_color,
        )
        .with_window(window);
        if !self.core.install_display_list_update(
            message.context_id,
            Rc::new(display_list),
            AccumulatedVisualContextTree::from_arc(tree),
            scroll_state_snapshot,
            self.now,
        ) {
            return Err(Misbehavior(DISPLAY_LIST_WITH_UNUSABLE_SCROLLING_STATE));
        }
        self.core
            .take_layer_plan_of_installed_update(
                message.context_id,
                message.layer_plan.map(LayerPlanOnWire::into_received),
            )
            .map_err(misbehavior_of_layer_plan)?;
        self.core.keep_only_drawn_resources(message.context_id);
        if display_list_timing_enabled() {
            let _ = writeln!(
                std::io::stderr(),
                "DISPLAY_LIST_RECEIVE bytes={} chunks={} sent={sent_chunk_count} adopt={} µs install={} µs",
                storage_size,
                chunk_count,
                adopt_time.as_micros(),
                (started_at.elapsed() - adopt_time).as_micros()
            );
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    fn update_visual_context_tree(&mut self, message: UpdateVisualContextTree) -> Result<(), Misbehavior> {
        let scroll_state_snapshot = message.scroll_state;
        if !scroll_state_snapshot.has_only_finite_offsets() {
            return Err(Misbehavior(
                "WebContent published a visual context tree with a scroll state the compositor cannot use",
            ));
        }
        let tree = message.visual_context_tree;
        if !self.context_is_owned_by_sender(message.context_id)? {
            return Ok(());
        }
        self.core.forget_layer_plan(message.context_id);
        let mut image_frame_ids = Vec::new();
        tree.for_each_effects_filter_image_frame_id(&mut |id| image_frame_ids.push(id));
        if !self
            .core
            .raster()
            .take_registered_image_frames(message.context_id, &image_frame_ids)
        {
            let _ = writeln!(
                std::io::stderr(),
                "Compositor: Dropping visual context tree update that draws image frames that are not registered"
            );
            return Ok(());
        }
        let tree_was_replaced = self.core.update_visual_context_tree(
            message.context_id,
            AccumulatedVisualContextTree::from_arc(tree),
            scroll_state_snapshot,
            message.keyboard_scroll_state,
            self.now,
        );
        if tree_was_replaced {
            self.core
                .take_layer_plan_of_installed_update(
                    message.context_id,
                    message.layer_plan.map(LayerPlanOnWire::into_received),
                )
                .map_err(misbehavior_of_layer_plan)?;
            self.core.keep_only_drawn_resources(message.context_id);
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    fn rasterize_display_list(
        &mut self,
        message: RasterizeDisplayList,
    ) -> Result<RasterizeDisplayListResponse, Misbehavior> {
        Ok(RasterizeDisplayListResponse {
            success: self.rasterize_staged_display_list(message)?,
        })
    }

    fn update_scroll_state(&mut self, message: UpdateScrollState) -> Result<(), Misbehavior> {
        let scroll_state_snapshot = message.scroll_state;
        if !scroll_state_snapshot.has_only_finite_offsets() {
            return Err(Misbehavior("Invalid scroll state"));
        }
        if self.context_is_owned_by_sender(message.context_id)? {
            self.core
                .update_scroll_state(message.context_id, scroll_state_snapshot, message.keyboard_scroll_state);
            self.core
                .take_layer_plan_of_scroll_state(
                    message.context_id,
                    message.layer_plan.map(LayerPlanOnWire::into_received),
                )
                .map_err(misbehavior_of_layer_plan)?;
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    fn invalidate_wheel_event_listener_state(
        &mut self,
        message: InvalidateWheelEventListenerState,
    ) -> Result<(), Misbehavior> {
        if self.context_is_owned_by_sender(message.context_id)? {
            self.core
                .invalidate_wheel_event_listener_state(message.context_id, message.generation);
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    fn invalidate_keyboard_scroll_state(
        &mut self,
        message: InvalidateKeyboardScrollState,
    ) -> Result<InvalidateKeyboardScrollStateResponse, Misbehavior> {
        if self.context_is_owned_by_sender(message.context_id)? {
            self.core
                .invalidate_keyboard_scroll_state(message.context_id, message.generation);
        }
        Ok(InvalidateKeyboardScrollStateResponse)
    }

    fn take_wheel_event_from_main_thread(
        &mut self,
        message: TakeWheelEventFromMainThread,
    ) -> Result<TakeWheelEventFromMainThreadResponse, Misbehavior> {
        let answer = if self.context_is_owned_by_sender(message.context_id)? && is_valid_wheel_event(&message.event) {
            self.core.take_wheel_event_from_main_thread(
                message.context_id,
                &message.event,
                message.operation_tracking,
                message.routing,
                self.now,
            )
        } else {
            WheelEventAnswer::default()
        };
        Ok(TakeWheelEventFromMainThreadResponse { answer })
    }

    fn wheel_event_let_through(
        &mut self,
        message: WheelEventLetThrough,
    ) -> Result<WheelEventLetThroughResponse, Misbehavior> {
        let answer =
            if self.context_is_owned_by_sender(message.context_id)? && is_valid_wheel_step_let_through(&message.step) {
                self.core.scroll_for_wheel_event_the_page_let_through(
                    message.context_id,
                    &message.step,
                    message.operation_tracking,
                    self.client_id,
                    self.now,
                )
            } else {
                WheelEventAnswer::default()
            };
        Ok(WheelEventLetThroughResponse { answer })
    }

    fn wheel_event_canceled(&mut self, message: WheelEventCanceled) -> Result<(), Misbehavior> {
        if self.context_is_owned_by_sender(message.context_id)? {
            self.core
                .forget_wheel_gesture_the_page_canceled(message.context_id, message.wheel_gesture_id);
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    fn apply_scroll_requests(&mut self, message: ApplyScrollRequests) -> Result<(), Misbehavior> {
        if !self.context_is_owned_by_sender(message.context_id)? {
            return Ok(());
        }
        if !message.scroll_requests.iter().all(is_valid_scroll_request) {
            return Err(Misbehavior("Invalid scroll request"));
        }
        self.core
            .apply_scroll_requests(message.context_id, &message.scroll_requests, self.now);
        Ok(())
    }

    fn scroll_state_for_testing(
        &mut self,
        message: ScrollStateForTesting,
    ) -> Result<ScrollStateForTestingResponse, Misbehavior> {
        let scroll_state = if self.context_is_owned_by_sender(message.context_id)? {
            self.core
                .scroll_state_for_testing(message.context_id, message.stretched_scroller)
        } else {
            String::new()
        };
        Ok(ScrollStateForTestingResponse {
            scroll_state: scroll_state.into(),
        })
    }

    fn route_first_wheel_step_for_testing(
        &mut self,
        message: RouteFirstWheelStepForTesting,
    ) -> Result<RouteFirstWheelStepForTestingResponse, Misbehavior> {
        let route = if self.context_is_owned_by_sender(message.context_id)? {
            self.core.route_first_wheel_step_for_testing(
                message.context_id,
                message.position,
                message.delta_in_css_pixels,
            )
        } else {
            None
        };
        Ok(match route {
            Some(route) => RouteFirstWheelStepForTestingResponse {
                decision: Some(route.route.decision),
                scroller: route.route.scroller,
                document_id: route.document_id,
            },
            None => RouteFirstWheelStepForTestingResponse {
                decision: None,
                scroller: None,
                document_id: None,
            },
        })
    }

    fn begin_input_trace_for_testing(
        &mut self,
        message: BeginInputTraceForTesting,
    ) -> Result<BeginInputTraceForTestingResponse, Misbehavior> {
        if self.context_is_owned_by_sender(message.context_id)? {
            self.core.begin_input_trace_for_testing(message.context_id);
        }
        Ok(BeginInputTraceForTestingResponse)
    }

    fn clear_per_test_input_state_for_testing(
        &mut self,
        message: ClearPerTestInputStateForTesting,
    ) -> Result<ClearPerTestInputStateForTestingResponse, Misbehavior> {
        if self.context_is_owned_by_sender(message.context_id)? {
            self.core.clear_per_test_input_state_for_testing(message.context_id);
        }
        Ok(ClearPerTestInputStateForTestingResponse)
    }

    fn take_input_trace_for_testing(
        &mut self,
        message: TakeInputTraceForTesting,
    ) -> Result<TakeInputTraceForTestingResponse, Misbehavior> {
        let records = if self.context_is_owned_by_sender(message.context_id)? {
            self.core.take_input_trace_for_testing(message.context_id)
        } else {
            Vec::new()
        };
        Ok(TakeInputTraceForTestingResponse { records })
    }

    fn take_pending_async_scroll_updates(
        &mut self,
        message: TakePendingAsyncScrollUpdates,
    ) -> Result<TakePendingAsyncScrollUpdatesResponse, Misbehavior> {
        let updates = if self.context_is_owned_by_sender(message.context_id)? {
            self.core.take_pending_async_scroll_updates(message.context_id)
        } else {
            PendingAsyncScrollUpdates::default()
        };
        Ok(TakePendingAsyncScrollUpdatesResponse { updates })
    }
}

pub struct MessagesFromPresentation<'a> {
    pub core: &'a CompositorCore,
    pub presentation_id: PresentationId,
    pub now: MonotonicTime,
}

impl MessagesFromPresentation<'_> {
    fn sender_gives_input_to(&self, context_id: CompositorContextId, event_id: u64) -> bool {
        if self.core.is_bound_to(context_id, self.presentation_id) {
            return true;
        }
        self.core
            .host
            .post_to_presentation(self.presentation_id, DidNotDispatchInputEvent { context_id, event_id });
        false
    }
}

impl compositor_presentation_server::Stub for MessagesFromPresentation<'_> {
    fn handle_and_dispatch_key_event(&mut self, message: HandleAndDispatchKeyEvent) -> Result<(), Misbehavior> {
        if !is_valid_key_event(&message.event) {
            return Err(Misbehavior("Invalid key event"));
        }
        if self.sender_gives_input_to(message.context_id, message.event.id) {
            self.core.handle_and_dispatch_key_event(
                message.context_id,
                message.event,
                message.allow_keyboard_scroll,
                self.now,
            );
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    fn handle_and_dispatch_pinch_event(&mut self, message: HandleAndDispatchPinchEvent) -> Result<(), Misbehavior> {
        if !is_valid_pinch_event(&message.event) {
            return Err(Misbehavior("Invalid pinch event"));
        }
        if self.sender_gives_input_to(message.context_id, message.event.id) {
            self.core
                .handle_and_dispatch_pinch_event(message.context_id, message.event);
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    fn handle_and_dispatch_mouse_event(&mut self, message: HandleAndDispatchMouseEvent) -> Result<(), Misbehavior> {
        if !is_valid_mouse_event(&message.event) {
            return Err(Misbehavior("Invalid mouse event"));
        }
        if self.sender_gives_input_to(message.context_id, message.event.id) {
            self.core
                .handle_and_dispatch_mouse_event(message.context_id, message.event, self.now);
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

pub struct MessagesFromControl<'a> {
    pub core: &'a CompositorCore,
    pub now: MonotonicTime,
}

impl compositor_control_server::Stub for MessagesFromControl<'_> {
    fn create_remote_layer(&mut self, message: CreateRemoteLayer) -> Result<CreateRemoteLayerResponse, Misbehavior> {
        let host_handle = self
            .core
            .create_remote_layer(PresentationId(message.presentation_id), message.remote_layer_id)
            .unwrap_or_else(|| {
                let _ = writeln!(
                    std::io::stderr(),
                    "Compositor: Ignoring remote layer {} for presentation {}, which is already gone",
                    message.remote_layer_id,
                    message.presentation_id
                );
                Compositing_RemoteLayerHostHandle {
                    kind: Compositing_RemoteLayerHostKind::None,
                    id: 0,
                }
            });
        Ok(CreateRemoteLayerResponse { host_handle })
    }

    fn destroy_remote_layer(&mut self, message: DestroyRemoteLayer) -> Result<(), Misbehavior> {
        self.core.destroy_remote_layer(message.remote_layer_id, self.now);
        Ok(())
    }

    fn show_context_in_remote_layer(&mut self, message: ShowContextInRemoteLayer) -> Result<(), Misbehavior> {
        self.core
            .show_context_in_remote_layer(message.remote_layer_id, message.context_id, self.now);
        Ok(())
    }

    fn set_remote_layer_fit(&mut self, message: SetRemoteLayerFit) -> Result<(), Misbehavior> {
        if message.fit_within.is_some_and(IntSize::is_empty) {
            return Err(Misbehavior("Empty size for a remote layer to fit frames within"));
        }
        self.core
            .set_remote_layer_fit(message.remote_layer_id, message.fit_within);
        Ok(())
    }

    fn begin_synchronized_resize(&mut self, message: BeginSynchronizedResize) -> Result<(), Misbehavior> {
        self.core
            .begin_synchronized_resize(message.remote_layer_id, message.token);
        Ok(())
    }

    fn await_synchronized_resize_frame(&mut self, message: AwaitSynchronizedResizeFrame) -> Result<(), Misbehavior> {
        self.core
            .await_synchronized_resize_frame(message.remote_layer_id, message.token, message.size);
        Ok(())
    }

    fn commit_synchronized_resize(&mut self, message: CommitSynchronizedResize) -> Result<(), Misbehavior> {
        self.core
            .commit_synchronized_resize(message.remote_layer_id, message.token);
        Ok(())
    }
}

//! Context lifecycle, frame scheduling, and input routing for the compositor.

mod input;
pub mod messages;

mod remote_layers;

use crate::host::{
    ContextTimer, DisplayTickInputs, DisplayTickResult, Host, PendingFrame, PresentRequest, PresentScheduling,
    PresentationId, Timer, WebContentClientId,
};
use crate::overlays::{UIOverlays, UIOverlaysChange};
use crate::presenting::ContextPresenting;
use crate::raster_host::RasterHost;
use crate::remote_layers::RemoteLayers;
use crate::surfaces::painting_surface::PaintingSurface;
use crate::wheel_gesture_routing::WheelGestureIdAllocator;

    AccumulatedVisualContextTree, CompositorContextId, DisplayList, KeyboardScrollState, ScrollStateSnapshot,

pub struct CompositorCore {
    host: Rc<Host>,
    raster: RasterHost,
    gpu: GpuBackend,
    contexts: HashMap<CompositorContextId, RefCell<ContextState>>,
    presenting: HashMap<CompositorContextId, RefCell<ContextPresenting>>,
    presentations: RefCell<HashMap<PresentationId, PresentationCapabilities>>,
    async_presents: RefCell<Vec<PendingAsyncPresent>>,
    window_server_may_show_high_dynamic_range: Cell<bool>,
    present_requests: RefCell<Vec<PresentRequest>>,
    is_entered: Cell<bool>,
    wheel_gesture_id_allocator: Rc<WheelGestureIdAllocator>,
    scrollbars_always_shown: bool,
    display_list_chunk_stores: RefCell<crate::display_list_chunk_stores::DisplayListChunkStores>,
    remote_layers: RefCell<RemoteLayers>,
    canvas_2d_contexts: RefCell<crate::canvas_2d_contexts::Canvas2DContexts>,
    webgl_contexts: RefCell<crate::webgl::WebGLContexts>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(u8)]
pub enum ContextOwnerCheckResult {
    OwnedByClient,
    ContextUnavailable,
    ConflictingOwner,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum WheelStepOrigin {
    UI,
    Fling,
    MainThread,
}

// How a wheel step went in a context that presented and published what the step changed itself.
#[derive(Default)]
struct AppliedWheelStep {
    // What is left for the context that routes the step to present and report.
    result: ContextUpdateResult,
    presents_frame: bool,
}

struct NestedContextTakingWheelStep<'a> {
    context_id: CompositorContextId,
    // Null when the step cannot be handed to the context.
    context: Option<&'a RefCell<ContextState>>,
    position: FloatPoint,
    route: FirstWheelStepRoute,
}

struct FirstWheelStepInNestedContexts<'a> {
    // The innermost context that the step went into, whose page sees the step.
    innermost_context_id: CompositorContextId,
    // The context that takes the step, which is empty when each of them passes the step on.
    taking_context: Option<NestedContextTakingWheelStep<'a>>,
}

struct Entered<'a>(&'a Cell<bool>);

impl<'a> Entered<'a> {
    fn new(is_entered: &'a Cell<bool>) -> Self {
        assert!(!is_entered.get());
        is_entered.set(true);
        Self(is_entered)
    }
}

impl Drop for Entered<'_> {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        self.0.set(false);
    }
}

impl CompositorCore {
    pub fn new(host: Rc<Host>, raster: RasterHost, scrollbars_always_shown: bool, gpu: GpuBackend) -> Self {
        Self {
            host,
            raster,
            gpu,
            contexts: HashMap::new(),
            presenting: HashMap::new(),
            presentations: RefCell::new(HashMap::new()),
            async_presents: RefCell::new(Vec::new()),
            window_server_may_show_high_dynamic_range: Cell::new(true),
            present_requests: RefCell::new(Vec::new()),
            is_entered: Cell::new(false),
            wheel_gesture_id_allocator: Rc::new(WheelGestureIdAllocator::default()),
            scrollbars_always_shown,
            display_list_chunk_stores: RefCell::default(),
            remote_layers: RefCell::default(),
            canvas_2d_contexts: RefCell::default(),
            webgl_contexts: RefCell::default(),
        }
    }

    /// Takes in the chunks of the display list `client` sent for `context_id` (see [`DisplayListChunkStores::take_in`]).
    ///
    /// [`DisplayListChunkStores::take_in`]: crate::display_list_chunk_stores::DisplayListChunkStores::take_in
    pub fn take_in_display_list_chunks(
        &self,
        client: WebContentClientId,
        context_id: CompositorContextId,
        sent: Vec<libcompositing_rust::display_list::storage::ListChunk>,
        chunks_in_paint_order: &[libcompositing_rust::display_list::chunks::ChunkId],
    ) -> Result<Option<Vec<std::sync::Arc<libcompositing_rust::display_list::storage::ListChunk>>>, &'static str> {
        self.display_list_chunk_stores
            .borrow_mut()
            .take_in(client, context_id, sent, chunks_in_paint_order)
    }

    pub fn raster(&self) -> &RasterHost {
        &self.raster
    }

    pub fn canvas_2d_contexts(&self) -> std::cell::RefMut<'_, crate::canvas_2d_contexts::Canvas2DContexts> {
        self.canvas_2d_contexts.borrow_mut()
    }

    pub fn webgl_contexts(&self) -> std::cell::RefMut<'_, crate::webgl::WebGLContexts> {
        self.webgl_contexts.borrow_mut()
    }

    /// Schedules what a message the core took asked for.
    pub fn finish_message(&self, now: MonotonicTime) {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        self.finish_entry(now);
    }

    pub fn create_context(
        &mut self,
        context_id: CompositorContextId,
        page_id: Option<u64>,
        web_content_client_id: WebContentClientId,
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) {
        let _entered = Entered::new(&self.is_entered);

        assert!(!self.contexts.contains_key(&context_id));
        if let Some(page_id) = page_id {
            assert!(page_id > 0);
            assert_eq!(context_id.0, page_id);
        }

        self.contexts.entry(context_id).or_insert_with(|| {
            RefCell::new(ContextState::new(
                context_id,
                page_id,
                web_content_client_id,
                self.host.clone(),
                self.wheel_gesture_id_allocator.clone(),
                self.scrollbars_always_shown,
            ))
        });
        self.presenting
            .insert(context_id, RefCell::new(ContextPresenting::new(page_id.is_some())));
        self.resize_backing_stores_if_needed(context_id, now);
        self.finish_entry(now);
    }

    // Also leaves the contexts nested in it without a parent.
    pub fn destroy_context(&mut self, context_id: CompositorContextId, now: MonotonicTime) {
        let _entered = Entered::new(&self.is_entered);

        assert!(self.context_if_present(context_id).is_some());
        self.cancel_pending_async_presents_for_context(context_id);
        self.clear_parent_context(context_id, now);
        for (&id, possible_child_context) in &self.contexts {
            if id == context_id {
                continue;
            }
            let parent_context_id = possible_child_context.borrow().parent_context_id();
            if parent_context_id == Some(context_id) {
                possible_child_context.borrow_mut().set_parent_context(None);
            }
        }
        self.contexts.remove(&context_id);
        self.presenting.remove(&context_id);
        self.remote_layers.borrow_mut().context_destroyed(context_id);
        self.host
            .destroy_timers(|timer| matches!(timer, Timer::Context(id, _) if *id == context_id));
        self.display_list_chunk_stores.borrow_mut().forget_context(context_id);
        self.update_scroll_capabilities();
        self.raster
            .set_maximum_display_refresh_rate(self.maximum_display_refresh_rate());
        self.finish_entry(now);
    }

    pub fn check_context_owner(
        &self,
        context_id: CompositorContextId,
        client: WebContentClientId,
    ) -> ContextOwnerCheckResult {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        let Some(context) = self.context_if_present(context_id) else {
            return ContextOwnerCheckResult::ContextUnavailable;
        };
        if !context.borrow().is_owned_by(client) {
            return ContextOwnerCheckResult::ConflictingOwner;
        }

        ContextOwnerCheckResult::OwnedByClient
    }

    // What a client shows is rooted at the context presented to it, and no context is nested in itself.
    pub fn context_can_be_nested_in(
        &self,
        context_id: CompositorContextId,
        parent_context_id: CompositorContextId,
    ) -> bool {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        let context = self.context_if_present(context_id).expect("context exists");
        !context.borrow().presents_to_client() && parent_context_id != context_id
    }

    pub fn presents_to_client(&self, context_id: CompositorContextId) -> bool {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        self.context_if_present(context_id)
            .is_some_and(|context| context.borrow().presents_to_client())
    }

    pub fn context_is_effectively_visible(&self, context_id: CompositorContextId) -> bool {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        self.context_if_present(context_id).is_some() && self.context_is_effectively_visible_inner(context_id)
    }

    pub fn parent_context(&self, context_id: CompositorContextId) -> Option<CompositorContextId> {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        self.context_if_present(context_id)
            .and_then(|context| context.borrow().parent_context_id())
    }

    pub fn bound_presentation(&self, context_id: CompositorContextId) -> Option<PresentationId> {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        self.context_if_present(context_id)
            .and_then(|context| context.borrow().bound_presentation())
    }

    pub fn set_parent_context(
        &self,
        context_id: CompositorContextId,
        parent_context_id: Option<CompositorContextId>,
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        self.set_parent_context_inner(context_id, parent_context_id, now);
        self.finish_entry(now);
    }

    pub fn stop_presenting_to_client(&self, context_id: CompositorContextId, now: MonotonicTime) {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        let context = self.context_if_present(context_id).expect("context exists");
        self.unbind_presentation_inner(context_id, now);
        context.borrow_mut().stop_presenting_to_client();
        if let Some(presenting) = self.presenting_of(context_id) {
            presenting.borrow_mut().presents_to_client = false;
        }
        self.finish_entry(now);
    }

    pub fn viewport_size_updated(
        &self,
        context_id: CompositorContextId,
        viewport_size: IntSize,
        device_pixel_ratio: f64,
        window_resize_in_progress: bool,
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        let (Some(context), Some(presenting)) = (self.context_if_present(context_id), self.presenting_of(context_id))
        else {
            return;
        };
        let overlays_repaint_everything = context
            .borrow_mut()
            .viewport_size_updated(viewport_size, device_pixel_ratio);
        let is_page_presentation_context = {
            let context = context.borrow();
            context.page_id().is_some() && context.parent_context_id().is_none()
        };
        presenting.borrow_mut().set_viewport_size(
            viewport_size,
            device_pixel_ratio,
            is_page_presentation_context && window_resize_in_progress,
        );
        self.resize_backing_stores_if_needed(context_id, now);
        if overlays_repaint_everything {
            self.request_present_repainting_everything(context_id, context);
        }
        if presenting.borrow().window_resize_in_progress() {
            presenting
                .borrow()
                .schedule_backing_store_shrink(context_id, &self.host);
        }
        self.finish_entry(now);
    }

    pub fn set_ui_overlays(&self, context_id: CompositorContextId, ui_overlays: UIOverlays, now: MonotonicTime) {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        let Some(context) = self.context_if_present(context_id) else {
            return;
        };
        let change = context.borrow_mut().set_ui_overlays(ui_overlays, now);
        match change {
            UIOverlaysChange::Nothing => {}
            UIOverlaysChange::OnlyCompositorLayers => self.request_present_keeping_tiles(context_id),
            UIOverlaysChange::RepaintsEverything => self.request_present_repainting_everything(context_id, context),
        }
        self.finish_entry(now);
    }

    fn request_present_keeping_tiles(&self, context_id: CompositorContextId) {
        self.present_requests.borrow_mut().push(PresentRequest {
            context_id,
            viewport_rect: None,
            forced_damage_rect: Default::default(),
            scheduling: PresentScheduling::OnNextDisplayTick,
        });
    }

    // A frame at the viewport rect the context is presented at, which repaints all of it.
    fn request_present_repainting_everything(&self, context_id: CompositorContextId, context: &RefCell<ContextState>) {
        self.present_requests.borrow_mut().push(PresentRequest {
            context_id,
            viewport_rect: None,
            forced_damage_rect: context.borrow().viewport_rect(),
            scheduling: PresentScheduling::OnNextDisplayTick,
        });
    }

    pub fn register_presentation(&self, presentation_id: PresentationId, capabilities: PresentationCapabilities) {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        self.presentations.borrow_mut().insert(presentation_id, capabilities);
        self.remote_layers
            .borrow_mut()
            .register_presentation(presentation_id, &self.raster);
    }

    // Leaves every context bound to the presentation unbound.
    pub fn unregister_presentation(&self, presentation_id: PresentationId, now: MonotonicTime) {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        let was_holding_changes = self.remote_layers.borrow().is_holding_changes();
        let stopped = self
            .remote_layers
            .borrow_mut()
            .unregister_presentation(presentation_id, &self.raster);
        self.update_synchronized_resize_hold_timer(was_holding_changes);
        for context_id in stopped {
            self.stop_showing_context_in_remote_layer(context_id, now);
        }

        let bound_context_ids: Vec<CompositorContextId> = self
            .contexts
            .iter()
            .filter(|(_, context)| context.borrow().bound_presentation() == Some(presentation_id))
            .map(|(&context_id, _)| context_id)
            .collect();
        for context_id in bound_context_ids {
            self.unbind_presentation_inner(context_id, now);
        }
        self.presentations.borrow_mut().remove(&presentation_id);
        self.finish_entry(now);
    }

    pub fn set_presentation_gpu_capability(
        &self,
        presentation_id: PresentationId,
        supported: bool,
        adapter_luid: u64,
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        {
            let mut presentations = self.presentations.borrow_mut();
            let Some(capabilities) = presentations.get_mut(&presentation_id) else {
                return;
            };
            let gpu_presentation_adapter_luid = supported.then_some(adapter_luid);
            if capabilities.gpu_presentation_adapter_luid == gpu_presentation_adapter_luid
                && capabilities.cannot_present_gpu_images == !supported
            {
                return;
            }
            capabilities.gpu_presentation_adapter_luid = gpu_presentation_adapter_luid;
            capabilities.cannot_present_gpu_images = !supported;
        }
        // Reallocate the backing stores of the presentation's contexts so they match the new capability.
        let bound_context_ids: Vec<CompositorContextId> = self
            .contexts
            .iter()
            .filter(|(_, context)| context.borrow().bound_presentation() == Some(presentation_id))
            .map(|(&context_id, _)| context_id)
            .collect();
        for context_id in bound_context_ids {
            self.invalidate_and_resize_backing_stores(context_id, now);
        }
        self.finish_entry(now);
    }

    pub fn set_scrollbar_track_press_jumps(&self, presentation_id: PresentationId, jumps: bool) {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        if let Some(capabilities) = self.presentations.borrow_mut().get_mut(&presentation_id) {
            capabilities.scrollbar_track_press_jumps = jumps;
        }
        self.update_scroll_capabilities();
    }

    fn invalidate_and_resize_backing_stores(&self, context_id: CompositorContextId, now: MonotonicTime) {
        if let Some(presenting) = self.presenting_of(context_id) {
            presenting.borrow_mut().invalidate_backing_stores();
        }
        self.resize_backing_stores_if_needed(context_id, now);
    }

    // Each root context presents to the presentation it is bound to. Unbound contexts keep rendering, but publish
    // nothing.
    pub fn bind_presentation(
        &self,
        context_id: CompositorContextId,
        presentation_id: PresentationId,
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        let Some(context) = self.context_if_present(context_id) else {
            return;
        };
        if !context.borrow().presents_to_client() {
            use std::io::Write;
            let _ = writeln!(
                std::io::stderr(),
                "Compositor: Ignoring presentation binding for context {}, which is not a root context",
                context_id.0
            );
            return;
        }
        if context.borrow().bound_presentation() == Some(presentation_id) {
            return;
        }
        self.unbind_presentation_inner(context_id, now);
        context.borrow_mut().set_bound_presentation(Some(presentation_id));
        self.update_scroll_capabilities();
        // The new presentation has seen none of the context's buffers, so it gets buffers of its own.
        self.invalidate_and_resize_backing_stores(context_id, now);
        self.finish_entry(now);
    }

    pub fn set_display_metadata(
        &self,
        context_id: CompositorContextId,
        display_id: Option<u64>,
        refresh_rate: f64,
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        assert!(refresh_rate.is_finite() && refresh_rate > 0.0);
        let Some(presenting) = self.presenting_of(context_id) else {
            return;
        };
        let pending_present_frame_scheduled = {
            let mut presenting = presenting.borrow_mut();
            presenting.display_id = display_id;
            presenting.display_refresh_rate = refresh_rate;
            presenting.pending_present_frame_scheduled()
        };
        if pending_present_frame_scheduled {
            self.schedule_pending_present_frame(context_id, now);
        }
        self.raster
            .set_maximum_display_refresh_rate(self.maximum_display_refresh_rate());
        // The contexts nested in it that know no display of their own are shown on its display too.
        self.resume_display_ticks_of_contexts_nested_in(context_id, now);
        self.finish_entry(now);
    }

    pub fn set_window_server_may_show_high_dynamic_range(&self, may_show: bool, now: MonotonicTime) {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        if self.window_server_may_show_high_dynamic_range.replace(may_show) == may_show {
            return;
        }
        let context_ids: Vec<CompositorContextId> = self.presenting.keys().copied().collect();
        for context_id in context_ids {
            self.present_current_frame(context_id, now);
        }
        self.finish_entry(now);
    }

    pub fn set_presents_from_cpu_memory(
        &self,
        context_id: CompositorContextId,
        presents_from_cpu_memory: bool,
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        let Some(presenting) = self.presenting_of(context_id) else {
            return;
        };
        if presenting.borrow().presents_from_cpu_memory == presents_from_cpu_memory {
            return;
        }
        let previous_gpu_sharing = self.gpu_sharing_allowed(context_id);
        presenting.borrow_mut().presents_from_cpu_memory = presents_from_cpu_memory;
        // NB: Without a GPU, the backing stores are in CPU memory either way.
        if !self.gpu.has_gpu || self.gpu_sharing_allowed(context_id) == previous_gpu_sharing {
            return;
        }
        // NB: Otherwise, the presentation would read every frame back from GPU memory on its main thread.
        self.invalidate_and_resize_backing_stores(context_id, now);
        self.finish_entry(now);
    }

    pub fn set_scales_frames_to_fit(
        &self,
        context_id: CompositorContextId,
        scales_frames_to_fit: bool,
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) {
        let _entered = self.enter();
        let Some(presenting) = self.presenting_of(context_id) else {
            return;
        };
        if presenting.borrow().scales_frames_to_fit == scales_frames_to_fit {
            return;
        }
        presenting.borrow_mut().scales_frames_to_fit = scales_frames_to_fit;
        self.present_current_frame(context_id, now);
        self.finish_entry(now);
    }

    pub fn request_rendering_opportunity(
        &self,
        context_id: CompositorContextId,
        maximum_frames_per_second: f64,
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        self.request_rendering_opportunity_inner(context_id, maximum_frames_per_second, now);
    }

    // Asks for the next display tick the context's maximum rate lets through, for its render clock.
    pub fn request_clock_tick(&self, context_id: CompositorContextId, maximum_frames_per_second: f64) {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        let Some(presenting) = self.presenting_of(context_id) else {
            return;
        };
        if !presenting
            .borrow_mut()
            .clock_tick_request
            .request(maximum_frames_per_second)
            || !self.context_is_effectively_visible_inner(context_id)
        {
            return;
        }
        let (display_id, refresh_rate) = self.display_of(context_id);
        self.raster.request_vsync(display_id, refresh_rate);
    }

    // Delivers the rendering opportunity a context requested now rather than at the next display tick: a viewport
    // change that arrived while an animation's opportunity was outstanding starts its update at once.
    pub fn hurry_rendering_opportunity(&self, context_id: CompositorContextId, now: MonotonicTime) {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        self.hurry_rendering_opportunity_inner(context_id, now);
    }

    // A frame the page laid out at the viewport rect.
    pub fn present_frame_of_page(
        &self,
        context_id: CompositorContextId,
        viewport_rect: libgfx_rust::IntRect,
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        let Some(presenting) = self.presenting_of(context_id) else {
            return;
        };
        {
            let mut presenting = presenting.borrow_mut();
            presenting.size_laid_out_by_page = IntSize {
                width: viewport_rect.width,
                height: viewport_rect.height,
            };
            // The frame joins whatever is queued, so a frame queued earlier cannot be presented after it.
            presenting.queue_present_frame(PendingFrame::repainting_changes(viewport_rect));
        }
        if !self.try_present_frame_during_resize(context_id, now) {
            self.schedule_pending_present_frame(context_id, now);
        }
        self.finish_entry(now);
    }

    pub fn presented_store_released(&self, context_id: CompositorContextId, bitmap_id: i32, now: MonotonicTime) {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        let Some(presenting) = self.presenting_of(context_id) else {
            return;
        };
        if !presenting.borrow_mut().release_presented_store(bitmap_id) {
            return;
        }
        self.schedule_pending_present_frame_if_unblocked(context_id, now);
        self.finish_entry(now);
    }

    pub fn vsync(&self, display_id: Option<u64>, frame_time: MonotonicTime, now: MonotonicTime) {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        self.vsync_inner(display_id, frame_time, now);
        self.finish_entry(now);
    }

    pub fn gpu_work_finished(&self, token: u64, now: MonotonicTime) {

        self.finish_entry(now);
    }

    pub fn frame_ready_for_hand_off(&self, token: u64, now: MonotonicTime) {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        self.frame_ready_for_hand_off_inner(token, now);
        self.finish_entry(now);
    }

    // A video sink or an image frame that the context draws has new pixels.
    pub fn context_content_changed(&self, context_id: CompositorContextId, now: MonotonicTime) {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        self.present_changed_live_content(context_id, now);
        self.finish_entry(now);
    }

    // A canvas of the client has new pixels, which the contexts that drew it last show next.
    pub fn canvas_content_changed(&self, client: WebContentClientId, canvas_id: u64, now: MonotonicTime) {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        let context_ids: Vec<CompositorContextId> = self
            .contexts
            .iter()
            .filter(|(context_id, context)| {
                context.borrow().is_owned_by(client)
                    && self
                        .presenting_of(**context_id)
                        .is_some_and(|presenting| presenting.borrow().draws_canvas(canvas_id))
            })
            .map(|(&context_id, _)| context_id)
            .collect();
        for context_id in context_ids {
            self.present_changed_live_content(context_id, now);
        }
        self.finish_entry(now);
    }

    pub fn paint_screenshot(

    }

    }

    // Returns false, leaving everything as it was, for scrolling state with numbers no scroll can be calculated with.
    pub fn install_display_list_update(
        &self,
        context_id: CompositorContextId,
        display_list: Rc<DisplayList>,
        visual_context_tree: AccumulatedVisualContextTree,
        scroll_state_snapshot: ScrollStateSnapshot,
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) -> bool {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        let context = self.context_if_present(context_id).expect("context exists");
        let installed = context.borrow_mut().install_display_list_update(
            display_list,
            visual_context_tree,
            scroll_state_snapshot,
            now,
        );
        self.finish_entry(now);
        installed
    }

    /// Forgets the plan of layers of the context, ahead of a display list or a visual context tree from WebContent that
    /// the context may not install.

        context.borrow_mut().forget_layer_plan();
    }

    /// Takes the plan of layers that came with the display list or the visual context tree the context just installed.
    /// Fails for a plan that does not pass the checks against them.
    pub fn take_layer_plan_of_installed_update(

    /// Takes the plan of layers that came with a scroll state, if any. Fails for a plan that does not pass the checks

    pub fn take_layer_plan_of_scroll_state(

    }

    /// Tells the host which fonts, image frames, video sinks and SVG images the context draws, now that it took a
    /// display list or a visual context tree. The host keeps those for it, and lets go of the others.
    pub fn keep_only_drawn_resources(&self, context_id: CompositorContextId) {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        let Some(context) = self.context_if_present(context_id) else {
            return;
        };
        let font_ids = context.borrow().font_ids_drawn();
        self.raster.set_drawn_fonts(context_id, &font_ids);
        let image_frame_ids = context.borrow().image_frame_ids_drawn();
        self.raster.set_drawn_image_frames(context_id, &image_frame_ids);
        let video_sink_handles = context.borrow().video_sink_handles_drawn();
        self.raster.set_drawn_video_sinks(context_id, &video_sink_handles);
        let vector_image_ids = context.borrow().vector_image_ids_drawn();
        self.raster.set_drawn_vector_images(context_id, &vector_image_ids);
    }

    // Returns false for a tree that does not fit the installed display list, of which only the scroll state is taken.
    pub fn update_visual_context_tree(
        &self,
        context_id: CompositorContextId,
        visual_context_tree: AccumulatedVisualContextTree,
        scroll_state_snapshot: ScrollStateSnapshot,
        keyboard_scroll_state: KeyboardScrollState,
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) -> bool {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        let context = self.context_if_present(context_id).expect("context exists");
        let replaced = context.borrow_mut().update_visual_context_tree(
            visual_context_tree,
            scroll_state_snapshot,
            keyboard_scroll_state,
            now,
        );
        self.finish_entry(now);
        replaced
    }

    // Ends the fling of a context that is hidden, whether or not it was visible. Answers whether the context became
    // visible.
    pub fn set_visibility(
        &self,
        context_id: CompositorContextId,
        visibility: ContextVisibility,
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) -> bool {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        let Some(context) = self.context_if_present(context_id) else {
            return false;
        };
        if visibility == ContextVisibility::Hidden {
            let event = context.borrow_mut().end_scroll_fling();
            self.dispatch_scroll_fling_step(context_id, context, event, now);
        }
        let visibility_changes = context.borrow().visibility() != visibility;
        let became_visible = visibility_changes && visibility == ContextVisibility::Visible;
        context.borrow_mut().set_visibility(visibility);
        if visibility_changes
            && visibility == ContextVisibility::Hidden
            && let Some(presenting) = self.presenting_of(context_id)
        {
            presenting
                .borrow()
                .schedule_hidden_store_retirement(context_id, &self.host);
        }
        if became_visible {
            self.host.cancel_timer(context_id, ContextTimer::HiddenStoreRetirement);
            self.restore_backing_stores_retired_while_hidden(context_id, now);
            self.resume_presentation_after_becoming_visible(context_id, now);
        }
        self.finish_entry(now);
        became_visible
    }

    pub fn timer_fired(&self, number: u64, now: MonotonicTime) {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        match self.host.timer_of_number(number) {
            Some(Timer::Context(context_id, timer)) => self.context_timer_fired(context_id, timer, now),
            Some(Timer::SynchronizedResizeHold) => self.synchronized_resize_hold_timed_out(),
            None => {}
        }
        self.finish_entry(now);
    }

    fn context_timer_fired(&self, context_id: CompositorContextId, timer: ContextTimer, now: MonotonicTime) {
        let Some(context) = self.context_if_present(context_id) else {
            return;
        };
        match timer {
            ContextTimer::BackingStoreShrink => {
                if let Some(presenting) = self.presenting_of(context_id) {
                    presenting.borrow_mut().finish_window_resize();
                }
                self.resize_backing_stores_if_needed(context_id, now);
            }
            ContextTimer::SurplusStoreRetirement => self.retire_idle_surplus_backing_stores(context_id),
            ContextTimer::HiddenStoreRetirement => self.retire_backing_stores_of_hidden_context(context_id),
            ContextTimer::SpareTileEviction => {
                if let Some(presenting) = self.presenting_of(context_id) {
                    let environment = self.environment(
                        context_id,
                        now,
                        &libcompositing_rust::display_list::replay::NoCompositedContexts,
                    );
                    presenting.borrow_mut().spare_tile_eviction_timer_fired(&environment);
                }
            }
            ContextTimer::TileRasterScratchSurfaceRelease => {
                if let Some(presenting) = self.presenting_of(context_id) {
                    presenting
                        .borrow_mut()
                        .tile_raster_scratch_surface_release_timer_fired();
                }
            }
            _ => {
                if context.borrow_mut().timer_fired(timer, now) {
                    self.present_requests.borrow_mut().push(PresentRequest {
                        context_id,
                        viewport_rect: None,
                        forced_damage_rect: Default::default(),
                        scheduling: PresentScheduling::OnNextDisplayTick,
                    });
                }
            }
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn context_still_nested_in(
        &self,
        containing_context_id: CompositorContextId,
        context_id: Option<CompositorContextId>,
    ) -> Option<&RefCell<ContextState>> {
        let context_id = context_id?;
        let context = self.context_if_present(context_id)?;
        if !self.is_nested_in(containing_context_id, context) {
            return None;
        }
        Some(context)
    }

    // Whether a context nested in the context `context_id` scrolled since the last frame its WebContent presented: the lane
    // of the context's document hands a pointer move to the lane of a same-process iframe, which hit tests it in the iframe.
    pub(super) fn nested_context_scrolled_since_last_frame(&self, context_id: CompositorContextId) -> bool {
        for context in self.contexts.values() {
            if context.borrow().scrolled_since_last_frame() && self.is_nested_in(context_id, context) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        false
    }

    pub(super) fn is_nested_in(
        &self,
        containing_context_id: CompositorContextId,
        context: &RefCell<ContextState>,
    ) -> bool {
        // A walk up the parents that outlasts the number of contexts went around a loop.
        let mut ancestor = Some(context);
        for _ in 0..self.contexts.len() {
            let Some(current_ancestor) = ancestor else { break };
            let Some(parent_context_id) = current_ancestor.borrow().parent_context_id() else {
                return false;
            };
            if parent_context_id == containing_context_id {
                return true;
            }
            ancestor = self.context_if_present(parent_context_id);
        }
        false
    }

    // Hands the context's async scroll updates to its WebContent process as soon as they exist,
    // so a rendering update reads them locally instead of asking for them over a synchronous call.
    pub(super) fn publish_pending_async_scroll_updates(&self, _: CompositorContextId, context: &RefCell<ContextState>) {
        context.borrow_mut().publish_pending_async_scroll_updates();
    }

    pub(super) fn request_present(&self, context_id: CompositorContextId, frame: &PendingFrame) {
        self.present_requests.borrow_mut().push(PresentRequest {
            context_id,
            viewport_rect: Some(frame.viewport_rect),
            forced_damage_rect: frame.forced_damage_rect,
            scheduling: PresentScheduling::OnNextDisplayTick,
        });
    }

    pub(super) fn display_tick_inner(
        &self,
        context_id: CompositorContextId,
        frame_time: MonotonicTime,
        now: MonotonicTime,
        inputs: &DisplayTickInputs,
    ) -> DisplayTickResult {
        let context = self.context_if_present(context_id).expect("context exists");

        let has_active_animation_on_display =
            context.borrow_mut().needs_animation_frames(now) && inputs.context_is_on_tick_display;
        let presents_on_display = inputs.present_is_scheduled_on_tick_display || has_active_animation_on_display;
        if presents_on_display {
            if inputs.context_is_on_tick_display {
                let event = context.borrow_mut().take_scroll_fling_step(frame_time);
                self.dispatch_scroll_fling_step(context_id, context, event, frame_time);
            }
            let animation_frame = context.borrow_mut().advance_smooth_scroll_animations(frame_time);
            if let Some(animation_frame) = animation_frame {
                self.present_requests.borrow_mut().push(PresentRequest {
                    context_id,
                    viewport_rect: Some(animation_frame),
                    forced_damage_rect: Default::default(),
                    scheduling: PresentScheduling::WithDisplayTickInProgress,
                });
            }
            let rebound_frame = context.borrow_mut().advance_elastic_overscroll_rebounds(frame_time);
            if let Some(rebound_frame) = rebound_frame {
                self.present_requests.borrow_mut().push(PresentRequest {
                    context_id,
                    viewport_rect: Some(rebound_frame),
                    forced_damage_rect: Default::default(),
                    scheduling: PresentScheduling::WithDisplayTickInProgress,
                });
            }
            if context.borrow_mut().advance_scrollbar_fades(frame_time) {
                self.present_requests.borrow_mut().push(PresentRequest {
                    context_id,
                    viewport_rect: None,
                    forced_damage_rect: Default::default(),
                    scheduling: PresentScheduling::WithDisplayTickInProgress,
                });
            }
        }

        // A render clock tick goes to the process's render clock thread, beside what its main thread is doing, with
        // where the compositor has scrolled to for this vsync, which that main thread may not have taken in yet.
        if let Some(interval) = inputs.clock_tick_interval_in_milliseconds {
            context.borrow().post_clock_tick(frame_time, interval);
        }

        if presents_on_display {
            self.publish_pending_async_scroll_updates(context_id, context);
            let needs_frame = context.borrow_mut().visual_animations_need_frame(now);
            if needs_frame {
                context.borrow_mut().advance_visual_animations(frame_time);
                self.present_requests.borrow_mut().push(PresentRequest {
                    context_id,
                    viewport_rect: None,
                    forced_damage_rect: Default::default(),
                    scheduling: PresentScheduling::WithDisplayTickInProgress,
                });
            }
            let overlay_fade_damage_rect = context.borrow_mut().advance_overlay_fades(frame_time);
            if let Some(overlay_fade_damage_rect) = overlay_fade_damage_rect {
                self.present_requests.borrow_mut().push(PresentRequest {
                    context_id,
                    viewport_rect: None,
                    forced_damage_rect: overlay_fade_damage_rect,
                    scheduling: PresentScheduling::WithDisplayTickInProgress,
                });
            }
            if context.borrow_mut().compositor_layers_overlay_needs_frame(frame_time) {
                self.present_requests.borrow_mut().push(PresentRequest {
                    context_id,
                    viewport_rect: None,
                    forced_damage_rect: Default::default(),
                    scheduling: PresentScheduling::WithDisplayTickInProgress,
                });
            }
        }
        DisplayTickResult {
            presents_on_display,
            needs_animation_frames: context.borrow_mut().needs_animation_frames(now),
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn context_if_present(&self, context_id: CompositorContextId) -> Option<&RefCell<ContextState>> {
        self.contexts.get(&context_id)
    }

    pub(super) fn apply_context_update_result(
        &self,
        context_id: CompositorContextId,
        context: &RefCell<ContextState>,
        result: &ContextUpdateResult,
    ) -> bool {
        if let Some(frame) = result.frame_to_present {
            self.request_present(context_id, &frame);
        }
        self.publish_pending_async_scroll_updates(context_id, context);
        if result.should_request_rendering_update {
            context.borrow_mut().request_rendering_update();
        }
        result.accepted
    }

    fn enter(&self) -> Entered<'_> {
        Entered::new(&self.is_entered)
    }
}

//! When the frames of the contexts are presented, the frames in flight on the GPU, and whom each is delivered to.
