//! Wheel gestures, nested scroll routing, and scroll requests for compositor contexts.

use super::input::position_in_nested_context;
use super::*;
use crate::context_state::{
    FirstWheelStepRouteKind, NestedContextWheelStep, TrackedScrollOperation, WheelEventListenerGate, WheelStep,
    WheelStepAdmission,
};
use libcompositing_rust::ipc_types::{
    Compositing_AsyncScrollOperationTracking as AsyncScrollOperationTracking,
    Compositing_SmoothScrollInitiator as SmoothScrollInitiator, Compositing_WheelEventAnswer as WheelEventAnswer,
    Compositing_WheelEventRouting as WheelEventRouting, Compositing_WheelStepLetThrough as WheelStepLetThrough,
    Web_InputTraceRecord as InputTraceRecord, Web_InputTraceStage as InputTraceStage,
};
use libcompositing_rust::scrolling::{
    AsyncScrollNodeStableID, InputRoutingDecision, KeyboardScrollState, MouseEvent, NestedContextHit,
    NestedContextRegions, PendingAsyncScrollUpdates, ScrollGesturePhase, ScrollRequest, WheelDeltaPrecision,
    WheelGestureMark,
};

impl CompositorCore {
    pub fn update_scroll_state(
        &self,
        context_id: CompositorContextId,
        scroll_state_snapshot: ScrollStateSnapshot,
        keyboard_scroll_state: KeyboardScrollState,
    ) {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        let context = self.context_if_present(context_id).expect("context exists");

        context
            .borrow_mut()
            .update_scroll_state(scroll_state_snapshot, keyboard_scroll_state);
    }

    pub fn invalidate_wheel_event_listener_state(&self, context_id: CompositorContextId, generation: u64) {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        let context = self.context_if_present(context_id).expect("context exists");
        context.borrow_mut().invalidate_wheel_event_listener_state(generation);
    }

    pub fn invalidate_keyboard_scroll_state(&self, context_id: CompositorContextId, generation: u64) {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        if let Some(context) = self.context_if_present(context_id) {
            context.borrow_mut().invalidate_keyboard_scroll_state(generation);
        }
    }

    // A fling step is scrolled at the frame time the fling synthesized it for.
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub(super) fn scroll_for_wheel_step(
        &self,
        context_id: CompositorContextId,
        context: &RefCell<ContextState>,
        event: &MouseEvent,
        origin: WheelStepOrigin,
        is_first_wheel_event_with_delta: bool,
        operation_tracking: AsyncScrollOperationTracking,
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) -> ContextUpdateResult {
        let gesture_id = context.borrow().wheel_gesture_id();
        let listener_context_id = context.borrow().wheel_event_listener_context().unwrap_or(context_id);
        let listener_context = if listener_context_id == context_id {
            Some(context)
        } else {
            self.context_still_nested_in(context_id, Some(listener_context_id))
        };
        let listener_gate = if let Some(listener_context) = listener_context {
            listener_context.borrow().wheel_event_listener_gate(gesture_id)
        } else {
            WheelEventListenerGate {
                reason_to_hold_latched_steps_back: Some(InputRoutingDecision::NestedContextUnavailable),
                ..Default::default()
            }
        };

        let mut result;
        let mut presents_frame;
        let route_from_listener = listener_context
            .is_some_and(|listener_context| !std::ptr::eq(listener_context, context))
            && listener_gate.page_let_the_gesture_through
            && !context.borrow().has_wheel_latch_for_gesture(gesture_id);
        if route_from_listener {
            let listener_context = listener_context.unwrap();
            // The page of a nested context let the gesture through while nothing took its steps, so they go to that context
            // again rather than to the page.
            let mut step = WheelStep::for_wheel_event(event, gesture_id, operation_tracking);
            let position =
                self.position_in_nested_context_ignoring_clips(context_id, context, listener_context, step.position);
            let Some(position) = position else {
                return ContextUpdateResult::declined(InputRoutingDecision::NestedContextUnavailable);
            };
            step.position = position;
            let applied_step = self.route_wheel_step_the_page_let_through(
                context_id,
                context,
                listener_context_id,
                listener_context,
                step,
                &[],
                None,
                now,
            );
            result = applied_step.result;
            result.nested_context_hand_off = Some(InputRoutingDecision::HandedToNestedContext);
            presents_frame = applied_step.presents_frame;
        } else {
            result = match origin {
                WheelStepOrigin::UI => {
                    context
                        .borrow_mut()
                        .handle_wheel_event(event, is_first_wheel_event_with_delta, &listener_gate, now)
                }
                WheelStepOrigin::Fling => context.borrow_mut().scroll_for_fling_step(event, &listener_gate, now),
                WheelStepOrigin::MainThread => context.borrow_mut().scroll_for_wheel_event_from_main_thread(
                    event,
                    is_first_wheel_event_with_delta,
                    &listener_gate,
                    operation_tracking,
                    now,
                ),
            };
            presents_frame = result.frame_to_present.is_some();
            if let Some(nested_step) = &result.nested_context_wheel_step {
                let applied_step = self.hand_wheel_step_to_nested_context(
                    context_id,
                    context,
                    event,
                    nested_step,
                    &listener_gate,
                    operation_tracking,
                    now,
                );
                result = applied_step.result;
                presents_frame = applied_step.presents_frame;
            }
        }

        // If the compositor accepts a momentum step of the fling but does not scroll, the scroller is at its edge.
        // Alternatively, a snap scroll uses the step. The next display tick ends the fling.
        if origin == WheelStepOrigin::Fling
            && event.scroll_gesture_phase == ScrollGesturePhase::Momentum
            && result.accepted
            && !presents_frame
        {
            context.borrow_mut().end_scroll_fling_on_next_step();
        }
        result
    }

    // A process only knows the ids of its own nodes, and only follows the operations of its own contexts.
    fn apply_wheel_step_result(
        &self,
        context_id: CompositorContextId,
        context: &RefCell<ContextState>,
        result: &ContextUpdateResult,
        reporting_client: WebContentClientId,
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) -> AppliedWheelStep {
        self.apply_context_update_result(context_id, context, result);
        context.borrow_mut().request_display_ticks_if_needed(now);
        // Node ids are only unique within the process that made them, and only that process follows the operations of the
        // context.
        let ids_are_of_reporting_process = context.borrow().is_owned_by(reporting_client);
        AppliedWheelStep {
            result: ContextUpdateResult {
                accepted: result.accepted,
                routing_decision: result.routing_decision,
                routed_scroller: if ids_are_of_reporting_process {
                    result.routed_scroller
                } else {
                    None
                },
                tracked_scroll_operation: if ids_are_of_reporting_process {
                    result
                        .tracked_scroll_operation
                        .as_ref()
                        .map(|operation| TrackedScrollOperation {
                            context_id: operation.context_id,
                            operation_id: operation.operation_id,
                        })
                } else {
                    None
                },
                ..Default::default()
            },
            presents_frame: result.frame_to_present.is_some(),
        }
    }

    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    fn hand_wheel_step_to_nested_context(
        &self,
        context_id: CompositorContextId,
        context: &RefCell<ContextState>,
        event: &MouseEvent,
        nested_step: &NestedContextWheelStep,
        listener_gate: &WheelEventListenerGate,
        operation_tracking: AsyncScrollOperationTracking,
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) -> AppliedWheelStep {
        let mut step = WheelStep::for_wheel_event(event, context.borrow().wheel_gesture_id(), operation_tracking);

        if nested_step.hit.is_none() {
            let nested_context = self.context_if_present(nested_step.context_id);
            if nested_context.is_none_or(|context| !self.is_nested_in(context_id, context)) {
                context.borrow_mut().forget_wheel_gesture_latch();
                return AppliedWheelStep {
                    result: ContextUpdateResult::declined(InputRoutingDecision::NestedContextUnavailable),
                    ..Default::default()
                };
            }
            let nested_context = nested_context.unwrap();
            // A blocking listener added during the gesture holds its later steps back until the page lets one through.
            if let Some(reason) = listener_gate.reason_to_hold_latched_steps_back {
                return AppliedWheelStep {
                    result: ContextUpdateResult::declined(reason),
                    ..Default::default()
                };
            }
            let admission = if listener_gate.page_let_the_gesture_through {
                WheelStepAdmission::LetThroughByThePage
            } else {
                WheelStepAdmission::ByThisPage
            };
            let nested_result = nested_context
                .borrow_mut()
                .take_latched_wheel_step_from_containing_context(&step, admission, now);
            if nested_result.routing_decision == Some(InputRoutingDecision::NestedContextUnavailable) {
                context.borrow_mut().forget_wheel_gesture_latch();
            }
            let reporting_client = context.borrow().web_content_client_id();
            return self.apply_wheel_step_result(
                nested_step.context_id,
                nested_context,
                &nested_result,
                reporting_client,
                now,
            );
        }

        let first_step = self.first_wheel_step_in_nested_contexts(
            context_id,
            {
                let hit = nested_step.hit.as_ref().unwrap();
                NestedContextHit {
                    child_context_id: hit.child_context_id,
                    position_in_content_box: hit.position_in_content_box,
                    content_box_size: hit.content_box_size,
                    paint_order_index: hit.paint_order_index,
                }
            },
            step.delta_in_css_pixels,
            step.wheel_delta_precision,
        );
        context
            .borrow_mut()
            .set_wheel_event_listener_context(first_step.innermost_context_id);
        let Some(taking_context) = first_step.taking_context else {
            let mut result =
                context
                    .borrow_mut()
                    .scroll_for_wheel_event_passed_on_by_nested_context(event, operation_tracking, now);
            result.nested_context_hand_off = Some(InputRoutingDecision::NestedContextPassedStepOn);
            let presents_frame = result.frame_to_present.is_some();
            return AppliedWheelStep { result, presents_frame };
        };

        let mut applied_step;
        if let Some(nested_context) = taking_context.context
            && taking_context.route.kind != FirstWheelStepRouteKind::Declined
        {
            step.position = taking_context.position;
            let nested_result = nested_context
                .borrow_mut()
                .take_first_wheel_step_from_containing_context(&taking_context.route, &step, now);
            let reporting_client = context.borrow().web_content_client_id();
            applied_step = self.apply_wheel_step_result(
                taking_context.context_id,
                nested_context,
                &nested_result,
                reporting_client,
                now,
            );
            context.borrow_mut().latch_wheel_gesture_to_nested_context(
                taking_context.context_id,
                applied_step.result.routed_scroller,
                step.scroll_gesture_phase,
            );
        } else {
            applied_step = AppliedWheelStep {
                result: ContextUpdateResult::declined(taking_context.route.decision),
                ..Default::default()
            };
        }
        applied_step.result.nested_context_hand_off = Some(InputRoutingDecision::HandedToNestedContext);
        applied_step
    }

    // Where the first step of a gesture over the content of a context nested in the context `context_id` goes, among
    // that context and the contexts nested in it.
    pub(super) fn first_wheel_step_in_nested_contexts(
        &self,
        context_id: CompositorContextId,
        mut hit: NestedContextHit,
        delta_in_css_pixels: FloatPoint,
        wheel_delta_precision: WheelDeltaPrecision,
    ) -> FirstWheelStepInNestedContexts<'_> {
        use FirstWheelStepRouteKind as Kind;
        // The contexts the step went into, outermost first, each nested in the one before.
        let mut contexts = Vec::new();
        let mut containing_context_id = context_id;
        loop {
            let declined_by_unavailable_context = || FirstWheelStepInNestedContexts {
                innermost_context_id: hit.child_context_id,
                taking_context: Some(NestedContextTakingWheelStep {
                    context_id: hit.child_context_id,
                    context: None,
                    position: FloatPoint::default(),
                    route: FirstWheelStepRoute {
                        kind: Kind::Declined,
                        decision: InputRoutingDecision::NestedContextUnavailable,
                        scroll_node_index: None,
                        scroller: None,
                        nested_context_hit: None,
                    },
                }),
            };
            // WebContent names the contexts its display lists draw, so a context only reaches those nested in it.
            let Some(nested_context) = self.context_if_present(hit.child_context_id) else {
                return declined_by_unavailable_context();
            };
            if nested_context.borrow().parent_context_id() != Some(containing_context_id) {
                return declined_by_unavailable_context();
            }
            let Some(position) = position_in_nested_context(&hit, nested_context) else {
                return declined_by_unavailable_context();
            };
            let route = nested_context
                .borrow_mut()
                .route_first_wheel_step_from_containing_context(
                    position,
                    delta_in_css_pixels,
                    wheel_delta_precision,
                    NestedContextRegions::HandToNestedContext,
                    WheelStepAdmission::ByThisPage,
                    &[],
                );
            let kind = route.kind;
            let nested_context_hit = route.nested_context_hit.as_ref().map(|hit| NestedContextHit {
                child_context_id: hit.child_context_id,
                position_in_content_box: hit.position_in_content_box,
                content_box_size: hit.content_box_size,
                paint_order_index: hit.paint_order_index,
            });
            contexts.push(NestedContextTakingWheelStep {
                context_id: hit.child_context_id,
                context: Some(nested_context),
                position,
                route,
            });
            if kind != Kind::NestedContext {
                break;
            }
            containing_context_id = hit.child_context_id;
            hit = nested_context_hit.unwrap();
        }

        // What a nested context passes on goes to whatever is painted under it in the context it is nested in, whose page
        // does not see the step.
        let innermost_context_id = contexts.last().unwrap().context_id;
        while contexts.last().unwrap().route.kind == Kind::PassedOn {
            contexts.pop();
            if contexts.is_empty() {
                return FirstWheelStepInNestedContexts {
                    innermost_context_id,
                    taking_context: None,
                };
            }
            let containing_context = contexts.last_mut().unwrap();
            containing_context.route = containing_context
                .context
                .unwrap()
                .borrow_mut()
                .route_first_wheel_step_from_containing_context(
                    containing_context.position,
                    delta_in_css_pixels,
                    wheel_delta_precision,
                    NestedContextRegions::Ignore,
                    WheelStepAdmission::PassedOnByNestedContext,
                    &[],
                );
        }
        FirstWheelStepInNestedContexts {
            innermost_context_id,
            taking_context: contexts.pop(),
        }
    }
}

// The page of one process scrolls a context of another process only by what the UI left to the page in the gesture, so
// that a page cannot scroll the document around it at will.
fn page_may_scroll_in(
    context: &RefCell<ContextState>,
    routing_context: &RefCell<ContextState>,
    page_client: Option<WebContentClientId>,
    step: &WheelStep,
) -> bool {
    let Some(page_client) = page_client else { return true };
    if context.borrow().is_owned_by(page_client) {
        return true;
    }
    routing_context
        .borrow_mut()
        .take_wheel_delta_left_to_the_page(step.delta_in_css_pixels)
}

impl CompositorCore {
    // Routes the first step of a gesture that the page of the listener context let through: in that context, from the
    // scrollers the page found around the target, and on to the contexts around it for what a context passes on, up to
    // the routing context, which latches the gesture. A page of another process than a context's scrolls it only by
    // what the UI left to the page in the gesture.
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    fn route_wheel_step_the_page_let_through(
        &self,
        routing_context_id: CompositorContextId,
        routing_context: &RefCell<ContextState>,
        listener_context_id: CompositorContextId,
        listener_context: &RefCell<ContextState>,
        mut step: WheelStep,
        mut scroll_chain: &[AsyncScrollNodeStableID],
        page_client: Option<WebContentClientId>,
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) -> AppliedWheelStep {
        use FirstWheelStepRouteKind as Kind;
        let reporting_client = page_client.unwrap_or_else(|| routing_context.borrow().web_content_client_id());
        let declined = |decision| AppliedWheelStep {
            result: ContextUpdateResult::declined(decision),
            ..Default::default()
        };

        let mut context_id = listener_context_id;
        let mut context = listener_context;
        // A walk up the parents that outlasts the number of contexts went around a loop.
        for _ in 0..self.contexts.len() {
            if std::ptr::eq(context, routing_context) {
                if !page_may_scroll_in(routing_context, routing_context, page_client, &step) {
                    return declined(InputRoutingDecision::StepExceedsInputLeftToThePage);
                }
                let result = routing_context
                    .borrow_mut()
                    .scroll_for_first_wheel_step_the_page_let_through(&step, scroll_chain, now);
                return self.apply_wheel_step_result(
                    routing_context_id,
                    routing_context,
                    &result,
                    reporting_client,
                    now,
                );
            }

            let route = context.borrow_mut().route_first_wheel_step_from_containing_context(
                step.position,
                step.delta_in_css_pixels,
                step.wheel_delta_precision,
                NestedContextRegions::Ignore,
                WheelStepAdmission::LetThroughByThePage,
                scroll_chain,
            );
            if matches!(route.kind, Kind::ScrollNode | Kind::Kept) {
                if !page_may_scroll_in(context, routing_context, page_client, &step) {
                    return declined(InputRoutingDecision::StepExceedsInputLeftToThePage);
                }
                let nested_result = context
                    .borrow_mut()
                    .take_first_wheel_step_from_containing_context(&route, &step, now);
                let client = routing_context.borrow().web_content_client_id();
                let latched_scroller = if context.borrow().is_owned_by(client) {
                    nested_result.routed_scroller
                } else {
                    None
                };
                routing_context.borrow_mut().latch_wheel_gesture_to_nested_context(
                    context_id,
                    latched_scroller,
                    step.scroll_gesture_phase,
                );
                return self.apply_wheel_step_result(context_id, context, &nested_result, reporting_client, now);
            }
            if route.kind != Kind::PassedOn {
                return declined(route.decision);
            }

            // What a nested context passes on goes to whatever is painted under it in the context it is nested in.
            let parent_context_id = context.borrow().parent_context_id();
            let parent_context = parent_context_id.and_then(|id| self.context_if_present(id));
            let Some(parent_context) = parent_context else {
                return declined(InputRoutingDecision::NestedContextUnavailable);
            };
            let viewport_size = context.borrow().viewport_size();
            let position = parent_context.borrow_mut().position_of_nested_context_position(
                context_id,
                step.position,
                viewport_size,
            );
            let Some(position) = position else {
                return declined(InputRoutingDecision::NestedContextUnavailable);
            };
            step.position = position;
            scroll_chain = &[];
            context_id = parent_context_id.unwrap();
            context = parent_context;
        }
        declined(InputRoutingDecision::NestedContextUnavailable)
    }

    // The nearest context, from the given one out to the presenting one, that noted the gesture.
    fn routing_context_of_wheel_gesture(
        &self,
        context_id: CompositorContextId,
        gesture_id: u64,
    ) -> Option<CompositorContextId> {
        // A walk up the parents that outlasts the number of contexts went around a loop.
        let mut candidate_context_id = Some(context_id);
        for _ in 0..self.contexts.len() {
            let id = candidate_context_id?;
            let candidate_context = self.context_if_present(id)?;
            if candidate_context.borrow().wheel_gesture_id() == Some(gesture_id) {
                return candidate_context_id;
            }
            candidate_context_id = candidate_context.borrow().parent_context_id();
        }
        None
    }

    pub(super) fn dispatch_scroll_fling_step(
        &self,
        context_id: CompositorContextId,
        context: &RefCell<ContextState>,
        event: Option<MouseEvent>,
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) {
        // Send each fling step on the same route as a wheel event from the UI.
        let Some(mut event) = event else { return };
        let result = self.scroll_for_wheel_step(
            context_id,
            context,
            &event,
            WheelStepOrigin::Fling,
            false,
            AsyncScrollOperationTracking::No,
            now,
        );
        if let Some(decision) = result.nested_context_hand_off {
            context.borrow_mut().input_trace_mut().record(InputTraceRecord {
                input_event_id: event.id,
                stage: InputTraceStage::Compositor,
                decision,
                scroller: None,
                dom_target: None,
            });
        }
        if let Some(decision) = result.routing_decision {
            context.borrow_mut().input_trace_mut().record(InputTraceRecord {
                input_event_id: event.id,
                stage: InputTraceStage::Compositor,
                decision,
                scroller: result.routed_scroller,
                dom_target: None,
            });
        }
        event.async_scroll_performed_default_action = self.apply_context_update_result(context_id, context, &result);
        if !event.async_scroll_performed_default_action {
            context.borrow_mut().note_wheel_event_left_to_the_page(&event);
        }
        context.borrow_mut().request_display_ticks_if_needed(now);
        context.borrow().dispatch_mouse_event_to_web_content(&event, false);
    }

    fn wheel_event_answer_for(
        &self,
        applied_step: &AppliedWheelStep,
        wheel_gesture_mark: Option<WheelGestureMark>,
    ) -> WheelEventAnswer {
        let tracked_scroll_operation = &applied_step.result.tracked_scroll_operation;
        WheelEventAnswer {
            performed_default_action: applied_step.result.accepted,
            wheel_gesture_mark,
            operation_id: tracked_scroll_operation
                .as_ref()
                .map(|operation| operation.operation_id),
            operation_context_id: tracked_scroll_operation.as_ref().map(|operation| operation.context_id),
            routing_decision: applied_step.result.routing_decision,
            routed_scroller: applied_step.result.routed_scroller,
        }
    }

    pub fn take_wheel_event_from_main_thread(
        &self,
        context_id: CompositorContextId,
        event: &MouseEvent,
        operation_tracking: AsyncScrollOperationTracking,
        routing: WheelEventRouting,
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) -> WheelEventAnswer {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        let context = self.context_if_present(context_id).expect("context exists");

        let noted = context.borrow_mut().note_wheel_event_from_main_thread(event, now);
        if routing == WheelEventRouting::AfterDispatch {
            return WheelEventAnswer {
                performed_default_action: false,
                wheel_gesture_mark: Some(noted.wheel_gesture_mark),
                operation_id: None,
                operation_context_id: None,
                routing_decision: None,
                routed_scroller: None,
            };
        }
        let result = self.scroll_for_wheel_step(
            context_id,
            context,
            event,
            WheelStepOrigin::MainThread,
            noted.is_first_wheel_event_with_delta,
            operation_tracking,
            now,
        );
        let reporting_client = context.borrow().web_content_client_id();
        self.wheel_event_answer_for(
            &self.apply_wheel_step_result(context_id, context, &result, reporting_client, now),
            Some(noted.wheel_gesture_mark),
        )
    }

    pub fn scroll_for_wheel_event_the_page_let_through(
        &self,
        listener_context_id: CompositorContextId,
        let_through: &WheelStepLetThrough,
        operation_tracking: AsyncScrollOperationTracking,
        page_client: WebContentClientId,
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) -> WheelEventAnswer {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        let listener_context = self.context_if_present(listener_context_id).expect("context exists");
        if listener_context.borrow().document_id() != Some(let_through.document_id) {
            return WheelEventAnswer {
                performed_default_action: false,
                wheel_gesture_mark: None,
                operation_id: None,
                operation_context_id: None,
                routing_decision: Some(InputRoutingDecision::ScrollerInOtherDocument),
                routed_scroller: None,
            };
        }

        let gesture_id = let_through.wheel_gesture_mark.gesture_id;
        // A step that moves along no axis goes to the page as no wheel event, so the page had no say in letting it through,
        // and it decides nothing for the steps after it.
        if !let_through.delta_in_css_pixels.is_zero() {
            listener_context
                .borrow_mut()
                .note_page_let_wheel_gesture_through(gesture_id);
        }
        let step = WheelStep {
            position: let_through.position,
            delta_in_css_pixels: let_through.delta_in_css_pixels,
            wheel_delta_precision: let_through.wheel_delta_precision,
            scroll_gesture_phase: let_through.scroll_gesture_phase,
            gesture_id: Some(gesture_id),
            operation_tracking,
        };
        let scroll_chain = let_through.scroll_chain.as_slice();
        let answer = |applied_step: &AppliedWheelStep| {
            self.wheel_event_answer_for(applied_step, Some(let_through.wheel_gesture_mark.clone()))
        };
        let declined = |decision| {
            answer(&AppliedWheelStep {
                result: ContextUpdateResult::declined(decision),
                ..Default::default()
            })
        };

        // A step of a gesture that the contexts around the page have moved past still scrolls, as the page let it.
        let routing_context_id = self.routing_context_of_wheel_gesture(listener_context_id, gesture_id);
        let routing_context = routing_context_id.and_then(|id| self.context_if_present(id));
        if routing_context.is_none_or(|context| {
            context
                .borrow()
                .wheel_step_was_overtaken(step.scroll_gesture_phase, let_through.wheel_gesture_mark.step_number)
        }) {
            let result = listener_context
                .borrow_mut()
                .scroll_for_overtaken_wheel_step(&step, scroll_chain, now);
            return answer(&self.apply_wheel_step_result(
                listener_context_id,
                listener_context,
                &result,
                page_client,
                now,
            ));
        }
        let routing_context = routing_context.unwrap();
        let routing_context_id = routing_context_id.unwrap();

        routing_context
            .borrow_mut()
            .set_wheel_event_listener_context(listener_context_id);
        // The end of a gesture lets go of the scroller it stretched.
        if step.scroll_gesture_phase == ScrollGesturePhase::Ended {
            routing_context.borrow_mut().end_wheel_gesture_stretch(now);
        }

        // A latched scroller that the page no longer has around the target of the step is gone from the page, and the step
        // is routed afresh.
        let latch_is_to_scroller_of_this_page = routing_context_id == listener_context_id
            && routing_context.borrow().nested_context_of_wheel_latch().is_none();
        if latch_is_to_scroller_of_this_page && !scroll_chain.is_empty() {
            let latched_scroller = routing_context.borrow().wheel_latched_scroller();
            if let Some(latched_scroller) = latched_scroller
                && !scroll_chain.contains(&latched_scroller)
            {
                routing_context.borrow_mut().forget_wheel_latch_of_gesture(gesture_id);
            }
        }

        let has_latch = routing_context.borrow().has_wheel_latch_for_gesture(Some(gesture_id));
        if has_latch {
            let nested_context_id = routing_context.borrow().nested_context_of_wheel_latch();
            if let Some(nested_context_id) = nested_context_id {
                let nested_context = self.context_still_nested_in(routing_context_id, Some(nested_context_id));
                let Some(nested_context) = nested_context else {
                    routing_context.borrow_mut().forget_wheel_latch_of_gesture(gesture_id);
                    return declined(InputRoutingDecision::NestedContextUnavailable);
                };
                if !page_may_scroll_in(nested_context, routing_context, Some(page_client), &step) {
                    return declined(InputRoutingDecision::StepExceedsInputLeftToThePage);
                }
                let nested_result = nested_context
                    .borrow_mut()
                    .take_latched_wheel_step_from_containing_context(
                        &step,
                        WheelStepAdmission::LetThroughByThePage,
                        now,
                    );
                return answer(&self.apply_wheel_step_result(
                    nested_context_id,
                    nested_context,
                    &nested_result,
                    page_client,
                    now,
                ));
            }
            if !page_may_scroll_in(routing_context, routing_context, Some(page_client), &step) {
                return declined(InputRoutingDecision::StepExceedsInputLeftToThePage);
            }
            let result = routing_context
                .borrow_mut()
                .scroll_for_latched_wheel_step_the_page_let_through(&step, now);
            if let Some(result) = result {
                return answer(&self.apply_wheel_step_result(
                    routing_context_id,
                    routing_context,
                    &result,
                    page_client,
                    now,
                ));
            }
        }

        answer(&self.route_wheel_step_the_page_let_through(
            routing_context_id,
            routing_context,
            listener_context_id,
            listener_context,
            step,
            scroll_chain,
            Some(page_client),
            now,
        ))
    }

    pub fn forget_wheel_gesture_the_page_canceled(&self, listener_context_id: CompositorContextId, gesture_id: u64) {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        let Some(listener_context) = self.context_if_present(listener_context_id) else {
            return;
        };
        listener_context
            .borrow_mut()
            .forget_page_let_wheel_gesture_through(gesture_id);
        // The listener scrolls by itself, so the next step of the gesture is routed afresh.
        if let Some(routing_context_id) = self.routing_context_of_wheel_gesture(listener_context_id, gesture_id) {
            self.context_if_present(routing_context_id)
                .expect("routing context exists")
                .borrow_mut()
                .forget_wheel_latch_of_gesture(gesture_id);
        }
    }
}

fn scroll_request_smoothly_scrolls_for_script(scroll_request: &ScrollRequest) -> bool {
    scroll_request
        .smooth_scroll
        .as_ref()
        .is_some_and(|scroll| scroll.initiator == SmoothScrollInitiator::Programmatic)
}

impl CompositorCore {
    pub fn apply_scroll_requests(
        &self,
        context_id: CompositorContextId,
        scroll_requests: &[ScrollRequest],
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        let Some(context) = self.context_if_present(context_id) else {
            return;
        };

        // A script's smooth scroll of a box ends the momentum scrolling it, as a key's does. A script's instant scroll only
        // moves the box, and the momentum goes on from there: pages keep their content in place under a flick that way.
        for scroll_request in scroll_requests {
            if scroll_request.takes_over_from_momentum || scroll_request_smoothly_scrolls_for_script(scroll_request) {
                let event = context
                    .borrow_mut()
                    .end_momentum_scrolling(scroll_request.stable_node_id);
                self.dispatch_scroll_fling_step(context_id, context, event, now);
            }
        }
        let frame_to_present = context.borrow_mut().apply_scroll_requests(scroll_requests, now);
        if let Some(frame_to_present) = frame_to_present {
            self.request_present(context_id, &frame_to_present);
        }
        context.borrow_mut().request_display_ticks_if_needed(now);
        self.publish_pending_async_scroll_updates(context_id, context);
    }

    pub fn take_pending_async_scroll_updates(&self, context_id: CompositorContextId) -> PendingAsyncScrollUpdates {
        let _entered = self.enter();

        let context = self.context_if_present(context_id).expect("context exists");

        context.borrow_mut().take_pending_async_scroll_updates()
    }
}

/*

 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause

//! A C++ object that the core owns, such as a window server or a remote layer, which it only hands back to the C++ that
//! made it and destroys with the function that came with it.

use std::ffi::c_void;
use std::ptr::NonNull;

/// A C++ object as the C++ side hands it over, or null for none.
#[repr(C)]
pub struct FfiCppObject {
    pub object: *mut c_void,
    pub destroy: Option<unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void)>,
}

impl Default for FfiCppObject {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            object: std::ptr::null_mut(),
            destroy: None,
        }
    }
}

pub struct CppObject {
    object: NonNull<c_void>,
    destroy: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void),
}

impl CppObject {
    /// # Safety
    ///
    /// A non-null object must be live and handed over, and its destroy function must destroy it.
    pub unsafe fn adopt(object: FfiCppObject) -> Option<CppObject> {
        Some(CppObject {
            object: NonNull::new(object.object)?,
            destroy: object.destroy.expect("a C++ object comes with its destroy function"),
        })
    }

    pub fn as_ptr(&self) -> *mut c_void {
        self.object.as_ptr()
    }
}

impl Drop for CppObject {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        // SAFETY: This owns the object.
        unsafe { (self.destroy)(self.object.as_ptr()) };
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
pub mod testing {
    use super::*;

    unsafe extern "C" fn destroy_nothing(_: *mut c_void) {}

    /// An object that stands for one of the C++ side, which is told apart by its address.
    pub fn object_for_testing(address: usize) -> CppObject {
        CppObject {
            object: NonNull::new(address as *mut c_void).expect("an address"),
            destroy: destroy_nothing,
        }
    }
}

FILE: Services/Compositor/Rust/src/display_list_chunk_stores.rs
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

//! The chunks of the display lists each WebContent client sent for each of its contexts. A client sends the chunks of
//! a display list that the latest lists of the context do not name, and names the rest: both ends keep the chunks of
//! the latest lists by the same rule, so neither tells the other what it keeps.

use crate::host::WebContentClientId;
use libcompositing_rust::display_list::chunks::{ChunkId, KeptChunks};
use libcompositing_rust::display_list::commands::CompositorContextId;
use libcompositing_rust::display_list::storage::ListChunk;
use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};
use std::sync::Arc;

#[derive(Default)]
struct ContextChunks {
    kept: KeptChunks,
    chunks: HashMap<ChunkId, Arc<ListChunk>>,
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct DisplayListChunkStores {
    stores: HashMap<(WebContentClientId, CompositorContextId), ContextChunks>,
    /// Contexts that were destroyed, whose ids never come back: what a client still sends for one goes nowhere.
    destroyed_contexts: HashSet<CompositorContextId>,
}

impl DisplayListChunkStores {
    /// Takes in the display list `client` sent for `context`, which names `chunks_in_paint_order` and carries `sent`:
    /// keeps what it sent and answers the chunks it names in paint order, or none for a context that is gone. A list
    /// that names a chunk it did not send and the context does not keep is a protocol error.
    pub fn take_in(
        &mut self,
        client: WebContentClientId,
        context: CompositorContextId,
        sent: Vec<ListChunk>,
        chunks_in_paint_order: &[ChunkId],
    ) -> Result<Option<Vec<Arc<ListChunk>>>, &'static str> {
        if self.destroyed_contexts.contains(&context) {
            return Ok(None);
        }
        let store = self.stores.entry((client, context)).or_default();
        let sent_ids: Vec<ChunkId> = sent.iter().map(|chunk| chunk.id).collect();
        for chunk in sent {
            // The bytes a name was first received with are the ones it stands for from then on.
            store.chunks.entry(chunk.id).or_insert_with(|| Arc::new(chunk));
        }
        let list = chunks_in_paint_order
            .iter()
            .map(|id| store.chunks.get(id).cloned())
            .collect::<Option<Vec<_>>>()
            .ok_or("WebContent published a display list that names a chunk the compositor does not keep");
        for dropped in store.kept.take_in(chunks_in_paint_order) {
            store.chunks.remove(&dropped);
        }
        for id in sent_ids {
            if !store.kept.keeps(id) {
                store.chunks.remove(&id);
            }
        }
        list.map(Some)
    }

    /// Forgets the chunks every client sent for `context`, which was destroyed.
    pub fn forget_context(&mut self, context: CompositorContextId) {
        self.stores.retain(|(_, store_context), _| *store_context != context);
        self.destroyed_contexts.insert(context);
    }
}

/// The chunks a display list sent whole names in paint order, or an error where it names one it did not send.
pub fn chunks_of_list_sent_whole(
    sent: Vec<ListChunk>,
    chunks_in_paint_order: &[ChunkId],
) -> Result<Vec<Arc<ListChunk>>, &'static str> {
    let sent: HashMap<ChunkId, Arc<ListChunk>> = sent.into_iter().map(|chunk| (chunk.id, Arc::new(chunk))).collect();
    chunks_in_paint_order
        .iter()
        .map(|id| sent.get(id).cloned())
        .collect::<Option<Vec<_>>>()
        .ok_or("WebContent sent a display list that names a chunk it does not carry")
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use libcompositing_rust::display_list::builder::DisplayListBuilder;
    use libcompositing_rust::display_list::chunks::{Chunk, DISPLAY_LISTS_WHOSE_CHUNKS_ARE_KEPT};
    use libcompositing_rust::display_list::commands::{ContextRef, EffectNodeIndex, FillRect};
    use libcompositing_rust::display_list::storage::{
        PackedChunkSize, packed_size_of_chunks, receive_packed_chunks, write_packed_chunks,
    };
    use libgfx_rust::{Color, CompositingAndBlendingOperator, IntRect};

    fn chunk(y: i32) -> Chunk {
        let mut builder = DisplayListBuilder::new();
        builder.append(
            &FillRect {
                rect: IntRect::new(0, y, 10, 10),
                color: Color::default(),
                compositing_and_blending_operator: CompositingAndBlendingOperator::Normal,
                background_color_animation_effect: EffectNodeIndex::NONE,
            },
            &[],
            ContextRef::default(),
        );
        builder.take_chunk()
    }

    fn sent(chunks: &[&Chunk]) -> Vec<ListChunk> {
        let mut packed = vec![0; packed_size_of_chunks(chunks)];
        write_packed_chunks(chunks, &mut packed);
        let sizes: Vec<PackedChunkSize> = chunks.iter().map(|chunk| PackedChunkSize::of(chunk)).collect();
        receive_packed_chunks(&packed, &sizes).unwrap()
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_list_names_what_the_latest_lists_of_its_context_kept_and_sends_the_rest() {
        let client = WebContentClientId(1);
        let context = CompositorContextId(7);
        let (first, second, third) = (chunk(0), chunk(10), chunk(20));
        let mut stores = DisplayListChunkStores::default();

        let list = stores
            .take_in(client, context, sent(&[&first, &second]), &[first.id, second.id])
            .unwrap()
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            list.iter().map(|chunk| chunk.id).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
            [first.id, second.id]
        );

        // The next list sends only what is new to the context.
        let list = stores
            .take_in(client, context, sent(&[&third]), &[third.id, first.id])
            .unwrap()
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            list.iter().map(|chunk| chunk.id).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
            [third.id, first.id]
        );

        // Another client, or another context, keeps nothing of it.
        assert!(
            stores
                .take_in(WebContentClientId(2), context, Vec::new(), &[first.id])
                .is_err()
        );
        assert!(
            stores
                .take_in(client, CompositorContextId(8), Vec::new(), &[first.id])
                .is_err()
        );

        // A chunk no kept list names is gone.
        for _ in 0..DISPLAY_LISTS_WHOSE_CHUNKS_ARE_KEPT {
            stores.take_in(client, context, Vec::new(), &[third.id]).unwrap();
        }
        assert!(stores.take_in(client, context, Vec::new(), &[second.id]).is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn what_a_client_sends_for_a_destroyed_context_goes_nowhere() {
        let client = WebContentClientId(1);
        let context = CompositorContextId(7);
        let first = chunk(0);
        let mut stores = DisplayListChunkStores::default();
        stores.take_in(client, context, sent(&[&first]), &[first.id]).unwrap();
        stores.forget_context(context);
        assert!(
            stores
                .take_in(client, context, Vec::new(), &[first.id])
                .unwrap()
                .is_none()
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_list_sent_whole_names_only_what_it_carries() {
        let (first, second) = (chunk(0), chunk(10));
        let list = chunks_of_list_sent_whole(sent(&[&first, &second]), &[second.id, first.id]).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            list.iter().map(|chunk| chunk.id).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
            [second.id, first.id]
        );
        assert!(chunks_of_list_sent_whole(sent(&[&first]), &[second.id]).is_err());
    }
}

FILE: Services/Compositor/Rust/src/display_list_coverage_watch.rs
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

//! Decides when a context asks its document's render clock for a display list where the compositor has scrolled to.
//! A display list holds what shows in a window around where its scrollers were when it was recorded, and WebContent
//! records one for a new window once its own frame scrolled half the window's margin from there. The context asks
//! once its scrolling does that: WebContent's event loop may be too busy to record one soon. It asks once for a display
//! list, and again once a scroller has moved half a viewport further.

use libcompositing_rust::display_list::window::RecordedWindow;
use libcompositing_rust::scrolling::ScrollStateSnapshot;
use libcompositing_rust::visual_context::VisualContextTree;
use libgfx_rust::{FloatPoint, FloatSize, IntSize};

const VIEWPORTS_SCROLLED_BEFORE_ASKING_AGAIN: f32 = 0.5;

pub struct ShownOfDisplayList<'a> {
    pub display_list_id: u64,
    pub window: &'a RecordedWindow,
    pub visual_context_tree: &'a VisualContextTree,
    pub scroll_state_snapshot: &'a ScrollStateSnapshot,
    pub viewport_size: IntSize,
}

struct Request {
    display_list_id: u64,
    device_scroll_offsets: Vec<FloatPoint>,
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct DisplayListCoverageWatch {
    last_request: Option<Request>,
    last_checked: Option<Request>,
}

/// Whether the window of the display list still holds what the viewport shows with the scrollers where the compositor
/// has them, with half the window's margin to spare.
fn window_still_covers(shown: &ShownOfDisplayList<'_>) -> bool {
    let window = shown.window;
    let tree = shown.visual_context_tree;
    let margin = window.margin();
    window.still_covers(
        tree,
        tree,
        shown.viewport_size,
        window.device_pixels_per_css_pixel,
        |node, _| shown.scroll_state_snapshot.device_offset_for_index(node),
        FloatSize {
            width: margin.width / 2.0,
            height: margin.height / 2.0,
        },
    )
}

fn scrolled_on_since(asked_at: &[FloatPoint], now: &[FloatPoint], viewport_size: IntSize) -> bool {
    let offset_at = |offsets: &[FloatPoint], index: usize| offsets.get(index).copied().unwrap_or_default();
    let horizontally = viewport_size.width as f32 * VIEWPORTS_SCROLLED_BEFORE_ASKING_AGAIN;
    let vertically = viewport_size.height as f32 * VIEWPORTS_SCROLLED_BEFORE_ASKING_AGAIN;
    (0..asked_at.len().max(now.len())).any(|index| {
        let (asked_at, now) = (offset_at(asked_at, index), offset_at(now, index));
        (now.x - asked_at.x).abs() >= horizontally || (now.y - asked_at.y).abs() >= vertically
    })
}

impl DisplayListCoverageWatch {
    pub fn asks_for_display_list_where_scrolled(&mut self, shown: &ShownOfDisplayList<'_>) -> bool {
        let device_scroll_offsets = shown.scroll_state_snapshot.device_offsets();
        let checked_already = self.last_checked.as_ref().is_some_and(|checked| {
            checked.display_list_id == shown.display_list_id && checked.device_scroll_offsets == device_scroll_offsets
        });
        if checked_already {
            return false;
        }
        self.last_checked = Some(Request {
            display_list_id: shown.display_list_id,
            device_scroll_offsets: device_scroll_offsets.to_vec(),
        });
        let request_is_outstanding = self.last_request.as_ref().is_some_and(|request| {
            request.display_list_id == shown.display_list_id
                && !scrolled_on_since(
                    &request.device_scroll_offsets,
                    device_scroll_offsets,
                    shown.viewport_size,
                )
        });
        if request_is_outstanding || window_still_covers(shown) {
            return false;
        }
        self.last_request = Some(Request {
            display_list_id: shown.display_list_id,
            device_scroll_offsets: device_scroll_offsets.to_vec(),
        });
        true
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use libcompositing_rust::display_list::commands::SpatialNodeIndex;
    use libcompositing_rust::node_slot_id::NodeSlotId;
    use libcompositing_rust::visual_context::scroll_state::NO_SCROLL_STATE_SLOT;
    use libcompositing_rust::visual_context::{ScrollData, SpatialData, VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX};
    use std::sync::Arc;

    const VIEWPORT: IntSize = IntSize {
        width: 800,
        height: 600,
    };

    struct PageWithAScrollerInIt {
        tree: VisualContextTree,
        page: SpatialNodeIndex,
        inner_scroller: SpatialNodeIndex,
    }

    impl PageWithAScrollerInIt {
        fn new() -> Self {
            let scroller = || {
                SpatialData::Scroll(ScrollData {
                    state_slot: NO_SCROLL_STATE_SLOT,
                    owner_paintable: NodeSlotId::INVALID,
                })
            };
            let mut tree = VisualContextTree::create_identity();
            let page = tree.append_spatial(scroller(), VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX);
            let inner_scroller = tree.append_spatial(scroller(), page);
            Self {
                tree,
                page,
                inner_scroller,
            }
        }

        // The scrollers scrolled down by each amount, in device pixels.
        fn device_offsets(&self, scrolled: &[(SpatialNodeIndex, f32)]) -> Vec<FloatPoint> {
            let mut offsets = vec![FloatPoint::default(); self.tree.spatial_nodes.len()];
            for &(scroller, by) in scrolled {
                offsets[scroller.0 as usize] = FloatPoint { x: 0.0, y: -by };
            }
            offsets
        }

        fn window_placed_with(&self, scrolled: &[(SpatialNodeIndex, f32)]) -> RecordedWindow {
            RecordedWindow::placed_at(VIEWPORT, 1.0, Arc::from(self.device_offsets(scrolled)))
        }

        fn asks(
            &self,
            watch: &mut DisplayListCoverageWatch,
            display_list_id: u64,
            window: &RecordedWindow,
            scrolled: &[(SpatialNodeIndex, f32)],
        ) -> bool {
            let snapshot = ScrollStateSnapshot::from_device_offsets(self.device_offsets(scrolled));
            watch.asks_for_display_list_where_scrolled(&ShownOfDisplayList {
                display_list_id,
                window,
                visual_context_tree: &self.tree,
                scroll_state_snapshot: &snapshot,
                viewport_size: VIEWPORT,
            })
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_context_asks_once_what_shows_comes_within_half_a_margin_of_the_window_edge() {
        let page = PageWithAScrollerInIt::new();
        let window = page.window_placed_with(&[]);
        let mut watch = DisplayListCoverageWatch::default();
        // The window reaches 1200 below the viewport, and half of that is kept ahead.
        assert!(!page.asks(&mut watch, 1, &window, &[(page.page, 600.0)]));
        assert!(page.asks(&mut watch, 1, &window, &[(page.page, 601.0)]));
    }

    #[test]
    fn scrollers_in_one_chain_run_out_of_the_window_together() {
        let page = PageWithAScrollerInIt::new();
        let window = page.window_placed_with(&[]);
        let mut watch = DisplayListCoverageWatch::default();
        assert!(!page.asks(&mut watch, 1, &window, &[(page.inner_scroller, 400.0)]));
        assert!(page.asks(
            &mut watch,
            1,
            &window,
            &[(page.page, 400.0), (page.inner_scroller, 400.0)]
        ));
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_context_asks_again_after_half_a_viewport_more_or_for_a_newer_list_that_falls_short() {
        let page = PageWithAScrollerInIt::new();
        let window = page.window_placed_with(&[]);
        let mut watch = DisplayListCoverageWatch::default();
        assert!(page.asks(&mut watch, 1, &window, &[(page.page, 700.0)]));
        assert!(!page.asks(&mut watch, 1, &window, &[(page.page, 999.0)]));
        assert!(page.asks(&mut watch, 1, &window, &[(page.page, 1000.0)]));
        // A list recorded where the page is now covers it, and a newer one recorded where it was does not.
        let window_where_scrolled = page.window_placed_with(&[(page.page, 1000.0)]);
        assert!(!page.asks(&mut watch, 2, &window_where_scrolled, &[(page.page, 1000.0)]));
        assert!(page.asks(&mut watch, 3, &window, &[(page.page, 1000.0)]));
    }
}

FILE: Services/Compositor/Rust/src/elastic_overscroll_controller.rs
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

use libcompositing_rust::scrolling::elastic_overscroll::ElasticOverscroll;
use libcompositing_rust::scrolling::scroll_fling::ScrollVelocityTracker;
use libcompositing_rust::scrolling::{
    AsyncScrollNode, AsyncScrollNodeStableID, AsyncScrollTree, ScrollGesturePhase, ScrollStateSnapshot,
    WheelDeltaPrecision,
};
use libcompositing_rust::time::MonotonicTime;
use libgfx_rust::{FloatPoint, FloatSize};

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct ElasticOverscrollController {
    enabled: bool,
    active_overscrolls: Vec<ActiveOverscroll>,
    step_velocity_tracker: ScrollVelocityTracker,
}

// A scroller that a touchpad gesture holds past an edge of its scroll range, or that is springing back from there.
// The stretch is only presented: it is in no scroll offset that the scroll tree or WebContent sees.
struct ActiveOverscroll {
    stable_node_id: AsyncScrollNodeStableID,
    overscroll: ElasticOverscroll,
}

impl ElasticOverscrollController {
    pub fn set_enabled(&mut self, enabled: bool) {
        self.enabled = enabled;
        if !enabled {
            self.forget();
        }
    }

    pub fn step_can_stretch(
        &self,
        wheel_delta_precision: WheelDeltaPrecision,
        scroll_gesture_phase: ScrollGesturePhase,
    ) -> bool {
        if !self.enabled {
            return false;
        }
        // Only a touchpad gesture says when the fingers lift, which is when a stretch has to spring back.
        if wheel_delta_precision != WheelDeltaPrecision::Precise {
            return false;
        }
        scroll_gesture_phase == ScrollGesturePhase::Ongoing || scroll_gesture_phase == ScrollGesturePhase::Momentum
    }

    pub fn note_step_from_ui(&mut self, delta: FloatPoint, now: MonotonicTime) {
        self.step_velocity_tracker.add_step(delta, now);
    }

    fn active_overscroll_of(&mut self, stable_node_id: AsyncScrollNodeStableID) -> Option<&mut ActiveOverscroll> {
        self.active_overscrolls
            .iter_mut()
            .find(|active| active.stable_node_id == stable_node_id)
    }

    pub fn has_active_overscroll_of(&self, stable_node_id: AsyncScrollNodeStableID) -> bool {
        self.active_overscrolls
            .iter()
            .any(|active| active.stable_node_id == stable_node_id)
    }

    pub fn stretch_of(&self, stable_node_id: AsyncScrollNodeStableID) -> FloatPoint {
        for active in &self.active_overscrolls {
            if active.stable_node_id == stable_node_id {
                return active.overscroll.stretch();
            }
        }
        FloatPoint::default()
    }

    // Uses the part of a finger step that points back to the scroll range to relax the stretch of the scroller, and
    // returns the rest of the step.
    pub fn relax_by(&mut self, stable_node_id: AsyncScrollNodeStableID, step_delta: FloatPoint) -> FloatPoint {
        let Some(active) = self.active_overscroll_of(stable_node_id) else {
            return step_delta;
        };
        let delta_left_to_scroll_with = active.overscroll.relax_by(step_delta);
        if active.overscroll.is_at_rest() {
            self.active_overscrolls
                .retain(|candidate| candidate.stable_node_id != stable_node_id);
        }
        delta_left_to_scroll_with
    }

    // Returns whether the scroller is at an edge that the step points past, which is what lets the step pull it.
    pub fn pull_by(
        &mut self,
        node: &AsyncScrollNode,
        scroll_offset: FloatPoint,
        step_delta: FloatPoint,
        delta_the_scroller_did_not_scroll_by: FloatPoint,
        visual_viewport_magnification: f32,
    ) -> bool {
        // A touchpad step is rarely along one axis exactly. Only its main direction pulls, so that a vertical pan next to
        // a side edge does not creep past that edge.
        let mut overscroll_delta = FloatPoint::default();
        let step_is_mainly_vertical = step_delta.y.abs() >= step_delta.x.abs();
        if step_is_mainly_vertical {
            let delta_y = delta_the_scroller_did_not_scroll_by.y;
            let is_at_the_edge_the_delta_points_past = (delta_y < 0.0 && scroll_offset.y <= node.min_scroll_offset.y)
                || (delta_y > 0.0 && scroll_offset.y >= node.max_scroll_offset.y);
            if node.can_be_wheel_scrolled_vertically
                && node.shows_overscroll_effect_vertically
                && is_at_the_edge_the_delta_points_past
            {
                overscroll_delta.y = delta_y;
            }
        } else {
            let delta_x = delta_the_scroller_did_not_scroll_by.x;
            let is_at_the_edge_the_delta_points_past = (delta_x < 0.0 && scroll_offset.x <= node.min_scroll_offset.x)
                || (delta_x > 0.0 && scroll_offset.x >= node.max_scroll_offset.x);
            if node.can_be_wheel_scrolled_horizontally
                && node.shows_overscroll_effect_horizontally
                && is_at_the_edge_the_delta_points_past
            {
                overscroll_delta.x = delta_x;
            }
        }
        if overscroll_delta.is_zero() {
            return false;
        }

        let active = match self
            .active_overscrolls
            .iter()
            .position(|active| active.stable_node_id == node.stable_node_id)
        {
            Some(index) => &mut self.active_overscrolls[index],
            None => {
                // A zoomed page shows only the part of the viewport's scrollport that its visual viewport is on, and that part
                // is what bounds how far the viewport stretches.
                let mut scrollport_size = FloatSize {
                    width: node.scrollport_rect.width as f32,
                    height: node.scrollport_rect.height as f32,
                };
                if node.is_viewport {
                    scrollport_size.width *= 1.0_f32 / visual_viewport_magnification;
                    scrollport_size.height *= 1.0_f32 / visual_viewport_magnification;
                }
                if scrollport_size.width.is_nan()
                    || scrollport_size.height.is_nan()
                    || scrollport_size.width < 0.0
                    || scrollport_size.height < 0.0
                {
                    return false;
                }
                self.active_overscrolls.push(ActiveOverscroll {
                    stable_node_id: node.stable_node_id,
                    overscroll: ElasticOverscroll::new(scrollport_size, visual_viewport_magnification),
                });
                self.active_overscrolls.last_mut().unwrap()
            }
        };
        active.overscroll.pull_by(overscroll_delta);
        true
    }

    pub fn release_held_by_fingers(&mut self, now: MonotonicTime) {
        let velocity = self.step_velocity_tracker.velocity_at_lift(now).unwrap_or_default();
        for active in &mut self.active_overscrolls {
            active.overscroll.release(velocity, now);
        }
    }

    // A scroller that something else scrolls along an axis it is stretched in lets go of the stretch at once, while one
    // that something else scrolls smoothly springs back from it.
    pub fn drop_stretch_moved_by(&mut self, stable_node_id: AsyncScrollNodeStableID, scroll_delta: FloatPoint) {
        let stretch = self.stretch_of(stable_node_id);
        if (stretch.x != 0.0 && scroll_delta.x != 0.0) || (stretch.y != 0.0 && scroll_delta.y != 0.0) {
            self.active_overscrolls
                .retain(|active| active.stable_node_id != stable_node_id);
        }
    }

    pub fn release_stretch_of(&mut self, stable_node_id: AsyncScrollNodeStableID, now: MonotonicTime) {
        if let Some(active) = self.active_overscroll_of(stable_node_id)
            && !active.overscroll.is_rebounding()
        {
            active.overscroll.release(FloatPoint::default(), now);
        }
    }

    pub fn end_gesture(&mut self, now: MonotonicTime) {
        self.release_held_by_fingers(now);
        self.step_velocity_tracker.reset();
    }

    pub fn forget(&mut self) {
        self.active_overscrolls.clear();
        self.step_velocity_tracker.reset();
    }

    pub fn did_install_scrolling_state(&mut self, async_scroll_tree: &AsyncScrollTree) {
        self.active_overscrolls.retain(|active| {
            let node = async_scroll_tree
                .scroll_node_index_for_stable_id(active.stable_node_id)
                .and_then(|index| async_scroll_tree.scroll_node_for_index(index));
            let Some(node) = node else {
                return false;
            };
            // A scroller that has been told not to stretch along an axis since it was pulled lets go at once.
            let stretch = active.overscroll.stretch();
            !((stretch.x != 0.0 && !node.shows_overscroll_effect_horizontally)
                || (stretch.y != 0.0 && !node.shows_overscroll_effect_vertically))
        });
    }

    pub fn has_rebound(&self) -> bool {
        self.active_overscrolls
            .iter()
            .any(|active| active.overscroll.is_rebounding())
    }

    pub fn advance_rebounds(&mut self, frame_time: MonotonicTime) -> bool {
        let mut a_presented_stretch_changed = false;
        self.active_overscrolls.retain_mut(|active| {
            if !active.overscroll.is_rebounding() {
                return true;
            }
            let stretch_before = active.overscroll.stretch();
            let is_still_rebounding = active.overscroll.advance_rebound_to(frame_time);
            if active.overscroll.stretch() != stretch_before {
                a_presented_stretch_changed = true;
            }
            is_still_rebounding
        });
        a_presented_stretch_changed
    }

    // The scroll offsets to present when a scroller is stretched, which are the only ones that leave a scroll range.
    pub fn stretched_scroll_state_snapshot(
        &self,
        scroll_state_snapshot: &ScrollStateSnapshot,
        async_scroll_tree: &AsyncScrollTree,
    ) -> Option<ScrollStateSnapshot> {
        let mut stretched_scroll_state_snapshot = None;
        for active in &self.active_overscrolls {
            let stretch = active.overscroll.stretch();
            if stretch.is_zero() {
                continue;
            }
            let Some(scroll_node_index) = async_scroll_tree.scroll_node_index_for_stable_id(active.stable_node_id)
            else {
                continue;
            };
            let snapshot = stretched_scroll_state_snapshot.get_or_insert_with(|| scroll_state_snapshot.clone());
            // Only the scroller's own entry moves. The sticky boxes in it keep the shifts resolved for the scroll offset
            // it really has, so they move with its content.
            snapshot.set_device_offset_for_index(
                scroll_node_index,
                snapshot.device_offset_for_index(scroll_node_index) - stretch,
            );
        }
        stretched_scroll_state_snapshot
    }
}

fn time(nanoseconds: i64) -> MonotonicTime {
    MonotonicTime::from_nanoseconds(nanoseconds)
}

/// # Safety
///
/// `host.host` and `raster_host.host` must outlive the core, and none of their entry points may call back into the
/// core.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn compositor_core_create(
    host: FfiCompositorCoreHost,
    raster_host: FfiRasterHost,
    scrollbars_always_shown: bool,
    gpu: GpuBackend,
) -> *mut CompositorCore {
    // SAFETY: The caller keeps the hosts alive for as long as the core, and their entry points out of the core.
    let (host, raster_host) = unsafe { (Rc::new(Host::new(host)), RasterHost::new(raster_host)) };
    Box::into_raw(Box::new(CompositorCore::new(
        host,
        raster_host,
        scrollbars_always_shown,
        gpu,
    )))
}

/// # Safety
///
/// `core` must be a core from `compositor_core_create` that nothing uses afterwards.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn compositor_core_destroy(core: *mut CompositorCore) {
    // SAFETY: The caller hands over the core `compositor_core_create` made.
    drop(unsafe { Box::from_raw(core) });
}

}

    let Some(parent) = core.parent_context(CompositorContextId(context_id)) else {

}

/// Paints a screenshot of the context into the surface, answering false for a context with nothing to paint yet.
///
/// # Safety
///
/// `surface` must be a live surface.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn compositor_core_paint_screenshot(
    core: &CompositorCore,
    context_id: u64,
    surface: *const PaintingSurface,
    now_nanoseconds: i64,
) -> bool {
    // SAFETY: The caller lends a live surface, which the painting holds while it lasts.
    let surface = unsafe { PaintingSurface::retained_from_ffi(surface) };
    core.paint_screenshot(CompositorContextId(context_id), &surface, time(now_nanoseconds))
}

/// The surface that holds the frame on screen as a whole, with one reference that the caller takes over, and the size
/// of the frame in it. Answers null where no frame is on screen.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn compositor_core_presented_frame_for_snapshot(
    core: &CompositorCore,
    context_id: u64,
    now_nanoseconds: i64,
    frame_size: &mut IntSize,
) -> *const PaintingSurface {
    let Some((source, size)) =
        core.presented_frame_for_snapshot(CompositorContextId(context_id), time(now_nanoseconds))
    else {
        return std::ptr::null();
    };
    *frame_size = size;
    PaintingSurface::into_ffi(source)
}

/// Takes a message of the CompositorWebContentServer endpoint that is marked [RustReceiver].
///
/// # Safety
///
/// `message` must be one `IPC::RawMessage::hand_to_rust()` made.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn compositor_core_handle_web_content_message(
    core: &CompositorCore,
    web_content_client_id: u64,
    message: RawMessage<'_>,
    now_nanoseconds: i64,
) {
    let mut stub = MessagesFromWebContent {
        core,
        client_id: WebContentClientId(web_content_client_id),
        now: time(now_nanoseconds),
    };
    // SAFETY: The caller hands over a message of that endpoint.
    unsafe {
        message.hand_to(|bytes, attachments| compositor_web_content_server::dispatch(&mut stub, bytes, attachments));
    };
    core.finish_message(time(now_nanoseconds));
}

///

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn compositor_core_handle_presentation_message(

    presentation_id: u64,

) {
    let mut stub = MessagesFromPresentation {
        core,
        presentation_id: PresentationId(presentation_id),
        now: time(now_nanoseconds),
    };
    // SAFETY: The caller hands over a message of that endpoint.
    unsafe {
        message.hand_to(|bytes, attachments| compositor_presentation_server::dispatch(&mut stub, bytes, attachments));
    };
    core.finish_message(time(now_nanoseconds));
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn compositor_core_set_ui_overlays(
    core: &CompositorCore,
    context_id: u64,
    ui_overlays: &FfiUIOverlays<'_>,
    now_nanoseconds: i64,
) {
    let paused_debugger = ui_overlays.has_paused_debugger.then(|| PausedDebuggerOverlayState {
        font_family: ui_overlays
            .paused_debugger_has_font_family
            .then(|| String::from_utf8_lossy(ui_overlays.paused_debugger_font_family.as_slice()).into_owned()),
        hovered_action: match (
            ui_overlays.paused_debugger_has_hovered_action,
            ui_overlays.paused_debugger_hovered_action,
        ) {
            (true, 0) => Some(PausedDebuggerOverlayAction::StepOver),
            (true, 1) => Some(PausedDebuggerOverlayAction::Continue),
            _ => None,
        },
    });
    let picture_in_picture_controls =
        ui_overlays
            .has_picture_in_picture_controls
            .then_some(PictureInPictureControlsState {
                shown: ui_overlays.picture_in_picture_controls_shown,
                hovered_control: match (
                    ui_overlays.picture_in_picture_controls_has_hovered_control,
                    ui_overlays.picture_in_picture_controls_hovered_control,
                ) {
                    (true, 0) => Some(PictureInPictureControl::BackToTab),
                    (true, 1) => Some(PictureInPictureControl::Close),
                    _ => None,
                },
            });
    core.set_ui_overlays(
        CompositorContextId(context_id),
        UIOverlays {
            paused_debugger,
            picture_in_picture_controls,
            compositor_layers: ui_overlays.has_compositor_layers.then(|| CompositorLayersOverlayState {
                font_family: ui_overlays.compositor_layers_has_font_family.then(|| {
                    String::from_utf8_lossy(ui_overlays.compositor_layers_font_family.as_slice()).into_owned()
                }),
                hidden_layer_ids: ui_overlays.compositor_layers_hidden_layer_ids.as_slice().to_vec(),
                selected_layer_ids: ui_overlays.compositor_layers_selected_layer_ids.as_slice().to_vec(),
                hovered_layer_id: ui_overlays
                    .compositor_layers_has_hovered_layer_id
                    .then_some(ui_overlays.compositor_layers_hovered_layer_id),
                raster_count_reset_generation: ui_overlays.compositor_layers_raster_count_reset_generation,
            }),
        },
        MonotonicTime::from_nanoseconds(now_nanoseconds),
    );
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn compositor_core_forget_web_content_client(core: &CompositorCore, web_content_client_id: u64) {
    let client = WebContentClientId(web_content_client_id);
    core.canvas_2d_contexts().forget_client(client);
    core.webgl_contexts().forget_client(client);
}

) -> ContextOwnerCheckResult {
    core.check_context_owner(
        CompositorContextId(context_id),
        WebContentClientId(web_content_client_id),
    )
}

/// A timer of the compositor, which fires once after the delay it is set to, until it is set again.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]

// The host knows a timer by a number of its own, which stays the same for as long as the timer exists.
#[derive(Default)]

    number_of_timer: HashMap<Timer, u64>,

/// A label of an overlay as the host shaped it, lent for the call it is handed to.
#[repr(C)]
pub struct FfiOverlayLabel<'a> {
    pub font_id: u64,
    pub glyph_ids: ak::Span<'a, u32>,
    pub glyph_x_positions: ak::Span<'a, f32>,
    pub width: f32,
    pub ascent: f32,
    pub descent: f32,
