    }
}

impl RemoteLayerHost for RasterHost {
    fn create_window_server(&self) -> Option<WindowServerObject> {
        let mut window_server = FfiCppObject::default();
        // SAFETY: The host outlives this, and writes the window server it made.
        if !unsafe { (self.0.create_window_server)(self.host(), &raw mut window_server) } {
            return None;
        }
        // SAFETY: The host handed a window server over.
        unsafe { WindowServerObject::adopt(window_server) }
    }

    fn create_remote_layer(
        &self,
        window_server: &WindowServerObject,
        remote_layer_id: u64,
    ) -> Option<(RemoteLayerObject, Compositing_RemoteLayerHostHandle)> {
        let mut layer = FfiCppObject::default();
        let mut host_handle = FfiRemoteLayerHostHandle::default();
        // SAFETY: The window server is live, and the host writes the layer it made with its handle.
        if !unsafe {
            (self.0.create_remote_layer)(
                window_server.as_ptr(),
                remote_layer_id,
                &raw mut layer,
                &raw mut host_handle,
            )
        } {
            return None;
        }
        // SAFETY: The host handed the layer over.
        let layer = unsafe { RemoteLayerObject::adopt(layer) }?;
        let kind = match host_handle.kind {
            1 => Compositing_RemoteLayerHostKind::CoreAnimationContext,
            2 => Compositing_RemoteLayerHostKind::Win32ChildWindow,
            _ => return None,
        };
        Some((
            layer,
            Compositing_RemoteLayerHostHandle {
                kind,
                id: host_handle.id,
            },
        ))
    }

    fn place_frame(&self, remote_layer: &RemoteLayerObject, fit_within: Option<IntSize>) {
        // SAFETY: The layer is live.
        unsafe {
            (self.0.remote_layer_place_frame)(
                remote_layer.as_ptr(),
                fit_within.is_some(),
                fit_within.unwrap_or_default(),
            );
        }
    }

    fn hold_changes_on_screen(&self, window_server: &WindowServerObject) {
        // SAFETY: The window server is live.
        unsafe { (self.0.window_server_hold_changes_on_screen)(window_server.as_ptr()) };
    }

    fn release_changes_held_off_screen(&self, window_server: &WindowServerObject) {
        // SAFETY: The window server is live.
        unsafe { (self.0.window_server_release_changes_held_off_screen)(window_server.as_ptr()) };
    }
}

/*

//! The remote layers that root contexts are shown in, which the window server of the presentation that made them shows
//! in views of their own, and the window resizes that hold what the window servers show until the presentation commits
//! them. The window servers and the layers are C++ objects, which the raster host works on.

use crate::cpp_object::{CppObject, FfiCppObject};
use crate::host::PresentationId;
use libcompositing_rust::display_list::commands::CompositorContextId;
use libcompositing_rust::ipc_types::{Compositing_RemoteLayerHostHandle, Compositing_RemoteLayerHostKind};
use libgfx_rust::IntSize;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::rc::Rc;

/// A `Compositor::WindowServer`, of which the core owns a reference.
pub struct WindowServerObject(CppObject);

impl WindowServerObject {
    /// # Safety
    ///
    /// A non-null object must be a live `Compositor::WindowServer` that is handed over, with the function that gives up
    /// the reference.
    pub unsafe fn adopt(object: FfiCppObject) -> Option<Self> {
        // SAFETY: The caller hands over the window server.
        unsafe { CppObject::adopt(object) }.map(Self)
    }

    pub fn as_ptr(&self) -> *mut std::ffi::c_void {
        self.0.as_ptr()
    }
}

/// A `Compositor::RemoteLayer`, which the core owns.
pub struct RemoteLayerObject(CppObject);

impl RemoteLayerObject {
    /// # Safety
    ///
    /// A non-null object must be a live `Compositor::RemoteLayer` that is handed over, with the function that destroys
    /// it.
    pub unsafe fn adopt(object: FfiCppObject) -> Option<Self> {
        // SAFETY: The caller hands over the layer.
        unsafe { CppObject::adopt(object) }.map(Self)
    }

    pub fn as_ptr(&self) -> *mut std::ffi::c_void {
        self.0.as_ptr()
    }
}

/// What is done to the window servers and the layers.
pub trait RemoteLayerHost {
    fn create_window_server(&self) -> Option<WindowServerObject>;
    fn create_remote_layer(
        &self,
        window_server: &WindowServerObject,
        remote_layer_id: u64,
    ) -> Option<(RemoteLayerObject, Compositing_RemoteLayerHostHandle)>;
    fn place_frame(&self, remote_layer: &RemoteLayerObject, fit_within: Option<IntSize>);
    fn hold_changes_on_screen(&self, window_server: &WindowServerObject);
    fn release_changes_held_off_screen(&self, window_server: &WindowServerObject);
}

/// A resize of a remote layer that the presentation is to hear of.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct ResizeNotice {
    pub presentation: PresentationId,
    pub remote_layer_id: u64,
    pub token: u64,
}

/// The contexts that a change of what a remote layer shows starts or stops showing in one.
#[derive(Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct ShownContextChange {
    pub stopped: Option<CompositorContextId>,
    pub started: Option<CompositorContextId>,
}

/// The layer that shows a context, and the window server it is in.
#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct ShowingLayer {
    pub layer: Rc<RemoteLayerObject>,
    pub window_server: Rc<WindowServerObject>,
}

pub struct RemoteLayer {
    presentation: PresentationId,
    layer: Rc<RemoteLayerObject>,
    window_server: Rc<WindowServerObject>,
    shown_context: Option<CompositorContextId>,
    fit_within: Option<IntSize>,
    // The size of the frame shown, where the page laid it out at that size.
    size_of_shown_frame_laid_out_by_page: Option<IntSize>,
}

impl RemoteLayer {
    pub fn showing_layer(&self) -> ShowingLayer {
        ShowingLayer {
            layer: self.layer.clone(),
            window_server: self.window_server.clone(),
        }
    }

    pub fn presentation(&self) -> PresentationId {
        self.presentation
    }

    pub fn fit_within(&self) -> Option<IntSize> {
        self.fit_within
    }
}

struct SynchronizedResize {
    remote_layer_id: u64,
    token: u64,
    awaited_size: Option<IntSize>,
    frame_is_held: bool,
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct RemoteLayers {
    window_servers: HashMap<PresentationId, Rc<WindowServerObject>>,
    layers: HashMap<u64, RemoteLayer>,
    layer_showing_context: HashMap<CompositorContextId, u64>,
    synchronized_resizes: Vec<SynchronizedResize>,
    window_servers_holding_changes: Vec<Rc<WindowServerObject>>,
}

fn no_host_handle() -> Compositing_RemoteLayerHostHandle {
    Compositing_RemoteLayerHostHandle {
        kind: Compositing_RemoteLayerHostKind::None,
        id: 0,
    }
}

impl RemoteLayers {
    pub fn register_presentation(&mut self, presentation: PresentationId, host: &dyn RemoteLayerHost) {
        if let Some(window_server) = host.create_window_server() {
            self.window_servers.insert(presentation, Rc::new(window_server));
        }
    }

    /// Destroys the layers of the presentation, answering the contexts that were shown in them.
    pub fn unregister_presentation(
        &mut self,
        presentation: PresentationId,
        host: &dyn RemoteLayerHost,
    ) -> Vec<CompositorContextId> {
        let mut remote_layer_ids: Vec<u64> = self
            .layers
            .iter()
            .filter(|(_, layer)| layer.presentation == presentation)
            .map(|(&id, _)| id)
            .collect();
        remote_layer_ids.sort_unstable();
        let stopped = remote_layer_ids
            .into_iter()
            .filter_map(|remote_layer_id| self.destroy_remote_layer(remote_layer_id, host))
            .collect();
        if let Some(window_server) = self.window_servers.remove(&presentation)
            && let Some(index) = self
                .window_servers_holding_changes
                .iter()
                .position(|holding| Rc::ptr_eq(holding, &window_server))
        {
            self.window_servers_holding_changes.remove(index);
            host.release_changes_held_off_screen(&window_server);
        }
        stopped
    }

    /// The host handle that the presentation shows the layer by, whose kind is none where the presentation has no
    /// remote layers or the layer exists already.
    pub fn create_remote_layer(
        &mut self,
        presentation: PresentationId,
        remote_layer_id: u64,
        host: &dyn RemoteLayerHost,
    ) -> Compositing_RemoteLayerHostHandle {
        if self.layers.contains_key(&remote_layer_id) {
            return no_host_handle();
        }
        let Some(window_server) = self.window_servers.get(&presentation).cloned() else {
            return no_host_handle();
        };
        let Some((layer, host_handle)) = host.create_remote_layer(&window_server, remote_layer_id) else {
            return no_host_handle();
        };
        self.layers.insert(
            remote_layer_id,
            RemoteLayer {
                presentation,
                layer: Rc::new(layer),
                window_server,
                shown_context: None,
                fit_within: None,
                size_of_shown_frame_laid_out_by_page: None,
            },
        );
        host_handle
    }

    /// Answers the context that the layer showed.
    pub fn destroy_remote_layer(
        &mut self,
        remote_layer_id: u64,
        host: &dyn RemoteLayerHost,
    ) -> Option<CompositorContextId> {
        let stopped = self
            .show_context_in_remote_layer(remote_layer_id, None, |_| false)
            .stopped;
        self.layers.remove(&remote_layer_id);
        let had_synchronized_resizes = !self.synchronized_resizes.is_empty();
        self.synchronized_resizes
            .retain(|resize| resize.remote_layer_id != remote_layer_id);
        if had_synchronized_resizes && self.synchronized_resizes.is_empty() {
            self.release_synchronized_resize_hold(host);
        }
        stopped
    }

    /// Shows the context in the layer instead of what it showed, where `can_be_shown` lets it. A context moves from
    /// any other layer it was shown in.
    pub fn show_context_in_remote_layer(
        &mut self,
        remote_layer_id: u64,
        context_id: Option<CompositorContextId>,
        can_be_shown: impl FnOnce(CompositorContextId) -> bool,
    ) -> ShownContextChange {
        let mut change = ShownContextChange::default();
        let Some(layer) = self.layers.get_mut(&remote_layer_id) else {
            return change;
        };
        if layer.shown_context == context_id {
            return change;
        }
        layer.size_of_shown_frame_laid_out_by_page = None;
        if let Some(shown_context) = layer.shown_context.take() {
            self.layer_showing_context.remove(&shown_context);
            change.stopped = Some(shown_context);
        }
        let Some(context_id) = context_id else {
            return change;
        };
        if !can_be_shown(context_id) {
            return change;
        }
        if let Some(other_remote_layer_id) = self.layer_showing_context.get(&context_id).copied()
            && let Some(other_layer) = self.layers.get_mut(&other_remote_layer_id)
        {
            other_layer.shown_context = None;
            other_layer.size_of_shown_frame_laid_out_by_page = None;
        }
        if let Some(layer) = self.layers.get_mut(&remote_layer_id) {
            layer.shown_context = Some(context_id);
        }
        self.layer_showing_context.insert(context_id, remote_layer_id);
        change.started = Some(context_id);
        change
    }

    /// The layer keeps the last frame of a context that is gone until another context is shown in it.
    pub fn context_destroyed(&mut self, context_id: CompositorContextId) {
        if let Some(remote_layer_id) = self.layer_showing_context.remove(&context_id)
            && let Some(layer) = self.layers.get_mut(&remote_layer_id)
        {
            layer.shown_context = None;
        }
    }

    /// The context is no longer shown in the layer that showed it, as when the layer could not show its frame.
    pub fn stop_showing_context(&mut self, context_id: CompositorContextId) {
        if let Some(remote_layer_id) = self.layer_showing_context.remove(&context_id)
            && let Some(layer) = self.layers.get_mut(&remote_layer_id)
        {
            layer.shown_context = None;
            layer.size_of_shown_frame_laid_out_by_page = None;
        }
    }

    pub fn layer_showing(&self, context_id: CompositorContextId) -> Option<&RemoteLayer> {
        self.layers.get(self.layer_showing_context.get(&context_id)?)
    }

    pub fn set_remote_layer_fit(
        &mut self,
        remote_layer_id: u64,
        fit_within: Option<IntSize>,
        host: &dyn RemoteLayerHost,
    ) {
        let Some(layer) = self.layers.get_mut(&remote_layer_id) else {
            return;
        };
        if layer.fit_within == fit_within {
            return;
        }
        layer.fit_within = fit_within;
        host.place_frame(&layer.layer, fit_within);
    }

    pub fn is_holding_changes(&self) -> bool {
        !self.window_servers_holding_changes.is_empty()
    }

    pub fn begin_synchronized_resize(&mut self, remote_layer_id: u64, token: u64, host: &dyn RemoteLayerHost) {
        let Some(layer) = self.layers.get(&remote_layer_id) else {
            return;
        };
        if !self
            .window_servers_holding_changes
            .iter()
            .any(|holding| Rc::ptr_eq(holding, &layer.window_server))
        {
            self.window_servers_holding_changes.push(layer.window_server.clone());
            host.hold_changes_on_screen(&layer.window_server);
        }
        self.synchronized_resizes.push(SynchronizedResize {
            remote_layer_id,
            token,
            awaited_size: None,
            frame_is_held: false,
        });
    }

    pub fn await_synchronized_resize_frame(
        &mut self,
        remote_layer_id: u64,
        token: u64,
        size: IntSize,
    ) -> Vec<ResizeNotice> {
        for resize in &mut self.synchronized_resizes {
            if resize.remote_layer_id == remote_layer_id && resize.token == token {
                resize.awaited_size = Some(size);
            }
        }
        self.held_synchronized_resize_frames(remote_layer_id)
    }

    /// The resizes of the layer whose frame it now shows, which the presentation is told of once.
    fn held_synchronized_resize_frames(&mut self, remote_layer_id: u64) -> Vec<ResizeNotice> {
        let mut held = Vec::new();
        let Some(layer) = self.layers.get(&remote_layer_id) else {
            return held;
        };
        let shown_size = layer.size_of_shown_frame_laid_out_by_page;
        for resize in &mut self.synchronized_resizes {
            if resize.remote_layer_id != remote_layer_id
                || resize.frame_is_held
                || resize.awaited_size.is_none()
                || resize.awaited_size != shown_size
            {
                continue;
            }
            resize.frame_is_held = true;
            held.push(ResizeNotice {
                presentation: layer.presentation,
                remote_layer_id,
                token: resize.token,
            });
        }
        held
    }

    pub fn commit_synchronized_resize(
        &mut self,
        remote_layer_id: u64,
        token: u64,
        host: &dyn RemoteLayerHost,
    ) -> Option<ResizeNotice> {
        self.synchronized_resizes
            .retain(|resize| !(resize.remote_layer_id == remote_layer_id && resize.token == token));
        if self.synchronized_resizes.is_empty() {
            self.release_synchronized_resize_hold(host);
        }
        let layer = self.layers.get(&remote_layer_id)?;
        Some(ResizeNotice {
            presentation: layer.presentation,
            remote_layer_id,
            token,
        })
    }

    pub fn release_synchronized_resize_hold(&mut self, host: &dyn RemoteLayerHost) {
        self.synchronized_resizes.clear();
        for window_server in std::mem::take(&mut self.window_servers_holding_changes) {
            host.release_changes_held_off_screen(&window_server);
        }
    }

    /// The layer that shows the context showed a frame of it, which the page laid out at the size it was painted at
    /// where `laid_out_by_page` says so. Answers the resizes whose frame the layer now shows.
    pub fn did_show_frame(
        &mut self,
        context_id: CompositorContextId,
        painted_size: IntSize,
        laid_out_by_page: bool,
    ) -> Vec<ResizeNotice> {
        let Some(remote_layer_id) = self.layer_showing_context.get(&context_id).copied() else {
            return Vec::new();
        };
        if let Some(layer) = self.layers.get_mut(&remote_layer_id) {
            layer.size_of_shown_frame_laid_out_by_page = laid_out_by_page.then_some(painted_size);
        }
        self.held_synchronized_resize_frames(remote_layer_id)
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::cpp_object::testing::object_for_testing;
    use std::cell::{Cell, RefCell};

    #[derive(Default)]
    struct RecordingHost {
        next_address: Cell<usize>,
        held: RefCell<Vec<usize>>,
        released: RefCell<Vec<usize>>,
        placed: RefCell<Vec<Option<IntSize>>>,
    }

    impl RecordingHost {
        fn next_object(&self) -> CppObject {
            self.next_address.set(self.next_address.get() + 0x10);
            object_for_testing(self.next_address.get())
        }
    }

    impl RemoteLayerHost for RecordingHost {
        fn create_window_server(&self) -> Option<WindowServerObject> {
            Some(WindowServerObject(self.next_object()))
        }

        fn create_remote_layer(
            &self,
            _: &WindowServerObject,
            remote_layer_id: u64,
        ) -> Option<(RemoteLayerObject, Compositing_RemoteLayerHostHandle)> {
            Some((
                RemoteLayerObject(self.next_object()),
                Compositing_RemoteLayerHostHandle {
                    kind: Compositing_RemoteLayerHostKind::CoreAnimationContext,
                    id: remote_layer_id,
                },
            ))
        }

        fn place_frame(&self, _: &RemoteLayerObject, fit_within: Option<IntSize>) {
            self.placed.borrow_mut().push(fit_within);
        }

        fn hold_changes_on_screen(&self, window_server: &WindowServerObject) {
            self.held.borrow_mut().push(window_server.as_ptr() as usize);
        }

        fn release_changes_held_off_screen(&self, window_server: &WindowServerObject) {
            self.released.borrow_mut().push(window_server.as_ptr() as usize);
        }
    }

    const PRESENTATION: PresentationId = PresentationId(1);
    const CONTEXT: CompositorContextId = CompositorContextId(7);
    const SIZE: IntSize = IntSize {
        width: 800,
        height: 600,
    };

    fn layers_with_one_layer(host: &RecordingHost) -> RemoteLayers {
        let mut layers = RemoteLayers::default();
        layers.register_presentation(PRESENTATION, host);
        let handle = layers.create_remote_layer(PRESENTATION, 1, host);
        assert_eq!(handle.id, 1);
        layers
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_layer_is_created_once_per_id() {
        let host = RecordingHost::default();
        let mut layers = layers_with_one_layer(&host);
        assert_eq!(
            layers.create_remote_layer(PRESENTATION, 1, &host).kind,
            Compositing_RemoteLayerHostKind::None
        );
        assert_eq!(
            layers.create_remote_layer(PresentationId(2), 2, &host).kind,
            Compositing_RemoteLayerHostKind::None
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_context_moves_between_layers() {
        let host = RecordingHost::default();
        let mut layers = layers_with_one_layer(&host);
        layers.create_remote_layer(PRESENTATION, 2, &host);
        assert_eq!(
            layers.show_context_in_remote_layer(1, Some(CONTEXT), |_| true),
            ShownContextChange {
                stopped: None,
                started: Some(CONTEXT)
            }
        );
        layers.show_context_in_remote_layer(2, Some(CONTEXT), |_| true);
        assert_eq!(layers.layers[&1].shown_context, None);
        assert_eq!(
            layers.layer_showing(CONTEXT).map(|layer| layer.presentation()),
            Some(PRESENTATION)
        );
        assert_eq!(layers.destroy_remote_layer(2, &host), Some(CONTEXT));
        assert!(layers.layer_showing(CONTEXT).is_none());
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_context_that_cannot_be_shown_is_ignored() {
        let host = RecordingHost::default();
        let mut layers = layers_with_one_layer(&host);
        let change = layers.show_context_in_remote_layer(1, Some(CONTEXT), |_| false);
        assert_eq!(change, ShownContextChange::default());
        assert!(layers.layer_showing(CONTEXT).is_none());
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_resize_is_held_until_the_frame_of_its_size_is_shown_and_released_when_committed() {
        let host = RecordingHost::default();
        let mut layers = layers_with_one_layer(&host);
        layers.show_context_in_remote_layer(1, Some(CONTEXT), |_| true);
        layers.begin_synchronized_resize(1, 5, &host);
        assert!(layers.is_holding_changes());
        assert_eq!(host.held.borrow().len(), 1);
        assert!(layers.await_synchronized_resize_frame(1, 5, SIZE).is_empty());
        assert!(layers.did_show_frame(CONTEXT, SIZE, false).is_empty());
        let held = layers.did_show_frame(CONTEXT, SIZE, true);
        assert_eq!(held.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(held[0].token, 5);
        assert!(layers.did_show_frame(CONTEXT, SIZE, true).is_empty());
        let committed = layers.commit_synchronized_resize(1, 5, &host);
        assert_eq!(committed.map(|notice| notice.token), Some(5));
        assert!(!layers.is_holding_changes());
        assert_eq!(host.released.borrow().len(), 1);
    }

    #[test]
    fn destroying_the_presentation_releases_what_its_window_server_holds() {
        let host = RecordingHost::default();
        let mut layers = layers_with_one_layer(&host);
        layers.show_context_in_remote_layer(1, Some(CONTEXT), |_| true);
        layers.begin_synchronized_resize(1, 5, &host);
        assert_eq!(layers.unregister_presentation(PRESENTATION, &host), vec![CONTEXT]);
        assert!(!layers.is_holding_changes());
        assert_eq!(host.released.borrow().len(), 1);
    }

    #[test]
    fn the_frame_is_placed_again_only_when_the_fit_changes() {
        let host = RecordingHost::default();
        let mut layers = layers_with_one_layer(&host);
        layers.set_remote_layer_fit(1, Some(SIZE), &host);
        layers.set_remote_layer_fit(1, Some(SIZE), &host);
        assert_eq!(*host.placed.borrow(), vec![Some(SIZE)]);
    }
}

/*

//! Synthesizes the momentum of a touchpad flick as wheel events, for platforms that send no momentum scroll events.

use crate::input_event::wheel_tick_120ths_from_pixel_delta;
use libcompositing_rust::scrolling::scroll_fling::{ScrollFling, ScrollFlingBooster, ScrollVelocityTracker};
use libcompositing_rust::scrolling::{
    DevicePixelPoint, KeyModifier, MouseButton, MouseEvent, MouseEventType, PointerInputData, ScrollGesturePhase,
    WheelDeltaPrecision, WheelGestureMark,
};
use libcompositing_rust::time::MonotonicTime;
use libgfx_rust::FloatPoint;

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct ScrollFlingController {
    velocity_tracker: ScrollVelocityTracker,
    booster: ScrollFlingBooster,
    active_fling: Option<ActiveFling>,
}

struct ActiveFling {
    fling: ScrollFling,
    // The fling steps use the position, modifiers and gesture of the gesture end event.
    position: DevicePixelPoint,
    screen_position: DevicePixelPoint,
    modifiers: KeyModifier,
    wheel_gesture_mark: Option<WheelGestureMark>,
    ends_on_next_step: bool,
}

fn is_touchpad_step(event: &MouseEvent) -> bool {
    event.wheel_delta_precision == WheelDeltaPrecision::Precise
        && event.scroll_gesture_phase == ScrollGesturePhase::Ongoing
}

impl ScrollFlingController {
    pub fn note_wheel_event(&mut self, event: &MouseEvent, now: MonotonicTime) {
        if is_touchpad_step(event) {
            self.velocity_tracker.add_step(
                FloatPoint {
                    x: event.wheel_delta_x as f32,
                    y: event.wheel_delta_y as f32,
                },
                now,
            );
            return;
        }
        self.velocity_tracker.reset();
        // Other wheel input cancels the boost of the next fling.
        if event.scroll_gesture_phase != ScrollGesturePhase::Ended {
            self.booster.reset();
        }
    }

    // Starts a fling if the gesture that the event ends was a flick.
    pub fn start_if_flicked(&mut self, gesture_end_event: &MouseEvent, now: MonotonicTime) -> bool {
        assert!(gesture_end_event.scroll_gesture_phase == ScrollGesturePhase::Ended);
        let velocity = self.velocity_tracker.velocity_at_lift(now);
        self.velocity_tracker.reset();
        let Some(velocity) = velocity else {
            return false;
        };

        let Some(fling) = ScrollFling::start(self.booster.boosted_velocity(velocity, now), now) else {
            return false;
        };
        self.active_fling = Some(ActiveFling {
            fling,
            position: gesture_end_event.position,
            screen_position: gesture_end_event.screen_position,
            modifiers: gesture_end_event.modifiers,
            wheel_gesture_mark: gesture_end_event.wheel_gesture_mark.clone(),
            ends_on_next_step: false,
        });
        true
    }

    pub fn is_active(&self) -> bool {
        self.active_fling.is_some()
    }

    // The next momentum step of the fling, or the end of its gesture once the fling has run out or was told to end.
    pub fn take_step(&mut self, frame_time: MonotonicTime) -> Option<MouseEvent> {
        let active = self.active_fling.as_mut()?;
        if active.ends_on_next_step {
            return self.end();
        }

        let Some(delta) = active.fling.step(frame_time) else {
            return self.end();
        };
        if delta.is_zero() {
            return None;
        }
        Some(self.event_of_active_fling(delta, ScrollGesturePhase::Momentum))
    }

    pub fn end_on_next_step(&mut self) {
        assert!(self.active_fling.is_some());
        self.active_fling.as_mut().unwrap().ends_on_next_step = true;
    }

    // The end of the gesture of the fling, if one is active.
    pub fn end(&mut self) -> Option<MouseEvent> {
        self.active_fling.as_ref()?;

        // WebContent holds the gesture open while momentum events arrive. The end of the gesture releases it.
        let event = self.event_of_active_fling(FloatPoint::default(), ScrollGesturePhase::Ended);
        self.active_fling = None;
        Some(event)
    }

    // Ends the fling before a wheel event from a new gesture or other input.
    pub fn interrupt(&mut self, event: &MouseEvent, now: MonotonicTime) -> Option<MouseEvent> {
        let active = self.active_fling.as_ref()?;

        // A new touchpad step stops the fling. The next flick can add the velocity of this fling.
        if is_touchpad_step(event) {
            self.booster.fling_was_interrupted(active.fling.velocity_at(now), now);
        }
        self.end()
    }

    fn event_of_active_fling(&self, delta: FloatPoint, phase: ScrollGesturePhase) -> MouseEvent {
        assert!(self.active_fling.is_some());
        let active = self.active_fling.as_ref().unwrap();
        MouseEvent {
            r#type: MouseEventType::MouseWheel,
            position: active.position,
            screen_position: active.screen_position,
            button: MouseButton::None,
            buttons: MouseButton::None,
            modifiers: active.modifiers,
            wheel_delta_x: delta.x as f64,
            wheel_delta_y: delta.y as f64,
            wheel_tick_120ths_x: wheel_tick_120ths_from_pixel_delta(delta.x as f64, WheelDeltaPrecision::Precise),
            wheel_tick_120ths_y: wheel_tick_120ths_from_pixel_delta(delta.y as f64, WheelDeltaPrecision::Precise),
            wheel_delta_precision: WheelDeltaPrecision::Precise,
            scroll_gesture_phase: phase,
            click_count: 0,
            async_scroll_performed_default_action: false,
            // The IDs of UI input events start at 1. Thus, ID 0 does not match a UI event.
            id: 0,
            scrollbar_dragged_by_compositor: None,
            pointer_data: PointerInputData { properties: None },
            wheel_gesture_mark: active.wheel_gesture_mark.clone(),
        }
    }
}

FILE: Services/Compositor/Rust/src/scroll_snap_controller.rs
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

//! Selects the snap positions of the wheel scrolls the compositor performs on snap containers, from the geometry the display list carries, the way the main thread selects them for the scrolls it performs itself. The context owns the scroll animations; this controller decides where they go and remembers what a gesture has asked for so far.

use libcompositing_rust::css_pixels::{CssPixelPoint, CssPixels};
use libcompositing_rust::scrolling::scroll_snap_selection::{
    MomentumFlingEstimator, SnapAxisCandidates, SnapContainerGeometry, SnapSelectionStrategy,
    SnapSelectionStrategyType, axes_to_evaluate, build_snap_candidates, select_snap_destination_with_candidates,
};
use libcompositing_rust::scrolling::{
    AsyncScrollNodeStableID, AsyncScrollOperationID, AsyncScrollTree, AsyncSnapContainer, ScrollAnimationKind,
    ScrollGesturePhase, ScrollStateSnapshot, SnapDestination, SpatialNodeIndex, StartedUserScroll,
    USER_SCROLL_SETTLE_DELAY,
};
use libcompositing_rust::time::MonotonicTime;
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, HashMap};

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct ScrollSnapController {
    nodes: BTreeMap<AsyncScrollNodeStableID, NodeState>,
    candidates: HashMap<AsyncScrollNodeStableID, SnapAxisCandidates>,
    momentum_snap_position_selection: MomentumSnapPositionSelection,
    momentum_fling_estimator: MomentumFlingEstimator,
}

// A snap scroll to start for a wheel delta.
pub struct SnapScrollStart {
    pub stable_node_id: AsyncScrollNodeStableID,
    pub initial_scroll_offset: CssPixelPoint,
    pub unsnapped_scroll_destination: CssPixelPoint,
    pub relative_scroll_delta: CssPixelPoint,
    pub selection: SnapDestination,
    pub animation_kind: ScrollAnimationKind,
    pub is_absolute_scroll: bool,
}

impl Default for SnapScrollStart {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            stable_node_id: AsyncScrollNodeStableID {
                node_id: Default::default(),
                kind: libcompositing_rust::scrolling::AsyncScrollNodeKind::Element,
                pseudo_element_type: 0,
            },
            initial_scroll_offset: Default::default(),
            unsnapped_scroll_destination: Default::default(),
            relative_scroll_delta: Default::default(),
            selection: Default::default(),
            animation_kind: ScrollAnimationKind::SmoothScroll,
            is_absolute_scroll: false,
        }
    }
}

// A step that selected the snap position the scrolling box already rests at, or is already scrolling to, is
// consumed without disturbing where the box is going. Keys can still advance the input for that scroll.
#[derive(Default)]
pub struct StepConsumed {
    pub updated_scroll: Option<StartedUserScroll>,
}

// What a scroll step over a snap container does with the snap position it selected; a step that selects none
// scrolls the box by itself.
pub enum StepDecision {
    StepConsumed(StepConsumed),
    SnapScrollStart(SnapScrollStart),
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct GestureEndSnap {
    pub scroll_node_index: SpatialNodeIndex,
    pub snap_scroll: SnapScrollStart,
}

struct InFlightSnapScroll {
    operation_id: AsyncScrollOperationID,
    destination: CssPixelPoint,
}

// Where the scrolling box rested when the gesture's input started moving it, from which the end of the gesture
// snaps; momentum that traveled over the box must not pass a snap position that always stops.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct GestureStart {
    offset: CssPixelPoint,
    travels_under_momentum: bool,
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct NodeState {
    // The offset the gesture's steps have asked for without snapping, which its next step travels from, so that a
    // burst of steps advances by the distance they asked for rather than by one snap position each.
    unsnapped_scroll_destination: Option<CssPixelPoint>,
    gesture_input_deadline: Option<MonotonicTime>,
    // The offset this controller last left the scrolling box at; a box resting anywhere else has been scrolled by
    // something else since, which ends the gesture.
    expected_scroll_offset: Option<CssPixelPoint>,
    // The snap scroll of this controller's own that the box is scrolling under.
    snap_scroll: Option<InFlightSnapScroll>,
    gesture_start: Option<GestureStart>,
}

// Momentum that selects no snap position is scrolled by for the rest of the gesture rather than being asked again
// for each delta it produces.
#[derive(Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum MomentumSnapPositionSelection {
    #[default]
    NotSelectedYet,
    ScrollingToSelectedPosition,
    NoPositionSelected,
}

// A scroll node a snap position can be selected for: one with snap geometry and a current offset.
struct SnapTarget<'a> {
    stable_node_id: AsyncScrollNodeStableID,
    snap_container: &'a AsyncSnapContainer,
    current_scroll_offset: CssPixelPoint,
}

impl ScrollSnapController {
    pub fn did_install_scrolling_state(&mut self, scroll_tree: &AsyncScrollTree) {
        self.candidates.clear();
        self.nodes
            .retain(|stable_node_id, _| scroll_tree.scroll_node_index_for_stable_id(*stable_node_id).is_some());
    }

    // Input that scrolls with a gesture reports its phases; the momentum of a flick and the end of a gesture snap
    // from what the gesture has done so far.
    pub fn note_gesture_phase(&mut self, phase: ScrollGesturePhase) {
        match phase {
            ScrollGesturePhase::None => self.end_gesture(),
            ScrollGesturePhase::Ongoing => self.reset_momentum_fling_state(),
            ScrollGesturePhase::Momentum | ScrollGesturePhase::Ended => {}
        }
    }

    fn reset_momentum_fling_state(&mut self) {
        self.momentum_snap_position_selection = MomentumSnapPositionSelection::NotSelectedYet;
        self.momentum_fling_estimator.reset();
    }

    fn end_gesture(&mut self) {
        self.reset_momentum_fling_state();
        for state in self.nodes.values_mut() {
            state.gesture_start = None;
        }
    }

    // A gesture whose steps this controller chains awaits its next step until its input deadline passes, and ends
    // once that happens without one.
    pub fn boxes_with_gesture_awaiting_input(&self) -> Vec<AsyncScrollNodeStableID> {
        let mut boxes = Vec::new();
        for (stable_node_id, state) in &self.nodes {
            if state.gesture_input_deadline.is_some() {
                boxes.push(*stable_node_id);
            }
        }
        boxes
    }

    pub fn earliest_gesture_input_deadline(&self) -> Option<MonotonicTime> {
        let mut earliest = None;
        for state in self.nodes.values() {
            let Some(deadline) = state.gesture_input_deadline else {
                continue;
            };
            if earliest.is_none_or(|earliest| deadline < earliest) {
                earliest = Some(deadline);
            }
        }
        earliest
    }

    // Returns the boxes whose gesture ended.
    pub fn end_gestures_whose_input_ran_out(&mut self, now: MonotonicTime) -> Vec<AsyncScrollNodeStableID> {
        let mut ended_boxes = Vec::new();
        for (stable_node_id, state) in &mut self.nodes {
            if state.gesture_input_deadline.is_none_or(|deadline| now <= deadline) {
                continue;
            }
            state.gesture_input_deadline = None;
            state.unsnapped_scroll_destination = None;
            ended_boxes.push(*stable_node_id);
        }
        ended_boxes
    }

    pub fn did_scroll_node_plainly(
        &mut self,
        stable_node_id: AsyncScrollNodeStableID,
        phase: ScrollGesturePhase,
        scroll_offset_before_scroll: CssPixelPoint,
    ) {
        if phase != ScrollGesturePhase::Ongoing && phase != ScrollGesturePhase::Momentum {
            return;
        }
        let state = self.node_state(stable_node_id);
        let gesture_start = state.gesture_start.get_or_insert(GestureStart {
            offset: scroll_offset_before_scroll,
            travels_under_momentum: false,
        });
        if phase == ScrollGesturePhase::Momentum {
            gesture_start.travels_under_momentum = true;
        }
    }

    pub fn did_start_main_thread_scroll(&mut self, stable_node_id: AsyncScrollNodeStableID) {
        // A scroll started for any reason other than this controller's input is going somewhere the gesture never asked
        // for, so the gesture's steps then travel from the scrolling box itself.
        self.nodes.remove(&stable_node_id);
    }

    pub fn did_start_snap_scroll(
        &mut self,
        stable_node_id: AsyncScrollNodeStableID,
        operation_id: AsyncScrollOperationID,
        destination: CssPixelPoint,
    ) {
        let state = self.node_state(stable_node_id);
        state.snap_scroll = Some(InFlightSnapScroll {
            operation_id,
            destination,
        });
        state.expected_scroll_offset = Some(destination);
    }

    pub fn did_end_snap_scroll(
        &mut self,
        stable_node_id: AsyncScrollNodeStableID,
        operation_id: AsyncScrollOperationID,
        scroll_offset: Option<CssPixelPoint>,
    ) {
        if !self.is_snap_scroll(stable_node_id, operation_id) {
            return;
        }
        let state = self.node_state(stable_node_id);
        state.snap_scroll = None;
        state.expected_scroll_offset = scroll_offset;
    }

    pub fn did_retarget_scroll(
        &mut self,
        stable_node_id: AsyncScrollNodeStableID,
        operation_id: AsyncScrollOperationID,
    ) {
        // A snap scroll sent somewhere other than the snap position selected for it no longer goes where the gesture's
        // input asked, so the gesture's steps then travel from where the scroll is headed instead.
        if self.is_snap_scroll(stable_node_id, operation_id) {
            self.nodes.remove(&stable_node_id);
        }
    }

    pub fn is_snap_scroll(
        &self,
        stable_node_id: AsyncScrollNodeStableID,
        operation_id: AsyncScrollOperationID,
    ) -> bool {
        self.nodes.get(&stable_node_id).is_some_and(|state| {
            state
                .snap_scroll
                .as_ref()
                .is_some_and(|scroll| scroll.operation_id == operation_id)
        })
    }

    pub fn unsnapped_destination_for_snap_scroll(
        &self,
        stable_node_id: AsyncScrollNodeStableID,
        operation_id: AsyncScrollOperationID,
    ) -> Option<CssPixelPoint> {
        if !self.is_snap_scroll(stable_node_id, operation_id) {
            return None;
        }
        self.nodes.get(&stable_node_id)?.unsnapped_scroll_destination
    }

    fn node_state(&mut self, stable_node_id: AsyncScrollNodeStableID) -> &mut NodeState {
        self.nodes.entry(stable_node_id).or_default()
    }

    fn candidates_for(
        &mut self,
        stable_node_id: AsyncScrollNodeStableID,
        snap_container: &AsyncSnapContainer,
    ) -> &SnapAxisCandidates {
        self.candidates.entry(stable_node_id).or_insert_with(|| {
            build_snap_candidates(
                &snap_container.geometry,
                &snap_container.areas,
                snap_container.geometry.axes,
            )
        })
    }

    fn snap_target_for<'a>(
        scroll_tree: &'a AsyncScrollTree,
        scroll_state_snapshot: &ScrollStateSnapshot,
        scroll_node_index: SpatialNodeIndex,
    ) -> Option<SnapTarget<'a>> {
        let node = scroll_tree.scroll_node_for_index(scroll_node_index);
        let snap_container = scroll_tree.snap_container_for_node(scroll_node_index);
        let current_scroll_offset = scroll_tree.css_scroll_offset_for_node(scroll_node_index, scroll_state_snapshot);
        let snap_container = snap_container?;
        if snap_container.geometry.min_scroll_offset.x > snap_container.geometry.max_scroll_offset.x
            || snap_container.geometry.min_scroll_offset.y > snap_container.geometry.max_scroll_offset.y
        {
            return None;
        }
        Some(SnapTarget {
            stable_node_id: node?.stable_node_id,
            snap_container,
            current_scroll_offset: current_scroll_offset?,
        })
    }
}

fn clamp_scroll_offset(offset: CssPixelPoint, geometry: &SnapContainerGeometry) -> CssPixelPoint {
    CssPixelPoint {
        x: offset
            .x
            .clamp(geometry.min_scroll_offset.x, geometry.max_scroll_offset.x),
        y: offset
            .y
            .clamp(geometry.min_scroll_offset.y, geometry.max_scroll_offset.y),
    }
}

// A scroll travels only along axes the container selects no snap position in is left to the ordinary relative scroll.
fn selected_snap_position_along_travel(selection: &SnapDestination, displacement: CssPixelPoint) -> bool {
    (selection.snapped_x && displacement.x != CssPixels::default())
        || (selection.snapped_y && displacement.y != CssPixels::default())
}

impl ScrollSnapController {
    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-scroll-snap-1/#scroll-types
    // A discrete wheel step is a relative scroll with only an intended direction.
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub fn decide_discrete_step(
        &mut self,
        scroll_tree: &AsyncScrollTree,
        scroll_state_snapshot: &ScrollStateSnapshot,
        scroll_node_index: SpatialNodeIndex,
        delta: CssPixelPoint,
        scroll_in_flight_destination: Option<CssPixelPoint>,
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) -> Option<StepDecision> {
        let target = Self::snap_target_for(scroll_tree, scroll_state_snapshot, scroll_node_index)?;
        let geometry = &target.snap_container.geometry;
        // The step selects a snap position only along the axes it travels in that the container snaps in.
        if !(geometry.axes.x && delta.x != CssPixels::default())
            && !(geometry.axes.y && delta.y != CssPixels::default())
        {
            return None;
        }

        let current_scroll_offset = target.current_scroll_offset;
        let state = self.node_state(target.stable_node_id);
        // A gesture ends once its steps stop arriving, and once anything but this controller has moved the scrolling box.
        let gesture_ended = state.gesture_input_deadline.is_some_and(|deadline| now > deadline)
            || (state.snap_scroll.is_none() && state.expected_scroll_offset != Some(current_scroll_offset));
        if gesture_ended {
            state.unsnapped_scroll_destination = None;
        }
        // A step selects its snap position from the offset the gesture's input deltas have reached, which a wheel scroll in
        // flight is headed for, rather than from the snap position it is scrolling to.
        let step_start = state
            .unsnapped_scroll_destination
            .unwrap_or(scroll_in_flight_destination.unwrap_or(current_scroll_offset));
        let unsnapped_destination = clamp_scroll_offset(step_start.translated(delta.x, delta.y), geometry);

        // NB: A step with only an intended direction ignores every snap position up to the offset its input asked for.
        let strategy = SnapSelectionStrategy {
            r#type: SnapSelectionStrategyType::Direction,
            start_offset: Some(step_start),
            displacement: delta,
            starting_positions_boundary: Some(unsnapped_destination),
        };
        let evaluated_axes = axes_to_evaluate(geometry.axes, &strategy);
        let selection = select_snap_destination_with_candidates(
            geometry,
            self.candidates_for(target.stable_node_id, target.snap_container),
            unsnapped_destination,
            &strategy,
            evaluated_axes,
        );
        if !selected_snap_position_along_travel(&selection, delta) {
            return None;
        }

        let state = self.nodes.get_mut(&target.stable_node_id).unwrap();
        state.unsnapped_scroll_destination = Some(unsnapped_destination);
        state.gesture_input_deadline = Some(now + USER_SCROLL_SETTLE_DELAY);
        let mut in_flight_destination = state.snap_scroll.as_ref().map(|scroll| scroll.destination);
        if in_flight_destination.is_none() {
            in_flight_destination = scroll_in_flight_destination;
        }
        if selection.position == in_flight_destination.unwrap_or(current_scroll_offset) {
            if state.snap_scroll.is_none() {
                state.expected_scroll_offset = Some(current_scroll_offset);
            }
            return Some(StepDecision::StepConsumed(StepConsumed::default()));
        }
        Some(StepDecision::SnapScrollStart(SnapScrollStart {
            stable_node_id: target.stable_node_id,
            initial_scroll_offset: current_scroll_offset,
            unsnapped_scroll_destination: unsnapped_destination,
            relative_scroll_delta: CssPixelPoint {
                x: unsnapped_destination.x - step_start.x,
                y: unsnapped_destination.y - step_start.y,
            },
            selection,
            animation_kind: ScrollAnimationKind::SmoothScroll,
            is_absolute_scroll: false,
        }))
    }

    // A scroll key is a command of its own rather than a step of a gesture: while a scroll is in flight it travels on
    // from the offset the steps before it asked for, otherwise from the scrolling box itself. An arrow key has only
    // an intended direction; a paging key has an intended end position as well.
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub fn decide_key_step(
        &mut self,
        scroll_tree: &AsyncScrollTree,
        scroll_state_snapshot: &ScrollStateSnapshot,
        scroll_node_index: SpatialNodeIndex,
        delta: CssPixelPoint,
        strategy_type: SnapSelectionStrategyType,
        scroll_in_flight_destination: Option<CssPixelPoint>,
        now: MonotonicTime,
    ) -> Option<StepDecision> {
        let target = Self::snap_target_for(scroll_tree, scroll_state_snapshot, scroll_node_index)?;
        let geometry = &target.snap_container.geometry;
        if !(geometry.axes.x && delta.x != CssPixels::default())
            && !(geometry.axes.y && delta.y != CssPixels::default())
        {
            return None;
        }

        let current_scroll_offset = target.current_scroll_offset;
        let state = self.node_state(target.stable_node_id);
        let mut in_flight_destination = state.snap_scroll.as_ref().map(|scroll| scroll.destination);
        if in_flight_destination.is_none() {
            in_flight_destination = scroll_in_flight_destination;
        }
        let step_start = if let Some(snap_scroll) = state.snap_scroll.as_ref() {
            state.unsnapped_scroll_destination.unwrap_or(snap_scroll.destination)
        } else {
            scroll_in_flight_destination.unwrap_or(current_scroll_offset)
        };
        let unsnapped_destination = clamp_scroll_offset(step_start.translated(delta.x, delta.y), geometry);

        let mut strategy = SnapSelectionStrategy {
            r#type: strategy_type,
            start_offset: Some(step_start),
            displacement: delta,
            starting_positions_boundary: None,
        };
        if strategy_type == SnapSelectionStrategyType::Direction {
            strategy.starting_positions_boundary = Some(unsnapped_destination);
        }
        let evaluated_axes = axes_to_evaluate(geometry.axes, &strategy);
        let selection = select_snap_destination_with_candidates(
            geometry,
            self.candidates_for(target.stable_node_id, target.snap_container),
            unsnapped_destination,
            &strategy,
            evaluated_axes,
        );
        if !selected_snap_position_along_travel(&selection, delta) {
            return None;
        }

        let state = self.nodes.get_mut(&target.stable_node_id).unwrap();
        state.unsnapped_scroll_destination = Some(unsnapped_destination);
        state.gesture_input_deadline = Some(now + USER_SCROLL_SETTLE_DELAY);
        if selection.position == in_flight_destination.unwrap_or(current_scroll_offset) {
            if state.snap_scroll.is_none() {
                state.expected_scroll_offset = Some(current_scroll_offset);
            }
            let updated_scroll = state.snap_scroll.as_ref().map(|snap_scroll| StartedUserScroll {
                stable_node_id: target.stable_node_id,
                operation_id: snap_scroll.operation_id,
                initial_scroll_offset: current_scroll_offset,
                unsnapped_scroll_destination: unsnapped_destination,
                relative_scroll_delta: CssPixelPoint {
                    x: unsnapped_destination.x - step_start.x,
                    y: unsnapped_destination.y - step_start.y,
                },
                selection,
                settles_gesture: false,
                is_absolute_scroll: false,
                animation_kind: None,
            });
            return Some(StepDecision::StepConsumed(StepConsumed { updated_scroll }));
        }
        Some(StepDecision::SnapScrollStart(SnapScrollStart {
            stable_node_id: target.stable_node_id,
            initial_scroll_offset: current_scroll_offset,
            unsnapped_scroll_destination: unsnapped_destination,
            relative_scroll_delta: CssPixelPoint {
                x: unsnapped_destination.x - step_start.x,
                y: unsnapped_destination.y - step_start.y,
            },
            selection,
            animation_kind: ScrollAnimationKind::SmoothScroll,
            is_absolute_scroll: false,
        }))
    }

    // The momentum of a flick is a relative scroll with an intended direction and, once its decay tells where it is
    // headed, an intended end position.
    pub fn decide_momentum_delta(
        &mut self,
        scroll_tree: &AsyncScrollTree,
        scroll_state_snapshot: &ScrollStateSnapshot,
        scroll_node_index: SpatialNodeIndex,
        momentum_delta: CssPixelPoint,
    ) -> Option<StepDecision> {
        if self.momentum_snap_position_selection == MomentumSnapPositionSelection::ScrollingToSelectedPosition {
            return Some(StepDecision::StepConsumed(StepConsumed::default()));
        }
        if self.momentum_snap_position_selection == MomentumSnapPositionSelection::NoPositionSelected {
            return None;
        }
        let remaining_displacement = self
            .momentum_fling_estimator
            .estimate_remaining_displacement(momentum_delta)?;
        let Some(target) = Self::snap_target_for(scroll_tree, scroll_state_snapshot, scroll_node_index) else {
            self.momentum_snap_position_selection = MomentumSnapPositionSelection::NoPositionSelected;
            return None;
        };
        let geometry = &target.snap_container.geometry;
        let state = self.node_state(target.stable_node_id);
        // The momentum travels on from the snap position a snap scroll already in flight is headed for.
        let in_flight_destination = state.snap_scroll.as_ref().map(|scroll| scroll.destination);
        let step_start = in_flight_destination.unwrap_or(target.current_scroll_offset);
        let unsnapped_destination = clamp_scroll_offset(
            step_start.translated(remaining_displacement.x, remaining_displacement.y),
            geometry,
        );

        let strategy = SnapSelectionStrategy {
            r#type: SnapSelectionStrategyType::EndPositionAndDirection,
            start_offset: Some(step_start),
            displacement: remaining_displacement,
            starting_positions_boundary: None,
        };
        let evaluated_axes = axes_to_evaluate(geometry.axes, &strategy);
        let selection = select_snap_destination_with_candidates(
            geometry,
            self.candidates_for(target.stable_node_id, target.snap_container),
            unsnapped_destination,
            &strategy,
            evaluated_axes,
        );
        if !selected_snap_position_along_travel(&selection, remaining_displacement) {
            self.momentum_snap_position_selection = MomentumSnapPositionSelection::NoPositionSelected;
            return None;
        }
        self.momentum_snap_position_selection = MomentumSnapPositionSelection::ScrollingToSelectedPosition;
        if selection.position == step_start {
            return Some(StepDecision::StepConsumed(StepConsumed::default()));
        }
        Some(StepDecision::SnapScrollStart(SnapScrollStart {
            stable_node_id: target.stable_node_id,
            initial_scroll_offset: target.current_scroll_offset,
            unsnapped_scroll_destination: unsnapped_destination,
            relative_scroll_delta: CssPixelPoint {
                x: unsnapped_destination.x - step_start.x,
                y: unsnapped_destination.y - step_start.y,
            },
            selection,
            animation_kind: ScrollAnimationKind::Momentum,
            is_absolute_scroll: false,
        }))
    }

    // The end of a gesture snaps each scrolling box it panned to the snap position nearest where it was released,
    // and ends the gesture.
    pub fn decide_gesture_end(
        &mut self,
        scroll_tree: &AsyncScrollTree,
        scroll_state_snapshot: &ScrollStateSnapshot,
    ) -> Vec<GestureEndSnap> {
        let mut snaps = Vec::new();
        for (stable_node_id, state) in &self.nodes {
            let Some(gesture_start) = state.gesture_start else {
                continue;
            };
            // Momentum that selected a snap position is still scrolling to it.
            if state.snap_scroll.is_some() {
                continue;
            }
            let stable_node_id = *stable_node_id;
            let Some(scroll_node_index) = scroll_tree.scroll_node_index_for_stable_id(stable_node_id) else {
                continue;
            };
            let Some(target) = Self::snap_target_for(scroll_tree, scroll_state_snapshot, scroll_node_index) else {
                continue;
            };
            let geometry = &target.snap_container.geometry;
            let current_scroll_offset = target.current_scroll_offset;

            // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-scroll-snap-1/#scroll-types
            // A pan reports where the user's input came to rest, so it settles as an absolute scroll; the momentum a flick
            // traveled under must not have passed a snap position that always stops on the way from where it started.
            let strategy = SnapSelectionStrategy {
                r#type: SnapSelectionStrategyType::EndPosition,
                start_offset: if gesture_start.travels_under_momentum {
                    Some(gesture_start.offset)
                } else {
                    None
                },
                displacement: CssPixelPoint {
                    x: current_scroll_offset.x - gesture_start.offset.x,
                    y: current_scroll_offset.y - gesture_start.offset.y,
                },
                starting_positions_boundary: None,
            };
            let evaluated_axes = axes_to_evaluate(geometry.axes, &strategy);
            if evaluated_axes.is_empty() {
                continue;
            }
            let selection = select_snap_destination_with_candidates(
                geometry,
                self.candidates
                    .entry(stable_node_id)
                    .or_insert_with(|| build_snap_candidates(geometry, &target.snap_container.areas, geometry.axes)),
                current_scroll_offset,
                &strategy,
                evaluated_axes,
            );
            if selection.position == current_scroll_offset {
                continue;
            }
            snaps.push(GestureEndSnap {
                scroll_node_index,
                snap_scroll: SnapScrollStart {
                    stable_node_id,
                    initial_scroll_offset: current_scroll_offset,
                    unsnapped_scroll_destination: current_scroll_offset,
                    relative_scroll_delta: CssPixelPoint::default(),
                    selection,
                    animation_kind: ScrollAnimationKind::SmoothScroll,
                    is_absolute_scroll: false,
                },
            });
        }
        self.end_gesture();
        snaps
    }
}

/*
