//! What the replay of WebGL asks of the C++ side: the GL contexts with their drawing buffers, which C++ makes current,
//! presents and reads back, and the images that it converts or copies for texture uploads.

use core::ffi::{CStr, c_void};

use libcompositing_rust::display_list::commands::{CanvasId, VideoSinkHandle};
use libcompositing_rust::webgl::ImageSource;
use libcompositing_rust::webgl::texture_upload::ExportFormat;
use libgfx_rust::{IntRect, IntSize};

use crate::host::WebContentClientId;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(C)]
pub struct DefaultBuffers {
    pub framebuffer: u32,
    pub renderbuffer: u32,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
#[repr(C)]
pub struct ContextOptions {
    pub webgl2: bool,
    pub depth: bool,
    pub stencil: bool,
    pub antialias: bool,
    pub size: IntSize,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(u8)]
pub enum PresentOutcome {
    Presented,
    /// Nothing ran since the frame presented last, which the canvas went on showing.
    ShowedPresentedFrame,
    NoDrawingBuffer,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct ImageConversion {
    pub export_format: ExportFormat,
    pub flip_y: bool,
    pub premultiply_alpha: bool,
    pub target_size: Option<IntSize>,
}

pub enum ImageConversionOutcome<P> {
    Converted { pixels: P, width: i32, height: i32 },
    UnknownImageFrame,
    Failed,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(C)]
pub struct VideoFrameCopy {
    /// The part of the frame to copy, from its top left.
    pub source_size: IntSize,
    pub size: IntSize,
    pub target: u32,
    pub level: i32,
    pub xoffset: i32,
    pub yoffset: i32,
    pub flip_y: bool,
    pub premultiply_alpha: bool,
}

/// Shared memory that WebContent writes into while the Compositor reads it, so no Rust reference may cover it.
pub trait MappedMemory {
    fn as_mut_ptr(&self) -> *mut u8;
    fn len(&self) -> usize;

    fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.len() == 0
    }
}

impl MappedMemory for crate::raster_host::SharedMemory {
    fn as_mut_ptr(&self) -> *mut u8 {
        self.as_ptr()
    }

    fn len(&self) -> usize {
        self.len()
    }
}

pub trait WebGLHost {
    type Pixels: AsRef<[u8]>;
    type VideoFrame;
    type VideoFrameImage;

    /// The address of a GL function, or null.
    fn gl_proc_address(&self, name: &CStr) -> *const c_void;
    fn allocate_canvas_id(&self) -> CanvasId;
    /// Answers whether a GL context with a drawing buffer of the size could be made.
    fn create_webgl_context(&self, client: WebContentClientId, canvas_id: CanvasId, options: ContextOptions) -> bool;
    fn destroy_webgl_context(&self, client: WebContentClientId, canvas_id: CanvasId);
    /// Makes the GL context current, allocating its drawing buffer if it has to.
    fn make_webgl_context_current(&self, client: WebContentClientId, canvas_id: CanvasId) -> DefaultBuffers;
    fn set_webgl_drawing_buffer_size(&self, client: WebContentClientId, canvas_id: CanvasId, size: IntSize);
    /// Makes what was drawn the content of the canvas, or the frame presented last where `show_presented_frame` asks for
    /// it and there is one.
    fn present_webgl_context(
        &self,
        client: WebContentClientId,
        canvas_id: CanvasId,
        preserve_drawing_buffer: bool,
        show_presented_frame: bool,
    ) -> PresentOutcome;
    /// Writes the part of the drawing buffer, or of the frame presented last, that the rect covers to `pixels` as
    /// premultiplied BGRA8888 rows, and answers the size of that part.
    ///
    /// # Safety
    ///
    /// `pixels` is valid for writes of `pixels_size` bytes.
    unsafe fn read_back_webgl_drawing_buffer(
        &self,
        client: WebContentClientId,
        canvas_id: CanvasId,
        from_presented_frame: bool,
        rect: IntRect,
        pixels: *mut u8,
        pixels_size: usize,
    ) -> Option<IntSize>;
    fn webgl_can_copy_images_into_textures(&self, client: WebContentClientId, canvas_id: CanvasId) -> bool;
    /// The frame of the video that the client holds, with its size.
    fn held_video_frame(
        &self,
        client: WebContentClientId,
        sink_handle: VideoSinkHandle,
        generation: u64,
    ) -> Option<(Self::VideoFrame, IntSize)>;
    fn video_frame_image(&self, frame: &Self::VideoFrame) -> Option<Self::VideoFrameImage>;
    fn copy_video_frame_image_into_bound_texture(
        &self,
        client: WebContentClientId,
        canvas_id: CanvasId,
        image: &Self::VideoFrameImage,
        copy: VideoFrameCopy,
    ) -> bool;
    fn convert_image_source(
        &self,
        client: WebContentClientId,
        source: ImageSource,
        conversion: ImageConversion,
    ) -> ImageConversionOutcome<Self::Pixels>;
}

//! The WebGL contexts of the clients: the GL contexts that C++ makes for them, and what replaying their commands needs

use std::collections::HashMap;

use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};

use libcompositing_rust::display_list::commands::CanvasId;
use libcompositing_rust::webgl::vocabulary::{CommandType, MAX_COMMAND_STRUCT_SIZE};
use libcompositing_rust::webgl::wire::{HEADER_SIZE, read_header};
use libcompositing_rust::webgl::{ImageSource, SHARED_DATA_REGION_OFFSET};
use libgfx_rust::{IntRect, IntSize};

use self::custom::{clear_buffer_to_default_values, supported_extensions};
use self::gl::GlFunctions;
use self::gl_constants::GL_MAP_READ_BIT;
use self::host::{ContextOptions, DefaultBuffers, MappedMemory, PresentOutcome, WebGLHost};
use self::object_map::ObjectMap;
use self::replay::{PayloadInSharedMemory, ReplayError, Replayer, only_gl_reads_the_data_of};
use crate::host::WebContentClientId;

const MAX_DRAWING_BUFFER_DIMENSION: i32 = 16384;

/// A copy of what is replayed that holds more than this is not kept for the next message.
const MAX_KEPT_SCRATCH_SIZE: usize = 1024 * 1024;

/// A record with a payload this big, which holds data that only GL reads, is replayed where WebContent wrote it rather
/// than copied.
const SMALLEST_PAYLOAD_REPLAYED_IN_PLACE: usize = 16 * 1024;

pub struct CreatedContext {
    pub canvas_id: CanvasId,
    pub supported_extensions: Vec<String>,
}

pub struct ReadPixelsResult {
    pub length: i32,
    pub columns: i32,
    pub rows: i32,
}

struct WebGLContext {
    webgl2: bool,
    objects: ObjectMap,
    command_buffer: Option<Box<dyn MappedMemory>>,
    /// A drawing buffer that is not preserved is cleared before the next command that draws or reads after the frame
    /// was presented, which goes on being the content of the canvas until then.
    needs_clear_before_next_frame: bool,
    stashed_errors: Vec<u32>,
    /// Where what is replayed is copied to, so that WebContent cannot change it while it is checked and replayed. Its
    /// elements keep the data of the records aligned as WebContent wrote it.
    scratch: Vec<u64>,
}

impl WebGLContext {
    fn new(webgl2: bool) -> Self {
        Self {
            webgl2,
            objects: ObjectMap::default(),
            command_buffer: None,
            needs_clear_before_next_frame: false,
            stashed_errors: Vec::new(),
            scratch: Vec::new(),
        }
    }

    fn give_back_scratch(&mut self, scratch: Vec<u64>) {
        if scratch.capacity() * size_of::<u64>() <= MAX_KEPT_SCRATCH_SIZE {
            self.scratch = scratch;
        }
    }
}

/// Copies bytes that WebContent can write while they are replayed into the scratch, which keeps the data of the records
/// as aligned as WebContent wrote it, and answers the copy.
///
/// # Safety
///
/// `bytes` is valid for reads of `size` bytes.
unsafe fn copy_to_scratch(scratch: &mut Vec<u64>, bytes: *const u8, size: usize) -> &[u8] {
    scratch.clear();
    scratch.resize(size.div_ceil(size_of::<u64>()), 0);
    // SAFETY: The caller passes as many readable bytes, and the scratch has room for them.
    unsafe {
        core::ptr::copy_nonoverlapping(bytes, scratch.as_mut_ptr().cast::<u8>(), size);
        ak::slice_from_raw_parts(scratch.as_ptr().cast::<u8>(), size)
    }
}

/// # Safety
///
/// `commands` is valid for reads of the bytes of `records`.
unsafe fn replay_copied_records<H: WebGLHost>(
    replayer: &mut Replayer<'_, H>,
    scratch: &mut Vec<u64>,
    commands: *const u8,
    records: Range<usize>,
) -> Result<(), ReplayError> {
    if records.is_empty() {
        return Ok(());
    }
    // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
    let copy = unsafe { copy_to_scratch(scratch, commands.add(records.start), records.len()) };
    replayer.replay_commands(copy)
}

/// Replays records that WebContent can write while they are replayed. Runs of records are copied before they are
/// replayed, and a record with a large payload that only GL reads is replayed where it is, with only its struct copied.
///
/// # Safety
///
/// `commands` is valid for reads of `size` bytes, which stay mapped while they are replayed.
unsafe fn replay_records_in_shared_memory<H: WebGLHost>(
    replayer: &mut Replayer<'_, H>,
    scratch: &mut Vec<u64>,
    commands: *const u8,
    size: usize,
) -> Result<(), ReplayError> {
    let mut copied_records_start = 0;
    let mut offset = 0;
    while size - offset >= HEADER_SIZE {
        let mut header = [0_u8; HEADER_SIZE];
        // SAFETY: The header lies inside the records.
        unsafe { core::ptr::copy_nonoverlapping(commands.add(offset), header.as_mut_ptr(), HEADER_SIZE) };
        let Some((type_number, payload_size)) = read_header(&header) else {
            break;
        };
        let payload_start = offset + HEADER_SIZE;
        if payload_size > size - payload_start {
            break;
        }
        let command_type = CommandType::from_number(type_number).filter(|&command_type| {
            payload_size >= SMALLEST_PAYLOAD_REPLAYED_IN_PLACE && only_gl_reads_the_data_of(command_type)
        });
        if let Some(command_type) = command_type {
            // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
            unsafe { replay_copied_records(replayer, scratch, commands, copied_records_start..offset)? };
            // SAFETY: The payload lies inside the records.
            let payload = unsafe { commands.add(payload_start) };
            // SAFETY: As above.
            let struct_bytes = unsafe { copy_to_scratch(scratch, payload, payload_size.min(MAX_COMMAND_STRUCT_SIZE)) };
            replayer.payload_in_shared_memory = Some(PayloadInSharedMemory {
                start: payload,
                size: payload_size,
            });
            let result = replayer.replay_record(command_type, struct_bytes);
            replayer.payload_in_shared_memory = None;
            result?;
            copied_records_start = payload_start + payload_size;
        }
        offset = payload_start + payload_size;
    }
    // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
    unsafe { replay_copied_records(replayer, scratch, commands, copied_records_start..size) }
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct WebGLContexts {
    gl: Option<Box<GlFunctions>>,
    clients: HashMap<WebContentClientId, HashMap<CanvasId, WebGLContext>>,
}

impl WebGLContexts {
    #[cfg(test)]
    fn with_gl_functions(gl: GlFunctions) -> Self {
        Self {
            gl: Some(Box::new(gl)),
            clients: HashMap::new(),
        }
    }

    fn context_and_gl(
        &mut self,
        client: WebContentClientId,
        canvas_id: CanvasId,
    ) -> Result<(&mut WebGLContext, &GlFunctions), ReplayError> {
        let context = self
            .clients
            .get_mut(&client)
            .and_then(|contexts| contexts.get_mut(&canvas_id))
            .ok_or(ReplayError("WebContent named a WebGL context that it has not created"))?;
        let gl = self
            .gl
            .as_deref()
            .expect("the GL functions are loaded before the first context is created");
        Ok((context, gl))
    }

    /// None where the context could not be created, which is no misbehavior: the canvas has no context then.
    pub fn create<H: WebGLHost>(
        &mut self,
        host: &H,
        client: WebContentClientId,
        options: ContextOptions,
    ) -> Option<CreatedContext> {
        let dimensions = 1..=MAX_DRAWING_BUFFER_DIMENSION;
        if !dimensions.contains(&options.size.width) || !dimensions.contains(&options.size.height) {
            return None;
        }
        let canvas_id = host.allocate_canvas_id();
        if !host.create_webgl_context(client, canvas_id, options) {
            return None;
        }
        if self.gl.is_none() {
            // SAFETY: The host answers the address of a GL function or null.
            match unsafe { GlFunctions::load(|name| host.gl_proc_address(name)) } {
                Ok(gl) => self.gl = Some(Box::new(gl)),
                Err(missing_function) => {
                    eprintln!("Compositor: Cannot replay WebGL without {missing_function:?}");
                    host.destroy_webgl_context(client, canvas_id);
                    return None;
                }
            }
        }
        let gl = self.gl.as_deref().expect("the GL functions are loaded");
        host.make_webgl_context_current(client, canvas_id);
        let supported_extensions = supported_extensions(gl);
        self.clients
            .entry(client)
            .or_default()
            .insert(canvas_id, WebGLContext::new(options.webgl2));
        Some(CreatedContext {
            canvas_id,
            supported_extensions,
        })
    }

    /// A context that is gone already is no misbehavior, as it is not for a 2D canvas.
    pub fn destroy<H: WebGLHost>(&mut self, host: &H, client: WebContentClientId, canvas_id: CanvasId) {
        if self
            .clients
            .get_mut(&client)
            .and_then(|contexts| contexts.remove(&canvas_id))
            .is_some()
        {
            host.destroy_webgl_context(client, canvas_id);
        }
    }

    /// The C++ side destroys the GL contexts of a client that went away with the rest of what it holds for it.
    pub fn forget_client(&mut self, client: WebContentClientId) {
        self.clients.remove(&client);
    }

    pub fn set_command_buffer(
        &mut self,
        client: WebContentClientId,
        canvas_id: CanvasId,
        command_buffer: Option<Box<dyn MappedMemory>>,
    ) -> Result<(), ReplayError> {
        let (context, _) = self.context_and_gl(client, canvas_id)?;
        let command_buffer = command_buffer
            .filter(|command_buffer| command_buffer.len() > SHARED_DATA_REGION_OFFSET)
            .ok_or(ReplayError("WebContent sent an invalid WebGL shared command buffer"))?;
        context.command_buffer = Some(command_buffer);
        Ok(())
    }

    fn replay<H: WebGLHost>(
        context: &mut WebGLContext,
        gl: &GlFunctions,
        host: &H,
        client: WebContentClientId,
        canvas_id: CanvasId,
        image_sources: &[ImageSource],
        commands: impl FnOnce(&mut Replayer<'_, H>) -> Result<(), ReplayError>,
    ) -> Result<(), ReplayError> {
        let defaults = host.make_webgl_context_current(client, canvas_id);
        clear_drawing_buffer_if_needed(context, gl, defaults);
        let mut replayer = Replayer {
            gl,
            host,
            client,
            canvas_id,
            webgl2: context.webgl2,
            objects: &mut context.objects,
            stashed_errors: &mut context.stashed_errors,
            defaults,
            image_sources,
            payload_in_shared_memory: None,
        };
        commands(&mut replayer)
    }

    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub fn execute_commands_from_shared_buffer<H: WebGLHost>(
        &mut self,
        host: &H,
        client: WebContentClientId,
        canvas_id: CanvasId,
        offset: u64,
        size_in_bytes: u64,
        flush_sequence_number: u64,
        image_sources: &[ImageSource],
    ) -> Result<(), ReplayError> {
        let (context, gl) = self.context_and_gl(client, canvas_id)?;
        let Some(command_buffer) = context.command_buffer.as_deref() else {
            return Err(ReplayError(
                "WebContent published WebGL commands without a shared command buffer",
            ));
        };
        let base = command_buffer.as_mut_ptr();
        let region_size = command_buffer.len() - SHARED_DATA_REGION_OFFSET;
        let range = usize::try_from(offset)
            .ok()
            .zip(usize::try_from(size_in_bytes).ok())
            .filter(|&(offset, size)| {
                offset.is_multiple_of(libcompositing_rust::webgl::wire::RECORD_ALIGNMENT)
                    && offset <= region_size
                    && size <= region_size - offset
            });
        let Some((offset, size)) = range else {
            return Err(ReplayError(
                "WebContent published an invalid WebGL shared command buffer range",
            ));
        };
        let mut scratch = core::mem::take(&mut context.scratch);
        // SAFETY: The range lies inside the region of records of the mapping, which is readable.
        let commands = unsafe { base.add(SHARED_DATA_REGION_OFFSET + offset) };
        let result = Self::replay(context, gl, host, client, canvas_id, image_sources, |replayer| {
            // SAFETY: The context holds the mapping while the records are replayed.
            unsafe { replay_records_in_shared_memory(replayer, &mut scratch, commands, size) }
        });
        // NB: The records were replayed, so WebContent may write over them once it learns that they were taken.
        // SAFETY: The mapping starts at a page, where the u64 that the sequence number is stored in is, and WebContent
        //         only reads it.
        unsafe { AtomicU64::from_ptr(base.cast::<u64>()) }.store(flush_sequence_number, Ordering::Release);
        context.give_back_scratch(scratch);
        result
    }

    pub fn execute_commands<H: WebGLHost>(
        &mut self,
        host: &H,
        client: WebContentClientId,
        canvas_id: CanvasId,
        commands: Option<&dyn MappedMemory>,
        size_in_bytes: u64,
        image_sources: &[ImageSource],
    ) -> Result<(), ReplayError> {
        let (context, gl) = self.context_and_gl(client, canvas_id)?;
        let commands = commands.ok_or(ReplayError("WebContent sent an invalid WebGL command buffer"))?;
        let size = usize::try_from(size_in_bytes)
            .ok()
            .filter(|&size| size <= commands.len())
            .ok_or(ReplayError(
                "WebContent sent more WebGL commands than their buffer holds",
            ))?;
        let mut scratch = core::mem::take(&mut context.scratch);
        let result = Self::replay(context, gl, host, client, canvas_id, image_sources, |replayer| {
            // SAFETY: The mapping holds as many readable bytes, and the caller holds it while the records are replayed.
            unsafe { replay_records_in_shared_memory(replayer, &mut scratch, commands.as_mut_ptr(), size) }
        });
        context.give_back_scratch(scratch);
        result
    }

    pub fn execute_sync_call<H: WebGLHost>(
        &mut self,
        host: &H,
        client: WebContentClientId,
        canvas_id: CanvasId,
        request: &[u8],
    ) -> Result<Vec<u8>, ReplayError> {
        let (context, gl) = self.context_and_gl(client, canvas_id)?;
        let mut scratch = core::mem::take(&mut context.scratch);
        // SAFETY: The request is readable.
        let request = unsafe { copy_to_scratch(&mut scratch, request.as_ptr(), request.len()) };
        let mut reply = Vec::new();
        let result = Self::replay(context, gl, host, client, canvas_id, &[], |replayer| {
            reply = replayer.handle_sync_request(request)?;
            Ok(())
        });
        context.give_back_scratch(scratch);
        result.map(|()| reply)
    }

    pub fn present<H: WebGLHost>(
        &mut self,
        host: &H,
        client: WebContentClientId,
        canvas_id: CanvasId,
        preserve_drawing_buffer: bool,
    ) -> Result<(), ReplayError> {
        let (context, _) = self.context_and_gl(client, canvas_id)?;
        match host.present_webgl_context(
            client,
            canvas_id,
            preserve_drawing_buffer,
            context.needs_clear_before_next_frame,
        ) {
            PresentOutcome::Presented => {
                if !preserve_drawing_buffer {
                    context.needs_clear_before_next_frame = true;
                }
            }
            PresentOutcome::ShowedPresentedFrame => {}
            PresentOutcome::NoDrawingBuffer => {
                eprintln!("Compositor: Cannot present a WebGL context without a drawing buffer");
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    /// A context that is gone already is left alone.
    pub fn clear_drawing_buffer<H: WebGLHost>(&mut self, host: &H, client: WebContentClientId, canvas_id: CanvasId) {
        let Ok((context, gl)) = self.context_and_gl(client, canvas_id) else {
            return;
        };
        let defaults = host.make_webgl_context_current(client, canvas_id);
        clear_buffer_to_default_values(gl, context.webgl2, defaults);
        context.needs_clear_before_next_frame = false;
    }

    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub fn read_pixels<H: WebGLHost>(
        &mut self,
        host: &H,
        client: WebContentClientId,
        canvas_id: CanvasId,
        rect: IntRect,
        format: u32,
        r#type: u32,
        buffer_size: i32,
        pixels: Option<&dyn MappedMemory>,
    ) -> Result<ReadPixelsResult, ReplayError> {
        let (context, gl) = self.context_and_gl(client, canvas_id)?;
        let pixels_size = pixels.map_or(0, |pixels| pixels.len());
        if usize::try_from(buffer_size).map_or(true, |buffer_size| buffer_size > pixels_size) {
            return Err(ReplayError("WebContent sent an invalid WebGL readPixels buffer"));
        }
        let defaults = host.make_webgl_context_current(client, canvas_id);
        clear_drawing_buffer_if_needed(context, gl, defaults);
        let mut result = ReadPixelsResult {
            length: 0,
            columns: 0,
            rows: 0,
        };
        let destination = pixels.map_or(core::ptr::null_mut(), |pixels| pixels.as_mut_ptr());
        // SAFETY: The context is current, and GL writes at most `buffer_size` bytes, which the mapping holds.
        unsafe {
            (gl.read_pixels_robust_angle)(
                rect.x,
                rect.y,
                rect.width,
                rect.height,
                format,
                r#type,
                buffer_size,
                &raw mut result.length,
                &raw mut result.columns,
                &raw mut result.rows,
                destination.cast(),
            );
        }
        Ok(result)
    }

    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub fn read_buffer_sub_data<H: WebGLHost>(
        &mut self,
        host: &H,
        client: WebContentClientId,
        canvas_id: CanvasId,
        target: u32,
        offset: i64,
        size: i64,
        data: Option<&dyn MappedMemory>,
    ) -> Result<bool, ReplayError> {
        let (_, gl) = self.context_and_gl(client, canvas_id)?;
        let data_size = data.map_or(0, |data| data.len());
        let Some(size) = usize::try_from(size).ok().filter(|&size| size <= data_size) else {
            return Err(ReplayError("WebContent sent an invalid WebGL buffer readback target"));
        };
        host.make_webgl_context_current(client, canvas_id);
        // SAFETY: The context is current.
        let mapped = unsafe { (gl.map_buffer_range)(target, offset as isize, size as isize, GL_MAP_READ_BIT) };
        if mapped.is_null() {
            return Ok(false);
        }
        if let Some(data) = data {
            // SAFETY: GL mapped `size` bytes of the buffer, and the shared memory holds at least as many.
            unsafe { core::ptr::copy_nonoverlapping(mapped.cast::<u8>(), data.as_mut_ptr(), size) };
        }
        // SAFETY: The context is current, and the buffer of the target is mapped.
        unsafe { (gl.unmap_buffer)(target) };
        Ok(true)
    }

    pub fn read_back_drawing_buffer<H: WebGLHost>(
        &mut self,
        host: &H,
        client: WebContentClientId,
        canvas_id: CanvasId,
        rect: IntRect,
        pixels: Option<&dyn MappedMemory>,
    ) -> Result<IntSize, ReplayError> {
        let (context, _) = self.context_and_gl(client, canvas_id)?;
        let Some(pixels) = pixels else {
            return Ok(IntSize::default());
        };
        // SAFETY: The mapping holds as many writable bytes.
        let size = unsafe {
            host.read_back_webgl_drawing_buffer(
                client,
                canvas_id,
                context.needs_clear_before_next_frame,
                rect,
                pixels.as_mut_ptr(),
                pixels.len(),
            )
        };
        Ok(size.unwrap_or_default())
    }
}

fn clear_drawing_buffer_if_needed(context: &mut WebGLContext, gl: &GlFunctions, defaults: DefaultBuffers) {
    if !context.needs_clear_before_next_frame {
        return;
    }
    clear_buffer_to_default_values(gl, context.webgl2, defaults);
    context.needs_clear_before_next_frame = false;
}

//! The GL objects of a context by the ids that WebContent gave them.

use core::ffi::c_void;
use std::collections::HashMap;

use super::replay::ReplayError;

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct ObjectMap {
    objects: HashMap<u32, u32>,
    syncs: HashMap<u32, *mut c_void>,
}

fn add_unique<V>(map: &mut HashMap<u32, V>, id: u32, value: V) -> Result<(), ReplayError> {
    if id == 0 {
        return Err(ReplayError("WebGL object id 0 is reserved"));
    }
    if map.contains_key(&id) {
        return Err(ReplayError("WebGL object id is already in use"));
    }
    map.insert(id, value);
    Ok(())
}

impl ObjectMap {
    /// 0 for an id that names no object.
    pub fn lookup(&self, id: u32) -> u32 {
        self.objects.get(&id).copied().unwrap_or(0)
    }

    pub fn take(&mut self, id: u32) -> u32 {
        self.objects.remove(&id).unwrap_or(0)
    }

    pub fn add(&mut self, id: u32, name: u32) -> Result<(), ReplayError> {
        add_unique(&mut self.objects, id, name)
    }

    pub fn lookup_sync(&self, id: u32) -> *mut c_void {
        self.syncs.get(&id).copied().unwrap_or(core::ptr::null_mut())
    }

    pub fn take_sync(&mut self, id: u32) -> *mut c_void {
        self.syncs.remove(&id).unwrap_or(core::ptr::null_mut())
    }

    pub fn add_sync(&mut self, id: u32, sync: *mut c_void) -> Result<(), ReplayError> {
        add_unique(&mut self.syncs, id, sync)
    }
}

//! The replay of the commands and the synchronous calls of one WebGL context, on a copy of what WebContent sent: every
//! struct, span and size is checked before GL sees it, and object ids become the names of GL objects.

use core::ffi::{c_char, c_void};

use libcompositing_rust::display_list::commands::CanvasId;
use libcompositing_rust::webgl::ImageSource;
use libcompositing_rust::webgl::vocabulary::{CommandType, SyncCallType, commands, sync_calls};
use libcompositing_rust::webgl::wire::{
    DataSpan, WireStruct, decode_sync_request, encode_reply, records, reply_data_spans,
};

use super::gl::GlFunctions;
use super::gl_constants::{GL_COLOR, GL_NO_ERROR};
use super::host::{DefaultBuffers, WebGLHost};
use super::object_map::ObjectMap;
use crate::host::WebContentClientId;

/// What WebContent sent that it must not send.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct ReplayError(pub &'static str);

/// A buffer that a synchronous call fills is never bigger than this.
const MAX_OUT_DATA_SIZE: usize = 64 * 1024 * 1024;

/// The payload of a record that is replayed where WebContent wrote it, of which only the struct was copied.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub struct PayloadInSharedMemory {
    pub start: *const u8,
    pub size: usize,
}

/// Data that only GL reads, which can be in memory that WebContent writes.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(super) struct OpaqueData {
    pub pointer: *const u8,
    pub size: usize,
}

impl OpaqueData {
    pub const EMPTY: Self = Self {
        pointer: core::ptr::null(),
        size: 0,
    };
}

pub struct Replayer<'a, H: WebGLHost> {
    pub gl: &'a GlFunctions,
    pub host: &'a H,
    pub client: WebContentClientId,
    pub canvas_id: CanvasId,
    pub webgl2: bool,
    pub objects: &'a mut ObjectMap,
    pub stashed_errors: &'a mut Vec<u32>,
    pub defaults: DefaultBuffers,
    pub image_sources: &'a [ImageSource],
    pub payload_in_shared_memory: Option<PayloadInSharedMemory>,
}

impl<H: WebGLHost> Replayer<'_, H> {
    pub fn replay_commands(&mut self, commands: &[u8]) -> Result<(), ReplayError> {
        for record in records(commands) {
            let (command_type, payload) = record.map_err(ReplayError)?;
            self.replay_record(command_type, payload)?;
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn handle_sync_request(&mut self, request: &[u8]) -> Result<Vec<u8>, ReplayError> {
        let (call_type, payload) = decode_sync_request(request).map_err(ReplayError)?;
        self.handle_sync_call(call_type, payload)
    }

    /// The errors that the Compositor's own GL work raised are kept apart, for WebGL to collect before those of GL.
    pub fn get_error(&mut self) -> u32 {
        if self.stashed_errors.is_empty() {
            // SAFETY: The context of the replayer is current.
            return unsafe { (self.gl.get_error)() };
        }
        self.stashed_errors.remove(0)
    }

    /// Answers whether GL had errors to stash.
    pub fn stash_errors(&mut self) -> bool {
        let mut stashed_any_errors = false;
        loop {
            // SAFETY: The context of the replayer is current.
            let error = unsafe { (self.gl.get_error)() };
            if error == GL_NO_ERROR {
                return stashed_any_errors;
            }
            if !self.stashed_errors.contains(&error) {
                self.stashed_errors.push(error);
            }
            stashed_any_errors = true;
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn opaque_data(&self, payload: &[u8], span: DataSpan) -> Result<OpaqueData, ReplayError> {
        let Some(payload_in_shared_memory) = self.payload_in_shared_memory else {
            let bytes = data_span(payload, span)?;
            return Ok(OpaqueData {
                pointer: bytes.as_ptr(),
                size: bytes.len(),
            });
        };
        let start = span.offset as usize;
        start
            .checked_add(span.size as usize)
            .filter(|&end| end <= payload_in_shared_memory.size)
            .ok_or(ReplayError("WebGL data span lies outside its payload"))?;
        Ok(OpaqueData {
            // SAFETY: The span lies inside the payload, which stays mapped while the record is replayed.
            pointer: unsafe { payload_in_shared_memory.start.add(start) },
            size: span.size as usize,
        })
    }

    pub fn discard_errors(&mut self) {
        loop {
            // SAFETY: The context of the replayer is current.
            let error = unsafe { (self.gl.get_error)() };
            if error == GL_NO_ERROR {
                return;
            }
            eprintln!("Compositor: Discarding GL error {error:#x} raised by the Compositor's own work");
        }
    }
}

pub(super) fn decode<S: WireStruct>(payload: &[u8]) -> Result<S, ReplayError> {
    S::read_from(payload).ok_or(ReplayError("WebGL payload does not hold its struct"))
}

pub(super) fn data_span(payload: &[u8], span: DataSpan) -> Result<&[u8], ReplayError> {
    let start = span.offset as usize;
    start
        .checked_add(span.size as usize)
        .and_then(|end| payload.get(start..end))
        .ok_or(ReplayError("WebGL data span lies outside its payload"))
}

pub(super) fn typed_data<T>(bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<*const T, ReplayError> {
    typed_opaque_data(OpaqueData {
        pointer: bytes.as_ptr(),
        size: bytes.len(),
    })
}

pub(super) fn typed_opaque_data<T>(data: OpaqueData) -> Result<*const T, ReplayError> {
    if !data.pointer.cast::<T>().is_aligned() || !data.size.is_multiple_of(size_of::<T>()) {
        return Err(ReplayError("WebGL data does not hold whole values"));
    }
    Ok(data.pointer.cast())
}

/// A string that ends at the last byte of its span.
pub(super) fn string_data(payload: &[u8], span: DataSpan) -> Result<*const c_char, ReplayError> {
    let bytes = data_span(payload, span)?;
    if bytes.last() != Some(&0) {
        return Err(ReplayError("WebGL string is not NUL-terminated"));
    }
    Ok(bytes.as_ptr().cast())
}

pub(super) fn object_ids(bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<impl ExactSizeIterator<Item = u32>, ReplayError> {
    let (ids, rest) = bytes.as_chunks::<{ size_of::<u32>() }>();
    if !rest.is_empty() {
        return Err(ReplayError("WebGL object ids do not fill their span"));
    }
    Ok(ids.iter().map(|id| u32::from_ne_bytes(*id)))
}

fn product(factors: &[i64]) -> Option<i64> {
    factors
        .iter()
        .try_fold(1_i64, |product, &factor| product.checked_mul(factor))
}

/// Whether data is as big as the factors that its arguments give.
pub(super) fn size_matches(size: usize, factors: &[i64]) -> bool {
    product(factors).is_some_and(|expected| i64::try_from(size) == Ok(expected))
}

/// The size of a buffer that a synchronous call fills, which its arguments give.
pub(super) fn out_data_size(factors: &[i64]) -> Result<usize, ReplayError> {
    product(factors)
        .and_then(|size| usize::try_from(size).ok())
        .filter(|&size| size <= MAX_OUT_DATA_SIZE)
        .ok_or(ReplayError("WebGL asks for a buffer of a size that it cannot have"))
}

pub(super) fn bytes_of_slice<T: Copy>(values: &[T]) -> &[u8] {
    // SAFETY: The values are plain numbers or pointers, every byte of which is initialized.
    unsafe { ak::slice_from_raw_parts(values.as_ptr().cast(), size_of_val(values)) }
}

/// Splits `count` strings that follow each other, each with a NUL after it.
pub(super) fn split_packed_strings(bytes: &[u8], count: i32) -> Result<Vec<*const c_char>, ReplayError> {
    const MAX_STRING_LIST_ENTRIES: i32 = 16384;
    if !(0..=MAX_STRING_LIST_ENTRIES).contains(&count) {
        return Err(ReplayError("WebGL string list is too long"));
    }
    let mut strings = Vec::with_capacity(count as usize);
    let mut rest = bytes;
    for _ in 0..count {
        let end = rest
            .iter()
            .position(|&byte| byte == 0)
            .ok_or(ReplayError("WebGL string is not NUL-terminated"))?;
        strings.push(rest.as_ptr().cast());
        rest = &rest[end + 1..];
    }
    Ok(strings)
}

use core::cell::{Cell, RefCell};
use core::ffi::{CStr, c_void};

use libcompositing_rust::display_list::commands::{CanvasId, VideoSinkHandle};

    VideoFrameCopy, WebGLHost,
};

thread_local! {
    static CALLS: RefCell<Vec<String>> = const { RefCell::new(Vec::new()) };
    static NEXT_NAME: Cell<u32> = const { Cell::new(1) };
}

pub fn record(call: String) {
    CALLS.with_borrow_mut(|calls| calls.push(call));
}

pub fn take_calls() -> Vec<String> {
    CALLS.take()
}

pub fn next_name() -> u32 {
    NEXT_NAME.replace(NEXT_NAME.get() + 1)
}

pub fn reset() {
    take_calls();
    NEXT_NAME.set(1);
}

pub struct TestMemory {
    data: *mut u8,
    len: usize,
    _storage: Box<[u64]>,
}

impl TestMemory {
    pub fn new(bytes: &[u8]) -> Self {
        let mut storage = vec![0_u64; bytes.len().div_ceil(8)].into_boxed_slice();
        let data = storage.as_mut_ptr().cast::<u8>();
        // SAFETY: The storage has room for the bytes.
        unsafe { core::ptr::copy_nonoverlapping(bytes.as_ptr(), data, bytes.len()) };
        Self {
            data,
            len: bytes.len(),
            _storage: storage,
        }
    }

    pub fn bytes(&self) -> &[u8] {
        // SAFETY: The storage holds `len` bytes, and nothing else writes them during a test.
        unsafe { ak::slice_from_raw_parts(self.data, self.len) }
    }
}

impl MappedMemory for TestMemory {
    fn as_mut_ptr(&self) -> *mut u8 {
        self.data
    }

    fn len(&self) -> usize {
        self.len
    }
}

pub struct FakeHost {

    pub defaults: Cell<DefaultBuffers>,
    pub can_copy_images_into_textures: Cell<bool>,
    pub held_video_frame_size: Cell<Option<IntSize>>,
    pub copy_succeeds: Cell<bool>,
    pub conversion: RefCell<Option<ImageConversionOutcome<Vec<u8>>>>,
    pub has_presented_frame: Cell<bool>,
}

impl Default for FakeHost {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            next_canvas_id: Cell::new(1),
            defaults: Cell::new(DefaultBuffers {
                framebuffer: 100,
                renderbuffer: 200,
            }),
            can_copy_images_into_textures: Cell::new(false),
            held_video_frame_size: Cell::new(None),
            copy_succeeds: Cell::new(true),
            conversion: RefCell::new(None),
            has_presented_frame: Cell::new(false),
        }
    }
}

impl WebGLHost for FakeHost {
    type Pixels = Vec<u8>;
    type VideoFrame = u64;
    type VideoFrameImage = u64;

    fn gl_proc_address(&self, _: &CStr) -> *const c_void {
        core::ptr::null()
    }

    fn allocate_canvas_id(&self) -> CanvasId {
        CanvasId(self.next_canvas_id.replace(self.next_canvas_id.get() + 1))
    }

    fn create_webgl_context(&self, client: WebContentClientId, canvas_id: CanvasId, options: ContextOptions) -> bool {
        record(format!(
            "host.create({}, {}, {}x{})",
            client.0, canvas_id.0, options.size.width, options.size.height
        ));
        true
    }

    fn destroy_webgl_context(&self, client: WebContentClientId, canvas_id: CanvasId) {
        record(format!("host.destroy({}, {})", client.0, canvas_id.0));
    }

    fn make_webgl_context_current(&self, _: WebContentClientId, _: CanvasId) -> DefaultBuffers {
        record("host.make_current".into());
        self.defaults.get()
    }

    fn set_webgl_drawing_buffer_size(&self, _: WebContentClientId, _: CanvasId, size: IntSize) {
        record(format!("host.set_size({}x{})", size.width, size.height));
    }

    fn present_webgl_context(
        &self,
        _: WebContentClientId,
        _: CanvasId,
        preserve_drawing_buffer: bool,
        show_presented_frame: bool,
    ) -> PresentOutcome {
        record(format!(
            "host.present({preserve_drawing_buffer}, {show_presented_frame})"
        ));
        if show_presented_frame && self.has_presented_frame.get() {
            return PresentOutcome::ShowedPresentedFrame;
        }
        self.has_presented_frame.set(true);
        PresentOutcome::Presented
    }

    unsafe fn read_back_webgl_drawing_buffer(
        &self,
        _: WebContentClientId,
        _: CanvasId,
        from_presented_frame: bool,
        rect: IntRect,
        _: *mut u8,
        _: usize,
    ) -> Option<IntSize> {
        record(format!("host.read_back({from_presented_frame})"));
        Some(IntSize {
            width: rect.width,
            height: rect.height,
        })
    }

    fn webgl_can_copy_images_into_textures(&self, _: WebContentClientId, _: CanvasId) -> bool {
        record("host.can_copy".into());
        self.can_copy_images_into_textures.get()
    }

    fn held_video_frame(
        &self,
        _: WebContentClientId,
        sink_handle: VideoSinkHandle,
        generation: u64,
    ) -> Option<(u64, IntSize)> {
        record(format!("host.held_video_frame({}, {generation})", sink_handle.0));
        self.held_video_frame_size.get().map(|size| (sink_handle.0, size))
    }

    fn video_frame_image(&self, frame: &u64) -> Option<u64> {
        record(format!("host.video_frame_image({frame})"));
        Some(*frame)
    }

    fn copy_video_frame_image_into_bound_texture(
        &self,
        _: WebContentClientId,
        _: CanvasId,
        image: &u64,
        copy: VideoFrameCopy,
    ) -> bool {
        record(format!("host.copy({image}, {}x{})", copy.size.width, copy.size.height));
        self.copy_succeeds.get()
    }

    fn convert_image_source(
        &self,
        _: WebContentClientId,
        source: ImageSource,
        conversion: ImageConversion,
    ) -> ImageConversionOutcome<Vec<u8>> {
        record(format!("host.convert({source:?}, {:?})", conversion.export_format));
        self.conversion
            .take()
            .expect("the test sets up what the conversion answers")
    }
}

const CLIENT: WebContentClientId = WebContentClientId(7);

fn record_of<C: Command>(command: &C, data: InlineData<'_>) -> Vec<u8> {
    Record::new(C::TYPE, command.as_bytes(), data).unwrap().encoded()
}

fn replay(
    contexts: &mut WebGLContexts,
    host: &FakeHost,
    canvas_id: CanvasId,
    records: &[Vec<u8>],
    image_sources: &[ImageSource],
) -> Result<(), ReplayError> {
    let commands = TestMemory::new(&records.concat());
    let size = commands.bytes().len() as u64;
    contexts.execute_commands(host, CLIENT, canvas_id, Some(&commands), size, image_sources)
}

fn ids(ids: &[u32]) -> Vec<u8> {
    ids.iter().flat_map(|id| id.to_ne_bytes()).collect()
}

fn gen_buffers(ids_bytes: &[u8], count: i32) -> Vec<u8> {
    let data = InlineData::Bytes(ids_bytes);
    record_of(
        &commands::GenBuffers {
            n: count,
            buffers: DataSpan::following::<commands::GenBuffers>(data),
        },
        data,
    )
}

#[test]
fn objects_are_named_by_the_ids_that_webcontent_gave_them() {
    let host = FakeHost::default();
    let (mut contexts, canvas_id) = contexts_with_one(&host, false);
    let delete_ids = ids(&[2, 1]);
    let delete_data = InlineData::Bytes(&delete_ids);
    let records = [
        gen_buffers(&ids(&[1, 2]), 2),
        record_of(
            &commands::BindBuffer {
                target: GL_ARRAY_BUFFER,
                buffer: 2,
            },
            InlineData::NONE,
        ),
        record_of(
            &commands::DeleteBuffers {
                n: 2,
                buffers: DataSpan::following::<commands::DeleteBuffers>(delete_data),
            },
            delete_data,
        ),
        record_of(
            &commands::BindBuffer {
                target: GL_ARRAY_BUFFER,
                buffer: 2,
            },
            InlineData::NONE,
        ),
    ];
    replay(&mut contexts, &host, canvas_id, &records, &[]).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        take_calls(),
        [
            "host.make_current",
            "glGenBuffers(1, \"ptr\")",
            "glGenBuffers(1, \"ptr\")",
            "glBindBuffer(34962, 2)",
            "glDeleteBuffers(2, \"ptr\")",
            "glBindBuffer(34962, 0)",
        ]
    );
}

#[test]
fn creating_objects_needs_as_many_ids_as_it_creates() {
    let host = FakeHost::default();
    let (mut contexts, canvas_id) = contexts_with_one(&host, false);
    assert_eq!(
        replay(&mut contexts, &host, canvas_id, &[gen_buffers(&ids(&[1, 2]), 3)], &[]),
        Err(ReplayError("GenBuffers has another number of objects than it creates"))
    );
    assert_eq!(
        replay(&mut contexts, &host, canvas_id, &[gen_buffers(&ids(&[0]), 1)], &[]),
        Err(ReplayError("WebGL object id 0 is reserved"))
    );
}

#[test]
fn the_object_id_0_of_a_framebuffer_is_the_drawing_buffer() {
    let host = FakeHost::default();
    let (mut contexts, canvas_id) = contexts_with_one(&host, false);
    let bind_default_framebuffer = record_of(
        &commands::BindFramebuffer {
            target: GL_FRAMEBUFFER,
            framebuffer: 0,
        },
        InlineData::NONE,
    );
    let resize = record_of(
        &commands::SetDrawingBufferSize { width: 10, height: 20 },
        InlineData::NONE,
    );
    let records = [bind_default_framebuffer.clone(), resize, bind_default_framebuffer];
    replay(&mut contexts, &host, canvas_id, &records[..1], &[]).unwrap();
    host.defaults.set(super::host::DefaultBuffers {
        framebuffer: 101,
        renderbuffer: 201,
    });
    replay(&mut contexts, &host, canvas_id, &records[1..], &[]).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        take_calls(),
        [
            "host.make_current",
            "glBindFramebuffer(36160, 100)",
            "host.make_current",
            "host.set_size(10x20)",
            "host.make_current",
            "glBindFramebuffer(36160, 101)",
        ]
    );
    let too_big = record_of(
        &commands::SetDrawingBufferSize {
            width: 16385,
            height: 1,
        },
        InlineData::NONE,
    );
    assert_eq!(
        replay(&mut contexts, &host, canvas_id, &[too_big], &[]),
        Err(ReplayError("WebGL drawing buffer size is out of range"))
    );
}

#[test]
fn data_has_the_size_that_its_arguments_give() {
    let host = FakeHost::default();
    let (mut contexts, canvas_id) = contexts_with_one(&host, false);
    let values = [1.0_f32, 2.0];
    let bytes: Vec<u8> = values.iter().flat_map(|value| value.to_ne_bytes()).collect();
    let data = InlineData::Bytes(&bytes);
    let uniform = |count| {
        record_of(
            &commands::Uniform2fv {
                location: 3,
                count,
                value: DataSpan::following::<commands::Uniform2fv>(data),
            },
            data,
        )
    };
    replay(&mut contexts, &host, canvas_id, &[uniform(1)], &[]).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        replay(&mut contexts, &host, canvas_id, &[uniform(2)], &[]),
        Err(ReplayError(
            "the data of Uniform2fv.value has another size than its arguments give"
        ))
    );
    assert!(replay(&mut contexts, &host, canvas_id, &[uniform(-1)], &[]).is_err());
}

#[test]
fn data_that_may_be_null_is_either_there_or_empty() {
    let host = FakeHost::default();
    let (mut contexts, canvas_id) = contexts_with_one(&host, false);
    let buffer_data = |has_data, size, span: DataSpan, data| {
        record_of(
            &commands::BufferData {
                target: GL_ARRAY_BUFFER,
                size,
                has_data,
                data: span,
                usage: GL_STATIC_DRAW,
                ..commands::BufferData::ZEROED
            },
            data,
        )
    };
    take_calls();
    replay(

        &host,
        canvas_id,

            true,

            data,
        )],
        &[],
    )
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(take_calls()[1], "glBufferData(34962, 4, \"ptr\", 35044)");

        replay(
            &mut contexts,
            &host,
            canvas_id,
            &[buffer_data(
                false,
                4,
                DataSpan::following::<commands::BufferData>(data),
                data
            )],
            &[],
        ),
        Err(ReplayError("BufferData.data has data although it has none"))
    );
}

struct BufferDataCall {
    data_address: usize,
    first_byte: u8,
    executed_flush_sequence_number: u64,
}

thread_local! {
    static BUFFER_DATA_CALLS: core::cell::RefCell<Vec<BufferDataCall>> = const { core::cell::RefCell::new(Vec::new()) };
    static SHARED_COMMAND_BUFFER_START: core::cell::Cell<usize> = const { core::cell::Cell::new(0) };
}

unsafe extern "system" fn buffer_data_that_notes_where_its_data_is(
    _: u32,
    _: isize,
    data: *const core::ffi::c_void,
    _: u32,
) {
    let shared_command_buffer_start = SHARED_COMMAND_BUFFER_START.get();
    // SAFETY: The replayer passes data that holds the bytes of the call, and a test that sets the start of a shared
    //         command buffer holds the buffer.
    let call = unsafe {
        BufferDataCall {
            data_address: data as usize,
            first_byte: data.cast::<u8>().read(),
            executed_flush_sequence_number: if shared_command_buffer_start == 0 {
                0
            } else {
                (shared_command_buffer_start as *const u64).read()
            },
        }
    };
    BUFFER_DATA_CALLS.with_borrow_mut(|calls| calls.push(call));
}

fn contexts_that_note_where_buffer_data_is(host: &FakeHost) -> (WebGLContexts, CanvasId) {
    reset();
    BUFFER_DATA_CALLS.take();
    SHARED_COMMAND_BUFFER_START.set(0);
    let mut gl = recording::functions();
    gl.buffer_data = buffer_data_that_notes_where_its_data_is;
    let mut contexts = WebGLContexts::with_gl_functions(gl);
    let canvas_id = contexts.create(host, CLIENT, options(false)).unwrap().canvas_id;
    (contexts, canvas_id)
}

fn buffer_data_of(bytes: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {
    let data = InlineData::Bytes(bytes);
    record_of(
        &commands::BufferData {
            target: GL_ARRAY_BUFFER,
            size: bytes.len() as i64,
            has_data: true,
            data: DataSpan::following::<commands::BufferData>(data),
            usage: GL_STATIC_DRAW,
            ..commands::BufferData::ZEROED
        },
        data,
    )
}

#[test]
fn a_large_upload_is_passed_to_gl_where_webcontent_wrote_it() {
    let host = FakeHost::default();
    let (mut contexts, canvas_id) = contexts_that_note_where_buffer_data_is(&host);
    let records = [
        buffer_data_of(&[9; 64]),
        buffer_data_of(&vec![7; 64 * 1024]),
        buffer_data_of(&[5; 64]),
    ];
    let commands = TestMemory::new(&records.concat());
    let written = commands.bytes().as_ptr_range();
    let written = written.start as usize..written.end as usize;
    contexts
        .execute_commands(
            &host,
            CLIENT,
            canvas_id,
            Some(&commands),
            commands.bytes().len() as u64,
            &[],
        )
        .unwrap();
    let calls = BUFFER_DATA_CALLS.take();
    let placements: Vec<(u8, bool)> = calls
        .iter()
        .map(|call| (call.first_byte, written.contains(&call.data_address)))
        .collect();
    assert_eq!(placements, [(9, false), (7, true), (5, false)]);
}

#[test]
fn the_data_of_a_large_upload_lies_inside_its_record() {
    let host = FakeHost::default();
    let (mut contexts, canvas_id) = contexts_that_note_where_buffer_data_is(&host);
    let bytes = vec![7; 64 * 1024];
    let data = InlineData::Bytes(&bytes);
    let span = DataSpan::following::<commands::BufferData>(data);
    let record = record_of(
        &commands::BufferData {
            target: GL_ARRAY_BUFFER,
            size: bytes.len() as i64 + 4096,
            has_data: true,
            data: DataSpan {
                size: span.size + 4096,
                ..span
            },
            usage: GL_STATIC_DRAW,
            ..commands::BufferData::ZEROED
        },
        data,
    );
    let commands = TestMemory::new(&record);
    assert_eq!(
        contexts.execute_commands(&host, CLIENT, canvas_id, Some(&commands), record.len() as u64, &[]),
        Err(ReplayError("WebGL data span lies outside its payload"))
    );
    assert!(BUFFER_DATA_CALLS.take().is_empty());
}

#[test]
fn only_the_records_that_webcontent_wrote_into_a_command_buffer_are_replayed() {
    let host = FakeHost::default();
    let (mut contexts, canvas_id) = contexts_with_one(&host, false);
    let enable = record_of(&commands::Enable { cap: 1 }, InlineData::NONE);
    let commands = TestMemory::new(&[enable.clone(), vec![0; 64]].concat());
    contexts
        .execute_commands(&host, CLIENT, canvas_id, Some(&commands), enable.len() as u64, &[])
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(take_calls(), ["host.make_current", "glEnable(1)"]);
    assert_eq!(
        contexts.execute_commands(
            &host,
            CLIENT,
            canvas_id,
            Some(&commands),
            commands.bytes().len() as u64 + 1,
            &[]
        ),
        Err(ReplayError(
            "WebContent sent more WebGL commands than their buffer holds"
        ))
    );
}

#[test]
fn a_shared_command_buffer_is_given_back_once_its_records_are_replayed() {
    let host = FakeHost::default();
    let (mut contexts, canvas_id) = contexts_that_note_where_buffer_data_is(&host);
    let record = buffer_data_of(&vec![7; 64 * 1024]);
    let mut shared = vec![0_u8; SHARED_DATA_REGION_OFFSET + record.len()];
    shared[SHARED_DATA_REGION_OFFSET..].copy_from_slice(&record);
    let shared = Box::new(TestMemory::new(&shared));
    let shared_start = shared.bytes().as_ptr();
    SHARED_COMMAND_BUFFER_START.set(shared_start as usize);
    contexts.set_command_buffer(CLIENT, canvas_id, Some(shared)).unwrap();
    contexts
        .execute_commands_from_shared_buffer(&host, CLIENT, canvas_id, 0, record.len() as u64, 42, &[])
        .unwrap();
    let calls = BUFFER_DATA_CALLS.take();
    assert_eq!(calls.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(calls[0].executed_flush_sequence_number, 0);
    // SAFETY: The test owns the memory, which the context holds.
    assert_eq!(unsafe { shared_start.cast::<u64>().read() }, 42);
    SHARED_COMMAND_BUFFER_START.set(0);
}

#[test]
fn a_record_whose_booleans_or_spans_are_out_of_range_is_rejected() {
    let host = FakeHost::default();
    let (mut contexts, canvas_id) = contexts_with_one(&host, false);
    let mut record = record_of(
        &commands::BufferData {
            target: GL_ARRAY_BUFFER,
            has_data: false,
            ..commands::BufferData::ZEROED
        },
        InlineData::NONE,
    );
    record[8 + 16] = 2;
    assert_eq!(
        replay(&mut contexts, &host, canvas_id, &[record], &[]),
        Err(ReplayError("WebGL payload does not hold its struct"))
    );
    let name = record_of(
        &commands::RequestExtensionANGLE {
            name: DataSpan { offset: 16, size: 64 },
        },
        InlineData::NONE,
    );
    assert_eq!(
        replay(&mut contexts, &host, canvas_id, &[name], &[]),
        Err(ReplayError("WebGL data span lies outside its payload"))
    );
    let mut truncated = record_of(&commands::Enable { cap: 1 }, InlineData::NONE);
    truncated.truncate(7);
    assert_eq!(
        replay(&mut contexts, &host, canvas_id, &[truncated], &[]),
        Err(ReplayError("Truncated WebGL command header"))
    );
}

#[test]
fn a_string_ends_with_a_nul_and_a_shader_source_is_passed_with_its_length() {
    let host = FakeHost::default();
    let (mut contexts, canvas_id) = contexts_with_one(&host, false);
    let source = InlineData::NulTerminated(b"void main() {}");
    let shader_source = record_of(
        &commands::ShaderSource {
            shader: 0,
            source: DataSpan::following::<commands::ShaderSource>(source),
        },
        source,
    );
    replay(&mut contexts, &host, canvas_id, &[shader_source], &[]).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(take_calls()[1], "glShaderSource(0, 1, \"ptr\", \"ptr\")");

    let unterminated = InlineData::Bytes(b"main");
    let shader_source = record_of(
        &commands::ShaderSource {
            shader: 0,
            source: DataSpan::following::<commands::ShaderSource>(unterminated),
        },
        unterminated,
    );
    assert_eq!(
        replay(&mut contexts, &host, canvas_id, &[shader_source], &[]),
        Err(ReplayError("WebGL string is not NUL-terminated"))
    );

    let varyings = InlineData::Bytes(b"a\0b");
    let transform_feedback_varyings = record_of(
        &commands::TransformFeedbackVaryings {
            program: 0,
            count: 2,
            varyings: DataSpan::following::<commands::TransformFeedbackVaryings>(varyings),
            buffer_mode: 0,
        },
        varyings,
    );
    assert_eq!(
        replay(&mut contexts, &host, canvas_id, &[transform_feedback_varyings], &[]),
        Err(ReplayError("WebGL string is not NUL-terminated"))
    );
}

fn sync_call<R: libcompositing_rust::webgl::wire::SyncRequest>(
    contexts: &mut WebGLContexts,
    host: &FakeHost,
    canvas_id: CanvasId,
    request: &R,
    data: InlineData<'_>,
) -> Result<Vec<u8>, ReplayError> {
    let mut bytes = Vec::new();
    assert!(encode_sync_request(&mut bytes, request, data));
    contexts.execute_sync_call(host, CLIENT, canvas_id, &bytes)
}

#[test]
fn a_page_never_blocks_the_compositor_on_a_sync_object() {
    let host = FakeHost::default();
    let (mut contexts, canvas_id) = contexts_with_one(&host, true);
    let fence = record_of(
        &commands::FenceSync {
            id: 5,
            condition: GL_SYNC_GPU_COMMANDS_COMPLETE,
            flags: 0,
        },
        InlineData::NONE,
    );
    replay(&mut contexts, &host, canvas_id, &[fence], &[]).unwrap();
    sync_call(
        &mut contexts,
        &host,
        canvas_id,
        &sync_calls::ClientWaitSyncRequest {
            sync: 5,
            flags: 1,
            timeout: 1_000_000,
            ..sync_calls::ClientWaitSyncRequest::ZEROED
        },
        InlineData::NONE,
    )
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        take_calls(),
        [
            "host.make_current",
            "glFenceSync(37143, 0)",
            "host.make_current",
            "glClientWaitSync(\"ptr\", 1, 0)",
        ]
    );
}

#[test]
fn a_synchronous_call_answers_its_outputs_after_its_struct() {
    let host = FakeHost::default();
    let (mut contexts, canvas_id) = contexts_with_one(&host, false);
    let reply = sync_call(
        &mut contexts,
        &host,
        canvas_id,
        &sync_calls::GetShaderInfoLogRequest { shader: 0, buf_size: 5 },
        InlineData::NONE,
    )
    .unwrap();
    let decoded = sync_calls::GetShaderInfoLogReply::from_reply_bytes(&reply);
    assert_eq!(decoded.info_log, DataSpan { offset: 16, size: 5 });
    assert_eq!(resolve_data_span(&reply, decoded.info_log), [0; 5]);
    assert_eq!(reply.len(), 32);

    assert_eq!(
        sync_call(
            &mut contexts,
            &host,
            canvas_id,
            &sync_calls::GetShaderInfoLogRequest {
                shader: 0,
                buf_size: -1,
            },
            InlineData::NONE,
        ),
        Err(ReplayError("WebGL asks for a buffer of a size that it cannot have"))
    );
}

unsafe extern "system" fn errors_of_the_compositor_and_then_of_the_page() -> u32 {
    thread_local! {
        static ERRORS: core::cell::RefCell<Vec<u32>> = core::cell::RefCell::new(vec![0x0502, 0x0502, 0x0505, 0, 0x0500, 0]);
    }
    ERRORS.with_borrow_mut(|errors| if errors.is_empty() { 0 } else { errors.remove(0) })
}

#[test]
fn the_errors_of_the_compositor_are_collected_before_those_of_gl() {
    let host = FakeHost::default();
    reset();
    let mut gl = recording::functions();
    gl.get_error = errors_of_the_compositor_and_then_of_the_page;
    let mut contexts = WebGLContexts::with_gl_functions(gl);
    let canvas_id = contexts.create(&host, CLIENT, options(false)).unwrap().canvas_id;
    let (context, gl) = contexts.context_and_gl(CLIENT, canvas_id).unwrap();
    let mut replayer = super::replay::Replayer {
        gl,
        host: &host,
        client: CLIENT,
        canvas_id,
        webgl2: false,
        objects: &mut context.objects,
        stashed_errors: &mut context.stashed_errors,
        defaults: host.defaults.get(),
        image_sources: &[],
        payload_in_shared_memory: None,
    };
    assert!(replayer.stash_errors());
    let errors: Vec<u32> = (0..4).map(|_| replayer.get_error()).collect();
    assert_eq!(errors, [0x0502, 0x0505, 0x0500, 0]);
}

fn tex_image(bitmap_index: u32, format: u32, explicit_size: Option<(i32, i32)>) -> Vec<u8> {
    record_of(
        &commands::TexImage2DFromBitmap {
            target: GL_TEXTURE_2D,
            level: 0,
            internalformat: GL_RGBA as i32,
            format,
            r#type: GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE,
            bitmap_index,
            has_explicit_destination_size: explicit_size.is_some(),
            destination_width: explicit_size.map_or(0, |size| size.0),
            destination_height: explicit_size.map_or(0, |size| size.1),
            flip_y: false,
            premultiply_alpha: false,
            ..commands::TexImage2DFromBitmap::ZEROED
        },
        InlineData::NONE,
    )
}

#[test]
fn an_image_upload_names_a_known_image_in_a_known_format() {
    let host = FakeHost::default();
    let (mut contexts, canvas_id) = contexts_with_one(&host, false);
    let image = [ImageSource::RegisteredImageFrame(ImageFrameResourceId(9))];
    assert_eq!(
        replay(&mut contexts, &host, canvas_id, &[tex_image(1, GL_RGBA, None)], &image),
        Err(ReplayError("WebGL image upload references an out-of-range bitmap"))
    );
    assert_eq!(
        replay(&mut contexts, &host, canvas_id, &[tex_image(0, GL_FLOAT, None)], &image),
        Err(ReplayError(
            "WebGL image upload has an unsupported format and type combination"
        ))
    );
    *host.conversion.borrow_mut() = Some(ImageConversionOutcome::UnknownImageFrame);
    assert_eq!(
        replay(&mut contexts, &host, canvas_id, &[tex_image(0, GL_RGBA, None)], &image),
        Err(ReplayError(
            "WebGL image upload names an image frame that is not registered"
        ))
    );
}

#[test]
fn a_converted_image_is_uploaded_with_the_unpack_state_of_packed_pixels() {
    let host = FakeHost::default();
    let (mut contexts, canvas_id) = contexts_with_one(&host, false);
    let image = [ImageSource::RegisteredImageFrame(ImageFrameResourceId(9))];
    *host.conversion.borrow_mut() = Some(ImageConversionOutcome::Converted {
        pixels: vec![0; 16],
        width: 2,
        height: 2,
    });
    replay(&mut contexts, &host, canvas_id, &[tex_image(0, GL_RGBA, None)], &image).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        take_calls(),
        [
            "host.make_current",
            "host.convert(RegisteredImageFrame(ImageFrameResourceId(9)), RGBA8888)",
            "glGetIntegerv(3317, \"ptr\")",
            "glPixelStorei(3317, 1)",
            "glGetString(7939)",
            "glTexImage2DRobustANGLE(3553, 0, 6408, 2, 2, 0, 6408, 5121, 16, \"ptr\")",
            "glPixelStorei(3317, 0)",
        ]
    );

    replay(
        &mut contexts,
        &host,
        canvas_id,
        &[tex_image(0, GL_RGBA, Some((-1, 2)))],
        &image,
    )
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        take_calls()[4],
        "glTexImage2DRobustANGLE(3553, 0, 6408, -1, 2, 0, 6408, 5121, 0, \"ptr\")"
    );
}

#[test]
fn a_held_video_frame_is_copied_on_the_gpu_where_it_can_be() {
    let host = FakeHost::default();
    let (mut contexts, canvas_id) = contexts_with_one(&host, false);
    let video = [ImageSource::HeldVideoFrame {
        sink_handle: VideoSinkHandle(4),
        generation: 2,
    }];
    host.can_copy_images_into_textures.set(true);
    host.held_video_frame_size.set(Some(IntSize { width: 8, height: 6 }));
    replay(&mut contexts, &host, canvas_id, &[tex_image(0, GL_RGBA, None)], &video).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        take_calls(),
        [
            "host.make_current",
            "host.held_video_frame(4, 2)",
            "host.can_copy",
            "host.video_frame_image(4)",
            "glGetError()",
            "glGetString(7939)",
            "glTexImage2DRobustANGLE(3553, 0, 6408, 8, 6, 0, 6408, 5121, 0, \"null\")",
            "glGetError()",
            "host.copy(4, 8x6)",
            "glGetError()",
        ]
    );

    host.copy_succeeds.set(false);
    *host.conversion.borrow_mut() = Some(ImageConversionOutcome::Failed);
    replay(&mut contexts, &host, canvas_id, &[tex_image(0, GL_RGBA, None)], &video).unwrap();
    let calls = take_calls();
    assert_eq!(calls[8], "host.copy(4, 8x6)");
    assert_eq!(
        calls[9],
        "host.convert(HeldVideoFrame { sink_handle: VideoSinkHandle(4), generation: 2 }, RGBA8888)"
    );
    assert_eq!(calls.len(), 10);
}

#[test]
fn a_drawing_buffer_that_is_not_preserved_is_cleared_before_the_next_frame() {
    let host = FakeHost::default();
    let (mut contexts, canvas_id) = contexts_with_one(&host, false);
    contexts.present(&host, CLIENT, canvas_id, false).unwrap();
    let pixels = TestMemory::new(&[0; 16]);
    let rect = IntRect {
        x: 0,
        y: 0,
        width: 2,
        height: 2,
    };
    contexts
        .read_back_drawing_buffer(&host, CLIENT, canvas_id, rect, Some(&pixels))
        .unwrap();
    contexts.present(&host, CLIENT, canvas_id, false).unwrap();
    replay(
        &mut contexts,
        &host,
        canvas_id,
        &[record_of(&commands::Flush::ZEROED, InlineData::NONE)],
        &[],
    )
    .unwrap();
    contexts
        .read_back_drawing_buffer(&host, CLIENT, canvas_id, rect, Some(&pixels))
        .unwrap();
    let calls = take_calls();
    assert_eq!(
        calls[..4],
        [
            "host.present(false, false)",
            "host.read_back(true)",
            "host.present(false, true)",
            "host.make_current",
        ]
    );
    assert_eq!(calls[4], "glGetIntegerv(36006, \"ptr\")");
    assert!(calls.contains(&"glClear(17664)".to_string()));
    assert_eq!(calls[calls.len() - 2], "glFlush()");
    assert_eq!(calls[calls.len() - 1], "host.read_back(false)");
}

#[test]
fn published_commands_lie_inside_the_shared_command_buffer() {
    let host = FakeHost::default();
    let (mut contexts, canvas_id) = contexts_with_one(&host, false);
    let enable = record_of(&commands::Enable { cap: 1 }, InlineData::NONE);
    let mut shared = vec![0_u8; SHARED_DATA_REGION_OFFSET + 64];
    shared[SHARED_DATA_REGION_OFFSET..SHARED_DATA_REGION_OFFSET + enable.len()].copy_from_slice(&enable);
    let shared = Box::new(TestMemory::new(&shared));
    let shared_bytes = shared.bytes().as_ptr();
    assert_eq!(
        contexts.execute_commands_from_shared_buffer(&host, CLIENT, canvas_id, 0, 16, 1, &[]),
        Err(ReplayError(
            "WebContent published WebGL commands without a shared command buffer"
        ))
    );
    contexts.set_command_buffer(CLIENT, canvas_id, Some(shared)).unwrap();
    contexts
        .execute_commands_from_shared_buffer(&host, CLIENT, canvas_id, 0, enable.len() as u64, 42, &[])
        .unwrap();
    // SAFETY: The test owns the memory, which the context holds.
    let executed = unsafe { shared_bytes.cast::<u64>().read() };
    assert_eq!(executed, 42);
    assert_eq!(take_calls()[1], "glEnable(1)");
    for (offset, size) in [(8, 16), (0, 65), (80, 0)] {
        assert_eq!(
            contexts.execute_commands_from_shared_buffer(&host, CLIENT, canvas_id, offset, size, 43, &[]),
            Err(ReplayError(
                "WebContent published an invalid WebGL shared command buffer range"
            ))
        );
    }
    assert_eq!(
        contexts.set_command_buffer(CLIENT, canvas_id, Some(Box::new(TestMemory::new(&[0; 128])))),
        Err(ReplayError("WebContent sent an invalid WebGL shared command buffer"))
    );
}

#[test]
fn a_context_is_named_by_its_client_and_canvas() {
    let host = FakeHost::default();
    let (mut contexts, canvas_id) = contexts_with_one(&host, false);
    let other_client = WebContentClientId(8);
    assert_eq!(
        contexts.present(&host, other_client, canvas_id, true),
        Err(ReplayError("WebContent named a WebGL context that it has not created"))
    );
    contexts.clear_drawing_buffer(&host, other_client, canvas_id);
    assert!(take_calls().is_empty());
    let pixels = TestMemory::new(&[0; 4]);
    let rect = IntRect {
        x: 0,
        y: 0,
        width: 1,
        height: 1,
    };
    assert_eq!(
        contexts
            .read_pixels(
                &host,
                CLIENT,
                canvas_id,
                rect,
                GL_RGBA,
                GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE,
                5,
                Some(&pixels)
            )
            .err(),
        Some(ReplayError("WebContent sent an invalid WebGL readPixels buffer"))
    );
    contexts.forget_client(CLIENT);
    assert!(contexts.present(&host, CLIENT, canvas_id, true).is_err());
    contexts.destroy(&host, CLIENT, canvas_id);
    record("end".into());
    assert_eq!(take_calls(), ["end"]);
}

/*
