#include <AK/Time.h>
#include <Compositor/VideoFrameHolds.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/VideoFrame.h>

namespace Compositor {

using Compositing::VideoFramePresentationPage;

void VideoFrameHolds::add_sink(Media::VideoSinkHandle handle, NonnullRefPtr<VideoFramePresentationPage> page)
{
    // WebContent may already hold generation 0.
    if (auto sink = m_sinks.get(handle); sink.has_value())
        retire_current_generation(handle, *sink, VideoFramePresentationPage::retired_generation);
    m_sinks.set(handle, Sink { .page = move(page), .generation = 0, .frame = nullptr, .presented_frame = {} });
}

void VideoFrameHolds::remove_sink(Media::VideoSinkHandle handle)
{
    auto sink = m_sinks.get(handle);
    if (!sink.has_value())
        return;
    retire_current_generation(handle, *sink, VideoFramePresentationPage::retired_generation);
    m_sinks.remove(handle);
}

void VideoFrameHolds::present_frame(Media::VideoSinkHandle handle, RefPtr<Media::VideoFrame> frame, Media::DisplayingVideoSinkFrameCounts new_frame_counts)
{
    auto sink = m_sinks.get(handle);
    if (!sink.has_value())
        return;
    if (sink->frame == frame) {
        add_frame_counts(handle, new_frame_counts);
        return;
    }
    auto next_generation = sink->generation + 1;
    retire_current_generation(handle, *sink, next_generation);
    sink->generation = next_generation;
    sink->frame = move(frame);

    auto& presented_frame = sink->presented_frame;
    presented_frame.generation = next_generation;
    presented_frame.presentation_time = MonotonicTime::now();
    presented_frame.media_time = AK::Duration::zero();
    presented_frame.width = 0;
    presented_frame.height = 0;
    presented_frame.presented_frame_count += new_frame_counts.presented;
    presented_frame.dropped_frame_count += new_frame_counts.dropped;
    if (sink->frame) {
        presented_frame.media_time = sink->frame->timestamp();
        presented_frame.width = sink->frame->width();
        presented_frame.height = sink->frame->height();
    }
    sink->page->publish_presented_frame(presented_frame);
}

void VideoFrameHolds::set_frame_is_up_to_date(Media::VideoSinkHandle handle, bool frame_is_up_to_date)
{
    auto sink = m_sinks.get(handle);
    if (!sink.has_value() || sink->presented_frame.frame_is_up_to_date == frame_is_up_to_date)
        return;
    sink->presented_frame.frame_is_up_to_date = frame_is_up_to_date;
    sink->page->publish_presented_frame(sink->presented_frame);
}

void VideoFrameHolds::add_frame_counts(Media::VideoSinkHandle handle, Media::DisplayingVideoSinkFrameCounts new_frame_counts)
{
    auto sink = m_sinks.get(handle);
    if (!sink.has_value())
        return;
    if (new_frame_counts.is_zero())
        return;
    sink->presented_frame.presented_frame_count += new_frame_counts.presented;
    sink->presented_frame.dropped_frame_count += new_frame_counts.dropped;
    sink->page->publish_presented_frame(sink->presented_frame);
}

void VideoFrameHolds::retire_current_generation(Media::VideoSinkHandle handle, Sink& sink, u64 next_generation)
{
    auto replaced = sink.page->replace_generation(next_generation);
    if (replaced.generation != sink.generation) {
        dbgln("Compositor: WebContent overwrote the generation of video sink {}", handle.value());
        return;
    }
    if (replaced.hold_count == 0)
        return;
    auto& retained_frames = m_retained_frames.ensure(handle);
    if (auto previous = retained_frames.get(sink.generation); previous.has_value() && previous.value().frame)
        m_retained_frame_count--;
    auto frame = sink.frame;
    if (frame && m_retained_frame_count >= MAX_RETAINED_FRAME_COUNT) {
        dbgln("Compositor: Not keeping the frame of video sink {} held past its presentation, since {} already are", handle.value(), m_retained_frame_count);
        frame = nullptr;
    }
    if (frame)
        m_retained_frame_count++;
    retained_frames.set(sink.generation, RetainedFrame { .frame = move(frame), .hold_count = replaced.hold_count });
}

ErrorOr<void> VideoFrameHolds::release_hold(Media::VideoSinkHandle handle, u64 generation)
{
    if (auto sink = m_sinks.get(handle); sink.has_value() && sink->generation == generation) {
        if (sink->page->release_hold_if_current(generation) != VideoFramePresentationPage::ReleaseResult::Released)
            return Error::from_string_literal("The current video frame was not held");
        return {};
    }

    auto retained_frames = m_retained_frames.get(handle);
    if (!retained_frames.has_value())
        return Error::from_string_literal("The video frame was not retained");
    auto retained_frame = retained_frames->get(generation);
    if (!retained_frame.has_value())
        return Error::from_string_literal("The video frame was not retained");
    if (--retained_frame->hold_count > 0)
        return {};
    if (retained_frame->frame)
        m_retained_frame_count--;
    retained_frames->remove(generation);
    if (retained_frames->is_empty())
        m_retained_frames.remove(handle);
    return {};
}

RefPtr<Media::VideoFrame> VideoFrameHolds::held_frame(Media::VideoSinkHandle handle, u64 generation) const
{
    if (auto sink = m_sinks.get(handle); sink.has_value() && sink->generation == generation)
        return sink->frame;
    auto retained_frames = m_retained_frames.get(handle);
    if (!retained_frames.has_value())
        return nullptr;
    auto retained_frame = retained_frames->get(generation);
    if (!retained_frame.has_value())
        return nullptr;
    return retained_frame->frame;
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/Error.h>

#include <AK/NonnullRefPtr.h>

#include <LibMedia/Sinks/DisplayingVideoSink.h>

#include <LibMediaCodecs/Forward.h>

namespace Compositor {

class VideoFrameHolds {
public:
    // A hold past this many retained frames keeps no frame.
    static constexpr size_t MAX_RETAINED_FRAME_COUNT = 64;

    void add_sink(Media::VideoSinkHandle, NonnullRefPtr<Compositing::VideoFramePresentationPage>);
    void remove_sink(Media::VideoSinkHandle);

    void present_frame(Media::VideoSinkHandle, RefPtr<Media::VideoFrame>, Media::DisplayingVideoSinkFrameCounts new_frame_counts);
    void add_frame_counts(Media::VideoSinkHandle, Media::DisplayingVideoSinkFrameCounts new_frame_counts);
    void set_frame_is_up_to_date(Media::VideoSinkHandle, bool);

    ErrorOr<void> release_hold(Media::VideoSinkHandle, u64 generation);
    RefPtr<Media::VideoFrame> held_frame(Media::VideoSinkHandle, u64 generation) const;

private:
    struct Sink {
        NonnullRefPtr<Compositing::VideoFramePresentationPage> page;
        u64 generation { 0 };
        RefPtr<Media::VideoFrame> frame;
        Compositing::VideoFramePresentationPage::PresentedFrame presented_frame;
    };
    struct RetainedFrame {
        RefPtr<Media::VideoFrame> frame;
        u64 hold_count { 0 };
    };

    void retire_current_generation(Media::VideoSinkHandle, Sink&, u64 next_generation);

    HashMap<Media::VideoSinkHandle, Sink> m_sinks;
    HashMap<Media::VideoSinkHandle, HashMap<u64, RetainedFrame>> m_retained_frames;
    size_t m_retained_frame_count { 0 };
};

}

SkYUVColorSpace skia_yuv_color_space(Media::CodingIndependentCodePoints cicp)
{
    bool full_range = cicp.video_full_range_flag() == Media::VideoFullRangeFlag::Full;

    switch (cicp.matrix_coefficients()) {
    case Media::MatrixCoefficients::BT709:
        return full_range ? kRec709_Full_SkYUVColorSpace : kRec709_Limited_SkYUVColorSpace;
    case Media::MatrixCoefficients::FCC:
        return full_range ? kFCC_Full_SkYUVColorSpace : kFCC_Limited_SkYUVColorSpace;
    case Media::MatrixCoefficients::BT470BG:
    case Media::MatrixCoefficients::BT601:
        return full_range ? kJPEG_Full_SkYUVColorSpace : kRec601_Limited_SkYUVColorSpace;
    case Media::MatrixCoefficients::SMPTE240:
        return full_range ? kSMPTE240_Full_SkYUVColorSpace : kSMPTE240_Limited_SkYUVColorSpace;
    case Media::MatrixCoefficients::YCgCo:
        return full_range ? kYCgCo_16bit_Full_SkYUVColorSpace : kYCgCo_16bit_Limited_SkYUVColorSpace;
    case Media::MatrixCoefficients::BT2020NonConstantLuminance:
    case Media::MatrixCoefficients::BT2020ConstantLuminance:
        return full_range ? kBT2020_16bit_Full_SkYUVColorSpace : kBT2020_16bit_Limited_SkYUVColorSpace;
    case Media::MatrixCoefficients::SMPTE2085:
        return full_range ? kYDZDX_Full_SkYUVColorSpace : kYDZDX_Limited_SkYUVColorSpace;
    case Media::MatrixCoefficients::Identity:
        return cicp.video_full_range_flag() == Media::VideoFullRangeFlag::Studio ? kGBR_Limited_SkYUVColorSpace : kGBR_Full_SkYUVColorSpace;
    default:
        // Default to BT.709 for unsupported matrix coefficients
        return full_range ? kRec709_Full_SkYUVColorSpace : kRec709_Limited_SkYUVColorSpace;
    }
}

static SkYUVAInfo::Subsampling skia_subsampling(Media::Subsampling subsampling)
{
    if (!subsampling.x() && !subsampling.y())
        return SkYUVAInfo::Subsampling::k444;
    if (subsampling.x() && !subsampling.y())
        return SkYUVAInfo::Subsampling::k422;
    if (!subsampling.x() && subsampling.y())
        return SkYUVAInfo::Subsampling::k440;
    return SkYUVAInfo::Subsampling::k420;
}

static u16 expand_sample_to_full_16_bit_range(u16 sample, u8 bit_depth)
{
    if (bit_depth >= 16)
        return sample;

    auto const shift = 16 - bit_depth;
    auto const inverse_shift = bit_depth - shift;
    return static_cast<u16>((sample << shift) | (sample >> inverse_shift));
}

static void copy_plane_expanded_to_full_16_bit_range(ReadonlyBytes source_buffer, SkPixmap const& destination, Gfx::IntSize plane_size, u8 bit_depth)
{
    VERIFY(bit_depth > 8);

    auto const* source = reinterpret_cast<u16 const*>(source_buffer.data());
    auto source_stride = static_cast<size_t>(plane_size.width());

    for (int row = 0; row < plane_size.height(); row++) {
        auto const* source_row = source + (static_cast<size_t>(row) * source_stride);
        auto* destination_row = destination.writable_addr16(0, row);
        for (int column = 0; column < plane_size.width(); column++)
            destination_row[column] = expand_sample_to_full_16_bit_range(source_row[column], bit_depth);
    }
}

SkYUVAPixmaps make_yuva_pixmaps(Gfx::YUVData const& yuv_data)
{
    auto size = yuv_data.size();
    auto skia_size = SkISize::Make(size.width(), size.height());

    auto yuva_info = SkYUVAInfo(
        skia_size,
        SkYUVAInfo::PlaneConfig::kY_U_V,
        skia_subsampling(yuv_data.subsampling()),
        skia_yuv_color_space(yuv_data.cicp()));

    SkColorType color_type;
    SkYUVAPixmapInfo::DataType data_type;
    size_t component_size;
    if (yuv_data.bit_depth() <= 8) {
        color_type = kAlpha_8_SkColorType;
        data_type = SkYUVAPixmapInfo::DataType::kUnorm8;
        component_size = 1;
    } else {
        SkYUVAPixmapInfo pixmap_info(yuva_info, SkYUVAPixmapInfo::DataType::kUnorm16, nullptr);
        auto pixmaps = SkYUVAPixmaps::Allocate(pixmap_info);
        if (!pixmaps.isValid())
            return pixmaps;

        copy_plane_expanded_to_full_16_bit_range(yuv_data.y_data(), pixmaps.plane(0), size, yuv_data.bit_depth());

        auto uv_size = yuv_data.subsampling().subsampled_size(size);
        copy_plane_expanded_to_full_16_bit_range(yuv_data.u_data(), pixmaps.plane(1), uv_size, yuv_data.bit_depth());
        copy_plane_expanded_to_full_16_bit_range(yuv_data.v_data(), pixmaps.plane(2), uv_size, yuv_data.bit_depth());

        return pixmaps;
    }

    auto y_row_bytes = static_cast<size_t>(size.width()) * component_size;

    auto uv_size = yuv_data.subsampling().subsampled_size(size);
    auto uv_row_bytes = static_cast<size_t>(uv_size.width()) * component_size;

    SkYUVAPixmapInfo pixmap_info(yuva_info, data_type, nullptr);

    // Create pixmaps from our buffers
    SkPixmap y_pixmap(
        SkImageInfo::Make(skia_size, color_type, kOpaque_SkAlphaType),
        yuv_data.y_data().data(),
        y_row_bytes);
    SkPixmap u_pixmap(
        SkImageInfo::Make(uv_size.width(), uv_size.height(), color_type, kOpaque_SkAlphaType),
        yuv_data.u_data().data(),
        uv_row_bytes);
    SkPixmap v_pixmap(
        SkImageInfo::Make(uv_size.width(), uv_size.height(), color_type, kOpaque_SkAlphaType),
        yuv_data.v_data().data(),
        uv_row_bytes);

    SkPixmap plane_pixmaps[SkYUVAInfo::kMaxPlanes] = { y_pixmap, u_pixmap, v_pixmap, {} };

    return SkYUVAPixmaps::FromExternalPixmaps(yuva_info, plane_pixmaps);
}

// Kept for a while after it was last drawn in case its surface comes back, but no longer, since the image keeps the
// surface's memory alive after the decoder has let go of it.
struct VideoSurfaceImage {
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    NonnullRefPtr<Media::VideoSurface const> surface;
    NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext> skia_backend_context;
    Media::CodingIndependentCodePoints cicp;
    sk_sp<SkImage> image;
    u64 shown_frame_id { 0 };
    MonotonicTime last_drawn_time { MonotonicTime() };
};

// Surface IDs are chosen by whoever sent the surface, so images are kept apart per sender.
struct VideoSurfaceImageKey {
    u64 sender_id { 0 };
    u64 surface_id { 0 };

    bool operator==(VideoSurfaceImageKey const&) const = default;
};

}

template<>
struct AK::Traits<Compositor::VideoSurfaceImageKey> : public DefaultTraits<Compositor::VideoSurfaceImageKey> {
    static unsigned hash(Compositor::VideoSurfaceImageKey const& key) { return pair_int_hash(u64_hash(key.sender_id), u64_hash(key.surface_id)); }
};

namespace Compositor {

static constexpr auto UNDRAWN_VIDEO_SURFACE_IMAGE_LIFETIME = AK::Duration::from_seconds(1);
static constexpr size_t MAX_VIDEO_SURFACE_IMAGES_PER_SENDER = 32;

static HashMap<VideoSurfaceImageKey, NonnullOwnPtr<VideoSurfaceImage>>& video_surface_images()
{
    // Leaked so that no image outlives the GPU context at exit.
    static auto& images = *new HashMap<VideoSurfaceImageKey, NonnullOwnPtr<VideoSurfaceImage>>;
    return images;
}

static void expire_undrawn_video_surface_images();

static Core::Timer& video_surface_image_expiry_timer()
{
    static auto& timer = Core::Timer::create_single_shot(AK::Duration::zero(), [] { expire_undrawn_video_surface_images(); }).leak_ref();
    return timer;
}

static void schedule_video_surface_image_expiry()
{
    auto& timer = video_surface_image_expiry_timer();
    if (timer.is_active())
        return;
    auto const& images = video_surface_images();
    if (images.is_empty())
        return;
    auto oldest_drawn_time = MonotonicTime::now();
    for (auto const& entry : images)
        oldest_drawn_time = min(oldest_drawn_time, entry.value->last_drawn_time);
    auto delay = max(AK::Duration::zero(), oldest_drawn_time + UNDRAWN_VIDEO_SURFACE_IMAGE_LIFETIME - MonotonicTime::now());
    timer.set_interval(delay);
    timer.start();
}

static void expire_undrawn_video_surface_images()
{
    auto expiry_time = MonotonicTime::now() - UNDRAWN_VIDEO_SURFACE_IMAGE_LIFETIME;
    video_surface_images().remove_all_matching([&](auto const&, auto const& image) {
        return image->last_drawn_time <= expiry_time;
    });
    schedule_video_surface_image_expiry();
}

static void make_room_for_video_surface_image(u64 sender_id)
{
    auto& images = video_surface_images();
    size_t sender_image_count = 0;
    Optional<VideoSurfaceImageKey> least_recently_drawn_key;
    MonotonicTime least_recently_drawn_time = MonotonicTime::now();
    for (auto const& [key, image] : images) {
        if (key.sender_id != sender_id)
            continue;
        sender_image_count++;
        if (!least_recently_drawn_key.has_value() || image->last_drawn_time < least_recently_drawn_time) {
            least_recently_drawn_key = key;
            least_recently_drawn_time = image->last_drawn_time;
        }
    }
    if (sender_image_count >= MAX_VIDEO_SURFACE_IMAGES_PER_SENDER)
        images.remove(least_recently_drawn_key.value());
}

static sk_sp<SkImage> image_for_video_surface(Media::VideoFrame const& frame, Media::VideoSurface const& surface, Gfx::SkiaBackendContext& skia_backend_context)
{
    auto sender_id = frame.storage()->sender_id();
    VideoSurfaceImageKey key { sender_id, surface.id() };

    auto& images = video_surface_images();
    auto* cached_image = [&]() -> VideoSurfaceImage* {
        auto cached = images.get(key);
        if (!cached.has_value())
            return nullptr;
        auto& image = *cached.value();
        if (image.skia_backend_context.ptr() != &skia_backend_context || image.cicp != frame.cicp())
            return nullptr;
        return &image;
    }();

    if (!cached_image) {
        images.remove(key);
        auto image = sk_image_from_video_surface(surface, frame.cicp(), skia_backend_context);
        if (!image)
            return nullptr;
        make_room_for_video_surface_image(sender_id);
        auto new_image = make<VideoSurfaceImage>(surface, skia_backend_context, frame.cicp(), move(image));
        cached_image = new_image.ptr();
        images.set(key, move(new_image));
    }

    cached_image->last_drawn_time = MonotonicTime::now();
    schedule_video_surface_image_expiry();

    if (cached_image->shown_frame_id != frame.id()) {
        video_surface_image_will_show_new_frame(*cached_image->image);
        cached_image->shown_frame_id = frame.id();
    }
    return cached_image->image;
}

static bool frame_holds_high_dynamic_range(Media::VideoFrame const& frame)
{
    auto transfer_characteristics = frame.cicp().transfer_characteristics();
    return transfer_characteristics == Media::TransferCharacteristics::SMPTE2084 || transfer_characteristics == Media::TransferCharacteristics::HLG;
}

// SDR masters of PQ video put SDR white near 100 nits, as AVFoundation does, rather than at BT.2408's 203 nits.
static constexpr float perceptual_quantizer_standard_dynamic_range_white_luminance = 100;

static sk_sp<SkColorSpace> with_standard_dynamic_range_white_of_perceptual_quantizer(SkColorSpace const& color_space)
{
    skcms_TransferFunction transfer_function;
    color_space.transferFn(&transfer_function);
    if (skcms_TransferFunction_getType(&transfer_function) != skcms_TFType_PQ)
        return nullptr;
    skcms_Matrix3x3 to_xyz_d50;
    if (!color_space.toXYZD50(&to_xyz_d50))
        return nullptr;
    // The PQ transfer function's a is the luminance in nits that it decodes to 1.
    transfer_function.a = perceptual_quantizer_standard_dynamic_range_white_luminance;
    return SkColorSpace::MakeRGB(transfer_function, to_xyz_d50);
}

static skhdr::Metadata high_dynamic_range_metadata_of(Media::ColorMetadata const& color_metadata)
{
    auto metadata = skhdr::Metadata::MakeEmpty();
    if (auto const& volume = color_metadata.mastering_display_color_volume; volume.has_value()) {
        metadata.setMasteringDisplayColorVolume({
            .fDisplayPrimaries = {
                volume->red.x,
                volume->red.y,
                volume->green.x,
                volume->green.y,
                volume->blue.x,
                volume->blue.y,
                volume->white_point.x,
                volume->white_point.y,
            },
            .fMaximumDisplayMasteringLuminance = volume->maximum_luminance,
            .fMinimumDisplayMasteringLuminance = volume->minimum_luminance,
        });
    }
    // Skia's tone map only reads MaxCLL, as the peak of the content. The peak of the scene replaces that of the video, so
    // that dark scenes are not compressed to make room for highlights elsewhere in it.
    if (color_metadata.maximum_scene_luminance.has_value())
        metadata.setContentLightLevelInformation({ .fMaxCLL = *color_metadata.maximum_scene_luminance, .fMaxFALL = 0 });
    else if (auto const& information = color_metadata.content_light_level_information; information.has_value() && information->maximum_content_light_level != 0)
        metadata.setContentLightLevelInformation(skhdr::ContentLightLevelInformation::MakeUint16(information->maximum_content_light_level, information->maximum_frame_average_light_level));
    return metadata;
}

// reinterpretColorSpace() copies the pixels of an image in memory, so such an image is given its new colour space by
// wrapping the same pixels instead. The pixel data holds a reference to the image, so the pixels stay alive and
// unchanged for as long as the new image uses them.
static sk_sp<SkImage> reinterpreted_in_color_space(sk_sp<SkImage> image, sk_sp<SkColorSpace> color_space)
{
    SkPixmap pixmap;
    if (!image->peekPixels(&pixmap))
        return image->reinterpretColorSpace(move(color_space));
    auto release_image = [](void const*, void* image) { static_cast<SkImage*>(image)->unref(); };
    auto pixels = SkData::MakeWithProc(pixmap.addr(), pixmap.computeByteSize(), release_image, SkRef(image.get()));
    if (auto reinterpreted_image = SkImages::RasterFromData(pixmap.info().makeColorSpace(color_space), move(pixels), pixmap.rowBytes()))
        return reinterpreted_image;
    return image->reinterpretColorSpace(move(color_space));
}

// A PQ or HLG frame holds light up to many times as bright as SDR white, which an SDR surface would clip. Such a frame
// is drawn once through a tone map into an sRGB image instead, on the GPU when there is a context for it.
static sk_sp<SkImage> tone_mapped_into_standard_dynamic_range(Media::ColorMetadata const& color_metadata, sk_sp<SkImage> image, GrDirectContext* gr_context)
{
    auto output_color_space = SkColorSpace::MakeSRGB();
    // Only the tone map sees the image with SDR white moved, so a frame that cannot be tone mapped keeps its own tag.
    auto image_to_tone_map = image;
    if (auto const* color_space = image->colorSpace()) {
        if (auto perceptual_quantizer_color_space = with_standard_dynamic_range_white_of_perceptual_quantizer(*color_space)) {
            image_to_tone_map = reinterpreted_in_color_space(image, move(perceptual_quantizer_color_space));
            // SDR masters are graded for the BT.1886 EOTF, and we show SDR video's pixels as sRGB, so encode the
            // tone-mapped light the way an SDR master would be encoded.
            output_color_space = SkColorSpace::MakeRGB(SkNamedTransferFn::kRec709, SkNamedGamut::kSRGB);
        }
    }

    // The headroom is in stops above SDR white.
    static constexpr float standard_dynamic_range_headroom = 0;
    auto tone_map = high_dynamic_range_metadata_of(color_metadata).makeToneMapColorFilter(standard_dynamic_range_headroom, image_to_tone_map->colorSpace());
    if (!tone_map)
        return image;
    auto image_info = SkImageInfo::Make(image->width(), image->height(), kBGRA_8888_SkColorType, kPremul_SkAlphaType, output_color_space);
    auto surface = gr_context ? SkSurfaces::RenderTarget(gr_context, skgpu::Budgeted::kYes, image_info) : SkSurfaces::Raster(image_info);
    if (!surface)
        return image;
    SkPaint paint;
    paint.setColorFilter(move(tone_map));
    paint.setBlendMode(SkBlendMode::kSrc);
    surface->getCanvas()->drawImage(image_to_tone_map.get(), 0, 0, SkSamplingOptions {}, &paint);
    return reinterpreted_in_color_space(surface->makeImageSnapshot(), SkColorSpace::MakeSRGB());
}

static sk_sp<SkImage> in_standard_dynamic_range(Media::VideoFrame const& frame, sk_sp<SkImage> image, GrDirectContext* gr_context)
{
    if (!image || !frame_holds_high_dynamic_range(frame))
        return image;
    return tone_mapped_into_standard_dynamic_range(frame.color_metadata(), move(image), gr_context);
}

static Gfx::ColorSpace color_space_of(Media::VideoFrame const& frame)
{
    auto color_space_result = Gfx::ColorSpace::from_cicp(frame.cicp());
    if (color_space_result.is_error())
        return {};
    return color_space_result.release_value();
}

sk_sp<SkImage> sk_image_from_video_frame(Media::VideoFrame const& frame, RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext> const& skia_backend_context)
{
    sk_sp<SkImage> image;
    auto* gr_context = skia_backend_context ? skia_backend_context->sk_context() : nullptr;
    auto surface = frame.surface();

    if (surface != nullptr && skia_backend_context)
        image = image_for_video_surface(frame, *surface, *skia_backend_context);

    auto yuv_data = image ? Optional<Gfx::YUVData> {} : frame.yuv_data();
    if (!image && !yuv_data.has_value() && surface == nullptr)
        return nullptr;

    auto color_space = color_space_of(frame);

    if (!image && gr_context && yuv_data.has_value()) {
        image = SkImages::TextureFromYUVAPixmaps(
            gr_context,
            make_yuva_pixmaps(*yuv_data),
            skgpu::Mipmapped::kNo,
            false,
            Gfx::to_skia_color_space(color_space));
    }

    if (!image) {
        // Without a GPU to sample a surface on, its pixels have to be read back into memory to be drawn.
        auto bitmap_or_error = frame.to_bitmap();
        if (bitmap_or_error.is_error()) {
            dbgln("Could not convert video frame to bitmap: {}", bitmap_or_error.release_error());
            return nullptr;
        }
        auto raster_image = Gfx::sk_image_adopting_bitmap(bitmap_or_error.release_value(), color_space);
        if (gr_context)
            image = SkImages::TextureFromImage(gr_context, raster_image.get(), skgpu::Mipmapped::kNo, skgpu::Budgeted::kYes);
        if (!image)
            image = move(raster_image);
    }

    return in_standard_dynamic_range(frame, move(image), gr_context);
}

// Draws the frame's surface on the GPU into a fresh surface and reads its pixels back from there, in sRGB.
static ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::Bitmap>> read_back_video_surface_through_gpu(Media::VideoFrame const& frame, RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext> const& skia_backend_context)
{
    auto image = sk_image_from_video_frame(frame, skia_backend_context);
    if (!image)
        return Error::from_string_literal("Could not make an image of the video frame's surface");
    auto size = frame.size().to_type<int>();
    auto surface = Gfx::PaintingSurface::create_with_size(size, Gfx::BitmapFormat::BGRA8888, Gfx::AlphaType::Premultiplied, skia_backend_context);
    auto rect = SkRect::MakeIWH(size.width(), size.height());
    surface->canvas().drawImageRect(image.get(), rect, rect, Gfx::to_skia_sampling_options(Gfx::ScalingMode::NearestNeighbor), nullptr, SkCanvas::kStrict_SrcRectConstraint);
    auto bitmap = TRY(Gfx::Bitmap::create(Gfx::BitmapFormat::BGRA8888, Gfx::AlphaType::Premultiplied, size));
    surface->read_into_bitmap(*bitmap);
    return bitmap;
}

sk_sp<SkImage> sk_image_in_memory_from_video_frame(Media::VideoFrame const& frame, RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext> const& skia_backend_context)
{
    auto bitmap_or_error = frame.to_bitmap();
    if (!bitmap_or_error.is_error())
        return in_standard_dynamic_range(frame, Gfx::sk_image_adopting_bitmap(bitmap_or_error.release_value(), color_space_of(frame)), nullptr);

    // NB: Only macOS reads a video surface on the CPU. Elsewhere the GPU reads it, into a surface of its own: a readback
    //     of the image of the video surface could be one Skia cached for an earlier frame that the surface showed.
    if (frame.surface() != nullptr && skia_backend_context) {
        bitmap_or_error = read_back_video_surface_through_gpu(frame, skia_backend_context);
        if (!bitmap_or_error.is_error())
            return Gfx::sk_image_adopting_bitmap(bitmap_or_error.release_value(), {});
    }

    dbgln("Could not convert video frame to bitmap: {}", bitmap_or_error.release_error());
    return nullptr;
}

ErrorOr<BitmapInColorSpace> bitmap_from_video_frame(Media::VideoFrame const& frame, RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext> const& skia_backend_context)
{
    if (frame.surface() != nullptr && skia_backend_context) {
        auto bitmap = TRY(read_back_video_surface_through_gpu(frame, skia_backend_context));
        // The pixels are read back in sRGB.
        return BitmapInColorSpace { move(bitmap), {} };
    }

    auto bitmap = TRY(frame.to_bitmap());
    if (!frame_holds_high_dynamic_range(frame))
        return BitmapInColorSpace { move(bitmap), color_space_of(frame) };

    auto image = tone_mapped_into_standard_dynamic_range(frame.color_metadata(), Gfx::sk_image_adopting_bitmap(bitmap, color_space_of(frame)), nullptr);
    auto tone_mapped_bitmap = TRY(Gfx::Bitmap::create(Gfx::BitmapFormat::BGRA8888, Gfx::AlphaType::Premultiplied, bitmap->size()));
    auto surface = Gfx::PaintingSurface::wrap_bitmap(*tone_mapped_bitmap);
    SkPaint paint;
    paint.setBlendMode(SkBlendMode::kSrc);
    surface->canvas().drawImage(image.get(), 0, 0, SkSamplingOptions {}, &paint);
    // The tone map leaves the pixels in sRGB.
    return BitmapInColorSpace { move(tone_mapped_bitmap), {} };
}

}

SkYUVColorSpace skia_yuv_color_space(Media::CodingIndependentCodePoints);

// Views the planes of the YUV data as Skia pixmaps. Samples deeper than 8 bits are copied and stretched to 16 bits.
SkYUVAPixmaps make_yuva_pixmaps(Gfx::YUVData const&);

// Views a decoder's surface as a GPU image, sampling its planes where they already are instead of uploading a copy.
// Returns null for a surface whose layout is not one the platform decoder produces, or on a platform that cannot
// sample its surfaces yet.
sk_sp<SkImage> sk_image_from_video_surface(Media::VideoSurface const&, Media::CodingIndependentCodePoints, Gfx::SkiaBackendContext&);

// A surface's image stays valid for every frame decoded into the surface, but the decoder hands the surface over afresh
// with each one, which Skia has to be told before it next samples the image.
void video_surface_image_will_show_new_frame(SkImage&);

// Makes an image of the frame's pixels, on the GPU when there is a backend context, and in memory otherwise.
sk_sp<SkImage> sk_image_from_video_frame(Media::VideoFrame const&, RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext> const&);

// Makes an image of the frame's pixels in memory, for a canvas that draws there. The CPU converts the frame where it can
// read it, and the GPU, when there is one, reads back a surface that only it can read.
sk_sp<SkImage> sk_image_in_memory_from_video_frame(Media::VideoFrame const&, RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext> const&);

struct BitmapInColorSpace {
    NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::Bitmap const> bitmap;
    Gfx::ColorSpace color_space;
};

// Reads the frame's pixels into memory. A surface is drawn on the GPU and read back from there, since only the GPU
// can read some surfaces.
ErrorOr<BitmapInColorSpace> bitmap_from_video_frame(Media::VideoFrame const&, RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext> const&);

#include <Compositor/SkiaBackendContext.h>

#include <core/SkImage.h>
#include <core/SkYUVAInfo.h>
#include <gpu/ganesh/GrBackendSurface.h>
#include <gpu/ganesh/GrDirectContext.h>
#include <gpu/ganesh/GrYUVABackendTextures.h>
#include <gpu/ganesh/SkImageGanesh.h>

#include <gpu/ganesh/mtl/GrMtlTypes.h>

namespace Compositor {

sk_sp<SkImage> sk_image_from_video_surface(Media::VideoSurface const& surface, Media::CodingIndependentCodePoints cicp, Gfx::SkiaBackendContext& skia_backend_context)
{
    auto* gr_context = skia_backend_context.sk_context();
    if (!gr_context)
        return nullptr;

    auto const& io_surface = surface.io_surface();

    auto format = Gfx::biplanar_pixel_format(io_surface.pixel_format());
    if (!format.has_value() || io_surface.plane_count() != 2)
        return nullptr;

    // Samples deeper than 8 bits sit in the high bits of each 16-bit component, so they read as full range unexpanded.
    Array plane_formats { Gfx::MetalTextureFormat::R8, Gfx::MetalTextureFormat::RG8 };
    if (format->bit_depth > 8)
        plane_formats = { Gfx::MetalTextureFormat::R16, Gfx::MetalTextureFormat::RG16 };

    auto subsampling = SkYUVAInfo::Subsampling::k420;
    if (format->subsampling == Media::Subsampling::yuv444())
        subsampling = SkYUVAInfo::Subsampling::k444;
    else if (format->subsampling == Media::Subsampling::yuv422())
        subsampling = SkYUVAInfo::Subsampling::k422;
    else if (format->subsampling != Media::Subsampling::yuv420())
        return nullptr;
    if (cicp.matrix_coefficients() == Media::MatrixCoefficients::Identity && subsampling != SkYUVAInfo::Subsampling::k444)
        return nullptr;

    GrBackendTexture plane_textures[SkYUVAInfo::kMaxPlanes];
    for (size_t plane = 0; plane < plane_formats.size(); plane++) {
        auto metal_texture = skia_backend_context.metal_context().create_texture_from_iosurface(io_surface, plane_formats[plane], plane);
        if (!metal_texture)
            return nullptr;

        // The backend texture retains the Metal texture, so it outlives this handle to it.
        GrMtlTextureInfo texture_info;
        texture_info.fTexture = sk_ret_cfp(metal_texture->texture());
        plane_textures[plane] = GrBackendTextures::MakeMtl(
            static_cast<int>(metal_texture->width()), static_cast<int>(metal_texture->height()),
            skgpu::Mipmapped::kNo, texture_info);
    }

    SkYUVAInfo yuva_info {
        SkISize::Make(static_cast<int>(io_surface.plane_width(0)), static_cast<int>(io_surface.plane_height(0))),
        SkYUVAInfo::PlaneConfig::kY_UV,
        subsampling,
        skia_yuv_color_space(cicp),
    };

    auto color_space = Gfx::ColorSpace {};
    if (auto color_space_result = Gfx::ColorSpace::from_cicp(cicp); !color_space_result.is_error())
        color_space = color_space_result.release_value();

    GrYUVABackendTextures yuva_textures { yuva_info, plane_textures, kTopLeft_GrSurfaceOrigin };
    return SkImages::TextureFromYUVATextures(gr_context, yuva_textures, Gfx::to_skia_color_space(color_space));
}

}

#include <Compositor/SkiaBackendContext.h>
#include <Compositor/SkiaUtils.h>

#include <LibGfx/ImportedYCbCrVulkanImage.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/VideoSurface.h>

#include <core/SkColorSpace.h>
#include <core/SkImage.h>
#include <gpu/MutableTextureState.h>
#include <gpu/ganesh/GrBackendSurface.h>
#include <gpu/ganesh/GrDirectContext.h>
#include <gpu/ganesh/SkImageGanesh.h>
#include <gpu/ganesh/vk/GrVkBackendSurface.h>
#include <gpu/ganesh/vk/GrVkTypes.h>
#include <gpu/vk/VulkanMutableTextureState.h>

namespace Compositor {

// The decoder hands each frame over in the general layout, released to whichever device takes the image next.
static constexpr VkImageLayout HANDED_OVER_LAYOUT = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL;
static constexpr u32 HANDED_OVER_QUEUE_FAMILY = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_EXTERNAL;

static VkSamplerYcbcrModelConversion ycbcr_model_for(Media::CodingIndependentCodePoints cicp)
{
    switch (cicp.matrix_coefficients()) {
    case Media::MatrixCoefficients::BT470BG:
    case Media::MatrixCoefficients::BT601:
        return VK_SAMPLER_YCBCR_MODEL_CONVERSION_YCBCR_601;
    case Media::MatrixCoefficients::BT2020NonConstantLuminance:
    case Media::MatrixCoefficients::BT2020ConstantLuminance:
        return VK_SAMPLER_YCBCR_MODEL_CONVERSION_YCBCR_2020;
    case Media::MatrixCoefficients::Identity:
        return VK_SAMPLER_YCBCR_MODEL_CONVERSION_RGB_IDENTITY;
    default:
        return VK_SAMPLER_YCBCR_MODEL_CONVERSION_YCBCR_709;
    }
}

// 4:2:0 video sites its chroma level with the first luma sample of each pair and between the two rows, where the
// format can sample it there.
static VkChromaLocation chroma_location(VkFormatFeatureFlags format_features, bool cosited)
{
    if (cosited && (format_features & VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_COSITED_CHROMA_SAMPLES_BIT) != 0)
        return VK_CHROMA_LOCATION_COSITED_EVEN;
    if ((format_features & VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_MIDPOINT_CHROMA_SAMPLES_BIT) != 0)
        return VK_CHROMA_LOCATION_MIDPOINT;
    return VK_CHROMA_LOCATION_COSITED_EVEN;
}

sk_sp<SkImage> sk_image_from_video_surface(Media::VideoSurface const& surface, Media::CodingIndependentCodePoints cicp, Gfx::SkiaBackendContext& skia_backend_context)
{
    auto* gr_context = skia_backend_context.sk_context();
    if (!gr_context)
        return nullptr;
    auto const& vulkan_context = skia_backend_context.vulkan_context();
    if (!vulkan_context.can_sample_through_ycbcr_conversion)
        return nullptr;

    auto imported_or_error = Gfx::ImportedYCbCrVulkanImage::import_dma_buf(vulkan_context, surface.dma_buf());
    if (imported_or_error.is_error()) {
        dbgln("Could not import a video surface: {}", imported_or_error.error());
        return nullptr;
    }
    auto imported = imported_or_error.release_value();

    auto format_features = imported->format_features();
    auto chroma_filter = VK_FILTER_NEAREST;
    if ((format_features & VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_SAMPLED_IMAGE_YCBCR_CONVERSION_LINEAR_FILTER_BIT) != 0)
        chroma_filter = VK_FILTER_LINEAR;
    auto range = VK_SAMPLER_YCBCR_RANGE_ITU_NARROW;
    if (cicp.video_full_range_flag() == Media::VideoFullRangeFlag::Full)
        range = VK_SAMPLER_YCBCR_RANGE_ITU_FULL;
    skgpu::VulkanYcbcrConversionInfo ycbcr_info {
        imported->format(),
        ycbcr_model_for(cicp),
        range,
        chroma_location(format_features, true),
        chroma_location(format_features, false),
        chroma_filter,
        VK_FALSE,
        {},
        format_features,
    };

    // The image is only borrowed, so its memory is named for Skia's bookkeeping and never freed by it.
    auto const& memory = imported->memories().first();
    GrVkImageInfo image_info;
    image_info.fImage = imported->image();
    image_info.fAlloc.fMemory = memory.memory;
    image_info.fAlloc.fSize = memory.size;
    image_info.fImageTiling = VK_IMAGE_TILING_DRM_FORMAT_MODIFIER_EXT;
    image_info.fImageLayout = HANDED_OVER_LAYOUT;
    image_info.fFormat = imported->format();
    image_info.fImageUsageFlags = Gfx::ImportedYCbCrVulkanImage::USAGE;
    image_info.fLevelCount = 1;
    image_info.fCurrentQueueFamily = HANDED_OVER_QUEUE_FAMILY;
    image_info.fYcbcrConversionInfo = ycbcr_info;

    auto color_space = Gfx::ColorSpace {};
    if (auto color_space_result = Gfx::ColorSpace::from_cicp(cicp); !color_space_result.is_error())
        color_space = color_space_result.release_value();

    auto size = surface.dma_buf().size;
    auto backend_texture = GrBackendTextures::MakeVk(size.width(), size.height(), image_info);
    auto release_image = [](void* context) { delete static_cast<Gfx::ImportedYCbCrVulkanImage*>(context); };
    // Skia only wraps each YCbCr format as the color type with the same sample depth.
    auto color_type = kRGB_888x_SkColorType;
    if (imported->format() == VK_FORMAT_G10X6_B10X6R10X6_2PLANE_420_UNORM_3PACK16)
        color_type = kRGBA_1010102_SkColorType;
    return SkImages::BorrowTextureFrom(gr_context, backend_texture, kTopLeft_GrSurfaceOrigin, color_type, kOpaque_SkAlphaType, Gfx::to_skia_color_space(color_space), release_image, imported.leak_ptr());
}

void video_surface_image_will_show_new_frame(SkImage& image)
{
    GrBackendTexture backend_texture;
    if (!SkImages::GetBackendTextureFromImage(&image, &backend_texture, false))
        return;
    backend_texture.setMutableState(skgpu::MutableTextureStates::MakeVulkan(HANDED_OVER_LAYOUT, HANDED_OVER_QUEUE_FAMILY));
}

}

#include <AK/Assertions.h>
#include <AK/Math.h>
#include <AK/Platform.h>
#include <Compositor/VSyncScheduler.h>
#include <LibCore/Timer.h>

#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
#    include <AK/Atomic.h>
#    include <AK/AtomicRefCounted.h>
#    include <AK/NonnullRefPtr.h>
#    include <AK/RefPtr.h>
#    include <CoreGraphics/CoreGraphics.h>
#    include <CoreVideo/CoreVideo.h>
#    include <LibCore/EventLoop.h>
#endif

namespace Compositor {

class TimerVSyncScheduler final : public VSyncScheduler {
public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    explicit TimerVSyncScheduler(Function<void(MonotonicTime)>&& tick_callback)
        : m_tick_callback(move(tick_callback))
        , m_timer(Core::Timer::create_single_shot(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(0), [this] {
            fire();
        }))
    {
    }

    virtual ~TimerVSyncScheduler() override
    {
        m_timer->on_timeout = {};
        m_timer->stop();
    }

    virtual void schedule(double refresh_rate) override
    {
        VERIFY(refresh_rate == refresh_rate);
        VERIFY(refresh_rate > 0);
        VERIFY(refresh_rate < AK::Infinity<double>);

        auto refresh_rate_changed = m_refresh_rate != refresh_rate;
        m_refresh_rate = refresh_rate;
        auto now = MonotonicTime::now();
        if (!m_next_tick_time.has_value() || refresh_rate_changed)
            m_next_tick_time = now + frame_interval();
        else
            advance_next_tick_time_past(now);

        if (m_timer->is_active() && !refresh_rate_changed)
            return;

        arm_timer(now);
    }

    virtual Optional<MonotonicTime> most_recent_tick_time(MonotonicTime now, double refresh_rate) override
    {
        if (!m_next_tick_time.has_value() || m_refresh_rate != refresh_rate)
            return {};

        advance_next_tick_time_past(now);
        return *m_next_tick_time - frame_interval();
    }

private:
    void fire()
    {
        auto now = MonotonicTime::now();
        advance_next_tick_time_past(now);
        auto frame_time = *m_next_tick_time - frame_interval();
        m_tick_callback(frame_time);
    }

    AK::Duration frame_interval() const
    {
        return AK::Duration::from_nanoseconds(static_cast<i64>((1'000'000'000.0 / m_refresh_rate) + 0.5));
    }

    void advance_next_tick_time_past(MonotonicTime now)
    {
        VERIFY(m_next_tick_time.has_value());
        if (*m_next_tick_time > now)
            return;

        auto interval = frame_interval();
        auto intervals_to_advance = (now - *m_next_tick_time).to_nanoseconds() / interval.to_nanoseconds() + 1;
        *m_next_tick_time += AK::Duration::from_nanoseconds(intervals_to_advance * interval.to_nanoseconds());
    }

    void arm_timer(MonotonicTime now)
    {
        VERIFY(m_next_tick_time.has_value());
        advance_next_tick_time_past(now);
        VERIFY(*m_next_tick_time > now);

        // NB: The timer is armed against a fixed display grid. Advancing by whole intervals keeps request and update
        //     latency from shifting later ticks.
        m_timer->restart(*m_next_tick_time - now);
    }

    Function<void(MonotonicTime)> m_tick_callback;
    double m_refresh_rate { 60.0 };
    RefPtr<Core::Timer> m_timer;
    Optional<MonotonicTime> m_next_tick_time;
};

#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)

static constexpr int display_link_idle_stop_delay_ms = 250;

static CVReturn display_link_callback(CVDisplayLinkRef, CVTimeStamp const*, CVTimeStamp const*, CVOptionFlags, CVOptionFlags*, void* context);

class DisplayLinkState final : public AtomicRefCounted<DisplayLinkState> {
public:
    static RefPtr<DisplayLinkState> create(u64 display_id, Core::EventLoop& event_loop, Function<void(MonotonicTime)>&& tick_callback)
    {
        CVDisplayLinkRef display_link = nullptr;

#    pragma clang diagnostic push
#    pragma clang diagnostic ignored "-Wdeprecated-declarations"
        auto result = CVDisplayLinkCreateWithCGDisplay(static_cast<CGDirectDisplayID>(display_id), &display_link);
#    pragma clang diagnostic pop

        if (result != kCVReturnSuccess || !display_link)
            return nullptr;

        auto state = adopt_ref(*new DisplayLinkState(event_loop, display_link));

#    pragma clang diagnostic push
#    pragma clang diagnostic ignored "-Wdeprecated-declarations"
        result = CVDisplayLinkSetOutputCallback(display_link, display_link_callback, state.ptr());
#    pragma clang diagnostic pop

        if (result != kCVReturnSuccess)
            return nullptr;

        state->tick_callback = move(tick_callback);
        return state;
    }

    ~DisplayLinkState()
    {
        stop_display_link();
    }

    bool request_tick();
    void stop_display_link();
    void schedule_display_link_stop_if_idle();
    void stop_display_link_if_idle();
    bool consume_tick_request();
    bool is_valid() const;
    bool is_running() const;

    Core::EventLoop& event_loop;
    Function<void(MonotonicTime)> tick_callback;
    Atomic<bool> invalidated { false };
    Atomic<bool> tick_requested { false };
    Atomic<i64> most_recent_tick_time_nanoseconds { 0 };
    CVDisplayLinkRef display_link { nullptr };
    NonnullRefPtr<Core::Timer> idle_stop_timer;

private:
    DisplayLinkState(Core::EventLoop& event_loop, CVDisplayLinkRef display_link)
        : event_loop(event_loop)
        , display_link(display_link)
        , idle_stop_timer(Core::Timer::create_single_shot(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(display_link_idle_stop_delay_ms), [this] {
            stop_display_link_if_idle();
        }))
    {
    }
};

bool DisplayLinkState::request_tick()
{
    if (invalidated.load() || !display_link)
        return false;

    tick_requested.store(true);
    idle_stop_timer->stop();

#    pragma clang diagnostic push
#    pragma clang diagnostic ignored "-Wdeprecated-declarations"
    auto is_running = CVDisplayLinkIsRunning(display_link);
#    pragma clang diagnostic pop

    if (is_running)
        return true;

#    pragma clang diagnostic push
#    pragma clang diagnostic ignored "-Wdeprecated-declarations"
    auto result = CVDisplayLinkStart(display_link);
#    pragma clang diagnostic pop

    if (result == kCVReturnSuccess || result == kCVReturnDisplayLinkAlreadyRunning)
        return true;

    tick_requested.store(false);
    return false;
}

void DisplayLinkState::stop_display_link()
{
    invalidated.store(true);
    tick_requested.store(false);
    idle_stop_timer->on_timeout = {};
    idle_stop_timer->stop();

    if (!display_link)
        return;

#    pragma clang diagnostic push
#    pragma clang diagnostic ignored "-Wdeprecated-declarations"
    CVDisplayLinkStop(display_link);
#    pragma clang diagnostic pop
    CVDisplayLinkRelease(display_link);
    display_link = nullptr;
}

void DisplayLinkState::schedule_display_link_stop_if_idle()
{
    if (invalidated.load() || tick_requested.load() || !display_link)
        return;

    idle_stop_timer->restart(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(display_link_idle_stop_delay_ms));
}

void DisplayLinkState::stop_display_link_if_idle()
{
    if (invalidated.load() || tick_requested.load() || !display_link)
        return;

#    pragma clang diagnostic push
#    pragma clang diagnostic ignored "-Wdeprecated-declarations"
    CVDisplayLinkStop(display_link);
#    pragma clang diagnostic pop
}

bool DisplayLinkState::consume_tick_request()
{
    if (invalidated.load())
        return false;

    if (!tick_requested.exchange(false))
        return false;

    return true;
}

bool DisplayLinkState::is_valid() const
{
    return !invalidated.load();
}

bool DisplayLinkState::is_running() const
{
    if (invalidated.load() || !display_link)
        return false;

#    pragma clang diagnostic push
#    pragma clang diagnostic ignored "-Wdeprecated-declarations"
    auto running = CVDisplayLinkIsRunning(display_link);
#    pragma clang diagnostic pop
    return running;
}

class CVDisplayLinkVSyncScheduler final : public VSyncScheduler {
public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    static OwnPtr<CVDisplayLinkVSyncScheduler> try_create(u64 display_id, Function<void(MonotonicTime)>&& tick_callback)
    {
        auto state = DisplayLinkState::create(display_id, Core::EventLoop::current(), move(tick_callback));
        if (!state)
            return nullptr;
        return adopt_own(*new CVDisplayLinkVSyncScheduler(state.release_nonnull()));
    }

    explicit CVDisplayLinkVSyncScheduler(NonnullRefPtr<DisplayLinkState> state)
        : m_state(move(state))
    {
    }

    virtual ~CVDisplayLinkVSyncScheduler() override
    {
        m_state->stop_display_link();
    }

    virtual void schedule(double) override
    {
        m_state->request_tick();
    }

    virtual Optional<MonotonicTime> most_recent_tick_time(MonotonicTime now, double refresh_rate) override
    {
        if (!m_state->is_running())
            return {};

        auto tick_time_nanoseconds = m_state->most_recent_tick_time_nanoseconds.load();
        if (tick_time_nanoseconds == 0 || tick_time_nanoseconds > now.nanoseconds())
            return {};

        auto age_nanoseconds = now.nanoseconds() - tick_time_nanoseconds;
        auto frame_interval_nanoseconds = static_cast<i64>((1'000'000'000.0 / refresh_rate) + 0.5);
        if (age_nanoseconds >= frame_interval_nanoseconds)
            return {};
        return now - AK::Duration::from_nanoseconds(age_nanoseconds);
    }

private:
    NonnullRefPtr<DisplayLinkState> m_state;
};

static CVReturn display_link_callback(CVDisplayLinkRef, CVTimeStamp const*, CVTimeStamp const*, CVOptionFlags, CVOptionFlags*, void* context)
{
    auto state = NonnullRefPtr { *static_cast<DisplayLinkState*>(context) };
    auto frame_time = MonotonicTime::now();
    state->most_recent_tick_time_nanoseconds.store(frame_time.nanoseconds());
    if (!state->consume_tick_request())
        return kCVReturnSuccess;

    // NB: Sample the shared monotonic clock on the display-link thread so deferred delivery does not shift the
    //     frame timestamp to the Compositor event-loop wakeup time.
    state->event_loop.deferred_invoke([state = move(state), frame_time] {
        if (!state->is_valid())
            return;
        state->tick_callback(frame_time);
        state->schedule_display_link_stop_if_idle();
    });
    return kCVReturnSuccess;
}

OwnPtr<VSyncScheduler> create_vsync_scheduler(Optional<u64> display_id, Function<void(MonotonicTime)>&& tick_callback)
{
    if (display_id.has_value()) {
        if (auto scheduler = CVDisplayLinkVSyncScheduler::try_create(*display_id, move(tick_callback)); scheduler)
            return scheduler;
    }

    return make<TimerVSyncScheduler>(move(tick_callback));
}

#else

OwnPtr<VSyncScheduler> create_vsync_scheduler(Optional<u64>, Function<void(MonotonicTime)>&& tick_callback)
{
    return make<TimerVSyncScheduler>(move(tick_callback));
}

#endif

}

#elif defined(AK_OS_WINDOWS) && defined(USE_DIRECTX)
    return DirectCompositionWindowServer::try_create();

ErrorOr<RefPtr<PresentableSurface>> WindowServer::try_create_presentable_surface_for_sublayers(Gfx::IntSize size, Gfx::SkiaBackendContext& skia_backend_context)
{
    // NB: A surface larger than the GPU's largest texture can't be a sublayer of its own, so it's drawn into the frame
    //     from memory instead.
    if (!skia_backend_context.can_hold_texture_of_size(size))
        return nullptr;
#ifdef AK_OS_MACOS
    return RefPtr<PresentableSurface> { TRY(CoreAnimationWindowServer::try_create_presentable_surface_over_new_iosurface(size, skia_backend_context)) };
#elif defined(AK_OS_WINDOWS) && defined(USE_DIRECTX)
    return RefPtr<PresentableSurface> { TRY(DirectCompositionWindowServer::try_create_presentable_surface_on_gpu(size, skia_backend_context)) };
#else
    return nullptr;
#endif
}

bool WindowServer::showing_tiles_of_painted_layers_is_switched_off()
{
    static bool is_switched_off = getenv("LADYBIRD_WINDOW_SERVER_SHOWS_NO_TILES") != nullptr;
    return is_switched_off;
}

WindowServer::FrameHandOff WindowServer::frame_hand_off_through_presentation()
{
#ifdef AK_OS_MACOS
    return FrameHandOff::OnceGpuWorkIsScheduled;
#else
    return FrameHandOff::OnceGpuWorkIsFinished;
#endif
}

/*

#pragma once

#include <AK/Error.h>
#include <AK/Noncopyable.h>
#include <AK/NonnullRefPtr.h>
#include <AK/OwnPtr.h>
#include <AK/RefCounted.h>
#include <AK/RefPtr.h>
#include <AK/Types.h>
#include <AK/Weakable.h>
#include <AK/kmalloc.h>
#include <Compositor/PresentableSurface.h>
#include <Compositor/RemoteLayer.h>
#include <LibGfx/Size.h>

namespace Compositor {

// The window server, as this process reaches it for the views of one presentation.
class WindowServer
    : public RefCounted<WindowServer>
    , public Weakable<WindowServer> {
    AK_MAKE_NONCOPYABLE(WindowServer);
    AK_MAKE_NONMOVABLE(WindowServer);

public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    // None where frames reach the screen only through the presentation.
    static RefPtr<WindowServer> try_create_for_presentation();
    virtual ~WindowServer() = default;

    virtual OwnPtr<RemoteLayer> try_create_remote_layer(u64 remote_layer_id) = 0;
    virtual ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<PresentableSurface>> try_create_presentable_surface(Gfx::IntSize, RefPtr<Gfx::SkiaBackendContext> const&) = 0;
    // None where no window server shows surfaces above the frames.
    static ErrorOr<RefPtr<PresentableSurface>> try_create_presentable_surface_for_sublayers(Gfx::IntSize, Gfx::SkiaBackendContext&);

    // Whether a remote layer of this window server shows each tile of a painted layer as a sublayer of its own, in a
    // group that places and clips the tiles of the layer, so that it can show every layer of a frame by itself.
    virtual bool shows_tiles_of_painted_layers() const { return false; }
    // Whether no window server shows tiles, as asked by the environment, which lets a frame composited by the window
    // server be told apart from one composited into a store.
    static bool showing_tiles_of_painted_layers_is_switched_off();
    // Whether a remote layer of this window server runs what it shows below a sublayer through a blur and color
    // matrices, as a backdrop filter does.
    virtual bool filters_what_is_below_layers() const { return false; }

    enum class FrameHandOff : u8 {
        OnceGpuWorkIsScheduled,
        OnceGpuWorkIsFinished,
    };
    virtual FrameHandOff frame_hand_off() const = 0;
    static FrameHandOff frame_hand_off_through_presentation();

    // While held, what every remote layer of this window server shows changes nowhere on screen, and changes all at once
    // when released.
    virtual void hold_changes_on_screen() = 0;
    virtual void release_changes_held_off_screen() = 0;

protected:
    WindowServer() = default;
};

}

#include <AK/Hex.h>

#include <AK/Queue.h>
#include <Hub/Application.h>

#include <Hub/Proxies.h>

#include <LibWebView/UpdateCheck.h>

namespace Hub {

Application::Application(ApplicationHost* host)
    : m_host(host)
{
}

void Application::create_platform_arguments(Core::ArgsParser& args_parser)
{
    args_parser.add_option(m_encoded_ui_info, "What the UI tells the Hub to start with", "ui-info", 0, "hex");
    args_parser.add_option(m_ui_mach_server_name, "Mach server to get the connection to the UI from", "ui-mach-server", 0, "name");
    // NB: main() reads this itself, before the arguments are parsed.
    args_parser.add_option(m_ui_pid, "Process of the UI, which the Hub ends with", "ui-pid", 0, "pid");
}

Optional<pid_t> Application::ui_process_id() const
{
    auto pid = m_ui_pid.to_number<pid_t>();
    if (!pid.has_value() || *pid <= 0)
        return {};
    return pid;
}

Hub::UIInfo const* Application::ui_info() const
{
    if (!m_ui_info.has_value() && !m_encoded_ui_info.is_empty()) {
        auto bytes = decode_hex(m_encoded_ui_info);
        if (bytes.is_error())
            return nullptr;
        FixedMemoryStream stream { bytes.value().bytes() };
        Queue<IPC::Attachment> attachments;
        IPC::Decoder decoder { stream, attachments };
        auto info = decoder.decode<Hub::UIInfo>();
        if (info.is_error())
            return nullptr;
        m_ui_info = info.release_value();
    }
    return m_ui_info.has_value() ? &*m_ui_info : nullptr;
}

bool Application::ui_has_location_source() const
{
    auto const* info = ui_info();
    return info && info->has_location_source;
}

bool Application::ui_has_translator() const
{
    auto const* info = ui_info();
    return info && info->has_translator;
}

void Application::set_ui_info(Hub::UIInfo info)
{
    auto scrollbar_track_press_jumps_changed = !m_ui_info.has_value() || m_ui_info->scrollbar_track_press_jumps != info.scrollbar_track_press_jumps;
    auto prefers_reduced_motion_changed = !m_ui_info.has_value() || m_ui_info->prefers_reduced_motion != info.prefers_reduced_motion;
    auto prefers_more_contrast_changed = !m_ui_info.has_value() || m_ui_info->prefers_more_contrast != info.prefers_more_contrast;
    m_ui_info = move(info);
    if (scrollbar_track_press_jumps_changed)
        platform_scrollbar_track_press_behavior_changed();
    if (prefers_reduced_motion_changed)
        platform_motion_preference_changed();
    if (prefers_more_contrast_changed)
        platform_contrast_preference_changed();
}

View& Application::create_view(View::InitialState initial_state, Optional<WebView::CanonicalTraversable&> traversable)
{
    auto view = make<View>(move(initial_state));
    auto& view_reference = *view;
    m_views.set(view->view_id(), move(view));
    view_reference.initialize(traversable);
    return view_reference;
}

void Application::notify_webdriver_window_created(String const& handle)
{
    // NB: WebDriver drives a window from the moment it hears of it. So, it must not hear of one before the UI has asked for
    //     what its windows start out showing, or that would replace the page WebDriver went to.
    if (ConnectionFromUI::the() && !m_ui_did_start) {
        m_webdriver_windows_awaiting_ui.append(handle);
        return;
    }
    WebView::Application::notify_webdriver_window_created(handle);
}

void Application::ui_did_start()
{
    m_ui_did_start = true;
    for (auto const& handle : m_webdriver_windows_awaiting_ui)
        WebView::Application::notify_webdriver_window_created(handle);
    m_webdriver_windows_awaiting_ui.clear();
    if (m_openssl_mismatch_awaiting_ui.has_value())
        display_openssl_mismatch(m_openssl_mismatch_awaiting_ui.release_value());
}

void Application::set_active_view(Optional<u64> view_id)
{
    m_active_view_id = view_id;
}

Optional<WebView::ViewImplementation&> Application::active_web_view() const
{
    if (!m_active_view_id.has_value())
        return {};
    return WebView::ViewImplementation::find_view_by_id(*m_active_view_id);
}

Optional<WebView::ViewImplementation&> Application::open_blank_new_tab(Web::HTML::ActivateTab activate_tab, WebView::ViewImplementation const* related_view) const
{
    auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the();
    if (!ui)
        return WebView::Application::open_blank_new_tab(activate_tab, related_view);

    // NB: A tab opened for a page starts out like that page's view, with its privacy, whichever view is active by now.
    View::InitialState initial_state;
    if (related_view)
        initial_state = static_cast<View const&>(*related_view).initial_state_for_related_view();
    else if (auto active_view = active_web_view(); active_view.has_value())
        initial_state = static_cast<View&>(*active_view).initial_state_for_related_view();
    auto& view = const_cast<Application&>(*this).create_view(move(initial_state));
    Optional<u64> source_view_id;
    if (related_view)
        source_view_id = related_view->view_id();
    ui->async_app_open_view_in_new_tab(view.view_id(), source_view_id, view.is_private(), activate_tab);
    return view;
}

// NB: Which window a tab goes to must not depend on what is active once the UI reads the message. A tab must stay in
//     the browsing session of the page that opened it. With no such page, the active view here is the one that was
//     active when the UI sent what led to this, since the UI's messages arrive in order.
Application::NewTabSource Application::new_tab_source(WebView::ViewImplementation const* source_view) const
{
    auto active_view = active_web_view();
    if (!source_view && active_view.has_value())
        source_view = &*active_view;
    if (!source_view)
        return {};
    return { source_view->view_id(), source_view->is_private() };
}

void Application::open_url_in_new_tab(URL::URL const& url, Web::HTML::ActivateTab activate_tab, WebView::ViewImplementation const* source_view) const
{
    if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the()) {
        auto source = new_tab_source(source_view);
        ui->async_app_open_url_in_new_tab(url, activate_tab, source.view_id, source.is_private);
    } else {
        WebView::Application::open_url_in_new_tab(url, activate_tab, source_view);
    }
}

void Application::activate_or_open_tab_with_url(URL::URL const& url) const
{
    if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the())
        ui->async_app_activate_or_open_tab_with_url(url);
    else
        WebView::Application::activate_or_open_tab_with_url(url);
}

void Application::open_urls_in_new_tabs(ReadonlySpan<URL::URL> urls) const
{
    auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the();
    if (!ui) {
        WebView::Application::open_urls_in_new_tabs(urls);
        return;
    }
    Vector<URL::URL> urls_to_open;
    urls_to_open.append(urls.data(), urls.size());
    ui->async_app_open_urls_in_new_tabs(move(urls_to_open));
}

void Application::open_url_in_new_window(URL::URL const& url, WebView::IsPrivate is_private)
{
    if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the())
        ui->async_app_open_url_in_new_window(url, is_private);
}

void Application::open_navigation_in_new_tab(Web::HTML::PreparedNavigationDescriptor navigation, Web::HTML::ActivateTab activate_tab, WebView::ViewImplementation const* source_view) const
{
    if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the()) {
        auto source = new_tab_source(source_view);
        ui->async_app_open_navigation_in_new_tab(move(navigation), activate_tab, source.view_id, source.is_private);
    } else {
        WebView::Application::open_navigation_in_new_tab(move(navigation), activate_tab, source_view);
    }
}

void Application::open_navigation_in_new_window(Web::HTML::PreparedNavigationDescriptor navigation, WebView::IsPrivate is_private)
{
    if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the())
        ui->async_app_open_navigation_in_new_window(move(navigation), is_private);
}

NonnullRefPtr<Core::Promise<ByteString>> Application::ask_user_for_download_path(ByteString const& file) const
{
    auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the();
    if (!ui)
        return WebView::Application::ask_user_for_download_path(file);

    auto promise = Core::Promise<ByteString>::construct();
    auto request_id = m_next_ui_request_id++;
    m_pending_download_paths.set(request_id, promise);
    ui->async_app_ask_user_for_download_path(request_id, file);
    return promise;
}

void Application::did_get_download_path(u64 request_id, Optional<ByteString> path)
{
    auto promise = m_pending_download_paths.take(request_id);
    if (!promise.has_value())
        return;
    if (path.has_value())
        (*promise)->resolve(path.release_value());
    else
        (*promise)->reject(Error::from_errno(ECANCELED));
}

void Application::display_download_confirmation_dialog(StringView download_name, LexicalPath const& path) const
{
    if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the())
        ui->async_app_display_download_confirmation_dialog(MUST(String::from_utf8(download_name)), path.string());
    else
        WebView::Application::display_download_confirmation_dialog(download_name, path);
}

void Application::display_error_dialog(StringView error_message) const
{
    if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the())
        ui->async_app_display_error_dialog(MUST(String::from_utf8(error_message)));
    else
        WebView::Application::display_error_dialog(error_message);
}

void Application::display_openssl_mismatch(PlatformFeatures::OpenSSLFacts const& facts)
{
    auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the();
    if (!ui)
        return;
    if (!m_ui_did_start) {
        m_openssl_mismatch_awaiting_ui = facts;
        return;
    }
    ui->async_app_display_openssl_mismatch(facts.curl_version.value_or({}), facts.linked_version);
}

#if defined(LADYBIRD_HAS_UPDATE_CHECK)
void Application::display_update_check_result(WebView::UpdateCheckResult const& result, WebView::UpdateCheckTrigger trigger)
{
    auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the();
    if (!ui)
        return;

    Optional<String> version;
    auto install_method = WebView::InstallMethod::Source;
    if (result.update.has_value()) {
        version = result.update->version;
        install_method = result.update->install_method;
    }
    ui->async_app_display_update_check_result(result.kind, move(version), install_method, trigger);
}
#endif

void Application::set_clipboard_text(String text, ClipboardType type)
{
    if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the())
        ui->async_app_set_clipboard_text(move(text), type);
    else
        WebView::Application::set_clipboard_text(move(text), type);
}

void Application::insert_clipboard_item(Web::Clipboard::SystemClipboardItem item)
{
    if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the())
        ui->async_app_insert_clipboard_item(move(item));
    else
        WebView::Application::insert_clipboard_item(move(item));
}

void Application::read_clipboard_text(ClipboardType type, Function<void(Utf16String)> on_read) const
{
    auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the();
    if (!ui) {
        WebView::Application::read_clipboard_text(type, move(on_read));
        return;
    }
    auto request_id = m_next_ui_request_id++;
    m_pending_clipboard_text_reads.set(request_id, move(on_read));
    ui->async_app_read_clipboard_text(request_id, type);
}

void Application::did_read_clipboard_text(u64 request_id, Utf16String text)
{
    if (auto on_read = m_pending_clipboard_text_reads.take(request_id); on_read.has_value())
        (*on_read)(move(text));
}

void Application::read_clipboard_item(Function<void(Web::Clipboard::SystemClipboardItem)> on_read) const
{
    auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the();
    if (!ui) {
        WebView::Application::read_clipboard_item(move(on_read));
        return;
    }
    auto request_id = m_next_ui_request_id++;
    m_pending_clipboard_item_reads.set(request_id, move(on_read));
    ui->async_app_read_clipboard_item(request_id);
}

void Application::did_read_clipboard_item(u64 request_id, Web::Clipboard::SystemClipboardItem item)
{
    if (auto on_read = m_pending_clipboard_item_reads.take(request_id); on_read.has_value())
        (*on_read)(move(item));
}

void Application::update_tabs_display() const
{
    if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the())
        ui->async_app_update_tabs_display();
}

void Application::did_clear_history_since(UnixDateTime since) const
{
    if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the())
        ui->async_app_did_clear_history_since(since);
}

void Application::quit_for_signal()
{
    // NB: The UI keeps the session, so it is the UI that quits. We end along with it.
    if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the()) {
        ui->async_app_quit_for_signal();
        return;
    }
    WebView::Application::quit_for_signal();
}

void Application::destroy_view(u64 view_id)
{
    m_views.remove(view_id);
}

Core::EventLoop& Application::create_platform_event_loop()
{
    // Headless mode has no UI to show anything in.
    if (browser_options().headless_mode.has_value())
        detach_from_host();

    if (m_host)
        m_host->will_create_event_loop(arguments());
    auto& event_loop = WebView::Application::create_platform_event_loop();
    if (m_host)
        m_host->did_create_event_loop(event_loop);
    return event_loop;
}

NonnullOwnPtr<WebView::DefaultBrowser> Application::create_default_browser()
{
    if (ui_info())
        return make<DefaultBrowserInUI>();
    return WebView::Application::create_default_browser();
}

NonnullOwnPtr<WebView::MicrophoneAuthorizer> Application::create_microphone_authorizer()
{
    // NB: The UI tells of no authorization where the system has no say over the microphone.
    if (auto const* info = ui_info(); info && info->microphone_authorization.has_value())
        return make<MicrophoneAuthorizerInUI>(*info->microphone_authorization);
    return WebView::Application::create_microphone_authorizer();
}

NonnullOwnPtr<WebView::NotificationBackend> Application::create_notification_backend()
{
    if (ConnectionFromUI::the())
        return make<NotificationBackendInUI>();
    return WebView::Application::create_notification_backend();
}

OwnPtr<WebView::MediaSessionPlatformBackend> Application::create_media_session_platform_backend()
{
    if (ConnectionFromUI::the())
        return make<MediaSessionPlatformBackendInUI>();
    return {};
}

}

OwnPtr<WebView::PictureInPictureWindow> Application::create_picture_in_picture_window(WebView::WebContentPage& requesting_page, WebView::CanonicalTraversable& traversable, Gfx::IntSize video_size)
{
    if (!ConnectionFromUI::the())
        return WebView::Application::create_picture_in_picture_window(requesting_page, traversable, video_size);

    auto& owner_view = static_cast<View&>(requesting_page.view());
    auto initial_state = owner_view.initial_state_for_related_view();
    initial_state.owner_view_id = owner_view.view_id();
    initial_state.is_tab = false;
    initial_state.scales_frames_to_fit = true;
    auto screen_size = owner_view.screen_size();
    auto& view = create_view(move(initial_state), traversable);
    return make<PictureInPictureWindowInUI>(view, owner_view.view_id(), video_size, WebView::PictureInPictureWindow::initial_size(video_size, screen_size));
}

void Application::focus_page_from_notification(WebView::WebContentPage& page)
{
    if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the())
        ui->async_app_focus_view_from_notification(page.view().view_id());
}

void Application::open_url_in_new_tab_from_notification(URL::URL const& url, Web::PageId, WebView::CanonicalTraversable* canonical_traversable, WebView::IsPrivate is_private)
{
    Optional<u64> view_id;
    if (canonical_traversable) {
        if (auto view = canonical_traversable->view(); view.has_value())
            view_id = view->view_id();
    }
    if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the())
        ui->async_app_open_url_in_new_tab_from_notification(url, view_id, is_private);
}

void Application::resolve_external_url_handler(URL::URL const& url, WebView::ExternalURLHandlerCallback callback) const
{
    auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the();
    if (!ui) {
        WebView::Application::resolve_external_url_handler(url, move(callback));
        return;
    }
    auto request_id = m_next_ui_request_id++;
    m_pending_external_url_handlers.set(request_id, move(callback));
    ui->async_external_url_resolve_handler(request_id, url);
}

void Application::did_resolve_external_url_handler(u64 request_id, Optional<u64> handler_id, String application_name, bool is_ladybird)
{
    auto callback = m_pending_external_url_handlers.take(request_id);
    if (!callback.has_value())
        return;
    if (handler_id.has_value())
        (*callback)(adopt_ref(*new ExternalURLHandlerInUI(*handler_id, move(application_name), is_ladybird)));
    else
        (*callback)(nullptr);
}

void Application::launch_external_url(u64 handler_id, URL::URL const& url, Function<void(bool)> callback) const
{
    auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the();
    if (!ui) {
        callback(false);
        return;
    }
    auto request_id = m_next_ui_request_id++;
    m_pending_external_url_launches.set(request_id, move(callback));
    ui->async_external_url_launch(handler_id, request_id, url);
}

void Application::did_launch_external_url(u64 request_id, bool launched)
{
    if (auto callback = m_pending_external_url_launches.take(request_id); callback.has_value())
        (*callback)(launched);
}

bool Application::supports_clipboard_type(WebView::Application::ClipboardType type) const

    if (auto const* info = ui_info())
        return type == ClipboardType::Text || info->supports_selection_clipboard;
    return WebView::Application::supports_clipboard_type(type);
}
