#pragma once

#include <Hub/View.h>
#include <LibCore/Promise.h>
#include <LibMain/Main.h>
#include <LibWebView/Application.h>
#include <LibWebView/DefaultBrowser.h>
#include <LibWebView/MicrophoneAuthorizer.h>
#include <LibWebView/NotificationBackend.h>
#include <LibWebView/PictureInPictureWindow.h>

namespace Hub {

// What the application needs from the UI. With no UI, as in headless mode, it does without.
class ApplicationHost {
public:
    virtual ~ApplicationHost() = default;

    virtual void will_create_event_loop(Main::Arguments&) = 0;
    virtual void did_create_event_loop(Core::EventLoop&) = 0;

    virtual void create_platform_actions() = 0;
    virtual Optional<String> ui_font_family() const = 0;
    virtual Web::CSS::PreferredColorScheme interface_color_scheme() const = 0;
    virtual Optional<String> system_font_family() const = 0;
    virtual bool supports_picture_in_picture() const = 0;
    virtual bool supports_clipboard_type(WebView::Application::ClipboardType type) const = 0;
    virtual bool supports_system_menu_bar() const = 0;
    virtual bool supports_vertical_tabs() const = 0;
    virtual bool supports_private_browsing_windows() const = 0;
    virtual bool supports_client_side_window_decorations() const = 0;
    virtual bool platform_reports_scroll_momentum() const = 0;
    virtual bool platform_scrolls_elastically() const = 0;
    virtual bool platform_scrollbar_track_press_jumps() const = 0;
    virtual bool platform_prefers_reduced_motion() const = 0;
    virtual bool platform_prefers_more_contrast() const = 0;
    virtual Vector<String> platform_preferred_languages() const = 0;
    virtual Optional<Gfx::GpuDeviceIdentity> platform_presentation_gpu_device() const = 0;
    virtual Vector<u64> platform_presentation_drm_format_modifiers() const = 0;
};

// The browser itself: its state, and the helper processes that do its work.
class Application final : public WebView::Application {
    WEB_VIEW_APPLICATION(Application)

public:
    // The host is going away, and takes no more calls.
    void detach_from_host() { m_host = nullptr; }

    View& create_view(View::InitialState, Optional<WebView::CanonicalTraversable&> = {});
    void destroy_view(u64 view_id);
    void destroy_all_views() { m_views.clear(); }

    void set_active_view(Optional<u64> view_id);

    // The UI has made its first windows and asked for what they start out showing.
    void ui_did_start();
    virtual void notify_webdriver_window_created(String const& handle) override;
    void set_ui_info(Hub::UIInfo);
    Hub::UIInfo const* ui_info() const;
    StringView ui_mach_server_name() const { return m_ui_mach_server_name; }
    bool ui_has_location_source() const;
    bool ui_has_translator() const;
    void did_resolve_external_url_handler(u64 request_id, Optional<u64> handler_id, String application_name, bool is_ladybird);
    void launch_external_url(u64 handler_id, URL::URL const&, Function<void(bool)>) const;
    void did_launch_external_url(u64 request_id, bool launched);
    void did_read_clipboard_text(u64 request_id, Utf16String);
    void did_read_clipboard_item(u64 request_id, Web::Clipboard::SystemClipboardItem);
    void did_get_download_path(u64 request_id, Optional<ByteString>);

private:
    explicit Application(ApplicationHost*);

    // ^WebView::Application
    virtual Core::EventLoop& create_platform_event_loop() override;
    virtual void create_platform_arguments(Core::ArgsParser&) override;
    virtual Optional<pid_t> ui_process_id() const override;
    virtual Optional<WebView::ViewImplementation&> active_web_view() const override;
    virtual Optional<WebView::ViewImplementation&> open_blank_new_tab(Web::HTML::ActivateTab, WebView::ViewImplementation const* related_view = nullptr) const override;
    virtual void open_url_in_new_tab(URL::URL const&, Web::HTML::ActivateTab, WebView::ViewImplementation const* source_view = nullptr) const override;
    virtual void activate_or_open_tab_with_url(URL::URL const&) const override;
    virtual void open_urls_in_new_tabs(ReadonlySpan<URL::URL>) const override;
    virtual void open_url_in_new_window(URL::URL const&, WebView::IsPrivate) override;
    virtual void open_navigation_in_new_tab(Web::HTML::PreparedNavigationDescriptor, Web::HTML::ActivateTab, WebView::ViewImplementation const* source_view = nullptr) const override;
    virtual void open_navigation_in_new_window(Web::HTML::PreparedNavigationDescriptor, WebView::IsPrivate) override;
    virtual NonnullRefPtr<Core::Promise<ByteString>> ask_user_for_download_path(ByteString const& file) const override;
    virtual void display_download_confirmation_dialog(StringView download_name, LexicalPath const& path) const override;
    virtual void display_error_dialog(StringView error_message) const override;
    virtual void display_openssl_mismatch(PlatformFeatures::OpenSSLFacts const&) override;
#if defined(LADYBIRD_HAS_UPDATE_CHECK)
    virtual void display_update_check_result(WebView::UpdateCheckResult const&, WebView::UpdateCheckTrigger) override;
#endif
    virtual void set_clipboard_text(String, ClipboardType) override;
    virtual void insert_clipboard_item(Web::Clipboard::SystemClipboardItem) override;
    virtual void read_clipboard_text(ClipboardType, Function<void(Utf16String)>) const override;
    virtual void read_clipboard_item(Function<void(Web::Clipboard::SystemClipboardItem)>) const override;
    virtual void update_tabs_display() const override;
    virtual void did_clear_history_since(UnixDateTime) const override;
    virtual void quit_for_signal() override;
    virtual NonnullOwnPtr<WebView::DefaultBrowser> create_default_browser() override;
    virtual NonnullOwnPtr<WebView::MicrophoneAuthorizer> create_microphone_authorizer() override;
    virtual NonnullOwnPtr<WebView::NotificationBackend> create_notification_backend() override;
    virtual OwnPtr<WebView::MediaSessionPlatformBackend> create_media_session_platform_backend() override;
    virtual bool captures_browser_crashes() const override { return true; }
    virtual void on_devtools_enabled() const override;
    virtual void on_devtools_disabled() const override;
    virtual void on_compositor_gpu_painting_changed() const override;
    virtual void create_platform_actions() override;
    virtual Optional<String> ui_font_family() const override;
    virtual Web::CSS::PreferredColorScheme interface_color_scheme() const override;
    virtual Optional<String> system_font_family() const override;
    virtual void focus_page_from_notification(WebView::WebContentPage& page) override;
    virtual void open_url_in_new_tab_from_notification(URL::URL const& url, Web::PageId originating_page, WebView::CanonicalTraversable* canonical_traversable, WebView::IsPrivate is_private) override;
    virtual bool supports_picture_in_picture() const override;
    virtual OwnPtr<WebView::PictureInPictureWindow> create_picture_in_picture_window(WebView::WebContentPage& requesting_page, WebView::CanonicalTraversable& canonical_traversable, Gfx::IntSize video_size) override;
    virtual void resolve_external_url_handler(URL::URL const& url, WebView::ExternalURLHandlerCallback callback) const override;
    virtual bool supports_clipboard_type(WebView::Application::ClipboardType type) const override;
    virtual bool supports_system_menu_bar() const override;
    virtual bool supports_vertical_tabs() const override;
    virtual bool supports_private_browsing_windows() const override;
    virtual bool supports_client_side_window_decorations() const override;
    virtual bool platform_reports_scroll_momentum() const override;
    virtual bool platform_scrolls_elastically() const override;
    virtual bool platform_scrollbar_track_press_jumps() const override;
    virtual bool platform_prefers_reduced_motion() const override;
    virtual bool platform_prefers_more_contrast() const override;
    virtual Vector<String> platform_preferred_languages() const override;
    virtual Optional<Gfx::GpuDeviceIdentity> platform_presentation_gpu_device() const override;
    virtual Vector<u64> platform_presentation_drm_format_modifiers() const override;

    ApplicationHost* m_host { nullptr };
    StringView m_encoded_ui_info;
    StringView m_ui_mach_server_name;
    StringView m_ui_pid;
    mutable Optional<Hub::UIInfo> m_ui_info;
    HashMap<u64, NonnullOwnPtr<View>> m_views;
    Optional<u64> m_active_view_id;
    bool m_ui_did_start { false };
    Vector<String> m_webdriver_windows_awaiting_ui;
    // The system probe reports while the UI may still be opening its windows.
    Optional<PlatformFeatures::OpenSSLFacts> m_openssl_mismatch_awaiting_ui;

    // What the Hub waits to hear from the UI.
    mutable HashMap<u64, Function<void(Utf16String)>> m_pending_clipboard_text_reads;
    mutable HashMap<u64, Function<void(Web::Clipboard::SystemClipboardItem)>> m_pending_clipboard_item_reads;
    mutable HashMap<u64, NonnullRefPtr<Core::Promise<ByteString>>> m_pending_download_paths;
    mutable HashMap<u64, WebView::ExternalURLHandlerCallback> m_pending_external_url_handlers;
    mutable HashMap<u64, Function<void(bool)>> m_pending_external_url_launches;
    struct NewTabSource {
        Optional<u64> view_id;
        WebView::IsPrivate is_private { WebView::IsPrivate::No };
    };
    NewTabSource new_tab_source(WebView::ViewImplementation const* source_view) const;

    mutable u64 m_next_ui_request_id { 1 };
};

namespace Hub {

static ConnectionFromUI* s_the;

ConnectionFromUI::ConnectionFromUI(NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport> transport)
    : IPC::ConnectionFromClient<HubClientEndpoint, HubServerEndpoint>(*this, move(transport), 1)
{
    s_the = this;

    // NB: The UI reads the gamepads.
    WebView::GamepadManager::the().set_source(make<GamepadSourceInUI>());
    Application::settings().on_persist = [this](JsonValue const& settings) {
        async_settings_changed(settings.serialized().to_byte_string(), m_last_applied_settings_change_id);
    };
    WebView::ApplicationWebUI::set_callbacks({
        .on_open = [this](u64 id, String const& host, WebView::IsPrivate is_private) { async_web_ui_opened(id, host, is_private); },
        .on_message = [this](u64 id, String name, JsonValue data) { async_web_ui_message(id, move(name), move(data)); },
        .on_close = [this](u64 id) { async_web_ui_closed(id); },
    });
    (void)WebView::TabPerformanceMonitor::the();

    auto& browser_process = Application::the().browser_process();
    browser_process.on_new_tab = [this](auto const& urls) { async_app_open_new_tab(urls); };
    browser_process.on_new_window = [this](auto const& urls) { async_app_open_new_window(urls); };
}

ConnectionFromUI::~ConnectionFromUI()
{
    WebView::ApplicationWebUI::set_callbacks({});
    Application::settings().on_persist = nullptr;
    auto& browser_process = Application::the().browser_process();
    browser_process.on_new_tab = nullptr;
    browser_process.on_new_window = nullptr;
    s_the = nullptr;
}

ConnectionFromUI* ConnectionFromUI::the()
{
    return s_the;
}

void ConnectionFromUI::die()
{
    // The UI is gone, which ends the browser, however that came to be.
    Core::EventLoop::current().quit(0);
}

// What the UI knows an input event by, while the Hub has it. The event carries it through the view's queue, in place of
// the data about the event that only the UI can hold. Once the event is gone, the UI can let go of that data.
struct InputFromUI final : public Web::BrowserInputData {
    InputFromUI(u64 view_id, u64 input_id)
        : view_id(view_id)
        , input_id(input_id)
    {
    }

    virtual ~InputFromUI() override
    {
        if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the())
            ui->async_view_release_input(view_id, input_id);
    }

    u64 view_id { 0 };
    u64 input_id { 0 };
};

Optional<u64> ConnectionFromUI::input_id_of(Web::BrowserInputData const* browser_data)
{
    if (auto const* input_from_ui = as_if<InputFromUI>(browser_data))
        return input_from_ui->input_id;
    return {};
}

template<typename EventType>
static void enqueue_input_from_ui(View& view, u64 input_id, EventType event)
{
    event.browser_data = make<InputFromUI>(view.view_id(), input_id);
    view.enqueue_input_event(move(event));
    view.push_state_to_ui();
}

void ConnectionFromUI::view_enqueue_key_event(u64 view_id, u64 input_id, Web::KeyEvent event)
{
    if (auto* view = find_view(view_id))
        enqueue_input_from_ui(*view, input_id, move(event));
}

void ConnectionFromUI::view_enqueue_mouse_event(u64 view_id, u64 input_id, Web::MouseEvent event)
{
    if (auto* view = find_view(view_id))
        enqueue_input_from_ui(*view, input_id, move(event));
}

void ConnectionFromUI::view_enqueue_drag_event(u64 view_id, u64 input_id, Web::DragEvent event)
{
    if (auto* view = find_view(view_id))
        enqueue_input_from_ui(*view, input_id, move(event));
}

void ConnectionFromUI::view_enqueue_pinch_event(u64 view_id, Web::PinchEvent event)
{
    if (auto* view = find_view(view_id)) {
        view->enqueue_input_event(move(event));
        view->push_state_to_ui();
    }
}

void ConnectionFromUI::release_backing_store(u64 page_id, i32 bitmap_id)
{
    // NB: A page can outlive its view, and a view can stop showing a page, so this goes by the page.
    Web::PageId id { page_id };
    auto client = WebView::WebContentClient::client_for_compositor_context_id(Web::compositor_context_id_for_page(id));
    if (!client.has_value())
        return;
    if (auto* page = client->page(id))
        page->release_presented_bitmap(bitmap_id);
}

static DownloadState state_of_download(WebView::FileDownloader::Download const& download)
{
    DownloadState state;
    state.id = download.id;
    state.is_private = download.is_private;
    state.url = download.url;
    state.destination = download.destination.string();
    state.status = download.status;
    state.downloaded_size = download.downloaded_size;
    state.total_size = download.total_size;
    state.error = download.error;
    state.can_resume = download.can_resume;
    state.connection_count = download.connection_count;
    state.bytes_per_second = download.bytes_per_second;
    state.is_waiting_to_retry = download.is_waiting_to_retry;
    state.created_time = download.created_time;
    state.segments = Application::the().file_downloader().segment_progress(download.id);
    return state;
}

Vector<DownloadState> ConnectionFromUI::downloads()
{
    Vector<DownloadState> downloads;
    for (auto const& download : Application::the().file_downloader().downloads())
        downloads.append(state_of_download(download));
    return downloads;
}

void ConnectionFromUI::download_added(WebView::FileDownloader::Download const& download)
{
    async_download_added(state_of_download(download));
}

void ConnectionFromUI::download_updated(WebView::FileDownloader::Download const& download)
{
    async_download_updated(state_of_download(download));
}

void ConnectionFromUI::download_removed(u64 id, WebView::IsPrivate is_private)
{
    async_download_removed(id, is_private);
}

void ConnectionFromUI::view_request_selected_text(u64 view_id, u64 request_id)
{
    auto* view = find_view(view_id);
    if (!view) {
        async_view_selected_text(view_id, request_id, {});
        return;
    }
    auto promise = view->selected_text();
    promise->when_resolved([this, view_id, request_id](ByteString& text) {
        async_view_selected_text(view_id, request_id, text);
    });
    promise->when_rejected([this, view_id, request_id](Error const&) {
        async_view_selected_text(view_id, request_id, {});
    });
}

void ConnectionFromUI::view_request_close_preflight(u64 view_id, u64 request_id)
{
    auto* view = find_view(view_id);
    if (!view) {
        async_view_close_preflight_finished(view_id, request_id, true);
        return;
    }
    view->request_close_preflight([this, view_id, request_id](bool may_close) {
        async_view_close_preflight_finished(view_id, request_id, may_close);
    });
}

void ConnectionFromUI::view_request_page_dumps(u64 view_id, u64 request_id)
{
    auto* view = find_view(view_id);
    if (!view) {
        async_view_page_dumps(view_id, request_id, {});
        return;
    }
    auto promise = WebView::WebCompatReport::request_page_dumps(*view);
    promise->when_resolved([this, view_id, request_id](String& dumps) {
        async_view_page_dumps(view_id, request_id, dumps);
    });
    promise->when_rejected([this, view_id, request_id](Error const&) {
        async_view_page_dumps(view_id, request_id, {});
    });
}

void ConnectionFromUI::request_platform_features_description(u64 request_id)
{
    async_platform_features_description(request_id, Application::the().describe_platform_features_for_report({}));
}

void ConnectionFromUI::view_prepare_for_immediate_close(u64 view_id)
{
    auto* view = find_view(view_id);
    if (!view)
        return;
    // NB: The UI looked before it asked, but a page can start to need a beforeunload check at any moment, and the user
    //     still wants the tab gone. A page must not be able to take the Hub down by racing that, and the UI has
    //     already closed the tab, so the page closes without prompting.
    if (view->needs_beforeunload_check()) {
        view->prepare_for_close_without_prompting()();
        return;
    }
    view->prepare_for_immediate_close();
}

void ConnectionFromUI::view_prepare_for_close_without_prompting(u64 view_id, u64 close_id)
{
    if (auto* view = find_view(view_id))
        m_prepared_closes.set(close_id, view->prepare_for_close_without_prompting());
}

void ConnectionFromUI::finish_prepared_close(u64 close_id)
{
    if (auto close = m_prepared_closes.take(close_id); close.has_value())
        (*close)();
}

    WebView::WebUI::add_application_page(move(host), move(title));

        web_ui->send_to_page(name, data);

Messages::HubServer::WebUiConsumeUserActivationResponse ConnectionFromUI::web_ui_consume_user_activation(u64 web_ui_id)

    auto* web_ui = WebView::ApplicationWebUI::find(web_ui_id);
    return web_ui && web_ui->consume_user_activation();
}

Messages::HubServer::InitializeResponse ConnectionFromUI::initialize()
{
    auto const& options = Application::browser_options();

    InitialState state;
    state.settings_json = Application::settings().serialize_json().serialized().to_byte_string();
    state.user_agent = Application::the().user_agent_string();
    state.navigator_compatibility_mode = Application::the().navigator_compatibility_mode();
    state.scripting_enabled = Application::the().scripting_enabled();
    state.blocks_pop_ups = Application::the().blocks_pop_ups();
    state.devtools_enabled = Application::the().devtools_enabled();
    state.sandbox_is_disabled = options.disable_sandbox == WebView::DisableSandbox::Yes;
    state.gpu_painting_enabled = Application::the().compositor_gpu_painting_enabled();
    state.downloads = downloads();
    state.urls = options.urls;
    state.raw_urls = options.raw_urls;
    state.crash_report_directory = WebView::CrashReportStore::the().directory();
    state.devtools_port = options.devtools_port;
    auto const& profile = Application::profile();
    state.config_directory = profile.paths().config;
    state.data_directory = profile.paths().data;
    state.persists_sessions = Application::the().persists_sessions();
    state.uses_sql_database = options.disable_sql_database == WebView::DisableSQLDatabase::No;
    state.profile_identifier = profile.identifier();
    state.profile_identity = profile.paths().identity;
    state.profile_is_temporary = profile.is_temporary();
    return state;
}

Messages::HubServer::CreateViewResponse ConnectionFromUI::create_view(Hub::NewViewRequest request)
{
    auto& view = Application::the().create_view({
        .is_private = request.is_private,
        .device_pixel_ratio = request.device_pixel_ratio,
        .maximum_frames_per_second = request.maximum_frames_per_second,
        .display_id = request.display_id,
        .screen_shows_high_dynamic_range = request.screen_shows_high_dynamic_range,
        .system_theme = move(request.system_theme),
        .screen_rects = move(request.screen_rects),
        .owner_view_id = request.owner_view_id,
        .websites_prefer_dark = request.websites_prefer_dark,
        .is_tab = request.is_tab,
    });
    return { view.view_id(), view.current_state() };
}

Messages::HubServer::ViewDescriptionResponse ConnectionFromUI::view_description(u64 view_id)
{
    // NB: The UI can ask about a view that the Hub has let go of already, and must not take the Hub down by that.
    auto* view = find_view(view_id);
    if (!view)
        return Hub::ViewState {};
    return { view->current_state() };
}

// NB: The UI makes no requests of its own choosing. It names a search engine and a query, and the Hub makes the request
//     for that engine's suggestions, as the UI's own settings say.
void ConnectionFromUI::fetch_search_suggestions(u64 request_id, String engine_name, String query, WebView::IsPrivate is_private)
{
    Optional<URL::URL> url;
    if (auto engine = Application::settings().find_search_engine_by_name(engine_name); engine.has_value())
        url = engine->suggestions_url_for_query(query);
    if (!url.has_value()) {
        async_request_finished(request_id, true, {}, {}, {});
        return;
    }

    auto request_headers = HTTP::HeaderList::create();
    request_headers->set({ "User-Agent"sv, Web::default_user_agent });

    static constexpr Array response_header_names { "Content-Type"sv };
    start_request(request_id, "GET"sv, *url, request_headers, {}, HTTP::CacheMode::Default, HTTP::Cookie::IncludeCredentials::Yes, is_private, response_header_names);
}

// NB: A report goes only to the report server, with no credentials, and with only the headers that reports carry.
void ConnectionFromUI::post_report(u64 request_id, URL::URL url, Vector<HTTP::Header> headers, ByteString body)
{
    if (!WebView::ReportSubmission::is_report_server_url(url)) {
        async_request_finished(request_id, true, {}, {}, {});
        return;
    }
    static constexpr Array report_header_names { "Content-Type"sv, "X-Ladybird-Challenge"sv, "X-Ladybird-Nonce"sv };
    auto request_headers = HTTP::HeaderList::create();
    for (auto& header : headers) {
        if (any_of(report_header_names, [&](auto name) { return header.name.equals_ignoring_ascii_case(name); }))
            request_headers->append(move(header));
    }
    static constexpr Array response_header_names { "Retry-After"sv };
    start_request(request_id, "POST"sv, url, *request_headers, body, HTTP::CacheMode::NoStore, HTTP::Cookie::IncludeCredentials::No, WebView::IsPrivate::No, response_header_names);
}

void ConnectionFromUI::start_request(u64 request_id, ByteString const& method, URL::URL const& url, HTTP::HeaderList const& headers, ByteString const& body, HTTP::CacheMode cache_mode, HTTP::Cookie::IncludeCredentials include_credentials, WebView::IsPrivate is_private, ReadonlySpan<StringView> response_header_names)
{
    RefPtr<Requests::Request> request;
    if (auto client = WebView::Application::request_server_client(is_private); !client.is_error())
        request = client.value()->start_request(method, url, HTTP::Cookie::SameSiteContext::same_site(), headers, body.bytes(), cache_mode, include_credentials);
    if (!request) {
        async_request_finished(request_id, true, {}, {}, {});
        return;
    }

    request->set_buffered_request_finished_callback(
        [this, request_id, response_header_names](u64, Requests::RequestTimingInfo const&, Optional<Requests::NetworkError> const& network_error,
            HTTP::HeaderList const& response_headers, Optional<u32> response_code, Optional<String> const&,
            Requests::CacheState, Core::ImmutableBytes payload) {
            // NB: The UI gets only the headers that the response is read for.
            Vector<HTTP::Header> headers_for_ui;
            for (auto name : response_header_names) {
                if (auto value = response_headers.get(name); value.has_value())
                    headers_for_ui.append({ name, value.release_value() });
            }
            async_request_finished(request_id, network_error.has_value(), response_code, move(headers_for_ui), ByteString::copy(payload.bytes()));

            // A request cannot be destroyed from inside its own callback.
            Core::deferred_invoke([this, request_id] {
                m_requests.remove(request_id);
            });
        });
    m_requests.set(request_id, request.release_nonnull());
}

void ConnectionFromUI::stop_request(u64 request_id)
{
    if (auto request = m_requests.take(request_id); request.has_value())
        (*request)->stop();
}

Messages::HubServer::ProcessSnapshotsResponse ConnectionFromUI::process_snapshots()
{
    auto snapshots = WebView::process_snapshots(Application::process_manager());
    for (auto& snapshot : snapshots) {
        if (snapshot.type == WebView::ProcessType::Browser)
            snapshot.type = WebView::ProcessType::Hub;
    }
    return snapshots;
}

Messages::HubServer::TerminateProcessResponse ConnectionFromUI::terminate_process(u64 child_id)
{
    return WebView::end_process(Application::process_manager(), child_id);
}

void ConnectionFromUI::view_restore_state_of_discarded_tab(u64 view_id, u64 discarded_tab_state_id)
{
    auto* view = find_view(view_id);
    if (!view) {
        WebView::ViewImplementation::forget_state_of_discarded_tab(discarded_tab_state_id);
        return;
    }
    view->restore_state_of_discarded_tab(discarded_tab_state_id);
    view->push_state_to_ui();
}

}

Messages::HubServer::ViewHistoryStepAtDeltaResponse ConnectionFromUI::view_history_step_at_delta(u64 view_id, i32 delta)
{
    auto* view = find_view(view_id);
    if (!view)
        return Optional<i32> {};
    auto const& traversable = view->traversable();
    auto used_steps = traversable.session_history().used_steps();
    auto step_index = traversable.effective_current_session_history_step_index() + delta;
    if (step_index >= used_steps.size())
        return Optional<i32> {};
    return Optional<i32> { used_steps[step_index] };
}

Messages::HubServer::ViewLookUpSelectedTextAtResponse ConnectionFromUI::view_look_up_selected_text_at(u64 view_id, Gfx::IntPoint position)
{
    auto* view = find_view(view_id);
    return view && view->look_up_selected_text_at(position);
}

Messages::HubServer::ViewPageDescriptionResponse ConnectionFromUI::view_page_description(u64 view_id)
{
    auto* view = find_view(view_id);
    if (!view)
        return { URL::URL {}, String {}, Gfx::IntSize {}, 1.0, 1.0 };
    auto page = WebView::WebCompatReport::describe_page(*view);
    return { move(page.url), move(page.user_agent), page.viewport_size, page.device_pixel_ratio, page.zoom_level };
}

void ConnectionFromUI::update_settings(u64 change_id, ByteString changes_json)
{
    auto changes = JsonValue::from_string(changes_json);
    if (changes.is_error() || !changes.value().is_object())
        return;

    // NB: This process owns the settings, so what the UI did not change stays as it is here, however old its copy is.
    auto settings = Application::settings().serialize_json();
    WebView::Settings::apply_changes(settings.as_object(), changes.value().as_object());
    m_last_applied_settings_change_id = change_id;
    Application::settings().replace_with_json(settings, WebView::Settings::PersistChange::Yes);
}

void ConnectionFromUI::view_take_frame_snapshot(u64 view_id, u64 request_id)
{
    auto* view = find_view(view_id);
    if (!view) {
        async_view_did_take_frame_snapshot(view_id, request_id, {});
        return;
    }
    view->take_frame_snapshot([view_id, request_id](Optional<Gfx::ShareableBitmap> snapshot) {
        if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the())
            ui->async_view_did_take_frame_snapshot(view_id, request_id, move(snapshot));
    });
}

// The UI waits for the answer on its main thread, so a view that is gone answers as well.
void ConnectionFromUI::view_await_synchronized_resize_frame(u64 view_id, u64 token, Gfx::IntSize size)
{
    if (auto* view = find_view(view_id))
        view->await_synchronized_resize_frame(token, size);
    else
        async_view_did_hold_synchronized_resize_frame(view_id, token);
}

void ConnectionFromUI::view_commit_synchronized_resize(u64 view_id, u64 token)
{
    if (auto* view = find_view(view_id))
        view->commit_synchronized_resize(token);
    else
        async_view_did_commit_synchronized_resize(view_id, token);
}

void ConnectionFromUI::view_dump_gc_graph(u64 view_id)
{
    auto* view = find_view(view_id);
    if (!view)
        return;

    auto gc_graph_path = view->dump_gc_graph();
    if (gc_graph_path.is_error()) {
        warnln("\033[31;1mFailed to dump GC graph: {}\033[0m", gc_graph_path.error());
        return;
    }
    warnln("\033[33;1mDumped GC graph into {}\033[0m", gc_graph_path.value());
    if (auto source_dir = Core::Environment::get("LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR"sv); source_dir.has_value())
        warnln("\033[33;1mGC graph explorer: file://{}/Meta/gc-heap-explorer.html?script=file://{}\033[0m", *source_dir, gc_graph_path.value());
}

#pragma once

#include <Hub/HubClientEndpoint.h>
#include <Hub/HubServerEndpoint.h>
#include <Hub/View.h>
#include <LibIPC/ConnectionFromClient.h>
#include <LibRequests/Request.h>
#include <LibWebView/CrashReportOutbox.h>
#include <LibWebView/FileDownloader.h>

namespace Hub {

// The Hub's end of its connection to the UI.
class ConnectionFromUI final
    : public IPC::ConnectionFromClient<HubClientEndpoint, HubServerEndpoint>
    , public WebView::FileDownloaderObserver
    , public WebView::CrashReportOutboxObserver {
    C_OBJECT(ConnectionFromUI);

public:
    virtual ~ConnectionFromUI() override;

    static ConnectionFromUI* the();

    static Vector<DownloadState> downloads();

    // The ID that the UI gave an input event, from the browser data of the event. Input the UI didn't send has none,
    // whether it carries no browser data or someone else's (WebDriver's, e.g.).
    static Optional<u64> input_id_of(Web::BrowserInputData const*);

    virtual void die() override;

private:
    explicit ConnectionFromUI(NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport>);

    // ^WebView::CrashReportOutboxObserver
    virtual void crash_reports_changed() override;

    static View* find_view(u64 view_id);

    // The requests that the UI has asked us to make, as it has no network of its own.
    HashMap<u64, NonnullRefPtr<Requests::Request>> m_requests;
    u64 m_last_applied_settings_change_id { 0 };

    // A close that the UI got ready for, and finishes once the tab is gone from its window.
    HashMap<u64, Function<void()>> m_prepared_closes;

    // ^WebView::FileDownloaderObserver
    virtual void download_added(WebView::FileDownloader::Download const&) override;
    virtual void download_updated(WebView::FileDownloader::Download const&) override;
    virtual void download_removed(u64 id, WebView::IsPrivate) override;

    // ^HubServerEndpoint
    virtual Messages::HubServer::InitializeResponse initialize() override;

#include <Hub/Application.h>
#include <Hub/ConnectionFromUI.h>
#include <Hub/Proxies.h>
#include <LibCore/GeolocationProvider.h>
#include <LibCore/Process.h>
#include <LibIPC/StartupTransport.h>
#include <LibMain/Main.h>
#include <LibThreading/Thread.h>
#include <LibWebView/BrowserProcess.h>

#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS) || defined(AK_OS_BSD_GENERIC)
#    include <sys/event.h>
#elif defined(AK_OS_LINUX)
#    include <poll.h>
#    include <sys/syscall.h>
#endif
#if !defined(AK_OS_WINDOWS)
#    include <errno.h>
#    include <signal.h>
#    include <unistd.h>
#endif

#if !defined(AK_OS_WINDOWS)
// How long the Hub may take to end by itself once the UI is gone.
static constexpr u32 seconds_to_outlive_the_ui = 10;

static void wait_for_process_to_exit(pid_t pid)
{
#    if defined(AK_OS_MACOS) || defined(AK_OS_BSD_GENERIC)
    auto queue = kqueue();
    if (queue >= 0) {
        struct kevent change {};
        EV_SET(&change, pid, EVFILT_PROC, EV_ADD | EV_ONESHOT, NOTE_EXIT, 0, nullptr);
        struct kevent event {};
        for (;;) {
            auto count = kevent(queue, &change, 1, &event, 1, nullptr);
            // NB: A process that is gone already cannot be watched. That, like any other failure to watch, is
            //     reported as an event when there is room for one.
            auto failed_to_watch = count > 0 && (event.flags & EV_ERROR) != 0;
            auto error = failed_to_watch ? static_cast<int>(event.data) : errno;
            if ((count > 0 && !failed_to_watch) || ((count < 0 || failed_to_watch) && error == ESRCH)) {
                (void)close(queue);
                return;
            }
            if (failed_to_watch || (count < 0 && error != EINTR))
                break;
        }
        (void)close(queue);
    }
#    elif defined(AK_OS_LINUX)
    auto process_fd = static_cast<int>(syscall(SYS_pidfd_open, pid, 0));
    if (process_fd >= 0) {
        // NB: The descriptor of a process becomes readable once the process has exited.
        pollfd poll_fd { .fd = process_fd, .events = POLLIN, .revents = 0 };
        while (poll(&poll_fd, 1, -1) < 0 && errno == EINTR)
            ;
        (void)close(process_fd);
        return;
    }
    if (errno == ESRCH)
        return;
#    endif

    // NB: Without a way to be told of the exit, look for the process now and then.
    while (kill(pid, 0) == 0 || errno != ESRCH)
        sleep(1);
}
#endif

// The Hub ends when the UI does, which it learns from its connection to the UI. It does not learn that while it has
// not taken that connection yet, or while its main thread waits for something else. A Hub that the UI left behind has
// no window to tell the user of it, yet it keeps its helpers running and the profile to itself. So this watches the UI
// from a thread of its own, and ends a Hub that does not end by itself.
static void end_with_ui_process([[maybe_unused]] Main::Arguments const& arguments)
{
    // FIXME: Do this on Windows as well.
#if !defined(AK_OS_WINDOWS)
    // NB: This starts before the arguments are parsed, as that is where the Hub may begin to wait.
    Optional<pid_t> ui_pid;
    for (auto argument : arguments.strings) {
        if (argument.starts_with("--ui-pid="sv))
            ui_pid = argument.substring_view("--ui-pid="sv.length()).to_number<pid_t>();
    }
    if (!ui_pid.has_value() || *ui_pid <= 0)
        return;

    auto watcher = Threading::Thread::construct("UIExitWatcher"sv, [pid = *ui_pid]() -> intptr_t {
        wait_for_process_to_exit(pid);
        sleep(seconds_to_outlive_the_ui);
        // NB: Nothing is logged here, as a Hub that is stuck writing to its output would keep us from ending it.
        Core::Process::terminate_immediately(1);
    });
    watcher->start();
    watcher->detach();
#endif
}

ErrorOr<int> ladybird_main(Main::Arguments arguments)
{
    AK::set_rich_debug_enabled(true);

    end_with_ui_process(arguments);

    auto application = TRY(Hub::Application::create(arguments, nullptr));
    if (application->browser_is_unresponsive()) {
        warnln("Ladybird is already running with this profile, but it is not responding");
        return WebView::BrowserProcess::unresponsive_browser_exit_status;
    }
    if (application->should_exit_after_profile_coordination()) {
        outln("Opening in existing process");
        return 0;
    }

    // Headless mode runs on its own, with no UI to serve.
    RefPtr<Hub::ConnectionFromUI> connection;
    if (!Hub::Application::browser_options().headless_mode.has_value()) {
        auto transport = TRY(IPC::take_over_startup_transport(application->ui_mach_server_name()));
        connection = Hub::ConnectionFromUI::construct(move(transport));

        // NB: Translating and finding the location need a run loop on macOS, and the UI is the process that has one.
        if (application->ui_has_translator())
            application->set_translator(make<Hub::TranslatorInUI>());
        if (auto const* info = application->ui_info(); info && info->has_spell_checker)
            application->set_spell_checker(make<Hub::SpellCheckerInUI>(info->spell_checker_learns_for_every_tag, info->spell_checker_can_suggest));
        Core::GeolocationProvider::set_provider_functions(
            []() -> ErrorOr<NonnullOwnPtr<Core::GeolocationProvider>> { return make<Hub::GeolocationProviderInUI>(); },
            [] { return Hub::Application::the().ui_has_location_source(); });
    }

    return application->execute();
}

#include <AK/HashMap.h>

namespace Hub {

static HashMap<u64, PictureInPictureWindowInUI*> s_picture_in_picture_windows;

PictureInPictureWindowInUI::PictureInPictureWindowInUI(View& view, u64 owner_view_id, Gfx::IntSize video_size, Gfx::IntSize initial_size)
    : m_view(view)
    , m_view_id(view.view_id())
    , m_size(initial_size)
{
    s_picture_in_picture_windows.set(m_view_id, this);
    report_page_close_of(view);
    if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the())
        ui->async_pip_open(m_view_id, owner_view_id, video_size);
}

PictureInPictureWindowInUI::~PictureInPictureWindowInUI()
{
    s_picture_in_picture_windows.remove(m_view_id);
    if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the())
        ui->async_pip_close(m_view_id);
}

PictureInPictureWindowInUI* PictureInPictureWindowInUI::find(u64 view_id)
{
    return s_picture_in_picture_windows.get(view_id).value_or(nullptr);
}

void PictureInPictureWindowInUI::did_resize(Gfx::IntSize size)
{
    m_size = size;
    if (on_resize)
        on_resize(size);
}

void PictureInPictureWindowInUI::did_close(bool video_keeps_playing)
{
    if (on_close)
        on_close(video_keeps_playing ? VideoKeepsPlaying::Yes : VideoKeepsPlaying::No);
}

void PictureInPictureWindowInUI::hide()
{
    if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the())
        ui->async_pip_hide(m_view_id);
}

void PictureInPictureWindowInUI::set_video_size(Gfx::IntSize video_size)
{
    if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the())
        ui->async_pip_set_video_size(m_view_id, video_size);
}

void MediaSessionPlatformBackendInUI::update(Optional<WebView::NowPlayingState> const& state)
{
    if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the())
        ui->async_media_session_update(state);
}

    s_notification_backend = this;

void NotificationBackendInUI::show(WebView::PlatformNotification const& notification)
{
    Optional<Gfx::ShareableBitmap> icon;
    if (notification.icon)
        icon = notification.icon->to_shareable_bitmap();
    if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the())
        ui->async_notification_show(notification.id, notification.page_id.value(), notification.replaces, notification.data, notification.attribution, move(icon));
}

void NotificationBackendInUI::close(u64 id)
{
    if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the())
        ui->async_notification_close(id);
}

static GeolocationProviderInUI* s_geolocation_provider = nullptr;

GeolocationProviderInUI::GeolocationProviderInUI()
{
    s_geolocation_provider = this;
    if (auto const* info = Application::the().ui_info(); info && info->location_authorization.has_value())
        m_authorization = *info->location_authorization;
    // NB: The UI's provider tells the Hub whenever the authorization changes, but only once it exists.
    if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the())
        ui->async_geolocation_start();
}

GeolocationProviderInUI::~GeolocationProviderInUI()
{
    s_geolocation_provider = nullptr;
}

GeolocationProviderInUI* GeolocationProviderInUI::the()
{
    return s_geolocation_provider;
}

ErrorOr<Core::GeolocationProvider::RequestId, Core::GeolocationError> GeolocationProviderInUI::request_current_position(SuccessCallback on_success, ErrorCallback on_error)
{
    auto id = m_next_id++;
    m_clients.set(id, make_ref_counted<Client>(Kind::CurrentPosition, move(on_success), move(on_error)));
    if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the())
        ui->async_geolocation_request_position(id);
    return id;
}

void GeolocationProviderInUI::cancel_current_position_request(RequestId id)
{
    if (!m_clients.remove(id))
        return;
    if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the())
        ui->async_geolocation_cancel_position_request(id);
}

ErrorOr<Core::GeolocationProvider::WatchId, Core::GeolocationError> GeolocationProviderInUI::start_watching_position(SuccessCallback on_success, ErrorCallback on_error)
{
    auto id = m_next_id++;
    m_clients.set(id, make_ref_counted<Client>(Kind::Watch, move(on_success), move(on_error)));
    if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the())
        ui->async_geolocation_start_watching(id);
    return id;
}

void GeolocationProviderInUI::stop_watching_position(WatchId id)
{
    if (!m_clients.remove(id))
        return;
    if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the())
        ui->async_geolocation_stop_watching(id);
}

void GeolocationProviderInUI::did_receive_position(u64 id, Core::GeolocationCoordinates coordinates)
{
    RefPtr<Client> client = m_clients.get(id).value_or(nullptr);
    if (!client)
        return;
    if (client->kind == Kind::CurrentPosition)
        m_clients.remove(id);
    client->on_success(move(coordinates));
}

void GeolocationProviderInUI::did_receive_error(u64 id, Core::GeolocationError error)
{
    RefPtr<Client> client = m_clients.get(id).value_or(nullptr);
    if (!client)
        return;
    if (client->kind == Kind::CurrentPosition)
        m_clients.remove(id);
    client->on_error(move(error));
}

void GeolocationProviderInUI::did_change_authorization(Core::GeolocationAuthorization authorization)
{
    m_authorization = authorization;
    if (on_authorization_change)
        on_authorization_change();
}

static MicrophoneAuthorizerInUI* s_microphone_authorizer = nullptr;

MicrophoneAuthorizerInUI::MicrophoneAuthorizerInUI(WebView::MicrophoneAuthorization authorization)
    : m_authorization(authorization)
{
    s_microphone_authorizer = this;
}

MicrophoneAuthorizerInUI::~MicrophoneAuthorizerInUI()
{
    s_microphone_authorizer = nullptr;
}

MicrophoneAuthorizerInUI* MicrophoneAuthorizerInUI::the()
{
    return s_microphone_authorizer;
}

void MicrophoneAuthorizerInUI::request_authorization(Function<void(WebView::MicrophoneAuthorization)> on_complete)
{
    // NB: With no UI to ask, nothing would ever answer, and every later request would wait behind this one.
    auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the();
    if (!ui) {
        on_complete(m_authorization);
        return;
    }

    // Requests made while the system is asking share its answer.
    m_pending_requests.append(move(on_complete));
    if (m_pending_requests.size() > 1)
        return;
    ui->async_microphone_request_authorization();
}

void MicrophoneAuthorizerInUI::did_change_authorization(WebView::MicrophoneAuthorization authorization)
{
    m_authorization = authorization;
    if (authorization == WebView::MicrophoneAuthorization::NotDetermined)
        return;
    auto pending_requests = move(m_pending_requests);
    for (auto& on_complete : pending_requests)
        on_complete(authorization);
}

static DefaultBrowserInUI* s_default_browser = nullptr;

DefaultBrowserInUI::DefaultBrowserInUI()
{
    s_default_browser = this;
}

DefaultBrowserInUI::~DefaultBrowserInUI()
{
    s_default_browser = nullptr;
}

DefaultBrowserInUI* DefaultBrowserInUI::the()
{
    return s_default_browser;
}

void DefaultBrowserInUI::make_default(Function<void(WebView::MakeDefaultBrowserResult const&)> on_complete)
{
    // With no UI to ask, nothing would ever answer, and every later request would wait behind this one.
    auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the();
    if (!ui) {
        on_complete({ .failed = true, .system_message = {} });
        return;
    }

    // Requests made while the system is asking share its answer.
    m_pending_requests.append(move(on_complete));
    if (m_pending_requests.size() > 1)
        return;
    ui->async_default_browser_make_default();
}

void DefaultBrowserInUI::did_make_default(WebView::MakeDefaultBrowserResult const& result)
{
    auto pending_requests = move(m_pending_requests);
    for (auto& on_complete : pending_requests)
        on_complete(result);
}

        ui->async_translator_create_session(session_id, source_language, target_language, prefer_higher_quality);
    return session_id;

    if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the())
        ui->async_translator_choose_session_model_again(session_id, prefer_higher_quality);
}

void TranslatorInUI::close_session(SessionId session_id)
{
    m_pending_translations.remove_all_matching([&](auto, auto const& translation) {
        return translation.session_id == session_id;
    });
    if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the())
        ui->async_translator_close_session(session_id);
}

void TranslatorInUI::translate(SessionId session_id, Web::TranslationUnit unit, Function<void(Optional<Vector<Web::TranslationRun>>)> on_complete)
{
    auto request_id = m_next_request_id++;
    m_pending_translations.set(request_id, { session_id, move(on_complete) });
    if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the())
        ui->async_translator_translate(request_id, session_id, unit);
}

void TranslatorInUI::did_translate(u64 request_id, Optional<Vector<Web::TranslationRun>> runs)
{
    if (auto translation = m_pending_translations.take(request_id); translation.has_value())
        translation->on_complete(move(runs));
}

void TranslatorInUI::open_language_download_settings()
{
    if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the())
        ui->async_translator_open_language_download_settings();
}

class GeolocationProviderInUI final : public Core::GeolocationProvider {
public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    GeolocationProviderInUI();
    virtual ~GeolocationProviderInUI() override;

    static GeolocationProviderInUI* the();

    void did_receive_position(u64 id, Core::GeolocationCoordinates);
    void did_receive_error(u64 id, Core::GeolocationError);
    void did_change_authorization(Core::GeolocationAuthorization);

private:
    enum class Kind : u8 {
        CurrentPosition,
        Watch,
    };
    // NB: A callback may stop or start a watch, so a client must stay alive while its callbacks run.
    struct Client : public RefCounted<Client> {
        Client(Kind kind, SuccessCallback on_success, ErrorCallback on_error)
            : kind(kind)
            , on_success(move(on_success))
            , on_error(move(on_error))
        {
        }

        Kind kind;
        SuccessCallback on_success;
        ErrorCallback on_error;
    };

    virtual ErrorOr<RequestId, Core::GeolocationError> request_current_position(SuccessCallback, ErrorCallback) override;
    virtual void cancel_current_position_request(RequestId) override;
    virtual ErrorOr<WatchId, Core::GeolocationError> start_watching_position(SuccessCallback, ErrorCallback) override;
    virtual void stop_watching_position(WatchId) override;
    virtual Core::GeolocationAuthorization authorization() const override { return m_authorization; }

    HashMap<u64, NonnullRefPtr<Client>> m_clients;
    u64 m_next_id { 1 };
    Core::GeolocationAuthorization m_authorization { Core::GeolocationAuthorization::Unknown };
};

#include <Hub/Application.h>
#include <Hub/ConnectionFromUI.h>
#include <Hub/View.h>
#include <LibWebView/PageTranslation.h>

namespace Hub {

// The backing stores of a view, as far as the view needs to know. The UI holds the images and shows them, and hears of
// each step so that it comes to the same result.
class BackingStoresInUI final : public WebView::PageBackingStores {
public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    explicit BackingStoresInUI(View& view)
        : m_view(view)
    {
    }

private:
    // The UI imports these images, so they're checked here first: A publication the UI would refuse is refused here as
    // well, and never sent, so both come to the same result.
    virtual ErrorOr<void> install(Vector<i32> bitmap_ids, Vector<Gfx::SharedImage> backing_stores) override
    {
        TRY(check_installed_backing_stores(backing_stores));
        track_installed_backing_stores(bitmap_ids);
        if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the())
            ui->async_view_install_backing_stores(m_view.view_id(), m_view.page().id().value(), move(bitmap_ids), move(backing_stores));
        m_view.did_install_backing_stores_in_ui();
        return {};
    }

    virtual ErrorOr<void> add(Vector<i32> bitmap_ids, Vector<Gfx::SharedImage> backing_stores) override
    {
        TRY(check_added_backing_stores(backing_stores));
        track_added_backing_stores(bitmap_ids);
        if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the())
            ui->async_view_add_backing_stores(m_view.view_id(), move(bitmap_ids), move(backing_stores));
        return {};
    }

    virtual void retire(ReadonlySpan<i32> bitmap_ids) override
    {
        if (refuses_backing_stores())
            return;
        PageBackingStores::retire(bitmap_ids);
        if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the()) {
            Vector<i32> retired_bitmap_ids;
            retired_bitmap_ids.append(bitmap_ids.data(), bitmap_ids.size());
            ui->async_view_retire_backing_stores(m_view.view_id(), move(retired_bitmap_ids));
        }
    }

    // The UI hands back the backing stores it presents from, other than those of a refused installation, which it never
    // got: Those go straight back from here.
    virtual PresentationResult present(i32 bitmap_id, Gfx::IntSize size, double device_pixel_ratio) override
    {
        if (refuses_backing_stores()) {
            m_view.page().release_presented_bitmap(bitmap_id);
            return { .did_swap = false, .bitmap_id_to_release = bitmap_id };
        }
        auto result = PageBackingStores::present(bitmap_id, size, device_pixel_ratio);
        if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the())
            ui->async_view_present_backing_store(m_view.view_id(), m_view.page().id().value(), bitmap_id, size, device_pixel_ratio);
        return result;
    }

    virtual void keep_front_as_backup() override
    {
        PageBackingStores::keep_front_as_backup();
        if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the())
            ui->async_view_keep_front_backing_store_as_backup(m_view.view_id());
    }

    virtual void clear_backup() override
    {
        PageBackingStores::clear_backup();
        if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the())
            ui->async_view_clear_backup_backing_store(m_view.view_id());
    }

    virtual void clear() override
    {
        PageBackingStores::clear();
        if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the())
            ui->async_view_clear_backing_stores(m_view.view_id());
    }

    View& m_view;
};

View::View(InitialState initial_state)
    : ViewImplementation(initial_state.is_private)
    , m_system_theme(move(initial_state.system_theme))
    , m_screen_rects(move(initial_state.screen_rects))
    , m_websites_prefer_dark(initial_state.websites_prefer_dark)
    , m_is_tab(initial_state.is_tab)
{
    m_device_pixel_ratio = initial_state.device_pixel_ratio;
    m_maximum_frames_per_second = initial_state.maximum_frames_per_second;
    m_display_id = initial_state.display_id;
    m_screen_shows_high_dynamic_range = initial_state.screen_shows_high_dynamic_range;
    set_scales_frames_to_fit(initial_state.scales_frames_to_fit);
    m_backing_stores = make<BackingStoresInUI>(*this);
    forward_callbacks_to_ui(initial_state.is_tab);

    if (initial_state.owner_view_id.has_value()) {
        if (auto owner_view = find_view_by_id(*initial_state.owner_view_id); owner_view.has_value())
            set_owner_view(*owner_view);
    }
    set_page_background_color_to_system_canvas(m_websites_prefer_dark);
}

void View::initialize(Optional<WebView::CanonicalTraversable&> traversable)
{
    initialize_tab(Web::HTML::VisibilityState::Hidden, traversable);
}

View::InitialState View::initial_state_for_related_view() const
{
    return {
        .is_private = is_private(),
        .device_pixel_ratio = device_pixel_ratio(),
        .maximum_frames_per_second = maximum_frames_per_second(),
        .display_id = display_id(),
        .screen_shows_high_dynamic_range = m_screen_shows_high_dynamic_range,
        .system_theme = m_system_theme,
        .screen_rects = m_screen_rects,
        .owner_view_id = {},
        .websites_prefer_dark = m_websites_prefer_dark,
        .is_tab = true,
    };
}

Gfx::IntSize View::screen_size() const
{
    if (!m_screen_rects.has_value() || m_screen_rects->main_screen_index >= m_screen_rects->available_rects.size())
        return m_viewport_size.to_type<int>();
    return m_screen_rects->available_rects[m_screen_rects->main_screen_index].size().to_type<int>();
}

void View::set_viewport(Web::DevicePixelSize size, double device_pixel_ratio)
{
    m_viewport_size = size;
    m_device_pixel_ratio = device_pixel_ratio;
    handle_resize();
}

void View::set_system_theme(Core::AnonymousBuffer theme)
{
    m_system_theme = move(theme);
    update_system_theme(m_system_theme);
}

void View::set_screen_rects(ScreenRects screen_rects)
{
    m_screen_rects = move(screen_rects);
    update_screen_rects();
}

void View::did_get_answer(u64 answer_id, bool answer)
{
    if (auto on_answer = m_pending_answers.take(answer_id); on_answer.has_value())
        (*on_answer)(answer);
}

void View::did_get_permission_answer(u64 answer_id, Web::Permissions::PromptOutcome outcome)
{
    if (auto on_answer = m_pending_permission_answers.take(answer_id); on_answer.has_value())
        (*on_answer)(outcome);
}

// NB: The UI may keep the tab, such as when the user sees it after all. It then stays as it is.
void View::did_request_discard()
{
    if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the())
        ui->async_view_discard(view_id());
}

void View::forward_callbacks_to_ui(bool is_tab)
{
    on_favicon_change = [this](Optional<Gfx::Bitmap const&> favicon) {
        if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the()) {
            push_state_to_ui();
            ui->async_view_favicon_change(view_id(), favicon.map([](auto const& bitmap) { return bitmap.to_shareable_bitmap(); }));
        }
    };

#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
    on_request_dictionary_lookup = [this](WebView::DictionaryLookup const& lookup, Gfx::IntPoint position) {
        if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the())
            ui->async_view_request_dictionary_lookup(view_id(), lookup, position);
    };
#endif

    add_navigation_listener({
        .on_load_start = [this](URL::URL const& url) {
            if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the()) {
                push_state_to_ui();
                ui->async_view_navigation_load_start(view_id(), url);
            } },
        .on_load_finish = [this](URL::URL const& url) {
            if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the()) {
                push_state_to_ui();
                ui->async_view_navigation_load_finish(view_id(), url);
            } },
    });

    // NB: What the view does differs on whether it has these, so a view that the UI will not answer for must not.
    if (is_tab) {
        on_request_before_unload = [this](String const& source, Function<void(bool)> on_complete) {
            auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the();
            if (!ui) {
                on_complete(true);
                return;
            }
            auto answer_id = m_next_answer_id++;
            m_pending_answers.set(answer_id, move(on_complete));
            push_state_to_ui();
            ui->async_view_request_before_unload(view_id(), answer_id, source);
        };

        on_request_external_url_confirmation = [this](URL::URL const& url, URL::Origin const& initiator_origin, WebView::ExternalURLHandler const& handler, Function<void(bool)> on_complete) {
            auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the();
            if (!ui) {
                on_complete(false);
                return;
            }
            auto answer_id = m_next_answer_id++;
            m_pending_answers.set(answer_id, move(on_complete));
            push_state_to_ui();
            ui->async_view_request_external_url_confirmation(view_id(), answer_id, url, initiator_origin, handler.application_name());
        };

        on_request_permission = [this](WebView::PermissionPromptRequest const& request, WebView::PermissionPromptCallback on_outcome) {
            auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the();
            if (!ui) {
                on_outcome(Web::Permissions::PromptOutcome::Dismissed);
                return;
            }
            auto answer_id = m_next_answer_id++;
            m_pending_permission_answers.set(answer_id, move(on_outcome));
            push_state_to_ui();
            ui->async_view_request_permission(view_id(), answer_id, request);
        };

        on_request_date_picker = [this](auto const&... arguments) {
            if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the()) {
                push_state_to_ui();
                ui->async_view_request_date_picker(view_id(), arguments...);
            }
        };

        on_new_web_view = [this](Web::HTML::ActivateTab activate_tab, Web::HTML::WebViewHints hints, WebView::CanonicalTraversable& traversable) {
            auto& view = Application::the().create_view(initial_state_for_related_view(), traversable);
            if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the()) {
                push_state_to_ui();
                ui->async_view_open_new_view(view_id(), view.view_id(), view.current_state(), activate_tab, hints);
            }
            return view.handle();
        };
    }

    on_finish_handling_key_event = [this](Web::KeyEvent const& event) {
        // NB: Input that the Hub came up with itself, such as WebDriver's, is nothing the UI knows about.
        auto input_id = ConnectionFromUI::input_id_of(event.browser_data.ptr());
        if (!input_id.has_value())
            return;
        if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the()) {
            push_state_to_ui();
            ui->async_view_finish_handling_key_event(view_id(), *input_id, event.clone_without_browser_data());
        }
    };

    on_finish_handling_mouse_event = [this](Web::MouseEvent const& event, Web::EventResult result) {
        // NB: Input that the Hub came up with itself, such as WebDriver's, is nothing the UI knows about.
        auto input_id = ConnectionFromUI::input_id_of(event.browser_data.ptr());
        if (!input_id.has_value())
            return;
        if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the()) {
            push_state_to_ui();
            ui->async_view_finish_handling_mouse_event(view_id(), *input_id, event.clone_without_browser_data(), result);
        }
    };

    on_finish_handling_drag_event = [this](Web::DragEvent const& event) {
        // NB: Input that the Hub came up with itself, such as WebDriver's, is nothing the UI knows about.
        auto input_id = ConnectionFromUI::input_id_of(event.browser_data.ptr());
        if (!input_id.has_value())
            return;
        if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the()) {
            push_state_to_ui();
            ui->async_view_finish_handling_drag_event(view_id(), *input_id, event.clone_without_browser_data());
        }
    };

    on_load_start = [this] {
        if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the()) {
            push_state_to_ui();
            ui->async_view_load_start(view_id());
        }
    };

    on_load_finish = [this](auto const&... arguments) {
        if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the()) {
            push_state_to_ui();
            ui->async_view_load_finish(view_id(), arguments...);
        }
    };

    on_activate_tab = [this] {
        if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the()) {
            push_state_to_ui();
            ui->async_view_activate_tab(view_id());
        }
    };

    on_close = [this] {
        if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the()) {
            push_state_to_ui();
            ui->async_view_close(view_id());
        }
    };

    on_link_hover = [this](auto const&... arguments) {
        if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the()) {
            push_state_to_ui();
            ui->async_view_link_hover(view_id(), arguments...);
        }
    };

    on_link_unhover = [this] {
        if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the()) {
            push_state_to_ui();
            ui->async_view_link_unhover(view_id());
        }
    };

    on_title_change = [this](auto const&... arguments) {
        if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the()) {
            push_state_to_ui();
            ui->async_view_title_change(view_id(), arguments...);
        }
    };

    on_url_change = [this](auto const&... arguments) {
        if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the()) {
            push_state_to_ui();
            ui->async_view_url_change(view_id(), arguments...);
        }
    };

    on_loading_state_change = [this](auto const&... arguments) {
        if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the()) {
            push_state_to_ui();
            ui->async_view_loading_state_change(view_id(), arguments...);
        }
    };

    on_top_level_navigation_commit = [this] {
        if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the()) {
            push_state_to_ui();
            ui->async_view_top_level_navigation_commit(view_id());
        }
    };

    on_browser_history_traversal_complete = [this] {
        if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the()) {
            push_state_to_ui();
            ui->async_view_browser_history_traversal_complete(view_id());
        }
    };

    on_cursor_change = [this](auto const&... arguments) {
        if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the()) {
            push_state_to_ui();
            ui->async_view_cursor_change(view_id(), arguments...);
        }
    };

    on_input_method_state_change = [this] {
        if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the()) {
            push_state_to_ui();
            ui->async_view_input_method_state_change(view_id());
        }
    };

    on_enter_tooltip_area = [this](auto const&... arguments) {
        if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the()) {
            push_state_to_ui();
            ui->async_view_enter_tooltip_area(view_id(), arguments...);
        }
    };

    on_leave_tooltip_area = [this] {
        if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the()) {

    on_request_alert = [this](auto const&... arguments) {
        if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the()) {

            ui->async_view_request_alert(view_id(), arguments...);

        if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the()) {

        if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the()) {

    on_before_browser_initiated_navigation = [this] {
        if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the()) {

        if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the()) {

    on_request_website_issue_report = [this] {
        if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the()) {

    on_request_screenshot = [this] {

    on_accessibility_tree_received = [this](auto const&... arguments) {

ViewState View::current_state() const
{
    ViewState state;
    state.url = url();
    state.displayed_url = displayed_url();
    state.title = title();
    state.handle = handle();
    state.is_loading = is_loading();
    state.zoom_level = zoom_level();
    state.can_navigate_back = can_navigate_back();
    state.can_navigate_forward = can_navigate_forward();
    state.is_node_picker_active = is_node_picker_active();
    if (has_traversable()) {
        auto& translation = const_cast<View&>(*this).page_translation();
        state.is_translated = translation.is_translated();
        state.translation_offered = translation.is_offered();
        for (auto const& target : translation.target_languages()) {
            state.translation_targets.append({
                .language = target.language,
                .needs_download = target.needs_download,
                .faster_after_download = target.faster_after_download,
                .higher_quality_available = target.higher_quality_available,
                .downloading = target.downloading,
                .languages_to_download = target.languages_to_download,
            });
        }
        state.translation_target_language = translation.target_language();
        state.translation_prefers_higher_quality = Application::settings().translation_prefers_higher_quality();
    }
    state.input_method_state = input_method_state();
    state.page_mute_state = page_mute_state();
    state.plays_audio_indicator_visible = tab_indicator_visible(WebView::TabIndicator::PlayingAudio);
    state.uses_location_indicator_visible = tab_indicator_visible(WebView::TabIndicator::UsingLocation);
    state.uses_microphone_indicator_visible = tab_indicator_visible(WebView::TabIndicator::UsingMicrophone);
    state.page_background_color = page_background_color();
    state.crash_overlay_active = crash_overlay_active();
    state.crash_report_name = crash_report_name();
    state.crash_report_website = crash_report_website();
    state.crash_overlay_failed_url = crash_overlay_failed_url();
    state.crash_overlay_is_for_memory_limit = crash_overlay_is_for_memory_limit();
    state.host_for_settings = current_host_for_settings();
    state.can_report_website_issue = can_report_website_issue();
    state.can_undo = can_undo();
    state.can_redo = can_redo();
    state.permission_origin = permission_origin();
    if (has_traversable()) {
        state.content_blocking_snapshot = content_blocking_snapshot();
        state.site_permission_rows = site_permission_rows();
        state.can_view_source = can_view_source();
        if (auto page = traversable().display_page(); page && page->is_open())
            state.web_content_pid = web_content_pid();
    }
    return state;
}

void View::push_state_to_ui()
{
    auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the();
    if (!ui || !has_traversable())
        return;

    auto state = current_state();

    // Most of what a view reports changes nothing about the state, so only say something if it changed.
    IPC::MessageBuffer buffer;
    IPC::Encoder encoder { buffer };
    MUST(encoder.encode(state));
    auto encoded_state = MUST(ByteBuffer::copy(buffer.data().span()));
    if (encoded_state == m_last_state_pushed_to_ui)
        return;
    m_last_state_pushed_to_ui = move(encoded_state);

    ui->async_view_state_changed(view_id(), move(state));
}

void View::did_accept_presented_backing_store(i32 bitmap_id, Gfx::IntRect damage_rect)
{
    if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the())
        ui->async_view_accept_presented_backing_store(view_id(), bitmap_id, damage_rect);
}

void View::did_create_remote_layer(Compositing::RemoteLayerHostHandle host_handle)
{
    m_ui_hosts_remote_layer = host_handle.kind != Compositing::RemoteLayerHostKind::None;
    m_ui_awaits_first_frame_in_remote_layer = m_ui_hosts_remote_layer;
    if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the())
        ui->async_view_set_remote_layer(view_id(), host_handle);
}

// The UI shows the backing stores it was given, as when a page from another process comes to display the tab, until it
// hears of a frame shown in the remote layer again.
void View::did_install_backing_stores_in_ui()
{
    m_ui_awaits_first_frame_in_remote_layer = m_ui_hosts_remote_layer;
}

void View::did_present_frame_in_remote_layer(Gfx::IntSize size, double device_pixel_ratio)
{
    if (!exchange(m_ui_awaits_first_frame_in_remote_layer, false) && !m_wants_frame_notifications)
        return;
    if (auto* ui = ConnectionFromUI::the())
        ui->async_view_did_present_frame_in_remote_layer(view_id(), size, device_pixel_ratio);
}

class View final : public WebView::ViewImplementation {

    struct InitialState {

    void push_state_to_ui();

    void set_system_theme(Core::AnonymousBuffer);
    void set_screen_rects(ScreenRects);
    void set_wants_frame_notifications(bool wants_frame_notifications) { m_wants_frame_notifications = wants_frame_notifications; }
    void did_install_backing_stores_in_ui();

    using ViewImplementation::microphone_authorizer;
    using ViewImplementation::rect_fitting_frame;
    using ViewImplementation::set_page_background_color_to_system_canvas;

    // ^WebView::ViewImplementation

    virtual Core::AnonymousBuffer system_theme() override { return m_system_theme; }
    virtual Optional<ScreenRects> screen_rects() const override { return m_screen_rects; }
    virtual void update_zoom() override;
    virtual void did_change_state() override { push_state_to_ui(); }
    virtual bool supports_discarding() const override { return m_is_tab; }
    virtual void did_request_discard() override;
    virtual Web::DevicePixelSize viewport_size() const override { return m_viewport_size; }
    virtual Gfx::IntPoint to_content_position(Gfx::IntPoint widget_position) const override { return widget_position; }
    virtual Gfx::IntPoint to_widget_position(Gfx::IntPoint content_position) const override { return content_position; }

    virtual void read_clipboard_item(Function<void(Web::Clipboard::SystemClipboardItem)>) const override;
    virtual void did_accept_presented_backing_store(i32 bitmap_id, Gfx::IntRect damage_rect) override;
    // NB: The UI hands a backing store back, once it no longer shows what is in it.
    virtual void release_backing_store(i32) override { }

    virtual void did_hold_synchronized_resize_frame(u64 token) override;

    Optional<ScreenRects> m_screen_rects;
    Web::DevicePixelSize m_viewport_size;
    bool m_websites_prefer_dark { false };
    bool m_is_tab { true };

    // What the view waits to hear from the user, through the UI.
    HashMap<u64, Function<void(bool)>> m_pending_answers;
    HashMap<u64, WebView::PermissionPromptCallback> m_pending_permission_answers;
    u64 m_next_answer_id { 1 };
};
