 */

#include <AK/ScopeGuard.h>
#include <LibCore/Notifier.h>
#include <RequestServer/AIA.h>
#include <RequestServer/CURL.h>
#include <RequestServer/ConnectionFromClient.h>
#include <RequestServer/Request.h>
#include <RequestServer/Resolver.h>
#include <RequestServer/WebSocketImplCurl.h>

namespace RequestServer {

static constexpr long s_connect_timeout_seconds = 90L;

NonnullRefPtr<WebSocketImplCurl> WebSocketImplCurl::create(CURLM* multi_handle, IsPrivate is_private)
{
    return adopt_ref(*new WebSocketImplCurl(multi_handle, is_private));
}

WebSocketImplCurl::WebSocketImplCurl(CURLM* multi_handle, IsPrivate is_private)
    : m_multi_handle(multi_handle)
    , m_aia_collector(make_ref_counted<AIACollector>(is_private))
{
}

WebSocketImplCurl::~WebSocketImplCurl()
{
    if (m_read_notifier)
        m_read_notifier->close();
    if (m_write_notifier)
        m_write_notifier->close();
    if (m_error_notifier)
        m_error_notifier->close();

    if (m_easy_handle) {
        curl_multi_remove_handle(m_multi_handle, m_easy_handle);
        curl_easy_cleanup(m_easy_handle);
    }

    for (auto* list : m_curl_string_lists) {
        curl_slist_free_all(list);
    }
}

void WebSocketImplCurl::connect(WebSocket::ConnectionInfo const& info)
{
    VERIFY(!m_easy_handle);
    VERIFY(on_connected);
    VERIFY(on_connection_error);
    VERIFY(on_ready_to_read);

    m_easy_handle = curl_easy_init();
    VERIFY(m_easy_handle); // FIXME: Allow failure, and return ENOMEM

    auto set_option = [this](auto option, auto value) -> bool {
        auto result = curl_easy_setopt(m_easy_handle, option, value);
        if (result == CURLE_OK)
            return true;
        dbgln("WebSocketImplCurl::connect: Failed to set curl option {}={}: {}", to_underlying(option), value, curl_easy_strerror(result));
        return false;
    };

    set_option(CURLOPT_PRIVATE, reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(this) | websocket_private_tag);
    set_option(CURLOPT_WS_OPTIONS, CURLWS_RAW_MODE);
    set_option(CURLOPT_CONNECT_ONLY, 2); // WebSocket mode

    // FIXME: Add a header function to validate the Sec-WebSocket headers that curl currently doesn't validate

    auto const& url = info.url();

    // Prevent curl from sending URL credentials in the handshake.
    auto url_without_credentials = url;
    url_without_credentials.set_username(""sv);
    url_without_credentials.set_password(""sv);
    set_option(CURLOPT_URL, url_without_credentials.to_byte_string().characters());
    set_option(CURLOPT_DISALLOW_USERNAME_IN_URL, 1L);
    set_option(CURLOPT_PORT, url.port_or_default());
    set_option(CURLOPT_PROTOCOLS_STR, "ws,wss");
    set_option(CURLOPT_CONNECTTIMEOUT, s_connect_timeout_seconds);
    set_option(CURLOPT_PROXY, m_proxy.has_value() ? m_proxy->to_curl_url().characters() : "");

    if (auto root_certs = info.root_certificates_path(); root_certs.has_value())
        set_option(CURLOPT_CAINFO, root_certs->characters());
    m_aia_collector->host = url.serialized_host().to_byte_string();
    m_aia_collector->port = url.port_or_default();
    if (configure_certificate_verification(m_easy_handle, *m_aia_collector) != CURLE_OK) {
        on_connection_error();
        return;
    }

    auto const origin_header = ByteString::formatted("Origin: {}", info.origin());
    curl_slist* curl_headers = curl_slist_append(nullptr, origin_header.characters());

    for (auto const& [name, value] : info.headers().headers()) {
        // curl will discard headers with empty values unless we pass the header name followed by a semicolon.
        ByteString header_string;
        if (value.is_empty())
            header_string = ByteString::formatted("{};", name);
        else
            header_string = ByteString::formatted("{}: {}", name, value);
        curl_headers = curl_slist_append(curl_headers, header_string.characters());
    }

    if (auto const& protocols = info.protocols(); !protocols.is_empty()) {
        StringBuilder protocol_builder;
        protocol_builder.append("Sec-WebSocket-Protocol: "sv);
        protocol_builder.append(ByteString::join(","sv, protocols));
        curl_headers = curl_slist_append(curl_headers, protocol_builder.to_byte_string().characters());
    }

    if (auto const& extensions = info.extensions(); !extensions.is_empty()) {
        StringBuilder protocol_builder;
        protocol_builder.append("Sec-WebSocket-Extensions: "sv);
        protocol_builder.append(ByteString::join(","sv, extensions));
        curl_headers = curl_slist_append(curl_headers, protocol_builder.to_byte_string().characters());
    }

    set_option(CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, curl_headers);
    m_curl_string_lists.append(curl_headers);

    curl_slist* resolve_list = nullptr;
    if (auto const& dns_info = info.dns_result(); dns_info.has_value())
        resolve_list = curl_slist_append(resolve_list, build_curl_resolve_list(*dns_info, url.serialized_host(), url.port_or_default()).characters());
    if (auto proxy_entry = curl_resolve_entry_for_proxy(m_proxy); proxy_entry.has_value())
        resolve_list = curl_slist_append(resolve_list, proxy_entry->characters());
    if (resolve_list) {
        set_option(CURLOPT_RESOLVE, resolve_list);
        m_curl_string_lists.append(resolve_list);
    }

    CURLMcode const err = curl_multi_add_handle(m_multi_handle, m_easy_handle);
    VERIFY(err == CURLM_OK);
}

ErrorOr<ByteBuffer> WebSocketImplCurl::read(int max_size)
{
    auto buffer = TRY(ByteBuffer::create_uninitialized(max_size));
    auto const read_bytes = TRY(m_read_buffer.read_some(buffer));
    return buffer.slice(0, read_bytes.size());
}

bool WebSocketImplCurl::send(ReadonlyBytes bytes)
{
    if (auto const error = m_pending_write_buffer.try_append(bytes); error.is_error()) {
        dbgln("Failed to queue WebSocket write: {}", error.error());
        on_connection_error();
        return false;
    }

    if (flush_pending_write_buffer())
        return true;

    on_connection_error();
    return false;
}

bool WebSocketImplCurl::eof()
{
    return m_read_buffer.is_eof();
}

void WebSocketImplCurl::discard_connection()
{
    if (m_read_notifier) {
        m_read_notifier->close();
        m_read_notifier = nullptr;
    }
    if (m_write_notifier) {
        m_write_notifier->close();
        m_write_notifier = nullptr;
    }
    if (m_error_notifier) {
        m_error_notifier->close();
        m_error_notifier = nullptr;
    }
    if (m_easy_handle) {
        curl_multi_remove_handle(m_multi_handle, m_easy_handle);
        curl_easy_cleanup(m_easy_handle);
        m_easy_handle = nullptr;
    }
    m_pending_write_buffer.clear();
    m_pending_write_buffer_offset = 0;
}

void WebSocketImplCurl::read_from_socket()
{
    bool received_data = false;

    // "Wait on the socket only if curl_easy_recv returns CURLE_AGAIN. The reason for this is libcurl or the SSL
    // library may internally cache some data, therefore you should call curl_easy_recv until all data is read which
    // would include any cached data."
    for (;;) {
        u8 buffer[65536];
        size_t nread = 0;
        CURLcode const result = curl_easy_recv(m_easy_handle, buffer, sizeof(buffer), &nread);
        if (result == CURLE_AGAIN)
            break;

        if (result != CURLE_OK) {
            dbgln("Failed to read from WebSocket: {}", curl_easy_strerror(result));
            // Process any successfully buffered data (e.g., the server's close frame) before reporting the error. This
            // handles cases where the server drops the connection immediately after sending the close frame, causing a
            // subsequent curl_easy_recv call to fail.
            if (received_data)
                on_ready_to_read();
            on_connection_error();
            return;
        }

        // "Reading exactly 0 bytes indicates a closed connection." which
        // may be part of the closing handshake

        received_data = true;
        if (0 == nread)
            break;

        add_network_usage(nread, 0);
        if (auto const err = m_read_buffer.write_until_depleted({ buffer, nread }); err.is_error()) {
            on_connection_error();
            return;
        }
    }

    if (received_data)
        on_ready_to_read();
}

bool WebSocketImplCurl::flush_pending_write_buffer()
{
    // Reported once per flush, as each report becomes a message to the client.
    size_t written = 0;
    ScopeGuard report_written_bytes = [&] {
        if (written == 0)
            return;
        add_network_usage(0, written);
        if (on_bytes_written)
            on_bytes_written(written);
    };

    while (m_pending_write_buffer_offset < m_pending_write_buffer.size()) {
        auto pending_bytes = m_pending_write_buffer.bytes().slice(m_pending_write_buffer_offset);

        size_t sent = 0;
        auto const result = curl_easy_send(m_easy_handle, pending_bytes.data(), pending_bytes.size(), &sent);
        if (result != CURLE_OK && result != CURLE_AGAIN) {
            dbgln("Failed to send to WebSocket: {}", curl_easy_strerror(result));
            return false;
        }

        m_pending_write_buffer_offset += sent;
        written += sent;
        if (sent > 0)
            continue;

        if (result == CURLE_AGAIN) {
            if (m_write_notifier)
                m_write_notifier->set_enabled(true);
            return true;
        }

        dbgln("Failed to make progress sending to WebSocket");
        return false;
    }

    m_pending_write_buffer.clear();
    m_pending_write_buffer_offset = 0;
    if (m_write_notifier)
        m_write_notifier->set_enabled(false);
    return true;
}

void WebSocketImplCurl::add_network_usage(u64 download_bytes, u64 upload_bytes) const
{
    auto usage = m_performance_origin;
    usage.download_bytes = download_bytes;
    usage.upload_bytes = upload_bytes;
    Request::add_network_usage(usage);
}

bool WebSocketImplCurl::did_connect()
{
    // NB: curl can finish the transfer successfully when the server closes the connection without sending a response
    //     to the opening handshake. Only a 101 response completes the handshake.
    long response_code = 0;
    if (curl_easy_getinfo(m_easy_handle, CURLINFO_RESPONSE_CODE, &response_code) != CURLE_OK || response_code != 101)
        return false;

    curl_socket_t socket_fd = CURL_SOCKET_BAD;
    auto res = curl_easy_getinfo(m_easy_handle, CURLINFO_ACTIVESOCKET, &socket_fd);
    if (res != CURLE_OK || socket_fd == CURL_SOCKET_BAD)
        return false;

    m_read_notifier = Core::Notifier::construct(socket_fd, Core::Notifier::Type::Read);
    m_read_notifier->on_activation = [this] {
        read_from_socket();
    };
    m_write_notifier = Core::Notifier::construct(socket_fd, Core::Notifier::Type::Write);
    m_write_notifier->on_activation = [this] {
        if (!flush_pending_write_buffer())
            on_connection_error();
    };
    m_write_notifier->set_enabled(false);
    m_error_notifier = Core::Notifier::construct(socket_fd, Core::Notifier::Type::Error | Core::Notifier::Type::HangUp);
    m_error_notifier->on_activation = [this] {
        on_connection_error();
    };

    on_connected();

    // There may be data waiting for us already (e.g. if the server sends us data immediately upon opening a WebSocket),
    // so try reading immediately.
    read_from_socket();

    return true;
}

}

#include <LibMediaCodecs/FFmpeg/FFmpegFunctions.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/FFmpeg/SystemFFmpeg.h>
#include <LibPlatformFeatures/Build.h>
#include <SystemProbe/FFmpegDescription.h>

static PlatformFeatures::FFmpegFacts describe_ffmpeg(Media::FFmpeg::FFmpegFunctions const& functions, bool shares_bundled_struct_layouts)
{
    return {
        .avcodec_version = functions.avcodec_version(),
        .avutil_version = functions.avutil_version(),
        .shares_bundled_struct_layouts = shares_bundled_struct_layouts,
    };
}

PlatformFeatures::FFmpegFacts describe_bundled_ffmpeg()
{
    return describe_ffmpeg(Media::FFmpeg::FFmpegFunctions::bundled(), true);
}

Optional<PlatformFeatures::FFmpegFacts> describe_system_ffmpeg()
{
    if constexpr (PlatformFeatures::this_build.has_system_ffmpeg) {
        Media::FFmpeg::SystemFFmpeg::load();
        if (auto const* system_ffmpeg = Media::FFmpeg::SystemFFmpeg::the())
            return describe_ffmpeg(system_ffmpeg->functions(), system_ffmpeg->shares_bundled_struct_layouts());
    }
    return {};
}

FILE: Services/SystemProbe/main.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.

#include <LibCore/ArgsParser.h>
#include <LibCore/File.h>
#include <LibGfx/GpuDeviceIdentity.h>
#include <LibMain/Main.h>
#include <LibPlatformFeatures/Build.h>
#include <LibPlatformFeatures/SystemFacts.h>
#include <SystemProbe/FFmpegDescription.h>
#include <SystemProbe/OpenSSLDescription.h>
#include <SystemProbe/VulkanDescription.h>

// Describes the system for the Browser's feature blocklist and its warnings about the system, and exits. It takes
// nothing but its arguments and writes nothing but its report, so that it can run with the GPU driver loaded and no
// sandbox.

ErrorOr<int> ladybird_main(Main::Arguments arguments)
{
    StringView gpu_device;

    Core::ArgsParser args_parser;
    args_parser.add_option(gpu_device, "The GPU that presents, as the presentation identifies it", "gpu-device", 0, "identity");
    args_parser.parse(arguments);

    Optional<Gfx::GpuDeviceIdentity> preferred_device;
    if (!gpu_device.is_empty()) {
        preferred_device = Gfx::GpuDeviceIdentity::from_string(gpu_device);
        if (!preferred_device.has_value())
            return Error::from_string_literal("Malformed GPU device identity");
    }

    PlatformFeatures::SystemFacts facts;
    if constexpr (PlatformFeatures::this_build.paints_through_vulkan)
        facts.gpu = describe_gpu_through_vulkan(preferred_device);
    if constexpr (PlatformFeatures::this_build.decodes_video_through_vulkan()) {
        facts.bundled_ffmpeg = describe_bundled_ffmpeg();
        facts.system_ffmpeg = describe_system_ffmpeg();
    }
    facts.openssl = describe_openssl();

    auto report = facts.to_json().serialized();
    auto output = TRY(Core::File::standard_output());
    TRY(output->write_until_depleted(report.bytes()));

    // Closing the output ends the report, so the Browser does not wait for the driver to unload as the probe exits.
    output->close();
    return 0;
}

FILE: Services/SystemProbe/OpenSSLDescription.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <AK/Format.h>
#include <SystemProbe/OpenSSLDescription.h>
#include <curl/curl.h>
#include <openssl/crypto.h>
#include <string.h>

PlatformFeatures::OpenSSLFacts describe_openssl()
{
    PlatformFeatures::OpenSSLFacts facts;
    facts.linked_version = MUST(String::formatted("{}.{}.{}", OPENSSL_version_major(), OPENSSL_version_minor(), OPENSSL_version_patch()));

    // A MultiSSL curl only settles on its backend once initialized, so it's initialized the way RequestServer does it
    // before being asked which one that is.
    if (auto result = curl_global_init(CURL_GLOBAL_ALL); result != CURLE_OK) {
        warnln("curl_global_init failed: {}", curl_easy_strerror(result));
        return facts;
    }

    auto const* version_info = curl_version_info(CURLVERSION_NOW);
    if (version_info && version_info->ssl_version) {
        if (auto version = PlatformFeatures::OpenSSLFacts::openssl_version_from_curl_ssl_version({ version_info->ssl_version, strlen(version_info->ssl_version) }); version.has_value())
            facts.curl_version = MUST(String::from_utf8(*version));
    }
    curl_global_cleanup();
    return facts;
}

FILE: Services/SystemProbe/VulkanDescription.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <LibPlatformFeatures/Build.h>
#include <SystemProbe/VulkanDescription.h>
#include <SystemProbe/VulkanVideoDescription.h>
#include <string.h>

static String string_from_driver(char const* characters, size_t capacity)
{
    return String::from_utf8_with_replacement_character({ characters, strnlen(characters, capacity) });
}

Optional<PlatformFeatures::GpuFacts> describe_gpu_through_vulkan(Optional<Gfx::GpuDeviceIdentity> const& preferred_device)
{
    VkApplicationInfo application_info {};
    application_info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_APPLICATION_INFO;
    application_info.pApplicationName = "Ladybird";
    application_info.apiVersion = VK_API_VERSION_1_3;

    VkInstanceCreateInfo instance_info {};
    instance_info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_INSTANCE_CREATE_INFO;
    instance_info.pApplicationInfo = &application_info;

    // The instance is never destroyed, since tearing the driver down only delays the exit.
    VkInstance instance = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    if (vkCreateInstance(&instance_info, nullptr, &instance) != VK_SUCCESS)
        return {};

    auto physical_device = Gfx::pick_physical_device(instance, preferred_device);
    if (physical_device.is_error())
        return {};

    VkPhysicalDeviceProperties basic_properties;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties(physical_device.value(), &basic_properties);

    VkPhysicalDeviceDriverProperties driver_properties {};
    driver_properties.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_DRIVER_PROPERTIES;
    VkPhysicalDeviceProperties2 properties {};
    properties.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_PROPERTIES_2;
    // Drivers describe themselves from Vulkan 1.2.
    if (basic_properties.apiVersion >= VK_API_VERSION_1_2)
        properties.pNext = &driver_properties;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties2(physical_device.value(), &properties);

    PlatformFeatures::GpuFacts gpu;
    gpu.vendor_id = properties.properties.vendorID;
    gpu.device_id = properties.properties.deviceID;
    gpu.device_name = string_from_driver(properties.properties.deviceName, sizeof(properties.properties.deviceName));
    gpu.driver_id = driver_properties.driverID;
    gpu.driver_name = string_from_driver(driver_properties.driverName, sizeof(driver_properties.driverName));
    gpu.driver_info = string_from_driver(driver_properties.driverInfo, sizeof(driver_properties.driverInfo));
    gpu.driver_version = properties.properties.driverVersion;
    gpu.api_version = properties.properties.apiVersion;
    gpu.device_identity = MUST(String::from_byte_string(Gfx::gpu_device_identity_of(physical_device.value()).to_byte_string()));
    gpu.supports_ycbcr_sampling = Gfx::device_can_sample_through_ycbcr_conversion(physical_device.value());
    if constexpr (PlatformFeatures::this_build.decodes_video_through_vulkan())
        describe_video_decoding_through_vulkan(gpu, instance, physical_device.value());
    else
        gpu.cannot_decode_video_because = "Video is not decoded through Vulkan on this platform"_string;
    return gpu;
}

FILE: Services/SystemProbe/VulkanVideoDescription.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <AK/AnyOf.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/Vulkan/VulkanVideoDevice.h>
#include <SystemProbe/VulkanVideoDescription.h>

struct VideoDecodeQuery {
    VkPhysicalDevice physical_device { VK_NULL_HANDLE };
    Vector<VkExtensionProperties> extensions;
    PFN_vkGetPhysicalDeviceVideoCapabilitiesKHR get_capabilities { nullptr };
    PFN_vkGetPhysicalDeviceVideoFormatPropertiesKHR get_formats { nullptr };
};

// Asks about the codec's 8-bit 4:2:0 profile, which every stream the decoders take in that codec can be decoded under.
static PlatformFeatures::VideoDecodeFacts describe_video_decoding(VideoDecodeQuery const& query, StringView extension, VkVideoCodecOperationFlagBitsKHR operation, void* codec_profile, void* codec_capabilities)
{
    PlatformFeatures::VideoDecodeFacts facts;
    auto has_extension = any_of(query.extensions, [&](auto const& properties) { return StringView { properties.extensionName, strlen(properties.extensionName) } == extension; });
    if (!has_extension || query.get_capabilities == nullptr || query.get_formats == nullptr)
        return facts;

    VkVideoProfileInfoKHR profile {};
    profile.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_VIDEO_PROFILE_INFO_KHR;
    profile.pNext = codec_profile;
    profile.videoCodecOperation = operation;
    profile.chromaSubsampling = VK_VIDEO_CHROMA_SUBSAMPLING_420_BIT_KHR;
    profile.lumaBitDepth = VK_VIDEO_COMPONENT_BIT_DEPTH_8_BIT_KHR;
    profile.chromaBitDepth = VK_VIDEO_COMPONENT_BIT_DEPTH_8_BIT_KHR;

    VkVideoDecodeCapabilitiesKHR decode_capabilities {};
    decode_capabilities.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_VIDEO_DECODE_CAPABILITIES_KHR;
    decode_capabilities.pNext = codec_capabilities;
    VkVideoCapabilitiesKHR capabilities {};
    capabilities.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_VIDEO_CAPABILITIES_KHR;
    capabilities.pNext = &decode_capabilities;
    if (query.get_capabilities(query.physical_device, &profile, &capabilities) != VK_SUCCESS)
        return facts;

    facts.supported = true;
    facts.dpb_and_output_coincide = (decode_capabilities.flags & VK_VIDEO_DECODE_CAPABILITY_DPB_AND_OUTPUT_COINCIDE_BIT_KHR) != 0;
    facts.dpb_and_output_distinct = (decode_capabilities.flags & VK_VIDEO_DECODE_CAPABILITY_DPB_AND_OUTPUT_DISTINCT_BIT_KHR) != 0;

    VkVideoProfileListInfoKHR profile_list {};
    profile_list.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_VIDEO_PROFILE_LIST_INFO_KHR;
    profile_list.profileCount = 1;
    profile_list.pProfiles = &profile;
    VkPhysicalDeviceVideoFormatInfoKHR format_info {};
    format_info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VIDEO_FORMAT_INFO_KHR;
    format_info.pNext = &profile_list;
    format_info.imageUsage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_VIDEO_DECODE_DPB_BIT_KHR;
    u32 format_count = 0;
    if (query.get_formats(query.physical_device, &format_info, &format_count, nullptr) != VK_SUCCESS)
        return facts;
    Vector<VkVideoFormatPropertiesKHR> formats;
    formats.resize(format_count);
    for (auto& format : formats)
        format.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_VIDEO_FORMAT_PROPERTIES_KHR;
    if (query.get_formats(query.physical_device, &format_info, &format_count, formats.data()) != VK_SUCCESS)
        return facts;
    facts.dpb_supports_drm_format_modifiers = any_of(formats, [](auto const& format) { return format.imageTiling == VK_IMAGE_TILING_DRM_FORMAT_MODIFIER_EXT; });
    return facts;
}

void describe_video_decoding_through_vulkan(PlatformFeatures::GpuFacts& gpu, VkInstance instance, VkPhysicalDevice physical_device)
{
    if (auto result = Media::VulkanVideoDevice::check_can_decode_video(physical_device); result.is_error()) {
        gpu.cannot_decode_video_because = MUST(String::from_utf8(result.error().string_literal()));
        return;
    }

    gpu.supports_video_maintenance2 = Media::VulkanVideoDevice::supports_video_maintenance2(physical_device);

    VideoDecodeQuery query;
    query.physical_device = physical_device;
    u32 extension_count = 0;
    vkEnumerateDeviceExtensionProperties(physical_device, nullptr, &extension_count, nullptr);
    query.extensions.resize(extension_count);
    vkEnumerateDeviceExtensionProperties(physical_device, nullptr, &extension_count, query.extensions.data());
    query.get_capabilities = reinterpret_cast<PFN_vkGetPhysicalDeviceVideoCapabilitiesKHR>(vkGetInstanceProcAddr(instance, "vkGetPhysicalDeviceVideoCapabilitiesKHR"));
    query.get_formats = reinterpret_cast<PFN_vkGetPhysicalDeviceVideoFormatPropertiesKHR>(vkGetInstanceProcAddr(instance, "vkGetPhysicalDeviceVideoFormatPropertiesKHR"));

    VkVideoDecodeH264ProfileInfoKHR h264_profile {};
    h264_profile.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_VIDEO_DECODE_H264_PROFILE_INFO_KHR;
    h264_profile.stdProfileIdc = STD_VIDEO_H264_PROFILE_IDC_HIGH;
    h264_profile.pictureLayout = VK_VIDEO_DECODE_H264_PICTURE_LAYOUT_PROGRESSIVE_KHR;
    VkVideoDecodeH264CapabilitiesKHR h264_capabilities {};
    h264_capabilities.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_VIDEO_DECODE_H264_CAPABILITIES_KHR;
    gpu.h264 = describe_video_decoding(query, VK_KHR_VIDEO_DECODE_H264_EXTENSION_NAME ""sv, VK_VIDEO_CODEC_OPERATION_DECODE_H264_BIT_KHR, &h264_profile, &h264_capabilities);

    VkVideoDecodeH265ProfileInfoKHR h265_profile {};
    h265_profile.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_VIDEO_DECODE_H265_PROFILE_INFO_KHR;
    h265_profile.stdProfileIdc = STD_VIDEO_H265_PROFILE_IDC_MAIN;
    VkVideoDecodeH265CapabilitiesKHR h265_capabilities {};
    h265_capabilities.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_VIDEO_DECODE_H265_CAPABILITIES_KHR;
    gpu.h265 = describe_video_decoding(query, VK_KHR_VIDEO_DECODE_H265_EXTENSION_NAME ""sv, VK_VIDEO_CODEC_OPERATION_DECODE_H265_BIT_KHR, &h265_profile, &h265_capabilities);

    VkVideoDecodeVP9ProfileInfoKHR vp9_profile {};
    vp9_profile.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_VIDEO_DECODE_VP9_PROFILE_INFO_KHR;
    vp9_profile.stdProfile = STD_VIDEO_VP9_PROFILE_0;
    VkVideoDecodeVP9CapabilitiesKHR vp9_capabilities {};
    vp9_capabilities.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_VIDEO_DECODE_VP9_CAPABILITIES_KHR;
    gpu.vp9 = describe_video_decoding(query, VK_KHR_VIDEO_DECODE_VP9_EXTENSION_NAME ""sv, VK_VIDEO_CODEC_OPERATION_DECODE_VP9_BIT_KHR, &vp9_profile, &vp9_capabilities);

    VkVideoDecodeAV1ProfileInfoKHR av1_profile {};
    av1_profile.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_VIDEO_DECODE_AV1_PROFILE_INFO_KHR;
    av1_profile.stdProfile = STD_VIDEO_AV1_PROFILE_MAIN;
    VkVideoDecodeAV1CapabilitiesKHR av1_capabilities {};
    av1_capabilities.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_VIDEO_DECODE_AV1_CAPABILITIES_KHR;
    gpu.av1 = describe_video_decoding(query, VK_KHR_VIDEO_DECODE_AV1_EXTENSION_NAME ""sv, VK_VIDEO_CODEC_OPERATION_DECODE_AV1_BIT_KHR, &av1_profile, &av1_capabilities);
}

FILE: Services/VideoDecoderServer/ControlConnection.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <LibCore/Process.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/VideoDecoderServerConnection.h>
#include <VideoDecoderServer/ControlConnection.h>

namespace VideoDecoderServer {

ControlConnection::ControlConnection(NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport> transport, ReadonlySpan<Media::VideoDecoderRegistration> hosted_decoders)
    : IPC::ConnectionFromClient<VideoDecoderServerControlClientEndpoint, VideoDecoderServerControlEndpoint>(*this, move(transport), 0)
    , m_hosted_decoders(hosted_decoders)
{
}

ControlConnection::~ControlConnection() = default;

void ControlConnection::die()
{
    Core::Process::terminate_immediately(0);
}

Messages::VideoDecoderServerControl::ConnectNewClientResponse ControlConnection::connect_new_client()
{
    if (m_client) {
        did_misbehave("The video decoder server serves only one client");
        return OptionalNone {};
    }

    auto paired_transports = IPC::Transport::create_paired();
    if (paired_transports.is_error()) {
        dbgln("Failed to connect a video decoder client: {}", paired_transports.error());
        return OptionalNone {};
    }

    // Once its client is gone, the server has nothing left to do.
    m_client = Media::VideoDecoderServerConnection::construct(move(paired_transports.value().local), m_hosted_decoders);
    m_client->on_death = [] {
        Core::Process::terminate_immediately(0);
    };
    return move(paired_transports.value().remote_handle);
}

}

FILE: Services/VideoDecoderServer/ControlConnection.h
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.

 */

#pragma once

#include <LibIPC/ConnectionFromClient.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/Forward.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/VideoDecoderRegistry.h>
#include <VideoDecoderServer/VideoDecoderServerControlClientEndpoint.h>
#include <VideoDecoderServer/VideoDecoderServerControlEndpoint.h>

namespace VideoDecoderServer {

// The control plane of the VideoDecoderServer, spoken only by the Browser over the initial socket. It connects the one
// client the server serves; the server exits when either the Browser or that client goes away.
class ControlConnection final
    : public IPC::ConnectionFromClient<VideoDecoderServerControlClientEndpoint, VideoDecoderServerControlEndpoint> {
    C_OBJECT(ControlConnection);

public:
    virtual ~ControlConnection() override;

    virtual void die() override;

private:
    ControlConnection(NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport>, ReadonlySpan<Media::VideoDecoderRegistration> hosted_decoders);

    virtual Messages::VideoDecoderServerControl::ConnectNewClientResponse connect_new_client() override;

    ReadonlySpan<Media::VideoDecoderRegistration> const m_hosted_decoders;
    RefPtr<Media::VideoDecoderServerConnection> m_client;
};

}

#include <AK/Array.h>
#include <LibCore/ArgsParser.h>
#include <LibCore/CrashHandler.h>
#include <LibCore/EventLoop.h>

#include <LibMediaCodecs/FFmpeg/MallocTuning.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/HardwareVideoDecoders.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/VideoDecoderRegistry.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/Vulkan/VulkanVideoDevice.h>
#include <LibPlatformFeatures/ProcessFeatures.h>
#include <VideoDecoderServer/ControlConnection.h>
#include <VideoDecoderServer/Sandbox.h>

#if defined(AK_OS_LINUX) && !defined(AK_OS_ANDROID)
#    include <LibMediaCodecs/FFmpeg/SystemFFmpeg.h>
#endif

static Media::DecoderErrorOr<NonnullOwnPtr<Media::VideoDecoder>> create_software_video_decoder(Media::CodecID codec_id, ReadonlyBytes codec_initialization_data)
{
    return NonnullOwnPtr<Media::VideoDecoder> { TRY(Media::FFmpeg::FFmpegVideoDecoder::try_create(codec_id, codec_initialization_data)) };
}

// Software decoders belong in the MediaServer, away from the GPU access this process will have. These are only for
// exercising the path through this process where no hardware decoder is available, as in tests.
static ReadonlySpan<Media::VideoDecoderRegistration> software_video_decoders_for_testing()
{
    static Array const decoders {
        Media::VideoDecoderRegistration { Media::FFmpeg::FFmpegVideoDecoder::capabilities, create_software_video_decoder },
    };
    return decoders;
}

ErrorOr<int> ladybird_main(Main::Arguments arguments)
{
    AK::set_rich_debug_enabled(true);

    Media::FFmpeg::set_fixed_mmap_threshold();

    int crash_report_fd = -1;
    StringView stats_log_directory;
    StringView mach_server_name;
    bool wait_for_debugger = false;
    bool disable_sandbox = false;
    bool host_software_decoders = false;
    StringView gpu_device;
    StringView platform_features;

    Core::ArgsParser args_parser;
    args_parser.add_option(stats_log_directory, "Directory for process statistics logs", "stats-log-dir", 0, "directory");
    args_parser.add_option(crash_report_fd, "Descriptor for anonymous crash diagnostics", "crash-report-fd", 0, "fd");
    args_parser.add_option(mach_server_name, "Mach server name", "mach-server-name", 0, "mach_server_name");
    args_parser.add_option(wait_for_debugger, "Wait for debugger", "wait-for-debugger");
    args_parser.add_option(disable_sandbox, "Disable process sandboxing", "disable-sandbox");
    args_parser.add_option(host_software_decoders, "Host software decoders, for testing", "host-software-decoders");
    args_parser.add_option(gpu_device, "The GPU to decode on, as the Compositor identifies it", "gpu-device", 0, "identity");
    args_parser.add_option(platform_features, "The platform features the Browser decided this process may use", "platform-features", 0, "feature,...");
    args_parser.parse(arguments);

    PlatformFeatures::ProcessFeatures::initialize_for_current_process(TRY(PlatformFeatures::ProcessFeatures::from_string(PlatformFeatures::FeatureProcess::VideoDecoderServer, platform_features)));
    auto const& features = PlatformFeatures::ProcessFeatures::the();

    if (crash_report_fd >= 0) {
        if (auto result = Core::CrashHandler::initialize(crash_report_fd); result.is_error())
            warnln("Could not install crash report handler: {}", result.error());
    }

    if (wait_for_debugger)
        Core::Process::wait_for_debugger_and_break();

    if (auto result = Core::Platform::adopt_foreground_application_task_role(); result.is_error())
        warnln("Could not adopt the foreground application task role: {}", result.error());
    if (auto result = Core::Platform::set_current_thread_qos(Core::Platform::ThreadQoS::UserInitiated); result.is_error())
        warnln("Could not set main thread QoS: {}", result.error());

    auto& event_loop = Core::EventLoop::initialize_for_current_thread();
    auto stats_log = TRY(Core::StatsLog::create(stats_log_directory, "VideoDecoderServer"sv));

    Optional<Gfx::GpuDeviceIdentity> gpu_device_identity;
    if (!gpu_device.is_empty() && features.is_enabled(PlatformFeatures::Feature::VulkanVideo)) {
        gpu_device_identity = Gfx::GpuDeviceIdentity::from_string(gpu_device);
        if (!gpu_device_identity.has_value())
            return Error::from_string_literal("Malformed GPU device identity");
    }

#if defined(AK_OS_LINUX) && !defined(AK_OS_ANDROID)
    // H.264 and HEVC decode through the system library, which loads before the sandbox would keep it from reading its
    // files or making the syscalls its dependencies make.
    Media::FFmpeg::SystemFFmpeg::load();
#endif

#if defined(AK_OS_LINUX)
    if (!disable_sandbox)
        TRY(VideoDecoderServer::restrict_filesystem(gpu_device_identity.has_value()));
#endif

#ifdef USE_VULKAN_DMABUF_IMAGES
    // The driver loads before the rest of the sandbox applies. Without a device, the GPU's decoders go unused.
    if (gpu_device_identity.has_value()) {
        if (auto result = Media::VulkanVideoDevice::create_for_process(*gpu_device_identity); result.is_error())
            warnln("Could not create a Vulkan device for decoding video: {}", result.error());
    }
#endif

    Vector<Media::VideoDecoderRegistration> hosted_decoders;
    auto hardware_decoders = Media::hardware_video_decoders();
    hosted_decoders.append(hardware_decoders.data(), hardware_decoders.size());
    if (host_software_decoders) {
        auto software_decoders = software_video_decoders_for_testing();
        hosted_decoders.append(software_decoders.data(), software_decoders.size());
    }

    if (!disable_sandbox)
        TRY(VideoDecoderServer::apply_sandbox(mach_server_name));

    auto client = TRY(IPC::take_over_accepted_client_from_system_server<VideoDecoderServer::ControlConnection>(mach_server_name, hosted_decoders));

    if (stats_log)
        stats_log->start_sampling();

    return event_loop.exec();
}

[[nodiscard]] ErrorOr<void> restrict_filesystem(bool allow_gpu_driver);

/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause

#include <AK/LexicalPath.h>
#include <LibCore/System.h>
#include <LibSandbox/Sandbox.h>
#include <LibSandbox/Seccomp.h>
#include <VideoDecoderServer/Sandbox.h>

namespace VideoDecoderServer {

ErrorOr<void> restrict_filesystem(bool allow_gpu_driver)
{
    TRY(Sandbox::install_no_new_privileges());
    TRY(Sandbox::configure_runtime());

    auto executable_path = TRY(Core::System::current_executable_path());
    auto build_root = LexicalPath::dirname(LexicalPath::dirname(executable_path));

    Vector<Sandbox::PathRule> paths;
    // cpptrace opens loaded ELF objects when symbolizing in-process stack traces.
    TRY(Sandbox::add_path_if_exists(paths, executable_path, Sandbox::PathRule::Access::ReadOnly));
    TRY(Sandbox::add_path_if_exists(paths, LexicalPath::join(build_root, "lib"sv).string(), Sandbox::PathRule::Access::ReadOnly));
    TRY(Sandbox::add_loaded_library_directories(paths, build_root));
    TRY(Sandbox::add_path_if_exists(paths, "/proc/self"sv, Sandbox::PathRule::Access::ReadOnly));
    if (allow_gpu_driver)
        TRY(Sandbox::add_gpu_driver_paths(paths));

    TRY(Sandbox::restrict_filesystem(paths.span()));
    return {};
}

// FIXME: Narrow the GPU access to what decoding needs, once hardware decoders run here.
ErrorOr<void> apply_sandbox(StringView)
{
    Sandbox::SeccompPolicy policy;
    policy.allow_readonly_file_opens();
    policy.allow_filesystem_metadata_queries();
    policy.allow_file_descriptor_operations();
    policy.allow_ipc();
    policy.allow_socket_pairs();
    policy.allow_common_runtime();
    // The driver opens its device files for writing once decoding starts. Landlock limits writes to those.
    policy.allow_filesystem_writes();
    policy.allow_gpu_device_operations();
    policy.allow_executable_memory_mappings();
    policy.allow_writable_executable_memory_mappings();
    TRY(policy.install());

    return {};
}

}

/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.

 */

#include <LibCore/System.h>
#include <LibSandbox/Sandbox.h>
#include <VideoDecoderServer/Sandbox.h>

namespace VideoDecoderServer {

ErrorOr<void> apply_sandbox(StringView mach_server_name)
{
    TRY(Sandbox::configure_runtime());

    auto executable_path = TRY(Core::System::current_executable_path());

    Vector<Sandbox::SeatbeltPath> paths;
    TRY(Sandbox::add_seatbelt_path_if_exists(paths, executable_path, Sandbox::SeatbeltPath::Access::ReadOnly));

    // The platform media frameworks look up the main bundle of the process.
    if (auto bundle = Sandbox::application_bundle_for_executable(executable_path); bundle.has_value())
        TRY(Sandbox::add_seatbelt_path_if_exists(paths, *bundle, Sandbox::SeatbeltPath::Access::ReadOnly));

    return Sandbox::apply_macos_sandbox({
        .paths = paths.span(),
        .mach_server_name = mach_server_name,
        .system_services = Sandbox::SystemService::VideoDecoding | Sandbox::SystemService::IOSurface,
    });
}

}

    : IPC::ConnectionFromClient<WebContentClientEndpoint, WebContentServerEndpoint>(*this, move(transport), 1)
    , m_page_host(PageHost::create(*this))
    , m_enable_test_mode(enable_test_mode)
{
    Web::StorageAPI::set_storage_area_mirror_client(this);
}

ConnectionFromClient::~ConnectionFromClient()
{
    Web::StorageAPI::set_storage_area_mirror_client(nullptr);
}

Web::Compositor::CompositorConnection* ConnectionFromClient::compositor_process_connection() const
{
    if (!m_compositor_connection || !m_compositor_connection->is_open())
        return nullptr;
    return m_compositor_connection.ptr();
}

void ConnectionFromClient::did_destroy_compositor_context(Web::CompositorContextId context_id)
{
    async_did_destroy_compositor_context(context_id);
}

void ConnectionFromClient::die()
{
    Core::Process::terminate_immediately(0);
}

// What the main thread and each worker thread give up when the process is short of memory.
static void release_memory_of_this_thread()
{
    Web::Fetch::Fetching::clear_http_memory_cache();
    // NB: This comes last, so that what the steps before it let go of goes back to the system as well.
    GC::Heap::the().collect_garbage_and_return_memory_to_system();
}

// The browser asks for this when the process is near its memory limit, or when its tabs were hidden for a while. The
// process gives up everything it can work without. What it gives up may cost time to make again.
void ConnectionFromClient::release_memory()
{
    // NB: The browser asks for more than one reason, and one release serves all requests that wait for it.
    static bool is_pending = false;
    if (is_pending)
        return;
    is_pending = true;

    Web::CSS::StyleScope::release_kept_data();
    Web::CSS::StyleScope::release_shaped_texts();

    WebWorker::post_to_worker_threads(release_memory_of_this_thread);
    // NB: This is deferred so that garbage collection runs with as little on the stack as possible.
    Core::deferred_invoke([] {
        is_pending = false;
        release_memory_of_this_thread();
    });
}

void ConnectionFromClient::set_font_service(IPC::TransportHandle handle, IPC::File catalog, u64 catalog_size, u64 generation)
{
    auto* font_provider = MUST(Compositing::install_font_service(move(handle), move(catalog), catalog_size, generation));
    Web::Platform::FontPlugin::install(*new Web::Platform::FontPlugin(m_enable_test_mode, font_provider));
}

void ConnectionFromClient::initialize(Web::PageId initial_page_id, Vector<Web::HTML::RemoteNavigableDescriptor> remote_navigables, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId root_navigable_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessIdAllocator cross_process_id_allocator, Web::HTML::SessionHistoryEntryDescriptor initial_history_entry, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId initial_document_id, Web::HTML::VisibilityState system_visibility_state)
{
    m_page_host->initialize(initial_page_id, move(remote_navigables), root_navigable_id, cross_process_id_allocator, move(initial_history_entry), initial_document_id, system_visibility_state);
}

void ConnectionFromClient::create_representing_page(Web::PageId page_id, Vector<Web::HTML::RemoteNavigableDescriptor> remote_navigables)
{
    auto& page = m_page_host->create_page(page_id);
    page.page().create_remote_navigable_graph(move(remote_navigables));
}

void ConnectionFromClient::create_embedded_page(Web::PageId page_id, Vector<Web::HTML::RemoteNavigableDescriptor> remote_navigables, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId root_navigable_id, Web::HTML::SessionHistoryEntryDescriptor initial_history_entry, Web::HTML::VisibilityState system_visibility_state)
{
    auto& page = m_page_host->create_page(page_id);
    page.page().set_system_visibility_state(system_visibility_state);
    page.page().create_remote_navigable_graph(move(remote_navigables));
    page.page().begin_hosting(root_navigable_id, initial_history_entry);
}

void ConnectionFromClient::media_session_action(Web::PageId page_id, Web::Bindings::MediaSessionAction action, Optional<double> seek_offset, Optional<double> seek_time, Optional<bool> fast_seek)
{
    if (auto page = this->page(page_id); page.has_value())
        page->page().handle_media_session_action(action, seek_offset, seek_time, fast_seek);
}

void ConnectionFromClient::insert_remote_navigable(Web::PageId page_id, Web::HTML::RemoteNavigableDescriptor navigable)
{
    if (auto page = this->page(page_id); page.has_value())
        page->page().insert_remote_navigable(move(navigable));
}

void ConnectionFromClient::remove_remote_navigable(Web::PageId page_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId navigable_id)
{
    if (auto page = this->page(page_id); page.has_value())
        page->page().remove_remote_navigable(navigable_id);
}

void ConnectionFromClient::update_remote_navigable(Web::PageId page_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId navigable_id, Web::HTML::ReplicatedNavigableState state)
{
    if (auto page = this->page(page_id); page.has_value())
        page->page().update_remote_navigable(navigable_id, move(state));
}

void ConnectionFromClient::content_navigable_completely_finished_loading(Web::PageId page_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId navigable_id)
{
    if (auto page = this->page(page_id); page.has_value())
        page->page().content_navigable_completely_finished_loading(navigable_id);
}

void ConnectionFromClient::update_local_root_container_state(Web::PageId page_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId navigable_id, Web::HTML::ReplicatedContainerState state)
{
    auto page = this->page(page_id);
    if (!page.has_value())
        return;
    auto* navigable = as_if<Web::HTML::LocalNavigable>(page->page().navigable_with_id(navigable_id).ptr());
    if (!navigable || !navigable->is_local_root())
        return;
    navigable->set_root_container_state(move(state));
}

void ConnectionFromClient::begin_hosting_navigable(Web::PageId page_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId navigable_id, Web::HTML::SessionHistoryEntryDescriptor current_history_entry, Web::HTML::VisibilityState system_visibility_state)
{
    if (auto page = this->page(page_id); page.has_value()) {
        page->page().set_system_visibility_state(system_visibility_state);
        // The container can have destroyed the navigable before the request arrived.
        if (auto navigable = Web::HTML::remote_navigable_with_id(page->page(), navigable_id); navigable && !navigable->has_been_destroyed())
            page->page().begin_hosting(navigable_id, current_history_entry);
    }
}

void ConnectionFromClient::discard_provisional_navigable(Web::PageId page_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId navigable_id)
{
    if (auto page = this->page(page_id); page.has_value())
        page->page().discard_provisional_navigable(navigable_id);
}

void ConnectionFromClient::stop_hosting_navigable(Web::PageId page_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId navigable_id, Web::HTML::ReplicatedNavigableState replicated_state)
{
    if (auto page = this->page(page_id); page.has_value()) {
        page->page().stop_hosting(navigable_id, move(replicated_state));
        page->page().client().request_frame();
    }
}

void ConnectionFromClient::set_rendering_stats_displayed(Web::PageId page_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId navigable_id, bool displayed)
{
    if (!Core::StatsLog::the())
        return;
    if (auto page = this->page(page_id); page.has_value()) {
        auto* navigable = as_if<Web::HTML::LocalNavigable>(page->page().navigable_with_id(navigable_id).ptr());
        if (navigable && navigable->is_local_root())
            Web::set_rendering_pending_ancestors_displayed(*navigable, displayed);
    }
}

    if (auto page = this->page(page_id); page.has_value())
        page->set_hosted_root_viewport(navigable_id, size, viewport_intersection, device_pixel_ratio);

        page->navigate_to_a_javascript_url(navigable_id, url, history_handling, initiator_origin, source_snapshot_params, user_involvement, csp_navigation_type, move(navigation_id));

}

void ConnectionFromClient::close_traversable_from_script(Web::PageId page_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId navigable_id)
{
    auto page = this->page(page_id);
    if (!page.has_value())
        return;
    if (auto* traversable = as_if<Web::HTML::LocalTraversableNavigable>(page->page().navigable_with_id(navigable_id).ptr()))
        traversable->close_top_level_traversable_from_script();
}

void ConnectionFromClient::run_focusing_steps_for_navigable(Web::PageId page_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId navigable_id, Web::HTML::FocusTrigger focus_trigger)
{
    auto page = this->page(page_id);
    if (!page.has_value())
        return;
    if (auto* navigable = as_if<Web::HTML::LocalNavigable>(page->page().navigable_with_id(navigable_id).ptr()))
        Web::HTML::run_focusing_steps(navigable->active_document(), nullptr, focus_trigger);
}

void ConnectionFromClient::focus_window_of_navigable(Web::PageId page_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId navigable_id)
{
    auto page = this->page(page_id);
    if (!page.has_value())
        return;
    auto* navigable = as_if<Web::HTML::LocalNavigable>(page->page().navigable_with_id(navigable_id).ptr());
    if (!navigable)
        return;
    if (auto window = navigable->active_window())
        window->focus();
}

void ConnectionFromClient::set_opener_of_navigable(Web::PageId page_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId navigable_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId opener_navigable_id)
{
    auto page = this->page(page_id);
    if (!page.has_value())
        return;
    auto* navigable = as_if<Web::HTML::LocalNavigable>(page->page().navigable_with_id(navigable_id).ptr());
    auto opener = Web::HTML::navigable_with_id_in_any_page(page->page(), opener_navigable_id);
    if (!navigable || !navigable->active_browsing_context() || !opener)
        return;
    navigable->active_browsing_context()->set_opener_browsing_context(*opener);
    navigable->report_opener_browsing_context();
}

Optional<PageClient&> ConnectionFromClient::page(Web::PageId index, SourceLocation location)
{
    if (auto page = m_page_host->page(index); page.has_value())
        return *page;

    dbgln("ConnectionFromClient::{}: Did not find a page with ID {}", location.function_name(), index);
    return {};
}

{
    if (auto page = m_page_host->page(index); page.has_value())
        return *page;

    dbgln("ConnectionFromClient::{}: Did not find a page with ID {}", location.function_name(), index);
    return {};
}

void ConnectionFromClient::start_worker_thread(IPC::TransportHandle worker_transport, Web::HTML::AgentType agent_type)
{
    // NB: The UI process notices a transport that nobody takes up, and tells the owners that their worker is gone.
    if (auto result = WebWorker::start_worker_thread(move(worker_transport), agent_type); result.is_error())
        dbgln("Unable to start a thread for a worker: {}", result.error());
}

Messages::WebContentServer::GetWindowHandleResponse ConnectionFromClient::get_window_handle(Web::PageId page_id)
{
    if (auto page = this->page(page_id); page.has_value())
        return as<Web::HTML::LocalTraversableNavigable>(*page->page().top_level_traversable()).window_handle().to_utf8();
    return String {};
}

    if (auto page = this->page(page_id); page.has_value()) {
        page->set_window_handle(Utf16String::from_utf8(handle));
        page->send_current_needs_beforeunload_check();
    }
}

// A WebDriver command sees what the commands before it did, such as the viewport they set. The sizes that the windows
// took while a rendering update was in flight become their sizes before the command runs.
static void take_viewport_sizes_held_for_webdriver_command(PageHost& page_host)
{
    page_host.for_each_page([](PageClient& page_client) {
        if (page_client.page().has_local_traversable())
            page_client.page().local_traversable()->take_viewport_size_held_for_rendering_update_in_flight();
    });
}

void ConnectionFromClient::run_webdriver_command(Web::PageId page_id, u64 command_id, Optional<Web::HTML::CrossProcessId> navigable_id, String name, JsonValue payload, Vector<String> arguments)
{
    auto page = this->page(page_id);
    if (!page.has_value()) {
        // NB: A command the driver is waiting on must be answered even when its page is gone here.
        async_webdriver_command_complete(page_id, command_id, Web::WebDriver::Error::from_code(Web::WebDriver::ErrorCode::NoSuchWindow, "Window not found"sv));
        return;
    }

    take_viewport_sizes_held_for_webdriver_command(*m_page_host);
    page->run_webdriver_command(command_id, navigable_id, name, move(payload), move(arguments));
}

void ConnectionFromClient::run_webdriver_bidi_command(Web::PageId page_id, u64 command_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId navigable_id, String method, JsonValue params)
{
    auto page = this->page(page_id);
    if (!page.has_value()) {
        // NB: A command the driver is waiting on must be answered even when its page is gone here.
        async_webdriver_command_complete(page_id, command_id, Web::WebDriver::Error::from_code(Web::WebDriver::ErrorCode::NoSuchFrame, "Browsing context not found"sv));
        return;
    }

    take_viewport_sizes_held_for_webdriver_command(*m_page_host);
    WebContent::run_webdriver_bidi_command(*page, command_id, navigable_id, method, move(params));
}

void ConnectionFromClient::set_webdriver_bidi_session_state(Web::WebDriver::BiDiSessionState state)

    WebContent::set_webdriver_bidi_session_state(move(state));
}

void ConnectionFromClient::disconnect_from_image_decoder()
{
    auto disconnect = [] {
        static_cast<Web::Platform::RemoteImageCodecPlugin&>(Web::Platform::ImageCodecPlugin::the()).disconnect_client();
    };
    disconnect();
    WebWorker::post_to_worker_threads(disconnect);
}

void ConnectionFromClient::connect_to_compositor_process(IPC::TransportHandle handle, IPC::TransportHandle render_clock_handle)
{
    auto transport = MUST(handle.create_transport());
    m_compositor_connection = adopt_ref(*new Web::Compositor::CompositorConnection(move(transport)));
    m_compositor_connection->on_mouse_event = [this](Web::PageId page_id, Web::MouseEvent event) {
        mouse_event(page_id, move(event));
    };
    m_compositor_connection->on_key_event = [this](Web::PageId page_id, Web::KeyEvent event) {
        key_event(page_id, move(event));
    };
    m_compositor_connection->on_pinch_event = [this](Web::PageId page_id, Web::PinchEvent event) {
        pinch_event(page_id, event);
    };
    m_compositor_connection->on_compositor_lost = [this] {
        m_page_host->compositor_process_lost();
    };
    m_compositor_connection->on_request_video_presentation_channel = [this] {
        async_request_video_presentation_channel();
    };

    m_compositor_connection->attach_render_clock(move(render_clock_handle));
    m_compositor_connection->hand_poster_to_paint_thread();
}

void ConnectionFromClient::compositor_process_reconnected()
{
    m_page_host->compositor_process_reconnected();
}

void ConnectionFromClient::connect_to_request_server(IPC::TransportHandle handle, int client_id, Optional<Utf16String> top_level_site)
{
    if (on_request_server_connection)
        on_request_server_connection(handle, client_id, top_level_site);
}

ErrorOr<NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport>> ConnectionFromClient::request_media_server_transport()
{
    auto response = send_sync_but_allow_failure<Messages::WebContentClient::RequestMediaServerConnection>();
    if (!response || !response->handle().has_value())
        return Error::from_string_literal("The Browser did not connect a media server");
    return response->take_handle()->create_transport();
}

{
    auto response = send_sync_but_allow_failure<Messages::WebContentClient::RequestAudioServerConnection>();
    if (!response || !response->handle().has_value())
        return Error::from_string_literal("The Browser did not connect an audio server");
    return response->take_handle()->create_transport();
}

ErrorOr<NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport>> ConnectionFromClient::request_webrtc_client_transport()
{
    auto response = send_sync_but_allow_failure<Messages::WebContentClient::RequestWebrtcClientConnection>();
    if (!response || !response->handle().has_value())
        return Error::from_string_literal("The Browser did not launch a WebRTCClient");
    return response->take_handle()->create_transport();
}

ErrorOr<NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport>> ConnectionFromClient::request_image_decoder_transport()
{
    auto response = send_sync_but_allow_failure<Messages::WebContentClient::RequestImageDecoderConnection>();
    if (!response || !response->handle().has_value())

    return response->take_handle()->create_transport();

void ConnectionFromClient::run_beforeunload_check(Web::PageId page_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId check_id, Vector<Web::HTML::CrossProcessId> navigable_ids, Optional<Web::HTML::SessionHistoryEntryDescriptor> target_entry, Optional<Web::HTML::UserNavigationInvolvement> user_involvement_for_navigate_event, Web::HTML::UnloadPromptShown unload_prompt_shown)
{
    auto page = this->page(page_id);
    if (!page.has_value()) {
        async_beforeunload_check_result(page_id, check_id, Web::HTML::CheckIfUnloadingIsCanceledResult::Continue, unload_prompt_shown);
        return;
    }

    page->page().history_executor().run_ui_beforeunload_check(move(navigable_ids), move(target_entry), user_involvement_for_navigate_event, unload_prompt_shown, GC::create_function(Web::HTML::main_thread_event_loop().heap(), GC::captures(make_weak_ptr<ConnectionFromClient>(), page_id, check_id), [](auto& connection, auto& page_id, auto& check_id, Web::HTML::CheckIfUnloadingIsCanceledResult result, Web::HTML::UnloadPromptShown unload_prompt_shown) {
        if (!connection)
            return;
        connection->async_beforeunload_check_result(page_id, check_id, result, unload_prompt_shown);
    }));
}

void ConnectionFromClient::unload_check_result(Web::PageId page_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId check_id, Web::HTML::CheckIfUnloadingIsCanceledResult result)
{
    if (auto page = this->page(page_id); page.has_value())
        page->did_receive_unload_check_result(check_id, result);
}

void ConnectionFromClient::discard_embedded_page(Web::PageId page_id)
{
    auto page = this->page(page_id);
    if (!page.has_value())
        return;

    // Input events are only taken by a page hosting a document, so drop the ones still queued for this page. The view
    // waits for every event it sent to finish, so they are reported as dropped.
    Queue<Web::QueuedInputEvent> events_for_other_pages;
    while (!m_input_event_queue.is_empty()) {
        auto event = m_input_event_queue.dequeue();
        if (event.page_id != page_id) {
            events_for_other_pages.enqueue(move(event));
            continue;
        }
        for (auto coalesced_event_id : event.coalesced_event_ids)
            async_did_finish_handling_input_event(page_id, coalesced_event_id, Web::EventResult::Dropped);
        async_did_finish_handling_input_event(page_id, Web::input_event_id(event.event), Web::EventResult::Dropped);
    }
    while (!events_for_other_pages.is_empty())
        m_input_event_queue.enqueue(events_for_other_pages.dequeue());

    page->page().discard();
}

void ConnectionFromClient::queue_navigation_api_state_clear_task(Web::PageId page_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId navigable_id)
{
    auto page = this->page(page_id);
    auto* navigable = page.has_value() ? as_if<Web::HTML::LocalNavigable>(page->page().navigable_with_id(navigable_id).ptr()) : nullptr;
    if (!navigable)
        return;

    navigable->queue_navigation_api_state_clear_task();
}

void ConnectionFromClient::continue_history_navigation_population(Web::PageId page_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId operation_id, Web::HTML::HistoryNavigationPopulation population)
{
    auto navigable_id = population.request.navigable_id;
    if (auto page = this->page(page_id); page.has_value() && page->page().history_executor().resume_history_navigation_population(operation_id, move(population)))
        return;
    async_changing_navigable_history_job_ready(page_id, operation_id, navigable_id, Web::HTML::ChangingNavigableHistoryStepJobDisposition::Skipped, false);
}

void ConnectionFromClient::populate_history_entry_document(Web::PageId page_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId operation_id, Web::HTML::SessionHistoryEntryDescriptor target_entry, Optional<Web::Bindings::NavigationType> navigation_type, bool ongoing_navigation_is_traversal, Web::HTML::HistoryNavigationPopulation population)
{
    auto navigable_id = population.request.navigable_id;
    auto page = this->page(page_id);
    if (!page.has_value()) {
        async_changing_navigable_history_job_ready(page_id, operation_id, navigable_id, Web::HTML::ChangingNavigableHistoryStepJobDisposition::Skipped, false);
        return;
    }
    page->page().history_executor().populate_ui_history_entry_document(operation_id, move(target_entry), navigation_type, ongoing_navigation_is_traversal, move(population),
        GC::create_function(Web::HTML::main_thread_event_loop().heap(), GC::captures(make_weak_ptr<ConnectionFromClient>(), page_id, operation_id, navigable_id), [](auto& connection, auto& page_id, auto& operation_id, auto& navigable_id, Web::HTML::ChangingNavigableHistoryStepJobDisposition disposition, bool update_only) {
            if (!connection)
                return;
            connection->async_changing_navigable_history_job_ready(page_id, operation_id, navigable_id, disposition, update_only);
        }));
}

void ConnectionFromClient::run_changing_navigable_history_job(Web::PageId page_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId operation_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId navigable_id, Web::HTML::SessionHistoryEntryDescriptor target_entry, Web::HTML::UserNavigationInvolvement user_involvement, Optional<Web::Bindings::NavigationType> navigation_type, Optional<Utf16String> finalized_navigation_id, bool ongoing_navigation_is_traversal, bool needs_population)
{
    auto page = this->page(page_id);
    if (!page.has_value()) {
        async_changing_navigable_history_job_ready(page_id, operation_id, navigable_id, Web::HTML::ChangingNavigableHistoryStepJobDisposition::Skipped, false);
        return;
    }

    page->page().history_executor().run_ui_changing_navigable_history_job(operation_id, navigable_id, move(target_entry), user_involvement, navigation_type, move(finalized_navigation_id), ongoing_navigation_is_traversal, needs_population, GC::create_function(Web::HTML::main_thread_event_loop().heap(), GC::captures(make_weak_ptr<ConnectionFromClient>(), page_id, operation_id, navigable_id), [](auto& connection, auto& page_id, auto& operation_id, auto& navigable_id, Web::HTML::ChangingNavigableHistoryStepJobDisposition disposition, bool update_only) {
        if (!connection)
            return;
        connection->async_changing_navigable_history_job_ready(page_id, operation_id, navigable_id, disposition, update_only);
    }));
}

void ConnectionFromClient::create_history_navigation_params(Web::PageId page_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId operation_id, Web::HTML::NavigationPopulationRequest request, bool allow_POST)
{
    auto navigable_id = request.navigable_id;
    if (auto page = this->page(page_id); page.has_value() && page->page().history_executor().create_ui_history_navigation_params(operation_id, move(request), allow_POST))
        return;
    async_changing_navigable_history_job_ready(page_id, operation_id, navigable_id, Web::HTML::ChangingNavigableHistoryStepJobDisposition::Skipped, false);
}

void ConnectionFromClient::clear_ongoing_history_traversal(Web::PageId page_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId operation_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId navigable_id)
{
    if (auto page = this->page(page_id); page.has_value())
        page->page().history_executor().clear_ui_changing_navigable_ongoing_traversal(operation_id, navigable_id);
}

void ConnectionFromClient::apply_changing_navigable_continuation(Web::PageId page_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId operation_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId navigable_id, Web::HTML::SessionHistoryEntryIdentity target_entry, u64 script_history_length, u64 script_history_index, Vector<Web::HTML::SessionHistoryEntryDescriptor> entries_for_navigation_api, bool clear_classic_history_api_state, bool clear_navigable_target_name)
{
    auto page = this->page(page_id);
    if (!page.has_value()) {
        async_changing_navigable_continuation_applied(page_id, operation_id, navigable_id, {}, {});
        return;
    }

    page->page().history_executor().apply_ui_changing_navigable_continuation(operation_id, navigable_id, target_entry, { script_history_length, script_history_index }, move(entries_for_navigation_api), clear_classic_history_api_state, clear_navigable_target_name, GC::create_function(Web::HTML::main_thread_event_loop().heap(), GC::captures(make_weak_ptr<ConnectionFromClient>(), page_id, operation_id, navigable_id), [](auto& connection, auto& page_id, auto& operation_id, auto& navigable_id, Optional<Web::HTML::HostedNavigableState> activated_navigable_state, Optional<Web::HTML::SessionHistoryEntryPersistedState> previous_entry_persisted_state) {
        if (!connection)
            return;
        connection->async_changing_navigable_continuation_applied(page_id, operation_id, navigable_id, move(activated_navigable_state), move(previous_entry_persisted_state));
    }));
}

void ConnectionFromClient::unload_displayed_document_and_apply_changing_navigable_continuation(Web::PageId page_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId operation_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId navigable_id, Web::HTML::SessionHistoryEntryIdentity target_entry, u64 script_history_length, u64 script_history_index, Vector<Web::HTML::SessionHistoryEntryDescriptor> entries_for_navigation_api, bool clear_classic_history_api_state, bool clear_navigable_target_name)
{
    auto page = this->page(page_id);
    if (!page.has_value()) {
        async_changing_navigable_continuation_applied(page_id, operation_id, navigable_id, {}, {});
        return;
    }

    page->page().history_executor().unload_displayed_document_and_apply_ui_changing_navigable_continuation(operation_id, navigable_id, target_entry, { script_history_length, script_history_index }, move(entries_for_navigation_api), clear_classic_history_api_state, clear_navigable_target_name, GC::create_function(Web::HTML::main_thread_event_loop().heap(), GC::captures(make_weak_ptr<ConnectionFromClient>(), page_id, operation_id, navigable_id), [](auto& connection, auto& page_id, auto& operation_id, auto& navigable_id, Optional<Web::HTML::HostedNavigableState> activated_navigable_state, Optional<Web::HTML::SessionHistoryEntryPersistedState> previous_entry_persisted_state) {
        if (!connection)
            return;
        connection->async_changing_navigable_continuation_applied(page_id, operation_id, navigable_id, move(activated_navigable_state), move(previous_entry_persisted_state));
    }));
}

void ConnectionFromClient::run_descendant_unload_task(Web::PageId page_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId unload_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId navigable_id, Web::HTML::ChildNavigableDestruction child_navigable_destruction, Web::HTML::StopHostingAfterUnload stop_hosting_after_unload)
{
    auto page = this->page(page_id);
    auto navigable = Web::HTML::local_navigable_with_id(navigable_id);
    if (!page.has_value() || !navigable) {
        async_descendant_unload_task_complete(page_id, unload_id, navigable_id);
        return;
    }
    VERIFY(&navigable->page() == &page->page());

    navigable->run_ui_descendant_unload_task(child_navigable_destruction, stop_hosting_after_unload, GC::create_function(navigable->heap(), GC::captures(make_weak_ptr<ConnectionFromClient>(), page_id, unload_id, navigable_id), [](auto& connection, auto& page_id, auto& unload_id, auto& navigable_id) {
        if (!connection)
            return;
        connection->async_descendant_unload_task_complete(page_id, unload_id, navigable_id);
    }));
}

void ConnectionFromClient::continue_child_navigable_destruction(Web::PageId page_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId navigable_id)
{
    auto page = this->page(page_id);
    if (!page.has_value())
        return;

    // The child has already been marked as destroyed, so a lookup through the page no longer finds it.
    GC::Ptr<Web::HTML::Navigable> navigable = Web::HTML::local_navigable_with_id(navigable_id);
    if (!navigable || &navigable->page() != &page->page())
        navigable = Web::HTML::remote_navigable_with_id(page->page(), navigable_id);
    if (!navigable)
        return;
    Web::HTML::NavigableContainer::continue_destroying_the_child_navigable(*navigable);
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/document-lifecycle.html#abort-a-document-and-its-descendants
void ConnectionFromClient::abort_navigable_document(Web::PageId page_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId navigable_id)
{
    auto page = this->page(page_id);
    if (!page.has_value())
        return;
    auto* navigable = as_if<Web::HTML::LocalNavigable>(page->page().navigable_with_id(navigable_id).ptr());
    if (!navigable || !navigable->active_window())
        return;

    // 3. For each descendantNavigable of descendantNavigables, queue a global task on the navigation and traversal task source given descendantNavigable's active window to perform the following steps:
    Web::HTML::queue_global_task(Web::HTML::Task::Source::NavigationAndTraversal, Web::HTML::relevant_global_object(*navigable->active_window()), GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(GC::Ref { *navigable }), [](auto& navigable) {
        auto document = navigable->active_document();
        if (!document)
            return;
        // NOTE: This is not in the spec but we need to abort ongoing navigations in all descendant navigables.
        //       See https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/9711
        navigable->set_ongoing_navigation({});

        // 1. Abort descendantNavigable's active document.
        // NB: With its own descendants, hosted here or elsewhere, which the requesting process could not reach.
        document->abort_a_document_and_its_descendants();
    }));
}

// https://fullscreen.spec.whatwg.org/#exit-fullscreen
void ConnectionFromClient::unfullscreen_navigable_document(Web::PageId page_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId navigable_id)
{
    auto page = this->page(page_id);
    if (!page.has_value())
        return;
    auto* navigable = as_if<Web::HTML::LocalNavigable>(page->page().navigable_with_id(navigable_id).ptr());
    if (!navigable)
        return;

    // 15. For each descendantDoc in descendantDocs:
    // NB: doc is hosted by another process, which asks this process to run these steps for navigable's document and
    //     the documents of navigable's descendants.
    Vector<GC::Root<Web::HTML::Navigable>> inclusive_descendants;
    inclusive_descendants.append(*navigable);
    if (auto document = navigable->active_document())
        inclusive_descendants.extend(document->descendant_navigables());
    page->page().unfullscreen_descendant_documents(inclusive_descendants);
}

// https://fullscreen.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-element-requestfullscreen
void ConnectionFromClient::fullscreen_navigable_container(Web::PageId page_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId navigable_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId requesting_navigable_id, Web::Fullscreen::RequestType request_type)
{
    auto page = this->page(page_id);
    GC::Ptr<Web::HTML::NavigableContainer> container;
    if (page.has_value()) {
        if (auto navigable = page->page().navigable_with_id(navigable_id))
            container = navigable->container();
    }
    if (container) {
        // 11 to 13, for the part of the chain of containers this process holds.
        if (auto hosted_root = page->page().fullscreen_element_and_its_containers(*container, request_type, Web::Page::ElementIsRequestedElement::No)) {
            page->page().client().page_did_request_container_fullscreen(hosted_root->id(), requesting_navigable_id, request_type);
            return;
        }
    }

    // The request waits in the process holding the requesting document until the whole chain is fullscreen.
    async_navigable_container_fullscreen_complete(page_id, requesting_navigable_id);
}

void ConnectionFromClient::container_fullscreen_complete(Web::PageId page_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId navigable_id)
{
    if (auto page = this->page(page_id); page.has_value())
        page->page().container_fullscreen_complete(navigable_id);
}

// https://fullscreen.spec.whatwg.org/#exit-fullscreen
void ConnectionFromClient::unfullscreen_navigable_container(Web::PageId page_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId navigable_id)
{
    auto page = this->page(page_id);
    GC::Ptr<Web::HTML::NavigableContainer> container;
    if (page.has_value()) {
        if (auto navigable = page->page().navigable_with_id(navigable_id))
            container = navigable->container();
    }

    // 12.6. If container's iframe fullscreen flag is set, break.
    auto* iframe = container ? as_if<Web::HTML::HTMLIFrameElement>(*container) : nullptr;
    if (!container || (iframe && iframe->iframe_fullscreen_flag()) || !container->document().is_fully_active() || !container->document().fullscreen_element()) {
        // The collection ends here, and the requesting process finishes its exit with the documents it holds.
        async_navigable_container_unfullscreen_complete(page_id, navigable_id);
        return;
    }

    // The collection carries on from the container's document, in the process that holds it: with it the documents
    // above, and the resize the process holding the top-level traversable decides on. The requesting process waits
    // for that exit to complete.
    Web::HTML::TemporaryExecutionContext context { container->document().relevant_settings_object(), Web::HTML::TemporaryExecutionContext::CallbacksEnabled::Yes };
    container->document().exit_fullscreen(nullptr, navigable_id);
}

void ConnectionFromClient::container_unfullscreen_complete(Web::PageId page_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId navigable_id)
{
    if (auto page = this->page(page_id); page.has_value())
        page->page().container_unfullscreen_complete(navigable_id);
}

void ConnectionFromClient::run_traversable_close_unload_task(Web::PageId page_id)
{
    if (auto page = this->page(page_id); page.has_value())
        as<Web::HTML::LocalTraversableNavigable>(*page->page().local_traversable()).run_ui_traversable_close_unload_task();
}

void ConnectionFromClient::update_nonchanging_navigable_history_state(Web::PageId page_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId operation_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId navigable_id, u64 script_history_length, u64 script_history_index)
{
    auto page = this->page(page_id);
    auto* navigable = page.has_value() ? as_if<Web::HTML::LocalNavigable>(page->page().navigable_with_id(navigable_id).ptr()) : nullptr;
    if (!navigable) {
        async_nonchanging_navigable_history_state_updated(page_id, operation_id, navigable_id);
        return;
    }

    navigable->update_nonchanging_navigable_history_step_state({ script_history_length, script_history_index }, GC::create_function(navigable->heap(), GC::captures(make_weak_ptr<ConnectionFromClient>(), page_id, operation_id, navigable_id), [](auto& connection, auto& page_id, auto& operation_id, auto& navigable_id) {
        if (!connection)
            return;
        connection->async_nonchanging_navigable_history_state_updated(page_id, operation_id, navigable_id);
    }));
}

void ConnectionFromClient::history_step_applied(Web::PageId page_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId operation_id, Web::HTML::HistoryStepResult result)
{
    if (auto page = this->page(page_id); page.has_value())
        page->page().history_executor().did_apply_ui_history_step(operation_id, result);
}

void ConnectionFromClient::reject_navigation_api_traversal(Web::PageId page_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId operation_id)
{
    if (auto page = this->page(page_id); page.has_value())
        page->page().history_executor().reject_ui_navigation_api_traversal(operation_id);
}

void ConnectionFromClient::complete_history_operation(Web::PageId page_id, Web::HTML::CrossProcessId operation_id, Optional<i32> target_entry_step, u64 session_history_entry_count)
{
    auto page = this->page(page_id);
    if (!page.has_value())
        return;

    if (auto* traversable = as_if<Web::HTML::LocalTraversableNavigable>(*page->page().top_level_traversable()))
        traversable->set_session_history_entry_count(session_history_entry_count);
    page->page().history_executor().complete_ui_history_operation(operation_id, target_entry_step);
}

    }

void ConnectionFromClient::key_event(Web::PageId page_id, Web::KeyEvent event)

    enqueue_input_event({ page_id, move(event), {}, {} });
}
