namespace {

// A '420v' surface described plane by plane, so a test can give it the geometry another process could.
Optional<Core::IOSurfaceHandle> create_surface_with_chroma_height(int width, int height, int chroma_height)
{
    auto set_number = [](CFMutableDictionaryRef dictionary, CFStringRef key, long value) {
        auto* number = CFNumberCreate(kCFAllocatorDefault, kCFNumberLongType, &value);
        CFDictionarySetValue(dictionary, key, number);
        CFRelease(number);
    };
    auto create_dictionary = [] {
        return CFDictionaryCreateMutable(kCFAllocatorDefault, 0, &kCFTypeDictionaryKeyCallBacks, &kCFTypeDictionaryValueCallBacks);
    };
    auto create_plane = [&](long plane_width, long plane_height, long bytes_per_element, long offset) {
        auto* plane = create_dictionary();
        set_number(plane, kIOSurfacePlaneWidth, plane_width);
        set_number(plane, kIOSurfacePlaneHeight, plane_height);
        set_number(plane, kIOSurfacePlaneBytesPerElement, bytes_per_element);
        set_number(plane, kIOSurfacePlaneBytesPerRow, plane_width * bytes_per_element);
        set_number(plane, kIOSurfacePlaneOffset, offset);
        set_number(plane, kIOSurfacePlaneSize, plane_width * bytes_per_element * plane_height);
        return plane;
    };

    long luma_size = static_cast<long>(width) * height;
    CFTypeRef planes[] = { create_plane(width, height, 1, 0), create_plane(width / 2, chroma_height, 2, luma_size) };
    auto* plane_array = CFArrayCreate(kCFAllocatorDefault, planes, 2, &kCFTypeArrayCallBacks);
    CFRelease(planes[0]);
    CFRelease(planes[1]);

    auto* properties = create_dictionary();
    set_number(properties, kIOSurfaceWidth, width);
    set_number(properties, kIOSurfaceHeight, height);
    set_number(properties, kIOSurfacePixelFormat, kCVPixelFormatType_420YpCbCr8BiPlanarVideoRange);
    set_number(properties, kIOSurfaceAllocSize, luma_size + (static_cast<long>(width) * chroma_height));
    CFDictionarySetValue(properties, kIOSurfacePlaneInfo, plane_array);
    CFRelease(plane_array);

    auto* io_surface = IOSurfaceCreate(properties);
    CFRelease(properties);
    if (io_surface == nullptr)
        return {};
    auto handle = Core::IOSurfaceHandle::from_ref(io_surface);
    CFRelease(io_surface);
    return handle;
}

}

TEST_CASE(accepts_surfaces_laid_out_like_a_decoders)
{
    EXPECT(!Gfx::validate_biplanar_video_surface(create_decoder_shaped_surface(63, 47, kCVPixelFormatType_420YpCbCr8BiPlanarVideoRange).release_value()).is_error());
    EXPECT(!Gfx::validate_biplanar_video_surface(create_decoder_shaped_surface(64, 48, kCVPixelFormatType_420YpCbCr10BiPlanarFullRange).release_value()).is_error());
    EXPECT(!Gfx::validate_biplanar_video_surface(create_surface_with_chroma_height(64, 48, 24).release_value()).is_error());
}

// Surfaces arrive from the decoder's process, so their planes must hold what their format says before anything reads
// them, or the readers walk past the chroma plane.
TEST_CASE(refuses_surfaces_whose_planes_do_not_hold_their_format)
{
    EXPECT(Gfx::validate_biplanar_video_surface(Core::IOSurfaceHandle::create(16, 16)).is_error());

    auto short_chroma = create_surface_with_chroma_height(64, 48, 1);
    VERIFY(short_chroma.has_value());
    EXPECT(Gfx::validate_biplanar_video_surface(*short_chroma).is_error());
}

TEST_CASE(biplanar_conversion_refuses_planes_shorter_than_the_size)
{
    auto luma = MUST(ByteBuffer::create_zeroed(64 * 48));
    auto chroma = MUST(ByteBuffer::create_zeroed(64 * 24));
    Gfx::BiplanarYUVPlane luma_plane { .data = luma.bytes(), .stride = 64 };
    EXPECT(!Gfx::biplanar_yuv_to_bitmap({ 64, 48 }, 8, Media::Subsampling::yuv420(), {}, luma_plane, { .data = chroma.bytes(), .stride = 64 }).is_error());
    EXPECT(Gfx::biplanar_yuv_to_bitmap({ 64, 48 }, 8, Media::Subsampling::yuv420(), {}, luma_plane, { .data = chroma.bytes().slice(0, 64), .stride = 64 }).is_error());
    EXPECT(Gfx::biplanar_yuv_to_bitmap({ 64, 48 }, 8, Media::Subsampling::yuv420(), {}, luma_plane, { .data = chroma.bytes(), .stride = 16 }).is_error());
}

namespace {

// Green, blue and red, held where luma, blue chroma and red chroma would be.
constexpr Sample RGB_TEST_SAMPLE { 40, 200, 120 };
constexpr Gfx::Color RGB_TEST_COLOR { 120, 40, 200 };
constexpr Sample TEN_BIT_RGB_TEST_SAMPLE { 160, 800, 480 };
constexpr Media::CodingIndependentCodePoints RGB_CICP { Media::ColorPrimaries::Unspecified, Media::TransferCharacteristics::Unspecified, Media::MatrixCoefficients::Identity, Media::VideoFullRangeFlag::Full };

bool colors_are_close(Gfx::Color a, Gfx::Color b)
{
    auto close = [](u8 x, u8 y) { return AK::abs(static_cast<int>(x) - static_cast<int>(y)) <= 2; };
    return close(a.red(), b.red()) && close(a.green(), b.green()) && close(a.blue(), b.blue());
}

// Every component of the pattern is constant within square blocks of this many pixels, and differs between them. At a
// block's center, chroma upsampling agrees whichever way it filters, but chroma read from the wrong row or column, or
// with the wrong subsampling, comes from another block.
constexpr int PATTERN_BLOCK_SIZE = 8;

Sample pattern_sample_at(int x, int y, u8 bit_depth)
{
    auto block_x = x / PATTERN_BLOCK_SIZE;
    auto block_y = y / PATTERN_BLOCK_SIZE;
    auto scale = 1 << (bit_depth - 8);
    return {
        static_cast<u16>((96 + (block_x * 4) + (block_y * 8)) * scale),
        static_cast<u16>((64 + (block_x * 16)) * scale),
        static_cast<u16>((80 + (block_y * 16)) * scale),
    };
}

void fill_biplanar_surface_with_pattern(Core::IOSurfaceHandle const& handle)
{
    auto format = Gfx::biplanar_pixel_format(handle.pixel_format());
    VERIFY(format.has_value());
    auto* io_surface = static_cast<IOSurfaceRef>(handle.core_foundation_pointer());
    IOSurfaceLock(io_surface, 0, nullptr);

    // Samples deeper than eight bits are carried in the high bits of each sixteen.
    auto bit_depth = format->bit_depth;
    auto store = [&](u8* row, size_t index, u16 sample) {
        if (bit_depth <= 8)
            row[index] = static_cast<u8>(sample);
        else
            reinterpret_cast<u16*>(row)[index] = static_cast<u16>(sample << (16 - bit_depth));
    };

    auto* luma = static_cast<u8*>(IOSurfaceGetBaseAddressOfPlane(io_surface, 0));
    auto luma_stride = IOSurfaceGetBytesPerRowOfPlane(io_surface, 0);
    for (size_t row = 0; row < handle.plane_height(0); row++) {
        for (size_t column = 0; column < handle.plane_width(0); column++)
            store(luma + (row * luma_stride), column, pattern_sample_at(column, row, bit_depth).luma);
    }

    auto subsampling = format->subsampling;
    auto* chroma = static_cast<u8*>(IOSurfaceGetBaseAddressOfPlane(io_surface, 1));
    auto chroma_stride = IOSurfaceGetBytesPerRowOfPlane(io_surface, 1);
    for (size_t row = 0; row < handle.plane_height(1); row++) {
        for (size_t column = 0; column < handle.plane_width(1); column++) {
            auto sample = pattern_sample_at(column << subsampling.x(), row << subsampling.y(), bit_depth);
            store(chroma + (row * chroma_stride), column * 2, sample.blue_chroma);
            store(chroma + (row * chroma_stride), (column * 2) + 1, sample.red_chroma);
        }
    }

    IOSurfaceUnlock(io_surface, 0, nullptr);
}

// The pattern laid out the way a software decoder hands it over, as three separate planes.
struct PatternPlanes {
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    ByteBuffer luma;
    ByteBuffer blue_chroma;
    ByteBuffer red_chroma;
    Optional<Gfx::YUVData> data;
};

NonnullOwnPtr<PatternPlanes> pattern_planes(u8 bit_depth, Media::Subsampling subsampling)
{
    auto planes = make<PatternPlanes>();
    size_t bytes_per_sample = bit_depth > 8 ? 2 : 1;
    Gfx::Size<size_t> size { TEST_WIDTH, TEST_HEIGHT };
    auto chroma_size = subsampling.subsampled_size(size);
    planes->luma = MUST(ByteBuffer::create_uninitialized(size.width() * size.height() * bytes_per_sample));
    planes->blue_chroma = MUST(ByteBuffer::create_uninitialized(chroma_size.width() * chroma_size.height() * bytes_per_sample));
    planes->red_chroma = MUST(ByteBuffer::create_uninitialized(chroma_size.width() * chroma_size.height() * bytes_per_sample));

    // Separate planes keep samples deeper than eight bits in the low bits of each sixteen.
    auto store = [&](ByteBuffer& plane, size_t index, u16 sample) {
        if (bytes_per_sample == 1)
            plane[index] = static_cast<u8>(sample);
        else
            reinterpret_cast<u16*>(plane.data())[index] = sample;
    };
    for (size_t row = 0; row < size.height(); row++) {
        for (size_t column = 0; column < size.width(); column++)
            store(planes->luma, (row * size.width()) + column, pattern_sample_at(column, row, bit_depth).luma);
    }
    for (size_t row = 0; row < chroma_size.height(); row++) {
        for (size_t column = 0; column < chroma_size.width(); column++) {
            auto sample = pattern_sample_at(column << subsampling.x(), row << subsampling.y(), bit_depth);
            store(planes->blue_chroma, (row * chroma_size.width()) + column, sample.blue_chroma);
            store(planes->red_chroma, (row * chroma_size.width()) + column, sample.red_chroma);
        }
    }

    planes->data = MUST(Gfx::YUVData::create({ TEST_WIDTH, TEST_HEIGHT }, bit_depth, subsampling, {},
        planes->luma.bytes(), planes->blue_chroma.bytes(), planes->red_chroma.bytes()));
    return planes;
}

Optional<SkBitmap> pixels_of(sk_sp<SkImage> const& image, GrDirectContext* gr_context)
{
    SkBitmap bitmap;
    if (!bitmap.tryAllocPixels(SkImageInfo::MakeN32Premul(image->width(), image->height(), SkColorSpace::MakeSRGB())))
        return {};
    if (!image->readPixels(gr_context, bitmap.pixmap(), 0, 0))
        return {};
    return bitmap;
}

// Compares the center of every block of the pattern.
void expect_pattern_blocks_alike(Function<Gfx::Color(int, int)> const& actual_color_at, Function<Gfx::Color(int, int)> const& expected_color_at)
{
    for (int block_y = 0; block_y < TEST_HEIGHT / PATTERN_BLOCK_SIZE; block_y++) {
        for (int block_x = 0; block_x < TEST_WIDTH / PATTERN_BLOCK_SIZE; block_x++) {
            auto x = (block_x * PATTERN_BLOCK_SIZE) + (PATTERN_BLOCK_SIZE / 2);
            auto y = (block_y * PATTERN_BLOCK_SIZE) + (PATTERN_BLOCK_SIZE / 2);
            auto actual = actual_color_at(x, y);
            auto expected = expected_color_at(x, y);
            if (!colors_are_close(actual, expected))
                warnln("Block ({}, {}): got {}, expected {}", block_x, block_y, actual, expected);
            EXPECT(colors_are_close(actual, expected));
        }
    }
}

// Reads a surface back on the CPU and checks it against its separate planes converted to pixels.
void expect_surface_reads_back_as_its_pattern(OSType pixel_format)
{
    auto surface = create_decoder_shaped_surface(TEST_WIDTH, TEST_HEIGHT, pixel_format);
    VERIFY(surface.has_value());
    fill_biplanar_surface_with_pattern(*surface);
    auto format = Gfx::biplanar_pixel_format(pixel_format).value();

    auto surface_bitmap = MUST(Gfx::bitmap_from_video_surface(*surface, {}));
    auto planes = pattern_planes(format.bit_depth, format.subsampling);
    auto planes_bitmap = MUST(planes->data->to_bitmap());
    auto color_at = [](Gfx::Bitmap const& bitmap) {
        return Function<Gfx::Color(int, int)>([&bitmap](int x, int y) { return bitmap.get_pixel(x, y); });
    };
    expect_pattern_blocks_alike(color_at(*surface_bitmap), color_at(*planes_bitmap));
}

// Draws a surface on the GPU and checks it against its separate planes drawn the same way.
void expect_surface_renders_as_its_pattern(OSType pixel_format, Gfx::SkiaBackendContext& context)
{
    auto* gr_context = context.sk_context();
    auto surface = create_decoder_shaped_surface(TEST_WIDTH, TEST_HEIGHT, pixel_format);
    VERIFY(surface.has_value());
    fill_biplanar_surface_with_pattern(*surface);
    auto format = Gfx::biplanar_pixel_format(pixel_format).value();

    auto surface_image = Compositor::sk_image_from_video_surface(MUST(Media::VideoSurface::create(surface.release_value())), {}, context);
    VERIFY(surface_image != nullptr);
    auto surface_pixels = pixels_of(surface_image, gr_context);
    VERIFY(surface_pixels.has_value());

    auto planes = pattern_planes(format.bit_depth, format.subsampling);
    auto planes_image = SkImages::TextureFromYUVAPixmaps(gr_context, Compositor::make_yuva_pixmaps(*planes->data), skgpu::Mipmapped::kNo, false, SkColorSpace::MakeSRGB());
    VERIFY(planes_image != nullptr);
    auto planes_pixels = pixels_of(planes_image, gr_context);
    VERIFY(planes_pixels.has_value());

    auto color_at = [](SkBitmap const& bitmap) {
        return Function<Gfx::Color(int, int)>([&bitmap](int x, int y) {
            auto color = bitmap.getColor(x, y);
            return Gfx::Color(SkColorGetR(color), SkColorGetG(color), SkColorGetB(color));
        });
    };
    expect_pattern_blocks_alike(color_at(*surface_pixels), color_at(*planes_pixels));
}

}

TEST_CASE(separate_ten_bit_rgb_planes_render_as_green_blue_and_red)
{
    auto context = gpu_context();
    if (!context) {
        warnln("No GPU context available, skipping");
        return;
    }
    auto* gr_context = context->sk_context();

    auto make_plane = [](u16 value) {
        auto plane = MUST(ByteBuffer::create_uninitialized(TEST_WIDTH * TEST_HEIGHT * sizeof(u16)));
        auto* samples = reinterpret_cast<u16*>(plane.data());
        for (size_t index = 0; index < plane.size() / sizeof(u16); index++)
            samples[index] = value;
        return plane;
    };
    auto green_plane = make_plane(TEN_BIT_RGB_TEST_SAMPLE.luma);
    auto blue_plane = make_plane(TEN_BIT_RGB_TEST_SAMPLE.blue_chroma);

        green_plane.bytes(), blue_plane.bytes(), red_plane.bytes()));

    auto image = SkImages::TextureFromYUVAPixmaps(gr_context, Compositor::make_yuva_pixmaps(yuv_data), skgpu::Mipmapped::kNo, false, SkColorSpace::MakeSRGB());
    VERIFY(image != nullptr);
    auto color = center_pixel_of(image, gr_context);
    VERIFY(color.has_value());
    EXPECT(colors_are_close(*color, RGB_TEST_COLOR));

// Studio range RGB spans 16 to 235 in every component.
TEST_CASE(studio_range_rgb_is_stretched_to_full_range)
{
    constexpr Sample studio_sample { 16, 235, 126 };
    constexpr Sample ten_bit_studio_sample { 64, 940, 504 };
    constexpr Gfx::Color expected_color { 128, 0, 255 };
    auto studio_cicp = RGB_CICP;
    studio_cicp.set_video_full_range_flag(Media::VideoFullRangeFlag::Studio);

    auto surface = create_decoder_shaped_surface(TEST_WIDTH, TEST_HEIGHT, kCVPixelFormatType_444YpCbCr8BiPlanarVideoRange);
    VERIFY(surface.has_value());
    fill_biplanar_surface(*surface, studio_sample);
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(Gfx::bitmap_from_video_surface(*surface, studio_cicp))->get_pixel(TEST_WIDTH / 2, TEST_HEIGHT / 2), expected_color);

    auto ten_bit_surface = create_decoder_shaped_surface(TEST_WIDTH, TEST_HEIGHT, kCVPixelFormatType_444YpCbCr10BiPlanarVideoRange);
    VERIFY(ten_bit_surface.has_value());
    fill_ten_bit_biplanar_surface(*ten_bit_surface, ten_bit_studio_sample);
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(Gfx::bitmap_from_video_surface(*ten_bit_surface, studio_cicp))->get_pixel(TEST_WIDTH / 2, TEST_HEIGHT / 2), expected_color);

    auto green_plane = MUST(ByteBuffer::create_uninitialized(TEST_WIDTH * TEST_HEIGHT));
    auto blue_plane = MUST(ByteBuffer::create_uninitialized(TEST_WIDTH * TEST_HEIGHT));
    auto red_plane = MUST(ByteBuffer::create_uninitialized(TEST_WIDTH * TEST_HEIGHT));
    green_plane.bytes().fill(static_cast<u8>(studio_sample.luma));
    blue_plane.bytes().fill(static_cast<u8>(studio_sample.blue_chroma));
    red_plane.bytes().fill(static_cast<u8>(studio_sample.red_chroma));
    auto yuv_data = MUST(Gfx::YUVData::create({ TEST_WIDTH, TEST_HEIGHT }, 8, Media::Subsampling::yuv444(), studio_cicp,
        green_plane.bytes(), blue_plane.bytes(), red_plane.bytes()));
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(yuv_data.to_bitmap())->get_pixel(TEST_WIDTH / 2, TEST_HEIGHT / 2), expected_color);

    auto context = gpu_context();
    if (!context) {
        warnln("No GPU context available, skipping");
        return;
    }
    auto* gr_context = context->sk_context();

    auto surface_image = Compositor::sk_image_from_video_surface(MUST(Media::VideoSurface::create(surface.release_value())), studio_cicp, *context);
    VERIFY(surface_image != nullptr);
    auto surface_color = center_pixel_of(surface_image, gr_context);
    VERIFY(surface_color.has_value());
    EXPECT(colors_are_close(*surface_color, expected_color));

    auto planes_image = SkImages::TextureFromYUVAPixmaps(gr_context, Compositor::make_yuva_pixmaps(yuv_data), skgpu::Mipmapped::kNo, false, SkColorSpace::MakeSRGB());
    VERIFY(planes_image != nullptr);
    auto planes_color = center_pixel_of(planes_image, gr_context);
    VERIFY(planes_color.has_value());
    EXPECT(colors_are_close(*planes_color, expected_color));
}

FILE: Tests/Compositor/TestVSyncScheduler.cpp
/*

#include <Compositor/VSyncScheduler.h>
#include <LibCore/EventLoop.h>
#include <LibCore/Timer.h>
#include <LibTest/TestCase.h>

TEST_CASE(requests_before_a_tick_are_coalesced)
{
    Core::EventLoop event_loop;
    int tick_count = 0;
    auto timeout = Core::Timer::create_single_shot(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000), [&] { event_loop.quit(0); });
    auto after_tick = Core::Timer::create_single_shot(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(50), [&] { event_loop.quit(0); });
    auto scheduler = Compositor::create_vsync_scheduler({}, [&](MonotonicTime) {
        ++tick_count;
        if (tick_count == 1)
            after_tick->start();
    });

    timeout->start();
    scheduler->schedule(120);
    scheduler->schedule(120);
    scheduler->schedule(120);
    event_loop.exec();

    EXPECT_EQ(tick_count, 1);
}

TEST_CASE(a_tick_callback_can_request_the_next_tick)
{
    Core::EventLoop event_loop;
    int tick_count = 0;
    auto timeout = Core::Timer::create_single_shot(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000), [&] { event_loop.quit(0); });
    OwnPtr<Compositor::VSyncScheduler> scheduler;
    scheduler = Compositor::create_vsync_scheduler({}, [&](MonotonicTime) {
        if (++tick_count == 1)
            scheduler->schedule(120);
        else
            event_loop.quit(0);
    });

    timeout->start();
    scheduler->schedule(120);
    event_loop.exec();

    EXPECT_EQ(tick_count, 2);
}

TEST_CASE(a_refresh_rate_change_rearms_the_pending_tick)
{
    Core::EventLoop event_loop;
    int tick_count = 0;
    auto timeout = Core::Timer::create_single_shot(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000), [&] { event_loop.quit(0); });
    auto scheduler = Compositor::create_vsync_scheduler({}, [&](MonotonicTime) {
        ++tick_count;
        event_loop.quit(0);
    });

    timeout->start();
    scheduler->schedule(0.1);
    scheduler->schedule(120);
    event_loop.exec();

    EXPECT_EQ(tick_count, 1);
}

FILE: Tests/Compositor/TestYUVData.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026, Aliaksandr Kalenik <kalenik.aliaksandr@gmail.com>
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <AK/Array.h>
#include <AK/FixedArray.h>
#include <Compositor/VideoFrameSkia.h>
#include <LibGfx/Bitmap.h>
#include <LibGfx/YUVData.h>
#include <LibTest/TestCase.h>

#include <core/SkYUVAPixmaps.h>

struct AllocatedPlanes {
    FixedArray<u8> storage;
    Gfx::YUVData data;
};

static ErrorOr<AllocatedPlanes> allocate_yuv_data(Gfx::IntSize size, u8 bit_depth, Media::Subsampling subsampling, Media::CodingIndependentCodePoints cicp)
{
    auto sizes = TRY(Gfx::YUVData::plane_sizes(size, bit_depth, subsampling));
    auto storage = TRY(FixedArray<u8>::create(sizes.total));

    auto y_data = storage.span().slice(0, sizes.y);
    auto u_data = storage.span().slice(sizes.y, sizes.u);
    auto v_data = storage.span().slice(sizes.y + sizes.u, sizes.v);
    auto data = TRY(Gfx::YUVData::create(size, bit_depth, subsampling, cicp, y_data, u_data, v_data));

    return AllocatedPlanes {
        .storage = move(storage),
        .data = data,
    };
}

static u16 expand_10_bit_sample_to_full_16_bit_range(u16 sample)
{
    return static_cast<u16>((sample << 6) | (sample >> 4));
}

template<size_t Size>
static void write_samples(Bytes plane, Array<u16, Size> const& samples)
{
    auto* destination = reinterpret_cast<u16*>(plane.data());
    for (size_t i = 0; i < Size; i++)
        destination[i] = samples[i];
}

template<size_t Size>
static void expect_samples(Bytes plane, Array<u16, Size> const& expected)
{
    auto const* samples = reinterpret_cast<u16 const*>(plane.data());
    for (size_t i = 0; i < Size; i++)
        EXPECT_EQ(samples[i], expected[i]);
}

template<size_t Size>
static void expect_expanded_pixmap_samples(SkPixmap const& plane, Array<u16, Size> const& native_samples, int width)
{
    for (size_t i = 0; i < Size; i++) {
        auto x = static_cast<int>(i % static_cast<size_t>(width));
        auto y = static_cast<int>(i / static_cast<size_t>(width));
        EXPECT_EQ(*plane.addr16(x, y), expand_10_bit_sample_to_full_16_bit_range(native_samples[i]));
    }
}

TEST_CASE(high_bit_depth_pixmaps_expand_without_mutating_native_samples)
{
    auto const cicp = Media::CodingIndependentCodePoints {
        Media::ColorPrimaries::BT709,
        Media::TransferCharacteristics::BT709,
        Media::MatrixCoefficients::BT709,
        Media::VideoFullRangeFlag::Full,
    };
    auto allocated_planes = TRY_OR_FAIL(allocate_yuv_data({ 2, 2 }, 10, Media::Subsampling { false, false }, cicp));
    auto& yuv_data = allocated_planes.data;

    Array<u16, 4> const y_samples { 0, 341, 682, 1023 };
    Array<u16, 4> const u_samples { 512, 513, 514, 515 };
    Array<u16, 4> const v_samples { 508, 509, 510, 511 };

    write_samples(yuv_data.y_data(), y_samples);
    write_samples(yuv_data.u_data(), u_samples);
    write_samples(yuv_data.v_data(), v_samples);

    auto bitmap_before = TRY_OR_FAIL(yuv_data.to_bitmap());

    auto pixmaps = Compositor::make_yuva_pixmaps(yuv_data);
    EXPECT(pixmaps.isValid());
    EXPECT(pixmaps.ownsStorage());
    EXPECT(pixmaps.dataType() == SkYUVAPixmapInfo::DataType::kUnorm16);
    EXPECT_EQ(pixmaps.numPlanes(), 3);

    expect_expanded_pixmap_samples(pixmaps.plane(0), y_samples, 2);
    expect_expanded_pixmap_samples(pixmaps.plane(1), u_samples, 2);
    expect_expanded_pixmap_samples(pixmaps.plane(2), v_samples, 2);

    EXPECT_EQ(yuv_data.bit_depth(), 10);
    expect_samples(yuv_data.y_data(), y_samples);
    expect_samples(yuv_data.u_data(), u_samples);
    expect_samples(yuv_data.v_data(), v_samples);

    auto bitmap_after = TRY_OR_FAIL(yuv_data.to_bitmap());
    for (int y = 0; y < yuv_data.size().height(); y++) {
        for (int x = 0; x < yuv_data.size().width(); x++)
            EXPECT_EQ(bitmap_after->get_pixel(x, y), bitmap_before->get_pixel(x, y));
    }
}

#include <AK/Array.h>
#include <LibAudio/CoreAudioChannelLayout.h>
#include <LibTest/TestCase.h>

#include <CoreAudioTypes/CoreAudioBaseTypes.h>

TEST_CASE(layout_with_top_middle_speakers_names_every_channel)
{
    Array<AudioChannelLabel, 8> labels {
        kAudioChannelLabel_Left,
        kAudioChannelLabel_Right,
        kAudioChannelLabel_Center,
        kAudioChannelLabel_LFEScreen,
        kAudioChannelLabel_LeftSurround,
        kAudioChannelLabel_RightSurround,
        kAudioChannelLabel_LeftTopMiddle,
        kAudioChannelLabel_RightTopMiddle,
    };
    constexpr size_t layout_size = offsetof(AudioChannelLayout, mChannelDescriptions) + labels.size() * sizeof(AudioChannelDescription);
    alignas(AudioChannelLayout) Array<u8, layout_size> layout_storage {};
    auto& layout = *reinterpret_cast<AudioChannelLayout*>(layout_storage.data());
    layout.mChannelLayoutTag = kAudioChannelLayoutTag_UseChannelDescriptions;
    layout.mNumberChannelDescriptions = labels.size();
    // The SDK declares one description, so the rest are reached through the storage rather than past that array.
    auto* descriptions = reinterpret_cast<AudioChannelDescription*>(layout_storage.data() + offsetof(AudioChannelLayout, mChannelDescriptions));
    for (size_t i = 0; i < labels.size(); i++)
        descriptions[i].mChannelLabel = labels[i];

    auto channel_map = MUST(Audio::core_audio_channel_layout_to_channel_map(layout, layout_size));
    EXPECT_EQ(channel_map,
        Audio::ChannelMap(
            Audio::Channel::FrontLeft,
            Audio::Channel::FrontRight,
            Audio::Channel::FrontCenter,
            Audio::Channel::LowFrequency,
            Audio::Channel::BackLeft,
            Audio::Channel::BackRight,
            Audio::Channel::TopSideLeft,
            Audio::Channel::TopSideRight));
}

TEST_CASE(channel_bitmap_with_top_middle_speakers_names_every_channel)
{
    AudioChannelLayout layout {};
    layout.mChannelLayoutTag = kAudioChannelLayoutTag_UseChannelBitmap;
    layout.mChannelBitmap = kAudioChannelBit_Left | kAudioChannelBit_Right | kAudioChannelBit_LeftTopMiddle | kAudioChannelBit_RightTopMiddle;

    auto channel_map = MUST(Audio::core_audio_channel_layout_to_channel_map(layout, sizeof(layout)));
    EXPECT_EQ(channel_map,
        Audio::ChannelMap(
            Audio::Channel::FrontLeft,
            Audio::Channel::FrontRight,
            Audio::Channel::TopSideLeft,
            Audio::Channel::TopSideRight));
}

TEST_CASE(channel_bitmap_names_bits_without_a_position_as_unknown_channels)
{
    AudioChannelLayout layout {};
    layout.mChannelLayoutTag = kAudioChannelLayoutTag_UseChannelBitmap;
    constexpr u32 bit_without_a_position = 1u << 27;
    layout.mChannelBitmap = kAudioChannelBit_Left | kAudioChannelBit_Right | static_cast<AudioChannelBitmap>(bit_without_a_position);

    auto channel_map = MUST(Audio::core_audio_channel_layout_to_channel_map(layout, sizeof(layout)));
    EXPECT_EQ(channel_map,
        Audio::ChannelMap(
            Audio::Channel::FrontLeft,

FILE: Tests/LibAudio/TestPlaybackStream.cpp
/*

#include <AK/Atomic.h>
#include <AK/ConditionVariable.h>
#include <AK/Mutex.h>
#include <AK/NeverDestroyed.h>
#include <LibAudio/NullPlaybackStream.h>
#include <LibCore/EventLoop.h>
#include <LibCore/Timer.h>
#include <LibTest/TestSuite.h>

static Core::EventLoop& never_destroyed_event_loop()
{
    static NeverDestroyed<Core::EventLoop> s_event_loop;
    return *s_event_loop;
}

TEST_CASE(null_playback_stream_completes_interleaved_controls_in_order)
{
    Mutex mutex;
    ConditionVariable condition { mutex };
    Vector<u32> completions;
    auto record_completion = [&](u32 index) {
        MutexLocker locker(mutex);
        completions.append(index);
        condition.signal();
    };

    RefPtr<Audio::PlaybackStream> stream;
    stream = Audio::NullPlaybackStream::create(Audio::OutputState::Suspended, 10, [&](Span<float>, MonotonicTime) -> ReadonlySpan<float> {
        // Queue all controls from the data callback so the output thread cannot resolve any of them until the batch is ready.
        stream->drain_buffer_and_suspend()
            ->when_resolved([&] { record_completion(0); })
            .when_rejected([](Error const&) { VERIFY_NOT_REACHED(); });
        stream->resume()
            ->when_resolved([&] { record_completion(1); })
            .when_rejected([](Error const&) { VERIFY_NOT_REACHED(); });
        stream->set_volume(0.5)
            ->when_resolved([&] { record_completion(2); })
            .when_rejected([](Error const&) { VERIFY_NOT_REACHED(); });
        stream->discard_buffer_and_suspend()
            ->when_resolved([&] { record_completion(3); })
            .when_rejected([](Error const&) { VERIFY_NOT_REACHED(); });
        stream->resume()
            ->when_resolved([&] { record_completion(4); })
            .when_rejected([](Error const&) { VERIFY_NOT_REACHED(); });
        stream->discard_buffer_and_suspend()
            ->when_resolved([&] { record_completion(5); })
            .when_rejected([](Error const&) { VERIFY_NOT_REACHED(); });
        return {};
    });
    stream->resume()->when_rejected([](Error const&) { VERIFY_NOT_REACHED(); });

    MutexLocker locker(mutex);
    condition.wait_while([&] { return completions.size() < 6; });
    for (u32 index = 0; index < completions.size(); ++index)
        EXPECT_EQ(completions[index], index);
}

TEST_CASE(null_playback_stream_pulls_only_while_playing)
{
    auto& event_loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    Atomic<u32> request_count { 0 };
    auto stream = Audio::NullPlaybackStream::create(Audio::OutputState::Suspended, 10, [&](Span<float> buffer, MonotonicTime) -> ReadonlySpan<float> {
        request_count.fetch_add(1);
        return buffer;
    });

    EXPECT_EQ(request_count.load(), 0u);
    EXPECT_EQ(stream->sample_specification().sample_rate(), 44100u);
    EXPECT_EQ(stream->sample_specification().channel_map(), Audio::ChannelMap::stereo());

    stream->resume()->when_rejected([](Error const&) { VERIFY_NOT_REACHED(); });
    auto poll_timer = Core::Timer::create_repeating(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1), [] { });
    poll_timer->start();
    event_loop.spin_until([&] { return request_count.load() > 0; });

    Atomic<bool> suspended { false };
    stream->discard_buffer_and_suspend()
        ->when_resolved([&] { suspended.store(true); })
        .when_rejected([](Error const&) { VERIFY_NOT_REACHED(); });
    event_loop.spin_until([&] { return suspended.load(); });
    poll_timer->stop();
    auto request_count_when_suspended = request_count.load();

    bool checked_suspension = false;
    auto timer = Core::Timer::create_single_shot(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(20), [&] {
        EXPECT_EQ(request_count.load(), request_count_when_suspended);
        checked_suspension = true;
    });
    timer->start();
    event_loop.spin_until([&] { return checked_suspension; });
}

TEST_CASE(null_playback_stream_dates_each_buffer_by_what_it_holds)
{
    auto& event_loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto resumed_at = MonotonicTime::now();
    Atomic<u32> request_count { 0 };
    Atomic<bool> every_buffer_dated_by_what_it_holds { true };
    // Only the output thread reads and writes this.
    auto previous_buffer_ends_at = resumed_at;
    auto stream = Audio::NullPlaybackStream::create(Audio::OutputState::Suspended, 100, [&](Span<float> buffer, MonotonicTime buffer_starts_playing_at) -> ReadonlySpan<float> {
        // Each buffer starts where the one before it ends, or later after an underrun, and never more than the target
        // after it was requested, however late the output thread runs.
        auto now = MonotonicTime::now();
        if (buffer_starts_playing_at < previous_buffer_ends_at - AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1) || buffer_starts_playing_at > now + AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(100))
            every_buffer_dated_by_what_it_holds.store(false);
        previous_buffer_ends_at = buffer_starts_playing_at + AK::Duration::from_time_units(buffer.size() / 2, 1, 44100);
        request_count.fetch_add(1);
        return buffer;
    });

    stream->resume()->when_rejected([](Error const&) { VERIFY_NOT_REACHED(); });
    auto poll_timer = Core::Timer::create_repeating(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1), [] { });
    poll_timer->start();
    event_loop.spin_until([&] { return request_count.load() > 2; });
    EXPECT(every_buffer_dated_by_what_it_holds.load());
    poll_timer->stop();
    stream->discard_buffer_and_suspend()->when_rejected([](Error const&) { VERIFY_NOT_REACHED(); });
}

TEST_CASE(null_playback_stream_recovers_from_underrun)
{
    auto& event_loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    Atomic<u32> request_count { 0 };
    auto stream = Audio::NullPlaybackStream::create(Audio::OutputState::Suspended, 10, [&](Span<float> buffer, MonotonicTime) -> ReadonlySpan<float> {
        if (request_count.fetch_add(1) == 0)
            return {};
        return buffer;
    });
    stream->resume()->when_rejected([](Error const&) { VERIFY_NOT_REACHED(); });

    auto poll_timer = Core::Timer::create_repeating(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1), [&] {
        stream->notify_data_available();
    });
    poll_timer->start();
    event_loop.spin_until([&] { return request_count.load() > 1; });
    poll_timer->stop();
}

TEST_CASE(null_playback_stream_resume_completes_pending_drain)
{
    auto& event_loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    Atomic<u32> request_count { 0 };
    auto stream = Audio::NullPlaybackStream::create(Audio::OutputState::Suspended, 1000, [&](Span<float> buffer, MonotonicTime) -> ReadonlySpan<float> {
        request_count.fetch_add(1);
        return buffer;
    });
    stream->resume()->when_rejected([](Error const&) { VERIFY_NOT_REACHED(); });

    auto poll_timer = Core::Timer::create_repeating(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1), [] { });
    poll_timer->start();
    event_loop.spin_until([&] { return request_count.load() > 0; });

    Atomic<bool> drained { false };
    stream->drain_buffer_and_suspend()
        ->when_resolved([&] { drained.store(true); })
        .when_rejected([](Error const&) { VERIFY_NOT_REACHED(); });
    stream->resume()->when_rejected([](Error const&) { VERIFY_NOT_REACHED(); });

    bool checked_drain = false;
    auto timer = Core::Timer::create_single_shot(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(50), [&] {
        EXPECT(drained.load());
        checked_drain = true;
    });
    timer->start();
    event_loop.spin_until([&] { return checked_drain; });
    poll_timer->stop();
}

FILE: Tests/LibAudio/TestSharedAudioFrameRing.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause

#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibAudio/SharedAudioFrameRing.h>
#include <LibCore/System.h>
#include <LibTest/TestCase.h>
#include <LibThreading/Thread.h>
#include <math.h>

static constexpr u32 SAMPLE_RATE = 48000;
static constexpr u32 CHANNEL_COUNT = 2;

// Encodes a float32-exact stamp for each sample of a frame, so that any reordered, torn,
// or repeated frame is detectable.
static float sample_for_frame(u64 frame_index, u32 channel)
{
    return static_cast<float>(frame_index % (1u << 20)) + (static_cast<float>(channel) * 0.25f);
}

static Vector<float> make_frames(u64 first_frame_index, size_t frame_count)
{
    Vector<float> samples;
    samples.ensure_capacity(frame_count * CHANNEL_COUNT);
    for (u64 frame = first_frame_index; frame < first_frame_index + frame_count; ++frame)
        for (u32 channel = 0; channel < CHANNEL_COUNT; ++channel)
            samples.append(sample_for_frame(frame, channel));
    return samples;
}

// A second mapping of the same memory, the way the consuming process receives it.
static Audio::SharedAudioFrameRing map_consumer_side(Audio::SharedAudioFrameRing const& producer_ring)
{
    auto buffer = MUST(Core::AnonymousBuffer::create_from_anon_fd(MUST(Core::System::dup(producer_ring.buffer().fd())), producer_ring.buffer().size()));
    return MUST(Audio::SharedAudioFrameRing::create(move(buffer)));
}

TEST_CASE(capacity_is_rounded_up_to_a_power_of_two)
{
    auto ring = MUST(Audio::SharedAudioFrameRing::create(SAMPLE_RATE, CHANNEL_COUNT, 3));
    EXPECT_EQ(ring.frame_capacity(), 4u);
    EXPECT_EQ(ring.sample_rate(), SAMPLE_RATE);
    EXPECT_EQ(ring.channel_count(), CHANNEL_COUNT);
    EXPECT_EQ(ring.frames_available(), 0u);
    EXPECT_EQ(ring.frames_free(), 4u);

    auto exact_ring = MUST(Audio::SharedAudioFrameRing::create(SAMPLE_RATE, 1, 8));
    EXPECT_EQ(exact_ring.frame_capacity(), 8u);
}

TEST_CASE(consumer_mapping_sees_the_header_and_the_frames)
{
    auto producer = MUST(Audio::SharedAudioFrameRing::create(SAMPLE_RATE, CHANNEL_COUNT, 16));
    auto consumer = map_consumer_side(producer);
    EXPECT_EQ(consumer.frame_capacity(), 16u);
    EXPECT_EQ(consumer.sample_rate(), SAMPLE_RATE);
    EXPECT_EQ(consumer.channel_count(), CHANNEL_COUNT);

    EXPECT_EQ(producer.try_push(make_frames(0, 5)), 5u);
    EXPECT_EQ(consumer.frames_available(), 5u);

    Vector<float> output;
    output.resize(5 * CHANNEL_COUNT);
    EXPECT_EQ(consumer.try_pop(output), 5u);
    for (u64 frame = 0; frame < 5; ++frame)
        for (u32 channel = 0; channel < CHANNEL_COUNT; ++channel)
            EXPECT_EQ(output[frame * CHANNEL_COUNT + channel], sample_for_frame(frame, channel));
    EXPECT_EQ(producer.frames_free(), 16u);
}

TEST_CASE(fill_and_drain_wraps_around)
{
    auto producer = MUST(Audio::SharedAudioFrameRing::create(SAMPLE_RATE, CHANNEL_COUNT, 8));
    auto consumer = map_consumer_side(producer);

    EXPECT_EQ(producer.try_push(make_frames(0, 6)), 6u);
    Vector<float> output;
    output.resize(4 * CHANNEL_COUNT);
    EXPECT_EQ(consumer.try_pop(output), 4u);

    // Six more frames fit (two remain), and the write straddles the end of the storage.
    EXPECT_EQ(producer.try_push(make_frames(6, 8)), 6u);
    EXPECT_EQ(producer.frames_free(), 0u);
    EXPECT_EQ(producer.frames_written(), 12u);

    output.resize(8 * CHANNEL_COUNT);
    EXPECT_EQ(consumer.try_pop(output), 8u);
    for (u64 frame = 4; frame < 12; ++frame)
        for (u32 channel = 0; channel < CHANNEL_COUNT; ++channel)
            EXPECT_EQ(output[(frame - 4) * CHANNEL_COUNT + channel], sample_for_frame(frame, channel));
    EXPECT_EQ(consumer.frames_available(), 0u);
}

TEST_CASE(mixing_pop_scales_and_accumulates)
{
    auto producer = MUST(Audio::SharedAudioFrameRing::create(SAMPLE_RATE, CHANNEL_COUNT, 8));
    auto consumer = map_consumer_side(producer);

    // Push across the wrap point so the mix walks both chunks.
    Vector<float> output;
    output.resize(6 * CHANNEL_COUNT);
    EXPECT_EQ(producer.try_push(make_frames(0, 6)), 6u);
    EXPECT_EQ(consumer.try_pop(output), 6u);
    EXPECT_EQ(producer.try_push(make_frames(6, 4)), 4u);

    Vector<float> mix;
    mix.resize(6 * CHANNEL_COUNT);
    mix.fill(1.0f);
    EXPECT_EQ(consumer.pop_mixing_into(mix, 0.5f), 4u);
    for (u64 frame = 6; frame < 10; ++frame)
        for (u32 channel = 0; channel < CHANNEL_COUNT; ++channel)
            EXPECT_EQ(mix[(frame - 6) * CHANNEL_COUNT + channel], 1.0f + sample_for_frame(frame, channel) * 0.5f);
    // Frames the ring could not supply are left alone.
    for (size_t i = 4 * CHANNEL_COUNT; i < mix.size(); ++i)
        EXPECT_EQ(mix[i], 1.0f);
    EXPECT_EQ(consumer.frames_available(), 0u);
}

TEST_CASE(mixing_pop_wraps_with_six_channels)
{
    // Eight frames of six channels hold 48 samples, which is not a power of two.
    static constexpr u32 channel_count = 6;
    auto producer = MUST(Audio::SharedAudioFrameRing::create(SAMPLE_RATE, channel_count, 8));
    auto consumer = map_consumer_side(producer);
    // Kept within the magnitude a mixing pop lets through.
    auto stamp = [](u64 frame, u32 channel) { return static_cast<float>(frame) + (static_cast<float>(channel) * 0.125f); };
    auto push_frames = [&](u64 first_frame, size_t frame_count) {
        Vector<float> samples;
        for (u64 frame = first_frame; frame < first_frame + frame_count; ++frame)
            for (u32 channel = 0; channel < channel_count; ++channel)
                samples.append(stamp(frame, channel));
        EXPECT_EQ(producer.try_push(samples), frame_count);
    };

    Vector<float> output;
    output.resize(5 * channel_count);
    push_frames(0, 5);
    EXPECT_EQ(consumer.try_pop(output), 5u);
    push_frames(5, 8);

    Vector<float> mix;
    mix.resize(8 * channel_count);
    mix.fill(0.0f);
    EXPECT_EQ(consumer.pop_mixing_into(mix, 1.0f), 8u);
    for (u64 frame = 5; frame < 13; ++frame)
        for (u32 channel = 0; channel < channel_count; ++channel)
            EXPECT_EQ(mix[(frame - 5) * channel_count + channel], stamp(frame, channel));
}

TEST_CASE(mixing_pop_keeps_the_mix_finite)
{
    auto producer = MUST(Audio::SharedAudioFrameRing::create(SAMPLE_RATE, CHANNEL_COUNT, 8));
    auto consumer = map_consumer_side(producer);
    auto huge = NumericLimits<float>::max();
    EXPECT_EQ(producer.try_push(Vector<float> { NAN, INFINITY, -INFINITY, 0.5f, huge, -huge, huge, -huge }), 4u);

    // Non-finite samples add nothing, and the rest pass through.
    Vector<float> mix;
    mix.resize(2 * CHANNEL_COUNT);
    mix.fill(0.0f);
    EXPECT_EQ(consumer.pop_mixing_into(mix, 1.0f), 2u);
    EXPECT_EQ(mix[0], 0.0f);
    EXPECT_EQ(mix[1], 0.0f);
    EXPECT_EQ(mix[2], 0.0f);
    EXPECT_EQ(mix[3], 0.5f);

    // Huge samples are bounded, so adding two of them up stays finite.
    mix.resize(CHANNEL_COUNT);
    mix.fill(0.0f);
    EXPECT_EQ(consumer.pop_mixing_into(mix, 1.0f), 1u);
    EXPECT_EQ(consumer.pop_mixing_into(mix, 1.0f), 1u);
    EXPECT(isfinite(mix[0]) && mix[0] > 0.0f);
    EXPECT(isfinite(mix[1]) && mix[1] < 0.0f);
}

TEST_CASE(discard_all_empties_the_ring)
{
    auto producer = MUST(Audio::SharedAudioFrameRing::create(SAMPLE_RATE, CHANNEL_COUNT, 8));
    auto consumer = map_consumer_side(producer);
    EXPECT_EQ(producer.try_push(make_frames(0, 7)), 7u);
    consumer.discard_all();
    EXPECT_EQ(consumer.frames_available(), 0u);
    EXPECT_EQ(producer.frames_free(), 8u);
    EXPECT_EQ(producer.frames_written(), 7u);
}

TEST_CASE(played_frames_follow_the_consumption_anchor)
{
    auto producer = MUST(Audio::SharedAudioFrameRing::create(SAMPLE_RATE, CHANNEL_COUNT, 1024));
    auto consumer = map_consumer_side(producer);

    // Nothing published yet: nothing played.
    EXPECT_EQ(producer.estimate_frames_played(1'000'000), 0u);

    EXPECT_EQ(producer.try_push(make_frames(0, 600)), 600u);
    Vector<float> output;
    output.resize(480 * CHANNEL_COUNT);
    EXPECT_EQ(consumer.try_pop(output), 480u);
    // The device will have played those 480 frames at 10 ms.
    consumer.publish_consumption(10'000'000, true);

    // 1 ms before that, 48 of them are still in the device.
    EXPECT_EQ(producer.estimate_frames_played(9'000'000), 432u);
    // At the anchor instant, exactly the consumed frames have played.
    EXPECT_EQ(producer.estimate_frames_played(10'000'000), 480u);
    // Extrapolation at the sample rate: 1 ms later is 48 more frames.
    EXPECT_EQ(producer.estimate_frames_played(11'000'000), 528u);
    // Never past what was written.
    EXPECT_EQ(producer.estimate_frames_played(1'000'000'000), 600u);
    // Never decreasing, even if asked about an earlier instant afterwards.
    EXPECT_EQ(producer.estimate_frames_played(10'500'000), 600u);

    // A non-playing anchor still plays out what the device holds, then freezes at its consumed count.
    auto fresh_producer = MUST(Audio::SharedAudioFrameRing::create(SAMPLE_RATE, CHANNEL_COUNT, 1024));
    auto fresh_consumer = map_consumer_side(fresh_producer);
    EXPECT_EQ(fresh_producer.try_push(make_frames(0, 600)), 600u);
    EXPECT_EQ(fresh_consumer.try_pop(output), 480u);
    fresh_consumer.publish_consumption(10'000'000, false);
    EXPECT_EQ(fresh_producer.estimate_frames_played(5'000'000), 240u);
    EXPECT_EQ(fresh_producer.estimate_frames_played(20'000'000), 480u);

    // A device holding more than was ever consumed from this ring has played none of it.
    auto late_producer = MUST(Audio::SharedAudioFrameRing::create(SAMPLE_RATE, CHANNEL_COUNT, 1024));
    auto late_consumer = map_consumer_side(late_producer);
    EXPECT_EQ(late_producer.try_push(make_frames(0, 48)), 48u);
    EXPECT_EQ(late_consumer.try_pop(output), 48u);
    late_consumer.publish_consumption(10'000'000, true);
    EXPECT_EQ(late_producer.estimate_frames_played(1'000'000), 0u);
}

TEST_CASE(rejects_buffers_that_do_not_match_their_header)
{
    auto producer = MUST(Audio::SharedAudioFrameRing::create(SAMPLE_RATE, CHANNEL_COUNT, 64));

    // A mapping that claims fewer bytes than the header's capacity needs.
    auto truncated = MUST(Core::AnonymousBuffer::create_from_anon_fd(MUST(Core::System::dup(producer.buffer().fd())), 512));
    EXPECT(Audio::SharedAudioFrameRing::create(move(truncated)).is_error());

    // A buffer with no header to speak of.
    auto zeroed = MUST(Core::AnonymousBuffer::create_with_size(4096));
    EXPECT(Audio::SharedAudioFrameRing::create(move(zeroed)).is_error());

    // A power-of-two capacity whose size in bytes wraps around to nothing.
    auto overflowing = producer.buffer();
    reinterpret_cast<Audio::AudioFrameRingHeader*>(overflowing.data<void>())->frame_capacity = 1ull << 61;
    EXPECT(Audio::SharedAudioFrameRing::create(move(overflowing)).is_error());
}

TEST_CASE(concurrent_producer_and_consumer_preserve_frame_order)
{
    static constexpr u64 TOTAL_FRAMES = 200'000;
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA auto producer = MUST(Audio::SharedAudioFrameRing::create(SAMPLE_RATE, CHANNEL_COUNT, 256));
    auto consumer = map_consumer_side(producer);

    auto producer_thread = Threading::Thread::construct("RingProducer"sv, [&]() -> intptr_t {
        u64 next_frame = 0;
        while (next_frame < TOTAL_FRAMES) {
            auto frame_count = min<u64>(37, TOTAL_FRAMES - next_frame);
            auto frames = make_frames(next_frame, frame_count);
            size_t pushed_frames = 0;
            while (pushed_frames < frame_count) {
                auto remaining = ReadonlySpan<float>(frames).slice(pushed_frames * CHANNEL_COUNT);
                pushed_frames += producer.try_push(remaining);
            }
            next_frame += frame_count;
        }
        return 0;
    });
    producer_thread->start();

    Vector<float> output;
    output.resize(53 * CHANNEL_COUNT);
    u64 next_expected_frame = 0;
    bool all_in_order = true;
    while (next_expected_frame < TOTAL_FRAMES) {
        auto popped_frames = consumer.try_pop(output);
        for (size_t frame = 0; frame < popped_frames; ++frame) {
            for (u32 channel = 0; channel < CHANNEL_COUNT; ++channel) {
                if (output[frame * CHANNEL_COUNT + channel] != sample_for_frame(next_expected_frame, channel))
                    all_in_order = false;
            }
            next_expected_frame++;
        }
    }
    (void)producer_thread->join();
    EXPECT(all_in_order);
    EXPECT_EQ(consumer.frames_available(), 0u);
}

#include <AK/Time.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibAudio/SpscAudioFrameRing.h>
#include <LibTest/TestCase.h>
#include <LibThreading/Thread.h>

static constexpr u32 CHANNEL_COUNT = 2;

// Encodes a float32-exact stamp for each sample of a frame, so that any reordered, torn,
// or repeated frame is detectable.
static float sample_for_frame(u64 frame_index, u32 channel)
{
    return static_cast<float>(frame_index % (1u << 20)) + (static_cast<float>(channel) * 0.25f);
}

static Vector<float> make_frames(u64 first_frame_index, size_t frame_count)
{
    Vector<float> samples;
    samples.ensure_capacity(frame_count * CHANNEL_COUNT);
    for (u64 frame = first_frame_index; frame < first_frame_index + frame_count; ++frame)
        for (u32 channel = 0; channel < CHANNEL_COUNT; ++channel)
            samples.append(sample_for_frame(frame, channel));
    return samples;
}

TEST_CASE(capacity_is_rounded_up_to_a_power_of_two)
{
    auto ring = make_ref_counted<Audio::SpscAudioFrameRing>(3, CHANNEL_COUNT);
    EXPECT_EQ(ring->frame_capacity(), 4u);
    EXPECT_EQ(ring->channel_count(), CHANNEL_COUNT);
    EXPECT_EQ(ring->frames_available(), 0u);
    EXPECT_EQ(ring->frames_free(), 4u);

    auto exact_ring = make_ref_counted<Audio::SpscAudioFrameRing>(8, 1u);
    EXPECT_EQ(exact_ring->frame_capacity(), 8u);
}

TEST_CASE(fill_and_drain)
{
    auto ring = make_ref_counted<Audio::SpscAudioFrameRing>(8, CHANNEL_COUNT);

    auto input = make_frames(0, 8);
    EXPECT_EQ(ring->try_push(input), 8u);
    EXPECT_EQ(ring->frames_available(), 8u);
    EXPECT_EQ(ring->frames_free(), 0u);

    EXPECT_EQ(ring->try_push(input), 0u);

    Vector<float> output;
    output.resize(8 * CHANNEL_COUNT);
    EXPECT_EQ(ring->try_pop(output), 8u);
    EXPECT_EQ(ring->frames_available(), 0u);
    EXPECT_EQ(ring->frames_free(), 8u);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < output.size(); ++i)
        EXPECT_EQ(output[i], input[i]);

    EXPECT_EQ(ring->try_pop(output), 0u);
}

TEST_CASE(partial_push_and_pop)
{
    auto ring = make_ref_counted<Audio::SpscAudioFrameRing>(4, CHANNEL_COUNT);

    auto three_frames = make_frames(0, 3);
    EXPECT_EQ(ring->try_push(three_frames), 3u);
    EXPECT_EQ(ring->try_push(three_frames), 1u);
    EXPECT_EQ(ring->frames_free(), 0u);

    Vector<float> output;
    output.resize(8 * CHANNEL_COUNT);
    EXPECT_EQ(ring->try_pop(output), 4u);

    for (u64 frame = 0; frame < 3; ++frame)
        for (u32 channel = 0; channel < CHANNEL_COUNT; ++channel)
            EXPECT_EQ(output[frame * CHANNEL_COUNT + channel], sample_for_frame(frame, channel));
    for (u32 channel = 0; channel < CHANNEL_COUNT; ++channel)
        EXPECT_EQ(output[3 * CHANNEL_COUNT + channel], sample_for_frame(0, channel));
}

TEST_CASE(wraparound_preserves_frame_order)
{
    auto ring = make_ref_counted<Audio::SpscAudioFrameRing>(8, CHANNEL_COUNT);

    // Push and pop 5 frames at a time; 5 does not divide 8, so the writes and reads keep
    // crossing the wraparound boundary at different offsets.
    u64 next_frame = 0;
    Vector<float> output;
    output.resize(5 * CHANNEL_COUNT);
    for (int iteration = 0; iteration < 100; ++iteration) {
        EXPECT_EQ(ring->try_push(make_frames(next_frame, 5)), 5u);
        EXPECT_EQ(ring->try_pop(output), 5u);
        for (u64 i = 0; i < 5; ++i)
            for (u32 channel = 0; channel < CHANNEL_COUNT; ++channel)
                EXPECT_EQ(output[i * CHANNEL_COUNT + channel], sample_for_frame(next_frame + i, channel));
        next_frame += 5;
    }
}

TEST_CASE(two_thread_stress)
{
    auto ring = make_ref_counted<Audio::SpscAudioFrameRing>(64, CHANNEL_COUNT);

    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<bool> producer_done { false };
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<u64> frames_pushed { 0 };
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<u64> frames_popped { 0 };
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<u64> mismatch_count { 0 };

    auto producer_thread = Threading::Thread::construct("RingProducer"sv, [ring, &producer_done, &frames_pushed]() {
        auto deadline = MonotonicTime::now() + AK::Duration::from_seconds(1);
        u64 next_frame = 0;
        size_t chunk_frames = 1;
        while (MonotonicTime::now() < deadline) {
            auto chunk = make_frames(next_frame, chunk_frames);

            // Retry the frames that did not fit, so the consumer sees an unbroken sequence.
            size_t frames_written = 0;
            while (frames_written < chunk_frames)
                frames_written += ring->try_push(chunk.span().slice(frames_written * CHANNEL_COUNT));

            next_frame += chunk_frames;
            chunk_frames = (chunk_frames % 17) + 1;
        }
        frames_pushed.store(next_frame);
        producer_done.store(true);
        return 0;
    });

    auto consumer_thread = Threading::Thread::construct("RingConsumer"sv, [ring, &producer_done, &frames_popped, &mismatch_count]() {
        u64 next_frame = 0;
        u64 mismatches = 0;
        size_t chunk_frames = 3;
        Vector<float> buffer;
        buffer.resize(17 * CHANNEL_COUNT);
        while (true) {
            auto frames_read = ring->try_pop(buffer.span().slice(0, chunk_frames * CHANNEL_COUNT));
            if (frames_read == 0) {
                if (producer_done.load() && ring->frames_available() == 0)
                    break;
                continue;
            }
            for (u64 i = 0; i < frames_read; ++i)
                for (u32 channel = 0; channel < CHANNEL_COUNT; ++channel)
                    if (buffer[i * CHANNEL_COUNT + channel] != sample_for_frame(next_frame + i, channel))
                        ++mismatches;
            next_frame += frames_read;
            chunk_frames = (chunk_frames % 13) + 1;
        }
        frames_popped.store(next_frame);
        mismatch_count.store(mismatches);
        return 0;
    });

    producer_thread->start();
    consumer_thread->start();
    (void)producer_thread->join();
    (void)consumer_thread->join();

    EXPECT(frames_pushed.load() > 0u);
    EXPECT_EQ(frames_popped.load(), frames_pushed.load());
    EXPECT_EQ(mismatch_count.load(), 0u);
    EXPECT_EQ(ring->frames_available(), 0u);
}

    Second,

FILE: Tests/LibCompositing/TestScrollRequest.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <LibCompositing/Types.h>
#include <LibTest/TestCase.h>

using namespace Compositing;

static RequestedRelativeScroll scroll_by(float delta, float minimum, float maximum)
{
    return {
        .delta = { 0, delta },
        .lower_bound = { 0, minimum },
        .upper_bound = { 0, maximum },
    };
}

// Applying each scroll in turn, clamped to the range it had.
static float scrolled_in_turn(float offset, ReadonlySpan<RequestedRelativeScroll> scrolls)
{
    for (auto const& scroll : scrolls)
        offset = scroll.applied_to({ 0, offset }).y();
    return offset;
}

TEST_CASE(folded_relative_scrolls_clamp_where_each_did)
{
    Array scrolls {
        scroll_by(300, 0, 500),
        scroll_by(-450, 0, 500),
        scroll_by(100, 0, 800),
    };
    auto folded = scrolls[0];
    folded.then(scrolls[1]);
    folded.then(scrolls[2]);

    for (float offset : { 0.0f, 100.0f, 250.0f, 400.0f, 500.0f, 700.0f })
        EXPECT_EQ(folded.applied_to({ 0, offset }).y(), scrolled_in_turn(offset, scrolls));
}

TEST_CASE(relative_scroll_after_a_jump_replaces_the_one_before)
{
    ScrollRequest request { .stable_node_id = {}, .request_id = 1, .jump_offset = {}, .visual_viewport_scale = {}, .relative_scroll = scroll_by(100, 0, 500), .relative_scroll_moves_visual_viewport_first = false, .instant_scroll_is_for_user_input = false, .smooth_scroll = {}, .takes_over_from_momentum = false };
    ScrollRequest jump { .stable_node_id = {}, .request_id = 2, .jump_offset = Gfx::FloatPoint { 0, 40 }, .visual_viewport_scale = {}, .relative_scroll = scroll_by(10, 0, 500), .relative_scroll_moves_visual_viewport_first = false, .instant_scroll_is_for_user_input = false, .smooth_scroll = {}, .takes_over_from_momentum = false };
    request.fold_later(jump);

    EXPECT_EQ(request.request_id, 2u);
    EXPECT_EQ(request.jump_offset, Gfx::FloatPoint(0, 40));
    EXPECT_EQ(request.relative_scroll->applied_to({ 0, 40 }).y(), 50.0f);
}

TEST_CASE(later_relative_scroll_folds_into_the_one_before)
{
    ScrollRequest request { .stable_node_id = {}, .request_id = 1, .jump_offset = Gfx::FloatPoint { 0, 40 }, .visual_viewport_scale = {}, .relative_scroll = scroll_by(500, 0, 500), .relative_scroll_moves_visual_viewport_first = false, .instant_scroll_is_for_user_input = false, .smooth_scroll = {}, .takes_over_from_momentum = false };
    ScrollRequest later { .stable_node_id = {}, .request_id = 2, .jump_offset = {}, .visual_viewport_scale = {}, .relative_scroll = scroll_by(-100, 0, 500), .relative_scroll_moves_visual_viewport_first = false, .instant_scroll_is_for_user_input = false, .smooth_scroll = {}, .takes_over_from_momentum = false };
    request.fold_later(later);

    EXPECT_EQ(request.jump_offset, Gfx::FloatPoint(0, 40));
    EXPECT_EQ(request.relative_scroll->applied_to({ 0, 40 }).y(), 400.0f);
}

static RequestedSmoothScroll smooth_scroll(Gfx::FloatPoint destination_offset, bool destination_is_relative, bool retargets_operation)
{
    return {
        .operation_id = first_operation_id_the_main_thread_requests + 1,
        .destination_offset = destination_offset,
        .destination_is_relative = destination_is_relative,
        .animation_kind = ScrollAnimationKind::SmoothScroll,
        .initiator = SmoothScrollInitiator::UserInput,
        .retargets_operation = retargets_operation,
        .settled_user_input_scroll_count = {},
    };
}

TEST_CASE(later_step_of_an_unsent_operation_goes_on_from_where_it_was_headed)
{
    auto by_a_distance = smooth_scroll({ 0, 100 }, true, false);
    by_a_distance.fold_later(smooth_scroll({ 0, 100 }, true, true));
    EXPECT_EQ(by_a_distance.destination_offset, Gfx::FloatPoint(0, 200));
    EXPECT(by_a_distance.destination_is_relative);
    EXPECT(by_a_distance.retargets_operation);

    auto to_an_offset = smooth_scroll({ 0, 300 }, false, false);
    to_an_offset.fold_later(smooth_scroll({ 0, 100 }, true, true));
    EXPECT_EQ(to_an_offset.destination_offset, Gfx::FloatPoint(0, 400));
    EXPECT(!to_an_offset.destination_is_relative);

    auto then_to_an_offset = smooth_scroll({ 0, 100 }, true, true);
    then_to_an_offset.fold_later(smooth_scroll({ 0, 50 }, false, false));
    EXPECT_EQ(then_to_an_offset.destination_offset, Gfx::FloatPoint(0, 50));
    EXPECT(!then_to_an_offset.destination_is_relative);
    EXPECT(then_to_an_offset.retargets_operation);
}

TEST_CASE(step_past_the_end_of_the_scroll_range_takes_nothing_from_the_later_step_of_an_unsent_operation)
{
    auto step = [](float delta) {
        auto scroll = smooth_scroll({ 0, delta }, true, true);
        scroll.relative_lower_bound = { 0, 0 };
        scroll.relative_upper_bound = { 0, 1000 };
        return scroll;
    };

    auto from_the_start = step(-100);
    from_the_start.fold_later(step(100));
    EXPECT_EQ(from_the_start.relative_scroll().applied_to({ 0, 0 }), Gfx::FloatPoint(0, 100));
    EXPECT_EQ(from_the_start.relative_scroll().applied_to({ 0, 500 }), Gfx::FloatPoint(0, 500));
    EXPECT_EQ(from_the_start.relative_scroll().applied_to({ 0, 1000 }), Gfx::FloatPoint(0, 1000));

    auto to_an_offset = smooth_scroll({ 0, 950 }, false, false);
    to_an_offset.fold_later(step(100));
    EXPECT_EQ(to_an_offset.destination_offset, Gfx::FloatPoint(0, 1000));
    to_an_offset.fold_later(step(-100));
    EXPECT_EQ(to_an_offset.destination_offset, Gfx::FloatPoint(0, 900));
}

FILE: Tests/LibCompositing/TestUIOverlays.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <AK/MemoryStream.h>
#include <AK/Queue.h>
#include <LibCompositing/UIOverlays.h>
#include <LibIPC/Attachment.h>
#include <LibIPC/Decoder.h>
#include <LibIPC/Encoder.h>
#include <LibIPC/Message.h>
#include <LibTest/TestCase.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/Page/InputEvent.h>

using namespace Compositing;

template<typename Encode>
static ErrorOr<UIOverlays> decode_overlays(Encode encode)
{
    IPC::MessageBuffer message_buffer;
    IPC::Encoder encoder { message_buffer };
    MUST(encode(encoder));

    auto data = message_buffer.take_data();
    FixedMemoryStream stream { data.span() };
    Queue<IPC::Attachment> attachments;
    IPC::Decoder decoder { stream, attachments };
    return IPC::decode<UIOverlays>(decoder);
}

TEST_CASE(overlays_survive_ipc)
{
    UIOverlays overlays;
    overlays.paused_debugger = PausedDebuggerOverlayState {
        .font_family = "Inter"_string,
        .hovered_action = PausedDebuggerOverlayAction::Continue,
    };
    overlays.picture_in_picture_controls = PictureInPictureControlsState {
        .shown = true,
        .hovered_control = PictureInPictureControl::BackToTab,
    };
    overlays.compositor_layers = CompositorLayersOverlayState {
        .font_family = "Example Sans"_string,
        .hidden_layer_ids = { 7, NumericLimits<u64>::max() },
        .selected_layer_ids = { 7, 8 },
        .hovered_layer_id = 9,
        .raster_count_reset_generation = 3,
    };

    auto decoded = MUST(decode_overlays([&](IPC::Encoder& encoder) { return encoder.encode(overlays); }));
    EXPECT(decoded == overlays);
}

TEST_CASE(an_overlay_that_is_not_shown_stays_absent)
{
    UIOverlays overlays;

    auto decoded = MUST(decode_overlays([&](IPC::Encoder& encoder) { return encoder.encode(overlays); }));
    EXPECT(!decoded.paused_debugger.has_value());
    EXPECT(!decoded.picture_in_picture_controls.has_value());
}

TEST_CASE(an_unknown_paused_debugger_action_is_rejected)
{
    auto decoded = decode_overlays([](IPC::Encoder& encoder) -> ErrorOr<void> {
        TRY(encoder.encode(true));
        TRY(encoder.encode(Optional<String> {}));
        TRY(encoder.encode(Optional<u8> { 255 }));
        TRY(encoder.encode(false));
        return {};
    });
    EXPECT(decoded.is_error());
}

TEST_CASE(an_unknown_picture_in_picture_control_is_rejected)
{
    auto decoded = decode_overlays([](IPC::Encoder& encoder) -> ErrorOr<void> {
        TRY(encoder.encode(false));
        TRY(encoder.encode(true));
        TRY(encoder.encode(true));
        TRY(encoder.encode(Optional<u8> { 255 }));
        return {};
    });
    EXPECT(decoded.is_error());
}

static Web::MouseEvent mouse_event(Web::MouseEvent::Type type, Web::UIEvents::MouseButton button = Web::UIEvents::MouseButton::Primary, Web::UIEvents::MouseButton buttons = Web::UIEvents::MouseButton::None)
{
    return {
        .type = type,
        .position = {},
        .screen_position = {},
        .button = button,
        .buttons = buttons,
        .browser_data = nullptr,
    };
}

static constexpr auto MouseDown = Web::MouseEvent::Type::MouseDown;
static constexpr auto MouseUp = Web::MouseEvent::Type::MouseUp;
static constexpr auto MouseMove = Web::MouseEvent::Type::MouseMove;
static constexpr auto MouseLeave = Web::MouseEvent::Type::MouseLeave;
static constexpr auto MouseCancel = Web::MouseEvent::Type::MouseCancel;

TEST_CASE(a_press_acts_once_released_over_its_button)
{
    OverlayPointerState<PausedDebuggerOverlayAction> pointer_state;
    pointer_state.handle_mouse_event(mouse_event(MouseDown), PausedDebuggerOverlayAction::StepOver);
    EXPECT(pointer_state.is_pressing());

    auto outcome = pointer_state.handle_mouse_event(mouse_event(MouseUp), PausedDebuggerOverlayAction::StepOver);
    EXPECT(outcome.activated_action == PausedDebuggerOverlayAction::StepOver);
    EXPECT(!pointer_state.is_pressing());
}

TEST_CASE(a_press_released_over_another_button_does_not_act)
{
    OverlayPointerState<PausedDebuggerOverlayAction> pointer_state;
    pointer_state.handle_mouse_event(mouse_event(MouseDown), PausedDebuggerOverlayAction::StepOver);

    auto outcome = pointer_state.handle_mouse_event(mouse_event(MouseUp), PausedDebuggerOverlayAction::Continue);
    EXPECT(!outcome.activated_action.has_value());
    EXPECT(!pointer_state.is_pressing());
}

TEST_CASE(a_press_released_away_from_the_buttons_does_not_act)
{
    OverlayPointerState<PausedDebuggerOverlayAction> pointer_state;
    pointer_state.handle_mouse_event(mouse_event(MouseDown), PausedDebuggerOverlayAction::StepOver);

    EXPECT(!pointer_state.handle_mouse_event(mouse_event(MouseUp), {}).activated_action.has_value());
}

TEST_CASE(a_press_ends_when_it_is_cancelled_or_the_pointer_leaves)
{
    OverlayPointerState<PausedDebuggerOverlayAction> pointer_state;
    pointer_state.handle_mouse_event(mouse_event(MouseDown), PausedDebuggerOverlayAction::Continue);
    pointer_state.handle_mouse_event(mouse_event(MouseCancel), {});
    EXPECT(!pointer_state.is_pressing());
    EXPECT(!pointer_state.handle_mouse_event(mouse_event(MouseUp), PausedDebuggerOverlayAction::Continue).activated_action.has_value());

    pointer_state.handle_mouse_event(mouse_event(MouseDown), PausedDebuggerOverlayAction::Continue);
    pointer_state.handle_mouse_event(mouse_event(MouseLeave), {});
    EXPECT(!pointer_state.is_pressing());
    EXPECT(!pointer_state.handle_mouse_event(mouse_event(MouseUp), PausedDebuggerOverlayAction::Continue).activated_action.has_value());
}

TEST_CASE(a_press_ends_once_its_button_is_no_longer_held)
{
    OverlayPointerState<PausedDebuggerOverlayAction> pointer_state;
    pointer_state.handle_mouse_event(mouse_event(MouseDown), PausedDebuggerOverlayAction::StepOver);
    pointer_state.handle_mouse_event(mouse_event(MouseMove, Web::UIEvents::MouseButton::None, Web::UIEvents::MouseButton::Primary), PausedDebuggerOverlayAction::StepOver);
    EXPECT(pointer_state.is_pressing());

    pointer_state.handle_mouse_event(mouse_event(MouseMove, Web::UIEvents::MouseButton::None), PausedDebuggerOverlayAction::StepOver);
    EXPECT(!pointer_state.is_pressing());
}

TEST_CASE(only_the_primary_button_presses_and_releases)
{
    OverlayPointerState<PausedDebuggerOverlayAction> pointer_state;
    pointer_state.handle_mouse_event(mouse_event(MouseDown, Web::UIEvents::MouseButton::Secondary), PausedDebuggerOverlayAction::StepOver);
    EXPECT(!pointer_state.is_pressing());

    pointer_state.handle_mouse_event(mouse_event(MouseDown), PausedDebuggerOverlayAction::StepOver);
    EXPECT(!pointer_state.handle_mouse_event(mouse_event(MouseUp, Web::UIEvents::MouseButton::Secondary), PausedDebuggerOverlayAction::StepOver).activated_action.has_value());
    EXPECT(pointer_state.is_pressing());
}

TEST_CASE(the_hovered_button_follows_the_pointer)
{
    OverlayPointerState<PausedDebuggerOverlayAction> pointer_state;

    auto outcome = pointer_state.handle_mouse_event(mouse_event(MouseMove, Web::UIEvents::MouseButton::None), PausedDebuggerOverlayAction::Continue);
    EXPECT(outcome.hover_changed);
    EXPECT(pointer_state.hovered_action() == PausedDebuggerOverlayAction::Continue);

    outcome = pointer_state.handle_mouse_event(mouse_event(MouseMove, Web::UIEvents::MouseButton::None), PausedDebuggerOverlayAction::Continue);
    EXPECT(!outcome.hover_changed);

    outcome = pointer_state.handle_mouse_event(mouse_event(MouseLeave), {});
    EXPECT(outcome.hover_changed);
    EXPECT(!pointer_state.hovered_action().has_value());
}

FILE: Tests/LibCompositing/TestVideoFrameHold.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <AK/BitCast.h>
#include <AK/SharedMemoryValue.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibCompositing/Video/VideoFrameHold.h>
#include <LibCompositing/Video/VideoFramePresentationPage.h>
#include <LibTest/TestCase.h>

using Compositing::VideoFrameHold;
using Compositing::VideoFramePresentationPage;

struct PagePair {
    NonnullRefPtr<VideoFramePresentationPage> web_content;
    NonnullRefPtr<VideoFramePresentationPage> compositor;
};

// Both processes map the same buffer, which two pages over one buffer stand in for.
static PagePair create_page_pair()
{
    auto web_content = MUST(VideoFramePresentationPage::create());
    auto compositor = MUST(VideoFramePresentationPage::create(web_content->buffer()));
    return { move(web_content), move(compositor) };
}

TEST_CASE(holds_are_counted_on_the_generation_they_were_taken_on)
{
    auto pages = create_page_pair();
    EXPECT_EQ(pages.compositor->replace_generation(1).generation, 0u);

    EXPECT_EQ(pages.web_content->hold_current_generation(), 1u);
    EXPECT_EQ(pages.web_content->hold_current_generation(), 1u);

    auto replaced = pages.compositor->replace_generation(2);
    EXPECT_EQ(replaced.generation, 1u);
    EXPECT_EQ(replaced.hold_count, 2u);
    EXPECT_EQ(pages.web_content->current_generation(), 2u);
}

TEST_CASE(holds_are_released_in_place_only_while_their_generation_is_current)
{
    auto pages = create_page_pair();
    pages.compositor->replace_generation(1);
    EXPECT_EQ(pages.web_content->hold_current_generation(), 1u);
    EXPECT_EQ(pages.web_content->release_hold_if_current(1), VideoFramePresentationPage::ReleaseResult::Released);
    EXPECT_EQ(pages.web_content->release_hold_if_current(1), VideoFramePresentationPage::ReleaseResult::NotHeld);

    EXPECT_EQ(pages.web_content->hold_current_generation(), 1u);
    EXPECT_EQ(pages.compositor->replace_generation(2).hold_count, 1u);
    EXPECT_EQ(pages.web_content->release_hold_if_current(1), VideoFramePresentationPage::ReleaseResult::NotCurrent);
}

TEST_CASE(a_retired_sink_cannot_be_held)
{
    auto pages = create_page_pair();
    pages.compositor->replace_generation(VideoFramePresentationPage::retired_generation);
    EXPECT(!pages.web_content->hold_current_generation().has_value());
}

TEST_CASE(an_unsent_hold_is_released_in_place)
{
    auto pages = create_page_pair();
    pages.compositor->replace_generation(1);
    Vector<u64> released_through_compositor;
    {
        auto hold = VideoFrameHold::hold_current_frame(pages.web_content, Media::VideoSinkHandle { 1 }, [&](auto, u64 generation) {
            released_through_compositor.append(generation);
        });
        EXPECT(hold);
        EXPECT_EQ(hold->generation(), 1u);
    }
    EXPECT(released_through_compositor.is_empty());
    EXPECT_EQ(pages.compositor->replace_generation(2).hold_count, 0u);
}

TEST_CASE(a_sent_hold_is_released_through_the_compositor)
{
    auto pages = create_page_pair();
    pages.compositor->replace_generation(1);
    Vector<u64> released_through_compositor;
    {
        auto hold = VideoFrameHold::hold_current_frame(pages.web_content, Media::VideoSinkHandle { 1 }, [&](auto, u64 generation) {
            released_through_compositor.append(generation);
        });
        hold->note_sent_to_compositor();
    }
    EXPECT_EQ(released_through_compositor, (Vector<u64> { 1 }));
    EXPECT_EQ(pages.compositor->replace_generation(2).hold_count, 1u);
}

TEST_CASE(an_unsent_hold_on_a_replaced_generation_is_released_through_the_compositor)
{
    auto pages = create_page_pair();
    pages.compositor->replace_generation(1);
    Vector<u64> released_through_compositor;
    {
        auto hold = VideoFrameHold::hold_current_frame(pages.web_content, Media::VideoSinkHandle { 1 }, [&](auto, u64 generation) {
            released_through_compositor.append(generation);
        });
        EXPECT_EQ(pages.compositor->replace_generation(2).hold_count, 1u);
    }
    EXPECT_EQ(released_through_compositor, (Vector<u64> { 1 }));
}

// The Compositor writes the presented frame record that WebContent reads, so WebContent must not believe a time that
// is not a Duration or dimensions no decoded frame could have.
TEST_CASE(forged_presented_frames_are_not_believed)
{
    auto pages = create_page_pair();

    VideoFramePresentationPage::PresentedFrame presented_frame;
    presented_frame.presented_frame_count = 1;
    presented_frame.width = 1920;
    presented_frame.height = 1080;
    SharedMemoryCodec<AK::Duration>::Representation forged_time { 3, 2'000'000'000 };
    presented_frame.media_time = bit_cast<SharedMemoryValue<AK::Duration>>(forged_time);
    pages.compositor->publish_presented_frame(presented_frame);

    auto read_back = pages.web_content->presented_frame();
    EXPECT(read_back.has_value());
    EXPECT_EQ(static_cast<AK::Duration>(read_back->media_time), AK::Duration::zero());
    EXPECT_EQ(read_back->width, 1920u);

    presented_frame.width = 1u << 20;
    pages.compositor->publish_presented_frame(presented_frame);
    EXPECT(!pages.web_content->presented_frame().has_value());
}

/*

#include <AK/ByteBuffer.h>
#include <AK/MaybeOwned.h>
#include <AK/MemoryStream.h>
#include <LibCompress/Zlib.h>
#include <LibTest/TestCase.h>

TEST_CASE(zlib_decompress_simple)
{
    Array<u8, 40> const compressed {
        0x78, 0x01, 0x01, 0x1D, 0x00, 0xE2, 0xFF, 0x54, 0x68, 0x69, 0x73, 0x20,
        0x69, 0x73, 0x20, 0x61, 0x20, 0x73, 0x69, 0x6D, 0x70, 0x6C, 0x65, 0x20,
        0x74, 0x65, 0x78, 0x74, 0x20, 0x66, 0x69, 0x6C, 0x65, 0x20, 0x3A, 0x29,
        0x99, 0x5E, 0x09, 0xE8
    };

    u8 const uncompressed[] = "This is a simple text file :)";

    auto decompressed = TRY_OR_FAIL(Compress::ZlibDecompressor::decompress_all(compressed));
    EXPECT(decompressed.bytes() == (ReadonlyBytes { uncompressed, sizeof(uncompressed) - 1 }));
}

TEST_CASE(zlib_decompress_stream)
{
    Array<u8, 40> const compressed {
        0x78, 0x01, 0x01, 0x1D, 0x00, 0xE2, 0xFF, 0x54, 0x68, 0x69, 0x73, 0x20,
        0x69, 0x73, 0x20, 0x61, 0x20, 0x73, 0x69, 0x6D, 0x70, 0x6C, 0x65, 0x20,
        0x74, 0x65, 0x78, 0x74, 0x20, 0x66, 0x69, 0x6C, 0x65, 0x20, 0x3A, 0x29,
        0x99, 0x5E, 0x09, 0xE8
    };

    u8 const uncompressed[] = "This is a simple text file :)";

    auto stream = make<AllocatingMemoryStream>();
    auto input = MaybeOwned<Stream> { *stream };
    auto decompressor = TRY_OR_FAIL(Compress::ZlibDecompressor::create(move(input)));
    TRY_OR_FAIL(stream->write_until_depleted(compressed));
    auto decompressed = TRY_OR_FAIL(decompressor->read_until_eof());
    EXPECT(decompressed.bytes() == (ReadonlyBytes { uncompressed, sizeof(uncompressed) - 1 }));
}
