TEST_CASE(flush_returns_mappable_body_file)
{
    auto disk_cache = MUST(HTTP::DiskCache::create(HTTP::DiskCache::Mode::Testing, test_cache_root())).release_value();
    TestCacheRequest request;

    auto url = parse_url("https://example.com/script.js"sv);
    auto request_headers = create_cacheable_request_headers();
    auto response_headers = create_cacheable_response_headers();

    auto& writer = create_cache_entry(disk_cache, request, url, *request_headers);
    TRY_OR_FAIL(writer.write_status_and_reason(200, "OK"_string, *request_headers, *response_headers));
    TRY_OR_FAIL(writer.write_data("console.log('hello');"sv.bytes()));

    auto body_file = TRY_OR_FAIL(writer.flush_and_take_body_file(request_headers));
    auto body = TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::ImmutableBytes::map_from_fd_range_and_close(body_file.fd, "cache body"sv, body_file.offset, body_file.size));
    EXPECT_EQ(body.bytes(), "console.log('hello');"sv.bytes());
}

TEST_CASE(replacing_cache_entry_keeps_existing_body_mapping_stable)
{
    auto disk_cache = MUST(HTTP::DiskCache::create(HTTP::DiskCache::Mode::Testing, test_cache_root())).release_value();
    TestCacheRequest request;

    auto url = parse_url("https://example.com/script.js"sv);
    auto request_headers = create_cacheable_request_headers();
    auto response_headers = create_cacheable_response_headers();

    auto& writer = create_cache_entry(disk_cache, request, url, *request_headers);
    TRY_OR_FAIL(writer.write_status_and_reason(200, "OK"_string, *request_headers, *response_headers));
    TRY_OR_FAIL(writer.write_data("console.log('old');"sv.bytes()));

    auto old_body_file = TRY_OR_FAIL(writer.flush_and_take_body_file(request_headers));
    auto old_body = TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::ImmutableBytes::map_from_fd_range_and_close(old_body_file.fd, "old cache body"sv, old_body_file.offset, old_body_file.size));
    EXPECT_EQ(old_body.bytes(), "console.log('old');"sv.bytes());

    auto replacement_request_headers = create_cacheable_request_headers();
    auto replacement_response_headers = create_cacheable_response_headers();
    auto& replacement_writer = create_cache_entry(disk_cache, request, url, *replacement_request_headers);
    TRY_OR_FAIL(replacement_writer.write_status_and_reason(200, "OK"_string, *replacement_request_headers, *replacement_response_headers));
    TRY_OR_FAIL(replacement_writer.write_data("console.log('new');"sv.bytes()));
    TRY_OR_FAIL(replacement_writer.flush(replacement_request_headers));

    EXPECT_EQ(old_body.bytes(), "console.log('old');"sv.bytes());
}

TEST_CASE(cache_partitions_do_not_share_entries)
{
    auto disk_cache = MUST(HTTP::DiskCache::create(HTTP::DiskCache::Mode::Testing, test_cache_root())).release_value();
    TestCacheRequest request;

    auto url = parse_url("https://cdn.example.net/library.js"sv);
    auto request_headers = create_cacheable_request_headers();
    auto response_headers = create_cacheable_response_headers();

    auto partition = test_partition();
    auto other_top_level_site = partition_for({
        .top_level_site = "https://other.example"_utf16,
        .frame_site = "https://example.com"_utf16,
    });
    auto other_frame_site = partition_for({
        .top_level_site = "https://example.com"_utf16,
        .frame_site = "https://other.example"_utf16,
    });
    auto subframe_document = partition_for({
        .top_level_site = "https://example.com"_utf16,
        .frame_site = "https://example.com"_utf16,
        .is_subframe_document = true,
    });
    auto cross_site_main_frame_navigation = partition_for({
        .top_level_site = "https://example.com"_utf16,
        .frame_site = "https://example.com"_utf16,
        .is_cross_site_main_frame_navigation = true,
    });

    auto& writer = create_cache_entry(disk_cache, request, url, *request_headers, partition);
    TRY_OR_FAIL(writer.write_status_and_reason(200, "OK"_string, *request_headers, *response_headers));
    TRY_OR_FAIL(writer.write_data("console.log('hello');"sv.bytes()));
    TRY_OR_FAIL(writer.flush(request_headers));

    for (auto const& other_partition : { other_top_level_site, other_frame_site, subframe_document, cross_site_main_frame_navigation }) {
        disk_cache.open_entry(request, other_partition, url, "GET"sv, *request_headers, HTTP::CacheMode::Default, HTTP::DiskCache::OpenMode::Read)
            .visit(
                [&](Optional<HTTP::CacheEntryReader&> reader) {
                    EXPECT(!reader.has_value());
                },
                [](HTTP::DiskCache::CacheHasOpenEntry) { });
    }

    EXPECT(open_cache_entry(disk_cache, request, url, *request_headers).has_value());

    disk_cache.remove_entries_accessed_since(UnixDateTime::earliest());
}

static Optional<HTTP::CacheEntryReader&> open_stale_cache_entry(HTTP::DiskCache& disk_cache, TestCacheRequest& request, URL::URL const& url, StringView cache_control, StringView age_in_seconds, HTTP::CacheMode cache_mode)
{
    auto request_headers = create_cacheable_request_headers();
    auto response_headers = HTTP::HeaderList::create({
        { "Cache-Control"sv, cache_control },
        { "ETag"sv, "\"v1\""sv },
    });

    auto& writer = create_cache_entry(disk_cache, request, url, *request_headers);
    MUST(writer.write_status_and_reason(200, "OK"_string, *request_headers, *response_headers));
    MUST(writer.write_data("data"sv.bytes()));
    MUST(writer.flush(request_headers));

    auto stale_request_headers = HTTP::HeaderList::create({
        { HTTP::TEST_CACHE_ENABLED_HEADER, "1"sv },
        { HTTP::TEST_CACHE_REQUEST_TIME_OFFSET, age_in_seconds },
    });

    Optional<HTTP::CacheEntryReader&> reader;
    disk_cache.open_entry(request, test_partition(), url, "GET"sv, *stale_request_headers, cache_mode, HTTP::DiskCache::OpenMode::Read)
        .visit(
            [&](Optional<HTTP::CacheEntryReader&> cache_entry_reader) {
                reader = cache_entry_reader;
            },
            [](HTTP::DiskCache::CacheHasOpenEntry) {
                FAIL("Cache entry was unexpectedly open");
            });

    return reader;
}

TEST_CASE(must_revalidate_overrides_stale_while_revalidate)
{
    auto disk_cache = MUST(HTTP::DiskCache::create(HTTP::DiskCache::Mode::Testing, test_cache_root())).release_value();
    TestCacheRequest request;

    auto reader = open_stale_cache_entry(disk_cache, request, parse_url("https://example.com/must-revalidate-and-swr"sv), "max-age=60, stale-while-revalidate=30, must-revalidate"sv, "70"sv, HTTP::CacheMode::Default);
    VERIFY(reader.has_value());
    EXPECT_EQ(reader->revalidation_type(), HTTP::CacheEntryReader::RevalidationType::MustRevalidate);
}

TEST_CASE(force_cache_reuses_stale_must_revalidate_entries)
{
    auto disk_cache = MUST(HTTP::DiskCache::create(HTTP::DiskCache::Mode::Testing, test_cache_root())).release_value();
    TestCacheRequest request;

    auto reader = open_stale_cache_entry(disk_cache, request, parse_url("https://example.com/force-cache"sv), "max-age=60, must-revalidate"sv, "120"sv, HTTP::CacheMode::ForceCache);
    VERIFY(reader.has_value());
    EXPECT_EQ(reader->revalidation_type(), HTTP::CacheEntryReader::RevalidationType::None);

    reader = open_stale_cache_entry(disk_cache, request, parse_url("https://example.com/only-if-cached"sv), "max-age=60, must-revalidate"sv, "120"sv, HTTP::CacheMode::OnlyIfCached);
    VERIFY(reader.has_value());
    EXPECT_EQ(reader->revalidation_type(), HTTP::CacheEntryReader::RevalidationType::None);
}

// Legacy disk SHA-1 prefix: cc4122efe2277ef8, with test_partition() and GET.
TEST_CASE(legacy_disk_hash_collision_does_not_alias_responses)
{
    auto disk_cache = MUST(HTTP::DiskCache::create(HTTP::DiskCache::Mode::Testing, test_cache_root())).release_value();
    TestCacheRequest request;
    auto a = parse_url("https://b.example/a15233b41c58b0cc"sv);
    auto b = parse_url("https://a.example/3a0fafd1c5bfae49"sv);
    auto headers = create_cacheable_request_headers();
    auto response_a = create_cacheable_response_headers();
    response_a->append({ "X-Identity"sv, "A"sv });
    auto response_b = create_cacheable_response_headers();
    response_b->append({ "X-Identity"sv, "B"sv });
    store_cache_entry(disk_cache, request, a, *headers, response_a, "response A"sv);
    auto unexpected = open_cache_entry(disk_cache, request, b, *headers);
    EXPECT(!unexpected.has_value());
    if (unexpected.has_value())
        disk_cache.close_entries_read_by(request);
    store_cache_entry(disk_cache, request, b, *headers, response_b, "response B"sv);
    for (auto which : { 0, 1 }) {
        auto const& url = which == 0 ? a : b;
        auto expected = which == 0 ? "response A"sv : "response B"sv;
        auto reader = open_cache_entry(disk_cache, request, url, *headers);
        VERIFY(reader.has_value());
        EXPECT_EQ(reader->response_headers().get("X-Identity"sv), Optional<ByteString> { which == 0 ? "A" : "B" });
        auto file = TRY_OR_FAIL(reader->take_body_file());
        auto body = TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::ImmutableBytes::map_from_fd_range_and_close(file.fd, "collision body"sv, file.offset, file.size));
        EXPECT_EQ(body.bytes(), expected.bytes());
    }
    disk_cache.invalidate(test_partition(), a);
    EXPECT(!open_cache_entry(disk_cache, request, a, *headers).has_value());
    EXPECT(open_cache_entry(disk_cache, request, b, *headers).has_value());
}

TEST_CASE(different_resources_do_not_share_writer_activity_or_locks)
{
    auto disk_cache = TRY_OR_FAIL(HTTP::DiskCache::create(HTTP::DiskCache::Mode::Testing, test_cache_root())).release_value();
    TestCacheRequest request_a;
    TestCacheRequest request_b;
    auto a = parse_url("https://b.example/a15233b41c58b0cc"sv);
    auto b = parse_url("https://a.example/3a0fafd1c5bfae49"sv);
    auto headers = create_cacheable_request_headers();
    request_a.activity = MonotonicTime::now();
    auto& writer_a = create_cache_entry(disk_cache, request_a, a, *headers);
    EXPECT(disk_cache.last_activity_time_of_open_entries(test_partition(), a, "GET"sv) == request_a.activity);
    EXPECT(!disk_cache.last_activity_time_of_open_entries(test_partition(), b, "GET"sv).has_value());
    // This helper fails if B is queued behind A, as happens with the legacy collision.
    auto& writer_b = create_cache_entry(disk_cache, request_b, b, *headers);
    TRY_OR_FAIL(writer_a.write_status_and_reason(200, "OK"_string, *headers, *create_cacheable_response_headers()));
    TRY_OR_FAIL(writer_b.write_status_and_reason(200, "OK"_string, *headers, *create_cacheable_response_headers()));
    disk_cache.invalidate(test_partition(), a);
    EXPECT(writer_a.write_data("A"sv.bytes()).is_error());
    TRY_OR_FAIL(writer_b.write_data("B"sv.bytes()));
    TRY_OR_FAIL(writer_b.flush(create_cacheable_request_headers()));
    EXPECT(open_cache_entry(disk_cache, request_b, b, *headers).has_value());
}

TEST_CASE(waiters_are_resumed_only_when_their_exact_resource_closes)
{
    Core::EventLoop event_loop;
    auto disk_cache = TRY_OR_FAIL(HTTP::DiskCache::create(HTTP::DiskCache::Mode::Testing, test_cache_root())).release_value();
    TestCacheRequest holder_a;
    TestCacheRequest holder_b;
    TestCacheRequest waiter_a;
    TestCacheRequest waiter_b;
    auto a = parse_url("https://b.example/a15233b41c58b0cc"sv);
    auto b = parse_url("https://a.example/3a0fafd1c5bfae49"sv);
    auto headers = create_cacheable_request_headers();
    auto& writer_a = create_cache_entry(disk_cache, holder_a, a, *headers);
    auto& writer_b = create_cache_entry(disk_cache, holder_b, b, *headers);
    for (auto which : { 0, 1 }) {
        auto& waiter = which == 0 ? waiter_a : waiter_b;
        auto const& url = which == 0 ? a : b;
        auto result = disk_cache.create_entry(waiter, test_partition(), url, "GET"sv, *headers, UnixDateTime::now());
        EXPECT(result.has<HTTP::DiskCache::CacheHasOpenEntry>());
    }
    writer_a.remove_incomplete_entry();
    event_loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    EXPECT_EQ(waiter_a.unblocked_count, 1u);
    EXPECT_EQ(waiter_b.unblocked_count, 0u);
    writer_b.remove_incomplete_entry();
    event_loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    EXPECT_EQ(waiter_b.unblocked_count, 1u);
}

TEST_CASE(cache_file_for_another_url_is_not_served)
{
    auto disk_cache = TRY_OR_FAIL(HTTP::DiskCache::create(HTTP::DiskCache::Mode::Testing, test_cache_root())).release_value();
    auto url = parse_url("https://example.com/a"sv);
    auto other_url = "https://example.com/b"_string;
    auto headers = create_cacheable_request_headers();
    TestCacheRequest request;
    store_cache_entry(disk_cache, request, url, *headers, create_cacheable_response_headers(), "body"sv);
    auto cache_key = HTTP::create_cache_key(test_partition(), HTTP::serialize_url_for_cache_storage(url), "GET"sv);
    auto path = HTTP::path_for_cache_entry(disk_cache.cache_directory(), cache_key, {});
    {
        auto file = TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::File::open(path.string(), Core::File::OpenMode::ReadWrite));
        auto header = TRY_OR_FAIL(file->read_value<HTTP::CacheHeader>());
        header.url_hash = other_url.hash();
        (void)TRY_OR_FAIL(file->seek(0, SeekMode::SetPosition));
        TRY_OR_FAIL(file->write_value(header));
        TRY_OR_FAIL(file->write_until_depleted(other_url));
    }
    EXPECT(!open_cache_entry(disk_cache, request, url, *headers).has_value());
    EXPECT(!FileSystem::exists(path.string()));
}

TEST_CASE(cache_file_for_another_key_is_not_served)
{
    auto disk_cache = TRY_OR_FAIL(HTTP::DiskCache::create(HTTP::DiskCache::Mode::Testing, test_cache_root())).release_value();
    auto url = parse_url("https://example.com/a"sv);
    auto headers = create_cacheable_request_headers();
    TestCacheRequest request;
    store_cache_entry(disk_cache, request, url, *headers, create_cacheable_response_headers(), "body"sv);
    auto cache_key = HTTP::create_cache_key(test_partition(), HTTP::serialize_url_for_cache_storage(url), "GET"sv);
    auto path = HTTP::path_for_cache_entry(disk_cache.cache_directory(), cache_key, {});
    {
        auto file = TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::File::open(path.string(), Core::File::OpenMode::ReadWrite));
        auto header = TRY_OR_FAIL(file->read_value<HTTP::CacheHeader>());
        header.vary_key.bytes.last() ^= 1;
        (void)TRY_OR_FAIL(file->seek(0, SeekMode::SetPosition));
        TRY_OR_FAIL(file->write_value(header));
    }
    EXPECT(!open_cache_entry(disk_cache, request, url, *headers).has_value());
    EXPECT(!FileSystem::exists(path.string()));
}

#include <LibTest/TestCase.h>

TEST_CASE(parses_max_age_token)
{
    auto policy = HTTP::HSTS::parse_header("max-age=31536000"sv);
    EXPECT(policy.has_value());
    EXPECT_EQ(policy->max_age, AK::Duration::from_seconds(31536000));
    EXPECT(!policy->include_sub_domains);
}

TEST_CASE(parses_max_age_quoted)
{
    auto policy = HTTP::HSTS::parse_header("max-age=\"31536000\""sv);
    EXPECT(policy.has_value());
    EXPECT_EQ(policy->max_age, AK::Duration::from_seconds(31536000));
}

TEST_CASE(oversized_valid_max_age_is_clamped)
{
    auto control_policy = HTTP::HSTS::parse_header("max-age=18446744073709551615"sv);
    VERIFY(control_policy.has_value());

    auto policy = HTTP::HSTS::parse_header("max-age=18446744073709551616"sv);
    EXPECT(policy.has_value());
    if (policy.has_value())
        EXPECT_EQ(policy->max_age, control_policy->max_age);
}

TEST_CASE(parses_include_sub_domains)
{
    auto policy = HTTP::HSTS::parse_header("max-age=100; includeSubDomains"sv);
    EXPECT(policy.has_value());
    EXPECT_EQ(policy->max_age, AK::Duration::from_seconds(100));
    EXPECT(policy->include_sub_domains);
}

TEST_CASE(directive_order_does_not_matter)
{
    auto policy = HTTP::HSTS::parse_header("includeSubDomains; max-age=100"sv);
    EXPECT(policy.has_value());
    EXPECT_EQ(policy->max_age, AK::Duration::from_seconds(100));
    EXPECT(policy->include_sub_domains);
}

TEST_CASE(directive_names_are_case_insensitive)
{
    auto policy = HTTP::HSTS::parse_header("MAX-AGE=100; INCLUDESUBDOMAINS"sv);
    EXPECT(policy.has_value());
    EXPECT_EQ(policy->max_age, AK::Duration::from_seconds(100));
    EXPECT(policy->include_sub_domains);
}

TEST_CASE(unknown_directives_are_ignored)
{
    auto policy = HTTP::HSTS::parse_header("max-age=100; foo=bar; baz"sv);
    EXPECT(policy.has_value());
    EXPECT_EQ(policy->max_age, AK::Duration::from_seconds(100));
}

TEST_CASE(quoted_value_in_unknown_directive_does_not_synthesise_directives)
{
    // A ';' inside an unknown directive's quoted-string value must not be mistaken for a directive
    // separator. With a quote-blind parser the embedded "max-age=42" would be parsed as a real
    // directive.
    auto policy = HTTP::HSTS::parse_header("foo=\"x; max-age=42; y\""sv);
    EXPECT(!policy.has_value());
}

#include <LibHTTP/HSTSPreloadData.h>
#include <LibTest/TestCase.h>

// Hosts from Chromium's transport_security_state_static.json:
//  - accounts.google.com: a preloaded force-https host (exact match).
//  - dev: a force-https TLD with include_subdomains, so any *.dev matches as a subdomain.
//  - example.test: a reserved TLD that is never preloaded.
// Stable enough to anchor tests; if upstream removes one the matching test fails loudly
// rather than silently regressing.
//
// is_known_preloaded_hsts_host expects an already-lowercased domain (callers canonicalize
// before querying), so these tests pass lowercased input.

TEST_CASE(congruent_match)
{
    EXPECT(HTTP::HSTSPreloadData::the().is_known_preloaded_hsts_host("accounts.google.com"sv));
}

TEST_CASE(subdomain_match_via_include_subdomains)
{
    EXPECT(HTTP::HSTSPreloadData::the().is_known_preloaded_hsts_host("anything.dev"sv));
}

TEST_CASE(non_preloaded_host_is_not_known)
{
    EXPECT(!HTTP::HSTSPreloadData::the().is_known_preloaded_hsts_host("example.test"sv));
}

#include <LibTest/TestCase.h>

TEST_CASE(collect_an_http_quoted_string)
{
    {
        auto test = "\"\""_string;
        GenericLexer lexer { test };

        auto result = HTTP::collect_an_http_quoted_string(lexer);
        EXPECT_EQ(result, "\"\""_string);
    }
    {
        auto test = "\"abc\""_string;
        GenericLexer lexer { test };

        auto result = HTTP::collect_an_http_quoted_string(lexer);
        EXPECT_EQ(result, "\"abc\""_string);
    }
    {
        auto test = "foo \"abc\""_string;

        GenericLexer lexer { test };
        lexer.ignore(4);

        auto result = HTTP::collect_an_http_quoted_string(lexer);
        EXPECT_EQ(result, "\"abc\""_string);
    }
    {
        auto test = "foo=\"abc\""_string;

        GenericLexer lexer { test };
        lexer.ignore(4);

        auto result = HTTP::collect_an_http_quoted_string(lexer);
        EXPECT_EQ(result, "\"abc\""_string);
    }
    {
        auto test = "foo=\"abc\" bar"_string;

        GenericLexer lexer { test };
        lexer.ignore(4);

        auto result = HTTP::collect_an_http_quoted_string(lexer);
        EXPECT_EQ(result, "\"abc\""_string);
    }
    {
        auto test = "\"abc\" bar"_string;
        GenericLexer lexer { test };

        auto result = HTTP::collect_an_http_quoted_string(lexer);
        EXPECT_EQ(result, "\"abc\""_string);
    }
}

TEST_CASE(extract_cache_control_directive)
{
    EXPECT(!HTTP::contains_cache_control_directive({}, "no-cache"sv));
    EXPECT(!HTTP::contains_cache_control_directive(","sv, "no-cache"sv));

    EXPECT(!HTTP::contains_cache_control_directive("no-cache"sv, "no"sv));
    EXPECT(!HTTP::contains_cache_control_directive("no-cache"sv, "cache"sv));
    EXPECT(!HTTP::contains_cache_control_directive("no-cache"sv, "no cache"sv));

    EXPECT(!HTTP::contains_cache_control_directive("abno-cache"sv, "no-cache"sv));
    EXPECT(!HTTP::contains_cache_control_directive("no-cachecd"sv, "no-cache"sv));
    EXPECT(!HTTP::contains_cache_control_directive("abno-cachecd"sv, "no-cache"sv));

    EXPECT_EQ(HTTP::extract_cache_control_directive("no-cache"sv, "no-cache"sv), ""sv);
    EXPECT_EQ(HTTP::extract_cache_control_directive("max-age=4"sv, "max-age"sv), "4"sv);
    EXPECT_EQ(HTTP::extract_cache_control_directive("max-age = 4"sv, "max-age"sv), "4"sv);
    EXPECT_EQ(HTTP::extract_cache_control_directive("max-age= 4"sv, "max-age"sv), "4"sv);
    EXPECT_EQ(HTTP::extract_cache_control_directive("max-age =4"sv, "max-age"sv), "4"sv);
    EXPECT_EQ(HTTP::extract_cache_control_directive("max-age = 4 , no-cache"sv, "max-age"sv), "4"sv);
    EXPECT_EQ(HTTP::extract_cache_control_directive("no-cache , max-age = 4"sv, "max-age"sv), "4"sv);
    EXPECT_EQ(HTTP::extract_cache_control_directive("s-maxage=4, max-age=5"sv, "max-age"sv), "5"sv);

    EXPECT_EQ(HTTP::extract_cache_control_directive("Max-Age=4"sv, "max-age"sv), "4"sv);
    EXPECT_EQ(HTTP::extract_cache_control_directive("MAX-AGE=4"sv, "max-age"sv), "4"sv);
    EXPECT_EQ(HTTP::extract_cache_control_directive("max-age=4"sv, "MAX-AGE"sv), "4"sv);
    EXPECT_EQ(HTTP::extract_cache_control_directive("No-Cache"sv, "no-cache"sv), ""sv);

    EXPECT_EQ(HTTP::extract_cache_control_directive("max-age=4,"sv, "max-age"sv), "4"sv);
    EXPECT_EQ(HTTP::extract_cache_control_directive("no-cache,"sv, "no-cache"sv), ""sv);
    EXPECT_EQ(HTTP::extract_cache_control_directive("no-cache, "sv, "no-cache"sv), ""sv);

    EXPECT_EQ(HTTP::extract_cache_control_directive("max-age=4, max-age=5"sv, "max-age"sv), "4"sv);
    EXPECT_EQ(HTTP::extract_cache_control_directive("no-cache, max-age=4, max-age=5"sv, "max-age"sv), "4"sv);
    EXPECT_EQ(HTTP::extract_cache_control_directive("max-age=4, no-cache"sv, "no-cache"sv), ""sv);

    EXPECT_EQ(HTTP::extract_cache_control_directive("max-age=\"4\""sv, "max-age"sv), "\"4\""sv);
    EXPECT_EQ(HTTP::extract_cache_control_directive("max-age=\"004\""sv, "max-age"sv), "\"004\""sv);
    EXPECT_EQ(HTTP::extract_cache_control_directive("max-age=\"4\", no-cache"sv, "max-age"sv), "\"4\""sv);
    EXPECT_EQ(HTTP::extract_cache_control_directive("foo=\"bar\", max-age=\"4\""sv, "max-age"sv), "\"4\""sv);
    EXPECT_EQ(HTTP::extract_cache_control_directive("max-age=\"4,5\", no-cache"sv, "max-age"sv), "\"4,5\""sv);

    EXPECT_EQ(HTTP::extract_cache_control_directive("max-age=\"4\\5\""sv, "max-age"sv), "\"4\\5\""sv);
    EXPECT_EQ(HTTP::extract_cache_control_directive("max-age=\"4\\\"5\""sv, "max-age"sv), "\"4\\\"5\""sv);
    EXPECT_EQ(HTTP::extract_cache_control_directive("max-age=\"4\\\\5\""sv, "max-age"sv), "\"4\\\\5\""sv);

    EXPECT(!HTTP::contains_cache_control_directive("max-age\"4\""sv, "max-age"sv));
    EXPECT(!HTTP::contains_cache_control_directive("max-age=\"4"sv, "max-age"sv));
    EXPECT(!HTTP::contains_cache_control_directive("foo=\"bar, max-age=4"sv, "max-age"sv));
    EXPECT(!HTTP::contains_cache_control_directive("\"unterminated"sv, "max-age"sv));
    EXPECT(!HTTP::contains_cache_control_directive("max-age=\"4, no-cache"sv, "max-age"sv));
    EXPECT(!HTTP::contains_cache_control_directive("max-age=\"4, no-cache"sv, "no-cache"sv));

    EXPECT_EQ(HTTP::extract_cache_control_directive("max-age=\"4, no-cache\", foo=bar"sv, "max-age"sv), "\"4, no-cache\""sv);
    EXPECT_EQ(HTTP::extract_cache_control_directive("max-age=\"4, no-cache\", foo=bar"sv, "foo"sv), "bar"sv);
    EXPECT_EQ(HTTP::extract_cache_control_directive("foo=\"bar,baz\", max-age=4"sv, "foo"sv), "\"bar,baz\""sv);
    EXPECT_EQ(HTTP::extract_cache_control_directive("foo=\"bar,baz\", max-age=4"sv, "max-age"sv), "4"sv);

    EXPECT_EQ(HTTP::extract_cache_control_directive(",,max-age=4"sv, "max-age"sv), "4"sv);
    EXPECT_EQ(HTTP::extract_cache_control_directive("max-age==4"sv, "max-age"sv), "=4"sv);
    EXPECT_EQ(HTTP::extract_cache_control_directive("max-age=4="sv, "max-age"sv), "4="sv);
    EXPECT(!HTTP::contains_cache_control_directive("=4"sv, "max-age"sv));
}

TEST_CASE(extract_header_values)
{
    struct TestHeader {
        StringView name;
        bool requires_at_least_one; // true = 1#token, false = #token
    };

    TestHeader const headers[] = {
        { "Access-Control-Expose-Headers"sv, false },
        { "access-control-expose-headers"sv, false },
        { "Access-Control-Allow-Headers"sv, false },
        { "Access-Control-Allow-Methods"sv, false },
        { "Access-Control-Request-Headers"sv, true },
        { "Accept-Ranges"sv, true },
    };

    for (auto const& [header, requires_at_least_one] : headers) {
        // Valid single token.
        auto result = HTTP::Header { header, "bb-8"sv }.extract_header_values();
        EXPECT_EQ(result, (Vector<ByteString> { "bb-8" }));

        // Valid multiple tokens, whitespace trimmed.
        result = HTTP::Header { header, "bb-8, no"sv }.extract_header_values();
        EXPECT_EQ(result, (Vector<ByteString> { "bb-8", "no" }));

        // Wildcard is a valid token.
        result = HTTP::Header { header, "*"sv }.extract_header_values();
        EXPECT_EQ(result, (Vector<ByteString> { "*" }));

        // Single-quoted tokens are valid (apostrophe is a tchar).
        result = HTTP::Header { header, "'bb-8',bb-8"sv }.extract_header_values();
        EXPECT_EQ(result, (Vector<ByteString> { "'bb-8'", "bb-8" }));

        // Leading/trailing commas: empty parts discarded.
        result = HTTP::Header { header, ",bb-8,"sv }.extract_header_values();
        EXPECT_EQ(result, (Vector<ByteString> { "bb-8" }));

        // Empty value and only-commas.
        result = HTTP::Header { header, ""sv }.extract_header_values();
        if (requires_at_least_one) {
            EXPECT_EQ(result, OptionalNone {});
        } else {
            EXPECT_EQ(result, (Vector<ByteString> {}));
        }

        // Two commas and some spaces.
        result = HTTP::Header { header, ",   ,"sv }.extract_header_values();
        if (requires_at_least_one) {
            EXPECT_EQ(result, OptionalNone {});
        } else {
            EXPECT_EQ(result, (Vector<ByteString> {}));
        }

        // Only a comma.
        result = HTTP::Header { header, ","sv }.extract_header_values();
        if (requires_at_least_one) {
            EXPECT_EQ(result, OptionalNone {});
        } else {
            EXPECT_EQ(result, (Vector<ByteString> {}));
        }

        // Empty list element ignored.
        result = HTTP::Header { header, "foo , ,bar,charlie"sv }.extract_header_values();
        EXPECT_EQ(result, (Vector<ByteString> { "foo", "bar", "charlie" }));

        // Leading empty list component.
        result = HTTP::Header { header, ",foo,bar"sv }.extract_header_values();
        EXPECT_EQ(result, (Vector<ByteString> { "foo", "bar" }));

        // Space inside a token is invalid.
        result = HTTP::Header { header, "no no"sv }.extract_header_values();
        EXPECT_EQ(result, OptionalNone {});

        // Double-quote is invalid.
        result = HTTP::Header { header, "\"bb-8\",bb-8"sv }.extract_header_values();
        EXPECT_EQ(result, OptionalNone {});

        // @ is invalid.
        result = HTTP::Header { header, "@invalid,bb-8"sv }.extract_header_values();
        EXPECT_EQ(result, OptionalNone {});

        // Vertical tab (0x0B) is invalid.
        result = HTTP::Header { header, "bb-8\x0B"sv }.extract_header_values();
        EXPECT_EQ(result, OptionalNone {});

        // Form feed (0x0C) is invalid.
        result = HTTP::Header { header, "bb-8\x0C"sv }.extract_header_values();
        EXPECT_EQ(result, OptionalNone {});

        // Invalid token alongside a valid one still fails.
        result = HTTP::Header { header, "bb-8,no no"sv }.extract_header_values();
        EXPECT_EQ(result, OptionalNone {});

        // Whitespace-only item is ignored.
        result = HTTP::Header { header, "bb-8,  ,no"sv }.extract_header_values();
        EXPECT_EQ(result, (Vector<ByteString> { "bb-8", "no" }));
    }

    // Other headers: returned as a single-element list regardless of content.
    auto result = HTTP::Header { "Content-Type"sv, "text/html; charset=utf-8"sv }.extract_header_values();
    EXPECT_EQ(result, (Vector<ByteString> { "text/html; charset=utf-8" }));
}

#include <LibCore/ImmutableBytes.h>
#include <LibHTTP/Cache/MemoryCache.h>
#include <LibHTTP/Cache/Utilities.h>
#include <LibHTTP/HeaderList.h>
#include <LibTest/TestCase.h>
#include <LibURL/Parser.h>

static URL::URL parse_url(StringView url)
{
    return URL::Parser::basic_parse(url).release_value();
}

static NonnullRefPtr<HTTP::HeaderList> create_cacheable_request_headers()
{
    return HTTP::HeaderList::create({
        { "Accept"sv, "*/*"sv },
    });
}

static NonnullRefPtr<HTTP::HeaderList> create_cacheable_response_headers()
{
    return HTTP::HeaderList::create({
        { "Cache-Control"sv, "max-age=60"sv },
    });
}

static NonnullRefPtr<HTTP::HeaderList> create_vary_user_agent_response_headers()
{
    return HTTP::HeaderList::create({
        { "Cache-Control"sv, "max-age=60"sv },
        { "Vary"sv, "User-Agent"sv },
    });
}

static Core::ImmutableBytes immutable_bytes(StringView bytes)
{
    return MUST(Core::ImmutableBytes::copy(bytes.bytes()));
}

TEST_CASE(permanent_redirects_without_explicit_freshness_are_reused)
{
    for (auto status_code : Array<u32, 2> { 301, 308 }) {
        auto cache = HTTP::MemoryCache::create();
        auto url = parse_url(MUST(String::formatted("https://example.com/redirect/{}", status_code)));
        auto request_headers = create_cacheable_request_headers();
        auto response_headers = HTTP::HeaderList::create({ { "Location"sv, "https://example.com/target"sv } });

        cache->create_entry(url, "GET"sv, *request_headers, UnixDateTime::now(), status_code, "Permanent Redirect"sv, *response_headers);
        cache->finalize_entry(url, "GET"sv, *request_headers, status_code, *response_headers, immutable_bytes({}));

        auto entry = cache->open_entry(url, "GET"sv, *request_headers, HTTP::CacheMode::Default);
        VERIFY(entry.has_value());
        EXPECT_EQ(entry->status_code, status_code);
    }
}

TEST_CASE(newer_response_replaces_entry_with_same_vary_key)
{
    auto cache = HTTP::MemoryCache::create();
    auto url = parse_url("https://example.com/script.js"sv);
    auto request_headers = create_cacheable_request_headers();
    auto old_response_headers = HTTP::HeaderList::create({ { "Cache-Control"sv, "max-age=60"sv }, { "Vary"sv, "Accept, User-Agent"sv } });
    auto new_response_headers = HTTP::HeaderList::create({ { "Cache-Control"sv, "max-age=60"sv }, { "Vary"sv, "User-Agent, Accept"sv } });

    cache->create_entry(url, "GET"sv, *request_headers, UnixDateTime::now(), 200, "OK"sv, *old_response_headers);
    cache->finalize_entry(url, "GET"sv, *request_headers, 200, *old_response_headers, immutable_bytes("old"sv));

    cache->create_entry(url, "GET"sv, *request_headers, UnixDateTime::now(), 200, "OK"sv, *new_response_headers);
    cache->finalize_entry(url, "GET"sv, *request_headers, 200, *new_response_headers, immutable_bytes("new"sv));

    auto entry = cache->open_entry(url, "GET"sv, *request_headers, HTTP::CacheMode::Default);
    VERIFY(entry.has_value());
    EXPECT_EQ(entry->response_body.bytes(), "new"sv.bytes());
}

TEST_CASE(not_modified_responses_are_not_stored)
{
    auto cache = HTTP::MemoryCache::create();
    auto url = parse_url("https://example.com/resource"sv);
    auto request_headers = HTTP::HeaderList::create({ { "If-None-Match"sv, "\"v1\""sv } });
    auto response_headers = HTTP::HeaderList::create({
        { "Cache-Control"sv, "max-age=60"sv },
        { "ETag"sv, "\"v1\""sv },
    });

    cache->create_entry(url, "GET"sv, *request_headers, UnixDateTime::now(), 304, "Not Modified"sv, *response_headers);
    cache->finalize_entry(url, "GET"sv, *request_headers, 304, *response_headers, immutable_bytes({}));

    EXPECT(!cache->open_entry(url, "GET"sv, *request_headers, HTTP::CacheMode::Default).has_value());
}

TEST_CASE(invalidation_removes_stored_and_pending_responses)
{
    auto cache = HTTP::MemoryCache::create();
    auto url = parse_url("https://example.com/resource"sv);
    auto request_headers = create_cacheable_request_headers();
    auto response_headers = create_cacheable_response_headers();

    cache->create_entry(url, "GET"sv, *request_headers, UnixDateTime::now(), 200, "OK"sv, *response_headers);
    cache->finalize_entry(url, "GET"sv, *request_headers, 200, *response_headers, immutable_bytes("old"sv));
    cache->create_entry(url, "HEAD"sv, *request_headers, UnixDateTime::now(), 200, "OK"sv, *response_headers);

    cache->invalidate(url);
    cache->finalize_entry(url, "HEAD"sv, *request_headers, 200, *response_headers, immutable_bytes({}));

    EXPECT(!cache->open_entry(url, "GET"sv, *request_headers, HTTP::CacheMode::Default).has_value());
    EXPECT(!cache->open_entry(url, "HEAD"sv, *request_headers, HTTP::CacheMode::Default).has_value());
}

TEST_CASE(abandoned_response_is_not_stored)
{
    auto cache = HTTP::MemoryCache::create();
    auto url = parse_url("https://example.com/resource"sv);
    auto request_headers = create_cacheable_request_headers();
    auto response_headers = create_cacheable_response_headers();

    cache->create_entry(url, "GET"sv, *request_headers, UnixDateTime::now(), 200, "OK"sv, *response_headers);
    cache->abandon_entry(url, "GET"sv, *request_headers, *response_headers, HTTP::MemoryCache::StoredResponse::Keep);
    cache->finalize_entry(url, "GET"sv, *request_headers, 200, *response_headers, immutable_bytes("partial"sv));

    EXPECT(!cache->open_entry(url, "GET"sv, *request_headers, HTTP::CacheMode::Default).has_value());
}

TEST_CASE(abandoning_a_response_leaves_other_pending_responses)
{
    auto cache = HTTP::MemoryCache::create();
    auto url = parse_url("https://example.com/resource"sv);
    auto request_headers = create_cacheable_request_headers();
    auto response_headers = create_cacheable_response_headers();

    cache->create_entry(url, "GET"sv, *request_headers, UnixDateTime::now(), 200, "OK"sv, *response_headers);
    cache->create_entry(url, "GET"sv, *request_headers, UnixDateTime::now(), 200, "OK"sv, *response_headers);
    cache->abandon_entry(url, "GET"sv, *request_headers, *response_headers, HTTP::MemoryCache::StoredResponse::Keep);
    cache->finalize_entry(url, "GET"sv, *request_headers, 200, *response_headers, immutable_bytes("complete"sv));

    auto entry = cache->open_entry(url, "GET"sv, *request_headers, HTTP::CacheMode::Default);
    VERIFY(entry.has_value());
    EXPECT_EQ(entry->response_body.bytes(), "complete"sv.bytes());
}

TEST_CASE(abandoning_a_response_matches_its_vary_headers)
{
    auto cache = HTTP::MemoryCache::create();
    auto url = parse_url("https://example.com/resource"sv);
    auto abandoned_request_headers = HTTP::HeaderList::create({
        { "Accept"sv, "*/*"sv },
        { "User-Agent"sv, "Abandoned"sv },
    });
    auto completed_request_headers = HTTP::HeaderList::create({
        { "Accept"sv, "*/*"sv },
        { "User-Agent"sv, "Completed"sv },
    });
    auto response_headers = create_vary_user_agent_response_headers();

    cache->create_entry(url, "GET"sv, *abandoned_request_headers, UnixDateTime::now(), 200, "OK"sv, *response_headers);
    cache->create_entry(url, "GET"sv, *completed_request_headers, UnixDateTime::now(), 200, "OK"sv, *response_headers);
    cache->abandon_entry(url, "GET"sv, *abandoned_request_headers, *response_headers, HTTP::MemoryCache::StoredResponse::Keep);
    cache->finalize_entry(url, "GET"sv, *abandoned_request_headers, 200, *response_headers, immutable_bytes("partial"sv));
    cache->finalize_entry(url, "GET"sv, *completed_request_headers, 200, *response_headers, immutable_bytes("complete"sv));

    EXPECT(!cache->open_entry(url, "GET"sv, *abandoned_request_headers, HTTP::CacheMode::Default).has_value());
    EXPECT(cache->open_entry(url, "GET"sv, *completed_request_headers, HTTP::CacheMode::Default).has_value());
}

TEST_CASE(non_storable_response_retires_stored_response)
{
    auto cache = HTTP::MemoryCache::create();
    auto url = parse_url("https://example.com/data"sv);
    auto request_headers = create_cacheable_request_headers();
    auto response_headers = create_cacheable_response_headers();
    auto no_store_response_headers = HTTP::HeaderList::create({ { "Cache-Control"sv, "no-store"sv } });

    cache->create_entry(url, "GET"sv, *request_headers, UnixDateTime::now(), 200, "OK"sv, *response_headers);
    cache->finalize_entry(url, "GET"sv, *request_headers, 200, *response_headers, immutable_bytes("old"sv));
    EXPECT(cache->open_entry(url, "GET"sv, *request_headers, HTTP::CacheMode::Default).has_value());

    cache->create_entry(url, "GET"sv, *request_headers, UnixDateTime::now(), 200, "OK"sv, *no_store_response_headers);
    cache->finalize_entry(url, "GET"sv, *request_headers, 200, *no_store_response_headers, immutable_bytes("current"sv));

    EXPECT(!cache->open_entry(url, "GET"sv, *request_headers, HTTP::CacheMode::Default).has_value());
}

TEST_CASE(force_cache_reuses_stale_must_revalidate_entries)
{
    auto cache = HTTP::MemoryCache::create();
    auto url = parse_url("https://example.com/must-revalidate"sv);
    auto request_headers = create_cacheable_request_headers();
    auto response_headers = HTTP::HeaderList::create({
        { "Age"sv, "120"sv },
        { "Cache-Control"sv, "max-age=60, must-revalidate"sv },
        { "ETag"sv, "\"v1\""sv },
    });

    cache->create_entry(url, "GET"sv, *request_headers, UnixDateTime::now(), 200, "OK"sv, *response_headers);
    cache->finalize_entry(url, "GET"sv, *request_headers, 200, *response_headers, immutable_bytes("data"sv));

    EXPECT(cache->open_entry(url, "GET"sv, *request_headers, HTTP::CacheMode::ForceCache).has_value());
    EXPECT(cache->open_entry(url, "GET"sv, *request_headers, HTTP::CacheMode::OnlyIfCached).has_value());
    EXPECT(!cache->open_entry(url, "GET"sv, *request_headers, HTTP::CacheMode::Default).has_value());
}

// Legacy memory SHA-1 prefix: 5955c546f462acaa, for URL + GET.
TEST_CASE(legacy_memory_hash_collision_does_not_alias_responses)
{
    auto cache = HTTP::MemoryCache::create();
    auto a = parse_url("https://b.example/a3e7f95e82b770fa"sv);
    auto b = parse_url("https://a.example/59179468b3084f39"sv);
    auto headers = create_cacheable_request_headers();
    auto response_a = create_cacheable_response_headers();
    response_a->append({ "X-Identity"sv, "A"sv });
    auto response_b = create_cacheable_response_headers();
    response_b->append({ "X-Identity"sv, "B"sv });
    cache->create_entry(a, "GET"sv, *headers, UnixDateTime::now(), 200, "OK"sv, *response_a);
    cache->finalize_entry(a, "GET"sv, *headers, 200, *response_a, immutable_bytes("response A"sv));
    EXPECT(!cache->open_entry(b, "GET"sv, *headers, HTTP::CacheMode::Default).has_value());
    cache->create_entry(b, "GET"sv, *headers, UnixDateTime::now(), 200, "OK"sv, *response_b);
    cache->finalize_entry(b, "GET"sv, *headers, 200, *response_b, immutable_bytes("response B"sv));
    for (auto which : { 0, 1 }) {
        auto entry = cache->open_entry(which == 0 ? a : b, "GET"sv, *headers, HTTP::CacheMode::Default);
        VERIFY(entry.has_value());
        EXPECT_EQ(entry->response_body.bytes(), (which == 0 ? "response A"sv : "response B"sv).bytes());
        EXPECT_EQ(entry->response_headers->get("X-Identity"sv), Optional<ByteString> { which == 0 ? "A" : "B" });
    }
    cache->invalidate(a);
    EXPECT(!cache->open_entry(a, "GET"sv, *headers, HTTP::CacheMode::Default).has_value());
    EXPECT(cache->open_entry(b, "GET"sv, *headers, HTTP::CacheMode::Default).has_value());
}

TEST_CASE(colliding_resources_keep_pending_responses_and_eviction_independent)
{
    auto usage = adopt_ref(*new HTTP::MemoryCacheUsage);
    auto cache = HTTP::MemoryCache::create(usage);
    auto a = parse_url("https://b.example/a3e7f95e82b770fa"sv);
    auto b = parse_url("https://a.example/59179468b3084f39"sv);
    auto headers = create_cacheable_request_headers();
    auto response_headers = create_cacheable_response_headers();
    cache->create_entry(a, "GET"sv, *headers, UnixDateTime::now(), 200, "OK"sv, *response_headers);
    cache->create_entry(b, "GET"sv, *headers, UnixDateTime::now(), 200, "OK"sv, *response_headers);
    cache->finalize_entry(b, "GET"sv, *headers, 200, *response_headers, immutable_bytes("B"sv));
    cache->abandon_entry(a, "GET"sv, *headers, *response_headers, HTTP::MemoryCache::StoredResponse::Retire);
    cache->finalize_entry(a, "GET"sv, *headers, 200, *response_headers, immutable_bytes("abandoned"sv));
    EXPECT(!cache->open_entry(a, "GET"sv, *headers, HTTP::CacheMode::Default).has_value());
    auto b_entry = cache->open_entry(b, "GET"sv, *headers, HTTP::CacheMode::Default);
    VERIFY(b_entry.has_value());
    EXPECT_EQ(b_entry->response_body.bytes(), "B"sv.bytes());
    cache->create_entry(a, "GET"sv, *headers, UnixDateTime::now(), 200, "OK"sv, *response_headers);
    cache->finalize_entry(a, "GET"sv, *headers, 200, *response_headers, immutable_bytes("A"sv));
    for (auto const& use : cache->complete_entry_uses()) {
        if (use.cache_key.url == HTTP::serialize_url_for_cache_storage(b))
            cache->evict_complete_entry(use.cache_key, use.vary_key);
    }
    EXPECT(cache->open_entry(a, "GET"sv, *headers, HTTP::CacheMode::Default).has_value());
    EXPECT(!cache->open_entry(b, "GET"sv, *headers, HTTP::CacheMode::Default).has_value());
    cache->invalidate(a);
    EXPECT_EQ(usage->bytes_in_memory, 0u);
    EXPECT_EQ(usage->mapped_bodies, 0u);
}

FILE: Tests/LibHTTP/TestProxy.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause

#include <LibTest/TestCase.h>

#include <AK/HashMap.h>
#include <LibHTTP/Proxy.h>
#include <LibURL/Parser.h>

static HTTP::ProxyConfiguration configuration_from(HashMap<StringView, StringView> const& environment)
{
    return HTTP::ProxyConfiguration::from_environment([&](StringView name) { return environment.get(name); });
}

static URL::URL url(StringView string)
{
    return URL::Parser::basic_parse(string).release_value();
}

TEST_CASE(parse_proxy)
{
    auto proxy = HTTP::Proxy::parse("proxy.example:3128"sv);
    EXPECT(proxy.has_value());
    EXPECT_EQ(proxy->type, HTTP::Proxy::Type::HTTP);
    EXPECT_EQ(proxy->host, "proxy.example"sv);
    EXPECT_EQ(proxy->port, 3128);
    EXPECT_EQ(proxy->to_curl_url(), "http://proxy.example:3128"sv);

    proxy = HTTP::Proxy::parse("SOCKS5H://user:pass@Proxy.Example/"sv);
    EXPECT(proxy.has_value());
    EXPECT_EQ(proxy->type, HTTP::Proxy::Type::SOCKS5Hostname);
    EXPECT_EQ(proxy->host, "proxy.example"sv);
    EXPECT_EQ(proxy->port, 1080);
    EXPECT_EQ(proxy->userinfo, "user:pass"sv);
    EXPECT_EQ(proxy->to_curl_url(), "socks5h://user:pass@proxy.example:1080"sv);

    proxy = HTTP::Proxy::parse("https://[::1]"sv);
    EXPECT(proxy.has_value());
    EXPECT_EQ(proxy->host, "::1"sv);
    EXPECT_EQ(proxy->port, 443);
    EXPECT_EQ(proxy->to_curl_url(), "https://[::1]:443"sv);

    EXPECT(!HTTP::Proxy::parse(""sv).has_value());
    EXPECT(!HTTP::Proxy::parse("ftp://proxy.example"sv).has_value());
    EXPECT(!HTTP::Proxy::parse("proxy.example:0"sv).has_value());
    EXPECT(!HTTP::Proxy::parse("proxy.example:99999"sv).has_value());
    EXPECT(!HTTP::Proxy::parse("http://:8080"sv).has_value());
    EXPECT(!HTTP::Proxy::parse("http://[::1:8080"sv).has_value());
    EXPECT(!HTTP::Proxy::parse("http://2001:db8::1:8080"sv).has_value());
}

TEST_CASE(parse_proxy_with_ipv6_zone)
{
    auto proxy = HTTP::Proxy::parse("http://[fe80::1%25eth0]:3128"sv);
    EXPECT(proxy.has_value());
    EXPECT_EQ(proxy->host, "fe80::1%25eth0"sv);
    EXPECT_EQ(proxy->to_curl_url(), "http://[fe80::1%25eth0]:3128"sv);
}

TEST_CASE(parse_proxy_with_percent_encoded_host)
{
    auto proxy = HTTP::Proxy::parse("http://%6cocal%2EHost:3128"sv);
    EXPECT(proxy.has_value());
    EXPECT_EQ(proxy->host, "local.host"sv);
    EXPECT_EQ(proxy->to_curl_url(), "http://local.host:3128"sv);
}

TEST_CASE(proxy_hostname_resolution)
{
    EXPECT(HTTP::Proxy::parse("http://proxy"sv)->resolves_hostnames());
    EXPECT(HTTP::Proxy::parse("https://proxy"sv)->resolves_hostnames());
    EXPECT(HTTP::Proxy::parse("socks4a://proxy"sv)->resolves_hostnames());
    EXPECT(HTTP::Proxy::parse("socks5h://proxy"sv)->resolves_hostnames());
    EXPECT(!HTTP::Proxy::parse("socks4://proxy"sv)->resolves_hostnames());
    EXPECT(!HTTP::Proxy::parse("socks5://proxy"sv)->resolves_hostnames());
}

TEST_CASE(proxy_environment_precedence)
{
    auto configuration = configuration_from({ { "all_proxy"sv, "socks5://all"sv }, { "https_proxy"sv, "http://secure"sv } });
    EXPECT_EQ(configuration.proxy_for(url("http://example.com"sv))->host, "all"sv);
    EXPECT_EQ(configuration.proxy_for(url("ws://example.com"sv))->host, "all"sv);
    EXPECT_EQ(configuration.proxy_for(url("https://example.com"sv))->host, "secure"sv);
    EXPECT_EQ(configuration.proxy_for(url("wss://example.com"sv))->host, "secure"sv);
    EXPECT(!configuration.proxy_for(url("file:///etc/passwd"sv)).has_value());

    configuration = configuration_from({ { "HTTP_PROXY"sv, "http://upper"sv }, { "HTTPS_PROXY"sv, "http://upper"sv } });
    EXPECT(!configuration.proxy_for(url("http://example.com"sv)).has_value());
    EXPECT_EQ(configuration.proxy_for(url("https://example.com"sv))->host, "upper"sv);

    configuration = configuration_from({ { "http_proxy"sv, "ftp://invalid"sv } });
    EXPECT(configuration.is_empty());
}

TEST_CASE(no_proxy_matching)
{
    auto configuration = configuration_from({
        { "all_proxy"sv, "http://proxy"sv },
        { "no_proxy"sv, "localhost, .internal.example corp.example.,10.0.0.0/8 ::1 192.168.1.1"sv },
    });

    auto is_proxied = [&](StringView string) { return configuration.proxy_for(url(string)).has_value(); };

    EXPECT(!is_proxied("http://localhost/"sv));
    EXPECT(!is_proxied("http://LOCALHOST./"sv));
    EXPECT(is_proxied("http://notlocalhost/"sv));
    EXPECT(!is_proxied("http://internal.example/"sv));
    EXPECT(!is_proxied("http://a.internal.example/"sv));
    EXPECT(!is_proxied("https://b.corp.example/"sv));
    EXPECT(is_proxied("https://xcorp.example/"sv));
    EXPECT(!is_proxied("http://10.1.2.3/"sv));
    EXPECT(is_proxied("http://11.1.2.3/"sv));
    EXPECT(!is_proxied("http://[::1]/"sv));
    EXPECT(is_proxied("http://[::2]/"sv));
    EXPECT(!is_proxied("http://192.168.1.1/"sv));
    EXPECT(is_proxied("http://192.168.1.2/"sv));

    configuration = configuration_from({ { "all_proxy"sv, "http://proxy"sv }, { "NO_PROXY"sv, "*"sv } });
    EXPECT(!is_proxied("https://example.com/"sv));
}

FILE: Tests/LibHTTP/TestStructuredFields.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026, Shannon Booth <shannon@serenityos.org>
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <LibTest/TestCase.h>

#include <LibHTTP/StructuredFields.h>

using namespace HTTP::StructuredFields;

static BareItem parse_bare_item(StringView input)
{
    auto item = MUST(parse<Item>(input));
    EXPECT(item.parameters.is_empty());
    return move(item.bare_item);
}

static BareItem string(StringView value)
{
    return ByteString { value };
}

static BareItem token(StringView value)
{
    return Token { value };
}

static ByteBuffer bytes(StringView value)
{
    return MUST(ByteBuffer::copy(value.bytes()));
}

TEST_CASE(integers)
{
    EXPECT(parse_bare_item("42"sv) == BareItem { i64 { 42 } });
    EXPECT(parse_bare_item("-42"sv) == BareItem { i64 { -42 } });
    EXPECT(parse_bare_item("0042"sv) == BareItem { i64 { 42 } });
    EXPECT(parse_bare_item("999999999999999"sv) == BareItem { i64 { 999'999'999'999'999 } });
    EXPECT(parse_bare_item("-999999999999999"sv) == BareItem { i64 { -999'999'999'999'999 } });

    EXPECT(parse<Item>("1000000000000000"sv).is_error());
    EXPECT(parse<Item>("-"sv).is_error());
    EXPECT(parse<Item>("-a"sv).is_error());
    EXPECT(parse<Item>("- 1"sv).is_error());
}

TEST_CASE(decimals)
{
    EXPECT(parse_bare_item("1.5"sv) == BareItem { 1.5 });
    EXPECT(parse_bare_item("-0.25"sv) == BareItem { -0.25 });
    EXPECT(parse_bare_item("123456789012.125"sv) == BareItem { 123456789012.125 });

    EXPECT(parse<Item>("1234567890123.0"sv).is_error());
    EXPECT(parse<Item>("1.2345"sv).is_error());
    EXPECT(parse<Item>("1."sv).is_error());
    EXPECT(parse<Item>("1.2.3"sv).is_error());
}

TEST_CASE(strings)
{
    EXPECT(parse_bare_item("\"foo bar\""sv) == string("foo bar"sv));
    EXPECT(parse_bare_item("\"\""sv) == string(""sv));
    EXPECT(parse_bare_item(R"("a \"quoted\" \\ string")"sv) == string(R"(a "quoted" \ string)"sv));

    EXPECT(parse<Item>("\"foo"sv).is_error());
    EXPECT(parse<Item>(R"("\a")"sv).is_error());
    EXPECT(parse<Item>("\"\\"sv).is_error());
    EXPECT(parse<Item>("\"foo\tbar\""sv).is_error());
    EXPECT(parse<Item>("\"foo\x7f\""sv).is_error());
}

TEST_CASE(tokens)
{
    EXPECT(parse_bare_item("same-origin"sv) == token("same-origin"sv));
    EXPECT(parse_bare_item("*foo"sv) == token("*foo"sv));
    EXPECT(parse_bare_item("text/html:x!#$%&'*+-.^_`|~"sv) == token("text/html:x!#$%&'*+-.^_`|~"sv));
    EXPECT(parse_bare_item("SAME-ORIGIN"sv) == token("SAME-ORIGIN"sv));

    EXPECT(parse<Item>("$same-origin"sv).is_error());
    EXPECT(parse<Item>("same-origin same-origin"sv).is_error());
    EXPECT(parse<Item>("same(origin"sv).is_error());
}

TEST_CASE(byte_sequences)
{
    EXPECT(parse_bare_item(":aGVsbG8=:"sv) == BareItem { bytes("hello"sv) });
    EXPECT(parse_bare_item("::"sv) == BareItem { ByteBuffer {} });

    // Recipients should neither require "=" padding nor reject non-zero pad bits.
    EXPECT(parse_bare_item(":aGVsbG8:"sv) == BareItem { bytes("hello"sv) });
    EXPECT(!parse<Item>(":iZ==:"sv).is_error());

    EXPECT(parse<Item>(":aGVsbG8="sv).is_error());
    EXPECT(parse<Item>(":aGVs bG8=:"sv).is_error());
    EXPECT(parse<Item>(":aGVsbG8_:"sv).is_error());
}

TEST_CASE(booleans)
{
    EXPECT(parse_bare_item("?1"sv) == BareItem { true });
    EXPECT(parse_bare_item("?0"sv) == BareItem { false });

    EXPECT(parse<Item>("?"sv).is_error());
    EXPECT(parse<Item>("?2"sv).is_error());
    EXPECT(parse<Item>("?true"sv).is_error());
}

TEST_CASE(dates)
{
    EXPECT(parse_bare_item("@1659578233"sv) == BareItem { Date { 1659578233 } });
    EXPECT(parse_bare_item("@-1659578233"sv) == BareItem { Date { -1659578233 } });

    EXPECT(parse<Item>("@1659578233.12"sv).is_error());
    EXPECT(parse<Item>("@"sv).is_error());
    EXPECT(parse<Item>("@foo"sv).is_error());
}

TEST_CASE(display_strings)
{
    EXPECT(parse_bare_item(R"(%"f%c3%bc%c3%bc")"sv) == BareItem { DisplayString { "füü"_string } });
    EXPECT(parse_bare_item(R"(%"")"sv) == BareItem { DisplayString { String {} } });

    EXPECT(parse<Item>(R"(%"f%C3%BC")"sv).is_error());
    EXPECT(parse<Item>(R"(%"%c3%28")"sv).is_error());
    EXPECT(parse<Item>(R"(%"%ed%a0%80")"sv).is_error());
    EXPECT(parse<Item>(R"(%"%c3")"sv).is_error());
    EXPECT(parse<Item>(R"(%"%c")"sv).is_error());
    EXPECT(parse<Item>(R"(%"foo)"sv).is_error());
    EXPECT(parse<Item>(R"(%foo)"sv).is_error());
}

TEST_CASE(parameters)
{
    auto item = MUST(parse<Item>("same-origin; report-to=\"endpoint\";a;b=?0;c=1"sv));
    EXPECT(item.bare_item == token("same-origin"sv));
    EXPECT_EQ(item.parameters.keys(), (Vector<ByteString> { "report-to"sv, "a"sv, "b"sv, "c"sv }));
    EXPECT(item.parameters.get("report-to"sv) == string("endpoint"sv));
    EXPECT(item.parameters.get("a"sv) == BareItem { true });
    EXPECT(item.parameters.get("b"sv) == BareItem { false });
    EXPECT(item.parameters.get("c"sv) == BareItem { i64 { 1 } });

    // A duplicate key overwrites the earlier value, but keeps its position.
    auto duplicate = MUST(parse<Item>("foo;a=1;b=2;a=3"sv));
    EXPECT_EQ(duplicate.parameters.keys(), (Vector<ByteString> { "a"sv, "b"sv }));
    EXPECT(duplicate.parameters.get("a"sv) == BareItem { i64 { 3 } });

    EXPECT(parse<Item>("same-origin;"sv).is_error());
    EXPECT(parse<Item>("same-origin;\tfoo=bar"sv).is_error());
    EXPECT(parse<Item>("same-origin ;foo=bar"sv).is_error());
    EXPECT(parse<Item>("same-origin;Foo=bar"sv).is_error());
    EXPECT(parse<Item>("same-origin;foo=(bar)"sv).is_error());
}

TEST_CASE(lists)
{
    EXPECT(MUST(parse<List>(""sv)).is_empty());
    EXPECT(MUST(parse<List>("   "sv)).is_empty());

    auto list = MUST(parse<List>("1, \"two\",\t three;x, (a b);y=?1, ()"sv));
    EXPECT_EQ(list.size(), 5u);
    EXPECT(list[0].get<Item>().bare_item == BareItem { i64 { 1 } });
    EXPECT(list[1].get<Item>().bare_item == string("two"sv));
    EXPECT(list[2].get<Item>().bare_item == token("three"sv));
    EXPECT(list[2].get<Item>().parameters.get("x"sv) == BareItem { true });

    auto const& inner_list = list[3].get<InnerList>();
    EXPECT_EQ(inner_list.items.size(), 2u);
    EXPECT(inner_list.items[0].bare_item == token("a"sv));
    EXPECT(inner_list.items[1].bare_item == token("b"sv));
    EXPECT(inner_list.parameters.get("y"sv) == BareItem { true });

    EXPECT(list[4].get<InnerList>().items.is_empty());

    EXPECT(parse<List>("1,"sv).is_error());
    EXPECT(parse<List>(",1"sv).is_error());
    EXPECT(parse<List>("1,,2"sv).is_error());
    EXPECT(parse<List>("1 2"sv).is_error());
    EXPECT(parse<List>("(a b"sv).is_error());
    EXPECT(parse<List>("(a,b)"sv).is_error());
}

TEST_CASE(dictionaries)
{
    EXPECT(MUST(parse<Dictionary>(""sv)).is_empty());

    auto dictionary = MUST(parse<Dictionary>("a=1, b, c;x=?0, d=(1 2), *e=\"f\""sv));
    EXPECT_EQ(dictionary.keys(), (Vector<ByteString> { "a"sv, "b"sv, "c"sv, "d"sv, "*e"sv }));
    EXPECT(dictionary.get("a"sv)->get<Item>().bare_item == BareItem { i64 { 1 } });
    EXPECT(dictionary.get("b"sv)->get<Item>().bare_item == BareItem { true });
    EXPECT(dictionary.get("c"sv)->get<Item>().bare_item == BareItem { true });
    EXPECT(dictionary.get("c"sv)->get<Item>().parameters.get("x"sv) == BareItem { false });
    EXPECT_EQ(dictionary.get("d"sv)->get<InnerList>().items.size(), 2u);
    EXPECT(dictionary.get("*e"sv)->get<Item>().bare_item == string("f"sv));

    // A duplicate key overwrites the earlier member, but keeps its position.
    auto duplicate = MUST(parse<Dictionary>("a=1, b=2, a=3"sv));
    EXPECT_EQ(duplicate.keys(), (Vector<ByteString> { "a"sv, "b"sv }));
    EXPECT(duplicate.get("a"sv)->get<Item>().bare_item == BareItem { i64 { 3 } });

    EXPECT(parse<Dictionary>("a=1,"sv).is_error());
    EXPECT(parse<Dictionary>("A=1"sv).is_error());
    EXPECT(parse<Dictionary>("a = 1"sv).is_error());
    EXPECT(parse<Dictionary>("a=1 b=2"sv).is_error());
}

TEST_CASE(field_values)
{
    EXPECT(parse_bare_item("  same-origin  "sv) == token("same-origin"sv));

    EXPECT(parse<Item>(""sv).is_error());
    EXPECT(parse<Item>("\tsame-origin"sv).is_error());
    EXPECT(parse<Item>("same-origin\t"sv).is_error());
    EXPECT(parse<Item>("same-origin, same-origin"sv).is_error());
    EXPECT(parse<Item>("\"f\xc3\xbc\""sv).is_error());
    EXPECT(parse<List>("a, b\xff"sv).is_error());
}

ladybird_test("TestImageDecoderClient.cpp" LibImageDecoderClient LIBS LibGfx LibImageDecoderClient LibIPC)

FILE: Tests/LibImageDecoderClient/TestImageDecoderClient.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <LibCore/EventLoop.h>
#include <LibCore/System.h>
#include <LibGfx/Bitmap.h>
#include <LibIPC/Transport.h>
#include <LibImageDecoderClient/Client.h>
#include <LibTest/TestCase.h>

// The decoder parses untrusted data, so a reply that does not add up must fail its request, not the client.

static Gfx::BitmapSequence bitmaps(size_t count)
{
    Gfx::BitmapSequence sequence;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i)
        sequence.bitmaps.append(MUST(Gfx::Bitmap::create(Gfx::BitmapFormat::BGRA8888, { 1, 1 })));
    return sequence;
}

static bool reply_is_accepted(Gfx::BitmapSequence sequence, Vector<u32> durations, i64 session_id)
{
    Core::EventLoop event_loop;
    auto paired = MUST(IPC::Transport::create_paired());
    auto client = adopt_ref(*new ImageDecoderClient::Client(move(paired.local)));
    // The first request has token 0.
    Array<u8, 1> encoded_data { 0 };
    auto promise = client->decode_image(encoded_data, {}, {});

    (void)MUST(client->handle(make<Messages::ImageDecoderClient::DidDecodeImage>(0, session_id != 0, 0, move(sequence), move(durations), Gfx::FloatPoint { 1, 1 }, Gfx::ColorSpace {}, session_id)));

    VERIFY(promise->is_resolved() || promise->is_rejected());
    return promise->is_resolved();
}

TEST_CASE(well_formed_replies_are_accepted)
{
    EXPECT(reply_is_accepted(bitmaps(1), { 0 }, 0));
    EXPECT(reply_is_accepted(bitmaps(2), { 10, 20 }, 0));

    // A streaming decode sends every frame's duration but only the first batch of bitmaps.
    EXPECT(reply_is_accepted(bitmaps(2), { 10, 20, 30 }, 1));
}

TEST_CASE(a_reply_without_bitmaps_is_refused)
{
    EXPECT(!reply_is_accepted(bitmaps(0), {}, 0));
    EXPECT(!reply_is_accepted(bitmaps(0), { 10 }, 1));
}

TEST_CASE(a_reply_without_a_duration_for_every_bitmap_is_refused)
{
    EXPECT(!reply_is_accepted(bitmaps(2), { 10 }, 0));
    EXPECT(!reply_is_accepted(bitmaps(1), { 10, 20 }, 0));
    EXPECT(!reply_is_accepted(bitmaps(3), { 10, 20 }, 1));
}

TEST_CASE(a_dying_client_is_let_go_of_before_its_decodes_are_rejected)
{
    Core::EventLoop event_loop;
    auto paired = MUST(IPC::Transport::create_paired());
    RefPtr<ImageDecoderClient::Client> client = adopt_ref(*new ImageDecoderClient::Client(move(paired.local)));

    bool decode_was_rejected = false;
    client->on_death = [&] { client = nullptr; };

    Array<u8, 4> encoded_data {};
    (void)client->decode_image(
        encoded_data.span(),
        [](ImageDecoderClient::DecodedImage&) -> ErrorOr<void> { return {}; },
        [&](Error&) {
            EXPECT(!client);
            decode_was_rejected = true;
        });

    client->shutdown();
    EXPECT(decode_was_rejected);
}

// Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.

#include <AK/ByteString.h>
#include <AK/Utf16String.h>
#include <LibIPC/File.h>

enum RustEcho::Shape : u8 { Circle, Square }

struct RustEcho::Record {
    [NonZero] u64 id;
    [MaxBytes=8] String label;
    [MaxBytes=8] ByteString name;
    [MaxBytes=8] ByteBuffer bytes;
    [MaxCount=3] Vector<u16> values;
    [Finite] double scale;
    RustEcho::Shape shape;
}

variant RustEcho::Value { Record RustEcho::Record, Number u32, Shape RustEcho::Shape }

endpoint RustEchoServer
{
    echo(u32 number, String text, Utf16String utf16_text, Vector<Optional<i64>> values, ByteBuffer bytes) => (u32 number, String text, Utf16String utf16_text, Vector<Optional<i64>> values, ByteBuffer bytes)
    write_to_file(IPC::File file, ByteString contents) => ()
    echo_files(Vector<IPC::File> files) => (Vector<IPC::File> files)
    stop() =|
    echo_utf8([UTF8] ByteString text, [UTF8] ByteBuffer bytes) => ([UTF8] ByteString text, [UTF8] ByteBuffer bytes)
    echo_value(RustEcho::Value value) => (RustEcho::Value value)
}

use std::env;
use std::error::Error;
use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::process::Command;

fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> {
    println!("cargo:rerun-if-env-changed=RUST_ECHO_SERVER_ENDPOINT");
    let endpoint = if let Some(path) = env::var_os("RUST_ECHO_SERVER_ENDPOINT") {
        let path = PathBuf::from(path);
        println!("cargo:rerun-if-changed={}", path.display());
        path
    } else {
        let manifest_dir = PathBuf::from(env::var("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")?);
        let definition = manifest_dir.join("../RustEchoServer.ipc");
        let generator = manifest_dir.join("../../../Meta/Generators/generate_ipc_definitions.py");
        println!("cargo:rerun-if-changed={}", definition.display());
        println!("cargo:rerun-if-changed={}", generator.display());
        // NB: The generator imports these from Meta/Utils.
        for module in ["lexer.py", "utils.py"] {
            println!(
                "cargo:rerun-if-changed={}",
                manifest_dir.join("../../../Meta/Utils").join(module).display()
            );
        }
        let output = PathBuf::from(env::var("OUT_DIR")?).join("RustEchoServerEndpoint.rs");
        let status = Command::new("python3")
            .arg(generator)
            .arg("--input")
            .arg(definition)
            .arg("--rust-output")
            .arg(&output)
            .status()?;
        if !status.success() {
            return Err("IPC endpoint generation failed".into());
        }
        output
    };
    println!("cargo:rustc-env=RUST_ECHO_SERVER_ENDPOINT={}", endpoint.display());
    Ok(())
}

/*

//! A Rust endpoint that TestRustEchoServer speaks with over the platform's transport, using code that the IPC compiler
//! generated for both languages from RustEchoServer.ipc.

#[path = "../../../../Libraries/RustDemangle.rs"]
mod rust_demangle;

#[path = "../../../../Libraries/RustPanic.rs"]
mod rust_panic;

use std::io::Write;

use libipc_rust::EndpointMessage;
#[cfg(all(unix, not(target_vendor = "apple")))]
use libipc_rust::transport_socket::TransportSocket as Transport;
#[cfg(target_vendor = "apple")]
use libipc_rust::{
    mach::{MachPort, PortRight},
    transport::TransportMachPort as Transport,
};

#[cfg(windows)]
use libipc_rust::transport_windows::{OwnedDescriptor, TransportWindows as Transport};

// NB: The generated code names the types RustEchoServer.ipc declares as crate::ipc_types::Namespace_Name.
mod ipc_types {
    include!(env!("RUST_ECHO_SERVER_ENDPOINT"));
}

use ipc_types::rust_echo_server;
use rust_echo_server::{
    Message,
    messages::{EchoFilesResponse, EchoResponse, EchoUtf8Response, EchoValueResponse, WriteToFileResponse},
};

#[cfg(all(test, unix))]
mod tests;

fn reply(transport: &Transport, message: impl EndpointMessage) -> std::io::Result<()> {
    let (bytes, attachments) = message.encode_message().expect("the reply encodes");
    transport.post_message(bytes, attachments)
}

fn serve(transport: Transport) {
    while let Some(received) = transport.receive() {
        let (bytes, attachments) = received.into_parts();
        let message = match Message::decode(bytes.as_ref(), attachments) {
            Ok(message) => message,
            Err(error) => {
                eprintln!("RustEchoServer: Refusing a message: {error:?}");
                break;
            }
        };
        let replied = match message {
            Message::Echo(echo) => reply(
                &transport,
                EchoResponse {
                    number: echo.number,
                    text: echo.text,
                    utf16_text: echo.utf16_text,
                    values: echo.values,
                    bytes: echo.bytes,
                },
            ),
            Message::WriteToFile(request) => {
                let mut file = std::fs::File::from(request.file.0);
                file.write_all(&request.contents.0).expect("the file is writable");
                reply(&transport, WriteToFileResponse)
            }
            Message::EchoFiles(request) => reply(&transport, EchoFilesResponse { files: request.files }),
            Message::EchoUtf8(request) => reply(
                &transport,
                EchoUtf8Response {
                    text: request.text,
                    bytes: request.bytes,
                },
            ),
            Message::EchoValue(request) => reply(&transport, EchoValueResponse { value: request.value }),
            Message::Stop(_) => break,
            Message::EchoResponse(_)
            | Message::WriteToFileResponse(_)
            | Message::EchoFilesResponse(_)
            | Message::EchoUtf8Response(_)
            | Message::EchoValueResponse(_) => {
                eprintln!("RustEchoServer: Refusing a response sent to it");
                break;
            }
        };
        if let Err(error) = replied {
            eprintln!("RustEchoServer: Could not reply: {error}");
            break;
        }
    }
    transport.flush();
}

/// Serves the endpoint on a thread of its own, taking over a receive right and a send right that this task holds.
#[cfg(target_vendor = "apple")]
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn rust_echo_server_serve(receive_right: u32, send_right: u32) {
    let receive_right = MachPort::adopt(receive_right, PortRight::Receive);
    let send_right = MachPort::adopt(send_right, PortRight::Send);
    let transport = Transport::new(receive_right, send_right).expect("the transport starts");
    std::thread::spawn(move || serve(transport));
}

/// Serves the endpoint on a thread of its own, taking over a connected Unix domain socket.
#[cfg(all(unix, not(target_vendor = "apple")))]
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn rust_echo_server_serve(socket_fd: std::os::fd::RawFd) {
    use std::os::fd::FromRawFd;
    // NB: The caller gives up its descriptor of a connected socket, which nothing else owns.
    let socket = unsafe { std::os::unix::net::UnixStream::from_raw_fd(socket_fd) };
    let transport = Transport::new(socket).expect("the transport starts");
    std::thread::spawn(move || serve(transport));
}

/// Serves the endpoint on a thread of its own, taking ownership of a LibCore pipe descriptor.
///
/// # Safety
/// The caller transfers sole ownership of a connected pipe descriptor.
#[cfg(windows)]
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn rust_echo_server_serve(descriptor: i32) {
    // SAFETY: The C++ caller transfers the server end of a newly created pipe.
    let descriptor = unsafe { OwnedDescriptor::from_raw(descriptor) };
    let transport = Transport::new(descriptor).expect("the transport starts");
    std::thread::spawn(move || serve(transport));
}

/*

use super::*;
use libipc_rust::DecodeError;
use rust_echo_server::messages::Stop;

#[test]
fn generated_messages_check_the_endpoint_and_message_number() {
    let (bytes, _) = Stop.encode_message().unwrap();
    assert!(matches!(Message::decode(&bytes, vec![]), Ok(Message::Stop(_))));
    for range in [0..4, 4..8] {
        let mut invalid = bytes.clone();
        invalid[range].fill(0);
        assert!(matches!(
            Message::decode(&invalid, vec![]),
            Err(DecodeError::InvalidValue(_))
        ));
    }
}

#[test]
fn generated_messages_refuse_truncated_bytes_and_accept_trailing_bytes_like_cpp() {
    let (mut bytes, _) = Stop.encode_message().unwrap();
    for length in 0..bytes.len() {
        assert!(Message::decode(&bytes[..length], vec![]).is_err());
    }
    bytes.push(0);
    assert!(matches!(Message::decode(&bytes, vec![]), Ok(Message::Stop(_))));
}

#[test]
fn generated_messages_accept_unused_attachments_like_cpp() {
    let (bytes, _) = Stop.encode_message().unwrap();
    let (mut reader, writer) = std::io::pipe().unwrap();
    let attachment = libipc_rust::Attachment::from_fd(writer.into()).unwrap();
    assert!(matches!(
        Message::decode(&bytes, vec![attachment]),
        Ok(Message::Stop(_))
    ));
    assert_eq!(std::io::Read::read(&mut reader, &mut [0]).unwrap(), 0);
}

#[test]
fn generated_utf8_validation_matches_cpp() {
    use libipc_rust::wire::ByteString;
    use libipc_rust::{Encode, EncodeError, Encoder};
    use rust_echo_server::messages::{EchoUtf8, EchoUtf8Response};

    for bytes in [
        b"".as_slice(),
        "héllo".as_bytes(),
        &[0xed, 0xa0, 0x80, 0xed, 0xbf, 0xbf],
    ] {
        let (encoded, attachments) = EchoUtf8 {
            text: ByteString(bytes.to_vec()),
            bytes: bytes.to_vec(),
        }
        .encode_message()
        .unwrap();
        let Message::EchoUtf8(decoded) = Message::decode(&encoded, attachments).unwrap() else {
            panic!("expected EchoUtf8");
        };
        assert_eq!(decoded.text.0, bytes);
        assert_eq!(decoded.bytes, bytes);
        let (encoded, attachments) = EchoUtf8Response {
            text: decoded.text,
            bytes: decoded.bytes,
        }
        .encode_message()
        .unwrap();
        let Message::EchoUtf8Response(decoded) = Message::decode(&encoded, attachments).unwrap() else {
            panic!("expected EchoUtf8Response");
        };
        assert_eq!(decoded.text.0, bytes);
        assert_eq!(decoded.bytes, bytes);
    }
    for bytes in [
        b"\xff".as_slice(),
        b"\xc0\x80",
        b"\xe2\x82",
        b"\xed\xa0\x80\xff",
        b"\xf4\x90\x80\x80",
    ] {
        for (text, bytes) in [(bytes.to_vec(), vec![]), (vec![], bytes.to_vec())] {
            for response in [false, true] {
                let mut encoded = Encoder::new();
                encoded.encode(&rust_echo_server::ENDPOINT_MAGIC).unwrap();
                let id = if response {
                    EchoUtf8Response::MESSAGE_ID
                } else {
                    EchoUtf8::MESSAGE_ID
                };
                encoded.encode(&id).unwrap();
                encoded.encode(&ByteString(text.clone())).unwrap();
                encoded.encode(&bytes).unwrap();
                assert!(matches!(
                    Message::decode(&encoded.finish().0, vec![]),
                    Err(DecodeError::InvalidValue("UTF-8"))
                ));
                let mut encoder = Encoder::new();
                let (borrowed, owned) = if response {
                    let message = EchoUtf8Response {
                        text: ByteString(text.clone()),
                        bytes: bytes.clone(),
                    };
                    (message.encode(&mut encoder), message.encode_message())
                } else {
                    let message = EchoUtf8 {
                        text: ByteString(text.clone()),
                        bytes: bytes.clone(),
                    };
                    (message.encode(&mut encoder), message.encode_message())
                };
                assert!(matches!(borrowed, Err(EncodeError::InvalidValue("UTF-8"))));
                assert!(matches!(owned, Err(EncodeError::InvalidValue("UTF-8"))));
            }
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn generated_owned_messages_move_files() {
    use libipc_rust::wire::File;
    use std::os::fd::AsRawFd;

    let (_reader, writer) = std::io::pipe().unwrap();
    let descriptor = writer.as_raw_fd();
    let files = vec![File(writer.into())];
    let (bytes, attachments) = EchoFilesResponse { files }.encode_message().unwrap();
    let Message::EchoFilesResponse(decoded) = Message::decode(&bytes, attachments).unwrap() else {
        panic!("expected EchoFilesResponse");
    };
    assert_eq!(decoded.files.len(), 1);
    #[cfg(not(target_vendor = "apple"))]
    assert_eq!(decoded.files[0].0.as_raw_fd(), descriptor);
    #[cfg(target_vendor = "apple")]
    let _ = descriptor;
}

#[test]
fn server_flushes_posted_replies_before_returning_on_errors() {
    use libipc_rust::wire::ByteString;
    use rust_echo_server::messages::{EchoUtf8, EchoUtf8Response};

    for invalid in [
        vec![0],
        EchoUtf8Response {
            text: ByteString(vec![]),
            bytes: vec![],
        }
        .encode_message()
        .unwrap()
        .0,
    ] {
        let (server, handle) = Transport::create_paired().unwrap();
        #[cfg(target_vendor = "apple")]
        let client = Transport::from_handle(handle).unwrap();
        #[cfg(not(target_vendor = "apple"))]
        let client = Transport::new(handle).unwrap();
        let thread = std::thread::spawn(move || serve(server));
        for number in 0..100u32 {
            reply(
                &client,
                EchoUtf8 {
                    text: ByteString(number.to_string().into_bytes()),
                    bytes: vec![],
                },
            )
            .unwrap();
        }
        client.post_message(invalid, vec![]).unwrap();
        for number in 0..100u32 {
            let received = client.receive().unwrap();
            let (bytes, attachments) = received.into_parts();
            let Message::EchoUtf8Response(response) = Message::decode(bytes.as_ref(), attachments).unwrap() else {
                panic!("expected EchoUtf8Response");
            };
            assert_eq!(response.text.0, number.to_string().as_bytes());
        }
        thread.join().unwrap();
        assert!(client.receive().is_none());
    }
}

#[test]
fn generated_encoders_refuse_what_decoders_refuse() {
    use crate::ipc_types::{RustEcho_Record, RustEcho_Shape};
    use libipc_rust::wire::{ByteString, Utf8String};
    use libipc_rust::{EncodeError, Encoder};

    let record = || RustEcho_Record {
        id: 7,
        label: Utf8String::from("label"),
        name: ByteString(b"name".to_vec()),
        bytes: b"bytes".to_vec(),
        values: vec![1, 2, 3],
        scale: 1.5,
        shape: RustEcho_Shape::Square,
    };
    assert!(Encoder::new().encode(&record()).is_ok());
    let invalidations: [fn(&mut RustEcho_Record); 7] = [
        |record| record.id = 0,
        |record| record.label = Utf8String::from("123456789"),
        |record| record.name = ByteString(b"123456789".to_vec()),
        |record| record.bytes = b"123456789".to_vec(),
        |record| record.values.push(4),
        |record| record.scale = f64::NAN,
        |record| record.scale = f64::INFINITY,
    ];
    for invalidate in invalidations {
        let mut invalid = record();
        invalidate(&mut invalid);
        assert!(matches!(
            Encoder::new().encode(&invalid),
            Err(EncodeError::InvalidValue(_))
        ));
        assert!(matches!(
            Encoder::new().encode_owned(invalid),
            Err(EncodeError::InvalidValue(_))
        ));
    }
}

#include <AK/Array.h>
