namespace {

constexpr u32 TEST_MAGIC = 0xCAFEF00D;
constexpr int TARGET_MESSAGE_ID = 1;
constexpr int OTHER_MESSAGE_ID = 2;

class TestMessage final : public IPC::Message {
public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    explicit TestMessage(int id, u64 sequence = 0, u32 magic = TEST_MAGIC)
        : m_id(id)
        , m_sequence(sequence)
        , m_magic(magic)
    {
    }

    u32 endpoint_magic() const override { return m_magic; }
    int message_id() const override { return m_id; }
    StringView message_name() const override { return "TestMessage"sv; }

    u64 sequence() const { return m_sequence; }

    ErrorOr<IPC::MessageBuffer> encode() const override
    {
        IPC::MessageBuffer buffer;
        u32 id = static_cast<u32>(m_id);
        TRY(buffer.append_data(reinterpret_cast<u8 const*>(&id), sizeof(id)));
        return buffer;
    }

private:
    int m_id { 0 };
    u64 m_sequence { 0 };
    u32 m_magic { TEST_MAGIC };
};

class CountingStub final : public IPC::Stub {
public:
    u32 magic() const override { return TEST_MAGIC; }
    ByteString name() const override { return "CountingStub"; }

    ErrorOr<OwnPtr<IPC::MessageBuffer>> handle(NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Message> message) override
    {
        ++m_handle_count;
        if (on_message)
            on_message(*message);
        return OwnPtr<IPC::MessageBuffer> {};
    }

    size_t handle_count() const { return m_handle_count; }

    Function<void(IPC::Message const&)> on_message;

private:
    size_t m_handle_count { 0 };
};

class TestConnection final : public IPC::ConnectionBase {
    C_OBJECT(TestConnection);

public:
    using ConnectionBase::drain_messages_from_peer;
    using ConnectionBase::handle_messages;
    using ConnectionBase::MayCancel;
    using ConnectionBase::PeerEOF;
    using ConnectionBase::post_sync_request;
    using ConnectionBase::wait_for_transport_to_become_readable;

    virtual void die() override { ++m_die_count; }
    size_t die_count() const { return m_die_count; }

    void inject_unprocessed_message(NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Message> message)
    {
        m_unprocessed_messages.append(move(message));
    }

    OwnPtr<IPC::Message> call_wait_for_specific_endpoint_message_impl(u32 endpoint_magic, int message_id, MayCancel may_cancel = MayCancel::No)
    {
        return wait_for_specific_endpoint_message_impl(endpoint_magic, message_id, may_cancel);
    }

protected:
    OwnPtr<IPC::Message> try_parse_message(IPC::ReceivedMessageBytes const& received_bytes, Queue<IPC::Attachment>&) override
    {
        auto bytes = received_bytes.bytes();
        if (bytes.size() != sizeof(u32))
            return nullptr;
        return make<TestMessage>(static_cast<int>(AK::ByteReader::load32(bytes.data())));
    }

private:
    TestConnection(IPC::Stub& stub, NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport> transport)
        : IPC::ConnectionBase(stub, move(transport), TEST_MAGIC)
    {
    }

    size_t m_die_count { 0 };
};

struct PeerCloseOutcome {
    size_t messages_dispatched { 0 };
    size_t die_count_before_deferred_shutdown { 0 };
    size_t die_count { 0 };
};

// Has the peer send one message and then close its end. Reports what the connection does with that message once it has
// seen the close.
ErrorOr<PeerCloseOutcome> send_one_message_then_close_peer(bool peer_owns_this_process)
{
    Core::EventLoop loop;

    auto pair = TRY(IPC::Transport::create_paired());

    CountingStub stub;
    auto connection = TestConnection::construct(stub, move(pair.local));
    connection->set_peer_owns_this_process(peer_owns_this_process);

    {
        CountingStub peer_stub;
        auto peer = TestConnection::construct(peer_stub, TRY(pair.remote_handle.create_transport()));
        TRY(peer->post_message(TestMessage { OTHER_MESSAGE_ID }));
        peer->transport().close_after_sending_all_pending_messages();
    }

    // Nothing pumps the event loop until the close has been seen, so the message is still queued at that point.
    do {
        connection->wait_for_transport_to_become_readable();
    } while (connection->drain_messages_from_peer() == TestConnection::PeerEOF::No);
    connection->handle_messages();

    PeerCloseOutcome outcome;
    outcome.die_count_before_deferred_shutdown = connection->die_count();

    while (loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents) != 0)
        ;

    outcome.messages_dispatched = stub.handle_count();
    outcome.die_count = connection->die_count();
    return outcome;
}

ByteBuffer patterned_bytes(size_t size, u8 seed)
{
    auto bytes = MUST(ByteBuffer::create_uninitialized(size));
    for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i)
        bytes[i] = static_cast<u8>(seed + i % 251);
    return bytes;
}

}

TEST_CASE(taking_unprocessed_messages_includes_the_current_dispatch_batch)
{
    Core::EventLoop loop;
    auto pair = TRY_OR_FAIL(IPC::Transport::create_paired());
    CountingStub stub;
    auto connection = TestConnection::construct(stub, move(pair.local));
    size_t taken_count = 0;
    stub.on_message = [&](IPC::Message const& message) {
        if (message.message_id() != OTHER_MESSAGE_ID)
            return;
        // A synchronous request from this handler can receive more pushes before its
        // response, but older pushes are still waiting in this dispatch batch.
        connection->inject_unprocessed_message(make<TestMessage>(TARGET_MESSAGE_ID, 2));
        auto taken = connection->take_unprocessed_messages(TEST_MAGIC, TARGET_MESSAGE_ID);
        taken_count = taken.size();
        for (size_t i = 0; i < taken.size(); ++i)
            EXPECT_EQ(static_cast<TestMessage const&>(*taken[i]).sequence(), i + 1);
    };
    connection->inject_unprocessed_message(make<TestMessage>(OTHER_MESSAGE_ID));
    connection->inject_unprocessed_message(make<TestMessage>(TARGET_MESSAGE_ID, 1));
    connection->handle_messages();
    EXPECT_EQ(taken_count, 2u);
    EXPECT_EQ(stub.handle_count(), 1u);
    EXPECT(connection->take_unprocessed_messages(TEST_MAGIC, TARGET_MESSAGE_ID).is_empty());
}

TEST_CASE(taking_unprocessed_messages_preserves_nested_batch_order_and_unrelated_messages)
{
    Core::EventLoop loop;
    auto pair = TRY_OR_FAIL(IPC::Transport::create_paired());
    CountingStub stub;
    auto connection = TestConnection::construct(stub, move(pair.local));
    constexpr int nested_message_id = 3;
    constexpr int unrelated_message_id = 4;
    Vector<int> dispatched;
    size_t taken_count = 0;
    stub.on_message = [&](IPC::Message const& message) {
        dispatched.append(message.message_id());
        if (message.message_id() == OTHER_MESSAGE_ID) {
            connection->inject_unprocessed_message(make<TestMessage>(nested_message_id));
            connection->inject_unprocessed_message(make<TestMessage>(TARGET_MESSAGE_ID, 2));
            connection->inject_unprocessed_message(make<TestMessage>(unrelated_message_id));
            connection->handle_messages();
        } else if (message.message_id() == nested_message_id) {
            connection->inject_unprocessed_message(make<TestMessage>(TARGET_MESSAGE_ID, 3));
            connection->inject_unprocessed_message(make<TestMessage>(TARGET_MESSAGE_ID, 4, TEST_MAGIC + 1));
            auto taken = connection->take_unprocessed_messages(TEST_MAGIC, TARGET_MESSAGE_ID);
            taken_count = taken.size();
            for (size_t i = 0; i < taken.size(); ++i)
                EXPECT_EQ(static_cast<TestMessage const&>(*taken[i]).sequence(), i + 1);
        }
    };
    connection->inject_unprocessed_message(make<TestMessage>(OTHER_MESSAGE_ID));
    connection->inject_unprocessed_message(make<TestMessage>(TARGET_MESSAGE_ID, 1));
    connection->inject_unprocessed_message(make<TestMessage>(unrelated_message_id));
    connection->handle_messages();
    EXPECT_EQ(taken_count, 3u);
    EXPECT_EQ(dispatched, (Vector<int> { OTHER_MESSAGE_ID, nested_message_id, unrelated_message_id, unrelated_message_id }));
    auto other_endpoint = connection->take_unprocessed_messages(TEST_MAGIC + 1, TARGET_MESSAGE_ID);
    EXPECT_EQ(other_endpoint.size(), 1u);
    EXPECT(connection->take_unprocessed_messages(TEST_MAGIC, TARGET_MESSAGE_ID).is_empty());
}

TEST_CASE(shutdown_stops_current_dispatch_batch)
{
    Core::EventLoop loop;
    auto pair = TRY_OR_FAIL(IPC::Transport::create_paired());
    CountingStub stub;
    auto connection = TestConnection::construct(stub, move(pair.local));
    stub.on_message = [&](IPC::Message const& message) {
        if (message.message_id() == OTHER_MESSAGE_ID)
            connection->shutdown();
    };

    connection->inject_unprocessed_message(make<TestMessage>(OTHER_MESSAGE_ID));
    connection->inject_unprocessed_message(make<TestMessage>(TARGET_MESSAGE_ID));
    connection->handle_messages();

    EXPECT_EQ(stub.handle_count(), 1u);
    EXPECT_EQ(connection->die_count(), 1u);
    EXPECT(!connection->is_open());
}

TEST_CASE(shutdown_discards_pending_messages_from_all_batches)
{
    Core::EventLoop loop;
    auto pair = TRY_OR_FAIL(IPC::Transport::create_paired());
    CountingStub stub;
    auto connection = TestConnection::construct(stub, move(pair.local));

    constexpr int shutdown_message_id = 3;
    constexpr u32 response_endpoint_magic = TEST_MAGIC + 1;
    Vector<int> dispatched;
    stub.on_message = [&](IPC::Message const& message) {
        dispatched.append(message.message_id());
        if (message.message_id() == OTHER_MESSAGE_ID) {
            connection->inject_unprocessed_message(make<TestMessage>(shutdown_message_id));
            connection->inject_unprocessed_message(make<TestMessage>(TARGET_MESSAGE_ID));
            connection->handle_messages();
        } else if (message.message_id() == shutdown_message_id) {
            connection->inject_unprocessed_message(make<TestMessage>(TARGET_MESSAGE_ID));
            connection->inject_unprocessed_message(make<TestMessage>(TARGET_MESSAGE_ID, 0, response_endpoint_magic));
            connection->shutdown();
            EXPECT(connection->take_unprocessed_messages(TEST_MAGIC, TARGET_MESSAGE_ID).is_empty());
            EXPECT(!connection->call_wait_for_specific_endpoint_message_impl(response_endpoint_magic, TARGET_MESSAGE_ID));
        }
    };

    connection->inject_unprocessed_message(make<TestMessage>(OTHER_MESSAGE_ID));
    connection->inject_unprocessed_message(make<TestMessage>(TARGET_MESSAGE_ID));
    connection->handle_messages();

    EXPECT_EQ(dispatched, (Vector<int> { OTHER_MESSAGE_ID, shutdown_message_id }));
}

TEST_CASE(anonymous_buffer_size_uses_64_bits)
{
    constexpr size_t buffer_size = 4096;
    auto buffer = MUST(Core::AnonymousBuffer::create_with_size(buffer_size));

    IPC::MessageBuffer message_buffer;
    IPC::Encoder encoder { message_buffer };
    MUST(encoder.encode(buffer));
    EXPECT_EQ(message_buffer.data().size(), sizeof(bool) + sizeof(u64));

    auto data = message_buffer.take_data();
    FixedMemoryStream stream { data.span() };

    Queue<IPC::Attachment> attachments;
    for (auto& attachment : message_buffer.take_attachments())
        attachments.enqueue(move(attachment));

    IPC::Decoder decoder { stream, attachments };
    auto decoded_buffer = MUST(decoder.decode<Core::AnonymousBuffer>());
    EXPECT_EQ(decoded_buffer.size(), buffer_size);
}

TEST_CASE(payloads_of_any_size_arrive_intact_with_their_attachments)
{
    auto pair = TRY_OR_FAIL(IPC::Transport::create_paired());
    auto receiver = TRY_OR_FAIL(pair.remote_handle.create_transport());

    Array<size_t, 3> payload_sizes { 1 * KiB, 2 * MiB, 65 * MiB };
    for (size_t i = 0; i < payload_sizes.size(); ++i) {
        auto attachment = TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::AnonymousBuffer::create_with_size(sizeof(size_t)));
        *attachment.data<size_t>() = i;

        IPC::MessageBuffer buffer;
        IPC::Encoder encoder { buffer };
        TRY_OR_FAIL(encoder.encode(patterned_bytes(payload_sizes[i], static_cast<u8>(i))));
        TRY_OR_FAIL(encoder.encode(attachment));
        TRY_OR_FAIL(buffer.transfer_message(*pair.local));
    }

    size_t received = 0;
    while (received < payload_sizes.size()) {
        receiver->wait_until_readable();
        auto should_shutdown = receiver->read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([&](auto&& message) {
            FixedMemoryStream stream { message.bytes.bytes() };
            IPC::Decoder decoder { stream, message.attachments };
            auto payload = MUST(decoder.decode<ByteBuffer>());
            auto attachment = MUST(decoder.decode<Core::AnonymousBuffer>());
            EXPECT(payload == patterned_bytes(payload_sizes[received], static_cast<u8>(received)));
            EXPECT_EQ(*attachment.data<size_t>(), received);
            EXPECT(message.attachments.is_empty());
            ++received;
        });
        if (should_shutdown == IPC::Transport::ShouldShutdown::Yes)
            break;
    }
    EXPECT_EQ(received, payload_sizes.size());
}

// Regression test for #9582. wait_for_specific_endpoint_message_impl is reachable from any sync IPC call, including
// from inside a constructor whose members are still being initialized (e.g., PageHost's construction issues a sync
// allocate_compositor_context_id IPC call before ConnectionFromClient::m_page_host has been assigned). If the peer
// disconnects before responding, the failure path must not synchronously dispatch unrelated queued messages. That can
// reenter arbitrary handlers from a context where caller state is only partially built.
TEST_CASE(sync_wait_failure_does_not_dispatch_queued_messages)
{
    Core::EventLoop loop;

    auto pair = TRY_OR_FAIL(IPC::Transport::create_paired());

    CountingStub stub;
    auto connection = TestConnection::construct(stub, move(pair.local));

    connection->inject_unprocessed_message(make<TestMessage>(OTHER_MESSAGE_ID));
    // Queue a deferred dispatch before the transport can observe EOF.
    EXPECT_EQ(connection->drain_messages_from_peer(), TestConnection::PeerEOF::No);

    // Hang up the peer before waiting for the response.
    {
        auto hung_up_peer = move(pair.remote_handle);
    }

    auto response = connection->call_wait_for_specific_endpoint_message_impl(TEST_MAGIC, TARGET_MESSAGE_ID);

    EXPECT(!response);
    EXPECT_EQ(stub.handle_count(), 0u);

    // The wait may not shut down if EOF was seen before it started.
    connection->shutdown();
    while (loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents) != 0)
        ;
    EXPECT_EQ(stub.handle_count(), 0u);
}

TEST_CASE(cancelled_thread_does_not_take_a_late_response)
{
    // NB: A canceller stays on its thread until that thread ends.
    auto thread = Threading::Thread::construct("Cancelled"sv, [] -> intptr_t {
        Core::EventLoop loop;

        auto pair = MUST(IPC::Transport::create_paired());

        CountingStub stub;
        auto connection = TestConnection::construct(stub, move(pair.local));

        auto canceller = IPC::SyncRequestCanceller::create();
        EXPECT(!IPC::SyncRequestCanceller::is_installed_on_this_thread());
        canceller->install_on_this_thread();
        EXPECT(IPC::SyncRequestCanceller::is_installed_on_this_thread());
        canceller->cancel();

        // The response to the wait that was cancelled comes in, and the thread then makes a request of the same type.
        connection->inject_unprocessed_message(make<TestMessage>(TARGET_MESSAGE_ID, 0, TEST_MAGIC + 1));
        EXPECT(!connection->call_wait_for_specific_endpoint_message_impl(TEST_MAGIC + 1, TARGET_MESSAGE_ID, TestConnection::MayCancel::Yes));

        connection->handle_messages();
        EXPECT_EQ(stub.handle_count(), 0u);

        connection->shutdown();
        while (loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents) != 0)
            ;
        return 0;
    });
    thread->start();
    TRY_OR_FAIL(thread->join());
}

TEST_CASE(async_posts_from_many_threads_all_arrive)
{
    Core::EventLoop loop;

    auto pair = TRY_OR_FAIL(IPC::Transport::create_paired());
    auto receiver_transport = TRY_OR_FAIL(pair.remote_handle.create_transport());

    CountingStub sender_stub;
    auto sender = TestConnection::construct(sender_stub, move(pair.local));
    CountingStub receiver_stub;
    auto receiver = TestConnection::construct(receiver_stub, move(receiver_transport));

    constexpr size_t thread_count = 8;
    constexpr size_t messages_per_thread = 250;

    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<size_t> failed_post_count { 0 };
    Vector<NonnullRefPtr<Threading::Thread>> threads;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < thread_count; i++) {
        auto thread = Threading::Thread::construct("Sender"sv, [&sender = *sender, &failed_post_count]() -> intptr_t {
            for (size_t j = 0; j < messages_per_thread; j++) {
                if (sender.post_message(TestMessage { TARGET_MESSAGE_ID }).is_error())
                    failed_post_count++;
            }
            return 0;
        });
        thread->start();
        threads.append(move(thread));
    }
    for (auto& thread : threads)
        MUST(thread->join());

    auto deadline = Core::ElapsedTimer::start_new();
    while (receiver_stub.handle_count() < thread_count * messages_per_thread && deadline.elapsed_milliseconds() < 10'000)
        loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);

    EXPECT_EQ(failed_post_count.load(), 0u);
    EXPECT_EQ(receiver_stub.handle_count(), thread_count * messages_per_thread);

    while (loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents) != 0)
        ;
}

TEST_CASE(async_posts_racing_close_are_safe)
{
    Core::EventLoop loop;

    // A live receiver keeps the transport's queue draining, so posts only fail once we shut the
    // connection down ourselves.
    auto pair = TRY_OR_FAIL(IPC::Transport::create_paired());
    auto receiver_transport = TRY_OR_FAIL(pair.remote_handle.create_transport());

    CountingStub stub;
    auto sender = TestConnection::construct(stub, move(pair.local));
    CountingStub receiver_stub;
    auto receiver = TestConnection::construct(receiver_stub, move(receiver_transport));

    constexpr size_t thread_count = 4;
    constexpr size_t posts_per_thread = 2000;

    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<size_t> successful_post_count { 0 };
    Vector<NonnullRefPtr<Threading::Thread>> threads;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < thread_count; i++) {
        auto thread = Threading::Thread::construct("Sender"sv, [&sender = *sender, &successful_post_count]() -> intptr_t {
            for (size_t j = 0; j < posts_per_thread; j++) {
                if (!sender.post_message(TestMessage { TARGET_MESSAGE_ID }).is_error())
                    successful_post_count++;
            }
            return 0;
        });
        thread->start();
        threads.append(move(thread));
    }

    // Close only once sends are provably in flight, so the shutdown overlaps them.
    auto deadline = Core::ElapsedTimer::start_new();
    while (successful_post_count.load() < 100 && deadline.elapsed_milliseconds() < 10'000)
        ;
    sender->shutdown();

    for (auto& thread : threads)
        MUST(thread->join());

    EXPECT(!sender->is_open());
    EXPECT(sender->post_message(TestMessage { TARGET_MESSAGE_ID }).is_error());

    while (loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents) != 0)
        ;
}

TEST_CASE(messages_sent_before_the_peer_closed_are_dispatched_before_shutdown)
{
    auto outcome = TRY_OR_FAIL(send_one_message_then_close_peer(false));
    EXPECT_EQ(outcome.messages_dispatched, 1u);
    EXPECT_EQ(outcome.die_count_before_deferred_shutdown, 0u);
    EXPECT(outcome.die_count > 0);
}

// A helper process exists only to serve the process that owns it. Once that peer has closed the connection, the
// handlers for whatever it sent before closing would run on a connection that's closed under them. So, the connection
// drops those messages, and shuts down right away.
TEST_CASE(messages_sent_before_a_peer_that_owns_this_process_closed_are_dropped)
{
    auto outcome = TRY_OR_FAIL(send_one_message_then_close_peer(true));
    EXPECT_EQ(outcome.messages_dispatched, 0u);
    EXPECT(outcome.die_count_before_deferred_shutdown > 0);
}

TEST_CASE(sync_request_to_a_closed_peer_that_owns_this_process_shuts_down)
{
    Core::EventLoop loop;

    auto pair = TRY_OR_FAIL(IPC::Transport::create_paired());

    CountingStub stub;
    auto connection = TestConnection::construct(stub, move(pair.local));
    connection->set_peer_owns_this_process(true);

    {
        auto hung_up_peer = move(pair.remote_handle);
    }
    // The transport has seen the peer close by the time this returns, but the connection hasn't drained it yet.
    connection->wait_for_transport_to_become_readable();

    // Whether the post itself fails is up to the transport. If it doesn't, then the wait for the response finds the
    // peer gone.
    if (!connection->post_sync_request(TestMessage { TARGET_MESSAGE_ID }).is_error())
        EXPECT(!connection->call_wait_for_specific_endpoint_message_impl(TEST_MAGIC, TARGET_MESSAGE_ID));

    EXPECT(connection->die_count() > 0);
    EXPECT_EQ(stub.handle_count(), 0u);

    while (loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents) != 0)
        ;
}

TEST_CASE(sync_wait_on_a_closed_peer_that_owns_this_process_shuts_down)
{
    Core::EventLoop loop;

    auto pair = TRY_OR_FAIL(IPC::Transport::create_paired());

    CountingStub stub;
    auto connection = TestConnection::construct(stub, move(pair.local));
    connection->set_peer_owns_this_process(true);

    {
        auto hung_up_peer = move(pair.remote_handle);
    }
    connection->wait_for_transport_to_become_readable();

    EXPECT(!connection->call_wait_for_specific_endpoint_message_impl(TEST_MAGIC, TARGET_MESSAGE_ID));
    EXPECT(connection->die_count() > 0);

    while (loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents) != 0)
        ;
}

#include <AK/ByteBuffer.h>
#include <AK/MemoryStream.h>
#include <AK/NumericLimits.h>
#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <AK/Queue.h>
#include <AK/String.h>
#include <AK/Utf16String.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibCore/AnonymousBuffer.h>
#include <LibCore/System.h>
#include <LibIPC/Attachment.h>
#include <LibIPC/Decoder.h>
#include <LibIPC/Encoder.h>
#include <LibIPC/File.h>
#include <LibTest/TestCase.h>

template<typename T>
static ErrorOr<T> decode_bytes(ReadonlyBytes bytes)
{
    FixedMemoryStream stream { bytes };
    Queue<IPC::Attachment> attachments;
    IPC::Decoder decoder { stream, attachments };
    return decoder.decode<T>();
}

TEST_CASE(decode_bool)
{
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(decode_bytes<bool>(Array<u8, 1> { 0 })), false);
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(decode_bytes<bool>(Array<u8, 1> { 1 })), true);
    EXPECT(decode_bytes<bool>(Array<u8, 1> { 2 }).is_error());
    EXPECT(decode_bytes<bool>(Array<u8, 1> { 0xff }).is_error());
}

TEST_CASE(decode_vector_of_bool)
{
    auto vector_bytes = [](Array<u8, 3> values) {
        Vector<u8> bytes;
        u32 size = values.size();
        bytes.append(reinterpret_cast<u8 const*>(&size), sizeof(size));
        bytes.append(values.data(), values.size());
        return bytes;
    };

    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(decode_bytes<Vector<bool>>(vector_bytes({ 1, 0, 1 }))), (Vector<bool> { true, false, true }));
    EXPECT(decode_bytes<Vector<bool>>(vector_bytes({ 1, 2, 1 })).is_error());
}

static Vector<u8> bytes_with_size_prefix(u32 size, ReadonlyBytes contents)
{
    Vector<u8> bytes;
    bytes.append(reinterpret_cast<u8 const*>(&size), sizeof(size));
    bytes.append(contents.data(), contents.size());
    return bytes;
}

TEST_CASE(decode_size_refuses_a_size_larger_than_the_rest_of_the_message)
{
    auto contents = "abcd"sv.bytes();

    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(decode_bytes<ByteString>(bytes_with_size_prefix(4, contents))), "abcd"sv);
    EXPECT(decode_bytes<ByteString>(bytes_with_size_prefix(5, contents)).is_error());

    EXPECT(decode_bytes<Vector<String>>(bytes_with_size_prefix(5, contents)).is_error());
    EXPECT(decode_bytes<Vector<String>>(bytes_with_size_prefix(NumericLimits<u32>::max(), contents)).is_error());
}

#if !defined(AK_OS_WINDOWS)
TEST_CASE(decode_size_counts_elements_that_are_only_attachments)
{
    auto decode_files = [](u32 claimed_size, size_t attachment_count) {
        auto bytes = bytes_with_size_prefix(claimed_size, {});
        FixedMemoryStream stream { bytes.span() };
        Queue<IPC::Attachment> attachments;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < attachment_count; ++i)
            attachments.enqueue(IPC::Attachment::from_fd(MUST(Core::System::open("/dev/null"sv, O_RDONLY))));
        IPC::Decoder decoder { stream, attachments };
        return decoder.decode<Vector<IPC::File>>();
    };

    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(decode_files(2, 2)).size(), 2u);
    EXPECT(decode_files(3, 2).is_error());
}
#endif

TEST_CASE(decode_byte_buffer_larger_than_64_mib)
{
    static constexpr size_t size = 65 * MiB;
    auto contents = MUST(ByteBuffer::create_uninitialized(size));
    contents.bytes().fill('A');
    contents[size - 1] = 'B';

    auto buffer = MUST(decode_bytes<ByteBuffer>(bytes_with_size_prefix(size, contents)));
    EXPECT_EQ(buffer.size(), size);
    EXPECT_EQ(buffer[0], static_cast<u8>('A'));
    EXPECT_EQ(buffer[size - 1], static_cast<u8>('B'));
}

#if !defined(AK_OS_WINDOWS)
TEST_CASE(decode_anonymous_buffer_refuses_a_size_larger_than_its_backing)
{
    auto decode_with_claimed_size = [](u64 claimed_size) {
        auto fd = MUST(Core::System::anon_create(4096, O_CLOEXEC, Core::System::AllowSealing::Yes));

        Vector<u8> bytes;
        bytes.append(1);
        bytes.append(reinterpret_cast<u8 const*>(&claimed_size), sizeof(claimed_size));

        FixedMemoryStream stream { bytes.span() };
        Queue<IPC::Attachment> attachments;
        attachments.enqueue(IPC::Attachment::from_fd(fd));
        IPC::Decoder decoder { stream, attachments };
        return decoder.decode<Core::AnonymousBuffer>();
    };

    auto buffer = MUST(decode_with_claimed_size(4096));
    EXPECT_EQ(buffer.size(), 4096u);

    EXPECT(decode_with_claimed_size(1 * MiB).is_error());
}
#endif

#if defined(AK_OS_LINUX)
TEST_CASE(decode_anonymous_buffer_refuses_a_backing_that_cannot_be_sealed)
{
    // Without a seal, the sender could shrink the backing after the size check passed.
    auto fd = MUST(Core::System::anon_create(4096, O_CLOEXEC, Core::System::AllowSealing::No));
    u64 claimed_size = 4096;

    Vector<u8> bytes;
    bytes.append(1);
    bytes.append(reinterpret_cast<u8 const*>(&claimed_size), sizeof(claimed_size));

    FixedMemoryStream stream { bytes.span() };
    Queue<IPC::Attachment> attachments;
    attachments.enqueue(IPC::Attachment::from_fd(fd));
    IPC::Decoder decoder { stream, attachments };
    EXPECT(decoder.decode<Core::AnonymousBuffer>().is_error());
}
#endif

TEST_CASE(sizes_are_bounded_before_contents_and_only_within_the_value)
{
    IPC::MessageBuffer buffer;
    IPC::Encoder encoder { buffer };
    MUST(encoder.encode("123456789"sv));
    MUST(encoder.encode(Optional<String> {}));
    MUST(encoder.encode("123456789"sv));
    auto bytes = buffer.take_data();

    {
        FixedMemoryStream stream { bytes.span() };
        Queue<IPC::Attachment> attachments;
        IPC::Decoder decoder { stream, attachments };
        EXPECT(decoder.decode_with_max_size<String>(8).is_error());
    }

    FixedMemoryStream stream { bytes.span() };
    Queue<IPC::Attachment> attachments;
    IPC::Decoder decoder { stream, attachments };
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(decoder.decode_with_max_size<String>(9)), "123456789"sv);
    EXPECT(!MUST(decoder.decode_with_max_size<Optional<String>>(4)).has_value());
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(decoder.decode<String>()), "123456789"sv);
}

TEST_CASE(durations_round_trip_exactly)
{
    Array durations {
        AK::Duration::min(),
        AK::Duration::from_nanoseconds(-1'500'000'001),
        AK::Duration::zero(),
        AK::Duration::from_nanoseconds(1'500'000'001),
        AK::Duration::from_seconds((NumericLimits<i64>::max() / 1'000'000'000) + 1),
        AK::Duration::max(),
    };
    IPC::MessageBuffer buffer;
    IPC::Encoder encoder { buffer };
    for (auto duration : durations)
        MUST(encoder.encode(duration));
    auto bytes = buffer.take_data();

    FixedMemoryStream stream { bytes.span() };
    Queue<IPC::Attachment> attachments;
    IPC::Decoder decoder { stream, attachments };
    for (auto duration : durations)
        EXPECT_EQ(MUST(decoder.decode<AK::Duration>()), duration);
}

TEST_CASE(decode_duration_refuses_a_nanosecond_part_of_a_second_or_more)
{
    Vector<u8> bytes;
    i64 seconds = 1;
    u32 nanoseconds = 1'000'000'000;
    bytes.append(reinterpret_cast<u8 const*>(&seconds), sizeof(seconds));
    bytes.append(reinterpret_cast<u8 const*>(&nanoseconds), sizeof(nanoseconds));
    EXPECT(decode_bytes<AK::Duration>(bytes).is_error());

    nanoseconds = 999'999'999;
    bytes.clear();
    bytes.append(reinterpret_cast<u8 const*>(&seconds), sizeof(seconds));
    bytes.append(reinterpret_cast<u8 const*>(&nanoseconds), sizeof(nanoseconds));
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(decode_bytes<AK::Duration>(bytes)), AK::Duration::from_nanoseconds(1'999'999'999));
}

TEST_CASE(decode_utf16_string_with_latin1_storage)
{
    auto latin1_string = [](ReadonlyBytes code_units) {
        Vector<u8> bytes;
        bytes.append(1);
        bytes.extend(bytes_with_size_prefix(code_units.size(), code_units));
        return MUST(decode_bytes<Utf16String>(bytes));
    };

    // "café crème", with each code unit as one byte.
    static constexpr u8 long_code_units[] = { 'c', 'a', 'f', 0xE9, ' ', 'c', 'r', 0xE8, 'm', 'e' };
    auto string = latin1_string(long_code_units);
    EXPECT_EQ(string, Utf16String::from_utf8("café crème"sv));
    EXPECT(string.utf16_view().has_latin1_storage());
    EXPECT(!string.has_ascii_storage());

    static constexpr u8 short_code_units[] = { 0xE9 };
    auto short_string = latin1_string(short_code_units);
    EXPECT_EQ(short_string, Utf16String::from_utf8("é"sv));
    EXPECT(!short_string.has_short_ascii_storage());

    static constexpr u8 ascii_code_units[] = { 'c', 'a', 'f', 'e' };
    EXPECT(latin1_string(ascii_code_units).has_short_ascii_storage());
}

#include <LibCore/System.h>
#include <LibIPC/File.h>
#include <LibTest/TestCase.h>
#include <fcntl.h>

static bool is_open(int fd)
{
    return fcntl(fd, F_GETFD) != -1;
}

TEST_CASE(move_assignment_closes_the_descriptor_it_replaces)
{
    auto replaced_fd = TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::System::open("/dev/null"sv, O_RDONLY | O_CLOEXEC));
    auto moved_fd = TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::System::open("/dev/null"sv, O_RDONLY | O_CLOEXEC));

    auto file = IPC::File::adopt_fd(replaced_fd);
    file = IPC::File::adopt_fd(moved_fd);
    EXPECT(!is_open(replaced_fd));
    EXPECT(is_open(moved_fd));
    EXPECT_EQ(file.fd(), moved_fd);
}

static ByteString server_name()
{
    return ByteString::formatted("org.ladybird.TestMachBootstrap.{}", generate_random_uuid());

TEST_CASE(idle_listener_can_be_stopped_repeatedly)
{
    IPC::MachBootstrapListener listener { server_name() };
    EXPECT(listener.is_initialized());
    listener.stop();
    listener.stop();
}

TEST_CASE(bootstrap_round_trip)
{
    IPC::TransportBootstrapMachServer server;
    Optional<IPC::TransportBootstrapMachPorts> server_ports;
    IPC::MachBootstrapListener listener { server_name() };
    EXPECT(listener.is_initialized());
    listener.on_bootstrap_request = [&](auto request) {
        auto result = MUST(server.handle_bootstrap_request(request.pid, move(request.reply_port)));
        VERIFY(result.template has<IPC::TransportBootstrapMachServer::OnDemandTransport>());
        server_ports = move(result.template get<IPC::TransportBootstrapMachServer::OnDemandTransport>().ports);
    };

    auto ports = TRY_OR_FAIL(IPC::bootstrap_transport_from_mach_server(listener.server_port_name()));
    EXPECT(MACH_PORT_VALID(ports.receive_right.port()));
    EXPECT(MACH_PORT_VALID(ports.send_right.port()));
    listener.stop();
    EXPECT(server_ports.has_value());
}

TEST_CASE(bootstrap_sends_only_the_task_name_port)
{
    IPC::TransportBootstrapMachServer server;
    Optional<Core::MachPort> received_task_name_port;
    IPC::MachBootstrapListener listener { server_name() };
    EXPECT(listener.is_initialized());
    listener.on_bootstrap_request = [&](auto request) {
        received_task_name_port = move(request.task_name_port);
        (void)server.handle_bootstrap_request(request.pid, move(request.reply_port));
    };

    (void)TRY_OR_FAIL(IPC::bootstrap_transport_from_mach_server(listener.server_port_name()));
    listener.stop();
    VERIFY(received_task_name_port.has_value());
    auto port = received_task_name_port->port();
    EXPECT_NE(port, mach_task_self());

    // The name port is enough for process statistics.
    mach_task_basic_info_data_t basic_info {};
    mach_msg_type_number_t count = MACH_TASK_BASIC_INFO_COUNT;
    EXPECT_EQ(task_info(port, MACH_TASK_BASIC_INFO, reinterpret_cast<task_info_t>(&basic_info), &count), KERN_SUCCESS);

    // It must not grant control over the sender, such as access to its memory.
    mach_vm_address_t address = 0;
    EXPECT_NE(mach_vm_allocate(port, &address, PAGE_SIZE, VM_FLAGS_ANYWHERE), KERN_SUCCESS);
}

static void send_raw_message(Core::MachPort const& server_port, mach_msg_header_t& header)
{
    header.msgh_remote_port = server_port.port();
    VERIFY(mach_msg(&header, MACH_SEND_MSG | MACH_SEND_TIMEOUT, header.msgh_size, 0, MACH_PORT_NULL, 1000, MACH_PORT_NULL) == KERN_SUCCESS);
}

TEST_CASE(listener_ignores_malformed_messages)
{
    IPC::TransportBootstrapMachServer server;
    size_t request_count = 0;
    IPC::MachBootstrapListener listener { server_name() };
    EXPECT(listener.is_initialized());
    listener.on_bootstrap_request = [&](auto request) {
        ++request_count;
        (void)server.handle_bootstrap_request(request.pid, move(request.reply_port));
    };
    auto server_port = TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::MachPort::look_up_from_bootstrap_server(listener.server_port_name()));

    // A message with an unknown id.
    {
        mach_msg_header_t header {};
        header.msgh_bits = MACH_MSGH_BITS(MACH_MSG_TYPE_COPY_SEND, 0);
        header.msgh_size = sizeof(header);
        header.msgh_id = 0x1234;
        send_raw_message(server_port, header);
    }

    // The bootstrap id without the task name port.
    {
        mach_msg_header_t header {};
        header.msgh_bits = MACH_MSGH_BITS(MACH_MSG_TYPE_COPY_SEND, 0);
        header.msgh_size = sizeof(header);
        header.msgh_id = IPC::SELF_TASK_NAME_PORT_MESSAGE_ID;
        send_raw_message(server_port, header);
    }

    // A receive right where the task name port belongs.
    {
        auto receive_right = TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::MachPort::create_with_right(Core::MachPort::PortRight::Receive));
        IPC::MessageWithSelfTaskNamePort message {};
        message.header.msgh_bits = MACH_MSGH_BITS(MACH_MSG_TYPE_COPY_SEND, 0) | MACH_MSGH_BITS_COMPLEX;
        message.header.msgh_size = sizeof(message);
        message.header.msgh_id = IPC::SELF_TASK_NAME_PORT_MESSAGE_ID;
        message.body.msgh_descriptor_count = 1;
        message.port_descriptor.name = receive_right.release();
        message.port_descriptor.disposition = MACH_MSG_TYPE_MOVE_RECEIVE;
        message.port_descriptor.type = MACH_MSG_PORT_DESCRIPTOR;
        send_raw_message(server_port, message.header);
    }

    // A message that is too large for the receive buffer.
    {
        struct {
            mach_msg_header_t header;
            u8 data[4096];
        } message {};
        message.header.msgh_bits = MACH_MSGH_BITS(MACH_MSG_TYPE_COPY_SEND, 0);
        message.header.msgh_size = sizeof(message);
        message.header.msgh_id = IPC::SELF_TASK_NAME_PORT_MESSAGE_ID;
        send_raw_message(server_port, message.header);
    }

    // The listener must still serve a well-formed request after all of the above.
    auto ports = TRY_OR_FAIL(IPC::bootstrap_transport_from_mach_server(listener.server_port_name()));
    EXPECT(MACH_PORT_VALID(ports.receive_right.port()));
    listener.stop();
    EXPECT_EQ(request_count, 1u);
}

    listener.on_bootstrap_request = [](auto) { };

    EXPECT(IPC::bootstrap_transport_from_mach_server(listener.server_port_name()).is_error());
}

TEST_CASE(bootstrap_reply_to_a_closed_peer_releases_the_transport_ports)
{
    auto reply_receive_right = TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::MachPort::create_with_right(Core::MachPort::PortRight::Receive));
    mach_port_t reply_port = MACH_PORT_NULL;
    mach_msg_type_name_t right_type = 0;
    VERIFY(mach_port_extract_right(mach_task_self(), reply_receive_right.port(), MACH_MSG_TYPE_MAKE_SEND_ONCE, &reply_port, &right_type) == KERN_SUCCESS);
    auto reply_send_once_right = Core::MachPort::adopt_right(reply_port, Core::MachPort::PortRight::SendOnce);
    reply_receive_right = {};

    auto receive_right = TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::MachPort::create_with_right(Core::MachPort::PortRight::Receive));
    auto peer_receive_right = TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::MachPort::create_with_right(Core::MachPort::PortRight::Receive));
    auto send_right = TRY_OR_FAIL(peer_receive_right.insert_right(Core::MachPort::MessageRight::MakeSend));
    auto receive_port = receive_right.port();
    auto send_port = send_right.port();

    IPC::TransportBootstrapMachServer server;
    {
        MutexLocker locker(server.child_registration_lock());
        server.register_child_transport(getpid(), { move(receive_right), move(send_right) });
    }
    // NB: Mach can silently consume a send-once message whose destination died. Either outcome must release its rights.
    (void)server.handle_bootstrap_request(getpid(), move(reply_send_once_right));

    mach_port_type_t type = 0;
    EXPECT_EQ(mach_port_type(mach_task_self(), reply_port, &type), KERN_INVALID_NAME);
    EXPECT_EQ(mach_port_type(mach_task_self(), receive_port, &type), KERN_INVALID_NAME);
    EXPECT_EQ(mach_port_type(mach_task_self(), send_port, &type), KERN_SUCCESS);
    EXPECT_EQ(type, static_cast<mach_port_type_t>(MACH_PORT_TYPE_RECEIVE));
}

TEST_CASE(bootstrap_reports_a_missing_reply_port)
{
    auto receive_right = TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::MachPort::create_with_right(Core::MachPort::PortRight::Receive));
    auto peer_receive_right = TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::MachPort::create_with_right(Core::MachPort::PortRight::Receive));
    auto send_right = TRY_OR_FAIL(peer_receive_right.insert_right(Core::MachPort::MessageRight::MakeSend));
    auto receive_port = receive_right.port();
    auto send_port = send_right.port();

    IPC::TransportBootstrapMachServer server;
    {
        MutexLocker locker(server.child_registration_lock());
        server.register_child_transport(getpid(), { move(receive_right), move(send_right) });
    }
    EXPECT(server.handle_bootstrap_request(getpid(), {}).is_error());

    mach_port_type_t type = 0;
    EXPECT_EQ(mach_port_type(mach_task_self(), receive_port, &type), KERN_INVALID_NAME);
    EXPECT_EQ(mach_port_type(mach_task_self(), send_port, &type), KERN_SUCCESS);
    EXPECT_EQ(type, static_cast<mach_port_type_t>(MACH_PORT_TYPE_RECEIVE));
}

enum class RegisterChild {
    WhileItRuns,
    AfterItExited,
};

// Blocks until the server lets go of the ports of a child that exits before it asks for them.
static void expect_ports_of_exited_child_to_be_released(RegisterChild register_child)
{
    auto local_receive_right = TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::MachPort::create_with_right(Core::MachPort::PortRight::Receive));
    auto child_send_right = TRY_OR_FAIL(local_receive_right.insert_right(Core::MachPort::MessageRight::MakeSend));
    auto child_receive_right = TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::MachPort::create_with_right(Core::MachPort::PortRight::Receive));
    auto child_receive_port = child_receive_right.port();

    // NB: This is how a transport learns that its peer is gone.
    auto notification_receive_right = TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::MachPort::create_with_right(Core::MachPort::PortRight::Receive));
    mach_port_t previous = MACH_PORT_NULL;
    VERIFY(mach_port_request_notification(mach_task_self(), local_receive_right.port(), MACH_NOTIFY_NO_SENDERS, 1, notification_receive_right.port(), MACH_MSG_TYPE_MAKE_SEND_ONCE, &previous) == KERN_SUCCESS);

    IPC::TransportBootstrapMachServer server;
    pid_t pid = -1;
    {
        MutexLocker locker(server.child_registration_lock());
        // NB: The child runs until its input ends, which is when we close our end of the pipe.
        int input[2] = {};
        VERIFY(pipe(input) == 0);
        posix_spawn_file_actions_t file_actions;
        VERIFY(posix_spawn_file_actions_init(&file_actions) == 0);
        VERIFY(posix_spawn_file_actions_adddup2(&file_actions, input[0], STDIN_FILENO) == 0);
        VERIFY(posix_spawn_file_actions_addclose(&file_actions, input[1]) == 0);
        char const* arguments[] = { "/bin/cat", nullptr };
        VERIFY(posix_spawn(&pid, arguments[0], &file_actions, nullptr, const_cast<char**>(arguments), nullptr) == 0);
        VERIFY(posix_spawn_file_actions_destroy(&file_actions) == 0);
        VERIFY(close(input[0]) == 0);
        if (register_child == RegisterChild::AfterItExited) {
            VERIFY(close(input[1]) == 0);
            siginfo_t info {};
            while (waitid(P_PID, pid, &info, WEXITED | WNOWAIT) < 0)
                VERIFY(errno == EINTR);
        }
        server.register_child_transport(pid, { move(child_receive_right), move(child_send_right) });
        if (register_child == RegisterChild::WhileItRuns)
            VERIFY(close(input[1]) == 0);
    }

    struct {
        mach_msg_header_t header;
        u8 body[64];
    } notification {};
    // NB: The limit only keeps a server that holds on to the ports from stopping the test run.
    static constexpr mach_msg_timeout_t limit_in_milliseconds = 60'000;
    EXPECT_EQ(mach_msg(&notification.header, MACH_RCV_MSG | MACH_RCV_TIMEOUT, 0, sizeof(notification), notification_receive_right.port(), limit_in_milliseconds, MACH_PORT_NULL), KERN_SUCCESS);
    EXPECT_EQ(notification.header.msgh_id, MACH_NOTIFY_NO_SENDERS);

    // The server lets go of the send right first, so the receive right may still be there for a moment.
    mach_port_type_t type = 0;
    auto deadline = MonotonicTime::now() + AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(limit_in_milliseconds);
    while (mach_port_type(mach_task_self(), child_receive_port, &type) != KERN_INVALID_NAME && MonotonicTime::now() < deadline)
        usleep(1'000);
    EXPECT_EQ(mach_port_type(mach_task_self(), child_receive_port, &type), KERN_INVALID_NAME);

    int status = 0;
    while (waitpid(pid, &status, 0) < 0)
        VERIFY(errno == EINTR);
}

TEST_CASE(ports_of_a_child_that_exits_before_taking_them_are_released)
{
    expect_ports_of_exited_child_to_be_released(RegisterChild::WhileItRuns);
}

TEST_CASE(ports_of_a_child_that_exited_before_registration_are_released)
{
    expect_ports_of_exited_child_to_be_released(RegisterChild::AfterItExited);
}

// NB: The generated header comes first, so that it declares its codecs before anything else in LibIPC is seen.
#include <RustEchoServerEndpoint.h>

#include <AK/Function.h>
#include <AK/MemoryStream.h>
#include <LibCore/File.h>
#include <LibCore/System.h>
#include <LibIPC/Decoder.h>
#include <LibIPC/Encoder.h>
#include <LibIPC/Transport.h>
#include <LibTest/TestCase.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <limits.h>
#include <math.h>
#if !defined(AK_OS_WINDOWS)
#    include <sys/resource.h>
#endif

// NB: Starts the Rust endpoint, which the IPC compiler generated Rust code for from the same definition as the C++ code
//     this test uses, and returns this end of a transport to it.
#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS) || defined(AK_OS_IOS)
extern "C" void rust_echo_server_serve(mach_port_t receive_right, mach_port_t send_right);

static NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport> start_server()
{
    auto our_receive_right = MUST(Core::MachPort::create_with_right(Core::MachPort::PortRight::Receive));
    auto server_send_right = MUST(our_receive_right.insert_right(Core::MachPort::MessageRight::MakeSend));
    auto server_receive_right = MUST(Core::MachPort::create_with_right(Core::MachPort::PortRight::Receive));
    auto our_send_right = MUST(server_receive_right.insert_right(Core::MachPort::MessageRight::MakeSend));
    IPC::TransportMachPort::raise_receive_queue_limit(server_receive_right);
    rust_echo_server_serve(server_receive_right.release(), server_send_right.release());
    return make<IPC::TransportMachPort>(move(our_receive_right), move(our_send_right));
}
#elif defined(AK_OS_WINDOWS)
extern "C" void rust_echo_server_serve(int descriptor);

static NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport> start_server()
{
    auto handles = MUST(Core::System::duplex_pipe());
    rust_echo_server_serve(handles[1]);
    return MUST(IPC::Transport::adopt_fd(handles[0]));
}
#else
extern "C" void rust_echo_server_serve(int socket_fd);

static NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport> start_server()
{
    int fds[2] {};
    MUST(Core::System::socketpair(AF_LOCAL, SOCK_STREAM | SOCK_CLOEXEC, 0, fds));
    rust_echo_server_serve(fds[1]);
    auto socket = MUST(Core::LocalSocket::adopt_fd(fds[0]));
    MUST(socket->set_blocking(false));
    return make<IPC::TransportSocket>(move(socket));
}
#endif

static void send(IPC::Transport& transport, ErrorOr<IPC::MessageBuffer> encoded)
{
    auto buffer = MUST(move(encoded));
    auto attachments = buffer.take_attachments();
    MUST(transport.post_message(buffer.take_data(), attachments));
}

template<typename Response>
static NonnullOwnPtr<Response> receive(IPC::Transport& transport)
{
    OwnPtr<IPC::Message> message;
    while (!message) {
        transport.wait_until_readable();
        auto should_shutdown = transport.read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([&](IPC::Transport::Message&& received) {
            VERIFY(!message);
            message = MUST(RustEchoServerEndpoint::decode_message(received.bytes.bytes(), received.attachments));
        });
        VERIFY(message || should_shutdown == IPC::Transport::ShouldShutdown::No);
    }
    VERIFY(message->message_id() == Response::static_message_id());
    return adopt_own(static_cast<Response&>(*message.leak_ptr()));
}

TEST_CASE(values_make_a_round_trip_through_rust)
{
    auto transport = start_server();
    auto utf16_text = Utf16String::from_utf8("naïve ✓"sv);
    Vector<Optional<i64>> values { 1, {}, -3 };
    auto bytes = MUST(ByteBuffer::copy("bytes"sv.bytes()));
    send(*transport, Messages::RustEchoServer::Echo::static_encode(42, "héllo"sv, utf16_text.utf16_view(), values.span(), bytes.bytes()));

    auto response = receive<Messages::RustEchoServer::EchoResponse>(*transport);
    EXPECT_EQ(response->number(), 42u);
    EXPECT_EQ(response->text(), "héllo"sv);
    EXPECT_EQ(response->utf16_text(), utf16_text);
    EXPECT_EQ(response->values(), values);
    EXPECT_EQ(response->bytes(), bytes);
}

TEST_CASE(latin1_strings_make_a_round_trip_through_rust)
{
    auto transport = start_server();
    // "crème brûlée", with each code unit as one byte.
    static constexpr u8 code_units[] = { 'c', 'r', 0xE8, 'm', 'e', ' ', 'b', 'r', 0xFB, 'l', 0xE9, 'e' };
    auto latin1_text = Utf16String::from_utf16(Utf16View::from_latin1(code_units, false));
    send(*transport, Messages::RustEchoServer::Echo::static_encode(1, ""sv, latin1_text.utf16_view(), {}, {}));

    auto response = receive<Messages::RustEchoServer::EchoResponse>(*transport);
    EXPECT_EQ(response->utf16_text(), latin1_text);
    EXPECT(response->utf16_text().utf16_view().has_latin1_storage());
}

        bytes[i] = static_cast<u8>(i * 7);

TEST_CASE(files_go_to_rust_as_attachments)
{
    auto transport = start_server();
    auto pipe = MUST(Core::System::pipe2(O_CLOEXEC));
    send(*transport, Messages::RustEchoServer::WriteToFile::static_encode(IPC::File::adopt_fd(pipe[1]), "from rust"sv));
    (void)receive<Messages::RustEchoServer::WriteToFileResponse>(*transport);

    auto reader = MUST(Core::File::adopt_fd(pipe[0], Core::File::OpenMode::Read));

// NB: Linux fails sending descriptors once all those the user has in flight exceed the sender's limit, which other
//     processes running at the same time count towards, so raise it as LibMain does for every process.
static void raise_descriptor_limit()
{
#if !defined(AK_OS_WINDOWS)
    rlimit limit {};
    VERIFY(getrlimit(RLIMIT_NOFILE, &limit) == 0);
    limit.rlim_cur = min<rlim_t>(limit.rlim_max, 65536);
#    if defined(AK_OS_MACOS) || defined(AK_OS_IOS)
    // NB: macOS rejects a descriptor limit above OPEN_MAX, but still needs one above its default of 256.
    limit.rlim_cur = min<rlim_t>(limit.rlim_cur, OPEN_MAX);
#    endif
    VERIFY(setrlimit(RLIMIT_NOFILE, &limit) == 0);
#endif
}

TEST_CASE(many_files_make_a_round_trip_through_rust)
{
    // NB: More files than one sendmsg() carries, so that on sockets some go ahead of the message.
    static constexpr size_t file_count = 200;
    raise_descriptor_limit();
    auto transport = start_server();
    Vector<NonnullOwnPtr<Core::File>> readers;
    Vector<IPC::File> files;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < file_count; ++i) {
        auto pipe = MUST(Core::System::pipe2(O_CLOEXEC));
        readers.append(MUST(Core::File::adopt_fd(pipe[0], Core::File::OpenMode::Read)));
        files.append(IPC::File::adopt_fd(pipe[1]));
    }
    send(*transport, Messages::RustEchoServer::EchoFiles::static_encode(files));

    auto returned_files = receive<Messages::RustEchoServer::EchoFilesResponse>(*transport)->take_files();
    EXPECT_EQ(returned_files.size(), file_count);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < min(returned_files.size(), file_count); ++i) {
        auto writer = MUST(Core::File::adopt_fd(returned_files[i].take_fd(), Core::File::OpenMode::Write));
        MUST(writer->write_until_depleted("!"sv.bytes()));
        writer->close();
        u8 buffer = 0;
        EXPECT_EQ(MUST(readers[i]->read_some({ &buffer, 1 })).size(), 1uz);
        EXPECT_EQ(buffer, '!');
    }
}

TEST_CASE(the_rust_end_closing_ends_the_connection)
{
    auto transport = start_server();
    send(*transport, Messages::RustEchoServer::Stop::static_encode());
    auto should_shutdown = IPC::Transport::ShouldShutdown::No;
    while (should_shutdown == IPC::Transport::ShouldShutdown::No) {
        transport->wait_until_readable();
        should_shutdown = transport->read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([](auto&&) { VERIFY_NOT_REACHED(); });
    }
}

TEST_CASE(utf8_attributes_match_cpp_validation)
{
    for (auto text : { ""sv, "héllo"sv, "\xed\xa0\x80\xed\xbf\xbf"sv }) {
        auto transport = start_server();
        send(*transport, Messages::RustEchoServer::EchoUtf8::static_encode(text, text.bytes()));
        auto response = receive<Messages::RustEchoServer::EchoUtf8Response>(*transport);
        EXPECT_EQ(response->text(), text);
        EXPECT_EQ(response->bytes().bytes(), text.bytes());
    }
    for (auto text : { "\xff"sv, "\xc0\x80"sv, "\xe2\x82"sv, "\xed\xa0\x80\xff"sv, "\xf4\x90\x80\x80"sv }) {
        for (auto invalid_text : { true, false }) {
            auto string = invalid_text ? text : ""sv;
            auto bytes = invalid_text ? ""sv.bytes() : text.bytes();
            auto buffer = MUST(Messages::RustEchoServer::EchoUtf8::static_encode(string, bytes));
            Queue<IPC::Attachment> attachments;
            EXPECT(RustEchoServerEndpoint::decode_message(buffer.data(), attachments).is_error());
            auto response = MUST(Messages::RustEchoServer::EchoUtf8Response::static_encode(string, bytes));
            EXPECT(RustEchoServerEndpoint::decode_message(response.data(), attachments).is_error());
        }
    }
}

TEST_CASE(cpp_decoder_accepts_unused_attachments)
{
    auto buffer = MUST(Messages::RustEchoServer::Stop::static_encode());
    auto pipe = MUST(Core::System::pipe2(O_CLOEXEC));
    Queue<IPC::Attachment> attachments;
    attachments.enqueue(IPC::Attachment::from_fd(pipe[1]));
    EXPECT(!RustEchoServerEndpoint::decode_message(buffer.data(), attachments).is_error());
    EXPECT_EQ(attachments.size(), 1u);
    MUST(Core::System::close(pipe[0]));
}

TEST_CASE(cpp_and_rust_decoders_accept_trailing_bytes)
{
    auto buffer = MUST(Messages::RustEchoServer::EchoUtf8::static_encode("hello"sv, {}));
    auto bytes = buffer.take_data();
    MUST(bytes.try_append(0));
    Queue<IPC::Attachment> attachments;
    EXPECT(!RustEchoServerEndpoint::decode_message(bytes, attachments).is_error());
    auto transport = start_server();
    Vector<IPC::Attachment> outgoing_attachments;
    MUST(transport->post_message(move(bytes), outgoing_attachments));
    auto response = receive<Messages::RustEchoServer::EchoUtf8Response>(*transport);
    EXPECT_EQ(response->text(), "hello"sv);
}

static RustEcho::Record make_record()
{
    return RustEcho::Record {
        .id = 7,
        .label = "label"_string,
        .name = "name"sv,
        .bytes = MUST(ByteBuffer::copy("bytes"sv.bytes())),
        .values = { 1, 2, 3 },
        .scale = 1.5,
        .shape = RustEcho::Shape::Square,
    };
}

static IPC::MessageDataType encode_value(RustEcho::Value const& value)
{
    IPC::MessageBuffer buffer;
    IPC::Encoder encoder { buffer };
    MUST(encoder.encode(value));
    return buffer.take_data();
}

static void expect_refused_by_cpp_and_rust(ReadonlyBytes message)
{
    Queue<IPC::Attachment> attachments;
    EXPECT(RustEchoServerEndpoint::decode_message(message, attachments).is_error());

    auto transport = start_server();
    Vector<IPC::Attachment> outgoing_attachments;
    IPC::MessageDataType bytes;
    bytes.append(message.data(), message.size());
    MUST(transport->post_message(move(bytes), outgoing_attachments));
    // NB: A valid message follows, so the Rust end either closes the connection or answers it, and never leaves this
    //     waiting. Having refused the first message, it may have closed the connection before this one is sent, and
    //     then the send itself fails.
    auto valid_message = MUST(Messages::RustEchoServer::EchoValue::static_encode(RustEcho::Value { 1u }));
    auto valid_message_attachments = valid_message.take_attachments();
    if (transport->post_message(valid_message.take_data(), valid_message_attachments).is_error())
        return;
    auto answered = false;
    auto should_shutdown = IPC::Transport::ShouldShutdown::No;
    while (!answered && should_shutdown == IPC::Transport::ShouldShutdown::No) {
        transport->wait_until_readable();
        should_shutdown = transport->read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([&](auto&&) { answered = true; });
    }
    if (answered)
        FAIL("The Rust endpoint answered a message after one it should have refused");
}

// NB: Encodes a message with a record field by field, past the generated encoder, which refuses invalid records.
static IPC::MessageDataType encode_record_message_unchecked(RustEcho::Record const& record)
{
    IPC::MessageBuffer buffer;
    IPC::Encoder encoder { buffer };
    MUST(encoder.encode(Messages::RustEchoServer::EchoValue::ENDPOINT_MAGIC));
    MUST(encoder.encode(Messages::RustEchoServer::EchoValue::static_message_id()));
    MUST(encoder.encode<u8>(0));
    MUST(encoder.encode(record.id));
    MUST(encoder.encode(record.label));
    MUST(encoder.encode(record.name));
    MUST(encoder.encode(record.bytes));
    MUST(encoder.encode(record.values));
    MUST(encoder.encode(record.scale));
    MUST(encoder.encode(record.shape));
    return buffer.take_data();
}

TEST_CASE(declared_types_make_a_round_trip_through_rust)
{
    auto transport = start_server();
    for (RustEcho::Value value : { RustEcho::Value { make_record() }, RustEcho::Value { 42u }, RustEcho::Value { RustEcho::Shape::Circle } }) {
        send(*transport, Messages::RustEchoServer::EchoValue::static_encode(value));
        auto response = receive<Messages::RustEchoServer::EchoValueResponse>(*transport);
        EXPECT_EQ(encode_value(response->value()), encode_value(value));
    }
}

TEST_CASE(declared_types_are_checked_by_cpp_and_rust)
{
    EXPECT_EQ(encode_record_message_unchecked(make_record()), MUST(Messages::RustEchoServer::EchoValue::static_encode(RustEcho::Value { make_record() })).take_data());

    Vector<Function<void(RustEcho::Record&)>> invalidations;
    invalidations.append([](auto& record) { record.id = 0; });
    invalidations.append([](auto& record) { record.label = "123456789"_string; });
    invalidations.append([](auto& record) { record.name = "123456789"sv; });
    invalidations.append([](auto& record) { record.bytes = MUST(ByteBuffer::copy("123456789"sv.bytes())); });
    invalidations.append([](auto& record) { record.values.append(4); });
    invalidations.append([](auto& record) { record.scale = NAN; });
    invalidations.append([](auto& record) { record.scale = INFINITY; });
    for (auto& invalidate : invalidations) {
        auto record = make_record();
        invalidate(record);
        EXPECT(Messages::RustEchoServer::EchoValue::static_encode(RustEcho::Value { record }).is_error());
        expect_refused_by_cpp_and_rust(encode_record_message_unchecked(record));
    }

    // NB: The variant's index follows the endpoint magic and message ID, and a shape follows its index.
    auto message = MUST(Messages::RustEchoServer::EchoValue::static_encode(RustEcho::Value { RustEcho::Shape::Square })).take_data();
    message[9] = 2;
    expect_refused_by_cpp_and_rust(message);
    message[8] = 3;
    message[9] = 0;
    expect_refused_by_cpp_and_rust(message);
}

TEST_CASE(declared_enums_are_checked_wherever_they_are_encoded)
{
    // NB: This file encodes and decodes the enum itself, which must use its generated codec and not LibIPC's codec
    //     for any enum, which takes every value.
    IPC::MessageBuffer buffer;
    IPC::Encoder encoder { buffer };
    EXPECT(encoder.encode(static_cast<RustEcho::Shape>(2)).is_error());

    Array<u8, 1> invalid_shape { 2 };
    FixedMemoryStream stream { invalid_shape.span() };
    Queue<IPC::Attachment> attachments;
    IPC::Decoder decoder { stream, attachments };
    EXPECT(decoder.decode<RustEcho::Shape>().is_error());
}

#include <AK/MemoryStream.h>
#include <AK/Time.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibCore/System.h>
#include <LibIPC/Attachment.h>
#include <LibIPC/Decoder.h>
#include <LibIPC/Encoder.h>
#include <LibIPC/Forward.h>
#include <LibIPC/Limits.h>
#include <LibIPC/Message.h>
#include <LibIPC/TransportHandle.h>
#include <LibIPC/TransportMachPort.h>
#include <LibTest/TestCase.h>
