#include <unistd.h>

static void post_transport_handle(IPC::TransportMachPort& carrier, IPC::TransportHandle const& handle)
{
    IPC::MessageBuffer buffer;
    IPC::Encoder encoder(buffer);
    MUST(encoder.encode(handle));
    auto attachments = buffer.take_attachments();
    MUST(carrier.post_message(buffer.take_data(), attachments));
    carrier.flush();
}

static OwnPtr<IPC::TransportMachPort> receive_transport(IPC::TransportMachPort& carrier)
{
    OwnPtr<IPC::TransportMachPort> transport;
    carrier.wait_until_readable();
    (void)carrier.read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([&](IPC::TransportMachPort::Message&& message) {
        FixedMemoryStream stream { message.bytes.bytes() };
        IPC::Decoder decoder { stream, message.attachments };
        transport = MUST(MUST(decoder.decode<IPC::TransportHandle>()).create_transport());
    });
    return transport;
}

static size_t read_until_eof(IPC::TransportMachPort& transport, u8 expected_byte)
{
    size_t received = 0;
    auto should_shutdown = IPC::TransportMachPort::ShouldShutdown::No;
    while (should_shutdown == IPC::TransportMachPort::ShouldShutdown::No) {
        transport.wait_until_readable();
        should_shutdown = transport.read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([&](IPC::TransportMachPort::Message&& message) {
            auto bytes = message.bytes.bytes();
            EXPECT_EQ(bytes.size(), 1uz);
            if (bytes.size() == 1)
                EXPECT_EQ(bytes[0], expected_byte);
            ++received;
        });
    }
    return received;
}

TEST_CASE(receive_barrier_publishes_preceding_messages)
{
    auto paired = TRY_OR_FAIL(IPC::TransportMachPort::create_paired());
    auto peer = TRY_OR_FAIL(paired.remote_handle.create_transport());

    for (size_t i = 0; i < 32; ++i) {
        IPC::MessageDataType payload;
        payload.append(static_cast<u8>(i));
        Vector<IPC::Attachment> attachments;
        TRY_OR_FAIL(paired.local->post_message(move(payload), attachments));
        paired.local->flush();
        peer->wait_until_incoming_is_current();

        size_t received = 0;
        (void)peer->read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([&](IPC::TransportMachPort::Message&& message) {
            EXPECT_EQ(message.bytes.bytes()[0], static_cast<u8>(i));
            ++received;
        });
        EXPECT_EQ(received, 1uz);
    }

    // A barrier with no preceding messages must also complete.
    peer->wait_until_incoming_is_current();
    OwnPtr<IPC::TransportMachPort> sender = move(paired.local);
    sender.clear();
    peer->wait_until_readable();
    EXPECT_EQ(peer->read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([](auto&&) { }),
        IPC::TransportMachPort::ShouldShutdown::Yes);
}

TEST_CASE(burst_to_not_yet_started_peer_is_delivered)
{
    constexpr size_t message_count = 32;

    auto paired = TRY_OR_FAIL(IPC::TransportMachPort::create_paired());

    for (size_t i = 0; i < message_count; ++i) {
        IPC::MessageDataType payload;
        payload.append(static_cast<u8>(i));
        Vector<IPC::Attachment> attachments;
        TRY_OR_FAIL(paired.local->post_message(move(payload), attachments));
    }

    paired.local->close_after_sending_all_pending_messages();

    // Construct the peer only after sending the startup burst.
    auto peer_transport = TRY_OR_FAIL(paired.remote_handle.create_transport());

    size_t received = 0;
    while (received < message_count) {
        peer_transport->wait_until_readable();
        (void)peer_transport->read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([&](IPC::TransportMachPort::Message&& message) {
            auto bytes = message.bytes.bytes();
            EXPECT_EQ(bytes.size(), 1uz);
            if (bytes.size() == 1)
                EXPECT_EQ(bytes[0], static_cast<u8>(received));
            ++received;
        });
    }

    EXPECT_EQ(received, message_count);
}

TEST_CASE(endpoint_whose_peer_closed_in_flight_reads_what_was_sent_then_eof)
{
    auto carrier = TRY_OR_FAIL(IPC::TransportMachPort::create_paired());
    auto channel = TRY_OR_FAIL(IPC::TransportMachPort::create_paired());

    IPC::MessageDataType payload;
    payload.append(42);
    Vector<IPC::Attachment> attachments;
    TRY_OR_FAIL(channel.local->post_message(move(payload), attachments));

    post_transport_handle(*carrier.local, channel.remote_handle);

    // Close the channel's local end while its other end is still queued on the carrier, so the send right in that
    // message names a dead port by the time the carrier's peer receives it.
    channel.local->close_after_sending_all_pending_messages();
    OwnPtr<IPC::TransportMachPort> closed_end = move(channel.local);
    closed_end.clear();

    auto carrier_peer = TRY_OR_FAIL(carrier.remote_handle.create_transport());
    auto endpoint = receive_transport(*carrier_peer);
    EXPECT(endpoint);
    if (!endpoint)
        return;

    EXPECT_EQ(read_until_eof(*endpoint, 42), 1uz);
}

TEST_CASE(endpoint_whose_peer_closed_can_be_transferred_again)
{
    auto first_carrier = TRY_OR_FAIL(IPC::TransportMachPort::create_paired());
    auto second_carrier = TRY_OR_FAIL(IPC::TransportMachPort::create_paired());
    auto channel = TRY_OR_FAIL(IPC::TransportMachPort::create_paired());

    post_transport_handle(*first_carrier.local, channel.remote_handle);

    OwnPtr<IPC::TransportMachPort> closed_end = move(channel.local);
    closed_end.clear();

    auto first_carrier_peer = TRY_OR_FAIL(first_carrier.remote_handle.create_transport());
    auto endpoint = receive_transport(*first_carrier_peer);
    EXPECT(endpoint);
    if (!endpoint)
        return;

    post_transport_handle(*second_carrier.local, TRY_OR_FAIL(endpoint->release_for_transfer()));
    endpoint.clear();

    auto second_carrier_peer = TRY_OR_FAIL(second_carrier.remote_handle.create_transport());
    auto transferred_endpoint = receive_transport(*second_carrier_peer);
    EXPECT(transferred_endpoint);
    if (!transferred_endpoint)
        return;

    EXPECT_EQ(read_until_eof(*transferred_endpoint, 0), 0uz);
}

TEST_CASE(explicit_close_notifies_peer_while_sender_is_alive)
{
    auto paired = TRY_OR_FAIL(IPC::TransportMachPort::create_paired());
    auto peer = TRY_OR_FAIL(paired.remote_handle.create_transport());
    paired.local->close();
    EXPECT_EQ(read_until_eof(*peer, 0), 0uz);
}

TEST_CASE(close_after_sending_delivers_queued_messages_then_eof)
{
    auto paired = TRY_OR_FAIL(IPC::TransportMachPort::create_paired());
    for (size_t i = 0; i < 32; ++i) {
        IPC::MessageDataType payload;
        payload.append(42);
        Vector<IPC::Attachment> attachments;
        TRY_OR_FAIL(paired.local->post_message(move(payload), attachments));
    }
    paired.local->close_after_sending_all_pending_messages();
    auto peer = TRY_OR_FAIL(paired.remote_handle.create_transport());
    EXPECT_EQ(read_until_eof(*peer, 42), 32uz);
}

TEST_CASE(eof_during_read_callback_preserves_pending_messages)
{
    auto paired = TRY_OR_FAIL(IPC::TransportMachPort::create_paired());
    auto peer = TRY_OR_FAIL(paired.remote_handle.create_transport());

    IPC::MessageDataType payload;
    payload.append(42);
    Vector<IPC::Attachment> attachments;
    TRY_OR_FAIL(paired.local->post_message(move(payload), attachments));
    paired.local->flush();
    peer->wait_until_incoming_is_current();

    size_t received = 0;
    auto should_shutdown = peer->read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([&](auto&&) {
        ++received;
        IPC::MessageDataType next_payload;
        next_payload.append(43);
        MUST(paired.local->post_message(move(next_payload), attachments));
        paired.local->close_after_sending_all_pending_messages();

        // Publish the second message and EOF while the first message's callback is running.
        // The receive barrier follows both on the same port, so no timing assumptions are needed.
        peer->wait_until_incoming_is_current();
    });
    EXPECT_EQ(received, 1uz);
    EXPECT_EQ(should_shutdown, IPC::TransportMachPort::ShouldShutdown::No);
    EXPECT_EQ(read_until_eof(*peer, 43), 1uz);
}

static Vector<IPC::Attachment> make_attachments(size_t count)
{
    Vector<IPC::Attachment> attachments;
    attachments.ensure_capacity(count);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i)
        attachments.unchecked_append(IPC::Attachment::from_fd(MUST(Core::System::open("/dev/null"sv, O_RDONLY))));
    return attachments;
}

TEST_CASE(message_with_the_maximum_number_of_attachments_arrives_whole)
{
    auto paired = TRY_OR_FAIL(IPC::TransportMachPort::create_paired());
    auto peer = TRY_OR_FAIL(paired.remote_handle.create_transport());

    IPC::MessageDataType payload;
    payload.append(42);
    auto attachments = make_attachments(IPC::MAX_MESSAGE_FD_COUNT);
    TRY_OR_FAIL(paired.local->post_message(move(payload), attachments));
    paired.local->flush();
    peer->wait_until_incoming_is_current();

    size_t received = 0;
    auto should_shutdown = peer->read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([&](IPC::TransportMachPort::Message&& message) {
        ++received;
        EXPECT_EQ(message.bytes.bytes().size(), 1uz);
        EXPECT_EQ(message.attachments.size(), IPC::MAX_MESSAGE_FD_COUNT);
        auto fd = message.attachments.dequeue().to_fd();
        EXPECT(fd >= 0);
        if (fd >= 0)
            MUST(Core::System::close(fd));
    });
    EXPECT_EQ(received, 1uz);
    EXPECT_EQ(should_shutdown, IPC::TransportMachPort::ShouldShutdown::No);
}

TEST_CASE(message_with_too_many_attachments_disconnects_the_peer)
{
    auto paired = TRY_OR_FAIL(IPC::TransportMachPort::create_paired());
    auto peer = TRY_OR_FAIL(paired.remote_handle.create_transport());

    IPC::MessageDataType payload;
    payload.append(42);
    auto attachments = make_attachments(IPC::MAX_MESSAGE_FD_COUNT + 1);
    TRY_OR_FAIL(paired.local->post_message(move(payload), attachments));
    paired.local->flush();

    size_t received = 0;
    auto should_shutdown = IPC::TransportMachPort::ShouldShutdown::No;
    while (should_shutdown == IPC::TransportMachPort::ShouldShutdown::No) {
        peer->wait_until_readable();
        should_shutdown = peer->read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([&](auto&&) { ++received; });
    }
    EXPECT_EQ(received, 0uz);
    EXPECT(!peer->is_open());
}

// Two peers that each post more messages than the kernel queue holds, before either reads: a transport whose IO thread
// blocks in a send can't drain its own queue, so two of them facing each other would wait on each other for good.
TEST_CASE(a_flood_in_both_directions_does_not_deadlock)
{
    auto paired = TRY_OR_FAIL(IPC::TransportMachPort::create_paired());
    auto peer = TRY_OR_FAIL(paired.remote_handle.create_transport());

    // Well past MACH_PORT_QLIMIT_LARGE (1024) in each direction.
    constexpr size_t message_count = 4096;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < message_count; ++i) {
        IPC::MessageDataType to_peer;
        to_peer.append(1);
        Vector<IPC::Attachment> no_attachments;
        TRY_OR_FAIL(paired.local->post_message(move(to_peer), no_attachments));

        IPC::MessageDataType to_local;
        to_local.append(2);
        TRY_OR_FAIL(peer->post_message(move(to_local), no_attachments));
    }

    size_t received_by_peer = 0;
    size_t received_by_local = 0;
    while (received_by_peer < message_count || received_by_local < message_count) {
        if (received_by_peer < message_count) {
            peer->wait_until_readable();
            (void)peer->read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([&](IPC::TransportMachPort::Message&& message) {
                EXPECT_EQ(message.bytes.bytes()[0], 1u);
                ++received_by_peer;
            });
        }
        if (received_by_local < message_count) {
            paired.local->wait_until_readable();
            (void)paired.local->read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([&](IPC::TransportMachPort::Message&& message) {
                EXPECT_EQ(message.bytes.bytes()[0], 2u);
                ++received_by_local;
            });
        }
    }
    EXPECT_EQ(received_by_peer, message_count);
    EXPECT_EQ(received_by_local, message_count);
}

// The same flood with payloads too large to send inline, which travel out of line.
// A send that times out on a full peer queue comes back pseudo-received, with a send right of its own on the
// destination. Every one of them has to be released again, or the peer never hears that its last sender has gone.
TEST_CASE(closing_after_timed_out_sends_still_reaches_the_peer_as_eof)
{
    auto paired = TRY_OR_FAIL(IPC::TransportMachPort::create_paired());
    auto peer = TRY_OR_FAIL(paired.remote_handle.create_transport());

    // Well past MACH_PORT_QLIMIT_LARGE (1024) while the peer reads nothing, so most of these time out at least once;
    // some inline, some out of line.
    constexpr size_t message_count = 4096;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < message_count; ++i) {
        IPC::MessageDataType to_peer;
        to_peer.resize(i % 2 == 0 ? 1 : 8192);
        to_peer[0] = 7;
        Vector<IPC::Attachment> no_attachments;
        TRY_OR_FAIL(paired.local->post_message(move(to_peer), no_attachments));
    }
    paired.local->flush();

    size_t received = 0;
    while (received < message_count) {
        peer->wait_until_readable();
        (void)peer->read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([&](IPC::TransportMachPort::Message&& message) {
            EXPECT_EQ(message.bytes.bytes()[0], 7u);
            ++received;
        });
    }
    EXPECT_EQ(received, message_count);

    OwnPtr<IPC::TransportMachPort> closed_end = move(paired.local);
    closed_end.clear();

    // Polled, rather than waited for, so a leaked right fails the test instead of hanging it.
    auto deadline = MonotonicTime::now() + AK::Duration::from_seconds(5);
    auto should_shutdown = IPC::TransportMachPort::ShouldShutdown::No;
    while (should_shutdown == IPC::TransportMachPort::ShouldShutdown::No && MonotonicTime::now() < deadline) {
        should_shutdown = peer->read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([&](IPC::TransportMachPort::Message&&) {
            FAIL("nothing else was sent");
        });
        if (should_shutdown == IPC::TransportMachPort::ShouldShutdown::No)
            usleep(10'000);
    }
    EXPECT_EQ(should_shutdown, IPC::TransportMachPort::ShouldShutdown::Yes);
}

TEST_CASE(a_flood_of_out_of_line_messages_in_both_directions_does_not_deadlock)
{
    auto paired = TRY_OR_FAIL(IPC::TransportMachPort::create_paired());
    auto peer = TRY_OR_FAIL(paired.remote_handle.create_transport());

    constexpr size_t message_count = 2048;
    constexpr size_t payload_size = 8192;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < message_count; ++i) {
        IPC::MessageDataType to_peer;
        to_peer.resize(payload_size);
        to_peer[0] = 1;
        Vector<IPC::Attachment> no_attachments;
        TRY_OR_FAIL(paired.local->post_message(move(to_peer), no_attachments));

        IPC::MessageDataType to_local;
        to_local.resize(payload_size);
        to_local[0] = 2;
        TRY_OR_FAIL(peer->post_message(move(to_local), no_attachments));
    }

    size_t received_by_peer = 0;
    size_t received_by_local = 0;
    while (received_by_peer < message_count || received_by_local < message_count) {
        if (received_by_peer < message_count) {
            peer->wait_until_readable();
            (void)peer->read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([&](IPC::TransportMachPort::Message&& message) {
                EXPECT_EQ(message.bytes.bytes().size(), payload_size);
                EXPECT_EQ(message.bytes.bytes()[0], 1u);
                ++received_by_peer;
            });
        }
        if (received_by_local < message_count) {
            paired.local->wait_until_readable();
            (void)paired.local->read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([&](IPC::TransportMachPort::Message&& message) {
                EXPECT_EQ(message.bytes.bytes().size(), payload_size);
                EXPECT_EQ(message.bytes.bytes()[0], 2u);
                ++received_by_local;
            });
        }
    }
    EXPECT_EQ(received_by_peer, message_count);
    EXPECT_EQ(received_by_local, message_count);
}

// Decodes a transport handle from the bytes an encoded one has, with the given attachments in place of its own.
static ErrorOr<IPC::TransportHandle> decode_transport_handle_with(Vector<IPC::Attachment> (*make_attachments)(Vector<IPC::Attachment>))
{
    auto pair = MUST(IPC::TransportHandle::create_pair());
    IPC::MessageBuffer buffer;
    IPC::Encoder encoder(buffer);
    MUST(encoder.encode(pair.first));
    auto bytes = buffer.take_data();

    Queue<IPC::Attachment> attachments;
    for (auto& attachment : make_attachments(buffer.take_attachments()))
        attachments.enqueue(move(attachment));
    FixedMemoryStream stream { bytes.span() };
    IPC::Decoder decoder { stream, attachments };
    return decoder.decode<IPC::TransportHandle>();
}

TEST_CASE(transport_handle_decodes_from_its_own_attachments)
{
    auto handle = decode_transport_handle_with([](Vector<IPC::Attachment> attachments) { return attachments; });
    EXPECT(!handle.is_error());
}

TEST_CASE(transport_handle_with_missing_attachments_is_a_decode_error)
{
    EXPECT(decode_transport_handle_with([](Vector<IPC::Attachment>) { return Vector<IPC::Attachment> {}; }).is_error());
    EXPECT(decode_transport_handle_with([](Vector<IPC::Attachment> attachments) {
        attachments.take_last();
        return attachments;
    }).is_error());
}

TEST_CASE(transport_handle_with_the_wrong_rights_is_a_decode_error)
{
    EXPECT(decode_transport_handle_with([](Vector<IPC::Attachment> attachments) {
        swap(attachments[0], attachments[1]);
        return attachments;
    }).is_error());
}

TEST_CASE(transport_handle_with_a_dead_receive_right_is_a_decode_error)
{
    EXPECT(decode_transport_handle_with([](Vector<IPC::Attachment> attachments) {
        attachments[0] = IPC::Attachment::from_mach_port(Core::MachPort::adopt_right(MACH_PORT_DEAD, Core::MachPort::PortRight::Receive), Core::MachPort::MessageRight::MoveReceive);
        return attachments;
    }).is_error());
}

// The transport's own data message ids, for building messages no transport would send.
static constexpr mach_msg_id_t IPC_DATA_MESSAGE_ID = 0x4950C001;
static constexpr mach_msg_id_t IPC_INLINE_DATA_MESSAGE_ID = 0x4950C002;

// A transport that this test also holds a send right to, so it can send it raw Mach messages.
struct TransportWithRawSender {
    NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::TransportMachPort> transport;
    Core::MachPort send_right;
    Core::MachPort transport_peer_receive_right;
};

static TransportWithRawSender make_transport_with_raw_sender()
{
    auto receive_right = MUST(Core::MachPort::create_with_right(Core::MachPort::PortRight::Receive));
    auto send_right = MUST(receive_right.insert_right(Core::MachPort::MessageRight::MakeSend));
    auto peer_receive_right = MUST(Core::MachPort::create_with_right(Core::MachPort::PortRight::Receive));
    auto send_right_to_peer = MUST(peer_receive_right.insert_right(Core::MachPort::MessageRight::MakeSend));
    auto transport = make<IPC::TransportMachPort>(move(receive_right), move(send_right_to_peer));
    return { move(transport), move(send_right), move(peer_receive_right) };
}

template<typename T>
static void append_bytes_of(Vector<u8>& bytes, T const& value)
{
    bytes.append(reinterpret_cast<u8 const*>(&value), sizeof(T));
}

static void append_inline_payload(Vector<u8>& bytes, u32 claimed_size, ReadonlyBytes payload)
{
    append_bytes_of(bytes, claimed_size);
    bytes.append(payload.data(), payload.size());
}

static mach_msg_port_descriptor_t port_descriptor(mach_port_t name)
{
    mach_msg_port_descriptor_t descriptor {};
    descriptor.name = name;
    descriptor.disposition = MACH_MSG_TYPE_COPY_SEND;
    descriptor.type = MACH_MSG_PORT_DESCRIPTOR;
    return descriptor;
}

static mach_msg_ool_descriptor_t out_of_line_descriptor(ReadonlyBytes payload)
{
    mach_msg_ool_descriptor_t descriptor {};
    descriptor.address = const_cast<u8*>(payload.data());
    descriptor.size = payload.size();
    descriptor.copy = MACH_MSG_VIRTUAL_COPY;
    descriptor.deallocate = false;
    descriptor.type = MACH_MSG_OOL_DESCRIPTOR;
    return descriptor;
}

static void send_raw_message(Core::MachPort const& destination, mach_msg_id_t id, bool is_complex, ReadonlyBytes contents)
{
    Vector<u8> message;
    message.resize(sizeof(mach_msg_header_t));
    message.append(contents.data(), contents.size());
    while (message.size() % sizeof(natural_t) != 0)
        message.append(0);

    auto* header = reinterpret_cast<mach_msg_header_t*>(message.data());
    header->msgh_bits = MACH_MSGH_BITS(MACH_MSG_TYPE_COPY_SEND, 0) | (is_complex ? MACH_MSGH_BITS_COMPLEX : 0);
    header->msgh_size = message.size();
    header->msgh_remote_port = destination.port();
    header->msgh_local_port = MACH_PORT_NULL;
    header->msgh_id = id;
    auto result = mach_msg(header, MACH_SEND_MSG, message.size(), 0, MACH_PORT_NULL, MACH_MSG_TIMEOUT_NONE, MACH_PORT_NULL);
    VERIFY(result == KERN_SUCCESS);
}

static void expect_disconnected_without_a_message(IPC::TransportMachPort& transport)
{
    size_t received = 0;
    auto should_shutdown = IPC::TransportMachPort::ShouldShutdown::No;
    while (should_shutdown == IPC::TransportMachPort::ShouldShutdown::No) {
        transport.wait_until_readable();
        should_shutdown = transport.read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([&](auto&&) { ++received; });
    }
    EXPECT_EQ(received, 0uz);
    EXPECT(!transport.is_open());
}

TEST_CASE(raw_message_built_like_the_transport_builds_one_arrives)
{
    auto raw = make_transport_with_raw_sender();
    Vector<u8> contents;
    append_bytes_of(contents, mach_msg_body_t { 1 });
    append_bytes_of(contents, port_descriptor(raw.send_right.port()));
    append_inline_payload(contents, 1, Array<u8, 1> { 42 });
    send_raw_message(raw.send_right, IPC_INLINE_DATA_MESSAGE_ID, true, contents);

    size_t received = 0;
    raw.transport->wait_until_readable();
    auto should_shutdown = raw.transport->read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([&](IPC::TransportMachPort::Message&& message) {
        ++received;
        EXPECT_EQ(message.bytes.bytes().size(), 1uz);
        EXPECT_EQ(message.bytes.bytes()[0], 42u);
        EXPECT_EQ(message.attachments.size(), 1uz);
    });
    EXPECT_EQ(received, 1uz);
    EXPECT_EQ(should_shutdown, IPC::TransportMachPort::ShouldShutdown::No);
}

TEST_CASE(message_with_an_unknown_id_disconnects_the_peer)
{
    auto raw = make_transport_with_raw_sender();
    Vector<u8> contents;
    append_inline_payload(contents, 1, Array<u8, 1> { 42 });
    send_raw_message(raw.send_right, 0x1234, false, contents);
    expect_disconnected_without_a_message(*raw.transport);
}

TEST_CASE(inline_message_claiming_more_payload_than_it_has_disconnects_the_peer)
{
    auto raw = make_transport_with_raw_sender();
    Vector<u8> contents;
    append_inline_payload(contents, 1000, Array<u8, 4> { 1, 2, 3, 4 });
    send_raw_message(raw.send_right, IPC_INLINE_DATA_MESSAGE_ID, false, contents);
    expect_disconnected_without_a_message(*raw.transport);
}

TEST_CASE(inline_message_without_a_payload_header_disconnects_the_peer)
{
    auto raw = make_transport_with_raw_sender();
    send_raw_message(raw.send_right, IPC_INLINE_DATA_MESSAGE_ID, false, {});
    expect_disconnected_without_a_message(*raw.transport);
}

TEST_CASE(message_with_a_null_port_disconnects_the_peer)
{
    auto raw = make_transport_with_raw_sender();
    Vector<u8> contents;
    append_bytes_of(contents, mach_msg_body_t { 1 });
    append_bytes_of(contents, port_descriptor(MACH_PORT_NULL));
    append_inline_payload(contents, 1, Array<u8, 1> { 42 });
    send_raw_message(raw.send_right, IPC_INLINE_DATA_MESSAGE_ID, true, contents);
    expect_disconnected_without_a_message(*raw.transport);
}

TEST_CASE(inline_message_with_out_of_line_memory_disconnects_the_peer)
{
    auto raw = make_transport_with_raw_sender();
    Array<u8, 4> memory { 1, 2, 3, 4 };
    Vector<u8> contents;
    append_bytes_of(contents, mach_msg_body_t { 1 });
    append_bytes_of(contents, out_of_line_descriptor(memory));
    append_inline_payload(contents, 1, Array<u8, 1> { 42 });
    send_raw_message(raw.send_right, IPC_INLINE_DATA_MESSAGE_ID, true, contents);
    expect_disconnected_without_a_message(*raw.transport);
}

TEST_CASE(out_of_line_message_without_descriptors_disconnects_the_peer)
{
    auto raw = make_transport_with_raw_sender();
    Vector<u8> contents;
    append_inline_payload(contents, 1, Array<u8, 1> { 42 });
    send_raw_message(raw.send_right, IPC_DATA_MESSAGE_ID, false, contents);
    expect_disconnected_without_a_message(*raw.transport);
}

TEST_CASE(out_of_line_message_without_its_payload_descriptor_disconnects_the_peer)
{
    auto raw = make_transport_with_raw_sender();
    Vector<u8> contents;
    append_bytes_of(contents, mach_msg_body_t { 1 });
    append_bytes_of(contents, port_descriptor(raw.send_right.port()));
    send_raw_message(raw.send_right, IPC_DATA_MESSAGE_ID, true, contents);
    expect_disconnected_without_a_message(*raw.transport);
}

TEST_CASE(transport_handle_whose_receive_right_was_sent_dead_is_a_decode_error)
{
    auto raw = make_transport_with_raw_sender();
    auto pair = MUST(IPC::TransportHandle::create_pair());
    IPC::MessageBuffer buffer;
    IPC::Encoder encoder(buffer);
    MUST(encoder.encode(pair.first));
    auto handle_bytes = buffer.take_data();

    auto receive_right_descriptor = port_descriptor(MACH_PORT_DEAD);
    receive_right_descriptor.disposition = MACH_MSG_TYPE_MOVE_RECEIVE;
    Vector<u8> contents;
    append_bytes_of(contents, mach_msg_body_t { 2 });
    append_bytes_of(contents, receive_right_descriptor);
    append_bytes_of(contents, port_descriptor(raw.send_right.port()));
    append_inline_payload(contents, handle_bytes.size(), handle_bytes.span());
    send_raw_message(raw.send_right, IPC_INLINE_DATA_MESSAGE_ID, true, contents);

    size_t received = 0;
    raw.transport->wait_until_readable();
    (void)raw.transport->read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([&](IPC::TransportMachPort::Message&& message) {
        ++received;
        FixedMemoryStream stream { message.bytes.bytes() };
        IPC::Decoder decoder { stream, message.attachments };
        EXPECT(decoder.decode<IPC::TransportHandle>().is_error());
    });
    EXPECT_EQ(received, 1uz);
}

TEST_CASE(nothing_after_a_malformed_message_arrives)
{
    auto raw = make_transport_with_raw_sender();
    for (u8 value : { 1, 2 }) {
        Vector<u8> contents;
        append_inline_payload(contents, 1, Array<u8, 1> { value });
        send_raw_message(raw.send_right, IPC_INLINE_DATA_MESSAGE_ID, false, contents);
        if (value == 1)
            send_raw_message(raw.send_right, 0x1234, false, contents);
    }

    Vector<u8> received;
    auto should_shutdown = IPC::TransportMachPort::ShouldShutdown::No;
    while (should_shutdown == IPC::TransportMachPort::ShouldShutdown::No) {
        raw.transport->wait_until_readable();
        should_shutdown = raw.transport->read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([&](IPC::TransportMachPort::Message&& message) {
            received.append(message.bytes.bytes()[0]);
        });
    }
    EXPECT_EQ(received, (Vector<u8> { 1 }));
}

static void post_byte_moving_a_send_right_to(IPC::TransportMachPort& transport, Core::MachPort& port, u8 value)
{
    IPC::MessageDataType payload;
    payload.append(value);
    Vector<IPC::Attachment> attachments;
    attachments.append(IPC::Attachment::from_mach_port(MUST(port.insert_right(Core::MachPort::MessageRight::MakeSend)), Core::MachPort::MessageRight::MoveSend));
    MUST(transport.post_message(move(payload), attachments));
}

struct ByteAndSendRight {
    u8 byte { 0 };
    mach_port_t send_right { MACH_PORT_NULL };
};

// Takes a message that the transport sent to a peer which is only a raw receive right, of the shape that
// post_byte_moving_a_send_right_to() posts.
static Optional<ByteAndSendRight> receive_byte_and_send_right(Core::MachPort const& receive_right, mach_msg_timeout_t timeout_in_milliseconds)
{
    Array<u8, 1024> buffer {};
    auto* header = reinterpret_cast<mach_msg_header_t*>(buffer.data());
    if (mach_msg(header, MACH_RCV_MSG | MACH_RCV_TIMEOUT, 0, buffer.size(), receive_right.port(), timeout_in_milliseconds, MACH_PORT_NULL) != KERN_SUCCESS)
        return {};
    EXPECT_EQ(header->msgh_id, IPC_INLINE_DATA_MESSAGE_ID);
    EXPECT(header->msgh_bits & MACH_MSGH_BITS_COMPLEX);
    auto const* body = reinterpret_cast<mach_msg_body_t const*>(header + 1);
    EXPECT_EQ(body->msgh_descriptor_count, 1u);
    auto const* descriptor = reinterpret_cast<mach_msg_port_descriptor_t const*>(body + 1);
    EXPECT_EQ(descriptor->disposition, static_cast<mach_msg_type_name_t>(MACH_MSG_TYPE_PORT_SEND));
    auto const* payload = reinterpret_cast<u8 const*>(descriptor + 1);
    u32 payload_size = 0;
    __builtin_memcpy(&payload_size, payload, sizeof(payload_size));
    EXPECT_EQ(payload_size, 1u);
    return ByteAndSendRight { payload[sizeof(payload_size)], descriptor->name };
}

static mach_port_urefs_t send_right_count(Core::MachPort const& port)
{
    mach_port_urefs_t count = 0;
    VERIFY(mach_port_get_refs(mach_task_self(), port.port(), MACH_PORT_RIGHT_SEND, &count) == KERN_SUCCESS);
    return count;
}

static void release_send_rights(Core::MachPort const& port, mach_port_urefs_t count)
{
    VERIFY(mach_port_mod_refs(mach_task_self(), port.port(), MACH_PORT_RIGHT_SEND, -static_cast<mach_port_delta_t>(count)) == KERN_SUCCESS);
}

// Messages that carry rights do not wait in the kernel for room in a full peer queue. They wait their turn with the
// transport, and go out whole and in order once the peer makes room.
TEST_CASE(messages_with_rights_wait_their_turn_for_a_full_peer_queue)
{
    auto raw = make_transport_with_raw_sender();
    auto attached_port = MUST(Core::MachPort::create_with_right(Core::MachPort::PortRight::Receive));

    // The raw peer's queue holds MACH_PORT_QLIMIT_DEFAULT (5) messages, and nothing reads it until all are posted.
    constexpr size_t message_count = 64;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < message_count; ++i)
        post_byte_moving_a_send_right_to(*raw.transport, attached_port, static_cast<u8>(i));

    size_t received = 0;
    while (received < message_count) {
        auto message = receive_byte_and_send_right(raw.transport_peer_receive_right, 5000);
        if (!message.has_value())
            break;
        EXPECT_EQ(message->byte, static_cast<u8>(received));
        // NB: A send right arrives under the name of the receive right that this task holds for the same port.
        EXPECT_EQ(message->send_right, attached_port.port());
        ++received;
    }
    EXPECT_EQ(received, message_count);

    // The sends that timed out on the full queue neither lost nor duplicated a right.
    EXPECT_EQ(send_right_count(attached_port), received);
    release_send_rights(attached_port, received);
}

TEST_CASE(transport_whose_peer_queue_is_full_of_messages_with_rights_can_be_destroyed)
{
    auto raw = make_transport_with_raw_sender();
    auto attached_port = MUST(Core::MachPort::create_with_right(Core::MachPort::PortRight::Receive));

    constexpr size_t message_count = 64;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < message_count; ++i)
        post_byte_moving_a_send_right_to(*raw.transport, attached_port, static_cast<u8>(i));
    OwnPtr<IPC::TransportMachPort> transport = move(raw.transport);
    transport.clear();

    // The messages that reached the peer carry their rights, and the rights of the rest went with the transport.
    size_t received = 0;
    while (receive_byte_and_send_right(raw.transport_peer_receive_right, 0).has_value())
        ++received;
    EXPECT(received < message_count);
    EXPECT_EQ(send_right_count(attached_port), received);
    release_send_rights(attached_port, received);
}

static void post_byte(IPC::TransportMachPort& transport, u8 value)
{
    IPC::MessageDataType payload;
    payload.append(value);
    Vector<IPC::Attachment> attachments;
    MUST(transport.post_message(move(payload), attachments));
}

// Reads the first byte of every message until there are at least `count`, the peer is gone, or the deadline passes, so
// that missing messages fail a test rather than hang it.
static Vector<u8> read_bytes(IPC::TransportMachPort& transport, size_t count)
{
    Vector<u8> received;
    auto const deadline = MonotonicTime::now() + AK::Duration::from_seconds(5);
    auto should_shutdown = IPC::TransportMachPort::ShouldShutdown::No;
    while (received.size() < count && should_shutdown == IPC::TransportMachPort::ShouldShutdown::No && MonotonicTime::now() < deadline) {
        transport.wait_until_readable(deadline);
        should_shutdown = transport.read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([&](IPC::TransportMachPort::Message&& message) {
            received.append(message.bytes.bytes()[0]);
        });
    }
    return received;
}

static Optional<u8> read_one_byte(IPC::TransportMachPort& transport)
{
    auto received = read_bytes(transport, 1);
    EXPECT_EQ(received.size(), 1uz);
    if (received.is_empty())
        return {};
    return received[0];
}

// Waits until the peer is gone, or the deadline passes, so that a missing EOF fails a test rather than hang it.
static bool sees_peer_go_away(IPC::TransportMachPort& transport)
{
    auto const deadline = MonotonicTime::now() + AK::Duration::from_seconds(5);
    while (MonotonicTime::now() < deadline) {
        transport.wait_until_readable(deadline);
        if (transport.read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([](auto&&) { }) == IPC::TransportMachPort::ShouldShutdown::Yes)
            return true;
    }
    return false;
}

// All transports of a process do their IO on one thread, which has to keep each of them to itself.
TEST_CASE(transports_that_share_the_io_thread_work_alone)
{
    Vector<NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::TransportMachPort>> local_ends;
    Vector<NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::TransportMachPort>> remote_ends;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
        auto paired = TRY_OR_FAIL(IPC::TransportMachPort::create_paired());
        local_ends.append(move(paired.local));
        remote_ends.append(TRY_OR_FAIL(paired.remote_handle.create_transport()));
    }
    for (size_t i = 0; i < local_ends.size(); ++i)
        post_byte(*local_ends[i], static_cast<u8>(i));
    for (size_t i = 0; i < remote_ends.size(); ++i) {
        EXPECT_EQ(read_one_byte(*remote_ends[i]), static_cast<u8>(i));
        post_byte(*remote_ends[i], static_cast<u8>(i + 100));
    }

    // One that goes must not take the others with it, and its peer finds out.
    local_ends.remove(3);
    EXPECT(sees_peer_go_away(*remote_ends[3]));
    remote_ends.remove(3);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < local_ends.size(); ++i) {
        auto expected = i < 3 ? i : i + 1;
        EXPECT_EQ(read_one_byte(*local_ends[i]), static_cast<u8>(expected + 100));
    }

    // A transport can leave the shared thread for another owner. The old owner keeps what the thread did take in for
    // it, and the new one gets the rest, so that each message arrives once and in order.
    post_byte(*local_ends[0], 42);
    auto handle = TRY_OR_FAIL(remote_ends[0]->release_for_transfer());
    Vector<u8> received;
    (void)remote_ends[0]->read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([&](IPC::TransportMachPort::Message&& message) {
        received.append(message.bytes.bytes()[0]);
    });
    remote_ends.remove(0);
    auto new_owner = TRY_OR_FAIL(handle.create_transport());
    post_byte(*local_ends[0], 43);
    received.extend(read_bytes(*new_owner, received.size() < 2 ? 2 - received.size() : 0));
    EXPECT_EQ(received, (Vector<u8> { 42, 43 }));
}

// A peer that stops reading leaves the messages it has no room for waiting with its transport. They must not hold up
// the IO thread, which the other transports share.
TEST_CASE(a_peer_that_stops_reading_does_not_hold_up_other_transports)
{
    auto stalled = make_transport_with_raw_sender();
    auto attached_port = MUST(Core::MachPort::create_with_right(Core::MachPort::PortRight::Receive));
    constexpr size_t stalled_message_count = 64;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < stalled_message_count; ++i)
        post_byte_moving_a_send_right_to(*stalled.transport, attached_port, static_cast<u8>(i));

    auto paired = TRY_OR_FAIL(IPC::TransportMachPort::create_paired());
    auto peer = TRY_OR_FAIL(paired.remote_handle.create_transport());
    for (u8 i = 0; i < 16; ++i) {
        post_byte(*paired.local, i);
        EXPECT_EQ(read_one_byte(*peer), i);
        post_byte(*peer, i);
        EXPECT_EQ(read_one_byte(*paired.local), i);
    }

    size_t received = 0;
    while (received < stalled_message_count && receive_byte_and_send_right(stalled.transport_peer_receive_right, 5000).has_value())
        ++received;
    EXPECT_EQ(received, stalled_message_count);
    release_send_rights(attached_port, received);
}

static Optional<u8> receive_raw_byte(Core::MachPort const& receive_right, mach_msg_timeout_t timeout_in_milliseconds)
{
    Array<u8, 1024> buffer {};
    auto* header = reinterpret_cast<mach_msg_header_t*>(buffer.data());
    if (mach_msg(header, MACH_RCV_MSG | MACH_RCV_TIMEOUT, 0, buffer.size(), receive_right.port(), timeout_in_milliseconds, MACH_PORT_NULL) != KERN_SUCCESS)
        return {};
    EXPECT_EQ(header->msgh_id, IPC_INLINE_DATA_MESSAGE_ID);
    EXPECT(!(header->msgh_bits & MACH_MSGH_BITS_COMPLEX));
    auto const* payload = reinterpret_cast<u8 const*>(header + 1);
    u32 payload_size = 0;
    __builtin_memcpy(&payload_size, payload, sizeof(payload_size));
    EXPECT_EQ(payload_size, 1u);
    return payload[sizeof(payload_size)];
}

// The IO thread sends a long backlog a part at a time. The rest has to follow even when the peer's queue never fills
// up again, so that no word comes from the kernel that it has room.
TEST_CASE(a_backlog_longer_than_one_turn_of_sending_arrives_whole)
{
    auto raw = make_transport_with_raw_sender();
    IPC::TransportMachPort::raise_receive_queue_limit(raw.transport_peer_receive_right);

    // MACH_PORT_QLIMIT_MAX (1024) messages fill the peer's queue, and the rest wait with the transport.
    constexpr size_t message_count = 1024 + 300;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < message_count; ++i)
        post_byte(*raw.transport, static_cast<u8>(i));

    size_t received = 0;
    while (received < message_count) {
        auto byte = receive_raw_byte(raw.transport_peer_receive_right, 5000);
        if (!byte.has_value())
            break;
        EXPECT_EQ(*byte, static_cast<u8>(received));
        ++received;
    }
    EXPECT_EQ(received, message_count);
}

// The task holds one send-possible request per name, and transports that send to the same port share one. Both have to
// get their backlogs through once the peer reads again, whichever of them holds the request.
TEST_CASE(transports_that_send_to_the_same_port_both_get_their_backlogs_through)
{
    auto peer_receive_right = MUST(Core::MachPort::create_with_right(Core::MachPort::PortRight::Receive));
    auto make_transport_sending_to_peer = [&] {
        auto receive_right = MUST(Core::MachPort::create_with_right(Core::MachPort::PortRight::Receive));
        auto send_right_to_peer = MUST(peer_receive_right.insert_right(Core::MachPort::MessageRight::MakeSend));
        return make<IPC::TransportMachPort>(move(receive_right), move(send_right_to_peer));
    };
    auto first = make_transport_sending_to_peer();
    auto second = make_transport_sending_to_peer();

    // The peer's queue holds MACH_PORT_QLIMIT_DEFAULT (5) messages, so both transports end up with a backlog.
    constexpr size_t message_count_per_transport = 64;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < message_count_per_transport; ++i)
        post_byte(*first, static_cast<u8>(i));
    for (size_t i = 0; i < message_count_per_transport; ++i)
        post_byte(*second, static_cast<u8>(128 + i));

    size_t received_from_first = 0;
    size_t received_from_second = 0;
    while (received_from_first + received_from_second < 2 * message_count_per_transport) {
        auto byte = receive_raw_byte(peer_receive_right, 5000);
        if (!byte.has_value())
            break;
        if (*byte < 128)
            EXPECT_EQ(*byte, static_cast<u8>(received_from_first++));
        else
            EXPECT_EQ(*byte, static_cast<u8>(128 + received_from_second++));
    }
    EXPECT_EQ(received_from_first, message_count_per_transport);
    EXPECT_EQ(received_from_second, message_count_per_transport);
}

using namespace AK::TimeLiterals;

static void spin_until(Core::EventLoop& loop, Function<bool()> condition, AK::Duration timeout = 2000_ms)
{
    i64 const timeout_ms = timeout.to_milliseconds();
    for (i64 elapsed_ms = 0; elapsed_ms < timeout_ms; elapsed_ms += 5) {
        (void)loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
        if (condition())
            return;
        MUST(Core::System::sleep_ms(5));
    }

    FAIL("Timed out waiting for condition");
}

// A message can carry far more descriptors than the default soft limit lets a process hold, so raise it as LibMain
// does for every process.
static void raise_descriptor_limit()
{
    rlimit limit {};
    VERIFY(getrlimit(RLIMIT_NOFILE, &limit) == 0);
    limit.rlim_cur = min<rlim_t>(limit.rlim_max, 65536);
    VERIFY(setrlimit(RLIMIT_NOFILE, &limit) == 0);
}

TEST_CASE(receive_barrier_does_not_wait_for_an_incomplete_frame)
{
    int fds[2] {};
    TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::System::socketpair(AF_LOCAL, SOCK_STREAM, 0, fds));
    ScopeGuard close_sender = [&] { MUST(Core::System::close(fds[1])); };
    auto socket = TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::LocalSocket::adopt_fd(fds[0]));
    MUST(socket->set_blocking(false));
    IPC::TransportSocket transport(move(socket));

    IPC::SocketMessageHeader header {
        .type = IPC::SocketMessageHeader::Type::Payload,
        .payload_size = 1,
        .fd_count = 0,
    };
    auto header_bytes = ReadonlyBytes { reinterpret_cast<u8 const*>(&header), sizeof(header) };
    EXPECT_EQ(TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::System::write(fds[1], header_bytes.slice(0, 1))), 1uz);
    transport.wait_until_incoming_is_current();
    transport.wait_until_incoming_is_current();

    EXPECT_EQ(TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::System::write(fds[1], header_bytes.slice(1))), sizeof(header) - 1);
    Array<u8, 1> payload { 'A' };
    EXPECT_EQ(TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::System::write(fds[1], payload)), 1uz);
    transport.wait_until_incoming_is_current();
    size_t received = 0;
    (void)transport.read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([&](auto&& message) {
        EXPECT_EQ(message.bytes.bytes()[0], static_cast<u8>('A'));
        ++received;
    });
    EXPECT_EQ(received, 1uz);
}

TEST_CASE(send_queue_does_not_send_message_bytes_without_fds)
{
    auto queue = adopt_ref(*new IPC::SendQueue);

    IPC::MessageDataType first_payload;
    first_payload.append('A');

    IPC::MessageDataType second_payload;
    second_payload.append('B');

    auto open_descriptor = [] {
        return adopt_ref(*new IPC::AutoCloseFileDescriptor(MUST(Core::System::open("/dev/null"sv, O_RDONLY))));
    };

    Vector<NonnullRefPtr<IPC::AutoCloseFileDescriptor>> first_fds;
    first_fds.ensure_capacity(Core::LocalSocket::MAX_TRANSFER_FDS);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < Core::LocalSocket::MAX_TRANSFER_FDS; ++i)
        first_fds.unchecked_append(open_descriptor());

    Vector<NonnullRefPtr<IPC::AutoCloseFileDescriptor>> second_fds;
    second_fds.append(open_descriptor());

    queue->enqueue_message({}, move(first_payload), move(first_fds));
    queue->enqueue_message({}, move(second_payload), move(second_fds));

    auto first_batch = queue->peek(4096);
    EXPECT_EQ(first_batch.bytes.size(), sizeof(IPC::SocketMessageHeader) + 1);
    EXPECT_EQ(first_batch.bytes[sizeof(IPC::SocketMessageHeader)], static_cast<u8>('A'));
    EXPECT_EQ(first_batch.fds.size(), Core::LocalSocket::MAX_TRANSFER_FDS);

    queue->discard(first_batch.bytes.size(), first_batch.fds.size());

    auto second_batch = queue->peek(4096);
    EXPECT_EQ(second_batch.bytes.size(), sizeof(IPC::SocketMessageHeader) + 1);
    EXPECT_EQ(second_batch.bytes[sizeof(IPC::SocketMessageHeader)], static_cast<u8>('B'));
    EXPECT_EQ(second_batch.fds.size(), 1u);
}

TEST_CASE(send_queue_sends_descriptors_that_do_not_fit_one_sendmsg_ahead_of_their_message)
{
    auto queue = adopt_ref(*new IPC::SendQueue);

    static constexpr size_t fd_count = 2 * Core::LocalSocket::MAX_TRANSFER_FDS + 5;
    auto null_fd = adopt_ref(*new IPC::AutoCloseFileDescriptor(MUST(Core::System::open("/dev/null"sv, O_RDONLY))));
    Vector<NonnullRefPtr<IPC::AutoCloseFileDescriptor>> fds;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < fd_count; ++i)
        fds.append(null_fd);

    IPC::MessageDataType payload;
    payload.append('A');
    IPC::SocketMessageHeader header {
        .type = IPC::SocketMessageHeader::Type::Payload,
        .payload_size = 1,
        .fd_count = fd_count,
    };
    queue->enqueue_message(header, move(payload), move(fds));

    auto expect_header = [](ReadonlyBytes bytes, IPC::SocketMessageHeader::Type type, u32 payload_size, u32 fd_count) {
        IPC::SocketMessageHeader header;
        VERIFY(bytes.size() >= sizeof(header));
        memcpy(&header, bytes.data(), sizeof(header));
        EXPECT_EQ(header.type, type);
        EXPECT_EQ(header.payload_size, payload_size);
        EXPECT_EQ(header.fd_count, fd_count);
    };

    for (size_t frame = 0; frame < 2; ++frame) {
        auto batch = queue->peek(4096);
        EXPECT_EQ(batch.bytes.size(), sizeof(IPC::SocketMessageHeader));
        EXPECT_EQ(batch.fds.size(), Core::LocalSocket::MAX_TRANSFER_FDS);
        expect_header(batch.bytes, IPC::SocketMessageHeader::Type::Attachments, 0, Core::LocalSocket::MAX_TRANSFER_FDS);
        queue->discard(batch.bytes.size(), batch.fds.size());
    }

    auto batch = queue->peek(4096);
    EXPECT_EQ(batch.bytes.size(), sizeof(IPC::SocketMessageHeader) + 1);
    EXPECT_EQ(batch.fds.size(), 5u);
    expect_header(batch.bytes, IPC::SocketMessageHeader::Type::Payload, 1, fd_count);
    EXPECT_EQ(batch.bytes[sizeof(IPC::SocketMessageHeader)], static_cast<u8>('A'));
    queue->discard(batch.bytes.size(), batch.fds.size());

    auto empty_batch = queue->peek(4096);
    EXPECT(empty_batch.bytes.is_empty());
    EXPECT(empty_batch.fds.is_empty());
}

struct TransportPair {
    Core::EventLoop loop;
    OwnPtr<IPC::TransportSocket> sender;
    OwnPtr<IPC::TransportSocket> receiver;

    TransportPair()
    {
        int fds[2] = {};
        MUST(Core::System::socketpair(AF_LOCAL, SOCK_STREAM, 0, fds));
        auto sender_socket = MUST(Core::LocalSocket::adopt_fd(fds[0]));
        auto receiver_socket = MUST(Core::LocalSocket::adopt_fd(fds[1]));
        MUST(sender_socket->set_blocking(false));
        MUST(receiver_socket->set_blocking(false));
        sender = make<IPC::TransportSocket>(move(sender_socket));
        receiver = make<IPC::TransportSocket>(move(receiver_socket));
    }

    // Posts a one-byte message carrying a fresh descriptor, a pipe holding the same byte, and returns that
    // descriptor's number in the sender.
    int post_with_descriptor(u8 tag)
    {
        IPC::MessageDataType payload;
        payload.append(tag);
        auto pipe_fds = MUST(Core::System::pipe2(0));
        MUST(Core::System::write(pipe_fds[1], { &tag, 1 }));
        MUST(Core::System::close(pipe_fds[1]));
        Vector<IPC::Attachment> attachments;
        attachments.append(IPC::Attachment::from_fd(pipe_fds[0]));
        MUST(sender->post_message(move(payload), attachments));
        return pipe_fds[0];
    }
};

static bool descriptor_is_open(int fd)
{
    return fcntl(fd, F_GETFD) >= 0;
}

// The kernel holds its own reference to a file once its descriptor is written, so the sender's copy is closed then.
TEST_CASE(a_sent_descriptor_is_closed_once_written)
{
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA TransportPair pair;

    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA size_t received = 0;
    pair.receiver->set_up_read_hook([&] {
        (void)pair.receiver->read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([&](auto&& message) {
            ++received;
            while (!message.attachments.is_empty())
                MUST(Core::System::close(message.attachments.dequeue().to_fd()));
        });
    });

    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA auto fd = pair.post_with_descriptor('A');
    spin_until(pair.loop, [&] {
        return received == 1 && !descriptor_is_open(fd);
    });
    EXPECT(!descriptor_is_open(fd));
}

TEST_CASE(an_interrupted_wait_returns_with_nothing_to_read)
{
    TransportPair pair;
    pair.receiver->interrupt_wait_until_readable();
    pair.receiver->wait_until_readable();
}

// A worker's owner aborts its script from the observer, on the IO thread, and that interrupts what the worker waits for.
TEST_CASE(an_incoming_message_observer_can_interrupt_a_wait)
{
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA TransportPair pair;

    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<bool> observed { false };
    pair.receiver->set_incoming_message_observer([&](ReadonlyBytes) {
        pair.receiver->interrupt_wait_until_readable();
        observed.store(true);
    });

    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA size_t received = 0;
    pair.receiver->set_up_read_hook([&] {
        (void)pair.receiver->read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([&](auto&& message) {
            ++received;
            while (!message.attachments.is_empty())
                MUST(Core::System::close(message.attachments.dequeue().to_fd()));
        });
    });

    (void)pair.post_with_descriptor('A');
    spin_until(pair.loop, [&] {
        return observed.load() && received == 1;
    });
    pair.receiver->set_incoming_message_observer({});
}

// A descriptor that another process sends us must not leak into a program that we exec() later.
TEST_CASE(a_received_descriptor_is_close_on_exec)
{
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA TransportPair pair;

    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Optional<int> received_fd_flags;
    pair.receiver->set_up_read_hook([&] {
        (void)pair.receiver->read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([&](auto&& message) {
            VERIFY(message.attachments.size() == 1);
            auto fd = message.attachments.dequeue().to_fd();
            received_fd_flags = MUST(Core::System::fcntl(fd, F_GETFD));
            MUST(Core::System::close(fd));
        });
    });

    (void)pair.post_with_descriptor('A');
    spin_until(pair.loop, [&] {
        return received_fd_flags.has_value();
    });
    EXPECT(received_fd_flags.has_value() && (*received_fd_flags & FD_CLOEXEC));
}

TEST_CASE(messages_posted_from_two_threads_arrive_with_their_descriptors)
{
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA TransportPair pair;

    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Vector<u8> received_tags;
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA bool every_message_carried_its_own_descriptor = true;
    pair.receiver->set_up_read_hook([&] {
        (void)pair.receiver->read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([&](auto&& message) {
            auto tag = message.bytes.bytes()[0];
            received_tags.append(tag);
            if (message.attachments.size() != 1) {
                every_message_carried_its_own_descriptor = false;
                return;
            }
            auto fd = message.attachments.dequeue().to_fd();
            u8 byte_in_descriptor = 0;
            if (MUST(Core::System::read(fd, { &byte_in_descriptor, 1 })) != 1 || byte_in_descriptor != tag)
                every_message_carried_its_own_descriptor = false;
            MUST(Core::System::close(fd));
        });
    });

    auto other_poster = Threading::Thread::construct("Other poster"sv, [&] {
        for (u8 tag = 'a'; tag <= 'j'; ++tag)
            (void)pair.post_with_descriptor(tag);
        return 0;
    });
    other_poster->start();
    for (u8 tag = 'A'; tag <= 'J'; ++tag)
        (void)pair.post_with_descriptor(tag);
    (void)other_poster->join();

    spin_until(pair.loop, [&] {
        return received_tags.size() == 20;
    });
    EXPECT_EQ(received_tags.size(), 20u);
    EXPECT(every_message_carried_its_own_descriptor);

    // Each thread's messages arrive exactly once and in the order it posted them; only their interleaving is free.
    Vector<u8> tags_from_other_poster;
    Vector<u8> tags_from_this_thread;
    for (auto tag : received_tags) {
        if (is_ascii_lower_alpha(tag))
            tags_from_other_poster.append(tag);
        else
            tags_from_this_thread.append(tag);
    }
    Vector<u8> expected_from_other_poster;
    Vector<u8> expected_from_this_thread;
    for (u8 tag = 'a'; tag <= 'j'; ++tag)
        expected_from_other_poster.append(tag);
    for (u8 tag = 'A'; tag <= 'J'; ++tag)
        expected_from_this_thread.append(tag);
    EXPECT(tags_from_other_poster == expected_from_other_poster);
    EXPECT(tags_from_this_thread == expected_from_this_thread);
}

// A reader that falls behind finds many whole messages on the socket at once. Their descriptors belong to complete
// messages, so they must not count towards the limit on descriptors that are still waiting for their message.
TEST_CASE(a_backlog_of_messages_with_descriptors_is_not_mistaken_for_a_flood)
{
    Core::EventLoop loop;

    int fds[2] {};
    TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::System::socketpair(AF_LOCAL, SOCK_STREAM, 0, fds));
    auto peer = TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::LocalSocket::adopt_fd(fds[1]));

    // Put every message on the socket before the reading transport exists, one full sendmsg() of descriptors at a time.
    static constexpr size_t batch_count = 6;
    static constexpr size_t message_count = batch_count * Core::LocalSocket::MAX_TRANSFER_FDS;
    auto null_fd = TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::System::open("/dev/null"sv, O_RDONLY));
    ScopeGuard close_null_fd = [&] { MUST(Core::System::close(null_fd)); };
    for (size_t batch = 0; batch < batch_count; ++batch) {
        ByteBuffer bytes;
        Vector<int> descriptors;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < Core::LocalSocket::MAX_TRANSFER_FDS; ++i) {
            IPC::SocketMessageHeader header {
                .type = IPC::SocketMessageHeader::Type::Payload,
                .payload_size = 1,
                .fd_count = 1,
            };
            bytes.append(&header, sizeof(header));
            bytes.append('A');
            descriptors.append(null_fd);
        }
        EXPECT_EQ(static_cast<size_t>(TRY_OR_FAIL(peer->send_message(bytes, 0, descriptors))), bytes.size());
    }

    auto reader_socket = TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::LocalSocket::adopt_fd(fds[0]));
    MUST(reader_socket->set_blocking(false));
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA IPC::TransportSocket transport(move(reader_socket));

    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA size_t received = 0;
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA size_t received_descriptors = 0;
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA bool observed_shutdown = false;
    transport.set_up_read_hook([&] {
        auto should_shutdown = transport.read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([&](auto&& message) {
            ++received;
            while (!message.attachments.is_empty()) {
                ++received_descriptors;
                MUST(Core::System::close(message.attachments.dequeue().to_fd()));
            }
        });
        if (should_shutdown == IPC::TransportSocket::ShouldShutdown::Yes)
            observed_shutdown = true;
    });

    spin_until(loop, [&] {
        return received == message_count || observed_shutdown;
    });
    EXPECT_EQ(received, message_count);
    EXPECT_EQ(received_descriptors, message_count);
    EXPECT(!observed_shutdown);
}

static size_t open_descriptor_count()
{
    rlimit limit {};
    VERIFY(getrlimit(RLIMIT_NOFILE, &limit) == 0);
    size_t count = 0;
    for (int fd = 0; static_cast<rlim_t>(fd) < limit.rlim_cur; ++fd) {
        if (descriptor_is_open(fd))
            ++count;
    }
    return count;
}

// A peer that sends descriptors without ever completing a message gets disconnected. The descriptors of the read that
// went over the limit are ours by then, so they must be closed along with the rest.
TEST_CASE(descriptors_received_past_the_limit_are_closed)
{
    raise_descriptor_limit();
    Core::EventLoop loop;
    auto descriptor_count_before = open_descriptor_count();

    {
        int fds[2] {};
        TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::System::socketpair(AF_LOCAL, SOCK_STREAM, 0, fds));
        auto peer = TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::LocalSocket::adopt_fd(fds[1]));

        auto reader_socket = TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::LocalSocket::adopt_fd(fds[0]));
        MUST(reader_socket->set_blocking(false));
        IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA IPC::TransportSocket transport(move(reader_socket));

        IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA bool observed_shutdown = false;
        transport.set_up_read_hook([&] {
            if (transport.read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([](auto&&) { }) == IPC::TransportSocket::ShouldShutdown::Yes)
                observed_shutdown = true;
        });

        // One byte is never a whole header, so none of these descriptors ever finds its message. Send more of them
        // than the largest message may carry; the reader disconnects at some point, after which sending fails.
        auto null_fd = TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::System::open("/dev/null"sv, O_RDONLY));
        ScopeGuard close_null_fd = [&] { MUST(Core::System::close(null_fd)); };
        Vector<int> descriptors;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < Core::LocalSocket::MAX_TRANSFER_FDS; ++i)
            descriptors.append(null_fd);
        Array<u8, 1> byte { 0 };
        static constexpr size_t batch_count = IPC::MAX_MESSAGE_FD_COUNT / Core::LocalSocket::MAX_TRANSFER_FDS + 2;
        for (size_t batch = 0; batch < batch_count; ++batch) {
            if (peer->send_message(byte, 0, descriptors).is_error())
                break;
        }

        spin_until(loop, [&] {
            return observed_shutdown;
        });
        EXPECT(observed_shutdown);
    }

    EXPECT_EQ(open_descriptor_count(), descriptor_count_before);
}

static int pipe_holding(u8 tag)
{
    auto pipe_fds = MUST(Core::System::pipe2(0));
    MUST(Core::System::write(pipe_fds[1], { &tag, 1 }));
    MUST(Core::System::close(pipe_fds[1]));
    return pipe_fds[0];
}

static Optional<u8> byte_in_descriptor(int fd)
{
    u8 byte = 0;
    if (MUST(Core::System::read(fd, { &byte, 1 })) != 1)
        return {};
    return byte;
}

TEST_CASE(message_with_the_maximum_number_of_descriptors_arrives_whole_and_in_order)
{
    raise_descriptor_limit();
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA TransportPair pair;

    // Tag the descriptors on either side of each sendmsg() boundary, so that a reordering or a lost descriptor shows.
    Array<size_t, 6> tagged_indices { 0, Core::LocalSocket::MAX_TRANSFER_FDS - 1, Core::LocalSocket::MAX_TRANSFER_FDS, IPC::MAX_MESSAGE_FD_COUNT - Core::LocalSocket::MAX_TRANSFER_FDS - 1, IPC::MAX_MESSAGE_FD_COUNT - Core::LocalSocket::MAX_TRANSFER_FDS, IPC::MAX_MESSAGE_FD_COUNT - 1 };
    auto tag_for_index = [](size_t index) { return static_cast<u8>(1 + index % 251); };
    Vector<IPC::Attachment> attachments;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < IPC::MAX_MESSAGE_FD_COUNT; ++i) {
        if (tagged_indices.contains_slow(i))
            attachments.append(IPC::Attachment::from_fd(pipe_holding(tag_for_index(i))));
        else
            attachments.append(IPC::Attachment::from_fd(MUST(Core::System::open("/dev/null"sv, O_RDONLY))));
    }
    IPC::MessageDataType payload;
    payload.append('A');
    MUST(pair.sender->post_message(move(payload), attachments));
    (void)pair.post_with_descriptor('B');

    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Vector<u8> received_tags;
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA bool descriptors_arrived_in_order = true;
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA bool observed_shutdown = false;
    pair.receiver->set_up_read_hook([&] {
        auto should_shutdown = pair.receiver->read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([&](auto&& message) {
            auto tag = message.bytes.bytes()[0];
            received_tags.append(tag);
            auto expected_count = tag == 'A' ? IPC::MAX_MESSAGE_FD_COUNT : 1;
            if (message.attachments.size() != expected_count) {
                descriptors_arrived_in_order = false;
                return;
            }
            for (size_t i = 0; !message.attachments.is_empty(); ++i) {
                auto fd = message.attachments.dequeue().to_fd();
                if (tag == 'B' && byte_in_descriptor(fd) != 'B')
                    descriptors_arrived_in_order = false;
                if (tag == 'A' && tagged_indices.contains_slow(i) && byte_in_descriptor(fd) != tag_for_index(i))
                    descriptors_arrived_in_order = false;
                MUST(Core::System::close(fd));
            }
        });
        if (should_shutdown == IPC::TransportSocket::ShouldShutdown::Yes)
            observed_shutdown = true;
    });

    spin_until(pair.loop, [&] { return received_tags.size() == 2 || observed_shutdown; }, 10000_ms);
    EXPECT_EQ(received_tags.size(), 2u);
    EXPECT(received_tags == Vector<u8>({ 'A', 'B' }));
    EXPECT(descriptors_arrived_in_order);
    EXPECT(!observed_shutdown);
}

TEST_CASE(message_with_the_maximum_number_of_descriptors_and_a_payload_in_shared_memory_arrives_whole)
{
    raise_descriptor_limit();
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA TransportPair pair;

    Vector<IPC::Attachment> attachments;
    attachments.append(IPC::Attachment::from_fd(pipe_holding('F')));
    for (size_t i = 2; i < IPC::MAX_MESSAGE_FD_COUNT; ++i)
        attachments.append(IPC::Attachment::from_fd(MUST(Core::System::open("/dev/null"sv, O_RDONLY))));
    attachments.append(IPC::Attachment::from_fd(pipe_holding('L')));
    static constexpr size_t payload_size = IPC::TransportSocket::MAX_INLINE_PAYLOAD_SIZE + 1;
    IPC::MessageDataType payload;
    payload.resize(payload_size);
    payload.span().fill('A');
    MUST(pair.sender->post_message(move(payload), attachments));
    (void)pair.post_with_descriptor('B');

    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Vector<u8> received_tags;
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA bool arrived_whole = true;
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA bool observed_shutdown = false;
    pair.receiver->set_up_read_hook([&] {
        auto should_shutdown = pair.receiver->read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([&](auto&& message) {
            auto bytes = message.bytes.bytes();
            received_tags.append(bytes[0]);
            Vector<int> fds;
            while (!message.attachments.is_empty())
                fds.append(message.attachments.dequeue().to_fd());
            if (bytes[0] == 'A') {
                if (bytes.size() != payload_size || any_of(bytes, [](u8 byte) { return byte != 'A'; }))
                    arrived_whole = false;
                if (fds.size() != IPC::MAX_MESSAGE_FD_COUNT || byte_in_descriptor(fds.first()) != 'F' || byte_in_descriptor(fds.last()) != 'L')
                    arrived_whole = false;
            } else if (fds.size() != 1 || byte_in_descriptor(fds.first()) != 'B') {
                arrived_whole = false;
            }
            for (auto fd : fds)
                MUST(Core::System::close(fd));
        });
        if (should_shutdown == IPC::TransportSocket::ShouldShutdown::Yes)
            observed_shutdown = true;
    });

    spin_until(pair.loop, [&] { return received_tags.size() == 2 || observed_shutdown; }, 10000_ms);
    EXPECT(received_tags == Vector<u8>({ 'A', 'B' }));
    EXPECT(arrived_whole);
    EXPECT(!observed_shutdown);
}

static bool reader_disconnects_after_receiving(ReadonlyBytes bytes, Vector<int, 1> descriptors = {})
{
    Core::EventLoop loop;
    int fds[2] {};
    MUST(Core::System::socketpair(AF_LOCAL, SOCK_STREAM, 0, fds));
    auto peer = MUST(Core::LocalSocket::adopt_fd(fds[1]));
    auto reader_socket = MUST(Core::LocalSocket::adopt_fd(fds[0]));
    MUST(reader_socket->set_blocking(false));
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA IPC::TransportSocket transport(move(reader_socket));

    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA bool observed_shutdown = false;
    transport.set_up_read_hook([&] {
        if (transport.read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([](auto&&) { }) == IPC::TransportSocket::ShouldShutdown::Yes)
            observed_shutdown = true;
    });
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(peer->send_message(bytes, 0, move(descriptors))), bytes.size());
    spin_until(loop, [&] {
        return observed_shutdown;
    });
    return observed_shutdown;
}

// The IO thread reads a bounded amount per round. A backlog larger than that must still arrive in full and in order,
// including the part that is left for the drain that runs once the peer has hung up.
TEST_CASE(a_backlog_larger_than_one_read_round_is_delivered_after_peer_hangup)
{
    Core::EventLoop loop;

    int fds[2] {};
    TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::System::socketpair(AF_LOCAL, SOCK_STREAM, 0, fds));

    static constexpr size_t message_count = 160;
    static constexpr size_t payload_size = 1024;
    {
        ByteBuffer bytes;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < message_count; ++i) {
            IPC::SocketMessageHeader header {
                .type = IPC::SocketMessageHeader::Type::Payload,
                .payload_size = payload_size,
                .fd_count = 0,
            };
            bytes.append(&header, sizeof(header));
            for (size_t j = 0; j < payload_size; ++j)
                bytes.append(static_cast<u8>(i));
        }
        ReadonlyBytes remaining = bytes;
        while (!remaining.is_empty())
            remaining = remaining.slice(TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::System::write(fds[1], remaining)));
        MUST(Core::System::close(fds[1]));
    }

    auto reader_socket = TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::LocalSocket::adopt_fd(fds[0]));
    MUST(reader_socket->set_blocking(false));
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA IPC::TransportSocket transport(move(reader_socket));

    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA size_t received = 0;
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA bool every_message_was_intact = true;
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA bool observed_shutdown = false;
    transport.set_up_read_hook([&] {
        if (observed_shutdown)
            return;
        auto should_shutdown = transport.read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([&](auto&& message) {
            auto bytes = message.bytes.bytes();
            if (bytes.size() != payload_size || bytes[0] != static_cast<u8>(received) || bytes[payload_size - 1] != static_cast<u8>(received))
                every_message_was_intact = false;
            ++received;
        });
        if (should_shutdown == IPC::TransportSocket::ShouldShutdown::Yes)
            observed_shutdown = true;
    });

    spin_until(loop, [&] {
        return observed_shutdown;
    });
    EXPECT_EQ(received, message_count);
    EXPECT(every_message_was_intact);
}

TEST_CASE(transports_that_share_an_io_thread_work_alone)
{
    Core::EventLoop loop;
    auto post = [](IPC::TransportSocket& transport, u8 value) {
        IPC::MessageDataType payload;
        payload.append(value);
        Vector<IPC::Attachment> attachments;
        MUST(transport.post_message(move(payload), attachments));
    };
    auto read_one = [&](IPC::TransportSocket& transport) -> Optional<u8> {
        Optional<u8> value;
        spin_until(loop, [&] {
            (void)transport.read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([&](auto&& message) {
                value = message.bytes.bytes()[0];
            });
            return value.has_value();
        });
        return value;
    };

    IPC::TransportSocket::set_share_io_thread_on_this_thread(true);
    ScopeGuard stop_sharing = [] { IPC::TransportSocket::set_share_io_thread_on_this_thread(false); };

    Vector<NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::TransportSocket>> local_ends;
    Vector<NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::TransportSocket>> remote_ends;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
        auto paired = TRY_OR_FAIL(IPC::TransportSocket::create_paired());
        local_ends.append(move(paired.local));
        remote_ends.append(TRY_OR_FAIL(paired.remote_handle.create_transport()));
    }
    for (size_t i = 0; i < local_ends.size(); ++i)
        post(*local_ends[i], static_cast<u8>(i));
    for (size_t i = 0; i < remote_ends.size(); ++i) {
        EXPECT_EQ(read_one(*remote_ends[i]), static_cast<u8>(i));
        post(*remote_ends[i], static_cast<u8>(i + 100));
    }

    // One that goes must not take the others with it, and its peer finds out.
    local_ends.remove(3);
    bool should_shut_down = false;
    spin_until(loop, [&] {
        should_shut_down = remote_ends[3]->read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([](auto&&) { }) == IPC::TransportSocket::ShouldShutdown::Yes;
        return should_shut_down;
    });
    remote_ends.remove(3);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < local_ends.size(); ++i) {
        auto expected = i < 3 ? i : i + 1;
        EXPECT_EQ(read_one(*local_ends[i]), static_cast<u8>(expected + 100));
    }

    // A transport can leave its shared thread for another owner. The old owner hands on what it did read, and the new
    // one gets the rest, so that each message arrives once and in order.
    post(*local_ends[0], 42);
    auto handle = TRY_OR_FAIL(remote_ends[0]->release_for_transfer());
    Vector<u8> received;
    (void)remote_ends[0]->read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([&](auto&& message) {
        received.append(message.bytes.bytes()[0]);
    });
    remote_ends.remove(0);
    auto new_owner = TRY_OR_FAIL(handle.create_transport());
    post(*local_ends[0], 43);
    spin_until(loop, [&] {
        (void)new_owner->read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([&](auto&& message) {
            received.append(message.bytes.bytes()[0]);
        });
        return received.size() >= 2;
    });
    EXPECT_EQ(received, (Vector<u8> { 42, 43 }));
}

TEST_CASE(a_frame_cut_in_two_by_a_transfer_arrives_whole)
{
    Core::EventLoop loop;

    int fds[2] {};
    TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::System::socketpair(AF_LOCAL, SOCK_STREAM, 0, fds));
    ScopeGuard close_sender = [&] { MUST(Core::System::close(fds[1])); };
    auto socket = TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::LocalSocket::adopt_fd(fds[0]));
    MUST(socket->set_blocking(false));
    IPC::TransportSocket transport(move(socket));

    IPC::SocketMessageHeader header {
        .type = IPC::SocketMessageHeader::Type::Payload,
        .payload_size = 4,
        .fd_count = 0,
    };
    EXPECT_EQ(TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::System::write(fds[1], ReadonlyBytes { reinterpret_cast<u8 const*>(&header), sizeof(header) })), sizeof(header));
    Array<u8, 4> payload { 'a', 'b', 'c', 'd' };
    EXPECT_EQ(TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::System::write(fds[1], payload.span().trim(2))), 2uz);

    // The old owner has read the first half of the frame off the socket, and the second half is yet to come.
    transport.wait_until_incoming_is_current();
    auto handle = TRY_OR_FAIL(transport.release_for_transfer());
    auto new_owner = TRY_OR_FAIL(handle.create_transport());
    EXPECT_EQ(TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::System::write(fds[1], payload.span().slice(2))), 2uz);

    ByteBuffer received;
    spin_until(loop, [&] {
        (void)new_owner->read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([&](auto&& message) {
            received.append(message.bytes.bytes());
        });
        return !received.is_empty();
    });
    EXPECT_EQ(received.bytes(), ReadonlyBytes { payload });
}

TEST_CASE(descriptors_ahead_of_their_message_go_along_with_a_transfer)
{
    Core::EventLoop loop;

    int fds[2] {};
    TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::System::socketpair(AF_LOCAL, SOCK_STREAM, 0, fds));
    auto peer = TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::LocalSocket::adopt_fd(fds[1]));
    auto socket = TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::LocalSocket::adopt_fd(fds[0]));
    MUST(socket->set_blocking(false));
    IPC::TransportSocket transport(move(socket));

    IPC::SocketMessageHeader attachments_header {
        .type = IPC::SocketMessageHeader::Type::Attachments,
        .payload_size = 0,
        .fd_count = 1,
    };
    auto attachments_bytes = ReadonlyBytes { reinterpret_cast<u8 const*>(&attachments_header), sizeof(attachments_header) };
    auto first_descriptor = pipe_holding('a');
    EXPECT_EQ(TRY_OR_FAIL(peer->send_message(attachments_bytes, 0, Vector<int, 1> { first_descriptor })), sizeof(attachments_header));
    MUST(Core::System::close(first_descriptor));

    // The old owner has taken the descriptor off the socket, and the message that claims it is yet to come.
    transport.wait_until_incoming_is_current();
    auto handle = TRY_OR_FAIL(transport.release_for_transfer());
    auto new_owner = TRY_OR_FAIL(handle.create_transport());

    IPC::SocketMessageHeader header {
        .type = IPC::SocketMessageHeader::Type::Payload,
        .payload_size = 1,
        .fd_count = 2,
    };
    ByteBuffer frame;
    frame.append(&header, sizeof(header));
    frame.append('X');
    auto second_descriptor = pipe_holding('b');
    EXPECT_EQ(TRY_OR_FAIL(peer->send_message(frame.bytes(), 0, Vector<int, 1> { second_descriptor })), frame.size());
    MUST(Core::System::close(second_descriptor));

    Vector<u8> tags;
    spin_until(loop, [&] {
        (void)new_owner->read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([&](auto&& message) {
            while (!message.attachments.is_empty()) {
                auto fd = message.attachments.dequeue().to_fd();
                tags.append(byte_in_descriptor(fd).value_or(0));
                MUST(Core::System::close(fd));
            }
        });
        return !tags.is_empty();
    });
    EXPECT_EQ(tags, (Vector<u8> { 'a', 'b' }));
}

TEST_CASE(messages_arrive_in_order_while_the_reader_is_transferred_again_and_again)
{
    Core::EventLoop loop;

    auto paired = TRY_OR_FAIL(IPC::TransportSocket::create_paired());
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA auto sender = move(paired.local);
    auto reader = TRY_OR_FAIL(paired.remote_handle.create_transport());

    // NB: The padding makes a message end anywhere in a read of the transport.
    static constexpr u32 message_count = 20000;
    static constexpr size_t padding = 701;
    auto sending_thread = Threading::Thread::construct("Sender"sv, [&sender] {
        for (u32 i = 0; i < message_count; ++i) {
            IPC::MessageDataType payload;
            payload.resize(sizeof(i) + padding);
            memcpy(payload.data(), &i, sizeof(i));
            Vector<IPC::Attachment> attachments;
            MUST(sender->post_message(move(payload), attachments));
        }
        return static_cast<intptr_t>(0);
    });
    sending_thread->start();

    u32 next = 0;
    bool in_order = true;
    auto read_what_is_there = [&](IPC::TransportSocket& transport) {
        (void)transport.read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([&](auto&& message) {
            u32 value = 0;
            memcpy(&value, message.bytes.bytes().data(), sizeof(value));
            in_order = in_order && value == next;
            ++next;
        });
    };
    spin_until(loop, [&] {
        read_what_is_there(*reader);
        auto handle = MUST(reader->release_for_transfer());
        read_what_is_there(*reader);
        reader = MUST(handle.create_transport());
        return next >= message_count || !in_order; }, 30000_ms);
    (void)sending_thread->join();

    EXPECT(in_order);
    EXPECT_EQ(next, message_count);
}

TEST_CASE(read_hook_is_notified_on_peer_hangup)
{
    Core::EventLoop loop;

    int fds[2] = {};
    MUST(Core::System::socketpair(AF_LOCAL, SOCK_STREAM, 0, fds));

    auto reader_socket = TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::LocalSocket::adopt_fd(fds[0]));
    auto peer_socket = TRY_OR_FAIL(Core::LocalSocket::adopt_fd(fds[1]));

    MUST(reader_socket->set_blocking(false));
    MUST(peer_socket->set_blocking(false));

    IPC::TransportSocket transport(move(reader_socket));

    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<bool> observed_shutdown = false;

    transport.set_up_read_hook([&] {
        auto should_shutdown = transport.read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([](auto&&) {
        });
        if (should_shutdown == IPC::TransportSocket::ShouldShutdown::Yes)
            observed_shutdown.store(true, AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed);
    });

    peer_socket->close();

    spin_until(loop, [&] {
        return observed_shutdown.load(AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed);
    });

    EXPECT(observed_shutdown.load(AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed));
}
