TEST_CASE(a_seek_resolved_from_held_frames_keeps_a_pending_restart)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();
    auto withheld_outputs = make_ref_counted<WithheldOutputs>();
    WithholdingVideoDecoder::set_withheld_outputs_for_new_decoders(withheld_outputs);
    ScopeGuard stop_withholding = [] { WithholdingVideoDecoder::set_withheld_outputs_for_new_decoders(nullptr); };

    auto sample_timestamps = presentation_timestamps_of_first_samples("./vp9_in_webm.webm"sv, 11);
    VERIFY(sample_timestamps.size() == 11);
    auto producer = create_started_producer(loop, "./vp9_in_webm.webm"sv);

    auto time_limit = AK::Duration::from_seconds(5);
    if (!hold_the_first_frame_through_a_restart(withheld_outputs, time_limit)) {
        FAIL("Timed out waiting for a restart to wait in the decoder");
        return;
    }

    // The first seek can't resolve from the held frames, so it's pending when the second one resolves from them.
    producer->seek(sample_timestamps[10]);
    producer->seek(sample_timestamps[0]);
    auto frame = take_frame_within_time_limit(*producer, loop, time_limit);
    if (frame == nullptr) {
        FAIL("Timed out waiting for the held frame");
        return;
    }
    EXPECT_EQ(frame->timestamp(), sample_timestamps[0]);

    AsynchronousOutputReleaser releaser { withheld_outputs };
    for (size_t frame_index = 1; frame_index < 4; frame_index++) {
        frame = take_frame_within_time_limit(*producer, loop, time_limit);
        if (frame == nullptr) {
            FAIL(ByteString::formatted("Timed out waiting for frame {}", frame_index));
            return;
        }
        EXPECT_EQ(frame->timestamp(), sample_timestamps[frame_index]);
    }
}

TEST_CASE(samples_that_follow_a_transient_end_of_stream_are_ignored)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();
    auto [inner_demuxer, track] = demuxer_and_video_track_for("./vp9_in_webm.webm"sv);
    auto demuxer = ResumingDemuxer::create(inner_demuxer);
    auto producer = TRY_OR_FAIL(Media::DecodedVideoProducer::try_create(loop, demuxer, track));
    producer->set_error_handler([&](Media::DecoderError&& error) {
        FAIL(ByteString::formatted("An error occurred while decoding: {}", error.description()));
    });

    // A seek past the end reads the whole stream first, so the decoder is drained on the end of stream and the
    // demuxer has resumed by the time the seek settles on the last frame.
    producer->seek(AK::Duration::from_seconds(60));
    producer->start();

    auto time_limit = AK::Duration::from_seconds(10);
    auto frame = take_frame_within_time_limit(*producer, loop, time_limit);
    if (frame == nullptr) {
        FAIL("Timed out waiting for the last frame");
        return;
    }
    EXPECT(demuxer->resumed_sample_count() > 0);

    auto start_time = MonotonicTime::now_coarse();
    while (producer->peek().status != Media::PipelineStatus::EndOfStream) {
        if (MonotonicTime::now_coarse() - start_time >= time_limit) {
            FAIL("Timed out waiting for the end of the stream");
            return;
        }
        loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    }
}

// Frames the decoder still holds when the data runs out for good are drained out, without ending the stream.
TEST_CASE(frames_held_by_the_decoder_are_delivered_when_data_becomes_permanently_unavailable)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();
    auto withheld_outputs = make_ref_counted<WithheldOutputs>();
    WithholdingVideoDecoder::set_withheld_outputs_for_new_decoders(withheld_outputs);
    ScopeGuard stop_withholding = [] { WithholdingVideoDecoder::set_withheld_outputs_for_new_decoders(nullptr); };

    auto sample_timestamps = presentation_timestamps_of_first_samples("./vp9_in_webm.webm"sv, 3);
    auto [inner_demuxer, track] = demuxer_and_video_track_for("./vp9_in_webm.webm"sv);
    auto demuxer = BlockingDemuxer::create(inner_demuxer, sample_timestamps.size());
    auto producer = TRY_OR_FAIL(Media::DecodedVideoProducer::try_create(loop, demuxer, track));
    producer->set_error_handler([&](Media::DecoderError&& error) {
        FAIL(ByteString::formatted("An error occurred while decoding: {}", error.description()));
    });
    producer->start();

    auto time_limit = AK::Duration::from_seconds(5);
    if (!demuxer->wait_until_a_read_blocks(time_limit)) {
        FAIL("Timed out waiting for the decode thread to block on the demuxer");
        return;
    }
    EXPECT_EQ(withheld_outputs->withheld_count(), sample_timestamps.size());

    demuxer->make_blocked_samples_permanently_unavailable();
    if (!withheld_outputs->wait_until_the_caller_waits_for_output(time_limit)) {
        FAIL("Timed out waiting for the decode thread to drain the decoder");
        return;
    }
    while (withheld_outputs->release_next()) { }

    for (auto timestamp : sample_timestamps) {
        auto frame = take_frame_within_time_limit(*producer, loop, time_limit);
        if (frame == nullptr) {
            FAIL("Timed out waiting for a frame drained from the decoder");
            return;
        }
        EXPECT_EQ(frame->timestamp(), timestamp);
    }

    auto deadline = MonotonicTime::now() + AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(200);
    while (MonotonicTime::now() < deadline) {
        auto status = producer->peek().status;
        loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
        if (status != Media::PipelineStatus::Pending) {
            FAIL(ByteString::formatted("Unexpected status {}", status));
            break;
        }
    }

    // The drained decoder has to start over, so the next seek moves the demuxer.
    auto seek_count = demuxer->seek_count();
    auto forced_seek_count = demuxer->forced_seek_count();
    producer->seek(sample_timestamps.last() + AK::Duration::from_seconds(10));
    auto seek_deadline = MonotonicTime::now() + time_limit;
    while (demuxer->seek_count() == seek_count && MonotonicTime::now() < seek_deadline)
        loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    EXPECT(demuxer->seek_count() > seek_count);
    EXPECT(demuxer->forced_seek_count() > forced_seek_count);
}

TEST_CASE(video_producer_seeks_while_frames_are_held)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto stream = load_test_file("vp9_oob_blocks.webm"sv);
    auto demuxer = create_demuxer(stream);
    auto tracks = TRY_OR_FAIL(demuxer->get_tracks_for_type(Media::TrackType::Video));
    VERIFY(!tracks.is_empty());

    auto producer = TRY_OR_FAIL(Media::DecodedVideoProducer::try_create(loop, demuxer, tracks[0]));
    producer->start();

    auto pull_next_frame = [&]() -> RefPtr<Media::VideoFrame> {
        auto time_limit = AK::Duration::from_seconds(10);
        auto start_time = MonotonicTime::now_coarse();
        while (MonotonicTime::now_coarse() - start_time < time_limit) {
            if (auto output = producer->peek(); output.frame != nullptr) {
                producer->consume();
                return output.frame;
            }
            loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
        }
        return nullptr;
    };

    // Hold a displaying sink's worth of frames plus a lagging media element reference, so the
    // seek below must decode towards its target while these frame pool slots stay occupied.
    Vector<NonnullRefPtr<Media::VideoFrame>> held_frames;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        auto frame = pull_next_frame();
        if (frame == nullptr) {
            FAIL("Timed out pulling the initial frames");
            return;
        }
        held_frames.append(frame.release_nonnull());
    }

    // Give the producer time to fill its decode-ahead queue behind the held frames.
    auto fill_until = MonotonicTime::now_coarse() + AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(250);
    while (MonotonicTime::now_coarse() < fill_until)
        loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);

    producer->seek(AK::Duration::from_seconds(2));

    if (pull_next_frame() == nullptr)
        FAIL("The seek did not resolve; the producer is likely starved of frame pool slots");
}

TEST_CASE(video_producer_seeks_past_the_end_resolve_within_queued_data)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto stream = load_test_file("vp9_oob_blocks.webm"sv);
    auto demuxer = create_demuxer(stream);
    auto tracks = TRY_OR_FAIL(demuxer->get_tracks_for_type(Media::TrackType::Video));
    VERIFY(!tracks.is_empty());

    auto producer = TRY_OR_FAIL(Media::DecodedVideoProducer::try_create(loop, demuxer, tracks[0]));
    producer->start();

    auto pump_until = [&](auto condition) {
        auto deadline = MonotonicTime::now_coarse() + AK::Duration::from_seconds(5);
        while (MonotonicTime::now_coarse() < deadline) {
            if (condition())
                return true;
            loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
        }
        return false;
    };

    auto past_end = AK::Duration::from_seconds(100);
    producer->seek(past_end);
    EXPECT(pump_until([&] { return producer->peek().status == Media::PipelineStatus::HaveData; }));

    // Give the decode loop time to observe the demuxer's end of stream behind the queued final frame.
    auto fill_until = MonotonicTime::now_coarse() + AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(250);
    while (MonotonicTime::now_coarse() < fill_until)
        loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);

    // Nothing exists beyond the queued final frame for the demuxer to re-emit, so a further seek past
    // the end must resolve with the queued frame instead of discarding it.
    producer->seek(past_end + AK::Duration::from_seconds(1));
    auto output = producer->peek();
    EXPECT_EQ(output.status, Media::PipelineStatus::HaveData);
    EXPECT(output.frame != nullptr);
    producer->consume();
    EXPECT(pump_until([&] { return producer->peek().status == Media::PipelineStatus::EndOfStream; }));

    // With the final frame consumed, nothing downstream is guaranteed to still hold it, so a later seek past the
    // end re-emits that same frame before reporting end of stream again.
    producer->seek(past_end + AK::Duration::from_seconds(2));
    auto re_emitted = producer->peek();
    EXPECT_EQ(re_emitted.status, Media::PipelineStatus::HaveData);
    EXPECT(re_emitted.frame.ptr() == output.frame.ptr());
    producer->consume();
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->peek().status, Media::PipelineStatus::EndOfStream);
}

TEST_CASE(video_producer_auto_suspends_and_resumes_only_from_a_seek)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto stream = load_test_file("big_buck_bunny_5s.webm"sv);
    auto demuxer = create_demuxer(stream);
    auto tracks = TRY_OR_FAIL(demuxer->get_tracks_for_type(Media::TrackType::Video));
    VERIFY(!tracks.is_empty());

    auto producer = TRY_OR_FAIL(Media::DecodedVideoProducer::try_create(loop, demuxer, tracks[0], SHORT_AUTO_SUSPEND_TIMEOUT));
    producer->start();

    EXPECT(pump_until(loop, [&] { return has_data_or_already_suspended(producer->peek().status); }));

    // Left idle, the producer suspends. The checking peeks are spaced wider than the idle timeout
    // so they cannot defer it indefinitely.
    EXPECT(pump_until(loop, [&] {
        sleep_past_the_idle_timeout();
        return producer->peek().status == Media::PipelineStatus::Suspended;
    }));

    // Peeking and consuming must not resume a suspended producer.
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        EXPECT_EQ(producer->peek().status, Media::PipelineStatus::Suspended);
        producer->consume();
    }
    sleep_past_the_idle_timeout();
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->peek().status, Media::PipelineStatus::Suspended);

    // A seek resumes decoding and wakes the waiting consumer.
    EXPECT(seek_to_resume_and_pump_until_woken_with_data(loop, *producer, AK::Duration::zero()).has_value());
}

TEST_CASE(video_producer_suspended_before_starting_reads_nothing_until_a_seek)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto [inner_demuxer, track] = demuxer_and_video_track_for("./vp9_in_webm.webm"sv);
    auto demuxer = BlockingDemuxer::create(inner_demuxer, NumericLimits<size_t>::max());
    auto producer = TRY_OR_FAIL(Media::DecodedVideoProducer::try_create(loop, demuxer, track, SHORT_AUTO_SUSPEND_TIMEOUT));

    bool woken = false;
    producer->set_wake_handler([&] { woken = true; });
    // A wake can still be queued on the shared event loop once this test returns.
    ScopeGuard stop_handling_wakes = [&] { producer->set_wake_handler({}); };
    producer->suspend();
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->peek().status, Media::PipelineStatus::Suspended);
    EXPECT(pump_until(loop, [&] { return woken; }));

    sleep_past_the_idle_timeout();
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->peek().status, Media::PipelineStatus::Suspended);
    EXPECT_EQ(demuxer->samples_served(), 0u);

    EXPECT(seek_to_resume_and_pump_until_woken_with_data(loop, *producer, AK::Duration::zero()).has_value());
    EXPECT(demuxer->samples_served() > 0);
}

// A producer suspended at the end of its stream no longer reports that end, which may be stale for a new consumer.
TEST_CASE(video_producer_suspended_at_the_end_of_its_stream_waits_for_a_seek)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto [demuxer, track] = demuxer_and_video_track_for("./vp9_in_webm.webm"sv);
    auto producer = TRY_OR_FAIL(Media::DecodedVideoProducer::try_create(loop, demuxer, track));
    producer->start();
    EXPECT(pump_until(loop, [&] {
        auto output = producer->peek();
        if (output.frame != nullptr)
            producer->consume();
        return output.status == Media::PipelineStatus::EndOfStream;
    }));

    bool woken = false;
    producer->set_wake_handler([&] { woken = true; });
    ScopeGuard stop_handling_wakes = [&] { producer->set_wake_handler({}); };
    producer->suspend();
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->peek().status, Media::PipelineStatus::Suspended);
    EXPECT(pump_until(loop, [&] { return woken; }));
    sleep_past_the_idle_timeout();
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->peek().status, Media::PipelineStatus::Suspended);

    EXPECT(seek_to_resume_and_pump_until_woken_with_data(loop, *producer, AK::Duration::zero()).has_value());
}

TEST_CASE(video_producer_suspended_during_a_blocked_read_stops_reading)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto [inner_demuxer, track] = demuxer_and_video_track_for("./vp9_in_webm.webm"sv);
    auto demuxer = BlockingDemuxer::create(inner_demuxer, 3);
    auto producer = TRY_OR_FAIL(Media::DecodedVideoProducer::try_create(loop, demuxer, track));
    producer->start();
    EXPECT(demuxer->wait_until_a_read_blocks(AK::Duration::from_seconds(5)));

    producer->suspend();
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->peek().status, Media::PipelineStatus::Suspended);
    auto samples_served = demuxer->samples_served();
    demuxer->stop_blocking_reads();
    sleep_past_the_idle_timeout();
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    EXPECT_EQ(demuxer->samples_served(), samples_served);
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->peek().status, Media::PipelineStatus::Suspended);
}

// A seek requested before the suspension is not one that the consumer is still waiting for.
TEST_CASE(video_producer_suspended_with_a_seek_pending_drops_that_seek)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto stream = load_test_file("big_buck_bunny_5s.webm"sv);
    auto demuxer = create_demuxer(stream);
    auto tracks = TRY_OR_FAIL(demuxer->get_tracks_for_type(Media::TrackType::Video));
    VERIFY(!tracks.is_empty());
    auto producer = TRY_OR_FAIL(Media::DecodedVideoProducer::try_create(loop, demuxer, tracks[0]));
    producer->start();
    EXPECT(pump_until(loop, [&] { return producer->peek().status == Media::PipelineStatus::HaveData; }));

    producer->seek(AK::Duration::from_seconds(3));
    producer->suspend();
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->peek().status, Media::PipelineStatus::Suspended);
    sleep_past_the_idle_timeout();
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->peek().status, Media::PipelineStatus::Suspended);

    auto output = seek_to_resume_and_pump_until_woken_with_data(loop, *producer, AK::Duration::zero());
    if (!output.has_value()) {
        FAIL("Expected data after seeking");
        return;
    }
    EXPECT(output->frame->timestamp() < AK::Duration::from_seconds(1));
}

TEST_CASE(video_producer_suspends_while_frames_are_held_and_wakes_the_consumer)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto stream = load_test_file("big_buck_bunny_5s.webm"sv);
    auto demuxer = create_demuxer(stream);
    auto tracks = TRY_OR_FAIL(demuxer->get_tracks_for_type(Media::TrackType::Video));
    VERIFY(!tracks.is_empty());

    auto producer = TRY_OR_FAIL(Media::DecodedVideoProducer::try_create(loop, demuxer, tracks[0], SHORT_AUTO_SUSPEND_TIMEOUT));
    producer->start();

    // Hold every frame pool slot so the decoder parks waiting for a free slot, as it would behind
    // a paused sink holding frames downstream.
    Vector<NonnullRefPtr<Media::VideoFrame>> held_frames;
    EXPECT(pump_until(loop, [&] {
        auto output = producer->peek();
        if (output.frame != nullptr) {
            held_frames.append(output.frame.release_nonnull());
            producer->consume();
        }
        return held_frames.size() == Media::VideoFramePool::MAX_SLOT_COUNT;
    }));

    // The queue is drained, so the last observed status is a waiting one and entering suspension
    // must dispatch a wake.
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->peek().status, Media::PipelineStatus::Pending);
    // Run any wake dispatch still queued from draining the frames above, so the wait below only
    // observes the wake dispatched by entering suspension.
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    bool woken = false;
    producer->set_wake_handler([&] { woken = true; });
    // A wake can still be queued on the shared event loop once this test returns.
    ScopeGuard stop_handling_wakes = [&] { producer->set_wake_handler({}); };
    EXPECT(pump_until(loop, [&] { return woken; }));
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->peek().status, Media::PipelineStatus::Suspended);
}

#include <LibMedia/DecoderRegistrations.h>

TEST_SETUP
{
    Media::install_video_decoders({ Media::hardware_video_decoders(), Media::ffmpeg_video_decoders() });
    Media::install_audio_decoders({ Media::audio_decoders() });
}

TEST_CASE(ffmpeg_decoder_capabilities)
{
    auto ffmpeg_capabilities = [](Media::ParsedCodec const& codec) {
        if (Media::track_type_from_codec_id(codec.codec_id()) == Media::TrackType::Audio)
            return Media::FFmpeg::FFmpegAudioDecoder::capabilities(codec);
        return Media::FFmpeg::FFmpegVideoDecoder::capabilities(codec);
    };

    for (auto codec_id : {
             Media::CodecID::VP8,
             Media::CodecID::VP9,
             Media::CodecID::MP3,
             Media::CodecID::AV1,
             Media::CodecID::Theora,
             Media::CodecID::Vorbis,
             Media::CodecID::Opus,
             Media::CodecID::FLAC,
             Media::CodecID::U8,
             Media::CodecID::S16LE,
             Media::CodecID::S24LE,
             Media::CodecID::S32LE,
             Media::CodecID::F32LE,
             Media::CodecID::ALaw,
             Media::CodecID::MuLaw,
         }) {
        auto capabilities = ffmpeg_capabilities(Media::ParsedCodec { codec_id });
        EXPECT(capabilities.has_value());
        EXPECT(capabilities->smooth);
        EXPECT_EQ(capabilities->power_efficient, Media::track_type_from_codec_id(codec_id) == Media::TrackType::Audio);
    }

    for (auto codec_id : { Media::CodecID::H264, Media::CodecID::H265, Media::CodecID::AAC })
        EXPECT(!ffmpeg_capabilities(Media::ParsedCodec { codec_id }).has_value());
}

TEST_CASE(an_unknown_codec_has_no_capabilities)
{
    EXPECT(!Media::decoder_capabilities(Media::ParsedCodec { Media::CodecID::Unknown }).has_value());
}

TEST_CASE(decoder_creation)
{
    auto audio_selection = Media::select_audio_decoder(Media::ParsedCodec { Media::CodecID::S16LE });
    EXPECT(audio_selection.has_value());
    auto audio_decoder = Media::create_audio_decoder(audio_selection, Media::CodecID::S16LE, Audio::SampleSpecification { 8'000, Audio::ChannelMap::mono() }, {});
    EXPECT(!audio_decoder.is_error());

    auto video_selection = Media::select_video_decoder(Media::ParsedCodec { Media::CodecID::VP9 });
    EXPECT(video_selection.has_value());
    auto video_decoder = Media::create_video_decoder(video_selection, Media::CodecID::VP9, {});
    EXPECT(!video_decoder.is_error());
}

TEST_CASE(selecting_past_the_last_decoder_finds_nothing)
{
    auto codec = Media::ParsedCodec { Media::CodecID::VP9 };

    auto selection = Media::select_video_decoder(codec);
    EXPECT(selection.has_value());

    // Every decoder below the last one that claimed the stream has been exhausted.
    auto last = selection;
    while (last.has_value())
        last = Media::select_video_decoder(codec, last);
    EXPECT(!last.has_value());
}

    EXPECT(!Media::select_video_decoder(Media::ParsedCodec { Media::CodecID::Vorbis }).has_value());
}

    auto selection = Media::select_audio_decoder(codec);
    EXPECT(selection.has_value());

    auto last = selection;
    while (last.has_value())
        last = Media::select_audio_decoder(codec, last);
    EXPECT(!last.has_value());
}

TEST_CASE(a_video_codec_selects_no_audio_decoder)

}

/*

#include <AK/NonnullRefPtr.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibCore/EventLoop.h>
#include <LibMedia/MonotonicMediaClock.h>
#include <LibMedia/Producers/VideoProducer.h>
#include <LibMedia/Sinks/DisplayingVideoSink.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/VideoFrame.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/VideoFramePool.h>
#include <LibTest/TestCase.h>

#include "TestMediaCommon.h"

namespace {

NonnullRefPtr<Media::VideoFrame> create_test_frame(Media::VideoFramePool& pool, AK::Duration timestamp, AK::Duration duration)
{
    static constexpr Gfx::IntSize frame_size { 2, 2 };
    static constexpr u8 bit_depth = 8;
    auto subsampling = Media::Subsampling(true, true);

    auto plane_sizes = MUST(Gfx::YUVData::plane_sizes(frame_size, bit_depth, subsampling));
    auto acquired = pool.try_acquire(plane_sizes.total).release_value();
    return make_ref_counted<Media::VideoFrame>(timestamp, duration, Gfx::Size<u32>(frame_size), bit_depth, subsampling, Media::ColorMetadata {}, move(acquired.storage));
}

}

TEST_CASE(seek_resolving_frame_is_presented_even_when_stale)
{
    never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto pool = MUST(Media::VideoFramePool::create());
    auto clock = MUST(Media::MonotonicMediaClock::try_create());
    clock->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000));

    auto sink = MUST(Media::DisplayingVideoSink::try_create(clock->time_reader()));
    auto producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    MUST(sink->connect_input(producer));
    sink->set_ticking(true);

    // The producer resolves the seek with a frame that covers the target, but whose presentation
    // interval has already passed relative to the clock.
    sink->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(900));
    producer->append_output(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(900), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(33)), Media::PipelineStatus::HaveData);

    auto result = sink->update(MonotonicTime::now());
    EXPECT(result.new_frame_available);

    auto current_frame = sink->current_frame();
    EXPECT(current_frame != nullptr);
    EXPECT_EQ(current_frame->timestamp(), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(900));
}

TEST_CASE(suspension_wake_releases_the_prefetched_frame)
{
    never_destroyed_event_loop();

    size_t freed_slots = 0;
    auto pool = MUST(Media::VideoFramePool::create());
    pool->set_slot_freed_callback([&freed_slots] { freed_slots++; });
    auto clock = MUST(Media::MonotonicMediaClock::try_create());
    clock->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000));

    auto sink = MUST(Media::DisplayingVideoSink::try_create(clock->time_reader()));
    auto producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    MUST(sink->connect_input(producer));
    sink->set_ticking(true);

    // Present the frame covering the current time, leaving the following frame prefetched.
    producer->append_output(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(33)), Media::PipelineStatus::HaveData);
    producer->append_output(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1033), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(33)), Media::PipelineStatus::HaveData);
    auto result = sink->update(MonotonicTime::now());
    EXPECT(result.new_frame_available);
    EXPECT_EQ(freed_slots, 0u);

    // The suspension wake must release the prefetched frame's slot while keeping the displayed frame.
    producer->append_output(nullptr, Media::PipelineStatus::Suspended);
    producer->wake();
    EXPECT_EQ(freed_slots, 1u);

    // Ticking past the prefetched frame's timestamp must not present it after the suspension.
    clock->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1040));
    result = sink->update(MonotonicTime::now());
    EXPECT(!result.new_frame_available);
    auto current_frame = sink->current_frame();
    EXPECT(current_frame != nullptr);
    EXPECT_EQ(current_frame->timestamp(), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000));
}

TEST_CASE(updates_are_required_until_the_clock_stops_and_frames_are_presented)
{
    never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto pool = MUST(Media::VideoFramePool::create());
    auto clock = MUST(Media::MonotonicMediaClock::try_create());
    clock->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000));

    auto sink = MUST(Media::DisplayingVideoSink::try_create(clock->time_reader()));
    auto producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    MUST(sink->connect_input(producer));
    sink->set_ticking(true);

    // A seek in flight keeps updates required while the clock is stopped.
    sink->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000));
    EXPECT(sink->update(MonotonicTime::now()).may_require_updates);

    // Resolving the seek with a presentable frame leaves nothing due at the stopped clock.
    producer->append_output(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(33)), Media::PipelineStatus::HaveData);
    auto result = sink->update(MonotonicTime::now());
    EXPECT(result.new_frame_available);
    EXPECT(!result.may_require_updates);

    // A running clock requires updates regardless of pending frames.
    clock->resume();
    EXPECT(sink->update(MonotonicTime::now()).may_require_updates);

    clock->pause();
    EXPECT(!sink->update(MonotonicTime::now()).may_require_updates);
}

TEST_CASE(paused_sink_before_its_first_frame_stays_suspended)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto pool = MUST(Media::VideoFramePool::create());
    auto clock = MUST(Media::MonotonicMediaClock::try_create());

    auto sink = MUST(Media::DisplayingVideoSink::try_create(clock->time_reader()));
    Vector<Media::PipelineStatus> dispatched_statuses;
    sink->set_state_change_handler([&dispatched_statuses](Media::PipelineStatus status, Media::PipelineCheckpoint) {
        dispatched_statuses.append(status);
    });
    auto producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    MUST(sink->connect_input(producer));
    sink->set_ticking(true);

    // The first frame starts after the paused time, so the seek resolves with nothing to present yet.
    sink->seek(AK::Duration::zero());
    producer->append_output(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(40), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(40)), Media::PipelineStatus::HaveData);
    EXPECT(sink->update(MonotonicTime::now()).new_frame_available);
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    EXPECT(!sink->update(MonotonicTime::now()).new_frame_available);
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    EXPECT(sink->current_frame() == nullptr);
    EXPECT_EQ(dispatched_statuses, (Vector { Media::PipelineStatus::HaveData }));

    // A suspension while paused must not be undone, since no frame is due until the clock moves.
    producer->append_output(nullptr, Media::PipelineStatus::Suspended);
    producer->wake();
    auto seek_count_at_suspension = producer->seek_count();
    for (auto i = 0; i < 3; i++)
        EXPECT(!sink->update(MonotonicTime::now()).may_require_updates);
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->seek_count(), seek_count_at_suspension);

    // Once the clock advances, the sink needs its frame again and resumes the input.
    clock->resume();
    sink->update(MonotonicTime::now());
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->seek_count(), seek_count_at_suspension + 1);
}

TEST_CASE(seek_within_the_displayed_frame_resumes_a_suspended_input)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto pool = MUST(Media::VideoFramePool::create());
    auto clock = MUST(Media::MonotonicMediaClock::try_create());
    clock->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000));

    auto sink = MUST(Media::DisplayingVideoSink::try_create(clock->time_reader()));
    Vector<Media::PipelineStatus> dispatched_statuses;
    sink->set_state_change_handler([&dispatched_statuses](Media::PipelineStatus status, Media::PipelineCheckpoint) {
        dispatched_statuses.append(status);
    });
    auto producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    MUST(sink->connect_input(producer));
    sink->set_ticking(true);

    producer->append_output(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(33)), Media::PipelineStatus::HaveData);
    EXPECT(sink->update(MonotonicTime::now()).new_frame_available);
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);

    producer->append_output(nullptr, Media::PipelineStatus::Suspended);
    producer->wake();
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);

    auto seek_count_before_seek = producer->seek_count();
    dispatched_statuses.clear();
    sink->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1010));
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->seek_count(), seek_count_before_seek + 1);
    EXPECT(dispatched_statuses.is_empty());
}

TEST_CASE(held_late_frame_waiting_on_input_reports_pending)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto pool = MUST(Media::VideoFramePool::create());
    auto clock = MUST(Media::MonotonicMediaClock::try_create());
    clock->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000));

    auto sink = MUST(Media::DisplayingVideoSink::try_create(clock->time_reader()));
    Vector<Media::PipelineStatus> dispatched_statuses;
    sink->set_state_change_handler([&dispatched_statuses](Media::PipelineStatus status, Media::PipelineCheckpoint) {
        dispatched_statuses.append(status);
    });
    auto producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    MUST(sink->connect_input(producer));
    sink->set_ticking(true);

    producer->append_output(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(33)), Media::PipelineStatus::HaveData);
    producer->append_output(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1033), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(33)), Media::PipelineStatus::HaveData);
    EXPECT(sink->update(MonotonicTime::now()).new_frame_available);
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    EXPECT_EQ(dispatched_statuses, (Vector { Media::PipelineStatus::HaveData }));

    // The clock passes the held frame while the input has nothing after it, so the sink is waiting for data.
    clock->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1100));
    dispatched_statuses.clear();
    EXPECT(!sink->update(MonotonicTime::now()).new_frame_available);
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    EXPECT_EQ(sink->current_frame()->timestamp(), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000));
    EXPECT_EQ(dispatched_statuses, (Vector { Media::PipelineStatus::Pending }));
}

TEST_CASE(seek_past_the_cached_frames_waits_for_the_frame_at_the_target)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto pool = MUST(Media::VideoFramePool::create());
    auto clock = MUST(Media::MonotonicMediaClock::try_create());
    clock->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000));

    auto sink = MUST(Media::DisplayingVideoSink::try_create(clock->time_reader()));
    Vector<Media::PipelineStatus> dispatched_statuses;
    sink->set_state_change_handler([&dispatched_statuses](Media::PipelineStatus status, Media::PipelineCheckpoint) {
        dispatched_statuses.append(status);
    });
    auto producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    MUST(sink->connect_input(producer));
    sink->set_ticking(true);

    producer->append_output(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(33)), Media::PipelineStatus::HaveData);
    producer->append_output(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1033), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(33)), Media::PipelineStatus::HaveData);
    EXPECT(sink->update(MonotonicTime::now()).new_frame_available);
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);

    // The target lies after the cached frames end, but before the later one's conservative end.
    clock->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1080));
    dispatched_statuses.clear();
    sink->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1080));
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    EXPECT(dispatched_statuses.is_empty());

    producer->append_output(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1066), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(33)), Media::PipelineStatus::HaveData);
    producer->wake();
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    EXPECT_EQ(sink->current_frame()->timestamp(), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1066));
    EXPECT_EQ(dispatched_statuses, (Vector { Media::PipelineStatus::HaveData }));
}

TEST_CASE(frames_passed_while_waiting_on_a_late_frame_are_counted_as_dropped)
{
    never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto pool = MUST(Media::VideoFramePool::create());
    auto clock = MUST(Media::MonotonicMediaClock::try_create());
    clock->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000));

    auto sink = MUST(Media::DisplayingVideoSink::try_create(clock->time_reader()));
    auto producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    MUST(sink->connect_input(producer));
    sink->set_ticking(true);

    producer->append_frame(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(40)));
    EXPECT(sink->update(MonotonicTime::now()).new_frame_available);
    EXPECT_EQ(sink->take_frame_counts().presented, 1u);

    // Both frames are late, and the second waits for a frame after it to replace it.
    clock->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1200));
    for (auto timestamp : { 1040, 1080 })
        producer->append_frame(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(timestamp), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(40)));
    EXPECT(!sink->update(MonotonicTime::now()).new_frame_available);
    EXPECT_EQ(sink->current_frame()->timestamp(), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000));
    auto frame_counts = sink->take_frame_counts();
    EXPECT_EQ(frame_counts.presented, 0u);
    EXPECT_EQ(frame_counts.dropped, 1u);
    EXPECT(sink->take_frame_counts().is_zero());
}

TEST_CASE(frame_past_its_duration_is_presented_until_the_next_frame_is_due)
{
    never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto pool = MUST(Media::VideoFramePool::create());
    auto clock = MUST(Media::MonotonicMediaClock::try_create());
    clock->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000));

    auto sink = MUST(Media::DisplayingVideoSink::try_create(clock->time_reader()));
    auto producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    MUST(sink->connect_input(producer));
    sink->set_ticking(true);

    producer->append_frame(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(40)));
    EXPECT(sink->update(MonotonicTime::now()).new_frame_available);
    EXPECT_EQ(sink->take_frame_counts().presented, 1u);

    // With reordered frames, a container can give a frame a duration of a single tick, although the frame after it
    // isn't due for another 40ms.
    clock->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1060));
    producer->append_frame(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1040), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1)));
    producer->append_frame(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1080), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(40)));
    EXPECT(sink->update(MonotonicTime::now()).new_frame_available);
    EXPECT_EQ(sink->current_frame()->timestamp(), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1040));
    auto frame_counts = sink->take_frame_counts();
    EXPECT_EQ(frame_counts.presented, 1u);
    EXPECT_EQ(frame_counts.dropped, 0u);
}

TEST_CASE(frames_passed_by_an_update_landing_on_time_are_counted_as_presented)
{
    never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto pool = MUST(Media::VideoFramePool::create());
    auto clock = MUST(Media::MonotonicMediaClock::try_create());
    clock->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000));

    auto sink = MUST(Media::DisplayingVideoSink::try_create(clock->time_reader()));
    auto producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    MUST(sink->connect_input(producer));
    sink->set_ticking(true);

    producer->append_frame(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(4)));
    EXPECT(sink->update(MonotonicTime::now()).new_frame_available);
    EXPECT_EQ(sink->take_frame_counts().presented, 1u);

    // Updates spaced further apart than the frames make the oldest ones late, but the frame landed on is on time.
    clock->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1016));
    for (auto timestamp : { 1004, 1008, 1012, 1016 })
        producer->append_frame(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(timestamp), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(4)));
    EXPECT(sink->update(MonotonicTime::now()).new_frame_available);
    EXPECT_EQ(sink->current_frame()->timestamp(), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1016));
    auto frame_counts = sink->take_frame_counts();
    EXPECT_EQ(frame_counts.presented, 4u);
    EXPECT_EQ(frame_counts.dropped, 0u);
}

TEST_CASE(frames_passed_by_a_seek_within_the_cached_frames_are_not_counted)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto pool = MUST(Media::VideoFramePool::create());
    auto clock = MUST(Media::MonotonicMediaClock::try_create());
    clock->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000));

    auto sink = MUST(Media::DisplayingVideoSink::try_create(clock->time_reader()));
    auto producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    MUST(sink->connect_input(producer));
    sink->set_ticking(true);

    // A long frame followed by a short one, so that a seek within the long one's conservative end lands after the
    // short one's.
    producer->append_frame(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(100)));
    producer->append_frame(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1100), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(10)));
    EXPECT(sink->update(MonotonicTime::now()).new_frame_available);
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    EXPECT_EQ(sink->take_frame_counts().presented, 1u);

    producer->append_frame(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1110), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(40)));
    clock->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1120));
    sink->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1120));
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    EXPECT_EQ(sink->current_frame()->timestamp(), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1110));
    auto frame_counts = sink->take_frame_counts();
    EXPECT_EQ(frame_counts.presented, 1u);
    EXPECT_EQ(frame_counts.dropped, 0u);
}

TEST_CASE(resuming_ticking_seeks_past_frames_held_behind_the_clock)
{
    never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto pool = MUST(Media::VideoFramePool::create());
    auto clock = MUST(Media::MonotonicMediaClock::try_create());
    clock->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000));

    auto sink = MUST(Media::DisplayingVideoSink::try_create(clock->time_reader()));
    auto producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    MUST(sink->connect_input(producer));
    sink->set_ticking(true);
    auto seeks_before_resuming = producer->seek_count();

    producer->append_frame(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(40)));
    producer->append_frame(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1040), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(40)));
    EXPECT(sink->update(MonotonicTime::now()).new_frame_available);
    EXPECT_EQ(sink->take_frame_counts().presented, 1u);

    // The displayed frame still covers the clock, so there is nothing to skip.
    sink->set_ticking(false);
    sink->set_ticking(true);
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->seek_count(), seeks_before_resuming);

    sink->set_ticking(false);
    clock->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1200));
    sink->set_ticking(true);
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->seek_count(), seeks_before_resuming + 1);

    producer->append_frame(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1200), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(40)));
    EXPECT(sink->update(MonotonicTime::now()).new_frame_available);
    EXPECT_EQ(sink->current_frame()->timestamp(), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1200));
    auto frame_counts = sink->take_frame_counts();
    EXPECT_EQ(frame_counts.presented, 1u);
    EXPECT_EQ(frame_counts.dropped, 0u);
}

// A sink that is not ticking reports its input's suspension at once, while the status of its last update is still waiting
// to be dispatched. That status is older than the suspension, so it must not be dispatched after it.
TEST_CASE(a_suspension_is_not_followed_by_the_status_it_replaced)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto clock = MUST(Media::MonotonicMediaClock::try_create());
    auto sink = MUST(Media::DisplayingVideoSink::try_create(clock->time_reader()));
    Vector<Media::PipelineStatus> dispatched_statuses;
    sink->set_state_change_handler([&dispatched_statuses](Media::PipelineStatus status, Media::PipelineCheckpoint) {
        dispatched_statuses.append(status);
    });
    auto producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    MUST(sink->connect_input(producer));
    sink->set_ticking(true);
    sink->set_ticking(false);

    producer->append_output(nullptr, Media::PipelineStatus::Blocked);
    (void)sink->update(MonotonicTime::now());

    producer->consume();
    producer->append_output(nullptr, Media::PipelineStatus::Suspended);
    producer->wake();
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);

    EXPECT(!dispatched_statuses.is_empty());
    if (!dispatched_statuses.is_empty())
        EXPECT_EQ(dispatched_statuses.last(), Media::PipelineStatus::Suspended);
}

// A sink reports its status in a deferred task, so a wake can arrive before that report is dispatched. The sink is
// already presenting a frame by then, and must not take further frames while it is not ticking.
TEST_CASE(wakes_before_a_status_is_dispatched_leave_frames_held_behind_the_clock)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto pool = MUST(Media::VideoFramePool::create());
    auto clock = MUST(Media::MonotonicMediaClock::try_create());
    clock->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000));

    auto sink = MUST(Media::DisplayingVideoSink::try_create(clock->time_reader()));
    auto producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    MUST(sink->connect_input(producer));
    sink->set_ticking(true);

    producer->append_frame(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(40)));
    EXPECT(sink->update(MonotonicTime::now()).new_frame_available);
    EXPECT_EQ(sink->take_frame_counts().presented, 1u);

    sink->set_ticking(false);
    clock->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1200));
    for (auto timestamp : { 1040, 1080, 1120, 1160 })
        producer->append_frame(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(timestamp), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(40)));
    producer->wake();
    EXPECT_EQ(sink->current_frame()->timestamp(), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000));
    EXPECT(sink->take_frame_counts().is_zero());
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
}

TEST_CASE(seek_while_not_ticking_resolves_once_a_frame_covers_the_target)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto pool = MUST(Media::VideoFramePool::create());
    auto clock = MUST(Media::MonotonicMediaClock::try_create());
    clock->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000));

    auto sink = MUST(Media::DisplayingVideoSink::try_create(clock->time_reader()));
    Vector<Media::PipelineStatus> dispatched_statuses;
    sink->set_state_change_handler([&dispatched_statuses](Media::PipelineStatus status, Media::PipelineCheckpoint) {
        dispatched_statuses.append(status);
    });
    auto producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    MUST(sink->connect_input(producer));
    sink->set_ticking(true);

    producer->append_frame(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(40)));
    EXPECT(sink->update(MonotonicTime::now()).new_frame_available);
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);

    sink->set_ticking(false);
    clock->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1200));
    dispatched_statuses.clear();
    sink->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1200));

    // The first frame back falls short of the target, so the seek stays pending.
    producer->append_frame(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1120), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(40)));
    producer->wake();
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    EXPECT(dispatched_statuses.is_empty());

    producer->append_frame(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1160), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(80)));
    producer->wake();
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    EXPECT_EQ(sink->current_frame()->timestamp(), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1160));
    EXPECT_EQ(dispatched_statuses, (Vector { Media::PipelineStatus::HaveData }));
}

TEST_CASE(frames_passed_catching_up_after_resuming_from_suspension_are_not_counted)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto pool = MUST(Media::VideoFramePool::create());
    auto clock = MUST(Media::MonotonicMediaClock::try_create());
    clock->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000));

    auto sink = MUST(Media::DisplayingVideoSink::try_create(clock->time_reader()));
    auto producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    MUST(sink->connect_input(producer));
    sink->set_ticking(true);

    producer->append_frame(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(40)));
    EXPECT(sink->update(MonotonicTime::now()).new_frame_available);
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    EXPECT_EQ(sink->take_frame_counts().presented, 1u);

    producer->append_output(nullptr, Media::PipelineStatus::Suspended);
    producer->wake();

    // A running clock makes the update resume the input with a seek.
    clock->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(2000));
    clock->resume();
    auto seeks_before_resuming = producer->seek_count();
    sink->update(MonotonicTime::now());
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->seek_count(), seeks_before_resuming + 1);
    producer->consume();

    // The clock passes the frame at the target before it arrives, and the following frames trail behind it.
    clock->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(2100));
    producer->append_frame(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(2000), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(40)));
    EXPECT(sink->update(MonotonicTime::now()).new_frame_available);
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);

    clock->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(2200));
    for (auto timestamp : { 2040, 2080 })
        producer->append_frame(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(timestamp), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(40)));
    sink->update(MonotonicTime::now());
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);

    producer->append_frame(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(2200), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(40)));
    EXPECT(sink->update(MonotonicTime::now()).new_frame_available);
    EXPECT_EQ(sink->current_frame()->timestamp(), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(2200));
    EXPECT_EQ(sink->take_frame_counts().dropped, 0u);
}

TEST_CASE(frames_replaced_within_an_update_are_presented_when_the_last_one_is_on_time)
{
    never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto pool = MUST(Media::VideoFramePool::create());
    auto clock = MUST(Media::MonotonicMediaClock::try_create());
    clock->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000));

    EXPECT(sink->update(MonotonicTime::now()).new_frame_available);

}

TEST_CASE(frames_passed_for_a_late_frame_ending_the_stream_are_counted_as_presented)
{
    never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto pool = MUST(Media::VideoFramePool::create());
    auto clock = MUST(Media::MonotonicMediaClock::try_create());
    clock->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000));

    auto sink = MUST(Media::DisplayingVideoSink::try_create(clock->time_reader()));
    auto producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    MUST(sink->connect_input(producer));

    EXPECT(sink->update(MonotonicTime::now()).new_frame_available);
    EXPECT_EQ(sink->take_frame_counts().presented, 1u);

    EXPECT_EQ(frame_counts.presented, 2u);
    EXPECT_EQ(frame_counts.dropped, 0u);
}

TEST_CASE(frames_out_of_order_with_a_passed_frame_are_not_counted)

// The input reaching its end leaves the last frame on screen until its interval ends, and only an update after that
// can report the end of the stream.
TEST_CASE(updates_are_required_until_the_last_frame_finishes_presenting)
{
    never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto pool = MUST(Media::VideoFramePool::create());
    auto clock = MUST(Media::MonotonicMediaClock::try_create());
    clock->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000));

    auto sink = MUST(Media::DisplayingVideoSink::try_create(clock->time_reader()));
    auto producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    MUST(sink->connect_input(producer));
    sink->set_ticking(true);

    sink->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000));
    producer->append_frame(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(100)));
    producer->append_output(nullptr, Media::PipelineStatus::EndOfStream);
    EXPECT(sink->update(MonotonicTime::now()).new_frame_available);

    clock->resume();
    EXPECT(sink->update(MonotonicTime::now()).may_require_updates);

    clock->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1200));
    EXPECT(!sink->update(MonotonicTime::now()).may_require_updates);
}

// Until the sink knows whether it ticks, starting its input either way could be wrong, so it holds the input and any
// seeks back and reports that it is waiting, which keeps the clock from starting.
TEST_CASE(undecided_sink_leaves_its_input_unstarted)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto clock = MUST(Media::MonotonicMediaClock::try_create());
    auto sink = MUST(Media::DisplayingVideoSink::try_create(clock->time_reader()));
    Vector<Media::PipelineStatus> dispatched_statuses;
    sink->set_state_change_handler([&](Media::PipelineStatus status, Media::PipelineCheckpoint) { dispatched_statuses.append(status); });
    auto producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    MUST(sink->connect_input(producer));

    clock->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(500));
    sink->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(500));
    (void)sink->update(MonotonicTime::now());
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    EXPECT(!sink->is_ticking());
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->start_count(), 0u);
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->suspend_count(), 0u);
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->seek_count(), 0u);
    EXPECT(dispatched_statuses.is_empty());

    sink->set_ticking(true);
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->start_count(), 1u);
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->suspend_count(), 0u);
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->seek_count(), 1u);
}

TEST_CASE(sink_first_decided_not_to_tick_suspends_its_input)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto clock = MUST(Media::MonotonicMediaClock::try_create());
    auto sink = MUST(Media::DisplayingVideoSink::try_create(clock->time_reader()));
    Vector<Media::PipelineStatus> dispatched_statuses;
    sink->set_state_change_handler([&](Media::PipelineStatus status, Media::PipelineCheckpoint) { dispatched_statuses.append(status); });
    auto producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    MUST(sink->connect_input(producer));
    sink->seek(AK::Duration::zero());

    sink->set_ticking(false);
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->start_count(), 0u);
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->suspend_count(), 1u);
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->seek_count(), 0u);

    producer->append_output(nullptr, Media::PipelineStatus::Suspended);
    producer->wake();
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    EXPECT_EQ(dispatched_statuses, Vector { Media::PipelineStatus::Suspended });

    // Playing on while unticked leaves the input suspended.
    clock->resume();
    sink->notify_clock_resumed();
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->seek_count(), 0u);

    // Ticking resumes the input at the current time.
    sink->set_ticking(true);
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->seek_count(), 1u);
}

// A sink that is connected after its ticking was decided starts its input right away.
TEST_CASE(sink_decided_before_connecting_starts_its_input_on_connect)
{
    never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto clock = MUST(Media::MonotonicMediaClock::try_create());
    auto ticking_sink = MUST(Media::DisplayingVideoSink::try_create(clock->time_reader()));
    ticking_sink->set_ticking(true);
    auto ticking_producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    MUST(ticking_sink->connect_input(ticking_producer));
    EXPECT_EQ(ticking_producer->start_count(), 1u);
    EXPECT_EQ(ticking_producer->seek_count(), 1u);

    auto unticked_sink = MUST(Media::DisplayingVideoSink::try_create(clock->time_reader()));
    unticked_sink->set_ticking(false);
    auto unticked_producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    MUST(unticked_sink->connect_input(unticked_producer));
    EXPECT_EQ(unticked_producer->suspend_count(), 1u);
    EXPECT_EQ(unticked_producer->seek_count(), 0u);
}

// Seeking a sink that isn't ticking would otherwise wake its suspended input only to decode frames that nothing shows.
TEST_CASE(unticked_sink_resolves_a_seek_without_waking_its_suspended_input)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto pool = MUST(Media::VideoFramePool::create());
    auto clock = MUST(Media::MonotonicMediaClock::try_create());
    clock->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000));
    auto sink = MUST(Media::DisplayingVideoSink::try_create(clock->time_reader()));
    Vector<Media::PipelineStatus> dispatched_statuses;
    sink->set_state_change_handler([&](Media::PipelineStatus status, Media::PipelineCheckpoint) { dispatched_statuses.append(status); });
    auto producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    MUST(sink->connect_input(producer));
    sink->set_ticking(true);

    producer->append_frame(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(40)));
    EXPECT(sink->update(MonotonicTime::now()).new_frame_available);
    producer->append_output(nullptr, Media::PipelineStatus::Suspended);
    sink->set_ticking(false);
    producer->wake();
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    auto seeks_before = producer->seek_count();

    dispatched_statuses.clear();
    clock->seek(AK::Duration::zero());
    sink->seek(AK::Duration::zero());
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->seek_count(), seeks_before);
    EXPECT_EQ(dispatched_statuses, Vector { Media::PipelineStatus::Suspended });
    // The frame from before the seek stays until the sink catches up.
    EXPECT_EQ(sink->current_frame()->timestamp(), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000));

    sink->set_ticking(true);
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->seek_count(), seeks_before + 1);
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->last_seek_timestamp(), AK::Duration::zero());
}

// The frame a sink keeps may show data that a seek invalidates, so such a seek reaches the input even when it isn't
// ticking.
TEST_CASE(unticked_sink_passes_on_a_seek_that_invalidates_held_data)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto pool = MUST(Media::VideoFramePool::create());
    auto clock = MUST(Media::MonotonicMediaClock::try_create());
    auto sink = MUST(Media::DisplayingVideoSink::try_create(clock->time_reader()));
    auto producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    MUST(sink->connect_input(producer));
    sink->set_ticking(true);
    producer->append_frame(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::zero(), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(40)));
    (void)sink->update(MonotonicTime::now());
    producer->append_output(nullptr, Media::PipelineStatus::Suspended);
    sink->set_ticking(false);
    producer->wake();
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);

    auto seeks_before = producer->seek_count();
    sink->seek(AK::Duration::zero(), Media::InvalidateHeldData::Yes);
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->seek_count(), seeks_before + 1);
}

TEST_CASE(frame_is_up_to_date_once_a_ticking_sink_has_caught_up)
{
    never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto pool = MUST(Media::VideoFramePool::create());
    auto clock = MUST(Media::MonotonicMediaClock::try_create());
    clock->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000));
    auto sink = MUST(Media::DisplayingVideoSink::try_create(clock->time_reader()));
    auto producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    MUST(sink->connect_input(producer));
    EXPECT(!sink->frame_is_up_to_date());

    // A sink that has just begun ticking has yet to bring its frame to the clock, even once it has updated.
    sink->set_ticking(true);
    EXPECT(!sink->frame_is_up_to_date());
    (void)sink->update(MonotonicTime::now());
    EXPECT(!sink->frame_is_up_to_date());
    producer->append_frame(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(40)));
    (void)sink->update(MonotonicTime::now());
    EXPECT(sink->frame_is_up_to_date());

    // A seek from upstream leaves the frame from before it, which is up to date until the seek resolves.
    sink->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(3000));
    EXPECT(sink->frame_is_up_to_date());
    producer->append_frame(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(3000), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(40)));
    clock->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(3000));
    (void)sink->update(MonotonicTime::now());
    EXPECT(sink->frame_is_up_to_date());

    sink->set_ticking(false);
    EXPECT(!sink->frame_is_up_to_date());

    // Catching up to a clock that moved while the sink wasn't ticking takes a seek of the sink's own.
    clock->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(5000));
    sink->set_ticking(true);
    (void)sink->update(MonotonicTime::now());
    EXPECT(!sink->frame_is_up_to_date());
    producer->append_frame(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(5000), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(40)));
    (void)sink->update(MonotonicTime::now());
    EXPECT(sink->frame_is_up_to_date());
    EXPECT_EQ(sink->current_frame()->timestamp(), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(5000));

    // A clock that stays within the frame needs no catching up.
    sink->set_ticking(false);
    sink->set_ticking(true);
    (void)sink->update(MonotonicTime::now());
    EXPECT(sink->frame_is_up_to_date());
}

// A screenshot catches a sink up to its clock without ticking it.
TEST_CASE(unticked_sink_catches_up_to_its_clock_on_request)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto pool = MUST(Media::VideoFramePool::create());
    auto clock = MUST(Media::MonotonicMediaClock::try_create());
    auto sink = MUST(Media::DisplayingVideoSink::try_create(clock->time_reader()));
    auto producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    MUST(sink->connect_input(producer));
    sink->set_ticking(false);
    producer->append_output(nullptr, Media::PipelineStatus::Suspended);
    producer->wake();
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);

    // Paused at a time the sink has no frame for, nothing but a request makes it seek.
    clock->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(2000));
    (void)sink->update(MonotonicTime::now());
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->seek_count(), 0u);

    sink->catch_up_to_clock();
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->seek_count(), 1u);
    EXPECT(sink->is_catching_up());

    producer->consume();
    producer->append_frame(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(2000), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(40)));
    producer->wake();
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    EXPECT(!sink->is_catching_up());
    EXPECT_EQ(sink->current_frame()->timestamp(), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(2000));
    EXPECT(!sink->frame_is_up_to_date());

    // A frame that already shows the clock's time needs no seek.
    sink->catch_up_to_clock();
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->seek_count(), 1u);
    EXPECT(!sink->is_catching_up());
}

TEST_CASE(sink_reports_changes_to_its_freshness)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto pool = MUST(Media::VideoFramePool::create());
    auto clock = MUST(Media::MonotonicMediaClock::try_create());
    auto sink = MUST(Media::DisplayingVideoSink::try_create(clock->time_reader()));
    size_t changes = 0;
    sink->set_on_freshness_changed([&] { changes++; });
    auto producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    MUST(sink->connect_input(producer));

    // An undecided sink and an unticked one are equally behind the clock.
    sink->set_ticking(false);
    EXPECT_EQ(changes, 0u);

    // Ticking starts a catch-up, and the frame is up to date once that is done.
    clock->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000));
    sink->set_ticking(true);
    EXPECT_EQ(changes, 1u);
    EXPECT(sink->is_catching_up());
    producer->append_frame(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(40)));
    producer->wake();
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    EXPECT(sink->frame_is_up_to_date());
    EXPECT_EQ(changes, 2u);

    sink->set_ticking(true);
    EXPECT_EQ(changes, 2u);
    sink->set_ticking(false);
    EXPECT_EQ(changes, 3u);
}

// A blocked catch-up isn't counted as catching up, so an input that suspends during it changes the sink's freshness.
TEST_CASE(sink_reports_its_freshness_when_its_input_suspends_during_a_blocked_catch_up)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto clock = MUST(Media::MonotonicMediaClock::try_create());
    auto sink = MUST(Media::DisplayingVideoSink::try_create(clock->time_reader()));
    size_t changes = 0;
    sink->set_on_freshness_changed([&] { changes++; });
    auto producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    MUST(sink->connect_input(producer));
    sink->set_ticking(false);
    producer->append_output(nullptr, Media::PipelineStatus::Suspended);
    producer->wake();
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);

    clock->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(2000));
    sink->catch_up_to_clock();
    producer->consume();
    producer->append_output(nullptr, Media::PipelineStatus::Blocked);
    producer->wake();
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    EXPECT(!sink->is_catching_up());

    auto changes_before_suspending = changes;
    producer->consume();
    producer->append_output(nullptr, Media::PipelineStatus::Suspended);
    producer->wake();
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    EXPECT(sink->is_catching_up());
    EXPECT_EQ(changes, changes_before_suspending + 1);
}

TEST_CASE(sink_reconnected_to_a_new_input_takes_its_frames)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto pool = MUST(Media::VideoFramePool::create());
    auto clock = MUST(Media::MonotonicMediaClock::try_create());
    clock->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000));
    auto sink = MUST(Media::DisplayingVideoSink::try_create(clock->time_reader()));
    auto first_producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    MUST(sink->connect_input(first_producer));
    sink->set_ticking(true);

    // The frame after the current one waits in the sink until the clock reaches it.
    first_producer->append_frame(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(40)));
    first_producer->append_frame(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1040), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(40)));
    (void)sink->update(MonotonicTime::now());
    EXPECT_EQ(sink->current_frame()->timestamp(), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000));
    EXPECT(sink->frame_is_up_to_date());
    sink->disconnect_input(first_producer);

    // The new input starts with a catch-up, which the sink reports.
    size_t changes = 0;
    sink->set_on_freshness_changed([&] { changes++; });
    auto second_producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    MUST(sink->connect_input(second_producer));
    EXPECT(!sink->frame_is_up_to_date());
    EXPECT_EQ(changes, 1u);
    auto frame = create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(40));
    second_producer->append_frame(frame);
    (void)sink->update(MonotonicTime::now());
    EXPECT(!sink->is_catching_up());
    EXPECT_EQ(sink->current_frame().ptr(), frame.ptr());
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
}

// A catch-up that the previous input left blocked says nothing about the new input's catch-up.
TEST_CASE(sink_reconnected_after_a_blocked_catch_up_catches_up_its_new_input)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto pool = MUST(Media::VideoFramePool::create());
    auto clock = MUST(Media::MonotonicMediaClock::try_create());
    clock->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000));
    auto sink = MUST(Media::DisplayingVideoSink::try_create(clock->time_reader()));
    auto first_producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    MUST(sink->connect_input(first_producer));
    sink->set_ticking(true);
    first_producer->append_output(nullptr, Media::PipelineStatus::Blocked);
    (void)sink->update(MonotonicTime::now());
    EXPECT(!sink->is_catching_up());
    sink->disconnect_input(first_producer);

    auto second_producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    MUST(sink->connect_input(second_producer));
    EXPECT(sink->is_catching_up());
    EXPECT(!sink->frame_is_up_to_date());

    second_producer->append_frame(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(40)));
    (void)sink->update(MonotonicTime::now());
    EXPECT(!sink->is_catching_up());
    EXPECT(sink->frame_is_up_to_date());
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
}

// Data that has yet to arrive holds a catch-up up indefinitely, so the frame from before it counts as up to date.
TEST_CASE(catch_up_that_waits_for_data_leaves_the_frame_up_to_date)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto pool = MUST(Media::VideoFramePool::create());
    auto clock = MUST(Media::MonotonicMediaClock::try_create());
    auto sink = MUST(Media::DisplayingVideoSink::try_create(clock->time_reader()));
    auto producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    MUST(sink->connect_input(producer));
    sink->set_ticking(true);
    producer->append_frame(create_test_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::zero(), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(40)));
    (void)sink->update(MonotonicTime::now());
    EXPECT(sink->frame_is_up_to_date());

    sink->set_ticking(false);
    clock->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(3000));
    sink->set_ticking(true);
    EXPECT(sink->is_catching_up());
    EXPECT(!sink->frame_is_up_to_date());

    producer->append_output(nullptr, Media::PipelineStatus::Blocked);
    producer->wake();
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    EXPECT(!sink->is_catching_up());
    EXPECT(sink->frame_is_up_to_date());
    EXPECT_EQ(sink->current_frame()->timestamp(), AK::Duration::zero());
}

// A sink that stops ticking dispatches its input's statuses directly, which can overtake a status that an earlier update
// left to be dispatched later. The later one must not report the earlier checkpoint after the newer one.
TEST_CASE(deferred_status_does_not_report_an_older_checkpoint)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto clock = MUST(Media::MonotonicMediaClock::try_create());
    auto sink = MUST(Media::DisplayingVideoSink::try_create(clock->time_reader()));
    Vector<Media::PipelineCheckpoint> dispatched_checkpoints;
    sink->set_state_change_handler([&](Media::PipelineStatus, Media::PipelineCheckpoint checkpoint) { dispatched_checkpoints.append(checkpoint); });
    auto producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    MUST(sink->connect_input(producer));
    sink->set_ticking(true);
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    dispatched_checkpoints.clear();

    producer->append_output(nullptr, Media::PipelineStatus::Suspended, 1);
    (void)sink->update(MonotonicTime::now());

    sink->set_ticking(false);
    producer->consume();
    producer->append_output(nullptr, Media::PipelineStatus::Suspended, 2);
    producer->wake();
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    EXPECT_EQ(dispatched_checkpoints, Vector<Media::PipelineCheckpoint> { 2 });
}

#include <AK/NonnullOwnPtr.h>

TEST_CASE(blocks_outside_the_sample_rate_range_are_refused)
{
    auto push_block_at_sample_rate = [](u32 sample_rate) {
        auto converter = MUST(Media::FFmpeg::FFmpegAudioConverter::try_create());
        MUST(converter->set_output_sample_specification(Audio::SampleSpecification { 48'000, Audio::ChannelMap::stereo() }));
        Media::AudioBlock block;
        block.initialize(Audio::SampleSpecification { sample_rate, Audio::ChannelMap::stereo() }, 0, 1024);
        return converter->push_block(block);
    };

    EXPECT(!push_block_at_sample_rate(Media::MIN_AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE).is_error());
    EXPECT(!push_block_at_sample_rate(Media::MAX_AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE).is_error());
    EXPECT(push_block_at_sample_rate(1).is_error());
    EXPECT(push_block_at_sample_rate(Media::MAX_AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE + 1).is_error());
}

TEST_CASE(output_specifications_outside_the_sample_rate_range_are_refused)
{
    auto set_output_sample_rate = [](u32 sample_rate) {
        auto converter = MUST(Media::FFmpeg::FFmpegAudioConverter::try_create());
        return converter->set_output_sample_specification(Audio::SampleSpecification { sample_rate, Audio::ChannelMap::stereo() });
    };

    EXPECT(!set_output_sample_rate(Media::MIN_AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE).is_error());
    EXPECT(!set_output_sample_rate(Media::MAX_AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE).is_error());

    EXPECT(set_output_sample_rate(Media::MAX_AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE + 1).is_error());
}

TEST_CASE(top_side_speakers_are_ffmpegs_top_side_channels)
{
    auto channel_map = Audio::ChannelMap(
        Audio::Channel::FrontLeft,
        Audio::Channel::FrontRight,
        Audio::Channel::FrontCenter,
        Audio::Channel::LowFrequency,
        Audio::Channel::BackLeft,
        Audio::Channel::BackRight,
        Audio::Channel::TopSideLeft,
        Audio::Channel::TopSideRight);
    auto layout = MUST(Media::FFmpeg::FFmpegChannelLayout::from_channel_map(Media::FFmpeg::FFmpegFunctions::bundled(), channel_map));
    EXPECT_EQ(layout.layout().order, AV_CHANNEL_ORDER_NATIVE);
    if (layout.layout().order != AV_CHANNEL_ORDER_NATIVE)
        return;
    EXPECT_EQ(layout.layout().u.mask, AV_CH_LAYOUT_5POINT1_BACK | AV_CH_TOP_SIDE_LEFT | AV_CH_TOP_SIDE_RIGHT);
    EXPECT_EQ(TRY_OR_FAIL(layout.to_channel_map()), channel_map);
}

TEST_CASE(stereo_converts_into_a_layout_with_top_side_speakers)
{
    auto layout_with_top_side_speakers = Audio::ChannelMap(
        Audio::Channel::FrontLeft,
        Audio::Channel::FrontRight,
        Audio::Channel::FrontCenter,
        Audio::Channel::LowFrequency,
        Audio::Channel::BackLeft,
        Audio::Channel::BackRight,
        Audio::Channel::TopSideLeft,
        Audio::Channel::TopSideRight);
    auto converter = MUST(Media::FFmpeg::FFmpegAudioConverter::try_create());
    MUST(converter->set_output_sample_specification(Audio::SampleSpecification { 48'000, layout_with_top_side_speakers }));

    constexpr size_t frame_count = 480;
    constexpr float front_left_sample = 0.5f;
    constexpr float front_right_sample = -0.25f;
    Media::AudioBlock stereo_block;
    stereo_block.initialize(Audio::SampleSpecification { 48'000, Audio::ChannelMap::stereo() }, 0, frame_count);
    for (size_t frame = 0; frame < frame_count; frame++) {
        stereo_block.set_sample(0, frame, front_left_sample);
        stereo_block.set_sample(1, frame, front_right_sample);
    }
    MUST(converter->push_block(stereo_block));

    Media::AudioBlock converted_block;
    MUST(converter->retrieve_block(converted_block));
    EXPECT_EQ(converted_block.sample_specification().channel_map(), layout_with_top_side_speakers);
    EXPECT_EQ(converted_block.frame_count(), frame_count);
    for (size_t frame = 0; frame < converted_block.frame_count(); frame++) {
        EXPECT_APPROXIMATE(converted_block.sample(0, frame), front_left_sample);
        EXPECT_APPROXIMATE(converted_block.sample(1, frame), front_right_sample);
        for (size_t channel = 2; channel < converted_block.channel_count(); channel++)
            EXPECT_EQ(converted_block.sample(channel, frame), 0.0f);
    }
}

TEST_CASE(a_channel_map_ending_in_one_unknown_channel_becomes_a_custom_layout)
{
    auto channel_map = Audio::ChannelMap(Audio::Channel::FrontLeft, Audio::Channel::FrontRight, Audio::Channel::Unknown);
    auto layout = MUST(Media::FFmpeg::FFmpegChannelLayout::from_channel_map(Media::FFmpeg::FFmpegFunctions::bundled(), channel_map));
    EXPECT_EQ(layout.layout().order, AV_CHANNEL_ORDER_CUSTOM);
    EXPECT_EQ(layout.layout().nb_channels, 3);
    if (layout.layout().order != AV_CHANNEL_ORDER_CUSTOM || layout.layout().nb_channels != 3)
        return;
    EXPECT_EQ(layout.layout().u.map[0].id, AV_CHAN_FRONT_LEFT);
    EXPECT_EQ(layout.layout().u.map[1].id, AV_CHAN_FRONT_RIGHT);
    EXPECT_EQ(layout.layout().u.map[2].id, AV_CHAN_UNKNOWN);
}

TEST_CASE(a_conversion_that_failed_to_set_up_fails_again_when_retried)
{
    auto layout_libswresample_refuses = Audio::ChannelMap(Audio::Channel::FrontLeft, Audio::Channel::FrontRight, Audio::Channel::Unknown);
    auto converter = MUST(Media::FFmpeg::FFmpegAudioConverter::try_create());
    MUST(converter->set_output_sample_specification(Audio::SampleSpecification { 48'000, layout_libswresample_refuses }));

    Media::AudioBlock stereo_block;
    stereo_block.initialize(Audio::SampleSpecification { 48'000, Audio::ChannelMap::stereo() }, 0, 480);
    EXPECT(converter->push_block(stereo_block).is_error());
    EXPECT(converter->push_block(stereo_block).is_error());
}

#include <AK/ByteBuffer.h>

TEST_SETUP
{
    Media::install_video_decoders({ Media::hardware_video_decoders(), Media::ffmpeg_video_decoders() });
    Media::install_audio_decoders({ Media::audio_decoders() });

template<typename Integer>
requires(IsIntegral<Integer>)
static void append_little_endian(ByteBuffer& buffer, Integer value)
{
    using Unsigned = MakeUnsigned<Integer>;
    Unsigned unsigned_value = static_cast<Unsigned>(value);
    auto bytes = buffer.must_get_bytes_for_writing(sizeof(Integer));
    for (size_t byte_index = 0; byte_index < sizeof(Integer); ++byte_index)
        bytes[byte_index] = static_cast<u8>(unsigned_value >> (byte_index * 8));
}

template<typename Sample>
requires(IsSigned<Sample>)
static ByteBuffer make_square_wav(size_t sample_count)
{
    constexpr u16 channel_count = 1;
    constexpr u32 sample_rate = 8'000;
    constexpr u16 bits_per_sample = sizeof(Sample) * 8;
    constexpr u16 block_align = channel_count * sizeof(Sample);
    constexpr u32 byte_rate = sample_rate * block_align;

    u32 data_size = static_cast<u32>(sample_count * sizeof(Sample));
    u32 riff_chunk_size = 36 + data_size;

    ByteBuffer buffer;
    buffer.ensure_capacity(44 + data_size);

    buffer.append("RIFF"sv.bytes());
    append_little_endian(buffer, riff_chunk_size);
    buffer.append("WAVE"sv.bytes());

    buffer.append("fmt "sv.bytes());
    append_little_endian(buffer, 16u);
    append_little_endian(buffer, static_cast<u16>(1));
    append_little_endian(buffer, channel_count);
    append_little_endian(buffer, sample_rate);
    append_little_endian(buffer, byte_rate);
    append_little_endian(buffer, block_align);
    append_little_endian(buffer, bits_per_sample);

    buffer.append("data"sv.bytes());
    append_little_endian(buffer, data_size);

    for (size_t sample_index = 0; sample_index < sample_count; ++sample_index) {
        Sample sample = (sample_index % 2 == 0) ? NumericLimits<Sample>::min() : NumericLimits<Sample>::max();
        append_little_endian(buffer, sample);
    }

    return buffer;
}

template<typename Sample>
requires(IsSigned<Sample>)
static void decode_and_expect()
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    constexpr size_t sample_count = 2048;
    auto wav_data = make_square_wav<Sample>(sample_count);
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_from_buffer(wav_data);
    auto demuxer = MUST(Media::WAV::WAVDemuxer::from_stream(stream));

    auto tracks = TRY_OR_FAIL(demuxer->get_tracks_for_type(Media::TrackType::Audio));
    VERIFY(!tracks.is_empty());
    auto producer = TRY_OR_FAIL(Media::DecodedAudioProducer::try_create(loop, demuxer, tracks[0]));

    producer->set_error_handler([&](Media::DecoderError&&) {
        FAIL("An error occurred while decoding generated WAV data.");
    });
    producer->start();

    bool saw_negative_full_scale_sample = false;
    bool saw_positive_peak_sample = false;
    size_t decoded_frame_count = 0;
    bool reached_end_of_stream = false;

    MonotonicTime deadline = MonotonicTime::now_coarse() + AK::Duration::from_seconds(1);
    while (MonotonicTime::now_coarse() < deadline) {
        auto output = producer->peek();
        if (output.status == Media::PipelineStatus::HaveData) {
            auto const& block = *output.block;
            EXPECT(!block.is_empty());
            for (size_t channel = 0; channel < block.channel_count(); ++channel) {
                for (float sample : block.channel_data(channel)) {
                    EXPECT(sample >= -1.0f);
                    if constexpr (sizeof(Sample) >= sizeof(i32))
                        EXPECT(sample <= 1.0f);
                    else
                        EXPECT(sample < 1.0f);
                    if (sample == -1.0f)
                        saw_negative_full_scale_sample = true;
                    if (sample > 0.0f)
                        saw_positive_peak_sample = true;
                }
            }
            decoded_frame_count += block.frame_count();
            producer->consume();
        } else if (output.status == Media::PipelineStatus::EndOfStream) {
            reached_end_of_stream = true;
            break;
        }

        loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    }

    EXPECT(reached_end_of_stream);
    EXPECT_EQ(decoded_frame_count, sample_count);
    EXPECT(saw_negative_full_scale_sample);
    EXPECT(saw_positive_peak_sample);
}

TEST_CASE(signed_16bit_pcm_to_float)
{
    decode_and_expect<i16>();
}

TEST_CASE(signed_32bit_pcm_to_float)
{
    decode_and_expect<i32>();
}
