#include <AK/ScopeGuard.h>
#include <LibGfx/VulkanContext.h>
#include <LibMedia/DemuxerRegistry.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/FFmpeg/FFmpegVulkanVideoDecoder.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/FFmpeg/SystemFFmpeg.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/VideoFrame.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/Vulkan/VulkanVideoDevice.h>
#include <LibPlatformFeatures/ProcessFeatures.h>

#include "TestMediaCommon.h"

namespace {

bool create_process_device()
{
    if (Media::VulkanVideoDevice::the() != nullptr)
        return true;

    // Each suite runs in its own process, so this sets up the process's features once, as VideoDecoderServer would
    // with nothing blocked.
    static auto initialized_process = [] {
        PlatformFeatures::ProcessFeatures::initialize_for_current_process(MUST(PlatformFeatures::ProcessFeatures::from_string(PlatformFeatures::FeatureProcess::VideoDecoderServer,
            "vulkan_video,vulkan_video.bundled_ffmpeg,vulkan_video.bundled_ffmpeg.direct_export,vulkan_video.bundled_ffmpeg.vp9,vulkan_video.bundled_ffmpeg.av1,"
            "vulkan_video.system_ffmpeg,vulkan_video.system_ffmpeg.direct_export,vulkan_video.system_ffmpeg.h264,vulkan_video.system_ffmpeg.h265"sv)));
        Media::FFmpeg::SystemFFmpeg::load();
        return true;
    }();
    (void)initialized_process;

    VkApplicationInfo application_info {};
    application_info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_APPLICATION_INFO;
    application_info.apiVersion = VK_API_VERSION_1_3;
    VkInstanceCreateInfo instance_info {};
    instance_info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_INSTANCE_CREATE_INFO;
    instance_info.pApplicationInfo = &application_info;
    VkInstance instance = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    if (vkCreateInstance(&instance_info, nullptr, &instance) != VK_SUCCESS)
        return false;
    ScopeGuard destroy_instance = [&] { vkDestroyInstance(instance, nullptr); };

    u32 count = 0;
    vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices(instance, &count, nullptr);
    Vector<VkPhysicalDevice> physical_devices;
    physical_devices.resize(count);
    vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices(instance, &count, physical_devices.data());
    for (auto* physical_device : physical_devices) {
        if (!Media::VulkanVideoDevice::create_for_process(Gfx::gpu_device_identity_of(physical_device)).is_error())
            return true;
    }
    return false;
}

struct DecodedFrame {
    AK::Duration timestamp;
    Gfx::Size<u32> size;
};

struct Decoding {
    NonnullOwnPtr<Media::FFmpeg::FFmpegVulkanVideoDecoder> decoder;
    NonnullRefPtr<Media::Demuxer> demuxer;
    Media::Track track;
    mutable size_t accepted_sample_count { 1 };

    Media::DecoderErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<Media::VideoFrame>> next_frame() const
    {
        while (true) {
            auto frame_result = decoder->take_next_output(track.video_data().color_metadata);
            if (!frame_result.is_error() || frame_result.error().category() != Media::DecoderErrorCategory::NeedsMoreInput)
                return frame_result;

            auto sample_result = demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track);
            if (sample_result.is_error()) {
                decoder->signal_end_of_stream();
                continue;
            }
            TRY(decoder->receive_coded_data(sample_result.release_value(), Media::DecodeIntent::Output));
            accepted_sample_count++;
        }
    }

    Media::DecoderError decode_all(Vector<DecodedFrame>& frames) const
    {
        while (true) {
            auto frame_result = next_frame();
            if (frame_result.is_error())
                return frame_result.release_error();
            auto frame = frame_result.release_value();
            frames.append({ frame->timestamp(), frame->size() });
        }
    }
};

Optional<Decoding> open_decoding(StringView path, Media::CodecID codec_id)
{
    if (!create_process_device()) {
        warnln("No Vulkan device can decode video, skipping");
        return {};
    }

    auto file = MUST(Core::File::open(path, Core::File::OpenMode::Read));
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_from_buffer(MUST(file->read_until_eof()));
    auto demuxer = MUST(Media::create_demuxer(stream));
    auto track = MUST(demuxer->get_preferred_track_for_type(Media::TrackType::Video));
    VERIFY(track.has_value());
    MUST(demuxer->create_context_for_track(*track));

    auto first_sample = MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(*track));
    auto start_decoding = [&] -> Media::DecoderErrorOr<NonnullOwnPtr<Media::FFmpeg::FFmpegVulkanVideoDecoder>> {
        auto decoder = TRY(Media::FFmpeg::FFmpegVulkanVideoDecoder::try_create(codec_id, first_sample.new_codec_configuration().value_or({})));
        // Whether the device can decode and export the stream is only known once the first frame negotiates its format.
        TRY(decoder->receive_coded_data(first_sample, Media::DecodeIntent::Output));
        return decoder;
    };
    auto decoder_result = start_decoding();
    if (decoder_result.is_error()) {
        if (decoder_result.error().category() == Media::DecoderErrorCategory::NotImplemented) {
            warnln("No Vulkan decoder for codec {}, skipping: {}", codec_id, decoder_result.error().description());
            return {};
        }
        FAIL(ByteString::formatted("Could not start Vulkan decoding of codec {}: {}", codec_id, decoder_result.error().description()));
        return {};
    }
    return Decoding { decoder_result.release_value(), move(demuxer), track.release_value() };
}

void expect_every_frame_across_a_size_change(StringView path, Media::CodecID codec_id, size_t frame_count, Gfx::Size<u32> first_size, Gfx::Size<u32> second_size)
{
    auto decoding = open_decoding(path, codec_id);
    if (!decoding.has_value())
        return;

    Vector<DecodedFrame> frames;
    auto error = decoding->decode_all(frames);
    EXPECT_EQ(error.category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream);
    EXPECT_EQ(frames.size(), frame_count);

    size_t size_changes = 0;
    for (size_t i = 1; i < frames.size(); i++) {
        EXPECT(frames[i - 1].timestamp < frames[i].timestamp);
        if (frames[i - 1].size != frames[i].size)
            size_changes++;
    }
    EXPECT_EQ(size_changes, 1u);
    if (!frames.is_empty()) {
        EXPECT_EQ(frames.first().size, first_size);
        EXPECT_EQ(frames.last().size, second_size);
    }
}

}

TEST_CASE(vp9_keyframe_size_change_continues_in_a_new_codec_context)
{
    expect_every_frame_across_a_size_change("./vp9_resize.webm"sv, Media::CodecID::VP9, 2, { 320, 240 }, { 640, 480 });
}

TEST_CASE(h264_size_change_keeps_reordered_frames)
{
    expect_every_frame_across_a_size_change("./h264_keyframe_resize.mkv"sv, Media::CodecID::H264, 20, { 320, 240 }, { 160, 120 });
}

TEST_CASE(h265_size_change_keeps_reordered_frames)
{
    expect_every_frame_across_a_size_change("./h265_keyframe_resize.mkv"sv, Media::CodecID::H265, 20, { 320, 240 }, { 256, 160 });
}

TEST_CASE(vp9_inter_frame_size_change_needs_another_decoder)
{
    auto decoding = open_decoding("./vp9_inter_frame_resize.webm"sv, Media::CodecID::VP9);
    if (!decoding.has_value())
        return;

    Vector<DecodedFrame> frames;
    auto error = decoding->decode_all(frames);
    EXPECT_EQ(error.category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::NotImplemented);
    // The keyframe decodes, and the inter-frame after it changes the size.
    EXPECT_EQ(decoding->accepted_sample_count, 1u);
    for (auto const& frame : frames)
        EXPECT_EQ(frame.size, Gfx::Size<u32>(1280, 720));
}

// A quality switch can start a sequence with larger frames, which FFmpeg does not renegotiate while the pixel format stays
// the same.
TEST_CASE(av1_sequence_with_larger_frames_continues_in_a_new_codec_context)
{
    auto decoding = open_decoding("./av1_sequence_size_increase.webm"sv, Media::CodecID::AV1);
    if (!decoding.has_value())
        return;

    Vector<DecodedFrame> frames;
    while (true) {
        auto frame_result = decoding->next_frame();
        if (frame_result.is_error()) {
            EXPECT_EQ(frame_result.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream);
            break;
        }
        auto frame = frame_result.release_value();
        auto surface = frame->surface();
        EXPECT(surface);
        if (surface) {
            EXPECT(frame->width() <= static_cast<u32>(surface->size().width()));
            EXPECT(frame->height() <= static_cast<u32>(surface->size().height()));
        }
        frames.append({ frame->timestamp(), frame->size() });
    }

    EXPECT_EQ(frames.size(), 12u);
    if (frames.size() == 12) {
        EXPECT_EQ(frames.first().size, Gfx::Size<u32>(320, 240));
        EXPECT_EQ(frames.last().size, Gfx::Size<u32>(640, 480));
    }
}

// The file's mastering display and content light levels are only in metadata OBUs, which must survive the copy of a frame
// made for export.
TEST_CASE(frames_carry_the_high_dynamic_range_metadata_in_their_bitstream)
{
    auto decoding = open_decoding("./av1_hdr_metadata_in_webm.webm"sv, Media::CodecID::AV1);
    if (!decoding.has_value())
        return;

    auto frame = MUST(decoding->next_frame());
    auto const& color_metadata = frame->color_metadata();
    EXPECT(color_metadata.content_light_level_information.has_value());
    if (color_metadata.content_light_level_information.has_value()) {
        EXPECT_EQ(color_metadata.content_light_level_information->maximum_content_light_level, 1005);
        EXPECT_EQ(color_metadata.content_light_level_information->maximum_frame_average_light_level, 315);
    }
    EXPECT(color_metadata.mastering_display_color_volume.has_value());
    if (color_metadata.mastering_display_color_volume.has_value())
        EXPECT_APPROXIMATE(color_metadata.mastering_display_color_volume->maximum_luminance, 1000.0);
}

static void expect_scene_peaks_of_every_frame(StringView path, Span<ExpectedScenePeak const> expected_scene_peaks)
{
    ScenePeakChecker scene_peaks { expected_scene_peaks };
    auto decoding = open_decoding(path, Media::CodecID::H265);
    if (!decoding.has_value())
        return;

    size_t frame_count = 0;
    while (true) {
        auto frame_result = decoding->next_frame();
        if (frame_result.is_error()) {
            EXPECT_EQ(frame_result.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream);
            break;
        }
        auto const& frame = *frame_result.value();
        scene_peaks.check(frame.timestamp(), frame.color_metadata().maximum_scene_luminance);
        frame_count++;
    }
    EXPECT_EQ(frame_count, expected_scene_peaks.size());
    scene_peaks.expect_every_frame_checked();
}

TEST_CASE(h265_frames_carry_their_own_hdr10_plus_scene_peaks)
{
    expect_scene_peaks_of_every_frame("./hevc_hdr10_plus_in_sei.mkv"sv, hevc_hdr10_plus_in_sei_scene_peaks);
}

{
    expect_scene_peaks_of_every_frame("./hevc_dolby_vision_rpus.mkv"sv, hevc_dolby_vision_rpus_scene_peaks);
}

/*

#include <AK/Atomic.h>
#include <LibCore/EventLoop.h>
#include <LibCore/File.h>
#include <LibCore/Timer.h>
#include <LibMedia/Containers/FLAC/FLACDemuxer.h>
#include <LibMedia/DecoderRegistrations.h>

#include <LibMediaCodecs/Limits.h>
#include <LibTest/TestCase.h>

#include "TestMediaCommon.h"
#include "TransientlyAbortingStream.h"

namespace {

TEST_SETUP
{
    Media::install_video_decoders({ Media::hardware_video_decoders(), Media::ffmpeg_video_decoders() });
    Media::install_audio_decoders({ Media::audio_decoders() });
}

// tone.flac: 48 kHz stereo, 84 frames of 4608 samples with a last frame of 1536, no seek table.
constexpr u32 TONE_SAMPLE_RATE = 48000;
constexpr u64 TONE_BLOCK_SIZE = 4608;
constexpr u64 TONE_SAMPLE_COUNT = 384000;
constexpr size_t TONE_FRAME_COUNT = 84;

// tone_8000_mono_seekpoints.flac: 8 kHz mono, frames of 4096 samples, a seek point every second.
constexpr u32 SEEKPOINTS_SAMPLE_RATE = 8000;
constexpr u64 SEEKPOINTS_BLOCK_SIZE = 4096;

ByteBuffer read_fixture(StringView path)
{
    auto file = MUST(Core::File::open(path, Core::File::OpenMode::Read));
    return MUST(file->read_until_eof());
}

Media::DecoderErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<Media::Demuxer>> demuxer_for(ByteBuffer const& data)
{
    return Media::FLAC::FLACDemuxer::from_stream(Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_from_buffer(data));
}

Media::Track audio_track(Media::Demuxer& demuxer)
{
    auto track = MUST(demuxer.get_preferred_track_for_type(Media::TrackType::Audio));
    VERIFY(track.has_value());
    MUST(demuxer.create_context_for_track(*track));
    return *track;
}

AK::Duration time_of_sample(u64 sample, u32 sample_rate = TONE_SAMPLE_RATE)
{
    return AK::Duration::from_time_units(static_cast<i64>(sample), 1, sample_rate);
}

struct FrameIdentity {
    AK::Duration timestamp;
    size_t byte_count { 0 };
    bool operator==(FrameIdentity const&) const = default;
};

Vector<FrameIdentity> read_every_frame(Media::Demuxer& demuxer, Media::Track const& track)
{
    Vector<FrameIdentity> frames;
    while (true) {
        auto frame = demuxer.get_next_sample_for_track(track);
        if (frame.is_error()) {
            EXPECT_EQ(frame.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream);
            break;
        }
        frames.append({ frame.value().presentation_timestamp(), frame.value().data().size() });
    }
    return frames;
}

Vector<Media::FLAC::FrameHeader> frame_headers_of(ByteBuffer const& data)
{
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_from_buffer(data);
    auto reader = MUST(Media::FLAC::Reader::from_stream(stream->create_cursor()));
    Media::FLAC::FrameIterator iterator { stream->create_cursor(), reader.frame_sync(), reader.first_frame_position(), Media::FLAC::FrameIterator::Resynchronize::No };
    Vector<Media::FLAC::FrameHeader> headers;
    while (true) {
        auto frame = iterator.read_next_frame();
        if (frame.is_error())
            break;
        headers.append(frame.value().header);
    }
    return headers;
}

TEST_CASE(demuxer_describes_the_only_track_of_the_stream)
{
    auto demuxer = MUST(demuxer_for(read_fixture("buffered-ranges/tone.flac"sv)));

    EXPECT(MUST(demuxer->get_tracks_for_type(Media::TrackType::Video)).is_empty());

    auto tracks = MUST(demuxer->get_tracks_for_type(Media::TrackType::Audio));
    EXPECT_EQ(tracks.size(), 1u);
    EXPECT_EQ(tracks[0].audio_data().sample_specification.sample_rate(), TONE_SAMPLE_RATE);
    EXPECT_EQ(tracks[0].audio_data().sample_specification.channel_map(), Audio::ChannelMap::stereo());
    EXPECT_EQ(tracks[0].parsed_codec().codec_id(), Media::CodecID::FLAC);

    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(demuxer->total_duration()), AK::Duration::from_seconds(8));
}

TEST_CASE(demuxer_reads_every_frame_with_its_sample_number)
{
    auto demuxer = MUST(demuxer_for(read_fixture("buffered-ranges/tone.flac"sv)));
    auto track = audio_track(*demuxer);

    u64 expected_sample = 0;
    size_t frame_count = 0;
    while (true) {
        auto frame = demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track);
        if (frame.is_error()) {
            EXPECT_EQ(frame.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream);
            break;
        }
        EXPECT_EQ(frame.value().presentation_timestamp(), time_of_sample(expected_sample));
        EXPECT(frame.value().is_keyframe());
        // STREAMINFO states the frame sizes of this stream as 478 to 1303 bytes.
        EXPECT(frame.value().data().size() >= 478 && frame.value().data().size() <= 1303);

        auto const& configuration = frame.value().new_codec_configuration();
        EXPECT_EQ(configuration.has_value(), frame_count == 0);
        if (configuration.has_value()) {
            EXPECT_EQ(configuration->size(), 42u);
            EXPECT(configuration->trim(4) == "fLaC"sv.bytes());
        }

        expected_sample += frame.value().duration().to_time_units(1, TONE_SAMPLE_RATE);
        frame_count++;
    }

    EXPECT_EQ(frame_count, TONE_FRAME_COUNT);
    EXPECT_EQ(expected_sample, TONE_SAMPLE_COUNT);
}

TEST_CASE(demuxer_seeks_to_the_frame_holding_a_timestamp)
{
    auto demuxer = MUST(demuxer_for(read_fixture("buffered-ranges/tone.flac"sv)));
    auto track = audio_track(*demuxer);

    auto expect_seek_to_land_on_frame = [&](AK::Duration target, u64 frame_index) {
        EXPECT_EQ(MUST(demuxer->seek_to_most_recent_keyframe(track, target)), Media::DemuxerSeekResult::MovedPosition);
        auto frame = MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track));
        EXPECT_EQ(frame.presentation_timestamp(), time_of_sample(frame_index * TONE_BLOCK_SIZE));
        EXPECT(frame.presentation_timestamp() <= target);
        EXPECT(frame.presentation_timestamp() + frame.duration() > target);
    };
    expect_seek_to_land_on_frame(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(3'500), 36);
    expect_seek_to_land_on_frame(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(7'990), TONE_FRAME_COUNT - 1);
    expect_seek_to_land_on_frame(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(96), 1);

    MUST(demuxer->seek_to_most_recent_keyframe(track, AK::Duration::from_seconds(10)));
    EXPECT_EQ(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track).error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream);

    MUST(demuxer->seek_to_most_recent_keyframe(track, AK::Duration::zero(), Media::DemuxerSeekOptions::NeedCodecConfiguration));
    auto first_frame = MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track));
    EXPECT_EQ(first_frame.presentation_timestamp(), AK::Duration::zero());
    EXPECT(first_frame.new_codec_configuration().has_value());
}

TEST_CASE(demuxer_seeks_through_the_seek_table)
{
    auto demuxer = MUST(demuxer_for(read_fixture("FLAC/tone_8000_mono_seekpoints.flac"sv)));
    auto track = audio_track(*demuxer);
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(demuxer->total_duration()), AK::Duration::from_seconds(5));

    MUST(demuxer->seek_to_most_recent_keyframe(track, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(3'200)));
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track)).presentation_timestamp(), time_of_sample(6 * SEEKPOINTS_BLOCK_SIZE, SEEKPOINTS_SAMPLE_RATE));

    MUST(demuxer->seek_to_most_recent_keyframe(track, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(4'900)));
    auto last_frame = MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track));
    EXPECT_EQ(last_frame.presentation_timestamp(), time_of_sample(9 * SEEKPOINTS_BLOCK_SIZE, SEEKPOINTS_SAMPLE_RATE));
    EXPECT_EQ(last_frame.presentation_timestamp() + last_frame.duration(), AK::Duration::from_seconds(5));
}

// An aborted read is retried by the next call, which delivers the frame the aborted read was after, so a pass
// interrupted anywhere delivers the same frames as one that was not.
TEST_CASE(demuxer_resumes_an_aborted_read_with_the_frame_it_was_reading)
{
    auto file_data = read_fixture("buffered-ranges/tone.flac"sv);

    Vector<FrameIdentity> expected_frames;
    {
        auto demuxer = MUST(demuxer_for(file_data));
        auto track = audio_track(*demuxer);
        expected_frames = read_every_frame(*demuxer, track);
    }

    // The data ends inside a frame, so the read that blocks has part of its frame.
    auto initial_chunk_size = (file_data.size() / 3) + 1000;
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_empty();
    stream->set_expected_size(file_data.size());
    stream->add_chunk_at(0, file_data.bytes().trim(initial_chunk_size));

    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA auto demuxer = MUST(Media::FLAC::FLACDemuxer::from_stream(stream));
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA auto track = audio_track(*demuxer);

    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<bool> read_blocked { false };
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<bool> read_was_aborted { false };
    demuxer->set_read_blocked_change_handler_for_track(track, [&](Media::ReadBlocked blocked) {
        read_blocked = blocked == Media::ReadBlocked::Yes;
    });

    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Vector<FrameIdentity> actual_frames;
    auto reader_thread = Threading::Thread::construct("TestReader"sv, [&]() -> intptr_t {
        while (true) {
            auto frame = demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track);
            if (frame.is_error()) {
                EXPECT_EQ(frame.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::Aborted);
                break;
            }
            actual_frames.append({ frame.value().presentation_timestamp(), frame.value().data().size() });
        }
        // Like a producer, the reading thread allows reads again before it reads on.
        demuxer->reset_blocking_reads_aborted_for_track(track);
        read_was_aborted = true;
        actual_frames.extend(read_every_frame(*demuxer, track));
        return 0;
    });
    reader_thread->start();

    while (!read_blocked.load()) { }
    demuxer->set_blocking_reads_aborted_for_track(track);
    while (!read_was_aborted.load()) { }

    stream->add_chunk_at(initial_chunk_size, file_data.bytes().slice(initial_chunk_size));
    stream->close();
    MUST(reader_thread->join());

    EXPECT_EQ(actual_frames.size(), expected_frames.size());
    for (size_t index = 0; index < min(actual_frames.size(), expected_frames.size()); index++) {
        if (actual_frames[index] != expected_frames[index]) {
            FAIL(ByteString::formatted("Frame {} differs after the abort: {}ms/{} bytes instead of {}ms/{} bytes", index, actual_frames[index].timestamp.to_milliseconds(), actual_frames[index].byte_count, expected_frames[index].timestamp.to_milliseconds(), expected_frames[index].byte_count));
            break;
        }
    }
}

// An abort that is reset before the reading thread looks at it still has to leave the frame it cut short to be read.
TEST_CASE(demuxer_resumes_after_a_transient_abort)
{
    auto file_data = read_fixture("buffered-ranges/tone.flac"sv);
    auto headers = frame_headers_of(file_data);
    VERIFY(headers.size() > 40);

    Vector<FrameIdentity> expected_frames;
    {
        auto demuxer = MUST(demuxer_for(file_data));
        auto track = audio_track(*demuxer);
        expected_frames = read_every_frame(*demuxer, track);
    }

    auto stream = TransientlyAbortingStream::create(file_data, headers[40].position);
    auto demuxer = MUST(Media::FLAC::FLACDemuxer::from_stream(stream));
    auto track = audio_track(*demuxer);

    Vector<FrameIdentity> actual_frames;
    size_t aborted_read_count = 0;
    while (true) {
        auto frame = demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track);
        if (frame.is_error()) {
            if (frame.error().category() != Media::DecoderErrorCategory::Aborted) {
                EXPECT_EQ(frame.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream);
                break;
            }
            aborted_read_count++;
            continue;
        }
        actual_frames.append({ frame.value().presentation_timestamp(), frame.value().data().size() });
    }
    EXPECT(stream->has_aborted_a_read());
    EXPECT_EQ(aborted_read_count, 1u);
    EXPECT_EQ(actual_frames, expected_frames);
}

// A frame whose body is damaged is still delivered, since the frame after it is where its header says. A frame whose
// header is damaged is lost, and the frame before it runs on to the next header.
TEST_CASE(demuxer_reads_on_past_damaged_frames)
{
    auto file_data = read_fixture("buffered-ranges/tone.flac"sv);
    auto headers = frame_headers_of(file_data);
    EXPECT_EQ(headers.size(), TONE_FRAME_COUNT);

    auto damaged_body_start = headers[10].position + headers[10].byte_size + 50;
    file_data.bytes().slice(damaged_body_start, 100).fill(0);
    file_data.bytes().slice(headers[20].position, 4).fill(0);

    auto demuxer = MUST(demuxer_for(file_data));
    auto track = audio_track(*demuxer);
    auto frames = read_every_frame(*demuxer, track);

    EXPECT_EQ(frames.size(), TONE_FRAME_COUNT - 1);
    size_t index = 0;
    for (u64 frame_index = 0; frame_index < TONE_FRAME_COUNT; frame_index++) {
        if (frame_index == 20)
            continue;
        if (index < frames.size())
            EXPECT_EQ(frames[index].timestamp, time_of_sample(frame_index * TONE_BLOCK_SIZE));
        index++;
    }
}

TEST_CASE(demuxer_skips_the_tags_around_a_stream)
{
    auto plain_data = read_fixture("buffered-ranges/tone.flac"sv);
    Vector<FrameIdentity> expected_frames;
    {
        auto demuxer = MUST(demuxer_for(plain_data));
        auto track = audio_track(*demuxer);
        expected_frames = read_every_frame(*demuxer, track);
    }

    // An ID3v2 tag of 100 bytes ahead of the stream, and an ID3v1 tag after it.
    ByteBuffer tagged_data;
    MUST(tagged_data.try_append(Array<u8, 10> { 'I', 'D', '3', 3, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 100 }.span()));
    MUST(tagged_data.try_resize(tagged_data.size() + 100));
    MUST(tagged_data.try_append(plain_data.bytes()));
    MUST(tagged_data.try_append("TAG"sv.bytes()));
    MUST(tagged_data.try_resize(tagged_data.size() + 125));

    auto demuxer = MUST(demuxer_for(tagged_data));
    auto track = audio_track(*demuxer);
    EXPECT_EQ(read_every_frame(*demuxer, track), expected_frames);
}

TEST_CASE(demuxer_declines_what_it_cannot_read)
{
    auto not_flac = demuxer_for(MUST(ByteBuffer::create_zeroed(4096)));
    EXPECT_EQ(not_flac.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::UnrecognizedFormat);

    ByteBuffer padding_first;
    MUST(padding_first.try_append("fLaC"sv.bytes()));
    MUST(padding_first.try_append(Array<u8, 4> { 0x81, 0, 0, 10 }.span()));
    MUST(padding_first.try_resize(padding_first.size() + 10));
    EXPECT_EQ(demuxer_for(padding_first).error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::Corrupted);

    ByteBuffer marker_only;
    MUST(marker_only.try_append("fLaC"sv.bytes()));
    EXPECT(demuxer_for(marker_only).is_error());
}

TEST_CASE(demuxer_refuses_sample_rates_outside_the_supported_range)
{
    auto with_sample_rate = [](u32 sample_rate) {
        // The sample rate is the first 20 bits after STREAMINFO's block and frame sizes.
        static constexpr size_t sample_rate_offset = 8 + 10;
        auto data = read_fixture("buffered-ranges/tone.flac"sv);
        data[sample_rate_offset] = static_cast<u8>(sample_rate >> 12);
        data[sample_rate_offset + 1] = static_cast<u8>(sample_rate >> 4);
        data[sample_rate_offset + 2] = static_cast<u8>(((sample_rate & 0xF) << 4) | (data[sample_rate_offset + 2] & 0xF));
        return data;
    };

    EXPECT(!demuxer_for(with_sample_rate(Media::MIN_AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE)).is_error());
    EXPECT(!demuxer_for(with_sample_rate(Media::MAX_AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE)).is_error());

    auto too_slow = demuxer_for(with_sample_rate(Media::MIN_AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE - 1));
    EXPECT_EQ(too_slow.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::NotImplemented);
    auto too_fast = demuxer_for(with_sample_rate(Media::MAX_AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE + 1));
    EXPECT_EQ(too_fast.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::NotImplemented);
}

TEST_CASE(demuxer_grows_the_duration_of_a_stream_that_does_not_state_its_length)
{
    auto file_data = read_fixture("buffered-ranges/tone.flac"sv);
    // The total sample count is the 36 bits that end STREAMINFO's fixed fields, 8 bytes into the stream.
    file_data[8 + 13] &= 0xF0;
    file_data.bytes().slice(8 + 14, 4).fill(0);

    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();
    auto demuxer = MUST(demuxer_for(file_data));
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(demuxer->total_duration()), AK::Duration::zero());

    demuxer->set_scan_state_change_handler([](auto const&) { });
    auto deadline_expired = false;
    auto deadline_timer = Core::Timer::create_single_shot(AK::Duration::from_seconds(1), [&] { deadline_expired = true; });
    deadline_timer->start();
    loop.spin_until([&] { return demuxer->scan_state().duration == AK::Duration::from_seconds(8) || deadline_expired; });
    demuxer->set_scan_state_change_handler(nullptr);
    EXPECT_EQ(demuxer->scan_state().duration, AK::Duration::from_seconds(8));

    auto track = audio_track(*demuxer);
    EXPECT_EQ(read_every_frame(*demuxer, track).size(), TONE_FRAME_COUNT);
}

// Over a network, a probe that lands past the target starts a request from an earlier position, so a seek into
// data that is not buffered should land before the target with as few probes as the stream's layout allows, then
// walk forward. This stream's first half is silence in tiny frames and its second half noise in large ones, so
// interpolating between the stream's ends overshoots a target in the first half by seconds. Only the metadata and
// the first frame are buffered, so that no scanned frame narrows the probing down.
TEST_CASE(demuxer_seeks_into_unbuffered_data_with_few_requests)
{
    auto file_data = read_fixture("FLAC/silence_then_noise_8000_mono.flac"sv);
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    constexpr size_t head_size = 100;
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_empty();
    stream->set_expected_size(file_data.size());
    stream->add_chunk_at(0, file_data.bytes().trim(head_size));

    // Answer each request with everything from its offset to the end, so that only the seek's reads decide which
    // requests are made.
    Vector<u64> requested_offsets;
    stream->set_data_request_callback([&](Optional<u64> offset) {
        if (!offset.has_value())
            return;
        requested_offsets.append(offset.value());
        stream->add_chunk_at(offset.value(), file_data.bytes().slice(offset.value()));
    });

    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA auto demuxer = MUST(Media::FLAC::FLACDemuxer::from_stream(stream));
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA auto track = audio_track(*demuxer);

    // The player stopped the fetch once its buffer was full and lets it go again for the seek, so every read of
    // data that is not buffered asks for a request from its own position.
    stream->set_may_idle(true);
    stream->set_may_idle(false);

    // 2.5 seconds falls in frame 4, well inside the silence.
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA auto target = AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(2'500);
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA AK::Duration landed_timestamp;
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<bool> seek_finished { false };
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA auto main_thread_event_loop = Core::EventLoop::current_weak();
    auto seeker_thread = Threading::Thread::construct("TestSeeker"sv, [&]() -> intptr_t {
        MUST(demuxer->seek_to_most_recent_keyframe(track, target));
        landed_timestamp = MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track)).presentation_timestamp();
        seek_finished = true;
        if (auto event_loop = main_thread_event_loop->take())
            event_loop->wake();
        return 0;
    });
    seeker_thread->start();

    auto deadline_expired = false;
    auto deadline_timer = Core::Timer::create_single_shot(AK::Duration::from_seconds(5), [&] { deadline_expired = true; });
    deadline_timer->start();
    loop.spin_until([&] { return seek_finished.load() || deadline_expired; });
    if (deadline_expired)
        FAIL(ByteString::formatted("The seek did not finish after requests at {}", requested_offsets));
    stream->set_data_request_callback(nullptr);
    if (!deadline_expired)
        MUST(seeker_thread->join());

    EXPECT_EQ(landed_timestamp, time_of_sample(4 * SEEKPOINTS_BLOCK_SIZE, SEEKPOINTS_SAMPLE_RATE));
    // One probe overshoots into the noise, and one step back by the noise's byte rate lands at the head.
    EXPECT_EQ(requested_offsets.size(), 2u);
}

// A header that nothing follows within a frame's reach was not a header, so the stream ends rather than delivering
// everything after it as one frame.
TEST_CASE(demuxer_gives_up_on_a_frame_that_never_ends)
{
    auto file_data = read_fixture("buffered-ranges/tone.flac"sv);
    auto first_header = frame_headers_of(file_data)[0];

    auto headerless_data = MUST(ByteBuffer::copy(file_data.bytes().trim(first_header.position + first_header.byte_size)));
    MUST(headerless_data.try_resize(headerless_data.size() + (5 * MiB), ByteBuffer::ZeroFillNewElements::Yes));

    auto demuxer = MUST(demuxer_for(headerless_data));
    auto track = audio_track(*demuxer);
    EXPECT(read_every_frame(*demuxer, track).is_empty());
}

TEST_CASE(demuxer_reads_no_more_of_a_seek_table_than_it_can_use)
{
    auto file_data = read_fixture("buffered-ranges/tone.flac"sv);
    auto headers = frame_headers_of(file_data);
    auto first_frame_position = headers[0].position;

    // The stream's STREAMINFO, then a seek table of 70,000 points of which only the first 84 are real, then its frames.
    constexpr size_t seek_point_count = 70'000;
    ByteBuffer tabled_data;
    MUST(tabled_data.try_append(file_data.bytes().trim(4 + 4 + 34)));
    tabled_data[4] = 0x00;
    u32 table_size = seek_point_count * 18;
    MUST(tabled_data.try_append(Array<u8, 4> { 0x83, static_cast<u8>(table_size >> 16), static_cast<u8>(table_size >> 8), static_cast<u8>(table_size) }.span()));
    for (size_t index = 0; index < seek_point_count; index++) {
        u64 sample_number = NumericLimits<u64>::max();
        u64 byte_offset = 0;
        if (index < headers.size()) {
            sample_number = headers[index].sample_number;
            byte_offset = headers[index].position - first_frame_position;
        }
        MUST(tabled_data.try_append(Array<u8, 18> { static_cast<u8>(sample_number >> 56), static_cast<u8>(sample_number >> 48), static_cast<u8>(sample_number >> 40), static_cast<u8>(sample_number >> 32), static_cast<u8>(sample_number >> 24), static_cast<u8>(sample_number >> 16), static_cast<u8>(sample_number >> 8), static_cast<u8>(sample_number), static_cast<u8>(byte_offset >> 56), static_cast<u8>(byte_offset >> 48), static_cast<u8>(byte_offset >> 40), static_cast<u8>(byte_offset >> 32), static_cast<u8>(byte_offset >> 24), static_cast<u8>(byte_offset >> 16), static_cast<u8>(byte_offset >> 8), static_cast<u8>(byte_offset), 0x12, 0x00 }.span()));
    }
    MUST(tabled_data.try_append(file_data.bytes().slice(first_frame_position)));

    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_from_buffer(tabled_data);
    auto reader = MUST(Media::FLAC::Reader::from_stream(stream->create_cursor()));
    EXPECT_EQ(reader.seek_points().size(), headers.size());

    auto demuxer = MUST(Media::FLAC::FLACDemuxer::from_stream(stream));
    auto track = audio_track(*demuxer);
    MUST(demuxer->seek_to_most_recent_keyframe(track, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(3'500)));
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track)).presentation_timestamp(), time_of_sample(36 * TONE_BLOCK_SIZE));
}

TEST_CASE(demuxer_feeds_a_decoder_to_the_end)

    decode_audio("buffered-ranges/tone.flac"sv, TONE_SAMPLE_RATE, 2, TONE_SAMPLE_COUNT);
    decode_audio("FLAC/tone_8000_mono_seekpoints.flac"sv, SEEKPOINTS_SAMPLE_RATE, 1, 40000);

FILE: Tests/LibMedia/TestFrameScanTimeline.cpp
/*

#include <AK/ScopeGuard.h>
#include <LibMedia/Containers/FrameScanTimeline.h>
#include <LibMedia/IncrementallyPopulatedStream.h>
#include <LibTest/TestCase.h>

// A stream of fixed-size frames, so that a byte position and a timestamp convert to each other by
// arithmetic the test can state outright. Only reading a frame consults the stream, so what a scan
// can reach is decided by which bytes have arrived, the way it is for a real container.
namespace {

constexpr size_t FRAME_BYTE_SIZE = 100;
constexpr size_t FRAME_COUNT = 1000;
constexpr size_t FILE_BYTE_SIZE = FRAME_BYTE_SIZE * FRAME_COUNT;

// Frames within these bytes carry twice the time for the same size, so that a test can give a
// stream a rate that differs from what the rest of it would predict.
struct DoubledFrameBytes {
    size_t start { 0 };
    size_t end { 0 };
};
Optional<DoubledFrameBytes> s_doubled_frame_bytes;

// Bytes within these hold no frames, the way a tag can sit between two concatenated streams or after
// the audio. Reading a frame among them finds the first one after them, as a resynchronizing reader
// does once it has read through them.
struct NonFrameBytes {
    size_t start { 0 };
    size_t end { 0 };

    bool contains(size_t position) const { return position >= start && position < end; }
};
Optional<NonFrameBytes> s_non_frame_bytes;

bool is_non_frame_byte(size_t position)
{
    return s_non_frame_bytes.has_value() && s_non_frame_bytes->contains(position);
}

// Runs while a seek resolves its frame boundary, standing in for the blocking read that brings the
// bytes around the target into the stream, and for the scan thread running in the meantime.
Function<void(size_t target_byte)> s_on_resync;

// Runs when the seek cursor reads a frame that has not arrived, standing in for a blocking read
// waiting for its bytes.
Media::MediaStreamCursor* s_blocking_cursor { nullptr };
Function<void(size_t position)> s_on_blocked_read;

// What a real resync reads: a chunk back from the target and the frames that verify a boundary.
constexpr size_t RESYNC_BYTES_BEFORE_TARGET = 4096;
constexpr size_t RESYNC_BYTES_AFTER_TARGET = 400;

class FixedSizeFrames final : public Media::FrameScanSource {
public:
    virtual Media::DecoderErrorOr<Optional<Frame>> next_frame(Media::MediaStreamCursor& cursor, size_t position) const override
    {
        auto bytes_are_readable = [&](size_t start, size_t end) {
            if (cursor.seek(start, AK::SeekMode::SetPosition).is_error())
                return false;
            auto data = cursor.read_bytes(end - start);
            return !data.is_error() && data.value().size() == end - start;
        };
        auto whole_frame_is_readable = [&] { return bytes_are_readable(position, position + FRAME_BYTE_SIZE); };

        if (is_non_frame_byte(position)) {
            if (!bytes_are_readable(position, s_non_frame_bytes->end))
                return Optional<Frame> {};
            position = s_non_frame_bytes->end;
        }

        auto readable = whole_frame_is_readable();
        if (!readable && &cursor == s_blocking_cursor && s_on_blocked_read) {
            s_on_blocked_read(position);
            readable = whole_frame_is_readable();
        }
        if (!readable)
            return Optional<Frame> {};

        auto sample_count = 1152u;
        if (s_doubled_frame_bytes.has_value() && position >= s_doubled_frame_bytes->start && position < s_doubled_frame_bytes->end)
            sample_count *= 2;
        return Frame { position, FRAME_BYTE_SIZE, Media::SampleDuration { sample_count, 48000 } };
    }

    virtual Media::DecoderErrorOr<Optional<size_t>> find_boundary_at_or_after(Media::MediaStreamCursor&, size_t start_byte, size_t upper_bound) const override
    {
        auto boundary = (start_byte + FRAME_BYTE_SIZE - 1) / FRAME_BYTE_SIZE * FRAME_BYTE_SIZE;
        if (is_non_frame_byte(boundary))
            boundary = s_non_frame_bytes->end;
        if (boundary + FRAME_BYTE_SIZE > upper_bound)
            return Optional<size_t> {};
        return boundary;
    }

    virtual Media::DecoderErrorOr<Optional<size_t>> find_boundary_at_or_before(Media::MediaStreamCursor&, size_t target_byte, size_t lower_bound, size_t upper_bound) const override
    {
        if (s_on_resync)
            s_on_resync(target_byte);

        auto boundary = min(target_byte, upper_bound) / FRAME_BYTE_SIZE * FRAME_BYTE_SIZE;
        while (boundary + FRAME_BYTE_SIZE > upper_bound && boundary >= FRAME_BYTE_SIZE)
            boundary -= FRAME_BYTE_SIZE;
        if (is_non_frame_byte(boundary))
            boundary = s_non_frame_bytes->start - FRAME_BYTE_SIZE;
        if (boundary < lower_bound)
            return Optional<size_t> {};
        return boundary;
    }
};

struct Fixture {
    Fixture(AK::Duration duration, Media::DurationSource duration_source = Media::DurationSource::Estimated, Optional<size_t> declared_byte_count = {}, size_t file_byte_size = FILE_BYTE_SIZE)
        : file_byte_size(file_byte_size)
        , stream(Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_empty())
        , scan_cursor(stream->create_cursor())
        , seek_cursor(stream->create_cursor())
        , timeline(make<FixedSizeFrames>(), 0, duration, duration_source, declared_byte_count)
    {
        stream->set_expected_size(file_byte_size);
        scan_cursor->set_is_blocking(false);
        seek_cursor->set_is_blocking(false);

        s_blocking_cursor = seek_cursor.ptr();
        s_on_resync = [this](size_t target_byte) {
            arrive(target_byte - min(target_byte, RESYNC_BYTES_BEFORE_TARGET), min(target_byte + RESYNC_BYTES_AFTER_TARGET, this->file_byte_size));
        };
        s_on_blocked_read = [this](size_t position) {
            if (position + FRAME_BYTE_SIZE <= this->file_byte_size)
                arrive(position, position + FRAME_BYTE_SIZE);
        };
    }

    ~Fixture()
    {
        s_blocking_cursor = nullptr;
        s_on_resync = nullptr;
        s_on_blocked_read = nullptr;
    }

    void arrive(size_t start, size_t end)
    {
        auto bytes = MUST(ByteBuffer::create_zeroed(end - start));
        stream->add_chunk_at(start, bytes.bytes());
    }

    Media::TimeRanges scan()
    {
        return timeline.buffered_time_ranges(scan_cursor, stream->available_byte_ranges(), file_byte_size).time_ranges;
    }

    Media::SeekedPosition seek_to(AK::Duration timestamp)
    {
        return MUST(timeline.seek_to_timestamp(scan_cursor, seek_cursor, *stream, timestamp));
    }

    size_t file_byte_size { FILE_BYTE_SIZE };
    NonnullRefPtr<Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream> stream;
    NonnullRefPtr<Media::MediaStreamCursor> scan_cursor;
    NonnullRefPtr<Media::MediaStreamCursor> seek_cursor;
    Media::FrameScanTimeline timeline;
};

void expect_range(Media::TimeRanges const& ranges, size_t index, i64 start_milliseconds, i64 end_milliseconds)
{
    EXPECT(index < ranges.size());
    if (index >= ranges.size())
        return;
    EXPECT_EQ(ranges[index].start, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(start_milliseconds));
    EXPECT_EQ(ranges[index].end, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(end_milliseconds));
}

void expect_same_range(Media::TimeRanges const& ranges, size_t index, Media::TimeRanges const& expected_ranges, size_t expected_index)
{
    EXPECT(index < ranges.size() && expected_index < expected_ranges.size());
    if (index >= ranges.size() || expected_index >= expected_ranges.size())
        return;
    EXPECT_EQ(ranges[index].start, expected_ranges[expected_index].start);
    EXPECT_EQ(ranges[index].end, expected_ranges[expected_index].end);
}

}

TEST_CASE(a_range_the_scan_creates_is_placed_at_the_rate_walked_before_it)
{
    // The stream is 24 seconds long, but only 2 were estimated from its first frames.
    Fixture fixture { AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(2'000) };
    fixture.arrive(0, 10'000);
    fixture.arrive(50'000, 60'000);

    // The 10000 walked bytes carry 2.4 seconds, so the 40000 bytes of the gap are given 9.6.
    auto ranges = fixture.scan();
    EXPECT_EQ(ranges.size(), 2u);
    expect_range(ranges, 0, 0, 2'400);
    expect_range(ranges, 1, 12'000, 14'400);
    EXPECT_EQ(fixture.timeline.duration(), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(24'000));
}

TEST_CASE(a_range_keeps_its_start_while_it_grows)
{
    // The second half of the stream carries twice the time per byte, so that growing the second
    // range would move it if what it is worth were measured against itself.
    s_doubled_frame_bytes = DoubledFrameBytes { 50'000, FILE_BYTE_SIZE };
    ScopeGuard restore_stream_shape { [] { s_doubled_frame_bytes = {}; } };

    Fixture fixture { AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(2'000) };
    fixture.arrive(0, 10'000);
    fixture.arrive(50'000, 60'000);
    auto before_growth = fixture.scan();
    expect_range(before_growth, 1, 12'000, 16'800);

    fixture.arrive(60'000, 70'000);
    auto after_growth = fixture.scan();
    EXPECT_EQ(after_growth.size(), 2u);
    expect_range(after_growth, 1, 12'000, 21'600);
}

TEST_CASE(a_duration_never_falls_below_the_frames_that_were_walked)
{
    Fixture fixture { AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(2'000) };
    fixture.arrive(0, 10'000);
    fixture.arrive(50'000, 60'000);
    auto ranges = fixture.scan();
    EXPECT(fixture.timeline.duration() >= ranges[ranges.size() - 1].end);

    // The frames that reached furthest into the stream are gone, but what is left was still walked.
    fixture.stream->remove_byte_range(50'000, 60'000);
    auto remaining = fixture.scan();
    EXPECT(fixture.timeline.duration() >= remaining[remaining.size() - 1].end);
}

TEST_CASE(a_seek_into_a_gap_lands_between_the_ranges_around_it)
{
    s_doubled_frame_bytes = DoubledFrameBytes { 50'000, FILE_BYTE_SIZE };
    ScopeGuard restore_stream_shape { [] { s_doubled_frame_bytes = {}; } };

    Fixture fixture { AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(2'000) };
    fixture.arrive(0, 10'000);
    fixture.arrive(50'000, 60'000);
    auto ranges = fixture.scan();
    EXPECT_EQ(ranges.size(), 2u);

    auto seeked = fixture.seek_to(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(8'000));
    EXPECT(seeked.timestamp > ranges[0].end);
    EXPECT(seeked.timestamp < ranges[1].start);
}

TEST_CASE(a_seek_into_a_gap_hours_long_lands_on_the_line_through_it)
{
    // Ten hours of frames, whose byte and tick spans multiply past what 64 bits can hold.
    Fixture fixture { AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(2'000), Media::DurationSource::Estimated, {}, 150'000'000 };
    fixture.arrive(0, 10'000);
    fixture.scan();
    EXPECT_EQ(fixture.timeline.duration(), AK::Duration::from_seconds(36'000));

    auto seeked = fixture.seek_to(AK::Duration::from_seconds(18'000));
    EXPECT_EQ(seeked.byte_position, 75'000'000);
    EXPECT_EQ(seeked.timestamp, AK::Duration::from_seconds(18'000));
}

TEST_CASE(a_seek_lands_on_the_frame_the_arriving_bytes_put_under_its_target)
{
    s_doubled_frame_bytes = DoubledFrameBytes { 50'000, FILE_BYTE_SIZE };
    ScopeGuard restore_stream_shape { [] { s_doubled_frame_bytes = {}; } };

    Fixture fixture { AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(24'000) };
    fixture.arrive(0, 60'000);
    fixture.scan();

    // Resolving the boundary reads backwards from its estimate, so bytes arrive from before the
    // target. The range they form starts on the line, and its frames carry more than the line gave
    // them, so the target falls a frame or two before the estimated byte.
    s_on_resync = [&fixture](size_t target_byte) { fixture.arrive(target_byte - 300, FILE_BYTE_SIZE); };

    auto seeked = fixture.seek_to(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(22'800));
    EXPECT_EQ(seeked.byte_position, 81'300);
    EXPECT_EQ(seeked.timestamp, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(22'784));

    auto ranges = fixture.scan();
    EXPECT_EQ(ranges.size(), 2u);
    expect_range(ranges, 1, 22'736, 31'760);
}

TEST_CASE(seeking_twice_to_the_same_timestamp_lands_on_the_same_byte)
{
    s_doubled_frame_bytes = DoubledFrameBytes { 50'000, FILE_BYTE_SIZE };
    ScopeGuard restore_stream_shape { [] { s_doubled_frame_bytes = {}; } };

    Fixture fixture { AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(24'000) };
    fixture.arrive(0, 60'000);
    fixture.scan();

    s_on_resync = [&fixture](size_t target_byte) { fixture.arrive(target_byte - 300, FILE_BYTE_SIZE); };

    // A seek is dispatched on both mouse down and mouse up, so the same target has to resolve to
    // the same byte even though the first one moved what the timeline knows.
    auto target = AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(22'800);
    auto first = fixture.seek_to(target);
    fixture.scan();

    auto second = fixture.seek_to(target);
    EXPECT_EQ(second.byte_position, first.byte_position);
    EXPECT_EQ(second.timestamp, first.timestamp);
}

TEST_CASE(seeking_forward_into_a_gap_moves_no_other_range)
{
    Fixture fixture { AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(2'000) };
    fixture.arrive(0, 10'000);
    fixture.arrive(50'000, 60'000);
    fixture.scan();

    auto seeked = fixture.seek_to(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(20'000));
    EXPECT_EQ(seeked.byte_position, 83'300);
    EXPECT_EQ(seeked.timestamp, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(19'992));

    fixture.arrive(83'300, 90'000);
    auto ranges = fixture.scan();
    EXPECT_EQ(ranges.size(), 3u);
    expect_range(ranges, 0, 0, 2'400);
    expect_range(ranges, 1, 12'000, 14'400);
    expect_range(ranges, 2, 19'032, 21'600);
    EXPECT_EQ(fixture.timeline.duration(), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(24'000));

    seeked = fixture.seek_to(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(8'000));
    EXPECT_EQ(seeked.byte_position, 33'300);
    EXPECT_EQ(seeked.timestamp, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(7'992));

    fixture.arrive(33'300, 40'000);
    ranges = fixture.scan();
    EXPECT_EQ(ranges.size(), 4u);
    expect_range(ranges, 0, 0, 2'400);
    expect_range(ranges, 1, 7'032, 9'600);
    expect_range(ranges, 2, 12'000, 14'400);
    expect_range(ranges, 3, 19'032, 21'600);
    EXPECT_EQ(fixture.timeline.duration(), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(24'000));
}

TEST_CASE(seeking_backward_into_a_gap_moves_no_other_range)
{
    Fixture fixture { AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(2'000) };
    fixture.arrive(0, 10'000);
    fixture.scan();

    // Buffer from near the end to the end of the stream, then seek back before it.
    auto seeked = fixture.seek_to(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(20'000));
    fixture.arrive(static_cast<size_t>(seeked.byte_position), FILE_BYTE_SIZE);
    auto before_seek = fixture.scan();
    EXPECT_EQ(before_seek.size(), 2u);
    expect_range(before_seek, 1, 19'032, 24'000);
    auto duration_before_seek = fixture.timeline.duration();

    seeked = fixture.seek_to(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(10'000));
    EXPECT(seeked.timestamp > before_seek[0].end);
    EXPECT(seeked.timestamp < before_seek[1].start);

    fixture.arrive(static_cast<size_t>(seeked.byte_position), static_cast<size_t>(seeked.byte_position) + 5'000);
    auto after_seek = fixture.scan();
    EXPECT_EQ(after_seek.size(), 3u);
    expect_same_range(after_seek, 0, before_seek, 0);
    expect_same_range(after_seek, 2, before_seek, 1);
    EXPECT_EQ(fixture.timeline.duration(), duration_before_seek);
}

TEST_CASE(a_seek_lands_on_the_walked_frame_when_the_range_behind_reaches_it)
{
    // The bytes the resync waits for run from the end of the playing range up to the target, so
    // that range walks through the target and places it by its frames rather than by the line.
    s_doubled_frame_bytes = DoubledFrameBytes { 11'000, 20'000 };
    ScopeGuard restore_stream_shape { [] { s_doubled_frame_bytes = {}; } };

    Fixture fixture { AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(2'000) };
    fixture.arrive(0, 10'000);
    fixture.scan();

    s_on_resync = [&fixture](size_t) { fixture.arrive(10'000, 20'000); };

    auto seeked = fixture.seek_to(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(3'000));
    EXPECT_EQ(seeked.byte_position, 11'700);
    EXPECT_EQ(seeked.timestamp, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(2'976));

    auto ranges = fixture.scan();
    EXPECT_EQ(ranges.size(), 1u);
    expect_range(ranges, 0, 0, 6'960);

    auto again = fixture.seek_to(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(3'000));
    EXPECT_EQ(again.byte_position, seeked.byte_position);
    EXPECT_EQ(again.timestamp, seeked.timestamp);
}

TEST_CASE(a_seek_landing_just_before_a_range_forms_a_range_up_to_it)
{
    Fixture fixture { AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(2'000) };
    fixture.arrive(0, 10'000);
    fixture.scan();

    auto seeked = fixture.seek_to(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(20'000));
    fixture.arrive(static_cast<size_t>(seeked.byte_position), 90'000);
    auto ranges = fixture.scan();
    expect_range(ranges, 1, 19'032, 21'600);

    // The resync reads back from a target just before that range, so its bytes join the range's
    // without a range of their own. They get one, and the seek lands within it rather than reading
    // the whole gap from the first range.
    seeked = fixture.seek_to(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(19'000));
    EXPECT_EQ(seeked.byte_position, 79'100);
    EXPECT_EQ(seeked.timestamp, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(18'984));

    ranges = fixture.scan();
    EXPECT_EQ(ranges.size(), 2u);
    expect_range(ranges, 0, 0, 2'400);
    expect_range(ranges, 1, 18'024, 21'600);
}

TEST_CASE(a_seek_waits_for_the_frame_spanning_its_target)
{
    // The walked frames carry twice the time of the gap's, so the line places the target earlier in
    // the gap than its frames do, and the bytes the resync brought in end before the frame spanning
    // it. The seek reads on until it reaches that frame, and a later seek finds the same one.
    s_doubled_frame_bytes = DoubledFrameBytes { 0, 60'000 };
    ScopeGuard restore_stream_shape { [] { s_doubled_frame_bytes = {}; } };

    Fixture fixture { AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(2'000) };
    fixture.arrive(0, 60'000);
    fixture.scan();

    s_on_resync = [&fixture](size_t target_byte) { fixture.arrive(target_byte - 300, target_byte + 100); };
    s_on_blocked_read = [&fixture](size_t position) { fixture.arrive(position, position + FRAME_BYTE_SIZE); };

    auto target = AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(40'000);
    auto first = fixture.seek_to(target);
    EXPECT_EQ(first.byte_position, 83'500);
    EXPECT_EQ(first.timestamp, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(39'984));

    fixture.scan();
    auto second = fixture.seek_to(target);
    EXPECT_EQ(second.byte_position, first.byte_position);
    EXPECT_EQ(second.timestamp, first.timestamp);
}

TEST_CASE(bytes_arriving_behind_a_seek_are_still_walked)
{
    Fixture fixture { AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(2'000) };
    fixture.arrive(0, 10'000);
    fixture.scan();

    auto seeked = fixture.seek_to(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(20'000));
    fixture.arrive(static_cast<size_t>(seeked.byte_position), 90'000);

    // Bytes still in flight for the range that was playing arrive after the seek.
    fixture.arrive(10'000, 20'000);
    auto ranges = fixture.scan();
    EXPECT_EQ(ranges.size(), 2u);
    expect_range(ranges, 0, 0, 4'800);
    expect_range(ranges, 1, 19'032, 21'600);
}

TEST_CASE(an_estimated_duration_extrapolates_the_tail_from_walked_frames)
{
    s_doubled_frame_bytes = DoubledFrameBytes { 0, FILE_BYTE_SIZE };
    ScopeGuard restore_stream_shape { [] { s_doubled_frame_bytes = {}; } };

    Fixture fixture { AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(2'000) };
    fixture.arrive(0, 10'000);
    fixture.scan();
    EXPECT_EQ(fixture.timeline.duration(), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(48'000));
}

TEST_CASE(an_estimated_duration_follows_its_anchor_back_down)
{
    // The first frames carry twice the time of the rest, so the anchor is placed at 48 seconds
    // before the rest of the stream shows it belongs at 39.
    s_doubled_frame_bytes = DoubledFrameBytes { 0, 10'000 };
    ScopeGuard restore_stream_shape { [] { s_doubled_frame_bytes = {}; } };

    Fixture fixture { AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(2'000) };
    fixture.arrive(0, 10'000);
    fixture.scan();
    EXPECT_EQ(fixture.timeline.duration(), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(48'000));

    auto seeked = fixture.seek_to(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(30'000));
    EXPECT_EQ(seeked.byte_position, 66'500);
    EXPECT_EQ(seeked.timestamp, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(30'000));

    // Walking the rest of the stream disproves the anchor, so the length follows it down.
    fixture.arrive(62'500, FILE_BYTE_SIZE);
    auto ranges = fixture.scan();
    expect_range(ranges, 1, 28'080, 38'040);
    EXPECT_EQ(fixture.timeline.duration(), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(38'040));

    // A timestamp past everything the stream holds still lands on its end.
    seeked = fixture.seek_to(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(45'000));
    EXPECT_EQ(seeked.byte_position, static_cast<i64>(FILE_BYTE_SIZE));
    EXPECT_EQ(seeked.timestamp, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(38'040));
}

TEST_CASE(a_seek_among_the_bytes_after_the_last_frame_lands_where_the_frames_end)
{
    // The anchor gives the bytes after the last frame time, but no frame can be found among them, so
    // the seek walks on from the last frame it knows of and finds nothing more.
    s_non_frame_bytes = NonFrameBytes { FILE_BYTE_SIZE - 200, FILE_BYTE_SIZE };
    ScopeGuard restore_stream_shape { [] { s_non_frame_bytes = {}; } };

    Fixture fixture { AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(2'000) };
    fixture.arrive(0, FILE_BYTE_SIZE);
    auto ranges = fixture.scan();
    EXPECT_EQ(ranges.size(), 1u);
    expect_range(ranges, 0, 0, 23'952);
    EXPECT_EQ(fixture.timeline.duration(), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(24'000));

    auto seeked = fixture.seek_to(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(23'980));
    EXPECT_EQ(seeked.byte_position, 99'800);
    EXPECT_EQ(seeked.timestamp, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(23'952));

    seeked = fixture.seek_to(fixture.timeline.duration());
    EXPECT_EQ(seeked.byte_position, 99'800);
    EXPECT_EQ(seeked.timestamp, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(23'952));
}

TEST_CASE(a_range_reaches_the_next_across_bytes_that_hold_no_frames)
{
    // Once the bytes between the two ranges arrive, the first walks through the ones holding no frames
    // to the second, which moves back by the time the gap had given them.
    s_non_frame_bytes = NonFrameBytes { 40'000, 50'000 };
    ScopeGuard restore_stream_shape { [] { s_non_frame_bytes = {}; } };

    Fixture fixture { AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(2'000) };
    fixture.arrive(0, 10'000);
    fixture.arrive(45'000, 60'000);
    auto ranges = fixture.scan();
    EXPECT_EQ(ranges.size(), 2u);
    expect_range(ranges, 0, 0, 2'400);
    expect_range(ranges, 1, 12'000, 14'400);

    fixture.arrive(10'000, 45'000);
    ranges = fixture.scan();
    EXPECT_EQ(ranges.size(), 1u);
    expect_range(ranges, 0, 0, 12'000);
}

TEST_CASE(a_declared_duration_is_never_extrapolated)
{
    s_doubled_frame_bytes = DoubledFrameBytes { 0, FILE_BYTE_SIZE };
    ScopeGuard restore_stream_shape { [] { s_doubled_frame_bytes = {}; } };

    Fixture fixture { AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(24'000), Media::DurationSource::Declared };
    fixture.arrive(0, 10'000);
    fixture.scan();
    EXPECT_EQ(fixture.timeline.duration(), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(24'000));

    // A seek past the declared duration lands at the end of the stream.
    auto seeked = fixture.seek_to(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(30'000));
    EXPECT_EQ(seeked.byte_position, static_cast<i64>(FILE_BYTE_SIZE));
}

TEST_CASE(a_declared_duration_rises_to_walked_frames_that_pass_it)
{
    s_doubled_frame_bytes = DoubledFrameBytes { 0, FILE_BYTE_SIZE };
    ScopeGuard restore_stream_shape { [] { s_doubled_frame_bytes = {}; } };

    Fixture fixture { AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(2'000), Media::DurationSource::Declared };
    fixture.arrive(0, 10'000);
    fixture.scan();
    EXPECT_EQ(fixture.timeline.duration(), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(4'800));
}

TEST_CASE(a_declared_duration_describes_only_the_bytes_it_declares)
{
    // The first frames carry twice the declared average, so a rate walked from them would misplace
    // the gap, and the declared duration covers only the first half of the file.
    s_doubled_frame_bytes = DoubledFrameBytes { 0, 10'000 };
    ScopeGuard restore_stream_shape { [] { s_doubled_frame_bytes = {}; } };

    Fixture fixture { AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(12'000), Media::DurationSource::Declared, 50'000 };
    fixture.arrive(0, 10'000);
    fixture.scan();

    // The bytes past the declared stream are given the declared average as well.
    EXPECT_EQ(fixture.timeline.duration(), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(24'000));

    auto seeked = fixture.seek_to(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(6'000));
    EXPECT_EQ(seeked.byte_position, 15'000);
    EXPECT_EQ(seeked.timestamp, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(6'000));
}

TEST_CASE(a_range_growing_into_the_next_absorbs_it)
{
    // The first frames carry twice the time of the rest, so the gap after them is given more
    // time than its bytes turn out to carry, and the range past it drifts back as they are walked.
    s_doubled_frame_bytes = DoubledFrameBytes { 0, 10'000 };
    ScopeGuard restore_stream_shape { [] { s_doubled_frame_bytes = {}; } };

    Fixture fixture { AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(2'000) };
    fixture.arrive(0, 10'000);
    fixture.scan();
    fixture.arrive(50'000, 60'000);
    auto ranges = fixture.scan();
    expect_range(ranges, 0, 0, 4'800);
    expect_range(ranges, 1, 24'000, 26'400);

    fixture.arrive(10'000, 30'000);
    ranges = fixture.scan();
    expect_range(ranges, 0, 0, 9'600);
    expect_range(ranges, 1, 16'000, 18'400);

    fixture.arrive(30'000, 50'000);
    ranges = fixture.scan();
    EXPECT_EQ(ranges.size(), 1u);
    expect_range(ranges, 0, 0, 16'800);
    EXPECT_EQ(fixture.timeline.duration(), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(28'000));
}

TEST_CASE(a_range_ahead_drifts_with_the_rate_the_range_behind_it_walks)
{
    // The bytes right after the first range carry twice the time the rate before them predicted.
    s_doubled_frame_bytes = DoubledFrameBytes { 10'000, 20'000 };
    ScopeGuard restore_stream_shape { [] { s_doubled_frame_bytes = {}; } };

    Fixture fixture { AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(2'000) };
    fixture.arrive(0, 10'000);
    fixture.scan();
    fixture.arrive(50'000, 60'000);
    auto ranges = fixture.scan();
    expect_range(ranges, 1, 12'000, 14'400);

    fixture.arrive(10'000, 20'000);
    ranges = fixture.scan();
    EXPECT_EQ(ranges.size(), 2u);
    expect_range(ranges, 0, 0, 7'200);
    expect_range(ranges, 1, 18'000, 20'400);

    fixture.arrive(20'000, 40'000);
    ranges = fixture.scan();
    EXPECT_EQ(ranges.size(), 2u);
    expect_range(ranges, 0, 0, 12'000);
    expect_range(ranges, 1, 15'000, 17'400);

    fixture.arrive(40'000, 50'000);
    ranges = fixture.scan();
    EXPECT_EQ(ranges.size(), 1u);
    expect_range(ranges, 0, 0, 16'800);

    // The duration reached 33.2 seconds while the range ahead sat furthest out, and comes back in
    // with it as the frames between them are walked.
    EXPECT_EQ(fixture.timeline.duration(), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(28'000));
}

TEST_CASE(a_declared_rate_too_large_for_the_timeline_gives_its_gaps_no_time)
{
    // A stream declaring 95 years of media within a single byte would scale every gap past the range the
    // timeline can hold, so the gaps are given no time rather than overflowing.
    Fixture fixture { AK::Duration::from_seconds(3'000'000'000), Media::DurationSource::Declared, 1 };
    fixture.arrive(0, FRAME_BYTE_SIZE * 4);
    fixture.scan();

    auto seeked = fixture.seek_to(AK::Duration::from_seconds(1));
    EXPECT(seeked.byte_position >= 0);
    EXPECT(static_cast<size_t>(seeked.byte_position) <= FILE_BYTE_SIZE);
}

#include <LibMedia/Containers/ISOBMFF/ISOBMFFDemuxer.h>
#include <LibMedia/Demuxer.h>
#include <LibMedia/DemuxerRegistry.h>
#include <LibMedia/IncrementallyPopulatedStream.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/FFmpeg/FFmpegVideoDecoder.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/FFmpeg/SystemFFmpeg.h>

#include "TestMediaCommon.h"

// H.264 is left out of the bundled FFmpeg, so these run against whatever system libavcodec decodes it.
static Media::FFmpeg::SystemFFmpeg const* h264_library()
{
    Media::FFmpeg::SystemFFmpeg::load();
    auto const* library = Media::FFmpeg::SystemFFmpeg::the();
    if (library == nullptr || !library->has_decoder(Media::CodecID::H264)) {
        warnln("No system FFmpeg decodes H.264, skipping");
        return nullptr;
    }
    return library;
}

TEST_CASE(avc_in_matroska)
{
    auto const* library = h264_library();
    if (library == nullptr)
        return;
    decode_video("./avc_in_matroska.mkv"sv, 50, [&](Media::Matroska::TrackEntry const& track) -> NonnullOwnPtr<Media::VideoDecoder> {
        return MUST(Media::FFmpeg::FFmpegVideoDecoder::try_create(library->functions(), Media::CodecID::H264, track.codec_private_data()));
    });
}

struct DemuxerAndVideoTrack {
    NonnullRefPtr<Media::Demuxer> demuxer;
    Media::Track track;
};

static DemuxerAndVideoTrack create_demuxer_and_video_track(StringView path)
{
    auto file = MUST(Core::File::open(path, Core::File::OpenMode::Read));
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_from_buffer(MUST(file->read_until_eof()));
    auto demuxer = MUST(Media::create_demuxer(stream));
    auto track = MUST(demuxer->get_preferred_track_for_type(Media::TrackType::Video));
    VERIFY(track.has_value());
    MUST(demuxer->create_context_for_track(*track));
    return { move(demuxer), track.release_value() };
}

TEST_CASE(h264_configuration_change)
{
    auto const* library = h264_library();
    if (library == nullptr)
        return;

    auto [initial_demuxer, initial_track] = create_demuxer_and_video_track("./avc.mp4"sv);
    auto initial_sample = MUST(initial_demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(initial_track));
    auto decoder = MUST(Media::FFmpeg::FFmpegVideoDecoder::try_create(library->functions(), initial_sample.codec_id(), initial_sample.new_codec_configuration().value()));

    auto [new_demuxer, new_track] = create_demuxer_and_video_track("./vfr.mkv"sv);

    bool decoded_frame = false;
    while (!decoded_frame) {
        auto sample = MUST(new_demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(new_track));
        MUST(decoder->receive_coded_data(sample, Media::DecodeIntent::Output));

        while (true) {
            auto decoded_frame_result = decoder->take_next_output(new_track.video_data().color_metadata);
            if (decoded_frame_result.is_error()) {
                EXPECT_EQ(decoded_frame_result.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::NeedsMoreInput);
                break;
            }
            EXPECT_EQ(decoded_frame_result.value()->size(), Gfx::Size<u32>(1280, 720));
            decoded_frame = true;
        }
    }
}

TEST_CASE(avc_in_mp4_with_reordered_frames)
{
    auto const* library = h264_library();
    if (library == nullptr)
        return;

    auto file = MUST(Core::File::open("./avc.mp4"sv, Core::File::OpenMode::Read));
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_from_buffer(MUST(file->read_until_eof()));
    auto demuxer = MUST(Media::ISOBMFF::ISOBMFFDemuxer::from_stream(stream));
    auto optional_track = MUST(demuxer->get_preferred_track_for_type(Media::TrackType::Video));
    VERIFY(optional_track.has_value());
    auto track = optional_track.release_value();
    MUST(demuxer->create_context_for_track(track));

    auto first_sample = MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track));
    auto decoder = MUST(Media::FFmpeg::FFmpegVideoDecoder::try_create(library->functions(), first_sample.codec_id(), first_sample.new_codec_configuration().value()));
    MUST(decoder->receive_coded_data(first_sample, Media::DecodeIntent::Output));

    size_t frame_count = 0;
    auto last_timestamp = AK::Duration::min();

    auto take_decoded_frame = [&]() -> Media::DecoderErrorOr<void> {
        auto decoded_frame = TRY(decoder->take_next_output(track.video_data().color_metadata));

        EXPECT(last_timestamp <= decoded_frame->timestamp());
        EXPECT(!decoded_frame->duration().is_zero());
        last_timestamp = decoded_frame->timestamp();
        ++frame_count;
        return {};
    };

    while (true) {
        auto sample_result = demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track);
        if (sample_result.is_error()) {
            EXPECT_EQ(sample_result.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream);
            break;
        }

        auto sample = sample_result.release_value();
        EXPECT(!sample.duration().is_zero());

        MUST(decoder->receive_coded_data(sample, Media::DecodeIntent::Output));
        while (true) {
            auto frame_result = take_decoded_frame();
            if (frame_result.is_error()) {
                EXPECT_EQ(frame_result.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::NeedsMoreInput);
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    decoder->signal_end_of_stream();
    while (true) {
        auto frame_result = take_decoded_frame();
        if (frame_result.is_error()) {
            EXPECT_EQ(frame_result.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream);
            break;
        }
    }

    EXPECT_EQ(frame_count, 50u);
}

TEST_CASE(h264_reference_only_frames_are_decoded_but_not_produced)
{
    auto const* library = h264_library();
    if (library == nullptr)
        return;

    auto [demuxer, track] = create_demuxer_and_video_track("./avc.mp4"sv);

    auto first_sample = MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track));
    auto decoder = MUST(Media::FFmpeg::FFmpegVideoDecoder::try_create(library->functions(), first_sample.codec_id(), first_sample.new_codec_configuration().value()));

    Vector<AK::Duration> presented_timestamps;
    auto drain = [&] {
        while (true) {
            auto decoded_frame_result = decoder->take_next_output(track.video_data().color_metadata);
            if (decoded_frame_result.is_error())
                return;
            presented_timestamps.append(decoded_frame_result.value()->timestamp());
        }
    };

    // Only the last of these frames is wanted for display; the rest are decoded so it has something to reference.
    static constexpr size_t REFERENCE_ONLY_SAMPLE_COUNT = 8;
    MUST(decoder->receive_coded_data(first_sample, Media::DecodeIntent::Reference));
    drain();
    for (size_t index = 1; index < REFERENCE_ONLY_SAMPLE_COUNT; index++) {
        auto sample = MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track));
        MUST(decoder->receive_coded_data(sample, Media::DecodeIntent::Reference));
        drain();
    }

    auto wanted_sample = MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track));
    auto wanted_timestamp = wanted_sample.presentation_timestamp();
    MUST(decoder->receive_coded_data(wanted_sample, Media::DecodeIntent::Output));
    decoder->signal_end_of_stream();
    drain();

    EXPECT_EQ(presented_timestamps.size(), 1u);
    EXPECT_EQ(presented_timestamps.first(), wanted_timestamp);
}

FILE: Tests/LibMedia/TestH265Decode.cpp
/*

#include <LibMedia/DemuxerRegistry.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/FFmpeg/FFmpegVideoDecoder.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/FFmpeg/SystemFFmpeg.h>

#include "TestMediaCommon.h"

// H.265 is left out of the bundled FFmpeg, so these run against whatever system libavcodec decodes it.
static Media::FFmpeg::SystemFFmpeg const* h265_library()
{
    Media::FFmpeg::SystemFFmpeg::load();
    auto const* library = Media::FFmpeg::SystemFFmpeg::the();
    if (library == nullptr || !library->has_decoder(Media::CodecID::H265)) {
        warnln("No system FFmpeg decodes H.265, skipping");
        return nullptr;
    }
    return library;
}

static size_t for_each_frame(Media::FFmpeg::SystemFFmpeg const& library, StringView path, Function<void(Media::VideoFrame const&)> callback)
{
    auto file = MUST(Core::File::open(path, Core::File::OpenMode::Read));
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_from_buffer(MUST(file->read_until_eof()));
    auto demuxer = MUST(Media::create_demuxer(stream));
    auto track = MUST(demuxer->get_preferred_track_for_type(Media::TrackType::Video));
    VERIFY(track.has_value());
    MUST(demuxer->create_context_for_track(*track));

    auto first_sample = MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(*track));
    auto decoder = MUST(Media::FFmpeg::FFmpegVideoDecoder::try_create(library.functions(), Media::CodecID::H265, first_sample.new_codec_configuration().value_or({})));
    MUST(decoder->receive_coded_data(first_sample, Media::DecodeIntent::Output));

    size_t frame_count = 0;
    while (true) {
        auto frame_result = decoder->take_next_output(track->video_data().color_metadata);
        if (!frame_result.is_error()) {
            callback(*frame_result.value());
            frame_count++;
            continue;
        }
        if (frame_result.error().category() == Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream)
            return frame_count;
        if (frame_result.error().category() != Media::DecoderErrorCategory::NeedsMoreInput) {
            FAIL(ByteString::formatted("Decoding failed: {}", frame_result.error().description()));
            return frame_count;
        }

        auto sample_result = demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(*track);
        if (!sample_result.is_error()) {
            MUST(decoder->receive_coded_data(sample_result.value(), Media::DecodeIntent::Output));
            continue;
        }
        if (sample_result.error().category() != Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream) {
            FAIL(ByteString::formatted("Demuxing failed: {}", sample_result.error().description()));
            return frame_count;
        }
        decoder->signal_end_of_stream();
    }
}

// The file's mastering display and content light levels are only in its SEI, not in its sample entry.
TEST_CASE(h265_frames_carry_the_high_dynamic_range_metadata_in_their_bitstream)
{
    auto const* library = h265_library();
    if (library == nullptr)
        return;

    auto frame_count = for_each_frame(*library, "./hevc_hdr_metadata_in_sei.mp4"sv, [](Media::VideoFrame const& frame) {
        auto const& color_metadata = frame.color_metadata();
        EXPECT(color_metadata.mastering_display_color_volume.has_value());
        if (color_metadata.mastering_display_color_volume.has_value()) {
            EXPECT_APPROXIMATE(color_metadata.mastering_display_color_volume->maximum_luminance, 1000.0);
            EXPECT_APPROXIMATE(color_metadata.mastering_display_color_volume->red.x, 0.68);
        }
        EXPECT(color_metadata.content_light_level_information.has_value());
        if (color_metadata.content_light_level_information.has_value()) {
            EXPECT_EQ(color_metadata.content_light_level_information->maximum_content_light_level, 1000);
            EXPECT_EQ(color_metadata.content_light_level_information->maximum_frame_average_light_level, 400);
        }
    });
    EXPECT_EQ(frame_count, 6u);
}

/*

#include <AK/Array.h>
#include <LibMedia/Containers/ID3.h>
#include <LibTest/TestCase.h>

static Array<u8, 10> version_2_header(u8 version, u8 flags, Array<u8, 4> size)
{
    return { 'I', 'D', '3', version, 0, flags, size[0], size[1], size[2], size[3] };
}

TEST_CASE(version_2_tag_size_covers_the_header_and_its_contents)
{
    auto header = version_2_header(3, 0, { 0, 0, 2, 1 });
    EXPECT_EQ(Media::ID3::version_2_tag_size(header), 10u + 257u);
}

TEST_CASE(version_2_tag_size_includes_the_footer_it_declares)
{
    auto with_footer = version_2_header(4, 0x10, { 0, 0, 0, 20 });
    EXPECT_EQ(Media::ID3::version_2_tag_size(with_footer), 10u + 20u + 10u);

    // The footer only exists from version 4 onwards, so the same flag means nothing before it.
    auto without_footer = version_2_header(3, 0x10, { 0, 0, 0, 20 });
    EXPECT_EQ(Media::ID3::version_2_tag_size(without_footer), 10u + 20u);
}

TEST_CASE(version_2_tag_size_rejects_bytes_that_only_look_like_a_tag)
{
    Array<u8, 10> audio { 0xFF, 0xF1, 0x4C, 0xA0, 0x01, 0xA0, 0x00, 0x21, 0x20, 0x03 };
    EXPECT(!Media::ID3::version_2_tag_size(audio).has_value());

    auto unknown_version = version_2_header(0xFF, 0, { 0, 0, 0, 20 });
    EXPECT(!Media::ID3::version_2_tag_size(unknown_version).has_value());

    // A size byte may not use its most significant bit.
    auto unsynchronized_size = version_2_header(4, 0, { 0, 0, 0x80, 20 });
    EXPECT(!Media::ID3::version_2_tag_size(unsynchronized_size).has_value());

    auto truncated = version_2_header(4, 0, { 0, 0, 0, 20 });
    EXPECT(!Media::ID3::version_2_tag_size(truncated.span().trim(9)).has_value());
}
