static ByteBuffer make_test_data(size_t size)
{
    auto buffer = MUST(ByteBuffer::create_uninitialized(size));
    for (size_t i = 0; i < size; i++)
        buffer[i] = static_cast<u8>(i);
    return buffer;
}

TEST_CASE(create_empty)
{
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_empty();
    EXPECT(!stream->expected_size().has_value());

    stream->set_expected_size(500);
    EXPECT(stream->expected_size().has_value());
    EXPECT_EQ(stream->expected_size().value(), 500u);
}

TEST_CASE(full_file_availability_requires_no_gaps)
{
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_empty();
    EXPECT(!stream->availability().all_bytes_are_available());
    auto data = make_test_data(100);
    stream->set_expected_size(100);
    stream->add_chunk_at(50, data.bytes().slice(50));
    stream->close();
    auto snapshot = stream->availability();
    EXPECT(snapshot.closing_bytes_are_available());
    EXPECT(!snapshot.all_bytes_are_available());

    stream->add_chunk_at(0, data.bytes().slice(0, 50));
    EXPECT(stream->availability().all_bytes_are_available());
    EXPECT(!snapshot.all_bytes_are_available());
    stream->remove_byte_range(20, 30);
    EXPECT(!stream->availability().all_bytes_are_available());
}

TEST_CASE(buffered_scan_reports_completeness_even_if_time_ranges_do_not_change)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_empty();
    auto data = make_test_data(100);
    stream->add_chunk_at(50, data.bytes().slice(50));
    stream->close();

    auto scan = Media::DemuxerScanThread<int>::start(stream, {}, 0, [](auto&, auto&) {
        Media::DemuxerScanState state;
        state.duration = AK::Duration::from_seconds(1);
        return state;
    });
    scan->set_change_handler([] { });
    auto deadline = MonotonicTime::now() + AK::Duration::from_seconds(5);
    while (scan->main_thread_state().duration == AK::Duration::zero() && MonotonicTime::now() < deadline)
        loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    EXPECT_EQ(scan->main_thread_state().duration, AK::Duration::from_seconds(1));
    EXPECT(!scan->main_thread_state().resource_is_complete);

    stream->add_chunk_at(0, data.bytes().slice(0, 50));
    deadline = MonotonicTime::now() + AK::Duration::from_seconds(5);
    while (!scan->main_thread_state().resource_is_complete && MonotonicTime::now() < deadline)
        loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    EXPECT(scan->main_thread_state().resource_is_complete);
    EXPECT(scan->main_thread_state().track_buffered_ranges.is_empty());
    scan->shutdown();
}

TEST_CASE(close_during_buffered_scan_requires_another_pass)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_empty();
    auto data = make_test_data(100);
    stream->add_chunk_at(0, data.bytes());
    auto scan = Media::DemuxerScanThread<int>::start(stream, {}, 0, [stream](Media::MediaStream::Availability const& availability, int& passes) {
        if (++passes == 1)
            stream->close();
        EXPECT_EQ(availability.is_closed, passes > 1);
        Media::DemuxerScanState state;
        state.duration = AK::Duration::from_seconds(passes);
        return state;
    });
    scan->set_change_handler([] { });
    auto deadline = MonotonicTime::now() + AK::Duration::from_seconds(5);
    while (!scan->main_thread_state().resource_is_complete && MonotonicTime::now() < deadline)
        loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    EXPECT(scan->main_thread_state().resource_is_complete);
    EXPECT(scan->main_thread_state().duration >= AK::Duration::from_seconds(2));
    scan->shutdown();
}

TEST_CASE(expected_size_changes_request_buffered_scans)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();
    auto data = make_test_data(100);
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_from_data(data.bytes());
    auto scan = Media::DemuxerScanThread<int>::start(stream, {}, 0, [](Media::MediaStream::Availability const& availability, auto&) {
        Media::DemuxerScanState state;
        state.duration = AK::Duration::from_seconds(availability.expected_size.value());
        state.reached_end_of_stream = availability.closing_bytes_are_available();
        return state;
    });
    scan->set_change_handler([] { });
    auto await_size = [&](u64 size) {
        auto duration = AK::Duration::from_seconds(size);
        auto deadline = MonotonicTime::now() + AK::Duration::from_seconds(5);
        while (scan->main_thread_state().duration != duration && MonotonicTime::now() < deadline)
            loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
        EXPECT_EQ(scan->main_thread_state().duration, duration);
    };
    await_size(100);
    EXPECT(scan->main_thread_state().resource_is_complete);

    stream->set_expected_size(200);
    await_size(200);
    EXPECT(!scan->main_thread_state().resource_is_complete);
    EXPECT(!scan->main_thread_state().reached_end_of_stream);

    stream->set_expected_size(100);
    await_size(100);
    EXPECT(scan->main_thread_state().resource_is_complete);
    EXPECT(scan->main_thread_state().reached_end_of_stream);
    scan->shutdown();
}

TEST_CASE(eviction_during_scan_does_not_change_its_availability_snapshot)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();
    auto data = make_test_data(100);
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_from_data(data.bytes());
    auto scan = Media::DemuxerScanThread<int>::start(stream, {}, 0, [stream](Media::MediaStream::Availability const& availability, int& passes) {
        if (++passes == 1) {
            stream->remove_byte_range(0, 50);
            EXPECT(availability.all_bytes_are_available());
            EXPECT_EQ(availability.byte_ranges.first().start, 0u);
        } else {
            EXPECT(!availability.all_bytes_are_available());
            EXPECT_EQ(availability.byte_ranges.first().start, 50u);
        }
        Media::DemuxerScanState state;
        state.duration = AK::Duration::from_seconds(passes);
        state.reached_end_of_stream = availability.closing_bytes_are_available();
        return state;
    });
    scan->set_change_handler([] { });
    auto deadline = MonotonicTime::now() + AK::Duration::from_seconds(5);
    while (scan->main_thread_state().duration < AK::Duration::from_seconds(2) && MonotonicTime::now() < deadline)
        loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    EXPECT(scan->main_thread_state().duration >= AK::Duration::from_seconds(2));
    EXPECT(!scan->main_thread_state().resource_is_complete);
    EXPECT(scan->main_thread_state().reached_end_of_stream);
    scan->shutdown();
}

TEST_CASE(cursor_seek_modes)
{
    auto data = make_test_data(100);
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_from_data(data.bytes());
    auto cursor = stream->create_cursor();

    EXPECT_EQ(cursor->position(), 0u);
    EXPECT_EQ(cursor->size(), 100u);

    MUST(cursor->seek(50, SeekMode::SetPosition));
    EXPECT_EQ(cursor->position(), 50u);

    MUST(cursor->seek(10, SeekMode::FromCurrentPosition));
    EXPECT_EQ(cursor->position(), 60u);

    MUST(cursor->seek(-10, SeekMode::FromEndPosition));
    EXPECT_EQ(cursor->position(), 90u);
}

TEST_CASE(cursor_read_operations)
{
    auto data = make_test_data(100);
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_from_data(data.bytes());
    auto cursor = stream->create_cursor();

    Array<u8, 10> buffer;
    auto bytes_read = MUST(cursor->read_into(buffer));
    EXPECT_EQ(bytes_read, 10u);
    EXPECT_EQ(cursor->position(), 10u);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < 10; i++)
        EXPECT_EQ(buffer[i], static_cast<u8>(i));

    MUST(cursor->seek(50, SeekMode::SetPosition));
    MUST(cursor->read_into(buffer));
    for (size_t i = 0; i < 10; i++)
        EXPECT_EQ(buffer[i], static_cast<u8>(50 + i));

    MUST(cursor->seek(95, SeekMode::SetPosition));
    bytes_read = MUST(cursor->read_into(buffer));
    EXPECT_EQ(bytes_read, 5u);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < 5; i++)
        EXPECT_EQ(buffer[i], static_cast<u8>(95 + i));

    MUST(cursor->seek(100, SeekMode::SetPosition));
    auto result = cursor->read_into(buffer);
    EXPECT(result.is_error());
    EXPECT_EQ(result.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream);

    MUST(cursor->seek(0, SeekMode::SetPosition));
    bytes_read = MUST(cursor->read_into(buffer.span().trim(0)));
    EXPECT_EQ(bytes_read, 0u);
    EXPECT_EQ(cursor->position(), 0u);

    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(cursor->read_value<u32>()), 0x00010203u);
}

{

    EXPECT_EQ(cursor->position(), 256u);
}

TEST_CASE(cursor_abort_and_reset)
{
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_empty();
    stream->set_expected_size(100);

    auto cursor = stream->create_cursor();

    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<bool> read_blocked { false };
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<bool> read_completed { false };
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<bool> was_aborted { false };

    cursor->set_blocked_change_handler([&](Media::ReadBlocked blocked) {
        read_blocked = blocked == Media::ReadBlocked::Yes;
    });

    EXPECT(!read_blocked.load());

    auto thread = Threading::Thread::construct("TestAbort"sv, [&, cursor]() -> intptr_t {
        Array<u8, 10> buffer;
        auto result = cursor->read_into(buffer);
        read_completed = true;
        was_aborted = result.is_error() && result.error().category() == Media::DecoderErrorCategory::Aborted;
        return 0;
    });

    thread->start();

    while (!read_blocked.load())
        ;
    EXPECT(read_blocked.load());

    cursor->abort();
    MUST(thread->join());

    EXPECT(!read_blocked.load());
    EXPECT(read_completed.load());
    EXPECT(was_aborted.load());

    // After aborting a read, reset_abort() should allow us to read again.
    cursor->reset_abort();
    auto data = make_test_data(100);
    stream->add_chunk_at(0, data.bytes());

    Array<u8, 10> buffer;
    auto result = cursor->read_into(buffer);
    EXPECT(!result.is_error());
    EXPECT_EQ(result.value(), 10u);
}

TEST_CASE(missing_data_made_permanently_unavailable_fails_waiting_reads_only)
{
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_empty();
    stream->set_expected_size(100);
    auto data = make_test_data(50);
    stream->add_chunk_at(0, data.bytes());

    auto waiting_cursor = stream->create_cursor();
    MUST(waiting_cursor->seek(60, AK::SeekMode::SetPosition));

    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<bool> read_blocked { false };
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<bool> was_permanently_unavailable { false };
    waiting_cursor->set_blocked_change_handler([&](Media::ReadBlocked blocked) {
        read_blocked = blocked == Media::ReadBlocked::Yes;
    });

    auto thread = Threading::Thread::construct("TestUnavailableRead"sv, [&, waiting_cursor]() -> intptr_t {
        Array<u8, 10> buffer;
        auto result = waiting_cursor->read_into(buffer);
        was_permanently_unavailable = result.is_error() && result.error().category() == Media::DecoderErrorCategory::PermanentlyUnavailable;
        return 0;
    });
    thread->start();
    while (!read_blocked.load())
        ;

    stream->make_missing_data_permanently_unavailable();
    MUST(thread->join());
    EXPECT(was_permanently_unavailable.load());

    // Later reads of missing data fail the same way instead of waiting.
    Array<u8, 10> buffer;
    auto result = waiting_cursor->read_into(buffer);
    EXPECT(result.is_error());
    EXPECT_EQ(result.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::PermanentlyUnavailable);

    // Data that is already there can still be read, and the stream does not end where that data ends.
    auto cursor = stream->create_cursor();
    auto read_result = cursor->read_into(buffer);
    EXPECT(!read_result.is_error());
    EXPECT_EQ(read_result.value(), 10u);
    EXPECT(!stream->is_closed());
    EXPECT_EQ(stream->expected_size(), 100u);
}

        return 0;

{
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_empty();
    auto data = make_test_data(200);

TEST_CASE(cursor_blocked_change_handler)
{
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_empty();
    stream->set_expected_size(100);

    auto cursor = stream->create_cursor();

    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<u32> blocked_count { 0 };
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<u32> unblocked_count { 0 };
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<bool> last_state { false };
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<bool> read_succeeded { false };

    cursor->set_blocked_change_handler([&](Media::ReadBlocked blocked) {
        last_state = blocked == Media::ReadBlocked::Yes;
        if (blocked == Media::ReadBlocked::Yes)
            blocked_count++;
        else
            unblocked_count++;
    });

    auto thread = Threading::Thread::construct("TestBlockHandler"sv, [&, cursor]() -> intptr_t {
        Array<u8, 10> buffer;
        read_succeeded = !cursor->read_into(buffer).is_error();
        return 0;
    });
    thread->start();

    // The read finds no data and parks, firing the handler with blocked=true exactly once.
    while (blocked_count.load() == 0)
        ;
    EXPECT_EQ(blocked_count.load(), 1u);
    EXPECT_EQ(unblocked_count.load(), 0u);
    EXPECT(last_state.load());

    // Appending the awaited data resumes the read, firing the handler with blocked=false.
    auto data = make_test_data(100);
    stream->add_chunk_at(0, data.bytes());

    MUST(thread->join());
    EXPECT(read_succeeded.load());
    EXPECT_EQ(blocked_count.load(), 1u);
    EXPECT_EQ(unblocked_count.load(), 1u);
    EXPECT(!last_state.load());
}

TEST_CASE(redundant_chunk_within_existing_chunk_at_nonzero_offset)
{
    // Regression test: add_chunk_at used to compare chunk.size() (a relative byte count)
    // against new_chunk_end (an absolute file offset). When the existing chunk started at
    // a non-zero offset, chunk.size() < new_chunk_end even if the new data was fully
    // covered, causing the buffer to be shrunk and data beyond the new chunk's end to be lost.
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_empty();

    constexpr size_t data_size = 200;
    auto data = make_test_data(data_size);

    // Add a chunk at a non-zero offset covering [100, 120).
    stream->add_chunk_at(100, data.bytes().slice(100, 20));

    // Add a redundant chunk fully within [100, 120), specifically [105, 115).
    // With the bug, this shrinks the existing chunk to [100, 115), losing bytes [115, 120).
    stream->add_chunk_at(105, data.bytes().slice(105, 10));

    stream->close();

    auto cursor = stream->create_cursor();
    MUST(cursor->seek(100, SeekMode::SetPosition));

    Array<u8, 20> buffer;
    auto bytes_read = MUST(cursor->read_into(buffer));

    EXPECT_EQ(bytes_read, 20u);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < 20; i++)
        EXPECT_EQ(buffer[i], static_cast<u8>(100 + i));
}

TEST_CASE(remove_byte_range_splits_chunk)
{
    auto data = make_test_data(100);
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_from_data(data.bytes());

    stream->remove_byte_range(30, 70);

    auto ranges = stream->available_byte_ranges();
    EXPECT_EQ(ranges.size(), 2u);
    EXPECT_EQ(ranges[0].start, 0u);
    EXPECT_EQ(ranges[0].end, 30u);
    EXPECT_EQ(ranges[1].start, 70u);
    EXPECT_EQ(ranges[1].end, 100u);

    auto cursor = stream->create_cursor();
    Array<u8, 30> buffer;
    auto bytes_read = MUST(cursor->read_into(buffer));
    EXPECT_EQ(bytes_read, 30u);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < 30; i++)
        EXPECT_EQ(buffer[i], static_cast<u8>(i));

    MUST(cursor->seek(70, SeekMode::SetPosition));
    bytes_read = MUST(cursor->read_into(buffer));
    EXPECT_EQ(bytes_read, 30u);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < 30; i++)
        EXPECT_EQ(buffer[i], static_cast<u8>(70 + i));
}

TEST_CASE(add_three_disjoint_then_connect)
{
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_empty();
    auto data = make_test_data(150);

    stream->add_chunk_at(0, data.bytes().trim(30));
    stream->add_chunk_at(60, data.bytes().slice(60, 30));
    stream->add_chunk_at(120, data.bytes().slice(120));

    auto ranges = stream->available_byte_ranges();
    EXPECT_EQ(ranges.size(), 3u);

    // Connect first and second with a chunk that touches both.
    stream->add_chunk_at(30, data.bytes().slice(30, 30));
    ranges = stream->available_byte_ranges();
    EXPECT_EQ(ranges.size(), 2u);
    EXPECT_EQ(ranges[0].start, 0u);
    EXPECT_EQ(ranges[0].end, 90u);

    // Connect second and third.
    stream->add_chunk_at(90, data.bytes().slice(90, 30));
    ranges = stream->available_byte_ranges();
    EXPECT_EQ(ranges.size(), 1u);
    EXPECT_EQ(ranges[0].start, 0u);
    EXPECT_EQ(ranges[0].end, 150u);
}

TEST_CASE(data_request_callback_invoked)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    // Stream size must be larger than FORWARD_REQUEST_THRESHOLD (1 MiB) to test callback
    static constexpr u64 stream_size = 2 * MiB;
    static constexpr u64 initial_chunk_size = 100;
    static constexpr u64 seek_position = stream_size - 100;

    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_empty();
    stream->set_expected_size(stream_size);

    // Add initial chunk so the callback logic can be triggered
    auto initial_data = make_test_data(initial_chunk_size);
    stream->add_chunk_at(0, initial_data.bytes());

    bool callback_invoked { false };
    u64 requested_offset { 0 };

    stream->set_data_request_callback([&](Optional<u64> offset) {
        auto data = make_test_data(100);
        stream->add_chunk_at(seek_position, data.bytes());
        callback_invoked = true;
        requested_offset = offset.value();
    });

    auto cursor = stream->create_cursor();
    MUST(cursor->seek(seek_position, SeekMode::SetPosition));

    auto thread = Threading::Thread::construct("TestCallback"sv, [cursor]() -> intptr_t {
        Array<u8, 10> buffer;
        MUST(cursor->read_into(buffer));
        return 0;
    });
    thread->start();

    auto start_time = MonotonicTime::now_coarse();
    while (!callback_invoked) {
        loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
        if (MonotonicTime::now_coarse() - start_time > AK::Duration::from_seconds(1))
            break;
    }

    EXPECT(callback_invoked);
    EXPECT(requested_offset >= initial_chunk_size);

    MUST(thread->join());
}

TEST_CASE(close_crossing_a_new_request_keeps_the_end_of_the_closing_fetch)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    static constexpr u64 stream_size = 2 * MiB;
    static constexpr u64 tail_position = stream_size - 100;
    auto data = make_test_data(stream_size);

    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_empty();
    stream->set_expected_size(stream_size);
    stream->add_chunk_at(0, data.bytes().trim(100));

    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Vector<u64> requested_offsets;
    stream->set_data_request_callback([&](Optional<u64> offset) {
        if (!offset.has_value())
            return;
        requested_offsets.append(*offset);
        if (requested_offsets.size() == 1) {
            // The fetch from the requested offset runs to the end of the resource.
            stream->add_chunk_at(*offset, data.bytes().slice(*offset));
            return;
        }
        // The first fetch's close arrives after the stream has already requested data elsewhere.
        stream->close();
        stream->add_chunk_at(*offset, data.bytes().slice(*offset, 200));
    });

    auto read_on_thread = [&](u64 position) {
        IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA auto cursor = stream->create_cursor();
        MUST(cursor->seek(position, SeekMode::SetPosition));
        IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Optional<Media::DecoderErrorOr<size_t>> result;
        IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<bool> finished { false };
        auto thread = Threading::Thread::construct("TestRead"sv, [&]() -> intptr_t {
            Array<u8, 10> buffer;
            result = cursor->read_into(buffer);
            finished = true;
            return 0;
        });
        thread->start();
        auto start_time = MonotonicTime::now_coarse();
        while (!finished && MonotonicTime::now_coarse() - start_time < AK::Duration::from_seconds(1))
            loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
        if (!finished)
            cursor->abort();
        MUST(thread->join());
        return result.release_value();
    };

    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(read_on_thread(tail_position)), 10u);
    EXPECT_EQ(requested_offsets.size(), 1u);

    auto result = read_on_thread(100);
    EXPECT_EQ(requested_offsets.size(), 2u);
    EXPECT(!result.is_error());
    EXPECT_EQ(stream->expected_size().value(), stream_size);
}

TEST_CASE(reading_past_the_end_of_a_chunk_requests_data_for_the_read)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    static constexpr u64 stream_size = 4 * MiB;
    static constexpr u64 gap_position = 3 * MiB;
    auto data = make_test_data(stream_size);

    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_empty();
    stream->set_expected_size(stream_size);
    stream->add_chunk_at(0, data.bytes().trim(100));

    Vector<u64> requested_offsets;
    stream->set_data_request_callback([&](Optional<u64> offset) {
        if (!offset.has_value())
            return;
        requested_offsets.append(*offset);
        // Like a fetch, keep delivering data from the requested offset through the read.
        stream->add_chunk_at(*offset, data.bytes().slice(*offset, gap_position + 200 - *offset));
    });

    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA auto cursor = stream->create_cursor();

    // A read within the chunk decides that nothing needs requesting yet.
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Array<u8, 10> buffer;
    MUST(cursor->read_into(buffer));
    EXPECT(requested_offsets.is_empty());

    // With nothing else changing, a read far past the chunk's end must still ask for its own data.
    MUST(cursor->seek(gap_position, SeekMode::SetPosition));
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Optional<Media::DecoderErrorOr<size_t>> result;
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<bool> finished { false };
    auto thread = Threading::Thread::construct("TestRead"sv, [&]() -> intptr_t {
        result = cursor->read_into(buffer);
        finished = true;
        return 0;
    });
    thread->start();
    auto start_time = MonotonicTime::now_coarse();
    while (!finished && MonotonicTime::now_coarse() - start_time < AK::Duration::from_seconds(1))
        loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    if (!finished)
        cursor->abort();
    MUST(thread->join());

    EXPECT_EQ(requested_offsets.size(), 1u);
    EXPECT(!result->is_error());
    EXPECT_EQ(buffer[0], static_cast<u8>(gap_position));
}

TEST_CASE(chunks_past_the_end_are_dropped_once_closed)
{
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_empty();
    auto data = make_test_data(100);

    stream->add_chunk_at(0, data.bytes());
    stream->close();
    EXPECT_EQ(stream->expected_size().value(), 100u);

    auto extra_data = make_test_data(50);
    stream->add_chunk_at(100, extra_data.bytes());

    auto ranges = stream->available_byte_ranges();
    EXPECT_EQ(ranges.size(), 1u);
    EXPECT_EQ(ranges[0].start, 0u);
    EXPECT_EQ(ranges[0].end, 100u);

    // A chunk straddling the end is cut at the end.
    stream->add_chunk_at(90, extra_data.bytes().trim(20));

    ranges = stream->available_byte_ranges();
    EXPECT_EQ(ranges.size(), 1u);
    EXPECT_EQ(ranges[0].end, 100u);

    auto cursor = stream->create_cursor();
    MUST(cursor->seek(90, SeekMode::SetPosition));

    Array<u8, 10> buffer;
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(cursor->read_into(buffer)), 10u);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < 10; i++)
        EXPECT_EQ(buffer[i], static_cast<u8>(90 + i));

    auto result = cursor->read_into(buffer);
    EXPECT(result.is_error());
    EXPECT_EQ(result.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream);
}

TEST_CASE(chunks_before_the_end_are_accepted_once_closed)
{
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_empty();

    EXPECT_EQ(ranges[0].start, 0u);
    EXPECT_EQ(ranges[0].end, 100u);
    EXPECT_EQ(stream->expected_size().value(), 100u);

    auto cursor = stream->create_cursor();
    Array<u8, 100> buffer;
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(cursor->read_into(buffer)), 100u);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < 100; i++)
        EXPECT_EQ(buffer[i], static_cast<u8>(i));
}

TEST_CASE(idling_stops_the_request_once_no_read_is_waiting)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_empty();
    stream->set_expected_size(100);

    Vector<Optional<u64>> requests;
    stream->set_data_request_callback([&](Optional<u64> offset) {
        requests.append(offset);
    });

    auto cursor = stream->create_cursor();
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<bool> read_blocked { false };
    cursor->set_blocked_change_handler([&](Media::ReadBlocked blocked) {
        read_blocked = blocked == Media::ReadBlocked::Yes;
    });
    auto thread = Threading::Thread::construct("TestIdle"sv, [cursor]() -> intptr_t {
        Array<u8, 10> buffer;
        MUST(cursor->read_into(buffer));
        return 0;
    });
    thread->start();
    while (!read_blocked.load())
        ;

    // The initial fetch keeps going while the read waits on it.
    stream->set_may_idle(true);
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    EXPECT(requests.is_empty());

    auto data = make_test_data(100);
    stream->add_chunk_at(0, data.bytes());
    MUST(thread->join());
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    EXPECT_EQ(requests.size(), 1u);
    EXPECT(!requests[0].has_value());

    // Nothing is waiting, so withdrawing the permission asks for nothing.
    stream->set_may_idle(false);
    stream->set_may_idle(true);
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    EXPECT_EQ(requests.size(), 1u);
}

TEST_CASE(withdrawing_idle_asks_for_the_data_a_read_is_waiting_on)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    static constexpr u64 stream_size = 2 * MiB;
    static constexpr u64 seek_position = stream_size - 100;

    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_empty();
    stream->set_expected_size(stream_size);
    auto initial_data = make_test_data(100);
    stream->add_chunk_at(0, initial_data.bytes());

    Vector<Optional<u64>> requests;
    stream->set_data_request_callback([&](Optional<u64> offset) {
        requests.append(offset);
    });

    stream->set_may_idle(true);
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    EXPECT_EQ(requests.size(), 1u);
    EXPECT(!requests[0].has_value());

    auto cursor = stream->create_cursor();
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<bool> read_blocked { false };
    cursor->set_blocked_change_handler([&](Media::ReadBlocked blocked) {
        read_blocked = blocked == Media::ReadBlocked::Yes;
    });
    MUST(cursor->seek(seek_position, SeekMode::SetPosition));
    auto thread = Threading::Thread::construct("TestWithdraw"sv, [cursor]() -> intptr_t {
        Array<u8, 10> buffer;
        MUST(cursor->read_into(buffer));
        return 0;
    });
    thread->start();
    while (!read_blocked.load())
        ;

    // A read that starts waiting while idle is allowed does not ask for data.
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    EXPECT_EQ(requests.size(), 1u);

    stream->set_may_idle(false);
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    EXPECT_EQ(requests.size(), 2u);
    EXPECT(requests[1].has_value());
    EXPECT(requests[1].value() >= 100u);
    EXPECT(requests[1].value() <= seek_position);

    auto data = make_test_data(100);
    stream->add_chunk_at(seek_position, data.bytes());
    MUST(thread->join());
}

TEST_CASE(a_read_after_idle_is_withdrawn_asks_for_data_when_none_has_arrived)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_empty();
    stream->set_expected_size(100);

    Vector<Optional<u64>> requests;
    stream->set_data_request_callback([&](Optional<u64> offset) {
        requests.append(offset);

    EXPECT_EQ(requests.size(), 1u);
    EXPECT(!requests[0].has_value());

    auto cursor = stream->create_cursor();

    cursor->set_blocked_change_handler([&](Media::ReadBlocked blocked) {

        Array<u8, 10> buffer;

        return 0;
    });

    while (!read_blocked.load())
        ;

    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    EXPECT_EQ(requests.size(), 2u);
    EXPECT_EQ(requests[1], 0u);

    MUST(thread->join());

TEST_CASE(chunk_ending_past_the_representable_size_is_ignored)
{
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_empty();
    stream->set_expected_size(NumericLimits<u64>::max());
    auto data = make_test_data(2);

    stream->add_chunk_at(NumericLimits<u64>::max() - 1, data.bytes());
    EXPECT(stream->availability().byte_ranges.is_empty());

    stream->add_chunk_at(NumericLimits<u64>::max() - 2, data.bytes());
    auto byte_ranges = stream->availability().byte_ranges;
    EXPECT_EQ(byte_ranges.size(), 1u);
    EXPECT_EQ(byte_ranges[0].start, NumericLimits<u64>::max() - 2);
    EXPECT_EQ(byte_ranges[0].end, NumericLimits<u64>::max());
}

TEST_CASE(cursor_rejects_seeks_outside_the_stream)
{
    auto data = make_test_data(10);
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_from_data(data.bytes());
    auto cursor = stream->create_cursor();

    EXPECT(cursor->seek(-1, AK::SeekMode::SetPosition).is_error());
    EXPECT(cursor->seek(-1, AK::SeekMode::FromCurrentPosition).is_error());
    EXPECT(cursor->seek(NumericLimits<i64>::max(), AK::SeekMode::FromEndPosition).is_error());
    EXPECT_EQ(cursor->position(), 0u);

    EXPECT(!cursor->seek(5, AK::SeekMode::SetPosition).is_error());
    EXPECT(!cursor->seek(-2, AK::SeekMode::FromEndPosition).is_error());
    EXPECT_EQ(cursor->position(), 8u);
}

TEST_CASE(read_and_discard_requires_every_byte_in_between)
{
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_empty();
    stream->set_expected_size(100);
    auto data = make_test_data(100);
    stream->add_chunk_at(0, data.bytes().slice(0, 40));
    stream->add_chunk_at(60, data.bytes().slice(60));

    auto cursor = stream->create_cursor();
    cursor->set_is_blocking(false);
    MUST(cursor->seek(30, AK::SeekMode::SetPosition));

    // The landing point is present, but the bytes before it are not.
    auto result = cursor->read_and_discard(35);
    EXPECT(result.is_error());
    EXPECT_EQ(result.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::NeedsMoreInput);
    EXPECT_EQ(cursor->position(), 30u);

    stream->add_chunk_at(40, data.bytes().slice(40, 20));
    MUST(cursor->read_and_discard(35));
    EXPECT_EQ(cursor->position(), 65u);

    stream->close();
    result = cursor->read_and_discard(40);
    EXPECT(result.is_error());
    EXPECT_EQ(result.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream);
    EXPECT_EQ(cursor->position(), 65u);
}

TEST_CASE(read_and_discard_in_a_closed_stream_requires_a_chunk_before_the_gap)
{
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_empty();
    auto data = make_test_data(100);
    stream->add_chunk_at(60, data.bytes().slice(60));
    stream->close();

    auto cursor = stream->create_cursor();
    cursor->set_is_blocking(false);
    auto result = cursor->read_and_discard(10);
    EXPECT(result.is_error());
    EXPECT_EQ(result.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::NeedsMoreInput);
    EXPECT_EQ(cursor->position(), 0u);

    stream->add_chunk_at(0, data.bytes().slice(0, 60));
    EXPECT(!cursor->read_and_discard(10).is_error());
    EXPECT_EQ(cursor->position(), 10u);
}

TEST_CASE(blocking_read_and_discard_past_the_expected_size_does_not_wait)
{
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_empty();
    stream->set_expected_size(100);
    auto data = make_test_data(100);
    stream->add_chunk_at(0, data.bytes());

    auto cursor = stream->create_cursor();

    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<bool> reached_end_of_stream { false };
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<bool> discard_finished { false };
    auto thread = Threading::Thread::construct("TestDiscard"sv, [&, cursor]() -> intptr_t {
        auto result = cursor->read_and_discard(101);
        reached_end_of_stream = result.is_error() && result.error().category() == Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream;
        discard_finished = true;
        return 0;
    });
    thread->start();

    auto start_time = MonotonicTime::now_coarse();
    while (!discard_finished.load() && MonotonicTime::now_coarse() - start_time < AK::Duration::from_seconds(1))
        ;
    if (!discard_finished.load())
        cursor->abort();
    MUST(thread->join());

    EXPECT(reached_end_of_stream.load());
    EXPECT_EQ(cursor->position(), 0u);
}

TEST_CASE(blocking_read_and_discard_waits_for_every_byte)
{
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_empty();
    stream->set_expected_size(100);
    auto data = make_test_data(100);
    stream->add_chunk_at(0, data.bytes().slice(0, 40));
    stream->add_chunk_at(60, data.bytes().slice(60));

    auto cursor = stream->create_cursor();

    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<bool> read_blocked { false };
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<bool> discard_succeeded { false };
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<bool> discard_finished { false };
    cursor->set_blocked_change_handler([&](Media::ReadBlocked blocked) {
        read_blocked = blocked == Media::ReadBlocked::Yes;
    });

    auto thread = Threading::Thread::construct("TestDiscard"sv, [&, cursor]() -> intptr_t {
        discard_succeeded = !cursor->read_and_discard(70).is_error();
        discard_finished = true;
        return 0;
    });
    thread->start();

    while (!read_blocked.load() && !discard_finished.load())
        ;
    stream->add_chunk_at(40, data.bytes().slice(40, 20));
    MUST(thread->join());

    EXPECT(discard_succeeded.load());
    EXPECT_EQ(cursor->position(), 70u);
}

TEST_CASE(read_bytes_allocates_only_once_every_byte_has_arrived)
{
    // A declared size that could never be allocated fails on the missing data instead of the allocation.
    static constexpr size_t declared_size = 1ull << 60;
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_empty();
    stream->set_expected_size(declared_size + 100);
    auto data = make_test_data(100);
    stream->add_chunk_at(0, data.bytes());
    stream->make_missing_data_permanently_unavailable();

    auto cursor = stream->create_cursor();
    auto result = cursor->read_bytes(declared_size);
    EXPECT(result.is_error());
    EXPECT_EQ(result.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::PermanentlyUnavailable);

    auto bytes = MUST(cursor->read_bytes(100));
    EXPECT_EQ(bytes.span(), data.bytes());
}

#include <AK/Atomic.h>
#include <AK/BitCast.h>
#include <AK/ByteBuffer.h>
#include <AK/NumericLimits.h>
#include <LibCore/File.h>
#include <LibMedia/Containers/ISOBMFF/FragmentSampleIterator.h>
#include <LibMedia/Containers/ISOBMFF/ISOBMFFDemuxer.h>
#include <LibMedia/Containers/ISOBMFF/Reader.h>
#include <LibMedia/Containers/ISOBMFF/Streamer.h>
#include <LibMedia/IncrementallyPopulatedStream.h>
#include <LibMedia/ReadonlyBytesCursor.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/Limits.h>
#include <LibTest/TestCase.h>
#include <LibThreading/Thread.h>

#include "TestMediaCommon.h"

namespace {

struct BoxMarker {
    size_t start { 0 };
};

void append_u16(ByteBuffer& bytes, u16 value)
{
    bytes.append(static_cast<u8>(value >> 8));
    bytes.append(static_cast<u8>(value));
}

void append_u32(ByteBuffer& bytes, u32 value)
{
    for (int shift = 24; shift >= 0; shift -= 8)
        bytes.append(static_cast<u8>(value >> shift));
}

void append_u64(ByteBuffer& bytes, u64 value)
{
    for (int shift = 56; shift >= 0; shift -= 8)
        bytes.append(static_cast<u8>(value >> shift));
}

void patch_u32(ByteBuffer& bytes, size_t position, u32 value)
{
    VERIFY(position + sizeof(value) <= bytes.size());
    for (size_t index = 0; index < sizeof(value); ++index)
        bytes[position + index] = static_cast<u8>(value >> ((sizeof(value) - index - 1) * 8));
}

void append_four_cc(ByteBuffer& bytes, char const (&type)[5])
{
    for (size_t index = 0; index < 4; ++index)
        bytes.append(type[index]);
}

BoxMarker begin_box(ByteBuffer& bytes, char const (&type)[5])
{
    auto start = bytes.size();
    append_u32(bytes, 0);
    append_four_cc(bytes, type);
    return { start };
}

void finish_box(ByteBuffer& bytes, BoxMarker box)
{
    auto size = bytes.size() - box.start;
    VERIFY(size <= NumericLimits<u32>::max());
    patch_u32(bytes, box.start, size);
}

void append_full_box_header(ByteBuffer& bytes, u8 version = 0, u32 flags = 0)
{
    append_u32(bytes, (static_cast<u32>(version) << 24) | flags);
}

Media::ISOBMFF::Streamer streamer_for(ByteBuffer const& bytes)
{
    return Media::ISOBMFF::Streamer(make_ref_counted<Media::ReadonlyBytesCursor>(bytes.bytes()));
}

void append_sample_count_box(ByteBuffer& bytes, char const (&type)[5], u32 entry_count)
{
    auto box = begin_box(bytes, type);
    append_full_box_header(bytes);
    append_u32(bytes, entry_count);
    finish_box(bytes, box);
}

void append_minimal_track(ByteBuffer& bytes, bool overflowing_sample_table_counts = false, bool nonzero_media_rate_fraction = false, u32 timescale = 1'000)
{
    auto track = begin_box(bytes, "trak");

    auto track_header = begin_box(bytes, "tkhd");
    append_full_box_header(bytes, 0, 1);
    append_u64(bytes, 0);
    append_u32(bytes, 1);
    finish_box(bytes, track_header);

    if (nonzero_media_rate_fraction) {
        auto edit = begin_box(bytes, "edts");
        auto edit_list = begin_box(bytes, "elst");
        append_full_box_header(bytes);
        append_u32(bytes, 1);
        append_u32(bytes, 0);
        append_u32(bytes, 0);
        append_u16(bytes, 1);
        append_u16(bytes, 1);
        finish_box(bytes, edit_list);
        finish_box(bytes, edit);
    }

    auto media = begin_box(bytes, "mdia");

    auto media_header = begin_box(bytes, "mdhd");
    append_full_box_header(bytes);
    append_u64(bytes, 0);
    append_u32(bytes, timescale);
    append_u32(bytes, 0);
    append_u16(bytes, 0);
    finish_box(bytes, media_header);

    auto handler = begin_box(bytes, "hdlr");
    append_full_box_header(bytes);
    append_u32(bytes, 0);
    append_four_cc(bytes, "vide");
    append_u32(bytes, 0);
    append_u32(bytes, 0);
    append_u32(bytes, 0);
    bytes.append(0);
    finish_box(bytes, handler);

    auto media_information = begin_box(bytes, "minf");
    auto sample_table = begin_box(bytes, "stbl");

    auto sample_description = begin_box(bytes, "stsd");
    append_full_box_header(bytes);
    append_u32(bytes, 0);
    finish_box(bytes, sample_description);

    append_sample_count_box(bytes, "stts", overflowing_sample_table_counts ? NumericLimits<u32>::max() : 0);
    append_sample_count_box(bytes, "stsc", overflowing_sample_table_counts ? 1 : 0);
    append_sample_count_box(bytes, "stco", 0);

    finish_box(bytes, sample_table);
    finish_box(bytes, media_information);
    finish_box(bytes, media);
    finish_box(bytes, track);
}

void append_movie_extends_box(ByteBuffer& bytes)
{
    auto movie_extends = begin_box(bytes, "mvex");
    auto track_extends = begin_box(bytes, "trex");
    append_full_box_header(bytes);
    append_u32(bytes, 1);
    append_u32(bytes, 1);
    append_u32(bytes, 1);
    append_u32(bytes, 1);
    append_u32(bytes, 0);
    finish_box(bytes, track_extends);
    finish_box(bytes, movie_extends);
}

void append_movie_box(ByteBuffer& bytes, bool overflowing_sample_table_counts = false, bool nonzero_media_rate_fraction = false, u32 movie_timescale = 1'000, u32 track_timescale = 1'000)
{
    auto movie = begin_box(bytes, "moov");

    auto movie_header = begin_box(bytes, "mvhd");
    append_full_box_header(bytes);
    append_u64(bytes, 0);
    append_u32(bytes, movie_timescale);
    append_u32(bytes, 0);
    finish_box(bytes, movie_header);

    append_minimal_track(bytes, overflowing_sample_table_counts, nonzero_media_rate_fraction, track_timescale);
    append_movie_extends_box(bytes);
    finish_box(bytes, movie);
}

void append_version_2_audio_movie(ByteBuffer& bytes)
{
    auto movie = begin_box(bytes, "moov");
    auto track = begin_box(bytes, "trak");

    auto track_header = begin_box(bytes, "tkhd");
    append_full_box_header(bytes, 0, 1);
    append_u64(bytes, 0);
    append_u32(bytes, 1);
    finish_box(bytes, track_header);

    auto media = begin_box(bytes, "mdia");
    auto handler = begin_box(bytes, "hdlr");
    append_full_box_header(bytes);
    append_u32(bytes, 0);
    append_four_cc(bytes, "soun");
    append_u32(bytes, 0);
    append_u32(bytes, 0);
    append_u32(bytes, 0);
    bytes.append(0);
    finish_box(bytes, handler);

    auto media_information = begin_box(bytes, "minf");
    auto sample_table = begin_box(bytes, "stbl");
    auto sample_description = begin_box(bytes, "stsd");
    append_full_box_header(bytes);
    append_u32(bytes, 2);

    for (auto sample_rate : { 96'000.0, 48'000.0 }) {
        auto sample_entry = begin_box(bytes, "mp4a");
        append_u32(bytes, 0);
        append_u16(bytes, 0);
        append_u16(bytes, 1);
        append_u16(bytes, 2);
        append_u16(bytes, 0);
        append_u32(bytes, 0);
        append_u16(bytes, 3);
        append_u16(bytes, 16);
        append_u16(bytes, 0xfffe);
        append_u16(bytes, 0);
        append_u32(bytes, 1 << 16);
        append_u32(bytes, 72);
        append_u64(bytes, bit_cast<u64>(sample_rate));
        append_u32(bytes, 6);
        append_u32(bytes, 0x7f000000);
        append_u32(bytes, 24);
        append_u32(bytes, 0);
        append_u32(bytes, 0);
        append_u32(bytes, 0);
        finish_box(bytes, sample_entry);
    }

    finish_box(bytes, sample_description);
    finish_box(bytes, sample_table);
    finish_box(bytes, media_information);
    finish_box(bytes, media);
    finish_box(bytes, track);
    finish_box(bytes, movie);
}

void append_movie_fragment_header(ByteBuffer& bytes)
{
    auto movie_fragment_header = begin_box(bytes, "mfhd");
    append_full_box_header(bytes);
    append_u32(bytes, 1);
    finish_box(bytes, movie_fragment_header);
}

Media::ISOBMFF::TrackFragmentContexts fragment_contexts()
{
    Media::ISOBMFF::TrackFragmentContexts contexts;
    contexts.set(1, {
                        .timescale = 1'000,
                        .sample_description_count = 2,
                        .sample_defaults = {
                            .sample_description_index = 1,
                            .sample_duration = 1,
                            .sample_size = 1,
                        },
                    });
    return contexts;
}

enum class ColourBoxOrder {
    None,
    BeforeConfiguration,
    AfterConfiguration,
};

void append_bt709_colour_information_box(ByteBuffer& bytes)
{
    auto colour_information = begin_box(bytes, "colr");
    append_four_cc(bytes, "nclx");
    append_u16(bytes, 1); // BT.709 primaries
    append_u16(bytes, 1); // BT.709 transfer characteristics
    append_u16(bytes, 1); // BT.709 matrix coefficients
    bytes.append(0);      // studio range
    finish_box(bytes, colour_information);
}

// An AV1 configuration record whose sequence header describes BT.2020 with the SMPTE 2084 transfer function.
void append_av1_configuration_box(ByteBuffer& bytes)
{
    static constexpr Array<u8, 21> record {
        0x81, 0x08, 0x0c, 0x00,
        0x0a, 0x0f, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x43, 0xfc, 0x1d, 0xfc, 0x10, 0xdd, 0xc2, 0x79, 0x90, 0x91, 0x00, 0x90
    };
    auto configuration = begin_box(bytes, "av1C");
    MUST(bytes.try_append(record.span()));
    finish_box(bytes, configuration);
}

void append_vp9_configuration_box(ByteBuffer& bytes)
{
    auto configuration = begin_box(bytes, "vpcC");
    append_full_box_header(bytes, 1);
    bytes.append(2);                        // profile
    bytes.append(31);                       // level
    bytes.append((10 << 4) | (1 << 1) | 0); // 10-bit, 4:2:0, studio range
    bytes.append(9);                        // BT.2020 primaries
    bytes.append(16);                       // SMPTE 2084 transfer characteristics
    bytes.append(9);                        // BT.2020 non-constant luminance matrix coefficients
    append_u16(bytes, 0);                   // codec initialization data size
    finish_box(bytes, configuration);
}

// BT.2020 primaries and a D65 white point mastered from 0.005 to 1000 cd/m², with primaries in mdcv's green, blue, red
// order.
void append_vp9_configuration_and_high_dynamic_range_boxes(ByteBuffer& bytes)
{
    append_vp9_configuration_box(bytes);

    auto mastering_display_colour_volume = begin_box(bytes, "mdcv");
    for (u16 value : { 8500, 39850, 6550, 2300, 35400, 14600, 15635, 16450 })
        append_u16(bytes, value);
    append_u32(bytes, 10'000'000);
    append_u32(bytes, 50);
    finish_box(bytes, mastering_display_colour_volume);

    auto content_light_level = begin_box(bytes, "clli");
    append_u16(bytes, 1005);
    append_u16(bytes, 315);
    finish_box(bytes, content_light_level);
}

// Each box is a byte short of the fields it holds.
void append_vp9_configuration_and_truncated_high_dynamic_range_boxes(ByteBuffer& bytes)
{
    append_vp9_configuration_box(bytes);

    auto mastering_display_colour_volume = begin_box(bytes, "mdcv");
    for (u16 value : { 8500, 39850, 6550, 2300, 35400, 14600, 15635, 16450 })
        append_u16(bytes, value);
    append_u32(bytes, 10'000'000);
    append_u16(bytes, 0);
    bytes.append(50);
    finish_box(bytes, mastering_display_colour_volume);

    auto content_light_level = begin_box(bytes, "clli");
    append_u16(bytes, 1005);
    bytes.append(1);
    finish_box(bytes, content_light_level);
}

void append_video_movie(ByteBuffer& bytes, char const (&format)[5], void (*append_configuration_box)(ByteBuffer&), ColourBoxOrder colour_box_order, Function<void(ByteBuffer&)> const& append_tables = {}, bool fragmented = false)
{
    auto movie = begin_box(bytes, "moov");
    auto track = begin_box(bytes, "trak");

    auto track_header = begin_box(bytes, "tkhd");
    append_full_box_header(bytes, 0, 1);
    append_u64(bytes, 0);
    append_u32(bytes, 1);
    finish_box(bytes, track_header);

    auto media = begin_box(bytes, "mdia");
    auto handler = begin_box(bytes, "hdlr");
    append_full_box_header(bytes);
    append_u32(bytes, 0);
    append_four_cc(bytes, "vide");
    append_u32(bytes, 0);
    append_u32(bytes, 0);
    append_u32(bytes, 0);
    bytes.append(0);
    finish_box(bytes, handler);

    auto media_information = begin_box(bytes, "minf");
    auto sample_table = begin_box(bytes, "stbl");
    auto sample_description = begin_box(bytes, "stsd");
    append_full_box_header(bytes);
    append_u32(bytes, 1);

    auto sample_entry = begin_box(bytes, format);
    append_u32(bytes, 0);
    append_u16(bytes, 0);
    append_u16(bytes, 1); // data_reference_index
    append_u32(bytes, 0); // pre_defined, reserved
    for (size_t index = 0; index < 3; ++index)
        append_u32(bytes, 0); // pre_defined
    append_u16(bytes, 1920);
    append_u16(bytes, 1080);
    append_u32(bytes, 0x00480000); // horizresolution
    append_u32(bytes, 0x00480000); // vertresolution
    append_u32(bytes, 0);          // reserved
    append_u16(bytes, 1);          // frame_count
    for (size_t index = 0; index < 32; ++index)
        bytes.append(0);       // compressorname
    append_u16(bytes, 24);     // depth
    append_u16(bytes, 0xffff); // pre_defined

    if (colour_box_order == ColourBoxOrder::BeforeConfiguration)
        append_bt709_colour_information_box(bytes);
    append_configuration_box(bytes);
    if (colour_box_order == ColourBoxOrder::AfterConfiguration)
        append_bt709_colour_information_box(bytes);

    finish_box(bytes, sample_entry);

    finish_box(bytes, sample_description);
    if (append_tables)
        append_tables(bytes);
    finish_box(bytes, sample_table);
    finish_box(bytes, media_information);
    finish_box(bytes, media);
    finish_box(bytes, track);
    if (fragmented)
        append_movie_extends_box(bytes);
    finish_box(bytes, movie);
}

void append_audio_movie(ByteBuffer& bytes, u32 timescale, u32 sample_rate, u16 channel_count, void (*append_configuration_box)(ByteBuffer&) = nullptr)
{
    auto movie = begin_box(bytes, "moov");
    auto track = begin_box(bytes, "trak");

    auto track_header = begin_box(bytes, "tkhd");
    append_full_box_header(bytes, 0, 1);
    append_u64(bytes, 0);
    append_u32(bytes, 1);
    finish_box(bytes, track_header);

    auto media = begin_box(bytes, "mdia");

    auto media_header = begin_box(bytes, "mdhd");
    append_full_box_header(bytes);
    append_u64(bytes, 0); // creation_time and modification_time
    append_u32(bytes, timescale);
    append_u32(bytes, 0);      // duration
    append_u16(bytes, 0x55c4); // und
    append_u16(bytes, 0);      // pre_defined
    finish_box(bytes, media_header);

    auto handler = begin_box(bytes, "hdlr");
    append_full_box_header(bytes);
    append_u32(bytes, 0);
    append_four_cc(bytes, "soun");
    append_u32(bytes, 0);
    append_u32(bytes, 0);
    append_u32(bytes, 0);
    bytes.append(0);
    finish_box(bytes, handler);

    auto media_information = begin_box(bytes, "minf");
    auto sample_table = begin_box(bytes, "stbl");
    auto sample_description = begin_box(bytes, "stsd");
    append_full_box_header(bytes);
    append_u32(bytes, 1);

    auto sample_entry = begin_box(bytes, "mp4a");
    append_u32(bytes, 0);
    append_u16(bytes, 0);
    append_u16(bytes, 1); // data_reference_index
    append_u16(bytes, 0); // version
    append_u32(bytes, 0);
    append_u16(bytes, 0); // reserved
    append_u16(bytes, channel_count);
    append_u16(bytes, 16); // bits_per_sample
    append_u16(bytes, 0);  // pre_defined
    append_u16(bytes, 0);  // reserved
    append_u32(bytes, sample_rate << 16);
    if (append_configuration_box)
        append_configuration_box(bytes);
    finish_box(bytes, sample_entry);

    finish_box(bytes, sample_description);
    finish_box(bytes, sample_table);
    finish_box(bytes, media_information);
    finish_box(bytes, media);
    finish_box(bytes, track);
    finish_box(bytes, movie);
}

// SampleEntry owns its configuration data and so cannot be copied out of the movie.
struct SampleEntrySummary {
    Optional<Media::CodingIndependentCodePoints> cicp;
    Optional<Media::ParsedCodec> parsed_codec;
    Optional<Media::MasteringDisplayColorVolume> mastering_display_color_volume;
    Optional<Media::ContentLightLevelInformation> content_light_level_information;
};

Media::DecoderErrorOr<Media::ISOBMFF::Movie> parse_movie(ByteBuffer& bytes)
{
    auto streamer = streamer_for(bytes);
    auto header = TRY(Media::ISOBMFF::Reader::read_box_header(streamer));
    return Media::ISOBMFF::Reader::parse_movie_box(streamer, header);
}

SampleEntrySummary parse_only_sample_entry(ByteBuffer& bytes)
{
    auto streamer = streamer_for(bytes);
    auto header = MUST(Media::ISOBMFF::Reader::read_box_header(streamer));
    auto movie = MUST(Media::ISOBMFF::Reader::parse_movie_box(streamer, header));
    auto const& sample_entries = movie.tracks.get(1).value()->sample_entries;
    VERIFY(sample_entries.size() == 1);
    auto const& video = *sample_entries[0].video;
    return { video.cicp, sample_entries[0].parsed_codec, video.mastering_display_color_volume, video.content_light_level_information };
}

}

static Optional<FixedArray<u8>> first_frame_codec_configuration(ByteBuffer const& data)
{
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_from_buffer(data);
    auto demuxer = MUST(Media::ISOBMFF::ISOBMFFDemuxer::from_stream(stream));
    auto track = MUST(demuxer->get_preferred_track_for_type(Media::TrackType::Audio));
    VERIFY(track.has_value());
    MUST(demuxer->create_context_for_track(*track));

    auto frame = MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(*track));
    auto configuration = frame.new_codec_configuration();
    if (!configuration.has_value())
        return {};
    return MUST(FixedArray<u8>::create(*configuration));
}

TEST_CASE(aac_track_keeps_the_configuration_its_container_carries)
{
    auto file = MUST(Core::File::open("./hevc_10bit.mp4"sv, Core::File::OpenMode::Read));
    auto configuration = first_frame_codec_configuration(MUST(file->read_until_eof()));

    // The track describes its own codec, so nothing is invented for it.
    EXPECT(configuration.has_value());
    EXPECT(configuration->size() >= 2);
}

TEST_CASE(aac_track_without_a_configuration_is_described_by_its_container)
{
    auto file = MUST(Core::File::open("./hevc_10bit.mp4"sv, Core::File::OpenMode::Read));
    auto data = MUST(file->read_until_eof());

    // Renaming the Elementary Stream Descriptor Box leaves a track that states its sample rate and
    // channel count but never describes the codec that decodes it.
    Optional<size_t> esds;
    for (size_t index = 0; index + 4 <= data.size(); index++) {
        if (StringView { data.bytes().slice(index, 4) } == "esds"sv) {
            EXPECT(!esds.has_value());
            esds = index;
        }
    }
    VERIFY(esds.has_value());
    data.overwrite(*esds, "free", 4);

    auto configuration = first_frame_codec_configuration(data);
    EXPECT(configuration.has_value());

    // An Audio Specific Config of object type 2, sampling frequency index 3 and channel
    // configuration 1: Low Complexity AAC at the 48000 Hz mono the container declares.
    EXPECT_EQ(configuration->size(), 2u);
    EXPECT_EQ((*configuration)[0], 0x11);
    EXPECT_EQ((*configuration)[1], 0x88);
}

TEST_CASE(rejects_file_type_box_with_partial_compatible_brand)
{
    ByteBuffer bytes;
    auto file_type = begin_box(bytes, "ftyp");
    append_four_cc(bytes, "iso5");
    append_u32(bytes, 0);
    bytes.append(0);
    finish_box(bytes, file_type);

    auto streamer = streamer_for(bytes);
    auto header = MUST(Media::ISOBMFF::Reader::read_box_header(streamer));
    EXPECT(Media::ISOBMFF::Reader::parse_file_type_box(streamer, header).is_error());
}

TEST_CASE(preserves_mp3_in_mp4a_without_decoder_specific_configuration)
{
    for (u8 object_type : { 0x69, 0x6b }) {
        ByteBuffer bytes;
        append_audio_movie(bytes, 48'000, 48'000, 2, [](ByteBuffer& bytes) {
            auto esds = begin_box(bytes, "esds");
            append_full_box_header(bytes);
            bytes.append(3); // ES_Descriptor
            bytes.append(18);
            append_u16(bytes, 1); // ES_ID
            bytes.append(0);      // flags
            bytes.append(4);      // DecoderConfigDescriptor
            bytes.append(13);
            bytes.append(0x6b); // MPEG-1 Audio
            bytes.append(0x15); // audio stream type, reserved bit
            bytes.append(0);
            append_u16(bytes, 0); // bufferSizeDB
            append_u32(bytes, 160'000);
            append_u32(bytes, 160'000);
            finish_box(bytes, esds);
        });
        // The final DecoderConfigDescriptor has a 13-byte payload beginning with the object type.
        bytes[bytes.size() - 13] = object_type;
        auto movie = MUST(parse_movie(bytes));
        auto const& entry = movie.tracks.get(1).value()->sample_entries.first();
        EXPECT_EQ(entry.codec_id, Media::CodecID::MP3);
        EXPECT(entry.codec_initialization_data.is_empty());
        auto track = Media::ISOBMFF::track_from_track_entry(*movie.tracks.get(1).value(), true);
        EXPECT_EQ(track.parsed_codec().codec_id(), Media::CodecID::MP3);
    }
}

static void append_seek_test_tables(ByteBuffer& bytes, u8 size_width = 0, u32 data_offset = 8, bool mark_sync_samples = true, u8 composition_offset_version = 1)
{
    auto times = begin_box(bytes, "stts");
    append_full_box_header(bytes);
    append_u32(bytes, 1);
    append_u32(bytes, 6);
    append_u32(bytes, 1);
    finish_box(bytes, times);

    auto compositions = begin_box(bytes, "ctts");
    append_full_box_header(bytes, composition_offset_version);
    append_u32(bytes, 6);
    for (i32 offset : { 0, 2, -1, -1, 2, -1 }) {
        append_u32(bytes, 1);
        append_u32(bytes, static_cast<u32>(offset));
    }
    finish_box(bytes, compositions);

    auto chunks = begin_box(bytes, "stsc");
    append_full_box_header(bytes);
    append_u32(bytes, 2);
    for (u32 chunk = 1; chunk <= 2; ++chunk) {
        append_u32(bytes, chunk);
        append_u32(bytes, 3);
        append_u32(bytes, 1);
    }
    finish_box(bytes, chunks);

    bool compact = size_width != 0 && size_width != 32;
    auto sizes = begin_box(bytes, compact ? "stz2" : "stsz");
    append_full_box_header(bytes);
    append_u32(bytes, compact ? size_width : size_width == 0 ? 1
                                                             : 0);
    append_u32(bytes, 6);
    if (size_width == 4) {
        bytes.append(0x12);
        bytes.append(0x34);
        bytes.append(0x56);
    } else if (size_width != 0) {
        for (u32 size = 1; size <= 6; ++size) {
            if (size_width == 8)
                bytes.append(size);
            else if (size_width == 16)
                append_u16(bytes, size);
            else
                append_u32(bytes, size);
        }
    }
    finish_box(bytes, sizes);

    auto offsets = begin_box(bytes, size_width == 0 ? "stco" : "co64");
    append_full_box_header(bytes);
    append_u32(bytes, 2);
    if (size_width == 0) {
        append_u32(bytes, data_offset);
        append_u32(bytes, data_offset + 3);
    } else {
        append_u64(bytes, 0x1'0000'0000);
        append_u64(bytes, 0x2'0000'0000);
    }
    finish_box(bytes, offsets);

    auto sync = begin_box(bytes, "stss");
    append_full_box_header(bytes);
    append_u32(bytes, mark_sync_samples ? 2 : 0);
    if (mark_sync_samples) {
        append_u32(bytes, 1);
        append_u32(bytes, 5);
    }
    finish_box(bytes, sync);
}

TEST_CASE(demuxes_quicktime_with_a_leading_wide_atom)
{
    ByteBuffer bytes;
    auto wide = begin_box(bytes, "wide");
    finish_box(bytes, wide);
    auto data = begin_box(bytes, "mdat");
    for (u8 i = 0; i < 6; ++i)
        bytes.append(i);
    finish_box(bytes, data);
    append_video_movie(bytes, "vp09", append_vp9_configuration_box, ColourBoxOrder::None, [](ByteBuffer& bytes) { append_seek_test_tables(bytes, 0, 16); });

    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_from_buffer(bytes);
    auto demuxer = MUST(Media::ISOBMFF::ISOBMFFDemuxer::from_stream(stream));
    auto track = MUST(demuxer->get_preferred_track_for_type(Media::TrackType::Video)).value();
    MUST(demuxer->create_context_for_track(track));
    for (u8 i = 0; i < 6; ++i) {
        auto sample = MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track));
        EXPECT_EQ(sample.data().size(), 1u);
        EXPECT_EQ(sample.data()[0], i);
    }
    auto end = demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track);
    EXPECT(end.is_error());
    EXPECT_EQ(end.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream);
}

static ByteBuffer seek_test_file(bool fragmented = false, Optional<u32> fragment_decode_time = {}, bool movie_has_samples = true)
{
    ByteBuffer bytes;
    auto data = begin_box(bytes, "mdat");
    for (u8 i = 0; i < 6; ++i)
        bytes.append(i);
    finish_box(bytes, data);
    append_video_movie(bytes, "vp09", append_vp9_configuration_box, ColourBoxOrder::None, [&](ByteBuffer& bytes) {
        if (movie_has_samples)
            append_seek_test_tables(bytes); }, fragmented);
    if (fragmented) {
        auto fragment = begin_box(bytes, "moof");
        auto fragment_header = begin_box(bytes, "mfhd");
        append_full_box_header(bytes);
        append_u32(bytes, 1);
        finish_box(bytes, fragment_header);
        auto traf = begin_box(bytes, "traf");
        auto header = begin_box(bytes, "tfhd");
        append_full_box_header(bytes, 0, 0x020018); // moof-relative offsets, default duration and size
        append_u32(bytes, 1);
        append_u32(bytes, 1);
        append_u32(bytes, 1);
        finish_box(bytes, header);
        // Without tfdt, decoding continues after the samples in moov or the preceding fragment.
        if (fragment_decode_time.has_value()) {
            auto decode_time = begin_box(bytes, "tfdt");
            append_full_box_header(bytes);
            append_u32(bytes, fragment_decode_time.value());
            finish_box(bytes, decode_time);
        }
        auto run = begin_box(bytes, "trun");
        append_full_box_header(bytes, 1, 0x000c01); // data offset, flags, composition offsets
        append_u32(bytes, 2);
        auto data_offset_position = bytes.size();
        append_u32(bytes, 0);
        append_u32(bytes, 0);
        append_u32(bytes, 2);
        append_u32(bytes, Media::ISOBMFF::SAMPLE_IS_NON_SYNC_SAMPLE);
        append_u32(bytes, 0);
        finish_box(bytes, run);
        finish_box(bytes, traf);
        finish_box(bytes, fragment);
        patch_u32(bytes, data_offset_position, bytes.size() + 8 - fragment.start);
        auto fragment_data = begin_box(bytes, "mdat");
        bytes.append(6);
        bytes.append(7);
        finish_box(bytes, fragment_data);
    }
    return bytes;
}

TEST_CASE(demuxes_sample_tables_in_decode_order_with_signed_composition_offsets)
{
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_from_buffer(seek_test_file());
    auto demuxer = MUST(Media::ISOBMFF::ISOBMFFDemuxer::from_stream(stream));
    auto track = MUST(demuxer->get_preferred_track_for_type(Media::TrackType::Video)).value();
    MUST(demuxer->create_context_for_track(track));
    Array<i64, 6> timestamps { 0, 3, 1, 2, 6, 4 };
    for (size_t index = 0; index < timestamps.size(); ++index) {
        auto sample = MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track));
        EXPECT_EQ(sample.decode_timestamp(), AK::Duration::from_seconds(index));
        EXPECT_EQ(sample.presentation_timestamp(), AK::Duration::from_seconds(timestamps[index]));
        EXPECT_EQ(sample.data()[0], index);
        EXPECT_EQ(sample.is_keyframe(), index == 0 || index == 4);
        EXPECT_EQ(sample.new_codec_configuration().has_value(), index == 0);
    }
    EXPECT_EQ(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track).error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream);
}

TEST_CASE(demuxes_negative_composition_offsets_from_a_version_0_box)
{
    ByteBuffer bytes;
    auto data = begin_box(bytes, "mdat");
    for (u8 i = 0; i < 6; ++i)
        bytes.append(i);
    finish_box(bytes, data);
    append_video_movie(bytes, "vp09", append_vp9_configuration_box, ColourBoxOrder::None, [](ByteBuffer& bytes) { append_seek_test_tables(bytes, 0, 8, true, 0); });

    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_from_buffer(bytes);
    auto demuxer = MUST(Media::ISOBMFF::ISOBMFFDemuxer::from_stream(stream));
    auto track = MUST(demuxer->get_preferred_track_for_type(Media::TrackType::Video)).value();
    MUST(demuxer->create_context_for_track(track));
    for (i64 timestamp : { 0, 3, 1, 2, 6, 4 })
        EXPECT_EQ(MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track)).presentation_timestamp(), AK::Duration::from_seconds(timestamp));
}

TEST_CASE(seeks_by_pts_and_skips_seeks_that_do_not_improve_position)
{
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_from_buffer(seek_test_file());
    auto demuxer = MUST(Media::ISOBMFF::ISOBMFFDemuxer::from_stream(stream));
    auto track = MUST(demuxer->get_preferred_track_for_type(Media::TrackType::Video)).value();
    MUST(demuxer->create_context_for_track(track));
    auto target = AK::Duration::from_seconds(5);
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(demuxer->seek_to_most_recent_keyframe(track, target)), Media::DemuxerSeekResult::MovedPosition);
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track)).data()[0], 0);
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track)).data()[0], 1);
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(demuxer->seek_to_most_recent_keyframe(track, target, Media::DemuxerSeekOptions::NeedCodecConfiguration)), Media::DemuxerSeekResult::KeptCurrentPosition);
    auto next = MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track));
    EXPECT_EQ(next.data()[0], 2);
    EXPECT(next.new_codec_configuration().has_value());
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(demuxer->seek_to_most_recent_keyframe(track, target, Media::DemuxerSeekOptions::Force)), Media::DemuxerSeekResult::MovedPosition);
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track)).data()[0], 0);
    EXPECT_EQ(demuxer->select_fast_seek_target_for_track(track, target, Media::SeekMode::FastBefore), AK::Duration::zero());
    EXPECT_EQ(demuxer->select_fast_seek_target_for_track(track, target, Media::SeekMode::FastAfter), AK::Duration::from_seconds(6));
}

TEST_CASE(keeps_its_position_while_reading_the_targets_group_of_pictures)
{
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_from_buffer(seek_test_file());
    auto demuxer = MUST(Media::ISOBMFF::ISOBMFFDemuxer::from_stream(stream));
    auto track = MUST(demuxer->get_preferred_track_for_type(Media::TrackType::Video)).value();
    MUST(demuxer->create_context_for_track(track));
    auto target = AK::Duration::from_seconds(2);

    // The second sample is presented after the target, but the samples presented before it have yet to be read.
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track)).data()[0], 0);
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track)).presentation_timestamp(), AK::Duration::from_seconds(3));
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(demuxer->seek_to_most_recent_keyframe(track, target)), Media::DemuxerSeekResult::KeptCurrentPosition);
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track)).data()[0], 2);

    // Reading the next keyframe leaves the target's group of pictures.
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track)).data()[0], 3);
    EXPECT(MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track)).is_keyframe());
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(demuxer->seek_to_most_recent_keyframe(track, target)), Media::DemuxerSeekResult::MovedPosition);

    // The keyframe a seek moves to counts as read before it is.
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(demuxer->seek_to_most_recent_keyframe(track, target)), Media::DemuxerSeekResult::KeptCurrentPosition);
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track)).data()[0], 0);
}

TEST_CASE(seeks_across_movie_and_fragment_samples_in_both_directions)
{
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_from_buffer(seek_test_file(true));
    auto demuxer = MUST(Media::ISOBMFF::ISOBMFFDemuxer::from_stream(stream));
    auto track = MUST(demuxer->get_preferred_track_for_type(Media::TrackType::Video)).value();
    MUST(demuxer->create_context_for_track(track));
    for (u8 index = 0; index < 8; ++index) {
        auto sample = MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track));
        EXPECT_EQ(sample.data()[0], index);
        EXPECT_EQ(sample.decode_timestamp(), AK::Duration::from_seconds(index));
    }
    struct SeekExpectation {
        i64 target;
        u8 sample_index;
    };
    for (auto [target, sample_index] : { SeekExpectation { 8, 6 }, SeekExpectation { 5, 0 }, SeekExpectation { 7, 4 }, SeekExpectation { 10, 6 } }) {
        MUST(demuxer->seek_to_most_recent_keyframe(track, AK::Duration::from_seconds(target), Media::DemuxerSeekOptions::Force));
        EXPECT_EQ(MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track)).data()[0], sample_index);
    }
}

TEST_CASE(sample_tables_remain_available_after_movie_bytes_are_evicted)
{
    auto bytes = seek_test_file();
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_from_buffer(bytes);
    auto demuxer = MUST(Media::ISOBMFF::ISOBMFFDemuxer::from_stream(stream));
    // Retain only the mdat. Creating iterators and seeking must use the owned table bytes.
    stream->remove_byte_range(14, bytes.size());
    auto track = MUST(demuxer->get_preferred_track_for_type(Media::TrackType::Video)).value();
    MUST(demuxer->create_context_for_track(track));
    MUST(demuxer->seek_to_most_recent_keyframe(track, AK::Duration::from_seconds(6)));
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track)).data()[0], 4);
}

TEST_CASE(rejects_sample_table_counts_larger_than_box_before_allocating)
{
    constexpr char types[][5] = { "stts", "ctts", "stsc", "stco", "co64", "stss", "stsz", "stz2" };
    for (auto const& type : types) {
        ByteBuffer bytes;
        append_video_movie(bytes, "vp09", append_vp9_configuration_box, ColourBoxOrder::None, [&](ByteBuffer& bytes) {
            auto box = begin_box(bytes, type);
            append_full_box_header(bytes);
            if (StringView(type, 4) == "stsz"sv)
                append_u32(bytes, 0); // variable sample sizes
            else if (StringView(type, 4) == "stz2"sv)
                append_u32(bytes, 4); // four-bit sample sizes
            append_u32(bytes, NumericLimits<u32>::max());
            finish_box(bytes, box);
        });
        EXPECT(parse_movie(bytes).is_error());
    }
}

TEST_CASE(iterates_compact_and_variable_sample_sizes_with_large_chunk_offsets)
{
    for (u8 width : { 4, 8, 16, 32 }) {
        ByteBuffer bytes;
        append_video_movie(bytes, "vp09", append_vp9_configuration_box, ColourBoxOrder::None, [&](ByteBuffer& bytes) {
            append_seek_test_tables(bytes, width);
        });
        auto movie = MUST(parse_movie(bytes));
        auto& track = *movie.tracks.get(1).value();
        EXPECT_EQ(track.sample_tables->sample_sizes->sizes.size(), 6u);
        track.sample_tables->sync_samples.clear();
        auto iterator = MUST(Media::ISOBMFF::SampleTableIterator::create(track));
        size_t expected_position = 0x1'0000'0000;
        for (u32 index = 0; index < 6; ++index) {
            if (index == 3)
                expected_position = 0x2'0000'0000;
            auto sample = MUST(iterator.next(track)).value();
            EXPECT_EQ(sample.data_size, index + 1);
            EXPECT_EQ(sample.data_position, expected_position);
            EXPECT(sample.is_sync_sample);
            expected_position += index + 1;
        }
        EXPECT(!MUST(iterator.next(track)).has_value());
    }
}

TEST_CASE(reads_composition_offsets_as_signed_in_either_version)
{
    for (u8 version : { 0, 1 }) {
        ByteBuffer bytes;
        append_video_movie(bytes, "vp09", append_vp9_configuration_box, ColourBoxOrder::None, [&](ByteBuffer& bytes) {
            auto box = begin_box(bytes, "ctts");
            append_full_box_header(bytes, version);
            append_u32(bytes, 1);
            append_u32(bytes, 100);
            append_u32(bytes, 0xffff'ffff);
            finish_box(bytes, box);
        });

        EXPECT_EQ(offsets[0].sample_count, 100u);
        EXPECT_EQ(offsets[0].sample_offset, -1);
    }
}

TEST_CASE(parses_odd_compact_sample_count_and_keeps_constant_sample_sizes_compressed)
{
    for (bool compact : { false, true }) {
        ByteBuffer bytes;
        append_video_movie(bytes, "vp09", append_vp9_configuration_box, ColourBoxOrder::None, [&](ByteBuffer& bytes) {
            auto box = begin_box(bytes, compact ? "stz2" : "stsz");
            append_full_box_header(bytes);
            append_u32(bytes, compact ? 4 : 123);
            append_u32(bytes, compact ? 3 : NumericLimits<u32>::max());
            if (compact) {
                bytes.append(0x12);
                bytes.append(0x3f); // The unused low nibble must not become another sample.
            }
            finish_box(bytes, box);
        });
        auto movie = MUST(parse_movie(bytes));
        auto const& sizes = movie.tracks.get(1).value()->sample_tables->sample_sizes.value();
        if (compact) {
            EXPECT_EQ(sizes.sizes.size(), 3u);
            EXPECT_EQ(sizes.sample_count, 3u);
            for (u32 index = 0; index < 3; ++index)
                EXPECT_EQ(sizes.size_of_sample(index), index + 1);
        } else {
            EXPECT(sizes.sizes.is_empty());
            EXPECT_EQ(sizes.sample_count, NumericLimits<u32>::max());
            EXPECT_EQ(sizes.size_of_sample(sizes.sample_count - 1), 123u);
        }
    }
}

TEST_CASE(retries_incomplete_fragment_metadata_without_losing_samples)
{
    auto bytes = seek_test_file(true);
    auto reader = streamer_for(bytes);
    MUST(reader.seek_to_position(14));
    auto header = MUST(Media::ISOBMFF::Reader::read_box_header(reader));
    auto movie = MUST(Media::ISOBMFF::Reader::parse_movie_box(reader, header));
    auto movie_end = header.end_position().value();
    auto source = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_empty();
    source->set_expected_size(bytes.size());
    source->add_chunk_at(0, bytes.bytes().trim(movie_end + 16));
    auto cursor = source->create_cursor();
    cursor->set_is_blocking(false);
    auto iterator = MUST(Media::ISOBMFF::SampleIterator::create(cursor, movie, 1, movie_end));
    for (u32 index = 0; index < 6; ++index)
        EXPECT_EQ(MUST(iterator.next())->decode_timestamp, AK::Duration::from_seconds(index));
    EXPECT_EQ(iterator.next().error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::NeedsMoreInput);
    source->add_chunk_at(movie_end + 16, bytes.bytes().slice(movie_end + 16));
    for (u32 index = 6; index < 8; ++index)
        EXPECT_EQ(MUST(iterator.next())->decode_timestamp, AK::Duration::from_seconds(index));
    EXPECT(!MUST(iterator.next()).has_value());
}

TEST_CASE(fragment_seeks_block_until_the_target_metadata_arrives_and_can_be_aborted)
{
    auto bytes = seek_test_file(true);
    auto reader = streamer_for(bytes);
    MUST(reader.seek_to_position(14));
    auto header = MUST(Media::ISOBMFF::Reader::read_box_header(reader));
    auto available_end = header.end_position().value() + 16;
    auto source = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_empty();
    // Leave a later box unavailable, so seeking must stop before reaching the end of the file.
    source->set_expected_size(bytes.size() + 8);
    source->add_chunk_at(0, bytes.bytes().trim(available_end));
    auto demuxer = MUST(Media::ISOBMFF::ISOBMFFDemuxer::from_stream(source));
    auto track = MUST(demuxer->get_preferred_track_for_type(Media::TrackType::Video)).value();
    MUST(demuxer->create_context_for_track(track));
    auto target = AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(8500);
    EXPECT_EQ(demuxer->select_fast_seek_target_for_track(track, target, Media::SeekMode::FastBefore), AK::Duration::from_seconds(6));

    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<bool> blocked { false };
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<bool> completed { false };
    demuxer->set_read_blocked_change_handler_for_track(track, [&](Media::ReadBlocked state) {
        blocked = state == Media::ReadBlocked::Yes;
    });
    for (bool abort : { true, false }) {
        completed = false;
        demuxer->reset_blocking_reads_aborted_for_track(track);
        auto thread = Threading::Thread::construct("TestSeek"sv, [&, demuxer, track, target, abort]() -> intptr_t {
            auto result = demuxer->seek_to_most_recent_keyframe(track, target);
            if (abort) {
                EXPECT(result.is_error());
                if (result.is_error())
                    EXPECT_EQ(result.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::Aborted);
            } else {
                EXPECT(!result.is_error());
            }
            completed = true;
            return 0;
        });
        thread->start();
        auto deadline = MonotonicTime::now() + AK::Duration::from_seconds(5);
        while (!blocked.load() && !completed.load() && MonotonicTime::now() < deadline) { }
        EXPECT(blocked.load());
        EXPECT(!completed.load());
        if (abort)
            demuxer->set_blocking_reads_aborted_for_track(track);
        else
            source->add_chunk_at(available_end, bytes.bytes().slice(available_end));
        MUST(thread->join());
    }
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track)).data()[0], 6);
    demuxer->set_read_blocked_change_handler_for_track(track, {});
}

// Reports each read that waits for data, so that a test can supply the data only once something waits for it.
class BlockedReadReportingStream final : public Media::MediaStream {
public:
    BlockedReadReportingStream(NonnullRefPtr<Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream> stream, Function<void()> on_read_blocked)
        : m_stream(move(stream))
        , m_on_read_blocked(move(on_read_blocked))
    {
    }

    virtual NonnullRefPtr<Media::MediaStreamCursor> create_cursor() override
    {
        auto cursor = m_stream->create_cursor();
        cursor->set_blocked_change_handler([this](Media::ReadBlocked blocked) {
            if (blocked == Media::ReadBlocked::Yes)
                m_on_read_blocked();
        });
        return cursor;
    }
    virtual Availability availability() const override { return m_stream->availability(); }
    virtual Optional<u64> expected_size() const override { return m_stream->expected_size(); }
    virtual bool is_closed() const override { return m_stream->is_closed(); }

private:
    NonnullRefPtr<Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream> m_stream;
    Function<void()> m_on_read_blocked;
};

TEST_CASE(creating_a_demuxer_waits_for_the_first_fragment_of_a_movie_without_samples)
{
    // The first sample's presentation time is needed for the earliest possible position.
    auto bytes = seek_test_file(true, 5, false);
    auto reader = streamer_for(bytes);
    MUST(reader.seek_to_position(14));
    auto header = MUST(Media::ISOBMFF::Reader::read_box_header(reader));
    auto available_end = header.end_position().value() + 16;
    auto source = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_empty();
    source->add_chunk_at(0, bytes.bytes().trim(available_end));

    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA auto main_thread_event_loop = Core::EventLoop::current_weak();
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<bool> read_blocked { false };
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<bool> created { false };
    auto wake_main_thread = [&] {
        if (auto event_loop = main_thread_event_loop->take())
            event_loop->wake();
    };
    auto stream = adopt_ref(*new BlockedReadReportingStream(source, [&] {
        read_blocked = true;
        wake_main_thread();
    }));

    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA RefPtr<Media::Demuxer> demuxer;
    auto thread = Threading::Thread::construct("TestCreate"sv, [&, stream]() -> intptr_t {
        demuxer = MUST(Media::ISOBMFF::ISOBMFFDemuxer::from_stream(stream));
        created = true;
        wake_main_thread();
        return 0;
    });
    thread->start();

    // Creation reads the fragment that holds the first sample, so it waits until that fragment arrives.
    loop.spin_until([&] { return read_blocked.load() || created.load(); });
    EXPECT(read_blocked.load());
    EXPECT(!created.load());
    source->add_chunk_at(available_end, bytes.bytes().slice(available_end));
    source->close();
    MUST(thread->join());

    auto track = MUST(demuxer->get_preferred_track_for_type(Media::TrackType::Video)).value();
    MUST(demuxer->create_context_for_track(track));
    auto first_sample = MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track));
    EXPECT(first_sample.presentation_timestamp() > AK::Duration::zero());
    EXPECT_EQ(demuxer->earliest_possible_position(), first_sample.presentation_timestamp());
}
