#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibCore/File.h>
#include <LibMedia/Containers/ID3.h>
#include <LibMedia/Containers/MP3/FrameHeader.h>
#include <LibMedia/Containers/MP3/StreamInfo.h>
#include <LibTest/TestCase.h>

static void append_big_endian(Vector<u8>& bytes, u32 value)
{
    for (auto shift : { 24, 16, 8, 0 })
        bytes.append(static_cast<u8>(value >> shift));
}

static void append_characters(Vector<u8>& bytes, StringView characters)
{
    for (auto character : characters)
        bytes.append(static_cast<u8>(character));
}

// A 128 kbps 48 kHz stereo Layer III frame, whose side information places a tag at offset 36.
static Vector<u8> version_1_stereo_frame(Vector<u8> const& tag)
{
    Vector<u8> frame;
    frame.resize(384);
    frame[0] = 0xFF;
    frame[1] = 0xFB;
    frame[2] = 0x94;
    frame[3] = 0x00;
    tag.span().copy_to(frame.span().slice(36));
    return frame;
}

// The same frame with its protection bit clear, which places a CRC before the side information.
static Vector<u8> version_1_stereo_frame_with_crc(Vector<u8> const& tag)
{
    Vector<u8> frame;
    frame.resize(384);
    frame[0] = 0xFF;
    frame[1] = 0xFA;
    frame[2] = 0x94;
    frame[3] = 0x00;
    tag.span().copy_to(frame.span().slice(38));
    return frame;
}

static Media::MP3::FrameHeader parse_header(Vector<u8> const& frame)
{
    auto header = Media::MP3::FrameHeader::parse(frame);
    VERIFY(header.has_value());
    return *header;
}

TEST_CASE(stream_info_reads_the_info_tag_of_a_real_file)
{
    auto file = MUST(Core::File::open("buffered-ranges/tone.mp3"sv, Core::File::OpenMode::Read));
    auto data = MUST(file->read_until_eof());

    auto tag_size = Media::ID3::version_2_tag_size(data);
    EXPECT_EQ(tag_size, 45u);

    auto frame = data.span().slice(*tag_size);
    auto header = Media::MP3::FrameHeader::parse(frame);
    EXPECT(header.has_value());

    auto stream_info = Media::MP3::StreamInfo::parse(frame, *header);
    EXPECT(stream_info.has_value());
    EXPECT_EQ(stream_info->frame_count, 335u);
    EXPECT_EQ(stream_info->byte_count, 129024u);
    EXPECT(stream_info->seek_table.has_value());
    EXPECT_EQ(stream_info->encoder_delay, 576);
    EXPECT_EQ(stream_info->encoder_padding, 1344);

    EXPECT_EQ(stream_info->total_sample_count(*header), 385920u);
}

TEST_CASE(stream_info_reads_a_xing_tag_without_a_seek_table)
{
    Vector<u8> tag;
    append_characters(tag, "Xing"sv);
    append_big_endian(tag, 0x03);
    append_big_endian(tag, 1000);
    append_big_endian(tag, 250000);

    auto frame = version_1_stereo_frame(tag);
    auto header = parse_header(frame);

    auto stream_info = Media::MP3::StreamInfo::parse(frame, header);
    EXPECT(stream_info.has_value());
    EXPECT_EQ(stream_info->frame_count, 1000u);
    EXPECT_EQ(stream_info->byte_count, 250000u);
    EXPECT(!stream_info->seek_table.has_value());
    EXPECT_EQ(stream_info->encoder_delay, 0);
    EXPECT_EQ(stream_info->total_sample_count(header), 1152u * 1000u);
}

TEST_CASE(stream_info_reads_a_xing_tag_that_a_crc_displaces)
{
    Vector<u8> tag;
    append_characters(tag, "Xing"sv);
    append_big_endian(tag, 0x03);
    append_big_endian(tag, 1000);
    append_big_endian(tag, 250000);

    auto frame = version_1_stereo_frame_with_crc(tag);
    auto header = parse_header(frame);
    EXPECT(header.has_crc);

    auto stream_info = Media::MP3::StreamInfo::parse(frame, header);
    EXPECT(stream_info.has_value());
    EXPECT_EQ(stream_info->frame_count, 1000u);
    EXPECT_EQ(stream_info->byte_count, 250000u);
}

TEST_CASE(stream_info_reads_the_encoder_delays_that_follow_the_seek_table)
{
    Vector<u8> tag;
    append_characters(tag, "Info"sv);
    append_big_endian(tag, 0x0F);
    append_big_endian(tag, 100);
    append_big_endian(tag, 38400);
    for (size_t index = 0; index < Media::MP3::StreamInfo::SEEK_TABLE_ENTRY_COUNT; index++)
        tag.append(static_cast<u8>(index));
    append_big_endian(tag, 0);
    append_characters(tag, "LAME3.100"sv);
    for (size_t index = 0; index < 12; index++)
        tag.append(0);
    tag.append(0x24);
    tag.append(0x05);
    tag.append(0x40);

    auto frame = version_1_stereo_frame(tag);
    auto header = parse_header(frame);

    auto stream_info = Media::MP3::StreamInfo::parse(frame, header);
    EXPECT(stream_info.has_value());
    EXPECT(stream_info->seek_table.has_value());
    EXPECT_EQ(stream_info->seek_table.value()[7], 7);
    EXPECT_EQ(stream_info->encoder_delay, 576);
    EXPECT_EQ(stream_info->encoder_padding, 1344);
}

TEST_CASE(stream_info_reads_a_vbri_tag)
{
    Vector<u8> tag;
    append_characters(tag, "VBRI"sv);
    tag.append(0);
    tag.append(1);
    append_big_endian(tag, 0);
    append_big_endian(tag, 250000);
    append_big_endian(tag, 1000);

    auto frame = version_1_stereo_frame(tag);
    auto header = parse_header(frame);

    auto stream_info = Media::MP3::StreamInfo::parse(frame, header);
    EXPECT(stream_info.has_value());
    EXPECT_EQ(stream_info->byte_count, 250000u);
    EXPECT_EQ(stream_info->frame_count, 1000u);
}

TEST_CASE(stream_info_rejects_frames_that_describe_nothing)
{
    Vector<u8> empty;
    auto plain_frame = version_1_stereo_frame(empty);
    EXPECT(!Media::MP3::StreamInfo::parse(plain_frame, parse_header(plain_frame)).has_value());

    Vector<u8> unsupported_vbri;
    append_characters(unsupported_vbri, "VBRI"sv);
    unsupported_vbri.append(0);
    unsupported_vbri.append(2);
    append_big_endian(unsupported_vbri, 0);
    append_big_endian(unsupported_vbri, 250000);
    append_big_endian(unsupported_vbri, 1000);
    auto vbri_frame = version_1_stereo_frame(unsupported_vbri);
    EXPECT(!Media::MP3::StreamInfo::parse(vbri_frame, parse_header(vbri_frame)).has_value());

    Vector<u8> tag;
    append_characters(tag, "Xing"sv);
    append_big_endian(tag, 0x03);
    append_big_endian(tag, 1000);
    append_big_endian(tag, 250000);
    auto truncated = version_1_stereo_frame(tag);
    auto header = parse_header(truncated);
    EXPECT(!Media::MP3::StreamInfo::parse(truncated.span().trim(44), header).has_value());

    auto layer_ii_header = header;
    layer_ii_header.layer = 2;
    EXPECT(!Media::MP3::StreamInfo::parse(truncated, layer_ii_header).has_value());
}

#include <AK/FixedArray.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/Codecs/H264.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/Codecs/H265.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/CodedFrame.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/NonReferenceFrameDetector.h>
#include <LibTest/TestCase.h>

using H264 = Media::Codecs::H264;
using H265 = Media::Codecs::H265;

static FixedArray<u8> length_prefixed_nal_units(Vector<ReadonlyBytes> const& nal_units)
{
    Vector<u8> data;
    for (auto nal_unit : nal_units) {
        auto size = static_cast<u32>(nal_unit.size());
        data.append(static_cast<u8>(size >> 24));
        data.append(static_cast<u8>(size >> 16));
        data.append(static_cast<u8>(size >> 8));
        data.append(static_cast<u8>(size));
        data.append(nal_unit.data(), nal_unit.size());
    }
    return MUST(FixedArray<u8>::create(data.span()));
}

static Media::CodedFrame coded_frame(Media::CodecID codec_id, Vector<ReadonlyBytes> const& nal_units, Optional<ReadonlyBytes> configuration = {})
{
    Optional<FixedArray<u8>> configuration_storage;
    if (configuration.has_value())
        configuration_storage = MUST(FixedArray<u8>::create(*configuration));
    return Media::CodedFrame(codec_id, {}, {}, {}, Media::FrameFlags::None, length_prefixed_nal_units(nal_units), move(configuration_storage));
}

// The slice data after each header is irrelevant, since only the headers are read.
static constexpr Array<u8, 2> H264_REFERENCE_SLICE { 0x41, 0x9a };
static constexpr Array<u8, 2> H264_NON_REFERENCE_SLICE { 0x01, 0x9e };
static constexpr Array<u8, 2> H264_IDR_SLICE { 0x65, 0x88 };
static constexpr Array<u8, 2> H264_SUPPLEMENTAL_ENHANCEMENT_INFORMATION { 0x06, 0x05 };

static ReadonlyBytes h264_configuration() { return H264::representative_configuration_record_for_profile(H264::Profile::High); }

TEST_CASE(h264_reports_frames_whose_slices_are_all_non_reference)
{
    Media::NonReferenceFrameDetector detector;
    EXPECT(!detector.frame_is_non_reference(coded_frame(Media::CodecID::H264, { H264_IDR_SLICE }, h264_configuration())));
    EXPECT(!detector.frame_is_non_reference(coded_frame(Media::CodecID::H264, { H264_REFERENCE_SLICE })));
    EXPECT(detector.frame_is_non_reference(coded_frame(Media::CodecID::H264, { H264_NON_REFERENCE_SLICE })));
    EXPECT(detector.frame_is_non_reference(coded_frame(Media::CodecID::H264, { H264_SUPPLEMENTAL_ENHANCEMENT_INFORMATION, H264_NON_REFERENCE_SLICE, H264_NON_REFERENCE_SLICE })));
    EXPECT(!detector.frame_is_non_reference(coded_frame(Media::CodecID::H264, { H264_NON_REFERENCE_SLICE, H264_REFERENCE_SLICE })));
    EXPECT(!detector.frame_is_non_reference(coded_frame(Media::CodecID::H264, { H264_SUPPLEMENTAL_ENHANCEMENT_INFORMATION })));
}

TEST_CASE(h264_passes_non_reference_frames_carrying_parameter_sets)
{
    Media::NonReferenceFrameDetector detector;
    auto sets = H264::parse_parameter_sets_from_configuration_record(h264_configuration());
    VERIFY(sets.has_value());
    EXPECT(!detector.frame_is_non_reference(coded_frame(Media::CodecID::H264, { H264_IDR_SLICE }, h264_configuration())));
    EXPECT(!detector.frame_is_non_reference(coded_frame(Media::CodecID::H264, { sets->sequence[0], H264_NON_REFERENCE_SLICE })));
    EXPECT(!detector.frame_is_non_reference(coded_frame(Media::CodecID::H264, { sets->picture[0], H264_NON_REFERENCE_SLICE })));
    EXPECT(detector.frame_is_non_reference(coded_frame(Media::CodecID::H264, { H264_NON_REFERENCE_SLICE })));
}

TEST_CASE(h264_reports_nothing_without_a_usable_configuration)
{
    Media::NonReferenceFrameDetector detector;
    EXPECT(!detector.frame_is_non_reference(coded_frame(Media::CodecID::H264, { H264_NON_REFERENCE_SLICE })));

    Array<u8, 1> truncated_configuration { 0x01 };
    EXPECT(!detector.frame_is_non_reference(coded_frame(Media::CodecID::H264, { H264_NON_REFERENCE_SLICE }, truncated_configuration.span())));
}

TEST_CASE(h264_reports_nothing_for_frames_that_cannot_be_split)
{
    Media::NonReferenceFrameDetector detector;
    EXPECT(!detector.frame_is_non_reference(coded_frame(Media::CodecID::H264, { H264_IDR_SLICE }, h264_configuration())));

    auto frame_data = length_prefixed_nal_units({ H264_NON_REFERENCE_SLICE });
    auto overrunning_data = MUST(FixedArray<u8>::create(frame_data.span()));
    overrunning_data[3] = 0xff;
    EXPECT(!detector.frame_is_non_reference(Media::CodedFrame(Media::CodecID::H264, {}, {}, {}, Media::FrameFlags::None, move(overrunning_data))));
}

TEST_CASE(a_codec_change_without_a_configuration_stops_reports)
{
    Media::NonReferenceFrameDetector detector;
    EXPECT(!detector.frame_is_non_reference(coded_frame(Media::CodecID::H264, { H264_IDR_SLICE }, h264_configuration())));
    EXPECT(detector.frame_is_non_reference(coded_frame(Media::CodecID::H264, { H264_NON_REFERENCE_SLICE })));
    EXPECT(!detector.frame_is_non_reference(coded_frame(Media::CodecID::VP9, { H264_NON_REFERENCE_SLICE })));
    EXPECT(!detector.frame_is_non_reference(coded_frame(Media::CodecID::H264, { H264_NON_REFERENCE_SLICE })));
}

// Two-byte headers: the type in bits 1 to 6 of the first byte, and TemporalId + 1 in the low bits of the second.
static constexpr Array<u8, 3> H265_IDR_SLICE { 0x26, 0x01, 0xaf };
static constexpr Array<u8, 3> H265_TRAIL_R_SLICE { 0x02, 0x01, 0xd0 };
static constexpr Array<u8, 3> H265_TRAIL_N_SLICE { 0x00, 0x01, 0xd0 };
static constexpr Array<u8, 3> H265_TRAIL_N_SLICE_AT_TEMPORAL_ID_1 { 0x00, 0x02, 0xd0 };
static constexpr Array<u8, 3> H265_RASL_N_SLICE { 0x10, 0x01, 0xd0 };

static ReadonlyBytes h265_configuration() { return H265::representative_configuration_record_for_profile(H265::Profile::Main); }

TEST_CASE(h265_reports_sub_layer_non_reference_frames_at_the_highest_temporal_id)
{
    Media::NonReferenceFrameDetector detector;
    EXPECT(!detector.frame_is_non_reference(coded_frame(Media::CodecID::H265, { H265_IDR_SLICE }, h265_configuration())));
    EXPECT(!detector.frame_is_non_reference(coded_frame(Media::CodecID::H265, { H265_TRAIL_R_SLICE })));
    EXPECT(detector.frame_is_non_reference(coded_frame(Media::CodecID::H265, { H265_TRAIL_N_SLICE })));
    EXPECT(detector.frame_is_non_reference(coded_frame(Media::CodecID::H265, { H265_RASL_N_SLICE })));
    EXPECT(!detector.frame_is_non_reference(coded_frame(Media::CodecID::H265, { H265_TRAIL_N_SLICE, H265_TRAIL_R_SLICE })));
    // The configuration's SPS allows a single sub-layer, so a picture above it says nothing about what references it.
    EXPECT(!detector.frame_is_non_reference(coded_frame(Media::CodecID::H265, { H265_TRAIL_N_SLICE_AT_TEMPORAL_ID_1 })));
}

TEST_CASE(h265_passes_non_reference_frames_carrying_parameter_sets)
{
    Media::NonReferenceFrameDetector detector;
    auto sets = H265::parse_parameter_sets_from_configuration_record(h265_configuration());
    VERIFY(sets.has_value());
    EXPECT(!detector.frame_is_non_reference(coded_frame(Media::CodecID::H265, { H265_IDR_SLICE }, h265_configuration())));
    EXPECT(!detector.frame_is_non_reference(coded_frame(Media::CodecID::H265, { sets->video[0], H265_TRAIL_N_SLICE })));
    EXPECT(!detector.frame_is_non_reference(coded_frame(Media::CodecID::H265, { sets->sequence[0], H265_TRAIL_N_SLICE })));
    EXPECT(!detector.frame_is_non_reference(coded_frame(Media::CodecID::H265, { sets->picture[0], H265_TRAIL_N_SLICE })));
    EXPECT(detector.frame_is_non_reference(coded_frame(Media::CodecID::H265, { H265_TRAIL_N_SLICE })));
}

#include <AK/Atomic.h>
#include <LibCore/EventLoop.h>
#include <LibCore/File.h>
#include <LibCore/Timer.h>

#include <LibMediaCodecs/VideoFrame.h>
#include <LibTest/TestCase.h>

#include "TestMediaCommon.h"

namespace {

TEST_SETUP
{
    (void)never_destroyed_event_loop();
    Media::install_video_decoders({ Media::hardware_video_decoders(), Media::ffmpeg_video_decoders() });
    Media::install_audio_decoders({ Media::audio_decoders() });
}

// sine_opus_1005ms.ogg: 48 kHz mono Opus, 48240 samples after a pre-skip of 312, packets of 960 samples.
constexpr i64 OPUS_PRE_SKIP = 312;
constexpr i64 OPUS_SAMPLE_COUNT = 48240;
// theora_vorbis_10fps.ogg: 64x48 Theora at 10 fps with a keyframe every 10 frames, beside 8 kHz mono Vorbis, 3 s.
constexpr size_t THEORA_FRAME_COUNT = 30;

ByteBuffer read_fixture(StringView path)
{
    auto file = MUST(Core::File::open(path, Core::File::OpenMode::Read));
    return MUST(file->read_until_eof());
}

Media::DecoderErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<Media::Demuxer>> demuxer_for(ByteBuffer const& data)
{
    return Media::Ogg::OggDemuxer::from_stream(Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_from_buffer(data));
}

Media::Track track_of_type(Media::Demuxer& demuxer, Media::TrackType type)
{
    auto track = MUST(demuxer.get_preferred_track_for_type(type));
    VERIFY(track.has_value());
    MUST(demuxer.create_context_for_track(*track));
    return *track;
}

AK::Duration time_of_sample(i64 sample, u32 sample_rate = 48000)
{
    return AK::Duration::from_time_units(sample, 1, sample_rate);
}

struct FrameIdentity {
    AK::Duration timestamp;
    size_t byte_count { 0 };
    bool operator==(FrameIdentity const&) const = default;
};

Vector<Media::CodedFrame> read_every_frame(Media::Demuxer& demuxer, Media::Track const& track)
{
    Vector<Media::CodedFrame> frames;
    while (true) {
        auto frame = demuxer.get_next_sample_for_track(track);
        if (frame.is_error()) {
            EXPECT_EQ(frame.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream);
            break;
        }
        frames.append(frame.release_value());
    }
    return frames;
}

Vector<FrameIdentity> identities_of(Vector<Media::CodedFrame> const& frames)
{
    Vector<FrameIdentity> identities;
    for (auto const& frame : frames)
        identities.append({ frame.presentation_timestamp(), frame.data().size() });
    return identities;
}

bool spin_until(Function<bool()> condition)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();
    auto deadline_expired = false;
    auto deadline_timer = Core::Timer::create_single_shot(AK::Duration::from_seconds(5), [&] { deadline_expired = true; });
    deadline_timer->start();
    loop.spin_until([&] { return condition() || deadline_expired; });
    return !deadline_expired;
}

Vector<Media::Ogg::PageHeader> page_headers(ByteBuffer const& data)
{
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_from_buffer(data);
    Media::Ogg::PageIterator pages { stream->create_cursor(), 0 };
    Vector<Media::Ogg::PageHeader> headers;
    while (pages.position() < data.size())
        headers.append(MUST(pages.read_next_page()).header);
    return headers;
}

Media::Ogg::Page packet_page(u32 sequence_number, bool continues_packet, ReadonlyBytes segment_sizes)
{
    size_t payload_size = 0;
    for (auto size : segment_sizes)
        payload_size += size;
    auto payload = MUST(FixedArray<u8>::create(payload_size));
    payload.span().fill(static_cast<u8>(sequence_number));
    return {
        .header = { .flags = static_cast<u8>(continues_packet ? 1 : 0), .sequence_number = sequence_number },
        .segment_sizes = MUST(FixedArray<u8>::create(segment_sizes)),
        .payload = move(payload),
    };
}

TEST_CASE(packet_assembly_handles_empty_packets_and_continuations)
{
    Media::Ogg::PacketAssembler assembler;
    auto first_page = packet_page(0, false, Array<u8, 4> { 0, 255, 0, 255 });
    auto packets = MUST(assembler.take_completed_packets(first_page));
    EXPECT_EQ(packets.size(), 2u);
    EXPECT(packets[0].is_empty());
    EXPECT_EQ(packets[1].size(), 255u);

    auto middle_page = packet_page(1, true, Array<u8, 1> { 255 });
    EXPECT(MUST(assembler.take_completed_packets(middle_page)).is_empty());
    auto final_page = packet_page(2, true, Array<u8, 2> { 0, 1 });
    packets = MUST(assembler.take_completed_packets(final_page));
    EXPECT_EQ(packets.size(), 2u);
    EXPECT_EQ(packets[0].size(), 510u);
    EXPECT_EQ(packets[0][0], 0u);
    EXPECT_EQ(packets[0][255], 1u);
    EXPECT_EQ(packets[1].size(), 1u);
    EXPECT_EQ(packets[1][0], 2u);
}

TEST_CASE(packet_assembly_discards_a_continuation_after_a_missing_page)
{
    Media::Ogg::PacketAssembler assembler;
    EXPECT(MUST(assembler.take_completed_packets(packet_page(0, false, Array<u8, 1> { 255 }))).is_empty());
    auto packets = MUST(assembler.take_completed_packets(packet_page(2, true, Array<u8, 2> { 1, 2 })));
    EXPECT_EQ(packets.size(), 1u);
    EXPECT_EQ(packets[0].size(), 2u);

    assembler.reset();
    packets = MUST(assembler.take_completed_packets(packet_page(2, true, Array<u8, 2> { 1, 2 })));
    EXPECT_EQ(packets.size(), 1u);
    EXPECT_EQ(packets[0].size(), 2u);
}

TEST_CASE(packet_assembly_preserves_continuity_across_sequence_number_wraparound)
{
    Media::Ogg::PacketAssembler assembler;
    EXPECT(MUST(assembler.take_completed_packets(packet_page(NumericLimits<u32>::max(), false, Array<u8, 1> { 255 }))).is_empty());
    auto packets = MUST(assembler.take_completed_packets(packet_page(0, true, Array<u8, 1> { 1 })));
    EXPECT_EQ(packets.size(), 1u);
    EXPECT_EQ(packets[0].size(), 256u);
}

TEST_CASE(buffered_scan_resynchronizes_after_an_invalid_header_near_the_end)
{
    auto data = read_fixture("buffered-ranges/tone_vorbis.ogg"sv);
    auto headers = page_headers(data);
    auto damaged_position = headers[headers.size() - 2].position;
    VERIFY(data.size() - damaged_position < Media::Ogg::MAXIMUM_PAGE_SIZE);
    data[damaged_position] = 'X';
    auto demuxer = MUST(demuxer_for(data));
    demuxer->set_scan_state_change_handler([](auto const&) { });
    auto expected_end = time_of_sample(headers.last().granule_position, 44100);
    EXPECT(spin_until([&] { return demuxer->scan_state().buffered_ranges().highest_end_time() == expected_end; }));
}

TEST_CASE(buffered_scan_waits_for_a_partial_page_to_finish)
{
    auto data = read_fixture("buffered-ranges/tone_vorbis.ogg"sv);
    auto headers = page_headers(data);
    auto const& partial_page = headers[headers.size() - 2];
    auto expected_end = time_of_sample(headers.last().granule_position, 44100);
    for (auto split_position : { partial_page.position + 12, partial_page.position + partial_page.byte_size / 2 }) {
        auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_empty();
        stream->add_chunk_at(0, data.bytes().trim(split_position));
        auto demuxer = MUST(Media::Ogg::OggDemuxer::from_stream(stream));
        demuxer->set_scan_state_change_handler([](auto const&) { });
        auto preceding_page_end = time_of_sample(headers[headers.size() - 3].granule_position, 44100);
        EXPECT(spin_until([&] { return demuxer->scan_state().duration == preceding_page_end; }));

        stream->add_chunk_at(split_position, data.bytes().slice(split_position));
        stream->close();
        EXPECT(spin_until([&] { return demuxer->scan_state().duration == expected_end; }));
    }
}

TEST_CASE(buffered_scan_connects_a_previously_isolated_link)
{
    auto data = read_fixture("Ogg/chained_opus_then_vorbis.ogg"sv);
    auto headers = page_headers(data);
    auto first_link_end_page = headers[3];
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_empty();
    stream->add_chunk_at(0, data.bytes().trim(first_link_end_page.position));
    stream->add_chunk_at(first_link_end_page.end_position(), data.bytes().slice(first_link_end_page.end_position()));
    auto demuxer = MUST(Media::Ogg::OggDemuxer::from_stream(stream));
    demuxer->set_scan_state_change_handler([](auto const&) { });
    EXPECT(spin_until([&] { return !demuxer->scan_state().buffered_ranges().is_empty(); }));

    stream->add_chunk_at(first_link_end_page.position, data.bytes().slice(first_link_end_page.position));
    stream->close();
    auto expected_end = time_of_sample(OPUS_SAMPLE_COUNT) + AK::Duration::from_seconds(1);
    EXPECT(spin_until([&] { return demuxer->scan_state().duration == expected_end; }));
    auto track = track_of_type(*demuxer, Media::TrackType::Audio);
    MUST(demuxer->seek_to_most_recent_keyframe(track, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1500), Media::DemuxerSeekOptions::None));
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track)).codec_id(), Media::CodecID::Vorbis);
}

TEST_CASE(buffered_scan_merges_concurrent_streams_discovered_separately)
{
    auto data = read_fixture("buffered-ranges/tone_vorbis.ogg"sv);
    auto first_link_headers = page_headers(data);
    auto first_link_duration = time_of_sample(first_link_headers.last().granule_position, 44100);
    auto second_link = read_fixture("Ogg/theora_vorbis_10fps.ogg"sv);
    auto second_link_headers = page_headers(second_link);
    auto missing_byte_position = data.size() + second_link_headers[0].end_position() - 1;
    MUST(data.try_append(second_link));
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_empty();
    stream->add_chunk_at(0, data.bytes().trim(missing_byte_position));
    stream->add_chunk_at(missing_byte_position + 1, data.bytes().slice(missing_byte_position + 1));
    auto demuxer = MUST(Media::Ogg::OggDemuxer::from_stream(stream));
    demuxer->set_scan_state_change_handler([](auto const&) { });
    EXPECT(spin_until([&] { return demuxer->scan_state().duration == first_link_duration; }));

    stream->add_chunk_at(missing_byte_position, data.bytes().slice(missing_byte_position));
    stream->close();
    EXPECT(spin_until([&] { return demuxer->scan_state().duration == first_link_duration + AK::Duration::from_seconds(3); }));
    auto track = track_of_type(*demuxer, Media::TrackType::Audio);
    MUST(demuxer->seek_to_most_recent_keyframe(track, first_link_duration + AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1500), Media::DemuxerSeekOptions::None));
    auto frame = MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track));
    EXPECT(frame.presentation_timestamp() >= first_link_duration);
    EXPECT(frame.presentation_timestamp() <= first_link_duration + AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1500));
}

TEST_CASE(buffered_scan_resolves_data_seen_before_its_stream_headers)
{
    auto data = read_fixture("Ogg/sine_opus_1005ms.ogg"sv);
    auto second_link_position = data.size();
    auto second_link = read_fixture("buffered-ranges/tone_vorbis.ogg"sv);
    auto headers = page_headers(second_link);
    auto second_link_header_end = second_link_position + headers[1].end_position();
    auto tail_position = second_link_position + headers[headers.size() / 2].position;
    MUST(data.try_append(second_link));
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_empty();
    stream->add_chunk_at(0, data.bytes().trim(second_link_position));
    stream->add_chunk_at(tail_position, data.bytes().slice(tail_position));
    auto demuxer = MUST(Media::Ogg::OggDemuxer::from_stream(stream));
    demuxer->set_scan_state_change_handler([](auto const&) { });
    EXPECT(spin_until([&] { return demuxer->scan_state().duration == time_of_sample(OPUS_SAMPLE_COUNT); }));

    stream->add_chunk_at(second_link_position, data.bytes().slice(second_link_position, second_link_header_end - second_link_position));
    auto expected_end = time_of_sample(OPUS_SAMPLE_COUNT) + time_of_sample(headers.last().granule_position, 44100);
    EXPECT(spin_until([&] { return demuxer->scan_state().duration == expected_end; }));
    EXPECT_EQ(demuxer->scan_state().buffered_ranges().size(), 2u);
}

TEST_CASE(buffered_scan_resumes_reading_later_link_headers)
{
    auto data = read_fixture("Ogg/chained_opus_then_vorbis.ogg"sv);
    auto headers = page_headers(data);
    auto split_position = headers[5].position + headers[5].byte_size / 2;

    stream->add_chunk_at(headers[6].position, data.bytes().slice(headers[6].position));

    stream->add_chunk_at(split_position, data.bytes().slice(split_position));
    stream->close();

}

TEST_CASE(buffered_scan_retains_later_vorbis_configuration_after_header_eviction)
{
    auto data = read_fixture("Ogg/chained_opus_then_vorbis.ogg"sv);
    auto headers = page_headers(data);
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_from_buffer(data);
    auto demuxer = MUST(Media::Ogg::OggDemuxer::from_stream(stream));
    demuxer->set_scan_state_change_handler([](auto const&) { });
    auto first_link_duration = time_of_sample(OPUS_SAMPLE_COUNT);
    EXPECT(spin_until([&] { return demuxer->scan_state().duration == first_link_duration + AK::Duration::from_seconds(1); }));

    stream->remove_byte_range(0, headers[6].position);
    EXPECT(spin_until([&] { return !demuxer->scan_state().resource_is_complete; }));
    auto ranges = demuxer->scan_state().buffered_ranges();
    EXPECT_EQ(ranges.size(), 1u);
    if (ranges.size() == 1) {
        EXPECT(ranges[0].start >= first_link_duration);
        EXPECT(ranges[0].start < first_link_duration + AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(50));
    }
}

// Pre-skip is dropped by the decoder, and the last page's granule position trims the last packet, so the packets
// cover exactly the stream's samples.
TEST_CASE(demuxer_leaves_opus_pre_skip_out_and_trims_the_last_packet)
{
    auto demuxer = MUST(demuxer_for(read_fixture("Ogg/sine_opus_1005ms.ogg"sv)));
    auto track = track_of_type(*demuxer, Media::TrackType::Audio);
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(demuxer->total_duration()), time_of_sample(OPUS_SAMPLE_COUNT));

    auto frames = read_every_frame(*demuxer, track);
    VERIFY(!frames.is_empty());
    EXPECT(frames.first().new_codec_configuration().has_value());
    EXPECT_EQ(frames.first().presentation_timestamp(), AK::Duration::zero());
    EXPECT_EQ(frames.first().leading_discard(), AK::Duration::zero());
    EXPECT_EQ(frames.first().duration(), time_of_sample(960 - OPUS_PRE_SKIP));

    for (size_t i = 1; i < frames.size(); i++) {
        auto const& previous = frames[i - 1];
        EXPECT_EQ(frames[i].presentation_timestamp(), previous.presentation_timestamp() + previous.duration());
        EXPECT(!frames[i].new_codec_configuration().has_value());
    }
    auto const& last = frames.last();
    EXPECT(last.trailing_discard() > AK::Duration::zero());
    EXPECT_EQ(last.presentation_timestamp() + last.duration(), time_of_sample(OPUS_SAMPLE_COUNT));
}

TEST_CASE(demuxer_reads_theora_frames_and_their_keyframes)

TEST_CASE(theora_frames_decode_to_the_end)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();
    auto demuxer = MUST(demuxer_for(read_fixture("Ogg/theora_vorbis_10fps.ogg"sv)));
    auto track = MUST(demuxer->get_preferred_track_for_type(Media::TrackType::Video));
    auto producer = MUST(Media::DecodedVideoProducer::try_create(loop, demuxer, *track));
    producer->set_error_handler([](Media::DecoderError&& error) {
        FAIL(ByteString::formatted("Decoding failed: {}", error.description()));
    });
    producer->start();

    Vector<AK::Duration> timestamps;
    EXPECT(spin_until([&] {
        while (true) {
            auto output = producer->peek();
            if (output.status == Media::PipelineStatus::HaveData) {
                timestamps.append(output.frame->timestamp());
                producer->consume();
                continue;
            }
            return output.status == Media::PipelineStatus::EndOfStream;
        }
    }));
    EXPECT_EQ(timestamps.size(), THEORA_FRAME_COUNT);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < timestamps.size(); i++)
        EXPECT_EQ(timestamps[i], AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(static_cast<i64>(i) * 100));
}

TEST_CASE(demuxer_seeks_video_to_the_keyframe_the_target_depends_on)
{
    auto demuxer = MUST(demuxer_for(read_fixture("Ogg/theora_vorbis_10fps.ogg"sv)));
    auto track = track_of_type(*demuxer, Media::TrackType::Video);

    for (auto target_milliseconds : { 1550, 1000, 2950, 50 }) {
        MUST(demuxer->seek_to_most_recent_keyframe(track, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(target_milliseconds), Media::DemuxerSeekOptions::None));
        auto frame = MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track));
        EXPECT(frame.is_keyframe());
        EXPECT_EQ(frame.presentation_timestamp(), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(static_cast<i64>(target_milliseconds / 1000) * 1000));
    }
}

// A seek lands before its target, early enough for Opus to have converged by then, and no more than a page earlier.
TEST_CASE(demuxer_seeks_audio_before_the_target)
{
    auto demuxer = MUST(demuxer_for(read_fixture("buffered-ranges/tone_opus.ogg"sv)));
    auto track = track_of_type(*demuxer, Media::TrackType::Audio);

    for (auto target_milliseconds : { 20'000, 3'500, 29'900, 100 }) {
        auto target = AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(target_milliseconds);
        MUST(demuxer->seek_to_most_recent_keyframe(track, target, Media::DemuxerSeekOptions::None));
        auto frame = MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track));
        auto start = frame.presentation_timestamp() - frame.leading_discard();
        EXPECT(start <= target - AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(80) || start <= AK::Duration::zero());
        EXPECT(start >= target - AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1'100));
    }
}

TEST_CASE(demuxer_plays_through_a_chained_file)
{
    auto demuxer = MUST(demuxer_for(read_fixture("Ogg/chained_opus_then_vorbis.ogg"sv)));
    // A chained file's duration is learned by reading its links.
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(demuxer->total_duration()), AK::Duration::zero());

    auto tracks = MUST(demuxer->get_tracks_for_type(Media::TrackType::Audio));
    EXPECT_EQ(tracks.size(), 1u);
    auto track = track_of_type(*demuxer, Media::TrackType::Audio);

    auto frames = read_every_frame(*demuxer, track);
    Optional<size_t> second_link_start;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < frames.size(); i++) {
        if (frames[i].codec_id() == Media::CodecID::Vorbis) {
            second_link_start = i;
            break;
        }
    }
    if (!second_link_start.has_value()) {
        FAIL("The second link's frames were not delivered");
        return;
    }
    auto const& first_vorbis_frame = frames[*second_link_start];
    EXPECT(first_vorbis_frame.new_codec_configuration().has_value());
    // The second link starts where the first ends.
    auto first_link_end = time_of_sample(OPUS_SAMPLE_COUNT);
    EXPECT(first_vorbis_frame.presentation_timestamp() >= first_link_end);
    EXPECT(first_vorbis_frame.presentation_timestamp() <= first_link_end + AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(50));
    for (size_t i = 1; i < frames.size(); i++)
        EXPECT(frames[i].presentation_timestamp() >= frames[i - 1].presentation_timestamp());
    auto end = frames.last().presentation_timestamp() + frames.last().duration();
    EXPECT_EQ(end, first_link_end + AK::Duration::from_seconds(1));
}

TEST_CASE(demuxer_grows_buffered_ranges_and_seeks_across_a_chain)
{
    auto demuxer = MUST(demuxer_for(read_fixture("Ogg/chained_opus_then_vorbis.ogg"sv)));
    auto track = track_of_type(*demuxer, Media::TrackType::Audio);

    demuxer->set_scan_state_change_handler([](auto const&) { });
    auto expected_end = time_of_sample(OPUS_SAMPLE_COUNT) + AK::Duration::from_seconds(1);
    EXPECT(spin_until([&] { return demuxer->scan_state().duration == expected_end; }));
    auto ranges = demuxer->scan_state().buffered_ranges();
    EXPECT_EQ(ranges.size(), 1u);
    if (ranges.size() == 1)
        EXPECT_EQ(ranges[0].end, expected_end);

    MUST(demuxer->seek_to_most_recent_keyframe(track, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1'500), Media::DemuxerSeekOptions::None));
    auto frame = MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track));
    EXPECT_EQ(frame.codec_id(), Media::CodecID::Vorbis);
    EXPECT(frame.new_codec_configuration().has_value());
    EXPECT(frame.presentation_timestamp() <= AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1'500));

    MUST(demuxer->seek_to_most_recent_keyframe(track, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(500), Media::DemuxerSeekOptions::None));
    frame = MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track));
    EXPECT_EQ(frame.codec_id(), Media::CodecID::Opus);
    EXPECT(frame.new_codec_configuration().has_value());
    EXPECT(frame.presentation_timestamp() <= AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(500));
}

// An aborted read is retried by the next call, which delivers the frame the aborted read was after, so a pass
// interrupted anywhere delivers the same frames as one that was not.
TEST_CASE(demuxer_resumes_an_aborted_read_with_the_frame_it_was_reading)
{
    auto file_data = read_fixture("buffered-ranges/tone_vorbis.ogg"sv);

    Vector<FrameIdentity> expected_frames;
    {
        auto demuxer = MUST(demuxer_for(file_data));
        auto track = track_of_type(*demuxer, Media::TrackType::Audio);
        expected_frames = identities_of(read_every_frame(*demuxer, track));
    }

    // The data ends inside a page, so the read that blocks has part of its page. The tail is there for the duration.
    auto initial_chunk_size = (file_data.size() / 3) + 1000;
    auto tail_start = file_data.size() - (2 * Media::Ogg::MAXIMUM_PAGE_SIZE);
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_empty();
    stream->set_expected_size(file_data.size());
    stream->add_chunk_at(0, file_data.bytes().trim(initial_chunk_size));
    stream->add_chunk_at(tail_start, file_data.bytes().slice(tail_start));

    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA auto demuxer = MUST(Media::Ogg::OggDemuxer::from_stream(stream));
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA auto track = track_of_type(*demuxer, Media::TrackType::Audio);

    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<bool> read_blocked { false };
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<bool> read_was_aborted { false };
    demuxer->set_read_blocked_change_handler_for_track(track, [&](Media::ReadBlocked blocked) {
        read_blocked = blocked == Media::ReadBlocked::Yes;
    });

    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Vector<FrameIdentity> actual_frames;
    auto reader_thread = Threading::Thread::construct("TestReader"sv, [&]() -> intptr_t {
        while (true) {
            auto frame = demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track);
            if (frame.is_error()) {
                EXPECT_EQ(frame.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::Aborted);
                break;
            }
            actual_frames.append({ frame.value().presentation_timestamp(), frame.value().data().size() });
        }
        // Like a producer, the reading thread allows reads again before it reads on.
        demuxer->reset_blocking_reads_aborted_for_track(track);
        read_was_aborted = true;
        actual_frames.extend(identities_of(read_every_frame(*demuxer, track)));
        return 0;
    });
    reader_thread->start();

    while (!read_blocked.load()) { }
    demuxer->set_blocking_reads_aborted_for_track(track);
    while (!read_was_aborted.load()) { }

    stream->add_chunk_at(initial_chunk_size, file_data.bytes().slice(initial_chunk_size));
    stream->close();
    MUST(reader_thread->join());

    EXPECT_EQ(actual_frames.size(), expected_frames.size());
    for (size_t index = 0; index < min(actual_frames.size(), expected_frames.size()); index++) {
        if (actual_frames[index] != expected_frames[index]) {
            FAIL(ByteString::formatted("Frame {} differs after the abort: {}ms/{} bytes instead of {}ms/{} bytes", index, actual_frames[index].timestamp.to_milliseconds(), actual_frames[index].byte_count, expected_frames[index].timestamp.to_milliseconds(), expected_frames[index].byte_count));
            break;
        }
    }
}

// A page that fails its CRC is skipped, losing only the packets it completes, and the packets after it keep their
// times since every page carries its own granule position.
TEST_CASE(demuxer_reads_on_past_a_damaged_page)
{
    auto file_data = read_fixture("buffered-ranges/tone_opus.ogg"sv);
    Vector<FrameIdentity> intact_frames;
    {
        auto demuxer = MUST(demuxer_for(file_data));
        auto track = track_of_type(*demuxer, Media::TrackType::Audio);
        intact_frames = identities_of(read_every_frame(*demuxer, track));
    }

    auto damaged_data = MUST(ByteBuffer::copy(file_data));
    damaged_data[damaged_data.size() / 2] ^= 0xFF;
    auto demuxer = MUST(demuxer_for(damaged_data));
    auto track = track_of_type(*demuxer, Media::TrackType::Audio);
    auto damaged_frames = identities_of(read_every_frame(*demuxer, track));

    EXPECT(damaged_frames.size() < intact_frames.size());
    EXPECT(damaged_frames.size() > intact_frames.size() - 100);
    EXPECT_EQ(damaged_frames.last(), intact_frames.last());
}

TEST_CASE(demuxer_declines_what_it_cannot_read)
{
    auto not_ogg = demuxer_for(read_fixture("WAV/tone_8000_mono.wav"sv));
    EXPECT(not_ogg.is_error());
    if (not_ogg.is_error())
        EXPECT_EQ(not_ogg.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::UnrecognizedFormat);
}

TEST_CASE(identification_refuses_sample_rates_outside_the_supported_range)
{
    auto vorbis_with_sample_rate = [](u32 sample_rate) {
        Array<u8, 30> packet {};
        "\x01vorbis"sv.bytes().copy_to(packet.span());
        packet[11] = 1;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof(sample_rate); i++)
            packet[12 + i] = static_cast<u8>(sample_rate >> (i * 8));
        return Media::Ogg::identify_stream(packet.span());
    };
    auto flac_with_sample_rate = [](u32 sample_rate) {
        Array<u8, 17 + 34> packet {};
        packet[0] = 0x7F;
        "FLAC"sv.bytes().copy_to(packet.span().slice(1));
        packet[5] = 1;
        "fLaC"sv.bytes().copy_to(packet.span().slice(9));
        // Block sizes of 4096.
        packet[17 + 0] = packet[17 + 2] = 0x10;
        packet[17 + 10] = static_cast<u8>(sample_rate >> 12);
        packet[17 + 11] = static_cast<u8>(sample_rate >> 4);
        packet[17 + 12] = static_cast<u8>((sample_rate & 0xF) << 4);
        return Media::Ogg::identify_stream(packet.span());
    };

    for (auto identify : { +vorbis_with_sample_rate, +flac_with_sample_rate }) {
        EXPECT(!identify(Media::MIN_AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE).is_error());
        EXPECT(!identify(Media::MAX_AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE).is_error());
        EXPECT_EQ(identify(Media::MIN_AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE - 1).error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::NotImplemented);
        EXPECT_EQ(identify(Media::MAX_AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE + 1).error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::NotImplemented);
    }
}

// A seek into data that is not there yet asks for little more than the pages its probes land on.
TEST_CASE(demuxer_seeks_into_unbuffered_data_with_few_requests)
{
    auto file_data = read_fixture("buffered-ranges/tone_opus.ogg"sv);
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    constexpr size_t head_size = 4 * KiB;
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_empty();
    stream->set_expected_size(file_data.size());
    stream->add_chunk_at(0, file_data.bytes().trim(head_size));

    // Serve the way a server does once asked: each request starts delivery at its offset, delivery goes on from
    // there a slice at a time, and a stopped request ends it.
    Vector<u64> requested_offsets;
    Optional<size_t> serving_position;
    stream->set_data_request_callback([&](Optional<u64> offset) {
        serving_position = offset.map([](u64 value) { return static_cast<size_t>(value); });
        if (offset.has_value())
            requested_offsets.append(*offset);
    });
    auto server = Core::Timer::create_repeating(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1), [&] {
        if (!serving_position.has_value() || *serving_position >= file_data.size())
            return;
        auto slice_size = min<size_t>(8 * KiB, file_data.size() - *serving_position);
        stream->add_chunk_at(*serving_position, file_data.bytes().slice(*serving_position, slice_size));
        *serving_position += slice_size;
    });
    server->start();

    // The fetch that delivered the head was stopped, so each read of data that is not there asks for a request from
    // its own position, starting with the duration's read of the end of the file.
    stream->set_may_idle(true);
    stream->set_may_idle(false);

    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA RefPtr<Media::Demuxer> demuxer;
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<bool> loaded { false };
    auto loader_thread = Threading::Thread::construct("TestLoader"sv, [&]() -> intptr_t {
        demuxer = MUST(Media::Ogg::OggDemuxer::from_stream(stream));
        loaded = true;
        return 0;
    });
    loader_thread->start();
    EXPECT(spin_until([&] { return loaded.load(); }));
    MUST(loader_thread->join());
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA auto track = track_of_type(*demuxer, Media::TrackType::Audio);
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(demuxer->total_duration()), AK::Duration::from_seconds(30));

    // The player stopped the fetch once its buffer was full and lets it go again for the seek.
    stream->set_may_idle(true);
    stream->set_may_idle(false);
    serving_position = {};
    auto requests_before_seeking = requested_offsets.size();

    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA auto target = AK::Duration::from_seconds(20);
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA AK::Duration landed_timestamp;
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<bool> seek_finished { false };
    auto seeker_thread = Threading::Thread::construct("TestSeeker"sv, [&]() -> intptr_t {
        MUST(demuxer->seek_to_most_recent_keyframe(track, target, Media::DemuxerSeekOptions::None));
        landed_timestamp = MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track)).presentation_timestamp();
        seek_finished = true;
        return 0;
    });
    seeker_thread->start();

    if (!spin_until([&] { return seek_finished.load(); }))
        FAIL(ByteString::formatted("The seek did not finish: {} requests, serving at {}", requested_offsets.size(), serving_position));
    server->stop();
    stream->set_data_request_callback(nullptr);
    MUST(seeker_thread->join());
    (void)loop;

    EXPECT(landed_timestamp <= target);
    EXPECT(landed_timestamp >= target - AK::Duration::from_seconds(2));
    EXPECT(requested_offsets.size() - requests_before_seeking <= 3);
}

}

namespace {

Media::Matroska::Streamer streamer_from_bytes(ReadonlyBytes bytes)
{
    return Media::Matroska::Streamer(make_ref_counted<Media::ReadonlyBytesCursor>(bytes));
}

void append_ebml_id(ByteBuffer& data, u32 id)
{
    bool saw_non_zero_byte = false;
    for (int shift = 24; shift >= 0; shift -= 8) {
        auto byte = static_cast<u8>(id >> shift);
        if (byte != 0)
            saw_non_zero_byte = true;
        if (saw_non_zero_byte)
            data.append(byte);
    }
}

void append_big_endian_uint(ByteBuffer& data, u64 value, size_t value_byte_width)
{
    VERIFY(value_byte_width <= sizeof(value));
    for (auto shift = static_cast<int>((value_byte_width - 1) * 8); shift >= 0; shift -= 8)
        data.append(static_cast<u8>(value >> shift));
}

void patch_big_endian_uint(ByteBuffer& data, size_t offset, u64 value, size_t value_byte_width)
{
    VERIFY(offset + value_byte_width <= data.size());
    for (size_t i = 0; i < value_byte_width; ++i)
        data[offset + i] = static_cast<u8>(value >> ((value_byte_width - i - 1) * 8));
}

void append_ebml_size(ByteBuffer& data, u64 element_data_size, size_t vint_byte_width = 1)
{
    VERIFY(vint_byte_width >= 1);
    VERIFY(vint_byte_width <= 8);
    VERIFY(element_data_size < (1ull << (vint_byte_width * 7)));

    auto size_payload_offset = data.size();
    append_big_endian_uint(data, element_data_size, vint_byte_width);
    data[size_payload_offset] |= 1u << (8 - vint_byte_width);
}

void patch_ebml_size(ByteBuffer& data, size_t offset, u64 element_data_size, size_t vint_byte_width)
{
    VERIFY(vint_byte_width >= 1);
    VERIFY(vint_byte_width <= 8);
    VERIFY(offset + vint_byte_width <= data.size());
    VERIFY(element_data_size < (1ull << (vint_byte_width * 7)));

    patch_big_endian_uint(data, offset, element_data_size, vint_byte_width);
    data[offset] |= 1u << (8 - vint_byte_width);
}

struct EBMLMaster {
    size_t size_offset { 0 };
    size_t payload_start { 0 };
};

EBMLMaster begin_ebml_master(ByteBuffer& data, u32 id)
{
    append_ebml_id(data, id);
    auto size_offset = data.size();
    append_ebml_size(data, 0, 8);
    return { size_offset, data.size() };
}

void finish_ebml_master(ByteBuffer& data, EBMLMaster master)
{
    patch_ebml_size(data, master.size_offset, data.size() - master.payload_start, 8);
}

size_t append_ebml_uint(ByteBuffer& data, u32 id, u64 value, size_t value_byte_width = 0)
{
    append_ebml_id(data, id);
    if (value_byte_width == 0) {
        value_byte_width = 1;
        while (value_byte_width < sizeof(value) && value >= (1ull << (value_byte_width * 8)))
            ++value_byte_width;
    }
    append_ebml_size(data, value_byte_width);
    auto payload_position = data.size();
    append_big_endian_uint(data, value, value_byte_width);
    return payload_position;
}

void append_ebml_float(ByteBuffer& data, u32 id, double value)
{
    append_ebml_id(data, id);
    append_ebml_size(data, sizeof(value));
    append_big_endian_uint(data, bit_cast<u64>(value), sizeof(value));
}

void append_ebml_string(ByteBuffer& data, u32 id, StringView value)
{
    append_ebml_id(data, id);
    append_ebml_size(data, value.length());
    data.append(value.bytes());
}

void append_empty_ebml_master(ByteBuffer& data, u32 id)
{
    auto master = begin_ebml_master(data, id);
    finish_ebml_master(data, master);
}

size_t append_seek_head(ByteBuffer& data, u32 target_id)
{
    auto seek_head = begin_ebml_master(data, Media::Matroska::SEEK_HEAD_ELEMENT_ID);
    auto seek = begin_ebml_master(data, Media::Matroska::SEEK_ELEMENT_ID);
    append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::SEEK_ID_ELEMENT_ID, target_id, 4);
    auto seek_position_payload_offset = append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::SEEK_POSITION_ELEMENT_ID, 0, 8);
    finish_ebml_master(data, seek);
    finish_ebml_master(data, seek_head);
    return seek_position_payload_offset;
}

void append_ebml_binary(ByteBuffer& data, u32 id, ReadonlyBytes value)
{
    append_ebml_id(data, id);
    append_ebml_size(data, value.size());
    MUST(data.try_append(value));
}

// An AV1 configuration record whose sequence header describes BT.2020 with the SMPTE 2084 transfer function.
constexpr Array<u8, 21> BT2020_PQ_AV1_CONFIGURATION_RECORD {
    0x81, 0x08, 0x0c, 0x00,
    0x0a, 0x0f, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x43, 0xfc, 0x1d, 0xfc, 0x10, 0xdd, 0xc2, 0x79, 0x90, 0x91, 0x00, 0x90
};

enum class WithColorElement : u8 {
    No,
    Yes,
    WithOnlyHighDynamicRangeMetadata,
    WithInfiniteMasteringLuminance,
    WithTwoByteMasteringLuminance,
    WithOnlyMasteringLuminances,
    WithOutOfRangeMasteringChromaticity,
    WithNineByteMaximumContentLightLevel,
};

ByteBuffer make_matroska_with_av1_track(WithColorElement with_color_element, Function<void(ByteBuffer&)> const& append_cluster_contents = {})
{
    ByteBuffer data;
    auto ebml_header = begin_ebml_master(data, Media::Matroska::EBML_MASTER_ELEMENT_ID);
    append_ebml_string(data, Media::Matroska::DOCTYPE_ELEMENT_ID, "webm"sv);
    append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::DOCTYPE_VERSION_ELEMENT_ID, 4);
    finish_ebml_master(data, ebml_header);

    auto segment = begin_ebml_master(data, Media::Matroska::SEGMENT_ELEMENT_ID);
    auto info = begin_ebml_master(data, Media::Matroska::SEGMENT_INFORMATION_ELEMENT_ID);
    append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::TIMESTAMP_SCALE_ID, 1000000);
    finish_ebml_master(data, info);

    auto tracks = begin_ebml_master(data, Media::Matroska::TRACK_ELEMENT_ID);
    auto track_entry = begin_ebml_master(data, Media::Matroska::TRACK_ENTRY_ID);
    append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::TRACK_NUMBER_ID, 1);
    append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::TRACK_UID_ID, 1);
    append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::TRACK_TYPE_ID, 1);
    append_ebml_string(data, Media::Matroska::TRACK_CODEC_ID, "V_AV1"sv);
    append_ebml_binary(data, Media::Matroska::TRACK_CODEC_PRIVATE_ID, BT2020_PQ_AV1_CONFIGURATION_RECORD);
    auto video = begin_ebml_master(data, Media::Matroska::TRACK_VIDEO_ID);
    append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::PIXEL_WIDTH_ID, 1920);
    append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::PIXEL_HEIGHT_ID, 1080);
    if (with_color_element == WithColorElement::Yes) {
        auto color = begin_ebml_master(data, Media::Matroska::COLOR_ENTRY_ID);
        append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::PRIMARIES_ID, 1);
        append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::TRANSFER_CHARACTERISTICS_ID, 1);
        append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::MATRIX_COEFFICIENTS_ID, 1);
        finish_ebml_master(data, color);
    } else if (with_color_element != WithColorElement::No) {
        auto color = begin_ebml_master(data, Media::Matroska::COLOR_ENTRY_ID);
        if (with_color_element == WithColorElement::WithNineByteMaximumContentLightLevel)
            append_ebml_binary(data, Media::Matroska::MAX_CLL_ID, Array<u8, 9> { 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0x03, 0xed });
        else
            append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::MAX_CLL_ID, 1005);
        append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::MAX_FALL_ID, 315);
        auto mastering_metadata = begin_ebml_master(data, Media::Matroska::MASTERING_METADATA_ID);
        if (with_color_element != WithColorElement::WithOnlyMasteringLuminances) {
            append_ebml_float(data, Media::Matroska::PRIMARY_R_CHROMATICITY_X_ID, with_color_element == WithColorElement::WithOutOfRangeMasteringChromaticity ? 1.25 : 0.708);
            append_ebml_float(data, Media::Matroska::PRIMARY_R_CHROMATICITY_Y_ID, 0.292);
            append_ebml_float(data, Media::Matroska::PRIMARY_G_CHROMATICITY_X_ID, 0.170);
            append_ebml_float(data, Media::Matroska::PRIMARY_G_CHROMATICITY_Y_ID, 0.797);
            append_ebml_float(data, Media::Matroska::PRIMARY_B_CHROMATICITY_X_ID, 0.131);
            append_ebml_float(data, Media::Matroska::PRIMARY_B_CHROMATICITY_Y_ID, 0.046);
            append_ebml_float(data, Media::Matroska::WHITE_POINT_CHROMATICITY_X_ID, 0.3127);
            append_ebml_float(data, Media::Matroska::WHITE_POINT_CHROMATICITY_Y_ID, 0.3290);
        }
        if (with_color_element == WithColorElement::WithTwoByteMasteringLuminance)
            append_ebml_binary(data, Media::Matroska::LUMINANCE_MAX_ID, Array<u8, 2> { 0x03, 0xe8 });
        else
            append_ebml_float(data, Media::Matroska::LUMINANCE_MAX_ID, with_color_element == WithColorElement::WithInfiniteMasteringLuminance ? AK::Infinity<double> : 1000);
        append_ebml_float(data, Media::Matroska::LUMINANCE_MIN_ID, 0.005);
        finish_ebml_master(data, mastering_metadata);
        finish_ebml_master(data, color);
    }
    finish_ebml_master(data, video);
    finish_ebml_master(data, track_entry);
    finish_ebml_master(data, tracks);

    auto cluster = begin_ebml_master(data, Media::Matroska::CLUSTER_ELEMENT_ID);
    append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::TIMESTAMP_ID, 0);
    if (append_cluster_contents)
        append_cluster_contents(data);
    finish_ebml_master(data, cluster);
    finish_ebml_master(data, segment);
    return data;
}

struct LinkedSeekHeadsTestFile {
    ByteBuffer data;
    size_t cluster_end { 0 };
    size_t cues_position { 0 };
};

LinkedSeekHeadsTestFile make_matroska_with_linked_seek_heads(size_t seek_head_count = 3)
{
    VERIFY(seek_head_count > 0);

    ByteBuffer data;
    auto ebml_header = begin_ebml_master(data, Media::Matroska::EBML_MASTER_ELEMENT_ID);
    append_ebml_string(data, Media::Matroska::DOCTYPE_ELEMENT_ID, "webm"sv);
    append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::DOCTYPE_VERSION_ELEMENT_ID, 4);
    finish_ebml_master(data, ebml_header);

    auto segment = begin_ebml_master(data, Media::Matroska::SEGMENT_ELEMENT_ID);
    auto segment_contents_position = data.size();

    Vector<size_t> seek_head_positions;
    Vector<size_t> seek_head_position_patch_offsets;

    MUST(seek_head_positions.try_append(data.size()));
    MUST(seek_head_position_patch_offsets.try_append(append_seek_head(data, seek_head_count == 1 ? Media::Matroska::CUES_ID : Media::Matroska::SEEK_HEAD_ELEMENT_ID)));

    auto info = begin_ebml_master(data, Media::Matroska::SEGMENT_INFORMATION_ELEMENT_ID);
    append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::TIMESTAMP_SCALE_ID, 1000000);
    finish_ebml_master(data, info);

    auto tracks = begin_ebml_master(data, Media::Matroska::TRACK_ELEMENT_ID);
    auto track_entry = begin_ebml_master(data, Media::Matroska::TRACK_ENTRY_ID);
    append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::TRACK_NUMBER_ID, 1);
    append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::TRACK_UID_ID, 1);
    append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::TRACK_TYPE_ID, 1);
    append_ebml_string(data, Media::Matroska::TRACK_CODEC_ID, "V_VP9"sv);
    auto video = begin_ebml_master(data, Media::Matroska::TRACK_VIDEO_ID);
    append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::PIXEL_WIDTH_ID, 1);
    append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::PIXEL_HEIGHT_ID, 1);
    finish_ebml_master(data, video);
    finish_ebml_master(data, track_entry);
    finish_ebml_master(data, tracks);

    append_empty_ebml_master(data, Media::Matroska::CLUSTER_ELEMENT_ID);
    auto cluster_end = data.size();

    data.append(Media::Matroska::EBML_VOID_ELEMENT_ID);
    data.append(0x8e);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < 14; ++i)
        data.append(0);

    auto cues_position = data.size();
    auto cues = begin_ebml_master(data, Media::Matroska::CUES_ID);
    auto cue_point = begin_ebml_master(data, Media::Matroska::CUE_POINT_ID);
    append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::CUE_TIME_ID, 0);
    auto cue_track_positions = begin_ebml_master(data, Media::Matroska::CUE_TRACK_POSITIONS_ID);
    append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::CUE_TRACK_ID, 1);
    append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::CUE_CLUSTER_POSITION_ID, 0);
    finish_ebml_master(data, cue_track_positions);
    finish_ebml_master(data, cue_point);
    finish_ebml_master(data, cues);

    for (size_t i = 1; i < seek_head_count; ++i) {
        MUST(seek_head_positions.try_append(data.size()));
        auto target_id = i + 1 == seek_head_count ? Media::Matroska::CUES_ID : Media::Matroska::SEEK_HEAD_ELEMENT_ID;
        MUST(seek_head_position_patch_offsets.try_append(append_seek_head(data, target_id)));
    }

    for (size_t i = 0; i < seek_head_count; ++i) {
        auto target_position = i + 1 == seek_head_count ? cues_position : seek_head_positions[i + 1];
        patch_big_endian_uint(data, seek_head_position_patch_offsets[i], target_position - segment_contents_position, 8);
    }

    finish_ebml_master(data, segment);

    return { move(data), cluster_end, cues_position };
}

enum class SegmentSize : u8 {
    Undeclared,
    LongerThanTheStream,
};

enum class ClusterSize : u8 {
    Known,
    Unknown,
};

ByteBuffer make_matroska_without_cues(SegmentSize segment_size, ClusterSize cluster_size)
{
    ByteBuffer data;
    auto ebml_header = begin_ebml_master(data, Media::Matroska::EBML_MASTER_ELEMENT_ID);
    append_ebml_string(data, Media::Matroska::DOCTYPE_ELEMENT_ID, "webm"sv);
    append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::DOCTYPE_VERSION_ELEMENT_ID, 4);
    finish_ebml_master(data, ebml_header);

    append_ebml_id(data, Media::Matroska::SEGMENT_ELEMENT_ID);
    auto segment_size_offset = data.size();
    append_ebml_size(data, 0, 8);
    auto segment_contents_position = data.size();

    auto info = begin_ebml_master(data, Media::Matroska::SEGMENT_INFORMATION_ELEMENT_ID);
    append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::TIMESTAMP_SCALE_ID, 1000000);
    finish_ebml_master(data, info);

    auto tracks = begin_ebml_master(data, Media::Matroska::TRACK_ELEMENT_ID);
    auto track_entry = begin_ebml_master(data, Media::Matroska::TRACK_ENTRY_ID);
    append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::TRACK_NUMBER_ID, 1);
    append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::TRACK_UID_ID, 1);
    append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::TRACK_TYPE_ID, 1);
    append_ebml_string(data, Media::Matroska::TRACK_CODEC_ID, "V_VP9"sv);
    auto video = begin_ebml_master(data, Media::Matroska::TRACK_VIDEO_ID);
    append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::PIXEL_WIDTH_ID, 1);
    append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::PIXEL_HEIGHT_ID, 1);
    finish_ebml_master(data, video);
    finish_ebml_master(data, track_entry);
    finish_ebml_master(data, tracks);

    if (cluster_size == ClusterSize::Unknown) {
        append_ebml_id(data, Media::Matroska::CLUSTER_ELEMENT_ID);
        data.append(0xff);
        append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::TIMESTAMP_ID, 0);
    } else {
        auto cluster = begin_ebml_master(data, Media::Matroska::CLUSTER_ELEMENT_ID);
        append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::TIMESTAMP_ID, 0);
        finish_ebml_master(data, cluster);
    }

    switch (segment_size) {
    case SegmentSize::Undeclared:
        patch_big_endian_uint(data, segment_size_offset, 0x01ffffffffffffff, 8);
        break;
    case SegmentSize::LongerThanTheStream:
        patch_ebml_size(data, segment_size_offset, data.size() - segment_contents_position + 1, 8);
        break;
    }

    return data;
}

ByteBuffer make_matroska_with_cue_points_for_tracks(Vector<Vector<u64>> const& track_numbers_of_cue_points)
{
    ByteBuffer data;
    auto ebml_header = begin_ebml_master(data, Media::Matroska::EBML_MASTER_ELEMENT_ID);
    append_ebml_string(data, Media::Matroska::DOCTYPE_ELEMENT_ID, "webm"sv);
    append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::DOCTYPE_VERSION_ELEMENT_ID, 4);
    finish_ebml_master(data, ebml_header);

    auto segment = begin_ebml_master(data, Media::Matroska::SEGMENT_ELEMENT_ID);
    auto segment_contents_position = data.size();

    auto info = begin_ebml_master(data, Media::Matroska::SEGMENT_INFORMATION_ELEMENT_ID);
    append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::TIMESTAMP_SCALE_ID, 1000000);
    finish_ebml_master(data, info);

    auto tracks = begin_ebml_master(data, Media::Matroska::TRACK_ELEMENT_ID);
    auto track_entry = begin_ebml_master(data, Media::Matroska::TRACK_ENTRY_ID);
    append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::TRACK_NUMBER_ID, 1);
    append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::TRACK_UID_ID, 1);
    append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::TRACK_TYPE_ID, 1);
    append_ebml_string(data, Media::Matroska::TRACK_CODEC_ID, "V_VP9"sv);
    auto video = begin_ebml_master(data, Media::Matroska::TRACK_VIDEO_ID);
    append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::PIXEL_WIDTH_ID, 1);
    append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::PIXEL_HEIGHT_ID, 1);
    finish_ebml_master(data, video);
    finish_ebml_master(data, track_entry);
    finish_ebml_master(data, tracks);

    auto cluster_position = data.size() - segment_contents_position;
    auto cluster = begin_ebml_master(data, Media::Matroska::CLUSTER_ELEMENT_ID);
    append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::TIMESTAMP_ID, 0);
    finish_ebml_master(data, cluster);

    auto cues = begin_ebml_master(data, Media::Matroska::CUES_ID);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < track_numbers_of_cue_points.size(); i++) {
        auto cue_point = begin_ebml_master(data, Media::Matroska::CUE_POINT_ID);
        append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::CUE_TIME_ID, i);
        for (auto track_number : track_numbers_of_cue_points[i]) {
            auto cue_track_positions = begin_ebml_master(data, Media::Matroska::CUE_TRACK_POSITIONS_ID);
            append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::CUE_TRACK_ID, track_number);
            append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::CUE_CLUSTER_POSITION_ID, cluster_position);
            finish_ebml_master(data, cue_track_positions);
        }
        finish_ebml_master(data, cue_point);
    }
    finish_ebml_master(data, cues);

    finish_ebml_master(data, segment);
    return data;
}

ByteBuffer make_track_entry_with_element_of_size(u32 id, size_t payload_size)
{
    ByteBuffer data;
    auto track_entry = begin_ebml_master(data, Media::Matroska::TRACK_ENTRY_ID);
    append_ebml_uint(data, Media::Matroska::TRACK_NUMBER_ID, 1);
    append_ebml_id(data, id);
    append_ebml_size(data, payload_size, 4);
    auto payload_offset = data.size();
    MUST(data.try_resize(payload_offset + payload_size));
    data.bytes().slice(payload_offset).fill('a');
    finish_ebml_master(data, track_entry);
    return data;
}

Media::DecoderErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<Media::Matroska::TrackEntry>> parse_track_entry(ByteBuffer const& data)
{
    // Parsing starts after the element ID.
    auto streamer = streamer_from_bytes(data.bytes().slice(1));
    return Media::Matroska::Reader::parse_track_entry(streamer);
}

}

TEST_CASE(streamer_read_element_id)
{
    // 1-byte ID: 0xEC (Void)
    auto streamer = streamer_from_bytes("\xEC"sv.bytes());
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(streamer.read_element_id()), 0xECu);

    // 2-byte ID: 0x42 0x86 (EBMLVersion)
    streamer = streamer_from_bytes("\x42\x86"sv.bytes());
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(streamer.read_element_id()), 0x4286u);

    // 4-byte ID: 0x1A 0x45 0xDF 0xA3 (EBML)
    streamer = streamer_from_bytes("\x1A\x45\xDF\xA3"sv.bytes());
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(streamer.read_element_id()), 0x1A45DFA3u);

    // Invalid: leading byte 0x00 (no width bit set)
    streamer = streamer_from_bytes("\x00"sv.bytes());
    EXPECT(streamer.read_element_id().is_error());
}

TEST_CASE(streamer_read_element_size)
{
    // 1-byte size: 0x85 = size 5
    auto streamer = streamer_from_bytes("\x85"sv.bytes());
    auto size = MUST(streamer.read_element_size());
    EXPECT(size.has_value());
    EXPECT_EQ(size.value(), 5u);

    // 1-byte size: 0x80 = size 0
    streamer = streamer_from_bytes("\x80"sv.bytes());
    size = MUST(streamer.read_element_size());
    EXPECT(size.has_value());
    EXPECT_EQ(size.value(), 0u);

    // 2-byte size: 0x40 0x02 = size 2
    streamer = streamer_from_bytes("\x40\x02"sv.bytes());
    size = MUST(streamer.read_element_size());
    EXPECT(size.has_value());
    EXPECT_EQ(size.value(), 2u);

    // 1-byte unknown size: 0xFF
    streamer = streamer_from_bytes("\xFF"sv.bytes());
    size = MUST(streamer.read_element_size());
    EXPECT(!size.has_value());

    // 2-byte unknown size: 0x7F 0xFF
    streamer = streamer_from_bytes("\x7F\xFF"sv.bytes());
    size = MUST(streamer.read_element_size());
    EXPECT(!size.has_value());

    // 4-byte unknown size: 0x1F 0xFF 0xFF 0xFF
    streamer = streamer_from_bytes("\x1F\xFF\xFF\xFF"sv.bytes());
    size = MUST(streamer.read_element_size());
    EXPECT(!size.has_value());

    // 8-byte unknown size: 0x01 0xFF 0xFF 0xFF 0xFF 0xFF 0xFF 0xFF
    streamer = streamer_from_bytes("\x01\xFF\xFF\xFF\xFF\xFF\xFF\xFF"sv.bytes());
    size = MUST(streamer.read_element_size());
    EXPECT(!size.has_value());
}

TEST_CASE(streamer_read_variable_size_integer)
{
    // 1-byte VINT: 7 data bits
    // 0x80 → data=0
    auto streamer = streamer_from_bytes("\x80"sv.bytes());
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(streamer.read_variable_size_integer()), 0u);

    // 0x81 → data=1
    streamer = streamer_from_bytes("\x81"sv.bytes());
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(streamer.read_variable_size_integer()), 1u);

    // 0xFE → data=126
    streamer = streamer_from_bytes("\xFE"sv.bytes());
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(streamer.read_variable_size_integer()), 126u);

    // 0xFF → data=127 (max for 1-byte)
    streamer = streamer_from_bytes("\xFF"sv.bytes());
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(streamer.read_variable_size_integer()), 127u);

    // 2-byte VINT: 14 data bits
    // 0x40 0x00 → data=0
    streamer = streamer_from_bytes("\x40\x00"sv.bytes());
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(streamer.read_variable_size_integer()), 0u);

    // 0x40 0x80 → data=128
    streamer = streamer_from_bytes("\x40\x80"sv.bytes());
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(streamer.read_variable_size_integer()), 128u);

    // 0x7F 0xFF → data=16383 (max for 2-byte)
    streamer = streamer_from_bytes("\x7F\xFF"sv.bytes());
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(streamer.read_variable_size_integer()), 16383u);

    // 4-byte VINT: 28 data bits
    // 0x10 0x00 0x01 0x00 → data=256
    streamer = streamer_from_bytes("\x10\x00\x01\x00"sv.bytes());
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(streamer.read_variable_size_integer()), 256u);

    // Invalid: leading byte 0x00
    streamer = streamer_from_bytes("\x00"sv.bytes());
    EXPECT(streamer.read_variable_size_integer().is_error());
}

TEST_CASE(streamer_read_variable_size_signed_integer)
{
    // 1-byte signed VINT: 7 data bits, bias = 2^6 - 1 = 63
    // 0xBF → data=63 → 63-63 = 0
    auto streamer = streamer_from_bytes("\xBF"sv.bytes());
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(streamer.read_variable_size_signed_integer()), 0);

    // 0x80 → data=0 → 0-63 = -63
    streamer = streamer_from_bytes("\x80"sv.bytes());
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(streamer.read_variable_size_signed_integer()), -63);

    // 0xFF → data=127 → 127-63 = 64
    streamer = streamer_from_bytes("\xFF"sv.bytes());
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(streamer.read_variable_size_signed_integer()), 64);

    // 2-byte signed VINT: 14 data bits, bias = 2^13 - 1 = 8191
    // 0x60 0x00 → data=8191 → 8191-8191 = 0
    streamer = streamer_from_bytes("\x5F\xFF"sv.bytes());
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(streamer.read_variable_size_signed_integer()), 0);

    // 0x40 0x00 → data=0 → 0-8191 = -8191
    streamer = streamer_from_bytes("\x40\x00"sv.bytes());
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(streamer.read_variable_size_signed_integer()), -8191);

    // 0x7F 0xFE → data=16382 → 16382-8191 = 8191
    streamer = streamer_from_bytes("\x7F\xFE"sv.bytes());
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(streamer.read_variable_size_signed_integer()), 8191);
}

TEST_CASE(streamer_read_u64)
{
    // Zero-length integer = 0
    auto streamer = streamer_from_bytes("\x80"sv.bytes());
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(streamer.read_u64()), 0u);

    // 1-byte integer: size=1, value=42
    streamer = streamer_from_bytes("\x81\x2A"sv.bytes());
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(streamer.read_u64()), 42u);

    // 2-byte integer: size=2, value=0x0100 = 256
    streamer = streamer_from_bytes("\x82\x01\x00"sv.bytes());
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(streamer.read_u64()), 256u);

    // 1-byte integer: size=1, value=0xFF = 255
    streamer = streamer_from_bytes("\x81\xFF"sv.bytes());
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(streamer.read_u64()), 255u);
}

TEST_CASE(streamer_read_i64)
{
    // Zero-length signed integer = 0
    auto streamer = streamer_from_bytes("\x80"sv.bytes());
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(streamer.read_i64()), 0);

    // 1-byte signed: size=1, value=0x01 = 1
    streamer = streamer_from_bytes("\x81\x01"sv.bytes());
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(streamer.read_i64()), 1);

    // 1-byte signed: size=1, value=0xFF = -1 (sign extended)
    streamer = streamer_from_bytes("\x81\xFF"sv.bytes());
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(streamer.read_i64()), -1);

    // 1-byte signed: size=1, value=0x80 = -128
    streamer = streamer_from_bytes("\x81\x80"sv.bytes());
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(streamer.read_i64()), -128);

    // 1-byte signed: size=1, value=0x7F = 127
    streamer = streamer_from_bytes("\x81\x7F"sv.bytes());
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(streamer.read_i64()), 127);

    // 2-byte signed: size=2, value=0xFF80 = -128
    streamer = streamer_from_bytes("\x82\xFF\x80"sv.bytes());
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(streamer.read_i64()), -128);

    // 2-byte signed: size=2, value=0x0080 = 128
    streamer = streamer_from_bytes("\x82\x00\x80"sv.bytes());
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(streamer.read_i64()), 128);
}

TEST_CASE(streamer_read_float)
{
    // Zero-length float = 0.0
    auto streamer = streamer_from_bytes("\x80"sv.bytes());
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(streamer.read_float()), 0.0);

    // 4-byte float: size=4, IEEE 754 1.0f = 0x3F800000
    streamer = streamer_from_bytes("\x84\x3F\x80\x00\x00"sv.bytes());
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(streamer.read_float()), 1.0);

    // 8-byte double: size=8, IEEE 754 1.0 = 0x3FF0000000000000
    streamer = streamer_from_bytes("\x88\x3F\xF0\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00"sv.bytes());
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(streamer.read_float()), 1.0);

    // 4-byte float: size=4, IEEE 754 -1.0f = 0xBF800000
    streamer = streamer_from_bytes("\x84\xBF\x80\x00\x00"sv.bytes());
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(streamer.read_float()), -1.0);

    // Invalid float size (3 bytes)
    streamer = streamer_from_bytes("\x83\x00\x00\x00"sv.bytes());
    EXPECT(streamer.read_float().is_error());
}
