struct FrameDigest {
    AK::Duration timestamp;
    u32 pixel_hash { 0 };

    bool operator==(FrameDigest const&) const = default;
};

template<>
struct AK::Formatter<FrameDigest> : Formatter<FormatString> {
    ErrorOr<void> format(FormatBuilder& builder, FrameDigest const& digest)
    {
        return Formatter<FormatString>::format(builder, "{}ms:{:08x}"sv, digest.timestamp.to_milliseconds(), digest.pixel_hash);
    }
};

namespace {

Media::DecoderErrorOr<NonnullOwnPtr<Media::VideoDecoder>> create_software_video_decoder(Media::CodecID codec_id, ReadonlyBytes codec_initialization_data)
{
    return NonnullOwnPtr<Media::VideoDecoder> { TRY(Media::FFmpeg::FFmpegVideoDecoder::try_create(codec_id, codec_initialization_data)) };
}

ReadonlySpan<Media::VideoDecoderRegistration> hosted_decoders()
{
    // The withholding decoder answers only while a test is withholding outputs.
    static Array decoders {
        WithholdingVideoDecoder::registrations()[0],
        Media::VideoDecoderRegistration { Media::FFmpeg::FFmpegVideoDecoder::capabilities, create_software_video_decoder },
    };
    return decoders;
}

Atomic<u32> s_server_launch_count { 0 };

// The server that is running, if any. Its connection is only touched on its own thread.
Mutex s_running_server_mutex;
Core::EventLoop* s_running_server_event_loop { nullptr };
Media::VideoDecoderServerConnection* s_running_server_connection { nullptr };
u32 s_close_every_server_after_frames { 0 };

// Hosts a server on a thread of its own, as the VideoDecoderServer process would.
ErrorOr<NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport>> launch_in_process_server()
{
    auto paired_transports = TRY(IPC::Transport::create_paired());
    s_server_launch_count++;

    auto thread = TRY(Threading::Thread::try_create("Video Decoder Server"sv, [transport = move(paired_transports.local)]() mutable -> intptr_t {
        Core::EventLoop loop;
        auto connection = Media::VideoDecoderServerConnection::construct(move(transport), hosted_decoders());
        {
            MutexLocker locker { s_running_server_mutex };
            if (s_close_every_server_after_frames > 0)
                connection->close_after_decoded_frame_count(s_close_every_server_after_frames);
            s_running_server_event_loop = &loop;
            s_running_server_connection = connection.ptr();
        }
        connection->on_death = [&loop] {
            MutexLocker locker { s_running_server_mutex };
            if (s_running_server_event_loop == &loop) {
                s_running_server_event_loop = nullptr;
                s_running_server_connection = nullptr;
            }
            loop.quit(0);
        };
        return loop.exec();
    }));
    thread->start();
    thread->detach();
    return paired_transports.remote_handle.create_transport();
}

// Applies to the running server, and to every one launched after it while the count is set.
void close_servers_after_decoded_frames(u32 frame_count)
{
    MutexLocker locker { s_running_server_mutex };
    s_close_every_server_after_frames = frame_count;
    if (s_running_server_event_loop == nullptr)
        return;
    s_running_server_event_loop->deferred_invoke([frame_count] {
        MutexLocker locker { s_running_server_mutex };
        if (s_running_server_connection != nullptr)
            s_running_server_connection->close_after_decoded_frame_count(frame_count);
    });
}

void use_remote_decoders()
{
    Media::install_video_decoders({ Media::remote_video_decoders(), Media::ffmpeg_video_decoders() });
}

void use_local_decoders()
{
    Media::install_video_decoders({ Media::ffmpeg_video_decoders() });
}

FrameDigest digest_frame(Media::VideoFrame const& frame)
{
    auto yuv_data = frame.yuv_data();
    VERIFY(yuv_data.has_value());
    auto hash = string_hash(reinterpret_cast<char const*>(yuv_data->y_data().data()), yuv_data->y_data().size());
    hash = string_hash(reinterpret_cast<char const*>(yuv_data->u_data().data()), yuv_data->u_data().size(), hash);
    hash = string_hash(reinterpret_cast<char const*>(yuv_data->v_data().data()), yuv_data->v_data().size(), hash);
    return { frame.timestamp(), hash };
}

NonnullRefPtr<Media::DecodedVideoProducer> create_started_producer(Core::EventLoop& loop, StringView path)
{
    auto file = MUST(Core::File::open(path, Core::File::OpenMode::Read));
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_from_buffer(MUST(file->read_until_eof()));
    NonnullRefPtr<Media::Demuxer> demuxer = MUST(Media::Matroska::MatroskaDemuxer::from_stream(stream));
    auto track = MUST(demuxer->get_preferred_track_for_type(Media::TrackType::Video)).release_value();
    auto producer = MUST(Media::DecodedVideoProducer::try_create(loop, demuxer, track));
    producer->set_error_handler([](Media::DecoderError&& error) {
        FAIL(ByteString::formatted("An error occurred while decoding: {}", error.description()));
    });
    producer->start();
    return producer;
}

Optional<FrameDigest> take_frame(Media::DecodedVideoProducer& producer, Core::EventLoop& loop)
{
    auto deadline = MonotonicTime::now_coarse() + AK::Duration::from_seconds(5);
    while (MonotonicTime::now_coarse() < deadline) {
        auto output = producer.peek();
        if (output.status == Media::PipelineStatus::HaveData) {
            auto digest = digest_frame(*output.frame);
            producer.consume();
            return digest;
        }
        if (output.status == Media::PipelineStatus::EndOfStream || output.status == Media::PipelineStatus::Error)
            return {};
        loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    }
    FAIL("Timed out waiting for a frame");
    return {};
}

// Frames submitted again after a decoder loses its state can repeat ones that were already delivered, which the
// sinks ignore, since they show nothing new.
void append_unless_repeated(Vector<FrameDigest>& digests, FrameDigest const& digest)
{
    if (!digests.is_empty() && digest.timestamp <= digests.last().timestamp)
        return;
    digests.append(digest);
}

Vector<FrameDigest> decode_every_frame(StringView path)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();
    auto producer = create_started_producer(loop, path);
    Vector<FrameDigest> digests;
    while (true) {
        auto digest = take_frame(*producer, loop);
        if (!digest.has_value())
            break;
        append_unless_repeated(digests, *digest);
    }
    return digests;
}

Vector<FrameDigest> decode_every_frame_locally(StringView path)
{
    use_local_decoders();
    auto digests = decode_every_frame(path);
    use_remote_decoders();
    return digests;
}

// The Browser is asked for transports from the MediaServer's main thread, which never asks for one itself. The tests
// ask from this thread, so the requester gets a thread of its own, as the Browser's answers would arrive on.
void install_transport_requester_on_its_own_thread()
{
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Mutex mutex;
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA ConditionVariable condition { mutex };
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA bool requester_is_installed = false;
    auto thread = MUST(Threading::Thread::try_create("Transport Requester"sv, [&]() -> intptr_t {
        Core::EventLoop loop;
        Media::RemoteVideoDecoder::set_transport_requester([](auto callback) { callback(launch_in_process_server()); });
        {
            MutexLocker locker { mutex };
            requester_is_installed = true;
            condition.broadcast();
        }
        return loop.exec();
    }));
    thread->start();
    thread->detach();

    MutexLocker locker { mutex };
    while (!requester_is_installed)
        condition.wait();
}

constexpr auto test_video_path = "./vp9_in_webm.webm"sv;

}

TEST_SETUP
{
    (void)never_destroyed_event_loop();
    install_transport_requester_on_its_own_thread();
    use_remote_decoders();
    Media::install_audio_decoders({ Media::audio_decoders() });
}

TEST_CASE(frames_decoded_by_the_server_match_local_decoding)
{
    auto expected = decode_every_frame_locally(test_video_path);
    EXPECT(expected.size() > 10);

    auto launches_before = s_server_launch_count.load();
    auto actual = decode_every_frame(test_video_path);
    EXPECT_EQ(actual, expected);
    EXPECT(s_server_launch_count.load() - launches_before <= 1);
}

TEST_CASE(a_lost_server_is_relaunched_and_decoding_resumes_where_it_left_off)
{
    auto expected = decode_every_frame_locally(test_video_path);

    auto launches_before = s_server_launch_count.load();
    close_servers_after_decoded_frames(7);
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();
    auto producer = create_started_producer(loop, test_video_path);
    Vector<FrameDigest> actual;
    while (true) {
        auto digest = take_frame(*producer, loop);
        if (!digest.has_value())
            break;
        append_unless_repeated(actual, *digest);
        // Only the first server is lost.
        if (s_server_launch_count.load() > launches_before)
            close_servers_after_decoded_frames(0);
    }
    EXPECT_EQ(actual, expected);
    EXPECT(s_server_launch_count.load() > launches_before);
}

TEST_CASE(a_decoder_that_keeps_losing_its_server_falls_back_to_the_next_decoder)
{
    auto expected = decode_every_frame_locally(test_video_path);

    auto launches_before = s_server_launch_count.load();
    bool server_was_running = false;
    {
        MutexLocker locker { s_running_server_mutex };
        server_was_running = s_running_server_event_loop != nullptr;
    }
    close_servers_after_decoded_frames(3);
    auto actual = decode_every_frame(test_video_path);
    close_servers_after_decoded_frames(0);
    EXPECT_EQ(actual, expected);

    // Every server it lost was replaced, except the last.
    auto expected_launches = Media::RemoteVideoDecoder::MAXIMUM_SERVER_LOSSES;
    if (!server_was_running)
        expected_launches++;
    EXPECT_EQ(s_server_launch_count.load() - launches_before, expected_launches);
}

TEST_CASE(a_seek_discards_the_frames_in_flight)
{
    auto expected = decode_every_frame_locally(test_video_path);
    VERIFY(expected.size() > 20);

    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();
    auto producer = create_started_producer(loop, test_video_path);
    for (size_t index = 0; index < 3; index++)
        EXPECT_EQ(take_frame(*producer, loop), expected[index]);

    // Seeking backward leaves the frames already submitted for later timestamps in flight.
    auto const& target = expected[1];
    producer->seek(target.timestamp, Media::InvalidateHeldData::Yes);
    EXPECT_EQ(take_frame(*producer, loop), target);
    EXPECT_EQ(take_frame(*producer, loop), expected[2]);
}

namespace {

// A decoder whose server withholds as many outputs as it can, and so has stopped answering: the last submissions in
// flight stay unanswered until the test releases an output.
struct StalledDecoding {
    NonnullRefPtr<WithheldOutputs> withheld_outputs;
    NonnullOwnPtr<Media::RemoteVideoDecoder> decoder;
};

StalledDecoding submit_until_the_server_stops_answering(size_t unanswered_submission_count)
{
    auto withheld_outputs = make_ref_counted<WithheldOutputs>();
    WithholdingVideoDecoder::set_withheld_outputs_for_new_decoders(withheld_outputs);
    ScopeGuard stop_withholding = [] { WithholdingVideoDecoder::set_withheld_outputs_for_new_decoders(nullptr); };

    auto file = MUST(Core::File::open(test_video_path, Core::File::OpenMode::Read));
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_from_buffer(MUST(file->read_until_eof()));
    NonnullRefPtr<Media::Demuxer> demuxer = MUST(Media::Matroska::MatroskaDemuxer::from_stream(stream));
    auto track = MUST(demuxer->get_preferred_track_for_type(Media::TrackType::Video)).release_value();
    MUST(demuxer->create_context_for_track(track));

    auto first_coded_frame = MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track));
    auto decoder = MUST(Media::RemoteVideoDecoder::try_create(first_coded_frame.codec_id(), first_coded_frame.new_codec_configuration().value()));
    decoder->set_decode_completed_callback([](Media::DecodeCompletion) { });

    MUST(decoder->receive_coded_data(first_coded_frame, Media::DecodeIntent::Output));
    for (size_t index = 1; index < WithholdingVideoDecoder::MAXIMUM_WITHHELD_OUTPUTS + unanswered_submission_count; index++)
        MUST(decoder->receive_coded_data(MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track)), Media::DecodeIntent::Output));
    EXPECT(withheld_outputs->wait_until_withheld_count_reaches(WithholdingVideoDecoder::MAXIMUM_WITHHELD_OUTPUTS, AK::Duration::from_seconds(5)));
    return { move(withheld_outputs), move(decoder) };
}

// Takes output on a thread of its own, so that a wait inside the call can be observed and ended from the test.
struct OutputTaker {
    explicit OutputTaker(Media::RemoteVideoDecoder& decoder)
        : thread(MUST(Threading::Thread::try_create("Taker"sv, [this, &decoder]() -> intptr_t {
            auto result = decoder.take_next_output({});
            MutexLocker locker { mutex };
            answer = result.is_error() ? result.error().category() : Media::DecoderErrorCategory::Unknown;
            condition.broadcast();
            return 0;
        })))
    {
        thread->start();
    }

    ~OutputTaker() { (void)thread->join(); }

    Optional<Media::DecoderErrorCategory> wait_for_answer(AK::Duration timeout)
    {
        auto deadline = MonotonicTime::now() + timeout;
        MutexLocker locker { mutex };
        while (!answer.has_value() && MonotonicTime::now() < deadline)
            condition.wait_for(deadline - MonotonicTime::now());
        return answer;
    }

    Mutex mutex;
    ConditionVariable condition { mutex };
    Optional<Media::DecoderErrorCategory> answer;
    NonnullRefPtr<Threading::Thread> thread;
};

}

// The server answers the submissions a flush supersedes only once its decoder lets it, so the frames submitted after
// the flush must not wait behind them.
TEST_CASE(superseded_submissions_are_not_waited_for_after_a_flush)
{
    auto stalled = submit_until_the_server_stops_answering(Media::RemoteVideoDecoder::MAXIMUM_FRAMES_IN_FLIGHT);
    stalled.decoder->flush();

    {
        OutputTaker taker { *stalled.decoder };
        auto answer = taker.wait_for_answer(AK::Duration::from_seconds(2));
        if (!answer.has_value())
            FAIL("The frames submitted before the flush were waited for");
        else
            EXPECT_EQ(*answer, Media::DecoderErrorCategory::NeedsMoreInput);
        // Letting the server's decoder finish answers the superseded submissions and ends the taker either way.
        while (stalled.withheld_outputs->release_next()) { }
    }
}

// A frame the server's decoder finishes after the server answered its submission has to reach the client, and wake
// it, without the client submitting anything else.
TEST_CASE(output_the_server_decoder_finishes_later_wakes_the_client)
{
    auto withheld_outputs = make_ref_counted<WithheldOutputs>();
    WithholdingVideoDecoder::set_withheld_outputs_for_new_decoders(withheld_outputs);
    ScopeGuard stop_withholding = [] { WithholdingVideoDecoder::set_withheld_outputs_for_new_decoders(nullptr); };

    auto file = MUST(Core::File::open(test_video_path, Core::File::OpenMode::Read));
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_from_buffer(MUST(file->read_until_eof()));
    NonnullRefPtr<Media::Demuxer> demuxer = MUST(Media::Matroska::MatroskaDemuxer::from_stream(stream));
    auto track = MUST(demuxer->get_preferred_track_for_type(Media::TrackType::Video)).release_value();
    TRY_OR_FAIL(demuxer->create_context_for_track(track));

    Mutex wake_mutex;
    ConditionVariable wake_condition { wake_mutex };
    size_t wake_count = 0;

    auto first_coded_frame = TRY_OR_FAIL(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track));
    auto decoder = TRY_OR_FAIL(Media::RemoteVideoDecoder::try_create(first_coded_frame.codec_id(), first_coded_frame.new_codec_configuration().value()));
    decoder->set_decode_completed_callback([&](Media::DecodeCompletion completion) {
        if (completion != Media::DecodeCompletion::ProducedOutput)
            return;
        MutexLocker locker { wake_mutex };
        wake_count++;
        wake_condition.broadcast();
    });

    constexpr size_t submitted_frame_count = 3;
    TRY_OR_FAIL(decoder->receive_coded_data(first_coded_frame, Media::DecodeIntent::Output));
    for (size_t index = 1; index < submitted_frame_count; index++)
        TRY_OR_FAIL(decoder->receive_coded_data(TRY_OR_FAIL(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track)), Media::DecodeIntent::Output));

    auto result = decoder->take_next_output({});
    EXPECT(result.is_error() && result.error().category() == Media::DecoderErrorCategory::NeedsMoreInput);
    EXPECT(withheld_outputs->wait_until_withheld_count_reaches(submitted_frame_count, AK::Duration::from_seconds(5)));
    EXPECT_EQ(wake_count, 0u);

    EXPECT(withheld_outputs->release_next());
    {
        auto deadline = MonotonicTime::now() + AK::Duration::from_seconds(5);
        MutexLocker locker { wake_mutex };
        while (wake_count == 0 && MonotonicTime::now() < deadline)
            wake_condition.wait_for(deadline - MonotonicTime::now());
        if (wake_count == 0) {
            FAIL("The client was not woken for the frame the server's decoder finished");
            return;
        }
    }

    auto frame = decoder->take_next_output({});
    if (frame.is_error())
        FAIL(ByteString::formatted("The frame the server's decoder finished was not delivered: {}", frame.error().description()));
    else
        EXPECT_EQ(frame.value()->timestamp(), first_coded_frame.presentation_timestamp());
}

// The server reports its decoder idle once it has sent the frame that the decoder finished, but that frame is still output
// for the client's caller to take, so the client must keep reporting a decode in progress until the frame is taken.
TEST_CASE(a_frame_waiting_to_be_taken_counts_as_a_decode_in_progress)
{
    auto withheld_outputs = make_ref_counted<WithheldOutputs>();
    WithholdingVideoDecoder::set_withheld_outputs_for_new_decoders(withheld_outputs);
    ScopeGuard stop_withholding = [] { WithholdingVideoDecoder::set_withheld_outputs_for_new_decoders(nullptr); };

    auto file = MUST(Core::File::open(test_video_path, Core::File::OpenMode::Read));
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_from_buffer(MUST(file->read_until_eof()));
    NonnullRefPtr<Media::Demuxer> demuxer = MUST(Media::Matroska::MatroskaDemuxer::from_stream(stream));
    auto track = MUST(demuxer->get_preferred_track_for_type(Media::TrackType::Video)).release_value();
    TRY_OR_FAIL(demuxer->create_context_for_track(track));

    Mutex mutex;
    ConditionVariable condition { mutex };
    bool output_arrived = false;

    auto coded_frame = TRY_OR_FAIL(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track));
    auto decoder = TRY_OR_FAIL(Media::RemoteVideoDecoder::try_create(coded_frame.codec_id(), coded_frame.new_codec_configuration().value()));
    decoder->set_decode_completed_callback([&](Media::DecodeCompletion completion) {
        if (completion != Media::DecodeCompletion::ProducedOutput)
            return;
        MutexLocker locker { mutex };
        output_arrived = true;
        condition.broadcast();
    });

    TRY_OR_FAIL(decoder->receive_coded_data(coded_frame, Media::DecodeIntent::Output));
    EXPECT(withheld_outputs->wait_until_withheld_count_reaches(1, AK::Duration::from_seconds(5)));
    EXPECT(decoder->has_any_decode_in_progress());

    EXPECT(withheld_outputs->release_next());
    {
        auto deadline = MonotonicTime::now() + AK::Duration::from_seconds(5);
        MutexLocker locker { mutex };
        while (!output_arrived && MonotonicTime::now() < deadline)
            condition.wait_for(deadline - MonotonicTime::now());
        if (!output_arrived) {
            FAIL("The frame the server's decoder finished did not reach the client");
            return;
        }

        // Give the server's report that its decoder is idle time to arrive.
        auto settle_deadline = MonotonicTime::now() + AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(300);
        while (decoder->has_any_decode_in_progress() && MonotonicTime::now() < settle_deadline)
            condition.wait_for(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(10));
    }
    EXPECT(decoder->has_any_decode_in_progress());

    auto frame = decoder->take_next_output({});
    EXPECT(!frame.is_error());
    EXPECT(!decoder->has_any_decode_in_progress());
}

// Once the client holds every slot the server can decode into, the server waits for one to be released, and the
// client answers TryAgain until a release of its own lets the server decode again.
TEST_CASE(a_server_out_of_slots_is_waited_for_until_a_frame_is_released)
{
    auto file = MUST(Core::File::open(test_video_path, Core::File::OpenMode::Read));
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_from_buffer(MUST(file->read_until_eof()));
    NonnullRefPtr<Media::Demuxer> demuxer = MUST(Media::Matroska::MatroskaDemuxer::from_stream(stream));
    auto track = MUST(demuxer->get_preferred_track_for_type(Media::TrackType::Video)).release_value();
    TRY_OR_FAIL(demuxer->create_context_for_track(track));

    auto coded_frame = TRY_OR_FAIL(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track));
    auto decoder = TRY_OR_FAIL(Media::RemoteVideoDecoder::try_create(coded_frame.codec_id(), coded_frame.new_codec_configuration().value()));
    size_t storage_freed_count = 0;
    decoder->set_storage_freed_callback([&] { storage_freed_count++; });
    decoder->set_decode_completed_callback([](Media::DecodeCompletion) { });

    Vector<NonnullRefPtr<Media::VideoFrame>> held_frames;
    auto server_ran_out_of_slots = false;
    for (size_t submitted_count = 0; submitted_count < 32 && !server_ran_out_of_slots; submitted_count++) {
        TRY_OR_FAIL(decoder->receive_coded_data(coded_frame, Media::DecodeIntent::Output));
        while (true) {
            auto result = decoder->take_next_output({});
            if (!result.is_error()) {
                held_frames.append(result.release_value());
                continue;
            }
            if (result.error().category() == Media::DecoderErrorCategory::TryAgain) {
                server_ran_out_of_slots = true;
                break;
            }
            if (result.error().category() == Media::DecoderErrorCategory::NeedsMoreInput)
                break;
            FAIL(ByteString::formatted("Unexpected decoder error: {}", result.error().description()));
            return;
        }
        coded_frame = TRY_OR_FAIL(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track));
    }
    EXPECT(server_ran_out_of_slots);
    EXPECT_EQ(held_frames.size(), static_cast<size_t>(Media::VideoFramePool::MAX_SLOT_COUNT));
    EXPECT_EQ(storage_freed_count, 0u);

    // Nothing has changed for the server, so the answer is the same without waiting.
    auto result = decoder->take_next_output({});
    EXPECT(result.is_error() && result.error().category() == Media::DecoderErrorCategory::TryAgain);

    auto last_held_timestamp = held_frames.last()->timestamp();
    held_frames.remove(0);
    EXPECT_EQ(storage_freed_count, 1u);

    auto frame = decoder->take_next_output({});
    if (frame.is_error())
        FAIL(ByteString::formatted("The frame decoded into the released slot was not delivered: {}", frame.error().description()));
    else
        EXPECT(frame.value()->timestamp() > last_held_timestamp);
    EXPECT_EQ(storage_freed_count, 1u);
}

// The file was encoded from hevc_hdr10_plus_in_sei.mkv, so its frames carry the same HDR10+, in BlockAdditions.
TEST_CASE(scene_peaks_from_the_container_reach_the_server_with_their_frames)
{
    ScenePeakChecker scene_peaks { hevc_hdr10_plus_in_sei_scene_peaks };
    auto file = MUST(Core::File::open("./vp9_hdr10_plus_in_block_additions.webm"sv, Core::File::OpenMode::Read));
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_from_buffer(MUST(file->read_until_eof()));
    NonnullRefPtr<Media::Demuxer> demuxer = MUST(Media::Matroska::MatroskaDemuxer::from_stream(stream));
    auto track = MUST(demuxer->get_preferred_track_for_type(Media::TrackType::Video)).release_value();
    TRY_OR_FAIL(demuxer->create_context_for_track(track));

    Mutex wake_mutex;
    ConditionVariable wake_condition { wake_mutex };
    auto first_coded_frame = TRY_OR_FAIL(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track));
    auto decoder = TRY_OR_FAIL(Media::RemoteVideoDecoder::try_create(first_coded_frame.codec_id(), first_coded_frame.new_codec_configuration().value()));
    decoder->set_decode_completed_callback([&](Media::DecodeCompletion) {
        MutexLocker locker { wake_mutex };
        wake_condition.broadcast();
    });

    TRY_OR_FAIL(decoder->receive_coded_data(first_coded_frame, Media::DecodeIntent::Output));
    while (true) {
        auto sample = demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track);
        if (sample.is_error())
            break;
        TRY_OR_FAIL(decoder->receive_coded_data(sample.release_value(), Media::DecodeIntent::Output));
    }
    decoder->signal_end_of_stream();

    size_t frame_count = 0;
    auto reached_end_of_stream = false;
    auto deadline = MonotonicTime::now() + AK::Duration::from_seconds(5);
    while (MonotonicTime::now() < deadline) {
        auto result = decoder->take_next_output({});
        if (!result.is_error()) {
            auto const& frame = result.value();
            scene_peaks.check(frame->timestamp(), frame->color_metadata().maximum_scene_luminance);
            frame_count++;
            continue;
        }
        if (result.error().category() == Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream) {
            reached_end_of_stream = true;
            break;
        }
        if (result.error().category() != Media::DecoderErrorCategory::NeedsMoreInput) {
            FAIL(ByteString::formatted("Unexpected decoder error: {}", result.error().description()));
            return;
        }
        MutexLocker locker { wake_mutex };
        wake_condition.wait_for(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(100));
    }
    EXPECT(reached_end_of_stream);
    EXPECT_EQ(frame_count, hevc_hdr10_plus_in_sei_scene_peaks.size());
    scene_peaks.expect_every_frame_checked();
}

NonnullRefPtr<DecodedVideoProducer> make_decoder(Core::EventLoop& loop, StringView path)
{
    auto stream = load_test_file(path);
    auto demuxer = create_demuxer(stream);
    auto tracks = MUST(demuxer->get_tracks_for_type(TrackType::Video));
    VERIFY(!tracks.is_empty());
    return MUST(DecodedVideoProducer::try_create(loop, demuxer, tracks[0]));
}

// Forwards to another producer, recording what the first peek of it saw.
class FirstPeekRecordingVideoProducer final : public VideoProducer {
public:
    static NonnullRefPtr<FirstPeekRecordingVideoProducer> create(NonnullRefPtr<VideoProducer> inner)
    {
        return adopt_ref(*new FirstPeekRecordingVideoProducer(move(inner)));
    }

    virtual void start() override { m_inner->start(); }
    virtual void suspend() override { m_inner->suspend(); }
    virtual VideoProducerOutput peek() override
    {
        auto output = m_inner->peek();
        MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
        if (!m_first_peeked_status.has_value())
            m_first_peeked_status = output.status;
        return output;
    }
    virtual void consume() override { m_inner->consume(); }
    virtual void set_wake_handler(PipelineWakeHandler handler) override { m_inner->set_wake_handler(move(handler)); }
    virtual void seek(AK::Duration timestamp, InvalidateHeldData invalidate_held_data) override { m_inner->seek(timestamp, invalidate_held_data); }

    Optional<PipelineStatus> first_peeked_status() const
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
        return m_first_peeked_status;
    }

private:
    explicit FirstPeekRecordingVideoProducer(NonnullRefPtr<VideoProducer> inner)
        : m_inner(move(inner))
    {
    }

    NonnullRefPtr<VideoProducer> m_inner;
    mutable Mutex m_mutex;
    Optional<PipelineStatus> m_first_peeked_status;
};

bool spin_until(Core::EventLoop& loop, Function<bool()> condition, AK::Duration timeout = AK::Duration::from_seconds(2))
{
    auto deadline = MonotonicTime::now_coarse() + timeout;
    while (MonotonicTime::now_coarse() < deadline) {
        if (condition())
            return true;
        loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    }
    return condition();
}

Vector<AK::Duration> decode_reference_timestamps(StringView path)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();
    auto decoder = make_decoder(loop, path);
    decoder->start();

    Vector<AK::Duration> timestamps;
    auto deadline = MonotonicTime::now_coarse() + AK::Duration::from_seconds(10);
    while (MonotonicTime::now_coarse() < deadline) {
        auto output = decoder->peek();
        if (output.status == PipelineStatus::HaveData) {
            timestamps.append(output.frame->timestamp());
            decoder->consume();
            continue;
        }
        if (output.status == PipelineStatus::EndOfStream)
            return timestamps;
        loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    }
    FAIL("Reference decode timed out");
    return timestamps;
}

// Bridges the two ends of the edge the way the IPC connection does. The sink's pump thread queues its messages, which
// the consumer's thread delivers in order, since RemoteVideoProducer is single-threaded; the consumer's delegates
// drive the sink directly.
struct VideoEdgeTestHarness
    : public AtomicRefCounted<VideoEdgeTestHarness>
    , public ThreadSafeWeakable<VideoEdgeTestHarness> {
    struct StatusMessage {
        PipelineStatus status { PipelineStatus::Pending };
        u32 seek_id { 0 };
        PipelineCheckpoint checkpoint { 0 };
    };
    using Message = Variant<RemoteVideoSink::LentFrame, StatusMessage>;
    struct PostedMessage {
        Message message;
        MonotonicTime post_time;
    };

    RefPtr<RemoteVideoSink> sink;
    RefPtr<RemoteVideoProducer> consumer;

    Mutex mutex;
    ConditionVariable signal { mutex };
    Vector<PostedMessage> pending_messages;
    bool signaled { false };
    // Messages are delivered only once they are this old, the way they take a while to cross between processes.
    AK::Duration delivery_delay;
    // Holds the consumer's suspension back from the pump until the test sends it, as it would be crossing processes.
    bool holds_suspension_requests { false };
    bool has_held_suspension_request { false };

    void post(Message message)
    {
        MutexLocker locker { mutex };
        pending_messages.append({ move(message), MonotonicTime::now() });
        signaled = true;
        signal.broadcast();
    }

    void wake()
    {
        MutexLocker locker { mutex };
        signaled = true;
        signal.broadcast();
    }

    void deliver_messages()
    {
        Vector<Message> messages;
        {
            MutexLocker locker { mutex };
            auto deliverable_count = 0uz;
            auto now = MonotonicTime::now();
            while (deliverable_count < pending_messages.size() && now - pending_messages[deliverable_count].post_time >= delivery_delay)
                deliverable_count++;
            for (size_t i = 0; i < deliverable_count; i++)
                messages.append(move(pending_messages[i].message));
            pending_messages.remove(0, deliverable_count);
        }
        for (auto& message : messages) {
            message.visit(
                [&](RemoteVideoSink::LentFrame& lent_frame) {
                    auto release = [weak = make_weak_ref(), lend_id = lent_frame.lend_id] {
                        if (auto harness = weak.strong_ref())
                            harness->sink->release_frame(lend_id);
                    };
                    auto frame = MUST(create_received_video_frame(lent_frame.metadata, move(lent_frame.pixels), 1, move(release)));
                    consumer->receive_frame(lent_frame.lend_id, lent_frame.seek_id, move(frame));
                },
                [&](StatusMessage const& status) {
                    consumer->receive_status(status.status, status.seek_id, status.checkpoint);
                });
        }
    }
};

enum class ConsumerStart : u8 {
    Running,
    Suspended,
};

void wire_full_node(VideoEdgeTestHarness& harness, NonnullRefPtr<VideoProducer> const& decoder, ConsumerStart start = ConsumerStart::Running)
{
    // The detached pump thread can invoke these delegates while the test scope is being torn down,
    // so they promote a weak reference to keep the harness alive for the duration of the call.
    RemoteVideoSink::Delegates sink_delegates;
    sink_delegates.send_frame = [weak = harness.make_weak_ref()](RemoteVideoSink::LentFrame lent_frame) {
        if (auto harness = weak.strong_ref())
            harness->post(move(lent_frame));
    };
    sink_delegates.send_status = [weak = harness.make_weak_ref()](PipelineStatus status, u32 seek_id, PipelineCheckpoint checkpoint) {
        if (auto harness = weak.strong_ref())
            harness->post(VideoEdgeTestHarness::StatusMessage { status, seek_id, checkpoint });
    };
    sink_delegates.notify_clock_resumed = [] { };
    sink_delegates.transmit_seek = [](InvalidateHeldData) { };
    sink_delegates.transmit_time_reader = [](MediaTimeReader const&) { };
    sink_delegates.transmit_ticking = [](bool) { };
    harness.sink = MUST(RemoteVideoSink::create(move(sink_delegates)));

    RemoteVideoProducer::Delegates consumer_delegates;
    consumer_delegates.request_start = [&harness] { harness.sink->start_input(); };
    consumer_delegates.request_suspend = [&harness] {
        if (harness.holds_suspension_requests) {
            harness.has_held_suspension_request = true;
            return;
        }
        harness.sink->suspend_input();
    };
    consumer_delegates.request_seek = [&harness](AK::Duration timestamp, InvalidateHeldData invalidate_held_data, u64 newest_received_lend_id) {
        harness.sink->seek_upstream(timestamp, invalidate_held_data, newest_received_lend_id);
    };
    harness.consumer = RemoteVideoProducer::create(move(consumer_delegates));
    harness.consumer->set_wake_handler([&harness] { harness.wake(); });

    // harness.consumer is set before connect_input, whose lock publishes it to the pump before the
    // pump can send anything to the consumer.
    MUST(harness.sink->connect_input(decoder));
    if (start == ConsumerStart::Suspended)
        harness.consumer->suspend();
    else
        harness.consumer->start();
}

NonnullRefPtr<VideoFrame> create_pooled_frame(VideoFramePool& pool, AK::Duration timestamp, AK::Duration duration = AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(33))
{
    static constexpr Gfx::IntSize frame_size { 2, 2 };
    static constexpr u8 bit_depth = 8;
    auto subsampling = Subsampling(true, true);

    auto layout = MUST(frame_plane_layout(frame_size, bit_depth, subsampling));
    auto acquired = pool.try_acquire(layout.total_byte_count).release_value();
    return make_ref_counted<VideoFrame>(timestamp, duration, Gfx::Size<u32>(frame_size), bit_depth, subsampling, ColorMetadata {}, move(acquired.storage));
}

// A frame as the consumer receives it, which counts its release.
NonnullRefPtr<VideoFrame> create_received_frame(VideoFramePool& pool, AK::Duration timestamp, Function<void()> on_release = [] { })
{
    auto frame = create_pooled_frame(pool, timestamp, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(100));
    return MUST(create_received_video_frame(VideoFrameMetadata::for_frame(*frame), frame->pixel_buffer(), 1, move(on_release)));
}

RemoteVideoProducer::Delegates make_consumer_delegates(size_t& upstream_seeks)
{
    RemoteVideoProducer::Delegates delegates;
    delegates.request_start = [] { };
    delegates.request_suspend = [] { };
    delegates.request_seek = [&upstream_seeks](AK::Duration, InvalidateHeldData, u64) { upstream_seeks++; };
    return delegates;
}

// Gives a consumer four frames at 1.0s..1.3s under seek 0, to exercise the seek fast path deterministically. Each frame
// runs the given callback, which must outlive them, once it is released.
void give_lookahead(RemoteVideoProducer& consumer, VideoFramePool& pool, Function<void()> const* on_release = nullptr)
{
    for (u64 i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        consumer.receive_frame(i + 1, 0, create_received_frame(pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000 + (i * 100)), [on_release] {
            if (on_release)
                (*on_release)();
        }));
    }
}

// Records what a sink lends, from its pump thread.
struct LentFrameRecorder : public AtomicRefCounted<LentFrameRecorder> {
    Mutex mutex;
    Vector<RemoteVideoSink::LentFrame> lent_frames;
    Vector<bool> transmitted_ticking;

    size_t count()
    {
        MutexLocker locker { mutex };
        return lent_frames.size();
    }

    RemoteVideoSink::LentFrame at(size_t index)
    {
        MutexLocker locker { mutex };
        return lent_frames[index];
    }
};

NonnullRefPtr<RemoteVideoSink> make_recorded_sink(LentFrameRecorder& recorder)
{
    RemoteVideoSink::Delegates delegates;
    delegates.send_frame = [recorder = NonnullRefPtr { recorder }](RemoteVideoSink::LentFrame lent_frame) {
        MutexLocker locker { recorder->mutex };
        recorder->lent_frames.append(move(lent_frame));
    };
    delegates.send_status = [](PipelineStatus, u32, PipelineCheckpoint) { };
    delegates.notify_clock_resumed = [] { };
    delegates.transmit_seek = [](InvalidateHeldData) { };
    delegates.transmit_time_reader = [](MediaTimeReader const&) { };
    delegates.transmit_ticking = [recorder = NonnullRefPtr { recorder }](bool ticking) {
        MutexLocker locker { recorder->mutex };
        recorder->transmitted_ticking.append(ticking);
    };
    auto sink = MUST(RemoteVideoSink::create(move(delegates)));
    // The consumer these sinks stand in for ticks.
    sink->set_ticking(true);
    return sink;
}

NonnullRefPtr<RemoteVideoSink> make_sink_with_inert_delegates()
{
    return make_recorded_sink(*make_ref_counted<LentFrameRecorder>());
}

}

// Without seeks the node must deliver every decoded frame, in order, exactly once: the count and
// timestamps are deterministic even though the pump and the drainer run concurrently.
TEST_CASE(remote_video_node_delivers_every_frame_in_order)
{
    auto reference = decode_reference_timestamps(TEST_CLIP);
    EXPECT(!reference.is_empty());

    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();
    auto decoder = make_decoder(loop, TEST_CLIP);
    auto harness = make_ref_counted<VideoEdgeTestHarness>();
    wire_full_node(*harness, decoder);

    Vector<AK::Duration> delivered;
    auto deadline = MonotonicTime::now_coarse() + AK::Duration::from_seconds(10);
    while (MonotonicTime::now_coarse() < deadline) {
        loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
        harness->deliver_messages();
        auto output = harness->consumer->peek();
        if (output.status == PipelineStatus::HaveData) {
            delivered.append(output.frame->timestamp());
            harness->consumer->consume();
            continue;
        }
        if (output.status == PipelineStatus::EndOfStream)
            break;
    }

    EXPECT_EQ(delivered, reference);
}

TEST_CASE(remote_video_node_suspended_before_starting_delivers_nothing_until_a_seek)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();
    auto decoder = make_decoder(loop, TEST_CLIP);
    auto harness = make_ref_counted<VideoEdgeTestHarness>();
    wire_full_node(*harness, decoder, ConsumerStart::Suspended);

    auto pump_until_consumer_reports = [&](PipelineStatus status) {
        auto deadline = MonotonicTime::now_coarse() + AK::Duration::from_seconds(10);
        while (MonotonicTime::now_coarse() < deadline) {
            loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
            harness->deliver_messages();
            auto reported_status = harness->consumer->peek().status;
            if (reported_status == status)
                return true;
            if (reported_status == PipelineStatus::HaveData)
                return false;
        }
        return false;
    };
    EXPECT(pump_until_consumer_reports(PipelineStatus::Suspended));

    harness->consumer->seek(AK::Duration::zero());
    EXPECT(pump_until_consumer_reports(PipelineStatus::HaveData));
}

// A producer that played to its end before its sink attached still reports that end. Until the consumer's suspension
// reaches the pump, the pump must not pass it on, or the consumer would see an end that the clock may be far from.
TEST_CASE(remote_video_node_attached_suspended_to_an_ended_producer_reports_no_end_of_stream)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();
    auto decoder = make_decoder(loop, TEST_CLIP);
    decoder->start();
    EXPECT(pump_until(loop, [&] {
        auto output = decoder->peek();
        if (output.frame != nullptr)
            decoder->consume();
        return output.status == PipelineStatus::EndOfStream;
    }));

    auto input = FirstPeekRecordingVideoProducer::create(decoder);
    auto harness = make_ref_counted<VideoEdgeTestHarness>();
    harness->holds_suspension_requests = true;
    wire_full_node(*harness, input, ConsumerStart::Suspended);
    EXPECT(harness->has_held_suspension_request);

    bool consumer_saw_end_of_stream = false;
    auto pump_until_consumer_reports = [&](PipelineStatus status) {
        return pump_until(loop, [&] {
            harness->deliver_messages();
            auto reported_status = harness->consumer->peek().status;
            if (reported_status == PipelineStatus::EndOfStream)
                consumer_saw_end_of_stream = true;
            return reported_status == status;
        });
    };

    // Give a pump that peeks too early the time to do so. Whether it does is checked from what it first saw.
    auto deadline = MonotonicTime::now_coarse() + AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(100);
    while (MonotonicTime::now_coarse() < deadline) {
        loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
        harness->deliver_messages();
    }

    harness->sink->suspend_input();
    EXPECT(pump_until_consumer_reports(PipelineStatus::Suspended));
    auto first_peeked_status = input->first_peeked_status();
    EXPECT(first_peeked_status.has_value());
    if (first_peeked_status.has_value())
        EXPECT_EQ(*first_peeked_status, PipelineStatus::Suspended);

    harness->consumer->seek(AK::Duration::zero());
    EXPECT(pump_until_consumer_reports(PipelineStatus::HaveData));
    EXPECT(!consumer_saw_end_of_stream);
}

// Stress the boundary under genuine concurrency: the pump thread and the draining thread race while
// seeks are injected mid-drain. Seeks go backward, so a correct node visibly rewinds; a leaked
// superseded-generation frame comes from ahead of where we were and trips the assertion. Also catches
// crashes, deadlocks, and lend leaks (which would starve the pool and hang). Repeat the executable to
// widen the interleaving coverage.
TEST_CASE(remote_video_node_streams_and_seeks_under_concurrency)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();
    auto decoder = make_decoder(loop, TEST_CLIP);
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA auto harness = make_ref_counted<VideoEdgeTestHarness>();
    wire_full_node(*harness, decoder);

    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<bool> stop { false };
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<size_t> frames_pulled { 0 };
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<bool> stale_detected { false };
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<i64> stale_observed_ms { 0 };
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<i64> stale_pre_seek_ms { 0 };

    auto drainer = Threading::Thread::construct("Consumer Drainer"sv, [&]() -> intptr_t {
        auto const seek_step = AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(300);
        size_t since_seek = 0;
        bool have_consumed = false;
        AK::Duration last_consumed;
        bool just_seeked = false;
        AK::Duration pre_seek_timestamp;

        auto seek_to = [&](AK::Duration target) {
            pre_seek_timestamp = last_consumed;
            harness->consumer->seek(target);
            just_seeked = true;
            since_seek = 0;
        };

        while (!stop.load(AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed)) {
            harness->deliver_messages();

            auto output = harness->consumer->peek();
            if (output.status == PipelineStatus::HaveData) {
                VERIFY(output.frame);
                auto timestamp = output.frame->timestamp();
                if (just_seeked) {
                    if (timestamp >= pre_seek_timestamp) {
                        stale_observed_ms.store(timestamp.to_milliseconds(), AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed);
                        stale_pre_seek_ms.store(pre_seek_timestamp.to_milliseconds(), AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed);
                        stale_detected.store(true, AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed);
                    }
                    just_seeked = false;
                }

                if (have_consumed && ++since_seek >= 20) {
                    // Seek with this frame still queued, so the drop covers it as well as the frames behind it.
                    seek_to(last_consumed > seek_step ? last_consumed - seek_step : AK::Duration::zero());
                    continue;
                }

                last_consumed = timestamp;
                have_consumed = true;
                frames_pulled.fetch_add(1, AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed);
                harness->consumer->consume();
                continue;
            }

            // Loop the clip (also a backward seek) so the stream keeps running for the test window.
            if (output.status == PipelineStatus::EndOfStream && have_consumed)
                seek_to(AK::Duration::zero());

            MutexLocker locker { harness->mutex };
            while (!harness->signaled && !stop.load(AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed) && harness->pending_messages.is_empty())
                harness->signal.wait();
            harness->signaled = false;
        }
        return 0;
    });
    drainer->start();

    auto deadline = MonotonicTime::now_coarse() + AK::Duration::from_seconds(1);
    while (MonotonicTime::now_coarse() < deadline)
        loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);

    stop.store(true, AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed);
    harness->wake();
    (void)drainer->join();

    if (stale_detected.load(AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed)) {
        FAIL(MUST(String::formatted("Stale frame at {}ms delivered after seeking back from {}ms",
            stale_observed_ms.load(AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed),
            stale_pre_seek_ms.load(AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed))));
    }
    EXPECT(frames_pulled.load(AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed) > 0);
}

// Seeks in both directions, many of them landing in frames that are still on their way to the consumer, which the sink
// has to lend again. Whichever way a seek is resolved, the first frame after it must hold the target or come just
// before it, and the frames after that must follow in order, or a frame was skipped or a stale one delivered.
TEST_CASE(remote_video_node_resolves_seeks_into_frames_on_their_way)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();
    auto decoder = make_decoder(loop, TEST_CLIP);
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA auto harness = make_ref_counted<VideoEdgeTestHarness>();
    harness->delivery_delay = AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(3);
    wire_full_node(*harness, decoder);

    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<bool> stop { false };
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<size_t> seek_count { 0 };
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<bool> failure_detected { false };
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<i64> failure_target_ms { 0 };
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<i64> failure_frame_ms { 0 };

    auto drainer = Threading::Thread::construct("Consumer Drainer"sv, [&]() -> intptr_t {
        u32 random_state = 0x9e3779b9;
        auto next_random = [&](u32 bound) {
            random_state ^= random_state << 13;
            random_state ^= random_state >> 17;
            random_state ^= random_state << 5;
            return random_state % bound;
        };

        Optional<AK::Duration> seek_target;
        Optional<AK::Duration> last_timestamp;
        size_t frames_since_seek = 0;
        auto fail = [&](AK::Duration target, AK::Duration frame_timestamp) {
            failure_target_ms.store(target.to_milliseconds(), AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed);
            failure_frame_ms.store(frame_timestamp.to_milliseconds(), AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed);
            failure_detected.store(true, AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed);
        };
        auto seek_to = [&](AK::Duration target) {
            harness->consumer->seek(target);
            seek_target = target;
            last_timestamp = {};
            frames_since_seek = 0;
            seek_count.fetch_add(1, AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed);
        };

        while (!stop.load(AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed)) {
            harness->deliver_messages();

            auto output = harness->consumer->peek();
            if (output.status == PipelineStatus::HaveData) {
                auto timestamp = output.frame->timestamp();
                if (seek_target.has_value() && !last_timestamp.has_value() && timestamp > seek_target.value())
                    fail(seek_target.value(), timestamp);
                if (last_timestamp.has_value() && timestamp <= last_timestamp.value())
                    fail(seek_target.value_or(AK::Duration::zero()), timestamp);
                last_timestamp = timestamp;
                harness->consumer->consume();

                if (++frames_since_seek >= 4 + next_random(8)) {
                    // Mostly short hops forward, which land in the frames still on their way, and some jumps anywhere.
                    if (next_random(4) != 0)
                        seek_to(timestamp + AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(10 + next_random(120)));
                    else
                        seek_to(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(next_random(4500)));
                }
                continue;
            }
            if (output.status == PipelineStatus::EndOfStream) {
                seek_to(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(next_random(2000)));
                continue;
            }

            MutexLocker locker { harness->mutex };
            if (harness->pending_messages.is_empty()) {
                while (!harness->signaled && !stop.load(AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed) && harness->pending_messages.is_empty())
                    harness->signal.wait();
            }
            harness->signaled = false;
        }
        return 0;
    });
    drainer->start();

    auto deadline = MonotonicTime::now_coarse() + AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1500);
    while (MonotonicTime::now_coarse() < deadline)
        loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);

    stop.store(true, AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed);
    harness->wake();
    (void)drainer->join();

    if (failure_detected.load(AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed)) {
        FAIL(MUST(String::formatted("Frame at {}ms delivered out of place after seeking to {}ms",
            failure_frame_ms.load(AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed),
            failure_target_ms.load(AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed))));
    }
    EXPECT(seek_count.load(AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed) > 10);
}

TEST_CASE(video_presentation_server_releases_playback_edge_when_connection_dies)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto manager = PlaybackManager::create(Media::AudioOutputFactory::create_null());
    bool metadata_parsed = false;
    manager->add_media_source(create_demuxer(load_test_file(TEST_CLIP)))->when_resolved([&](auto&) {
        metadata_parsed = true;
    });
    if (!spin_until(loop, [&] { return metadata_parsed; })) {
        FAIL("Timed out waiting for metadata");
        return;
    }
    if (manager->video_tracks().is_empty()) {
        FAIL("Expected a video track");
        return;
    }

    auto track = manager->video_tracks()[0];
    auto handle = manager->reserve_video_sink_handle(track);

    auto paired = MUST(IPC::Transport::create_paired());
    auto server = VideoPresentationServerConnection::construct(move(paired.local));
    auto client = adopt_ref(*new VideoPresentationClientConnection(MUST(paired.remote_handle.create_transport())));
    bool edge_ready = false;
    MUST(client->create_edge(handle, [&](NonnullRefPtr<DisplayingVideoSink>) {
        edge_ready = true;
    }));
    if (!spin_until(loop, [&] { return edge_ready; })) {
        FAIL("Timed out waiting for video edge");
        return;
    }
    EXPECT(manager->track_is_enabled(track));

    server->shutdown();
    EXPECT(!manager->track_is_enabled(track));
}

// The playback manager decides on ticking for a sink, and the sink hears of it across its edge, both of a decision made
// before the edge existed and of later ones.
TEST_CASE(video_presentation_edge_carries_the_ticking_decision_to_its_sink)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();

    auto manager = PlaybackManager::create(Media::AudioOutputFactory::create_null());
    bool metadata_parsed = false;
    manager->add_media_source(create_demuxer(load_test_file(TEST_CLIP)))->when_resolved([&](auto&) {
        metadata_parsed = true;
    });
    if (!spin_until(loop, [&] { return metadata_parsed; })) {
        FAIL("Timed out waiting for metadata");
        return;
    }
    if (manager->video_tracks().is_empty()) {
        FAIL("Expected a video track");
        return;
    }

    auto handle = manager->reserve_video_sink_handle(manager->video_tracks()[0]);
    PlaybackManager::set_video_sink_ticking(handle, true);

    auto paired = MUST(IPC::Transport::create_paired());
    auto server = VideoPresentationServerConnection::construct(move(paired.local));
    auto client = adopt_ref(*new VideoPresentationClientConnection(MUST(paired.remote_handle.create_transport())));
    RefPtr<DisplayingVideoSink> sink;
    MUST(client->create_edge(handle, [&](NonnullRefPtr<DisplayingVideoSink> ready_sink) {
        sink = move(ready_sink);
    }));
    if (!spin_until(loop, [&] { return sink && sink->is_ticking(); })) {
        FAIL("Timed out waiting for a ticking video edge");
        return;
    }

    PlaybackManager::set_video_sink_ticking(handle, false);
    EXPECT(spin_until(loop, [&] { return !sink->is_ticking(); }));
    PlaybackManager::set_video_sink_ticking(handle, true);
    EXPECT(spin_until(loop, [&] { return sink->is_ticking(); }));

    server->shutdown();
}

// Each edge keeps the frames it is lent, so a client that asks for edges without end is refused past the limit, until
// it releases one.
TEST_CASE(video_presentation_client_limits_its_edges)
{
    auto paired = MUST(IPC::Transport::create_paired());
    auto server = VideoPresentationServerConnection::construct(move(paired.local));
    auto client = adopt_ref(*new VideoPresentationClientConnection(MUST(paired.remote_handle.create_transport())));

    Vector<VideoSinkHandle> handles;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < VideoPresentationClientConnection::MAX_EDGE_COUNT; i++) {
        handles.append(allocate_video_sink_handle());
        EXPECT(!client->create_edge(handles.last(), [](NonnullRefPtr<DisplayingVideoSink>) { }).is_error());
    }
    EXPECT(client->create_edge(allocate_video_sink_handle(), [](NonnullRefPtr<DisplayingVideoSink>) { }).is_error());

    client->release_edge(handles.first());
    EXPECT(!client->create_edge(allocate_video_sink_handle(), [](NonnullRefPtr<DisplayingVideoSink>) { }).is_error());
}

// A forward seek landing inside the received lookahead is resolved locally; a seek past it re-fetches.
TEST_CASE(consumer_resolves_forward_seeks_within_the_lookahead)
{
    auto pool = MUST(VideoFramePool::create());
    size_t upstream_seeks = 0;
    auto consumer = RemoteVideoProducer::create(make_consumer_delegates(upstream_seeks));
    give_lookahead(*consumer, *pool);

    consumer->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1200));
    EXPECT_EQ(upstream_seeks, 0u);

    consumer->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(3000));
    EXPECT_EQ(upstream_seeks, 1u);
}

// A backward seek leaves the lookahead behind, so it must re-fetch upstream.
TEST_CASE(consumer_sends_backward_seeks_upstream)
{
    auto pool = MUST(VideoFramePool::create());
    size_t upstream_seeks = 0;
    auto consumer = RemoteVideoProducer::create(make_consumer_delegates(upstream_seeks));
    give_lookahead(*consumer, *pool);

    consumer->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(500));
    EXPECT_EQ(upstream_seeks, 1u);
}

// The seek must reach upstream before the stale frames are released, naming the newest frame received so far, and a
// frame of the new seek that arrives in between must be kept.
TEST_CASE(consumer_requests_seeks_before_releasing_stale_frames)
{
    auto pool = MUST(VideoFramePool::create());
    Vector<StringView> events;
    Optional<u64> requested_newest_received_lend_id;
    RefPtr<RemoteVideoProducer> consumer;
    RemoteVideoProducer::Delegates delegates;
    delegates.request_start = [] { };
    delegates.request_suspend = [] { };
    delegates.request_seek = [&](AK::Duration, InvalidateHeldData, u64 newest_received_lend_id) {
        events.append("seek"sv);
        requested_newest_received_lend_id = newest_received_lend_id;
        consumer->receive_frame(5, 1, create_received_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(500)));
    };
    consumer = RemoteVideoProducer::create(move(delegates));
    Function<void()> on_release = [&] { events.append("release"sv); };
    give_lookahead(*consumer, *pool, &on_release);

    consumer->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(500));

    EXPECT_EQ(events, (Vector<StringView> { "seek"sv, "release"sv, "release"sv, "release"sv, "release"sv }));
    EXPECT_EQ(requested_newest_received_lend_id, 4u);
    auto output = consumer->peek();
    EXPECT_EQ(output.status, PipelineStatus::HaveData);
    EXPECT_EQ(output.frame->timestamp(), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(500));
}

// With the end of stream received, no frames exist beyond the lookahead for the producer to
// re-emit, so a seek past the end must resolve locally instead of discarding the queued tail.
TEST_CASE(consumer_resolves_seeks_past_the_end_of_stream_locally)
{
    auto pool = MUST(VideoFramePool::create());
    size_t upstream_seeks = 0;
    auto consumer = RemoteVideoProducer::create(make_consumer_delegates(upstream_seeks));
    give_lookahead(*consumer, *pool);
    consumer->receive_status(PipelineStatus::EndOfStream, 0, 0);

    consumer->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(3000));
    EXPECT_EQ(upstream_seeks, 0u);

    // Backward seeks below the queued tail still re-fetch, end of stream or not.
    consumer->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(500));
    EXPECT_EQ(upstream_seeks, 1u);
}

// Observing a suspended edge must release every queued frame, so that the suspended producer's storage is actually
// reclaimed; resuming demand-seeks past those frames anyway.
TEST_CASE(consumer_releases_queued_frames_on_suspension)
{
    auto pool = MUST(VideoFramePool::create());
    size_t upstream_seeks = 0;
    size_t released_frames = 0;
    Function<void()> on_release = [&] { released_frames++; };
    auto consumer = RemoteVideoProducer::create(make_consumer_delegates(upstream_seeks));
    give_lookahead(*consumer, *pool, &on_release);

    consumer->receive_status(PipelineStatus::Suspended, 0, 0);

    EXPECT_EQ(released_frames, 4u);
    auto output = consumer->peek();
    EXPECT(output.frame == nullptr);
    EXPECT_EQ(output.status, PipelineStatus::Suspended);
}

// The clock resuming reaches a sink as a wake from its consumer. If the consumer suspended while the clock stood still,
// that wake is the sink's only chance to resume it, or no frame is shown again.
TEST_CASE(sink_resumes_a_suspended_consumer_when_the_clock_resumes)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();
    auto pool = MUST(VideoFramePool::create());
    size_t upstream_seeks = 0;
    auto consumer = RemoteVideoProducer::create(make_consumer_delegates(upstream_seeks));
    auto clock = MUST(MonotonicMediaClock::try_create());
    auto sink = MUST(DisplayingVideoSink::try_create(clock->time_reader()));
    MUST(sink->connect_input(consumer));
    sink->set_ticking(true);
    EXPECT_EQ(upstream_seeks, 1u);

    consumer->receive_frame(1, 1, create_received_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::zero()));
    EXPECT(sink->current_frame() != nullptr);

    consumer->receive_status(PipelineStatus::Suspended, 1, 0);
    loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    EXPECT_EQ(upstream_seeks, 1u);

    clock->resume();
    consumer->notify_clock_resumed();
    EXPECT_EQ(upstream_seeks, 2u);
    sink->disconnect_input(consumer);
}

// Frames lent under a seek the consumer has moved past are released as they arrive, and so are frames past the
// queue's limit, so that a peer cannot make the consumer hold its storage without end.
TEST_CASE(consumer_releases_frames_it_does_not_queue)
{
    auto pool = MUST(VideoFramePool::create());
    size_t upstream_seeks = 0;
    size_t released_frames = 0;
    auto consumer = RemoteVideoProducer::create(make_consumer_delegates(upstream_seeks));

    consumer->seek(AK::Duration::from_seconds(5));
    consumer->receive_frame(1, 0, create_received_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::zero(), [&] { released_frames++; }));
    EXPECT_EQ(released_frames, 1u);
    EXPECT_EQ(consumer->peek().status, PipelineStatus::Pending);

    for (u64 i = 0; i < RemoteVideoProducer::MAX_QUEUED_FRAME_COUNT + 2; i++)
        consumer->receive_frame(i + 2, 1, create_received_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(5000 + i), [&] { released_frames++; }));
    EXPECT_EQ(released_frames, 3u);
}

// The sink's input has moved past the frames on their way to the consumer when the consumer asks for a seek. If those
// frames hold the target, they are lent again under the seek's stamp instead of seeking the input back.
TEST_CASE(sink_lends_frames_on_their_way_again_for_a_seek_into_them)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();
    auto recorder = make_ref_counted<LentFrameRecorder>();
    auto sink = make_recorded_sink(*recorder);

    auto pool = MUST(VideoFramePool::create());
    auto producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
        producer->append_frame(create_pooled_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(i * 33)));
    MUST(sink->connect_input(producer));
    sink->start_input();
    EXPECT(spin_until(loop, [&] { return recorder->count() == 4; }));

    // The consumer had received only the first frame.
    auto newest_received_lend_id = recorder->at(0).lend_id;
    sink->seek_upstream(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(70), InvalidateHeldData::No, newest_received_lend_id);
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->seek_count(), 0u);

    if (!spin_until(loop, [&] { return recorder->count() == 6; })) {
        FAIL("The frames on their way were not lent again");
        return;
    }
    EXPECT_EQ(recorder->at(4).seek_id, 1u);
    EXPECT_EQ(recorder->at(4).metadata.timestamp, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(66));
    EXPECT_EQ(recorder->at(5).metadata.timestamp, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(99));
    EXPECT(recorder->at(5).lend_id > recorder->at(3).lend_id);
}

// A seek outside the frames on their way to the consumer goes to the input, whether those frames end before the target
// or the consumer had received them all.
TEST_CASE(sink_seeks_its_input_for_seeks_outside_the_frames_on_their_way)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();
    auto recorder = make_ref_counted<LentFrameRecorder>();
    auto sink = make_recorded_sink(*recorder);

    auto pool = MUST(VideoFramePool::create());
    auto producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
        producer->append_frame(create_pooled_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(i * 33)));
    MUST(sink->connect_input(producer));
    sink->start_input();
    EXPECT(spin_until(loop, [&] { return recorder->count() == 4; }));

    sink->seek_upstream(AK::Duration::from_seconds(5), InvalidateHeldData::No, recorder->at(0).lend_id);
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->seek_count(), 1u);

    sink->seek_upstream(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(70), InvalidateHeldData::No, recorder->at(3).lend_id);
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->seek_count(), 2u);

    sink->seek_upstream(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(70), InvalidateHeldData::Yes, recorder->at(0).lend_id);
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->seek_count(), 3u);
}

// A seek the consumer holds nothing for goes to the input right away, and the consumer's request for it, which
// follows, is already answered; a request for anywhere else is a new seek.
TEST_CASE(sink_seeks_its_input_directly_when_the_consumer_holds_nothing_for_the_seek)
{
    auto sink = make_sink_with_inert_delegates();
    auto producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    MUST(sink->connect_input(producer));

    sink->seek(AK::Duration::from_seconds(1));
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->seek_count(), 1u);
    sink->seek_upstream(AK::Duration::from_seconds(1), InvalidateHeldData::No, 0);
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->seek_count(), 1u);

    sink->seek_upstream(AK::Duration::from_seconds(2), InvalidateHeldData::No, 0);
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->seek_count(), 2u);
}

// A consumer that doesn't tick may leave its suspended input be for a seek, so the seek waits for its request. The sink
// passes the ticking on to the consumer.
TEST_CASE(sink_leaves_seeks_to_a_consumer_that_does_not_tick)
{
    auto recorder = make_ref_counted<LentFrameRecorder>();
    auto sink = make_recorded_sink(*recorder);
    sink->set_ticking(false);
    {
        MutexLocker locker { recorder->mutex };
        EXPECT_EQ(recorder->transmitted_ticking, (Vector { true, false }));
    }
    auto producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    MUST(sink->connect_input(producer));

    sink->seek(AK::Duration::from_seconds(1));
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->seek_count(), 0u);
    sink->seek_upstream(AK::Duration::from_seconds(1), InvalidateHeldData::No, 0);
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->seek_count(), 1u);
}

// The consumer may seek on its own while a direct seek awaits its request, as when it starts ticking again. Its
// request supersedes the direct seek, so the input follows the consumer, pumping resumes under the request's stamp,
// and the request for the direct seek, which arrives after, is a seek of its own again.
TEST_CASE(a_request_for_another_seek_supersedes_the_direct_seek)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();
    auto recorder = make_ref_counted<LentFrameRecorder>();
    auto sink = make_recorded_sink(*recorder);

    auto pool = MUST(VideoFramePool::create());
    auto producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    MUST(sink->connect_input(producer));
    sink->start_input();

    sink->seek(AK::Duration::from_seconds(1));
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->seek_count(), 1u);

    producer->append_frame(create_pooled_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_seconds(2)));
    sink->seek_upstream(AK::Duration::from_seconds(2), InvalidateHeldData::No, 0);
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->seek_count(), 2u);
    EXPECT(spin_until(loop, [&] { return recorder->count() == 1; }));
    EXPECT_EQ(recorder->at(0).seek_id, 1u);

    sink->seek_upstream(AK::Duration::from_seconds(1), InvalidateHeldData::No, recorder->at(0).lend_id);
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->seek_count(), 3u);
}

// The frames lent across the edge may satisfy a seek on the consumer's side, so such a seek waits for the consumer's
// decision.
TEST_CASE(sink_leaves_seeks_within_the_lent_frames_to_the_consumer)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();
    auto recorder = make_ref_counted<LentFrameRecorder>();
    auto sink = make_recorded_sink(*recorder);

    auto pool = MUST(VideoFramePool::create());
    auto producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    producer->append_frame(create_pooled_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::zero()));
    producer->append_frame(create_pooled_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(33)));
    MUST(sink->connect_input(producer));
    sink->start_input();
    EXPECT(spin_until(loop, [&] { return recorder->count() == 2; }));

    sink->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(20));
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->seek_count(), 0u);
    sink->seek_upstream(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(20), InvalidateHeldData::No, recorder->at(1).lend_id);
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->seek_count(), 1u);

    sink->seek(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(500));
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->seek_count(), 2u);
}

// Between the direct seek and the consumer's request for it, a frame of the new position would be stamped with the
// seek before it, so pumping waits for the request.
TEST_CASE(pump_holds_off_after_a_direct_seek_until_the_consumer_requests_it)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();
    auto recorder = make_ref_counted<LentFrameRecorder>();
    auto sink = make_recorded_sink(*recorder);

    auto pool = MUST(VideoFramePool::create());
    auto producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    MUST(sink->connect_input(producer));
    sink->seek(AK::Duration::from_seconds(1));
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->seek_count(), 1u);
    sink->start_input();
    producer->append_frame(create_pooled_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::zero()));
    producer->append_frame(create_pooled_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(33)));
    producer->wake();

    auto hold_off_deadline = MonotonicTime::now_coarse() + AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(100);
    while (MonotonicTime::now_coarse() < hold_off_deadline) {
        EXPECT_EQ(recorder->count(), 0u);
        loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    }

    sink->seek_upstream(AK::Duration::from_seconds(1), InvalidateHeldData::No, 0);
    EXPECT_EQ(producer->seek_count(), 1u);
    EXPECT(spin_until(loop, [&] { return recorder->count() > 0; }));
    EXPECT_EQ(recorder->at(0).seek_id, 1u);
}

// The pump stops taking frames from its input once the limit of frames lent at once is reached, until one comes back.
TEST_CASE(pump_waits_for_a_release_once_it_has_lent_its_limit)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();
    auto recorder = make_ref_counted<LentFrameRecorder>();
    auto sink = make_recorded_sink(*recorder);

    auto pool = MUST(VideoFramePool::create(VideoFramePool::DEFAULT_BYTE_BUDGET));
    auto producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    auto frame = create_pooled_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::zero());
    for (size_t i = 0; i < RemoteVideoSink::MAX_LENT_FRAME_COUNT + 1; i++)
        producer->append_frame(frame);
    MUST(sink->connect_input(producer));
    sink->start_input();

    EXPECT(spin_until(loop, [&] { return recorder->count() == RemoteVideoSink::MAX_LENT_FRAME_COUNT; }));
    auto hold_off_deadline = MonotonicTime::now_coarse() + AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(100);
    while (MonotonicTime::now_coarse() < hold_off_deadline) {
        EXPECT_EQ(recorder->count(), RemoteVideoSink::MAX_LENT_FRAME_COUNT);
        loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);
    }

    sink->release_frame(recorder->at(0).lend_id);
    EXPECT(spin_until(loop, [&] { return recorder->count() == RemoteVideoSink::MAX_LENT_FRAME_COUNT + 1; }));
}

// A stopped pump lends nothing more, but the frames it lent stay lent until the consumer releases them.
TEST_CASE(stopped_pump_keeps_its_lent_frames_until_they_are_released)
{
    auto& loop = never_destroyed_event_loop();
    auto recorder = make_ref_counted<LentFrameRecorder>();
    auto sink = make_recorded_sink(*recorder);

    auto pool = MUST(VideoFramePool::create());
    auto producer = ScriptedVideoProducer::create();
    producer->append_frame(create_pooled_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::zero()));
    producer->append_frame(create_pooled_frame(*pool, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(33)));
    MUST(sink->connect_input(producer));
    sink->start_input();
    EXPECT(spin_until(loop, [&] { return recorder->count() == 2; }));

    sink->stop();
    EXPECT(sink->has_lent_frames());

    sink->release_frame(recorder->at(0).lend_id);
    EXPECT(sink->has_lent_frames());
    sink->release_frame(recorder->at(1).lend_id);
    EXPECT(!sink->has_lent_frames());
}
