#include <AK/ConditionVariable.h>
#include <AK/MemoryStream.h>
#include <AK/Mutex.h>
#include <AK/Queue.h>
#include <AK/Random.h>
#include <AK/Time.h>
#include <LibCore/System.h>
#include <LibIPC/Decoder.h>
#include <LibIPC/Encoder.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/Limits.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/VideoFrame.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/VideoFrameMetadata.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/VideoFramePool.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/VideoSurface.h>
#include <LibTest/TestCase.h>
#include <LibThreading/Thread.h>

static constexpr size_t FRAME_BYTE_COUNT = 4096;

static NonnullRefPtr<Media::VideoFramePool> make_pool(Function<void()> slot_freed_callback = nullptr, size_t byte_budget = Media::VideoFramePool::DEFAULT_BYTE_BUDGET)
{
    auto pool = MUST(Media::VideoFramePool::create(byte_budget));
    pool->set_slot_freed_callback(move(slot_freed_callback));
    return pool;
}

// The size of one allocated slot buffer, as observed through the pool's byte accounting.
static size_t measured_slot_buffer_size(size_t byte_count)
{
    auto pool = make_pool();
    (void)pool->try_acquire(byte_count).release_value();
    return pool->allocated_byte_count();
}

static constexpr Gfx::IntSize RESOLVED_FRAME_SIZE { 64, 64 };
static constexpr u8 RESOLVED_FRAME_BIT_DEPTH = 8;
static Media::Subsampling const RESOLVED_FRAME_SUBSAMPLING { true, true };

static size_t resolved_frame_byte_count()
{
    return MUST(Media::frame_plane_layout(RESOLVED_FRAME_SIZE, RESOLVED_FRAME_BIT_DEPTH, RESOLVED_FRAME_SUBSAMPLING)).total_byte_count;
}

static Media::VideoFrameMetadata make_metadata()
{
    return Media::VideoFrameMetadata {
        .timestamp = AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(40),
        .duration = AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(20),
        .size = RESOLVED_FRAME_SIZE,
        .bit_depth = RESOLVED_FRAME_BIT_DEPTH,
        .subsampling = RESOLVED_FRAME_SUBSAMPLING,
        .color_metadata = {
            .cicp = {
                Media::ColorPrimaries::BT709,
                Media::TransferCharacteristics::BT709,
                Media::MatrixCoefficients::BT709,
                Media::VideoFullRangeFlag::Full,
            },
            .mastering_display_color_volume = {},
            .content_light_level_information = {},
            .maximum_scene_luminance = {},
        },
    };
}

// Maps a slot's buffer a second time, as receiving it in another process would.
static Core::AnonymousBuffer received_copy_of(Core::AnonymousBuffer const& buffer)
{
    return MUST(Core::AnonymousBuffer::create_from_anon_fd(MUST(Core::System::dup(buffer.fd())), buffer.size()));
}

static bool buffers_share_memory(Core::AnonymousBuffer const& a, Core::AnonymousBuffer const& b)
{
    return a.is_valid() && b.is_valid() && a.data<u8 const>() == b.data<u8 const>();
}

TEST_CASE(acquire_exhaustion_and_release)
{
    auto pool = make_pool();
    Vector<Media::VideoFramePool::AcquiredSlot> slots;
    for (u32 i = 0; i < Media::VideoFramePool::MAX_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
        slots.append(pool->try_acquire(FRAME_BYTE_COUNT).release_value());

    EXPECT(!pool->try_acquire(FRAME_BYTE_COUNT).has_value());

    slots.take_last();
    EXPECT(pool->try_acquire(FRAME_BYTE_COUNT).has_value());
}

TEST_CASE(a_slot_stays_held_while_any_frame_shares_its_storage)
{
    auto pool = make_pool();
    auto slot = pool->try_acquire(FRAME_BYTE_COUNT);
    RefPtr<Media::VideoFrameStorage> second_reference = slot->storage;
    auto slot_buffer = slot->storage->pixel_buffer();
    slot.clear();

    Vector<Media::VideoFramePool::AcquiredSlot> other_slots;
    for (u32 i = 0; i < Media::VideoFramePool::MAX_SLOT_COUNT - 1; i++)
        other_slots.append(pool->try_acquire(FRAME_BYTE_COUNT).release_value());
    EXPECT(!pool->try_acquire(FRAME_BYTE_COUNT).has_value());

    second_reference = nullptr;
    auto reacquired = pool->try_acquire(FRAME_BYTE_COUNT);
    EXPECT(reacquired.has_value());
    EXPECT(buffers_share_memory(reacquired->storage->pixel_buffer(), slot_buffer));
}

TEST_CASE(buffers_are_reused_on_exact_capacity_match)
{
    auto pool = make_pool();
    auto first = pool->try_acquire(FRAME_BYTE_COUNT);
    auto first_buffer = first->storage->pixel_buffer();
    auto allocated_after_first = pool->allocated_byte_count();
    first.clear();

    // Reacquiring the same byte count reuses the free buffer without allocating.
    auto reacquired = pool->try_acquire(FRAME_BYTE_COUNT);
    EXPECT(buffers_share_memory(reacquired->storage->pixel_buffer(), first_buffer));
    EXPECT_EQ(pool->allocated_byte_count(), allocated_after_first);
    reacquired.clear();

    // A different byte count needs a buffer of its own.
    auto larger = pool->try_acquire(FRAME_BYTE_COUNT * 2).release_value();
    EXPECT(pool->allocated_byte_count() > allocated_after_first);
}

TEST_CASE(budget_always_allows_the_liveness_floor)
{
    // With a zero budget, every allocation exceeds the budget, so exactly the liveness floor
    // can be held at once.
    auto pool = make_pool(nullptr, 0);
    Vector<Media::VideoFramePool::AcquiredSlot> slots;
    for (u32 i = 0; i < Media::VideoFramePool::MIN_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
        slots.append(pool->try_acquire(FRAME_BYTE_COUNT).release_value());

    EXPECT(!pool->try_acquire(FRAME_BYTE_COUNT).has_value());

    slots.take_last();
    EXPECT(pool->try_acquire(FRAME_BYTE_COUNT).has_value());
}

TEST_CASE(excess_free_buffers_are_dropped_to_fit_the_budget)
{
    auto slot_buffer_size = measured_slot_buffer_size(FRAME_BYTE_COUNT);
    auto byte_budget = slot_buffer_size * (Media::VideoFramePool::MIN_SLOT_COUNT + 1);
    auto pool = make_pool(nullptr, byte_budget);

    // Fill the budget with free buffers.
    {
        Vector<Media::VideoFramePool::AcquiredSlot> slots;
        for (u32 i = 0; i < Media::VideoFramePool::MIN_SLOT_COUNT + 1; i++)
            slots.append(pool->try_acquire(FRAME_BYTE_COUNT).release_value());
    }
    EXPECT_EQ(pool->allocated_byte_count(), byte_budget);

    // A larger allocation replaces one free buffer and sheds another to return to the budget.
    auto larger_byte_count = slot_buffer_size * 2;
    auto larger = pool->try_acquire(larger_byte_count).release_value();
    EXPECT_EQ(pool->allocated_byte_count(), measured_slot_buffer_size(larger_byte_count) + (slot_buffer_size * (Media::VideoFramePool::MIN_SLOT_COUNT - 1)));
}

TEST_CASE(the_liveness_floor_stays_allocated_past_the_budget)
{
    auto slot_buffer_size = measured_slot_buffer_size(FRAME_BYTE_COUNT);
    auto pool = make_pool(nullptr, 0);
    {
        Vector<Media::VideoFramePool::AcquiredSlot> slots;
        for (u32 i = 0; i < Media::VideoFramePool::MIN_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
            slots.append(pool->try_acquire(FRAME_BYTE_COUNT).release_value());
    }

    (void)pool->try_acquire(FRAME_BYTE_COUNT).release_value();
    EXPECT_EQ(pool->allocated_byte_count(), slot_buffer_size * Media::VideoFramePool::MIN_SLOT_COUNT);
}

TEST_CASE(reallocation_replaces_the_largest_free_buffer)
{
    auto slot_buffer_size = measured_slot_buffer_size(FRAME_BYTE_COUNT);
    auto pool = make_pool();
    {
        auto smaller = pool->try_acquire(slot_buffer_size).release_value();
        auto larger = pool->try_acquire(slot_buffer_size * 4).release_value();
    }

    auto middle_byte_count = slot_buffer_size * 2;
    (void)pool->try_acquire(middle_byte_count).release_value();
    EXPECT_EQ(pool->allocated_byte_count(), slot_buffer_size + measured_slot_buffer_size(middle_byte_count));
}

TEST_CASE(frame_layouts_beyond_the_size_limits_are_refused)
{
    Media::Subsampling subsampling { true, true };
    EXPECT(!Media::frame_plane_layout({ 32767, 16 }, 8, subsampling).is_error());
    EXPECT(Media::frame_plane_layout({ 32768, 16 }, 8, subsampling).is_error());
    EXPECT(Media::frame_plane_layout({ 16, 32768 }, 8, subsampling).is_error());
    EXPECT(!Media::frame_plane_layout({ 16384, 32767 }, 8, subsampling).is_error());
    EXPECT(Media::frame_plane_layout({ 23171, 23171 }, 8, subsampling).is_error());
}

TEST_CASE(shed_storage_frees_all_but_held_slots)
{
    auto pool = make_pool();
    auto held = pool->try_acquire(resolved_frame_byte_count());
    held->bytes.fill(0x42);
    auto frame = MUST(Media::create_received_video_frame(make_metadata(), received_copy_of(held->storage->pixel_buffer()), 0, [] { }));

    (void)pool->try_acquire(FRAME_BYTE_COUNT).release_value();

    pool->shed_storage();

    // Only the held slot's buffer remains.
    EXPECT_EQ(pool->allocated_byte_count(), measured_slot_buffer_size(resolved_frame_byte_count()));
    EXPECT_EQ(frame->yuv_data()->y_data()[0], 0x42);

    // The held buffer is freed once its last hold releases, while a frame received from it keeps reading it.
    held.clear();
    EXPECT_EQ(pool->allocated_byte_count(), 0u);
    EXPECT_EQ(frame->yuv_data()->y_data()[0], 0x42);
}

TEST_CASE(acquisition_ends_shedding_of_held_buffers)
{
    auto pool = make_pool();
    auto held = pool->try_acquire(FRAME_BYTE_COUNT);

    pool->shed_storage();

    // An acquisition returns the pool to service, so the buffer held through the shed is
    // recycled rather than freed when its hold releases.
    auto reacquired = pool->try_acquire(FRAME_BYTE_COUNT);
    held.clear();
    EXPECT_EQ(pool->allocated_byte_count(), measured_slot_buffer_size(FRAME_BYTE_COUNT) * 2);

    reacquired.clear();
    EXPECT_EQ(pool->allocated_byte_count(), measured_slot_buffer_size(FRAME_BYTE_COUNT) * 2);
}

TEST_CASE(smaller_acquisitions_replace_oversized_buffers)
{
    auto pool = make_pool();
    {
        Vector<Media::VideoFramePool::AcquiredSlot> slots;
        for (u32 i = 0; i < Media::VideoFramePool::MAX_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
            slots.append(pool->try_acquire(FRAME_BYTE_COUNT * 2).release_value());
    }

    // With every slot holding an oversized free buffer, an exact-size acquisition replaces one
    // rather than reusing the excess capacity.
    auto exact = pool->try_acquire(FRAME_BYTE_COUNT).release_value();
    EXPECT_EQ(pool->allocated_byte_count(),
        (measured_slot_buffer_size(FRAME_BYTE_COUNT * 2) * (Media::VideoFramePool::MAX_SLOT_COUNT - 1))
            + measured_slot_buffer_size(FRAME_BYTE_COUNT));
}

TEST_CASE(slot_freed_callback_fires_when_a_slot_becomes_free)
{
    size_t freed_count = 0;
    auto pool = make_pool([&freed_count] { freed_count++; });

    auto slot = pool->try_acquire(FRAME_BYTE_COUNT);
    RefPtr<Media::VideoFrameStorage> second_reference = slot->storage;

    // Dropping a reference that leaves the slot held does not fire.
    slot.clear();
    EXPECT_EQ(freed_count, 0u);

    second_reference = nullptr;
    EXPECT_EQ(freed_count, 1u);
    EXPECT(pool->try_acquire(FRAME_BYTE_COUNT).has_value());
}

TEST_CASE(slot_freed_callback_wakes_a_waiting_acquirer)
{
    // The waiter mirrors how a producer integrates the callback: it sleeps on its own
    // condition variable and retries try_acquire() on each callback-driven wake.
    struct WaiterState {
        Mutex mutex;
        ConditionVariable condition { mutex };
    };
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA WaiterState waiter;
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA auto pool = make_pool([&waiter] {
        MutexLocker locker { waiter.mutex };
        waiter.condition.broadcast();
    });

    Vector<Media::VideoFramePool::AcquiredSlot> slots;
    for (u32 i = 0; i < Media::VideoFramePool::MAX_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
        slots.append(pool->try_acquire(FRAME_BYTE_COUNT).release_value());

    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<bool> started { false };
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Mutex acquired_mutex;
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Optional<Media::VideoFramePool::AcquiredSlot> acquired;
    auto acquirer_thread = Threading::Thread::construct("PoolAcquirer"sv, [&pool, &waiter, &started, &acquired_mutex, &acquired]() {
        MutexLocker locker { waiter.mutex };
        started.store(true);
        while (true) {
            if (auto slot = pool->try_acquire(FRAME_BYTE_COUNT); slot.has_value()) {
                MutexLocker acquired_locker { acquired_mutex };
                acquired = slot.release_value();
                return 0;
            }
            waiter.condition.wait();
        }
    });
    acquirer_thread->start();

    while (!started.load())
        ;
    auto released_buffer = slots.last().storage->pixel_buffer();
    slots.take_last();

    // If the release fails to wake the waiter, this join hangs the test.
    (void)acquirer_thread->join();
    MutexLocker acquired_locker { acquired_mutex };
    EXPECT(buffers_share_memory(acquired->storage->pixel_buffer(), released_buffer));
}

TEST_CASE(received_frames_read_their_buffer_and_release_it_once_dropped)
{
    auto pool = make_pool();
    auto slot = pool->try_acquire(resolved_frame_byte_count()).release_value();
    slot.bytes.fill(0x33);

    bool released = false;
    {
        auto frame = MUST(Media::create_received_video_frame(make_metadata(), received_copy_of(slot.storage->pixel_buffer()), 7, [&] { released = true; }));
        EXPECT_NE(frame->yuv_data()->y_data().data(), static_cast<u8 const*>(slot.bytes.data()));
        EXPECT_EQ(frame->yuv_data()->y_data()[0], 0x33);
        EXPECT_EQ(frame->timestamp(), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(40));
        EXPECT_EQ(frame->storage()->sender_id(), 7u);
        EXPECT(!released);
    }
    EXPECT(released);
}

// The storage comes from another process, so a frame it could not hold is refused, and the storage released at once.
TEST_CASE(received_frames_must_fit_their_storage)
{
    auto pool = make_pool();
    auto slot = pool->try_acquire(resolved_frame_byte_count()).release_value();

    auto release_count = 0u;
    auto oversized = make_metadata();
    oversized.bit_depth = 10;
    EXPECT(Media::create_received_video_frame(oversized, received_copy_of(slot.storage->pixel_buffer()), 0, [&] { release_count++; }).is_error());
    EXPECT_EQ(release_count, 1u);

    auto too_small = MUST(Core::AnonymousBuffer::create_with_size(16));
    EXPECT(Media::create_received_video_frame(make_metadata(), too_small, 0, [&] { release_count++; }).is_error());
    EXPECT_EQ(release_count, 2u);

    EXPECT(Media::create_received_video_frame(make_metadata(), Core::AnonymousBuffer {}, 0, [&] { release_count++; }).is_error());
    EXPECT_EQ(release_count, 3u);
}

// Metadata comes from another process, so metadata describing a frame no decoder produces is refused, even when the
// storage could hold it.
TEST_CASE(received_frames_must_be_ones_a_decoder_could_produce)
{
    auto pool = make_pool();
    auto slot = pool->try_acquire(MUST(Media::frame_plane_layout(RESOLVED_FRAME_SIZE, 12, Media::Subsampling::yuv444())).total_byte_count).release_value();
    auto receive = [&](Media::VideoFrameMetadata const& metadata) {
        return Media::create_received_video_frame(metadata, received_copy_of(slot.storage->pixel_buffer()), 0, [] { });
    };
    EXPECT(!receive(make_metadata()).is_error());

    auto thirteen_bit = make_metadata();
    thirteen_bit.bit_depth = 13;
    EXPECT(receive(thirteen_bit).is_error());

    auto negative_duration = make_metadata();
    negative_duration.duration = AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(-20);
    EXPECT(receive(negative_duration).is_error());

    auto unknown_primaries = make_metadata();
    unknown_primaries.color_metadata.cicp.set_color_primaries(static_cast<Media::ColorPrimaries>(200));
    EXPECT(receive(unknown_primaries).is_error());

    auto too_wide = make_metadata();
    too_wide.size = { static_cast<int>(Media::MAX_VIDEO_FRAME_DIMENSION) + 1, 1 };
    EXPECT(!too_wide.is_valid());

    auto subsampled_rgb = make_metadata();
    subsampled_rgb.color_metadata.cicp.set_matrix_coefficients(Media::MatrixCoefficients::Identity);
    EXPECT(receive(subsampled_rgb).is_error());
    subsampled_rgb.subsampling = Media::Subsampling::yuv444();
    EXPECT(!receive(subsampled_rgb).is_error());
}

// Only a picture without chroma subsampling can hold RGB.
TEST_CASE(frames_keep_an_identity_matrix_only_without_subsampling)
{
    auto pool = make_pool();
    auto slot = pool->try_acquire(MUST(Media::frame_plane_layout(RESOLVED_FRAME_SIZE, 8, Media::Subsampling::yuv444())).total_byte_count).release_value();
    Media::ColorMetadata color_metadata;
    color_metadata.cicp.set_matrix_coefficients(Media::MatrixCoefficients::Identity);
    auto make_frame = [&](Media::Subsampling subsampling) {
        return make_ref_counted<Media::VideoFrame>(AK::Duration::zero(), AK::Duration::zero(), RESOLVED_FRAME_SIZE.to_type<u32>(), 8, subsampling, color_metadata, slot.storage);
    };
    EXPECT_EQ(make_frame(Media::Subsampling::yuv444())->cicp().matrix_coefficients(), Media::MatrixCoefficients::Identity);
    EXPECT_EQ(make_frame(Media::Subsampling::yuv420())->cicp().matrix_coefficients(), Media::MatrixCoefficients::Unspecified);
    EXPECT_EQ(make_frame(Media::Subsampling::yuv422())->cicp().matrix_coefficients(), Media::MatrixCoefficients::Unspecified);
}

TEST_CASE(metadata_that_could_not_have_been_decoded_is_refused_over_ipc)
{
    auto metadata = make_metadata();
    metadata.bit_depth = 13;

    IPC::MessageBuffer message;
    IPC::Encoder encoder { message };
    MUST(encoder.encode(metadata));
    Queue<IPC::Attachment> attachments;
    FixedMemoryStream stream { message.data().span() };
    IPC::Decoder decoder { stream, attachments };
    EXPECT(decoder.decode<Media::VideoFrameMetadata>().is_error());
}

#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS) || defined(AK_OS_LINUX)

// Stands in for what a decoder gives with a surface to keep its pixels in place, counting how many are alive.
class TestSurfaceContents final : public Media::VideoSurfaceContents {
public:
    explicit TestSurfaceContents(Atomic<u32>& live_count)
        : m_live_count(live_count)
    {
        m_live_count++;
    }
    virtual ~TestSurfaceContents() override { m_live_count--; }

private:
    Atomic<u32>& m_live_count;
};

static NonnullRefPtr<Media::VideoSurface> make_surface()
{
#    ifdef AK_OS_MACOS
    return MUST(Media::VideoSurface::create(Core::IOSurfaceHandle::create(16, 16)));
#    else
    Gfx::LinuxDmaBufHandle dma_buf;
    dma_buf.size = { 16, 16 };
    return MUST(Media::VideoSurface::create_from_dma_buf(get_random<u64>(), move(dma_buf)));
#    endif
}

static NonnullRefPtr<Media::VideoSurfaceContents> make_contents(Atomic<u32>& live_count)
{
    return make_ref_counted<TestSurfaceContents>(live_count);
}

static NonnullRefPtr<Media::VideoSurfaceContents> make_contents()
{
    static Atomic<u32> s_unwatched_live_count { 0 };
    return make_contents(s_unwatched_live_count);
}

TEST_CASE(distinct_surfaces_have_distinct_ids)
{
    auto first_surface = make_surface();
    auto second_surface = make_surface();
    EXPECT_NE(first_surface->id(), second_surface->id());
}

// The decoder recycles surfaces it is no longer kept from using, and may free them after a while, so the budget lets
// go of a surface and its contents along with the last frame holding them.
TEST_CASE(surface_budget_lets_go_of_a_surface_with_its_last_hold)
{
    Atomic<u32> live_contents { 0 };
    auto budget = make_ref_counted<Media::VideoSurfaceBudget>();
    auto surface = make_surface();

    auto storage = budget->try_hold(surface, make_contents(live_contents));
    EXPECT_NE(storage, nullptr);
    EXPECT_EQ(storage->surface()->id(), surface->id());
    EXPECT_EQ(live_contents.load(), 1u);

    auto second_reference = storage;
    storage = nullptr;
    EXPECT_EQ(live_contents.load(), 1u);

    second_reference = nullptr;
    EXPECT_EQ(live_contents.load(), 0u);
    EXPECT_EQ(surface->ref_count(), 1u);
}

TEST_CASE(surface_budget_refuses_to_exceed_its_held_surface_count)
{
    auto budget = make_ref_counted<Media::VideoSurfaceBudget>();

    // The platform allocator hands out surfaces without limit, so the budget is what stops a decoder from running
    // arbitrarily far ahead of whoever is displaying its frames.
    Vector<NonnullRefPtr<Media::VideoFrameStorage>> held;
    for (u32 index = 0; index < Media::VideoSurfaceBudget::MAX_HELD_SURFACE_COUNT; index++)
        held.append(budget->try_hold(make_surface(), make_contents()).release_nonnull());

    auto surface_too_many = make_surface();
    EXPECT_EQ(budget->try_hold(surface_too_many, make_contents()), nullptr);
    // A held surface handed back again counts as another frame in flight.
    EXPECT_EQ(budget->try_hold(held.first()->surface().release_nonnull(), make_contents()), nullptr);

    held.remove(0);
    EXPECT_NE(budget->try_hold(surface_too_many, make_contents()), nullptr);
}

#    ifdef AK_OS_MACOS
TEST_CASE(surfaces_survive_a_mach_port_round_trip)
{
    auto surface = make_surface();

    auto reimported = MUST(Core::IOSurfaceHandle::from_mach_port(surface->create_mach_port()));
    EXPECT_EQ(static_cast<u64>(reimported.id()), surface->id());
    EXPECT_EQ(reimported.width(), 16u);
    EXPECT_EQ(reimported.height(), 16u);
}
#    endif

TEST_CASE(received_surface_frames_read_their_surface)
{
    auto surface = make_surface();
    auto metadata = make_metadata();
    metadata.size = { 16, 16 };

    auto frame = MUST(Media::create_received_video_frame(metadata, surface, 0, [] { }));
    EXPECT_EQ(frame->surface()->id(), surface->id());
    // The planes of a surface-backed frame are in the surface, so no view into a buffer is offered.

    auto larger_than_the_surface = metadata;
    larger_than_the_surface.size = { 32, 16 };
    EXPECT(Media::create_received_video_frame(larger_than_the_surface, surface, 0, [] { }).is_error());
}

TEST_CASE(surface_budget_reports_each_released_surface)
{
    auto freed_count = 0u;
    auto budget = make_ref_counted<Media::VideoSurfaceBudget>();
    budget->set_storage_freed_callback([&] { freed_count++; });
    auto storage = budget->try_hold(make_surface(), make_contents());

    auto second_reference = storage;
    storage = nullptr;
    EXPECT_EQ(freed_count, 0u);

    second_reference = nullptr;
    EXPECT_EQ(freed_count, 1u);
}

#include <AK/HashTable.h>
#include <LibMedia/DemuxerRegistry.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/CodecParameters.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/Codecs/AV1.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/Codecs/H264.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/VideoFrame.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/VideoFramePool.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/VideoSurface.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/VideoToolbox/VideoToolboxVideoDecoder.h>

#include "TestMediaCommon.h"

namespace {

struct Decoding {
    NonnullOwnPtr<Media::VideoToolbox::VideoToolboxVideoDecoder> decoder;
    NonnullRefPtr<Media::Demuxer> demuxer;
    Media::Track track;

    Media::DecoderErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<Media::VideoFrame>> next_frame() const
    {
        while (true) {
            auto frame_result = decoder->take_next_output(track.video_data().color_metadata);
            if (!frame_result.is_error() || frame_result.error().category() != Media::DecoderErrorCategory::NeedsMoreInput)
                return frame_result;

            auto sample_result = demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track);
            if (sample_result.is_error()) {
                decoder->signal_end_of_stream();
                continue;
            }
            TRY(decoder->receive_coded_data(sample_result.release_value(), Media::DecodeIntent::Output));
        }
    }
};

Decoding open_decoding(StringView path, Media::CodecID codec_id)
{
    auto file = MUST(Core::File::open(path, Core::File::OpenMode::Read));
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_from_buffer(MUST(file->read_until_eof()));
    auto demuxer = MUST(Media::create_demuxer(stream));
    auto track = MUST(demuxer->get_preferred_track_for_type(Media::TrackType::Video));
    VERIFY(track.has_value());
    MUST(demuxer->create_context_for_track(*track));

    auto decoder = MUST(Media::VideoToolbox::VideoToolboxVideoDecoder::try_create(codec_id, {}));
    return Decoding { move(decoder), move(demuxer), track.release_value() };
}

// A Mac without a decoder for this codec has nothing to test.
bool decoding_is_unavailable(Media::DecoderError const& error)
{
    return error.category() == Media::DecoderErrorCategory::NotImplemented;
}

}

TEST_CASE(decodes_vp9_onto_surfaces)
{
    auto decoding = open_decoding("./vp9_in_webm.webm"sv, Media::CodecID::VP9);

    auto last_timestamp = AK::Duration::min();
    size_t frame_count = 0;

    while (true) {
        auto frame_result = decoding.next_frame();
        if (frame_result.is_error()) {
            if (decoding_is_unavailable(frame_result.error()))
                return;
            EXPECT_EQ(frame_result.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream);
            break;
        }
        auto frame = frame_result.release_value();

        EXPECT_NE(frame->surface(), nullptr);
        // The pixels live on the surface, so there are no planes in the slot's buffer to view.
        EXPECT(!frame->yuv_data().has_value());
        EXPECT_EQ(frame->size(), Gfx::Size<u32>(854, 480));
        EXPECT(last_timestamp <= frame->timestamp());
        last_timestamp = frame->timestamp();
        frame_count++;
    }

    EXPECT_EQ(frame_count, 25u);
}

TEST_CASE(a_format_change_mid_stream_rebuilds_the_session)
{
    // A stream that changes format has to tear the session down, or its later frames are decoded against a
    // description that no longer matches them.
    auto decoding = open_decoding("./vp9_resize.webm"sv, Media::CodecID::VP9);

    Vector<Gfx::Size<u32>> sizes;
    while (true) {
        auto frame_result = decoding.next_frame();
        if (frame_result.is_error()) {
            if (decoding_is_unavailable(frame_result.error()))
                return;
            EXPECT_EQ(frame_result.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream);
            break;
        }
        auto size = frame_result.release_value()->size();
        if (sizes.is_empty() || sizes.last() != size)
            sizes.append(size);
    }

    EXPECT_EQ(sizes.size(), 2u);
    if (sizes.size() == 2) {
        EXPECT_EQ(sizes[0], Gfx::Size<u32>(320, 240));
        EXPECT_EQ(sizes[1], Gfx::Size<u32>(640, 480));
    }
}

TEST_CASE(surfaces_are_not_reused_while_their_frames_are_held)
{
    auto decoding = open_decoding("./vp9_in_webm.webm"sv, Media::CodecID::VP9);

    // The media engine recycles surfaces as soon as they fall out of use, and holding a frame is what has to keep
    // one in use. Were that claim missing, these frames would be a handful of surfaces overwriting one another.
    Vector<NonnullRefPtr<Media::VideoFrame>> held_frames;
    HashTable<u32> held_surface_ids;
    while (held_frames.size() < Media::VideoSurfaceBudget::MAX_HELD_SURFACE_COUNT) {
        auto frame_result = decoding.next_frame();
        if (frame_result.is_error() && decoding_is_unavailable(frame_result.error()))
            return;
        auto frame = TRY_OR_FAIL(move(frame_result));
        auto surface = frame->surface();
        EXPECT_NE(surface, nullptr);
        EXPECT(!held_surface_ids.contains(surface->id()));
        held_surface_ids.set(surface->id());
        held_frames.append(move(frame));
    }
}

TEST_CASE(storage_runs_out_while_every_frame_is_held)
{
    auto decoding = open_decoding("./vp9_in_webm.webm"sv, Media::CodecID::VP9);

    Vector<NonnullRefPtr<Media::VideoFrame>> held_frames;
    while (held_frames.size() < Media::VideoSurfaceBudget::MAX_HELD_SURFACE_COUNT) {
        auto frame_result = decoding.next_frame();
        if (frame_result.is_error() && decoding_is_unavailable(frame_result.error()))
            return;
        held_frames.append(TRY_OR_FAIL(move(frame_result)));
    }

    auto exhausted_result = decoding.next_frame();
    EXPECT(exhausted_result.is_error());
    EXPECT_EQ(exhausted_result.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::TryAgain);

    // Letting the first frame go makes room for another.
    held_frames.remove(0);
    EXPECT(!decoding.next_frame().is_error());
}

TEST_CASE(only_the_profiles_the_hardware_covers_are_claimed)
{
    auto vp9_codec = [](u8 profile, u8 bit_depth, Media::Subsampling subsampling) {
        return Media::ParsedCodec { Media::Codecs::VP9::Parameters {
            .profile = profile,
            .level = 10,
            .bit_depth = bit_depth,
            .color_parameters = { .subsampling = subsampling, .cicp = {} },
        } };
    };

    using Decoder = Media::VideoToolbox::VideoToolboxVideoDecoder;

    // Without a hardware decoder at all there is nothing to distinguish, so this says nothing either way.
    if (!Decoder::capabilities(Media::ParsedCodec { Media::CodecID::VP9 }).has_value()) {
        warnln("No hardware VP9 decoder available, skipping");
        return;
    }

    EXPECT(Decoder::capabilities(vp9_codec(0, 8, Media::Subsampling::yuv420())).has_value());
    EXPECT(Decoder::capabilities(vp9_codec(2, 10, Media::Subsampling::yuv420())).has_value());

    // 4:2:2 and 4:4:4 have no hardware behind them, and no Apple decoder reaches 12 bits.
    EXPECT(!Decoder::capabilities(vp9_codec(1, 8, Media::Subsampling::yuv422())).has_value());
    EXPECT(!Decoder::capabilities(vp9_codec(3, 10, Media::Subsampling::yuv444())).has_value());
    EXPECT(!Decoder::capabilities(vp9_codec(2, 12, Media::Subsampling::yuv420())).has_value());
}

TEST_CASE(a_codec_string_without_a_profile_is_answered_for_main)
{
    using Decoder = Media::VideoToolbox::VideoToolboxVideoDecoder;

    auto h264_main = Media::parse_codec_parameters_string("avc1.4D401E"sv);
    auto h265_main = Media::parse_codec_parameters_string("hvc1.1.6.L93.B0"sv);
    EXPECT(h264_main.has_value());
    EXPECT(h265_main.has_value());

    EXPECT_EQ(Decoder::capabilities(Media::ParsedCodec { Media::CodecID::H264 }).has_value(), Decoder::capabilities(*h264_main).has_value());
    EXPECT_EQ(Decoder::capabilities(Media::ParsedCodec { Media::CodecID::H265 }).has_value(), Decoder::capabilities(*h265_main).has_value());
}

TEST_CASE(what_the_hardware_decodes_is_claimed_power_efficient)
{
    auto capabilities = Media::VideoToolbox::VideoToolboxVideoDecoder::capabilities(Media::ParsedCodec { Media::CodecID::VP9 });
    if (!capabilities.has_value()) {
        warnln("No hardware VP9 decoder available, skipping");
        return;
    }

    // Hardware is the only thing this decoder is ever chosen for, so anything it claims it claims as power efficient.
    EXPECT(capabilities->power_efficient);
}

TEST_CASE(decodes_av1_onto_surfaces)
{
    auto decoding = open_decoding("./av1_in_webm.webm"sv, Media::CodecID::AV1);

    auto last_timestamp = AK::Duration::min();
    size_t frame_count = 0;

    while (true) {
        auto frame_result = decoding.next_frame();
        if (frame_result.is_error()) {
            if (decoding_is_unavailable(frame_result.error()))
                return;
            EXPECT_EQ(frame_result.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream);
            break;
        }
        auto frame = frame_result.release_value();

        EXPECT_NE(frame->surface(), nullptr);
        EXPECT_EQ(frame->size(), Gfx::Size<u32>(854, 480));
        EXPECT(last_timestamp <= frame->timestamp());
        last_timestamp = frame->timestamp();
        frame_count++;
    }

    EXPECT_EQ(frame_count, 25u);
}

TEST_CASE(only_the_av1_profiles_the_hardware_covers_are_claimed)
{
    auto av1_codec = [](u8 profile, u8 bit_depth, Media::Subsampling subsampling) {
        return Media::ParsedCodec { Media::Codecs::AV1::Parameters {
            .profile = profile,
            .level = 8,
            .tier = Media::Codecs::AV1::Tier::Main,
            .bit_depth = bit_depth,
            .optional_fields = { .monochrome = false, .subsampling = subsampling, .chroma_sample_position = 0, .cicp = {} },
        } };
    };

    using Decoder = Media::VideoToolbox::VideoToolboxVideoDecoder;

    if (!Decoder::capabilities(av1_codec(0, 8, Media::Subsampling::yuv420())).has_value()) {
        warnln("No hardware AV1 decoder available, skipping");
        return;
    }

    EXPECT(Decoder::capabilities(av1_codec(2, 10, Media::Subsampling::yuv420())).has_value());

    // Only the profile that subsamples both axes has hardware behind it.
    EXPECT(!Decoder::capabilities(av1_codec(1, 8, Media::Subsampling { false, false })).has_value());
}

// Taking output as it becomes available, the way playback does, is the only shape that can catch a frame handed

            if (decoding_is_unavailable(frame_result.error()))
                return;
            EXPECT_EQ(frame_result.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream);
            break;
        }
        auto frame = frame_result.release_value();

        EXPECT_NE(frame->surface(), nullptr);
        EXPECT_EQ(frame->size(), Gfx::Size<u32>(854, 480));
        EXPECT(last_timestamp <= frame->timestamp());
        last_timestamp = frame->timestamp();
        frame_count++;
    }

    EXPECT_EQ(frame_count, 50u);
}

// This clip's second key frame is a CRA picture whose three RASL pictures follow it in decoding order and
// precede it in display order.
TEST_CASE(open_gop_leading_pictures_are_kept_while_decoding_runs_through_them)
{
    auto decoding = open_decoding("./hevc_open_gop.mp4"sv, Media::CodecID::H265);

    auto last_timestamp = AK::Duration::min();
    size_t frame_count = 0;
    while (true) {
        auto frame_result = decoding.next_frame();
        if (frame_result.is_error()) {
            if (decoding_is_unavailable(frame_result.error()))
                return;
            EXPECT_EQ(frame_result.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream);
            break;
        }
        auto frame = frame_result.release_value();
        EXPECT_EQ(frame->size(), Gfx::Size<u32>(128, 128));
        EXPECT(last_timestamp <= frame->timestamp());
        last_timestamp = frame->timestamp();
        frame_count++;
    }

    // Decoding never restarted, so the pictures the leading pictures reference were all decoded.
    EXPECT_EQ(frame_count, 24u);
}

TEST_CASE(decoding_restarted_at_an_open_gop_drops_its_leading_pictures)
{
    auto decoding = open_decoding("./hevc_open_gop.mp4"sv, Media::CodecID::H265);

    auto first_frame = decoding.next_frame();
    if (first_frame.is_error() && decoding_is_unavailable(first_frame.error())) {
        warnln("No H.265 decoder available, skipping");
        return;
    }
    (void)TRY_OR_FAIL(move(first_frame));

    // A seek leaves the decoder without the pictures that precede the random access point it resumes at.
    auto seek_target = AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1000);
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(decoding.demuxer->seek_to_most_recent_keyframe(decoding.track, seek_target)), Media::DemuxerSeekResult::MovedPosition);
    decoding.decoder->flush();

    auto last_timestamp = AK::Duration::min();
    size_t frame_count = 0;
    while (true) {
        auto frame_result = decoding.next_frame();
        if (frame_result.is_error()) {
            EXPECT_EQ(frame_result.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream);
            break;
        }
        auto frame = frame_result.release_value();
        // The leading pictures display before the random access point, so none of them can reach the output.
        EXPECT(seek_target <= frame->timestamp());
        EXPECT(last_timestamp <= frame->timestamp());
        last_timestamp = frame->timestamp();
        frame_count++;
    }

    // The random access point and the eleven trailing pictures after it, without its three leading pictures.
    EXPECT_EQ(frame_count, 12u);
}

TEST_CASE(h264_parameter_sets_can_arrive_separately_and_outlive_their_frames)
{
    for (bool sequence_in_band : { false, true }) {
        auto decoding = open_decoding("./avc.mp4"sv, Media::CodecID::H264);
        auto sample = MUST(decoding.demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(decoding.track));
        auto configuration = sample.new_codec_configuration();
        VERIFY(configuration.has_value());
        auto sets = Media::Codecs::H264::parse_parameter_sets_from_configuration_record(*configuration);
        VERIFY(sets.has_value());
        VERIFY(sets->nal_unit_length_size == 4);

        auto const& initial_sequence = sets->sequence;
        auto const& initial_picture = sets->picture;
        ByteBuffer initial_configuration = MUST(ByteBuffer::copy(configuration->trim(5)));
        MUST(initial_configuration.try_append(static_cast<u8>(0xe0 | (sequence_in_band ? 0 : initial_sequence.size()))));
        auto append_sets = [](ByteBuffer& output, auto const& parameter_sets) {
            for (auto nal_unit : parameter_sets) {
                MUST(output.try_append(static_cast<u8>(nal_unit.size() >> 8)));
                MUST(output.try_append(static_cast<u8>(nal_unit.size())));
                MUST(output.try_append(nal_unit));
            }
        };
        if (!sequence_in_band)
            append_sets(initial_configuration, initial_sequence);
        MUST(initial_configuration.try_append(static_cast<u8>(sequence_in_band ? initial_picture.size() : 0)));
        if (sequence_in_band)
            append_sets(initial_configuration, initial_picture);
        decoding.decoder = MUST(Media::VideoToolbox::VideoToolboxVideoDecoder::try_create(Media::CodecID::H264, initial_configuration));

        {
            ByteBuffer data;
            auto const& in_band_sets = sequence_in_band ? initial_sequence : initial_picture;
            for (auto nal_unit : in_band_sets) {
                for (int shift = 24; shift >= 0; shift -= 8)
                    MUST(data.try_append(static_cast<u8>(nal_unit.size() >> shift)));
                MUST(data.try_append(nal_unit));
            }
            MUST(data.try_append(sample.data()));
            Media::CodedFrame frame { sample.codec_id(), sample.presentation_timestamp(), sample.decode_timestamp(), sample.duration(), sample.flags(), MUST(FixedArray<u8>::create(data.bytes())) };
            auto result = decoding.decoder->receive_coded_data(frame, Media::DecodeIntent::Output);
            if (result.is_error() && decoding_is_unavailable(result.error())) {
                warnln("No H.264 decoder available, skipping");
                return;
            }
            EXPECT(!result.is_error());
            if (result.is_error())
                return;
        }

        // The in-band frame's storage is gone; subsequent frames have no parameter-set updates.
        size_t frame_count = 0;
        auto last_timestamp = AK::Duration::min();
        while (true) {
            auto result = decoding.next_frame();
            if (result.is_error()) {
                EXPECT_EQ(result.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream);
                break;
            }
            auto frame = result.release_value();
            EXPECT(last_timestamp <= frame->timestamp());
            last_timestamp = frame->timestamp();
            ++frame_count;
        }
        EXPECT_EQ(frame_count, 50u);
    }
}

TEST_CASE(input_after_the_end_of_stream_is_rejected_until_flushed)
{
    auto decoding = open_decoding("./vp9_in_webm.webm"sv, Media::CodecID::VP9);
    auto first_frame = MUST(decoding.demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(decoding.track));
    auto second_frame = MUST(decoding.demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(decoding.track));

    auto first_result = decoding.decoder->receive_coded_data(first_frame, Media::DecodeIntent::Output);
    if (first_result.is_error() && decoding_is_unavailable(first_result.error()))
        return;
    EXPECT(!first_result.is_error());
    decoding.decoder->signal_end_of_stream();

    auto result = decoding.decoder->receive_coded_data(second_frame, Media::DecodeIntent::Output);
    EXPECT(result.is_error());
    EXPECT_EQ(result.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream);

    decoding.decoder->flush();
    EXPECT(!decoding.decoder->receive_coded_data(first_frame, Media::DecodeIntent::Output).is_error());
}

// The file's mastering display and content light levels are only in its SEI, not in its sample entry.
TEST_CASE(h265_frames_carry_the_high_dynamic_range_metadata_in_their_bitstream)
{
    auto decoding = open_decoding("./hevc_hdr_metadata_in_sei.mp4"sv, Media::CodecID::H265);
    EXPECT(!decoding.track.video_data().color_metadata.mastering_display_color_volume.has_value());

    size_t frame_count = 0;
    while (true) {
        auto frame_result = decoding.next_frame();
        if (frame_result.is_error()) {
            if (decoding_is_unavailable(frame_result.error()))
                return;
            EXPECT_EQ(frame_result.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream);
            break;
        }
        auto const& color_metadata = frame_result.value()->color_metadata();
        EXPECT(color_metadata.mastering_display_color_volume.has_value());
        if (color_metadata.mastering_display_color_volume.has_value()) {
            EXPECT_APPROXIMATE(color_metadata.mastering_display_color_volume->maximum_luminance, 1000.0);
            EXPECT_APPROXIMATE(color_metadata.mastering_display_color_volume->red.x, 0.68);
        }
        EXPECT(color_metadata.content_light_level_information.has_value());
        if (color_metadata.content_light_level_information.has_value()) {
            EXPECT_EQ(color_metadata.content_light_level_information->maximum_content_light_level, 1000);
            EXPECT_EQ(color_metadata.content_light_level_information->maximum_frame_average_light_level, 400);
        }
        frame_count++;
    }
    EXPECT_EQ(frame_count, 6u);
}

// The file's mastering display and content light levels are only in metadata OBUs, not in its Matroska Colour element.
TEST_CASE(av1_frames_carry_the_high_dynamic_range_metadata_in_their_bitstream)
{
    auto decoding = open_decoding("./av1_hdr_metadata_in_webm.webm"sv, Media::CodecID::AV1);
    auto frame_result = decoding.next_frame();
    if (frame_result.is_error() && decoding_is_unavailable(frame_result.error()))
        return;
    auto frame = MUST(move(frame_result));
    auto const& color_metadata = frame->color_metadata();

    EXPECT(color_metadata.content_light_level_information.has_value());
    if (color_metadata.content_light_level_information.has_value()) {
        EXPECT_EQ(color_metadata.content_light_level_information->maximum_content_light_level, 1005);
        EXPECT_EQ(color_metadata.content_light_level_information->maximum_frame_average_light_level, 315);
    }
    EXPECT(color_metadata.mastering_display_color_volume.has_value());
    if (color_metadata.mastering_display_color_volume.has_value()) {
        EXPECT_APPROXIMATE(color_metadata.mastering_display_color_volume->maximum_luminance, 1000.0);
        EXPECT_APPROXIMATE_WITH_ERROR(color_metadata.mastering_display_color_volume->red.x, 0.708, 1.0 / (1 << 16));
    }
}

TEST_CASE(input_after_the_end_of_stream_is_rejected_until_flushed)
{
    auto file = MUST(Core::File::open("vorbis/44_1Khz_stereo.ogg"sv, Core::File::OpenMode::Read));
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_from_buffer(MUST(file->read_until_eof()));
    auto demuxer = MUST(Media::create_demuxer(stream));
    auto tracks = MUST(demuxer->get_tracks_for_type(Media::TrackType::Audio));
    VERIFY(!tracks.is_empty());
    auto const& track = tracks[0];
    MUST(demuxer->create_context_for_track(track));

    auto first_frame = MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track));
    auto second_frame = MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track));
    auto decoder = MUST(Media::FFmpeg::FFmpegAudioDecoder::try_create(first_frame.codec_id(), track.audio_data().sample_specification, *first_frame.new_codec_configuration()));

    MUST(decoder->receive_coded_data(first_frame));
    decoder->signal_end_of_stream();

    auto result = decoder->receive_coded_data(second_frame);
    EXPECT(result.is_error());
    EXPECT_EQ(result.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream);

    decoder->flush();
    MUST(decoder->receive_coded_data(first_frame));
}

{

TEST_CASE(input_after_the_end_of_stream_is_rejected_until_flushed)
{
    auto file = MUST(Core::File::open("./vp9_in_webm.webm"sv, Core::File::OpenMode::Read));
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_from_buffer(MUST(file->read_until_eof()));
    auto demuxer = MUST(Media::create_demuxer(stream));
    auto track = MUST(demuxer->get_preferred_track_for_type(Media::TrackType::Video));
    VERIFY(track.has_value());
    MUST(demuxer->create_context_for_track(*track));

    auto first_frame = MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(*track));
    auto second_frame = MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(*track));
    auto decoder = MUST(Media::FFmpeg::FFmpegVideoDecoder::try_create(first_frame.codec_id(), *first_frame.new_codec_configuration()));

    MUST(decoder->receive_coded_data(first_frame, Media::DecodeIntent::Output));
    decoder->signal_end_of_stream();

    auto result = decoder->receive_coded_data(second_frame, Media::DecodeIntent::Output);
    EXPECT(result.is_error());
    EXPECT_EQ(result.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream);

    decoder->flush();
    MUST(decoder->receive_coded_data(first_frame, Media::DecodeIntent::Output));
}

// The file was encoded from hevc_hdr10_plus_in_sei.mkv, so its frames carry the same HDR10+, in BlockAdditions.
TEST_CASE(frames_carry_their_own_hdr10_plus_scene_peaks_from_block_additions)
{
    ScenePeakChecker scene_peaks { hevc_hdr10_plus_in_sei_scene_peaks };
    auto file = MUST(Core::File::open("./vp9_hdr10_plus_in_block_additions.webm"sv, Core::File::OpenMode::Read));
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_from_buffer(MUST(file->read_until_eof()));
    auto demuxer = MUST(Media::create_demuxer(stream));
    auto track = MUST(demuxer->get_preferred_track_for_type(Media::TrackType::Video));
    VERIFY(track.has_value());
    MUST(demuxer->create_context_for_track(*track));

    auto first_frame = MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(*track));
    auto decoder = MUST(Media::FFmpeg::FFmpegVideoDecoder::try_create(first_frame.codec_id(), *first_frame.new_codec_configuration()));
    MUST(decoder->receive_coded_data(first_frame, Media::DecodeIntent::Output));

    size_t frame_count = 0;
    while (true) {
        auto frame_result = decoder->take_next_output(track->video_data().color_metadata);
        if (!frame_result.is_error()) {
            auto const& frame = *frame_result.value();
            scene_peaks.check(frame.timestamp(), frame.color_metadata().maximum_scene_luminance);
            frame_count++;
            continue;
        }
        if (frame_result.error().category() == Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream)
            break;
        if (frame_result.error().category() != Media::DecoderErrorCategory::NeedsMoreInput) {
            FAIL(ByteString::formatted("Decoding failed: {}", frame_result.error().description()));
            return;
        }

        auto sample_result = demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(*track);
        if (!sample_result.is_error()) {
            MUST(decoder->receive_coded_data(sample_result.value(), Media::DecodeIntent::Output));
            continue;
        }
        if (sample_result.error().category() != Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream) {
            FAIL(ByteString::formatted("Demuxing failed: {}", sample_result.error().description()));
            return;
        }
        decoder->signal_end_of_stream();
    }
    EXPECT_EQ(frame_count, hevc_hdr10_plus_in_sei_scene_peaks.size());
    scene_peaks.expect_every_frame_checked();
}

TEST_CASE(decoding_an_entire_stream_refuses_audio_past_the_size_limit)
{
    auto file = MUST(Core::File::open("WAV/tone_8000_mono.wav"sv, Core::File::OpenMode::Read));
    auto data = MUST(file->read_until_eof());
    auto decode_with_limit = [&](size_t maximum_decoded_byte_count) {
        return Media::decode_entire_audio_stream(Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_from_buffer(data), {}, maximum_decoded_byte_count);
    };

    static constexpr size_t decoded_byte_count = 40000 * sizeof(float);
    auto decoded = decode_with_limit(decoded_byte_count);
    EXPECT(!decoded.is_error());
    EXPECT_EQ(decoded.value().channels.first().size(), 40000u);

    auto refused = decode_with_limit(decoded_byte_count - sizeof(float));
    EXPECT_EQ(refused.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::Memory);
}

#include <AK/Atomic.h>
#include <AK/Endian.h>
#include <AK/MemoryStream.h>
#include <LibCore/File.h>
#include <LibMedia/Containers/WAV/WAVDemuxer.h>
#include <LibMedia/IncrementallyPopulatedStream.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/CodedFrame.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/Limits.h>
#include <LibTest/TestCase.h>
#include <LibThreading/Thread.h>

namespace {

struct WaveLayout {
    u16 format_tag { 1 };
    u16 channel_count { 2 };
    u32 sample_rate { 48000 };
    u16 bits_per_sample { 16 };
    // Writes the extensible form of the header.
    Optional<u32> speaker_position_mask {};
    u32 sample_data_size { 48000 * 4 };
    Optional<u32> declared_sample_data_size {};
    // An odd size checks that chunks are padded to even sizes.
    u32 list_chunk_size { 0 };
};

ByteBuffer make_wave(WaveLayout const& layout)
{
    static constexpr Array<u8, 14> media_subtype_guid_tail { 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x10, 0x00, 0x80, 0x00, 0x00, 0xAA, 0x00, 0x38, 0x9B, 0x71 };
    auto padded = [](u32 size) { return size + (size & 1); };
    auto bytes_per_frame = static_cast<u16>(layout.channel_count * ((layout.bits_per_sample + 7) / 8));
    u32 format_chunk_size = layout.speaker_position_mask.has_value() ? 40 : 16;
    u32 list_chunk_total_size = layout.list_chunk_size > 0 ? 8 + padded(layout.list_chunk_size) : 0;

    AllocatingMemoryStream wave;
    auto write_chunk_header = [&](StringView type, u32 size) {
        MUST(wave.write_until_depleted(type.bytes()));
        MUST(wave.write_value<LittleEndian<u32>>(size));
    };
    write_chunk_header("RIFF"sv, 4 + 8 + format_chunk_size + list_chunk_total_size + 8 + layout.sample_data_size);
    MUST(wave.write_until_depleted("WAVE"sv.bytes()));

    write_chunk_header("fmt "sv, format_chunk_size);
    MUST(wave.write_value<LittleEndian<u16>>(layout.speaker_position_mask.has_value() ? 0xFFFE : layout.format_tag));
    MUST(wave.write_value<LittleEndian<u16>>(layout.channel_count));
    MUST(wave.write_value<LittleEndian<u32>>(layout.sample_rate));
    MUST(wave.write_value<LittleEndian<u32>>(layout.sample_rate * bytes_per_frame));
    MUST(wave.write_value<LittleEndian<u16>>(bytes_per_frame));
    MUST(wave.write_value<LittleEndian<u16>>(layout.bits_per_sample));
    if (layout.speaker_position_mask.has_value()) {
        MUST(wave.write_value<LittleEndian<u16>>(22));
        MUST(wave.write_value<LittleEndian<u16>>(layout.bits_per_sample));
        MUST(wave.write_value<LittleEndian<u32>>(*layout.speaker_position_mask));
        MUST(wave.write_value<LittleEndian<u16>>(layout.format_tag));
        MUST(wave.write_until_depleted(media_subtype_guid_tail.span()));
    }

    auto silence = MUST(ByteBuffer::create_zeroed(max(layout.sample_data_size, list_chunk_total_size)));
    if (layout.list_chunk_size > 0) {
        write_chunk_header("LIST"sv, layout.list_chunk_size);
        MUST(wave.write_until_depleted(silence.bytes().trim(padded(layout.list_chunk_size))));
    }

    write_chunk_header("data"sv, layout.declared_sample_data_size.value_or(layout.sample_data_size));
    MUST(wave.write_until_depleted(silence.bytes().trim(layout.sample_data_size)));
    return MUST(wave.read_until_eof());
}

ByteBuffer read_fixture(StringView path)
{
    auto file = MUST(Core::File::open(path, Core::File::OpenMode::Read));
    return MUST(file->read_until_eof());
}

Media::DecoderErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<Media::Demuxer>> demuxer_for(ByteBuffer const& data)
{
    return Media::WAV::WAVDemuxer::from_stream(Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_from_buffer(data));
}

Media::Track audio_track(Media::Demuxer& demuxer)
{
    auto track = MUST(demuxer.get_preferred_track_for_type(Media::TrackType::Audio));
    VERIFY(track.has_value());
    MUST(demuxer.create_context_for_track(*track));
    return *track;
}

struct PacketIdentity {
    AK::Duration timestamp;
    size_t byte_count { 0 };
    bool operator==(PacketIdentity const&) const = default;
};

Vector<PacketIdentity> read_every_packet(Media::Demuxer& demuxer, Media::Track const& track)
{
    Vector<PacketIdentity> packets;
    while (true) {
        auto packet = demuxer.get_next_sample_for_track(track);
        if (packet.is_error()) {
            EXPECT_EQ(packet.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream);
            break;
        }
        packets.append({ packet.value().presentation_timestamp(), packet.value().data().size() });
    }
    return packets;
}

TEST_CASE(demuxer_describes_the_only_track_of_the_stream)
{
    auto demuxer = MUST(demuxer_for(read_fixture("buffered-ranges/tone.wav"sv)));

    EXPECT(MUST(demuxer->get_tracks_for_type(Media::TrackType::Video)).is_empty());

    auto tracks = MUST(demuxer->get_tracks_for_type(Media::TrackType::Audio));
    EXPECT_EQ(tracks.size(), 1u);
    EXPECT_EQ(tracks[0].audio_data().sample_specification.sample_rate(), 48000u);
    EXPECT_EQ(tracks[0].audio_data().sample_specification.channel_map(), Audio::ChannelMap::stereo());
    EXPECT_EQ(tracks[0].parsed_codec().codec_id(), Media::CodecID::S16LE);

    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(demuxer->total_duration()), AK::Duration::from_seconds(8));
}

TEST_CASE(demuxer_reads_every_sample_frame_with_exact_timestamps)
{
    auto demuxer = MUST(demuxer_for(read_fixture("buffered-ranges/tone.wav"sv)));
    auto track = audio_track(*demuxer);

    size_t packet_count = 0;
    i64 frame_count = 0;
    while (true) {
        auto packet = demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track);
        if (packet.is_error()) {
            EXPECT_EQ(packet.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream);
            break;
        }
        EXPECT_EQ(packet.value().presentation_timestamp(), AK::Duration::from_time_units(frame_count, 1, 48000));
        EXPECT_EQ(packet.value().data().size(), 4096u);
        EXPECT(packet.value().is_keyframe());
        EXPECT_EQ(packet.value().new_codec_configuration().has_value(), packet_count == 0);
        frame_count += static_cast<i64>(packet.value().data().size() / 4);
        packet_count++;
    }

    EXPECT_EQ(packet_count, 375u);
    EXPECT_EQ(frame_count, 384000);
}

TEST_CASE(demuxer_seeks_to_the_sample_frame_holding_a_timestamp)
{
    auto demuxer = MUST(demuxer_for(read_fixture("buffered-ranges/tone.wav"sv)));
    auto track = audio_track(*demuxer);

    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(demuxer->seek_to_most_recent_keyframe(track, AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(3'500))), Media::DemuxerSeekResult::MovedPosition);
    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track)).presentation_timestamp(), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(3'500));

    // A target between two sample frames lands on the earlier one.
    auto target = AK::Duration::from_microseconds(1'000'010);
    MUST(demuxer->seek_to_most_recent_keyframe(track, target));
    auto packet = MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track));
    EXPECT_EQ(packet.presentation_timestamp(), AK::Duration::from_seconds(1));
    EXPECT(packet.presentation_timestamp() + AK::Duration::from_time_units(1, 1, 48000) > target);

    MUST(demuxer->seek_to_most_recent_keyframe(track, AK::Duration::from_seconds(10)));
    EXPECT_EQ(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track).error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream);

    MUST(demuxer->seek_to_most_recent_keyframe(track, AK::Duration::zero(), Media::DemuxerSeekOptions::NeedCodecConfiguration));
    packet = MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track));
    EXPECT_EQ(packet.presentation_timestamp(), AK::Duration::zero());
    EXPECT(packet.new_codec_configuration().has_value());
}

// An aborted read is retried by the next call, which delivers the packet the aborted read was after, so a pass
// interrupted anywhere delivers the same packets as one that was not.
TEST_CASE(demuxer_resumes_an_aborted_read_with_the_packet_it_was_reading)
{
    auto file_data = read_fixture("buffered-ranges/tone.wav"sv);

    Vector<PacketIdentity> expected_packets;
    {
        auto demuxer = MUST(demuxer_for(file_data));
        auto track = audio_track(*demuxer);
        expected_packets = read_every_packet(*demuxer, track);
    }

    // The data ends inside a packet, so the read that blocks has part of its packet.
    auto initial_chunk_size = (file_data.size() / 3) + 1000;
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_empty();
    stream->set_expected_size(file_data.size());
    stream->add_chunk_at(0, file_data.bytes().trim(initial_chunk_size));

    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA auto demuxer = MUST(Media::WAV::WAVDemuxer::from_stream(stream));
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA auto track = audio_track(*demuxer);

    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<bool> read_blocked { false };
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Atomic<bool> read_was_aborted { false };
    demuxer->set_read_blocked_change_handler_for_track(track, [&](Media::ReadBlocked blocked) {
        read_blocked = blocked == Media::ReadBlocked::Yes;
    });

    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Vector<PacketIdentity> actual_packets;
    auto reader_thread = Threading::Thread::construct("TestReader"sv, [&]() -> intptr_t {
        while (true) {
            auto packet = demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track);
            if (packet.is_error()) {
                EXPECT_EQ(packet.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::Aborted);
                break;
            }
            actual_packets.append({ packet.value().presentation_timestamp(), packet.value().data().size() });
        }
        // Like a producer, the reading thread allows reads again before it reads on.
        demuxer->reset_blocking_reads_aborted_for_track(track);
        read_was_aborted = true;
        actual_packets.extend(read_every_packet(*demuxer, track));
        return 0;
    });
    reader_thread->start();

    while (!read_blocked.load()) { }
    demuxer->set_blocking_reads_aborted_for_track(track);
    while (!read_was_aborted.load()) { }

    stream->add_chunk_at(initial_chunk_size, file_data.bytes().slice(initial_chunk_size));
    stream->close();
    MUST(reader_thread->join());

    EXPECT_EQ(actual_packets.size(), expected_packets.size());
    for (size_t index = 0; index < min(actual_packets.size(), expected_packets.size()); index++) {
        if (actual_packets[index] != expected_packets[index]) {
            FAIL(ByteString::formatted("Packet {} differs after the abort: {}ms/{} bytes instead of {}ms/{} bytes", index, actual_packets[index].timestamp.to_milliseconds(), actual_packets[index].byte_count, expected_packets[index].timestamp.to_milliseconds(), expected_packets[index].byte_count));
            break;
        }
    }
}

Audio::ChannelMap channel_map_of(WaveLayout const& layout)
{
    auto demuxer = MUST(demuxer_for(make_wave(layout)));
    return MUST(demuxer->get_tracks_for_type(Media::TrackType::Audio))[0].audio_data().sample_specification.channel_map();
}

TEST_CASE(demuxer_reads_speaker_positions_from_an_extensible_header)
{
    using Audio::Channel;
    constexpr u32 front_left = 1 << 0;
    constexpr u32 front_right = 1 << 1;
    constexpr u32 side_left = 1 << 9;
    constexpr u32 side_right = 1 << 10;

    EXPECT_EQ(channel_map_of({ .channel_count = 4, .speaker_position_mask = front_left | front_right | side_left | side_right }), Audio::ChannelMap(Channel::FrontLeft, Channel::FrontRight, Channel::SideLeft, Channel::SideRight));
    EXPECT_EQ(channel_map_of({ .channel_count = 6, .speaker_position_mask = 0x3F }), Audio::ChannelMap::surround_5_1());

    // The bits past the last position the header defines name no speaker.
    constexpr u32 reserved_positions = (1 << 18) | (1 << 19);
    EXPECT_EQ(channel_map_of({ .channel_count = 2, .speaker_position_mask = reserved_positions }), Audio::ChannelMap::stereo());

    // Positions that do not account for every channel are ignored in favour of the usual layout for the count.
    EXPECT_EQ(channel_map_of({ .channel_count = 6, .speaker_position_mask = front_left | front_right }), Audio::ChannelMap::surround_5_1());
    EXPECT_EQ(channel_map_of({ .channel_count = 6 }), Audio::ChannelMap::surround_5_1());
    EXPECT_EQ(channel_map_of({ .channel_count = 1 }), Audio::ChannelMap::mono());

    auto unplaced = channel_map_of({ .channel_count = 3 });
    EXPECT_EQ(unplaced.channel_count(), 3);
    EXPECT_EQ(unplaced.channel_at(0), Channel::Unknown);
}

Media::CodecID codec_id_of(WaveLayout const& layout)
{
    auto demuxer = MUST(demuxer_for(make_wave(layout)));
    return MUST(demuxer->get_tracks_for_type(Media::TrackType::Audio))[0].parsed_codec().codec_id();
}

TEST_CASE(demuxer_identifies_every_sample_format_it_supports)
{
    EXPECT_EQ(codec_id_of({ .bits_per_sample = 8 }), Media::CodecID::U8);
    EXPECT_EQ(codec_id_of({ .bits_per_sample = 16 }), Media::CodecID::S16LE);
    EXPECT_EQ(codec_id_of({ .bits_per_sample = 24 }), Media::CodecID::S24LE);
    EXPECT_EQ(codec_id_of({ .bits_per_sample = 32 }), Media::CodecID::S32LE);
    EXPECT_EQ(codec_id_of({ .format_tag = 3, .bits_per_sample = 32 }), Media::CodecID::F32LE);
    EXPECT_EQ(codec_id_of({ .format_tag = 6, .bits_per_sample = 8 }), Media::CodecID::ALaw);
    EXPECT_EQ(codec_id_of({ .format_tag = 7, .bits_per_sample = 8 }), Media::CodecID::MuLaw);
    EXPECT_EQ(codec_id_of({ .format_tag = 3, .bits_per_sample = 32, .speaker_position_mask = 0x3 }), Media::CodecID::F32LE);
}

TEST_CASE(demuxer_declines_what_it_cannot_read)
{
    auto not_a_wave = demuxer_for(MUST(ByteBuffer::create_zeroed(4096)));
    EXPECT_EQ(not_a_wave.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::UnrecognizedFormat);

    auto adpcm = demuxer_for(make_wave({ .format_tag = 0x11, .bits_per_sample = 4 }));
    EXPECT_EQ(adpcm.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::NotImplemented);

    auto double_precision = demuxer_for(make_wave({ .format_tag = 3, .bits_per_sample = 64 }));
    EXPECT_EQ(double_precision.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::NotImplemented);

    auto header_without_data = make_wave({});
    header_without_data.resize(12 + 8 + 16);
    auto no_data_chunk = demuxer_for(header_without_data);
    EXPECT_EQ(no_data_chunk.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::Corrupted);
}

TEST_CASE(demuxer_refuses_sample_rates_outside_the_supported_range)
{
    EXPECT(!demuxer_for(make_wave({ .sample_rate = Media::MIN_AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE })).is_error());
    EXPECT(!demuxer_for(make_wave({ .sample_rate = Media::MAX_AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE })).is_error());

    auto too_slow = demuxer_for(make_wave({ .sample_rate = Media::MIN_AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE - 1 }));
    EXPECT_EQ(too_slow.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::NotImplemented);
    auto too_fast = demuxer_for(make_wave({ .sample_rate = Media::MAX_AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE + 1 }));
    EXPECT_EQ(too_fast.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::NotImplemented);
}

TEST_CASE(demuxer_reads_to_the_end_of_a_stream_whose_data_size_is_left_open)
{
    constexpr u32 frame_count = 2500;
    auto demuxer = MUST(demuxer_for(make_wave({ .sample_data_size = frame_count * 4, .declared_sample_data_size = NumericLimits<u32>::max(), .list_chunk_size = 7 })));
    auto track = audio_track(*demuxer);

    EXPECT_EQ(MUST(demuxer->total_duration()), AK::Duration::from_time_units(frame_count, 1, 48000));

    auto packets = read_every_packet(*demuxer, track);
    size_t byte_count = 0;
    for (auto const& packet : packets)
        byte_count += packet.byte_count;
    EXPECT_EQ(byte_count, frame_count * 4u);
    EXPECT_EQ(packets.last().timestamp, AK::Duration::from_time_units(frame_count - (packets.last().byte_count / 4), 1, 48000));
}

FILE: Tests/LibMedia/TestWebMByteStreamParser.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <LibCore/File.h>
#include <LibMedia/MediaSourceExtensions/WebMByteStreamParser.h>
#include <LibMedia/ReadonlyBytesCursor.h>

#include "TestMediaCommon.h"

static Vector<Media::CodedFrame> parse_every_coded_frame(StringView path)
{
    auto file = MUST(Core::File::open(path, Core::File::OpenMode::Read));
    auto data = MUST(file->read_until_eof());
    auto cursor = adopt_ref(*new Media::ReadonlyBytesCursor(data.bytes()));
    Media::MediaSourceExtensions::WebMByteStreamParser parser;

    Vector<Media::CodedFrame> coded_frames;
    while (true) {
        // The segment parser loop waits for more data where the bytes run out.
        if (auto skip_result = parser.skip_ignored_bytes(*cursor); skip_result.is_error()) {
            EXPECT_EQ(skip_result.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream);
            return coded_frames;
        }
        if (cursor->position() >= data.size())
            return coded_frames;

        auto segment_type = MUST(parser.sniff_segment_type(*cursor));
        if (segment_type == Media::MediaSourceExtensions::SegmentType::InitializationSegment) {
            MUST(parser.parse_initialization_segment(*cursor));
            continue;
        }
        VERIFY(segment_type == Media::MediaSourceExtensions::SegmentType::MediaSegment);
        while (true) {
            auto position = cursor->position();
            auto result = MUST(parser.parse_media_segment(*cursor));
            auto made_progress = !result.coded_frames.is_empty() || cursor->position() != position;
            for (auto& demuxed_coded_frame : result.coded_frames)
                coded_frames.append(move(demuxed_coded_frame.coded_frame));
            if (result.completed_segment)
                break;
            // All of the file is already given to the parser, so a cluster it cannot finish will never finish.
            if (!made_progress) {
                FAIL("The file ends inside a cluster");
                return coded_frames;
            }
        }
    }
}

// The file was encoded from hevc_hdr10_plus_in_sei.mkv, so its frames carry the same HDR10+, in BlockAdditions.
TEST_CASE(coded_frames_carry_the_hdr10_plus_scene_peaks_of_their_block_additions)
{
    ScenePeakChecker scene_peaks { hevc_hdr10_plus_in_sei_scene_peaks };
    auto coded_frames = parse_every_coded_frame("./vp9_hdr10_plus_in_block_additions.webm"sv);
    EXPECT_EQ(coded_frames.size(), hevc_hdr10_plus_in_sei_scene_peaks.size());
    for (auto const& coded_frame : coded_frames)
        scene_peaks.check(coded_frame.presentation_timestamp(), coded_frame.maximum_scene_luminance());
    scene_peaks.expect_every_frame_checked();
}

FILE: Tests/LibMedia/TestWindowsMediaFoundationAudioDecode.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibCore/File.h>
#include <LibMedia/Demuxer.h>
#include <LibMedia/DemuxerRegistry.h>
#include <LibMedia/IncrementallyPopulatedStream.h>
#include <LibMedia/Track.h>
#include <LibMedia/WindowsMediaFoundation/WindowsMediaFoundationAudioDecoder.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/AudioBlock.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/CodedFrame.h>
#include <LibTest/TestCase.h>

namespace {

// Matroska stores timestamps in milliseconds, so output timed from them can land up to one away from exact.
constexpr auto TIMESTAMP_TOLERANCE = AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(1);

struct CodedStream {
    Media::Track track;
    Vector<Media::CodedFrame> samples;
};

struct DecodedBlock {
    Audio::SampleSpecification sample_specification;
    AK::Duration start;
    AK::Duration end;
    size_t frame_count { 0 };
};

CodedStream read_coded_stream(StringView path)
{
    auto file = MUST(Core::File::open(path, Core::File::OpenMode::Read));
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_from_buffer(MUST(file->read_until_eof()));
    auto demuxer = MUST(Media::create_demuxer(stream));
    auto track = MUST(demuxer->get_preferred_track_for_type(Media::TrackType::Audio));
    VERIFY(track.has_value());
    MUST(demuxer->create_context_for_track(*track));

    Vector<Media::CodedFrame> samples;
    while (true) {
        auto sample = demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(*track);
        if (sample.is_error()) {
            VERIFY(sample.error().category() == Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream);
            break;
        }
        samples.append(sample.release_value());
    }
    return { track.release_value(), move(samples) };
}

NonnullOwnPtr<Media::WindowsMediaFoundation::WindowsMediaFoundationAudioDecoder> create_decoder(Media::Track const& track)
{
    return MUST(Media::WindowsMediaFoundation::WindowsMediaFoundationAudioDecoder::try_create(Media::CodecID::AAC, track.audio_data().sample_specification, {}));
}

// Returns the error category that stopped the decoder.
Media::DecoderErrorCategory write_available_blocks(Media::AudioDecoder& decoder, Vector<DecodedBlock>& blocks, Vector<Vector<float>>* channel_samples = nullptr)
{
    Media::AudioBlock block;
    while (true) {
        auto result = decoder.write_next_block(block);
        if (result.is_error())
            return result.error().category();

        blocks.append({ block.sample_specification(), block.media_time_start(), block.media_time_end(), block.frame_count() });
        if (channel_samples == nullptr)
            continue;
        channel_samples->resize(block.channel_count());
        for (u8 channel = 0; channel < block.channel_count(); channel++)
            channel_samples->at(channel).append(block.channel_data(channel).data(), block.frame_count());
    }
}

Vector<DecodedBlock> decode_entire_stream(Media::AudioDecoder& decoder, CodedStream const& stream, Vector<Vector<float>>* channel_samples = nullptr)
{
    Vector<DecodedBlock> blocks;
    for (auto const& sample : stream.samples) {
        MUST(decoder.receive_coded_data(sample));
        EXPECT_EQ(write_available_blocks(decoder, blocks, channel_samples), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::NeedsMoreInput);
    }
    decoder.signal_end_of_stream();
    EXPECT_EQ(write_available_blocks(decoder, blocks, channel_samples), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream);
    return blocks;
}

bool is_within_tolerance(AK::Duration actual, AK::Duration expected)
{
    return actual >= expected - TIMESTAMP_TOLERANCE && actual <= expected + TIMESTAMP_TOLERANCE;
}

void expect_contiguous_output(Vector<DecodedBlock> const& blocks, AK::Duration start)
{
    EXPECT(!blocks.is_empty());
    auto expected_start = start;
    for (auto const& block : blocks) {
        EXPECT(is_within_tolerance(block.start, expected_start));
        expected_start = block.end;
    }
}

// Each channel of the surround source is a tone of a different frequency.
Optional<u32> source_frequency_for_channel(Audio::Channel channel)
{
    switch (channel) {
    case Audio::Channel::FrontLeft:
        return 400;
    case Audio::Channel::FrontRight:
        return 800;
    case Audio::Channel::FrontCenter:
        return 200;
    case Audio::Channel::LowFrequency:
        return 100;
    case Audio::Channel::BackLeft:
        return 3200;
    case Audio::Channel::BackRight:
        return 6400;
    default:
        return {};
    }
}

size_t total_frame_count(Vector<DecodedBlock> const& blocks)
{
    size_t frame_count = 0;
    for (auto const& block : blocks)
        frame_count += block.frame_count;
    return frame_count;
}

}

TEST_CASE(decodes_aac_lc)
{
    auto stream = read_coded_stream("./aac_lc_in_matroska.mka"sv);
    auto decoder = create_decoder(stream.track);

    auto blocks = decode_entire_stream(*decoder, stream);

    for (auto const& block : blocks)
        EXPECT_EQ(block.sample_specification, Audio::SampleSpecification(48'000, Audio::ChannelMap::stereo()));
    expect_contiguous_output(blocks, stream.samples.first().presentation_timestamp());
    EXPECT_EQ(total_frame_count(blocks), stream.samples.size() * 1024);
}

TEST_CASE(discarded_output_is_dropped)
{
    auto stream = read_coded_stream("./aac_lc_in_matroska.mka"sv);
    auto baseline_decoder = create_decoder(stream.track);
    auto baseline_blocks = decode_entire_stream(*baseline_decoder, stream);

    // Trim the stream as appending it with an append window would: the presented span of the first and last frames
    // shrinks, and the output outside of it is discarded.
    auto sample_rate = baseline_blocks.first().sample_specification.sample_rate();
    constexpr i64 leading_frame_count = 100;
    constexpr i64 trailing_frame_count = 300;
    auto leading_discard = AK::Duration::from_time_units(leading_frame_count, 1, sample_rate);
    auto trailing_discard = AK::Duration::from_time_units(trailing_frame_count, 1, sample_rate);
    auto& first_sample = stream.samples.first();
    first_sample.set_leading_discard(leading_discard);
    first_sample.set_presentation_timestamp(first_sample.presentation_timestamp() + leading_discard);
    first_sample.set_duration(first_sample.duration() - leading_discard);
    auto& last_sample = stream.samples.last();
    last_sample.set_trailing_discard(trailing_discard);
    last_sample.set_duration(last_sample.duration() - trailing_discard);

    auto decoder = create_decoder(stream.track);
    auto blocks = decode_entire_stream(*decoder, stream);

    expect_contiguous_output(blocks, baseline_blocks.first().start + leading_discard);
    auto expected_frame_count = static_cast<i64>(total_frame_count(baseline_blocks)) - leading_frame_count - trailing_frame_count;
    auto frame_count_difference = static_cast<i64>(total_frame_count(blocks)) - expected_frame_count;
    // Millisecond timestamps can put a discard boundary up to a frame away on either end.
    EXPECT(frame_count_difference >= -2 && frame_count_difference <= 2);
}

TEST_CASE(he_aac_output_stays_contiguous_across_the_frames_that_sbr_delays)
{
    auto stream = read_coded_stream("./he_aac_in_matroska.mka"sv);
    auto decoder = create_decoder(stream.track);

    auto blocks = decode_entire_stream(*decoder, stream);

    // SBR doubles the core coder's sample rate and frame count.
    for (auto const& block : blocks)
        EXPECT_EQ(block.sample_specification, Audio::SampleSpecification(48'000, Audio::ChannelMap::stereo()));
    expect_contiguous_output(blocks, stream.samples.first().presentation_timestamp());
    EXPECT_EQ(total_frame_count(blocks), stream.samples.size() * 2048);
}

TEST_CASE(flushing_restarts_output_at_the_next_packet)
{
    auto stream = read_coded_stream("./he_aac_in_matroska.mka"sv);
    auto decoder = create_decoder(stream.track);

    Vector<DecodedBlock> blocks;
    for (size_t index = 0; index < 4; index++) {
        TRY_OR_FAIL(decoder->receive_coded_data(stream.samples[index]));
        EXPECT_EQ(write_available_blocks(*decoder, blocks), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::NeedsMoreInput);
    }

    decoder->flush();
    blocks.clear();

    // Windows' decoder outputs each packet once it has the next one.
    auto const& resumed_sample = stream.samples[8];
    for (size_t index = 8; index < 10; index++) {
        TRY_OR_FAIL(decoder->receive_coded_data(stream.samples[index]));
        EXPECT_EQ(write_available_blocks(*decoder, blocks), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::NeedsMoreInput);
    }
    expect_contiguous_output(blocks, resumed_sample.presentation_timestamp());
}

TEST_CASE(a_new_configuration_takes_over_once_the_previous_output_is_written)
{
    static constexpr size_t he_aac_sample_count = 4;

    auto he_aac_stream = read_coded_stream("./he_aac_in_matroska.mka"sv);
    auto lc_stream = read_coded_stream("./aac_lc_in_matroska.mka"sv);
    auto decoder = create_decoder(he_aac_stream.track);

    Vector<DecodedBlock> blocks;
    for (size_t index = 0; index < he_aac_sample_count; index++) {
        TRY_OR_FAIL(decoder->receive_coded_data(he_aac_stream.samples[index]));
        EXPECT_EQ(write_available_blocks(*decoder, blocks), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::NeedsMoreInput);
    }

    auto lc_sample = lc_stream.samples.first();
    EXPECT(lc_sample.new_codec_configuration().has_value());
    lc_sample.set_presentation_timestamp(he_aac_stream.samples[he_aac_sample_count].presentation_timestamp());
    TRY_OR_FAIL(decoder->receive_coded_data(lc_sample));
    EXPECT_EQ(write_available_blocks(*decoder, blocks), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::NeedsMoreInput);
    // Windows' decoder outputs a packet once it has the next one, or once it is drained.
    decoder->signal_end_of_stream();
    EXPECT_EQ(write_available_blocks(*decoder, blocks), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream);

    // The frames that the HE-AAC decoder delayed are written before the LC decoder's first packet.
    expect_contiguous_output(blocks, he_aac_stream.samples.first().presentation_timestamp());
    EXPECT_EQ(total_frame_count(blocks), (he_aac_sample_count * 2048) + 1024);
}

TEST_CASE(surround_channels_are_written_in_the_order_of_their_channel_map)
{
    auto stream = read_coded_stream("./aac_5_1_in_matroska.mka"sv);
    auto decoder = create_decoder(stream.track);

    Vector<Vector<float>> channel_samples;
    auto blocks = decode_entire_stream(*decoder, stream, &channel_samples);
    auto const& channel_map = blocks.first().sample_specification.channel_map();
    EXPECT_EQ(channel_map.channel_count(), 6);

    // Skip the encoder's priming, and count zero crossings for a quarter second.
    static constexpr size_t first_frame = 4096;
    static constexpr size_t frame_count = 12'000;
    for (u8 channel = 0; channel < channel_map.channel_count(); channel++) {
        auto expected_frequency = source_frequency_for_channel(channel_map.channel_at(channel));
        EXPECT(expected_frequency.has_value());

        auto samples = channel_samples[channel].span().slice(first_frame, frame_count);
        size_t zero_crossing_count = 0;
        for (size_t index = 1; index < samples.size(); index++) {
            if ((samples[index - 1] < 0) != (samples[index] < 0))
                zero_crossing_count++;
        }
        auto measured_frequency = static_cast<double>(zero_crossing_count) / 2 * 48'000 / frame_count;
        EXPECT_APPROXIMATE_WITH_ERROR(measured_frequency, static_cast<double>(expected_frequency.value()), expected_frequency.value() * 0.05);
    }
}

TEST_CASE(aac_without_a_configuration_is_left_to_another_decoder)
{
    auto decoder = MUST(Media::WindowsMediaFoundation::WindowsMediaFoundationAudioDecoder::try_create(Media::CodecID::AAC, Audio::SampleSpecification { 48'000, Audio::ChannelMap::stereo() }, {}));

    Media::CodedFrame frame { Media::CodecID::AAC, AK::Duration::zero(), AK::Duration::zero(), AK::Duration::zero(), Media::FrameFlags::Keyframe, MUST(FixedArray<u8>::create({ 0x21, 0x10, 0x04 })), FixedArray<u8> {} };
    auto result = decoder->receive_coded_data(frame);
    EXPECT(result.is_error());
    EXPECT_EQ(result.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::NotImplemented);
}

TEST_CASE(input_after_the_end_of_stream_is_rejected_until_flushed)
{
    auto stream = read_coded_stream("./aac_lc_in_matroska.mka"sv);
    auto decoder = create_decoder(stream.track);

    MUST(decoder->receive_coded_data(stream.samples[0]));
    decoder->signal_end_of_stream();

    auto result = decoder->receive_coded_data(stream.samples[1]);
    EXPECT(result.is_error());
    EXPECT_EQ(result.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream);

    decoder->flush();
    MUST(decoder->receive_coded_data(stream.samples[0]));
}

FILE: Tests/LibMedia/TestWindowsMediaFoundationDecode.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
