#include <LibMedia/DemuxerRegistry.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/VideoFrame.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/WindowsMediaFoundation/WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder.h>

#include "TestMediaCommon.h"

namespace {

struct DemuxerAndVideoTrack {
    NonnullRefPtr<Media::Demuxer> demuxer;
    Media::Track track;
};

DemuxerAndVideoTrack create_demuxer_and_video_track(StringView path)
{
    auto file = MUST(Core::File::open(path, Core::File::OpenMode::Read));
    auto stream = Media::IncrementallyPopulatedStream::create_from_buffer(MUST(file->read_until_eof()));
    auto demuxer = MUST(Media::create_demuxer(stream));
    auto track = MUST(demuxer->get_preferred_track_for_type(Media::TrackType::Video));
    VERIFY(track.has_value());
    MUST(demuxer->create_context_for_track(*track));
    return { move(demuxer), track.release_value() };
}

// Windows N editions ship without the H.264 decoder, and HEVC needs an extension from the Store.
OwnPtr<Media::WindowsMediaFoundation::WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder> create_decoder_if_available(Media::CodedFrame const& first_sample)
{
    auto decoder_or_error = Media::WindowsMediaFoundation::WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder::try_create(first_sample.codec_id(), first_sample.new_codec_configuration().value_or({}));
    if (decoder_or_error.is_error()) {
        EXPECT_EQ(decoder_or_error.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::NotImplemented);
        warnln("Media Foundation has no decoder for {}, skipping", first_sample.codec_id());
        return nullptr;
    }
    return decoder_or_error.release_value();
}

struct DecodeResult {
    size_t frame_count { 0 };
    RefPtr<Media::VideoFrame> first_frame;
};

Optional<DecodeResult> decode_all_frames(StringView path, Function<void(Media::VideoFrame const&)> check_frame = {})
{
    auto [demuxer, track] = create_demuxer_and_video_track(path);
    auto first_sample = MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track));
    auto decoder = create_decoder_if_available(first_sample);
    if (!decoder)
        return {};

    DecodeResult result;
    auto last_timestamp = AK::Duration::min();
    auto take_decoded_frames = [&](Media::DecoderErrorCategory expected_end) {
        while (true) {
            auto frame_result = decoder->take_next_output(track.video_data().color_metadata);
            if (frame_result.is_error()) {
                EXPECT_EQ(frame_result.error().category(), expected_end);
                return;
            }
            auto frame = frame_result.release_value();
            EXPECT(last_timestamp < frame->timestamp());
            EXPECT(!frame->duration().is_zero());
            last_timestamp = frame->timestamp();
            if (check_frame)
                check_frame(*frame);
            if (!result.first_frame)
                result.first_frame = frame;
            result.frame_count++;
        }
    };

    MUST(decoder->receive_coded_data(first_sample, Media::DecodeIntent::Output));
    take_decoded_frames(Media::DecoderErrorCategory::NeedsMoreInput);
    while (true) {
        auto sample_result = demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track);
        if (sample_result.is_error()) {
            EXPECT_EQ(sample_result.error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream);
            break;
        }
        MUST(decoder->receive_coded_data(sample_result.value(), Media::DecodeIntent::Output));
        take_decoded_frames(Media::DecoderErrorCategory::NeedsMoreInput);
    }

    decoder->signal_end_of_stream();
    take_decoded_frames(Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream);
    return result;
}

// A decoder that hands back an empty or misplaced chroma plane draws a flat green picture.
void expect_picture_has_detail(Media::VideoFrame const& frame)
{
    auto yuv_data = frame.yuv_data();
    VERIFY(yuv_data.has_value());
    auto component_size = frame.bit_depth() > 8 ? 2u : 1u;

    auto plane_varies = [&](ReadonlyBytes plane) {
        for (size_t i = component_size; i < plane.size(); i += component_size) {
            if (plane.slice(i, component_size) != plane.slice(0, component_size))
                return true;
        }
        return false;
    };
    EXPECT(plane_varies(yuv_data->y_data()));
    EXPECT(plane_varies(yuv_data->u_data()));
    EXPECT(plane_varies(yuv_data->v_data()));
}

}

TEST_CASE(avc_in_mp4_with_reordered_frames)
{
    auto result = decode_all_frames("./avc.mp4"sv);
    if (!result.has_value())
        return;
    EXPECT_EQ(result->frame_count, 50u);
    if (!result->first_frame)
        return;
    expect_picture_has_detail(*result->first_frame);
}

TEST_CASE(avc_in_matroska)
{
    auto result = decode_all_frames("./avc_in_matroska.mkv"sv);
    if (!result.has_value())
        return;
    EXPECT_EQ(result->frame_count, 50u);
}

TEST_CASE(hevc_10bit)
{
    auto result = decode_all_frames("./hevc_10bit.mp4"sv, [](Media::VideoFrame const& frame) {
        EXPECT_EQ(frame.bit_depth(), 10);
    });
    if (!result.has_value())
        return;
    EXPECT(result->frame_count > 0);
    if (!result->first_frame)
        return;
    expect_picture_has_detail(*result->first_frame);

    // Ten significant bits must land in the low end of each sample.
    auto luma = result->first_frame->yuv_data()->y_data();
    for (size_t i = 0; i + 1 < luma.size(); i += 2)
        EXPECT((luma[i + 1] & 0xFC) == 0);
}

TEST_CASE(h264_reference_only_frames_are_decoded_but_not_produced)
{
    auto [demuxer, track] = create_demuxer_and_video_track("./avc.mp4"sv);
    auto first_sample = MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track));
    auto decoder = create_decoder_if_available(first_sample);
    if (!decoder)
        return;

    Vector<AK::Duration> presented_timestamps;
    auto drain = [&] {
        while (true) {
            auto decoded_frame_result = decoder->take_next_output(track.video_data().color_metadata);
            if (decoded_frame_result.is_error())
                return;
            presented_timestamps.append(decoded_frame_result.value()->timestamp());
        }
    };

    static constexpr size_t REFERENCE_ONLY_SAMPLE_COUNT = 8;
    MUST(decoder->receive_coded_data(first_sample, Media::DecodeIntent::Reference));
    drain();
    for (size_t index = 1; index < REFERENCE_ONLY_SAMPLE_COUNT; index++) {
        auto sample = MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track));
        MUST(decoder->receive_coded_data(sample, Media::DecodeIntent::Reference));
        drain();
    }

    auto wanted_sample = MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track));
    auto wanted_timestamp = wanted_sample.presentation_timestamp();
    MUST(decoder->receive_coded_data(wanted_sample, Media::DecodeIntent::Output));
    decoder->signal_end_of_stream();
    drain();

    EXPECT_EQ(presented_timestamps.size(), 1u);
    if (!presented_timestamps.is_empty())
        EXPECT_EQ(presented_timestamps.first(), wanted_timestamp);
}

TEST_CASE(flush_restarts_decoding_from_a_keyframe)
{
    auto [demuxer, track] = create_demuxer_and_video_track("./avc.mp4"sv);
    auto first_sample = MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track));
    auto decoder = create_decoder_if_available(first_sample);
    if (!decoder)
        return;

    MUST(decoder->receive_coded_data(first_sample, Media::DecodeIntent::Output));
    for (size_t index = 0; index < 10; index++)
        MUST(decoder->receive_coded_data(MUST(demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(track)), Media::DecodeIntent::Output));
    decoder->flush();

    MUST(decoder->receive_coded_data(first_sample, Media::DecodeIntent::Output));
    decoder->signal_end_of_stream();
    auto frame = MUST(decoder->take_next_output(track.video_data().color_metadata));
    EXPECT_EQ(frame->timestamp(), first_sample.presentation_timestamp());
    EXPECT_EQ(decoder->take_next_output(track.video_data().color_metadata).error().category(), Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream);
}

// The file's mastering display and content light levels are only in its SEI, not in its sample entry.
TEST_CASE(hevc_frames_carry_the_high_dynamic_range_metadata_in_their_bitstream)
{
    auto result = decode_all_frames("./hevc_hdr_metadata_in_sei.mp4"sv, [](Media::VideoFrame const& frame) {
        auto const& color_metadata = frame.color_metadata();
        EXPECT(color_metadata.mastering_display_color_volume.has_value());
        if (color_metadata.mastering_display_color_volume.has_value()) {
            EXPECT_APPROXIMATE(color_metadata.mastering_display_color_volume->maximum_luminance, 1000.0);
            EXPECT_APPROXIMATE(color_metadata.mastering_display_color_volume->red.x, 0.68);
        }
        EXPECT(color_metadata.content_light_level_information.has_value());
        if (color_metadata.content_light_level_information.has_value()) {
            EXPECT_EQ(color_metadata.content_light_level_information->maximum_content_light_level, 1000);
            EXPECT_EQ(color_metadata.content_light_level_information->maximum_frame_average_light_level, 400);
        }
    });
    if (!result.has_value())
        return;
    EXPECT_EQ(result->frame_count, 6u);
}

#pragma once

#include <AK/Atomic.h>
#include <AK/ByteBuffer.h>
#include <LibMedia/MediaStream.h>
#include <LibMedia/ReadonlyBytesCursor.h>

// Fails the first blocking read that starts at or after a position the way an abort would, but leaves no abort flag
// set behind it, as when the abort is reset before the reading thread could look at it.
class TransientlyAbortingStream final : public Media::MediaStream {
public:
    static NonnullRefPtr<TransientlyAbortingStream> create(ByteBuffer data, size_t aborted_read_position)
    {
        return adopt_ref(*new TransientlyAbortingStream(move(data), aborted_read_position));
    }

    virtual NonnullRefPtr<Media::MediaStreamCursor> create_cursor() override { return make_ref_counted<Cursor>(*this); }
    virtual Availability availability() const override { return { { { 0, m_data.size() } }, m_data.size(), true }; }
    virtual Optional<u64> expected_size() const override { return m_data.size(); }
    virtual bool is_closed() const override { return true; }

    bool has_aborted_a_read() const { return m_has_aborted_a_read.load(); }

private:
    class Cursor final : public Media::MediaStreamCursor {
    public:
        explicit Cursor(TransientlyAbortingStream& stream)
            : m_stream(stream)
            , m_bytes(make_ref_counted<Media::ReadonlyBytesCursor>(stream.m_data.bytes()))
        {
        }

        virtual void set_is_blocking(bool is_blocking) override { m_is_blocking = is_blocking; }
        virtual Media::DecoderErrorOr<void> seek(i64 offset, AK::SeekMode mode) override { return m_bytes->seek(offset, mode); }

        virtual Media::DecoderErrorOr<size_t> read_into(Bytes bytes) override
        {
            TRY(abort_if_reading_the_aborted_position());
            return m_bytes->read_into(bytes);
        }

        virtual Media::DecoderErrorOr<FixedArray<u8>> read_bytes(size_t size) override
        {
            TRY(abort_if_reading_the_aborted_position());
            return m_bytes->read_bytes(size);
        }

        virtual Media::DecoderErrorOr<void> read_and_discard(size_t size) override
        {
            TRY(abort_if_reading_the_aborted_position());
            return m_bytes->read_and_discard(size);
        }

        virtual size_t position() const override { return m_bytes->position(); }
        virtual Optional<u64> size() const override { return m_bytes->size(); }
        virtual size_t blocking_size() const override { return m_bytes->blocking_size(); }

    private:
        Media::DecoderErrorOr<void> abort_if_reading_the_aborted_position()
        {
            if (!m_is_blocking || position() < m_stream->m_aborted_read_position || m_stream->m_has_aborted_a_read.exchange(true))
                return {};
            return Media::DecoderError::with_description(Media::DecoderErrorCategory::Aborted, "Read aborted"sv);
        }

        NonnullRefPtr<TransientlyAbortingStream> m_stream;
        NonnullRefPtr<Media::ReadonlyBytesCursor> m_bytes;
        bool m_is_blocking { true };
    };

    TransientlyAbortingStream(ByteBuffer data, size_t aborted_read_position)
        : m_data(move(data))
        , m_aborted_read_position(aborted_read_position)
    {
    }

    ByteBuffer m_data;
    size_t m_aborted_read_position { 0 };
    Atomic<bool> m_has_aborted_a_read { false };
};

#pragma once

#include <AK/AtomicRefCounted.h>
#include <AK/ConditionVariable.h>
#include <AK/Function.h>
#include <AK/Mutex.h>
#include <AK/NeverDestroyed.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/CodecID.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/CodedFrame.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/VideoDecoder.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/VideoDecoderRegistry.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/VideoFrame.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/VideoFramePool.h>

// The outputs that a WithholdingVideoDecoder has finished but not handed out yet. A test releases them one at a time,
// from whichever thread it likes, the way a decoder running on threads of its own finishes frames.
class WithheldOutputs final : public AtomicRefCounted<WithheldOutputs> {
public:
    struct Output {
        AK::Duration timestamp;
        AK::Duration duration;
    };

    bool release_next()
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
        if (m_withheld.is_empty())
            return false;
        m_released.append(m_withheld.take_first());
        m_released_changed.broadcast();
        if (m_decode_completed_callback && !m_caller_is_waiting_for_output)
            m_decode_completed_callback(Media::DecodeCompletion::ProducedOutput);
        return true;
    }

    // The decoder reports that it lost its state once, instead of handing out the output at this index.
    void lose_state_instead_of_handing_out_output(size_t output_index)
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
        m_output_index_that_loses_state = output_index;
    }

    // The decoder reports that it lost its state once, instead of reporting the end of the stream.
    void lose_state_at_end_of_stream()
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
        m_loses_state_at_end_of_stream = true;
    }

    bool state_was_lost() const
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
        return m_state_was_lost;
    }

    size_t withheld_count() const
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
        return m_withheld.size();
    }

    bool wait_until_withheld_count_reaches(size_t count, AK::Duration timeout)
    {
        auto deadline = MonotonicTime::now() + timeout;
        MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
        while (m_withheld.size() < count) {
            auto now = MonotonicTime::now();
            if (now >= deadline)
                return false;
            m_withheld_changed.wait_for(deadline - now);
        }
        return true;
    }

    bool wait_until_the_caller_waits_for_output(AK::Duration timeout)
    {
        auto deadline = MonotonicTime::now() + timeout;
        MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
        while (!m_caller_is_waiting_for_output) {
            auto now = MonotonicTime::now();
            if (now >= deadline)
                return false;
            m_caller_wait_changed.wait_for(deadline - now);
        }
        return true;
    }

private:
    friend class WithholdingVideoDecoder;

    mutable Mutex m_mutex;
    ConditionVariable m_released_changed { m_mutex };
    ConditionVariable m_withheld_changed { m_mutex };
    ConditionVariable m_caller_wait_changed { m_mutex };
    Vector<Output> m_withheld;
    Vector<Output> m_released;
    Function<void(Media::DecodeCompletion)> m_decode_completed_callback;
    bool m_caller_is_waiting_for_output { false };
    size_t m_handed_out_count { 0 };
    Optional<size_t> m_output_index_that_loses_state;
    bool m_loses_state_at_end_of_stream { false };
    bool m_state_was_lost { false };
};

// Produces a blank frame for every coded frame it is given, and withholds each one until the test releases it.
class WithholdingVideoDecoder final : public Media::VideoDecoder {
public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    static constexpr Gfx::Size<u32> FRAME_SIZE { 16, 16 };
    static constexpr size_t MAXIMUM_WITHHELD_OUTPUTS = 4;

    // Decoders created while this is set withhold their outputs there; the installed registration is skipped otherwise.
    static void set_withheld_outputs_for_new_decoders(RefPtr<WithheldOutputs> withheld_outputs)
    {
        MutexLocker locker { *s_withheld_outputs_mutex };
        *s_withheld_outputs_for_new_decoders = move(withheld_outputs);
    }

    static ReadonlySpan<Media::VideoDecoderRegistration> registrations()
    {
        static constexpr Array registrations {
            Media::VideoDecoderRegistration { capabilities, create },
        };
        return registrations.span();
    }

    virtual ~WithholdingVideoDecoder() override
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_withheld_outputs->m_mutex };
        m_withheld_outputs->m_decode_completed_callback = nullptr;
    }

    virtual void set_storage_freed_callback(Function<void()> callback) override { m_frame_pool->set_slot_freed_callback(move(callback)); }
    virtual void set_decode_completed_callback(Function<void(Media::DecodeCompletion)> callback) override
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_withheld_outputs->m_mutex };
        m_withheld_outputs->m_decode_completed_callback = move(callback);
    }
    virtual bool has_any_decode_in_progress() const override
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_withheld_outputs->m_mutex };
        return !m_withheld_outputs->m_withheld.is_empty() || !m_withheld_outputs->m_released.is_empty();
    }

    virtual Media::DecoderErrorOr<void> receive_coded_data(Media::CodedFrame const& coded_frame, Media::DecodeIntent intent) override
    {
        if (intent == Media::DecodeIntent::Reference)
            return {};
        MutexLocker locker { m_withheld_outputs->m_mutex };
        // A device decoding as many frames as it can at once takes the next one only when one of them finishes.
        while (m_withheld_outputs->m_withheld.size() >= MAXIMUM_WITHHELD_OUTPUTS) {
            m_withheld_outputs->m_caller_is_waiting_for_output = true;
            m_withheld_outputs->m_caller_wait_changed.broadcast();
            m_withheld_outputs->m_released_changed.wait();
            m_withheld_outputs->m_caller_is_waiting_for_output = false;
        }
        m_withheld_outputs->m_withheld.append({ coded_frame.presentation_timestamp(), coded_frame.duration() });
        m_withheld_outputs->m_withheld_changed.broadcast();
        return {};
    }

    virtual void signal_end_of_stream() override { m_reached_end_of_stream = true; }

    virtual Media::DecoderErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<Media::VideoFrame>> take_next_output(Media::ColorMetadata const& container_color_metadata, Optional<AK::Duration>) override
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_withheld_outputs->m_mutex };
        // Draining waits for the withheld outputs, as a decoder waits for its device to finish them, and so does
        // holding as many as a device would decode at once.
        auto must_wait_for_a_release = [&] {
            if (!m_withheld_outputs->m_released.is_empty() || m_withheld_outputs->m_withheld.is_empty())
                return false;
            return m_reached_end_of_stream || m_withheld_outputs->m_withheld.size() >= MAXIMUM_WITHHELD_OUTPUTS;
        };
        while (must_wait_for_a_release()) {
            m_withheld_outputs->m_caller_is_waiting_for_output = true;
            m_withheld_outputs->m_caller_wait_changed.broadcast();
            m_withheld_outputs->m_released_changed.wait();
            m_withheld_outputs->m_caller_is_waiting_for_output = false;
        }
        if (m_withheld_outputs->m_released.is_empty()) {
            if (m_reached_end_of_stream) {
                if (exchange(m_withheld_outputs->m_loses_state_at_end_of_stream, false)) {
                    m_withheld_outputs->m_state_was_lost = true;
                    return Media::DecoderError::with_description(Media::DecoderErrorCategory::NeedsResubmission, "The decoder lost its state"sv);
                }
                return Media::DecoderError::with_description(Media::DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream, "Every withheld output has been taken"sv);
            }
            return Media::DecoderError::with_description(Media::DecoderErrorCategory::NeedsMoreInput, "No withheld output has been released"sv);
        }

        if (m_withheld_outputs->m_output_index_that_loses_state == m_withheld_outputs->m_handed_out_count) {
            m_withheld_outputs->m_output_index_that_loses_state.clear();
            m_withheld_outputs->m_state_was_lost = true;
            return Media::DecoderError::with_description(Media::DecoderErrorCategory::NeedsResubmission, "The decoder lost its state"sv);
        }

        auto byte_count = FRAME_SIZE.width() * FRAME_SIZE.height() * 3 / 2;
        auto acquired_slot = m_frame_pool->try_acquire(byte_count);
        if (!acquired_slot.has_value())
            return Media::DecoderError::with_description(Media::DecoderErrorCategory::TryAgain, "Every video frame slot is held elsewhere"sv);

        auto output = m_withheld_outputs->m_released.take_first();
        m_withheld_outputs->m_handed_out_count++;
        return make_ref_counted<Media::VideoFrame>(output.timestamp, output.duration, FRAME_SIZE, 8, Media::Subsampling::yuv420(), container_color_metadata, move(acquired_slot->storage));
    }

    virtual void flush() override
    {
        m_reached_end_of_stream = false;
        MutexLocker locker { m_withheld_outputs->m_mutex };
        m_withheld_outputs->m_withheld.clear();
        m_withheld_outputs->m_released.clear();
    }

private:
    static Optional<Media::DecoderCapabilities> capabilities(Media::ParsedCodec const& codec)
    {
        if (Media::track_type_from_codec_id(codec.codec_id()) != Media::TrackType::Video)
            return {};
        MutexLocker locker { *s_withheld_outputs_mutex };
        if (*s_withheld_outputs_for_new_decoders == nullptr)
            return {};
        return Media::DecoderCapabilities { .smooth = true, .power_efficient = false };
    }

    static Media::DecoderErrorOr<NonnullOwnPtr<Media::VideoDecoder>> create(Media::CodecID, ReadonlyBytes)
    {
        RefPtr<WithheldOutputs> withheld_outputs;
        {
            MutexLocker locker { *s_withheld_outputs_mutex };
            withheld_outputs = *s_withheld_outputs_for_new_decoders;
        }
        if (withheld_outputs == nullptr)
            return Media::DecoderError::with_description(Media::DecoderErrorCategory::NotImplemented, "No test is withholding outputs"sv);
        auto frame_pool = Media::VideoFramePool::create();
        if (frame_pool.is_error())
            return Media::DecoderError::with_description(Media::DecoderErrorCategory::Memory, "Failed to create a frame pool"sv);
        return NonnullOwnPtr<Media::VideoDecoder> { adopt_own(*new WithholdingVideoDecoder(withheld_outputs.release_nonnull(), frame_pool.release_value())) };
    }

    WithholdingVideoDecoder(NonnullRefPtr<WithheldOutputs> withheld_outputs, NonnullRefPtr<Media::VideoFramePool> frame_pool)
        : m_withheld_outputs(move(withheld_outputs))
        , m_frame_pool(move(frame_pool))
    {
    }

    static inline NeverDestroyed<Mutex> s_withheld_outputs_mutex;
    static inline NeverDestroyed<RefPtr<WithheldOutputs>> s_withheld_outputs_for_new_decoders;

    NonnullRefPtr<WithheldOutputs> m_withheld_outputs;
    NonnullRefPtr<Media::VideoFramePool> m_frame_pool;
    bool m_reached_end_of_stream { false };
};

#include <AK/Array.h>
#include <AK/StringBuilder.h>
#include <AK/Utf16String.h>
#include <LibTest/TestCase.h>

#include <LibRegex/ECMAScriptRegex.h>

static ErrorOr<regex::ECMAScriptRegex, String> compile_regex_result(Utf16View pattern, regex::ECMAScriptCompileFlags flags = {})
{
    return regex::ECMAScriptRegex::compile(pattern, flags);
}

static ErrorOr<regex::ECMAScriptRegex, String> compile_regex_result(StringView pattern, regex::ECMAScriptCompileFlags flags = {})
{
    auto utf16_pattern = Utf16String::from_utf8(pattern);
    return compile_regex_result(utf16_pattern.utf16_view(), flags);
}

static regex::ECMAScriptRegex compile_regex(StringView pattern, regex::ECMAScriptCompileFlags flags = {})
{
    return MUST(compile_regex_result(pattern, flags));
}

static bool compile_succeeds(StringView pattern, regex::ECMAScriptCompileFlags flags = {})
{
    return !compile_regex_result(pattern, flags).is_error();
}

static bool matches(StringView pattern, StringView subject, regex::ECMAScriptCompileFlags flags = {})
{
    auto regex = compile_regex(pattern, flags);
    auto utf16_subject = Utf16String::from_utf8(subject);
    auto result = regex.test(utf16_subject, 0);
    EXPECT(result != regex::MatchResult::LimitExceeded);
    return result == regex::MatchResult::Match;
}

static Optional<Utf16View> capture_group(regex::ECMAScriptRegex const& regex, Utf16View input, unsigned group_index)
{
    auto start = regex.capture_slot(group_index * 2);
    auto end = regex.capture_slot(group_index * 2 + 1);
    if (start < 0 || end < 0)
        return {};
    return input.substring_view(start, end - start);
}

static void expect_capture_eq(regex::ECMAScriptRegex const& regex, Utf16View input, unsigned group_index, StringView expected)
{
    auto capture = capture_group(regex, input, group_index);
    EXPECT(capture.has_value());
    if (capture.has_value())
        EXPECT(*capture == expected);
}

static void expect_capture_unmatched(regex::ECMAScriptRegex const& regex, unsigned group_index)
{
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.capture_slot(group_index * 2), -1);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.capture_slot(group_index * 2 + 1), -1);
}

TEST_CASE(compile_rejects_invalid_pattern)
{
    auto regex = compile_regex_result("("sv, {});
    EXPECT(regex.is_error());
}

TEST_CASE(exec_tracks_named_capture_slots)
{
    auto regex = MUST(compile_regex_result("(?<word>foo)(bar)"sv, {}));

    EXPECT_EQ(regex.capture_count(), 2u);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.total_groups(), 3u);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.named_groups().size(), 1u);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.named_groups()[0].name, "word"sv);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.named_groups()[0].index, 1u);

    EXPECT_EQ(regex.exec(u"foobar"sv, 0), regex::MatchResult::Match);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.capture_slot(0), 0);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.capture_slot(1), 6);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.capture_slot(2), 0);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.capture_slot(3), 3);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.capture_slot(4), 3);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.capture_slot(5), 6);
}

TEST_CASE(exec_reports_unmatched_optional_groups)
{
    auto regex = MUST(compile_regex_result("(foo)?bar"sv, {}));

    EXPECT_EQ(regex.exec(u"bar"sv, 0), regex::MatchResult::Match);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.capture_slot(0), 0);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.capture_slot(1), 3);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.capture_slot(2), -1);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.capture_slot(3), -1);
}

TEST_CASE(ascii_backed_inputs_preserve_match_results)
{
    auto regex = MUST(compile_regex_result("(?<word>foo)(bar)"sv, {}));

    EXPECT_EQ(regex.exec("foobar"sv, 0), regex::MatchResult::Match);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.capture_slot(0), 0);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.capture_slot(1), 6);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.capture_slot(2), 0);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.capture_slot(3), 3);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.capture_slot(4), 3);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.capture_slot(5), 6);

    EXPECT_EQ(regex.test("foobar"sv, 0), regex::MatchResult::Match);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.find_all("foobar foobar"sv, 0), 2);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.find_all_match(0).start, 0);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.find_all_match(0).end, 6);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.find_all_match(1).start, 7);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.find_all_match(1).end, 13);
}

{
    auto regex = MUST(compile_regex_result("casesensitive"sv, { .ignore_case = true }));

    EXPECT_EQ(regex.test(u"CaseSensitive"sv, 0), regex::MatchResult::Match);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.test(u"something else"sv, 0), regex::MatchResult::NoMatch);
}

TEST_CASE(mixed_positive_class_with_word_builtin_preserves_legacy_ignore_case_behavior)
{
    auto regex = MUST(compile_regex_result("[\\w\\$]+"sv, { .ignore_case = true }));

    EXPECT_EQ(regex.test("AZ_09$"sv, 0), regex::MatchResult::Match);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.test(u"\u017F"sv, 0), regex::MatchResult::NoMatch);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.test(u"\u212A"sv, 0), regex::MatchResult::NoMatch);
}

TEST_CASE(mixed_positive_class_with_digit_builtin_preserves_behavior)
{
    auto regex = MUST(compile_regex_result("[A-Z\\d-]+"sv, { .ignore_case = true }));

    EXPECT_EQ(regex.test("ABC-123"sv, 0), regex::MatchResult::Match);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.test("abc"sv, 0), regex::MatchResult::Match);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.test("!"sv, 0), regex::MatchResult::NoMatch);
}

TEST_CASE(find_all_returns_non_overlapping_matches)
{
    auto regex = MUST(compile_regex_result("aba"sv, {}));

    EXPECT_EQ(regex.find_all(u"aba aba"sv, 0), 2);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.find_all_match(0).start, 0);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.find_all_match(0).end, 3);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.find_all_match(1).start, 4);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.find_all_match(1).end, 7);
}

TEST_CASE(unicode_find_all_skips_surrogate_interiors_after_empty_matches)
{
    for (auto flags : { regex::ECMAScriptCompileFlags { .unicode = true }, regex::ECMAScriptCompileFlags { .unicode_sets = true } }) {
        auto empty = compile_regex("(?<a>)\\k<a>"sv, flags);
        EXPECT_EQ(empty.find_all(u"😀😀"sv, 0), 3);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
            EXPECT_EQ(empty.find_all_match(i).start, static_cast<i32>(i * 2));
            EXPECT_EQ(empty.find_all_match(i).end, static_cast<i32>(i * 2));
        }

        auto lookbehind = compile_regex("(?<!.)"sv, flags);
        EXPECT_EQ(lookbehind.find_all(u"😀😀"sv, 0), 1);
        EXPECT_EQ(lookbehind.find_all_match(0).start, 0);
        EXPECT_EQ(lookbehind.find_all_match(0).end, 0);

        auto lookahead = compile_regex("(?!\\W)"sv, flags);
        EXPECT_EQ(lookahead.find_all(u"😀😀"sv, 0), 1);
        EXPECT_EQ(lookahead.find_all_match(0).start, 4);
        EXPECT_EQ(lookahead.find_all_match(0).end, 4);
    }
}

TEST_CASE(unicode_property_matching_works)
{
    auto regex = MUST(compile_regex_result("\\p{ASCII}+"sv, { .unicode = true }));

    EXPECT_EQ(regex.test(u"ASCII"sv, 0), regex::MatchResult::Match);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.test(u"😀"sv, 0), regex::MatchResult::NoMatch);
}

TEST_CASE(end_anchored_suffix_patterns_preserve_behavior)
{
    auto regex = MUST(compile_regex_result("(.*)\\/client-(.*)\\.js$"sv, {}));

    EXPECT_EQ(regex.test(u"https://cdn.example.com/assets/client-main.js"sv, 0), regex::MatchResult::Match);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.test(u"<script src=\"/assets/client-main.js\"></script>"sv, 0), regex::MatchResult::NoMatch);
}

TEST_CASE(leading_start_or_separator_prefix_preserves_behavior)
{
    auto regex = MUST(compile_regex_result("(?:^|;)\\s*foo=([^;]*)"sv, {}));

    {
        auto subject = Utf16String::from_utf8("foo=bar"sv);
        EXPECT_EQ(regex.exec(subject, 0), regex::MatchResult::Match);
        expect_capture_eq(regex, subject, 1, "bar"sv);
    }

    {
        auto subject = Utf16String::from_utf8("a=1; foo=bar; baz=qux"sv);
        EXPECT_EQ(regex.exec(subject, 0), regex::MatchResult::Match);
        expect_capture_eq(regex, subject, 1, "bar"sv);
    }

    EXPECT_EQ(regex.test(u"a=1; baz=qux"sv, 0), regex::MatchResult::NoMatch);
}

TEST_CASE(leading_literal_alternatives_preserve_line_endings)
{
    auto regex = compile_regex("\\r\\n?|\\n"sv);

    for (auto subject : { Utf16View { "one\r\ntwo\nthree\rfour"sv }, u"one\r\ntwo\nthree\rfour"sv }) {
        EXPECT_EQ(regex.find_all(subject, 0), 3);
        EXPECT_EQ(regex.find_all_match(0).start, 3);
        EXPECT_EQ(regex.find_all_match(0).end, 5);
        EXPECT_EQ(regex.find_all_match(1).start, 8);
        EXPECT_EQ(regex.find_all_match(1).end, 9);
        EXPECT_EQ(regex.find_all_match(2).start, 14);
        EXPECT_EQ(regex.find_all_match(2).end, 15);

        EXPECT_EQ(regex.exec(subject, 4), regex::MatchResult::Match);
        EXPECT_EQ(regex.capture_slot(0), 4);
        EXPECT_EQ(regex.capture_slot(1), 5);
        EXPECT_EQ(regex.test(subject, subject.length_in_code_units()), regex::MatchResult::NoMatch);
    }

    EXPECT_EQ(regex.test(u""sv, 0), regex::MatchResult::NoMatch);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.test(u"no line endings"sv, 0), regex::MatchResult::NoMatch);
}

TEST_CASE(leading_literal_alternatives_preserve_captures_and_match_order)
{
    auto regex = compile_regex("(abb*)|(acc*)|(dd*)"sv);

    for (auto subject : { Utf16View { "xxazddabbb"sv }, u"xxazddabbb"sv }) {
        EXPECT_EQ(regex.exec(subject, 0), regex::MatchResult::Match);
        EXPECT_EQ(regex.capture_slot(0), 4);
        expect_capture_eq(regex, subject, 0, "dd"sv);
        expect_capture_unmatched(regex, 1);
        expect_capture_unmatched(regex, 2);
        expect_capture_eq(regex, subject, 3, "dd"sv);

        EXPECT_EQ(regex.exec(subject, 6), regex::MatchResult::Match);
        expect_capture_eq(regex, subject, 1, "abbb"sv);
        expect_capture_unmatched(regex, 2);
        expect_capture_unmatched(regex, 3);
    }

    auto ordered = compile_regex("(ab)|(abb*)|(cc*)"sv);
    EXPECT_EQ(ordered.exec(u"xxabbb"sv, 0), regex::MatchResult::Match);
    expect_capture_eq(ordered, u"xxabbb"sv, 1, "ab"sv);
    expect_capture_unmatched(ordered, 2);
    expect_capture_unmatched(ordered, 3);
}

TEST_CASE(leading_literal_alternatives_preserve_assertions_and_flags)
{
    struct Test {
        StringView pattern;
        Utf16View subject;
        size_t start;
        i32 match_start;
        i32 match_end;
        regex::ECMAScriptCompileFlags flags {};
    };

    static constexpr Test tests[] {
        { "^|aa*|bb*"sv, u"xxbb"sv, 0, 0, 0 },
        { "^|aa*|bb*"sv, u"xxbb"sv, 1, 2, 4 },
        { "^|aa*|bb*"sv, u"xx"sv, 2, -1, -1 },
        { "^x|aa*|bb*"sv, u"zzaabb"sv, 0, 2, 4 },
        { "aa*|bb*|"sv, u"xx"sv, 0, 0, 0 },
        { "aa*|bb*|$"sv, u"xx"sv, 0, 2, 2 },
        { "a*|bb*"sv, u"xx"sv, 0, 0, 0 },
        { "aa*|bb*"sv, u"xxBB"sv, 0, 2, 4, { .ignore_case = true } },
        { "(?i:aa*)|bb*"sv, u"xxAA"sv, 0, 2, 4 },
        { "^x|aa*|bb*"sv, u"zz\nx"sv, 0, 3, 4, { .multiline = true } },
        { "aa*|bb*"sv, u"xxbb"sv, 0, -1, -1, { .sticky = true } },
        { "aa*|bb*"sv, u"xxbb"sv, 2, 2, 4, { .sticky = true } },
        { "\\b(?:aa*|bb*)"sv, u"xa bb"sv, 0, 3, 5 },
        { "(?<=x)aa*|bb*"sv, u"xxaa"sv, 0, 2, 4 },
        { "éé*|bb*"sv, u"xxéé"sv, 0, 2, 4 },
        { "\\uD83D|bb*"sv, u"x😀"sv, 0, 1, 2 },
        { "\\uD83D|bb*"sv, u"x😀bb"sv, 0, 3, 5, { .unicode = true } },
        { "aa*|bb*|cc*"sv, u"xxcc"sv, 0, 2, 4 },
    };

    for (auto const& test : tests) {
        auto regex = compile_regex(test.pattern, test.flags);
        auto result = regex.exec(test.subject, test.start);
        EXPECT_EQ(result, test.match_start < 0 ? regex::MatchResult::NoMatch : regex::MatchResult::Match);
        if (result == regex::MatchResult::Match) {
            EXPECT_EQ(regex.capture_slot(0), test.match_start);
            EXPECT_EQ(regex.capture_slot(1), test.match_end);
        }
    }
}

TEST_CASE(required_literal_prefilter_preserves_assignment_extractors)
{
    auto regex = MUST(compile_regex_result("(?:^|;)\\s*foo=([^;]*)"sv, {}));

    {
        auto subject = Utf16String::from_utf8("a=1; bar=baz; foo=qux"sv);
        EXPECT_EQ(regex.exec(subject, 0), regex::MatchResult::Match);
        expect_capture_eq(regex, subject, 1, "qux"sv);
    }

    EXPECT_EQ(regex.test(u"a=1; bar=baz; quux=7"sv, 0), regex::MatchResult::NoMatch);
}

TEST_CASE(ascii_ignore_case_required_literal_prefilter_preserves_behavior)
{
    auto regex = MUST(compile_regex_result("\\bfoo\\s*=\\s*([^;]*)"sv, { .ignore_case = true }));

    {
        auto subject = Utf16String::from_utf8("FOO = Bar"sv);
        EXPECT_EQ(regex.exec(subject, 0), regex::MatchResult::Match);
        expect_capture_eq(regex, subject, 1, "Bar"sv);
    }

    EXPECT_EQ(regex.test(u"bar = baz"sv, 0), regex::MatchResult::NoMatch);
}

TEST_CASE(required_literal_prefilter_handles_common_substrings_across_alternatives)
{
    auto regex = MUST(compile_regex_result("(\\$\\{name\\})|(\\$name\\b)"sv, {}));

    EXPECT_EQ(regex.find_all("${name} $name"sv, 0), 2);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.find_all_match(0).start, 0);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.find_all_match(0).end, 7);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.find_all_match(1).start, 8);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.find_all_match(1).end, 13);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.test(u"${other} $other"sv, 0), regex::MatchResult::NoMatch);
}

TEST_CASE(required_literal_prefilter_compiles_large_exact_quantifiers)
{
    StringBuilder pattern_builder;
    pattern_builder.append("(?:ab){"sv);
    pattern_builder.appendff("{}", 1'000'000);
    pattern_builder.append("}"sv);
    auto pattern = MUST(pattern_builder.to_string());

    EXPECT(compile_succeeds(pattern));
}

TEST_CASE(required_literal_prefilter_compiles_long_literal_alternations)
{
    StringBuilder branch_builder;
    branch_builder.append_repeated("a"sv, 1'024);
    auto shared_prefix = MUST(branch_builder.to_string());

    StringBuilder pattern_builder;
    pattern_builder.append(shared_prefix);
    pattern_builder.append("b|"sv);
    pattern_builder.append(shared_prefix);
    pattern_builder.append("c"sv);
    auto pattern = MUST(pattern_builder.to_string());

    auto regex = MUST(compile_regex_result(pattern, {}));

    StringBuilder subject_builder;
    subject_builder.append(shared_prefix);
    subject_builder.append("c"sv);
    auto matching_subject = MUST(subject_builder.to_string());

    subject_builder.trim(1);
    subject_builder.append("d"sv);
    auto missing_subject = MUST(subject_builder.to_string());

    EXPECT_EQ(regex.test(Utf16String::from_utf8(matching_subject), 0), regex::MatchResult::Match);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.test(Utf16String::from_utf8(missing_subject), 0), regex::MatchResult::NoMatch);
}

    struct Test {
        StringView pattern;
        bool should_compile { true };
        regex::ECMAScriptCompileFlags flags {};
    };

    static constexpr Test tests[] {
        { "^hello.$"sv },
        { "\\x"sv },
        { "\\x1"sv },
        { "\\x1"sv, false, { .unicode = true } },
        { "\\x11"sv, true, { .unicode = true } },
        { "\\"sv, false },
        { "(?"sv, false },
        { "\\u1234"sv, true, { .unicode = true } },
        { "[\\u1234]"sv, true, { .unicode = true } },
        { "\\u1"sv, false, { .unicode = true } },
        { "[\\u1]"sv, false, { .unicode = true } },
        { "{1}"sv, false },
        { "{1,2}"sv, false },
        { "\\uxxxx"sv, false, { .unicode = true } },
        { "\\u{10ffff}"sv, true, { .unicode = true } },
        { "\\u{110000}"sv, false, { .unicode = true } },
        { "\\p{ASCII}"sv, true, { .unicode = true } },
        { "\\p{}"sv, false, { .unicode = true } },
        { "\\p{AsCiI}"sv, false, { .unicode = true } },
        { "(?<a>a)(?<a>b)"sv, false },
        { "(?:(?<x>a)|(?<y>a)(?<x>b))(?:(?<z>c)|(?<z>d))"sv },
        { "(?<1a>a)"sv, false },
        { "(?<$$_$$>a)"sv },
        { "(?<ÿ>a)"sv },
        { "(?<𝓑𝓻𝓸𝔀𝓷>a)"sv },
        { "(?ii:a)"sv, false },
        { "(?-:a)"sv, false },
        { "(?i)"sv, false },
        { "(?-i)"sv, false },
        { "["sv, false },
        { "[ -"sv, false },
        { "[[x[]]]"sv, true, { .unicode_sets = true } },
        { "[\\w--x]"sv, true, { .unicode_sets = true } },
    };

    for (auto const& test : tests)
        EXPECT_EQ(compile_succeeds(test.pattern, test.flags), test.should_compile);
}

TEST_CASE(restored_ecmascript_match_coverage)
{
    struct Test {
        StringView pattern;
        StringView subject;
        bool should_match { true };
        regex::ECMAScriptCompileFlags flags {};
    };

    static constexpr Test tests[] {
        { "^hello.$"sv, "hello1"sv },
        { "^h{0,1}ello.$"sv, "ello1"sv },
        { "^hell\\x6f1$"sv, "hello1"sv },
        { "^hel(?<LO>l.)1$"sv, "hello1"sv },
        { "\\b.*\\b"sv, "hello1"sv },
        { "bar(?=f.)foo"sv, "barfoo"sv },
        { "bar(?=foo)bar"sv, "barbar"sv, false },
        { "bar(?!foo)bar"sv, "barbar"sv },
        { "bar(?!bar)bar"sv, "barbar"sv, false },
        { "bar.*(?<=foo)"sv, "barbar"sv, false },
        { "bar.*(?<!foo)"sv, "barbar"sv },
        { "(?:)"sv, ""sv },
        { "(?<=.{3})f"sv, "abcdef"sv },
        { "(?<=.{3})f"sv, "abc😀ef"sv, true, { .unicode = true } },
        { "a(?=.(?=c)|b)b"sv, "ab"sv },
        { "(?=)(?=\\d)"sv, "smart"sv, false },
        { "(?<!.*q.*?)(?<=h.*)THIS(?=.*!)"sv, "hey THIS does match!"sv },
        { "(.*a)?(x)"sv, "x"sv },
        { "^\\w*[\\u212A]"sv, "K"sv, true, { .ignore_case = true, .unicode = true } },
        { "^a*A\\d"sv, "aaaa5"sv, true, { .ignore_case = true } },
        { "^\\u{017f}*s$"sv, "ſs"sv, true, { .ignore_case = true, .unicode = true } },
        { "(a+)+b"sv, "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"sv, false },
    };

    for (auto const& test : tests)
        EXPECT_EQ(matches(test.pattern, test.subject, test.flags), test.should_match);
}

TEST_CASE(restored_lookbehind_capture_coverage)
{
    {
        auto regex = compile_regex("(?<=(a|cc))b"sv);
        auto subject = Utf16String::from_utf8("ccb"sv);

        EXPECT_EQ(regex.exec(subject, 0), regex::MatchResult::Match);
        expect_capture_eq(regex, subject, 0, "b"sv);
        expect_capture_eq(regex, subject, 1, "cc"sv);
    }
    {
        auto regex = compile_regex("((?<=\\b)[d-f]{3})"sv);
        auto subject = Utf16String::from_utf8("abc def"sv);

        EXPECT_EQ(regex.exec(subject, 0), regex::MatchResult::Match);
        expect_capture_eq(regex, subject, 0, "def"sv);
        expect_capture_eq(regex, subject, 1, "def"sv);
    }
    {
        auto regex = compile_regex("(?<=(b+))c"sv);
        auto subject = Utf16String::from_utf8("abbbbbbc"sv);

        EXPECT_EQ(regex.exec(subject, 0), regex::MatchResult::Match);
        expect_capture_eq(regex, subject, 0, "c"sv);
        expect_capture_eq(regex, subject, 1, "bbbbbb"sv);
    }
    {
        auto regex = compile_regex("(?<=((?:b\\d{2})+))c"sv);
        auto subject = Utf16String::from_utf8("ab12b23b34c"sv);

        EXPECT_EQ(regex.exec(subject, 0), regex::MatchResult::Match);
        expect_capture_eq(regex, subject, 0, "c"sv);
        expect_capture_eq(regex, subject, 1, "b12b23b34"sv);
    }
}

TEST_CASE(restored_zero_width_backreference_coverage)
{
    {
        auto regex = compile_regex("(a*)b\\1+"sv);
        auto subject = Utf16String::from_utf8("baaac"sv);

        EXPECT_EQ(regex.exec(subject, 0), regex::MatchResult::Match);
        expect_capture_eq(regex, subject, 0, "b"sv);
        expect_capture_eq(regex, subject, 1, ""sv);
    }
    {
        auto regex = compile_regex("(x)?\\1y"sv);
        auto subject = Utf16String::from_utf8("y"sv);

        EXPECT_EQ(regex.exec(subject, 0), regex::MatchResult::Match);
        expect_capture_eq(regex, subject, 0, "y"sv);
        expect_capture_unmatched(regex, 1);
    }
    {
        auto regex = compile_regex("(?!(y)y)(\\1)z"sv);
        auto subject = Utf16String::from_utf8("xyyz"sv);

        EXPECT_EQ(regex.exec(subject, 0), regex::MatchResult::Match);
        expect_capture_eq(regex, subject, 0, "z"sv);
        expect_capture_unmatched(regex, 1);
        expect_capture_eq(regex, subject, 2, ""sv);
    }
}

TEST_CASE(restored_backreference_to_undefined_capture_groups)
{
    {
        auto regex = compile_regex("(?:(?<x>a)|(?<x>b))\\k<x>"sv);
        auto subject = Utf16String::from_utf8("bb"sv);

        EXPECT_EQ(regex.exec(subject, 0), regex::MatchResult::Match);
        expect_capture_eq(regex, subject, 0, "bb"sv);
        expect_capture_unmatched(regex, 1);
        expect_capture_eq(regex, subject, 2, "b"sv);
    }
    {
        auto regex = compile_regex("(?:(?:(?<x>a)|(?<x>b))\\k<x>){2}"sv);
        auto subject = Utf16String::from_utf8("aabb"sv);

        EXPECT_EQ(regex.exec(subject, 0), regex::MatchResult::Match);
        expect_capture_eq(regex, subject, 0, "aabb"sv);
        expect_capture_unmatched(regex, 1);
        expect_capture_eq(regex, subject, 2, "b"sv);
    }
    {
        auto regex = compile_regex("(?:(?<x>a)|(?<x>b))\\k<x>"sv);
        auto subject = Utf16String::from_utf8("aa"sv);

        EXPECT_EQ(regex.exec(subject, 0), regex::MatchResult::Match);
        expect_capture_eq(regex, subject, 0, "aa"sv);
        expect_capture_eq(regex, subject, 1, "a"sv);
        expect_capture_unmatched(regex, 2);
    }
    {
        auto regex = compile_regex("(.*?)a(?!(a+)b\\2c)\\2(.*)"sv);
        auto subject = Utf16String::from_utf8("baaabaac"sv);

        EXPECT_EQ(regex.exec(subject, 0), regex::MatchResult::Match);
        expect_capture_eq(regex, subject, 0, "baaabaac"sv);
        expect_capture_eq(regex, subject, 1, "ba"sv);
        expect_capture_unmatched(regex, 2);
        expect_capture_eq(regex, subject, 3, "abaac"sv);
    }
    {
        auto regex = compile_regex("^(?:(?<a>x)|(?<a>y)|z)\\k<a>$"sv);
        auto subject = Utf16String::from_utf8("z"sv);

        EXPECT_EQ(regex.exec(subject, 0), regex::MatchResult::Match);
        expect_capture_eq(regex, subject, 0, "z"sv);
        expect_capture_unmatched(regex, 1);
        expect_capture_unmatched(regex, 2);
    }
    {
        auto regex = compile_regex("^(?:(?<a>x)|(?<a>y)|z){2}\\k<a>$"sv);
        auto subject = Utf16String::from_utf8("xz"sv);

        EXPECT_EQ(regex.exec(subject, 0), regex::MatchResult::Match);
        expect_capture_eq(regex, subject, 0, "xz"sv);
        expect_capture_unmatched(regex, 1);
        expect_capture_unmatched(regex, 2);
    }
}

TEST_CASE(restored_optional_groups_with_empty_matches)
{
    {
        auto regex = compile_regex("^(.*)(.*)?$"sv);
        auto subject = Utf16String::from_utf8("a"sv);

        EXPECT_EQ(regex.exec(subject, 0), regex::MatchResult::Match);
        expect_capture_eq(regex, subject, 1, "a"sv);
        expect_capture_unmatched(regex, 2);
    }
    {
        auto regex = compile_regex("()?"sv);
        auto subject = Utf16String::from_utf8(""sv);

        EXPECT_EQ(regex.exec(subject, 0), regex::MatchResult::Match);
        expect_capture_unmatched(regex, 1);
    }
    {
        auto regex = compile_regex("(z)((a+)?(b+)?(c))*"sv);
        auto subject = Utf16String::from_utf8("zaacbbbcac"sv);

        EXPECT_EQ(regex.exec(subject, 0), regex::MatchResult::Match);
        expect_capture_eq(regex, subject, 1, "z"sv);
        expect_capture_eq(regex, subject, 2, "ac"sv);
        expect_capture_eq(regex, subject, 3, "a"sv);
        expect_capture_unmatched(regex, 4);
        expect_capture_eq(regex, subject, 5, "c"sv);
    }
    {
        auto regex = compile_regex("(?:(?=(abc)))?a"sv);
        auto subject = Utf16String::from_utf8("abc"sv);

        EXPECT_EQ(regex.exec(subject, 0), regex::MatchResult::Match);
        expect_capture_eq(regex, subject, 0, "a"sv);
        expect_capture_unmatched(regex, 1);
    }
    {
        auto regex = compile_regex("^(?:(?=(abc))){0,1}a"sv);
        auto subject = Utf16String::from_utf8("abc"sv);

        EXPECT_EQ(regex.exec(subject, 0), regex::MatchResult::Match);
        expect_capture_eq(regex, subject, 0, "a"sv);
        expect_capture_unmatched(regex, 1);
    }
}

TEST_CASE(restored_ecmascript_modifier_coverage)
{
    struct Test {
        StringView pattern;
        StringView subject;
        bool should_match { true };
        regex::ECMAScriptCompileFlags flags {};
    };

    static constexpr Test tests[] {
        { "a(?i:b)c"sv, "aBc"sv },
        { "a(?i:b)c"sv, "aBC"sv, false },
        { "a(?s:.)c"sv, "a\nc"sv },
        { "(?ims:a.b)"sv, "A\nB"sv },
        { "(?i:a(?-i:b)c)"sv, "AbC"sv },
        { "(?i:a(?-i:b)c)"sv, "ABC"sv, false },
        { "a(?-i:b)c"sv, "AbC"sv, true, { .ignore_case = true } },
        { "a(?-i:b)c"sv, "ABC"sv, false, { .ignore_case = true } },
        { "x.(?m:^a)"sv, "x\na"sv, true, { .dot_all = true } },
    };

    for (auto const& test : tests)
        EXPECT_EQ(matches(test.pattern, test.subject, test.flags), test.should_match);
}

TEST_CASE(restored_unicode_property_and_sets_coverage)
{
    struct Test {
        StringView pattern;
        StringView subject;
        bool should_match { true };
        regex::ECMAScriptCompileFlags flags {};
    };

    static constexpr Test tests[] {
        { "\\p{ASCII}"sv, "a"sv, false },
        { "\\p{ASCII}"sv, "p{ASCII}"sv },
        { "\\p{ASCII}"sv, "a"sv, true, { .unicode = true } },
        { "\\p{ASCII}"sv, "😀"sv, false, { .unicode = true } },
        { "\\P{ASCII}"sv, "a"sv, false, { .unicode = true } },
        { "\\P{ASCII}"sv, "😀"sv, true, { .unicode = true } },
        { "\\p{ASCII_Hex_Digit}"sv, "1"sv, true, { .unicode = true } },
        { "\\P{ASCII_Hex_Digit}"sv, "x"sv, true, { .unicode = true } },
        { "\\p{General_Category=Cased_Letter}"sv, "A"sv, true, { .unicode = true } },
        { "\\P{Cased_Letter}"sv, "9"sv, true, { .unicode = true } },
        { "\\p{sc=Latin}"sv, "A"sv, true, { .unicode = true } },
        { "\\u{1f600}"sv, "😀"sv, true, { .unicode = true } },
        { "[\\w--x]"sv, "x"sv, false, { .unicode_sets = true } },
        { "[\\w--x]"sv, "y"sv, true, { .unicode_sets = true } },
        { "[\\w&&x]"sv, "x"sv, true, { .unicode_sets = true } },
        { "[[0-9\\w]--x--6]"sv, "6"sv, false, { .unicode_sets = true } },
        { "[[0-9\\w]--x--6]"sv, "9"sv, true, { .unicode_sets = true } },
    };

    for (auto const& test : tests)
        EXPECT_EQ(matches(test.pattern, test.subject, test.flags), test.should_match);
}

TEST_CASE(restored_empty_match_and_loop_coverage)
{
    static constexpr StringView patterns[] {
        "(a*)*"sv,
        "(a*?)*"sv,
        "(a*)*?"sv,
        "(?:)*?"sv,
        "(a?)+$"sv,
    };

    for (auto pattern : patterns)
        EXPECT(matches(pattern, ""sv));

    auto regex = compile_regex(".*"sv, { .global = true });
    auto subject = Utf16String::from_utf8(""sv);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.find_all(subject, 0), 1);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.find_all_match(0).start, 0);
    EXPECT_EQ(regex.find_all_match(0).end, 0);
}

TEST_CASE(restored_long_fork_chain_coverage)
{
    auto regex = compile_regex("(?:aa)*"sv);
    auto subject = MUST(String::repeated('a', 1000));
    auto utf16_subject = Utf16String::from_utf8(subject.bytes_as_string_view());

    EXPECT_EQ(regex.test(utf16_subject, 0), regex::MatchResult::Match);
}

/*

 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause

#include <LibCore/EventLoop.h>
#include <LibIPC/Transport.h>
#include <LibRequests/Request.h>
#include <LibRequests/RequestClient.h>
#include <LibTest/TestCase.h>
#include <LibURL/Parser.h>

namespace {

// A client whose RequestServer end of the connection is held, and never read.
struct ConnectedClient {
    NonnullRefPtr<Requests::RequestClient> client;
    IPC::TransportHandle request_server;
};

}

static ConnectedClient connect_client(int client_id)
{
    auto pair = MUST(IPC::Transport::create_paired());
    auto client = make_ref_counted<Requests::RequestClient>(move(pair.local), client_id);
    return { move(client), move(pair.remote_handle) };
}

static NonnullRefPtr<Requests::Request> start_request(Requests::RequestClient& client)
{
    auto url = URL::Parser::basic_parse("https://example.com/"sv);
    VERIFY(url.has_value());
    auto request = client.start_request("GET"sv, *url, HTTP::Cookie::SameSiteContext {});
    VERIFY(request);
    return request.release_nonnull();
}

TEST_CASE(requests_of_two_clients_with_the_same_id_have_different_transport_epochs)
{
    Core::EventLoop event_loop;

    // RequestServer can give a replacement client the id of the client it replaces.
    auto first = connect_client(1);
    auto replacement = connect_client(1);
    auto other = connect_client(2);

    auto first_request = start_request(*first.client);
    auto replacement_request = start_request(*replacement.client);
    EXPECT_EQ(first_request->id(), replacement_request->id());

    EXPECT_EQ(first_request->transport_epoch(), first.client->transport_epoch());
    EXPECT_EQ(replacement_request->transport_epoch(), replacement.client->transport_epoch());
    EXPECT_NE(first.client->transport_epoch(), replacement.client->transport_epoch());
    EXPECT_NE(other.client->transport_epoch(), first.client->transport_epoch());
    EXPECT_NE(other.client->transport_epoch(), replacement.client->transport_epoch());
}

TEST_CASE(a_request_keeps_its_transport_epoch_once_its_client_is_gone)
{
    Core::EventLoop event_loop;

    RefPtr<Requests::Request> request;
    u64 epoch = 0;
    {
        auto connected = connect_client(1);
        epoch = connected.client->transport_epoch();
        request = start_request(*connected.client);
    }
    EXPECT_EQ(request->transport_epoch(), epoch);
}

/*

#include <AK/Platform.h>
#include <AK/StringBuilder.h>
#include <LibSandbox/FileBroker.h>
#include <LibSandbox/Sandbox.h>
#include <LibSandbox/Seccomp.h>
#include <LibTest/TestCase.h>
#include <arpa/inet.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <linux/filter.h>
#include <linux/netlink.h>
#include <linux/seccomp.h>
#include <netinet/in.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <stddef.h>

#include <string.h>
