using Sandbox::file_broker_allows;
using Sandbox::FileBrokerAccess;
using Sandbox::PathRule;
using Sandbox::ResolvedPathRule;

static ResolvedPathRule rule(StringView path, PathRule::Access access, bool is_directory)
{
    return { path, path, access, is_directory };
}

TEST_CASE(a_directory_rule_covers_what_is_inside_it)
{
    Vector<ResolvedPathRule> rules { rule("/a/b"sv, PathRule::Access::ReadOnly, true) };
    EXPECT(file_broker_allows(rules, "/a/b"sv, FileBrokerAccess::Read));
    EXPECT(file_broker_allows(rules, "/a/b/c/d"sv, FileBrokerAccess::Read));
    EXPECT(!file_broker_allows(rules, "/a/bc"sv, FileBrokerAccess::Read));
    EXPECT(!file_broker_allows(rules, "/a/b/c"sv, FileBrokerAccess::Write));
}

TEST_CASE(a_file_rule_covers_only_that_file)
{
    Vector<ResolvedPathRule> rules { rule("/a/file"sv, PathRule::Access::ReadWrite, false) };
    EXPECT(file_broker_allows(rules, "/a/file"sv, FileBrokerAccess::Write));
    EXPECT(!file_broker_allows(rules, "/a/file/x"sv, FileBrokerAccess::Read));
    EXPECT(!file_broker_allows(rules, "/a/other"sv, FileBrokerAccess::Read));
}

TEST_CASE(directories_above_a_rule_expose_their_metadata_and_nothing_else)
{
    Vector<ResolvedPathRule> rules { rule("/a/b"sv, PathRule::Access::ReadOnly, true) };
    EXPECT(file_broker_allows(rules, "/"sv, FileBrokerAccess::Metadata));
    EXPECT(file_broker_allows(rules, "/a"sv, FileBrokerAccess::Metadata));
    EXPECT(!file_broker_allows(rules, "/a"sv, FileBrokerAccess::Read));
    EXPECT(!file_broker_allows(rules, "/a/other"sv, FileBrokerAccess::Metadata));
}

TEST_CASE(rules_add_up_along_a_path)
{
    Vector<ResolvedPathRule> rules { rule("/a"sv, PathRule::Access::ReadWrite, true), rule("/a/b"sv, PathRule::Access::ReadOnly, true) };
    EXPECT(file_broker_allows(rules, "/a/b/c"sv, FileBrokerAccess::Write));
}

TEST_CASE(a_link_named_by_a_rule_exposes_its_metadata)
{
    Vector<ResolvedPathRule> rules { { "/a/link"sv, "/b/target"sv, PathRule::Access::ReadOnly, false } };
    EXPECT(file_broker_allows(rules, "/a/link"sv, FileBrokerAccess::Metadata));
    EXPECT(file_broker_allows(rules, "/a"sv, FileBrokerAccess::Metadata));
    EXPECT(!file_broker_allows(rules, "/a/link"sv, FileBrokerAccess::Read));
    EXPECT(file_broker_allows(rules, "/b/target"sv, FileBrokerAccess::Read));
}

TEST_CASE(only_a_writable_directory_lets_its_entries_change)
{
    Vector<ResolvedPathRule> rules { rule("/a/file"sv, PathRule::Access::ReadWrite, false), rule("/b"sv, PathRule::Access::ReadWrite, true), rule("/c"sv, PathRule::Access::ReadOnly, true) };
    EXPECT(!file_broker_allows(rules, "/a/file"sv, FileBrokerAccess::ChangeEntry));
    EXPECT(!file_broker_allows(rules, "/b"sv, FileBrokerAccess::ChangeEntry));
    EXPECT(file_broker_allows(rules, "/b/entry"sv, FileBrokerAccess::ChangeEntry));
    EXPECT(!file_broker_allows(rules, "/c/entry"sv, FileBrokerAccess::ChangeEntry));
}

// Hides Landlock, which is what a kernel without it looks like from here.
static void leave_only_the_broker_available()
{
    sock_filter filter[] = {
        BPF_STMT(BPF_LD | BPF_W | BPF_ABS, offsetof(seccomp_data, nr)),
        BPF_JUMP(BPF_JMP | BPF_JEQ | BPF_K, __NR_landlock_create_ruleset, 0, 1),
        BPF_STMT(BPF_RET | BPF_K, SECCOMP_RET_ERRNO | ENOSYS),
        BPF_STMT(BPF_RET | BPF_K, SECCOMP_RET_ALLOW),
    };
    sock_fprog program {
        .len = sizeof(filter) / sizeof(filter[0]),
        .filter = filter,
    };
    if (prctl(PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS, 1, 0, 0, 0) < 0 || prctl(PR_SET_SECCOMP, SECCOMP_MODE_FILTER, &program) < 0)
        _exit(100);
}

static void make_file(ByteString const& path)
{
    auto fd = open(path.characters(), O_CREAT | O_WRONLY | O_CLOEXEC, 0600);
    VERIFY(fd >= 0);
    VERIFY(write(fd, "k", 1) == 1);
    close(fd);
}

// Each check has its own exit code, so that a failure says which one it was.
static void check(int code, bool condition)
{
    if (!condition)
        _exit(code);
}

static int error_opening(ByteString const& path, int flags)
{
    auto fd = open(path.characters(), flags | O_CLOEXEC, 0600);
    if (fd < 0)
        return errno;
    close(fd);
    return 0;
}

static void confine(ReadonlySpan<PathRule> rules)
{
    leave_only_the_broker_available();
    check(50, !Sandbox::restrict_filesystem(rules).is_error());
    check(51, Sandbox::file_broker_is_active());

    Sandbox::SeccompPolicy policy;
    policy.allow_readonly_file_opens();
    policy.allow_filesystem_metadata_queries();
    policy.allow_filesystem_writes();
    policy.allow_file_descriptor_operations();
    policy.allow_ipc();
    policy.allow_socket_pairs();
    policy.allow_common_runtime();
    check(52, !policy.install().is_error());
}

TEST_CASE(the_broker_enforces_the_path_rules)
{
    char base_template[] = "/tmp/lb-file-broker-XXXXXX";
    VERIFY(mkdtemp(base_template));
    ByteString base { base_template };
    auto read_only = ByteString::formatted("{}/read-only", base);
    auto writable = ByteString::formatted("{}/writable", base);
    auto hidden = ByteString::formatted("{}/hidden", base);
    auto read_only_file = ByteString::formatted("{}/file", read_only);
    auto hidden_file = ByteString::formatted("{}/file", hidden);

    VERIFY(mkdir(read_only.characters(), 0700) == 0);
    VERIFY(mkdir(writable.characters(), 0700) == 0);
    VERIFY(mkdir(hidden.characters(), 0700) == 0);
    make_file(read_only_file);
    make_file(hidden_file);
    auto subdirectory = ByteString::formatted("{}/subdirectory", read_only);
    VERIFY(mkdir(subdirectory.characters(), 0700) == 0);

    auto child = fork();
    VERIFY(child >= 0);
    if (child == 0) {
        Vector<PathRule> rules;
        MUST(Sandbox::add_path_if_exists(rules, read_only, PathRule::Access::ReadOnly));
        MUST(Sandbox::add_path_if_exists(rules, writable, PathRule::Access::ReadWrite));
        MUST(Sandbox::add_path_if_exists(rules, "/proc/self"sv, PathRule::Access::ReadOnly));
        confine(rules);

        // Reading.
        auto fd = open(read_only_file.characters(), O_RDONLY | O_CLOEXEC);
        check(1, fd >= 0);
        char byte = 0;
        check(2, read(fd, &byte, 1) == 1 && byte == 'k');
        close(fd);

        // What the rules leave out.
        check(3, error_opening(hidden_file, O_RDONLY) == EACCES);
        check(4, error_opening("/etc/passwd"sv, O_RDONLY) == EACCES);
        check(5, error_opening(ByteString::formatted("{}/does-not-exist", hidden), O_RDONLY) == EACCES);

        // Writing.
        check(6, error_opening(read_only_file, O_WRONLY) == EACCES);
        check(7, error_opening(ByteString::formatted("{}/new", read_only), O_CREAT | O_WRONLY) == EACCES);
        auto created = ByteString::formatted("{}/created", writable);
        check(8, error_opening(created, O_CREAT | O_WRONLY) == 0);
        check(9, error_opening(created, O_CREAT | O_EXCL | O_WRONLY) == EEXIST);

        // Metadata.
        struct stat statbuf;
        check(10, stat(created.characters(), &statbuf) == 0 && S_ISREG(statbuf.st_mode));
        check(11, stat(hidden_file.characters(), &statbuf) < 0 && errno == EACCES);
        check(12, stat(base.characters(), &statbuf) == 0 && S_ISDIR(statbuf.st_mode));
        check(13, access(read_only_file.characters(), R_OK) == 0);
        check(14, access(read_only_file.characters(), W_OK) < 0 && errno == EACCES);

        // Making a link is refused rather than fatal, so a library that tries one can carry on.
        check(15, symlink(hidden_file.characters(), ByteString::formatted("{}/link", writable).characters()) < 0 && errno == EPERM);
        check(16, syscall(__NR_symlinkat, hidden_file.characters(), AT_FDCWD, ByteString::formatted("{}/link", writable).characters()) < 0 && errno == EPERM);

        // Changing the contents of a writable directory.
        auto directory = ByteString::formatted("{}/directory", writable);
        check(20, mkdir(directory.characters(), 0700) == 0);
        check(21, mkdir(ByteString::formatted("{}/nope", read_only).characters(), 0700) < 0 && errno == EACCES);
        check(28, mkdir(read_only.characters(), 0700) < 0 && errno == EEXIST);
        auto renamed = ByteString::formatted("{}/renamed", writable);
        check(22, rename(created.characters(), renamed.characters()) == 0);
        check(23, rename(renamed.characters(), ByteString::formatted("{}/stolen", hidden).characters()) < 0 && errno == EACCES);
        check(24, rename(read_only_file.characters(), ByteString::formatted("{}/stolen", writable).characters()) < 0 && errno == EACCES);
        check(25, unlink(renamed.characters()) == 0);
        check(26, unlink(read_only_file.characters()) < 0 && errno == EACCES);
        check(27, rmdir(directory.characters()) == 0);

        // Relative to a directory the process has open.
        auto directory_fd = open(read_only.characters(), O_RDONLY | O_DIRECTORY | O_CLOEXEC);
        check(30, directory_fd >= 0);
        fd = openat(directory_fd, "file", O_RDONLY | O_CLOEXEC);
        check(31, fd >= 0);
        close(fd);
        check(32, openat(directory_fd, "../hidden/file", O_RDONLY | O_CLOEXEC) < 0 && errno == EACCES);

        // Going back up reports the directory that the path ends in.
        struct stat through_parent;
        check(36, stat(read_only.characters(), &statbuf) == 0);
        check(37, stat(ByteString::formatted("{}/subdirectory/..", read_only).characters(), &through_parent) == 0);
        check(38, statbuf.st_ino == through_parent.st_ino);

        // /proc/self has to mean this process, not the broker.
        fd = open("/proc/self/stat", O_RDONLY | O_CLOEXEC);
        check(33, fd >= 0);
        char status[32] {};
        check(34, read(fd, status, sizeof(status) - 1) > 0);
        close(fd);
        check(35, atoi(status) == getpid());
        char own_pid[32] {};
        check(39, readlink("/proc/self", own_pid, sizeof(own_pid) - 1) > 0 && atoi(own_pid) == getpid());
        memset(own_pid, 0, sizeof(own_pid));
        check(40, readlink("/proc/./self", own_pid, sizeof(own_pid) - 1) > 0 && atoi(own_pid) == getpid());

        // A trailing slash only ever names a directory.
        check(41, stat(ByteString::formatted("{}/", read_only_file).characters(), &statbuf) < 0 && errno == ENOTDIR);
        check(42, stat(ByteString::formatted("{}/", read_only).characters(), &statbuf) == 0);

        // A descriptor can be queried with no path at all.
        check(43, syscall(__NR_newfstatat, directory_fd, nullptr, &statbuf, AT_EMPTY_PATH) == 0 && S_ISDIR(statbuf.st_mode));

        _exit(0);
    }

    int status = 0;
    VERIFY(waitpid(child, &status, 0) == child);
    EXPECT(WIFEXITED(status));
    if (WIFEXITED(status))
        EXPECT_EQ(WEXITSTATUS(status), 0);

    EXPECT_EQ(error_opening(read_only_file, O_RDONLY), 0);
    EXPECT_EQ(error_opening(hidden_file, O_RDONLY), 0);

    (void)unlink(hidden_file.characters());
    (void)unlink(read_only_file.characters());
    (void)rmdir(subdirectory.characters());
    (void)rmdir(hidden.characters());
    (void)rmdir(writable.characters());
    (void)rmdir(read_only.characters());
    (void)rmdir(base.characters());
}

// Runs the body in a child with LADYBIRD_SANDBOX_DEBUG set, and returns what the child and its broker wrote to stderr.
template<typename Body>
static ByteString stderr_of_debugged_child(Body body)
{
    int fds[2];
    VERIFY(pipe(fds) == 0);
    auto child = fork();
    VERIFY(child >= 0);
    if (child == 0) {
        close(fds[0]);
        check(60, dup2(fds[1], STDERR_FILENO) == STDERR_FILENO);
        close(fds[1]);
        check(61, setenv("LADYBIRD_SANDBOX_DEBUG", "1", 1) == 0);
        body();
        _exit(0);
    }

    close(fds[1]);
    StringBuilder output;
    char buffer[4096];
    ssize_t received = 0;
    while ((received = read(fds[0], buffer, sizeof(buffer))) > 0)
        output.append(StringView { buffer, static_cast<size_t>(received) });
    close(fds[0]);

    int status = 0;
    VERIFY(waitpid(child, &status, 0) == child);
    EXPECT(WIFEXITED(status));
    if (WIFEXITED(status))
        EXPECT_EQ(WEXITSTATUS(status), 0);
    return output.to_byte_string();
}

TEST_CASE(sandbox_debugging_logs_each_refused_path_once)
{
    char base_template[] = "/tmp/lb-file-broker-XXXXXX";
    VERIFY(mkdtemp(base_template));
    ByteString base { base_template };
    auto read_only = ByteString::formatted("{}/read-only", base);
    auto hidden = ByteString::formatted("{}/hidden", base);
    auto hidden_file = ByteString::formatted("{}/file", hidden);
    VERIFY(mkdir(read_only.characters(), 0700) == 0);
    VERIFY(mkdir(hidden.characters(), 0700) == 0);
    make_file(hidden_file);

    auto output = stderr_of_debugged_child([&] {
        Vector<PathRule> rules;
        MUST(Sandbox::add_path_if_exists(rules, read_only, PathRule::Access::ReadOnly));
        MUST(Sandbox::add_path_if_exists(rules, "/proc/self"sv, PathRule::Access::ReadOnly));
        confine(rules);

        check(1, error_opening(hidden_file, O_RDONLY) == EACCES);
        check(2, error_opening(hidden_file, O_RDONLY) == EACCES);
        // A directory that exists is reported as such, which is no refusal to log.
        check(3, mkdir(read_only.characters(), 0700) < 0 && errno == EEXIST);
    });

    auto refusal = ByteString::formatted("read access to {}\n", hidden_file);
    EXPECT_EQ(output.count(refusal), 1u);
    EXPECT(!output.contains("entry change"sv));

    (void)unlink(hidden_file.characters());
    (void)rmdir(hidden.characters());
    (void)rmdir(read_only.characters());
    (void)rmdir(base.characters());
}

TEST_CASE(sandbox_debugging_logs_what_the_file_system_filter_refuses)
{
    auto output = stderr_of_debugged_child([&] {
        confine({});

        // The policy allows links, but the file system filter refuses them.
        check(1, link("/", "/") < 0 && errno == EPERM);
    });

    EXPECT(output.contains("Sandbox refusal in "sv));
    EXPECT(output.contains(": errno 1 for syscall link"sv));
}

TEST_CASE(the_broker_does_not_follow_a_link_out_of_a_writable_directory)
{
    char base_template[] = "/tmp/lb-file-broker-XXXXXX";
    VERIFY(mkdtemp(base_template));
    ByteString base { base_template };
    auto writable = ByteString::formatted("{}/writable", base);
    auto hidden = ByteString::formatted("{}/hidden", base);
    auto hidden_file = ByteString::formatted("{}/file", hidden);
    auto link_to_file = ByteString::formatted("{}/link-to-file", writable);
    auto link_to_directory = ByteString::formatted("{}/link-to-directory", writable);

    VERIFY(mkdir(writable.characters(), 0700) == 0);
    VERIFY(mkdir(hidden.characters(), 0700) == 0);
    make_file(hidden_file);
    // The sandbox can't make these itself. A helper that found one, or was handed a directory with one, is the concern.
    VERIFY(symlink(hidden_file.characters(), link_to_file.characters()) == 0);
    VERIFY(symlink(hidden.characters(), link_to_directory.characters()) == 0);

    auto child = fork();
    VERIFY(child >= 0);
    if (child == 0) {
        Vector<PathRule> rules;
        MUST(Sandbox::add_path_if_exists(rules, writable, PathRule::Access::ReadWrite));
        confine(rules);

        check(1, error_opening(link_to_file, O_RDONLY) == EACCES);
        check(2, error_opening(link_to_file, O_WRONLY) == EACCES);
        check(3, error_opening(ByteString::formatted("{}/file", link_to_directory), O_RDONLY) == EACCES);
        check(4, error_opening(ByteString::formatted("{}/new", link_to_directory), O_CREAT | O_WRONLY) == EACCES);
        check(5, error_opening(link_to_file, O_RDONLY | O_NOFOLLOW) == ELOOP);

        // A link's own text is part of the directory the helper may read.
        char target[PATH_MAX];
        auto length = readlink(link_to_file.characters(), target, sizeof(target));
        check(6, length == static_cast<ssize_t>(hidden_file.length()));

        // Not following the link means that where it leads doesn't matter.
        check(8, syscall(__NR_faccessat2, AT_FDCWD, link_to_file.characters(), F_OK, AT_SYMLINK_NOFOLLOW) == 0);
        check(9, syscall(__NR_faccessat2, AT_FDCWD, link_to_file.characters(), F_OK, 0) < 0 && errno == EACCES);

        // Going up from an allowed directory is not a way out.
        check(7, error_opening(ByteString::formatted("{}/../hidden/file", writable), O_RDONLY) == EACCES);
        _exit(0);
    }

    int status = 0;
    VERIFY(waitpid(child, &status, 0) == child);
    EXPECT(WIFEXITED(status));
    if (WIFEXITED(status))
        EXPECT_EQ(WEXITSTATUS(status), 0);

    (void)unlink(link_to_directory.characters());
    (void)unlink(link_to_file.characters());
    (void)unlink(hidden_file.characters());
    (void)rmdir(hidden.characters());
    (void)rmdir(writable.characters());
    (void)rmdir(base.characters());
}

TEST_CASE(a_socket_cannot_create_a_file_outside_the_path_rules)
{
    char base_template[] = "/tmp/lb-file-broker-XXXXXX";
    VERIFY(mkdtemp(base_template));
    ByteString base { base_template };
    auto hidden = ByteString::formatted("{}/hidden", base);
    auto writable = ByteString::formatted("{}/writable", base);
    auto planted = ByteString::formatted("{}/planted", hidden);
    VERIFY(mkdir(hidden.characters(), 0700) == 0);
    VERIFY(mkdir(writable.characters(), 0700) == 0);

    auto child = fork();
    VERIFY(child >= 0);
    if (child == 0) {
        Vector<PathRule> rules;
        MUST(Sandbox::add_path_if_exists(rules, writable, PathRule::Access::ReadWrite));
        leave_only_the_broker_available();
        check(50, !Sandbox::restrict_filesystem(rules).is_error());

        Sandbox::SeccompPolicy policy;
        policy.allow_file_descriptor_operations();
        policy.allow_ipc();
        policy.allow_socket_pairs();
        policy.allow_common_runtime();
        policy.allow_network();
        check(52, !policy.install().is_error());

        int pair[2];
        check(1, socketpair(AF_UNIX, SOCK_STREAM | SOCK_CLOEXEC, 0, pair) == 0);

        sockaddr_un address {};
        address.sun_family = AF_UNIX;
        memcpy(address.sun_path, planted.characters(), planted.length());
        check(2, bind(pair[0], reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&address), sizeof(address)) < 0 && errno == EACCES);

        // Internet sockets still bind, because the network policies are there for them.
        auto udp = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_DGRAM | SOCK_CLOEXEC, 0);
        check(3, udp >= 0);
        sockaddr_in loopback {};
        loopback.sin_family = AF_INET;
        loopback.sin_addr.s_addr = htonl(INADDR_LOOPBACK);
        check(4, bind(udp, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&loopback), sizeof(loopback)) == 0);
        socklen_t length = sizeof(loopback);
        check(5, getsockname(udp, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&loopback), &length) == 0 && loopback.sin_port != 0);

        // glibc binds one of these to ask the kernel about the network interfaces.
        auto netlink = socket(AF_NETLINK, SOCK_RAW | SOCK_CLOEXEC, NETLINK_ROUTE);
        check(6, netlink >= 0);
        sockaddr_nl netlink_address {};
        netlink_address.nl_family = AF_NETLINK;
        check(7, bind(netlink, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&netlink_address), sizeof(netlink_address)) == 0);
        _exit(0);
    }

    int status = 0;
    VERIFY(waitpid(child, &status, 0) == child);
    EXPECT(WIFEXITED(status));
    if (WIFEXITED(status))
        EXPECT_EQ(WEXITSTATUS(status), 0);

    struct stat statbuf;
    EXPECT(lstat(planted.characters(), &statbuf) < 0);

    (void)unlink(planted.characters());
    (void)rmdir(hidden.characters());
    (void)rmdir(writable.characters());
    (void)rmdir(base.characters());
}

TEST_CASE(a_helper_cannot_reach_a_unix_socket_outside_the_path_rules)
{
    char base_template[] = "/tmp/lb-file-broker-XXXXXX";
    VERIFY(mkdtemp(base_template));
    ByteString base { base_template };
    auto stream_path = ByteString::formatted("{}/stream", base);
    auto datagram_path = ByteString::formatted("{}/datagram", base);

    auto address_of = [](ByteString const& path) {
        sockaddr_un address {};
        address.sun_family = AF_UNIX;
        memcpy(address.sun_path, path.characters(), path.length());
        return address;
    };

    auto stream_address = address_of(stream_path);
    auto datagram_address = address_of(datagram_path);
    auto listener = socket(AF_UNIX, SOCK_STREAM | SOCK_NONBLOCK | SOCK_CLOEXEC, 0);
    auto receiver = socket(AF_UNIX, SOCK_DGRAM | SOCK_NONBLOCK | SOCK_CLOEXEC, 0);
    VERIFY(listener >= 0 && receiver >= 0);
    VERIFY(bind(listener, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&stream_address), sizeof(stream_address)) == 0);
    VERIFY(listen(listener, 4) == 0);
    VERIFY(bind(receiver, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&datagram_address), sizeof(datagram_address)) == 0);

    auto child = fork();
    VERIFY(child >= 0);
    if (child == 0) {
        Vector<PathRule> rules;
        leave_only_the_broker_available();
        check(50, !Sandbox::restrict_filesystem(rules).is_error());

        Sandbox::SeccompPolicy policy;
        policy.allow_file_descriptor_operations();
        policy.allow_ipc();
        policy.allow_socket_pairs();
        policy.allow_common_runtime();
        policy.allow_network();
        check(52, !policy.install().is_error());

        int unusable[2];
        check(1, socketpair(AF_UNIX, SOCK_DGRAM | SOCK_CLOEXEC, 0, unusable) < 0);
        check(5, socket(AF_UNIX, SOCK_DGRAM | SOCK_CLOEXEC, 0) < 0);
        check(6, socket(AF_UNIX, SOCK_STREAM | SOCK_CLOEXEC, 0) < 0);

        for (int type : { SOCK_STREAM, SOCK_SEQPACKET }) {
            int pair[2];
            check(2, socketpair(AF_UNIX, type | SOCK_CLOEXEC, 0, pair) == 0);

            auto cannot_leave_its_pair = [&](int code) {
                check(code, connect(pair[0], reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&stream_address), sizeof(stream_address)) < 0);
                check(code + 1, connect(pair[0], reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&datagram_address), sizeof(datagram_address)) < 0);
                (void)sendto(pair[0], "x", 1, MSG_NOSIGNAL | MSG_DONTWAIT, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&datagram_address), sizeof(datagram_address));
            };

            cannot_leave_its_pair(10);
            check(3, shutdown(pair[0], SHUT_RDWR) == 0);
            cannot_leave_its_pair(20);
            check(4, close(pair[1]) == 0);
            cannot_leave_its_pair(30);
        }
        _exit(0);
    }

    int status = 0;
    VERIFY(waitpid(child, &status, 0) == child);
    EXPECT(WIFEXITED(status));
    if (WIFEXITED(status))
        EXPECT_EQ(WEXITSTATUS(status), 0);

    char byte = 0;
    EXPECT(accept(listener, nullptr, nullptr) < 0 && errno == EAGAIN);
    EXPECT(recv(receiver, &byte, 1, 0) < 0 && errno == EAGAIN);

    close(listener);
    close(receiver);
    (void)unlink(stream_path.characters());
    (void)unlink(datagram_path.characters());
    (void)rmdir(base.characters());
}

TEST_CASE(files_are_refused_as_soon_as_the_broker_runs)
{
    char base_template[] = "/tmp/lb-file-broker-XXXXXX";
    VERIFY(mkdtemp(base_template));
    ByteString base { base_template };
    auto allowed = ByteString::formatted("{}/allowed", base);
    auto hidden = ByteString::formatted("{}/hidden", base);
    auto allowed_file = ByteString::formatted("{}/file", allowed);
    auto hidden_file = ByteString::formatted("{}/file", hidden);
    auto linked_file = ByteString::formatted("{}/linked", allowed);
    VERIFY(mkdir(allowed.characters(), 0700) == 0);
    VERIFY(mkdir(hidden.characters(), 0700) == 0);
    make_file(allowed_file);
    make_file(hidden_file);

    auto child = fork();
    VERIFY(child >= 0);
    if (child == 0) {
        Vector<PathRule> rules;
        MUST(Sandbox::add_path_if_exists(rules, allowed, PathRule::Access::ReadOnly));
        leave_only_the_broker_available();
        check(50, !Sandbox::restrict_filesystem(rules).is_error());

        // No policy yet, as while a helper sets up its GPU driver.
        check(1, error_opening(hidden_file, O_RDONLY) == EACCES);
        check(2, error_opening(allowed_file, O_RDONLY) == 0);
        struct stat statbuf;
        check(3, stat(hidden_file.characters(), &statbuf) < 0 && errno == EACCES);
        check(4, truncate(hidden_file.characters(), 0) < 0 && errno == EACCES);
        check(5, chmod(hidden_file.characters(), 0777) < 0 && errno == EPERM);
        char value[8];
        check(6, lgetxattr(hidden_file.characters(), "user.test", value, sizeof(value)) < 0 && errno == EOPNOTSUPP);
        check(7, link(hidden_file.characters(), linked_file.characters()) < 0 && errno == EPERM);
        auto inotify = inotify_init1(IN_CLOEXEC);
        check(8, inotify >= 0 && inotify_add_watch(inotify, hidden_file.characters(), IN_ALL_EVENTS) < 0 && errno == EACCES);
        char* arguments[] = { const_cast<char*>("true"), nullptr };
        check(9, execve("/bin/true", arguments, nullptr) < 0 && errno == EACCES);
        check(10, ptrace(PTRACE_ATTACH, getppid(), nullptr, nullptr) < 0 && errno == EPERM);

        // open_tree(), openat2() and io_uring_setup(), by the numbers that every architecture shares.
        check(11, syscall(428, AT_FDCWD, hidden_file.characters(), 0) < 0 && errno == EPERM);
        check(12, syscall(437, AT_FDCWD, hidden_file.characters(), nullptr, 0) < 0 && errno == ENOSYS);
        check(13, syscall(425, 1, nullptr) < 0 && errno == ENOSYS);
        check(14, syscall(472) < 0 && errno == ENOSYS);
#if ARCH(X86_64)
        check(15, syscall(0x40000000 | __NR_openat, AT_FDCWD, hidden_file.characters(), O_RDONLY) < 0 && errno == ENOSYS);
#endif
        _exit(0);
    }

    int status = 0;
    VERIFY(waitpid(child, &status, 0) == child);
    EXPECT(WIFEXITED(status));
    if (WIFEXITED(status))
        EXPECT_EQ(WEXITSTATUS(status), 0);

    struct stat statbuf;
    EXPECT(stat(hidden_file.characters(), &statbuf) == 0 && statbuf.st_size == 1 && (statbuf.st_mode & 0777) == 0600);
    EXPECT(lstat(linked_file.characters(), &statbuf) < 0);

    (void)unlink(allowed_file.characters());
    (void)unlink(hidden_file.characters());
    (void)rmdir(allowed.characters());
    (void)rmdir(hidden.characters());
    (void)rmdir(base.characters());
}

TEST_CASE(a_thread_that_blocks_every_signal_still_reaches_the_broker)
{
    char base_template[] = "/tmp/lb-file-broker-XXXXXX";
    VERIFY(mkdtemp(base_template));
    ByteString base { base_template };
    auto file = ByteString::formatted("{}/file", base);
    make_file(file);

    auto child = fork();
    VERIFY(child >= 0);
    if (child == 0) {
        rlimit limit { 0, 0 };
        setrlimit(RLIMIT_CORE, &limit);

        Vector<PathRule> rules;
        MUST(Sandbox::add_path_if_exists(rules, base, PathRule::Access::ReadOnly));
        leave_only_the_broker_available();
        check(50, !Sandbox::restrict_filesystem(rules).is_error());

        Sandbox::SeccompPolicy policy;
        policy.allow_readonly_file_opens();
        policy.allow_file_descriptor_operations();
        policy.allow_threads();
        policy.allow_common_runtime();
        check(52, !policy.install().is_error());

        // As glibc does while a thread exits, which can still open a file.
        sigset_t all_signals;
        sigfillset(&all_signals);
        check(1, pthread_sigmask(SIG_BLOCK, &all_signals, nullptr) == 0);
        check(2, error_opening(file, O_RDONLY) == 0);

        sigset_t blocked;
        check(3, pthread_sigmask(SIG_SETMASK, nullptr, &blocked) == 0);
        check(4, sigismember(&blocked, SIGUSR1) == 1 && sigismember(&blocked, SIGSYS) == 0);

        sigset_t user_signal;
        sigemptyset(&user_signal);
        sigaddset(&user_signal, SIGUSR1);
        check(5, pthread_sigmask(SIG_UNBLOCK, &user_signal, nullptr) == 0);
        check(6, pthread_sigmask(SIG_SETMASK, nullptr, &blocked) == 0);
        check(7, sigismember(&blocked, SIGUSR1) == 0 && sigismember(&blocked, SIGUSR2) == 1);
        _exit(0);
    }

    int status = 0;
    VERIFY(waitpid(child, &status, 0) == child);
    EXPECT(WIFEXITED(status));
    if (WIFEXITED(status))
        EXPECT_EQ(WEXITSTATUS(status), 0);

    (void)unlink(file.characters());
    (void)rmdir(base.characters());
}

TEST_CASE(a_policy_that_refuses_a_path_still_wins_over_the_broker)
{
    char base_template[] = "/tmp/lb-file-broker-XXXXXX";
    VERIFY(mkdtemp(base_template));

TEST_CASE(process_creation_without_landlock_cannot_signal_other_processes)
{
    auto parent = getpid();
    auto child = fork();
    VERIFY(child >= 0);
    if (child == 0) {
        leave_only_the_broker_available();
        check(50, !Sandbox::restrict_filesystem().is_error());
        check(51, !Sandbox::signals_stay_within_the_process_tree());

        Sandbox::SeccompPolicy policy;
        policy.allow_common_runtime();
        policy.allow_process_creation();
        policy.allow_file_descriptor_operations();
        check(52, !policy.install().is_error());

        check(1, syscall(__NR_tgkill, getpid(), syscall(__NR_gettid), 0) == 0);
        check(2, syscall(__NR_tgkill, parent, parent, 0) < 0 && errno == EPERM);

        auto grandchild = fork();
        check(3, grandchild >= 0);
        if (grandchild == 0) {
            check(4, syscall(__NR_tgkill, parent, parent, 0) < 0 && errno == EPERM);
            _exit(0);
        }
        int status = 0;
        check(6, waitpid(grandchild, &status, 0) == grandchild);
        check(WIFEXITED(status) ? WEXITSTATUS(status) : 7, WIFEXITED(status) && WEXITSTATUS(status) == 0);
        _exit(0);
    }

    int status = 0;
    VERIFY(waitpid(child, &status, 0) == child);
    EXPECT(WIFEXITED(status));
    if (WIFEXITED(status))
        EXPECT_EQ(WEXITSTATUS(status), 0);
}

TEST_CASE(a_policy_that_sends_nothing_to_the_broker_still_cannot_pair_sockets)
{
    // ImageDecoder's sandbox: no paths at all, and no sockets of its own.
    auto child = fork();
    VERIFY(child >= 0);
    if (child == 0) {
        rlimit limit { 0, 0 };
        setrlimit(RLIMIT_CORE, &limit);
        leave_only_the_broker_available();
        check(50, !Sandbox::restrict_filesystem().is_error());

        Sandbox::SeccompPolicy policy;
        policy.deny_readonly_filesystem_probes();
        policy.allow_file_descriptor_operations();
        policy.allow_ipc();
        policy.allow_common_runtime();
        check(52, !policy.install().is_error());

        check(1, error_opening("/", O_RDONLY) == EACCES);
        int fds[2];
        (void)socketpair(AF_UNIX, SOCK_STREAM, 0, fds);
        _exit(0);
    }

    int status = 0;
    VERIFY(waitpid(child, &status, 0) == child);
    EXPECT(WIFSIGNALED(status));
    if (WIFSIGNALED(status))
        EXPECT_EQ(WTERMSIG(status), SIGSYS);
}

TEST_CASE(the_broker_goes_away_with_the_helper)
{
    int pipe_fds[2];
    VERIFY(pipe(pipe_fds) == 0);

    auto child = fork();
    VERIFY(child >= 0);
    if (child == 0) {
        close(pipe_fds[0]);
        leave_only_the_broker_available();
        check(1, !Sandbox::restrict_filesystem().is_error());
        // Our write end stays open in the broker only if it failed to close what it inherited.
        _exit(0);
    }

    close(pipe_fds[1]);
    int status = 0;
    VERIFY(waitpid(child, &status, 0) == child);
    EXPECT(WIFEXITED(status) && WEXITSTATUS(status) == 0);

    char byte;
    EXPECT_EQ(read(pipe_fds[0], &byte, 1), 0);
    close(pipe_fds[0]);
}

#include <AK/ByteString.h>
#include <AK/Function.h>
#include <AK/LexicalPath.h>
#include <AK/ScopeGuard.h>
#include <CoreGraphics/CoreGraphics.h>
#include <LibCore/IOSurface.h>
#include <LibCore/System.h>
#include <LibTest/TestCase.h>
#include <Security/Security.h>
#include <Services/Compositor/Sandbox.h>
#include <Services/RendererSandbox.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <limits.h>
#include <mach/mach.h>
#include <servers/bootstrap.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/wait.h>
#include <unistd.h>

// These tests apply the real sandbox of a helper in a child process, then try an operation that the helper must not
// be able to perform.

enum class Outcome {
    Allowed,
    Denied,
};

static Outcome run_in_helper_sandbox(Function<ErrorOr<void>()> const& apply_sandbox, Function<bool()> const& operation)
{
    // These tests fork without exec, so initialize the native runtime in the parent. Objective-C cannot initialize
    // classes in a child forked from a multithreaded process, such as one that has already queried CoreGraphics.
    Core::IOSurfaceHandle::initialize();

    auto child = fork();
    VERIFY(child >= 0);
    if (child == 0) {
        if (apply_sandbox().is_error())
            _exit(2);
        _exit(operation() ? 0 : 1);
    }

    int status = 0;
    VERIFY(waitpid(child, &status, 0) == child);
    if (WIFSIGNALED(status))
        return Outcome::Denied;
    VERIFY(WIFEXITED(status));
    VERIFY(WEXITSTATUS(status) == 0 || WEXITSTATUS(status) == 1);
    return WEXITSTATUS(status) == 0 ? Outcome::Allowed : Outcome::Denied;
}

static ByteString darwin_user_cache_directory()
{
    char directory[PATH_MAX];
    VERIFY(confstr(_CS_DARWIN_USER_CACHE_DIR, directory, sizeof(directory)) > 0);
    char resolved[PATH_MAX];
    VERIFY(realpath(directory, resolved));
    return resolved;
}

// A directory that stands in for another application's cache.
struct OtherApplicationCache {
    OtherApplicationCache()
    {
        path = ByteString::formatted("{}/org.ladybird.TestHelperSandboxes.{}", darwin_user_cache_directory(), getpid());
        VERIFY(mkdir(path.characters(), 0700) == 0);
        file = ByteString::formatted("{}/secret", path);
        auto fd = open(file.characters(), O_CREAT | O_EXCL | O_WRONLY | O_CLOEXEC, 0600);
        VERIFY(fd >= 0);
        VERIFY(write(fd, "secret", 6) == 6);
        close(fd);
    }

    ~OtherApplicationCache()
    {
        unlink(file.characters());
        rmdir(path.characters());
    }

    ByteString path;
    ByteString file;
};

static bool can_open(ByteString const& path, int flags)
{
    auto fd = open(path.characters(), flags | O_CLOEXEC);
    if (fd < 0)
        return false;
    close(fd);
    return true;
}

static ByteString temporary_cache_path()
{
    char path_template[] = "/tmp/TestHelperSandboxes.XXXXXX";
    VERIFY(mkdtemp(path_template));
    return path_template;
}

TEST_CASE(compositor_cannot_touch_other_applications_caches)
{
    OtherApplicationCache other_application;
    auto cache_path = temporary_cache_path();
    for (auto flags : { O_RDONLY, O_WRONLY })
        EXPECT_EQ(run_in_helper_sandbox([&] { return Compositor::apply_sandbox({}, cache_path, {}); }, [&] { return can_open(other_application.file, flags); }), Outcome::Denied);
}

static bool can_reach_the_window_server()
{
    mach_port_t port = MACH_PORT_NULL;
    return bootstrap_look_up(bootstrap_port, "com.apple.windowserver.active", &port) == KERN_SUCCESS;
}

static bool sees_an_active_display()
{
    u32 active_display_count = 0;
    return CGGetActiveDisplayList(0, nullptr, &active_display_count) == kCGErrorSuccess && active_display_count > 0;
}

TEST_CASE(compositor_sees_the_displays)
{
    // Only a process in a GUI login session with a display can see them at all.
    if (!can_reach_the_window_server() || !sees_an_active_display()) {
        warnln("Skipping: no display is visible from this session");
        return;
    }

    auto cache_path = temporary_cache_path();
    EXPECT_EQ(run_in_helper_sandbox([&] { return Compositor::apply_sandbox({}, cache_path, {}); }, [] { return can_reach_the_window_server(); }), Outcome::Allowed);
    EXPECT_EQ(run_in_helper_sandbox([&] { return Compositor::apply_sandbox({}, cache_path, {}); }, [] { return sees_an_active_display(); }), Outcome::Allowed);
}

TEST_CASE(renderer_cannot_touch_other_applications_caches)
{
    OtherApplicationCache other_application;
    for (auto flags : { O_RDONLY, O_WRONLY })
        EXPECT_EQ(run_in_helper_sandbox([&] { return RendererSandbox::apply_sandbox({}); }, [&] { return can_open(other_application.file, flags); }), Outcome::Denied);
}

TEST_CASE(renderer_cannot_touch_profile_cache)
{
    auto cache_path = temporary_cache_path();
    auto cached_response = ByteString::formatted("{}/response", cache_path);
    auto fd = open(cached_response.characters(), O_CREAT | O_EXCL | O_WRONLY | O_CLOEXEC, 0600);
    VERIFY(fd >= 0);
    VERIFY(write(fd, "secret", 6) == 6);
    VERIFY(close(fd) == 0);
    ScopeGuard cleanup = [&] {
        unlink(cached_response.characters());
        rmdir(cache_path.characters());
    };

    for (auto flags : { O_RDONLY, O_WRONLY })
        EXPECT_EQ(run_in_helper_sandbox([&] { return RendererSandbox::apply_sandbox({}); }, [&] { return can_open(cached_response, flags); }), Outcome::Denied);
}

struct HelperSignature {
    bool uses_hardened_runtime { false };
    bool may_map_jit_memory { false };
};

static Optional<HelperSignature> signature_of_helper(StringView name)
{
    // The helpers live in the application bundle next to the test executables.
    auto test_directory = LexicalPath::dirname(MUST(Core::System::current_executable_path()));
    auto path = ByteString::formatted("{}/Ladybird.app/Contents/MacOS/{}", test_directory, name);
    struct stat metadata {};
    if (stat(path.characters(), &metadata) != 0)
        return {};

    auto url = CFURLCreateFromFileSystemRepresentation(nullptr, reinterpret_cast<u8 const*>(path.characters()), path.length(), false);
    SecStaticCodeRef code = nullptr;
    VERIFY(SecStaticCodeCreateWithPath(url, kSecCSDefaultFlags, &code) == errSecSuccess);
    CFRelease(url);
    CFDictionaryRef information = nullptr;
    VERIFY(SecCodeCopySigningInformation(code, kSecCSSigningInformation, &information) == errSecSuccess);

    HelperSignature signature;
    u32 flags = 0;
    if (auto flags_number = static_cast<CFNumberRef>(CFDictionaryGetValue(information, kSecCodeInfoFlags)))
        CFNumberGetValue(flags_number, kCFNumberSInt32Type, &flags);
    signature.uses_hardened_runtime = (flags & kSecCodeSignatureRuntime) != 0;
    if (auto entitlements = static_cast<CFDictionaryRef>(CFDictionaryGetValue(information, kSecCodeInfoEntitlementsDict)))
        signature.may_map_jit_memory = CFDictionaryGetValue(entitlements, CFSTR("com.apple.security.cs.allow-jit")) == kCFBooleanTrue;

    CFRelease(information);
    CFRelease(code);
    return signature;
}

TEST_CASE(helpers_run_with_the_hardened_runtime)
{
    // With the hardened runtime, the kernel refuses to run code from memory that was writable, unless the process may
    // map JIT memory. Only the renderers run code that they compile at runtime.
    for (auto name : { "AudioServer"sv, "Compositor"sv, "ImageDecoder"sv, "MediaServer"sv, "ProcessReaper"sv, "RequestServer"sv, "WebContent"sv }) {
        auto signature = signature_of_helper(name);
        if (!signature.has_value()) {
            warnln("Skipping {}, which was not built", name);
            continue;
        }
        EXPECT(signature->uses_hardened_runtime);
        EXPECT_EQ(signature->may_map_jit_memory, name == "WebContent"sv);
    }
}

#include <AK/Function.h>
#include <ImageDecoder/Sandbox.h>

// These tests apply the real sandbox of the image decoder in a child process. The decoder parses untrusted images,
// and only ever talks over the channel the Browser handed it, so it must not be able to make sockets or reach files.

static int run_in_image_decoder_sandbox(Function<void()> const& body)
{
    auto child = fork();
    VERIFY(child >= 0);
    if (child == 0) {
        rlimit limit { 0, 0 };
        setrlimit(RLIMIT_CORE, &limit);
        if (ImageDecoder::apply_sandbox({}).is_error())
            _exit(2);
        body();
        _exit(0);
    }

    int status = 0;
    VERIFY(waitpid(child, &status, 0) == child);
    return status;
}

TEST_CASE(image_decoder_cannot_pair_sockets)
{
    auto status = run_in_image_decoder_sandbox([] {
        int fds[2];
        (void)socketpair(AF_UNIX, SOCK_STREAM, 0, fds);
    });

    EXPECT(WIFSIGNALED(status));
    if (WIFSIGNALED(status))
        EXPECT_EQ(WTERMSIG(status), SIGSYS);
}

TEST_CASE(image_decoder_cannot_create_sockets)
{
    auto status = run_in_image_decoder_sandbox([] {
        VERIFY(socket(AF_UNIX, SOCK_STREAM, 0) == -1);
        VERIFY(errno == EAFNOSUPPORT);
    });

    EXPECT(WIFEXITED(status));
    if (WIFEXITED(status))
        EXPECT_EQ(WEXITSTATUS(status), 0);
}

TEST_CASE(image_decoder_cannot_open_files)
{
    auto status = run_in_image_decoder_sandbox([] {
        VERIFY(open("/etc/passwd", O_RDONLY | O_CLOEXEC) == -1);
        VERIFY(errno == EACCES);
    });

    EXPECT(WIFEXITED(status));
    if (WIFEXITED(status))
        EXPECT_EQ(WEXITSTATUS(status), 0);
}

/*

#include <LibSandbox/Sandbox.h>
#include <LibSandbox/Seccomp.h>
#include <LibTest/TestCase.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <linux/audit.h>
#include <linux/filter.h>
#include <linux/landlock.h>
#include <linux/seccomp.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <sys/prctl.h>
#include <sys/socket.h>
#include <sys/syscall.h>
#include <sys/un.h>
#include <sys/wait.h>
#include <unistd.h>

// Makes the kernel answer the Landlock version probe with the given errno (0 makes the probe return an ABI of 0), then
// asks for a sandbox in a child process. Whatever else the kernel can do, a helper must still get one, and it must keep
// the helper from its files at once.
static bool can_restrict_filesystem_when_version_probe_returns(u32 error)
{
    char file_template[] = "/tmp/lb-landlock-XXXXXX";
    auto file_fd = mkstemp(file_template);
    VERIFY(file_fd >= 0);
    close(file_fd);

    auto child = fork();
    VERIFY(child >= 0);
    if (child == 0) {
        sock_filter filter[] = {
            BPF_STMT(BPF_LD | BPF_W | BPF_ABS, offsetof(seccomp_data, nr)),
            BPF_JUMP(BPF_JMP | BPF_JEQ | BPF_K, __NR_landlock_create_ruleset, 0, 1),
            BPF_STMT(BPF_RET | BPF_K, SECCOMP_RET_ERRNO | (error & SECCOMP_RET_DATA)),
            BPF_STMT(BPF_RET | BPF_K, SECCOMP_RET_ALLOW),
        };
        sock_fprog program {
            .len = sizeof(filter) / sizeof(filter[0]),
            .filter = filter,
        };
        if (prctl(PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS, 1, 0, 0, 0) < 0 || prctl(PR_SET_SECCOMP, SECCOMP_MODE_FILTER, &program) < 0)
            _exit(2);

        if (Sandbox::restrict_filesystem().is_error())
            _exit(1);
        auto fd = open(file_template, O_RDONLY | O_CLOEXEC);
        _exit(fd < 0 && errno == EACCES ? 0 : 3);
    }

    int status = 0;
    VERIFY(waitpid(child, &status, 0) == child);
    (void)unlink(file_template);
    VERIFY(WIFEXITED(status));
    VERIFY(WEXITSTATUS(status) == 0 || WEXITSTATUS(status) == 1 || WEXITSTATUS(status) == 3);
    return WEXITSTATUS(status) == 0;
}

TEST_CASE(a_kernel_without_landlock_still_gets_a_sandbox)
{
    EXPECT(can_restrict_filesystem_when_version_probe_returns(ENOSYS));
}

TEST_CASE(a_kernel_with_landlock_disabled_still_gets_a_sandbox)
{
    EXPECT(can_restrict_filesystem_when_version_probe_returns(EOPNOTSUPP));
}

TEST_CASE(a_landlock_abi_of_zero_still_gets_a_sandbox)
{
    EXPECT(can_restrict_filesystem_when_version_probe_returns(0));
}

TEST_CASE(a_container_that_blocks_landlock_still_gets_a_sandbox)
{
    EXPECT(can_restrict_filesystem_when_version_probe_returns(EPERM));
}

TEST_CASE(a_process_with_a_second_thread_refuses_the_sandbox)
{
    auto child = fork();
    VERIFY(child >= 0);
    if (child == 0) {
        int pipe_fds[2];
        if (pipe(pipe_fds) < 0)
            _exit(2);

        // The thread waits on the pipe, so it is still there when we ask for the sandbox.
        pthread_t thread;
        auto wait_for_pipe = [](void* argument) -> void* {
            char byte;
            auto nread = read(*static_cast<int*>(argument), &byte, 1);
            (void)nread;
            return nullptr;
        };
        if (pthread_create(&thread, nullptr, wait_for_pipe, &pipe_fds[0]) != 0)
            _exit(2);

        auto result = Sandbox::restrict_filesystem();
        _exit(result.is_error() ? 0 : 1);
    }

    int status = 0;
    VERIFY(waitpid(child, &status, 0) == child);
    VERIFY(WIFEXITED(status));
    EXPECT_EQ(WEXITSTATUS(status), 0);
}

#ifdef LANDLOCK_SCOPE_ABSTRACT_UNIX_SOCKET
TEST_CASE(abstract_unix_sockets_outside_the_landlock_domain_are_unreachable)
{
    auto abi = syscall(__NR_landlock_create_ruleset, nullptr, 0, LANDLOCK_CREATE_RULESET_VERSION);
    if (abi < 6) {
        warnln("Skipping abstract UNIX socket scoping test: Landlock ABI 6 is required");
        return;
    }

    auto receiver = socket(AF_UNIX, SOCK_DGRAM | SOCK_NONBLOCK, 0);
    VERIFY(receiver >= 0);
    // Autobind chooses a unique abstract address without needing a file on disk.
    sockaddr_un address {};
    address.sun_family = AF_UNIX;
    VERIFY(bind(receiver, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&address), sizeof(sa_family_t)) == 0);
    socklen_t address_length = sizeof(address);
    VERIFY(getsockname(receiver, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&address), &address_length) == 0);

    auto sender = socket(AF_UNIX, SOCK_DGRAM, 0);
    VERIFY(sender >= 0);
    VERIFY(sendto(sender, "k", 1, 0, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&address), address_length) == 1);
    char byte = 0;
    VERIFY(recv(receiver, &byte, 1, 0) == 1);
    VERIFY(byte == 'k');

    int handed_over[2];
    VERIFY(socketpair(AF_UNIX, SOCK_STREAM, 0, handed_over) == 0);

    auto child = fork();
    VERIFY(child >= 0);
    if (child == 0) {
        MUST(Sandbox::install_no_new_privileges());
        MUST(Sandbox::restrict_filesystem());

        // No seccomp policy is installed: these refusals must come from Landlock.
        VERIFY(connect(sender, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&address), address_length) == -1);
        VERIFY(errno == EPERM);
        VERIFY(sendto(sender, "k", 1, 0, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&address), address_length) == -1);
        VERIFY(errno == EPERM);

        char payload = 'k';
        iovec io { .iov_base = &payload, .iov_len = 1 };
        msghdr message {};
        message.msg_name = &address;
        message.msg_namelen = address_length;
        message.msg_iov = &io;
        message.msg_iovlen = 1;
        VERIFY(sendmsg(sender, &message, 0) == -1);
        VERIFY(errno == EPERM);

        // Existing IPC channels remain usable after entering the Landlock domain.
        VERIFY(send(handed_over[0], &payload, 1, 0) == 1);
        VERIFY(recv(handed_over[1], &payload, 1, 0) == 1);
        VERIFY(payload == 'k');
        _exit(0);
    }

    int status = 0;
    VERIFY(waitpid(child, &status, 0) == child);
    EXPECT(WIFEXITED(status));
    if (WIFEXITED(status))
        EXPECT_EQ(WEXITSTATUS(status), 0);
    EXPECT_EQ(recv(receiver, &byte, 1, 0), -1);
    EXPECT_EQ(errno, EAGAIN);
    VERIFY(close(handed_over[0]) == 0);
    VERIFY(close(handed_over[1]) == 0);
    VERIFY(close(sender) == 0);
    VERIFY(close(receiver) == 0);
}
#endif

#ifdef LANDLOCK_SCOPE_SIGNAL
TEST_CASE(signals_stay_within_the_landlock_process_tree)
{
    auto abi = syscall(__NR_landlock_create_ruleset, nullptr, 0, LANDLOCK_CREATE_RULESET_VERSION);
    if (abi < 6) {
        warnln("Skipping signal scoping test: Landlock ABI 6 is required");
        return;
    }

    auto parent = getpid();
    auto child = fork();
    VERIFY(child >= 0);
    if (child == 0) {
        MUST(Sandbox::install_no_new_privileges());
        MUST(Sandbox::restrict_filesystem());
        VERIFY(Sandbox::signals_stay_within_the_process_tree());
        Sandbox::SeccompPolicy policy;
        policy.allow_common_runtime();
        policy.allow_process_creation();
        policy.allow_file_descriptor_operations();
        MUST(policy.install());

        VERIFY(syscall(__NR_tgkill, parent, parent, 0) == -1);
        VERIFY(errno == EPERM);
        auto grandchild = fork();
        VERIFY(grandchild >= 0);
        if (grandchild == 0) {
            VERIFY(syscall(__NR_tgkill, getpid(), syscall(__NR_gettid), 0) == 0);
            VERIFY(syscall(__NR_tgkill, parent, parent, 0) == -1);
            VERIFY(errno == EPERM);
            _exit(0);
        }
        int status = 0;
        VERIFY(waitpid(grandchild, &status, 0) == grandchild);
        VERIFY(WIFEXITED(status) && WEXITSTATUS(status) == 0);
        _exit(0);
    }
    int status = 0;
    VERIFY(waitpid(child, &status, 0) == child);
    EXPECT(WIFEXITED(status));
    if (WIFEXITED(status))
        EXPECT_EQ(WEXITSTATUS(status), 0);
}
#endif

TEST_CASE(gpu_driver_paths_leave_out_shader_caches_that_cannot_be_used)
{
    char directory_template[] = "/tmp/lb-shader-cache-XXXXXX";
    VERIFY(mkdtemp(directory_template));
    auto directory = ByteString { directory_template };
    auto regular_file = ByteString::formatted("{}/file", directory);
    auto mesa_cache = ByteString::formatted("{}/mesa", directory);
    auto nvidia_cache = ByteString::formatted("{}/nvidia", directory);

    auto fd = open(regular_file.characters(), O_CREAT | O_WRONLY | O_CLOEXEC, 0600);
    VERIFY(fd >= 0);
    VERIFY(close(fd) == 0);
    VERIFY(setenv("__GL_SHADER_DISK_CACHE_PATH", nvidia_cache.characters(), 1) == 0);

    auto rules_for_mesa_cache = [](char const* mesa_cache_path) {
        VERIFY(setenv("MESA_SHADER_CACHE_DIR", mesa_cache_path, 1) == 0);
        Vector<Sandbox::PathRule> rules;
        EXPECT(!Sandbox::add_gpu_driver_paths(rules).is_error());
        return rules;
    };
    auto has_rule_for = [](Vector<Sandbox::PathRule> const& rules, StringView path) {
        return any_of(rules, [&](auto const& rule) { return rule.path == path; });
    };

    auto rules = rules_for_mesa_cache(regular_file.characters());
    EXPECT(!has_rule_for(rules, regular_file));

    rules = rules_for_mesa_cache("../cache");
    EXPECT(!has_rule_for(rules, "../cache"sv));

    rules = rules_for_mesa_cache(mesa_cache.characters());
    EXPECT(any_of(rules, [&](auto const& rule) {
        return rule.path == mesa_cache && rule.access == Sandbox::PathRule::Access::ReadWrite;
    }));

    VERIFY(unsetenv("MESA_SHADER_CACHE_DIR") == 0);
    VERIFY(unsetenv("__GL_SHADER_DISK_CACHE_PATH") == 0);
    (void)unlink(regular_file.characters());
    (void)rmdir(mesa_cache.characters());
    (void)rmdir(nvidia_cache.characters());
    (void)rmdir(directory.characters());
}

enum class Outcome {
    Allowed,
    Denied,
};

// Runs the operation in a child process after applying the profile. The operation returns whether it succeeded. A
// child that dies from a signal counts as denied: the syscall filter kills with SIGKILL, and some system frameworks
// crash when the sandbox refuses them.
static Outcome run_sandboxed(Sandbox::SeatbeltProfile const& profile, Function<bool()> const& operation)
{
    auto child = fork();
    VERIFY(child >= 0);
    if (child == 0) {
        if (Sandbox::apply_macos_sandbox(profile).is_error())
            _exit(2);
        _exit(operation() ? 0 : 1);
    }

    int status = 0;
    VERIFY(waitpid(child, &status, 0) == child);
    if (WIFSIGNALED(status))
        return Outcome::Denied;
    VERIFY(WIFEXITED(status));
    VERIFY(WEXITSTATUS(status) == 0 || WEXITSTATUS(status) == 1);
    return WEXITSTATUS(status) == 0 ? Outcome::Allowed : Outcome::Denied;
}

static Outcome run_sandboxed(Function<bool()> const& operation)
{
    return run_sandboxed({}, operation);
}

// A scratch directory with one directory that the tests grant to the sandbox and one that they do not.
struct Fixture {
    Fixture()
    {
        char path_template[] = "/tmp/TestSeatbelt.XXXXXX";
        VERIFY(mkdtemp(path_template));
        char resolved[PATH_MAX];
        VERIFY(realpath(path_template, resolved));
        root = resolved;
        granted = ByteString::formatted("{}/granted", root);
        outside = ByteString::formatted("{}/outside", root);
        VERIFY(mkdir(granted.characters(), 0700) == 0);
        VERIFY(mkdir(outside.characters(), 0700) == 0);
        granted_file = create_file(granted, "file", "granted"sv);
        outside_file = create_file(outside, "file", "outside"sv);
    }

    ~Fixture()
    {
        auto command = ByteString::formatted("rm -rf '{}'", root);
        (void)system(command.characters());
    }

    static ByteString create_file(ByteString const& directory, char const* name, StringView contents)
    {
        auto path = ByteString::formatted("{}/{}", directory, name);
        auto fd = open(path.characters(), O_CREAT | O_EXCL | O_WRONLY | O_CLOEXEC, 0600);
        VERIFY(fd >= 0);
        VERIFY(write(fd, contents.characters_without_null_termination(), contents.length()) == static_cast<ssize_t>(contents.length()));
        VERIFY(close(fd) == 0);
        return path;
    }

    Vector<Sandbox::SeatbeltPath> granted_paths(Sandbox::SeatbeltPath::Access access = Sandbox::SeatbeltPath::Access::ReadOnly) const
    {
        Vector<Sandbox::SeatbeltPath> paths;
        MUST(Sandbox::add_seatbelt_path_if_exists(paths, granted, access));
        return paths;
    }

    ByteString root;
    ByteString granted;
    ByteString outside;
    ByteString granted_file;
    ByteString outside_file;
};

static bool can_open_for_reading(ByteString const& path)
{
    auto fd = open(path.characters(), O_RDONLY | O_CLOEXEC);
    if (fd < 0)
        return false;
    close(fd);
    return true;
}

TEST_CASE(sandboxed_process_can_do_ordinary_work)
{
    EXPECT_EQ(run_sandboxed([] {
        pthread_t thread;
        if (pthread_create(&thread, nullptr, [](void*) -> void* { return nullptr; }, nullptr) != 0)
            return false;
        pthread_join(thread, nullptr);

        auto* memory = static_cast<u8*>(malloc(16 * MiB));
        if (!memory)
            return false;
        memset(memory, 1, 16 * MiB);
        free(memory);

        int sockets[2];
        if (socketpair(AF_UNIX, SOCK_STREAM, 0, sockets) != 0)
            return false;
        return write(sockets[0], "x", 1) == 1;
    }),
        Outcome::Allowed);
}

TEST_CASE(sandboxed_process_can_create_nonblocking_pipes)
{
    EXPECT_EQ(run_sandboxed([] {
        auto result = Core::System::pipe2(O_CLOEXEC | O_NONBLOCK);
        if (result.is_error())
            return false;
        auto fds = result.release_value();
        for (auto fd : fds) {
            if ((fcntl(fd, F_GETFD) & FD_CLOEXEC) == 0 || (fcntl(fd, F_GETFL) & O_NONBLOCK) == 0)
                return false;
        }
        char byte = 0;
        bool success = write(fds[1], "x", 1) == 1 && read(fds[0], &byte, 1) == 1 && byte == 'x';
        close(fds[0]);
        close(fds[1]);
        return success;
    }),
        Outcome::Allowed);
}

#    if defined(SYS_pipe2)
TEST_CASE(sandboxed_process_can_use_native_pipe2)
{
    if (__builtin_available(macOS 27.0, *)) {
        Function<bool()> create_pipe = [] {
            int fds[2];
            if (pipe2(fds, O_CLOEXEC | O_NONBLOCK) != 0)
                return false;
            for (auto fd : fds) {
                if ((fcntl(fd, F_GETFD) & FD_CLOEXEC) == 0 || (fcntl(fd, F_GETFL) & O_NONBLOCK) == 0)
                    return false;
            }
            char byte = 0;
            bool success = write(fds[1], "x", 1) == 1 && read(fds[0], &byte, 1) == 1 && byte == 'x';
            close(fds[0]);
            close(fds[1]);
            return success;
        };
        EXPECT_EQ(run_sandboxed(create_pipe), Outcome::Allowed);
        EXPECT_EQ(run_sandboxed({ .network_access = Sandbox::NetworkAccess::Allowed }, create_pipe), Outcome::Allowed);
    }
}
#    endif

// The helpers raise their main thread's QoS before the sandbox is applied, but every thread they create afterwards,
// including the IPC IO threads, gets its QoS class through pthread_create() attributes. Both calls run on a new
// thread here: the main thread of a fork()ed child refuses QoS changes with EPERM even without a sandbox.
TEST_CASE(sandboxed_process_can_set_thread_qos)
{
    EXPECT_EQ(run_sandboxed([] {
        pthread_t thread;
        auto create_result = pthread_create(&thread, nullptr, [](void*) -> void* {
            if (pthread_set_qos_class_self_np(QOS_CLASS_USER_INTERACTIVE, -1) != 0)
                return reinterpret_cast<void*>(static_cast<uintptr_t>(QOS_CLASS_UNSPECIFIED));
            return reinterpret_cast<void*>(static_cast<uintptr_t>(qos_class_self())); }, nullptr);
        if (create_result != 0)
            return false;
        void* thread_qos_class = nullptr;
        pthread_join(thread, &thread_qos_class);
        return reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(thread_qos_class) == QOS_CLASS_USER_INTERACTIVE;
    }),
        Outcome::Allowed);

    EXPECT_EQ(run_sandboxed([] {
        pthread_attr_t attributes;
        if (pthread_attr_init(&attributes) != 0)
            return false;
        if (pthread_attr_set_qos_class_np(&attributes, QOS_CLASS_USER_INITIATED, 0) != 0)
            return false;
        pthread_t thread;
        auto create_result = pthread_create(&thread, &attributes, [](void*) -> void* { return reinterpret_cast<void*>(static_cast<uintptr_t>(qos_class_self())); }, nullptr);
        pthread_attr_destroy(&attributes);
        if (create_result != 0)
            return false;
        void* thread_qos_class = nullptr;
        pthread_join(thread, &thread_qos_class);
        return reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(thread_qos_class) == QOS_CLASS_USER_INITIATED;
    }),
        Outcome::Allowed);
}

static int scheduling_priority_of_current_thread()
{
    thread_extended_info_data_t info {};
    mach_msg_type_number_t count = THREAD_EXTENDED_INFO_COUNT;
    auto thread = mach_thread_self();
    auto result = thread_info(thread, THREAD_EXTENDED_INFO, reinterpret_cast<thread_info_t>(&info), &count);
    mach_port_deallocate(mach_task_self(), thread);
    if (result != KERN_SUCCESS)
        return -1;
    return info.pth_priority;
}

// Adopts the role and reports the priority a user-interactive thread then gets, or 0 when a step fails.
static int priority_of_a_user_interactive_thread_after_adopting_the_foreground_application_task_role()
{
    if (Core::Platform::adopt_foreground_application_task_role().is_error())
        return 0;

    task_category_policy_data_t category_policy {};
    mach_msg_type_number_t count = TASK_CATEGORY_POLICY_COUNT;
    boolean_t get_default = FALSE;
    if (task_policy_get(mach_task_self(), TASK_CATEGORY_POLICY, reinterpret_cast<task_policy_t>(&category_policy), &count, &get_default) != KERN_SUCCESS)
        return 0;
    if (category_policy.role != TASK_FOREGROUND_APPLICATION)
        return 0;

    pthread_attr_t attributes;
    if (pthread_attr_init(&attributes) != 0)
        return 0;
    if (pthread_attr_set_qos_class_np(&attributes, QOS_CLASS_USER_INTERACTIVE, 0) != 0)
        return 0;
    pthread_t thread;
    auto create_result = pthread_create(&thread, &attributes, [](void*) -> void* { return reinterpret_cast<void*>(static_cast<intptr_t>(scheduling_priority_of_current_thread())); }, nullptr);
    pthread_attr_destroy(&attributes);
    if (create_result != 0)
        return 0;
    void* thread_priority = nullptr;
    pthread_join(thread, &thread_priority);
    auto priority = reinterpret_cast<intptr_t>(thread_priority);
    return priority > 0 ? static_cast<int>(priority) : 0;
}

// Runs the operation in a child process without a sandbox and returns what it reported.
static int run_in_child_process(Function<int()> const& operation)
{
    auto child = fork();
    VERIFY(child >= 0);
    if (child == 0)
        _exit(operation());

    int status = 0;
    VERIFY(waitpid(child, &status, 0) == child);
    VERIFY(WIFEXITED(status));
    return WEXITSTATUS(status);
}

// Without an application role the kernel squashes user-interactive threads down to the default class. The helpers
// adopt the role before the sandbox, but the policy calls are plain Mach messages that the profile leaves open. What
// the role unlocks depends on how the test process itself was launched: a task launched as an application reaches
// priority 47, one launched as a daemon is capped at user-initiated, and a launchd job of the background kind is
// capped at 20 whatever its role. So the sandboxed child is only held to what the same steps reach without a sandbox.
TEST_CASE(sandboxed_process_can_adopt_the_foreground_application_task_role)
{
    auto priority_without_sandbox = run_in_child_process([] {
        return priority_of_a_user_interactive_thread_after_adopting_the_foreground_application_task_role();
    });
    EXPECT(priority_without_sandbox > 0);

    EXPECT_EQ(run_sandboxed([&] {
        return priority_of_a_user_interactive_thread_after_adopting_the_foreground_application_task_role() == priority_without_sandbox;
    }),
        Outcome::Allowed);
}

// Registers a bootstrap service in the test process, standing in for the Browser endpoint or for an unrelated service.
static ByteString register_bootstrap_service(StringView purpose)
{
    auto name = ByteString::formatted("org.ladybird.TestSeatbelt.{}.{}", purpose, getpid());
    auto port = MUST(Core::MachPort::create_with_right(Core::MachPort::PortRight::Receive));
    auto send_right = MUST(port.insert_right(Core::MachPort::MessageRight::MakeSend));
    MUST(send_right.register_with_bootstrap_server(name));
    (void)port.release();
    (void)send_right.release();
    return name;
}

static bool can_look_up_bootstrap_service(ByteString const& name)
{
    mach_port_t port = MACH_PORT_NULL;
    return bootstrap_look_up(bootstrap_port, name.characters(), &port) == KERN_SUCCESS;
}

TEST_CASE(sandboxed_process_looks_up_only_its_own_mach_server)
{
    static auto browser_endpoint = register_bootstrap_service("browser"sv);
    static auto unrelated_service = register_bootstrap_service("unrelated"sv);

    EXPECT_EQ(run_sandboxed({ .mach_server_name = browser_endpoint }, [&] { return can_look_up_bootstrap_service(browser_endpoint); }), Outcome::Allowed);
    EXPECT_EQ(run_sandboxed({ .mach_server_name = browser_endpoint }, [&] { return can_look_up_bootstrap_service(unrelated_service); }), Outcome::Denied);
    EXPECT_EQ(run_sandboxed({ .mach_server_name = browser_endpoint }, [&] { return can_look_up_bootstrap_service("com.apple.pasteboard.1"); }), Outcome::Denied);
}

TEST_CASE(sandboxed_process_reaches_the_window_server_only_when_granted)
{
    // Only a process in a GUI login session sees the window server at all.
    if (!can_look_up_bootstrap_service("com.apple.windowserver.active")) {
        warnln("Skipping: the window server is not reachable from this session");
        return;
    }

    EXPECT_EQ(run_sandboxed({}, [] { return can_look_up_bootstrap_service("com.apple.windowserver.active"); }), Outcome::Denied);
    EXPECT_EQ(run_sandboxed({ .system_services = Sandbox::SystemService::Display }, [] { return can_look_up_bootstrap_service("com.apple.windowserver.active"); }), Outcome::Allowed);
}

static bool can_read_sysctl(StringView name)
{
    char value[4096];
    size_t size = sizeof(value);
    return sysctlbyname(ByteString(name).characters(), value, &size, nullptr, 0) == 0;
}

TEST_CASE(sandboxed_process_reads_only_allowed_sysctls)
{
    EXPECT_EQ(run_sandboxed([] { return can_read_sysctl("hw.ncpu"sv) && can_read_sysctl("hw.optional.arm64"sv); }), Outcome::Allowed);

    // Another process's arguments and environment.
    auto parent = getpid();
    EXPECT_EQ(run_sandboxed([&] {
        int mib[] = { CTL_KERN, KERN_PROCARGS2, parent };
        char arguments[4096];
        size_t size = sizeof(arguments);
        return sysctl(mib, 3, arguments, &size, nullptr, 0) == 0;
    }),
        Outcome::Denied);

    // The system-wide TCP connection table.
    EXPECT_EQ(run_sandboxed([] {
        size_t size = 0;
        return sysctlbyname("net.inet.tcp.pcblist64", nullptr, &size, nullptr, 0) == 0;
    }),
        Outcome::Denied);
}

// NECP descriptors answer questions about network interfaces, such as their private addresses.

#    pragma clang diagnostic push

#    pragma clang diagnostic pop
}

TEST_CASE(sandboxed_process_cannot_open_existing_shared_memory)
{
    // One object with an arbitrary name, and one that matches the names used by Core::System::anon_create().
    auto unrelated_name = ByteString::formatted("/TestSeatbelt-{}", getpid());
    auto anonymous_name = ByteString::formatted("/shm-{:016x}-{:08x}", static_cast<u64>(getpid()), 0u);
    for (auto const& name : { unrelated_name, anonymous_name }) {
        auto fd = shm_open(name.characters(), O_RDWR | O_CREAT | O_EXCL, 0600);
        VERIFY(fd >= 0);
        VERIFY(ftruncate(fd, 4096) == 0);
        close(fd);
    }

    for (auto const& name : { unrelated_name, anonymous_name }) {
        EXPECT_EQ(run_sandboxed([&] { return shm_open(name.characters(), O_RDWR) >= 0; }), Outcome::Denied);
        EXPECT_EQ(run_sandboxed([&] { return shm_open(name.characters(), O_RDWR | O_CREAT, 0600) >= 0; }), Outcome::Denied);
        shm_unlink(name.characters());
    }
}

TEST_CASE(sandboxed_process_cannot_change_shared_file_state_through_fcntl)
{
    Fixture fixture;
    auto paths = fixture.granted_paths();
    auto run_fcntl = [&](int command, auto argument) {
        return run_sandboxed({ .paths = paths }, [&] {
            auto fd = open(fixture.granted_file.characters(), O_RDONLY | O_CLOEXEC);
            if (fd < 0)
                return false;
            return fcntl(fd, command, argument) != -1;
        });
    };

    EXPECT_EQ(run_fcntl(F_GETFL, 0), Outcome::Allowed);
    EXPECT_EQ(run_fcntl(F_SETFD, FD_CLOEXEC), Outcome::Allowed);

    // Changes caching for every descriptor of the file.
    EXPECT_EQ(run_fcntl(F_GLOBAL_NOCACHE, 1), Outcome::Denied);
    // Changes the file's data protection class.
    EXPECT_EQ(run_fcntl(F_SETPROTECTIONCLASS, 3), Outcome::Denied);
    // Reveals the path of a descriptor that was handed over without one.
    char path[PATH_MAX];
    EXPECT_EQ(run_fcntl(F_GETPATH, path), Outcome::Denied);

    // The GPU service and AudioToolbox's decoders need F_GETPATH, and the helpers that hold those services never
    // receive files from the Browser. The renderer that plays WebAudio does, so the Audio service alone grants nothing.
    auto run_getpath_with = [&](Sandbox::SystemService services) {
        return run_sandboxed({ .paths = paths, .system_services = services }, [&] {
            auto fd = open(fixture.granted_file.characters(), O_RDONLY | O_CLOEXEC);
            char path[PATH_MAX];
            return fd >= 0 && fcntl(fd, F_GETPATH, path) != -1;
        });
    };
    EXPECT_EQ(run_getpath_with(Sandbox::SystemService::GPU), Outcome::Allowed);
    EXPECT_EQ(run_getpath_with(Sandbox::SystemService::Audio | Sandbox::SystemService::AudioDecoding), Outcome::Allowed);
    EXPECT_EQ(run_getpath_with(Sandbox::SystemService::Audio), Outcome::Denied);
}

TEST_CASE(sandboxed_process_cannot_preallocate_disk_space_through_inherited_files)
{
    Fixture fixture;
    auto fd = open(fixture.outside_file.characters(), O_RDWR | O_CLOEXEC);
    VERIFY(fd >= 0);

    EXPECT_EQ(run_sandboxed([&] {
        fstore_t store { .fst_flags = F_ALLOCATEALL | F_ALLOCATEPERSIST, .fst_posmode = F_PEOFPOSMODE, .fst_offset = 0, .fst_length = 1 * MiB, .fst_bytesalloc = 0 };
        return fcntl(fd, F_PREALLOCATE, &store) != -1;
    }),
        Outcome::Denied);
    close(fd);
}

#    ifndef F_TRANSFEREXTENTS
#        define F_TRANSFEREXTENTS 110
#    endif

TEST_CASE(sandboxed_process_cannot_move_disk_reservations_out_of_readonly_files)
{
    Fixture fixture;
    auto source = open(fixture.granted_file.characters(), O_RDWR | O_CLOEXEC);
    VERIFY(source >= 0);
    fstore_t store { .fst_flags = F_ALLOCATEALL, .fst_posmode = F_PEOFPOSMODE, .fst_offset = 0, .fst_length = 1 * MiB, .fst_bytesalloc = 0 };
    VERIFY(fcntl(source, F_PREALLOCATE, &store) == 0);
    close(source);
    auto target_path = Fixture::create_file(fixture.outside, "target", ""sv);

    Vector<Sandbox::SeatbeltPath> paths;
    MUST(Sandbox::add_seatbelt_path_if_exists(paths, fixture.granted, Sandbox::SeatbeltPath::Access::ReadOnly));
    MUST(Sandbox::add_seatbelt_path_if_exists(paths, fixture.outside, Sandbox::SeatbeltPath::Access::ReadWrite));
    EXPECT_EQ(run_sandboxed({ .paths = paths }, [&] {
        auto source = open(fixture.granted_file.characters(), O_RDONLY | O_CLOEXEC);
        auto target = open(target_path.characters(), O_RDWR | O_CLOEXEC);
        if (source < 0 || target < 0)
            return false;
        return fcntl(source, F_TRANSFEREXTENTS, target) != -1;
    }),
        Outcome::Denied);
}

TEST_CASE(sandboxed_process_cannot_redirect_sigio_to_another_process)
{
    auto parent = getpid();
    EXPECT_EQ(run_sandboxed([&] {
        int sockets[2];
        if (socketpair(AF_UNIX, SOCK_STREAM, 0, sockets) != 0)
            return false;
        return fcntl(sockets[0], F_SETOWN, parent) != -1;
    }),
        Outcome::Denied);
}

// Finds the embedded code signature of the running executable, so a test can try to attach it to the file's vnode.
static Optional<fsignatures_t> code_signature_of_executable()
{
    auto const* header = reinterpret_cast<mach_header_64 const*>(_dyld_get_image_header(0));
    auto const* command = reinterpret_cast<load_command const*>(header + 1);
    for (u32 i = 0; i < header->ncmds; ++i) {
        if (command->cmd == LC_CODE_SIGNATURE) {
            auto const* signature = reinterpret_cast<linkedit_data_command const*>(command);
            fsignatures_t request {};
            request.fs_file_start = 0;
            request.fs_blob_start = reinterpret_cast<void*>(static_cast<uintptr_t>(signature->dataoff));
            request.fs_blob_size = signature->datasize;
            return request;
        }
        command = reinterpret_cast<load_command const*>(reinterpret_cast<u8 const*>(command) + command->cmdsize);
    }
    return {};
}

TEST_CASE(sandboxed_process_cannot_attach_code_signatures_to_readonly_files)
{
    auto executable = MUST(Core::System::current_executable_path());
    auto signature = code_signature_of_executable();
    VERIFY(signature.has_value());

    Vector<Sandbox::SeatbeltPath> paths;
    MUST(Sandbox::add_seatbelt_path_if_exists(paths, executable, Sandbox::SeatbeltPath::Access::ReadOnly));
    EXPECT_EQ(run_sandboxed({ .paths = paths }, [&] {
        auto fd = open(executable.characters(), O_RDONLY | O_CLOEXEC);
        if (fd < 0)
            return false;
        auto request = *signature;
        return fcntl(fd, F_ADDFILESIGS, &request) != -1;
    }),
        Outcome::Denied);
}

// fcntl() forwards unknown commands to the descriptor's ioctl handler, which the libc wrapper would not pass through.
static int raw_fcntl(int fd, unsigned long command)
{
#    pragma clang diagnostic push
#    pragma clang diagnostic ignored "-Wdeprecated-declarations"
    return syscall(SYS_fcntl, fd, static_cast<int>(command), 0);
#    pragma clang diagnostic pop
}

TEST_CASE(sandboxed_process_cannot_control_a_terminal_through_fcntl)
{
    auto controller = posix_openpt(O_RDWR | O_NOCTTY);
    VERIFY(controller >= 0);
    VERIFY(grantpt(controller) == 0 && unlockpt(controller) == 0);
    auto terminal = open(ptsname(controller), O_RDWR | O_NOCTTY);
    VERIFY(terminal >= 0);

    EXPECT_EQ(run_sandboxed([&] { return raw_fcntl(terminal, TIOCSTOP) != -1; }), Outcome::Denied);

    close(terminal);
    close(controller);
}

TEST_CASE(sandboxed_process_locks_only_writable_files)
{
    Fixture fixture;
    auto locks = [&](Sandbox::SeatbeltPath::Access access, bool use_flock) {
        auto paths = fixture.granted_paths(access);
        return run_sandboxed({ .paths = paths }, [&] {
            auto fd = open(fixture.granted_file.characters(), O_RDONLY | O_CLOEXEC);
            if (fd < 0)
                return false;
            if (use_flock)
                return flock(fd, LOCK_EX | LOCK_NB) == 0;
            struct flock lock {};
            lock.l_type = F_RDLCK;
            lock.l_whence = SEEK_SET;
            return fcntl(fd, F_SETLK, &lock) == 0;
        });
    };

    EXPECT_EQ(locks(Sandbox::SeatbeltPath::Access::ReadWrite, true), Outcome::Allowed);
    EXPECT_EQ(locks(Sandbox::SeatbeltPath::Access::ReadWrite, false), Outcome::Allowed);
    EXPECT_EQ(locks(Sandbox::SeatbeltPath::Access::ReadOnly, true), Outcome::Denied);
    EXPECT_EQ(locks(Sandbox::SeatbeltPath::Access::ReadOnly, false), Outcome::Denied);
}

TEST_CASE(sandboxed_process_resolves_granted_paths)
{
    Fixture fixture;
    auto paths = fixture.granted_paths();
    EXPECT_EQ(run_sandboxed({ .paths = paths }, [&] {
        char resolved[PATH_MAX];
        struct stat metadata {};
        return realpath(fixture.granted_file.characters(), resolved) && stat(fixture.granted_file.characters(), &metadata) == 0;
    }),
        Outcome::Allowed);

    // The fixture lives in /private/tmp, which is also reachable as /tmp.
    VERIFY(fixture.granted_file.starts_with("/private/tmp/"sv));
    auto short_path = fixture.granted_file.substring("/private"sv.length());
    EXPECT_EQ(run_sandboxed({ .paths = paths }, [&] { return access(short_path.characters(), F_OK) == 0 && can_open_for_reading(short_path); }), Outcome::Allowed);
}

TEST_CASE(sandboxed_process_cannot_read_metadata_outside_granted_paths)
{
    Fixture fixture;
    auto paths = fixture.granted_paths();
    auto link_path = ByteString::formatted("{}/link", fixture.outside);
    VERIFY(symlink("/secret/link/target", link_path.characters()) == 0);

    EXPECT_EQ(run_sandboxed({ .paths = paths }, [&] {
        struct stat metadata {};
        return stat(fixture.outside_file.characters(), &metadata) == 0;
    }),
        Outcome::Denied);

    // The target of a symbolic link.
    EXPECT_EQ(run_sandboxed({ .paths = paths }, [&] {
        char target[PATH_MAX];
        return readlink(link_path.characters(), target, sizeof(target)) >= 0;
    }),
        Outcome::Denied);

    // Finder information, an extended attribute that getattrlist() reports as metadata.
    EXPECT_EQ(run_sandboxed({ .paths = paths }, [&] {
        attrlist attributes {};
        attributes.bitmapcount = ATTR_BIT_MAP_COUNT;
        attributes.commonattr = ATTR_CMN_FNDRINFO;
        u8 buffer[64];
        return getattrlist(fixture.outside_file.characters(), &attributes, buffer, sizeof(buffer), 0) == 0;
    }),
        Outcome::Denied);
}

TEST_CASE(sandboxed_process_cannot_watch_directories_outside_granted_paths)
{
    Fixture fixture;
    auto paths = fixture.granted_paths();

    EXPECT_EQ(run_sandboxed({ .paths = paths }, [&] {
        auto directory = open(fixture.outside.characters(), O_SEARCH | O_CLOEXEC);
        if (directory < 0)
            return false;
        auto queue = kqueue();
        struct kevent change {};
        EV_SET(&change, directory, EVFILT_VNODE, EV_ADD | EV_CLEAR, NOTE_WRITE, 0, nullptr);
        return kevent(queue, &change, 1, nullptr, 0, nullptr) == 0;
    }),
        Outcome::Denied);

    EXPECT_EQ(run_sandboxed({ .paths = paths }, [&] {
        auto directory = CFStringCreateWithCString(nullptr, fixture.outside.characters(), kCFStringEncodingUTF8);
        auto directories = CFArrayCreate(nullptr, reinterpret_cast<void const**>(&directory), 1, &kCFTypeArrayCallBacks);
        FSEventStreamContext context {};
        auto stream = FSEventStreamCreate(nullptr, [](ConstFSEventStreamRef, void*, size_t, void*, FSEventStreamEventFlags const*, FSEventStreamEventId const*) { }, &context, directories, kFSEventStreamEventIdSinceNow, 0.01, kFSEventStreamCreateFlagFileEvents);
        if (!stream)
            return false;
        FSEventStreamSetDispatchQueue(stream, dispatch_get_main_queue());
        return FSEventStreamStart(stream) != false;
    }),
        Outcome::Denied);
}

TEST_CASE(sandboxed_process_cannot_map_execute_only_files_outside_granted_paths)
{
    Fixture fixture;
    auto paths = fixture.granted_paths();
    VERIFY(chmod(fixture.outside_file.characters(), 0100) == 0);

    EXPECT_EQ(run_sandboxed({ .paths = paths }, [&] {
        auto fd = open(fixture.outside_file.characters(), O_EXEC | O_CLOEXEC);
        if (fd < 0)
            return false;
        auto* mapping = mmap(nullptr, 4096, PROT_NONE, MAP_PRIVATE, fd, 0);
        if (mapping == MAP_FAILED)
            return false;
        return mprotect(mapping, 4096, PROT_READ) == 0;
    }),
        Outcome::Denied);
}
